reviews.author: Laura T
reviews.title: Excellent place to relax
reviews.text: I recently stayed here with my sister to celebrate my 50th birthday.  The resort is gated which made us feel safer and the grounds are beautiful and maintained daily.  We had an Oceanfront room in the reserve adult only section,  it was worth the extra money.  I loved waking up to the water view every morning.  We had our own concierge,  Harry,  who was amazing! The food was good, nothing exceptional but good. We were not impressed with the restaurant that was only for the guests staying at the reserve, we both agreed that the other restaurants were better.  The resort is large and we never felt like it was overcrowded. The pools are beautiful and they maintain the beach. It's more of a quieter resort,  so if you are looking for something that has a lot of activities,  this is not the place for you. They do have a few daily activities but not much. Everyone we encountered that worked at the resort was so nice and helpful.  Fernando,  who i believe ia the activities director,  was very fun and personable.  I highly recommend this resort if you are looking for a place to unwind.

reviews.author: Maria Pilar
reviews.title: Voyage avec un couple d'amis
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une magnifique semaine au Paradisus Palma, dans la section réservée aux adultes, The Reserve. Un grand merci à Brandy, à la réception, pour son accueil.
Notre adorable concierge Eriol, qui parle très bien français, nous a permis de profiter de soupers dans tous les restaurants à la carte. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié le Flora, avec un grand merci à Ana Iris, Kelvin et Yolandi ; le Mina, merci à Antonio et Yoleidi ; et enfin le Mascalzone, merci à Daniela et Jesús.
Les chambres sont belles, spacieuses et impeccablement propres. Le buffet est excellent et très varié — merci à Rossana et Maria pour leur service exceptionnel.
La plage est magnifique, longue et idéale pour ceux qui aiment marcher. Merci également à Pedro et Raul pour leur gentillesse.
Je dois toutefois préciser que le début de notre séjour n’a pas tout à fait été à la hauteur de nos attentes, en raison de petits incidents avec les bagages ainsi qu’au restaurant Santé. Heureusement, l’intervention de la manager Laura nous a rapidement fait oublier ces désagréments. Un grand merci à elle : son professionnalisme et son attention nous ont donné envie de revenir. Nous espérons te recroiser, que ce soit lors d’un prochain séjour ici ou dans un autre hôtel de Meliá.

Pasamos una semana maravillosa en el Paradisus Palma, en la sección solo para adultos, The Reserve. Muchas gracias a Brandy, en recepción, por su amable bienvenida.
Nuestro encantador concierge Eriol, que habla muy bien francés, nos permitió disfrutar de cenas en todos los restaurantes a la carta. Apreciamos especialmente Flora, con un agradecimiento especial a Ana Iris, Kelvin y Yolandi; Mina, gracias a Antonio y Yoleidi; y por último Mascalzone, gracias a Daniela y Jesús.
Las habitaciones son bonitas, amplias y están impecablemente limpias. El buffet es excelente y muy variado; gracias a Rossana y Maria por su servicio excepcional.
La playa es hermosa, larga e ideal para quienes disfrutan caminar. Gracias también a Pedro y Raul por su amabilidad.
Sin embargo, debo señalar que el inicio de nuestra estancia no estuvo del todo a la altura de nuestras expectativas, debido a pequeños inconvenientes con el equipaje y en el restaurante Santé. Afortunadamente, la intervención de la gerente Laura nos hizo olvidar rápidamente estos contratiempos. Muchísimas gracias a ella: su profesionalismo y su atención nos dieron ganas de volver. Esperamos volver a verte, ya sea en una próxima estancia aquí o en otro hotel de Meliá.

reviews.author: Jade Huguet
reviews.title: Not a 5-star experience - extremely disappointing stay
reviews.text:
We chose this resort expecting a true 5-star experience, especially because it had been renovated in the last 2 years. Unfortunately, it has been one of the most disappointing hotel stays we’ve had. From the moment we arrived, things started off disappointingly. We checked in at 3:00 PM and quickly realized that the sofa bed mattress in our room was completely unacceptable, you could feel every spring, making it impossible to sleep on. 
They knew we were 3 mothers. We reported this issue to the front desk around 5:00 PM before dinner and were assured it would be resolved. When we returned at 9:30 PM, exhausted from traveling, nothing had been done. 
Cockroach: The situation got worse when we discovered a large cockroach on the wall of our room. While we understand that insects can occasionally happen in tropical destinations, this is absolutely not acceptable in a hotel that claims to be 5-star. Even more concerning was the lack of urgency or proper response from staff when we reported it. We have photos documenting these issues, its not an exaggeration. We were told that “a” manager would contact us the following day at 10:00 AM. No such contact was made. We were instead obliged to follow up again, and only received a response at 3:22 PM the next day. This delay further demonstrates a lack of prompt and appropriate handling of the situation. The proposed alternative only included a room change within the same building.
The Melia will probably answer in this chat that they responded rapidly and with a nice offer. This is not true and I have WhatsApp chat to prove it. After2 days of discussion with them, meaning we had to fight for a proper upgrade, an additional “compensation” was offered, including access to a Bali bed, a 30-minute massage (only 2, and we were 3). These compensation are wholly inadequate given the circumstances. It does not compensate for the distress experienced, including the discomfort and concern associated with the presence of the insect, the repeated delays, the effort required to obtain responses, and the attitude displayed by your staff.
Lying to customer: At check-in, we requested to pay the USD 450 upgrade fee for access to “The Reserve” section. The front desk employee informed us that no availability remained. However, in parallel, I contacted the representative by email, who advised that rooms were indeed available and that we should present ourselves accordingly. This inconsistency raises concerns regarding the accuracy of the information provided and the overall standard of customer service.
Additional hidden fees: To make matters worse, the next morning we were told that if we wanted beach chairs with an ocean view, we would need to pay an additional fee. Charging extra for basic beach access in an all-inclusive resort, especially at this price point, is simply unacceptable.
Overall, the service, responsiveness, and quality of the experience do not match the level this hotel advertises. At this price, guests should not have to deal with uncomfortable sleeping arrangements, hygiene concerns, and constant upselling. We strongly recommend future travelers to reconsider before booking here, as this property does not deliver on its promises.
We believe that transparency is important, and as such, we intend to accurately report our experience. Note that I have not uploaded all WhatsApp conv. But did upload the insect photo.  

Overall, the resort offers excellent food, the buffet is varied and high quality, and the steakhouse is outstanding. However, the wine selection is disappointing, and the à la carte options are priced at an excessive markup.
More importantly, the overall management approach at the Melia property feels lacking. There is a clear absence of follow-up and accountability, which gives the impression that issues are left unresolved in the hope that guests will simply move on. For example, a meaningful room upgrade could likely have mitigated the impact of the first night and improved the rest of the stay, rather than having to deal with ongoing discomfort.
The so-called “upgrades” offered (such as a short massage or access to a Bali bed with additional hidden fees) feel superficial and do not reflect the level of service expected from a resort of this category. In higher-quality resorts such as Club Med, more substantial gestures are typically made to address guest concerns and make them come back. This contrast gives the impression that Melia prioritizes revenue without delivering a comparable level of service in return.

reviews.author: Rose A
reviews.title: Friends getaway
reviews.text:
My friend and I had an amazing week. We stayed in the reserve section. I emailed ahead to ask for two beds and that was accommodated. I also was able to have them book the next nights dinner as we arrived very late and I didn't want to look after that next morning. Our butler Basilio was good, He did what was asked of him. No issues, we made contact daily as needed via WhatsApp. Our favorite bartenders was Marcus and Junior, We met at their bar daily around 4:00pm for our start of day drink. No ask was too much. Always a smile. Thank you guys... We loved our pool view room and the rocking chairs on the balcony was a big hit. We loved it in the evening while we laughed and had a couple of drinks before getting ready for dinner. All ala cart restaurants was great, we enjoyed the steak as our best. But all very good. We accidentally left our safe open and there was a polite note stuck in the locked safe that they found it open and locked it and we needed to call to have it open. NOTHING was missing. As for someone writing a review to say someone stole 100.00 out of your safe I find that very hard to believe. I tested this resort with a friend as I am somewhat picky and I loved it. In fact my hubby and I, along with another couple are going to go for 2 weeks in Sept because of the great week I had. 
The beds on the beach is awesome, so comfy. I loved the lounge chairs too so you could go from full sun to shade when required. A couple bars ran out of grey goose vodka a few times which was annoying because I book specialty or reserve for that reason. I don't drink a lot but do expect what I pay for, That would be my only thing to mention, please keep your bars stocked to accommodate what your guests pay for. I look forward to coming back in Sept. I will email prior to coming to let you know when. Thank you Paradisus and thank you also to Odeht to responding to my emails and booking my first dinner reservation. It was appreciated..... See you soon...Rose and Sheri.....

reviews.author: Giorgia A
reviews.title: Paradise in paradise!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at Paradisus Palma Real. From the very moment we set foot on the property we were well attended to and so impressed by the grounds and hotel aesthetic. We booked on the Reserve side which meant we had a separate reception where we were welcomed with a glass of bubbly, as well as a small buffet for if you’re feeling peckish. We were able to access all the hotel facilities whilst we waited for our room, including the restaurants etc.
I would definitely recommend booking the Reserve side if you are an Adults Only party. The pools and beach area was fabulous, as well as access to Santé (adults only restaurant). However, in general the hotel did not feel overcrowded or too “childish” though there were families. And though it felt exclusive, it did not feel exclusionary which I personally liked. The on the beach location was incredible, I would not want to go without it, the beach itself is gorgeous and well maintained, with plenty of sun loungers and beds.

The food at the hotel in general was of a decent standard, I particularly liked the buffet and à la carte at Santé, as well as Flora. Overall nothing to scream home about but decent enough with decent quality. We also took full advantage of the Nespresso spot and the cafeteria upstairs. Another nice touch was a bbq by the Reserve pools during the day, with freshly grilled meat and even lobster! They would also have live musical entertainment. I was in love with their piña colada slushies and had plenty of those by the hand of Gilberto at the beach bar. In general they are quick with the beverage service which is great. One small note is the bars could be open a little later on the beach/by the pools.  

The entertainment options at the hotel were very varied and unique! Our favourites were the Aerial yoga and the bike ride around the Melia grounds, genuinely loved both! I wish the aerial class could be a bit longer. We also enjoyed the Pole class. Sadly we didn’t get a chance to try the coconut oil making or the coffee making but I know those would be so fun, particularly due to the staff facilitating. We also missed the catamaran tour - they need to do it more often! The nightly entertainment was also cute and fun, it got everyone engaged and dancing. In general there’s a lot of dancing a good vibes throughout the day/evening which we loved. There are so many to name but the staff do an amazing job at keeping good vibes and friendliness throughout the resort, big gracias to Fernando, Johan, Carlos and the rest of the entertainment team, including the boys in blue!

In general the rooms were a very good size and very clean from the start, they have all the amenities you would need. They do a turndown service which was a nice touch. The beds are relatively comfortable and other than hearing the occasional other guest, we felt like it was quiet at night. We did find that the daily cleaning could be more thorough however, it seemed they would dispose of the bins and then do a quick sweep of the place. We understand the cleaning staff work very hard and have a lot of rooms to clean, but a slightly more thorough clean would’ve been appreciated where possible. The general resort however is spotless and smells lovely as soon as you arrive (this includes the pools/beach/restaurants). You can tell they work very hard to maintain it.

We were introduced to our Concierge Eriol at check in, he was very friendly from the start, gave us a tour of the hotel and Reserve area. He gave us his number so we could WhatsApp him with any questions, and quickly asked us to tell him which restaurants we would like to book for the evenings we were there. He also sent us a list of the daily activities going on in the hotel which was very helpful and was always on hand to answer any doubts. Additionally he surprised us with a bottle of wine during our stay to our room. The hotel provide a courtesy room for guests who are leaving on the final day post check out but this was fully booked when we needed it. However, Eriol was able to book us individual courtesy rooms in the spa instead which was extremely helpful. He’s a great concierge, thank you Eriol!

As said, our overall stay was amazing, we did not want to leave! It is a very well set up resort, with great attention to detail, very clean, stunning location with very friendly and helpful staff. Considering the price compared to others, it was definitely worth it. Our own paradise in the paradise that is DR. Thank you again!

P.s. for those complaining about staff not speaking English, you’re in a Spanish speaking country and I guarantee they are trying their best - get over yourselves!

reviews.title: Major disappointment
reviews.text:
This resort is interesting— very beautiful setting in the beach and impressive views; but the rooms are the absolute worst I’ve ever experienced! The walls and door is so paper thin—it’s currently 2:15 am and I’m wide awake listening to a baby crying on one side and a couple on the other side “sporting”. This was after being able to hear the live music in the lobby area playing until 11:00 pm. 

And while it’s all inclusive, the quality of the food offered is low. Room service is unappealing and many of the on-resort restaurants are a disappointment including the massive breakfast buffet. 

Such a shame. This place has a lot of potential but I’d wish we would have booked some place else.

reviews.author: Robert P
reviews.title: Good week of golf and good hotel
reviews.text:
Just returned from a 4 night stay where we played 5 rounds at Cocotal golf club and stayed at the Paradius Palma Real. 

It was a really solid stay with a really nice sized room. The patio or sliding door didn’t lock which isn’t ideal and we requested it to be fixed 3 times without any luck. Not sure what happened at all but what can you do. 

Also never received an extra pillow that was requested 3 times as well. Minibar was stocked and room cleaned well. 

Food was pretty good. Mexican was outstanding but they need more servers as mine was very busy as it took 45 minutes to get a beer with my meal. 

Steakhouse was disappointing as we had a late reservation and the steak was just ok. Great service though. 

Pools were outstanding but tough to find a chair as people reserve them and never seem to use them. Not a huge deal as we were on the course moat of the day. 

Bellmen were super helpful and always willing to assist. 

Service at the bars was very slow and understaffed. Buffet was good, good service and friendly but it’s a buffet right. 

All in all a really solid resort considering the challenges we faced. I am a positive dude and don’t let things damper my trip. Hopefully we some tweaks this place could be great. 

Resolving hotel issues and guest requests should be priority number one. 

Golf was solid as well. Will review the course as well. 

Casino was full of high school kids vaping and smoking away. Couldn’t get a seat at any of the tables.

reviews.author: Ronald and Mich... B
reviews.title: Fantastic visit at a beautiful resort
reviews.text: This was our third visit to Punta Cana (staying at properties that were nothing to write home about.) But as they say, the third time was absolutely the charm. Paradisus is a stunningly gorgeous resort with beautiful updates. We stayed on the Reserve side with an ocean front room. It was well-appointed, well-stocked and quite comfortable. We usually found a spot at the main pool, though the Reserve does have two gorgeous pools that we visited, as well. Be warned that there is a bit of towel jockeying from folks wake early to place towels in beds and chairs that they didn’t even return to until well after noon. That was a bit disappointing but we worked around it. (wry smile) All of the bartenders and pool wait staff were friendly and helpful. We had a fantastic time at the pools. We usually ate breakfast at Sante, the restaurant for Reserve guests. The omelette station is the star there. There’s definitely a much wider breakfast selection at The Lunch Box. But if you want to avoid the crowds, stick with Sante. We had dinner at Mascalzone (Italian - great!) and birthday dinner at Mina (Steakhouse - excellent). Room service was serviceable. When you need a quesadilla at 11:30 pm, it rocks. The only minor con was a lack of towels at ALL of the pools at one point during the stay. But it was quickly remedied. The beaches were beautiful and tended to. No sargassum during our stay. Cristian was our concierge and he was very attentive and helpful in booking reservations. There were nightly shows in the main foyer. Disco night was fantastic. We did venture over to Caribe for the casino, which was very tiny. Getting back to our resort was hit or miss. No one really knew how to call the transport to get us back. We had to flag down a cab.  All in all, I absolutely recommend this resort for a visit to the Dominican Republic. As someone whose previous visits left a bit of a sour taste in my mouth, this resort, the staff, the sights and the accommodations changed my mind. If you are traveling without littles, definitely check out The Reserve. Though there seemed to be a ton of activities for kiddos, as well.

reviews.author: Romuald_Sh
reviews.title: В целом так себе, ADULTS ONLY в отеле нет
reviews.text:
Добрый день! Пишу пока свежи впечатления! 

1. Видели бы вы общественные туалеты в зоне бассейнов и пляжей! Это уровень ЖД вокзала в Индии, а не 5* отеля в Доминикане. Видимо руководство отеля считает, что нормально просто окунуться в бассейн и помочится в него!
2. В основном ресторане нет смены питания ни на завтрак, ни на обед, ни на ужин, 7 дней в неделю, 3 раза в день одно и то же. Ресторанов а-ла-карте много, но радости по кухне никакой от них нет. Диетического стола тоже нет. 
3. Также один из самых неприятных моментов в том, что в отеле на пляже как бы есть зона "только для взрослых", есть при этом  специальная намного бо́льшая зона для семей с детьми, но по факту пляж для взрослых заполнен безумными детьми и не менее безумными родителями. Персоналу просто наплевать на это, я был вынужден ругаться, но простите, в конкретно  ЭТОМ отеле это настолько массовое явление, что выяснение с наглыми гостями подобно борьбе с ветряными мельницами. Визжащие, свистящие, орущие дети на пляже для взрослых по уровню шума напоминают новогоднюю ночь! И в этом отеле это  есть явление массовое. Отель ограничился лишь информацией на бумажном концерте про зоны только для взрослых. Повторюсь, персоналу плевать, ноль реакции на происходящее.

  Внешне отель очень красивый, персонал food and beverage в целом хороший. Но отель далеко не люкс. Когда-то это был самый лучший, люксовый отель курорта, общее его состояние внешне, на первый взгляд, неплохое и сейчас (минус общественные туалеты, возмущен настолько, что внутри до сих пор все клокочет), но поверьте, сейчас здесь много мелочей, которые расстраивают общее впечатление от отдыха.  По своей сути теперь это отель более низкого уровня, чем это было до пандемии!

reviews.author: Keri B
reviews.title: Exceptional Service and Unforgettable Memories
reviews.text:
Our girls’ group stayed in The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real, and the ocean views were absolutely gorgeous. Our concierge, Adriel, was attentive to every detail of our stay and truly went above and beyond to make our trip memorable. He also surprised us with thoughtful, special touches throughout our stay that made the experience feel extra special and unforgettable.

The entire staff was warm, helpful, and accommodating, and even the other guests were kind and friendly, which added to the welcoming atmosphere. We especially looked forward to learning fun dances each day from Cooper and Fernando — they brought so much energy and joy to our experience!

We also took the catamaran tour offered by the resort, and it was amazing. When I realized I had forgotten my shoes, Cooper kindly stayed with my friend and me while we walked all the way back to retrieve them. He took excellent care of us and made us feel completely comfortable.

Rafael took wonderful care of our group on the beach every day. He always had our chairs set up and even remembered our favorite drinks, bringing them to us each morning after we arrived. All of these gentlemen made us feel genuinely welcomed and cared for throughout our stay.

This was a girls’ trip, but I would absolutely bring my family back to Paradisus Palma Real. Our experience was outstanding!

reviews.author: Lisa P
reviews.title: Stay anywhere else!! Workers are not trustworthy
reviews.text: Do not stay here. The workers are liars. The customer service is sub par. The resort is new and the rooms are nice but service leaves a lot to be desired. If you request any changes to your reservation make sure you get them in writing. No waiter service by the pool or beach. No food service by the pool or beach either. We booked directly through the hotel and stayed on the reserve side. Our butler / concierge made dinner reservations for us at times we did not prefer however the dinners were good. Room service menu is limited. The fridge in our room did not work all week and all they offered was an ode bucket that remained on the table all week after melting the first day. The hotel is not very crowded and no where near at capacity. Check in took forever despite having private check in at the vip suite. Skip this place and find somewhere with staff that is more accommodating. Rooms didn’t get cleaned until 530 one night. Finally got wash cloths on our last day. After our two hour check in, we were taken on a tour of the resort and when we finally got to our rooms our bags still weren’t there. Slow service. Stay elsewhere. Also you can’t turn the AC below 69F but the room only ever gets to 74F. Everything was very damp in our room.

He took such great care of us while we were at the beach. He always had our chairs ready and made sure we were hydrated. 😜 Both men were gentlemen, friendly and also so fun. reviews.author: Glaymi Vega
reviews.title: Bueno, pero puede mejorar
reviews.text:
Comenzaré por los puntos positivos. El hotel es precioso: el layout está muy bien distribuido y la arquitectura es realmente bonita y bien pensada. El buffet es bueno, con variedad y opciones para todos los gustos; solo considero que podría mejorar un poco la selección de postres.

La primera impresión es positiva, especialmente gracias al equipo de maleteros, quienes hacen un excelente trabajo. La limpieza de las habitaciones es impecable.

Y sin duda, lo mejor del hotel es el equipo de animación: logran mantener a los huéspedes entretenidos, te motivan a participar en las actividades y siempre lo hacen con una sonrisa. Quiero destacar especialmente a DANA, FERNANDO y Mr. POLLITO; les sobra carisma y se nota que disfrutan genuinamente de su trabajo.

Ahora bien, es importante mencionar que el servicio al cliente no es el fuerte del hotel. Trabajo en la industria hotelera, por lo que hablo desde la experiencia. Comenzando por la recepción: este es el primer departamento que debe darte la bienvenida y colocarte “en órbita”, y lamentablemente eso no ocurrió.

La información brindada fue mínima: únicamente nos indicaron dónde estaba el buffet y cómo hacer las reservas de los restaurantes (para luego, cuando lo intentamos, decirnos que ya estaban cerradas, a pesar de que la máquina funciona las 24 horas). No nos explicaron dónde se ubicaba la habitación, cómo funcionaban las toallas de piscina, a qué áreas teníamos acceso ni si existían áreas familiares. Imaginen mi sorpresa al haber elegido un hotel solo adultos y encontrar bebés y niños en el buffet, sin haber recibido ninguna aclaración previa sobre espacios compartidos.

Además, a pesar de haber llamado en varias ocasiones antes de nuestra llegada y de haber confirmado que estaba registrada la nota de que viajábamos por una despedida de soltera y un cumpleaños, no se nos incluyó ningún tipo de amenidad ni atención especial, lo cual resultó muy decepcionante considerando que este tipo de detalles marcan la diferencia en la experiencia del huésped.

El servicio en restaurantes y bares deja mucho que desear. El personal parece estar siempre apurado, no presta atención a los pequeños detalles ni a las necesidades del cliente. Entiendo que existe una falta de personal, pero lo que realmente incomoda es la ausencia de vocación de servicio: muchas interacciones se sienten hechas por obligación, sin calidez ni interés.

Asimismo, en el buffet se presentaron fallas importantes: ausencia de etiquetas para identificar los alimentos y falta de utensilios. Considero que sería preferible abrir un poco más tarde si no todo está listo, en lugar de obligar al huésped a preguntar al cocinero, quien en ocasiones ni siquiera sabe qué platillo es porque no fue quien lo preparó.

La mayor decepción ocurrió al llegar a la habitación: el inodoro no tiene puerta, algo totalmente insólito. Incluso el clóset cuenta con una cortina, al igual que otras áreas del baño, pero el inodoro, que es el espacio que más privacidad requiere, está completamente abierto. Aun viajando en pareja (que no fue mi caso), considero que esto es una falta total de privacidad.

reviews.author: Federico C
reviews.title: Experiencia muy negativa con membresía Club Meliá – falta de transparencia
reviews.text:
En 2015 adquirí una membresía de Club Meliá durante una estadía en este hotel, por un valor aproximado de USD 27.000.

Con el paso del tiempo comprobé que los créditos ofrecidos resultan de muy difícil o prácticamente imposible utilización real, debido a restricciones, costos adicionales y falta de disponibilidad que no fueron explicadas claramente al momento de la venta.

A pesar de haber abonado la totalidad del contrato, actualmente mantengo créditos sin utilizar por un valor cercano a USD 17.000 y me encuentro solicitando formalmente la rescisión del contrato y una solución razonable, sin haber recibido hasta el momento una respuesta concreta por parte de la empresa.

Al pedir explicaciones porque la membresía no cumplía lo prometido, me ofrecieron asistir a una reunion para un upgrade indicando que la original ya no era conveniente, junto con masajes como incentivo por asistir a la reunión. 
Finalizada la reunion sin que yo acceda a la nueva membresia, no los otorgaron alegando que debía ir en pareja, condición nunca informada y que tampoco existía cuando contraté la membresía.

Considero importante que futuros huéspedes se informen exhaustivamente antes de aceptar presentaciones comerciales de membresías dentro del hotel.

reviews.author: Chechi23
reviews.title: Le falta al personal
reviews.text: El hotel es lindo pero la atención y el personal no corresponde a la categoría del hotel. Los empleados no tienen idea de nada. Casi suspenden la fiesta de año nuevo por lluvia y cuando se confirmó, nadie se  dignaba a retirar los plásticos mojados de las sillas (yo misma tuve que hacerlo), no organizaron la entrega de copas de champán, fue todo improvisado. Hoy no habían toallas para la playa, le pregunté al empleado a qué hora reponían y me respondió que le no sabía y para completar hoy volví a mi cuarto 7pm y no habían toallas de ducha y tampoco habían repuesto el agua del fríobar ni los snacks. Un par de veces que he preguntado a algún empleado donde es el bufete o donde está un restaurante y tampoco dan razón. Parece que todos fueran nuevos y estuvieran perdidos en la luna.

reviews.text:
I’m not one to complain…especially when I’m on vacation…BUT we’ve had several unexpected disappointments since our arrival which has not been the case on all my previous stays here:
1. Our room was ready for checkin  much later than promised 
2. Booking an ocean view room and getting a garden view room. We can see the ocean from the side of our balcony…but definitely NOT what is shown in the booking picture. 
3. Not having power in the room and having to have maintenance come back twice to finally replace a breaker that kept tripping
4. Our refrigerator isn’t working and hasn’t for 2 days which does not bode well when Jody’s medication needs to be refrigerated.  We’ve been keeping it in the ice bucket with us grabbing ice from the bar as it melts 🙄
5. There is no lighting in the hallways in our building so we have to stumble in the dark￼ or remember to bring our phones to use the flashlight app. Clearly there has been some power issues in the building that have yet to be resolved.

reviews.author: Evan R
reviews.title: Best Hôtel in punta cana
reviews.text:
Super bonne expérience c’était incroyable ! Super bonne équipe très souriante avec Fernando et Juan 
Chambres refaite tout les jours à la perfection

reviews.author: Stacy C
reviews.title: We are coming back!
reviews.text: It was a great experience, the service was great and the beach was extremely nice. The service we experienced was top notch!

reviews.author: TravelingAroundForFun
reviews.title: Fantastic resort!
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

After staying at three different resorts, I feel like I actually have a solid point of comparison and this one was by far the best experience overall.

The service was fantastic from start to finish. Every single person I encountered was professional, warm, and genuinely attentive. The property itself feels very peaceful, with greenery everywhere, which made it easy to fully relax.

I upgraded to The Reserve and it was absolutely worth it. Our butler, Yaleidi, was incredible. She checked in on us daily, helped secure dinner reservations, and made sure everything ran smoothly throughout our stay. Compared to other butler experiences I’ve had, she’s a true 10 out of 10.

The gym was excellent, fully stocked with weights, water, and towels. Those things may sound basic, but they are often missing at other resorts and here everything was consistently well maintained. I also never had trouble finding space at the pool or the beach, which made the experience feel calm and unhurried.

In the evenings, there was always something happening, including live bands and relaxing aromatics, which added a nice touch without feeling over the top.

Overall, this was such a fantastic stay. Thoughtful service, beautiful surroundings, and a well run resort. I would absolutely come back and would recommend it without hesitation.

reviews.author: Adam M
reviews.title: Ask for Alam
reviews.text: Spent an awesome time at Palma Real Reserve for a week vacation. Perfect beautiful weather, good food, cold drinks and awesome beach. Rafael is the man on the beach! The best was our concierge ALAM! He took care of us like family and set up everything we needed/ wanted. Definitely recommend him!

reviews.author: Paul T
reviews.title: Would go again
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Rafael at the beach is your hook up for all your drink needs. Alam the concierge was the best. Would definitely think about coming back again.

reviews.author: Sarah T
reviews.title: Would come back!
reviews.text: Alam is great, attentive and responsive! Rafael at the beach bar was fantastic! Would totally recommend coming to this resort!

reviews.author: Anne D
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text: Arisleida was wonderful!! She was totally on top of our needs, lovely as she could be, friendly, sweet - we loved her and can’t wait to come back and see her again.  Antonio also super helpful in getting us reservations for dinner.

reviews.author: Trail24462739312
reviews.title: Relaxing at the Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text: Our Concierge Emmanuel at the Melia Palma Real was amazing. Impeccable service and a wonderful person too. We stayed in the Reserve section. Spa and Beach Attendent Martin were great as well.

reviews.author: Rick Y
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text:
Wonderful location with a beautiful facility.   The staff was friendly and attentive      Our Concierges, Christopher and Yaleidi , were professional and hard working.    They took care of all of our requests quickly and efficiently.     
   The rooms and the public space were very clean and well kept.     The pools were sparkling.   The gym was good for a resort gym with everything you need for a decent work out ,     The food was very good with a huge variety available.      I would highly recommend this resort and we will be back next year

reviews.author: Robert V
reviews.text: Service was excellent service Amanda and my yasmailin made sure the netto was made Enrique.kanna beach had a beautiful and wonderful time with resort

reviews.author: Lili S
reviews.title: Amazing stay and exceptional service from staff!
reviews.text: As someone who has traveled to a variety of places and stayed at many hotels, I was blown away from the service of Paradisus from the moment I arrived to the entrance. The dedication and willingness to help and accommodate from all the staff was something I have never experienced before! we stayed at the reserve side which I would definitely recommend. The reserve has a seperate beach and pool which was amazing, and bars that have higher shelf liquor and an extra restaurant with better food, and a fully inclusive mini bar restocked every day, which was so worth it! We had a small issue with our meal at Sante, and the staff there (Miasel, Melqui) went above and beyond to make up for this, and the chef made us a special dinner with lobster, champagne and more. Christopher was our concierge and he texted us every morning with the actives and found us in person every day to ask if we needed anything. He also decorated the bathtub with a happy birthday sign made out of flower petals! Johan, Alfredo and Fernando from the Entertainment team were great dancers and super fun to be around. Yuderi, Martin, Gilberto, Rafael, who were amazing beach servers and bartenders at the Reserve beach and made our bed/drinks everyday. Maximo who worked at the winery was very knowledgeable and fun to talk to. Pool bartenders, Alberto, Jonathan, and Jorge were amazing as well. Other bartenders and waiters that went above and beyond were, Miguel, Jhojan, Diorgenis, Victor, Jean, Eduardo, Luis, Yefry, Jean, Miguel, Richard, and Manolo. I have never had that much of a positive experience with a resort staff until I came here. I will definitely be back on service alone, but not to mention the amount of space in the room and the size of the pools. Everything was modern, up to date, and we had an amazing time. The food was a hit or miss, but that's expected at an all inclusive. 10/10 stay, thank you to all!

reviews.author: Alejandro S
reviews.title: Amabilidad y calidez humana
reviews.text:
Nuestra estadía fue muy buena, muy lindas instalaciones, la comida muy buena y variada, sin embargo lo mas espectacular fue la amabilidad y profesionalismo de todo el personal, especialmente el de nuestra concierge Zenovia.
Zenovia se encargó de que nuestra estadía fuera inolvidable en todos los aspectos, gracias a su calidez humana y su atención al más mínimo detalle y apoyo con nuestros pedidos. ¡Muchas gracias Zenovia, espero que nos volvamos a cruzar pronto!

reviews.author: Aldo S
reviews.title: Gran experiencia!
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, muy cómodas habitaciones, rica comida, bares y acceso a la playa. La atención es increíble, en especial la de nuestra concierge Zenovia, que nos ayudó a disfrutar la experiencia mucho más, ayudándonos a preparar una celebración de cumpleaños, reservando restaurantes y actividades. Totalmente recomendado.

reviews.author: Robert C
reviews.title: Amazing Stay at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, everything about Paradisus Palma Real exceeded our expectations. The resort is stunning, and the rooms were immaculately clean and perfectly maintained—truly a five-star experience. Every detail throughout the property was in order, making it feel both luxurious and welcoming.

A special shout-out to our incredible concierge, Yaleidi! She went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. From helping us secure reservations to organizing travel plans and keeping us informed about all the resort’s events, her attentiveness and professionalism were outstanding. She made everything effortless and stress-free.

The all-inclusive experience was top-notch, with beautiful pools, and plenty of activities to keep everyone entertained. If you’re looking for a relaxing, worry-free getaway in the Dominican Republic, Paradisus Palma Real is the place to be.

reviews.author: giulia l
reviews.title: De locos
reviews.text: Este viaje ha sido uno de los mejores recuerdos que llevaré por siempre en mi corazón. GRACIAS a nuestro mayordomo JENDRY por habernos cuidado tanto y por haber hecho que nuestra estancia fuera aún más especial. Sin ti no hubiera sido lo mismo!! Un abrazo desde Canarias :)

reviews.author: Leofrd
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: A truly perfect stay at this incredible hotel. Everything was flawless — the room was perfect, there were numerous high-quality restaurants to choose from, plenty of pools, activities, and more. The staff were exceptionally attentive. We were accompanied throughout our stay by our concierge, Christopher. A special mention to Christopher, who was simply outstanding. He assisted us throughout the entire stay, always there to answer our requests — such a kind, thoughtful, and attentive person. A big thank you!

reviews.author: Cecilia S
reviews.title: Excelente sitio para vacacionar
reviews.text: La experiencia fue maravillosa, las habitaciones muy limpias y agradables , la comida deliciosa y la atención espectacular , especial agradecimiento a nuestro concierge Ariel, a nuestros amigos del bar de la playa Pedro y Rafael, a nuestros amigos del bar de la piscina Julia y Rafael , y a nuestra adorada Martita que nos atendía al desayuno y almuerzo en el buffet .

reviews.author: Patti S
reviews.title: Home away from Home!!
reviews.text: Just completed what I believe was our 11th visit to Paradisus Palma Real and as usual we were not disappointed!! Our concierge Eriol Alix took amazing care of us from start to finish including making my birthday so special with our room decorated on arrival and topped off with a surprise birthday cake and serenade at the wonderful Italian restaurant. He took care of all of our dinner and spa reservations and greeted us each morning with his big smile and great attitude. Martin and Gilberto made our beach experience each day perfect! reviews.text:

También el restaurante Tokimeko me dejó satisfecha con la atención de Dismaily y Luis, excelente atención.

Pero en cuanto al Hotel, room services, el buffet, la selección de la habitación, la vista, todo mal, mala atención, problemas desde el día 1, no me gustó para nada el servicio.

reviews.author: gi0vannil87
reviews.title: BELLO MA .. DA MIGLIORARE
reviews.text:
Sono stato ospite del Paradisus Palma Real per 10 notti e posso dire che, come gruppo Melia Hotels, questa struttura si presenta come una delle più belle di Punta Cana. L'hotel è ampio e offre diverse zone di svago e intrattenimento.

La mia Suite Master era spaziosa e rispecchiava le mie aspettative, ma la pulizia non è stata sempre all'altezza. Ho notato che le lenzuola non venivano sempre cambiate con la frequenza desiderata e, in alcuni casi, non erano perfettamente pulite. Suggerirei di migliorare la frequenza di cambio delle lenzuola e di assicurarsi che siano sempre bianche e fresche di bucato.

Il buffet iniziale era meraviglioso, ma purtroppo la qualità è calata nei giorni successivi. I ristoranti all'interno dell'hotel, invece, sono stati deludenti. La cucina era priva di sapori e non consiglierei nessuno di questi ristoranti, in particolare il Mascalzone e il ristorante messicano.

La spiaggia era ben attrezzata e il servizio di beverage era eccellente. Tuttavia, se non fosse stato per il buffet, avrei avuto difficoltà a trovare opzioni culinarie soddisfacenti all'interno dell'hotel.

In conclusione, il Paradisus Palma Real è un hotel bellissimo, con paesaggi mozzafiato e acque cristalline. Tuttavia, ci sono margini di miglioramento nella pulizia delle camere e nella qualità dei ristoranti. Spero che queste osservazioni vengano prese in considerazione per migliorare l'esperienza degli ospiti futuri.

reviews.author: Sylvio E
reviews.title: Excelente hotel para diversão entre amigos
reviews.text: Hotel incrível, quartos excelentes, boa comida e o destaque está para o Alberto, atendente do bar 96 degrees na piscina

reviews.author: James C
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: We went to Punta Cana and will absolutely be back to this resort! Had an incredible time! The service was great with Christian! From the time we got there to the day we left we had excellent service from Christian! Our reservations got planned from dinner to excursions. Christian is an amazing employee and an absolute asset to Paradisus! We will be back again and hope to have Christian again!

reviews.author: Nathaly S
reviews.title: Una estadia muy placentera
reviews.text:
Tuve una experiencia bastante agradable y satisfactoria. Las instalaciones son de primera y los servicios de comida y bebida fueron de lo mejor.
La atención del staff fue muy amena y cordial.

reviews.author: Castro-coru
reviews.title: MARAVILLOSO
reviews.text:
Llevamos ya varios años alojándonos en The Reserve del Paradisus Palma Real, y siempre repetimos por muchas razones: las instalaciones, el entorno, la playa, las comodidades… Pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia es su equipo humano.
Queremos empezar agradeciendo a Álvaro, que siempre ha estado pendiente de nosotros en cada visita. Esta vez, por un cambio repentino, conocimos a parte de la nueva gerencia, y la experiencia fue igualmente maravillosa. En especial, destacamos a Carolina, que con su amabilidad y cercanía, hizo que nuestras vacaciones fueran inolvidables. También a Alexia, una pieza fundamental para que todo funcione a la perfección. Siempre con una sonrisa, cuidando cada detalle.
Nuestro concierge Gustavo merece una mención especial: atento, educado, servicial… uno de los mejores mayordomos del hotel sin duda.
Esta vez, aunque ya conocemos todos los restaurantes, fuimos directamente a Flora, el dominicano, donde trabaja Eduardo, a quien apreciamos muchísimo y que ya sentimos como un amigo más.
En The Reserve tienes acceso al restaurante Santé para desayunar, comer y cenar. La experiencia allí es siempre excelente: Barnelis te recibe con una calidez que se agradece muchísimo, y los chefs Santos y Rafa sorprenden con platos deliciosos y muy bien presentados. Enrique es un auténtico showman y el servicio de Reinaldo (al que cariñosamente llamamos “nuestro Mario Casas”) es de lujo. Y Misael, con su amabilidad y educación, se ha convertido en uno de nuestros camareros favoritos.
Mención muy especial también para Wendy, que siempre nos atiende con una sonrisa, haciendo que nos sintamos como en casa. Su dedicación y atención hacen que tu experiencia suba de nivel.
En la zona exclusiva de playa, el servicio es excelente gracias a Pedro, Martín, Rafa y Yuderis, siempre dispuestos a ayudarte con lo que necesites.
Ahora bien, queremos comentar algo que empañó un poco nuestra estancia: los supuestos “fotógrafos” con animales como guacamayos o iguanas, que no aceptan un no por respuesta y resultan bastante agresivos. Lamentablemente, tuvimos que solicitar la presencia de seguridad casi a diario por esta situación, que llegó a ser muy incómoda. Por eso, queremos agradecer a Juan, Elisaldo y otros miembros del equipo de seguridad por su profesionalidad. Este es un punto que el hotel debería revisar seriamente: este tipo de personas no deberían tener acceso a las zonas privadas.
Como sugerencia de mejora, creemos que un hotel de esta categoría debería retomar el código de vestimenta que existía antes. No es agradable ver a personas cenando en bañador y chanclas, o con los pies encima de las mesas en la Plaza Colonial. Son pequeños detalles, sí, pero en un 5 estrellas gran lujo, esos detalles son los que marcan la diferencia entre una buena experiencia y una excelente.
En resumen, seguimos eligiendo The Reserve no solo por lo bonito que es el lugar, sino por las personas que hacen que todo funcione y que cada visita sea especial. ¡Gracias por hacernos sentir siempre como en casa!

And overall a wonderful trip!!!

reviews.author: Jacqueline N
reviews.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE!!!
reviews.text:
This was an incredible experience from start to finish! It started with emailing with Alexia Garcia who was incredibly helpful and do friendly.  We couldn’t wait to meet her when we arrived.  
We arrived and were treated like royalty from the minute we stepped out of the car. They took our luggage and brought  us straight to the Reserve area.  We had champagne and met Carolina and the staff and were introduced to our concierges (we had two) Emmanuel Villa and Adriel Cabrera who were with us all five days and took care of everything!  They took us on a tour of the resort, booked our dinner reservations, came and picked us up for dinner, took care of our excursion reservations, brought us anything we needed to our room, etc.  Alexia, Emmanuel and Adriel set up a mixology lesson in our room that was so much fun! 
While on the yoga catamaran outing, we met Fernando who is incredible with the guests and so much fun!  We looked forward to seeing him around the resort daily at the activities. We did Aqua HIIT in the main pool with Freilyn who brings all the energy and knows how to work the crowd no matter where he is working throughout the day. 
We HIGHLY recommend the Reserve and the Presidential suite stay!

reviews.author: Antonio J

reviews.author: Erik H

reviews.author: Adam D

reviews.author: Kenny E
reviews.title: Ramon at the Beach!
reviews.text: Ramon at the beach made my stay extra special. He looked after me and my friend, provided a cabana, and even moved my lounge chair and belongings to a better spot at the front of the water without me having to ask. When I saw him around the resort he always came over to see me and ask when I was coming to the beach and to come see him when I do. I even got a hug when it was time for me to go home. Also special shout out Luis in the restaurants for helping out big group with special dinners in a private room for several nights. Ramon and Luis made us feel like family.

reviews.author: dalyeche
reviews.title: Un hotel para relajarse y descansar en un sector de excelente playa.
reviews.text:
Es la tercera vez que estoy en este hotel, la experiencia general bastante buena, excelentes habitaciones, buena infraestructura, excelente playa, un lugar muy agradable para pasar unos días, en mi caso 1 semana. Para mejorar, sin duda, la comida, el buffet Malva bastante bueno para el desayuno y cualquiera de las otters comidas del día. Con respecto a los restaurantes con reserva, solo merece mencionar el dominicano y mexicano, los otros, japonés, italiano, steakhouse, sencillamente malos, no valen la pena. 
Otro punto a mencionar el la mesa de Pool en el bar deportivo, las bochas incompletas (una vergüenza) y los tacos en pésimo estado. Si van a tener mesa de pool o billar para los huéspedes, tiene que estar en excelente estado, sino sáquenla.
En resumen, vale la pena visitar pero recomiendo evaluar otras alternativas ya que la calidad de la comida esta bajo el promedio para esta calidad de hotel.

reviews.author: Diane A
reviews.title: Amazing vacation with Mr Ayayaya
reviews.text: Mr. Ayayay, made our time here so much fun!!! He has got a great personality and so funny! We will NEVER forget him and how much fun he brought to us the week we stayed at the resort. He is also a great dancer!!! He does a GREAT job!!!

Nos gusto mucho el
Servicio y el trato del personal, especialmente de Milton y Alexandra, muy buenos platos y seleccion de ingredientes, muy atentos …………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………,..,,,,,,,,,,,.,,

reviews.author: Martina P
reviews.title: Buena experiencia con espacio para mejoras
reviews.text: Muy buena infraestructura, excelente playa. El servicio deja mucho que desear. Da la sensación de que están esperando una propina por todo y muchas veces atienden mal. También tuvimos un problema de seguridad grave (habitacion en 1er piso y una persona trató de entrar a nuestra habitacion por la ventana. Nosotros estabamos adentro) avisamos al hotel y no hubo seguimiento ni mayor interes de parte del hotel. Y de hecho, ese día obviamente nos fijamos en dejar la ventana cerrada con ambos pestillos y cuando volvimos en la tarde, el pestillo estaba abierto... ¿pq housekeeping abrió el pestillo?...En general super buena experiencia. Limpieza del hotel 10/10, comidas decentes, muy buena piscina. Salvo por el incidente de seguridad del último día que dejó un sabor amargo.

reviews.author: Kim L
reviews.title: Front desk help

We took a trip with friends and kids
  The resort was amazing but the front desk was as absolutely wonderful.   Santiago cheeked up in and made sure all our needs the resort were met !    We asked about taking the
Kids to the mall souvenir shopping he suggested a souvenir shop and arranged travel to and from for us and guaranteed it was safe !   It was a great experience. If you go to the Paradisus Palma Real Life please ask for Santiago he will take good care of you and make sure you have the best experience at the resort 
Thanks Santiago

reviews.author: John and Nancy L
reviews.title: Not our first trip and we’d love to go again.
reviews.text: Very nice time at Paradisus. This is our third trip and we’ve been to several other DR and Mexican  resorts. This is one of our favorites. Jendry, our concierge was in touch every day via messaging. It was an overall very relaxed and beautiful resort with excellent beaches!

reviews.author: Compass38344701761
reviews.title: Group Stay
reviews.text: It was an amazing stay.  Our concierge Jendrie went above and beyond.  We had a group of 12 of us and we were well taken care of.  Rafael setup our beach accomodations every mornng and then made sure that we had whatever we needed.  Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Patti S
reviews.title: Another week in Paradise!!
reviews.text: We just completed our 10th visit to paradise! As always, our vacation was perfect. Our concierge Eriol took wonderful care of us each and every day. He made all of our reservations, surprised us with special treats in our room each afternoon, and make sure we had anything and everything we wanted. As usual, our beach experience was amazing thanks to Wanda, Pedro and Martin, who we love and are three of the reasons we continue to come back once or twice a year! And of course I cannot forget Gladys, who is the best massage therapist in the DR. She is incredible as is all those associated with the Yhi Spa! The room was spacious and clean with an ocean view and food choices were plentiful. There is nowhere that we travel where the people are kinder or want to enhance your experience more than Paradisus Palma Real!  Thank you and see you again soon!!

reviews.author: Kim M
reviews.title: Domenican trip 2025
reviews.text: We ate at Flora and our experience was amazing.  The mushrooms deep were to die for. The food overall was exceptional and our server Andrea was the best!  We will defintely eat here again when we come back!  The atmosphere is so different as you feel as though you are eating in a park under trees with a lighted canopy. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

reviews.author: Kerolin K
reviews.title: In the days I've been at the hotel I've really liked it and the entertainment team is very attentive to making sure the

Good waiters, excellent entertainment, especially Fernando Chipa from the entertainment department. I give it a 10 out of 10. Thank you. See you soon.

reviews.author: Heidi Z
reviews.title: Perfect Weekend Escape – Thanks to Alam!
reviews.text:
My sister and I took a quick weekend getaway, and it truly felt like a dream! The resort was absolutely beautiful. We stayed on the "Reserve" side, and our room was nothing short of luxurious—comfortable beds, spacious bathroom areas, and an overall serene atmosphere that made getting ready a breeze. The private beach access was also a huge plus, offering a peaceful and exclusive experience.

While everything about the resort was impressive, what really elevated our trip was the outstanding service from our concierge, Alam M. His attention to detail and dedication to ensuring we had a seamless experience were unmatched. He was incredibly responsive, helping us with questions and requests at any time. He handled all of our dinner and spa reservations, and even checked in with us each morning via text to share the day’s events and make sure we didn’t miss out on anything.

Alam was warm, professional, and genuinely seemed to love what he does. His thoughtful care made a great trip into an unforgettable one. We’re already talking about our next visit—and hope to have Alam as our concierge again! 10/10 would recommend the Paradisus to friends and family in the future!

reviews.author: A..
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Simply put, everything was excellent.  Stayed on adults side.  Resort never felt crowded.  Always clean. Rooms are great. Food was good.  Beach was great.  Pools are great.  Staff is great.  Only negative I have is (which wasn't too bad) that sometimes families with kids would sit on adults only side of the beach.

reviews.author: Cho M
reviews.title: La mejors del mundo Leticia - Ariza y Olga que servicio
reviews.text: Hermoso destino en punta cana un servicio excepcional en la piscina 90 grados Paradisus palma real con Leticia,Raisa y Olga son las mejores si van a este hotel no duden en preguntar por ellas y buscarlas, gracias mil de corazón 🥰😍😍😍😍😍😍😍

reviews.author: Karen E
reviews.title: Magnification
reviews.text: My stay was magnificent! Basilo who is part of the concierge staff made my stay everything I could dream. It was my 1st trip to Punta Cuna and the resort! I had s great time. Definitely take the ATV tour!    My room was beautiful, Room service was excellent

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: PROBABLY WON'T RETURN
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, there was total chaos at the front desk. There were 4 in my group, and 2 arrived approx 2 hours before the rest of us  and still had not gotten their room key. 3 of us reserved swim up King rooms and there were only 2 available. The mini bar was not stocked and the snacks  were stale.

The grounds are an 8 out of 10 but the service was not what you would expect from a 4 Diamond rated resort.

Initially when we tried to make dinner reservations we were told all the  restaurants were booked  thru Sunday..mind you we arrived on Wednesday.  We had to reach out to a gentleman named Antonio who went out of his way to get us reservations. Baffles me how a person could say the restaurants were all booked for dinner but you are checking guests in. THANK GOODNESS FOR HIM.  Also, Jose Rameriaz was also very helpful during our stay. THANKS JOSE! 
The food was nothing to brag about and was average. All guest have to eat  breakfast at one location unless you are club members..I  assume they have other options.
Additionally,  I  would suggest arranging your own transportation to and from the airport as the resort has no dedicated transportation service.
I don't know if this review will elicit a response and I really don't want to hear back from the resort. I WILL JUST SAY THAT THE CUSTOMER SERVICE NEEDS TO DRASTICALLY IMPROVE ESPECIALLY AT THE FRONT DESK. ONCE AGAIN, THANKS TO JOSE AND ANTONIO FOR THEIR EFFORTS

reviews.author: Alexandra D

This is the third paradisus hotel we’ve been too!  Great times to be had by all!

reviews.title: Paraíso dominicano

Los restaurantes de calidad, tanto el buffet como los restaurantes a la carta. La zona The Reserve (solo adultos) un oasis de paz, con varias piscinas, zona exclusiva en la playa con camas balinesas y experiencias incluidas como excursión en catamarán a una isla virgen para realizar yoga, muy top! El personal siempre atento y con una sonrisa. Destacar el servicio de nuestro concierge Christopher que hizo que nuestra experiencia fuese inmejorable, estuvo pendiente de nosotros en todo momento, realizando las reservas de los restaurantes y ayudándonos con todas nuestras peticiones. reviews.author: Abel J
reviews.title: Vacaciones en el paraíso

Desde el entorno paradisíaco hasta las instalaciones de última generación, todo está pensado para ofrecer una estancia inolvidable. Pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia es el personal: profesionales impecables que te reciben con una sonrisa y te hacen sentir como en casa. Para una experiencia aún más exclusiva, recomiendo la opción Destination Inclusive con The Reserve. Disfrutarás de acceso a zonas premium y experiencias únicas, como una clase privada de yoga en una plataforma virgen con vistas espectaculares. Además, contarás con un servicio de mayordomo personalizado. Queremos destacar especialmente a Christopher, quien hizo de nuestra estancia algo mágico. Su atención al detalle, su amabilidad y su disposición para anticiparse a nuestras necesidades fueron excepcionales. ¡Gracias, Christopher! Sin duda, volveremos a este paraíso, y lo recomendaremos a todos nuestros amigos
