reviews.author: wanderingerin613
reviews.title: A Happy Surprise!
reviews.text:
We actually booked the Melia Wellness resort located nearby many months back, but they did not have the rooms we booked when we finally arrived, so Melia moved us to the Paradisus property. It was amazing! We stayed in the adults only, Reserve section. The separate breakfast restaurant for Reserve was lovely; it has both buffet and a la carte menu options. Overall the food was great; however, there were very few vegetarian options outside of the buffet. The process for reservations was annoying; if you are a Reserve guest, you are supposed to have a butler to do this for you, but our group was not assigned one. It much better to either make your reservations for the entire week at once, or forgo the entire reservation system like many other resorts do. In the end, we ate well though, so no real complaints. 
One of the best things about this resort, is that they never ran out of beach towels. They were always plentiful. And the hotel room towels themselves were great quality. Housekeeping was sometimes a bit too timely in the mornings, but they did an excellent job. The rooms and property were very well maintained.
My only suggestions for improvement are 1) that the rooms need more hooks/hangers for towels, wet clothing, robes, etc. in the bathrooms;  and, 2) it would be better if the entertainment options would be posted in a weekly format, instead of posted daily around the resort. It would allow people to better plan their activities and excursions.
The coffee bar in the lobby was a real treat. The staff were gracious and helpful. Overall, a very excellent week spent on this property!

reviews.author: Trisha D
reviews.title: Amazing time with friends and family
reviews.text: Part of our group stayed in the Reserve and absolutely loved it. Our concierge, Gustavo, was absolutely amazing! He assisted with reservations at restaurants and the spa, kept us updated on daily activities and seemed to always be around to say hello and ask if we needed anything. The nightly entertainment was wonderful. I would definitely recommend getting dinner reservations at the restaurants surrounding the main courtyard. They are all great! If you go be sure and ask for Gustavo!!

reviews.author: Terri R
reviews.title: Beautiful place but lacks all-inclusive and adults-only experience
reviews.text:
Paradisus has some of the best food we've had at an all-inclusive. While there is only one buffet, it is delicious and has something for everyone, including vegetarians and those dairy-free. We had dinner at three of the restaurants available to non-members and can recommend Flora (Dominican) and Mascalzone (Italian). Skip Blue Agave (Mexican).

Paradisus has the most luxurious room we've enjoyed at an all-inclusive. There's a king size bed, soaking tub, lounge area, and balcony, among other amenities. Note: we paid for the adults-only area of the hotel, and the rooms were set up with couples in mind. There is no private space to dress, other than a light curtain around the bath area. If you are traveling with a friend or family member, I suggest asking if there are rooms with more privacy.

Even with the best food and room–and with the hotel situated directly on a gorgeous and inviting beachfront–I felt misled. The hotel photos and map boast 10+ restaurants and a plethora of pools, but non-members are relegated to one-third of the property, including only a handful of restaurants and 2 pools. Smell a barbecue wafting from a pool deck? Ignore it. Looking for an adults-only experience? It’s simply not there for non-members and should not be offered (and up-charged!).

Everyone can enjoy the beachfront activities (paddle board, snorkeling, boogie board, and catamaran), fitness center, and daily aqua exercising. Also available to all are the nighttime performances and parties. During our stay, these included a fun silent dance party and a kooky “under-the-sea” themed concert complete with familiar sing-along tunes and photo ops with staff dressed as sea creatures.

Paradisus was a quieter, calmer all-inclusive, and I appreciate that might be just the ticket for first-timers or families looking for a low-key, easy break. The staff were unfailingly nice. With its all-white buildings, terra cotta rooftops, and pristine grounds, the word that came to mind was “classy”. We definitely want that in our all-inclusive. But we also want the fun, abundance, and yes, inclusiveness that the all-inclusive name suggests. With so many members-only restaurants, pools, and beach segments, I found myself feeling confined by our third day. Thus, while we are glad to have visited this once, I’m not at all sure we’ll be back.

reviews.author: Nickolas B
reviews.title: Best Melia Resort stay (so far)
reviews.text:
We’ve been to a couple Melia resorts in Punta Cana and Paradisus is our favorite. The rooms are spacious, the restaurants offer great selection (best Melia food we’ve had by far) and lovely evening entertainment. The beach and pool were fantastic. The close proximity of our rooms to the restaurants, pool and beach were also a huge plus. 

Service here was also great. Christopher, our butler/concierge did a fantastic job balancing attentiveness (ie checking in with us throughout the day) and letting us be. He was very responsive to making dinner reservations and providing details on the resorts daily activities. He was also very attentive whenever we ran into any issues with restaurants, occasionally even after his standard work hours . 

The only downside (and it might’ve just been our room because our friends didn’t have the same issue) was our bed was very hard and the air conditioning unit was very loud when it turned on and off in the middle of the night. 

Overall - our whole group agrees - 10/10 would absolutely recommend -  we will be back.

reviews.author: Kristen M
reviews.title: Look elsewhere
reviews.text:
Not the luxury arrival you would expect no towel no drink and then to make matters work we were  not given or told about resort just given incorrect information about the restaurant situation.
We were told restaurants were open or available to us when they were not open.we complained to the concierge regarding the amount of time and inconvenience we had making reservations.  The concierge told us that he would look into it and get back to us.  We never received further communication from him.
If you have a food allergy stay away I have a lactose allergy.  This was on the reservations card and was told to the staff when we arrived at the restaurant.  When questioned about the food, staff did not know what foods had lactose and at Flora I was given butter in her main dish.  I do want to point out that at Mascalzone the staff did pay attention to my food allergy.

At 11:00 am we were lying out by the adult pool.  However, our peaceful morning was interrupted by staff doing yard maintenance including using a very loud chainsaw.
Children were always in the adult area and pool. This is not enforced at all. Screaming babies and children jumping in the pool.

Every morning when we would go out to lay by the pool at 10:00 am we could not find beach towels.  We always had to wait for them.
We would ask Staff how and where to make reservations, get towels, or how to make our airport transfer. We were provided with different answers or staff didn’t know. This was frustrating because we did not know what was going on.
Staff did not explain what they were doing with our luggage during the checkout process. ie where to go, cutting wrist band, room charges.

I asked when they can cut off the wrist band she stated upon departure no one ever cut anything off of us. Another stupid thing but they all start to add up.

WiFi password was not given to us nor was there information in the room. I called and was given the information to use a certain network that didn’t work and so they said “ooo you have an apple phone, you need to to use this other network and the password was like 1000 characters and numbers. Again no information shared and when it was shared it was complicated for no reason.
On the night we arrived (2/15/25) we discovered a stain on the duvet cover. Waited for over an hour for it to be replaced by housekeeping. They did not replace the duvet cover, just put a sheet on the comforter. The woman was very kind but I figured it be replaced the following day - it never was. The curtains had stains on them. The walls in the toilet area were dirty. The shower is very nice but confusing and multiple guests I heard had to call to have it explained. It took us a bit to figure it out. Again easily fixed by a guide book of some sort. Further the mini bar has lack luster snacks. The light fixtures were very very dusty. The light switches are soo confusing again easily fixed by a room/resort guide. The app is terrible and provides no real help. The funniest thing was the room service photos. They will give you a good laugh. Pros The coffee maker is however nice. They provide nice toiletries! Nice bathroom towels - honestly they were amazing. Huge big bath towels! The floors were clean.

Food & drinks
The hot food offered at the buffet was cold and the cold food was lukewarm. Eating lukewarm ceviche was not appetizing. When we arrived at the Lunch Box we were not shown where to sit. Therefore, we would have to wander around to find a seat. Once we did finally find a seat, we were not given water or drinks. We would come back from getting our food, only to have nothing to drink. This was frustrating. I would have to flag down multiple servers to no avail. when we sat down for breakfast without any beverages we were told that they could not serve us coffee because they ran out of cups. On another day we sat down for lunch we were not given any silverware, because they ran out. An all-inclusive resort that size should have ample culinary sets especially because it was not at capacity when we were there. At the buffet for breakfast, my lactose allergy was ignored . At the omelet station she would tell the staff that she needed a clean bowel for her eggs because the prior one had cheese in it. The staff would ignore this request - despite knowing of my food allergy. Often rolling their eyes.

Noteworthy details
We were told by multiple Paradisus staff that it was easy to get reservations. We did not experience this. We had to get up early in the morning to make reservations. We were told if we were not in line by 8:00 am we were likely not to get reservations and we had to go to the concierge multiple times to make reservations. On 2/16/25 we got up early to make dinner reservations because we did not want to be forced to eat at the Lunch Box (Buffet) again after our terrible experience on the first night. We were told by the staff that we needed to be in line by 8:00 am. This completely defeats the purpose of our vacation at Paradisus. We wanted to relax and not worry about being somewhere at some time. When we were in the concierge line to make dinner reservations, we were unable to make them for the following night on 2/17/25 because the system was down. The concierge told us to be back at 12:00 pm to make the following night’s dinner reservations. Once again, this completely defeats the purpose of our stay and vacation with Paradisus because we were not able to relax and unplug because we had to be back in line by 12:00 for dinner reservations. We arrived at the concierge to make dinner reservations for 2/17/25 at 12:00; however, the system was still down. The line was very long. We had to stay in this line for over 45 minutes while on our vacation just to be able to make dinner reservations.

reviews.author: T C
reviews.title: Great hospitality
reviews.text: Everything is great. We enjoyed food, service and beach. You can also try sea activity like parasailing. We came here to celebrate my friends birthday, and the staff here made a cake for him. We appreciated all hospitality from this hotel. We had wonderful time here and I am sure I will come back here again.

reviews.author: marisa g
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: This place is truly paradise. White sand and blue water with plenty pools and space to relax. Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Gustavo helped us get reservations for the restaurants we wanted and checked it with us over the course of the stay to make sure we had the best time possible. Would definitely return!

reviews.author: Nicolas F
reviews.title: Meliá Palma Real
reviews.text:
Es una experiencia para recomendar. Todo el trato en el hotel es excelente, te hacen sentir como en tu propia casa. 
Espero poder regresar pronto. Muchas gracias. Nereida, Francesca, Andreina , Dominga y demás nos has tratado con mucha calidez

Gracias

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.title: Amazing Trip
reviews.text:
Went for 2 weeks to celebrate wife's 50th bday.  Couldn't of asked for a better trip.  The staff are extremely friendly and courteous.
Eriol our concierge went out of his way to make sure we had what we needed.  He also made our dinner reservations which was a plus.  Checked in daily to see how we were doing and loves his job.
The bartenders at all the Celcius bars are awesome.  They remember you and what you like and are always happy and dancing and having fun.
The food at every restaurant was outstanding with lots of choices.  Something for everyone.  Starting with the hostesses who were very sweet to our servers not one bad thing to say.
The grounds are immaculate and the beach is groomed constantly to keep seaweed away.
If you read any negative reviews take them with a grain of salt.  This place is the real deal.

reviews.author: renzoefrain
reviews.title: Todo ok
reviews.text: Gracias por todo, me gustó mucho las instalaciones, el personal de la playa y piscina súper atentos, igual q el de los restaurantes, la verdad nos sentimos muy contentos y cómodos

reviews.author: anapm95
reviews.title: Una experiencia bastante desagradable
reviews.text:
Muy mal trato, fuimos al mejor “hotel” y nadie pudo ayudarnos nunca. 
No podíamos ni comer por falta de un mayordomo que ellos deberían de haber asignado a cada habitación. 
Al momento de hacer el check in me dieron una habitación con personas dentro, para después decirme que una de mis tres habitaciones una había sido modificada para abril por alguien en recepción a una hora en la que yo no estaba ni siquiera en República Dominicana.
La inseguridad que nos causo a un grupo de 8 mujeres que pudimos entrar a una  habitacion ocupada y que cualquier persona podía modificar mi reserva. 
A la mañana siguiente fui a recepción a ver lo de la modificación y no solo me querían hechar la culpa si no que querían cobrarme la habitación a la tarifa del dia cuando yo hice mi reserva desde octubre del 2024.
En fin una experiencia bastante desagradable ya que nadie tomaba responsabilidad ni estaba dispuesto a resolver o mínimo a ayudar
Después de todo esto no recibimos ni una disculpa, ni un chocolate, ni una recompensa.

reviews.author: Joan G
reviews.title: A Week in Paradise will cost you 4 lbs.
reviews.text: Our group of 4 couples were treated like family from the front door of the resort throughout the week. Gustavo and Emmanuel provided the best concierge services for the group. This is my 5th time at the resort. Everyone in our group is already planning next year's  return trip. Every member of the staff makes you feel welcome. The rooms are beautiful and very comfortable with great views of the pool and ocean. There is entertainment and a variety of activities from morning til evening hours. Each night we dined at a different restaurant. All served awesome food and we took may pictures of the presentation. We will be back!

reviews.author: Steve L
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: Room was very nice. Only thing was the shower was difficult to figure how to turn on and get the correct temperature. Beach was gorgeous. Overall resort was too. Staff friendly and helpful. Our concierge Francisco was very good. We were a little disappointed that we weren’t able to try the Italian restaurant.

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! Rooms are modern and clean. The pool area is beautiful and tons of places to lay out in the pool/beach area. Do recommend doing the reserve for the easiest experience- Emanuel did a great job planning our trips and restaurant reservations for the week. I also recommend doing those when you get there as the restaurants do seem to book up fast.

reviews.author: Nathan E
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real- Good food, friendly people
reviews.text: The food was the best we’ve had at an all inclusive and the room was extremely clean! Everyone was friendly and it was a great atmosphere.  Emmanuel was our butler and he made reservations for dinner and navigation around the resort extremely easy!

reviews.author: Mauro Eligio A
reviews.title: Excelente Atencion .....................................................................................................
reviews.text: La estancia fue perfecta, la atencion de Samaria muy puntual y atenta, el servicio estuvo excelente y muy serviciales ......................................................................................................

reviews.author: thtgrl68
reviews.title: Great service and very friendly
reviews.text: First stop was the Ginger Bar, Staff there was amazing. Ismael, Antonio, Dominga,Maria,Francesca, and Clary were all so friendly. We will definitely stop here for more amazing drinks.  They were all very informative about their surroundings and the resort. My friend and I all had a great time there.

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: Friends vacation
reviews.text: The service was great! Antonio, Ismael, Dominga, Maria, Clara were fantastic. They were fast and so helpful. I will visit again! Highly recommend. Ginger bar was amazing! Thank you to the staff and the atmosphere was fantastic! Cheers to all of you!

reviews.author: Gail G
reviews.title: Very Clean nice resort
reviews.text:
16 of us went down Jan 13th. This hotel is very clean and the rooms very nice. You want a spot on the beach and someone to look after you, Padreo is the best, such a kind, friendly hard working man. Our Conceirge Basilio was very good at arranging our bookings for dinner and letting us know our activities for the day. Now one thing this resort unfortunately is lacking  is a night life.  They have music in the courtyard but no real show per say.  One night at Gingers there was a girl singer and she was amazing. She had the whole place rocking, unfortunately she did not last long. Then you would hear there was a karaoke party at 11:30 in the sports bar…well that is too late. They should start it at 8 or 9.
Buffet lots of variety and good just food does not taste hot unless you go to a cooking station. Buffet near pool much better. Speciality restaurants…Italian, seafood, steak house and sports bar good, others not so good. The one that serves local food…service absolutely awful. Almost 2 hours in there.  With some small tweaks…food, service in some specialty restaurants and better nightly entertainment this could be the number 1 spot to go to.  I have been to many places in Punta Cana and this does rate up there.

reviews.author: Sightseer46471715726
reviews.title: Un site merveilleux !!!
reviews.text:
Un site merveilleux d’une beauté exceptionnelle. 
Les chambres sont d’une propreté sans reproche. Lit super confortable. La plage est très belle pour aller marcher et nous ne manquons jamais de chaises. La bouffe est très bonne et les restaurants à la carte sont excellents.
Une mention spéciale à Jean Carlos pour son service exceptionnel au restaurant. Toujours avec le sourire, il fait tout pour répondre à nos demandes pour toujours bien nous servir. Un serveur d’exception. 
Prendre l’apéro au lobby avec de la belle musique débute bien notre soirée.
Un site merveilleux !!!
Des vacances de rêve !!!

reviews.author: Frank P
reviews.title: Excelente lugar
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio las señoritas muy guapa, Jose del Rosario me atendió y super amable.
La comida excelente, la cerveza buen fría y el ambiente del lugar está  muy bien.
La música excelente y las temáticas que manejan son de lo mejor  me la pase muy bien con mis amigos

reviews.author: Donna F
reviews.title: Punta Cana 2025
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and well laid out. The property is very clean and beaches are well kept and nice for walking. The food is average for an all inclusive but overall good. Making reservations for the restaurants was frustrating because you could only book 2 days at a time and to try to get in at 7 was near impossible although when you walked by the restaurants at that time they were basically empty? The adult pool was lovely and quiet which was nice after spending a couple of days at the main pool where all of the activities were happening and very loud music! It’s great to have both options. The adult only buffet was closed the entire time we were there which didn’t make sense as we were told the resort was at 85% capacity? Getting chairs around the pools was no problem at all, there were always plenty of them empty. Entertainment in the evenings was good but they could turn the volume down as you couldn’t hear yourself think while it was on.

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.title: Great place to relax! This was a great vacation! Long review.
reviews.text:
We just returned from a trip to Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. We used Best punta cana tours for our transportation to and from the airport. They were great. No issues. 

We stayed at the Paradisius Palma Real - Reserve, the adult section. We booked the presidential suite that had two bedrooms and was right on the beach. We thought it was a ground floor suite but it ended up being on the third floor. It was still a great view. We had a concierge, Alvaro, that helped us with everything from restaurant bookings, excursions, room stock customizations, even seats at the beach. He was always available and very quick to respond.  

When we arrived, we went to the Reserve only reception area. It was stocked with drinks and snacks. While there, we received a bracelet that served as our room key. I love this as I didn't want to keep up with a room key the whole time. As for the room, the suite had 2 bedrooms, one with 2 full beds and one with a king. There was also a living room in between the rooms with an additional bathroom with a stand up shower. It would have been nice if there was a tv in there because the guys wanted to watch the playoffs that were happening while on vacation. In the king sized room, the bathroom and closet were very spacious. There was also a living room type setup with a tv in there, which is where we spent the late nights watching football and playing games. The second room with the 2 beds was definitely smaller in the bathroom and the closet wasn't in the room, which was odd. You had to go out in the shared space to access the closet. The rooms were great but the bedding could be way better. The mattresses and pillows were hard. Honestly, the lounge chairs outside by the beach were comfier. The balcony was huge. It had rocking chairs, lounge chairs and a shallow hot tub. The room was stocked with vodka, rum, whiskey, wine, beer, sodas, water and some snacks daily. The concierge made sure we had just what we wanted. They even did a couple of charcuterie type welcome when we arrived and a fruit plate another night. We received a beach bag, robes and house shoes in our room which we all loved! The WiFi in our room was good. It worked in many areas of the resort as well. So, that was a plus. Also, I feel like the map is a bit deceiving. We were worried everything wasn’t within walking distance from the reserve but it is. We didn’t venture past the plaza where all of the restaurants are though. Beach, pools, restaurants, coffee, bars, towels are all relatively close. 

We booked a snorkeling excursion with Hello Catamaran Punta Cana with Jiro and Nine. They were great!! It was a good time. 

We fell in love with the Palapas. They provide the ultimate shade when you want it. We were able to have one at the beach with the very comfy layout beds. The crew did a wonderful job at cleaning the seaweed at the resort. The swim area in the ocean was really big compared to other resorts I saw. The beach is definitely a huge win for this resort! 
The pool is really big and has a swim up bar on one side. There is also a pool in the Reserve section. We didn't spend a lot of time at the pools though because the water was freezing!!! 

Our concierge sent us an activities schedule each day, which was so nice. The resort had some type of entertainment, whether a band or dj every night in the open area. It was hit or miss but still enjoyable. It’s so nice to have music and something to do. They had a silent party one night where everyone got headphones and listened to music that way. It was really fun to see everyone dancing but hearing nothing as you walked by. 

The resort had some type of craft or experience each day. My friend and I attended a hat painting and a macrame craft. The crafts we attended were led by Brandol and he was wonderful. Both sessions we attended were really fun and it's fun to have a reminder of our trip. 

Now, for the food. 
We ate mainly at Sante for breakfast. They have both a menu and a smaller buffet. Then, for lunch, we ate at the big buffet at Kanna. They have so many options it can be overwhelming. Just remember that it's not all seasoned well and it's not very hot. I enjoyed the pasta station the best since he seasoned it as he cooked and it was really hot. We did visit Ginger, the coffee bar, quite a bit for a cappuccino and a sweet treat. The pound cake was delicious! We never ordered room service or ate at Kicks, the sport bar, so I can't speak to those. 
We ate at all of the restaurant but Mina, the steak house. Since, we're from Texas and eat a lot of great steak, we decided we could skip this one. Our first night, we ate at Sante. It was ok. Sante is definitely the least busy restaurant on the site. Per my friend, try the octopus. He said it's delicious. I personally loved the mixed vegetables they served. I could eat those every day. 
The next night, we ate at Flora, the Dominican restaurant by Chef Leandro Diaz. Everything was really good. This was probably our favorite of all of the restaurants. Everything was really flavorful. We each ordered an appetizer and shared all of them so we could taste it all. I thought my spicy short ribs were the best but I am biased. 
Blue Agave was next with mexican food. The guacamole was so good. I think the tacos with shredded meat or the burrito was the best on the menu. The rest could have used some additional seasoning. 
Mascalzones is Anotnia Lofaso's italian restaurant. It was all very tasty. We had the lasagna, fettucine alfredo and the quatro formagio calzone. The tiramisù was very good.
Tokimeku Habachi was really fun. We did the hibachi and the chef was great. It was tons of food, probably the largest servings of our whole stay and it was all delicious. It was fun to sit next to other guests and talk. The only recommendation for this is to have a paper menu. Our waitress really struggled to communicate the different options and had to repeat everything multiple times as her English wasn't very good. 

If you want to shop, beware! The sales people at the markets are very aggressive. They will approach you on the beach and offer you cheapie cheapie. If you aren't a negotiator, expect to pay more. Likely more than the item is worth. I personally suck at this so I'd almost rather shop at the airport to avoid this. 

Overall, it was a great vacation that went by way too fast. I'd book again at the Paradisius Palma Real. You can't go wrong with Alvaro. He was wonderful!

reviews.author: Excursion770719
reviews.title: Very restful
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Paradisus. We stay for a full 7 days. It was very quiet and relaxing. We stayed in the adult section and we had the premium service. Because the resort was in between the shoulder and the high season we had the concierge to ourselves. The beach was wonderful the palapas were plentiful and it wasn't very crowded. Typical restaurant fare. Best restaurant was Sante for lunch and dinner. Best breakfast was at the buffet.

reviews.author: B D
reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text:
Have been coming here for many years with 7 other guys for a week of golf. This place has gone seriously downhill and we will be looking for another location next year
Arrived on Monday and found my room had no working bar fridge and no AC. Reported it to the concierge and as of Thursday still no change and no one follows up too let you know what’s going on.
Fees for the golf course have gone up way higher than warranted for a course of its caliber ( mediocre) and the golf carts are well beyond their life cycle. One of our carts died on the 3rd hole today.
For what this place costs these days you’d be better to look elsewhere!

reviews.author: S B
reviews.title: Great vacation but Circle Membership needs to be honoured
reviews.text:
As Circle members, who have been coming to the DR for the last 15 years, we ended up having a great week for our first time at Palma Real.

The kids loved the action and activities. The food was excellent. The selection of wine and liquor for Circle members was outstanding. The resort does a great job with entertainment. Brandol and the boys were so fun encouraging dancing and activities. 

Our concierge, Analeya was very good. The gifts in our room was lovely. 
Vanessa at the Members Circle bar was very attentive.
Jose at Brisas was great too. 
Our favourite Jose Remirez at the front is so awesome! 

Unfortunately our check in was the worst we have ever experienced as Members. We loved our stay and appreciate the help Manager Gladys Batista provided us. However Melia needs to really care for their members, especially Circle, and improve the check in process. Not the best way to start but in the end the place was outstanding!

reviews.author: Reinena D
reviews.title: The servers and the beach make your vacation wonderful
reviews.text:
The beach is beautiful. Even on rainy days, it was very relaxing at the resort. If you come in a rainy season (like December), skid-free shoes are very helpful because most of the resort is open to the elements and the flooring is very slippery when wet.

The servers are tremendously attentive. Yafreisy and Yessica in the Lunch Box buffet are very pleasant and their service is  excellent! It was a pleasure to sit in their section at breakfast and lunch because they are friendly and accommodating. Gold stars are also due for Manuel, Ricky, Marya and Maira in Lunch Box! We enjoyed chatting briefly with them when they came to our table. Their interactions with us made us feel at home among friends.  Juan at Santé and Manuel at Mina are  great, too! They willingly gave recommendations for our meal that were delicious and their service is what you expect at a fine dining restaurant. 

We can’t forget the Activities staff. The dance classes are fun. The staff member who led the Mama Juana experience (Dec 19) and the Ceviche and Margarita experience (Dec 20) was great! He made sure everyone enjoyed themselves.

reviews.author: Kerry W
reviews.title: 3 night getaway
reviews.text: Great stay.  Rooms updated and very nice.  Staff super nice throughout.  Christopher, concierge in Reserve, was awesome!  You’ll be lucky to get him.  Food outlets very nice, good selections and no issues getting in.  Plenty of pool chairs, no need to run down early to save a chair. Beach nice, a few chairs need replacement.

reviews.author: lcpmiguel2021
reviews.title: agradable la estancia
reviews.text: muy buena ubicación para estar en la playa está un poco descuidado el hotel, no dan snack en la playa, la playa limpia, vigilada, tranquila, segura, los echaderos cómodos, algunas áreas del hotel descuidadas sobre todo el área que no es THE RESERVE

reviews.author: Zibouil
reviews.title: Great infrastructure but all the rest is average!!
reviews.text:
Wonderful hotel with comfortable rooms, several pools and enough sun beds, nice prepared beach but that all doesn't compensate the quality of service which isn't what it should be in a 5* hotel.

Restaurant reservations are very difficult and very badly organised internally.
Concierge service is very poor compared to other places in the region.
Food is average in all of the restaurants available.

Customers are mainly Americans or Canadians, anyway the English level of all the staff is very very low.
Great advantage if you expect a good quality of service: speaking Spanish!!

Worse part: if any of the concierges suggest you to take part at a presentation of the hotel and its advantages, just send him to Hell!
It's just a very bad manner to get you to lose some of your holiday time and try to get you to become a member of their "Melia Circle" what will cost you much more money than they tell you.

We had a good time because the staff was mainly very nice but I wouldn't go again.

reviews.author: FarAway24121306704
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real... Fantastic
reviews.text: Such a beautiful hotel.  Everything was just perfect.  Food was great, accomodation fantastic and can't say more for the staff.  I have never been at a resort where the staff were so engaged, efficient and caring.  For the most part our personal concierge, Eriol, made everything so easy and effortless.  We were two ladies travelling alone...thanks to eriol we always felt safe.  He checked on us constantly and made all our reservations without asking.  He provided us with lots of water and was always there via WhatsApp if he was at the hotel or not.  It was a very effortless vacation thanks to Eriol. Can't say enough.  He is a true gem to the Melia group.   Hope to come back to this stunning hotel soon.

reviews.author: Ruby M
reviews.title: Very high caliber all inclusive!
reviews.text: We were here for a long weekend girls trip and the whole trip was nothing short of amazing! The facilities are very well kept and beautiful. The beach is calm and clean. The service and food were fantastic. The spa was one of the most relaxing ones I’ve been to. But the best part was our concierge Basilio. He took amazing care of us, paying attention to every detail and very responsive to all our answers and requests. Would highly recommend coming here and asking specifically for Basilio ☺️

reviews.author: 305sallieg
reviews.title: A Great Time to Visit
reviews.text: It was my first trip to the DR. I loved the resort. Very open to the sea breeze. Lots of variety on restaurants. Entertainment every night. The rooms were spacious and comfortable. We were assigned our very own assistant who we could contact at any time. Great service throughout. Very relaxing trip!

reviews.author: NATALIA C
reviews.title: Hotel perfeito em tudo
reviews.text: Hotel impecável. Tivemos uma experiência perfeita, Franklyn nos recepcionou muito bem, tirou todas nossas dúvidas, e nos orientou em tudo. Ótimas opções de restaurantes e comidas. Na praia a água é uma delícia e eles limpam todos os dias.

reviews.author: Emma G
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Excellent service in blue agave! The staff was phenomenal and warm! Laura and Alexander Bryan were excellent!!!!!!!!! The food had great Taste! They went out of their way to help set up a birthday suprise with great detail and attentation!

reviews.author: Jessie B
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Thank you to my butler Franklyn for making it possible to check in and out with ease! Also Franklyn sent the daily activities which is so useful. I loved the variety of pools and places to relax. I recommend the reserve section of Palma Real resort.

reviews.author: Alexia C
reviews.title: Beautiful setting for a wedding!
reviews.text: We had an incredible time at this hotel. We were here for a friend’s wedding and they took such good care of all the wedding guests. It was also my first time at an all inclusive and it exceeded expectations. Just a heads up to book the restaurants for dinner beforehand if you don’t fancy the buffet every night! Special shout out to Carlos and Wily on the front desk who were so helpful with every query we had!

reviews.author: John R
reviews.title: Paradisus in Paradise.
reviews.text:
Such an amazing resort and experience. From a foodie aspect it was well worth it. I highly recommend upgrading to the reserve rooms, if it’s an adult trip. The adults only side of the resort is spectacular. Sante is a restaurant for the upgraded adult side of the resort. Same with the reserve beach area and bars.

Our concierge Emmanuel Nosotro was an amazing blessing. We were unaware of this before checking in. After we met Emmanuel we wanted for not as he took care of everything. Every morning he sent the event schedule for the day and every night as what the next days reservations were and booked them according. From fishing to the the ladies wanting to go to shopping her handled everything, above expectation. 

This was our first time here but not our last. The staff, the food, the location, the beauty of the resort, and on and on, made it worth the flight from California to here. Can’t wait to return, already planning the trip.

reviews.author: krista s
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: When we arrived expecting a junior suite, king bed, ocean front/hot tub for my Birthday vacation. They put us in a double bed suite with partial ocean view. Anyela at front desk was great! She wanted to make us happy and moved us to a room with a king bed and beautiful view. She was very helpful all week! She made my experience great! Everyone was so nice! The resort is beautiful!

reviews.author: Carinette B
reviews.title: Quelles belles vacances!!!
reviews.text:
Superbe hôtel , service A1 et mentions spécial à Wander au resto de plage KANNU ainsi qu’au Mina . Nous avons été reçu comme la famille , avons même eu droit à des leçons d’espagnol . Cette hôtel porte bien  son nom , Paradisus!!!!

Le seule critère que j’aurai à dire , système de réservation pour les restos à la carte , en 2024 et avec la prestance de cet hôtel , ça ne devrait plus exister .

reviews.author: chema
reviews.title: El mejor hotel del Caribe, sin duda.
reviews.text: Sin duda el mejor hotel del Caribe. Habitaciones impecables, la comida, excelente, servicio de limpieza espectacular. Atención del personal, maravillosa. La playa, muy limpia. Spa impecable.  Y el conserje, Basilio, muy atento y eficiente.

reviews.author: worldexperttraveler

reviews.author: Margarita C
reviews.title: Home again with my Melia Family!
reviews.text: We just returned from a week’s vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. This was a return visit for us. We stayed on the adults only Reserva section. Our concierge Zenovia greeted us with open arms, “welcome back family.”This is the hardest working woman I have met. She absolutely took care of everything for us (dinner reservations, special requests and constantly checking in with us). In her few days off Christian took over. What an amazing young man. He did an amazing job on fulfilling our requests. Also, the Reserva side has an inclusive restaurant for us Sante. All of the staff there (breakfast, lunch & dinner) were so professional and kind. They recognized us from last year. The a la carte restaurants were fabulous, some better than others but we definitely noticed some big changes in food items. Now the beach service..what can I say a true paradise. From the beach beds yes I said beds to the butler service. The staff that I must mention are Raphael, Pedro and Martin and also the bartender (forgot his name). You want luxury and top service book Reserva. These men worked tirelessly all day without a flinch. Always smiling and constantly refilling drinks which they remember by heart. Their kindness is next to none. Also treated myself to a massage and all I can say is Gladys you have some magic hands! Best massage ever! This is definitely my go to vacation spot. Thank you for the perfect vacation it takes a team effort to make a whole experience happen. Hasta luego till next year!

reviews.author: Rossana Gonzalez
reviews.title: Very good experience!
reviews.text:
7 night stay
Suite junior garden view
Service - bars, coffees,restaurant ( lunch box and malva) excellent! Very helpful team. During my stay Edito, Edisson and Broxny .. among others made our stay like home. Luis at pool bar made q great difference as well.
Food quality- not the best compare with similar type of hotels.
Opportunities for improvement: desserts… lack of typical things such as avocado or mango.
Tematic restaurants average food… good service.
Room- very nice! Coffee, mini bar all included 
Gym great! Open 6 to 8 pm
Pool- adult are was not always respected and kids were playing around disrupting daily activities. Very good 1230 adult pool fitness activities ( jumping, spinning, hit, paddle)
Very good pool towel service.
Beach, while is very nice could be cleaner.
Night activities— good live music, silent disco and others!
Free shop and store convenient prices.
Something to highlight we weren’t chased by hotel promoters neither to upgrade nor to sell offers !!! THANKS!!
Overall very good experience! Thank to the bar and dinning room personnel to make our stay great!!!

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text:
We first came here on an RCI trade and we loved it so much we bought in. I was skeptical about all inclusive resorts but never on e have I ever felt that there was ever any compromise on the facilities, the food, drink, service or entertainment. It is all outstanding and we are proud to bring friends and family here. The people are charming, friendly and professional. We feel particularly safe here and the other guests are also courteous and friendly.
This trip we have had 2 out of 2 great dining experiences. We loved the restaurant Sante- and Elvis, the sommelier helped us pick outstanding wines which he decanted at our table. The next night was at Flora and we really enjoyed the outstanding Dominican cuisine. Upon being seated they brought us appetizers- even before we ordered any. For mains we had short rib and a flavorful steak dish I can neither remember or pronounce. The short rib was the best I ever tasted. The steak was amazing as well- it had peppers, onions and chopped jalepeno with it. Our sommelier also decanted  our wine for us. They brought a tray full of desserts over after dinner. We weren’t rushed at all and after dinner we were so happy we called the manager, Eduardo over so we could tell him how satisfied we were with the food and the service that we received frim Francesca and her team!  Thanks Paradisius Palma Real! What an operation here!

reviews.author: Danielle W
reviews.title: 4 star review
reviews.text: Let me start by saying I had a lot of fun! This place is huge and very pretty. There are a couple pools to choose from and the bartenders at the pool were super nice. The hibachi restaurant and Flora were really good! The people in our group that ate the fish at the Italian restaurant were disappointed and ended up having to go to the buffet for dinner. Mina was good as well but we almost didn’t get to eat there. I confirmed our reservation with 3 people but the host and another employee insisted I didn’t have a reservation. I had to show proof multiple times and they were still convinced I was wrong. The older male employee was very rude even though they had a private room that was not being used at the time. The female manager came in and saved the day. We ate family style and it was great. Now the cons: I saw multiple cockroaches on the property. All in the hallways and lobby and not in the rooms or restaurant thank goodness. I had a swim up room at the reserve. It’s not a real swim up. The pool is about 30 feet from the patio and you share it with the other 5-6 rooms in your building and the pool closes at 6pm. If you pay extra for the swim up you should be able to use it until at least 10. Quite a few waiters & waitress will approach you while you are eating and ask you to scan a QR code and write a review. They will literally stand over your shoulder, press 5 stars on your phone for you and wait for you to write the review. It’s rude and awkward. I appreciate the room service but the menu is very limited. Last, of course the more you tip the employees the better service and more alcohol you get.

reviews.title: Excelente cena, un rato inolvidable bajo el servicio de Milton, en un ambiente de gran camaradería!

El hotel tiene maravillosas instalaciones, los restaurantes excelentes y los miembros del staff súper preocupados por atender a todos! Volveremos seguro!

reviews.author: girlfromSC
reviews.title: Excellent Group Holiday
reviews.text:
We’ve just departed Palma Real and it’s been a wonderful six night stay. Overall I’d highly recommend the place and I’m not sure why there are so many negative reviews. 
We booked two Nikte swim-up junior suites, one Nikte swim-up master suite, and one Reserve garden suite. The rooms were great, very clean and comfortable, with good air conditioning and convenient cleaning. The swim-up rooms were fantastic for the 4 under-5’s we had with us, and we managed to be all in a row which was so great for hanging out during the day. I didn’t go to the Reserve room but my mom and aunt enjoyed the quiet it afforded them when they needed an escape from 4 little boys. 
The minibar was restocked regularly with treats for kids and adults, and if you happened to be in the room when your attendant came round, you could make sure they knew your preferences. 
One thing that was slightly disappointing was the lack of Nikte toys and decor for the children. I’ve stayed at other Paradisus with Nikte where they set up a tepee and had Meliã toys for them. Also the concierge situation is a bit of luck. Ours was pretty useless despite us tipping and not asking for much, but we had other excellent staff members that made up for it. We didn’t speak to him after day 3 because it was pointless. I think they’d benefit from centralised concierge service managed through WhatsApp, which is how at least one other Paradisus I’ve been to does theirs. It’s quicker and more efficient and responsive, though you might not get as much personal interaction. 
With a swim-up room we had a great pool right outside the door, and there was regular drink service. Edickson was fabulous and took great care of us. 
The main pool was lovely and we managed to get a Bali bed one day without going out super early. We also really enjoyed the beach and spent several mornings in the sea. 
Restaurants were generally good with a couple very good. Mina (chicken josper was amazing) and Mascalzone were our favourites but we also had Tokimeku and Blue Agave (shrimp tacos are 10/10!). Great service, though one night was inexplicably slow but as a group of 11 that’s maybe not unexpected. Edito (kinda everywhere) and Alexander (Mina) were wonderful and our boys were in love with them. Breakfast was tasty and didn’t disappoint, except we had fantastic chilaquiles one day and they never made it back into the buffet rotation… the fried egg tostadas were a suitable substitute. Ricki always took great care of us on a morning. 
We typically had Kanna for lunch and though the options were limited, we still enjoyed it. Room service was also a limited menu but very handy for kids lunches. 
We did quite a lot of activities as well: macrame, artisan crafts, soap making, mamajuana tasting… all were great fun and well run. Brandol was helpful and let us know where things would be happening. We didn’t get to do the off-site activity as it’s not available for under 5’s. I wish we’d known before arrival because we were really looking forward to it. 
Would we come again? Maybe, though it’s quite a trek from the U.K.  That said, I’d 100% recommend it to anyone who wanted a nice holiday.

I’ve stayed at multiple Paradisus properties and this is by far the most stunning. This resort is located right on the beach & has multiple restaurants and pools for your choosing. Given that this is an all-inclusive, the food was pretty decent. My favorite was Flora.

Attached are pics.

reviews.author: Matt M
reviews.title: Clean, great staff, beautiful, good food
reviews.text:
We booked through Costco Travel, along with two other families. I highly recommend this method. 

We had two concierge’s serving our group of 4 rooms. They were Ariel and Willy. Both were absolutely amazing!  Ariel would message me every morning with the event schedule of the day, so we always knew what we could participate in. The guys also made our dinner and excursion reservations for our group, which made this a hassle free vacation. They even arranged bag pick-up when it was time to leave. 

The resort itself is beautiful. We had the Nikte Swim Up Master Suite. It was worth the upgrade price. Our teen son slept on the pull-out in the living room and we had a king bed in the master.  

The entire staff was very friendly and there was constant upkeep being done. It was not distracting, just an observation. The entire property and buildings were spotless at all times. 

The buffet food was typical for breakfast. They cater to many cultures, so the variety is excellent. We only had one evening dinner there, but it was excellent and included fresh lobster tail. 

The other restaurants were excellent!  We were there. Week, so we tried everything. Great service at all. My favorite was the steak house and Jesus, our server. 

The resort is quite large, yet did not feel crowded. It was a mix of young families up to older couples. There were quite a few young children, but there are adult only areas if you do not want to day-drink around the pool with kids around. Note that the drinking age is 18 there, so you might see young adults with a drink. We did not witness any out of control partying though. 

We had 4 teenage (hs seniors) in our group and 3 dads who golfed multiple times. It was a very easy shuttle on the property to get to the clubhouse. Friendly staff at the course. The course itself is beautiful, but the greens are not great. If you are a very serious golfer, go with an open mind and be prepared for a few terrible greens.  Also, the course has a mix of family homes and mini vacation complexes on it. There are people constantly walking the cart path (more so on the weekends). 

Bring lots of tip money!  $1, $2, $5 get used a lot!!  If we were sitting poolside for a long period, we just tipped the servers big  ($20-$50) to start and then didn’t worry the rest of the day. 

Overall, we had a great time with friends and the resort was wonderful. Would definitely recommend and we plan to visit again.

reviews.author: 123govacation

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Edna T
reviews.title: An Amazing Trip on PC, DR.
reviews.text:
Our bedroom and bathroom was very clean and comfortable.  The restaurants were great, loved the food we were served. The pool was very clean and surrounded decks great. Our spa experience was relaxing and staff caring and well trained. 
Wolfen our concierge 
 was an amazing man who took care of everything for us. Very responsive and caring of our stay being excellent! He was very professional and knowledgeable of all the Resort and area.

reviews.author: Michael O
reviews.title: Beware - overcharging
reviews.text:
I rarely submit reviews unless I've had a fantastic or an abysmal experience. In this case it's the latter. The resort itself is very beautiful and in general the staff are helpful and pleasant. I stayed there from 7th-12th March, along with my wife and 12 other friends. We booked dining rooms for three of the nights we were there and purchased wines for 2 birthday celebrations. When I was checking out I discovered that they had significantly overcharged us for the wine (by about $1600). We discovered this just 1 hour before we were due to go to the airport. It took 5 different people / manager to partly resolve some of the overcharging, still leaving us with $450 overcharge. We had to leave it to our friends (who were leaving a day later) to sort out the rest. They believed they had resolved it, and the hotel indicated that I needed to contact them to finalize the refund. I did contact them multiple times with all the details with no response. We remain $450 poorer for our experience.. So if you do stay at this resort, I would offer the following advice.
1.	If you purchase wine, at the end of dinner, take a photo of the empty bottle consumed – you will need this when/if you have to dispute some overcharge.
2.	Check you bill the day prior to departure, or at a minimum, 3-4 hours prior to departure, as you will need that much time to argue your case. I had to argue our case to 4-5 different people behind the front desk before we got any satisfaction.
3.	If you traveled with a group of friends, have all of them check their bills a day before departure, as we found that the waiters had charged 2 rooms for the same wine!

reviews.author: jessicalbenson
reviews.title: Spring Break Girls Week Away---For Rest and Relaxation.  SUCCESS!
reviews.text: What an amazing week full of fun, sun, laughs and delicious food.  We loved the NITKE swim up suite which was perfect for the R and R that we needed.  We had a GREAT Concierge, Wolfan, who was excellent at his job and helped us with everything we asked of him!  We had an absolute wonderful girls week!!!!

I will definitely return soon

reviews.author: Jenna Schulte
reviews.title: Glorious.
reviews.text: It was very good food and service, Bernarde and Milton were very nice and accommodating to us. Had a big nice smile and were very attentive! Perfecto! The food was great and they did such a nice job. Asking about drinks we wanted explaining the food.

reviews.author: Ashley L
reviews.title: Great customer service and beautiful resort
reviews.text: It is a very beautiful resort to stay in. The beach and hotel grounds are amazing and a very nice hotel room. The stand out here is the customer service. My concierge Tomas was amazing, very attentive and helpful the entire trip. Took care of booking the restaurants for dinner and really went above and beyond my expectations. It allowed us to just enjoy the vacation with no work on our part. We also had a beach concierge Argenis who gave awesome service all week on the beach and took care of our drinks and remembered us everytime we came back. These smaller things make a huge difference in making a great trip. The entertainment at night was fun and different each evening. All around relaxing and beautiful place to stay. Would go back!

reviews.author: anthony m
reviews.title: Excellent ambiance
reviews.text: Food and service was excellent, many thanks to Cesar for being so attentive. The air conditioning is just right and the restaurant looks bright and new with an amazing selection of drinks. Glenys was our server and pulled out all the stops to make our evening special. 👌

reviews.author: charlenebrooks
reviews.title: Disappointed.
reviews.text:
I have been vacationing at this hotel every year since  2008.
This is the first time I’ve had a bad experience in all the years that I’ve been vacationing here. I’ve brought friends with me to show them what an exceptional, high quality resort with excellent customer service, and amenities is like in Punta Cana.at this resort. However, my visit this week has been terrible. I understand there was o major renovations, but that does not excuse the lack of customer service,  the lack of information regarding the different levels of service etc. (no more flamingos, so sad.). Dining has never been a problem in the past however, dining at the property this week  (post pandemic) was very disappointing. The beach is always the best part of this property. Unfortunately, I will not be returning to my beloved favorite vacation resort.
Best wishes and good luck!

Loyal Club Meliá vacationer

reviews.author: Kelly B
reviews.title: Lovely stay
reviews.text: Would like to rank this at 4.5 stars if that was an option. The resort grounds are beautiful, well-maintained and clean. The beach was by far the best beach in the area. Buffet food was as expected and sometimes really good. All of the restaurants with reservations needed were very good and accommodating for a party of 2. We had some issues with our room and had to change, but Eduardo at the front desk was very helpful. We had the pleasure of having Adriel the butler assist us in our room issues and making reservation. He went above and beyond to make sure we had a great stay and my friend had a special birthday. The facial at the spa was heavenly and I wish I remembered the name of the woman who did it- she had amazing hands. We appreciated the adults only pool and the music played there every day. Pro tip- pack sunscreen or wander offsite to buy some. It is $30+ at the resort.

reviews.text: We booked a four day stay with them this would be our second time at resort as we were extremely pleased the first time , this time we encountered some difficulties BUT the resort made up for it with a welcome back offer and a upgraded visit to our expectations over all the resort and the GM  Richard Sanchez was a great resource and restored our confidence in the brand and the staff that work very hard to please it’s guests

reviews.author: Erica C
reviews.title: 7 days in paradise
reviews.text: My friend and I were gifted a 5 night stay at the Paradisus after coming last year and decided to add an extra night. To say this trip was unmatched is an understatement. From the moment we arrived at the resort we were immediately taken care of. We stayed in a junior suite in the reserve section. We are both teachers so having a quiet area to relax over vacation was exactly what we were looking for. We were checked in and greeted by Alvaro. He took care of us our entire stay, making sure we got everything we needed from reservations to a late checkout. We were also taken care of on the beach. Martin made sure each morning our chairs were saved for us.  We have made many friends during our stay and hope to see them here again.  We couldn’t have asked for a better 6 nights here and are sad to go. If you are staying in the reserve I highly suggest requesting Alvaro if possible. He was absolutely wonderful.

reviews.author: Tamiko G
reviews.title: Good and great
reviews.text: Trip was nice. Room was beautiful, clean and turn down service was a nightly surprise; which l loved. The only issue was making dinner reservations if you don’t have a concierge. We had a concierge with Delta vacation, we just did not meet h until the next day, when we were under the impression we would connect the first day; which resulted in undo first day stressors. Would love to have food service poolside and on the beach, they do not do this. Breakfast options other than the buffet were missing. Buffet was fine but got boring real quick! Also night time entertainment was not my thing, but they can’t appeal to everyone. Overall, I give it a good rating. We had a great time. I do recommend!

reviews.author: Happiness742831
reviews.title: Authentic assessment
reviews.text:
The place is beautiful. The view is spectacular. The rooms are nice and the people are nice, but I wouldn’t return to the hotel. We had a very long day of travel and when we got to the hotel it was around 7:30pm. 

They gave me the contact to our direct concierge but didn’t provide any details about what they do for you. A gentleman walked with us to our room with our luggage cart where we learned none of our keys work, and neither did his master key. He called somebody. We thought it would be a five minute wait. He called six more times, and around the hour mark, somebody came to change the battery out to our door so the keys worked. We were tired, sweaty and hungry. If that’s the worst part of trip-then no big deal. He was a trooper though, he didn’t leave us and his tip was well deserved.  

Most employees only speak Spanish which I respect so we used Google translate, but my two friends spoke much better Spanish and that helped. 

Somebody said we needed reservations at all restaurants so I texted our concierge, and asked if he could just schedule us each night at a new restaurant and have a two hour time frame to pick from and the five restaurants that interested us. He could only do one day at a time so I had to message him every morning at 9am. I asked if he could get us beach chairs. He couldn’t but he didn’t say which chairs we could or couldn’t sit in so we learned that quickly being asked to move from front row. He then spent the next two days asking where I was so he could meet us. I’d tell him, and the get a text he couldn’t make it but where were we now. That was two full days of texted every few hours. I finally met him, but he didn’t really offer anything I hadn’t figured out by then. 

The drinks were great. The food is okay, but kinda of expect that at an all-inclusive.
 
The beach: the water and sand are perfect. However, the locals walk up to you nonstop while lounging on resort beah chairs  all day to buy their things. First few times saying no thanks was no big deal. Saying it all day took away from experience. Setup a place where if we want to buy, we can go there and buy but putting animals on your shoulder behind you while reading isn’t welcomed. 

Massage-recommend. Amazing!

Lastly, the nonstop asks for Google reviews. This is not the employees fault. They clearly get rewarded financially for five star reviews so you do it. This is why there are so many five star reviews. They hand you the paper to scan and it takes you to a review where they put 5 stars for each category and then ask you to write a review and give you their name and often manager’s name. It’s a 200 word minimum required for each. Once done, they take your phone, take pic of review and submit it. This is the servers at pool, beach, restaurants and bars. 

Oh and bring lots of cash for tipping. I’m glad I brought a bit extra this trip not knowing how they handle tipping, and that cash was needed. 

The pools are wonderful, plenty of space, lots of towels. Bathrooms are clean and the resort is clean. If you don’t mind everything else, it’s a beautiful view. The airport is also very efficient and easy to maneuver through Customs.

reviews.author: Norberto R. Magdalena
reviews.title: Paraíso perdido
reviews.text:
Hace 14 años estuve en este conjunto En total con mi visita reciente han sido cuatro veces que los visité. No recordaba haber tenido una experiencia tan mala como en esta oportunidad, el conjunto arquitectónico es estupendo muy hermoso un diseño muy bien logrado,  perfecto y con un mantenimiento excepcional. Las playas es lo que hay que esperar del Caribe, aguas templadas, claras y en esta época del año con tal vez un poco más de sargazo de lo deseable pero es la naturaleza y en Punta Cana todo muy bien con muchas actividades y buen servicio de los camareros de playa. 
Lo que este año me impresionó y me decepcionó y no regresaré sin investigarlo bien de qué se trata y qué me ofrecen a un “All inclusive” en el cual la calidad de la comida y de la bebida en los restaurantes nocturnos ha llegado a niveles tan bajos 
Excepto el Japones “a la plancha” el resto es comida impasable. 
El personal es muy simpático pero no pueden más porque el sistema los aplasta y tienen poca preparación de dialogar con los turistas
Además me impresionó en forma sumamente negativa estando en un país de habla española que lo primero que hacen es tratar de comunicarse en inglés cuando en realidad deberían empezar con el español y si el turista no lo entiende entonces cambiar a inglés, pero la transición es muy lenta Además intentaron durante tres horas venderme el producto Meliá Circle que es una especie de tiempo compartido y fue un tiempo perdido, es obvio que Melia lo que le interesa es beneficios pero lo que brinda al público que no está dentro de su círculo brinda muy poca calidad. Allí no volveré y repito investiguen los detalles del All inclusive antes de comprometerse y reservar

reviews.author: Dianne R
reviews.title: The Winery
reviews.text:
Tonight’s dinner at the  Winery was excellent. The servers go out of their way to make your experience special. They were happy to to honour our dietary restrictions. Both steaks were cooked to perfection. The salmon was delicious.One highlight was the outstanding red wine HESS Cabaret Sauvignon. All three of the servers who work here went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of beautifully. We also like the fact that you could order from any menu at any restaurant on the resort, and they are happy to produce it for you. It was worth paying extra to have a nice bottle of Californian Cabernet Sauvignon as opposed to the house wines offered.
Thank you to Jhonatan, Jonathan and Juan for your pleasant and caring service.

reviews.author: Debra C
reviews.title: Above and beyond service
reviews.text: Im staying at the Paradisus Palna Real.  I have unusual diet restrictions and the manager, Jhoel, the chef and Christian ( concierge) went above and beyond’s to care about, and address my diet restrictions.  They truly made me feel special. Mucho gracias!!

reviews.author: gportmann
reviews.title: Tolles Hotel, eine Reise wert. 👍💪
reviews.text: Grossartiges Hotel in traumhafter Umgebung. Personal ist sehr freundlich, die Restaurants und das Essen sehr gut. Tolle Pools und ein grosser Strandbereich vervollständigen das Ferienerlebnis. Die Guest Service Managerin Stefanie Castillo hat uns grossartig betreut. Ebenfalls Tolle Unterstützung erhielten wir von Juan Peña und Juan Carlos Lloret. Das Hotel hat eine tolle Management Crew. Man kann es in jeder Beziehung nur empfehlen.

reviews.author: John C
reviews.title: True to her name! Virtuous!!!
reviews.text: Virtudes, our waitress, was excellent in every facet of her service. She anticipated our needs and was professional and cheerful at all times. Her welcoming manner and joyful comments made our dinner a delight. We will certainly look for  her during our next visit.

reviews.author: Yousif g
reviews.title: Boys golf trip
reviews.text: We took our golf trip to DR this year and had Irvin Nolasco as our conceriege during our stay. He was very helpful to us and very pleasant to deal with. If you end up at this resort, I recommend you ask for Irvin for his knowledge of the city and the hospitality. Great resort, very clean and great staff

reviews.author: Julie M
reviews.title: Bien mais sans plus.
reviews.text:
Vieille hôtel qui a voulu se réinventer.  La qualité de la nourriture est très moyenne ,  le service … Ils sont tous très gentils  Mais sans la finesse  et le professionnalisme  D’un cinq étoiles . La chambre sent beaucoup l’humidité et l’air climatisé dans les chambres est bloqué à 22 degré. 
Je dois avouer  Que les lieux sont très propres  et que les lit sont vraiment très confortables . 
La section adulte est tranquille  et la piscine des Swim Out  Sont également très tranquille . 
Bien mais me sans plus.

reviews.author: KimmyArbo
reviews.title: Mina 1/20/24
reviews.text: Alex, and Jose at Mina were excellent. We appreciated their service! The ambiance was great and we had a delicious bottle of Joseph Phelps Cabernet Sauvignon. The steak knives could have been a tad sharper. The roasted potatoes were excellent.

reviews.author: carole k
reviews.title: Great experience on the beach l
reviews.text: Argenis was a gracious gost to my friends and i today on the beach. If you have a chance to stay here at the resort, request Argenis. He is attentive and funny and never forgets an order.  While he’s new to the job, his professionalism is superb. #recommend

reviews.author: CharlSal
reviews.title: Excellent Service!
reviews.text: Vanessa and Marilee are wonderful!  They took great care of us on the beach and at the pool. They are so happy and cheerful, always have a big smile and are so much fun to be around.   Our party of six were all very impressed with how they give great service.

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: Had an amazing time here!! The best!!
reviews.text: We've been to other all inclusive in punta cana before and this resort is truly a cut above the rest. The service is spectacular the food and restaurants are great. We got the Nikte swim up room which was totally worth it. The beach is white sands and blue waters. You will not be disappointed if you go here. Thank you for an amazing experience.

reviews.author: Jesus S
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio y atención. Siempre dispuestos a resolver tus dudas. 
Fue una cena divertida con el chef Víctor, super ameno y lleno de risas.

Definitivamente recomendado si quieres pasar unas increíbles vacaciones en familia, amigos o pareja.

reviews.author: robert_vc86
reviews.title: Asian restaurant
reviews.text:
Muy buena atención y experiencia. Ambiente divertido y cómodo, comida muy bien preparada de sabor y acompañamiento.

Experiencia agradable que hacía entrar en confianza. Ambiente agradable y de amistad, nos tocó con otro grupo de amigo americanos y la experiencia fue genial

reviews.author: Jay_18_1163
reviews.title: No safety/security
reviews.text:
Stayed for 1 week at the beginning of December. Upon arrival one luggage has been dropped at the wrong resort. When checking in we received the wrong room. Had to wait 30 min for room change and luggage to arrive.
As we came late at night, we ordered room service. Only 2 items available on already small room service menu for a 5* hotel 
We were told it would take 45 min. Called over 1hr later and told 20 min longer. Had to call again as it took 3hrs for cold/dry food to arrive with no cutlery! 

Biggest problem was on our third night as someone entered our room before midnight. Doors have no safety latches! Once asked who it is, they ran off saying something in Spanish. 
At guest services making a report, they told us it might of been housekeeping... right before midnight? And why would they not announce coming in and run away..
We were told to come back as it would take 24-48hrs for a investigation. Next day there was still no answer and manager never showed up. 
There was a camera right outside our door. Then they made up a story of it being an electrical issue and the camera not working. So we ended up not getting anywhere

Most buffet food was always cold and had minimal taste. 
One night we asked 3 servers for a spoon and finally got it over 10min later. Service was always bad

Service at the pool and beach was almost non existent, same as the day/night entertainment. Room was not cleaned everyday. Most of the staff don't speak English. Also not enough towels at this resort 

When leaving, there was only 1 shower for people after check out. Sports bar has a small menu but don't serve food at all.
Could not eat anywhere after 5pm before leaving the resort at 6:30pm

We tried all the restaurants and the food was always good and hot. Best service received was at Flora

Resort itself and beach are very nice 

This is definitely not a 5* hotel, after paying almost $2000, you'd expect better service and safety/security compared to other resorts we've stayed at

reviews.author: Josph G
reviews.title: Vacation with friends
reviews.text: We are having a great time with my friends and we like the activity of going to the Bar in the Lobby with the singers, it is very nice and relaxing. Although my favorite restaurant is the Mina and then the Japanese show with Mr. Santos i like the hotel

reviews.author: Tracey S
reviews.title: A fabulous time was had.
reviews.text: We had an excellent time on our vacation with our friends! The Paradisus Palma Real was a fabulous resort. We were well taken of by our butler Lewis. I would highly recommend him. He was very personable and fantastic at his job! We had a lovely time at the beach and at our pool. The restaurants offered delicious food and was enjoyed immensely by all of us. We hope to go back to Paradisus Palma Real and look forward to an equally spectacular time.

reviews.author: KMM
reviews.title: Viaje inolvidable!!!
reviews.text: Muy buena estancia, personal muy amable y de gran simpatía, gran variedad de alimentos y bebidas, todo muy bien elaborados y de gran calidad. Restaurantes a la carta variados y muy atractivos con una amplia gama de platos con mucho sabor y estilo. Áreas públicas muy espaciosas y muy bien decoradas, los jardines son impresionantes así cómo la playa. La habitación era muy linda y amplia, muy bien mantenida y con reposición diaria de las bebidas del minibar. Piscinas muy espaciosas y con diferentes opciones gastronómicas. Quisiera mencionar a nuestro Conserje Dalmis, al súper Pedro en la playa siempre con un carisma sin igual y a Wanda en el bar de la piscina. Fue una muy linda experiencia. Un saludo a todos!!!

reviews.author: YammyyL
reviews.title: Una experiencia memorable
reviews.text:
El servicio en The Reserve es excelente. Su habitación es amplia, climatizada adecuadamente, con una cama súper cómoda y con el mayodormo Felix verificando cada detalle para una estadía memorable.
La comida es muy buena, principalmente en el restaurante Santé, con Estafani, Gustavo, Luz, Nilsa y demás personal atendiendo todos tus deseos y necesidades. 
Las instalaciones son de primera, con varias piscinas y el servicio en la playa con Pedro y sus compañeros aún mejor.

reviews.author: Brenda H
reviews.title: Fabulous and awesome trip! Such a beautiful resort!
reviews.text: I would like to thank the wonderful staff, Nicholas, Martin, Raphael and all the rest of the staff that made our stay so enjoyable. Great food, beautiful grounds and rooms. Gorgeous resort with breathtaking views. So much to do and see. Everything was fabulous! From day one till our last day here we were taking good care of. All of our needs were met and always accommodated. I will definitely come back to stay here again.

reviews.author: Alfonso
reviews.title: Barco a la deriva
reviews.text: Hotel en general bien pero con muchos problemas con el personal. Hemos estado en muchos hoteles todo incluido a lo largo del caribe pero este está entre los peores con respecto a servicio y procedimientos. Cada dia tuvimos varios problemas e incluso tuvieron que ofrecernos un upgrade gratuito para intentar compensar los muchos problemas sufridos, infinita lentitud en ciertos servicios, vino del todo incluido imbebible, descoordinación total entre departamentos, y muy poca falta de trabajar en la mayoría de los empleados. El hotel carecía de director en la semana que estuvimos y se notaba, barco a la deriva. Stephanie, la guest service manager genial, el subdirector bastante ineficaz ante el ultimo problema que tuvimos. Pondremos una reclamación en la central en mallorca. Próximas vacaciones, seguramente con otra compañía hotelera, tipo iberostar, barcelo o similar.

reviews.author: stefanie h
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
My friend and I booked this trip last minute and we are so glad we did- we did a Sunday-Thursday and booked the reserve/adults only accommodations. From the moment we got to the resort the staff was amazing! Irvin our concierge was SO helpful! He made all of our dinner reservations, made recommendations, checked in everyday via text and sent the daily activities to us. We decided not to do any of the offered excursions but there were plenty to chose from. Jonathan at the pool bar took care of us all day serving great cocktails! All
Of our dinners were wonderful but I highly recommend you make reservations at the winery. Here you can buy a good bottle of wine and then order your food from any of the restaurants available. They do a meat board from Mina the steak house and the steak was outstanding, cooked to perfection! Jonathan, Jhonathan and Maximo are so helpful at the winery and will give wine recommendations if needed. Another gem is the bar Ginger. They make the best espresso martinis and have coffee 24/7. There was plenty of live music and entertainment every night but If you are looking for a club you won’t find that here. We are already planning to go back in 2024- the only things we would do differently is stay longer so we can do an excursion or 2 and go at a different time of year. We would like to be with a more lively crowd- it was on the quieter side and we believe it’s because the time of year we went.

reviews.title: Punta Cana Perfection
reviews.text: We stayed 10 days at the Paradisus Palma Real and it was simply amazing.  We loved Jhon at the Bell Desk who went out of his way to make sure we were greeted by name every time we arrived back on property from golf.  Not to mention our concierge team of Fransisco and Juan who were simply awesome. They made our dinner reservations and kept us informed of all daily activities. Francisco even drove off property twice to pick up large bandages that covered a nasty gash I got on an off site island tour.  If you are planning a trip to Punta Cana, this is definitely the place to stay.

We stayed at the reserve the room were just remodel and they are beautiful    we had to swim up suite that was amazing. We had a lot of time to spend with a young lady named Stephanie She also was 1 of the managers. This young lady knew what you wanted to do before you did that much on top of her job.    The restaurant manager his name  is Hipalito. We saw him morning noon night and he always had a smile on his face and make sure you had quality food.  Another manager we met his name was Jessie he's in charge of the rooms Like the others always there to help. Insane that 1 of the managers under him Mary Lisa    she was in charge of the butlers.1 of the couples that came with us flight was delayed and they got in about 930 at night she went out of her way to make sure they could get a hot meal before they turned in for the night.   The gentlemen around the pool was also very helpful. His name was Edgar it did not matter if you wanted a coke a sprite work cocktail he may sure he brought it to you with a smile on his face. Always make sure you had enough tiles and if you wanted a day bed he make sure you had that also.  The beach is beautiful very wide with many a day beds on it also. There are many choices for restaurants from the steakhouse to seafood to just a quick buffet and bleach me the buffets are also outstanding. So did not matter what you wanted snack or a full meal there's always something there for you to enjoy as a matter of fact they would bring snacks around the pool such as little pc of melon To make sure that you have something to snack on.    1 of the massage ladies her name is Gladys would come around the pool give you a 5 minute or so neck rub or shoulder rub and invite you to come for a full massage believe me it was well worth the 90 minutes you spent with her.  The entertainment very good in the evening.   Every night there was something different in the main area around the restaurants.  I could go on and on to how great this location is. But I think I said enough when we already Planning our trip for April. I hope to see you there again 1 of the best trips we've ever had
