reviews.author: Lenin G
reviews.title: The Reserve Experience is Impeccable
reviews.text:
This was my second time this year. Originally went in June on a whim after seeing beautiful pictures and the kind of experience I wanted -- Adults Only.

I went again this time to celebrate my birthday. I went in with no expectations and I feel like it exceeded even my wildest dreams of how it would've gone. I ended up making friends with people from Scotland, Chile, Argentina, and Canada.

The staff are attentive and friendly. If you stay on The Reserve (Adults Only) side, then you have to go to Wanda at the bar between the pool and the beach. She's always smiling and a good time. She has different servers working there, Yuriel (I called him Barahona) is attentive and funny.

The swim-up bar pool on The Reserve side I was served by Nathanael and Rosanna. I had one of the best times there. They were both great --  drinks flowing, dancing, joking. Just an incredible time, couldn't have asked for better.

In the Plaza you'll find Manuela working either the Tanqueray or Titos bar carts. You can't go wrong with either drink and Manuela is there to take care of you.

Santo killed it at Flora with my surprise bday cake. He went out of his way with making the night spectacular and memorable. Smile on his face and ready to make your night as amazing as it can be. Flora in general is delicious, it's my fave restaurant there. You have to try the octopus! tender on the inside and crispy/crunchy on the outside.

Our concierge was Alvaro. I cannot say enough good things about him. He is top tier. Above and beyond.

Overall, the place is magical. Make friends with people all over the world. Have the friendliest and most helpful staff. Eat delicious food (ceviche is a must). Drinks flowing. Beautifully located in front of a white sand beach.

reviews.author: Doug R
reviews.title: Incredible Experience
reviews.text:
Traveled with a group of friends for a birthday trip and we were in the reserve (adults only) section. Honestly, the whole experience was incredible. Our concierge Alvaro made sure to get our restaurants booked and even arranged special surprises for my friends birthday. There were 3 adults only pools, one with a swim up bar where we had a great time with Natanael and received great service.

At the pool bar Wanda and Yuderi were a godsend and were always there to make sure we had drinks and were having fun. They were incredible!

The restaurants were very good. My personal favorites were the French toast at Santé for breakfast. The Italian restaurant was also pretty good, but Flora was probably the best. The Chivo Guisado was very good, but the attentive service by Santo there was even better.

Would come back.

reviews.title: Trip with Friends
reviews.text: Overall, my friends and I had a wonderful experience here and we would consider visiting again given the right circumstances/price. But after some wonderful experiences with other staff members (shout out to Yiri from Ginger Bar, Yensy del Rosario, Jairo from activities, & Stormin Capitan, Franklin Diaz, and Maria Santana from Malva Restaurant), my friends and I came to the conclusion that these individuals are the ones who deserve recognition. We especially loved the pizza making/mixology class, our master suite, and the details/decor throughout the resort.

The team at the beach on the reserve side are on point. Thank you Paradisius team, your service is what makes you a resort of choice for premium travelers.

We were married here 10 years ago with 70 guests. We returned 9 years ago with our first child and today we leave after a 10 day vacation with our 3 children! Ages 9/6/3

The resort has changed a bit but mostly still the same with mostly  new staff

Sujeidy

Wilda 

All the staff here were great

Wily & Alvaro were our personal concierge and worked hard to fix issues and organize our dinner reservations. We thanks you for your quick attention and assistance 

We went to the Spa many times and highly recommend Carmen & Lillet. The lady who’s name starts with “W”at the reception was excellent organizing sorry I can’t spell your name my Spanish is poor.  

Overall all the staff is great. Our room was cleaned daily and in great order 

I recommend that the hotel allow guests to dine by the beach and not add unusual barricades. On a beach holiday people want beach views. Please increase staff for Kanna and allow people to dine here all day. It’s your only beach front restaurant 

Also please fix the walls and floors in the rooms they are not finished properly and make the room look sloppy. You can be 5 star with more effort on construction finishes 

The resort lacks entertainment! We missed this very much because it was great before

Pools are great the beach now has toooooooo many beach chairs ! Like 20 for each guest !  It looks industrial now. More beach view is better and more chic. This makes it 4star not 5 

Mexican and Japanese restaurants were our favorite

If Meliá didn’t cut some corners on alcohol quality and finishes it would be 5 star all around like the 5 star staff. 

Many thanks for all your efforts and for making our 10 year anniversary fun

reviews.author: David K
reviews.title: False Advertising and Major Disappointment.
reviews.text: The resort is a waste of money. Spending $350-$400/nt is not good enough for them. They cater to members and treat regular guests poorly. They mention several restaurants in there advertisements but only have a few open at a time, it appears  they are failing as a resort. Menu descriptions are false. The specialized restaurants are ridiculous/ low quality. The Blue Agave served very old pork I had to spit out. The majority of the menu at Mina steakhouse is substandard.  The Malva restaurant is the same food as the Lunchbox, these are there general restaurants. One will close and the other might open. Food is very bland, simple things like cooked beans/refried beans no restaurant had. Tokimeku was a ghost town and sketchy. There were several incidents with stares, attitude and rudeness from several employees including the  female  manager. Lying is normal. Service is terrible for towels, room service, drinks, etc. Some in our group were reoeatedly flirted/sexual innuendo  everywhere they went and couldn’t  relax. They were very annoyed. Several employees pushed for internet reviews, wanting you to scan QR codes after they get you food or drink. They tell you to mention there name. There is no thought for respecting or assisting guests when you have problems with room or dining, look angry.

reviews.title: Mejores vacaciones 2023
reviews.text: La pasé demasiado bien en mis vacaciones totalmente disfrutadas sin desperdicio, excelente trato y servicio, quiero agradecer especialmente a sthephanie ovalles por haver hecho la lección de bachata conmigo y mi amiga ella es la mejor un abrazo fuerte nos veremos pronto👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽 gracias por todo.

reviews.author: Juan_Moscoso
reviews.title: No se pierdan KICKS en Palma
reviews.text:
De fiesta con Luis Rosario, Víctor, andreina y Flor! En Kicks bar. Excelente servicio 🤩🤩🤩🤩
Si quieren terminar una noche en Paradisus, nada mejor que Kicks. 
Pool, buena música y deportes. 
Si señor!

reviews.author: YENNI A
reviews.title: Experiencias
reviews.text:
Se necesita más Personal y/o un poco más de experiencia de parte de los mismo y mejor respuesta frente al cliente.

El restaurante tiene mucha variedad, pero deben mejorar la variedad de postres según vayan cambiando los días.

El tiempo de espera del servicio al cliente es demasiado largo.

El Ginger Bar es un bar excelente, personas atentas y pendientes al usuario.

reviews.author: Suiden D
reviews.title: Muy buen servicio!
reviews.text: Excelente servicio en el bar Gunger, Aperol spritz en su punto. Criceida es muy amable y atenta!! Las instalaciones limpias, amplio espacio con distintos ambientes agradables…. Muy recomendable para venir con amigos y grupos!

reviews.author: Sune P
reviews.title: Wonderful time in paradise, except for the initial welcome
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing time at the Palma Real, from amazing food, tasty beverages and the most courteous and amazingly friendly staff. Special shout out to Yuderi Reyes for making us feel like royalty on the beach, and always being ready with a drink, water or towel and even teaching us some Spanish. Another special shout-out to Franky Feliz, for his upbeat spirit and good service, and Miguel Peña for his assistance with booking of activities. 

The staff is what makes this resort so special. The only exception was when we initially arrived at the resort…because I exchanged this holiday using timeshare elsewhere with RCI, we checked in at the circle lounge, not the usual check in desk. The person working there, whose name I can’t remember, was extremely rude to the couple ahead of us and we received a similar unfriendly welcome. He refused to answer any questions we had about restaurant reservations, etc, instead told us that a concierge would be reaching out to us and handed us a piece of paper with a QR code. No one reached out and when we stopped by the next day to ask about this he was again very rude. Thankfully his colleague was much more helpful and put us in touch with Claritzel Otañez who was extremely helpful in answering our questions throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Freddy B
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: Ismael in the ginger bar was so helpful making us terrific tropical cocktails as we're all the waitresses they made us feel at home....my concierge Aeriol was absolutely terrific and over the top 5 star service all the way can't thank you enough your my reason for wanting to come back and we will come back for sure sooner than later.truly my best stay here in Punta Cana Ever and I've been Here six times I'm al.ost Dominican Now lol.

reviews.author: Pavandeep Singh A
reviews.title: Great service, super clean.
reviews.text:
The resort was amazing, always kept super clean and staff were all friendly. The room itself was stunning, and minibar was free so no shortage of drinks ;). 

Felix Garcia was the concierge I had for my trip and he was amazing, always helping out and offering to get stuff for us should we need it. 

Only annoyance was you had to reserve most restaurants and even when they looked empty they sometimes refused us.

reviews.author: Freddy B
reviews.title: Fantastic 5 star experience beautiful Hotel Resort
reviews.text: This place is so beautifully  done the decore the pools the food the service all over the top 5 star plus plus is all I can say absolutely amazing experience first class all the way and a Butler to Boot  what  can I say it's a must do thing to put on your bucket list  and Marielisa was such a dear friend  to us helping  us out at every availability she's an asset for paradises Palma real your lucky to have her as we were to meet her.

reviews.author: E M
reviews.title: Super happy with the service!
reviews.text: Super happy, with the great team! We really enjoyed our combined business and leisure trip. Special thanks to Ismael, Olga martinez  , Soranyi, and Olga rosario  criceida la jefa es supel👍🏻🙏🏼💪🏼👍🏻

reviews.author: Morgan M
reviews.title: Great place to get married!
reviews.text:
We had our wedding at the Paradisus Palma Real. Planning a destination wedding is pretty nerve wracking but we had Stephanie Bellido as our wedding coordinator and she as well as Raquel made sure everything ran smoothly. The wedding was GORGEOUS, even better than I could’ve imagined.
Our concierge Mack Cesar was also amazing and he did a wonderful job making our wedding super special.
Typically all inclusive resort’s food options can be questionable but the food was great.
I’d recommend this hotel to anyone!

reviews.author: NLG
reviews.title: Not worth it.
reviews.text: We went on free business trip for four days.  For free it was great.  I wouldn’t pay for it though.  Service was very poor.  You’d have people come over to take your order and then never bring whatever it was.  I’m vegan and was informed ahead of time that I’d be able to eat here.  It was very very hard.  The restaurant on the premises that’s advertised as vegan - Flora - changed its menu and it’s now fully meat. Both the website and hotel brochures still say it’s vegan though. The restaurants told us they could accommodate me but when we’d get there, it was clear they had no idea what vegan was and couldn’t handle anything off menu other than a green salad - which since the water is bad here, isn’t safe to eat.   If you wanted to eat at a red you needed to make reservations at  a particular desk that closed at 4.  After that they wouldn’t let you in even if the restaurant was empty.  Several times we were told no for something that when our Butler asked magically appeared.  Beach was gross with sea weed.  Overall just not worth it and don’t bother if you eat anything other than meat.

reviews.author: D Garcia
reviews.title: Excelente estadía gracias a José Arismendy!
reviews.text: La mejor experiencia de todas, fui con unos amigos y todos disfrutamos al máximo, el hotel ha hecho muchos cambios para mejor, las habitaciones están hermosas, la comida de buena calidad. Mención especial a JOSE ARISMENDY maletero, que siempre estuvo pendiente a nosotros desde la llegada, asegurándose de que no nos falte nada y a José capitan del restaurante Santé por su excelente servicio.

reviews.author: Big Mike
reviews.title: Concierge Top!!!
reviews.text: Great Service in the Concierge Melvin!!!! beutifull  hotel , beaches, great room service at 1am... Full Aperol Spritz, white sand everywhere,  every day different activities to do! children will love all of the activities!

reviews.author: Mike W
reviews.title: Another great stay!
reviews.text: This is by far our favorite resort. We've been 7 times and it's always been great. Our concierge Felix was always on top of things. He checked on us throughout the day and always came through when we needed something. Thanks again Paradisus and Felix.

reviews.author: Luis M
reviews.title: Experiencia top en Punta Cana
reviews.text: Este hotel esta frente a una playa increíble. La comida y bebida es de gran calidad y con marcas premium de bebidas alcohólicas. Quiero dar las gracias a Luis Gabriel Cadet, fue nuestro concierge durante la estancia, por su paciencia y por hacer todo los posible para que nuestra estancia fuera más placentera. Simplemente fue un 10 sobre 10!

reviews.author: isamouve
reviews.title: paradisus palma real mars 2023
reviews.text:
Trés bel hôtel, belles infrasturctures 
les chambres refaitent à neuf sont superbes , très spacieuses et propres
la plage est nettoyée chaque jour, elle est très belle également et la piscine superbe
les repas au buffet sont très variés et les produits très frais
par contre je vous déconseille les restaurants à la carte qui ne valent vraiement pas le coup !
grand choix également d'alcool locaux et internationaux dans les différents bars et bons vins à table.
un bémol mais un gros bémol, le service ! il faut des heures avant d'être servi aux bars et même quand ils vous voient, ils ne se déplacent pas toujours, il nous est arrivé d'aller chercher nos consommations nous même ! et ça ce n'est pas diqne d'un 5 étoiles !
le seul bar ou tout était parfait est le bar de la piscine, Mario et Victor toujours très serviables et réactifs
Merci également à Maria Luz au buffet qui s'est très bien occupée de nous.
ce voyage était ma 17ème fois en République Dominicaine, mais la première fois dans cet hôtel, je mettrait un 7 sur 10 pour l'hôtel en lui même mais un 2 sur 10 pour le service;
moi qui vantais à mes amis la gentillesse, la serviabilité, la joie de vivre des dominicains, ce ne fut pas de cas dans cet hôtel.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: Relentless high pressure time share sales people
reviews.text:
Unfortunately we will not likely return to this resort.  The beach is one of the best we’ve seen in the Dominican (have vacationed in the DR eight different years). The wait staff was fantastic and the food was on par with most all inclusive resorts. Pedro and Rosanna deserve special mention as they were fantastic. 
Unfortunately our concierge Hector was relentless at tracking us down daily to try to get us to attend a timeshare type sales pitch even after being told “no, we are not interested”.  After five days of this we had to get angry with him to get him to stop. As a result we won’t return to this resort. Other resorts have always respected our answer of no to time shares and left us alone to enjoy our vacation, unfortunately this doesn’t seem to be the case at Malia resorts. 
If you want a relaxing vacation, free from high pressure sales people, then do not go to the Paradisus Real Malia.

reviews.author: Dwyane M
reviews.title: Best Service in the DR.
reviews.text: This is the trip i’ve ever taken. Alejandro Gomez was the best. He took care of us the entire time. Best service ever. Bartender Ruby was also amazing. The both of them provided the best customer service I’ve ever had.

reviews.author: Nicole T
reviews.title: Paradisus ginger lobby bar

He checked all the time if we need anything. Whenever we contact him he responded immediately and helped us with passion. We really appreciate it and wish all the best to him.

reviews.author: Joelle T
reviews.title: Paradise in Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
We have been to two other Paradisus resorts in Los Cabo and Cancun. This resort- the Palma Real is by far our favorite. The resort is beautiful! The weather was amazing! The beach was as gorgeous! I can’t say enough about this resort! We don’t want to leave. 
We were lucky to have a personal concierge Miguel. He was so friendly and was able to answer any question we had. He helped us make reservations for dinners and our excursions.  If we saw Miguel while walking around the resort, he would always make sure to stop and say hello and make sure we had everything we needed. We can’t wait to come back and bring our kids with us.

reviews.author: coastal218549
reviews.title: Golf Group
reviews.text:
Our group of 9 golfers has been staying at Paradissus Palma Real for years, and this was our best trip yet. Our rooms were newly renovated, as was most of the resort, and they have done a fantastic job !
A special shout out to our concierge Nicolas who always looks after us with professional top notch service. Nicolas has become a friend to our group over the years with his friendly attitude and his willingness to go above and beyond. He is the best !
I would also like to mention Francisco Santos, the Reserve manager for helping guide our group prior to arrival . Francisco checked in with us to make sure all was well, which was a nice personal touch. 
We met Juan Pena, the customer experience manager, who came around at several of our meals to make sure we were happy.
Our Bellman, Jose Ramirez, greeted us each day with a big smile and a helping hand.
The restaurants have all been renovated. We especially enjoyed the Blue Agave and the Wine Bar.
Beaches are outstanding  , new swimming pools and landscaping.
Would definitely recommend this resort !

reviews.author: Megan O
reviews.title: Highly recommend for a relaxing beach vacation
reviews.text: John and Luciano are amazing!! Highly recommend this place for vacation spot. So many fun activities. The staff and people are so welcoming and friendly. Great time to lounge on the beach and relax. Had so much fun, will be coming back!

reviews.author: Amy S
reviews.title: Hotel is gorgeous - service and food need improvement
reviews.text:
Traveled with friends - all experienced resort travelers. We stayed on the reserve side - we all checked in together but the resort gave one couple the wrong room (2nd floor vs swim up) - it took days to resolve it even though we showed them swim up room was confirmed on the reservation they seemed to deny it. 

Our concierge was not great - our group shared one which was how the resort set it up. That made sense since for the most part we did everything together but he seemed to be less proactive compared to other concierges we witnessed assigned to other guests. I wish he would have asked us more questions about what we wanted to experience and offer suggestions. He seemed passive and potentially not experienced or thoroughly trained for this job position. He told us we could use our resort bracelet to pay for things at the stores but the gift shop said we had to pay cash or credit card which was annoying so you had to carry money around to grab basic things like candy or sunscreen. He was confused about one of the restaurants being closed on a particular day - shouldn't that be part of his job to know what days they're open or if one is closed for a wedding/large group? Our concierge was more interested in pushing us to make an appointment for the timeshare/club membership which was really annoying (more on that below). 

The best description for the service and food is inconsistent.

Rooms and grounds - the hotel itself and numerous pools are awesome - so picturesque! You can socialize or have privacy. Easy access to the beach with lots of chairs, umbrellas and cabanas (those do cost extra per day). The bars at the pool and beach were good - I was surprised they served some drinks in glasses near the pool area and then other drinks were served in paper cups - one example of the inconsistency. The spa is stunning. The bed in our room was comfortable and the room was clean. Stocked mini-fridge. The coffee maker is not great but better than nothing. Free room service so I suggest you order coffee if you don't want to walk to get coffee at one of the restaurants. We had plenty of bath towels in our rooms. Beach towels are available without issue. On the reserve side you can get a massage in a private area with rooms or on the beach so you don't have to travel to the spa which is a walk or short golf cart ride away. I wish the resort had a book in each room with restaurant menus, map of the resort, services, etc.. They expect guests to download their app which shouldn't be a requirement. It's a big and incorrect assumption that all guests at a resort will want to use their phones. Plus, the wifi was inconsistent during our stay.

Bars and restaurants - The buffet is ok but not the best. Lots of food selection but the language barrier is an issue to get eggs or meats cooked to order at the buffet stations. Seemed to be an issue regardless of whether guests spoke English or Spanish. One of the omelette station cooks was outright mean/rude to every resort guest on more than 1 day. It would have been better to have self-serve water and coffee at the buffet - we often waited for those each morning at our table.

Restaurants on the resort wanted us to use a QR code to access the dinner menu. Why would guests be required to use their phones when dining at a nicer restaurant on vacation? When a printed menu was requested, they would often bring a couple for a table of 6 or 8 diners. On the plus side, the printed menus usually had both Spanish and English versions of the menu. 

The Mexican restaurant had the tastiest food and best service, but other guests we talked to had bad (not tasty) food at this restaurant the same night we ate there. We ate as a group and the waiter offered to serve us family style even though that was not presented on the menu. The family style service allowed us to sample all of the menu and worked out very well.

The Steakhouse was a horrific experience. Our waiter didn't understand how to use his app/device to take our order and he couldn't understand that we needed to specify how we wanted our steaks cooked (rare, medium, etc). Appears that staff training is severely lacking and they may have issues with their ordering program between server and the kitchen. I saw another table had similar issues. The staff brought the wrong food to our table 5 different times - it was ridiculous. No wine menu was presented - they have a wine restaurant next door so it seems that would be an easy and obvious offering. The waiter struggled with any alcohol orders.

The Italian restaurant was an odd experience. Food was ok - not as flavorful as we expected but or waiter was unorganized and the language barrier interfered with ordering both food and beverages.

The Ginger bar - it is a nice open-air atmosphere and it is open morning and evening so you can get coffee and cookie or muffin in the morning or an after dinner cocktail. 

Sports Bar - it has a pool table, large TV, couches , high top tables and a bar. It has space for a DJ and a small stage. The daily activities list confirms if there will be live music or a DJ there. The staff there was very nice and alcohol drink orders were accurate, unlike at the restaurants. No food served there - only beverages.

There was outdoor entertainment in the main area near the lobby 1 or 2 nights of our trip. Other than that it was fairly quiet - we traveled in February. For 2 days there was a corporate group and then different guests checked in.

Club/timeshare solicitation - We were asked a couple of times to sit for the club (ie timeshare) presentation by our concierge. The first time was before we scheduled any excursions, spa treatments or restaurant reservations. It was obvious what their priority was. The 2nd time they acted like we had an appointment that none of us had agreed to and then the concierge along with another co-worker literally begged us to do it, trying to guilt us that we owed it to our concierge, so obviously they are training/compensating the concierge for each club appointment booked. They want minimum 45 minutes for their presentation which will obviously become much of your day if you let it. Given the service and food issues we had experienced, they had not earned the right to ask us a 2nd time. Some of our group took time to explain to the club salespeople our experience and explain why none of us were interested in joining the club, and while they said they cared, but it was obvious they didn't care since we weren't going to sign up for the club. We didn't need a discount or anything special but wanted them to understand they need to improve their guests' experiences. They agreed to give us a credit for 1 message, then reneged on it when we asked for the certificate they offered, denying they offered it at all.  For a supposedly top tier resort, we should not have been subjected to that. During our stay, we met 2 couples (not traveling together) who were club members and both couples said their experiences this trip were not great, especially the food. The members detailed all the money spent on renovations and detailed all of the resort improvements recently completed but it seems most of the staff didn't return to this resort when they reopened or were not properly trained on the changes and new systems.  

I will not be returning to this property. Management did not take our feedback seriously and the food and service issues were both disappointing and unresolved. The pressure to sit for the club presentation twice was the tipping point showing the resort's disrespect for their paying guests.

reviews.author: Wendi T
reviews.title: Served by Angela front desk, house was nice, everyone was great!
reviews.text: Very nice, very accommodating. The food is good. The venue was beautiful and we enjoyed ourselves.  Everyone was friendly and I will be coming back. That’s all I have to say. It won’t let me exit the review unless I add more words but this is what I have to say. Blah blah blah have a nice day!!

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.title: Amazing views and staff but food and drinks sucks
reviews.text: Food is inferior but staff is awesome.  Amazing views of the ocean.  Needs more entertainment and again food sucks.  Staff awesome.  It’s a time share and the business plan changed.  Apparently they chose not include the current membership but want you to buy into the circle membership but wait a minute I just purchased membership in 2015 and now treating club Melina like a second class member.  The experience is not worth the upgrade with inferior food and alcohol.  Another point - the inclusive package offers - alcohol that is off label liquor that you probably will get a headache and the premium brown alcohol was missing the dark huge which leads me to believe it was watered down(personal observation).

reviews.author: Elizabeth Y
reviews.title: Beautiful relaxing stay
reviews.text: Jose Simeon was wonderful at helping our stay be excellent. It was relaxing and beautiful. Food was good, the rooms were comfortable, clean, and a great design. Everything was made easy for a wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: Jamie O
reviews.title: Best experience
reviews.text: Had a blast and good hostess   Elvin and Delvin martinez made our vacation one of the best ever experience❤️❤️❤️.. also the bartender by the pool Victor was great excellent service.. our dj and dancer motivator reynaldo

reviews.author: LaMonica J
reviews.title: Just Say No!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin?!?!
1: They checked us into a family swim-up. I paid for the Reserve area (adults only) swim-up. By the way,  after complaining moved me to my room 3 hours later to a poolside room. 
2. The room I was moved to had no soap. Did I say no soap? 
3. One of the amenities was supposed to be a daily bar service. I'm still waiting on that to happen. 
4. Another amenity that was SUPPOSE to come with the “Reserve Area” is having a reservation and priority dining. Needless to say, that never happened. And was also told we could not eat at the Itailian resturant after waiting for an hour after our reservation was to begin. 
5. LAWD, can a person just get some towels in this place to wash their body with? Asked several times for face towels and they would only bring one for a room with three people. 
6. I’m a little tired but I got to do it. Our Concierge was sweet but, his follow thru sucked.  He complained about the service as much as I did and did nothing about it. 
7. Food, NOPE! I'm hungry!
8. Spoke with several people at the resort and they are having the same experience. 
9. Overall, beautiful resort very poor customer service. 😔

reviews.author: Doffie C
reviews.title: Service was great!! Definitely a 5 star resort..
reviews.text: Dalmis Rodriguez was great!! He was always available when we needed him. The accommodations and service was impeccable.  I would definitely recommend this resort if you’re planning on visiting Punta Cana soon.

reviews.author: famtravlesny
reviews.title: Beautiful, newly renovated. Terrible info and communications.
reviews.text:
We went for a wedding of about 80 people. Summary: beautiful room and facilities. Everything was renovated recently. Massive lack of information. No maps. No menus for the restaurants. No information written or verbally about how things work. Most of the staff could not speak English. No maps or menus or info at the front desk, in the lobby or in the room. 

Some restaurant examples: we were told the only restaurant we needed reservations for was the Asian restaurant. Yet, when we went to have dinner, the restaurants either could not accommodate us or had a one hour wait. At the Asian restaurant they told us we could not reserve there, but had to reserve at the concierge. So we walked upstairs. At the concierge desk they told us we could not reserve until 10 AM for the next day. We called at 10 AM for a reservation and left messages. We never heard back from our messages! We went to the desk at 10 AM they told us the restaurant was fully booked for groups. This happened three days in a row and we gave up. One restaurant is listed as vegan. We asked for the menu and we’re showing a menu with no vegetarian options. We learned the next day that we were given the wrong menu. Nonetheless, it is not a vegan restaurant! There are a few vegetarian options on the menu. We were later told that the extension on the paper they gave (8005);us was not the correct extension for restaurant reservations (8258). In any case, neither one worked. We left messages, but never heard back.

Language: at the egg station in the morning the chef did not know word, such as fried egg or omelette. OK, I don’t know Spanish. I probably should know a little Spanish. My friend asked for vodka at the bar, and the bartender insisted he was saying water. Happy new, be a bartender, and not have heard the word vodka! We also confirmed it’s the same word in Spanish! This happens again, and again. Even at the front desk or the concierge their English language skills were very poor.

There is a coffee maker in the room with coffee. But there are no coffee cups or cups that fit into the coffee maker.

I was in the room with the do not disturb light on. The cleaning service ignored the do not disturb light and knocked on the door. Then they used their key to open the door. I looked outside and confirmed that the light was on. I believe the staff is not well trained.

It’s a big place so people spread out. Pools not busy. Beach can be busy with many people walking on the beach. 

The wedding came off well. The rooms, restaurants, pools, beaches, etc are nicely appointed. The food is decent. It’s a good thing that it is an all inclusive resort because you can mostly avoid the staff and take care of yourself. It is unfortunate that the service, the information, and the language skills are so weak. Oh, and it’s not just language skills, my friend speaks Spanish and could not get information from the staff. They just don’t know. The best thing I can say, is that the problems they have can be fixed. The facilities are excellent. They need to improve the quality and knowledge of their staff and the information they provide.

reviews.author: Danny
reviews.title: February 2023 visit to Punta Cana
reviews.text: This newly renovated resort is beautiful and meticulously maintained. The staff is always smiling and willing to help in any way. There are several restaurants to pick from, as well as a fantastic buffet open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  Our trip date was early February so the water was a little cold in the pools.

reviews.author: Gigi X 4
reviews.title: Service Lacking
reviews.text:
This resort is lovely, but that’s where the  good part ends. The service is abysmal. Our room was only cleaned sporadically. And not cleaned thoroughly when the housekeepers did show up. It’s a large place and direction signs were minimal. Most of the staff had essentially no English so asking for directions didn’t help. 

The food was mediocre, especially the Blue Agave restaurant. Reservations were difficult to get at the times our group requested even though we supposedly had a “personal concierge”.  

We would definitely return to Punta Cana for the weather and the beach, but will stay elsewhere next time.

reviews.author: Andrew H
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Palma Real this year. The weather, beach, food, and pools were great. Our concierge Starlin was very helpful with showing us around the property, checking in to how we were doing each morning and making reservations for dinner each day. 
Odebyi and Rinneli were our beach service for the week and had our spot set up each morning for us and we’re always checking in to make sure we had drinks and were comfortable. We will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Sue T
reviews.title: Vacation Buddies
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay very much! Excellent service, beautiful grounds, terrific food. We would highly recommend a stay at this resort. We hate to be leaving! Lewis was an AMAZING host! 

Easy to book excursions. Everybody was friendly, and we had a great time at the beach. The food is good. Well, the place is very beautiful and hopefully will come back again is that is very cool at home and we love the weather here.

reviews.author: LMN
reviews.title: Awesome times at Sante Restaurant!!!
reviews.text: If you want to be spoiled be sure to spend time with Jose and his incredible team, Dionis Marelin,Andrea,and Rafael at Sante Restaurant! They will leave u with incredible moments and memories that will last u a lifetime. Thank u from the bottom of our hearts!!!

reviews.author: Brian r
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text:
Excellent staff and accommodation’s were provided at the Paradisus Palma Real.  We were there for two weeks commencing January 23, 2023 to February 6, 2023.

The maids were great at their jobs but the service at the restaurants and bars was excellent.

reviews.author: Suiyen H
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: My friends, my son and I had a blast in this resort. The staffs in each restaurants were great, specially our concierge (Luis). He was very attentive and tried his best to accommodate our request. He went above and beyond with his duty as concierge. The dancing activities in the resort were so much fun. Jorge fiesta (entertainer in dancing) was so animated and great instructor. My friends and I learned the bachata move in just 1 class. However, the nespresso coffee was not there as I expected like in Melia Playa del Carmen. Palma real should have a coffee place 24/7 with sandwiches and pastries in case guests want midnight snacks and coffee time while talking.

reviews.author: Kristen B
reviews.title: Nice hotel, excellent staff.
reviews.text:
Stayed 5 nights on a girls trip. Had difficulties with the check in process and our reservation. After sorting out our room, we had an excellent stay. The 90 Celsius bar by the adults only pool had the most amazing staff- Arisleida, Eddy and Rosana were the highlight of our trip. They were friendly and attentive making us all feel like a million bucks. Go visit them when you come!

The food at the lunch box was good (try the fresh cooked tuna!). Food at the other restaurants was good, but the Italian restaurant was closed while there. Had a great aromatherapy massage at the spa- highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kate S
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: Check in process was atrocious- tons of confusion stemming from the recent name change. Once settled the rooms were nice, we had a few cockroach and lizard visitors, but overall the rooms felt safe and clean. Our personal concierge, Lewis, was pleasant but not especially helpful- although he did book our massages- which were amazing!! Delaney at the Garden Suites spa was incredible, best massage I’ve ever had. The thing that really MADE the vacation though was Aries, Eddy and Rosanna at the 90 degrees swim up bar in The Reserve area (adults only). Friendly, fun, great drinks, truly made us feel welcome and at home- had it not been for them, I would have given the overall review a 1. If you come, make a stop and tell them that the Mamas from Minnesota sent you!!

reviews.author: D_morri
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: We scheduled our girls trip back in September 2022 and we finally arrived to Paradisus in February 2023. The service we had from Arisleida Perez, Eddie and Rosanna at 90 Degree bar was hands down the highlight of our trip. Great service and such fantastic people. So wonderful and they really made our trip. Kudos to Arisleida, Rosanna and Eddie!

reviews.author: Marina G
reviews.title: ¡De 10!
reviews.text:
El Paradisus Palma Real fue la última parada de nuestra ruta por este maravilloso país. Una sabia elección para disfrutar de unos días de descanso y desconexión antes de poner rumbo a Madrid. Cuando creíamos que con semejantes instalaciones y un entorno de ensueño la experiencia sería inmejorable, llegó Alan López para recordarnos qué se siente cuando alguien trabaja con el corazón; sin lugar a duda, él ya ha pasado a formar parte de nuestros mejores recuerdos del viaje a República Dominicana. Su amabilidad y atención constante hacen que te sientas especial y no quieras irte jamás. Me gustaría destacar también la profesionalidad del Chef, Ángel Duarte, el cual, además de encantador es capaz de deleitar hasta los paladares más exigentes. Víctor Feliz (su propio apellido lo define), Geraldino, Patricia, Franklin y Yanira Sosa son otras de las muchas caras amables y sonrientes que siempre estaban “a la orden” e hicieron de nuestra estancia una EXPERIENCIA INOLVIDABLE. 
¡Gracias! 
¡Ya estamos deseando volver!

reviews.author: Dave L
reviews.title: 90 Degree Bar experience and Service above and beyond.
reviews.text:
We visited the subject resort Jan 23 to Feb 6 2023. 
Overall rating is excellent and in particular Eddy Luis de los santos and Arisleida Perez went above and beyond to make our stay excellent. They were the servers at the bar 90 Degrees.
We would certainly recommend that if visiting the resort to attend at the 90 Degree Bar and pool.

reviews.author: GyroPelican
reviews.title: Rina Herman is the best pool person
reviews.text:
Rina made our trip extremely special. She anticipated our needs and went above and beyond. When you stay here you must ask for her and your trip will be much brighter.   
The family buffet has a very wide range of food options and the staff was very helpful.

reviews.author: Maude D
reviews.title: FLORA restaurant
reviews.text: Grandiose service by Felix, great food. Best meal and best service we had all week. GRACIAS Felix Uribe! He was vwry attentive and efficient. We will be back for sure. Other restaurants dont conpare, go there for lunch!

reviews.author: TITTI T
reviews.title: evitatelo
reviews.text:
assolutamente da evitare. Struttura che si propone come un 5 stelle ma in realtà ha la pessima gestione di un 3 stelle. Dilettanti allo sbaraglio. Assistenza Melià inesistente.
Prima stanza: Niket Junior Suite con aria condizionata e minibar mal funzionanti. Cambio stanza: dopo 2 ore si soggiorno Tubature rotte.
Da parte di Melia ufficio prenotazioni assoluto silenzio e nessun tipo di riscontro. 
Da evitare assolutamente. Pessima esperienza ancora in corso.

reviews.author: chris
reviews.title: Girls trip to Punta Cana
reviews.text: Definitely a great trip exploring a new resort (to me).  This was my first time staying at Paradisus Palma Real.   We stayed in the Reserve Garden Suite, which was adults only.   I loved the property, so many beautiful pools.   It was nice going to the pool around 10 and having plenty of options of seats.  So The service and food  for the most part was good.  Sometime the food was really good and some times it was cold.  Sometimes the service was above and beyond other times it was slow and none existent.  The room service food was awful.  I would definitely stay in the Reserve adult only rooms again, just to have the stocked mini bar and pools and access to the reserve only restaurants.  The beach had a little seaweed but the staff did a great job cleaning it up.   It is a beautiful big beach with beach bars and food carts and plenty of chairs.   Victor at the pool bar made our drinks perfectly and Eddie and Arisleida at the swim up bar were excellent.

reviews.author: Fred P
reviews.title: Great Vacation wonderful 7 days.
reviews.text:
Excellent service at all bars and restaurants. Room staff was great!
Large selections of pools.
Cocotal Golf is a bargain, beautifully maintained and challenging. 
Spa was very nice, people very friendly.

reviews.author: Kathryn C
reviews.title: Good times
reviews.text: We just came back from Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort. We were there with the F.W Webb group. The place is beautiful, rooms were very nice.  The service is excellent.  We were treated with kindness and the staff was very accommodating.   Especially at the Flora restaurant.  Luz, Vivianny, Gustavo and Felix were more than happy to get you anything you needed.  The weather was perfect.  The food was OK.  And I wished they heated there pool. The court yard at night was always hopping with music and was very enjoyable. Over all we had a great time.

reviews.author: Daniela R
reviews.title: Vacations at paradissus palma real Punta Cana
reviews.text: The days at paradissus palma real were perfect, our host Starlin Tavares was the best person, excellent very kind, the waiters Rosanny paniagua and boris santos were very friendly and excellent people, and the pothographer rafael of novia mia, very friendly, very professional, very funny and excellent work. Highly recommended. The hotel is excellent and very beautiful.

reviews.author: Mafer B
reviews.title: El mejor hotel de punta cana
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio desde que pisamos el hotel.Starling Tavares muy amable y dispuesto en cada momento y el personal en gral demasiado atentos 
Agradecimiento especial a Rosany y Santos que nos atendieron de la mejor forma en el restaurante.
La atención personalizada en todo momento 
El hotel ,la comida ,el personal y las actividades sin duda una experiencia inolvidable.

reviews.author: RCtraveler
reviews.title: Great trip with awesome company!!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa felt like a piece of heaven on earth! The cool breeze from the Atlantic Ocean gave a special touch to the atmosphere in the mornings and evening. 
Our suite was beautiful, clean, and spacious with a luxurious feel. The mini-bar and snacks were always stocked. Our awesome concierge, Cris was extremely attentive and readily available to assist with anything we needed. He was always there to answer questions not matter of the time and ask what else he can do to make our stay comfortable. He went above Abe’s beyond to give us a great customer experience. 
Each of the staff had a welcoming smile and warmth feeling. They made our experience much more memorable. The resort came alive in the night with live music and entertainment. 
Really didn’t wanted to leave but there’s always a next time!

reviews.author: ivntvm
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: Jose Ventura at the Shaker is absolutely magnificent! We had the best night with Jose. We had the best craft margaritas and conversations with the guests and the bartenders. We enjoy dinner had the best service right after!

reviews.author: Diane B
reviews.title: Amazing Memories Made!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is a wonderful location to gather with friends or family for fun and relaxation. The newly renovated resort has been updated beautifully and is sparkling clean.  While not completely done, any areas that were still being worked on you couldn’t see or hear any of the work being done.  All of the restaurants were well staffed, and the food was always fresh & flavorful with a wide array of choices. We never had a problem getting seated or with service anywhere we went.  The head chef for the resort is frequently seen checking in around the resort.  

Our suite was beautiful, spacious and comfortable.  The mini-bar and snacks were always well stocked.  We requested extra towels which was no problem.  The bath and shower amenities were very nice.  Our wonderful concierge, Felix, was so attentive and happy to assist with anything we needed, always ready to answer questions promptly no matter the time! 

The main asset to the resort, which made our experience so memorable, was outstanding staff we encountered.  As mentioned above Felix went above & beyond.  Another concierge that was so helpful and always smiling was Harry.  Our favorite place to visit, relax, people watch or just look out at the gorgeous view was the lobby bar Ginger.  From morning to night everyone is ready with a smile! Antonio, Ismael Criceida, Lucia, and several more special people!  The best espresso, cortado and pastries in the morning to finishing off the night with an old fashion & espresso martini.  

We look forward to our next visit!

reviews.author: Marc-andré B
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great service! Marianna our janitor was really kind. Recommand this hôtel for everyone. The beach was Great. The alcohol was on point. The drink were strong and tasty. The wifi was a little bit hard to get on the resort

reviews.author: BARBARA A
reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE.  DO NOT GO TO THIS RESORT UNLESS YOU WANT TO PAY $133.00 PER NIGHT TO EAT COLD CUTS.
reviews.text: The worst experience of my life.  I booked this vacation (as a Melia Club Member) for 14 people having stayed here many years ago and bragged about how great it was.  Well to my surprise and that of my guests the hotel is totally run down, the rooms are musty and wet, there is black mold on the ceilings.  Our concierge apologized over and over but  he could not get us reservations for dinner we had to eat at the buffet, the buffet was out of orange juice and bacon 3 days out of our 5 day stay.  We were eaten alive with the amount of mosquitos, I have stayed in other Melia resorts which give the children gifts and toys as a grand gesture here there was nothing for them.  I was truly embarrassed after having told my guests of what a great place this was and then having to experience this disaster with them. I later learned that the hotel is being renovated this month.  I wish I would have known that the hotel was not being kept up due to upcoming renovations this should have been disclosed upon us making the reservations I would have never asked friends to join us on this vacation.  I truly believe that we should get a refund on the all inclusive price that was paid since we were unable to experience dinner outside of the buffet which was basically the same food night after night.

reviews.author: elizamendesrr
reviews.title: Viagem com amigos
reviews.text:
O hotel está  sem conservação . Parece existirr confusão em relação a Rede Melia. Acontece a implantacao de um programa. 
Reservamos um hotel e ficamos em outro por conta de uma reforma.
As pessoas que trabalham  na rede hoteleira parecem  sem orientação em termos de servir e se colocar.
Não recomendo !

reviews.author: M K
reviews.title: Hands off if looking for a 5* hotel
reviews.text:
The beach is a construction site. 
At the central pool area there is extremely loud music who nobody is interesting in and is disturbing even 150 yards away. 
Also at the restaurants very high noise level. 
Front desk is not really helpful and does not take care of complaints.
Concierge service unreliable.

reviews.author: Akeshia A
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.text: The staff made the experience very enjoyable. There was good service. At the restaurant the staff listened to our special requests. The food was excellent, and they made us feel very welcomed my favourite part was the wings

reviews.author: Andrea C
reviews.title: Hydro Grill - The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Dinner was delicious.  I had the short rib and my husband had the sirloin.  I would definitely dine here again. 

The atmosphere is beautiful with the pool all lit up in the background. 

The wait staff are very attentive. 

Alba, the hostess, was wonderful.

reviews.author: Angel A
reviews.title: Dionys Excelent waiter
reviews.text: Dio ya was an excellent waiter, took great care of us, was really kind and made excellently suggestions. Food was great here and the salmon was delicious as well as the drinks, he should get a raise!!!

reviews.author: Jeffrye R
reviews.title: Beta resort ever
reviews.text:
The paradisus Palma real reserve is fantastic. We can right afte the hurricane and the staff was amazing in cleaning up quickly. The staff was very friendly. Clirtzal was our concierge and Did a great job.  
The beach was great. 
Will be back

reviews.author: Areli G
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I enjoyed myself at the reserve. The activities were a lot of fun. The guys from the activities were great, especially keyby and darlin, Jairo . They made it really fun and enjoyable. I also did enjoy the wine tasting with Jonatan and I enjoyed the tequila workshop with johanna. I learned a lot from them and it was a new experience. I will say the food at the resort could be a little better. Needs a little bit more of a verity of food. But I can’t deny that the service was really good.

reviews.author: Mert E
reviews.title: Paradisus Bewertung
reviews.text: We had a Good time in this Hotel the Services and the Staffs were very nice and helpfull we Visited for a week and had a Great time we want to thanks to our concierge Starlin Tavarez and the guest Service Team Special Mention to leandra Polanco Thanks for everything  we will come back with all our Family and Friends

reviews.author: Sarah Z
reviews.title: Cena espectacular
reviews.text: Atendidos por Sanyl y Franklin, henos experimentado excelencia en comida gourmet y un servicio muy agradable, Gracias, disfrutamos la fabulosa experiencia en un ambiente  muy acogedor Restaurant en Meliá Paradisus!

reviews.author: Maria Castellano
reviews.title: Such an Amazing Trip and Relaxation
reviews.text:
Amazing place and staff out of all the many options we love to return because of the staff and how they go above and beyond to service the client! 

Our previous concierge Sairen Rebinson came to greet us and made sure we were taken care of! 

Our concierge Clarizel made our vacation unforgettable. She went the extra mile to make us feel we were at home!  The room is always in perfect condition, and the jacuzzi always ready to enjoy. The pool is in Amazing condition to jump in. 

Manuel Torres and George Castillo, Gregorin Aria, Restaurant managers, Santos as Capitán and the head chef Carlos Seuno, thank you for your dedication to us and giving  us the best of the best! Always ready to give the best food and service! 
The amazing services in all the restaurants in Gabi club, Aqua and Hydro grill. 
At the bar Virginia the capitán of Gabi bar She is very attentive and makes the most special mamajuanas in the Reserve at paradisus including her staff Magda Noruso, Leonardo Ramirez, Johana Cabrera and Juan Vicente.
 We feel so special with them and it is impossible to enjoy our vacation without their wonderful service!
Adrianne, the Director has amazing staff to care for the guests.

We absolutely love the warmth of the staff and their service and is what makes us return above all the other things! 

We highly recommend this hotel: clean, gorgeous amenities, personalized services and excellent food. Thank you again for having us!

reviews.author: Steve H
reviews.title: Vacation with friends
reviews.text: Yaleidi Sims was the best concierge.   Friendly,  thorough and very professional.  She took all the "guessing " out of our stay.   We knew what our options were daily and each recommendation was on point.  Looking forward to coming back to the DR in part because of her.

reviews.author: Patricio H
reviews.title: Misu the reseve
reviews.text:
El próximo año que venga para mi cumpleaños quiero que me atienda Henry Ventura, cónico lo tapan increíble y Melvin de la Cruz nos sirvió excelentes trajos. 
Lo mejor de punta cana que hemos probado!!!

reviews.author: Mo D
reviews.title: The customer service worst experience to date
reviews.text: This trip was a disaster from start to finish. We booked a bachelors party in December of 2021 for June 2022. We booked the ADULTS ONLY Section through Expedia. Three weeks before our trip in June I called multiple times in May to make sure everything would be ready for us and to confirm our room selection. In the last week before our trip was set to begin. The resort informed be via telephone that they no longer had the adults only section, and it had been under construction for months. Due to people calling in they changed the reservation with online parties so the adults only selection would no longer be available. I asked why we were not informed of this prior the resort staff Daniel simply said I don’t know I apologize. I req a full refund they denied me. I call Expedia and asked why they had not informed us of the change the agent Michelle said I don’t and apologized. Again I requested a full refund I was denied and told our room would be upgraded. I explained to the Expedia agent and the Resort agent that we did not want to spend a bachelors party at a family resort with children running around. Neither were helpful and our money was not refunded. Without being able to cancel we were forced to be at a family resort on bachelors party due to the lack of communication from both Expedia and this Grand Reserve resort. We spent the weekend watching kids running around and the only group of guys there with no kids or family. This was absolutely the worst trip of our lives. Paying for a service and getting something completely different, far from what you requested has got to be  the biggest slap in the face. The Reserve at Grand Paradisus owes us an apology and a refund

reviews.author: Curious562540
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: My girlfriends and I had an amazing stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. Our concierge, Ariel Benzo was attentive, friendly, accommodating and just flat out amazing! He helped us plan each day perfectly and was available to answer all questions and accommodate every request.

reviews.author: Jessica Roland
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK!
reviews.text:
DO NOT BOOK! 

The room we booked was in a building that is not even open. Booked beach front and got an “upgrade” to a swim up room with no view and had to take a golf cart to get to the beach. We were told that we received an email about this change but never received anything from the hotel. We went on this trip with several other couples and expected to be in the same building but this was not the case. We also booked the “adults only” side and this was also not open. Management was unwilling to reduce our rate, gave us a 30 minute massage for free (that I did not use). Don’t get me started on the horrible food and bugs in the room. 

Avoid this place! They are committing fraud by letting people book rooms that don’t exist!!!

reviews.author: Marta G
reviews.title: Cafetería the reserve Palma real
reviews.text:
Los camareros son muy majos y están muy pendientes 
El ambiente agradable y las copas muy buenas .
Doris y Juan Vicente y Diana son muy simpáticos 
Volveremos en próximas ocasiones 
Ha sido un viaje muy bueno

reviews.author: Riley G
reviews.title: Visit to the Reserve at Paradisus
reviews.text: Our stay at the Reserve was excellent. The staff was all accommodating and helpful, especially our concierge Starlin and Jesus at customer service. Our rooms were very nice and the resort was beautiful. The beach is just a quick golf cart ride away and has delicious food trucks that are with the resort.

reviews.author: brandonianiro
reviews.title: Great bar service from Delvi and Miguel at the Gabi Club Bar!
reviews.text: Miguel and Delvi handcrafted the perfect drink from friends and I. Not only did they create something unique, their service went above and beyond! They were super nice just as other members at the Paradisus reserve are.

reviews.author: neda s
reviews.title: Spontaneous Vacation
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful. Gran Cana had more entertainment and more modern. Great service. Entertainment was excellent. Favorite restaurant is Lemon Fish. We stayed at the Presidential suite in the Reserve, private pool and quiet area. Definitely enjoyed that. Cons: golf cart service to other property was very slow, sometimes we were waiting for 20 min.. 
We were served raw chicken at Mangú restaurant, and that was scary. Steakhouse was great as well. 

The best part was our Concierge Eliezer Sanchez, he made sure we had all we needed, he is kind, responsive and attentive. 

Also Domingo at Gabi Club was an excellent server. He remembered how we take our coffee(we asked for espresso and not drip coffee) and he welcomed us every morning. 

Overall a good experience. Definitely will come back when the new section opens up (beach front)

reviews.author: karapisani
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation in Punta Cana
reviews.text: We are just leaving a 5 day trip that my friend and I planned for our recent high school graduate sons. Coming from Fort Lauderdale, FL it was a quick 2.5 hr flight. We arranged transport through Odium to get 5 of us from airport to paradisus resort. It was an easy process getting from airport to hotel. Well organized and well marked. Upon arrival at resort the lobby had snacks, drinks, etc waiting for us and the check-in process was easy as can be. I’m not sure where the bad reviews are coming from. We found the staff to be warm, friendly and so helpful every step of the way. The hotel rooms were clean and spacious. We stayed in the Reserve and that hotel was more geared to families but we had access the grand Cana- the adult resort. Our concierge, Claritzel Otañez, was excellent- very helpful in making hotel reservations and provided us with activities and excursions during our stay. We selected a tour yo a private island that included stops at Chavon River, casa de campo and the worlds largest natural swimming pool. To say it was gorgeous is an understatement. The food at the resort was good enough. No real complaints there and plenty of everything. I highly recommend staying at Paradisus Punta Cana. You can not go wrong for the price with an all- inclusive resort!!!

reviews.author: Kirsty G
reviews.title: You get more than you pay for- Great Resort with Amazing staff.
reviews.text:
This is an amazing resort!!  The staff through out the resort and restaurants are all friendly and very helpful. The grounds and beach are beautiful. Food and drinks are good. Many activities available or just relax at pool or beach.

We had booked at the Palma Real which is currently under total renovation, we discovered this through revisiting reviews the week before coming on trip. We had not read about this when booking in January for trip in June. Glad we read the new reviews as we made calls and spoke with resort and new what to expect and that our rooms where now in the reserve. The Reserve does feel a bit dated in the rooms but it also feels authentic to the DR and grounds are amazing. The Grand Cana ( we had use of that property also) us prank new and beautiful but has a bit of a sterile feel- it could be anywhere and does not have the tropical feel that the reserve provides. 

The bed and pillows where comfortable. 

Fresh towels and room service everyday with refilled snacks and mini bar daily. 

Entertainment available every night. 

Looking forward to returning and checking out the Palma Real.

reviews.author: Jenna G
reviews.title: Dinner Disaster
reviews.text:
We just checked in today. The hotel claims you can call a number or use the Meliá app to make dinner reservations. We are traveling with a party of 8 for a big wedding at the resort and after sending multiple emails, calling the reservations number and attempting to use the app (which is useless) we still have no dinner reservations. 

This is so inconvenient and unprofessional. For an all-inclusive experience, this is not very inclusive. Not a great way to start our vacation.

reviews.author: ceetzel
reviews.title: Paradisus 2022
reviews.text:
Raul is the best! He tended to our group of friends with our diverse orders every day of our stay with a smile on his face. 

The views were incredible and Paradisus was very accommodating. We loved our stay here and would recommend it for families and friends alike.

reviews.author: Liliana
reviews.title: Cielo excelente comida en Palma Real ! Deli !
reviews.text:
Chicos muy rico todo ! Se pasó el chef! Francis Javier chef , la atención de Ariel Perez y la dedicación de José Batista manager. De todos ! Y de la alegre Lili que nos solucionó una reseva peddida 😂. 
Ahora a divertirnos un rato y descansar, nos tocó una súper habitación , 6 amigas en 2 habitaciones contiguas  en The Reserve ! Se los recomiendo .

reviews.author: Happiness375652
reviews.title: Páscoa no Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Aspectos positivos: localização, arquitetura e praia.
Qualidade da Alimentação boa em todos os restaurantes excepto o italiano ( Olio…) top o restaurante japonês e a picanha no restaurante Sal.
No restaurante central variado nas 3 refeições.
Áreas dos quartos otimas.
Profissionais de restauração: muitos terão de ter oportunidade de melhorar e não pensar só na propina.
Aula de pilates com a instrutora Argentina e alongamentos  e zumba  e dança com o Pedro excelentes.
Ginásio top

Aspectos a melhorar: reformar quartos alguns estão muito danificados e cheiram a mofo.
Controlo de mosquitos no lobby Bar ( um dos espaços de convívio mais interessantes mas onde os mosquitos são mais que muitos.
Actividades: a equipa de actividades de adultos não estimula a participação se as pessoas aparecem muito bem se não têm conhecimento, ficam sem participar em nada porque os animadores nada dizem.
Aula de Yoga pelo menos ter alguém com mais conhecimento na área.

Se dás gorjeta (propina) és bem tratado se pensas que vais com tudo incluído e nada dás, podes em alguns sectores como na praia, ficar a esperar sentado. 
Tem tudo para se desfrutar umas excelentes férias .

reviews.author: Daniela F
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!
reviews.text:
Os quartos são muito bonitos, assim como a piscina e a praia. Este hotel é memorável! 
Fomos jantar ao restaurante mexicano e a comida estava maravilhosa, especialmente a carne. O funcionário Alexander Santos merece os parabéns, muito simpático e prestável. Assim como Juan Vicente fez as nossas bebidas, Francis Javier cozinhou estes pratos deliciosa os, e José Batista, o chefe de sala, foi muito prestável também.

reviews.author: Beatriz Azevedo
reviews.title: Muito bom
reviews.text:
Comida muito boa, o melhor era a carne como prato principal. Muito bom atendimento do Alexander Santos, sempre preocupado em nos servir é muito atencioso. Sobremesa três leites boa. 
Comida é boa não é picante

reviews.author: Damaris
reviews.title: Fantastic experience
reviews.text: Great service loved the attention from each individual! Will return 100% recommend to family and friends. Great experience no complaints. Experience was full of laughter and enjoyment. Made to feel very special

reviews.author: Mariela Nieva
reviews.title: Bufete Nao
reviews.text: Estuvimos de vacaciones 12 días en el hotel! Realmente pasamos unos días espectaculares, no solo el lugar es hermoso, la calidad de la comida y la atención cálida que recibimos nos hicieron terminar nuestra estadía con una sonrisa. En varias ocaciones tuvimos la suerte de coincidir con José Batista, quien nos atendió con mucha amabilidad, predisposición y alegria. Un gusto cruzarse con gente así. Extrañaremos no solo la comodidad y confort del hotel sino también la calidez de su gente y servicio! Volveremos!

reviews.author: Agustin Bernasconi
reviews.title: Excelente estadía
reviews.text:
Estuvimos 2 semanas en paradisus y la pasamos muy bien. 
Jose Batista nos atendió muy bien tanto en el buffet Nao como en Cielo.
También destacar la atención de Alexander en Mama y Juana y de marilin sanchez en el buffet de paradisus gran cana.

reviews.author: Carmen
reviews.title: Fabuloso almuerzo en buffet Nao
reviews.text: Nos atendió muy amablemente José Emilio Batista!. Excelente variedad de comida y un gran servicio. Nos hospedamos en Grand Cana pero disfrutamos varios días de esta gran opción para almorzar al visitar la playa.

reviews.author: Michele B
reviews.title: 50th B day celebration
reviews.text: We had a great time the staff was excellent. Yoiner was our personal concierge. He was very responsive. He along with Julio in the Circle office made my stay easy and enjoyable. Arisleida and Reyna greeted us with a smile every day. This is why I joined as a member this weekend.

reviews.author: Colleen M
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Avenue bar is very fun because the service is very good especially altogracia and Luis and Dori because they are always happy and friendly and it made me feel really good at avenue bar. The drinks are very good too!!

reviews.author: Jasmine C
reviews.title: Bartender
reviews.text: Adrienne  is amazing!!!! She is sooo genuine and has such a great soul! I didn’t expect to come on Vacation and make new friend but now I’m leaving with one! She deserve the world! Can’t wait to come bk

reviews.author: Victor_reviews
reviews.title: Amazing beach front resort! Super interesting and fun activities and great food! A the place to stay!
reviews.text:
My very first time at this resort and what an amazing experience!
1. Beachfront spectacular with plenty of space 
2. Outstanding activities and entertainment. Including activities for all ages. Congratulations to the activities team.
3.great staff and great service all across the resort

Definitely a must to stay when visiting the Dominican Republic. And a great location!

reviews.author: Amy F
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Reserve Upgrade
reviews.text: Let me start by saying the Dominican Republic is amazing! We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real. Upon arriving I asked about the upgrade to Reserve status and we decided to do it! Best decision ever! The butler service alone is worth it. Our Butler was Jose Simeon. I wish I could bring him on every vacation we go on. He was the absolute best. With him just a text or call away on WhatsApp I didn’t have to worry about a thing. He made all of our restaurant reservations, took care of some excursion issues, and helped answer a ton of questions. He came by to see us wherever we were hanging out and was just an all around good guy. We had a few issues our first day but he fixed everything within a few hours of his service and we never looked back. One of the best trips we’ve done and Simeon made it all the better. We will be back. 💜💜

reviews.author: Nicolas G
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio de Boris 🍷🍸🍹
reviews.text:
Doris agradecerle la estadía, por toda su entrega de su gran trabajo en Avenue, la humildad y su sonrisa hacen unas vacaciones inolvidables. 

La comida también es espectacular  y todo en general

Miles de bendiciones. 

Costa Rica Pura Vida

reviews.author: julio isaias g
reviews.title: Execelente servicio
reviews.text: Estoy encantado con el servicio de éste hotel en general y destacar el buen servicio del bard avenue, y felicitar a Doris es una exelente camarera todos quedamos encantado con ella y sus compañeros del bard

reviews.author: Melissa K
reviews.title: Amazing experience at Paradisus palma
reviews.text: We travelled from Canada for 6 days. We had an amazing experience at this resort. Everything was perfect. Food, housekeeping, bars, pools, gardens. Staff at the buffet and resuturants are very nice. The night music and bands are so good and very different with other resort I have been in south before. Thank you Alba, Atrahracia, Edwin, Adriel, Jose. I’ll definitely come back 🙏😍

reviews.author: Trish333
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing!! I had an issue and they were very prompt to assist me and follow up! Night shows were great! Staff was super friendly especially Yiri, Altagracia, Luis and Antonio from Avenue Bar. If you have any issues you would want have Delbis from guest service and Andres (manager) by your side! I am beyond thankful for them!! My stay was amazing and they for sure made it better! Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Katie N
reviews.title: Absolutely delicious!
reviews.text: Wonderful selection of seafood, as well as beef and chicken plates. I got the chicken canga, which was so flavorful. AB, aka Abraham, who is the manager, was delightful! Highly recommend at Paradisus!

reviews.author: ANDREW V
reviews.title: Paradises The Reserves
reviews.text: Awesome trip with awesome staff. Irvin did a fantastic job and every other staff was all so helpful. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience in Punta Cana. The whole resort was amazing and beautiful. Thanks again. We will be back!

reviews.author: Amy D
reviews.title: The only thing all inclusive was the rude staff.
reviews.text: Wow, where do I begin? Oh I know- how rude the staff is. Nothing but a nightmare since checkin. Imagine being told you can’t eat dinner at an all inclusive restaurant (that you paid for) because there are no reservations? Or having a manager thank you for your patronage because with us giving him business he can feed his family but has no problem taking our money and not making sure his guests are taken care of? Or having managers be in a “meeting” all day and can’t step out to solve situations with multiple upset guest? Being denied entering the buffet because you’re wearing a bathing suit with a cover up because it’s too “inappropriate” but yet half of the people inside the buffet are practically naked? When the staff thinks you don’t know Spanish but you do and here them talking about you in their language? Yup, imagine it because this is what happens at the Paradisus Palma real. You must need to have a severe attitude problem to be hired here, if not, you won’t be fit for the job!

reviews.author: Alejandro L
reviews.title: Restó Óleo en Paradisus Palma Real golf & spa.
reviews.text:
Muy linda cena en óleo, excelente atención de Jessica, un servicio de alta calidad
Nuestra primera noche en esta temporada arrancó muy bien, es grato sentirse tan bien recibido, veremos como sigue en los próximos dias

reviews.author: Caroline B
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma real
reviews.text: 5 stars for Thomas good service. We loved the restaurant and the food thank you so much! Let us sit down and have us drinks and we're very nice to me and all of my friends. Not really sure what else to write!

reviews.author: Shane P
reviews.title: Kanye
reviews.text: Victor sanchez is the best!!! Give this man a raise!!!! Service was incredible, everyone was very nice. Beach and pool were amazing and the drinks were fantastic! 10/10 would recommend for college spring breakers

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Victor Sanchez is the GOAT. Great service, great laughs with even better friends. I had a lot of fun on this trip and will definitely recommend this hotel to my friends and family. I hope I can come back

reviews.author: Caleb C
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Great bar. Great resort with a very friendly staff. They will treat you well! The rooms are very clean and the staff is very nice. The Avenue bar is the best one in the resort and they will hook you up. Find Luis Rosario, Altagracia, Daniel, and Luis Morel in the Avenue bar and they will treat you right. Overall, a great vacation and great experience.

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Muy recomendado Restaurante Sal
reviews.text:
Decidimos cambiar la comida en el buffet del hotel y probar algo diferente y optamos por probar el Restaurante Sal dentro del hotel y la comida fue excelente. 
Pedimos de entrante los camarones, la provoleta y el carpaccio: todos riquísimos y muy recomendable.
Pero sin duda lo mejor el plato principal: pedimos dos picanhas que estaban buenísimas.
El corte de la Carme y el punto de cocción eran excelentes ( todo a cargo del chef Orlando el cual fue muy atento explicándonos la preparación de los platos)
Recomendadisimo ir Al restaurante sal si van al Melia beach resort en punta cana

reviews.author: Gonzalo B
reviews.title: Increíble experiencia
reviews.text: Los trabajadores son más majos que las pesetas. Todo muy rico. El entorno es único. Repetiría sin ninguna duda. Joel Valdez, del bar Gaby, es un profesional sin parangón, igual que Luis, del bar del Lobby. Marisol deja más que desear, todo hay que decirlo.

reviews.author: Eag23
reviews.title: Ya quiero regresar!!
reviews.text:
Reservé en PPRL para celebrar mi cumpleaños y pasar un buen rato con familia y amigos, gratamente, resultó en una experiencia inolvidable desde antes de llegar. Estamos muy agradecidos con las consideraciones de Genaro Gil con las habitaciones y gestión en general, con el check in vip con Daniel, Katherine (la sonrisa más bonita de la recepción) y Angeli. Me sentí privilegiada de tener al mejor mayordomo que he conocido Starling Tavarez, que genuinamente se preocupó por cada detalle de mi celebración y mis reservas. 
En el restaurante Gaby, en THR mi querido Santos que supera todas las expectativas de servicio, los maleteros Omar Hasbun y Francisco Williams destacados por su proactividad. Resaltando el masaje del spa con las terapeutas Karina y Eliana que brindaron un servicio de lujo. 
En conclusión, espero regresar pronto y seguir viendo esos rostros alegres y esas personas maravillosas que caracterizan este hotel. No fuera lo mismo sin ellos.

reviews.author: sara00fantastic
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real & Oilo
reviews.text: Olio restaurant was delicious. Our experience was made so much better by Jose Ramos and Bernabe. We ordered just about everything on the menu and enjoyed it all! We’re about to enjoy all of the desserts and call it a night. Thank you to the resort, to our concierge Anayely, and all of the lovely people we’ve met along the way.

reviews.author: Michael O
reviews.title: Great experience in tropical paradise
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real when our friends got married. Great atmosphere and environment by the beach. Wonderful and friendly service for drinks and refreshments at the Gabi Beach Bar by Arisleisa Perez. Delicious coffee. Strong cocktails. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Amber W
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real  Gabi Beach Bar
reviews.text: Ruby Vallejo, Miguel Solar and Yiri Sil Vestre at Gabi Beach was very welcoming and friendly. Best part of our trip was spending time with them, and their friendliness. We definitely recommend this resort with their amazing team.

reviews.author: Dave C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Felix uribe andino Jimenez y Chet Juan gave us great service at Palazzo Resto.
Luis. Desa at the lobby bar was also great. We were there for 9 days and he always remembered our drinks after our first visit. Courteous and efficient with a smile.

reviews.author: Amelia T
reviews.title: Palazzo Restaurant at Paradisus Palms Real
reviews.text: We had a awesome meal tonight. Chef Nelson and Javier cooked two wonderful dishes. Red Snapper and beef tenderloin. Andino our waiter was on point also Definitely coming back on our next visit to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: E M
reviews.title: Muy mal.
reviews.text:
Aquí hay que armarse de paciencia. Llegamos al hotel por la noche tras un largo vuelo. Nos pasamos la noche con el inodoro haciendo ruido. Al día siguiente no funciona, he tenido que hablar con todo el personal del hotel para que me arreglen el problema y cada vez me dicen que mandan a alguien. Solución… moverme a una habitación con dos camas en lugar de una… realmente agotador. 

Viajo mucho y Melia suele ser compromiso fiable pero esta vez no lo ha sido.

reviews.author: SergioJr
reviews.title: Restaurante Mizu
reviews.text:
Excelente atención de Fanny y Joel, pendientes en todo momento de nosotros y de nuestro confort. Rafael, el chef, hizo una obra magistral, cocina sencilla pero muy bien ejecutada en el tepanyaki.
Los productos empleados de muy buena calidad. Un placer esta noche.

reviews.author: jppk1
reviews.title: Cena restaurante Mizu
reviews.text:
Fanny es excelente. Joel buenísimo! Hemos disfrutado mucho de todo y todos. Una experiencia imprescindible en este lugar, Joel y Fanny no lo pueden hacer mejor y la comida es buenísima. 
Recomiendo a todo el que esté por la zona venir y ojalá tengáis suerte y estéis en manos de Joel y Fanny.

Rafael cocino espectacular!

reviews.author: WALTER C
reviews.title: Atención
reviews.text:
He disfrutado en oportunidades anteriores, sigue manteniendo la calidez y excelente atención.ñ, salvando algunas dificultades manifiestas atribuibles a la pandemia.
Quiero felicitar la atención en la playa de Hensel Peguero, educación y calidez. Excelente

reviews.author: Lisa Y
