reviews.title: Volsfan
reviews.text: Excellent service from Leonardo and the meal was fabulous!  Hope to make it back again in this trip. We all had different entrees and all were really good.  Also sampled the desserts and they were also good

reviews.author: Darin C
reviews.title: Beautiful Weather and Resort!!!
reviews.text: We had a group of 4 and stayed in a Reserve 2 bedroom swim up master suite.  The resort was beautiful and well maintained.  Our personal concierge, Sandy Gil, was extremely attentive and always made us feel taken care of.  I would highly recommend Sandy to any family or group.  The buffet could have been better, but Sandy always worked his magic to get us the reservations at the restaurants we requested.  The language barrier was difficult at times with some of the bartenders and waitstaff, but I think that added to the tropical feel.  Overall, I would recommend this resort.  ****

reviews.author: Jenn R
reviews.title: Amazing service at The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text: We had amazing service. Alvaro and Edward we so attentive as our concierge’s. John and Fernando our VIP Golf cart drivers were always Johnny on the spot whenever we called!! Mario kept the drinks flowing at the swim up bar at Palma Real. Jesus did a great job as our server at Vento. Leonardo took good care of us at the Gabi Club for breakfast. And Darius was so attentive with our room service orders. Everyone made us feel like we were in paradise!!!

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: Great vacation at The Reserve!!
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip. There were 17 of us. Edward, Alvaro, and Edgar were FANTASTIC! They answered all our questions super quick. They made the trip smooth and easy. They definitely went above and beyond! We will definitely recommend for friends!

reviews.author: Beachbum757
reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: The service from Edward and Alvaro was perfect! They were both very helpful and quick to reply to messages with information or anything that we needed. If we come back, I hope we get them as our hosts on our next visit.

reviews.author: Girlguns3
reviews.title: Punta Cana 22
reviews.text: Wow wow wow the staff here has been beyond amazing, from Edward, Alvaro, John and Fernando our drivers, to the hotel Bar staff…it’s been a pleasure vacationing to your country. Thank you we hope to see you soon!!!

reviews.author: Staci B
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Amazing resort. Had an amazing time.  All
Of the staff were amazing especially Robert (bar tender) Mario at the swim-up bar.  The Rum tasting activity with Darwin and Happy Boy was fun and entertaining.  Not only did we get to do shots of local rum we had a great time doing it.

reviews.author: Drodo
reviews.title: 2022 wedding Trip
reviews.text:
I want to first off by saying that the resort, beach and pool is beautiful. But the food is garbage. 90% of the food at the buffet is cold and the other half is gone. Went to the buffet at 730pm and a lot of the food was picked over and not replenished.  Some of the specialty restaurants are tasty but seemed to be understaffed and not ran well ( at one restaurant we waited an hour for the appetizer... ). 

The drinks were really good at the resort but not consistent at every bar.  Overall it was an amazing trip but wouldn't go to this resort again based on the food experience.

reviews.author: Andrew F
reviews.title: Lo mejor de punta cana
reviews.text: Lo mejor en punta cana es un paraíso en este hotel paradisus palma real sin lugar a duda las habitaciones el servicio pero sobre todo los restaurantes el personal muy amable tokimeku el trato fue espectacular

reviews.author: Giancarlo M
reviews.title: Hotel paradisus palma real
reviews.text: En el bar vento el bartender Juan Vicente me dio un servicio excepcional y sus tragos especiales fueron muy buenos su atencion al cliente es una de las mejores que eh recibido,  muchas gracias por todo este bar es muy recomendado!

reviews.author: Reynerio M
reviews.title: Un paraíso
reviews.text: Encantados con el servicio de este maravilloso paraíso con un paisaje espectacular la comida exquisita especialmente destacar el servicios de los restaurantes el trato, el servicio la comida es excelente

reviews.author: Alexandria J
reviews.title: Satisfied customer
reviews.text:
We received great service from Juan Vicente! He makes the best drinks friendly welcoming vibes. Always smiling giving a good laugh when needed. When visiting please
Ask for Juan VICENTE. He may be at a different area but try his drinks and energy!

reviews.author: Darling Sax
reviews.title: Que gran hotel
reviews.text:
Soy Saxofonista en este hotel , pero nunca lo visité como cliente 

Y wao … quede encantado 

La comida , los bares , la playa , los empleados 

Todo fue fenomenal 

Gracias a la dirección, gerencia y todo el equipo de entrenamiento 

Pedro , Nataly, La señora Adrianne , la señora anuska … gracias por su amabilidad y hospitalidad

reviews.author: prod tamoentoa
reviews.title: Day pass entre amigos
reviews.text: Wao!! Sorprendente pasar un día en el hotel palma real compartir un montón con mis amigos buen ambiente el real paraíso con buena bebida, entretenimiento del equipo de Meliá los muchachos nos acompañaron todo el día con sus actividades

reviews.author: Robbc
reviews.title: Gabi Bar at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Alvin Batista, bar tender at the Gabi Bar was excellent!  Don’t forget to tip him. He’s friendly, cordial, professional and makes a wonderful drink. He’s expert!!!!  Super nice gentleman!!  Again……Excellennt!!!

reviews.author: Francisco Domenech
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Lugar paradisíaco gente maravillosa ve y disfruta de lo demás se encarga un equipo de profesionales gente cercana y familiar en especial Adriane encantadora y siempre atenta restaurantes de lujo seguro que encuentras el tuyo a tu gusto y actividades para todos los gustos recomendado 100x100

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Gabi Beach Bar
reviews.text: Yiri, Ruby, Albin, and Raysen give amazing service at the Gabi Beach Bar!!! They are all so helpful, friendly and energetic. They really made our trip so great! Definitely recommend the resort overall!

reviews.author: Glenis E
reviews.title: Un paraíso en punta cana
reviews.text: Este hotel es espectacular con una Plata hermosa pero sobre todo con una gastronomía exquisita destacar el servicio de todo el personal de alimentos y bebidas en especial el de Eddy suero quien nos ayudo con las reservas y bueno el show cooking fue lo mejor

reviews.author: MARIA M
reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text:
I AM at the hotel and I have never seen a more horrible service than here.
 The beach is really wonderful!  Beautiful sea and white sand!
 But…..
 Right now , I'm not taking a shower because  the hot water ended. 
The air conditioner looks like a refrigerator making noise.  Employees are grumpy.  You ask for something at the reception and don't come.  A horror show.
 What is saving is the wonderful place and my companions who are wonderful too, but otherwise…
 I'm in room 1026, I arrived on the 2nd and will stay until 15/01/22.  Let's see if anything improves.

reviews.author: Jia O
reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text:
This resort has so much potential but the management and receptionist are terrible, food is okay and I honestly wouldn’t bother coming back. 

The only reason I gave this 2 stars was because our server on the beach, Rafael was amazing. He was attentive, made sure we always had a spot on the beach and nearby the pool and honestly suggested amazing drinks to my friends and I. 
If it was not for Rafael, I would’ve gave this 0 stars. 

This hotel needs better management, better service and overall needs to be organized. 
I’ve never had experienced such terrible service at a “5 star” hotel. 
They don’t even live up to the 5 stars - they’re honestly a 3 star hotel and that’s me being generous.

reviews.author: Milka C
reviews.title: Vacaciones en Palma Real punta Cana
reviews.text: Excelente  eres vacaciones, Darlin y Roberto muy buenos entretenedores y anfitriones de las distintas actividades del hotel. Existen muchas actividades, la comida muy buena y pudimos descansar. Volveríamos en una próxima oportunidad.

reviews.author: Gerardo
reviews.title: Melia Vacaciones
reviews.text:
El mejor lugar para disfrutar del baile y la alegria caribeña! La playa excelente, los chicos de animación Roberto y Darlin muy buenos profesores de baile!
Muy bueno para hacer deporte y botar en el baile lo tomado y comido!

reviews.author: A S
reviews.title: Winter vacation
reviews.text: Sairen was our concierge for the week and he did not disappoint. He took extra care of me and my travel partner. He was very attentive to our requests and insured that our requests were met with satisfaction. This resort always delivers excellent service and the staff are always friendly, courteous and aim to please. Thank you Sairen for taking great attention and care!

reviews.author: Rockgirlca1
reviews.title: Great resort & Concierge Franklin
reviews.text:
Wanted to write this review before I departed spent an exceptional time  at Paradisus Palma Real over the last week . The weather/beach/ resort was perfect but more important were the staff , always greeted with a smile . During my stay , the concierge Franklin Truque was tremendously helpful  whether it was restaurant recommendations or activities . Franklin was very professional ,he knows the resort well and shared best recommendations for lunch / dinner each day . Franklin’s attention to detail made our stay even better , so much so another trip is being planned ! 

Thank you Paradisus Palma Real and Franklin !

reviews.author: irmscher7
reviews.title: Hotel precioso
reviews.text: Hotel muy bonito con personal muy amable y atento. Se come muy bien en los restaurantes, sobretodo en el Brisas, Sal y Tokymeku. Comer en este último es un espectáculo. El lugar es inmejorable, delante de una preciosa playa de arena blanca. Volvería sin dudarlo.

reviews.author: Manel M
reviews.title: Vacaciones espectaculares!
reviews.text:
Tanto las instalaciones, como el personal, como los restaurantes son espectaculares!
Hotel totalmente recomendable para venir, en pareja, en familia o con amigos.
Ya estamos planeando volver el próximo invierno!

reviews.author: Albert Achón
reviews.title: Totalmente recomendable
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, muy limpio y con un personal muy amable y todo tipo de servicios. Ideal para pasar unos días en la isla. La comida buenísima y variada. Una experiencia muy grata y que repetiría sin dudarlo. Totalmente recomendable.

reviews.author: Justin T
reviews.title: Great Service!!
reviews.text: My group of 10 stayed here last week, and we received amazing service specifically at the beach! Our server Jesus Evangelista was very attentive and was super nice! He would help grab us drinks whether we were sitting poolside or by the beach. He made our trip such a wonderful experience. Thanks Jesus!

reviews.author: sandy c
reviews.title: Could be better...
reviews.text:
I travelled here with my friends with the intent of experiencing the resort first hand before booking her destination wedding here for next year. We are currently still here on day 3.
The check in process was not pleasant. As soon as we arrived we wanted to take our luggage with us. We were forced to leave it with the bell boys. Then we were asked to be seated and someone would come talk to us. He basically gave us our bracelets and told us our room number with no other information about the resort, how we go about booking the restaurant or our covid tests back.
Because it was 3 of us we confirmed that there were at least 2 beds in the room. There were 2 bed alright but pushed together to make one giant bed. When we tried to call front desk they kept hanging up on us so we had to go back to front desk to make our requests. We asked that the beds be separated and also have a roll in bed brought in (we were not keen to use the sofa/pull out bed). When we returned they brought the roll in, pulled out the sofa bed and the two double beds were still together. All good. We made the best of it. Also we did not expect the rooms to have open concept washrooms. Overall not a huge inconvenience, just some hiccups. 

We haven't had a chance to try the restaurant food yet as we arrived on Friday evening and all reservations were booked.
(Tip: restaurant reservations open up for the week on Sunday morning. If you arrive for your trip on say a Monday or Tuesday, you probably won't get a reservation.) 
But so far we have really enjoyed the buffet food and variety. 

Here is where it goes downhill... 
By the second night in our bedroom just before bed, I noticed little bumps on my legs. It wasn't from mosquitos as we hadn't seen any. And immeditaky I knew to check the bed (I slept on the extra roll in bed). There were bedbug droppings and stains. I didn't sleep all night. The next morning we requested for a room change - I will say that they were very accommodating and did not question or challenge us and agreed to change our rooms. Although when I showed them the photos I took of the bed they said was was just 'rust'. 
We asked that the room have the beds separated. Once again the beds were not separated plus it was just not a stocked/ready room in general (empty fridge, no robes or slippers etc) so we called (at 5pm) to have this corrected. 20 mins they said. The fridge was stocked at 6:30pm and we went for dinner. We returned at 10pm and the beds were still not separated. Made another call and they came right away. Finally. 

Although no fault of the resort, the beach was just not quality compared to those in Jamaica, Varadero, or Mexico. Very choppy and full of Seaweed, despite their best efforts to clean it up constantly. 

The positive is that the service staff are incredible: 
Ismal from the lobby bar makes the best 'happy cofee' and Ruby from the main bar next to the buffet 
is just an absolute gem - pun intended.
The resort grounds are beautiful and kept immaculate. 
Even Alejandro or 'happy boy' - the event staff is a ton of fun and super friendly.

Lastly, my friend never received a response back from the wedding booking/romance office. And at this point the decision has been made not to hold the wedding here.

We do have 4 more days here... So let's see how it goes... But for me personally and my extremely itchy legs... It's put quite the damper on my mood. But I will make the best of it, because this is still paradise and will update should anything notable is worth sharing.

reviews.author: Pamela R
reviews.title: We’ll be back!!!
reviews.text: We had an awesome vacation! Beautiful resort with plenty of nightly entertainment. Our concierge Jose Salvador was very professional, he took care of all our daily needs. Made our daily dinner reservations, informed us of daily activities, provided covid testing info, Jose went & got a copy when results didn't come to our email.  5 star rating was for Jose, beautiful and well maintained property & entertainment. The drink selection sucks, lobby bar was only bar that had descent drink selection other 6+ only had well liquors.  Don't pay for premium liquor!! You’ll be disappointed at the selection

reviews.author: Mariela F
reviews.title: Camarera
reviews.text: La atencion de la senorita Altagracia Cruz en Avenue bar fue excelente,muy atenta y pendiente a todos los clientes.Estamos realmente satisfecho con el cervicio de esta barra y su equipo de trabajo.Si recomendamos que el hotel ofresca mas entretenimientos,como musica especialmente tipica de este pais como bachata y merengue,porque si viajas a un pais caribeño eso es lo que esperas disfrutar,al igual qie musica varida para complacer todos los gustos y no solamente los gustos de personas de otros continentes.

reviews.author: Jim H
reviews.title: Golf vacation
reviews.text: Golf 4 days everything was good Gabriel Bobadilla was extremely helpful and professional, the service and hotel are very good, beautiful area, food was great, we really enjoy our time, Katherine was very nice and helpful at the check out.

reviews.author: Randy B
reviews.title: Great vacation!!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort with many amenities. We stayed in the presidential suite. The view from the room was amazing. Spectacular views of the ocean. I would recommend this resort to everyone. The property was in great shape. The rooms were extremely clean and you can tell that they were taking precautions with COVID-19. They had sanitizer stations throughout the property. At the restaurants they would give you gloves to wear if you were going to the buffet. I must say out of all the all inclusive resorts I have stayed at the food here is the best. They have many restaurants and the food was exquisite. I would like to give out a shout out to some of the employees at the Paradisus. Starting with Pedro at the beach services. He was incredible and very accommodating. He had the best personality and he would make my wife and I laughed at the things he said. Each morning Pedro would go out and put towels on our chair and have it set up for us. He was a joy to see first thing in the morning with his positive personality.
Secondly I would like to give a shout out to Sanchez. I can’t pronounce his first name but his last name is Sanchez. He took care of all of our needs from the time we arrived at the resort until we departed. He booked all of our reservations for the restaurants. Also we had a few small minor problems. We notified Sanchez and he took care of all of our needs. Great job Sanchez. Thank you for all of your hard work and your dedication to the resort guest. Lastly I would like to give a shout out to Gabriel. This guy is unbelievable at customer service and so professional. Gabriel followed up on the minor issues that we had. He went above my expectations of resolve. He checked on us frequently throughout our stay to make sure that everything was running smoothly. I’m returning to the resort in November. I was having a issue with golf reservations for our return trip. Gabriel took it upon himself to call the golf course to ensure that we would have reservations in November. I was really blown away by his customer service skills. We were unable to get the golf reservations settled before I left the resort. However, Gabriel assured me he would take care of this after I left the resort to be sure that the golf situation was resolved. Thank you Gabriel Bobadilla for all that you did. I have all the confidence in the world and Gabriel when it comes to resolving issues of resort guest. I’m looking forward to returning in November.

reviews.author: Larry M
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation!!
reviews.text: The hotel has great food and service golf, pools and Gabriel Bobadilla went above and beyond the call of duty. Also our cleaning lady Altagracia she did a great job every day, the whole experience was very nice for sure coming back.

reviews.author: yanetrodriguez792
reviews.title: Excelente lugar y servicios que ofrecen
reviews.text: Es un lugar muy encantador y  acondicionado para estadías y diferentes actividades, felicidades a su personal por todas las atenciones brindadas, su confort es excelente para pasar momentos agradables y en relación a comidas es excepcional

reviews.author: Karlene Barry
reviews.title: Concierge of the year!!!
reviews.text:
Yesica Reyes was our concierge for vacation - she was wonderful and accommodating our every wish. She came to check on us to be sure we were happy with everything.

At the spa Alba was great. We enjoyed every day, relaxing at the beach and by the pool.

reviews.author: Theresa D
reviews.title: Best concierge ever!!!  Beautiful resort!!  Will be back for sure
reviews.text: Yesica Reyes, our concierge,  has made the trip the most wonderful vacation I’ve ever experienced. I will not only recommend this resort, good food, good service, but the most extrodinary concierge Yesica.

reviews.author: LS
reviews.title: Relax
reviews.text:
Beautiful views, very relaxing.
The beds and pillows are very comfortable with a spacious room including a patio with rockers, loungers, hot tub and beautiful beach views! Sunrise was spectacular. Room 6005.
The adult pool is very quiet with excellent attention being paid to you by Pedro, Wanda and Martin. Always happy and very accommodating.
We had a "butler" Kelvin, who was also excellent in his service and attention. Anything we needed, you text and he makes it happen. It is part of "the reserve" accommodations. 
Along with that reserve reservation there is another pool that is very large and fairly quiet. There arre plenty of lounging areas, with tanning "beds"on the beach and around the pool and lots of cabanas.
José was in charge of our mini bar which was ALWAYS stocked and ready. Again, any attention you needed was paid. Housekeeping was on point and as the rest, excellent.
The Neo's restaurant for buffet lunch was great and a special shout out to Santo for being to kind!
I only had a massage at the spa, and I do recommend pampering yourself there if you can.
There are numerous lounge areas and bars with very lively music and fun at night.
Overall a very relaxing, sun and fun filled trip!

reviews.author: Marcela
reviews.title: Our experience: the wait staff was super friendly. However, Juan Castillo, our concierge, in particular was outstanding!
reviews.text:
With exception of the Wine shop, Sal. Steakhouse and Brisas, the food left a lot to be desired. The Italian restaurant (next Brisas) could not find a bottle is Astica, I had to get the bottle from room. 
Our room had a leaky drain pipe and we were out of Kleenex for three day although we made very obvious there were none.

reviews.author: Jeanlouis G
reviews.title: Best time at lobby bar
reviews.text: I had the best time at the lobby bar with the excellent staff Altagracia Cruz and Lucia Dias at lobby bar . Great  drinks and professional staff would recommend any day of the week. If you have any question just ask the staff they will treat you like royalty.

reviews.author: Arturo L
reviews.title: Awesome staff!!
reviews.text:
Such an amazing place!
We had the best time ever!

In Avenue bar, Lucia, Yisauri, Leticia and Luis Rosario made us feel like at home! 10/10

They are so nice and welcoming and everyone at the hotel is so nice.

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: Thank you for the hospitality!
reviews.text: The Avenue Bar is the best late night spot at the resort with the best mojitos I've had all thanks to the best bartenders in Punta cana. I wish I could rate them 10 stars. Gracias Altagracia Cruz, Lucía días, Yisauri Luis garces. If you are looking for an after dinner drink and great conversation Definitely check out the Avenue!

reviews.author: Rocío Castillo
reviews.title: An unforgettable experience.
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is one of the best hotels I've ever had the pleasure to visit. The environment is very relaxing, the food is extremely delicious and the staff's attentions are exceptional. Had a really great time, would totally recommend it.

reviews.author: RK Watkins
reviews.title: excellent dinners
reviews.text: The food was amazing and the service was even better.  Our waiter Luis made us feel like special family. He and the Olio staff at Paradisus Palma Real made our trip ! We will be sure to return every time we are here.

reviews.author: dmbt1972
reviews.title: EXCELENTE
reviews.text: Me encantó la atención de mi concierge, Reyna de Paula, espectacular servicio, compromiso total con los clientes, atención personalizada, instalaciones impecables, cómodas confortables, servicio de bufette  variado, restaurantes de comida internacional, shows y entretenimiento maravillosos, en general toda mi experiencia de descanso y recreación fue de primera categoría en el hotel Meliá Palma Real

reviews.author: Lorena E
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text: The staff was friendly and attentive, Yudadis made sure we had a great time with good drinks while our beautiful suite was being prepared. Great music and atmosphere by the pool areas at night. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Compass570523
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.text: “ People say when you have a business the number 1 rule is “location, location, location”. A lot of businesses have that, but they lack excellence in customer service. Paradisus Palma Real has both a beautiful location and EXCELLENT customer service. The team in this resort will go over and beyond to assist you and make your stay a fantastic one. We are very thankful that we’ve hit it out of the park picking this place for our vacation and we will be sure to return as they have won not only mine, but my friend’s and family’s customer loyalty for years to come. ”

reviews.author: Samantha P
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
We had a great time at our stay. Jose was our personal concierge and he was truly amazing! Very kind, patient, and always one step ahead of us! Whenever we had questions regarding our dining reservations, excursions, or needs for our suite, Jose responded or showed up immediately. He checked in with us multiple times throughout the day to make sure we were doing okay - always on top of it! He always made sure our best interests and safety came first. 

The resort was really beautiful, clean, and all of the staff we interacted with treated us like family. A really lovely place to escape when you need to relax and reset!

reviews.author: veronica f
reviews.title: Sunset Bar
reviews.text:
Wanda se portó 1000000 puntos, excelente anfitriona, nos tendió a cuerpo de reyes durante toda la estadía! Recomendadisimoooo! 

Si se hospedan en Paradisus palma real este bar es el mejor gracias a la atención de Wanda.

reviews.author: Javier M
reviews.title: Gracias Braulio Cedeño
reviews.text: Todo fantástico, sobre todo el servicio de Braulio Cedeño en el restaurante Vento. Un super camarero que sabe atender y dar el mejor servicio que he recibido en toda mi estancia en el Paradisus Palma Real. Espero que Melia cuide a empleados como él.

reviews.author: Yafreisy Manuel F
reviews.title: Vacaciones Paradisus palma real
reviews.text: Estuve en Paradisus palma real. Unas vacaciones excelente gracias a los chicos de el bar de la piscina me dieron un buen servicio el señor Luis ,gerinaldo,Mario y Luis el capitán muy buena personas la habitación muy bonita gracias por el servicio regresaré pronto

reviews.author: Lavern G
reviews.title: Great!!!!
reviews.text:
The service was exceptional. The hotel and resort was very clean. The food was exceptionally good at the buffet in at all the restaurants.
The whole staff was efficient and very helpful.  The Bar Avenue and Atlagracia Cruz were very professional! Great service!

reviews.author: Itziar P
reviews.title: Nuestros ángeles de la guarda
reviews.text:
Fuimos mi amiga y yo solas y nos han tratado de maravilla, el personal muy cercano y cariñoso, las instalaciones preciosas y un servicio estupendo. Queremos dar mención especial a 
- Victor Sánchez y Luis del Gabi bar
- Niurka Espinales y Osvaldo de Vento.
- Cancú del Vento y Palazzo 
- Darwin de la barra del Vento 
- María de recepción
- Drácula del Tepanyaki
Y por último, especialmente agradecidas a Yesica Reyes, nuestra conscierge que nos ha ayudado con cada problema que hemos tenido y ha sido nuestra ángel de la guarda dominicana!! 
Gracias por esta maravilloda experiencia y estamos deseando repetir con vosotros.

reviews.author: Patricia B
reviews.title: Superb!!!! Hotel novo, quartos excelentes: ficamos em uma junior suite com vista para a piscina e banheira na varanda.
reviews.text: Hotel novo, luxuoso e equipe muito amável e prestativa. Concierge sempre disponivel e super atuante: reservou todos os jantares e massagem/spa. A equipe nos informou que tinhamos o teste de antigeno no pacote, necessario para a entrada nos USA. Para o Brasil é necessário apresentar teste PCR negativo, que tem custo para o hospede.

reviews.author: Carolina V
reviews.title: Agradecida
reviews.text: Feliz. Los mejores anfitriones. Me sentí en casa con las personas de lobby bar. Conozcan a capitán Joan castillo. Las camareras más espectaculares del hotel sin duda alguna. Olga y walquiria. Un amor de mujeres

reviews.author: Craig M
reviews.title: Wanda y Martín son fantásticos
reviews.text: Wanda and Martín always made amazing drinks, and they were a pleasure to talk with. We really appreciate all they did! It wouldn’t have been the same experience at Paradisus Palma Real without them!!!

reviews.author: FellowTraveler223318
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Everyone was helpful and caring.  Employees all do their best and service was outstanding. As the hotel had reopened in June I could tell it needs a little more time for a 5/5. Administration should be going around the building to notice some tiles are missing in the swimming pool floor, a glass in an elevator was broken and never fixed while we were there, and some paint jobs are needed.  Reservations for restaurants should be easier to do.  At check in, guests should be told they need reservations to use the facility.

reviews.author: Alfonso U
reviews.title: Perfectas
reviews.text:
La atencion del personal excelente, incorporaria algun tipo mas variado de comida europea.
El buffete para mi lo mejor, sin dezmejorar el resto.
Darling de actividades perfecta en su labor de hacer disfrutar a los clientes, asi como Reina en sus consejos dentro de estas estupendas instalaciones.
Saludos desde Vilanova i la Geltru

reviews.author: Francesca
reviews.title: Awesome Customer Service
reviews.text:
Paradisius Palma Reale is GORGEOUS, clean and such a pleasure to stay!  The care and concern that the staff shows is one that makes you feel like family!  

Our butler, Jose, was there for us whenever we needed, and he did so much for us, leaving us time to enjoy the amenities of resort!  From reserving our COVID test appointments to getting our results to us in a timely fashion to reserving our transport to the airport, he did it all!!   The food, even the buffet, was delicious.  The entertainment was good, considering there are restrictions due to the pandemic, but we were entertained every night. 

If there was anything I didn’t like, it was from some of the vendors that were a little pushy…. The photographer was a little too much and I felt like he was in our face every 5 mins asking when we would do a photo session. Other than that, this place is PHENOMENAL!!!

reviews.author: Jessica M
reviews.title: Family/friends vacation
reviews.text: Was great, he had everything planned and sorted out for us. Never any confusion when dealing with  Nathaniel. Hope for the next vacation we get him again! Definitely a wonderful place to vacation. See you again soon

reviews.author: Beatriz janna p
reviews.title: El mejor hotel
reviews.text: Fui con unas amigas a pasar un fin de semana y la verdad quedamos encantadas, la comida súper buena en el buffet, la cena en el restaurante palazzo con las atenciones de Wilkins fue espectacular. En los bares nos prepararon una bebida llamada Miami beach que nos encantó, el staff del spa con unas atenciones increíbles, Sandro el recepcionista súper amable y Yeimy la terapeuta con manos mágicas terminaron de completar mi súper fin de semana. Volveremos, eso es seguro.

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Wedding weekend
reviews.text: Amazing weekend at Paradisus for a wedding. The resort was beautiful and well maintained. Everyone at the hotel was very professional. Additionally our concierge Edward was the best. He made sure everything was in place and we had a great time.

reviews.author: Omgitzfern
reviews.title: Avenue Lounge is Amazing
reviews.text: Lucia and the night time crew at Avenue Lounge were super attentive. They knew our drink orders after ONE time ordering, awesome crew! Head there after dinner for a good time. Dancing right in front by the dance crew. It was a blast

reviews.author: William A
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia!
reviews.text: He tenido una de las mejores experiencias vacacionales en Punta Cana. Definitivamente lo recomendaria. Tuvieron un buen protocolo de seguridad contra el Covid-19, limpieza y sobre un excelente servicio al cliente.

reviews.author: Mailmanmike60
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real June 2021
reviews.text: We visited the hotel June 13 through the 19th , we used optium private transfer company to the hotel and back, Price was $88 round-trip, this was our second trip back to the hotel so we brought a few of our friends along , with Covid there was some restrictions but all the restaurants were open which were excellent highly recommend reservations we use concierge Lewis de la Cruz, We would highly recommend him, we spoke daily and he was on top of everything that was requested, very knowledgeable of the facility and off the grounds, also spoke with Alvaro M Fernandez about excursions off the ship, The grounds were beautiful , the pools also , some small issues with the beach with the sea grass but they did maintain it the best they could , There was some Covid restrictions one being when you went to the Buffet you were given a pair of gloves when entering , The Buffet has a huge selection of items and was a excellent choice for breakfast and lunch daily , also some activities at night but not as much as last time we visited , The pool bar was not open in the pool seating area , But there was enough waiters walking around to order a drink or two, we also spoke to a Rafeal Luis who also was very helpful during our stay , we would highly recommend any of these three for your travel needs, Lewis de la cruz made our week stay enjoyable and memorable and we can’t wait to go visit this excellent hotel in the future, we would highly recommend , oh , Covid test was required and we did it at the hotel 72 hrs prior to leaving , we had our results within 15 minutes, paperwork was given to us for return home

reviews.author: Gmills54
reviews.title: Spa was great. The food and drinks were great. Keeping the room clean daily was great. Seven day stay.
reviews.text: The place was nice. The air quality was great. Glad they cleaned the room every day. The food at Palazzo, Vento, Cafeteria and Sal was good. Not happy with what Sal and Rosemary put me through with reservations and spa time.  My three days of spa time was awesome.  Poto over pricing needs to stop. People spend a lot to attend and do things the photos should not cost that much. Otherwise let peering their on cameras or phones and take pictures if you are going to price gouge.

reviews.author: Sarah R
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
I have been to more than 5 different resorts in the Dominican- usually around Bavaro, but this was the best. 
Jose Salvador our concierge was amazing- he went out of his way multiple times to give us an unforgettable experience. One night we forgot to book dinner reservations so we tried 2 different places on our own and both were booked, we called him (after he left the resort for the night) and he managed to get us a last minute reservation at the steakhouse, Sal. He texted us good morning, asked us how we are doing, if we need anything, how dinner was the previous night and sent us the list of activities every day. He would periodically find us around the resort during the day just to check up on us and see if we needed anything. We brought a giant inflatable unicorn and he helped us carry him to the pool. Even as we were checking out of the hotel he met us at the lobby and spoke with our airport transportation person to clarify our pick up spot. From beginning to end he really facilitated a stress free trip for us. 

One of our major concerns before going out of country was covid testing. Jose made our appointment, printed out necessary paperwork and sent us an online link to use. The covid testing is on site at the hotel, takes 5 minutes start to finish and was a very simple process- especially with him to schedule it. 

At Sunset bar on the adults only side, which you can go to if you are booked under “the reserve at Paradisus palma real” was the best bartender- Wanda! Wanda was so fun, very welcoming and extremely accommodating. We would go to her for drinks regardless of where we were set up for the day. She made us unique and fun drinks, took amazing pictures for us and was so kind. 

Martin who is also a bartender at sunset would set up a spot for us with towels and a book, bring us drinks and made us feel very welcomed. He was very kind, funny and made us feel at home.

reviews.author: Yareli C
reviews.title: Ariel Benzo
reviews.text: Ariel benzo was our guide during our trip. He booked everything for us! All of our dinners and activities! He made our stay stress free! Everything was taken care of by him! He is amazing, always with a smile on his face and so helpful! We loved our stay!

reviews.author: Patricia W
reviews.title: Darlin and Edison
reviews.text: Great hotel resort.Darlin and Edison are friendly.  Beautiful Rooms.  Very friendly.  The food is excellent.   Met interesting people all over the country.  Spa massage is highly recommended.  Rum Tasting is recommended!!

reviews.author: Vivian
reviews.title: Vacaciones de Cumpleaños
reviews.text:
La atención de lis empleados es excelente la comida también es buena
La piscina es excelente
Yo con mucho gusto regresaría nuevament
Las tiendas son buenas
El ambiente es muy placentero y Darlin de actividades es alegre simpática y divertida

reviews.author: Shirley D
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: I real enjoyed and amazing  👏  love it . Guy real wonderful.  It was my first time artist 🎨  Darlin  . Onal real good teach to peoples . God bless . 😃🤟🤟 . It wonderful  active . I love u all . 😊😊🤗🤩

reviews.author: dasha p
reviews.title: Darya
reviews.text: My first time at Paradisus Punta Cana and Love this amazing resort and I will definitely come back again! Service is amazing! Everyone is treating you with respect and smile on their faces. Jesus Peguero from guest service is one of them amazing person helps you with anything you need at this resort. Pools are just speechless and gorgeous design!

reviews.author: Samantha
reviews.title: Best vacation
reviews.text: I visited in June and the hotel is gorgeous. The food is great and the rooms are so clean and comfortable. The staff is amazing especially Geraldo Ramirez. He was nothing but helpful and kind our entire stay. I highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Jerry
reviews.title: Friends vacation!!!!
reviews.text:
It was an amazing time celebrating a friends birthday the hospitality was outstanding from the moment when we arrived to walking us out the door! All around an amazing experience! 

Thank you to Alvaro for making my experience one of the best ever! 

We will be back again soon.

reviews.author: Sofia Lopez Farina
reviews.title: Chocolate tasting
reviews.text: we came for a family friend trip and so when we came for the chocolate tasting we were able to learn a few new things about the processing about chocolate. it was very interesting and the tasting made the experience better. we would recommend this to our friends. we did this with geraldo.

reviews.author: Kab
reviews.title: Girls weekend!!!
reviews.text:
Great arrival reception!! Our butler Alvaro was exceptional and the hotel was so accommodating to our every request!!!Martin and Pedro always had our pool chairs ready and swim towels for us!!!
Beautiful property and plenty of restaurant options!!

reviews.author: Kesari P
reviews.title: Staff was amazing!
reviews.text: The staff at the resort is what made our trip so memorable. Geraldo, in activities, was so much fun and made our time at the resort so special! I am so happy I had the chance to meet all of the wonderful people at the resort!

reviews.author: Krissy
reviews.title: beautiful hotel, super nice staff
reviews.text:
I felt very comfortable in this hotel and spent a wonderful time there.  Pool and food were great and the beach was beautiful.  

The staff were very nice, especially Geraldo, with whom we participated in a lot of activities.  He entertained us well and was very warm to us.  Thank you for the lovely stay, we'd love to come back!

reviews.author: Mary H
reviews.title: Mary H
reviews.text: Alvaro Fernandez provided excellent service throughout our trip. And Wanda at the Reserve Bar was awesome! Not all the restaurants were open, but the ones that were were good. The civiche tasting was yummy and the wine tasting informative.

reviews.author: agodevais
reviews.title: EDISON & HAPPY BOY ARE THE BEST
reviews.text: We had so much fun with Edison and Happy Boy doing all sorts of activities like wine tasting, cocktail making, macrame etc. Edison makes the best cocktails and Happy Boy is so nice and fun to chat with. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Juliana C
reviews.title: MARAVILLOSO
reviews.text: Tivemos uma estada MARAVILHOSA no Paradisus Palma Real. Felizmente, eu e meus 7 amigos fomos atendidos pelo funcionário ARIEL BENZO. QUE ATENDIMENTO! Ariel, sempre atencioso, se mostrava disponível 24h para nos atender. Solícito e educado, foi o ponto alto da nossa viagem, com certeza! Agradecemos por esse momento tão especial! Além disso, tivemos o prazer de sermos atendidos no bar perto à piscina do The Reserve pela funcionária WANDA! Que felicidade!!!

reviews.author: GabriellaPapaleo
reviews.title: EXCELENTE
reviews.text: Ficamos na categoria The Reserve do Paradisus Palma Real. Nosso grupo era de 8 pessoas e tivemos a felicidade de receber o atendimento do funcionário Ariel Benzo! Ele foi atencioso e se encarregou 24/7 de organizar e planejar nossas atividades (jantares, almoços, passeios e outros). A estrutura do hotel e o atendimento do staff eram impecáveis e, com toda a certeza, fizeram a nossa estada se tornar excelente!

reviews.author: Danilo C
reviews.title: SENSACIONAL
reviews.text: Chegamos em 4 casais e só temos a agradecer. Quando chegamos o nosso mordomo Ariel Benzo nos recepcionou e tratou de tornar nossa hospedagem a melhor possível até o final da viagem, somos muito gratos! Assim como ele, outros membros do staff também foram extremamente atenciosos com o grupo, sempre com o melhor humor do mundo. Especialmente a Wanda e o Mario do bar the reserve, nosso amigo Pedro concierge da piscina, o Edison no bar do lobby e o mehor garçom Jose!!!!! Fico Muito agradecido por tudo.

reviews.author: RetiredandReady
reviews.title: Beware - the property is not open. You will stay at The Circle by Meliá
reviews.text:
The good- DR is beautiful and we were able to get into the country and resort last minute. We were headed to Cozumel until Hurricane Delta hit. So fast forward 2 days. We originally book at another resort but service there was no existent. Agent got us move to PPRG&SR last minute, but when we arrived we actually were at the Circle by Meliá. Very modern but NOT beach front. So I can’t review PPRG&SR, but until Covid impact is over be sure and ask what resort you will actually be at. 
They didn’t tell my agent about the change.

reviews.author: AMPGMC_15
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed here at the end of February before all the COVID madness and we had the most wonderful stay! The staff and hotel were exceptional, and the setting is just beautiful. There is a great selection of restaurants and the food it lovely. I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Sean H
reviews.title: Paradisus

reviews.author: maur0r0cha
reviews.title: Hotel bom, mas podia ser melhor!
reviews.text: Eu fiquei hospedada na área VIP do hotel, mas achei o serviço um pouco precário em relação ao que nos é oferecido. Tudo é movido a gorjetas para um melhor atendimento. Os Quartos precisam de melhor manutenção. E a privacidade dos banheiro no quarto é péssima. Tudo que precisamos demora muito para ser resolvido, Há poucos empregados para o numero de hospedes, e alguns estão sempre com a cara amarrada. No geral, gostei da minha estadia, pois fomos com amigos e até os contra tempos acabam ficando divertidos. Nos restaurantes tudo é muito demorado, nossos jantares eram marcados às 20hs e em todos eles nossa comida demorava em média mais de 1 hora para chegar. Serviço muito lento. Percebemos porém, que quando devamos gorjetas antes do atendimento e serviço melhorava um pouco. Enfim, o hotel no geral é bem bonito, gostoso de ficar, mas precisa de alguns ajustes.

reviews.author: Lauren U
reviews.title: Great first time at all inclusive
reviews.text:
This was my first time at an all inclusive and it was great. I typically do cruises and this experience had way better access to chairs, beaches, and pools. While at the beach, we had an awesome guy, Jendry de Luna who took amazing care of our group of 4 friends, setting our chairs up, brining is drinks, making sure we were content.

My only critique is the restaurants. Sal’s, the steak place lost our reservation, one night, seated us an hour late the next, then served our mediocre at best food another hour later. Stick to the buffet or habachi, which are excellent.

Thank you Edison, Lillian, Luis, Jendry,Rauly and Teudy until we meet again!
South Dakota!
Jerry and Cara Beers

reviews.text: What a great time we had. The service, grounds, food and room was amazing! reviews.author: SimplyTravel
reviews.title: Complex nice - service & food medium
reviews.text:
We have been with a big group. 
This is a typical Dom Rep resort. Even bigger that the ones we have been before. 
The complex is nice. Beach is great and everything seems to be well maintained.
Check in was good. Pick up from the airport also worked fine. 

3 things that really annoyed us, and are the reasons we will most probably choose another hotel the next time:

- Service: we have been to Punta Cana before and experienced great service. Not here. Most people working here seemed annoyed by guests. Some where even unfriendly or refuse to work.
Drinks come after 10 mins. In the restaurant. Orders are not taken correctly and waiters are angry if you tell them. One day we asked 3 times for an extra plate- never was brought to the table.
For a hotel.of this category an absolute no-go.
Service at the beach - hm. Got asked one time - afterwards no one came. As well : could be better

-Food: most all-inclusive hotels we have been so far, food never was spectacular but rather tasted neutral. This is even kind of understandable. Nevertheless, we thought the food to be worse than in most other places. Actually most food tastes like nothing. Some dishes are even just bad. Truffle Pasta without truffle (no truffle oil - simply nothing).
Beef with seemingly 50% Fat. 
Hashbrowns which are obviously several hours old or rewarmed with a consistency of rubber.
Wine which is rather vinegar than wine. 
All salt pepper shakers blocked from humidity (if you find some). Personal not able to help you when complaining.

Honestly the best food were the burgers which they make at their beach as well.as the pizza at the buffet as well as the fresh eggs and the French toast at the breakfast. Everything else really not worth it. 
- Room & service: our shower was leaking. We asked 2 times to repair it. Nothing happend and the water kept running for 6 days. I have been to 2 star hotels where this would have been handled more professional.

All together we were kind of disappointed.
As we have been more than 100 people, I know that most of our companions thought the same way.
Consering the price they charge, at least de service should be better.

reviews.author: Swy A.
reviews.title: Mi estadía en Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text:
En general me gustó la experiencia en este hotel, me aloje en el Royal Service y no me arrepiento. Fui a celebrar mi cumpleaños y la pasé muy bien. 

Positivo:
Excelente proceso de check-in y check out. Para el check-in te reciben en un lobby privado con bebidas y picaderas (snacks) y el check out fue realizado por nuestro mayordomo, no tuvimos que hacer ningún proceso.
Excelentes bebidas, bebidas de calidad y reconocidas incluidas en el servicio. 
Acceso a todas las instalaciones. 
Muy lindo y limpio lugar. 
Habitaciones buenas y buen lugar para descansar. 
La comida estuvo excelente. 

Negativos:
No tiene diversión nocturna, no hay shows ni discoteca. En el tiempo que fui el hotel es muy aburrido de noche. 
Casi no hay música durante el día, los huéspedes son los que por lo general la ponen. 

Si te puedes alojar en el Royal Service, el personal te da un trato distinguido y tienes acceso a areas privadas. En todos los lugares que vas y saben  que eres Royal el servicio es super excelente.

Mi mayordomo Juan Carlos fue bueno y nos atendió muy bien durante la estadía.

reviews.author: PaulSLondon1
reviews.title: Fantastic in every way. Could not fault it
reviews.text:
The staff at this hotel are fantastic. 
Olive. Helpful. Well trained - they helped make a thoroughly enjoyable and relaxing break. 

The pool is excellent, with sun all day and seconds from the beach and the sea. 

The food was excellent with a wide range of options at both breakfast and lunch, and the restaurants were all very good, with a wide range of options to suit all. I would particularly recommend the sushi restaurant on the beach front. 

Definitely one to return to.

reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: Our concierge Gabino was amazing. He was very attentive and incredibly helpful at every turn. We were part of a large group and the butler, Daniel, took care of all of us, down to prepping transportation back to the airport. Both Gabino and Daniel checked on us to ensure we were home safe. We'll definitely be going back next year

reviews.author: Anmatama
reviews.title: Normal
reviews.text: Fuimos a pasar un cumpleaños un grupo enorme. Llegamos unos días antes que todos junto con 2 familias más. Solicitamos estar en el mismo piso que una de esas familias ya que tenemos niñas chicas y nos era cómodo, nos informaron que no había disponibilidad en ese momento, les pregunte si iba a haberla después así no desempacaba y nos mudábamos pero nos informaron que no. Al otro día y los días subsiguientes llegaron todas las otras familias y fueron instaladas en el piso que solicitamos INCREÍBLE! Tuvimos un inconveniente y lo trataron de solucionar lo mejor posible. El personal muy desatento y con mala gana. Solamente destacar a 1 o 2 que fueron amables. El resto no. Las habitaciones cómodas pero un poco anticuadas, la comida bajo la calidad y variedad desde la última vez que estuvimos. Podría escribir muchas cosas más...

Lo único bueno, es que los trabajadores eran simpáticos !

Nuestro más grato agradecimiento  para el equipo de Royal Service, Glenys Martínez  (Gerente de Royal Service), Ángela Núñez( Concierge) Juan Carlos (Mayordomo), Martín  Tineo (Pool Concierge) y Martín Ubiera (Gerente de AyB).

reviews.author: Dhiogo L
reviews.title: Really Good Experience
reviews.text:
It was our first time in Punta Cana and the experience was really good!
The Royal Service is much more than we expected! Beginning with the reception/ check in: an exclusive and fancy lounge with Mimosas!
Our Butler, Armando Minier, is an attentive man! Always kind and respectful!
I celebrated my birthday during my staying, and I received a surprise cake, birthday balloons in my room, and the bathtub was prepared to relax at the end of the day!
Some days we had a exquisite chocolate with strawberries in our room!
The beach in front at the hotel wasn’t so beautiful because the seaweeds (they are “invading” all beaches from Caribe to North Atlantic), but the pool is worth (Royal Service has an exclusive pool, and u can also use all hotel’s pools).
The food is good too! We had diversity food to choice, my favorite was the Japanese Restaurant !
Positive Points: Pools, Royal Service, Armando (Butler), Wanda (Cocktail Lady), Fruits (always sweet), room service in general.
Points to Improve: The hotel said we were invited to have a lunch with them and showed us an better hotel close by,  trying to sell us a vacation club! We lost one morning there, and the time we spent saying NO was exhausting!!
Concluding: I really recommend! My family now is talking to go back all together soon!
