reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: I was so I'll (3 types of ECOLI)
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Reserve from June 6-9, 2019. Multiple people in our large group were very ill. On the 8th I began feeling very ill and I got progressively ill on the 9th traveling home. On the 10th, I was so sick that I had to go to the hospital. I just got my test results back which were positive for three types of ECOLI. No one seems to be able to return the travel agents call to resolve this problem. I only stayed at the resort and never left. I did not drink the water and did not drink any alcohol while there. I even used bottled water for brushing my teeth. It's clear that the safety procedures for handling food at this resort are very poor.

reviews.author: Yleana M
reviews.title: Vacaciones de primas
reviews.text: La mejor vacacion del mundo.un lugar maravilloso. Gracias a Richard Ortiz y a Omar Doroteo por tan buen servicio y trato. Estamos encantadas. Un Paraiso de verdad. Los restaurants magnifico, la playa maravillosa. Todos muy amables.

reviews.author: Alina1988
reviews.title: Beautiful but too many tourists
reviews.text: The place was beautiful with many amenities. The people that worked their were very nice and always williing to help and serve you. A+ for customer service and experience. The downfall is that you had little to no privacy when outside of your hotel room. Their are entertainers that walk around trying to talk to people in order to convince them to join a free class or workshop. They were fun but sometimes I just wanted to lay back and relax. They would approach me as im sun tanning in the pool or even laying on the sand on the beach. THEY ARE EVERYWHERE! But because of that I did go to some fun dance classes and cooking classes. So it balances out but just so you know if your looking for a more private getaway this is not it. A few folks that approached me and were good to me are Jose Rivera from NAOS, Davidson German Camarero, Gregorio Arias 'capitan', Jose Vargas, Michael Regeg, Davidson Michole, Yuberly, Pamela, Rosendo, Angel, Tata and Risorys, and Emma my expedia local expert that is stationed at this hotel. Thank you for the fun time! :D

reviews.author: JVA_JVA
reviews.title: A wonderful resort experience
reviews.text:
This property is stunning and a wonderful destination for our group celebrating a birthday.  From your arrival at the lobby, you are transformed to a beautiful oasis.  The beach view and access were perfect.  The lobby, bars, pools and rooms are spacious and beautiful.  Some areas could use a refreshing, but overall wonderful.
The restaurant options on property (or within a short complimentary cart ride away) were fantastic menus with great service for the majority of our four nights.  
Although I did not have high expectations for our included excursion, it was extraordinary.  Our daily routine evolved into the morning on the beach and afternoon at the pool.  Chairs were readily available and the servers were eager to get you a drink if you'd prefer to lounge over enjoy the swim-up bar and submerged seating options at the pool.  I do warn to be prepared for the abundance of vendors who will approach you while on the beach (the pop-up ads of your peaceful reading or conversation), but they're not aggressive and adhere to your frequent declines, if you aren't interested.  My friends were happy with their purchases, but the frequency of offers was a tad much.  
Friends also enjoyed the water activities and equipment the resort offered.  In talking with others at different resorts, I had wished ours had hosted and/or communicated the evening activities better (ie a daily handout or sign, instead of referring us to the low-rated resort app). Even if we didn't participate it would have been nice to know our options. 
The resort had so many conversation and lounging areas for all periods of day.  It added the inviting community feeling.  The ease of finding bars and knowledgable bartenders was another asset to our wonderful experience.  I do recommend this resort.

reviews.author: jenniferm_ny
reviews.title: Me case y Era Muy Bonito! Patricia es maravillosa!
reviews.text:
El Servicio es excelente! La comida era increíble y la habitación era hermosa.Todo el mundo fue servicial y maravilloso y para la boda fue perfecto. Fue mi boda de ensueño. 
El planificador se ocupó de todas nuestras necesidades y se aseguró de que todo funcionara a la perfección.

reviews.author: Flyer536641
reviews.title: The most amazing time!
reviews.text:
Paradisus! If I could give 10 stars I would. We went for 5 days June 2019. In the mist of some tragic events of mysterious and extremely unfortunate death occurrences. 

First we were 3 women traveling to Punta Cana for the first time. We opted for the butler service which I highly recommend. We were a little shaken by all the news and we expressed our concerns to our Butler upon arrival. He took the time to reassure us that Punta Cana is a highly sot after destination spot. He assured us that the resort was a safe place to stay. That really helped us ease into our Vacay in Paradise! 

I’ve listed the first 4 days of our amazing vacation below and we literally didn’t lift a finger for the entire duration. The resort is beautiful and the rooms are very clean. I’ve been to all inclusive resorts before in many other countries and I have to say Paradisus Palma Real is the BEST all inclusive resort I’ve been to. The employees there are very friendly and you can tell they enjoy working there. I never saw a mean or upset face the entire time. 

Everything you need is onsite and if it’s not I’m sure the employees will do everything they can to accommodate. 

They use real alcohol. The restaurants are good and so is the food. I love the breakfast options at Gabbi’s. 

We felt very safe on the resort and there’s a shopping mall onsite. 

I recommend bringing cash for tips. A dollar goes a long way in expressing your gratitude. 

I recommend drinking lots and lots and lots of water. Go light on the drinks because of the humidity and the exposure to the sun. There were a few moments where I was extremely dehydrated and had to go to the clinic onsite. 

Only get taxis from the resorts. 

We planned to lock our belongings away in the safe but we forgot to let our Butler know and everything was still in tact. 

Check with the resort before going out to local restaurants and bars. Punta Cana in general is pretty safe but it’s a good idea to get the feedback from the hotel. 

Suggestions for the Hotel: 
1. To have authentic Dominican Food or a Dominican night where we can learn about the culture and history. 
2. Visiting the clinic was a little confusing at first. Our Butler notified the Hotel manager who escorted us to the clinic himself. 

Snap shot of a Day by day 

Day 1: We were escorted to our rooms, our Butler made dinner reservations and showed us around the facilities. Our bags arrived shortly after and we enjoyed the beach. There are a lot of vendors on the beach selling trinkets and souvenirs. Our Butler then introduced us to the beach waiter and asked if we were interested going on any excursions and helped arrange everything. We went to the onsite theater and lounge for fun in the evening. 

Day 2: We enjoyed the beach and celebrated our friends birthday. There’s a lounge onsite so we didn’t have to go out. Although we decided to watch the Basketball championship at Hard Rock Cafe. We purchased our drinks from the not all inclusive bar there another thing I recommend if you visit other resorts outside of Paradisus. We told our Butler where we were going and had our hotel arrange the taxis. Much safer than trying to get a taxi on your own. 

Day 3: We did an excursion to the Dun Buggies which was so fun! We were celebrating our friend birthday so our Butler surprised her with a beautiful cake and jacuzzi when we got back. She was So surprised and loved the extra touch in making her birthday special. Also dinner was planned for us when we returned. We were so hungry and it was nice to not have to think of where to eat or stress over a dinner reservations. 

Day 4: We did a different excursion on the Party boat - A must! Our Butler brought us a charcuterie board which was so lovely. 

You won’t regret staying at Paradisus Palma Real!!!

reviews.author: martinmo1970
reviews.title: Was lucky to get upgraded to the Reserve when i got there.
reviews.text:
Just realized the the Reserve is considered a seperate resort on the same grounds of the Paradisus so below is the review i wrote but is good towards the whole place.Just left there Thursday so here are a few thoughts. And will be going back in January 2020.
The trolleys are sometimes everywhere and other times disappear so be prepared to walk. Naos has the best buffet. The Grill and Italian place were very good. Friends had the Mexican and loved it. Make reservations right away or try early to get in. Gabi beach is loud at night so be prepared for noise if you are by the beach. The night life is fun but the music is repetitive no matter which DJ is working. Don’t be shy to tip. Had great service from Elisabeth , Carmen, Santa, Julio, Jesus and animator Oscar. Brush up on your baseball and ask about their country they love that. Overall loved the place with minor annoyances. Remember you are visiting their country so be respectful.

reviews.author: Pam S
reviews.title: LACKING CUSTOMER SERVICE AND QUALITY
reviews.text:
Overall, I was underwhelmed with my stay at this Paradisus. I've stayed at other Paradisus and Melia properties and this has been the worst. The lack of customer service and quality in all aspects is disappointing as I've never experienced this from this brand. From the front office management, concierge, and overall staff, it wasn't the level to be expected at a higher end resort. No one seemed happy, lots of sullen faces from the staff, and even when they say "it's a pleasure" you can tell they don't mean it....

The quality of food was subpar. Nothing was special, all under-seasoned and the menus at the restaurants didn't make sense ..... There is limited options as well. At other properties there are several pool side food bars, lots of staff around the beaches and pool and at this one there was not. 

The beach was nice and the workers out there were the hardest working! They were attentive and ran back and forth in the heat. In the main lobby, most guest agents were on their phones with their heads down, no greetings and little English. 

Overall, I will not be returning to the DR to stay there ...

reviews.author: Dennisis S
reviews.title: VacAciones
reviews.text:
Es la primera vez que vengo al hotel,vine por que me gané estas vacaciones por lograr mis metas anual en la compañia bercol.Me gustó mucho. La estadía,muy buen servicio,sus empleados están muy bien preparado para darle muy buen servicio.
Estoy muy agradecida de ustedes por el trato,especialmente con la empleada Jennifer Peña,muy buena chica.Nos vemos pronto

reviews.author: nerydf12
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: La estacia fue muy placentera las comidas muy buenas buena limpieza en las habitaciones entretenimiento en las noches excelente.  Personal muy atento.  Fuimos al restaurante de Juan Luis Guerra tomamos un taxi la pasamos súper.

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.title: Poor spa experience
reviews.text:
I stayed with 2 friends at this resort from June 10-15. The 2 stars are for the beauty of the beach and resort. Other bright spots included a number of waiters and staff who were lovely and accommodating. 

Otherwise the trip was disappointing, especially compared to other paradisus properties. The food was not great and breakfast and lunch are both buffets. Our dinners were not booked in advance and we often did not know until 5pm what time dinner would be that evening. To our surprise several of the dinner restaurants weren’t good which again has not been our experience at other melia resorts. What really left a bad taste in our mouths, though, was our spa experience. We booked 2 massages and a facial for one of the days. The massages were a verbal special of $65 (usd) and the facial was from a book that also was apparently a special for $127. We asked if we could use the resort spa coupons for these services and were told not for the massages but for the facial and we repeated and clarified that the coupons could be used for the facial and it was affirmed that this was the case. Upon bringing the coupons to the facial we were told the facial was a special price and thus the coupons did not apply. We could not cancel the spa services as we signed an agreement that we would give 24 hours cancellation notice. Again, we booked the facial with the understanding that we could use the coupons. We spoke with several managers who kept putting off dealing with the situation to someone else and finally at checkout they refused to accommodate us and honor their word. Very disappointing customer service and surprising as again this has not been our experience at other properties from this chain.

reviews.author: Sightseer08884571939
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Nice trip with friends, the staff were very helpful , little big, very nice room but not enough towels, food good but the buffet not enough variety but we still ate a lot and it was good, and the beach is very nice.

reviews.author: Rociibiri
reviews.title: Personas increíbles!
reviews.text: El hotel tiene unas instalaciones y restaurantes muy buenos pero lo que realmente marca la diferencia son las personas que lo forman, me gustaría destacar a nuestro mayordomo Álvaro que estuvo muy pendiente de todo, destacar también a Anabel de la recepción de Royal service siempre con una enorme sonrisa! De restaurantes me gustaría destacar a Junior Eresme de pasión profesionalidad y simpatía en una sola persona. También estuvimos con Johelvi y Jeuri que nos trataron genial, mil gracias por todas las recomendaciones! Deseando volver a ese país tan maravilloso. Muchas gracias a todo por hacerlo posible.

reviews.author: Mikhaella22
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana is Paradise
reviews.text:
Hotel is amazing, the beach is stunning.
The property is well taken care of and the staff is truly serviced oriented.
Bartenders are wonderful and super skilled 
Juan Carpio went above and beyond, excellent customer service. I recommend staying at the Paradisus Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Christy N
reviews.title: Great Vacation at Paradisus Palma Real!
reviews.text: We spent 6 days and 5 nights at Paradisus Palma Real. The resort is beautiful and has easy access to restaurants and entertainment. We were upgraded from Paradisus Punta Cana resort and absolutely loved our ocean view room. Reason for just 4 stars is based on food selection. I feel Paradisus Punta Cana has a better selection of restaurants but Palma Real is definitely more upgraded and nicer. We had a butler for the royal service area. I would highly recommend royal service as it’s adults only if traveling with no kids. Our butler, Juan Suarez was awesome! I would recommend requesting him upon arrival. Overall great experience for our 3rd time staying at a Melia resort in Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Debbie P
reviews.title: Butler service
reviews.text: If you chose the Royal Service, which I recommend, you get a Butler with your room. Ours was Juan Suarez!  Juan was phenomenal. He helped with our dinner reservations. He helped us with booking our excursions and arranging transportation to the airport at the end of our stay. He made sure we had fresh fruit in our rooms and they were cleaned spotless. He has a team of people who look after your drink needs at the beach. They reserve your chairs in the exclusive private part for guests who have the royal service. Juan worries about all the details so you don’t have to. I highly recommend you get the Royal Service and ask for Juan Suarez!!

reviews.author: H.P.
reviews.title: Great Stay! Royal Service Review
reviews.text:
I took my mom on a mother/daughter trip here and purchased the Royal Service package.  We absolutely loved our stay!  The Royal Services includes its own pool, restaurant and beach area.  You are also provided with a Butler who will help you make reservations for dinner among other things.  We worked with Argenis Romemro who helped show us around, give restaurant recommendations and take care of any questions/concerns that came up.  he gave me his phone number when we arrived and was available via iMessage which was SUPER convenient.  
Pedro from the pool/beach area was absolutely our favorite!  He reserved our cabana and beach chairs for us every single morning in the spot that we requested so that we could take our time with getting ready and having breakfast.  His energy was so positive and amazing.  He made us smoothies, brought us our favorite drinks throughout the day and even got my mom real aloe vera when he saw how burnt she was.  He definitely took my review from a 4 to 5 stars here.

If you are looking for a quiet, beautiful and relaxing vacation this is the place for you.  The resort was very beautiful and clean, the staff was friendly and knowledgeable and the royal services is definitely worth the upgrade.  We will definitely return!

reviews.author: Mali R
reviews.title: Great weekend to relax
reviews.text:
Good arrival experience, friendly staff at The Reserve lounge when doing check in. Sofia Paternina kindly lead us to our room and provide room orientation. 

Juan Guerrero, F&B Director helped us on getting a reservation in Passion which was a great experience. At the beginning I was not much convinced on going as I already have done Passion experience at Paradisus Palma Real; however the team at Passion in Paradisus Punta Cana exceeded my expectations. Food there was really great.

My phone accidentally fall into the jacuzzi for a couple of seconds so I called room service to see if they could help me with a bucket of rice to try dry my phone faster. After 5 min of having called, they showed up with the rice. Speedy and nice service.

reviews.author: Gnae S
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Our vacation was amazing but the best part of our stay was the butler Luis Sanchez he made sure we were taken care of with anything that we needed when we return again I wish I could request him. And the food was great eating at different restaurant each day 😊

reviews.author: MrsG
reviews.title: Fun girls trip !!
reviews.text: First off, the resort is beautiful. Rooms were very pretty, and staff was very helpful and friendly. We stayed in a “Royal Service “ garden view room. I’ve noticed with some resorts,,, upgrading above a standard room is difficult or didn’t really get you anything and not worth it, while others are worth it.. This is one of places where it’s worth it. The butler service really made us feel special and appreciated and made things easier. It helped with booking reservations, excursions ect. ( unlike my recent trip to another resort that made me feel like I had to upgrade just to get any form of respect). The resort felt safe!!! This was very important since it was the first time traveling with just us two girls.... every year for the last 13 years I’ve gone to an all inclusive resort and never the same place twice. And the Bartenders here are the best ever..great attitude and truly talented . especially  the lobby bar.. they made specialty drinks that took a lot of effort and each drink looked like a piece if art and was delicious!! Top shelf liquor.. they definitely weren’t just handing out pina coladas and margaritas all day.. there’s a little cute casino which is fun to stop in if it rains or before or after dinner.. entertainment was good. Pool beautiful ( water is a little deep for a resort pool ) my friend who is 5’3” had to kinda hop or swim to keep her head above water and although this was really entertaining for me after a few drinks,, but a huge pain for her... And now the only real Negative:: the food was Not at all as good the other resorts I’ve been to. So if you are a ” foody” this May be a issue for you. This made me sad because everything else is so great . But despite the food I would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Shy
reviews.title: Best staff member!
reviews.text: Had a nice stay at Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana! The food was good, weather was great but the best part about it was hanging out with Jose Luis Mandela, he was great, so helpful and very fun, he made the entertainment so much better! He is a great dancer!

reviews.author: cgiacamanh
reviews.title: Caro, pero regular
reviews.text:
Estuvimos una semana junto a un grupo de 22 personas en este hotel que se dice "Family Friendly", pero la verdad resultó que todas las instalaciones para niños (había 12 en el grupo) estaban en otro hotel que pertenecía al complejo donde estabamos, por lo que se hacía imposible dejarlos jugando o haciendo actividades.
En general el hotel tiene excelentes instalaciones, unas habitaciones increibles y está ubicado en una muy buena playa y tiene piscinas suficientes para todos.
Donde falla es en el nivel de servicio, ya que todo el tiempo, a la hora de almorzar o cenar en el buffet, nos ponían problemas, o se demoraban mucho en limpiar la mesa o en traer agua o servicios en general.
La comida era exactamente la misma todo el tiempo, no hubo variación alguna.

Por otro lado, los restaurantes con reserva eran excelentes, con muy buenas preparaciones y muy bien atendidos.
El bar también tenía una selección muy buena y muy variada

En general recomendaría este hote, pero para ir con un grupo de amigos o sólo con tu pareja. En ningún caso para ir con niños, ya que éstos no tienen mucho que hacer

reviews.author: Scott L
reviews.title: Service here is a joke
reviews.text:
This is a very beautiful resort.  Unfortunately, the staff is missing a common sense gene and despite what they consider to be their best efforts, they cannot provide good service. 
I was on a golf trip with 3 of my friends. We took Royal Service and each had our own room.  We were assigned a butler. His only task for us was to make us dinner reservations for 7:30 each night.  this proved to be too much for him.
Our butler could not get our dinner reservations right and on the third night, we were treated extremely poorly by the restaurant manager who basically shoved us out of the way to seat other guests.  We had to go to the Royal Service office and summon the butler to rectify the situation. The manager sat us and offered a begrudging apology. There were also several other minor stupid incidents that should not occur at a 5 star resort.  I will definitely NEVER go back there.

reviews.author: Eddie N
reviews.title: Freddy Mota - Playa - Pool
reviews.text: Freddy has been awesome and attentive. Always helping us out with a smile. He is making our experience complete. This is our first time away and the experience has been nothing short of amazing. Will definitely be recommending this spot to family and friends.

reviews.author: Spiceland
reviews.title: Amazing, entertaining staff!
reviews.text: We had a great time at this resort. The staff was super friendly and the resort was beautiful. Nixon led an amazing Bachata dance class, made us all look like pros. The poolside Zumba class was so much fun. We had two outstanding instructors who made working out challenging and fun at the same time. Ramona, at the YHI Spa, fixed my hair and it looked beautiful for my friend's wedding.

reviews.author: Wander66210176978
reviews.title: All I can say is amazing!!
reviews.text: It was everything I had hoped for and more. It was clean and beautiful. The concierges were on point especially Xavier and Alexander, they were amazing and definitely knew how to make the experience wonderful! Awesome place!

reviews.author: NYCharm
reviews.title: The Best Vacation
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real was more than I could have hoped for. Please upgrade to a package that includes a butler. Our Royal Service butler Jeuri was excellent! He anticipated and addressed every single want or need. Because of the amazing staff (Pedro + Omar) we were treated more  like family-which is what they called us! 
The accommodations were spacious and comfortable. There's a variety of dining choices to suit your taste. The Hibachi and Buffet styles were the most impressive. A great additions would be an authentic Dominican and seafood restaurants. The property is large enough to never feel crowded. I would highly recommend this as a destination in Punta Cana and Royal Service!

reviews.author: PaulJ
reviews.title: Butler Richard was the star of Royal Service
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  The Royal Service was a treat with our butler Richard taking immediate care of our every need.  I don't want to spoil the surprise, but if you get Royal Service make sure they setup the Jacuzzi tub for you!  Everybody treats you like you're their best friend, the hostess at Palazo always knew our room number without telling her, how does she do that??  We really felt pampered and royal.

reviews.author: Jennifer Ohio USA
reviews.title: Excellent vacation in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
I was so happy with my stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort! We picked the Ocean Front view with Royal Service. This is what you should chose as your vacation! The Royal Service includes a Room Butler, Yohel, who took care of our every need! He was wonderful! Highly recommend Yohel! We also had a Beach/Pool Concierge, Pedro. Pedro was Fantastic! He sets up our beach cabana with towels, drinks, water everyday with anything that you need! He checks on you for drink refills from the bar and keeps you refreshed! 
Both Yohel and Pedro made our trip the perfect paradise getaway!!! 
The room was gorgeous and the food had s lot of variety and was really good! The staff spoke Spanish and English.
The free nightly entertainment in the Olympus area was great! 
5 Stars

reviews.author: Mecooper205
reviews.title: Amazing Girls Trip
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service ocean front room. Our room butler took Great care scheduling our meals and experiences daily, Yohelui. The beach supervisor Pedro Cedano set up the best places on the beach for us and keep the drinks creative and flowing. Schedule treatments at both spas, you won’t regret it! Best water ritual I’ve experienced to date!! We can’t wait to come back and see our friends again!! #Butler #Smile #Beach #Spa #YHISpa

reviews.author: Elaine P
reviews.title: Great hotel but lack of information
reviews.text:
This is a lovely hotel with very nice rooms. Pool areas are well appointed with sun beds and service for drinks is great. Only big negative point we have found is that we had to wait 6 days for resort credit vouchers we were entitled to and only got them after constant daily/hourly visits to Guest Services/reception/Circle staff. Antonio on Guest Services and General Manager Domingo were very helpful but it would have been much better if we had received the vouchers when we first checked in so that we could get the most from them and spend our time enjoying our holiday instead of chasing up the vouchers! 
There is also very little/no information on show in respect of activities available throughout the day and the only way we found out was by asking the Guest Services team for a copy of the entertainment program. There are no hotel information books in the rooms apart from one for room service and one for the YHI Spa.
On a positive note, the pool areas and gardens are kept very well and the nightly turndown service is a nice touch.

reviews.author: Carlee
reviews.title: Wedding Vacation of a lifetime!!
reviews.text:
It has been about a Month since we have been back from this dream vacation and this is going to be a long review!

 To start we were a group of 28 adults heading to Paradisus Palma Real for our wedding, we had a few health accommodations that we asked to take into considerations when assigning rooms other than that we were a pretty easy group. The day before we were to leave,our travel agent called us saying they have changed our stay and we are now all  being upgraded to the RESERVE as it will best accommodate the group. To say this place was amazing is an understatement, it was beautiful and secluded and intimate and everything you would want in a vacation.

When we arrived we were all greeted by "our crew" and taken in and brought to our rooms...Rudy from Guest Services and Mariangel from the  Romance Department were with me and my husband the whole week making it truly an amazing experience. They arranged all of our dinners as a group, any nightly entertainment, we wanted some alcohol in our room they made it happen, anything we wanted! 

We met with Mariangel and the rest of the her team a few days before the wedding day and went through step by step what the day would look like and what we wanted to change or add.She organised our hair/makeup appointments, and came the morning of the wedding to make sure all was running smoothly. She help us make the decision whether to use the back up rain plan or not. (it was likely going to rain for us but we asked if they could keep the stereo system under the covered bar area and that we were okay with a little rain after dinner,(the back up plan would have still been beautiful). It did rain around 9pm for about 20 mins and it actually made the day even better.) 

We had our Ceremony in the Garden at the Paradisus, we opted for the garden area not the gazebo as it would have been  a funny lay out for us with chairs,so  we added a small canopy and a few lights and had it at sunset!

Our reception was at the Beach Terrace which was so secluded and private, the buffet was  on the sand and the way Mariangel set up the decorations I brought was absolutely perfect.We brought a phone with music playlists on them and purchased the sound system no DJ and the tech team working the music was amazing. Our bartenders on this night were also amazing Vincent and Happy:).

After the wedding day was done the amazing time did not end, we had a few rooms that were swim outs (which i would totally suggest).

28 of us hung in the pool and cabanas all day while the bartenders brought us food and drinks. They were so great, our first day we had Gabriel who was fantastic unfortunately we caught him on his last day of  his set so we didn't get to see him again but the rest of the week we were lucky enough to have 2 more outstanding servers! Wilken,and Gerijandro (G Baby) around the pool. They were so attentive to anything we wanted or asked for they were hilarious and totally got us in the mood to enjoy ourselves. For breakfasts   Fidel Rosario and Alexander were so great to us. They were always happy  to see us and had our table ready for the couples that made it to breakfast each  morning. With that being said the buffets and meals at both the RESERVE and Paradisus main were outstanding.

We went in April and weather was perfect, rained at night but made for such fresh green grass and plants the next day! If i had to give a downside i would say when we did go to the main resort (Paradisus Palma real golf resort and spa) it was pretty busy but that still made for a great atmosphere.

Any brides out there looking for a place to have your wedding i would highly recommend looking into this resort. Get a great group together and stay at the Reserve but do your wedding at the Paradisus Palma real golf resort and spa!

reviews.author: JSuth22
reviews.title: Amazing time
reviews.text: Visited the resort with a large group in the beginning of May. The resort it self was awesome! Beautiful and clean. The trip was made even better by our butlers Kelvin and Juan Carlos. They made sure our dinner reservations were taken care of every night and made sure we got anything we needed, no matter what time of day. Those two guys were a homerun!! Highly recommend this resort and getting the Royal Service.

reviews.author: Sandra D
reviews.title: Friends Trip to Punta Cana!!!!
reviews.text: Our trip to Paradisus has been great! We have been here two nights and look forward to the remainder of our trip!! The food, drinks and night life has been awesome!!  Our hotel room is modern and clean!!  The staff are so friendly and hospitable. I want to give a special shoutout to Nixon and Santos!!  I would definitely return to this beautiful hotel. You can’t go wrong staying here!!! This is my first time in Punta Cana and it has been an enjoyable experience. Thank you!!! 😀

reviews.author: Gayle G
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: The hotel’s Jr. suite were magnificent!  Rooms are updated and with a full kitchen. The restaurants were all very good. The facilities outside your hotel rooms were very clean.  The staff eras very friendly and accommodating. A huge shoutout to Nixon and Santo for excellent customer service!!!

reviews.author: Shley7280
reviews.title: Ariel is the best!!!
reviews.text: Ariel is the best butler you can have at Paradisus Palma Real. We had a big group of us at the resort for a sales trip and he took care of our VIPs. He could make anything happen at the drop of a hat. He was always calm cool and collected. Most importantly he was responsive, kind, and went out of his way every time to come and explain things you. He even helped others in our group who were supposed to be using other butlers. His English is great which is a bonus. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Richard S
reviews.title: Armando is a great Butler!!
reviews.text: Great resort. Armando is an excellent Butler and took care of us!  Excellent options on the resort. Anything you need Armando will assist with. A lot of activities to chose from. Comfortable rooms and great outdoor concept.

reviews.author: Arubagirl
reviews.title: April/ May Vacay
reviews.text:
Great location to relax and enjoy the beach.  Restaurants are good and staff are very accommodating.

The best part of trip was Zumba classes with Reynaldo and Nixon.  Reynaldo awesome instructor and they are part of the nightly entertainment team. Please seek them out for classes and and evening events for a great time.

reviews.author: Ali C
reviews.title: Amazing service, staff and experience!
reviews.text: Came to Punta Cana for our Presidents Club trip and had amazing, attentive butler service from Armando. The beach at Royal Service is tops. Recommend sushi at Bana, ice coffee at Palazzo and drinks at Gabi. Green Juice and Indian at Naos is the best. So relaxing with just enough fun.

reviews.author: Leticia Perez
reviews.title: Royal Service -Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: We had the best time at Parasidus Palma Real. We enjoyed Royal service by Felix! He was quick, thoughtful and took care of everything we needed. He also provides tips about the resort & communicated so well! I’d recommend him to anyone, anytime!

reviews.author: Alli
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I loved our experience here! tip: definitively eat the hibachi dinner—very good. Drinks were a bit watered down but if you stick to wine beer etc. you will feel the buzz quicker.  Beautiful resort, wedding location, pool, and beach. Staff was friendly, attentive and respectful. All in all great place for a wedding and friends/family trip!

reviews.author: Alvaro F
reviews.title: Vacaciones de fin de semana
reviews.text: Estubimos pasando el fin de semana 6 familias selebrando el cumpleaños de uno del grupo. El personal es muy servicial y atento siempre ofreciendo el extra.El restaura The Grill es el final con sus cortes de carnes 1A pregunten por Luis Martines el camarero para un servicio superior, el restaurante Bana excelente tambien gracias al cheff Jose Kawasaki. Luis bartender en playa the reserve todo un profesional y los camareros piscina the reserve siempre atentos. Habitaciones limpias y comodas. Area de mejora(buffe Gaby beach) calidad de la comida ha disminuido. El buffe Naos tiene mucho mas variedad de comida fresca y en vivo

reviews.author: dgold226
reviews.title: Vacation and wedding
reviews.text: Luis Sanchez was excellent. He was available any time and ensured we had a great time. We lost some items at the spa and he got them for us with no problem. When we come back to Paradisus we will request to have Luis as our butler.

reviews.author: Jennifer C.
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL Vacation!
reviews.text: We just returned from Paradisus Palma Real on Tuesday.  We had a fantastic 6 days in paradise!  We had Royal Service which I highly recommend.  Our butler Richard was great. Made all of our dinner reservations.  Checked in at least twice a day to see what we needed.  When we returned from the beach there was either fruit and cheese or chocolate covered strawberries waiting for us daily.  The food was very good.  Wanda the bartender at the royal service bar was very nice.  Martin our beach waiter was great.  He was sweet and took great care of us!  The beach is beautiful.  The beds on the beach and around the pool were so comfortable. All the restaurants were very good.  DJ every night and always something going on to do.  I can't wait to go back!

reviews.title: GREAT VACATION

Getting reservations at the restaurant's were next to impossible unless you wanted to eat dinner at 9:00pm.  Our mini bar person Andrew was fabulous, thank you for the kind notes.  The staff on the whole made sure we were having a great time. The bartenders at the pool bar were simply wonderful. A great time was had by all.  We will be back .

Por último dar las gracias a parte del equipo de ventas (Raquel y Juanita) por sus atenciones y su buen trato con nosotros.

En cuanto a las instalaciones (restaurantes, piscinas, gym, spa, comida...) Todo fue excelente, pensado para una experiencia inolvidable de todos los huéspedes.

Lo recomendamos a todo el mundo y volveremos al 100%!!

We loved going to our favorite bar at the entry/main lobby and enjoyed our time with our favorite bartender: Edison. His energy and service is the best!!!!! He was always focused on his clients and interacted with his colleagues, who were also friendly. They were Ana, Liliana and Juan Carlos.

reviews.author: Rachael Trotta
reviews.title: Company Presidents club trip
reviews.text:
I just spent the last 4 days at the Paradisus Palm Real Hotel in Punta Cana D.R. I was with a large group ( my husbands presidents club- 45 people) and everyone had the same complaints.  
Let me also preface that we had the basic package. I know that there were upgraded royal service etc.  so I’m sure not everyone who stays there has the same service and experience. Although the president of the company we were with stayed at the royal service and had many complaints as well. 
So... First off the drinks (even the wine) were watered down.  They refused to give us straws. The royal service got the paper straws. It was weird.  
The food was terrible. And the restaurants were just about impossible to get a reservation in at a decent time. They were very small and couldn’t accommodate the amount of people that stay at the resort. I guess they want people to go to the buffet. There is no food at the pool... only at the buffet. 
The service was terrible as well.  The wait staff at the buffet & in the restaurants were slow, rude ... just horrible. 
However I will say the service on the beach was great!   The beach was the best part... there were many lounge chairs with the hut umbrellas which was great. We would go down early to reserve a spot large enough for part of our group otherwise we would never get to be together because they fill up fast. 

Everything closes at 11:00 except for at the casino so that was a bummer. 
The rooms... they were fine.  We had a bad view of the road but there only seems to be a handful of rooms that actually have sea views.  It seems that most of the rooms have a garden view (better than ours).  There is a huge tub and a shower. The shower most complained  that they were too short (I’m short so I had no problem lol.) and very difficult to get the temperature right.
The toilet room and shower both had half doors and they were glass with boxes of frosted glass. It was very strange. Not much privacy. 
The resort is very large and pretty. The spa I couldn’t get a massage so I don’t know how that was. 
We’ve been on this trip with the large group to many different islands and I have to say that this was by far the worst hotel / resort we’ve stayed at.

reviews.author: Alisa S
reviews.title: Spring break fun with friends
reviews.text:
We visited the reserve with our friends, two couples and three kids ages 6, 9 and 13. Everyone had a good time, and we didn’t have enough time to enjoy it all, the shows, the dinners, the beach, pool, spa and kids club. 
What stands out about the Paradisus chain is the service, I find it extraordinary. I felt almost submersed in smiles and positivity from everyone. I wish I spoke the language and then I could converse with ease but unfortunately I only know a few words, and so I end up speaking English. This might sound ridiculous and I usually keep my reviews to positives and negatives only, so forgive me for straying. 
The positives:
Reserve section of the resort is very nice, if you are wondering which is better the reserve here or at Palma Real, both are good, with the design slightly better at Palma Real. Just to clarify, as I’ve seen some mistakes, there are no swim up suites at the reserve in Paradisus Punta Cana. In fact the rooms are divided into two categories, those that face the pool, and those that face the road. Hence, ask for pool view. There are three floors and unless you have mobility issues or a stroller, ask for the higher floor. It will give you more privacy, better view and less noise. The rooms that face the road are a bad choice because of the trolleys and other vehicles which pass by constantly.  
The reserve section has one large pool, one kids pool and a baby pool. Very convenient for everyone. The seating is spread out with multiple Bali beds and soft loungers, set up in a way so that no one is right next to you, unless it’s your own family and friends. My friend and I disagreed about the beds, she didn’t think they were clean enough. I suppose she may have been right, and they should be cleaned more often. You put a towel down first, so it’s not a huge deal. Unfortunately guests were messy, and the staff had to really keep on top of it. The worst was a dirty diaper someone left next to a bed we were using, who does that? It was removed of course, but come on guys, use a garbage can! The grounds are cared for daily, and the flowers were beautiful. Gardners were collecting coconuts and all you had to do was ask, and there you are with a great drink. Please tip them, they work hard. I also noticed that no one was waiting for a handout, meaning that if you didn’t have cash and asked for something extra, special drink, scuba lesson in the pool, they were not going to chase you down. 
Another note about the rooms, they are not so much in bad shape as some have mentioned, but more prone to neglect by management. Little things make a difference especially when everything else is pretty great. We had a broken shelf in the bathroom, markings on the granite, and a crooked dresser drawer. All this could be fixed within an hour, but somehow it wasn’t. My friends said, are you buying the place? And I decided to let it go, I didn’t really want handymen in my room fixing anything. 
The food and drinks. The buffet at the reserve is a great place for breakfast and lunch. We all liked the small pre made portions which looked and tasted delicious. Small coconuts with fruit, salads cut in different varieties, fresh made egg omelettes in the mornings, and plantains prepared differently. Everything was replenished and fresh. Desserts also good. Drinks are best at the beach bar, a great bartender will be happy to customize your beverage made with fresh fruits, this gentleman is Lous, and if he’s there, consider yourself lucky, he is awesome! If you need assistance and don’t know whom to ask, he is the person, his English is perfect. As others have mentioned the beach area for the reserve guests is very nice. Even without a personal concierge and in a busy season we were always able to find a spot in the shade, with very comfy beds and lounge chairs. We were closer to the back, if you want the front row I suppose you need a concierge. Spots are reserved and guarded, so we stuck to the back. 
The beach. Some have noted that they could not swim, because of high waves. Please note that this changes daily, we indeed had more days when the water was a bit rough, this did not mean we didn’t swim, just meant we had to be careful walking in. If you are uncomfortable with this consider booking somewhere else, so as not to ruin your vacation. The water is clean and on the calmer days, it’s very clear. The sand is beautiful and kids had a blast playing in it. We went sailing on one of the days when the surf was rough, it was difficult to get out to the open water and even worse getting back in, as it seemed that a high wave was going to tip the boat over. It didn’t, but we got yelled at for not jumping off quickly enough. I thought this was a bit rude, and also created panic, rather than actual help. The kids ended up staying on land, this was too dangerous. As the saying of an old commercial goes, we did have some good weather on the day we left. The ocean was calm, but we didn’t get a chance to sail with our daughter, hopefully next year!

Raphael was very attentive as out waiter. Wanda was amazing at beach bar and Franily made wonderful smoothies everyday. They need to be clear on the $1000 resort credit (coupons) as it is misleading. We were only able to use about $100 of the coupons. I and my party had a great time and highly recommend the Royal Service and the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Katiuska2013
reviews.title: What a shame!
reviews.text:
I visited this resort a few years ago and I had such a good time that I decided to return. It has completely changed and I don't mean when it comes to the additional buildings like the Reserve or the level but as far as the service and entertainment is concerned.

Pros: Building and rooms are beautiful and clean. Employees at the Bar Gabi Beach and Avenue are great when it comes to preparing drinks.

Cons: The buffet is terrible. Food is either cold like it has been sitting there for a long time or warmed up from the day before. It's pretty much the same thing every day but arranged differently! The only thing that seems fresh is the eggs that are made to order in the morning or the chicken or steak from the grilling station.  Staff does not help you find a table. Depending on how busy they are, they don't bring you water or drinks to your table unless you call them. No mimosas offered when you check in or at breakfast which was something they used to do the first time I came. The music that is played either at the bar or the restaurant is to put you to sleep. There is no back up plan for entertainment on rainy days. There is only one bar that plays Salsa, Merengue, Bachata (Avenue Bar) and the music is lowered or in some cases stops after 11:00pm. The shows offered at night are boring or there isn't any offered at all. The disco closes at 1:00am. The girls at the reception desk are rude, the people at the guest service practically ignore you even after standing there for at least 10 minutes. The app they tell you to use to find out the activities for the day or make restaurant reservations doesn't work and I went to the reception desk to let them know and instead they just said here is a printout of the week activities which led me to believe they already knew it wasn't working then why didn't they give me the list at check in?
In summary, if you want to go to sleep early or just sit, eat and drink all day this is your place to be. If not, stay away. I know for sure I won't be coming back.

Por su atención cuando llegue y las veces q hablé con ella antes de mi llegada. . Tambien hiero agradecer a mi mayordomo Alvaro Fernandez por excelente atencion. También Elbin Contanzo quien me atendió en todo momento en la playa donde pasaba casi todo el dia. Se esmeró en su atención.  Richard Rosari, Supervisor de Room Service. Que nos conocimos el último día pero su atención y servicio hacia mi fue excelente. Desde el 2016 visitaba siempre Royal Service de Parradissus Punta Cana. Este año quise probar Palma Real. En verdad q me decepcione. Tienen que mejorar mucho en la calidad ,variedad y cantidad de la comidad. Las veces q visite el buffet no compara con Paradissus. Falta de personal , readiestral al personal. Llegar a una mesa y ver que le pasamos por el lado y no atender a uno. En el desayuno una mesa sin azúcar. Cubiertos , sal ni pimienta. Tuve q decirle a la mesera q me trajera todo esto. En cuanto uno llega deben venir a ofrecerle café h jugo. Yo tenía q llamar a la meder. Un día en  el almuerzo en el restaurante d Royal Service me quede esperando un vaso de hielo q nunca llego. Debe haber supervisores en los restaurantes verificando cómo se está llevando el servicio. Presencia de moscas sobre los alimentos , Eso no puede pasar, La amabilidad de los empleados tanto de servicio como de oficinas al pasarle a uno por el lado debe de mejorar. Estuve en en esa isla caribeña. Donde se distribuye por su música. No quiero escuchar música en inglés por un DJ. Quiero merengue , bachata, salsa. Presencia de un grupo todas las noches. En el Lobby. El americano, europeo les encanta esa música latina como a nosotros.  Música americana de más hay en la discoteca. Pensé que sería superior  a Parradissus pero no. Sigo visitando Parradissus PUnta Cana. El ambiente , atención , calidad , familiaridad, servicio es superior.

reviews.author: Michaelle S
reviews.title: Wonderful Employees
reviews.text: If anyone is looking to stay at the Melia Paradisus Resort in the Dominican Republic, you must look up Juan Suarez and Martin Tineo.  While we found several hard working employees at the resort, none were more efficient or helpful than these two.  Juan, our Butler, allowed us to navigate the trip with ease arranging events, transfers, treats, and meals for us.  Martin Tineo worked the beach and always wore a smile, had chairs ready, and a drink in hand!  These two gentlemen added more to our trip than we could have imagined!

reviews.author: andrewdoromal
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text: All the employees I might were amazing. I made friends with many of them especially Reynaldo, Jose, Nicholas and many of the bartenders. It was awesome they make you feel very welcome and at home. Leo and Luis Baustista the dancers were also great.

reviews.author: Travelbug
reviews.title: Wonderful resort for royal service
reviews.text: We went to this resort to play golf and enjoy the beach. We upgraded to Royal Service and was very glad we did. The royal restaurant Palazzo was set apart and really the only other place we could eat besides the general buffet for breakfast and lunch. A special thank you to Francis, our butler and also to Michael at Palazzo. The resort was clean, organized and well laid out. Nightlife was a little sparse. The beach was unimpressive and rough, with some seaweeds. Very commercial. I don't think I would enjoy it so much if we did not do royal service.

reviews.author: Charles L
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: This hotel is fun Very good service Reynaldo and josé is a nice guy. Pool was great service was great I had a great time. It’s so amazing everything drinks sun beach the sea I love Palma real paradisus

reviews.author: Aidan C
reviews.title: Palma real
reviews.text: Very nice servants and people all around. Reynaldo helped me out every day. Great food and drinks everywhere. I appreciate the service and would recommend going to this place every time. Thank you to the staff and Reynaldo and Jose very nice dancer

reviews.author: Michael B
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Me and my boy randomdo are chilling. This hotel is awesome and randoldo is an og . It’s awesome we are having the best times ever and it’s great food great resort and great company. Lead by renaldo we are having a great time he is the best.

reviews.author: Leigh C
reviews.title: Go somewhere else
reviews.text: The property is gorgeous and the rooms are gorgeous but the food was bad enough that i dropped 5 lbs and we moved to another resort. The food was served cold and wet at times. We werent even sure if we were served the right meat at the steakhouse...

reviews.author: Josephine K
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds but if you plan on starving this is the place to be!
reviews.text: The reviews here are honest EXCEPT for the food. Horrible limited options and the food is always stale. No flavor and the chefs don’t know how to cook here. We are on the 4th day and still in shock with the “buffet” options and lack of. We have been to 4 star hotels with exceptional food and larger options. Even going over to the shared standard section of the Punta Cana Resort and Spa is bland and disappointing. The bathrooms are subpar for a master suite. They need to up their game and quality of food. The customer service and people are moody and rude. They don’t know how to be friendly and it looks fake and painful when they try. The grounds are beautiful thanks to nature! I would suggest this place if you want to overspend and feel like you’re in a “reserve” special spot but on a fasting diet!

reviews.author: Robert R
reviews.title: Lobby Bar
reviews.text: Edison and Lilian were terrific. They made great drinks and were super friendly.  We visited them every night!  Our friends also enjoyed them and the drinks they made. Don’t go to Paradisus Real without paying them a visit.

reviews.author: Hayden W
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Good food good drink the pool beach the weather it’s amazing the restaurant good service disco club amazing the show and activities the entertainment Jose Luis Gonzalez its very good guy every thing it’s good

reviews.author: Marianne
reviews.title: Best time!
reviews.text:
The food was wonderful and the staff was incredible! They had unique activities like a trampoline work out class and yoga on paddle boards. The environment was fantastic with lots of families and staff that made you feel so welcome! 

We went as friends for spring break (young adults) and were put in the family concierge building, and we were lucky enough to have the most wonderful concierge staff! At one point we locked ourselves in the balcony, and someone from the concierge downstairs ran up the three flights of stairs to let us in right away. Each building has like 8 suites and has its own concierge available for booking restaurants (8 are included), and make sure that you have anything you need! We were also steps away from the beautiful gym. There were shows at nights or dance parties on the beach with a good DJ and hype men to get everyone dancing, where teenagers and families all gathered to hang out!

The resort is huge and very nice, with a large beach span which is kept well groomed, I would definitely recommend upgrading from the resort to the reserve because of all the extra things you have access to. 

Will definitely be coming again!

reviews.author: momgurl0290
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: I was traveling with a large friend group  and I did not know what to expect with an all inclusive resort.  Paradisus Palma Real totally exceeded my expectations.  The resort is beautiful and very clean. There were many dining options and the food was consistently good.  Best meals we had were at the wine bar (steak and lobster tails!) and the Japanese steak house.  I did upgrade to Royal Service and it was worth every penny.  The private beach with very comfy beds under thatch cabanas and attentive staff was wonderful.  As was the private dining for breakfast and lunch.  There was always food available.  We had a lot of teenagers with us and the midnight buffet and 24 hour room service was a godsend.  I want to give special recognition to our Royal Service Butler Nicolas.   He was incredible.   He communicated via text daily and was incredibly responsive.  He even brought a special Dominican Republic lunch to us one day on the beach - delicious grilled chicken and "Dominican french fries".   I do wish there was a way to keep all of the beach vendors from bothering the guests.  It is very annoying when you are trying to relax and enjoy the beautiful ocean view.  I would definitely return to Palma Real

reviews.author: Adelaide K
reviews.title: amazing resort !
reviews.text: here for spring break and its been an amazing time. beautiful water and food is great. cant ask for anything more. staff is so friendly — personal favorite is nixón ! hes pictured above. definetley reccomend

reviews.author: Thomas L
reviews.title: Bilando
reviews.text: The dancers are amazaing and awesome and the beach is great.  Shout out to Reynaldo y his amigos para ayúdame with my dance moves! And I liked all the employees because they were nice to me and we all had a good time.

reviews.author: Sutton O
reviews.title: Great!!!
reviews.text: I came here for my senior spring break and absolutely loved it!!!! Everyone is so friendly and helpful and the amenities are lovely. The weather was beautiful the entire time, the restaurants were great (& family friendly) and we especially loved Nixón!

reviews.author: Kool A
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: I just returned from the New Circle by Melia resort in Punta Cana. The resort was beautiful the food was good but not enough entertainment for adults. Most of my friends went to the near by other resorts for that, while I stayed true to the Circle for all my trip, except to go to the beach.

reviews.author: BDWatts85
reviews.title: Great Service Richard Made The Trip!
reviews.text: The place is beautiful. Went down for award ceremony for work. Our room attendant was on it. Checked in with us throughout the trip. Whenever he saw us out and about would come over and make sure we had everything we needed. He definitely made sure our trip was off the hook. Would recommend this location for a great get away!

reviews.author: ETHAN D
reviews.title: Freddy Mota
reviews.text: Freddy was the best, he is so nice and funny. He Was always comming over to us and would bring more drinks at the time we asked. No better server in the resort and the man deserves to be with his family. Much love for Freddy

reviews.author: COOPER Y
reviews.title: Freddy Mota Review
reviews.text: The service by Freddy Mota and the rest of the staff was excellent! I had an amazing vacation with my friends and family and we love coming down to Punta Cana. We became great buddies with Freddy and the rest of the staff and they made our stay more enjoyable.

reviews.author: vandutch101
reviews.title: This is my third trip to the reserve.
reviews.text: The staff are superb at the Reserve.  On the beach the service by Ramon Ramirez and Santos Frias was excellent getting our chairs ready and checking on us all the time if we needed drinks.  When going by the pool I have to mention Jairo Minier who was constantly taking care of us.  Paula Jimenez in our building helped us with many things.  The above people made our trip extremely enjoyable and restful.  Paradisus is lucky to have these individuals servicing the customers.  I can't mention everyone but every staff member had a smile from landscaping, maintenance and housekeeping.  The shows in the theatre were very good.  Will I be returning yes and I can't wait to go back.  I highly recommend this hotel for a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Jesse Brown
reviews.title: Freddy Mota
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful. Freddy is a very hard worker and he served us very fast and made conversations with us. He brought a positive and energetic attitude to work with him and we appreciate him helping us.

reviews.author: blake e
reviews.title: Freddy mota
reviews.text: Freddy was a amazing guy. Everyday around the pool and beach he was always so helpful and full of energy. He also loves to connect with people which makes him much more enjoyable. I would highly recommend meeting him. Unbelievable person!!

reviews.author: Mitchell B
reviews.title: Freddy mota

reviews.author: Claire F
reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text: When we arrived we immediately felt at home with the friendly resort staff. All seven of the all inclusive restaurants were fantastic as well as the buffet! There were always poolside activities from Zumba to paddle boarding available for the guests. The beach was also beautiful and very clean! Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Annika
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We arrived at the hotel and were met with such friendly staff. Checking in was very easy and quick. The food for an All inclusive hotel was definitely impressive. I have come to Punta Cana every year and this year has been the best by far. The staff especially Nixón has been phenomenal and always was there to help us this entire week. I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a relaxing week with endless drink and food!

reviews.author: Rachel M
reviews.title: Awesome place for Spring Break!
reviews.text: Been going to the Caribbean for each spring break, and this place is by far the best. The food, the drinks, and definitely the staff have all be fantastic (Nixon has been our hook up at the pool - so friendly and helpful)! Comfy beds, super clean rooms, and you get a great experience for an all inclusive resort. Definitely will be returning!!

reviews.author: AJ T
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:

Thanks

If you travel to PuntaCana hotel Padarisus ask for Felix, you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jody s
reviews.title: Best trip ever!
reviews.text: We had a great trip! The resort was always clean and beautiful with very friendly staff. Would definitly reccomend. Our Butler Angelo made the trip even better, he was very helpful and a ton of fun to be around, if you can absolutly request him, he rocks!

reviews.author: Sabine F
reviews.title: Amazing trip!

Nixon and bolanco are my favorites and Im going to miss them dearly. Everyone who has the chance to meet them are lucky Individuals! 10/10

reviews.author: Angie Y
reviews.title: Crazy fun!!!
reviews.text: Paradisus is one of the best resorts I’ve been to, amazing service and club, always a great time!! Nixon and Blanco are amazing people, they made the experience excellent! The beach and the pool are beautiful!

reviews.author: Molly H
reviews.title: Best trip ever
reviews.text: Came here for our senior spring break with a group of friends and had the best week ever! Resort was super clean, had great food, great beach and a super fun night life. Big shoutout to Nixon and Bolaco for being great!

reviews.author: Gregory L
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise - Royal Service & Property Review
reviews.text:
Just got back from our 4 day, 3 night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. There were three of us and we opted for a Royal Service Beachfront room.  The property + beach was gorgeous, the room spacious, the service top notch, and the fun never-ending.  The people who made the experience perfect was our Butler Nicolas, Bartender Wanda, Beach Guy Martin, and Palazzo waitress Yenny. More about them below.  

The view & ambiance when you first arrive in the lobby is noteworthy - getting your first glimpse of paradise.  The main pool is great (has a swim up bar, nuff said) and is massive, with other more private pools available for Royal Service (The Reserve has the same).  The beach & palm trees are so picturesque.  All rooms have balconies in Royal Service which is nice, and the beds were comfortable.  The beds are full size, NOT queens.  And the sofa is a pullout. Only thing to note is that the bathroom isn't totally private from the bedroom / living area (light, sound, smell...). But you shouldn't be in your room that much anyway! Highly recommend getting Royal Service, if only so you can meet Nicolas, Wanda, Martin and Yenny, but the other perks are great too (access to the Fresh Juice & Smoothie Bar!!).  Nicolas was our go-to guy for everything - helped with reservations, recommendations, providing daily activities, was always checking in with us, and was funny. Wanda always had smile and joke, and fueled our entire trip haha.  We love Wanda! Martin helped reserve our beach beds / chairs every morning to ensure we got the same one every day and made sure we were relaxed, hydrated, and enjoying ourselves.  Yenny from Palazzo (more on this below) was so friendly and funny - she always came to say hi even if we weren't in her section.  Truly the entire staff was fantastic - the Royal Service welcome staff (those melon towels and mimosas thoo!) Waitress Judy from Bana / Naos, all the other bartenders, the entertainment team, everyone.  

Restaurant Review:
Palazzo (Royal Service Only)
-Breakfast: with the only other options Naos Buffet + Room Service, if you are doing Royal Service, this is your go-to breakfast spot. Great omelets + benedicts, freshest fruit, charcuterie spread, bagels/rolls, and SECRET MENU ITEM....pancakes :) 
Lunch: Better than Naos, but has fewer options.
Dinner: Food wasn't as good as we were expecting tbh.  The Carbonara and Ravioli was good tho!

Bana 
Dinner: Hibachi! and pretty good too! Chicken & Shrimp were the best, the steak was fine.  

Aqua
Dinner: at the Reserve but open to Royal Service (and maybe everyone? not sure). Favorite meal by far.  Chicken Parm + lamb were bomb, croquettes were good, dessert was really good too. 

Naos
Whenenver - decent buffet food. the pasta is probably the best since they good it in front of you (Vapiano style). Wide variety.  The french fries are good too. Don't have high expectations and you'll be fine. 

Room Service (Royal Service)
Whenever - literally 24/7.  The burger was actually really good + the grilled chicken sandwich too. Pizza wasn't good. 

Definitely recommend coming here!!!!

reviews.author: Go32323331440
reviews.title: Lovely room lovely beach delicious food.
reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay at the beach resort of the reserve. Slowed down by a bad so finally an elevator was tiring. All the staff was friendly and so helpful. Spa massage excellent and evening entertainment was fun but music too loud. Knowing Spanish is helpful.

reviews.author: Riley
reviews.title: So good!
reviews.text: Came here for spring break trip, the weather is amazing and the people are so great! So friendly and helpful! The rooms are nice and spacious! Good food and good drinks! Night life is good and the resort is great at entertaining, no need to even leave the resort, very happy thus far! Nixón was very helpful very entertaining, taught me how to dance! Luis is great as well!

reviews.author: Nikki K
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: The hotel is absolutely great. They have great food with many choices. The staff and promoters are five star!! We had a foam party. A silent disco. Non-stop fun!!! We definitely plan on coming back! Nixón was absolutely great! Visited every day to make sure we were having a good time and told us what was happening throughout the day/night. Luis, Yuverky, Benjamin were a ton of fun!

reviews.author: Jessica R
reviews.title: Nice ocean
reviews.text:
The weather was gorgeous here!  The pool amazing plus there was a swim up bar.  Bartenders sweet and nice!  Beautiful atmosphere with beautiful blue skies!  

Nixon and his team were very friendly and nice, Tata, Pamela, and Yuverky!  The foam party was fun and the silent party was amazing!  Good music and great company!

reviews.author: Cristina A
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: During my period at Paradisus Meliá at Punta Cana all days were the same, wonderful and perfect. Waiters and attendants are all happy in attend all guests. Drinks provide all places in any time. Clean restaurant, pleasant smell, hot food and yummy. Stores perfects, products well exposed.

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: Horrible Management, Excellent Staff
reviews.text:
So I am extremely torn about this resort. The staff is the beyond amazing staff (minus one, well get to that later) and the grounds are beautiful. But I’ll just start from the beginning. The only reason I’m giving it three stars is because of the great staff. Also, I feel like the Royal Service rooms could be better, ours felt a tad worn and tired. 

This was a girls trip with myself (29), my sister (27) and our cousin (26). We booked our reservation through RCI for 2/23-3/2. About a week out, we still hadn’t heard from Paradisus. We sent them an email because we wanted to pay for the pre paid all inclusive fees. We heard back from them and were sent a form to fill out with our stay information as well as the credit card information. There was an issue with a signature and we had to refill it out, but that was the only issue they said there was. A week later we arrived and went to check in. Our receptionist Alicia (?) was very sweet and kind, but went to confirm our dates and said we were only there until 3/1, which we corrected her right away. We wanted to upgrade to Royal Service and a manager was brought out to see if there were rooms available. Again, they said until 3/1 and we corrected them once again and all we got was “okay okay.” So we thought there was just an error on their side since all of our paperwork said 3/2. We were taken over to Royal Service and received our keys and wrist bands and met our Butler, Jose. He was very nice and escorted us to our room. We quickly told him what restaurants we were interested in for our stay and then went to enjoy the rest of our day. Before Jose left us, he said again that he has us until Friday, and again we said “no, we’re here until Saturday.” He said he’ll try to figure it out. Then again on Wednesday, we found ourselves in the Royal Service Lounge and they said again we were supposed to check out on Friday and we corrected them again and heard nothing. Come Thursday Jose found us after breakfast and told us that we were in fact checking out on Friday. So back up to the Royal Service Lounge we went. Angela was so sweet and tried helping us and ended up getting reservations on the phone for us. The woman we spoke to was so extremely rude and kept talking over both me and my sister for about an hour. What the issue was, was there was an email sent BEFORE we sent in the final paperwork that said six nights instead of seven. On our final paperwork the dates were 2/23-3/2 with a final amount circled and initialed by someone in accounting and our credit card receipt attached. I guess they only charged us for six nights. Now. We wouldn’t have had any issue if we had solved this within the first couple of days like we were trying to, but they waited until the very last minute to say something and basically left us with the choice to pay or leave because of someone else’s mistake. We ended up talking to the Royal Service manager and showed her our paper work all signed off and completed with our dates on there and all she kept doing was showing us copies of the email that said six nights. No dates and it was just an email, not official paperwork. We kept trying to tell her this but she was so extremely nasty and rude and ended up screaming at us “you know what. I think you did this on purpose and said six nights and booked your flight a day later wanting to get a free night and free $500 from us!” I have NEVER, EVER been so disrespected in my entire life. She was so unprofessional and she humiliated us in front of all of the other guests inside the full Royal Service Lounge. Why would we be trying to get a free night if we had been trying to take care of the issue ourselves since we checked in?! And for multiple days after?! There was no apology for the mishap on their end just the accusation of trying to “get $500 for free.” No compensation for the inconvenience of wasting four hours of one of our last days (we missed the pool party we had been waiting for all week and even moved our excursion because we wanted to attend it so badly). All we wanted was an apology that someone on their end didn’t look over the paperwork correctly and some kind of compensation for the inconvenience of them waiting until the very last minute to address the issue we had been trying to solve ourselves since the day we got there and for being berated by the Royal Service manager. I’m a flight attendant, my sister is the manager of a hair salon, and my cousin is a server so we all come from a customer service background and were so throughly disappointed in the way the situation was handled and how we were talked to. We also believe that this was an age discrimination issue. We all felt that if we were an older couple, this never would have happened. We were also embarrassed to step foot into the Royal Service Lounge for the remainder of our trip because we were so embarrassed. Even going in there to check out, I almost had an anxiety attack. 

Now, onto the good things about the resort. The staff (in no particular order)!!! I can’t say how wonderful it was to see the same faces every day and have everyone know and remember us.  

Every morning we walked onto the beach, they always had towels and a bed waiting for us. Elbin was our go to guy for four days. He was so friendly and constantly made sure we were doing okay. He would even have a tray of new drinks for us before we were even done with our first ones! And even when we were by the pool, we still got the same great service. Martin was always so happy and singing and dancing and willing to help. Rafael was also amazing at helping us with whatever it was that we needed quickly. They all work so hard and it really shows. Alberto and Nixon at the activities desk we so nice and so much fun and helped up book and reschedule (because we wanted to go to that pool party...) our excursion. We all LOVED Polanco!!! He was by the pool every morning for activities (he taught us to salsa) and every night for the party at Gabi Beach and was always fun to dance with and talk to (and even helped my sister out when a guy was getting a little too close for comfort for her). 

The bar staff!!! Every bar we went to had such an amazing bar staff. At the Royal Service pool bar, Wanda made the best bloody Mary’s, Pedro would bounce back and fourth between the beach and the bar but would always take care of us, Wilfredo kept our drinks coming all day (he made the best drunk donkeys!). And Wonderly!!! We only saw him one day, but he really did make an impression on us because of his customer service skills and he was so kind. At the lobby bar Jacinto was our favorite!!! He made us the best drinks and was always on top of refilling us and he was such a good time (and he made the best lemon drop shots we had all week). Teddy was working at the disco one night and also was amazing and kept us very happy (the DJ was also super nice and played a great selection of music). Armondo was our server for two nights (one at Vento and one at Rare). We had dinner at the two, two nights apart and he still had remembered our drink orders. Jose at Palazzo was always so kind and welcoming to us and always made sure to say “see you tomorrow” each time we left. Our hostess at Palazzo was also always so nice and kind each time we saw her. Ariel in room service was also our best friend at night once all the restaurants had closed. He was so funny!!

Now onto our butler situation. When we checked in we had Jose. He was very nice, but we didn’t feel like he was being attentive enough to us. I don’t know if it was because we were young and were low maintenance, but we would always just get general answers from him (like we asked about the pool party one day and all he said was “there’s an activity by the pool at noon every day.” But we didn’t know what kind of activity. I feel like this is also on the hotel, there should be a sheet or something in the lobby that tells you the schedule of events happening in the hotel. Every night we just walked past Gabi Beach at 2100 to see what was going on. I’m sure he is a great butler to others, but I don’t think he was the right fit for us. We had Jeuri as our butler for the last two days and he was more our speed. He was super attentive and would stop to chat with us every time he saw us (even before he became our butler, he knew us and was taking care of us). He also had a wonderful cheese and meat plate as well as chocolate covered strawberries waiting for us one day. 

Overall, we really liked the feeling of the resort and how everyone knew us (we’re from California and were known as the golden girls all week). Every time one of the above staff members saw us, they always took time to check in with us and that meant the world to us. But with the issue we had and the way we were treated by that Royal Service manager, I really don’t think we’ll ever return, and it honestly breaks my heart. I will also be letting all 30,000 of my co workers know to stay away from this resort and Melia in general because of the horrible management and treatment we received by them.

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: The staff at the pool and bar were fantastic.  They made the stay at the hotel very enjoyable.
reviews.text: The stay was nice, the room was nice and clean.  The staff that took care of us around the pool and bar were fantastic.
