reviews.author: Marta S
reviews.title: Amazing time in Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
I visited Dominican Republic in February 2019 and my holidays were amazing!
I had a great time at Paradisus, and would like to thank the hotel team for great service. Accommodation at the hotel was great, especially the rooms, additional services like gym and access to the beach. My stay was very entertaining especially thanks to amazing Barbara (@FITFORCARRIBIC) from NRG2GO who held pilates and other sport classes!
I would gladly come back again.

reviews.author: Jason R
reviews.title: Amazing holidays
reviews.text: The food was good, the beach was awesome! rooms are really beautiful and the staff is great but Jean is the best animator without a doubt! Great guy! Buffet is not that huge but really good... the pasta guy at lunch... bad: in general... great trip!!!!

reviews.author: Sharron
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Second year visiting this complex. If you want beauty and peace this is the place for you. Of all the places we have stayed in the Caribbean ( over 25), this is our favorite!
We would like to focus on the excellent employees that we have met. Paula J. and Erika T. in our Congierge Service were excellent! They are pleasant and efficient. They always were able to fill our requests promptly. The bartenders, Juan Diego and Yonairi S were amazing. They were upbeat and able to remember you and your favorite drinks in short time. They are an asset to your hotel. The one employee who stood out above the rest is Lorenzo Jimenez from the casino. He is amazing! He has a great sense of humor, makes you feel welcome and has excellent English. He belongs in the Customer Service area. He is one reason that we return!
We did not spend time on the facilities because as other reviews state, they are beautiful ! Same goes for the rooms, pool and beach

reviews.author: Avant
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text:
Go with Royal service, and hope you get Ariel for Butler. He and his team went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time.
Beautiful property, great staff. Beach was fantastic- white sand blue water. Everything laid out well-didn't have to walk far to access restaurants/bars on property.

reviews.author: Laurie K
reviews.title: Wonderful...
reviews.text: On a girl's trip and loved the ease of this resort...the staff was incredible, the food was amazing (be sure to get advance reservations), the weather was beautiful, beach was sandy and blue and pretty...in fact, am having Paradisus withdrawals!  My only thing I would be sure to do on our next trip, is get a room that is not near shipping and receiving...it was loud. Other than that, I wanted to give a shout-out to our favorite staff people...Alejandro (Happy Boy), Nixon, Vladimir, Juan...and the rest of the staff. Can't wait to go back....

reviews.author: Angiedeahl
reviews.title: Awesome resort!
reviews.text: I got the Costco deal for 7 nights at The Reserve for three adults, and we couldn't have been happier! Johnny Rodriguez and Juan Cruz made our trip unforgettable! They were the best bartenders, ever! They were so attentive, and knowledgeable about the resort, they never led us astray! We will definitely be back, and recommend the reserve (and bartender Johnny) to everyone that ventures here!

reviews.author: Jet12030043317
reviews.title: Worst 2 week stay ever. Night mare
reviews.text: This experience was horrible from the time there was no elevator to a 3rd floor room to the fleas and the toilet that didn't flush and the power that was off nearly as much as it was on to save energy. WOW

reviews.author: Susan629
reviews.title: Great service, professional staff, lots of fun
reviews.text:
This hotel is a terrific spot for anyone that wants an easy vacation with options of places to dine, things to do and a very nice beach and pool. The food options are many. If you are a highly seasoned fine dining restaurant goer, you will have to pick and choose which restaurants you go to. Some are better than others. The morning buffet was terrific and they have excellent coffee.
The staff are extremely pleasant and always ready to help. The food service was excellent. The beach service for beverages and water was excellent too. The beach was clean and there was plenty is lounge chairs for all—same for the pool. We had a great time with our daughters at the disco and at the Gabi Bar. Our rooms were clean and the room staff did a wonderful job every day. Also- the rooms very quiet. We were a group of mothers and daughters and it was a terrific spot for this sort of trip. Everyone could eat during the day when they wanted to, we met on the beach or at the pool and then had reservations for dinner.

reviews.author: Teddyelders
reviews.title: HS Senior girls/Moms trip to Punta Cana
reviews.text: Stayed for five nights on a mother daughter trip/group of 10. Amazing staff at this resort. I had an issue with a lost item and Vladimir Rodriguez and Domingo Beltre were extremely helpful in sorting out the problem.  They were patient and professional. The resort is gorgeous and very clean. Incredible beach.  The entire experience feels like a much more expensive hotel - excellent value. The only downside is the food is mediocre but in my opinion it’s on par with most all-inclusive hotel dining.

reviews.author: Amanda M
reviews.title: Un lugar hermoso sin embargo no volvería
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia.

Un lugar hermoso, higiénico de mas, espectacular  pero se quemaron en servicio

Fuimos un grupo de amigos y nuestra experiencia fue horrible en varios aspecto:
1) tienen los camareros y su personal que parecen máquinas cuando te reciben. Los empleados hay que direccionarlos pero hay que dejarlos ser (te reciben el restauran, saludos yo le estaba esperando. Dígame que  es un placer servirme, pero no que yo me de cuenta que usted tiene un esquema, los gerentes deben revisar que le dicen a sus colaboradores y la manera que lo entrenan.
2) En otro orden, escuché un gerente hablar de manera un poco denigrante de los dominicanos, si usted está trabajando en mi país lo menos que merece la tierra que le da la comida a usted y su familia es respeto, si tiene algo que decir o comentar, puede hacerlo en la intimidad de su oficina, no en un lugar publico de su hotel, porque una persona como yo le puede escuchar.
3) A la hora de salir en recepción te preguntan, cuándo llegaste? se supone que tienes un registro en tu computadora que te indica cuando llegué y que puedes cobrar y listo, no hacerme sentir que un lugar tan espectacular no saben trabajar.
4) En el caso de cuando avisas que vas a la playa y reservas el carrito, primero se llevan a todos, menos al que es dominicano, si su Hotel no está destinado al país en el cual están, entonces deben decirlo, para no pasar el mal gusto de ir y gastar mi dinero.
5) En los restaurante que son de reservas nos dejaron esperando mas de una hora para darnos el servicio, si no nos quejamos quizás estaríamos esperando aun.

reviews.author: Dalton257
reviews.title: Golf resort....Really?
reviews.text: Hotel is fine. Beach is great. Spa is very relaxing. Passion restaurant is worth the surcharge. Palazzo restaurant for Royal service guests is excellent, especially for breakfast and lunch. HOWEVER, if you’re planning on playing golf, beware! Course is mediocre. Carts are disgusting and cost $65 per person + $1 for a bottle of water! For $75 per person, water is included but the carts are still dirty and in disrepair. Security is lacking on the course. A hotel that claims to be a golf resort should have golf amenities that are on a par with the hotel.

reviews.author: Karen T
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text:
I have been traveling to this resort for many years and continue to return.  The location is beautiful, with a fabulous beach and multiple pools.  The staff is very friendly and eager to please.  There is a little something for everyone.
I would particularly like to mention three people who showed outstanding service this trip. 
The first is Gabriel, our concierge in Club Melia.  He went out of his way to make sure I was taken care of.
At the pool was Ravel Maldonado, who made sure we were happy and satisfied all day, every day for the entire week.
At Naos, the buffet, when Joaquina saw us coming for breakfast and lunch she knew what our coffee order was after the first day and made sure we had everything we wanted.

reviews.author: eliasb244
reviews.title: True Paradise
reviews.text: It was a trip to paradise, amazing property, tremendous food options, beautiful beaches.  We have been to many all inclusive resorts, this one tops the list.  The room was very large, nice sized bathroom, private balcony and great internet coverage throughout the property.

reviews.author: Escape10725261177
reviews.title: Es un PARAISO
reviews.text:
Fue una linda experiencia y siempre lo recomendaría, donde conocí mucha gente, unos días de mucha integración, Siempre con buen servicio y atención por parte de todo el personal del Hotel.
En los días de eventos que hemos tenido, el personal siempre un paso adelante. Lo que mas me impresionó fue el recorrido por la parte de la cocina y todo está totalmente sincronizado, el personal de cada área muy identificado con su trabajo, pero lo mas importante es que siempre están con una sonrisa y con mucha alegría. Esa actitud de cada uno de ellos lo he compartido en mi trabajo.

reviews.author: GFBastian
reviews.title: No Electricity & no Hot water
reviews.text:
On February 10, 2019 our group of 10 people went to Paradisus-Palma-Real all inclusive resort in Punta Cana for our 7 day Tennis Vacation.  The Pool, Grounds, & Beach were wonderful as was the help.

To make our tennis vacation even more memorable we agreed to Upgrade.  What we got for our Upgrade was the electricity going offs on numerous occasions, a shower that malfunctioned and would not provide Hot water, & toilets that did not work.  In addition, when we made the reservations, we ask to have our rooms near each other.  Two of our party were in building #12 on the 1st floor, two were in building #38 on the 1st floor, & one was in building #38 on the 3rd floor. 

Did I mention that it was a Tennis Vacation?  The tennis courts were horrible & unplayable. 

They call it an All Inclusive Resort.  That is not true.  You had to pay extra to dine at two of their restaurants.  In fact, for Valentines Day they wanted to charge $240 per couple extra for dinner.

We selected the Melia Resort because we stayed at other Melia Resorts & was very pleased with our stay.

This resort is a beautiful resort but it appears that the infrastructure in not being maintained.
  
Needless to say, our group will never go to another Melia Resorts unless we are guaranteed that all these problems are solved.

reviews.author: Steve B
reviews.title: Yanira Sosa
reviews.text: Will review the overall hotel later but this lady was so helpful and friendly at every meal time. A smile everytime and always attentive...most of tge staff were great but this lady stood out.....thank you Yanira

reviews.author: Bobee p
reviews.title: Memorable experience
reviews.text:
Although the trip was very long from California, our stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana was fantastic.
Marcelo and Johnny at both pool bars treated us right, the service at Fuego was amazing and so was the food.  There was plenty to do over our seven day stay to keep us entertained. The people are warm and friendly and the service never lacking. If we had one complaint it was that some of the food at the buffets was a little bland. We had a wonderful time and look forward to returning some day soon!

reviews.author: MTL_Jetsetters514
reviews.title: Wedding in January
reviews.text: We had our wedding here with 25 guests consisting of family and friends in January 2019. Although this resort is a bit on pricey side, you will not be disappointed. Granted that some of the rooms a bit on the older side, they are clean and well maintained by the staff. Every single person working at this resort is extremely polite and very willing to help. The food is amazing and it doesn't matter if you go to the a la carte restaurants or the buffet. Our wedding planner Patricia was great. She offered great advice and assistance with the wedding and all of the events that we wanted to plan with our guests throughout the week. we had Luis as our personal butler who would have beautiful treats setup for us when we would get back to the room after being out all day, such as food or the hot tub in our room ready to go with champagne. I can't say enough about how wonderful everything moment went during our stay for us and all of our guests and you can be sure that we will be back as soon as we can to make more memories.

reviews.author: FellowTraveler257924
reviews.title: Beautiful facility and employees with bad attitudes
reviews.text:
Summary: beautiful facility and events but multiple bad experiences with employees ruined the vacation. Mediocre food and facility is full of aggressive salespersons.

Facility: 5/5 beautiful facilities on the beach. Love the architecture and design. Great pool and beach setup. Daily electrical blackouts for ten to twenty minutes at a time but only during the day. 

Food: 3/5 complete hit or miss. The majority of the buffet food is quite horrible but has a good desert bar. Make sure to get your reservations in for the sit down restaurants - these were decent. No real dress code.

Employees: 1/5 multiple encounters over multiple days many rude employees and we did not cheap out on the tips. With each of the departments (front desk, bell boy, reservations, cleaning), there were employees that were rude and made you feel uncomfortable. Not looking for bad attitudes on a beach vacation... For example, bell boy took our luggage, lost an article of clothing, and attempted to blame us for losing it... Also picture this, you are sitting on a white sand beach sipping a mojito and enjoying the ocean views. Two minutes in, a salesperson comes. Another two minutes pass another one yells at you from afar. Repeat every day and every two minutes for multiple days... Do not get me wrong there were a handful of superb employees there too but the amount of bad experiences made it unruly.

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Great trip at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a nice resort that is clean and well-kept.  Overall, the employees are extremely helpful and friendly.  

The good:  Food at Rare and Aqua was particularly good.  There was a nice variety of food at the buffet.  Service at the pool bar was great.

Not so good:  Food at the buffet was not kept hot--or even warm in most cases.  Just doing a better job keeping hot food hot would be a huge improvement because the quality of the food is pretty good.

Tennis courts are in poor condition.  Although Juan-Carlos did a great job taking care of us at the tennis courts, the surface needs to be replaced.  A resort of this quality should have better courts.

reviews.author: Carol C
reviews.title: Fun girls trip! Feb 7-12
reviews.text: We had a wonderful vacation at the resort. The stay was very friendly. Our customer service representative Vladimer  Rodriquez was awesome.  I highly recommend going to water aerobics with happy boy at the pool.  His personality was so fun and we then were served drinks by the pool by Juan. If you get a chance to go remember these employees and ask for them by name. They helped make our vacation top notch. We will go back.

reviews.author: Escape58192125820
reviews.title: Excellent vacation
reviews.text:
Yuleidy at Palazzo restaurant was very helpful and friendly. Enjoyed talking with her every day. 
Loved our butlers Ariel and Angelo.  They couldn't do enough for us. They were the very best. 
Carlos brought us everything we needed while at the beach.

reviews.author: Tammy C
reviews.title: Wonderful Girls Trip
reviews.text:
Just arrived back from a girls trip at Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa.  What a fantastic trip.  Based on the reading the reviews we were getting a little nervous.  No need for that!  Starting with the check in process, how wonderful and everything was all arranged.  We have to laugh because someone kept trying to help us and we had read that "timeshare" people try to catch you.  Our poor Guest relations team member, Vladimir Rodriguez, finally helped explained.  He was amazing and such a professional the entire trip. Cannot thank him enough for all he did to make certain our trip was fantastic. 

We arranged for dinners prior to our stay.  Dinner reservations open on Sunday.  We had all set.  Love all of the restaurants but would have to say that Rare and Bana were our favorites.  Even the buffets were wonderful.

The rooms are not the Ritz, but they are comfortable, large and if anything goes wrong they are right there to help.  Maid service was exceptional!  The beds were very comfortable.

Without a doubt the grounds are amazing!  They are meticulously maintained!  We never had an issue getting where we wanted to sit on the beach or anywhere for that matter.

Have to give a big big shout out to a couple of staff members:  Happy Boy was just a delight with the dancing and water aerobics class.  His smile just says it all, loves what he does and the hotel is lucky to have him. Jaun Tiren had our towels and drinks as we walked up, he was also wonderful.  At the beach we love that they have a staff member walking around to challenge you to games.  Nixon Batede was so fun, hard to beat him but we all loved trying!

The vendors on the beach are respectful and if you say "no thank you" it is not an issue.  They didn't harass!  There is also security on the beach.  We never felt uncomfortable once.  You have to be smart (use the safe), but that is anywhere you travel.  You can't leave cash lying around. 

The hotel recommended a catamaran excursion and we had a blast there as well.

We did tip for good service, but we honestly never felt we had to.  They were always very appreciative!

All of us cannot wait to go back!

Thank you for a great experience.

reviews.author: Wendy S
reviews.title: Reconocimiento a la excelente servicio!
reviews.text: Buen día, quiero realizar un reconocimiento a la atención de todo el equipo del hotel. Son maravillosos, gentiles y muy agradables. Excelente atención. Super recomendado, volveremos siempre! Saludos a Cristian Castro

reviews.author: Dustin F
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Accomodations were great from the bars to the lobby area  Food was excellent from the buffet to the restaurants.  Truly enjoyed the hospitality of Nixon Bao and Boni Ramos at the pool area.  Made us really feel at home.

reviews.author: Travis Bussa
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
The resort is great.  The staff has been fantastic.   Nixon, the activities director is great. He is very friendly and made sure we were good several times each day.  Boni 
, at the pool bar area, made sure we had our spots each morning and was very helpful throughout the day. Great dudes!

reviews.author: NorthStar605328
reviews.title: AMAZING vacation spot!!
reviews.text: The staff at the resort was outstanding!!! Nixon Bao and Pamela ,manta ,benjami,nwas were the BEST! Nixon definitely took care of everything we needed. We will be back to visit Punta, Nixon, and the beautiful beach. ❤️

reviews.author: Jen C
reviews.title: Great Time, Despite The Food
reviews.text:
This is my 4th stay at the Palma Real. I usually enjoy the food, however this time I found the food very salty and flavorless. It’s a shame when the food at the buffet tastes better than the speciality restaurant.Passion of course was excellent as usual.
Except for the food I still enjoyed myself, thanks to the excellent service of Joaquina and Michael at Naos (buffet) and the entertainment crew Jean Marcos, Angel, Nixon, Risorys and Tata. There were so many activities that we were busy all day and night.

reviews.author: Freedom00523056709
reviews.title: Excellence from beginning to end.
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time., no complaints at all. Food was excellent, Drinks were plenty. The beach, the pool, the rooms were all lovely. The staff were always accommodating and friendly and I can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Jaz0918
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text:
The resort is clean and well kept with great rooms but without the staff it wouldn’t be as good as it is. Namely we would like to mention the following people for their excellent customer service:

Luis Alvearo and Onil (Front desk/Reception), Ramon Ramirez, Luis Parra and Naomi by the reserve pool. 

They all made our stay that extra bit special and they went the extra mile.

reviews.author: Patricia M
reviews.title: Beautiful with some imperfections, but quickly remedied. Thank you, Vladimir!
reviews.text:
The initial impression of this resort when you step into the lobby is Gorgeous! The staff were very welcoming and check in was fast and efficient.
The room was average but the bed was excellent. However, the lack of bathroom privacy(only a curtain between rooms) was a little strange for anyone not travelling as a couple.

The next day started off with a very abundant and varied buffet. Again the staff were friendly and helpful. All week our group of 9 received excellent service from Juan Mejia who always had our table ready and knew all our drinks. Thank you, Juan!

Now, the major imperfection: the restaurant reservation system. Reservations have to be made in person at the reservation desk at only specific times. At 10AM on our first day we were told that there were NO reservations available for our group of 9 for the entire week. The woman we were dealing with, basically shrugged when we expressed our displeasure with this situation. Her attitude was, oh well, there's a buffet.

Fortunately, after contacting our travel agent who made some inquiries, we met with Vladimir Rodrigues, Assistant Manager of Guest Services. He was the epitome of professionalism, courtesy, and efficiency. He handled all of our reservations and the rest of our week was an excellent experience.

Minor details: the pool was critically cold with very few shaded areas and minimal activities. The beach area was full of palm canopies providing abundant shade. Our beach waiter, Boni Ramos, was excellent; as was the dance instructor "Dark Chocolate" !!!

reviews.author: Dan F
reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text:
This is not a 5 star resort (more on that later) but we really enjoyed our stay.   Beautiful and huge property with a great staff (overall), especially Rafael at the Royal Service private beach (he was so incredibly good to us and went out of his way to please us), very nice food and restaurants, and a very nice fitness center.  

The reason I did not rate this resort as 5 stars is because of the following:
1.   Our room was dated and worn looking.  
2.   On our final evening, water cascaded from the ceiling of our room.  
3.   No flexibility with restaurant reservations:   (1) we went one night to a Japanese restaurant at The Reserve and we went by golf cart driven by a hotel staffer.   He did not understand us and took us to the resort’s shopping mall by mistake, causing us to arrive late to our restaurant.  The hostess refused to seat us because we were late and did not care we were late because of a mistake by the hotel staff.   She made us wait 20 minutes until another guest failed to show up on time for their reservation, even though the restaurant was only half full.  (2) on our first night, we arrived too late to make any restaurant reservations but we noticed a fish restaurant that was completely empty.   The host refused to seat us because we did not have a reservation.  
4.   This is a very small issue because you can get whatever you want here whenever you want it, but the minibar in our room was kind of a joke.   Upon our arrival, our fridge had 1 can of beer, 2 bottles of water, 3 bottles of soda, 1 tiny package of Oreo cookies and 1 little bag of potato chips.

reviews.author: lpihearu
reviews.title: Great week at the RESERVE
reviews.text:
I just returned from a week at the RESERVE with my two (27 and 31) daughters. JORGE, our concierge, was amazing. Jorge was instrumental in making our week run smoothly and happily. Jorge greeted us when we arrived, contacted us daily, made our restaurant reservations, and made sure my daughter got her intake of M & Ms.  Our room was spacious and had a nice size patio. Housekeeping services were dependable
The facility is beautiful, the pools and grounds are beautiful and well kept. The beach is lovely and staff is very attentive. Every restaurant is delicious and worth trying. It was so nice to be able to go over to the main hotel to eat there (their buffet is more extensive) and where many more people are and entertainment to see. The disappointing restaurant is RARE steak house. We expected a real treat of special steaks/beef. They didn't even have a filet. Nothing special. All the other restaurants were delicious. Transportation is easy, although walking is an option.
I have to mention the spa which is next to the fitness center. One daughter had an amazing massage, the other daughter got a pedicure. The pools at the spa are amazing. Outdoor showers and very calming. 
Overall, we had a great week. I would definitely recommend the RESERVE at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Sylvain
reviews.title: Changement d opinions
reviews.text:
Nous sommes venus entre amis 
Nous avions eu de très bon commentaires 
Autant pour le service que pour la qualité de la nourriture.

Le service est excellent courtois et jovial sauf à notre arrivée les clefs ne fonctionnaient pas et le lit n était pas fait 

Le service de concierge était rapide et courtois.

La plage est belle 
Bon service à la plage 
Et très peu de vendeur
Aucun vendeur à insistant 

J enlevé des étoile sur la nourriture 
Oui les deux buffets ont de ka nourriture fraîche 
Belle salade et en quantité modérée qui diminue le gaspillage 
Mais quelques fous le soir les plateaux étaient vides
Les resto sont adéquats 
Comme on peut s y attendre
Mais au resto dans la portion Paradisus 
A deux occasion l hamburger n était pas assez cuit 
On redemande une cuisson et il revient encore saignant ce qui est inacceptable d un point de vue hygiène et net à risque du E.Coli e157 
Puis un soir dans l autre resto buffet un très long cheveux dans le plat des pâtes 

Je suis aller voir le manager des excuses mais trop peu trop tard la confiance sera longue à regagner 

De plus apporter votre vin car celui générique est infecte 

Je le downgrade de 5 à 4

reviews.author: Ciarra C
reviews.title: Dominican republic
reviews.text: Richard was beyond amazing. He constantly checked in on us every morning, made sure we had everything we needed, gave us many recommendations which we awesome. He made our trip THAT much better and couldn’t thank him enough.

reviews.author: DEG549
reviews.title: First visit to the Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
Our trip to Punta Cana was great!
Miguel Carpio and team took great care of us, from welcome and registration to making reservations at restaurants.  All we had to do was show up.

Carlos Rosario set up our beach location every day, asking us if we needed anything every time he saw us. His great service was much appreciated.

And, Wanda provided all our beach refreshments with a smile and great banter.

The restaurants and food ranged from average to slightly above average. The wait staff was very attentive, though.

Overall, a great time was had by all.  We will more fluent in Spanish the next time we visit. 

Thanks to all for a great time!

reviews.author: Marc_Chem
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation - Excellent service
reviews.text:
Stayed in Paradisus resort for 6 days celebrating NYE. This was my third stay in the Carraibian and that vacation was the best by far. Hotel is just wonderful, has everything one would need (clean, nice beach, a variety of restaurants, nice pool, lots of entertainment, fitness, tennis courts...). I was amazed by how good the food was which isn’t always a certainty in all inclusive resorts. 
What made our stay even greater is that we had chosen the royal service. If I have an advice to anyone it would be to take it: such a worthy use of your money. Our butler, Darleni, was AMAZING. Detail-oriented, so helpful, available all the time and giving all she has to make our stay special and unique. She drew a smile on our faces every day! If you pick the royal service, make sure to ask for her services, you won’t be disappointed. On top of that, access to the beach, an adult-only pool (that is very small though) and a very good restaurant (Palazzo) and private lounge make your royal service stay even more special. Of course, you don’t get the same level of service in every part of that huge resort (which is usual in all these islands) but overall the experience with service was pretty good. In summary, great hotel, wonderful royal service, nice beach, pretty good food and entertainment: definitely a good pick if you visit Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Susan M
reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Dirty rooms with multiple amenities not working. Power went out during the night before my friends wedding & everyone was forced to get ready in the dark with no water for hours. Manager was cold & unapologetic

reviews.author: Vintage1952
reviews.title: Best vacation because of Naomi
reviews.text:
Naomi on the activities staff was fantastic!
We enjoyed working out with her and dancing the night away.
The grounds are beautiful and the staff fantastic and very friendly. 
The pool and the beach are lovely.
Can't wait to come back !

reviews.author: Radha Somanchi
reviews.title: Great Vacation and lots of Activities for everyone!
reviews.text:
This was our first time in Punta Cana and we loved our experience! The rooms were spacious, the food was great and lots of amenities. What I enjoyed the most was the various activities that they had at the beach for everyone starting with pilates, Zumba, water aerobics - Barbara was splendid! She made sure everyone was comfortable with pace and were having fun!! I went there to relax on the beach with a book, but ended up looking out for these classes and came back home much fitter and motivated to continue working out!!!

At evening, they used to set up barbecue, musical events outside and it was a perfect way to enjoy the beach. Though the resort is smaller than some of the other places we have been it, I felt that was the charm of this place -- not too big and not too small.

One thing that can be improved probably was the quality of the drinks and the service. The drinks were definitely lower quality and service was average. However, since our group was not huge into drinks or food, we still had a lot of fun! Definitely a place, I would recommend.

reviews.author: Caryn H
reviews.title: Poor quality food and drink and we became sick.
reviews.text:
Theis hotel features lovely accommodations, nice pools, a beautiful beach, and  a very nice staff.
The problem is the food and drinks. Very poor quality liquor, much lower quality than RIU and Iberostar chains that I have visited previously.
I requested a room with 2 beds upon booking, but was assigned a king bed room upon checking in, so I had to wait until after 5pm to get a room, waiting in the lobby for almost 3 hours. I had to make 3 trips to the restaurant reservation station because the system was down.
The food preparation staff do not wear gloves. There is a problem with the filtered water and the ice in the bar drinks. My companion and I became very I'll after a few days at this resort and we learned that other guests also became sick ( stomach and intestinal symptoms). The hotel has a bad sewage type smell outside some of the buildings that are away from the beach area. 
I would not recommend this hotel to anyone

reviews.author: JMK8383
reviews.title: Great Time at Paradisus
reviews.text: Wanda - at the Royal Bar - and Pedro - at the Royal Pool area - made the trip.  Loved their spirit and friendliness.   Overall - good time had by all.   Palazzo restaurant was also great.    Restaurants - Rare and Passion and Aqua good.

reviews.author: Jonah E
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: 5 stars would reccomend to everyone! Luis Boutista helped make my trip amazing. The food here is great, trip of a life time would come back here everyday of my life if I could! The staff are amazing and the service is great!

reviews.author: high standards
reviews.title: The wonderful staff at  the Reserve
reviews.text:
This was my fourth visit and I was very impressed with certain staff at the Reserve.  For starters, my butler,Anthony, was always there to help and super attentive and on the ball.  Second time he's been my butler and I hope he always will be.
Liz and Angie at Member Services were fantastic.  Both so professional and kind.  They made check-in and check-out a breeze and always asked if I needed anything.
Marisol at the Spa was the most skilled massage therapist, and I tried many in my numerous visits. 
Sofia at La Palapa couldn't be sweeter and always made sure I was happy with my special diet requirements.
Maritza, the hostess and the Reserve buffet, was extraordinary - kind and friendly and was now moving to La Palapa, I believe, so I'll hopefully see her there next December.
Overall had a great time.
I hope they update the mattress situation in rooms and on the bali beds because they were so soft and unsupportive, I had a really bad back from it.  The ones on the beach and really worn out, some ripped, and that only aggravated my herniated disc even more.  They need to update key card situation because they rarely work.

I still look forward to going back:)

reviews.author: Ben Tasseff
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: When I first came to the resort I had my doubts it would match a previous all-inclusive trip I have taken. My friends and I had a blast! I got a wonderful message and did a lot of activities like Zumba, paddleboard yoga, and beach volleyball. One day there was a foam party in the pool and we had soooo much fun! The most memorable thing about this resort was the night bartenders at the lobby bar. Lillian was such a happy, friendly and overall amazing woman. She remembered my name and gave us a fun experience every night. When Eddison started 2 days into our trip and jumped in to serve us he matched Lillian's energy! They are a great duo and we were so sad to leave them on our last night.

reviews.author: pandccoppola
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star Resort
reviews.text:
It is always difficult for me to give a less than good rating.  In this case, I have no choice.  My wife and I booked this resort with 5 other couples.  Four of us requested room changes after the first night.  The rooms we were assigned were the most remote rooms on the resort.  In addition, they were dirty, one had no hot water, the door to our room was half off the hinges, the décor was dated along with many other problems.  Did I mention we were all seniors?
The day after moving our rooms, the rooms we originally occupied were torn apart and were being rehabbed.  We were told the resort was 50-60 % occupied.  There was no good reason for assigning us these rooms.
Now for the "average" part.  The food was just OK.  The buffet rarely changed.  In the reservations required restaurants the food was barely average.  In the high end steak restaurant, 4 people found their rib eye steaks too tough to chew.  We made reservations to restaurants on the resort with our personal concierge and in all but 1 instance they managed to mess those up, wrong time, wrong number of people.
Staff always managed a "good day" when we passed them in the halls.  Just don't make a request.  I could go on with everything that fell short of their promises and our expectations.
Fortunately we were all good friends and laughed at these misadventures.  There are many 5 star resorts in Punta Cana.  This is not one of them.

reviews.author: Crista B
reviews.title: Palma Paradisus Real Golf & Spa
reviews.text: This trip was a 50th celebration with  3 couples.  I loved the food and entertainment in every restaurant.    The rooms are spacious, clean and you feel pampered.  They are cleaned every night and treats are left.   The wait service is above & beyond expectations.  They make you feel at home and know your preferences after your 1st visit . We never waited for anything. Everything was at our service. The room safe secured all of our belongings and purchases.The spa is not included and very expensive. This trip was like a dream . Paradise for sure . Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gary B
reviews.title: I Love this place!
reviews.text:
This is a great resort.  It looks fabulous and the staff is awesome.  The one bedroom suite was very spacious and clean.  It has a great breakfast buffet and multiple speciality restaurants.  The Japanese restaurant is a must try.  The nightly shows were very entertaining as well.
Kudos to Jesus Evangelista, Yesenia Farias, Obeydey Rodriguez, Ravel Maldonado from member services.  They were fantastic and a major reason the week was so pleasant.  They went out of their way to make us feel special.

reviews.author: Claudio F
reviews.title: Cumpleaños de un amigo
reviews.text: Verdad que el hotel en general es bueno todas las intalaciones salvo que la comida es muy repetida y las nueces nos las ponen salvo que las pidas,despues lo que es limpieza es buena y la bienvenidas tampoco es gran cosa te dan un mapa de 2x 2 pedimos uno mas grande a una tal Rocio la respuesta fuen en una hora estan en las habitaciones nunca aparecio.Ahh y despues en las terrazas no tienen donde colgar los bañadore cuando uno llega de la playa o la piscina .yo me he alojado en otros hoteles mas baratos como el iberostar  y lo tiene.

reviews.author: Carolina G
reviews.title: Check in for good
reviews.text: I want to thank all staff members for making us feel welcomed throughout our stay. I especially want to thank Benjamin the artist as we called him. Thank you for being so sweet, helpful and making our stay extra special because of your personality. I will definitely re visit this hotel in the future! It was by far the most amazing time and a trip to remember for a lifetime.

reviews.author: JayB
reviews.title: Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: I came to DR with friends to celebrate my birthday. Overall, excellent birthday vacation. The resort was very nice and well maintained. The staff was wonderful and very helpful. Nixon was amazing, he kept me and all of my friends dancing and entertained. Absolutely love the foam party in the pool. I have been to Punta Cana a couple of times, but this was the best experience by far.

reviews.author: nsany
reviews.title: Great Front Desk Staff and Excellent Spa
reviews.text: We visited the Paradius Palma Real resort for our two milestone birthdays. We were a group of 14 and the hotel guest relations and the reservations department took excellent care of us. Specifically Domingo Beltre and Wally Pana. From the minute you walked in you could see the ocean and the lobby was beautiful. Our rooms were of a very good size with a separate seating area and a large balcony. The property was well kept with manicured lawn and plenty of beach chairs and umbrellas, Frequent drink service at the beach was readily available. Domingo and his staff had arranged a cake and other goodies in our room prior to our arrival. The door had a happy birthday banner and other touches which made it special for the birthday girls. There was plenty of variety of food at the buffet and so were the drinks. The spa was excellent. Omar was a wonderful masseuse, All in all a special stay for a special occasion.

reviews.author: VILLAALLEGRIA
reviews.title: Good and bad parts!!
reviews.text:
I was here three times ,,, first in 2012, second 2016 and november 2018. Always at The rezerve. 
I am Inlove with this place! The best thing is the garden , the nature , which is more than beautiful . For me , it is what i expect for a Carribean place. The food is excelent . The hotel rooms are well maintained , but needs a renovation. Overall , the rooms are good. Most profesional and nice people are the boys from the H2o beach bar , Ramon Ramirez and Luis Para . Very profesional and helpfull. And the Ihi Spa experience with Marisol was beautiful ! Also Sandra , who took us to see the Circle !
The bad parts, because i have to say , are the reception staff ! In our villa, nr 38 , the personal from the reception never salute ,always with eyes on the computer... 
and the personal in reception from the mainlobby   are rude and nonprofesional !
I think they have to know when you make the check out bill ,what your costs are , at 10.00 oclock in the morning , not when you leave at 18.00 ( after you pay late check out 200 usd !!) . 
The other nonprofesional think is that nobody notice that we were three times there , and every time 2 rooms! It is about fidelizing your clients...
I hope that somebody from the management will see this , because the personal from  reception is the only bad think i have to say!

reviews.author: durant218
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful.  The rooms are nice except for the outdated tvs.  The resort is so big that if you aren’t staying in the main building you have to golf cart it to the pools and food.  The villas away from the main building are in dark and secluded areas.  I don’t recommend them unless you have a group of people with you.  The food was good.  The rooms were clean.  The first night I had no running water and the person at the front said that the water was out throughout the complex.  That was a lie.  I was the only one in my group without water.  They had to send one of the workers to take me to one of the villas to shower.  Very inconvenient.  The water was on the next day but was only a trickle.  They eventually fixed that.  So after 1 1/2 days of no or little water I started to enjoy myself. The staff was friendly.  They had exciting events at night.

reviews.author: Odyssey26057480867
reviews.title: Horrible Stay
reviews.text: I don't want to take much more of my time to express my unhappiness with this place.  Limited food options, rooms very outdated, frogs in the room under crib for baby on the second floor, zero customer service, unfriendly staff, beds at the beach are old and uncomfortable.  This hotel does mate care to make your stay warm and inviting.  This is not a high end resort.  Overpriced and disgusting.

reviews.author: Chonee
reviews.title: Fun Times
reviews.text: My husband and I along with a large group of friends stayed at this resort for a few days and we had an amazing time.  Check-in took a little longer than I would have liked however the staff was friendly and helpful.  The grounds are large so our room was pretty far from the pool/restaurants/bars however, it was not that big of a deal - they have golf carts running at all times which allow guests to hop on and off.  You can also call the front desk and request one for a specific time.  The room was clean, beautiful, and quite large with a nice kitchen, dining and living room with a nice bedroom and big bathroom.  The food - breakfast, lunch and dinner - at the buffet restaurant was very good and satisfying.  There was always lots of options available and if you wanted something specific that was not out (such as french fries) you can ask one of the chefs and they would be more than willing to prepare some for you and bring them out to your table.  We did not have dinner at any of the specialty restaurants because we were more than satisfied with the buffet dinners.  The grounds were very well kept and clean.  The pool was large and the beach was beautiful.  The staff were always eager to get you drinks and anything you may have needed to make your stay great.  Junior was amazing and always made sure our cups were filled!!  If i had any complaints, it would just be that the bartenders need to put more liquor into the drinks :)  The gym was quite impressive (yes, i workout on vacation) with lots of equipment and weigh options.  Overall it was a fun and great stay and we would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: jgoergen728
reviews.title: Great DR destination!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed 4 nights and the Paradisus Palma Real resort, for our anniversary as well as a friends’ wedding. It was an excellent time! Our butler, Argenis Romero, made every effort ensure we had a great experience. He prepared our room on our anniversary personally, and made all of our restaurant reservations as well as confirmed our return transportation. I cannot say enough great things. The property was very picturesque, and all the staff were friendly and helpful. We would definitely return!

reviews.author: Brandon N
reviews.title: Very nice -excellent beach vacation
reviews.text: Love the beach and the water was amazing. Junior was very helpful and the best waiter we had. He always had chairs ready for our group in the morning The overall service was great at restaurants. The hibachi grill was my favorite.

reviews.author: Aurelia L
reviews.title: Laura & Caesar's Wedding
reviews.text: GREAT price for all-inclusive. GREAT atmosphere, vibes, food, friendly and attentive staff...the furniture was beautiful, the pools, the views, the hotel room, the ambiance...overall WONDERFUL. Would definitely come back!! We came for a wedding and already are planning to come back. I heard about Paradisus but didn't expect it to be as good as it was. The wedding TOPPED it ALL OFF! It was absolutely GORGEOUS! We had all-white beach party, and wedding in Bavaro Ballroom. Staff was fun and dancing with us. Food was good. We are vegetarian and only eat greens and fish. The fish was good. Every time you pass an employee in any department, they will never pass you without saying 'HOLA' with a genuine smile. Makes you feel welcome. No one judges you, everyone caters to you and goes that extra length to satisfy the customer. God Bless!

reviews.author: Guide186314
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We had the best vacation thanks to the amazing care and service from our butler Jeuri. We all felt incredibly taken care of and welcomed throughout our trip. We will definitely be returning and hope to cross paths with Jeuri again!

reviews.author: Exploration779077
reviews.title: Painting class
reviews.text: Nixon, Risarys, Jean, and La Manta assisted with the painting class. It was so much fun! Everyone’s was different but the same idea. Good way to spend some afternoon down time. La Manta was the instructor and danced to the music in the room. He made us feel like we were great when clearly there is a reason he is the instructor and we aren’t 🤗

reviews.author: Cristina
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful but it’s the employees make it an amazing experience. Richard was always available whenever we needed anything or had questions. He’d randomly leave little surprises in the room (I won’t ruin them for you 😉). Martin at the royal services beach was amazing!!!! He always made sure we had the “best” cabana and that it was waiting for us each morning. This was our first trip away since becoming parents and it was much needed. So, relaxing all morning with front row beach seating was just what we needed. Thank you, Martin! Wanda at the royal service bar was equally as amazing. I have a new found love of sitting on the beach drinking piña coladas!

reviews.author: Rodolfo R
reviews.title: Espectacular hotel
reviews.text:
Alguno tenía que ser mi primer comentario, y no veo mejor ocasión que este.
Llegamos a Punta Cana por primera vez para nosotros y no nos defraudó. Los primeros días los dedicamos a conocer un poco el hotel y sus instalaciones, que nos sorprendieron gratamente. La mayor parte de los restaurantes nos encantaron, con especial mención a Passion, donde Rodny y su equipo nos hicieron vivir una experiencia increíble, alucinamos, literalmente.
Por otro lado, el pool bar, con Luis al frente, nos regalaron tardes infinitas con sus tragos y fiestas de aqua gym, paddle board y sus fiestas de la espuma. 
Pero si algo nos cautivó fue el lobby bar y su personal. Mención en mayúsculas merecen Edison y Lilian, dos excepcionales trabajadores y bellísimas personas, cercanos, simpáticos, amables que nos brindaron ratos eternos de risas y buenos cocktails. 
En general todo el equipo de Paradisus nos hizo sentir como en casa, pero si tuviera que quedarme con algo en particular, sería con esas dos personas que hicieron que, personalmente, me sintiera como en casa. Espero que sigan ahí mucho tiempo y tener la oportunidad de volver. 
Un saludo a todo el equipo y, de nuevo, gracias por todo.

reviews.author: Relax68705263151
reviews.title: 50th Birthday Trip
reviews.text: We had a great time at this resort and would go back again.  Our butler, Juan Suarez, was very attentive.  Loved the "Wanda" special at the Royal Service pool bar.  Rafael and Pedro were great at the Royal Service beach area.  Everything was clean and well maintained.  We were able to get into all the restaurants we wanted to.  Food was good all week, but I did end up with Montezuma's revenge after eating a caeser salad on our last full day.

reviews.author: Passenger65854513771
reviews.title: Restaurant
reviews.text: The service by Jose Miguel Martas was exceptional.  Very attentive, and welcoming.  He was the reason we kept going back to the restaurant.  The service could not be topped anywhere else.  He made us feel like family.

reviews.author: Sightseer62429766968
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: We came for a wedding and spent 6 days at the paradisus. Every employee was welcoming and helpful for myself especially who has never been to the DR and is very intermediate in Spanish. The employees not only served us with everything we needed, but they contributed to the fun with dancing, making us their specialty drinks, friendly hellos and making sure we had a great time. Catherine and the staff, who was the wedding planner, which my boyfriend was groomsman, was amazing in planning, organizing and putting on the best welcome dinner and wedding I’ve ever been to! If anyone is looking for an all inclusive resort in the DR, I highly recommend the paradisus. I even more recommend it for a destination wedding !

reviews.author: OnAir16858327693
reviews.title: Maravilloso lugar!
reviews.text:
La comida del Resturante Brisas buenísima!!
El lugar muy agradable, todo muy amables
Felicidades y gracias a Cristian Castro y Juan Robles por su excelente atención!!

Muchas gracias, espero regresar pronto

reviews.author: kat88nyc
reviews.title: Waste of Money
reviews.text:
First... The photo advertising The Reserve at Paradisus is misleading.  It is a 15 minute walk to the beach unless you take the trolley which you have to wait for.

Upon arrival we were told our room wasn’t ready so they were upgrading us to a larger room.  The young lady who showed us to a room immediately started pushing us to make a reservation for breakfast the next morning.  No thank you... all I wanted was for her to show us how to shut off the ceiling fans, however she turned her back on me and walked out of the room while I was speaking to her.  Thank God we didn’t take her up on the breakfast reservation because we later found out it was to push the timeshare that would have taken the entire morning (3 hours) and we were only there for two days/3 nights.  Here’s an idea... be honest if you want to try and get people to listen to your timeshare pitch,  don’t steal their vacation time.  Or an even better idea would be to figure out how to market it differently.

The room was clearly only cleaned in some areas and not others.  The air conditioning stayed on one freezing temperature no matter what we did to try and change it.  The shower which was dirty had one temperature of scalding hot water.  The slippers were clearly used with dirty feet prints  inside of them.  Don’t give up slippers if you don’t want to change them.  There was no hair dryer and when we went to speak to the concierge in our building she replied in a condescending manner that she would go to the room with us and show us where it was as she could not take our word for it.  When we went back to the room to prove there was no hair dryer we showed her the problem with the air conditioning and the shower.  Long story short... they never fixed the air conditioning and changed the problem with the scalding hot water in the shower to extremely low pressure with only cool water.  after that the shower was dirtier than it was when we got there and it was never cleaned during our stay.  The young lady that was the housekeeper looked miserable and never smiled even once.

If you want to eat in a restaurant for dinner... you need a reservation for all of them.  Good luck with that as we were told there were no reservations until Monday evening and we are leaving Monday morning.  After arguing about it we got a reservation for Sunday night at the Mexican restaurant for 8 PM.  Later on they did come through with a reservation for the Grill at 7 PM on Friday evening, I don’t understand why it was so difficult when there were plenty of empty tables throughout our entire dinner.  On Saturday evening upon coming back from the pool The concierge told me that she made us a reservation for the Mexican restaurant at 7 PM that night at a different restaurant at 7 PM the following night.  I told her that 7 PM is not good for us and we had already had a reservation for Sunday night at the Mexican restaurant at 8 PM.  She responded in her usual condescending manner ...saying well I changed it.  Excuse me... you didn’t pay for my trip so you should not be changing the reservation time that I made without asking me.  By the way,  there were empty tables at that restaurant as well.  The breakfast at the buffet was good but the staff seemed annoyed to get the beverages.  Last but not least, I asked the concierge if there was a bottle of wine for the room and I was told if I wanted wine in the room I needed to call  room service and they would bring me a GLASS of wine.  

I met no less than three other people waiting at the concierge desk with complaints of a similar nature during my three night stay.

On the upside... once you get away from The Reserve, and you will have to if you want to eat in a restaurant...The resort that is Paradisus Punta Cana appears very beautiful and well-maintained.  Also, there was an amazing happy guy serving drinks at The Reserve pool who came around to get your order.  They should promote him from getting drinks to being the manager of training and customer service.

Also there seem to be only kittens around... can’t help but wonder what happened to the older ones😬

This all being said, it’s a shame we stayed in The Reserve  section and not in the Paradisus section as I wouldn’t chance going back there.  Clearly the resort is mismanaged since they allow such poor customer service and lack of work ethic.

reviews.author: Richard S
reviews.title: Golf getaway with friends
reviews.text:
As are most resorts in Punta Cana Paradisus is all- inclusive. Food, drinks including liquor are included and plentiful. The resort is very large with many restaurants. It’s aesthetically pleasing and very well maintained. 
The best thing about it is the staff. They were universally friendly and helpful. 
Specifically Lilian and Edison at the lobby bar, Betty at Reception, Victor the lead bellman, and Luz  Villa at the Buffet. Many more whose names I didn’t jot down. 
My only reason for less than 5 stars has more to do with management. 
Restaurants require reservations which are almost impossible to get with short notice. This is unnecessary as there were always empty tables and had we not persisted we would have ended up eating at the Buffet which isn’t bad. 
Overall I would recommend it

reviews.author: OnAir10408586598
reviews.title: Turning 50
reviews.text:
Bunch of friends decided to go away for our 50.  Decided on the royal service.  Private check in area with no lines.  Met our butler, Juan.  He took us on a tour of the resort and explained his services.  Provided us with his phone contact using what’s app.  Hotel had internet that worked almost everywhere, including beach.  This was very convenient.  Being a party of 10 people it was difficult to plan dining at the specialty restaurants.  But Juan made it happen.  Needs a few things over the week, just a text and they were in room.  He introduced us to Martin on the private side of beach.  Told him what we wanted and everyday lounge chairs, beds, cabana all set.  He knew your drink and would bring it right to your chair.  Awesome.  The hotel lobby bar we met Victor (bartender).  Always a smile to see you and made a great mojito.  Pool bar was Joel. Great banana daiquiris.  Another guy always smiling and great to talk to.
Place had one of the best buffets I’ve seen., been to a dozen all inclusive.  Only downside was the people selling stuff on beach.  Got very annoying.

reviews.author: MKrebs
reviews.title: Worse food ever!
reviews.text: I've been in many Hotels and this is the one with the most horrible food I've ever had. I spent 5 days and the best I eaten was the Omelets. Not even the snacks were decent. I even tried 2 of the reserved restaurants and were as bad as the buffet restaurants. Paradisus Punta Cana & Paradisus The Reserve would NEVER see me there again.

reviews.author: Jose C
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text:
Royal Service!
...We stayed in Royal Service, our butler Armando is highly recommended. He did a great job making our trip special and took care of everything so all we had to do was sit back and relax and enjoy ourselves. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Maps49008845660
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time at this resort. The staff was very respectful and attentive. My Butler (Faustino) was great. He made sure all my request were taken care of in a timely fashion. Furthermore, he went above and beyond to ensure I had a wonderful stay. As a result of this, I would definitely consider this property again.

reviews.author: Leonardo L. Monescau
reviews.title: Opiniones encontradas
reviews.text:
Fuimos una semana del 27/10 al 3/11. Nuestra experiencia ha sido variada pero no me permite calificar al hotel mejor. Comienzo con lo bueno:

La Recepción: nos han recibido con mucha cordialidad y nos guardaron la valijas un par de horas dado que llegamos a las 13 y el check-in es a las 15 hs. 

Nuestra Coordinadora: Tuvimos de coordinadora a una chica muy amable llamada Trazy que supo aconsejarnos y resolver todas nuestras consultas en forma satisfactoria y profesional.

Las habitaciones: Nos alojamos en una Suite Junior, si bien eran grandes y con camas muy cómodas, no nos gustó que entre el baño y la habitación haya una ventana con una cortina, lo cual hace que se escuchen todos los ruidos naturales que se pueden hacer dentro del baño y resulta muy incomodo por mas que sean parejas o amigos.

Los restaurantes: El buffet principar donde se sirven el desayudo, almuerzo y cena es muy completo, gran variedad de platos y los mozos muy amables y atentos.

LO MALO:

Cucarachas: en 3 partes distintas del predio (Buffet, Entrada de Restaurante Vento y baño de la habitación) hemos encontrado estos insectos.

Ladrones: Uno de nuestros amigos olvidó su billetera en la habitación y le robaron 20 dólares e hicieron compras con su tarjeta de crédito.

Vendedores: Termina siendo insoportable la cantidad de vendedores dentro del hotel y en su playa, deberían controlarlo mas ya que a veces son muy molestos.

Club de Vacaciones Melia: Te invitan a una charla para que conozcas el nuevo hotel que están construyendo, The Circle, la misma promete ser de 30 minutos o 45 como mucho y termina siendo una charla de 1 hora y media en donde al final te presentan el Club de Vacaciones del Hotel en donde practicamente te obligan ahí mismo a comprar el paquete mientras que a cada rato "otros sospechosos compradores" que parecían mas actores que otra cosa celebran con champan su compra gritando para que se escuche y así convencerte a comprar (estrategia de venta). Me pareció muy maleducado el vendedor que nos atendía que al ver nuestra negativa a comprar se fue sin saludar. Si no estás interesado en comprar un club de vacaciones, no vayas a la charla pues es una pérdida de tiempo.

reviews.author: LiveToWonder
reviews.title: Beautiful resort POORLY managed. Very disappointed!
reviews.text:
This is my very first time staying at an all inclusive resort. We stayed at the reserve, not knowing it was 15 minutes walk to the beach. Arrived on Friday for three nights. 
At the lobby we were told we got an upgrade since our room were not ready and he didn’t want to see us waiting :) there was an envelope addressed to the Johnson family in the room (maybe they didn’t like it and was passed on to us)
We wanted to maximized our staying, took a golf cart to the beach, by asking our ‘concierge’ to book for dinner, her response was ‘all the restaurants are booked for tonight and tomorrow’ REALLY??? Where can we eat?? Buffet. I said to her ‘It was a girls weekend and we paid a lot of money for an all incluye resort to eat buffet every night?’ She kept apologizing and mentioned the Italian and the hibachi were under construction, ok miss concierge there are 5 others!!! She finally gave us one for our first at the Grill.
The food was good, the restaurant was kind of empty, they could definitely sit more parties of two. 
Our first night back to the room, the AC was too cold for us, no hair dryer and the water in he shower was boiling hot. I called reception at 10 and was told someone will come in to help, I call three times more at 11, no answer, I ended up calling room service and finally was connected to the lobby and same thing... no one ever came. 
The very next day I asked my concierge to take care of these problems, the AC was never fixed till we left, the shower water got cold instead of warm. They sent us a drier. Oh... we got USED, DIRTY slippers. 
THIS IS ONE BEAUTIFUL NICE RESORT, well kept LANDSCAPE. But the people who work there are not friendly nor helpful and looking for tips at all time. 
I was told by the staff at the pool, the resort closes 3-4 restaurants when guests capacity is light. Buffet everyday....
I definitely advise travelers, if you want quality DO NOT pick this resort it’s a big disappointment.

reviews.author: Mónica Silvia
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones!!!
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia. Muy recomendable, la calidad de la gente fantástica. El servicio de muy buena calidad. 100 % recomendable. 🏝️🌴☀️En cuanto al personal que podría decir, desde el Dj. El señor Jhanc Carlos del bar Avenue que hizo de nuestras noches un disfrute total tanto por su música como por su persona. De los animadores otro tanto, el señor Reynaldo un genio, no paraba de bailar y derrochar simpatía, sin dudas un gran ser humano, la señora Lucía barman del bar Aveniu una divina total... Siempre sonriente y muy amable. Luego Cesar del del restaurante Naos y Óleo, excelente atención y muy buen trato, gracias a el conocimos la esquicita Mamajuana 🍸 realmente muy recomendable. Haaa antes de que me olvide, también la excelente atención de Luis (barman) y Jesús (mozo) del bar de la piscina el Swim UP. Bueno que más decir, tienen un grupo humano excelente, de mi parte les doy las gracias por hacerme pasar días hermosos, ojalá que el destino me regrese a República Dominicana y pueda pasar unos días más con ustedes. Gracias. Será hasta la próxima. 🥂🍾🌴☀️

reviews.author: mariangray2018
reviews.title: Professional relaxation
reviews.text: Work Hard, Play even harder. Great beaches, the swim up bar was lovely and the staff was amazing. The rooms was clean and down fall was the water pressure.  Overall, great time, food was decent and Entertainment was nice.

reviews.author: Gina J
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: We had an incredible experience at this resort. Beautiful facility and great customer service. Really enjoyed the work of Edison at the lobby bar and the spa services water features. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ciciincville
reviews.title: Another name for Paradise
reviews.text:
Magnificent Ocean view when you step off the bus. Engineered for convenience & beauty. We had Royal Service so this review will be mostly for the adult pool, bali beds, room amenities, Palazzo restaurant which were all great.  Favorites were the king sized plus bed and the jacuzzi tub.  Our butler in Villa 8 was Armando. We used the What's App for communication & Armando was there. So friendly & communicative & available.  Armando filled the tub with bubbles & rose petals: a first and much appreciated.   
At the pool Carlos Rosario was the man to call.  Banana mamma and a smile were what Carlos delivered. He seemed to know when we were thirsty and was there to serve.  
The YHI spa seemed to lack management. Beautiful but would give it only 3+ stars.
And finally, our one over all suggestion: add a coffee bar and better coffee

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text:
My friend and I are on our last day of our vacation and we couldn’t be more sad about leaving this beautiful resort. We are both fairly inexperienced with travel so the support and welcoming nature from all the staff here has been amazing. 

The mini bar is always stocked with water, juice and snacks which is a nice surprise when you come back to the room after a long day in the sun. While at the pool, you are never too far from a bathroom (which is nice!) and there is no shortage of available food and drinks. We especially liked the variety of activities and I have to give a massive thank you to Oscar (aka Tarzan) as he really helped ease my anxieties about being away and in a new place. He remembered it was my birthday and on the day he came up and wished me well. He was an absolute gem the whole week. 

The buffet is FANTASTIC and I was very impressed with the quality of food. As usual the wait staff were very friendly and catered to any needs we had. 
While at the pool we were always warmly greeted and asked if we wanted a drink (yes!) and Argenis and Jensy were always checking in to see how we were doing. 

All in all it was a fabulous vacation and the only downside of it all was the noisy air conditioning and the tv wasn’t working. 

Would definitely stay here again. 

Gracias!

reviews.author: Sam T
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana October 2018
reviews.text: With me being a first time traveler to a tropical destination, Paradisus Punta Cana was an AMAZING experience. The staff at the resort are so friendly, and I felt completely comfortable the entire trip. One of the activities coordinators, Oscar Santana, who guided us through a morning pool cycling class was very friendly and helped us with any questions we had, and he remembered our faces through the entire week, and checked in on us. The bartenders at the pool really got to know us as well. Argenis de los Santos is a wonderful bartender who always had a huge smile on his face. Him and is co worker, Jensy Rijo were so friendly, and their service was amazing and they never forgot our drink orders! The resort itself is very clean, and the food is amazing! 10/10 would definitely come again, and recommend it to anyone looking to get away!

reviews.author: Julie M
reviews.title: Coco
reviews.text: Nixon made the trip along with our Butler Angelo. The facility is beautiful and the weather was great. The beach was nice and clean and there was always Cabanas at the pool. Every morning we were created by a butler who would also make our dinner reservations it made the trip very easy and relaxing.

reviews.author: Ismary G
reviews.title: wedding
reviews.text: the hotel was great, we usually go there every year, my son had his weeding on september 29th 2018 and everything was spectacular!  Maria Angeles Sanchez was the weeding coordinator, and she took care of everything!!!!!!!,  sincerely we were very please with her services 10 out of 10.  Jessica the lady from the beauty spa and all the people that work for the Romance department (Beatriz), made everything perfect for the bride, groom and their family, also the people from the room service Christian Medina and Maikel Feliz were very friendly and helpful.  It was unforgettable times, memories to be cherished forever .....thank you to all the staff!! and specially Mary Angeles..... hope to see everyone soon, love Punta Cana!!!

reviews.author: Jason M
reviews.title: Reynaldo "Snoopy" made our trip amazing!
reviews.text: We recently spent several days in Punta Cana at the Paradisus resort. All of the staff members were professional, polite, and accomodating. One person, in particular, made the stay over-the-top entertaining and fun. Reynaldo aka "Snoopy" always had a smile and went out of his way - day and night - to ensure our group was taken care of. He definitely has a great future ahead of him in management and customer service. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Mercedes I
reviews.title: Exelente Resort!!
reviews.text: Realmente de exelencia todo!! Piscinas, restaurantes, bares, show,la playa! Todo!!Gracias a todo el personal,  atentos, simpaticos,siempre dispuestos a atendernos! especialmente a Felix y Juan, mayordomos del Royal Service, a Pedro del bar de la piscina del mismo sector.Fue una estadia inolvidable!!

reviews.author: lmtlpc15
reviews.title: Great times with great people!
reviews.text: Service was excellent for a large group of people! The group I attended with had several events on site & service was excellent from Day 1, first event.  Servers were attentive, polite & charming attending to our every need!!

reviews.author: Zina C
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: Everything is excellent! The suits,food,activities, and views are dreams come true. The staff are very friendly and wonderful like Nixon, Nina, and Reynaldo. The shows are amazing!The food is delicious

reviews.author: islandgirlvacations
reviews.title: Beautiful beach & pools!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a girls trip & had some fun at the Paradisus Palma Real. The service was NOT good to start...no one seemed to know where to take us & the reception was not very friendly. BUT luckily the situation improved & we did have some ***excellent, very attentive service in the pool area! FREDDY...NIXON & JEAN are wonderful*** pool/bar attendants & made our girls trip so fun :)
I am a travel agent and travel very frequently-so I'll give a brief recap of other aspects of the hotel....Food is OK, drinks OK (very hard to get ahold of top shelf or a beer other than Presidente). The 2 bedroom master suite had excellent space-which we needed in our group of 4. It was clean, but was quite dated.
The specialty restaurants are a bit difficult to make reservations in but we did try the steak house "Rare"...food again was OK...I think my burger was a frozen patty. The hibatchi grill was better-we enjoyed that, but could only get in at 9:45pm, which was pretty late. The entertainment at night was fun! we particularly enjoyed the Circus (Cirque de soleil-style). We also had a very fun night in the dance club :) 
Overall, this "research" trip was pretty much what I expected Punta Cana to be, personally I like Mexico much better.

reviews.author: mdiazvaro
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at the hotel. The hotel staff was very friendly. The pool, room and other amenities were beautiful. Also I had a situation were I needed immediate tailoring services for my bridesmaids dress and they were able to find me one quickly.  Overall my whole experience at the hotel was incredible and I’m looking forward to go back.

reviews.author: Valentina S
reviews.title: Excelentes Vacaciones

Jean Maicol se encargó de que pasáramos unas excelentes vacaciones y nos enseñó a bailar bachata y merengue. Por otro lado Yenny en el restaurante nos alegró las mañanas! Gustavo en el bar de la piscina siempre atento y divertido. En la discoteca el bar tender Miguel junto con Nurys se encargaron de que nuestra última noche sea la mejor!! Todos los que trabajan en el hotel son excelentes y siempre dispuestos a ayudarte. 100% recomendable

Since we stayed at the Reserve it was quite a walk to the beach and it would have been nice if the shuttles came more often.

reviews.author: trondin82
reviews.title: Детальный отзыв по отелю. Сентябрь 2018.
reviews.text:
Это путешествие для нас было первым опытом поездки в Доминиканскую республику и состоялось благодаря нашим друзьям, которые организовали там свою свадьбу и собрали на мероприятие друзей. По отелю Paradisus Palma Real Golf&Spa Resort 5*, к сожалению, было не так много свежих отзывов, что создавало в процессе подготовки определённую информационную брешь. Поэтому я, в свою очередь, постарался написать отзыв так, чтобы информация оказалась подробной, полезной для других путешественников и по возможности не дублировалась, а также снабдил его максимально подробным фото-отчётом. Я думаю, что подобная форма изложения будет полезна для тех, кто летит в Доминиканскую республику в первый раз и кому необходимо дополнить уже собранную информацию на этапе подготовки, составить представление об отеле в процессе выбора, учесть все нюансы, либо для тех, кто хотел бы прочитать динамику изменений по отелю. 
1.	Подготовка к поездке (туроператор, авиаперевозчик). 
На этапе подготовки к поездке мы изучили приличный объем информации по стране, пересмотрели множество блогов. Проходило очень много информации о грудах водорослей, превративших прибрежную полосу в компот, причем не важно, был ли это берег дорогого отеля или скромной трёшки (просто пляж дорогих отелей старались оперативно приводить в порядок). О местах, расположенных примерно так же близко к экватору мы впервые получили представление в Тайланде, где были года два назад, собственно поэтому в поездку купили солнцезащитные крема с коэффициентом 50. Кстати, крем не спасает, мазались по три раза в день. Несмотря на то, что кое-где встречались упоминания о необходимости перед поездкой сделать ряд прививок от ряда тропических болезней, мы этим пренебрегли, но тут уж никого ни к чему не призываю, решайте сами (от той же холеры, например, нет стопроцентной защиты кроме вашей собственной осмотрительности). Тур был куплен у оператора «Пегас», с чартером а/к «NORDWIND», тур покупали через интернет, оплачивали так же, через приложение «Сбербанк-онлайн», документы получили по электронке за пару дней до вылета. 
2.	Перелёт/трансфер. 
В рамках тур.путевки у нас был предусмотрен чартер а/к «NORDWIND» с ранним вылетом из а/к «Шереметьево» в 5 утра. Так как ранее мы уже пользовались услугами этой а/к в одной из поездок в Крым и, сказать по правде, впечатления остались отвратительные, я решил досконально изучить как сам рейс которым мы должны были полететь по имеющимся отзывам (у нас был туда N4 3517, обратно N4 3518), так и воздушное судно и компоновку его салона, обслуживание на борту. Несколько раз созванивался с представителями поддержки а/к в Москве. Вопросов было несколько. Первое – багаж. В эконом-классе предусмотрена возможность взять на борт по 20 кг в качестве багажа и по 5 кг в качестве ручной клади, при этом дополнительно вы можете взять ещё рюкзак (весом 5 кг), а также прочие вещи (верхняя одежда, портплед, фотокамера, и далее по их списку). Проверено: нормы ручной клади позволяют провезти и собственно «ручную кладь» и рюкзак (того же веса). Но учтите, если везете с собой какую-то еду, ее могут забрать либо на вылете в Шереметьево либо на прилете в Пунта-кане. Кроме того, если, например, вы летите вдвоём с одним чемоданом на двоих существует услуга объединения багажа, тогда максимальный вес чемодана допускаемого к провозу в багажном отсеке увеличивается до 30 кг. (но требуется за сутки до вылета уведомить а/к по специальному адресу эл.почты).  Второй вопрос – рассадка и выбор мест. В компании существует практика рандомной рассадки пассажиров, которые не оплатили места заранее (к слову  - обычные места 30$, предпочтительные – 50$ и комфортные – 75$). По отзывам судя, и это подтвердил оператор телефонной поддержки а/к бывали ситуации, когда детей сажают отдельно от родителей, как следствие в течение всего полета по самолёту ходят люди, очень не комфортно в целом, особенно в зонах турбулентности (которые случаются, это вам не полет в Турцию). На линии телефонной поддержки мне порекомендовали просто пораньше приехать в аэропорт на регистрацию и тогда всё-таки существует возможность выбора мест бесплатно. Третий момент – на рейсах «NORDWIND» в течение 12-тичасового перелёта кормят 1 раз, кроме того все как один в отзывах упомянули то, что даже воду не разносят нормально (самим приходится ходить и наливать её где-то), более того не хватает пледов (их раздают только детям), все это так и есть. Мы рассмотрели несколько вариантов дополнительного питания – 1) можно на сайте а/к заказать дополнительное горячее питание, 2) можно заказать специальный сервис доставки еды в дорогу от Аркадия Новикова в зону вылета, 3) можно просто самим где-то заранее купить нормальных бутербродов и в дьютифри купить воды и сока. Чтобы не попасть в досадную ситуацию с опозданием и, конечно же, выбрать места рядом, мы за три часа до вылета приехали в «Шереметьево». Вылет был из терминала F, я даже сначала не поверил что в Шереметьево может быть настолько старый терминал. Здесь учитывая то, что самолёт большой (на рейс ставится боинг 777-300ER (борт с одноклассовой (эконом) компоновкой салона (рассадка 3-4-3), предсказуемо долго сдавали багаж и получали посадочные, так как мы летели большой группой и ждали всех остальных. Места рядом нам дали, проблем не возникло, наверное потому что пораньше приехали. Расстояние между рядами кресел нормальное, комфортно. Быстро прошли паспортный контроль и попали в сонный терминал (время было часа 3 ночи уже) вылет как по часам, чётко вовремя. Сам перелёт, учитывая то, что лететь предстояло 12 часов получился не особенно комфортный, обратно ещё хуже было, потому что мы час простояли на взлетной полосе, ждали завершения каких-то бумажных процедур, касающихся депортации одного из пассажиров. Всё же чувствуется разница во времени, минус 7 часов по сравнению с Москвой, но я был к этому изначально готов, купил специальный препарат Мелаксен, который помогает нормализовать сон и адаптироваться после смены часовых поясов. В аэропорту Пунта-Каны на прилёте быстро получили багаж, сдали миграционные карточки и таможенную декларацию, которые заполнили ещё в самолёте (выдают стюардессы) и прошли паспортный контроль, и улыбчивые пограничники практически не глядя ставят штамп в паспорт, hola Доминикана! 
В Пунта-Кане уже с утра было солнечно, мы собрали народ в кучу и рванули к регистрации на трансфер, здесь всё быстро, пара минут и мы в небольшом автобусе. Групповой трансфер в отель длился около 20 минут (у нас он был индивидуальный).
Сразу по обратному вылету напишу. Приходится заполнять ещё раз миграционную карточку на каждого до того как вы попадете к стойке регистрации на рейс. Нас так же посадили рядом без доплат, хотя в очереди мы были практически последними (поздно привезли нас в аэропорт). По багажу следят строго – не более 20 кг, это важно учитывать (если будет 21 либо перекладывать, либо в ручную кладь). Дьютифри у них на вылете очень хороший, есть всё, но и цены в 2,5 раза выше.
