Нет никаких доплат за въезд и выезд (встречалась такая информация ранее).
3.	Номер. 
Изначально до вылета мы выбирали из двух категорий номеров (либо luxury suit, либо paradisus suit, оба около 50 кв.м площадью). Забронировали paradisus suit. По прилету на ресепшен заполняете необходимые бумаги на туристов, у вас копируют загранпаспорт и на руку прикрепляют красивые плетёные браслеты (если стандартная категория обслуживания в отеле – зелёного цвета, если у вас royal service - золотого). Кроме того, выдают пару карточек - ключей от номера и две карточки на полотенца (полотенца получаете утром в павильоне рядом с пляжем и сдать можно до 18:00). Заселение происходит только после 15:00, это неизменное правило. Но вы можете оставить багаж в камере хранения и пользоваться всей инфраструктурой отеля до заселения (на чемодан вешается специальная бирка с отрывным талоном, который передается вам как владельцу). Сам номер указанной категории располагался на третьем этаже одной из вилл (все виллы трехэтажные). Важный момент – лифтов на виллах нет. Номер paradisus suit  площадью 49 кв.м., в нём две сдвинутые полутораметровые кровати (очень комфортные матрасы, кстати), зона гостиной с диваном и стульями и большая ванная комната с двухместным джакузи и отдельным душем. Вся мебель в номерах сделана из массива дерева. Из ванной в комнату раскрывается окно, предназначение которого не ясно) Есть большая лоджия с плетеной мебелью и столиком. В номере есть телевизор, часы-будильник. Вид из номера не на море. Кому интересно, № 3063. Номер дважды в день убирают (вечером закрывают шторы и кладут шоколадку на покрывало), при этом непонятно как они узнают, что жильцы его покидают, мы ни разу не сталкивались с персоналом. Я предположил, что по срабатывающим датчикам движения в номере. Ежедневно пополняется запас косметики в ванной – гель для душа, бальзам для волос и крем для тела – всё марки Terry Mugler. Ежедневно пополняется минибар – кока-кола, спрайт, минеральная вода, пиво. В номере тихо, соседей не слышно. Пожалуй, за все мои путешествия, это оказался самый комфортный номер, из тех что мне доставались, хотя и мебель не новая. Качество интернет-соединения на всей территории отеля включая пляж прекрасное, позволяет общаться по видеосвязи по вайберу/ватсапп.

4.	Море. Температура воздуха и воды.
Море - немаловажный пункт, ради которого мы летели и по поводу которого переживали особенно по причине водорослей. Первое что мы увидели, когда попали на пляж – трактор, который сражался с огромной полосой водорослей, которые нанесло прибоем. Это сражение продолжалось каждое утро, соответственно, водоросли побеждали. Само море вплоть до буйков, в пределах которых разрешено купаться, мутное и везде, везде, везде плавают водоросли, а иногда поля из водорослей. На пляже везде стоят таблички, где указывается что нам необходимо относиться с пониманием к природе региона и этим самым водорослям. Вы думаете, что ваш пляж будет как на картинке из рекламного проспекта? Так вот, я вас ОЧЕНЬ СИЛЬНО РАЗОЧАРУЮ. На пляже почти нет людей, просто потому что купаться в этом бульоне из водорослей неприятно и никто этого не делает. Все купаются в бассейнах отеля. Мутная вода, плывешь и тебя постоянно касаются водоросли, которые плавают на поверхности целыми полотнами. Но сам пляж прекрасен – мягчайший бело-розовый песочек, не обжигающий ноги, даже в самую лютую жару после 12 часов дня, на пляже очень чисто. Установлено множество лежаков, пустых. Допускаю, что это особенность сезона. Так уж вышло, что этот отель расположен на берегу Саргассова моря. Со стороны Карибского моря водорослей нет. По температуре воды – около 28, абсолютно комфортно. Отсюда вывод – выбирайте сезон, когда водорослей не так много. Температура воздуха днём в пределах 30-35 градусов, солнце очень жарит после 12 часов дня, очень высокая влажность, весь день там провести сложно, устаешь от зноя. Была, единственное, пара пасмурных дней числа 13-14 сентября, дул бриз. Рядом с пляжем у бассейна есть бар с напитками и алкоголем (всевозможные коктейли, вода, соки). Также от пляжа можно добрести до основного ресторана и набрать еды, фруктов и мороженого. В основном мы были у бассейна или на пляже, обычно приходили с утра с 8 и были до 12, потом я уходил на тренировку в фитнес-центр и во второй половине дня снова на пляж с 15 до 18. Купаться можно было до половины 7 вечера, солнце заходило примерно в 18:45. Бармены в баре очень доброжелательны, по поводу сервиса все на уровне, особенно есть вы иногда будете 1-2 доллара им на чай оставлять, готовят практически любые коктейли (но выбор напитков самый большой в баре у главного ресторана). Музыка в баре у пляжа днём и вечером в баре у основного ресторана насыщена местным колоритом и очень зажигательная). Особенность – как только вы выходите на пляж вы увидите цепочку местных, стоящих у кромки моря и активно зазывающих вас подойти поближе (сами они не подойдут – это запрет, исполнение которого контролирует охрана отеля). Эти ребята – местные продавцы всего чего только можно купить за деньги, экскурсий, полетов над морем на парашюте, сигар, мамахуаны и прочего. Они сходу пытаются подружиться, но цель одна – прямо сейчас или чуть позже вытянуть из вас деньги. Иногда досаждают. Просто не обращайте внимание. Также по пляжу постоянно ходят продавцы: шляп, очков, украшений из камня лоримара, сигар и мамахуаны. С ними можно и нужно торговаться, иногда получается сбить цену в 4-5 раз.
5.	Концепция - 2018.

Сейчас мне кажется бессмысленно писать о том, как там кормят, просто потому что там, как мне кажется было вообще всё что себе можно представить. Питание полноценное и всегда можно найти для себя что-то новое. По утрам можно попросить чтобы вам сделали фрэш из экзотических фруктов (выбор из фруктов очень хороший – все они свежие и спелые), вечером бывают лангусты или стейки из тунца, говядины, курицы, периодически запекают целого поросенка. При вас могут приготовить пасту, есть суши-бар, есть сыры на любой вкус. Есть несколько нормальных а-лякарт ресторанов (были в китайском и в RARE). Всегда готовится пицца очень вкусная. Питание на территории отеля осуществляется с утра до вечера. Из напитков: виски до 12 лет, отличный доминиканский ром выдержанный, текила, шампанское. Могут приготовить любые коктейли. Если хотите попробовать молоко кокосового ореха – вот за него придется заплатить 5 баксов, продают их в баре у бассейна.
Детский стол организован прилично, питание детское есть. 
Официанты невероятно расторопны, учтивы, стараются помочь, только вы присаживаетесь вам сразу наливают воду и принимают заказ на напитки. Общение на английском.

6.	Территория. То, чем себя можно в принципе занять.

В отеле очень спокойно всё в плане анимации. Можно сказать, что её нет вообще. Это не Турция.
Фитнес-клуб. На пять с плюсом, народу почти всегда нет, несколько беговых дорожек, есть все необходимые тренажёры по всем группам.
На пляже днём играют в волейбол.
Бассейн. Раз в неделю устраивают пенную вечеринку) Днём бывают уроки танцев у бассейна, а также водная аэробика на велосипедах.
Раз в неделю можно порисовать картины маслом на мастер-классе.
Территория отеля огромная, очень зелёная, много пальм.
Вечерние анимационные шоу бывают редко и они по уровню очень посредственные.

7.	Атмосфера в отеле. Гости отеля. 

Русскоязычных туристов можно не встретить вообще. Основа отдыхающих – американцы, бразильцы. В отеле довольно спокойно. Мало отдыхающих с детьми. В течение нашего отдыха было очень много различных корпоративных мероприятий разных компаний, которые устраивали там свои вечеринки, складывается такое чувство что это какой-то конгресс-отель, со стороны можно понаблюдать выступление артистов, которые приглашаются на мероприятия. 
Понадобится знание английского, на нём говорит почти весь персонал. Но есть и те, кто говорит только на испанском.
Есть некий представитель по работе с русскоязычными гостями, Виолетта, кажется. Она довольно странная, речь не поставлена, к тому же общаясь с вами она в первую очередь выясняет как часто вы путешествуете и куда ездите, как мы поняли, исключительно для того, чтобы в последующем продать вам некое членство в клубе сети отелей за 30 тыс. долларов (для понимания – эта сумма уплачивается за то, чтобы зафиксировать для вас на 10 лет вперёд ценник сети отелей по всему миру на определённом уровне, но это не депозит, при этом вы ещё уплачиваете 300 баксов за оформление членства, такое крохоборство). Толку от самой Виолетты и от этого членства мало, подозреваю что долгое проживание в таком климате порядком разжижает мозги.

8.	Экскурсии. 
По поводу этих экскурсий – такое чувство, что их продажей занимаются все подряд, потому что нам эти экскурсии попытался предложить даже парень, который занимается выдачей полотенец, я уж не говорю про продавцов экскурсий с пляжа, а также всевозможных агентов, которые ходили по отелю.
Выбор там довольно большой, но все экскурсии как правило довольно дорогие, потому что рассчитаны в основном на американцев. Есть полеты на вертолете, экстрим-парки, экскурсии в Санто-Доминго и город художников, экскурсии на остров Саона, экскурсии на водопады, плавание с дельфинами и катание на вейк-борде.
Мы были на одной экскурсии – ездили на остров Саона с остановкой в природном бассейне. Лазурная вода, морские звёзды – все очень красиво. Единственное – не так долго по времени вы находитесь на самом острове и очень много лодок в природном бассейне. 
9.	Гид по шоппингу - 2018. 

Рядом с отелем есть некий шоппинг-центр, который принадлежит этому же отелю. Выбирать там особенно не из чего, но мы тем не менее нашли что купить в местном ювелирном (там выбор изделий из золота, серебра с доминиканским лоримаром, уровень изделий высокий, но и ценник тоже). 
Также если немного пройти рядом есть супермаркет для местных с нормальными ценами на тот же ром, кофе и прочее. Там же можно купить, например, манго и сувениры.
Сигары, как ни странно, дешевле покупать в небольшом магазине «CIGAR’S» в самом отеле. 

10.	Общая оценка и выводы.
Я сразу оговорюсь, что не стану сравнивать этот отель с другими, потому что в других отелях Доминиканы не бывал, но все-таки укажу отдельные его характеристики.
Первая составляющая это, естественно, питание – здесь безусловно всё супер. 
Уровень вечерних мероприятий в отеле крайне посредственный, на этом администрация экономит. 
Фитнес-клуб – супер. Но в целом какого-то внушительного набора дополнительных развлечений в отеле нет.
Шоппинг. Выбор магазинов рядом не велик, а ведь это важно, когда можно оперативно из отеля добраться куда-то, без сложной логистики. 
Территория отеля очень большая, но как-то скучновато, схема лежак-бар-номер. 
Отель относительно не далеко расположен от аэропорта, всего 20-25 минут езды. 
На мой взгляд 25 тысяч в сутки за пользование подобным комплексом услуг с учётом мутного моря – много.

reviews.author: Lawanda H
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: Do not waste money and pay extra to stay at the reserve if you’re looking to have a good time. Having a concierge means nothing if they are not responsive. I was asked could I walk to the main lobby instead of being taken by the shuttle because it was a short distance. I paid like the rest of the guest and if I wanted to ride 20 feet that was my perogative. For people who do not speak Spanish and may not fit the colonized picture scheme staff still need to have respect for all and service their guest the same.

reviews.author: NobelMatos
reviews.title: Mucha decepción!!
reviews.text: Estuve visitando este hotel, despues de casi 3 años y la verdad es que me sorprendio lo que habia decaido el mismo vs la vez anterior que lo visite. Lo que más me llamo la atención fue el mal servicio al cliente de sus empleados durante las horas de almuerzo del buffet. Malas respuestas ante solicitudes que le hacia en buena forma y mucha lentitud para atenderme. La calidad de la comida estuvo pésima y poco variada. Todos los días era lo mismo siempre en las 3 opciones. El hotel se notaba muerto, sin ambiente, sino fue porque había un grupo grande de una empresa que siempre  se veia vacio y sin vida. Escuche muchas quejas de ese grupo en relación a las habitaciones, decian que no estaban adecuadas para su necesidades. Aparentemente no se dimensionaron bien para el tamaño del grupo. Quisiera volver algún día, pero antes averiguaré si las cosas han mejorado, porque de seguir así no vuelvo.

reviews.author: cmatostwentythree
reviews.title: Beautiful establishment...but it lacks hospitality and are in major need of staff training
reviews.text: i visited this establishment for the a wedding on the weekend of August 18, 2018. It all started when my sister and I arrived,  getting to our room was a mission.  No one could tell us where our room was, all we kept hearing was "it's over there."  No one offered to walk us since it was obvious that we have been walking around in a circle ( we also did mention it). We were not briefed on the different restaurants. We asked other questions, and no one had an answer. I overheard another guest asking what time did the pool close and the bartender pretty said you can stay as long as you want.  The pool closed at 6pm. I thought that perhaps the issue with the service was due to a language barrier, but speaking in the native language did not make a difference. On our last night, I made a reservation for my sister's birthday. We were recommended a restaurant - Brisas , because we were told that this was a seafood restaurant. When we arrived, we discovered it was a sushi and sashimi restaurant, not a seafood restaurant.  This was upsetting, and the ONLY hotel staff that made accommodations for us was Emill, a great bartender who assisted us twice. We explained the situation to other staff and they were not trying make the night better for us.  I also wanted a birthday cake for that night, went to guest services to put in the order, and they failed on that also. While in the pool, they had staff get in the pool with their uniforms to clean the pool.  I couldn't believe that they would want staff walking around in soaking wet clothes. Why not have staff wear appropriate water gear to clean the pool, instead of getting in a pool wearing a polo shirt and shorts.  This was my first resort experience and I must say I would not recommend this place to anyone.  It is unfortunate that this place is aesthetically pleasing, but it lacks tremendously in service.  I'm glad the wedding turned out beautiful, but everything else four thumbs down.  I hope this review helps others, and definitely the resort.

reviews.author: Francisco I
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Maravilloso
reviews.text:
Tremendo resort, muy buen resort
Todo bien excelente el Royal Service y nuestro conserje Alberto. Restaurantes, bares y todo el servicio entregado estuvo a la altura 100% recomendado y esperamos volver pronto

reviews.author: Nima S
reviews.title: Worse service I have ever seen for a 5 star
reviews.text:
Went there September 4th-One hour wait for check ins, my bed was wet the first night, no hot water for the shower the entire week, water wouldn’t drain in the shower, asked for towels took longer then an hour, no smiles from staff. Buffet had the same food lunch and dinner everyday all day, pizza was good. One night I went to the bar @ 2:05 needed a drink but the bartender said can’t serve you cause bar closes at 2, hospitality nightmare. 
I know this is not in their control but the ocean looked like a swap from seaweed.
Save yourself money and go to Chic Punta Cana and get the vacation of your life.

reviews.author: Arshia G
reviews.title: Would not recommend it
reviews.text:
This is place was terrible... it took us 3 hours to check into our rooms, the mattresses were dirty, fridge were never stocked and upon ordering drinks for the fridge, they would only bring max 4 beers and waters at a time.... food was terrible, the service was slow, the majority of the staff were unfriendly... the oceanfront was covered in seaweed. The only positive aspect of this hotel was the cleanliness of the lobby and pool areas. 

Amongst our group, a few people had items stollen from their room. 

Do not come here.

reviews.author: Arash
reviews.title: Terrible place ! Stay away - not a 5 star resort...
reviews.text:
The good: The grounds are nice and maintained well. The bad: everything else! 

Bad experience started with checking. We had to wait hours. Half the day was wasted. They are very unorganized and inefficient at taking people in. 

The beach is unusable. There is seaweed all over the beach and in the water. It smells disgusting, you cannot even go near the water. You could even smell it inside the resort! We went to other beaches outside of the resort and they did not have this problem.....

The rooms are dated. Some of the rooms smelled. Some were wet. Beds are terrible. Definitely not 5 star worthy. Also the bathroom and shower has glass doors so you can see others inside from the room.

The food was a joke. Same crap every day. Restaurants were even worst. Be prepared to eat garbage all week. They would not give us reservations for restaurants even though they were not busy, we walked in on a couple of them and they had many tables and seats empty, just didn't want to serve their customers! 

Service could not be any worst. The staff are all angry, rude, most don't even speak basic English. Even for a big tipper the service was just unacceptable. 

Excursions - the activities desk inside the actual resort scammed our group and refused to provide any refund. We did some excursions outside of the resort and those went well.

We also had a wedding and some group events that were ruined with poor planning, there was a corporate group that interfered with ours.  

There is construction going on in parts of the resort, including the front entrance. We could hear construction in the room at times. 

The exchange rate at the desk was ridiculous. They charged a 30% fee. What a joke!

The Casino which is a just small room with 2 tables is 100% rigged. Specially the black jack table. We caught the dealers CHEATING multiple times, which resulted in a fight and us leaving the Casino and never returning. 

Multiple people got ear infections from the poor water.

The whole place was pretty much dead and we still received poor service and quality. Don't want to imagine how much worst it is during busier times. 

Stay away this place is not worth the money they are charging. Seriously.

reviews.author: Sam B
reviews.title: Worst Experience Of A Hotel Ever
reviews.text: Worst resort experience I've ever had in my life. To start they gave me the wrong room twice they wanted me to initially sleep on a rolling bed for a week then they gave me a double room which smelled like paint after a night of sleeping in that and hours of going back and forth they gave us the royal service room. There is nothing special about that room at all couldn't order fresh juices didn't bring me liquor at night and to top it all off a lot of us got sick from the late night hamburgers that we ordered I guess they left it out all day and fed it to us. Apart from that they only had one buffet which was the same food over and over and the quality was far from decent and all the restraints were booked and the food wasn't even good when you got there. The service was horrible they just look at you and smile and not even ask what the problem is or try to help they just want more money from you and walk away. if you want a cab to go somewhere Make sure not to use them they will charge you 10 times the price that it actually cost overalll there is nothing positive that I can say about this resort except it looks nice but that docent cut it for a quick summary for you guys. FOOOD BAD SERVICE BAD DRINKS BAD SCAMMERS ALOT OF wouldn't reccomend people to go here save yourself the time and look for anotherr resort in Dominican. only thing that made it bearable was the 100 friends that came out for the wedding the rest was garbage.

reviews.author: Gabrielle D
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text: I had the privilege of staying on the Royal side of the resort and it was amazing. My Butler Argenis was very professional, prompt, and very knowledgeable about the resort. He helped me whenever I needed help and never had a problem doing so. The food was great, and the atmosphere was even better. Do look at the reviews book your stay and upgrade to royal. The rooms are spacious and you have private amenities!

reviews.author: Lyman B
reviews.title: Best vacation ever😎
reviews.text: I must say I can’t say enough good things about this resort. Everybody is very helpful and friendly and the place is clean and in tiptop shape. All of the activities they have were very fun as well as visiting different restaurants. One of my favorite and most memorable activities was the zip line and Polaris to the ocean where the Atlantic and Caribbean meet.  I highly recommend this resort for anybody looking for an incredible getaway vacation this all inclusive will make you feel like royalty. I had the pleasure of meeting Kerlyn who is in charge of guest services he’s a great guy. I also had the pleasure of meeting Annabel who is very nice and had the privilege of meeting their great manager Janet . Again there’s not enough kind words I can say about this lovely resort and staff everybody is so friendly and the place is top-notch from start to finish. Book your trip now it’s something you won’t regret one thing I should let you know is  the seaweed season is from May to November so if you want prettier beaches go when it’s not seaweed season. make sure you stay at this lovely resort you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Frank J
reviews.title: Paradisus palma real crap
reviews.text:
Arrived on Sept 6. Waited an hour for check in, and got to room was a mess waited another 2 hours for them to clean the room. Went to restaurants waited an hour just to be served. The service was horrible in the buffet looked like they didn't even want to be there. One chef was always angry with guest. The beach was never cleaned of the sea weed on it, yet all the resorts we cleaned. Not enough staff to cater to everyone. Yet one bartender "Fernando" and always had a smile on his face and took care of all 95 of us. We thank you Fernando at the walk up pool bar.

I would never come to this resort ever again.

reviews.author: anushabala
reviews.title: Fantastic First All Inclusive Experience
reviews.text: First all-inclusive trip and my experience was wonderful.  Staff at the resort was amazing, I can’t say enough about how wonderful they truly are; friendly, attentive and accommodating.  Food was delicious, fresh, flavorful and as a lacto-vegetarian I had tons of options.  Moreover, resort was clean and well kept.  Would highly recommend the resort.  Best part, they served real Nutella 😉

reviews.author: Whitney D
reviews.title: My bartenders where Freakin Amazing
reviews.text: From the time I touched the resort my hands were never empty! Found 3 great bartenders Lillian, Luis, Jacinto bomb.com. Thanks for being great, all I can say is mamajuana gets you to the next level of being drunk.... you won’t reme how you got to your room lol.

reviews.author: Vladily H
reviews.title: Hermoso lugar
reviews.text: Definitivamente es un lugar esta muy elegante las personas son súper simpáticas , muestran mucha empatía con sus clientes  , me encanta de verda muy buena atención y servicio Raynol Tamayo es una de las personas que hizo que nuestra estadía fuera una maravilla gracias gracias a los chicos de bares súper atento la comida muy buena sin duda regreso a este hermoso lugar🌴

reviews.author: Géneh H
reviews.title: Magnífico lugar
reviews.text: El hotel es muy bonito las personas son muy amable este es mi primeras vacaciones en este lugar y pensamos venir, la playa no está la mejor pero se entiende por el clima pero es un lugar agradable la comida es muy buena nuestro restaurante favorito es el grill por el tipo de langosta y churrasco muy bueno, el personal de actividades, barrender son súper incluyendo los demás gracias Raynol Tamayo por ser amable y brindaron alegria y buena estancia gracias Oscar Santana y francisco mateo, antinio j Rodríguez son muy amables gracias chicos nos vemos el próximo año

reviews.author: Jodi P
reviews.title: Beautiful, epitome of hospitality!
reviews.text:
The property is very well kept and very beautiful.  The staff is amazing - very professional, courteous, and service minded.
A previous review mentioned the rooms are "like a box of chocolates, you never know what you're going to get" - and I think that is the most accurate description possible. They are in various stages of remodels, so although the same layout exists in each room, you might have slightly different furnishings or a small maintenance issue.  Regardless, any issue you face will quickly be rectified by the EXTREMELY friendly and courteous staff!  We had a few minor issues that were all immediately taken care of.  
The maid service was great, turndown service was great - but little touches were different with the different staff members each day.
We had a very large group that was well taken care of by Alain and Suleyka and many others.  Luis, Nixon, Emely and many more were wonderful!
The only slightly disappointing facet of our stay was the food.  It was average fare for an all-inclusive, and the dining hours were off - no snack bar, coffee bar or anything like that to grab a quick bite during hours the buffet was closed.  There was always at least one restaurant open, but sometimes you just need a pastry and coffee, or a bag of chips!
Overall, it was a great experience.

reviews.author: cece
reviews.title: Professional Relaxation at Paradisus
reviews.text: First I want to say the resort is beautiful and if you have the Royal Service, you are truly treated like royalty. My personal butler Carlos Hinostroza was amazing, he made sure that all our accommodations and expections were met day and night, from breakfast to dinner reservations, transportation off the resort, pool service and even to check out. Carlos truly made my vacation memorable and beyond my expectations!!!’

reviews.author: Chantalsdolls
reviews.title: Paradise at the RESERVE  in Paradisus-Melia
reviews.text:
WOW!!!!!! Incredible VACATION!!!!! Luxury at it's finest!!!! 
We spent the best week of our lives here!!!! And it has absolutely gone too fast! 
We have had the most beautiful, fun, and relaxing experience ever with FIRST CLASS IMENITIES!!! However, what has made this vacation even more perfect was of course being with our best friends...and the people who have made it so perfect including Manuel Torres, in Aqua and in Mizu, treating us like royalty every single visit to his restaurants, and Eudy at the bar along with Anabelis, Friman, and Yerry. All were so courteous and professional and always smiling and so perfect!!! Thank you all for a wonderful and unforgettable memory!!!  Also, Manual Santana that drove us on the golf cart was awesome and so were Orlando and Heddi in the Reserve downstairs at our room. We had the absolute time of our lives!!!!!!

reviews.author: Passport166451
reviews.title: Personal de animación y de la piscina de Royal service excelente
reviews.text:
Estuve Alojada con 4 amigas y el personal que nos atendía en el bar de la piscina del Royal service fue excelente. Un trato super amable, alegres y siempre pendientes de lo que necesitábamos. Muchas gracias a Luisito y Pedrito!! 
El personal de animación del hotel, super divertido. Gracias a los chicos que nos hicieron bailar en las noches!! El jefe de este servicio super amable y los otros chicos también!

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: The Cat in the Hat
reviews.text: The front desk staff were professional to a degree. Some were very pushy and didn't seem to understand that folks would split their room bill and spa services. There was a mildew smell on alot of the pillows in the rooms on the couches and on the bed. Emil in the bar between Rare and the Hibatchi restaurant had a great personality and was an excellent bartender. Davidson was a great waiter and was very attentive during my breakfast at the buffet spot. It took a long while for someone to address one of my friends issue with her room due to the moldy/sewage smell that hit you once you hit the door. There was a random cat that walked the halls of the facility while I was there. Aqua restaurant was awesome.

reviews.author: Felicia C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real w/butler Juan Carlos
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my stay here. I was here with a large travel group. The staff was fairly attentive. The property is gorgeous. 

Food was really good at Rare and Olio. Speaking of Rare, I want to give our server Abraham a shout out. He was very accommodating. Although I had Royal Service, I’d say skip Palazzo. The buffet was better. Sorry. It was. Jean Carlos was an excellent server. The other place to skip is Mizu. Not much of a show. Food was okay. If you’ve been to any basic Japanese hibachi type restaurant in the US you get a show. Stick with that. And the good stuff didn’t come back out to the buffet until the group left. 

Yes, there was the seaweed on the beach issue. I didn’t spend a lot of time there anyway. However, this resort wasn’t slick! They didn’t clean up the beach until after our group left. Not cool. Not everyone left on Monday please understand that.

Had a blast at the swim up bar. Gustavo, Lee, Mario and Jonathan took really good care of us each day. 

Last and certainly not least my butler Juan Carlos! Mi persona favorita en Palmas Real. He took really good care of me. He was prompt in responding to any question, concern or request. Even watching him interact with others in my travel group he was patient and was happy to help.  I enjoyed the treats he left on my room. Whatever I needed he handled it from cabana bed to restaurant reservations to drawing brand to lavender scented pillows. Also, Juan Carlos took the time to check in with me not just through What’s App but made a point to talk with me face to face. I read lots of good things about him in trip advisor and was excited to find out he would be my butler. All of it is true. Juan Carlos knows how to do his job well.

reviews.author: msm19812018
reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Beautiful property. My only issue is I expected top shelf liquor to be available for royal service members at all bars all restaurants to be open everyday but they were at least four closedExcellent butler service from  Alberto Vargas & Carlos Hinostroza

reviews.author: javierdejv
reviews.title: Fantastica experiencia
reviews.text:
Fantastico hotel, buenas instalaciones, un entorno natural cuidado y muy bonito y un personal super amable y profesional.
La habitacion era grande, con espacios separados, jacuzzi y terraza. La ducha es lo unico mejorable.
La comida del buffet y los restaurantes muy rica. Mejorable el servicio en alguno de ellos y la flexibilidad de horarios al reservar.
Las pisicnas, la zona de playas, el Kids zone (y sus actividades), las actividades de adultos y el gimnasio realmente bien.

reviews.author: janella s
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostroza was my Butler and he was excellent. Greeted us when we arrived and checked on us everyday. He made reservations everyday and booked our cabana with fruits was a special touch. So glad we used him

reviews.author: ceciaco1981
reviews.title: Para meditar y descansar bueno...para divertirse con amigos no es el lugar
reviews.text: El concepto del hotel se orienta a un sector de invitados que solo quieren silencio y descanso. Para grupo de parejas de amigos sin hijos no tiene mucho que ofrecer. Por lo tanto no encontré completamente lo que buscaba

reviews.author: TravelingDiva044
reviews.title: 1st Time @ Paradisus
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus was nice and it was a beautiful resort. I had the room with the butler service and butler Carlos was da bomb. What i didnt like was the food selections and no food service pool side is the reason I gave it 4 stars. The resturant that has the steakhouse (Rare) and Japanese with the bar in the middle was the best place to drinks from. Emil and Emmanuel was wonderful wwith their personalities and mixing drinks the way I like it. Most of the other drinks taste like cough syrup.😂🤣😎 Overall, nice resturant but they need to work on the food selection and offer food pool side.

reviews.author: Jamie G
reviews.title: Professional Relaxation Punta Cana 2018
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostroza was an awesome butler at the resort where we stayed, Paradisus Palma Real.  He was very helpful with anything that we needed.  He provided us with a number to contact him directly.  He left us nightly goodies such as wine and other things.  On our last night, he prepared the hot tub with flower petals and bubbles.  Great experience.  The only issue was that the ATM was not operable most of the time.  We needed more cash to tip the helpful staff.

reviews.author: Ashjo45
reviews.title: Friendly Service
reviews.text: I visited he Paradisus Palma Resort and I think the best thing about the service is the staff.  Nixon, Felix, and Daniel in particular were very friendly and accommodating.  I really appreciate it. It made my trip even more enjoyable! Thank you!

reviews.author: Missshay16
reviews.title: Review of Stay
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostrosa has been most helpful during my stay! He has checked with me daily to ensure I am enjoying my stay and to see if there’s anything that I needed. He helped me book dinner reservations and poolside beds. I have truly enjoyed Carlos during my stay. He has helped make this a wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: dtg713
reviews.title: Nixon-Pool Entertainment
reviews.text: Vacation with friends. Resort was beautiful. Nixon was great. He was always there to get people involved for the entertainment around the pool and during the evening. Had a lot of laughs. Enjoyed my vacation.

reviews.author: Daydream565908
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text:
Estuvimos alojadas en el Royal Service
Las habitaciones lindas, cómodas y bien ubicadas.
El grupo de animación de primera, felicitaciones Luis Bautista y staff nos hicieron pasar unas divertidas noches.
La atención en la playa y piscina de primera, nuestro agradecimiento a Luis y Pedro que siempre estuvieron atentos para que disfrutáramos nuestras vacaciones a pesar de las algas en el mar.

reviews.author: Greg K
reviews.title: Royal Service - Alvaro
reviews.text: Had a great time this last week at this resort.  Definitely recommend Royal Service, ask for Alvaro as your butler.  He made our stay so relaxing and handled anything we needed during our stay.  Terrific service throughout the resort.  Our rooms were upgraded without us even asking.  Gerinaldo and Martin at the Royal Service pool were outstanding.  Definitely recommend this resort, do the Royal Service and make sure to ask for Alvaro as your butler!

reviews.author: cristina q
reviews.title: Deli experiencia !
reviews.text: El área  de entretenimiento estuvo súper ! Los chicos lindisimos y súper amables, sobre todo el jefe de ellos que no recuerdo su nombre  !En el bar del área del royal service el señor Raül es espectacular!!!! Nos trató a todas cómo reynas !Y luis ni que decir ! Se encargó de acomodarnos las poltronas y estar pendientes de que nunca nos falte nada !!!!En líneas generales todo súper bien , tuvimos mala suerte con el mayordomo que nos tocó , no fue muy proactivo ni atento , a comparación de otros chicos que veíamos x ahí .

reviews.author: cs1019
reviews.title: Awesome vacation - Royal service is wonderful - Best Butler Francis Newton
reviews.text:
My best friend and I visited the resort for a week in June.  From the moment we arrived until we left - we were taken care of.   Our butler , Francis Newton was amazing.  He took care of everything for us from reservations to snacks for when we arrived back from the beach to helping me look for my phone when I lost it.   When you go ask for Francis - you will not be disappointed.   Francis goes the extra mile for his guests.  He made our stay incredible.  Our vacation would not be the same without him - he was the

The grounds of the hotel are beautiful.  Yes there was some seafood but that’s Mother Nature.  

Everyone has a smile - I didn’t have one bad experience at the hotel.  We did stay on the royal service side and it’s definitely worth the extra money.  From reservations to excursions - everything was taken care of for us. 

We definitely plan to return next year

reviews.author: Jesus Maria P
reviews.title: Vacaciones en el paraíso
reviews.text: El hotel es una maravilla destaco el trato humano de sus trabajadores aunque debo destacar a una persona por su amabilidad y atención GRACIAS Bryan Aracena un abrazo espero que tus jefes sepan valorar tu explendido trabajo.

reviews.author: Rita-Ciana P
reviews.title: WOW Vacay!! Amazing Concierge/Butler Service by Wily!!
reviews.text:
First of all, I generally do NOT write reviews. But I would be remiss not to share the absolutely terrific service rendered by the Paradisus Palma Real Resort - The Reserve. Beginning from check-in with Christopher personally showing me my oceanfront room and asking if I was pleased or wanted to change as part of The Reserve Exclusive, to the intro to my personal concierge - Wily (yeehaww :-)).  

From this point forward, Wily was amazing in handling ALL my requests daily, even anticipating some before informing him, e.g. reservations at restaurants in advance,  daily Gabi Beach cabana reservations along w/cold bottles of wine and snacks ready on deck (my man!).  To reservations for massages at YHI Spa making sure I had the same masseuse. 

He magically was ALWAYS in view of me, checking to ensure my stay was going as I expected.  He would say "I'm here for you, anytime you need me just contact me day/night...no worries" with a warm smile might I add. I could go on and on about Wily's service and dedication to follow through details.  He was exceptional at making my stay at The Reserve unforgettable!!

reviews.author: pupo8127
reviews.title: vacation 2018
reviews.text: good experience and very funny. always the staff very affable and  friendly you feel like family .we all could enjoy the a la carte restaurants and taste an excellent cuisine .the hotel also has many good excursions.only nuisance was not  being able to enjoy the beach .we did not recognizing the effort of the workers of the pool area ,very good.oh and the other thing that we are not comfortable is the closing time of the pool.

reviews.author: Megan J
reviews.title: Enjoyed Paradise at Paradisus!
reviews.text: My stay with Paradisus was very enjoyable thanks to Jose (front desk) and Antonio (customer service). Both gentleman bent over backyards to make sure our stay was top of the line, and it was! It did not start off that way though... To our surprise, getting reservations at each of the restaurants quickly became a task that we were not successful at completing. Everything was booked! There was a slight language barrier with the support team taking reservations and my friends and I were left without a place to eat our first night (thankful for room service). With the help of Jose and Antonio, we were set for the remainder of our stay with reservations for dinner every night. I HIGHLY recommend Aqua restaurant! By far the best menu on the resort! The rooms were very nice and clean. Make sure you reserve a room within walking distance to the pool and beach. The resort is huge! We loved our garden view with only a 3-4 minute walk to the beach. Overall, a very good experience. The first night was the only reason I did not give 5 stars.

reviews.author: fatirodriguezin
reviews.title: Mis mejores vacaciones!!!
reviews.text: Un hotel muy grande un servicio sensacional. Trabajadores muy amables y considerados con todo, encantadores. Mis mejores vacaciones en muchísimo tiempo. La comida estupenda, las habitaciones grandes y cómodas y por supuesto una animacio muy buena, en especial José capuchino un chico excepcional,amable y muy dedicado a su trabajo. Gracias por hacernos pasar unos días inolvidable. El año que viene vuelvo seguro.

reviews.author: gonru
reviews.title: Todo perfecto
reviews.text:
Nada más  llegar lo que más  impresiona son los jardines y lo bien cuidados que estan. Las habitaciones muy amplias ,teniamos un conserje  en nuestro bloque , que estuvo en todo momento atento a todas nuestras necesidades y nos hizo nuestra estancia maravillosa.gracias Braian Aracen por ser tan profesional y hacernos  en este hotel tan maravilloso ,unas vacaciones inolvidables.
Reserve paradisus punta cana un hotel muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Christy T
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Absolutely  loved the resort! Great food, great  entertainment. The host Melvin took amazing care of us got all our  reservation! Miguel is  a great bartender. Raphyel from activities was a great guy. He is so up beat and gets the crowd up and moving. Want to bring my whole family back!! Highly recommend this resort to anyone!!

reviews.author: Cary G
reviews.title: Paradises Palma Real resort, Punta Cana, DR
reviews.text: Very poor resort.    Poor service, terrible rooms, mediocre food.  Room infested with mosquitoes, took three days to get a wash cloth.  Closet space practically nonexistent.   Water is not drinkable.    I have a long list of problems with this place.   Not recommended.

reviews.author: s g
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: Our stay July 21-28 with friends. We have stayed at Paradisis Punta Cana Resort 9 times and decided to try Palma Real. Place was beautiful, weather was great. Everyone we came in contact with were all awesome but unfortunately we didn’t get cards from all but a few of our standout employees are Delvin (Naos) for breakfast , Lilian Aquino (aka Dimples ) in lobby bar, Abraham at Rare steakhouse, Boni Ramos on the beach ,Lee  and Geiorgie at Pool bar. Such awesome personalities! Restaurants were great, Rare was one of our favorites and we ate there 2X. Naos was great for breakfast and dinner. Beach grill was good at lunch time. No complaints, because what could anyone find to complain about while vacationing in Paradise !!! Will be back.

reviews.author: Sandra M
reviews.title: Servicio extraordinario, lugar increible
reviews.text: La playa increíble, siempre Suli con alguna actividad. Las habitaciones excelentes y con todas las comodidades. En los restaurantes la comida excelente y el personal muy atento y siempre listo para ayudar. Comimos delicioso! El chef ejecutivo siempre alerta y servicial viendo cada detalle, en el bar Hermes y Oneida super!!

reviews.author: Jeremy R
reviews.title: Great Customer Service.
reviews.text: While we were lounging eating breakfast, Michael Reyes  accommodated his services to us by making sure we were satisfied with our food and experience. ontop of Mr.Reyes’s wonderful work, the entire staff does a great and making everyone feel happy and comfortable, I will recommend the place to everyone and will be coming back to this place very soon.

reviews.author: golfdolph
reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: great place only issue was charged incorrect price and NO attempt was made to contact me to correct problem during stay...not informed until checkout. It seems funny that when they want to sell you something you can be found. HUM?

reviews.author: shammo93
reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: The resort was amazing. The food was phenomenal. It was great being on the adult only side. We did not have to hear screaming children. The butler service was amazing as well. They were very kind and set up all of our dinner reservations for us.

reviews.author: Warren I
reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: I was recently in attendance as part of a 50 person wedding group at this resort.  The overall experience was wonderful and we had great service throughout our groups stay.  From the front desk staff of Emely, Jose, Marcos and Marcos taking care of our guests at check in to the MOD Emmanuel helping trouble shoot the few issues we had and making sure our guests were satisfied; to amazing bar service from Lillian at the Lobby Bar; To the great bellman/porter service from Pedro and Omar; everything at check in and in the lobby was great.  Then we had the best time with Luis at the Pool Bar.  He was amazing and took great care of our group every day.  Then we had great service in the restaurants, buffet, and at the wedding reception from Ronald, Victor, Nixon, Davidson, and others that I can't remember.  Finally, the best praise goes to Pamela/Catherine in the Wedding Office who was totally amazing and took great care of our group from start to finish. She was awesome and made the experience wonderful for everyone!  I definitely recommend this resort for others praise the staff for their great customer service.

reviews.author: Annmarie E
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Just wanted to share about the great service we received from the staff at this resort. Everyone is always so friendly and willing to meet your every need. We truly appreciate our concierge, Jose Salvador, Juan Tiren, our pool waiter, and Manuel, our waiter at The Gabi Club. They made us feel special and very welcomed. Thank you for making our stay even better for us.

reviews.author: far113
reviews.title: Friends Trip
reviews.text:
Made reservations for the big restaurants, we were a group of 17.
Disappointed that we could not sit at one table, we had to divide up our party
Pool staff friendly, enjoyed the pool activities, towels were adequate also.

reviews.author: presserg
reviews.title: I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS HOTEL IF YOU WANT AN ALL INCLUSIVE  ADULT ONLY & IF YOU ARE A FOODIE!
reviews.text:
I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS HOTEL IF YOU WANT AN ALL INCLUSIVE  ADULT ONLY & IF YOU ARE A FOODIE  We were informed of events going on in the hotel,we were also not informed that we had several options for 
1 free dinner or excursion he only told us about the Michelin dinner & finally he cared more about the Coco Bongo rep then us!

reviews.author: 321denise
reviews.title: Lugar lindo
reviews.text: O Hotel e belíssimo, os quartos muito grandes, no banheiro o vaso e o chuveiro ficam separado da pia e da banheira . O café da manhã e bem farto, temos a Marta que serve o café e o leite que é muito simpático com todos desde as crianças até aos mais velhos 👏👏. O almoço é uma delícia,no jantar pode escolher os restaurantes (marca no dia que chegar, se não você não consegue ir em todos). Tem aula de dança e hidroginástica e yoga na praia todo manhã. A noite as 21:00 tem show belíssimos no teatro. Ia me esquecendo as camareira também é uma simpatia

reviews.author: Kathy V
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: Great vacation and definitely recommend upgrading to Royal Service. Luis at the Royal Service pool did a great job entertaining us and keeping our drinks fresh. He was such a sweetheart and was awesome.  Bladimir, our butler, also took great care of us.  He met all our needs and was always quick and responsive. He made all our reservations and we were never disappointed.  These two men made all the difference for a great vacation experience.

reviews.author: iraima62
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel pero...
reviews.text: Excelente ambientación pero deben mejorar en las actividades nocturnas. Es un hotel alejado y a pie no hay nada por lo que asistir a un shows dentro debe ser una opción pero no lo hay. La gente se conforma con estar en los bares o cenando. Debe haber algo más que eso.

reviews.author: Carolina F
reviews.title: Sushi making class
reviews.text: Nixon and Yeimi were excellent and had a very entertaining class. Lots of different sushi  rolls were made and all students were engaged and taken into consideration. Would definitely come again!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: rafaelasetenta
reviews.title: Pós atendimento péssimo
reviews.text: O hotel tem uma estrutura boa. A área externa é ótima. A comida do buffet deixa a desejar, mas os restaurantes são bons, especialmente o Rare e o Mizu. Éramos um grupo bem grande, aproximadamente 30 pessoas, era casamento de uma de nós. Então, a farra foi boa, mas seria em qualquer lugar. Não voltaria a esse Hotel com grupo pequeno ou só casal. Até porque a praia não é maravilhosa (maravilhoso foi o atendimento do garçom da praia: Fernando Gonzalez). Vale a pena se for uma turma bem grande! O PIOR DE TUDO: infelizmente, FUI FURTADA DENTRO DO MEU QUARTO. Fiz a bobagem de não usar o cofre. Deixei minha carteira dentro da mala trancada todos os dias, não peguei pra nada, até porque você não precisa usar dinheiro no Hotel e nós não saímos. Porém, esqueci a mala aberta um dia. Quando me dei conta fui verificar na carteira e faltavam 100 dólares (verifiquei que também faltava meu cartão de crédito, mas já estava no aeroporto). Então, fiz a reclamação lá mesmo, no Hotel, preenchi um formulário e assinei. Disseram que fariam uma investigação e me dariam um retorno por e-mail, porque isso aconteceu na véspera do meu retorno. Perguntaram se eu queria acionar a Polícia, mas eu disse que não seria necessário (me arrependi). Sei que o Hotel só se responsabiliza pelo que é deixado no cofre, por isso não esperei em momento algum que me devolvessem o dinheiro. Apenas esperava uma postura mais decente do hotel. ACREDITEM, 8 dias depois do meu retorno, não tinha resposta do hotel. Então, enviei um e-mail copiando todos os e-mails do Melia que encontrei na internet. Aí sim, já perto de meia noite, responderam o e-mail dizendo que entendiam o meu "sentir", mas que depois das investigações que realizaram, NÃO IDENTIFICARAM O ACESSO DE NINGUÉM NO MEU QUARTO (BASICAMENTE INSINUARAM QUE EU ESTAVA MENTINDO). A diária do hotel custa 500 dólares, ficamos lá 4 noites. Realmente, não faz muito sentido eu inventar que me roubaram 100 dólares... Enfim, numa situação dessa, o que esperamos de um hotel dessa categoria é uma postura decente, profissional. Um pedido de desculpas pelo inconveniente, para se dizer o mínimo. Não recomendo.

reviews.author: CataAtenas
reviews.title: Maravillosa estadia
reviews.text:
El hotel es maravilloso... Leí buenas recomendaciones por acá y realmente es todo o más de lo que ofrece... La gente es muy amable y siempre está atenta a ayudarte en todo lo que necesites...
Quisiera destacar especialmente a Henyi Núñez del bar de la piscina de Gaby Club... Prepara los mejores tragos y cócteles que he probado en mi vida!! Además fue muy simpático y amable, contándonos detalles de R. Dominicana y siempre atendiendo con una sonrisa y con alguna sorpresa en sus preparaciones.
Por otra parte, el gran servicio de Miguel de la Rosa y Luis Peña del Hydro Grill... Siempre atentos, amables y dando la mejor de las sonrisas (y una buena comida también)
Los jardines son maravillosos, y todos los restaurantes tienen muy buena comida (destaco el The Grill por sobre todos!!, más aún si les gusta la carne).. Quizás me hubiera gustado que los postres tuvieran como ingrediente principal frutas típicas de R. Dominicana.... A veces las opciones se repetían mucho. 
Lo único malo, es que habían muchas algas (sargazo) pero eso fue por la época... Sin embargo debo decir que recorrí la playa de otros hoteles cercanos y la del Reserve era la que estaba mejor cuidada... Fui testigo que todas las noches limpiaban y sacaban las algas. 
Por último, las habitaciones eran de ensueño... Comodisimas y con todo lo necesario para un buen descanso... 
Si quiere relajarse, descansar y disfrutar este sin duda es el lugar... Sin duda volveré!!

reviews.author: Vince G
reviews.title: Second Time Around is a Charm!
reviews.text:
My wife and daughter and I just returned from the Paradisus Palma Real.  We stayed from 6/25-7/1.  WE were there with a group of11 in total.  No easy feat to make sure all had a wonderful and memorable experience.  This was our second trip to this fantastic property.  We have been to many all-inclusives but have only stayed at the same one twice, this was one of them and the sequel did not disappoint!  Well before our arrival we were in contact with one of the Concierge's named Vladimir Stalin Rodriquez Cruz.  His name may be long but Vlad is also very long on talents.  He was able to coordinate the rooms in advance (not common) so that we were all in the same building (not easy nor common).  This was an even bigger challenge as my wife was only weeks off knee surgery.  Vlad secured a wheel chair, upgraded room and a first floor room closest to the front for us.  In addition, and this is HUGE, Vladimir made reservations for our entire group for each night at all the restaurants I had asked for at the times I requested before we ever even landed!  Big time!  No need to fight the reservations line and availability.  He checked in on us all along the way and couldn't have been nicer.  

We were in room 1201 orginally which was a great first floor room but he was able to get us moved to 1003 which was right by the pool and restuarants on the first floor.  Loved that room!  

The activities were all very enjoyable and great.  The entertainment staff couldn't have been nicer and more entertaining.  Nixon and Reynaldo were both so pleasant, enjoyable and frankly fantastic dancers and entertainers.  The others from the pool staff (Santo worked so hard) and the bartenders were all incredible.  Got you what you wanted, when you wanted it!  Great service overall.  

Loved the Dominican night dancers but the "King of Pop" Michael Jackson show was a show stopper!  Lion Ling was good as well and the Circle Dance show at Gabi Beach was a blast!  

Now about the food...  Great choices all around.  Our very favorite above all was Aqua.  Located in the reserve but open to all was amazing.  With a group of 11 we had mostly everything on the menu and not a single meal we wouldn't call fantastic!   Feugo (Peruvian) was also fantastic.  Olio (Italian) also had an apptizer br that was more than meal worthy before we even ordered.  Delicious!  Rare steakhouse was spot on with all their entrees and Bana the hibachi was an absolute blast!  It was by far the most food (and delicious) of any hibachi I've every eaten at.  (you know how you always thing their won't be enough?)  NOT!  Even the buffet (which you could visit late into the evening for an extra snack or late night appetite quencher) offered plenty of choices.  Eggs cooked to order, Fish cooked fresh, meats, tons of breakfast items, great lunch selections all offered.  

The lobby bar and the Feugo bar definitely had the best drinks but EVERY bar used top shelf liquor so no complaints there.  The grounds were maintained very well and the sand on the beach was pure white.  The pool had activities every day and music going.  One side was more relaxed and the other (the swim up bar side) was a bit moreengaged and fun.  Plenty of pool chairs but you need to be up beofre 7am to get your favorite spots.  The court yard area lit up in purple every evening had music going a few nights as well and was a great place to just hang out and enjoy your vacation time.  Gabi beach was the perfect gathering place for a drink in a very comfortable environment while looking at the beach and ocean.  Perfect!

There was even a shopping mall with many great stores just a short golf cart ride away!

Our only complaint was that the beach down by the water had a significant amount of seaweed.  Obviously it wasn'rt the Resorts fault.  They did however work very hard to clean it up as much as possible every single morning.

All in all it was a great and memorable trip had by all.  The second time around was as good if not better than the first trip.  Who knows, maybe a trifecta may be in order.  :-)

reviews.author: LauCBSAS
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text: Mi estadía en el hotel fue excelente, tanto por el servicio como por las instalaciones, gastronomía y cordialidad. Quiero resaltar especialmente la atención de la señora Sandra Cedeño, que con enorme profesionalismo se ocupó de brindarme un servicio de alta gama. Espero volver pronto a disfrutar del hotel y su gente.

reviews.author: sissy516
reviews.title: Servicio malo
reviews.text: Estuve 4 dias en este hotel durante un congreso. Fue una experiencia decepcionante, habia estado hospedado ahí hace años y me habia encantado, estaba feliz por volver al hotel paradissus palma real. Esta vez fue horrible, parece que cambiaron la administración del hotel, el servicio de restaurant pésimo, la comida mala, el persona poco amistoso, parecen siempre estar cansados y agobiados por tanto trabajo, siempre estaban discutiendo entre ellos y quejándose aun delante de los huéspedes. Me sorprende leer tan buenos comentarios de este hotel donde le dan 5 estrellas, en mi opinión no volvería a hospedarme en ese hotel, su precio es muy elevado para el servicio que ofrecen. Lo único que puedo resaltar como bueno es el club de niños y el restaurant aqua.  Una advertencia cuando se hospeden ahí, cuiden sus pertenencias y guardarlas en la caja de seguridad de la habitación .

reviews.author: jessiquitavasquez
reviews.title: LADRONES POR DOQUIER
reviews.text: Se celebro alla el congreso dominicano de oftalmología en diferentes habitaciones de mis colegas se realizaron robos por parte de el personal ya que las puertas no eran ni siquiera violentadas. Robaron dinero, celulares y otras cosas. Lo mejor del caso es que el hotel hace caso omiso a las denuncias y no se hacen responsables.

reviews.author: PHILB999-UK
reviews.title: Guest & Royal Services
reviews.text: If I was writing this review purely on the level of Customer Service engagement I experienced from Stephanie Bellido in Guest services then it would be a 5 star Excellent rating as all my dealings with Stephanie demonstrated she had a passion for delivering a memorable Customer service experience. She was diligent, efficient & well organised always with a cheerful disposition - thank you Stephanie!! Overall all other staff at the Resort were courteous, attentive, always seeking to deliver a positive experience & our Butler Bladimir was definitely in this category. e.g. Bladimir setup a romantic bath with wine, and chocolates for an anniversary & my friends Birthday. My friends (who had been to the resort twice before 10 years ago) & I felt that given the Cost of Royal Service the 'sparkle' that was anticipated was missing e.g. bookings at the restaurants were not always properly recorded & the rooms although nice need a refresh to deliver that luxurious 5 star feel. I know my Butler had arranged for our Bags to be collected from our Room on departure at a specific time but no one turned up & I was left chasing down a porter to ensure i got to my Taxi to the airport on time! So a Very Good experience with the small shortcomings to be overcome for an excellent rating.

reviews.author: fnmnltchr1
reviews.title: Sandra Cedeno from Circle Melia is the BEST
reviews.text: We received tip top service from our concierge from the moment we set foot upon the property. We connected via WhatsApp in order to remain in consistent communication throughout our trip. From making dinner reservations yo booking excursions to securing a premium spot on the beach, she took care of EVERYTHING! She even surprised my daughter with cake, balloons and champagne for her birthday. Service was impeccable. The resort is clean and beautiful. There's plenty of room on the beach. The drinks can be a little stronger. The good at The Grill restaurant was the best on the resort. Music and entertainment is available every night including fun activities for kids and teens. I would definitely return!

reviews.author: Margie C
reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: Much need renovations under way as resort is outdated. Rooms are nice though. Construction next to room. Moved me...construction again. My relaxing vacation turned into No sleeping in. One buffet restaurant equals all inclusive. No snack bars or even fruit bowls. All other restaurants closed. Front desk could care less if you have a problem. They are all about fees. Ie: Room service is all inclusive. Only 10 minutes after you order, they call you and tell there is a service charge if you want your food you pay. Late check out? $20 per hour.

reviews.author: KaryGIl
reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text:
My best friend and I visited Paradisus Palma Real for June 7th to June 10th. I had stayed at Paradisus back in 2006 and 2006 and had fallen in love with the place. I was very excited to visit again after 11 years. Grounds are still breathtakingly beautiful, customer service is as wonderful as I remember it to be. However,  food quality has definitely changed, I usually don't expect much from buffets, but back in 2006 and 2007 the food at Naos buffet was pretty good, now it was just bad, especially for breakfast, lunch was a little better, but still disappointing. Olio was simply horrible,  the only decent thing I ate there was the tiramisu,  other than that food was simply not good.
I did enjoy Bana, and is still as delicious as it was 11 years ago. We also had dinner at Palazzo and we lived it, food was really good. 
One night after having a wonderful time at the Red Lounge, my friend and I were hungry and Rare steakhouse was still open way after midnight,  we had burgers and were very tasty.

I highly recommend stopping by Red Lounge,  even if it's not full, trust me,  Teudy and Nurys who are the bartenders will make your night fun, they were so much to hang out with them, wonderful nice people and excellent bartenders, ask Teudy to make you a mini beer, that shot was soo delicious. I gotta say it was actually kinda sad to say bye to this two and cannot wait to see them again in October.
If you have the opportunity to meet Jesus, the waiter at the beach, you will also have a wonderful time. He was so nice,  and always making sure we had a drink in our hands even before asking. He would even set up our towels in our chairs every morning. He was wonderful,  very nice guy, eager to make our day simply wonderful.

Although food quality has changed over the years, I will be going back to this wonderful place, and I just hope they work on their food.
Like I said, staff is wonderful, from the housekeepers to front desk, all very nice,  helpful people.
Thanks for the wonderful stay!

reviews.author: Jennifer D
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: Our experience at Paradisus was amazing. The staff of Argenis, Nixon, Delvis holguin( Chicken Legs) and Raphael made it even better with their attention to detail. We enjoyed the many options for food and the fact they were so attentive to our needs being in Royal Service. Would certainly come back.

reviews.author: awe a
reviews.title: Excellent time
reviews.text: The H2O bar is the best bar here. Ramon Ramirez, Pedro Amparo and Jairo were awesome. They made the beach stay wonderful. Very charismatic and made everyday enjoyable. Me and my friends came to his bar everyday we stayed here.

reviews.author: Karla S
reviews.title: Great!!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, and there is a places name it M-Bar, they treat us excelent!! 
Oscar Polanco was great with us. For sure we´ll come back for summer. 
The services in general was really good, and the instalation were beautiful.

reviews.author: Jason F
reviews.title: Royal service-  pretty sweet
reviews.text:
My expectations were low when I came here being my first trip to the Dominican republic. Upon entering, I realize that I really underestimated the place from the website. 

  The staff has been exceptional. We had Royal service for the week, and really enjoyed the help we got from Arjunes, and our other friend Carlos, who was not our Butler, but was happy to help us always.

 The food included with the Royal service was really good. The buffet was better than average, and the quality of alcohol, was anything from well all the way up to top shelf. The Mimosa’s were delicious, the piña colada’s were cold and tasty, and all in all we really had a great time.

 We played the Cocatal  Golf Course one day, really enjoyed that. Had some really beautiful Bermuda greens and fairways, and was really far beyond my expectations- again the website has pretty poor pictures to describe a really beautiful golf course with interesting holes but not too difficult for a high handicap golfer like myself.

  The beach is full or sea weed this week and has a real funky smell- and the peddlers are relentless. Avoid the beach if you don’t want to be bothered by them. The royal service section of the pool is nice- quiet and easy to find palapas and chairs.

reviews.author: Melodie E
reviews.title: Great Resort!!
reviews.text:
Went here for a senior trip. 4 adult chaperones and 14 kids. Because of our own errors, check in was a complete mess but the front desk people managed to get us all sorted out and were very patient with us!  

Rooms were clean and showed only a little wear. I do recommend leaving a small gratuity to show your appreciation to housekeeping. It helps if you need extra towels etc. 

Food was fantastic!  Service at all restaurants was great. A little slow at buffet but not too bad. We even got a surprise cheese and fruit tray and a bottle of wine in our room one day- very nice. 

The pool area was clean and never hard to find a chair. The beach area was right there so you could sit on the beach/palapa and be just steps away from Pool. That was nice because the seaweed was kind of bad. 

Overall these resort is beautiful, clean, safe, friendly, and a good size with lots to do (or not!) but it is not so huge you cannot get around.  Also, we didn’t need it but there is a small shopping center right next door. 

I would absolutely stay here again!

reviews.author: Explorer456215
reviews.title: Fantastique
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé un séjour inoubliable et je recommande cet hôtel à tout ceux qui veulent se détendre et être très bien servi. Toutes mes félicitations à toute votre équipe ce fût extraordinaire.

Merci

reviews.author: Bobby C
reviews.title: GREAT, FANTASTIC, WONDERFUL, FIRST CLASS AND MUCH MORE!! AWESOME
reviews.text:
I am not going to write a long review because there are just too many great things to say about this Resort, its staff , service and quality.. Just to much!! So to make it short and sweet, If you DO NOT CONSIDER this Resort for your trip to Punta Cana, you will be doing yourself a GRAVE disservice PERIOD!!   

However I would like to thank a few people that did go ABOVE AND BEYOND to make my stay AWESOME!!  Jose Argelis Front Desk Kateri Lyicel Guest Services Marcos Front Desk, Emely Front Desk... All these people NEED TO BE RECOGNIZED in some way by this company, PLEASE they are making your Resort a great place to be and treating your guest very good.. Abraham works in the Breakfast Buffet and in Rare Steak House, he needs an IMMEDIATE PROMOTION OF SOME KIND!! He is very special and master of his craft this guy is a very value able asset to your company and should be rewarded for such!!

Suleyka Vinas.. What can I say.. The dictionary does not have a word to express how I feel about the way she did her job!! OUTSTANDING comes close but still not good enough to describe her job.. WELL DONE!!  She was my group coordinator and she left no stone un turned AT ALL!!

Thank you All

reviews.author: Jose Luis F
reviews.title: Antes estaba mejor
reviews.text: Visite por tercera vez el Paradisus Palma Real de punta cana y si bien pienso que sigue siendo de los mejores veo que tuvo una caída en algunos detalles de mantenimiento y de atención , cómo siempre el personal es atento y educado me llamo la atención que no mostraban ese extra que es la alegria al comentarlo con ellos me entero que es por un cambio gerencial que los perjudica tanto al hotel como a ellos, espero que esto se revierta para poder seguir disfrutando de este maravilloso lugar

reviews.author: Aiden B
reviews.title: Ariel
reviews.text: Was very good to me and my family and we want to thank him for everything! We had a great time and he set up a wonderful trip for us. He showed us around the resort and setup zip lining and a yacht trip that we had a fun time on.

reviews.author: ririmay9
reviews.title: Most relaxing week!
reviews.text:
Very pleased with the overall cleanliness of the resort. The beach was amazing and the pools were great to mix up the scenery. The quality of the food exceeded expectations, especially at the restaurants requiring reservation which I would highly recommend. Bana (hibachi) and Rare (steakhouse) were our favorites, but don't think you could go wrong with any of the restaurants. 

We attended finger painting and brush painting (free mid-day activities) which were o much fun and the staff member instructors for both were great! Wish I had gotten their names.. 

We owe a huge thank you to Reynaldo for the amount of fun we had the whole week - he was incredibly entertaining, hilarious, and really livened up our stay! We will miss him dearly. Boni and Fernando (waiters) were awesome and constantly checking up on us while at the beach and pool to bring us drinks. Most of the staff was great, but these 3 were really stand out members and so genuine.

reviews.author: Mercé V
reviews.title: Playa
reviews.text: Estuvimos 11dias en el hotel y los chicos de la playa Felipe y Fernando nos atendieron siempre muy bien. Atentos y muy serviciales. Gracias por todo. Fueron unos dias inolvidables. Siempre pendientes de todo. Fueron muy amables.

reviews.author: Jacelynn T
reviews.title: perfect vacation
reviews.text: excellent trip!! Great place for a senior trip for moms and friends!! Yesica and Samuel provided great assistance!! They helped our trip become the best it could be! Highly recommend this resort! Best girls trip!

reviews.author: kateh3297291
reviews.title: Paradisus Trip
reviews.text: Yesica and Samuel were excellent personal concierges! My trip was so much fun thanks to them! They were always available to help! They made any request we asked happen. 10 out of 10 would recommend this trip!!

reviews.author: ksbledsoe
reviews.title: Paradises Punta Cana
reviews.text: My husband and I went to this Resort with a group of 6 couples. The Resort was very clean and the staff was very friendly and accommodating. We spent most of our time at the Gabby Beach bar. Our servers, Jose Alejandro and Jhoan Tavarez went above and beyond to provid excellent service and made sure our group had a lot of fun as well! Jose coordinated cake and champagne on the beach to celebrate a birthday for one of the people in our party. Jhoan provided so many entertaining moments with his outgoing personality. The swim up bar was so much fun. One day there was a bubble party and dance party poolside. Leanardo, Willie Diogenes and Marcelo, all poolside bartenders also had outstanding service. All of the dinners we went to were delicious. I would highly recommend visiting Paradisus Puta Cana for your next trip!!!

reviews.author: ChicagoTraveler26
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text:
My friend and I stayed May 28-June 2, we've both traveled a lot but this was our first time in the DR. We LOVED it!  All the good stuff...with a few things that could be better.

Check in - The fastest, most simple check in I've had at a resort

Resort - Its beautiful! The view at check in is amazing! The grounds were gorgeous and well kept, the pool and beach area very clean. 

The Food- The food was beyond good! I've always had mediocre food at all inclusives, but everything we had was amazing! We ate at a different restaurant each night, buffet for breakfast & lunch.  The drinks were also really good! They had a nice selection of liquor & wine. Some of our mixed favorites the dirty monkey & mambo #5, the drinks were quite strong and made with fresh ingredients. 

The Room-This is the one area that could be improved. It was kind of dated, which is not a huge deal because we didn't spend much time in it, but the shower was in rough shape, the showerhead didn't work at all, just the handheld part.  The design of the room with an open window to the bathroom and clear toilet/shower door was a little awkward, there wasn't any privacy.  I was traveling with a friend so we took turns hanging out on the balcony when showering or needing personal time. Even if I was with my husband I don't think I would like that lack of privacy, it was weird. 

The staff- Everyone was fantastic, happy, helpful, smiling. A few special shout outs to people that really went out of their way to make our week great

Pablo Perez-Greeted us at check in, met us in our room showed us everything, made our dinner reservations, spa reservations, contacted us regularly to see if we needed anything. He was great! 

Junior Daniel-Our favorite beach server! Recommended great drinks for us

Antonio-super friendly made sure we were having fun and smiling

Yasmine @ gabi beach bar-great drinks & late night snacks

The spa - The spa is gorgeous! Tranquil and relaxing.  I had the 80 minute massage with Altagracia, it was fantastic.  I work in the salon industry,  I get massage on a regular basis, I'm pretty picky and I was not a bit disappointed.  She did a great job. 

The beach - The beach is beautiful, we hung out there most days. The salespeople on the beach were really annoying, it was very intrusive.  Every 10 minutes someone comes by to sell something and many of them don't take a 'no gracias' they set their goods on your chair and keep talking.  The seaweed is bad, they constantly tried to clean it, but it's nearly impossible.  The last day it was so bad we couldn't go in the water at all.  There are also several men that stand at the water edge and when you go in they try to sell you things, parasailing, partyboats, drugs etc.  That was a little uncomfortable also. 

Activities - We were there for relaxation so we didn't want to do much however, we did do parasailing, through the resort, with Alexander the great.  He was so friendly and had the greatest smile and laugh, we had a great time.    

I know it's an 'all inclusive' resort but it surprises me how many people don't tip, I wish more people would recognize the hard work that goes into making your vacation a little better and support the staff & servers. 
 
I will go back for sure, it was a great vacation!

reviews.author: Lynne W
reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text: This place was fabulous. The staff was very attentive and couldn’t do enough for us. Food was amamzing. Rooms were exceptionally clean. Pools and beach were amazing. I would definitely go back.  And even bring our husbands next time!

reviews.author: clarabec
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: My friend and I visited the resort for our birthdays and had a blast! It was a very nice place and we enjoyed every minute of it.  When our flight was cancelled and we couldn't come until they next day, they made it very easy to switch our reservation with no trouble. They also brought a champagne bottle to our room for our birthdays, which was sweet!  Dionis Ramirez and Felipe Morla were by far our favorites!  They were very attentive and funny!  We definitely plan on visiting again!

reviews.author: Alicia S
reviews.title: LUXURY!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a fantastic week at Paradisus Palma Real! Words can’t express how wonderful the experience was.

The grounds are stunning, clean, and well maintained. Every day we would come accross cleaning personnel and gardeners working hard to maintain the beauty and cleanliness of the resort. 

The food at the buffets and at the à la carte restaurants was delicious and offered a wide variety. We especially enjoyed the fresh fruit and lobster tails at the main buffet, and had a fantastic dinner at Aqua.

All of the staff we encountered were so professional, welcoming, attentive and kind. The entertainment staff (Ángel, Luis, Reynaldo, Looky-Looky, Antonio, and Nixon) made the vacation for us. We had a great time participating in the variety of classes and activities offered by the hotel each day. The classes offered by the NRG 2 GO instructor allow the regular entertainment staff to collaborate with international instructors, and as the instructor this past week I cannot express how much of a pleasure it was to work with the staff. 

We also received excellent service at the pool bar from Luis, as well as from Freddy and from Miguel at the main buffet. 

Domingo and Jimmy Sosa were also wonderful.

Overall, our experience at Paradisus Palma Real was phenomenal, and we cannot wait to be back !

reviews.author: asrossiter23
reviews.title: Amazing experience!!
reviews.text:
Just spent an amazing week at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana and could not speak more highly of this resort. The resort was absolutely beautiful and very clean. 

The food was delicious; the buffet was fresh and had a great variety of food, and the sit down restaurants exceeded all expectations. 

The entertainment staff made the experience especially enjoyable. Angel, Nixon, Luis, Reynaldo, Looky-Looky, Antonio and Raphyel were very welcoming, fun and made us feel at home. 

Zumba classes with the NRG2GO instructor Alicia Silvestri were especially fun! She led fun, challenging classes on the beach and was very professional. She made an effort to engage with guests around the resort to promote the class and a sense of belonging for kids and adults alike!

reviews.author: Santina M
reviews.title: Paradise island
reviews.text: I loved my recent stay. This was the first all inclusive that I have been to. You are treated like Royalty here the minute you get off the plane. The hotel lobby is gorgeous, the staff is very friendly. Nixon and Boni were my two favorites they treated me and my group very well. The rooms were clean, beach front was gorgeous, the buffet was excellente’ as were the restaurants. Only one thing was a negative is that the dancing would stop at 11:00 we can from Sunday through Thursday not sure if it’s any different on the weekend!

reviews.author: Mjaet360
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text:
We were 6 who were on our yearly friends trip.  Easy and quick flight from Newark or 
jfk. Transportation to the hotel is $6-$8 and no more than 20 minutes from the airport. Check in was easy and our room was ready early but if not they have a hospitality spot where you can change. We were part of the club accommodations and had a separate check in/out and a concierge who made our meal reservations, reserved our chairs by the pool and beach, stocked our fridge with our preferred snacks and drinks and we could contact with any questions etc. there is also the royal service.  Each group has their own bracelet color since there are specific seating areas at the beach and some of the restaurants, pools and bars are only for people part of royal service The reserved seating at the beaches and pools is great so that you don’t have to rush to claim a spot.   There is waiter service at the pools and beaches for drinks only.  There was Music and some activities by the main pool that also has a swim up bar  but other quieter pools if you preferred.  Certain times of the year there is a lot of seaweed on the beach and in the ocean.  They have equipment that comes to remove it from the shoreline but I would recommend checking when seaweed season is and try to avoid since it’s not pleasant in the water with it. We arranged through the hotel  a private half day boogie atv type tour and it was a lot of fun.  There are snorkeling, catamaran and other tour options you can arrange.
