There are several tour desks but a lot also come around while you are by the pool and beach to arrange a trip or sell souvenirs(but don’t harass you once you say no thank you). We ate at two of the restaurants at the reserve hotel  for dinner that were Beautifully decorated, great service/drinks and food was very good-especially for an all inclusive.  We were all impressed with the food in general.  You can order room service,go to a buffet or sit down through out the day so you can certainly find something  to eat. We really liked Fuego for a sit down lunch, room service or buffet for breakfast, dinner at aqua and hibachi at the  reserve and rare(steak restaurant). At night they usually had a band followed by a DJ. There is a small casino and disco    We  enjoyed our vacation and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Jkrash68
reviews.title: First time in the reserve at The Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: Is amazing come to visit this amazing place definitely is my favorite. The staff is exceptional. They are very helpful, courteous, service with a smile. Thank (Raynold) and all entertainment staff for keeping me entertained my entire vacation.

reviews.author: Hannah H
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Fun time with my best friend and we will come back to Dance and every employer is so fantastic. The attention is great thank you Raynold Tamayo for showing us how to dance bachata we enjoyed it a lot.

reviews.author: EJCC
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: Had such an amazing time during my trip at this resort. The Royal Service is sooo worth the extra money. I was fortunate enough to have Kevin F. as my butler and he was phenomenal with his service. He made several reservations for me and ensured I was able to enjoy all the amenities of the property. I will definitely be returning here soon!

reviews.author: Scenic772846
reviews.title: GENUINELY Friendly staff
reviews.text: The service at Gabi club was always outstanding. I was traveling in a group of 10. The servers, the hostess, the chefs are always smiling at this family friendly buffet. The assortment of foods were consistently delicious and diverse. It went beyond my expectations. I assumed the food would be bland or become too boring. I am happy to be wrong. What made our trip so fun is being able to run into the friendly faces of Frankely, Jesus, and Dennis. My first night Benjamin, the service manager went out of his way to make sure my room service order was perfect. WOW GUYS. You are a SUPERSTAR TEAM.

reviews.author: ellengrubb
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa is Wonderful
reviews.text: Girls  Long Weekend! We stayed in the Royal Service and our Butler Angelo and Bar Maid Wanda were the best! Angelo went above and beyond to help us with every little thing...One of the ladies forgot her iPad and Angelo went and found it and shipped it back to her after we were home!  Everyone was so Friendly and Fun! Thoroughly enjoyed ourselves!

reviews.author: conradloew
reviews.title: Literally Paradise
reviews.text: The rooms are incredible no matter where you stay. The actual resort is beautiful and they have the largest beach front for a few miles. I didn't come across one worker that wasn't happy and trying to make you smile. The bars are super nice, especially the Avenue bar near the casino. If you get the chance to talk to a bartender at the Avenue bar named Lucia, she was one of the reasons my group had such an amazing time. Also the drinks are incredible and the casino is insanely fun.

reviews.author: Catherine M
reviews.title: Great beach front service from Pedro
reviews.text: Pedro was absolutely awesome and helped make our experience at Paradisus Palma Real Resort a wonderful vacation. Pedro was very informative about the entire resort and he was very accommodating. Great drinks!

reviews.author: sophiasypniak
reviews.title: Fun vacation
reviews.text: I definitely recommend this resort... the people are super friendly and there’s always something going on! On weekends there are dance parties on the beach and shows almost every night. My favorite person is Ruber Perez! Always looking to make a good time and very funny!

reviews.author: phylliswill
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Nixon entertainment was a great experience of helping entertainment all the for days I had fun every time he was in my presence 💯👏🏽Music was ok food was ok need to be hot more beach was nice pool was excellent room service the people that brought   snack was always on time and will invite others to this resort

reviews.author: Marie B
reviews.title: Great Plsce
reviews.text:
We just returned from a twelve day trip, and all a I can say it was fabulous.  We were in the Royal Suites, and the service was splendid starting with Jeuri our butler,
the beach  attendants Carlos Rosario and Pedro Cedano.  These fine gentlemen took
very good care of us.we could not ask for more.  We love the Paradisus and recommend it highly.  If your looking for a relaxation vacation, this is where to go, and if you do ask for these three gentlemen.

reviews.author: jruhberg
reviews.title: Excellente'
reviews.text: We have just enjoyed a wonderful relaxing time here at The Paradisius. The food was very good and the nightly entertainment was amazing. Our concierge Zenovia was truly spectacular!  Her attention to detail made everything so nice. All our reservations and beach accommodations were taken care of. Thank you to all of the people at the resort for a fantastic vacation.

reviews.author: hahafunnee
reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: had the best girls trip to Punta Cana! The weather was beautiful, food delicious and the service was top notch! a special callout to our fun advisor Raynold Tamayo... kept us busy with yoga, stretching, and dancing! can’t wait to come back soon!

reviews.author: sportsfann
reviews.title: Victor Arias @ Fuego
reviews.text: Victor was outstanding as a server and entertainer. Our meals and drinks were perfect. The Paradisus Punta Cana has been a joy for our group of 15. The experience was made better by having Victor take care of us at Gabi Beach as well.

reviews.author: matheus2rres
reviews.title: Viagem casamento amigos
reviews.text: Praia sensacional, vista do hotel vale super a pena, no geral otimo hotel, funcionários frotdesk poderiam ter um pouco mais de treinamento, o all inclusive vale super a pena se levarmos em consideração o preço.

reviews.author: Rachel M
reviews.title: Amazing time
reviews.text: I traveled here with a good friend of mine and we had an awesome time. The staff, Nixon  especially, were wonderful and made our stay all that more enjoyable. The food was great, resort was extremely clean, the beach was awesome and the pool was great too! We will definely be back!

reviews.author: Lorena F
reviews.title: Do not go to this Hotel!!!
reviews.text:
The hotel is NOT well maintained... you can find humidity all over the place... very very - i mean VERY- slow service... you can stay 45 minutes waiting for a bottle of water...
If you go in a low season, there are directly ZERO activities at night. Not fun at all!
Employees seems stressed... underpaid, and unhappy... you can tell... very inefficient in every way. The ONLY amazing restaurant is RES. Best meat, best service by far.

reviews.author: josicanta
reviews.title: Ótima estrutura porém o serviço deixou a desejar
reviews.text:
O Hotel é lindo e aconchegante! Porém os funcionários não dão atenção nenhuma atendem de cara feia. Estávamos em um grupo grande de amigos e muitos tiveram seus pertences roubados.
1 hora da manhã fecha tudo e não conseguimos fazer mais nada.

reviews.author: Laury D
reviews.title: Vacation Of A Lifetime!!
reviews.text: My husband and I recently visited this resort with a group of my work colleagues. We stayed on the property for 6 glorious nights. I can not stress enough what a phenomenal experience we had. Our personal butler, Angelo Mercedes, was outstanding! He was available for all of our questions and needs, had afternoon snacks put in our room, made dinner reservations for us and took care of getting our luggage to and from our room. The resort itself breathtaking-gorgeous beach area, spectacular pools, fabulous spa. Nothing is overlooked or not the best of the best. The buffets are delicious, the rooms are spacious and spotless and the nightlife is fantastic. I would highly recommend visiting this resort and we can not wait to return!!

reviews.author: José E
reviews.title: Bajo la calidad de antaño
reviews.text:
Vine hace un año y no es lo mismo! Te limitan comida y tragos. La verdad que me desilusionaron. Traje a 12 amigos y no fue lo que esperamos.
Se noto el cambio de administracion. 
Nos paso lo mismo en todas las intalaciones... en pocas palabras no es un all inclusive

reviews.author: Gabriel C
reviews.title: Muito bom!
reviews.text: Estivemos em um casamento aqui e foi muito divertido e tivemos uma ótima estádia. Pessoal do hotel muito atencioso e prestativo, sem contar o humor, apenas melhoraria o chuveiro dos quartos e ficamos uma parte de um dia sem água mas nada que atrapalhasse

reviews.author: Ramon R
reviews.title: Service beyond expectations!!
reviews.text: It started with a lot of turbulence, people trying to sell you a vacation membership and wouldn’t take no for an answer. But Edwin Padilla, Maria Ortiz and Gregorin Ortiz were just amazing. Because of you we will make this our home in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: David D
reviews.title: VERY GREAT!!!!
reviews.text: Wally,Luis Hidro grill the chef in the pool area and jhonatan Medina were great with everything helped me with any and everything I needed. I plan on coming back just because of their hospitality!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Mallory s
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I stayed  at the Reserve April 19- April24 and was quite disappointed,,,I stayed at Paradisus about 11 yrs ago and loved it,,,so I thought I would take my niece for her bday and stay at the Reserve,,,checked in and told I was upgraded on my room ,,the view was the back of a kitchen,,,,the couch was broken,,,the wall between the bath and bedroom was filthy soap scum,,,the hall had a huge puddle which was not lit so we fell 2x ,,,we requested the light be fixed not once was it on ,,very dangerous,,,room so cold could not lower thermostat,,,got sick 
the best thing the help ,,need a little better English,
oh and the casino was a joke ripped carpet looked so tacky
will not be back

reviews.author: Nicole M
reviews.title: Nixon is awesome!
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing and beautiful. The food was decent and as good as any inclusive resort but what made this hotel great was the staff! Anytime you were without a drink within minutes there was someone there asking if they can get you a refill and I promise you will not pass a single employee that does not say hello to you! If you visit make sure to look for Nixon who works around the pool, he literally came up to our group with a connect four board and challened us to a game! He was a blast!

reviews.author: Vesna K
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway
reviews.text: Stayed in the royal service section.  Nice adults only part of the resort.  Much quieter, would highly recommend it.  Our butler Carlos was amazing.  So sweet and genuine, he really does go out of his way to ensure your stay is perfect.  Rafael at the beach is the best.  After the first day, he knew to reserve our beach beds and even have them turned facing the sun just the way we liked it.  Drink service on the beach is great, someone is always making sure you’re taken care of.  Olga at the smoothie bar is pure joy.  She’s just so pleasant, always smiling.  Not to mention that she can whip up some tasty smoothies.  I’d come back to this resort just because of the wonderful employees.  They are the ones who really make your vacation a memorable one.

reviews.author: Alex K
reviews.title: Great resort! Amazing Service
reviews.text: Pictures don’t this resort justice! Beautiful resort but we really enjoyed the staff. Nixon in activities was a blast. Had to let him win a couple games of connect four! Thanks Nixon you are the man and thanks for making us laugh!! 😀

reviews.author: Tiffany M
reviews.title: Staff is amazing!
reviews.text: Nixon was very helpful! He came over talked to us, he made us feel welcomed! He came over to us while we were by the pool & made us laugh and played games! Kids were here and he was so great with them!

reviews.author: Nicholas A
reviews.title: Staff very friendly
reviews.text:
Nixon from activities and Nicolas from avenue bar provided excellent service!!!!

Boni was our waiter on the beach and he provided great service as well. 

Resort is beautiful and would recommend to anyone 10/10

reviews.author: Kyle C
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: The staff really treats you like loyalty, from Boni bringing you drinks to Nixon playing you  in connect four on the beach. Very nice and personal staff. I would reccomend this resort! Its absolutely beautiful here.

reviews.author: melissa r
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great staff, very quiet
reviews.text:
Firstly, this resort looks exactly like the pictures online. The grounds and beach are absolutely breath taking, it is truly like paradise. The staff are extremely helpful and attentive. In particular a young gentleman named RAYNOLD TAMAYO stood out, he provided amazing customer service and truly made our stay that much more enjoyable. If you have the chance to encounter him during your stay here you are lucky and sure to be amazed! 

The food is above average for resort food, both the buffets and a la carte restaurants. But you have to make reservations for the a la cartes as soon as you get there, or you will have a hard time eating anywhere else but the buffet for the week. Best restaurants are Aqua, Mole and the Grill. 

Resort is very close to shops, restaurants, nightclubs and casinos (2-10 mins walk!). Felt very safe leaving the resort to go eat during the day, as well as taking taxis at night to go to the nightclubs! 

Cons: 
- Room service very slow or doesn’t come at all 
- the reserve is quite far from the beach and main areas 
- There need to be more carts going around to pick people up and bring them around the resort, particularly past 11 pm (sometimes you would be stuck at the beach for like 20 mins waiting for someone to pick you up and bring you back to your room)
- The resort is VERY quiet. It is an older crowd, fewer young people, many families. There is currently no disco (they are building one), but there is a nightly DJ by the beach bar which is nice (but usually pretty dead). It can also get pretty cold by the beach that late due to the wind and the mosquitos get pretty bad. Still fun, but If you are looking for a more upbeat resort with music, dancing, day/beach parties or a nightclub I wouldn’t recommend this resort. Or if you are okay with leaving the resort past 11 for nightlife then you will be okay.
- Not that many things to do during the day, wish there were more organized events (I feel like there was never anything going on). Like I walked to other resorts where the music was blasting, pool parties, volleyball, dance competitions, shows etc.. where as I said this place is very quiet and relaxing. 

Overall beautiful resort, great staff, good food, needs a little more excitement :) would definitely return!

reviews.author: Bob G
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: We just spent 5 days at Paradisus and had Alex as our personal butler. He was perfect in every way! The resort was beautiful and very well maintained. Our room was taken care of 2x a day. The royal service was very helpful. Our friends has steve as a butler and he was also super friendly. Thanks again Alex and Steve!!!

reviews.author: StuSarni
reviews.title: Spring Break 2018
reviews.text: Shout out to GEORGE ALRICHE at the Reserve beach for taking such excellent care of out group during our stay last week.  He was very attentive and had water and drinks ready for us without us even asking.  George made out stay at Paradisus Palma one that won't be forgotten.

reviews.author: 988pedrod
reviews.title: Reencuentro amigos
reviews.text:
si buscas un all inclusive un poco más tranquilo y exclusivo este es el lugar.  Nosotros éramos 10 y nos asignaron a una persona de Guest Service, Carlos Sulca que nos atendió de maravilla.  Es importante que alguien te ayude con los datos del hotel de acuerdo a lo que quieran hacer para sacarle provecho.
La comida es bastante buena y hay varias opciones de restaurantes.
El hotel es grande y tienes carritos que te llevan a tosas partes.  Para que no se demoren es bueno avisar al concierge o cualquier persona del hotel que pueda notificar que esperas el servicio.  Así no esperas casi nada.
En el gym, David Contreras da la mejor clase de spinning.  Además  tienen algunas trotadoras y otras máquinas para ejercitarse.
En la playa Ramón Ramírez y Santos te atienden con un buen humor envidiable.
Las habitaciones son cómodas y están bien mantenidas.  En general bastante recomendable.

reviews.author: fmrswimr
reviews.title: George Alriche
reviews.text:
George made our trip!  He arranged our chairs, towels, and water at the beach so there were no concerns.  He greeted us every day with a huge smile and a new towel.
Find him in the reserve section of the beach and your trip will be even better!

George is fabulous!

reviews.author: Madison M
reviews.title: Relaxing girls weekend!
reviews.text: Had the most stress-free and incredible time at the Reserve! Went with three girlfriends, and we had no complaints. The food at every restaurant was fantastic, and the beach/pools/cabanas were all amazing. The highlight of our trip was the rockstar service we received from the staff members. Anthony de Paula, in particular, made our trip unforgettable. He was there at our every beck and call for questions, driving us around the (very large) property, and arranging reservations. Additionally, the beach staff of h2o were awesome! Ramon, José, Santos, and Jairo were so fun, friendly, and helpful that we never wanted to leave the beach area! 5 stars for these 5 men and the resort as a whole.

reviews.author: lizzie8888
reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text:
Stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus and it was an amazing stay. Great for solo, friends, family, or romantic trip. Specifically, Anthony de Paula was an amazing host/concierge and provided unbelievable service to us. If you can get him as your butler/concierge you are lucky!!! At the beach, ask for Ramon, Santos, José, and Jario - they were so welcoming and helpful throughout our stay with great service!

Thanks Paradisus for an awesome trip!

reviews.author: Kelsey Y
reviews.title: Wonderful girls trip
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve for just under a week in April and had an amazing time. The room was beautiful, we were able to reserve a beachfront cabana every day and the food was incredible - far exceeded my expectations for a resort. We ate at Gabi Beach, Gabi Club, Mole and Fuego and they were all amazing. The buffets have sushi, lobster and endless incredible foods. What really made our trip so special was our wonderful concierge Anthony de Paula. He helped us reserve a cabana each day, drove us around the large resort, helped us with restaurant reservations, airport transportation and anything else we needed - always with a smile on his face. Our trip would not have been be same without Anthony and we are going to miss him very much. In addition to Anthony, Ramon, Santos, José and Jairo were all amazing as well. They made sure we had what we needed on the beach whether it was towels, fresh coconut water, a dirty monkey or just a smiling face. Thank you all for making our trip so amazing! We don’t want to leave.

reviews.author: Heinz C
reviews.title: Urlaub ..... der beste Urlaub seit Jahren
reviews.text: Tolle Anlage...Die Anlage ist wirklich ein Paradies... besonders gut war das Restaurant Mole . VICTOR ARIAS ein toller freundlicher Mensch. Das Essen hervorragend.  Die Bedinungen auch . Seh r empfehlenswert.

reviews.author: Casey B
reviews.title: Wonderful resort & staff!
reviews.text: This is paradise! The resort is gorgeous, well-kept & friendly staff! The entertainment staff are incredible, especially my new friends Nixon & Lois! They make the activities fun with their friendly smiles! We will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Kate S
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!!
reviews.text: Raynold is such a great dancer 💃 people are very friendly, greet you with a smile food is awesome! The beach is amazing the most important is the service all employees are good and have good vibes and thanks Gaby Joseph for great attention definitely we come back

reviews.author: edielloyd
reviews.title: Best Ever
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real has never disappointed me. Three years in a row I have experienced the BEST Food, BEST Service in a Spotless Resort. I would like a special mention to Luis Sanchez our Royal Service Butler for three years now. Also special mention to Royal Service Butlers: Carlos,Richard,Alberto
Royal Service Staff:Fatima
Smoothie bar staff:Olga/Joel

Also Martin Pool Concerige and his trusty side kick Big Pedro and Crew.They will arrange your purple towels on the beach/pool as you wish. Wanda the Sunset Bartender will create You her special drink.

Special mention to our Very Good Waiter at Plazzo,Felix#2. Golf carts are arranged to take you to YHI Spa on the Reserve a must visit for massage. The grounds are breath taking. 
Freddy the Coconut slayer will keep you safe from coconuts by chopping them off prior to falling off. You can enjoy fresh coconut water from his labour. 
Francesco our special towel collector cleans up after us by lugging heavy bundles of towels to the cart.
Don't forget to buy a premium cigar from Jose who will visit you on the beach lugging a very large very heavy bag of cigars(good cigars as long as you only smoke one)
Cleaning/House Keeping staff visit at least 2-3 times per day and as needed. 
Room Service shout out to Darius and Michael. 
The onsite gym is wonderful. Thank You Noel. 
Pools are Spotless.

Hope to be back next year

reviews.author: Rachelle W
reviews.title: Activities
reviews.text: Amazing Zumba! Best Zumba ever! Me and my friends had a GREAT time! Really good music!! Highly recommend!!!! Scooby Doo (Raphyel) is amazing. Loved the music! Raphyel is so friendly and very fun! I would recommend his Zumba class to all my friends.

reviews.author: wineloversMichigan
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text:
My golf group (eight guys) have stayed in various properties in the Punta Cana area over the last dozen years and our sweet spot is the Paradisus Punta Cana. We stay in the Reserve and enjoy the special attention that we receive from the moment that I start making my reservations until the time we check out. Of special note was Jose Adamas, one of the concierge staff that especially stood out. Since I organize everything for my group, it was especially important for me to do as much as possible in the pre-planning phase and to do as little organizing as possible on property so that I could enjoy my vacation maximally once I got down there, Jose took care of golf reservations, dinner reservations, advanced car/bus transportation, etc., very politely and professionally. He returned my calls/emails promptly and delivered on what he said that we would.  
If I had to pick a downside for the trip it would be the kids in the Reserve pool. There is a kiddie pool 100 feet from the reserve pool and that is where the kids should be hanging out--not at the Reserve pool. The reason that we book the Reserve area is to get away from the noise and relax and the children make that impossible. I don't think that the parents realize how disruptive their children are to others around them. 
Overall great property--we plan to return.

reviews.author: gman19692018
reviews.title: Clarify All Inclusive Golf Resort???
reviews.text:
The property is beautiful.  The golf course is also top shelf. The food, buffet included in the selection offered good food and many selections.  The staff is well trained, friendly and make you feel very welcome, appreciated and safe.  The website is not clear on what you will need to additionally pay for, especially if you are golfing.  A surprising $75 cart fee per person is added.  The website also leads you to believe you will be getting premium drinks, but that comes with an additional charge of $45 per person / per day.

The golf course is nice and a short 3 minute bus ride away.  You will need to get handwritten vouchers from the hotel to take to the course.  You will then be informed that the golf is included, but the cart fee is $75 per person.  None of the people we rode over on the bus with were aware of the charge so I'm pretty sure that I just missed that detail???

The staff at the golf course is helpful and friendly.  The process to check in at the pro shop is maddening.  If you are the fifth person in line to register and pay, this will be a 25 minute experience.  The voucher system is bad, many questions on each transaction.  Many people get checked out for golf fees, but then come back to add the club rental.  Golf charges are separate from golf ball and apparel sales so these take separate credit card transactions adding to the time and confusion.  Some people were waiting almost an hour to get checked in.

If you play after 2:00 the club rental fee is waived / free.  Many people were on the 1:50 bus, so be sure to sit in the front of the bus to save time in the pro shop.  When getting the discount rate they will load you up on some very old, beat up carts.  The nice carts are apparently saved for full paying fares.

The golf course has 27 holes.  All are comparable in quality and challenge.  Tip the starter and they will get you in the best spot to play quickly.

reviews.author: Sarah B
reviews.title: the best vacation
reviews.text: Great service, food, activities, and night dancing! The restaurants were very good and had excellent service. I liked how most things were all inclusive. I especially liked Jairol Duran and Luis Florian, they kept everyone dancing and were very nice!

reviews.author: dadasoda
reviews.title: The People
reviews.text:
The people at the resort were awesome. Couldn't do enough for you. Great food. No complaints except the room keys would sometimes lose their activation.
We had the pleasure of meeting and getting to know some of the staff, one in particular Ravel Maldonado. The guy was awesome, his service was awesome. Nothing but good things to say. See you again soon.

reviews.author: bobsmith599
reviews.title: Resort employees highlight visit
reviews.text:
The resort is excellent overall, although some employees are better than others. It's sort of a mixed bag in terms of who you will get at any given point, so when you find a good bar or bartender, you'll find yourself going back.

Luis at Fuego Bar was excellent. He was one of the highlights of our trip. He made the best drinks out of all the bars at the resort, he was extremely personable and friendly, and professional.

reviews.author: Peter R
reviews.title: A wonderful escape from snowy New York
reviews.text: I just returned from a truly memorable visit to the Paradisus Resort the Reserve in Punta Cana.  From the arrival to this resort we were welcomed by our fabulous private concierge Omar.  He sat with us and planned our entire visit.  When things did not go as we expected he was right on top of everything and made sure everything was taken care of. He was available to us 24/7 and even gave us his own personal telephone number to contact him. I certainly would recommend having him if you decide to visit. Additionally,  there was not one staff member there that was rude or unpleasant. You were always greeted with a smile, and a warm " good morning, afternoon or evening!"  I did not come across one staff member who did not speak English, Spanish if you prefered.   I must say a special thank you to the pool staff and Gabi bar waiter, pool and beach staff.  Jonathan Medina, Juan Diego, Wander Roa, Jose Reinoso, Jesus Avelino, and Elizaerr Rodriguez, to mention a few.  They made sure our drinks were filled, made properly,  served with care and speed.  Each took pride in what they did and looked at you as an individual person. They cared about what you were doing,  who you were, where you were from, and engaged in conversation which is very rare for staff of these all inclusive properties.   The food in the restaurants was excellent.  I most especially enjoyed the buffet that they had on both ends of the property. The food was fresh,  prepared well, and again served with a pleasant smile.  I was extremely impressed at the gentleman who made the omelets in the morning. I never got his name but he was terrific, he remembered what kind of omelette you actually liked.  The maintenance staff and the people who keep this property clean are incredible. It was absolutely spotless. I never saw so much as a piece of paper on the growns.   Towels were clean and fresh in the bathroom.  At the pool the cushions were washed and cleaned every single day.  The entertainment was wonderful each evening and the casino though small, was fun. The staff there was terrific as well.  I will certainly make another visit to this wonderful Resort. Kudos to the management company and to all those I mentioned specifically. But none-the-less every person that work there should be praised. A great trip a memorable one and I thank them for making it so!

reviews.author: cpaul205
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.text: What a beautiful place!!! I had a great time , Amazing food, amazing night life. I met a beautiful lady name Yanit Hernandez, who showed us around the resort gave us great ideas for fun activities. I was very impressed with her professionalism, a very well spoken person, but in all I had a great time in this resort , definitely going for a 2nd trip

reviews.author: Abel A
reviews.title: Nice location, average food, poor service
reviews.text: Nice beach and facilities. Very few employees smiled or spoke...had to find things out for ourselves. There were very few that understood guest experience, spoke understandable English and acted like the cared

reviews.author: Melanie B
reviews.title: Great spring break trip, but could've been better
reviews.text:
Myself and 9 of my friends just returned home from a week-long stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. I've stayed at a different Paradisus resort before (in Riviera Maya) and had a wonderful experience, so I was excited to see how this resort compared. Upon arrival, it was clear that the staff was having trouble finding all of our reservations. They took us to a private area and informed us that because of the issue, they were going to upgrade us to The Reserve, free of charge. With the Reserve, you have access to exclusive areas, bars, restaurants, etc. so we were very happy about that. It took much longer than expected to get into our rooms, but once we did we were able to relax. 

The rooms were very nice. Just a forewarning that there isn't a lot of privacy between the room and bathroom, so if you aren't very comfortable with the people you are staying with, it might be better to get separate rooms. Our room was extremely humid, and we were never able to figure out why. Besides that, everything was great. 

The pool and beach area were very nice and we spent most of our time around the swim up bar. Leonardo was a wonderful bartender, and we made sure to leave him tips throughout the week. We loved all of the drinks, with some of our favorites being the mojitos (with no simple syrup) and the dos amigos. You won't be disappointed. 

One of the things I was most disappointed about was the food. I've stayed at around 10 different all-inclusive resorts in the past, and this resort's food did not impress me whatsoever. We made reservations at Fuego and Venti (after reading about how great the food was). The salmon and hummus at Venti were both good, and the wait staff was great. However, our entire group at Fuego did not enjoy their meals. The portions were very small and there wasn't much flavor in any of our dishes. We talked to a few other families who all recommended the Hibachi grill. So, if you are thinking about reservations, I would definitely try for that, instead. 

The service was friendly, but not very attentive to our group. I'm not sure if it was because we were a group of college-aged students, but it seemed like we were getting ignored by a lot of the staff members at restaurants. At almost every restaurant we went to, whether it be the buffet or a restaurant we made reservations at, we were having to ask for drinks multiple times throughout our meal and sometimes we would just never receive them. We were always very polite and made sure to tip our waiters, so I'm still unsure of why we weren't treated like the other families at the resort (especially after being upgraded to The Reserve). 

Overall, it was a great place to stay. I think we would have run into fewer problems if we were there with our families, rather than a big group of friends, but I think that if you're going to pay the amount of money we did to stay here, we should be treated much better than we were.

reviews.author: Ashley B
reviews.title: Amazing trip we come back””
reviews.text: This was my very first time visiting the Dominican Republic and the Paradisus made the entire trip absolutely remarkable for me. The staff was absolutely incredible from the moment we entered to the very last day. Our group was a huge fan of the entertainment group specifically Raynold Tamayo. Everyone at the resort was extremely helpful and friendly and made our stay so enjoyable. I cannot wait to recommend this resort to many people in the near future!

reviews.author: mcagosalvez
reviews.title: Mejor imposible
reviews.text: Ha sido una experiencia inolvidable la semana de vacaciones en este hotel. Genial el equipo de animación en especial Argenis,Luis y Angel. También espectacular el equipo del Royal Service sobre todo Rafael, Pedro y Angelo.Nunca olvidare estas vacaciones

reviews.author: titiprieto
reviews.title: Realmente es el paraiso
reviews.text:
He pasado una semana en el Paradisus Palma Real y realmente ha sido maravillosa. Me han tratado especialmente bien, destacando entre otros a Rafael, Angelo y Martín de Royal Service que han sido muy cariñosos conmigo. 
Si quieres descansar es un acierto ir a este hotel, pero si quieres diversión también la tienes asegurada. Hemos pasado unos ratos estupendos, nos hemos reído y hemos bailado con Natalia Luis y Argenis. Sin ellos no tiene sentido la animación. Siempre me acordaré de ellos. 
No quiero olvidar a Boni que en la piscina siempre estaba pendiente de que no me faltara de nada.

reviews.author: oceanblue772
reviews.title: Wunderschöner Urlaub
reviews.text: The Reserve Paradisus Hotel ist absolut empfehlenswert wunderschöne Suiten sehr sauber, hervorragendes essen!! am liebsten in Gabi Club, freundliches Personal besonders Kellner Frankely Morrobel und Miguell Benjamin so zuvorkommende höflich junge Männer, wir danken Ihnen das Sie unser Urlaub noch schöner gemacht haben.

reviews.author: Mary V
reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.text: Our trip was great. Jose Cappuccino and Luis and Gaby we're so helpful and soooooo much fun. The beach was beautiful as well as the shows. The grounds were very nice and a nice variety of food. The bartender's were fast and courteous and had a nice selection as well.

reviews.author: Andre H
reviews.title: IDP2018
reviews.text: Other than one of my friends having a freak accident that landed her in the hospital this place was great.   I got all the sun that I came for and leaving with my skin as red as a strawberry. Lol. Food was great and the people where amazingly sweet. Jose Capuchino was amazing, entertaining, uplifting, and sweet to us. Going to miss this guy. Always put a smile on our faces. Thanks Jose. Going to miss the sunny weather and amazing service. Till next time Paradisus Punta Cana. #IDP2018

reviews.author: LaurD757
reviews.title: First time but not my last!
reviews.text:
My best friend and I recently returned from a week stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We were able to enjoy not only a relaxing getaway vacation but were met with wonderful accommodations, amazing staff that were friendly and kind and always helpful. 

While on our trip we met some staff that we have to thank personally. Raynold Tamayo & Oscar Santana, their ability to not only get us to work on our dance skills but were genuinely kind gentlemen which is always a wonderful sign of hospitality. They were also hilarious! 

We also had two amazing bar tenders; Miguel Rodriguez & Juan De Los Santos that were kind, friendly and had a mean pour. They also introduced us to local/more traditional Dominican drinks, that we throughly enjoyed while getting to know more about them throughout our stay. 

And finally, thank you to Yaritza Rodriguez who was a wonderful hostess. She went above and beyond when taking care of my food allergies. Making sure I had allergy friendly options at all the meals and always checked in to see how our stay was going and what activities we had on our agenda for the day! 

I would, without a doubt return to the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Thank you for making it an unforgettable first time to Punta Cana and the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: mmg0715
reviews.title: Beautiful Getaway
reviews.text: I was recently at the PPR for a girl's getaway.  The resort was fantastic!  We stayed on the royal service side and it was well worth it.  The property is gorgeous and well maintained.  My room in Villa 8 was large and well equipped.  We were right by the beach and our private pool and restaurant.  We were met by our Butler Jeuri in the Royal Service VIP lounge upon arrival and he took care of all our needs from then until we left.  Request him and you will be very pleased!  In addition, I can't say enough about our beach attendant, Martin Tineo.  He took care of us on the beach/pool daily.  He reserved beds for us on the beach with towels and tables every day.  We never waited for drinks.  Speaking of drinks, Wanda Correa at the pool bar is quite the bartender.  She makes awesome drinks and is very fun and friendly.  The food in all the restaurants was delicious.  There are many options and reservations are required, but don't worry, your butler will handle it.  The bars have top shelf liquor, wine and beer.  Lilyette at the Spa has an excellent massage therapist. The beach and water were amazing.  I would definitely go back to this property.

reviews.author: AAL790
reviews.title: Best week of my life!
reviews.text:
We just revisited this resort, we went april 2015 and couldnt wait to come back! We liked it so much in fact that out of the several resorts weve been to in other countries included, we chose it to being our friends and family to to get MARRIED!

Everything was perfect. First the wedding. For about a year I worked with a wonderful planner named Kenia, who about a month before the wedding left the resort. I was initially nervous, but after speaking with my new planner Catherine I knew I was still in good hands! She went through all of the emails and work we had put in and caught herself up immediately. She was from day one on top of everything even better than I was! She was also incredibly wonderful to work with and very personable. I instantly felt like she was a friend and I had known her forever! Loved her!

She did a beautiful job putting both ceremony and reception together. Her vision with my ideas together created the most beautiful space. My guests were amazed! Everything went seamlessly from the first email through the bridal suite all the way to ceremony and reception. The part I must thank her for most, was totally unexpected, but I completely panicked right before entrance to ceremony (I hate attention and didnt realize just how nervous I was going to get until it hit me) She helped me relax and tune out people looking at me and focus on walking to my groom! I truly cannot thank Catherine enough for being my planner and my friend when I needed her in that moment! She is exceptional.

Another moment I must thank her for was we had no rain until the last 30min of the wedding in which we had to move inside. She smoothly transitioned us to another space and even made sure my last song request was played even though my original MC/DJ had to leave!<3 A final thank you to her!!

Back to hair and makeup, Ramona did a beautiful job on my hair! It came out just as I wanted:) Jessica was INCREDIBLE at makeup!! She even did several of my bridesmaids and we were all beyond happy! She has such talent! 

Now for the vacation...
We really go for two reasons, the food and the pool bar experience!
The food at this resort compared to all others we have visited is exceptional. Even the buffet always impresses! We drink the water (its al filtered or bottled) and eat all the food we like and noone in our group either trip (6 ppl then 42) got sick and everyone was happy with meal choices! AQUA and BANA ARE THE BEST!!! Try them!! Rare was also great! Olio probably got the least favorable review. 

And now for the next and final allstar employee at this resort, and that is swim up pool bar bartender LUIS!!!! He is the man! He was there both trips! We spent every day just about by the pool and he is a large reason why! Not only is he great at his job, but he goes above and beyond! And he has an excellent personality and is like having an added fun friend who you look forward to seeing each day:) we want to go back to this resort annually and hope to always meet him again! Wonderful person!

Thank you Paradisus! Until next year!

reviews.author: danvt6351
reviews.title: Gabi bar
reviews.text: Wow what great bartenders- always have our drinks ready and make sure the grand marnier is full for or end of night visits! Great job Miguel Rodriguez and Juan Diego! Swim up bar was great and Anthony is taking care of everything for us

reviews.author: Dr. Aja Selenic
reviews.title: Perfect vacation!!
reviews.text: I stayed here with a friend in a February 2017, it was her birthday celebration. From the first moment we got here everything was just amazing. We had Royal service Garden View suite and room was very spacious with jacuzzi and balcony. Starting from out butler Juan who was beyond this world amazing, everyone else was super professional and always ready to help with everything we needed. Juan is very educated young man who went above and beyond to help me prepare a surprise for my friend. He made us restaurant reservations, excursion trips, and made sure both of us felt like real royalty. We couldn’t thank him enough for unforgettable vacation. Martin and Pedro were serving our drinks at the beach very efficiently and Abraham was our favorite server in the buffet restaurant. The property is beautiful itself, and beach chairs are very comfortable. Overall It was amazing experience, I liked it that much that I booked it again for next month for my boyfriend’s birthday. If you like luxury and being pampered stay here, you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Al F
reviews.title: Spring break!
reviews.text: At our check in time we have a very nice, we went to the naos the buffet that is amazing,  the pool and the beach are very beautiful and  clear water. Our concierges Carolina Franco and Mayloren are very friendly and nice. The room is fabulous,  we like so much.  We definitely are having a great vacation.

reviews.author: sfeinesq
reviews.title: Terrific Service Makes For A Great Vacation
reviews.text: We haven't missed a year in the last 10. It's the perfect vacation from winter in New York. One of the best things about Paradisus Palma Real is the staff. You're always greeted with a smile, a nod, a cheerful "Buenos Dias". This year, for the first time in 10 years, we sat around the pool rather than on the beach. While the service has always been great, one stood out from all the rest. GEORGE ALRICHE was solicitous without being obsequious. He was always there when we wanted or needed something. There were times he knew before we did that we wanted or needed something, He was the perfect pool attendant. He took care of a number of "familias" around the pool and was constantly in motion. Nobody had to ask twice for anything. His cheerful outlook made some of the clouds go away. I heartily recommend you ask where GEORGE ALRICHE is working and ask to be assigned there.

reviews.author: Samantha H
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real review
reviews.text:
This is our 4th year here staying in the royal service. Our butlers are Angelo and Alvaro and they are top notch. Could not ask for more.  They are responsive, professional, friendly, helpful, etc. I cannot speak highly enough regarding every aspect of the services they provide. 
The resort employees all work together in a cohesive way that assures the experiences of the individuals on holiday are unsurpassed. 
Pedro, on the beach, bringing chairs, towels and fresh beverages before we even know that we need them. The wonderful staff at the spa provide the best services in the world for facials and massages. We have had the very best of experiences with Sintiya, Kharen, Lilete, Lucia, and Ratih.  Marcia and Risma are also wonderful. They have  been consistently first class.  
Palazzo is our favorite restaurant!  The staff, and food  are five star. Fabulous breakfasts, lunches and dinners every time. 
Mikel from room service brings hot coffee and fresh fruit every morning and could not be nicer. 
Also, very clean accommodations. 
No hesitation to give high marks.

reviews.author: brett l
reviews.title: Awesome again!
reviews.text: First visit here was unbelievable so we came back 3 years later to get married.  Everything was   as good as it was the first time.  They did a fantastic job with the wedding. I want to especially thank Luis at the pool bar. He remembered several of our guests from our group trip 3 years ago..even a few by name. He was there every morning with a huge smile and a great attitude.  Thanks Luis!

reviews.author: DiningInFlorida
reviews.title: The positives outweigh the negatives
reviews.text:
Enjoyed 5 days at this property but it’s fair to say there was very good, good, and not so good.

The Good: 

~Property-Property is beautiful ; lovely setting; gorgeous turquoise and deep blue water. Grounds are nicely manicured and tended to.  The open air atmosphere everywhere is very pleasant.  I really enjoyed the large open air lobby area with full bar and plenty of comfortable seating.  

~Room-Had a lovely, spacious, room facing the ocean. Room was clean.  Bed was comfortable. 

~Food and Drink- Food and drink were plentiful.  There are many restaurants to choose from plus a buffet with an enormous variety for both breakfast and lunch.  I was grateful that I never had a meal that bothered my stomach and I have a sensitive stomach. They had everything you could hope to drink (except that I wish there were a bigger selection of bottled beer).  Smoothies on the beach were delicious. I appreciated that there was plenty of bottled water available.  I also like that there was a dress code at some of the restaurants, as it cuts down on the tacky people who always feel the need to dine in flip flops and sleeveless shirts in a tropical setting.

~Staff-All workers we encountered were either super friendly or at the very least professional.  

~Spa-Spa area was very tranquil and my massage was superb!

~Adult Only Areas-I appreciated the fact that there were adult pools and family friendly pools.  

The Not So Good: 

~”Butlers”-The butler thing sounds like a good idea but…without going into a long drawn out story, the bottom line is that it’s just not a smooth operation and really turned out to be something that only sounded good in theory.  If you like telling your friends that you had a “butler” to cater to your every whim on vacation because it makes you feel like you indulged in some exclusive luxury, so be it.  But in reality, it just made things more complicated.  

~Reservations-The dinner and cabana reservation system is nothing short of a debacle. You were supposed to have your butler make reservations for dinner, as well as reserve your pool or beach cabana. But every day it was a big question mark as to whether or not you actually had a reservation for either. There was almost never a day where it was actually done and smooth.  In the end, I found the whole butler system to be more of a nuisance than a luxury. 
 
~Room Downsides-The semi "open concept" bathrooms are just unfortunate.  I can't understand why anyone would find this appealing. I would venture to guess that most guests would prefer a bathroom area to be private so taking away this creature comfort for the sake of trying to make the room more modern or chic is just silly.  Secondly, the mini fridge kept things slightly cool but not cold. Also, if you are light sensitive like I am, the smoke detector light is pure torture as it is not only brightly illuminated but BLINKS throughout the night. 

~Food/Restaurants-Food ranged from fine to good but never great.  Desserts were all dry and tasteless. When dining at "Rare" steakhouse I was a little put off by the fact that the giant overhead light fixtures above the tables were dirty and filled with dead bugs.  Also, I wish that there were dining areas that took advantage of the beach setting or spectacular view.  Most restaurants are dark, enclosed spaces that could be located in Ohio for all you know when you're in there.  

~Noise-They have a stray cat or two that live on the property that are either sick, starving, or in heat and they made startling noises at night and in the morning, relentlessly yowling, which echoed throughout the courtyard among the rooms.  Finally, and this is a minor complaint but for those of us who treasure a good morning cup a coffee, it's a bummer when the coffee tastes like mud.

~Vendors-While enjoying the beach, we did not go 15 minutes at a time without a visit from one of many very aggressive vendors trying to sell something.  I appreciate their need to make a living but maybe they could all be stationed at a section of the beach to be visited by those who choose to shop because the frequency and aggressiveness was just downright intrusive when you are trying to relax on the beach.

reviews.author: Maydele V
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Had the most amazing time at Paradisus but the highlight was definitely the party groove with dance instructor Raynold Tamayo.  His energy was so engaging and he had lots of patience teaching our group the Latin moves! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: vandutch101
reviews.title: Best Service ever from maids to concierage to bartenders not one person did not greet you with a smile and a good mornng
reviews.text: The room was immaculate with our balcony overlooking the pool area.  The beach was clean and the bartenders extremely accommodating. I had an incident the last day where I needed medical attention, they called the shuttle for me to bring me to the Doctor onsite. unfortunately I had to go to the hospital they had a shuttle bring me back to my room for my passport, he waited for me and when I went back to the Doctor a cab was waiting to bring me to the hospital.  When I came back numerous people on the property were concerned and wanted to make sure I was alright.  Their caring and concern meant a lot to me.  Everything about this resort is wonderful and I would not go anyplace else.

reviews.author: ELENA G
reviews.title: Posto paradisiaco
reviews.text:
Già il posto è splendido di x se, per le istallazioni,x le piscine,x i già dimi ,la spiaggia lunghissima di sabbia bianchissima,ma il Sr Wilamo capo chef fa di tutti i ristoranti un esperienza culinaria da ricordare.

Complimenti a tutti x il loro lavoro

reviews.author: maureengny
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
My trip at the Paradisus Parma Real is always wonderful. Each year I like to recognize the staff members who go above and beyond. Our room service Felix came every morning at the same time with our coffee. He was so pleasant and accommodating. Always asked us if we needed anything to make our stay enjoyable. 
Then every day we had Dionis Ramirez at the beach. He made sure we had chairs and towels. He knew where we liked to sit on the beach and made sure we were all taken care of each morning. Also delivered drinks with a smile. My last staff member to recognize is George Alriche always there by the pool and made sure we had chairs and towels and of course our drinks. We never had to ask for anything he was there before we even looked for him. Thank you to your staff for a wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: John C
reviews.title: Amazing service from George Alriche
reviews.text:
Recently returned from an outstanding week at the Paradisus Palma Real. This is an organization that is all about service, and George Alriche at the club members' pool represents the best of the best. Always cheerful...always helpful...George truly added a special note to an already delightful vacation. Service like this - in stellar resorts - is why we upgraded our membership to Circle.

Bravo!

reviews.author: Molabeille
reviews.title: Endroit magique
reviews.text:
Super hôtel dans un magnifique jardin botanique
Chambre très confortable 
10 restaurants tous différents 
Service irréprochable
Direction très présente 
Allez y les yeux fermés 
Un véritable endroit pour la détente avec tout ce qu'il faut pour les enfants, piscine et animation

reviews.author: Pascal-Vero-B
reviews.title: Magique !!! Hôtel au sein d'un magnifique jardin botanique
reviews.text:
A notre arrivée à la Réserve de l'hôtel Paradisus, un accueil chaleureux, des explications claires pour notre séjour. 
Belle chambre spacieuse avec terrasse, ménage et services irréprochables. 
WIFI gratuit dans les chambres et dans tout le reste du complexe. 
Les transats disponibles sur la plage ou à la piscine à tout moment.

Sans oublier la manager Christelle pour son professionnalisme et sa disponibilité.
Véro & Pascal
Membre du club des abeilles

reviews.author: Jean-Luc L
reviews.title: Un séjour inoublable
reviews.text:
Je voudrai vous dire que nous revenons de cet endroit qui porte bien son nom car c’est vraiment un paradis ... us
D’abord le lieu, situé en bord de plage dans un parc luxuriant 
Des chambres de plus de 35 m2 très bien équipées installées dans des petits bâtiments de 1 étage répartis dans cet énorme végétation très bien entretenue
