Je ne pourrai pas citer tout le monde mais l’équipe du restaurant « le vento » qui s’occupait de nous également au petit déjeuner à été remarquable.
L’équipe du bar de la réserve tous les soirs souriante 
Santos et Ramon du bar de la plage toujours de bonne humeur, disponibles, souriants.
L’équipe des sports toujours prêts à vous défier dans un match de Padel , merci beaucoup à José.
Enfin un tres grand merci au manager, Christelle, française qui plus est et qui a toujours été disponible pour que nous puissions passé de magnifique vacances
Je vous embrasse tous, nous reviendrons 
Jean Luc le bourdon des abeilles

reviews.author: Abdelnour D
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: Genesis Mariano was the best guest concierge. She helped up situate everything from beginning to end. I definitely would recommend her to help with your stay! Ivan Villasmil is the best blue agent. He helped us with all of our excursions from boogies to parasailing to an awesome boat party. He will definitely help make your trip a memorable one! These two made my stay here in the Dominican Republic amazing! I'll definitely be back because of their awesome service!

reviews.author: PGD
reviews.title: Gran hotel!
reviews.text: La experiencia a sido muy buena, Buffet habitaciones, playa, restaurantes para la cena, una pena que el tiempo no acompañará del todo, pero eso no depende del hotel! Lo recomiendo para parejas y familias, pero no para gente joven qe va soltera y busca algo más de movimiento...

reviews.author: orudiskt
reviews.title: Four Adults who paid for Adults Only Royal Service put in Kids Hotel
reviews.text:
Checked in today and I don’t understand how 4 adults who paid for the adults only Royal Service extras were put in an area of the resort without this service.  If I wanted to be surrounded by kids I could’ve stayed home. Taking a shuttle to the adult only section is a total hassle and not a real solution. 

Also, the outdoor restaurant in this hotel was dirty when we arrived today and there were flies everywhere.  

I expected more overall.

reviews.author: Kacie M
reviews.title: Best Girls Weekend
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at Paradisus Palma Real. The staff was very attentive and fun! Highly recommend Royal Service. Ask for Armando, he is the best. He anticipated anything that we may need or want!

reviews.author: islandgirl88
reviews.title: Clean, comfortable but not the greatest beach experience. Really for pool people.
reviews.text: This was my first time to an all inclusive and also first time to the Dominican. The rooms are very spacious and clean. The whole place was very clean. The beach was ok with lots of thatched "umbrellas" and lounge chairs but lots of hawkers except  before 10am bothering you all day. The buffet was ok and the Agua restaurant was the best food wise. There was only one  restaurant (other than the buffet) which was open to the night air which was too bad. I think it was called Fuego. Some of the others had the AC blasting. The staff very pleasant but they failed to mention at check in that one should not drink the tap water. Also the beach while nice was not to compare to Turks and Cayman where the water is also safe. And they do rope you off not far from shore. It's fine but if you really like to swim a bit cramped feeling.  And motor boats passing close to the swim area with para-sailors a lot of the time too. Not the most relaxing beach experience at all.

reviews.author: Javier
reviews.title: Golf torneo Audi Movistar Plus
reviews.text:
Tuve la gran suerte de poder disfrutar de este magnífico hotel durante la disputa del torneo de golf Audi Movistar. Instalaciones 
increíbles, fantásticas.
Felicitar a todo el personal por su gran profesionalidad y su buen hacer. Todo son palabras y gestos amables, y en especial a una persona que me hizo sentir muy bien, siendo en todo momento :amabilidad, dulzura, sonrisa, saber estar y una profesional 10, en el bar del lobby, Yorcaris. 
Felicitar a todo el equipo Melia por las atenciones recibidas.

reviews.author: Frank B
reviews.title: ROYAL SERVICE at PARADISUS PALMA REAL resort,
reviews.text:
Great place, the staff is friendly and helpful  at every turn.
You will be assigned a butler. Ours was Francis Newton, he treated my friends and I like we were family,
Restaurants from buffet to fine dining all had great food.
I will be going back with my family.

reviews.author: Ignaciomazarrasa77
reviews.title: Expectacular
reviews.text: Estuvimos en el royal services y la verdad que fue una maravilla, sobre todo agradecer a Monica por que cualquier duda o consulta que teniamos nos ayudo al momento con sus recomendaciones y pocas veces te encuentras con gente tan profesional en el sector hotelero se nota que disfruta de su trabajo. Volveremos sin duda

reviews.author: Walt_tbay
reviews.title: 10th Annual Golf Trip
reviews.text:
We’re at the end of our 10th annual golf trip staying at the Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service and once again it was a wonderful experience. Yolehvi was our butler and took care of every detail from pool chairs to dinner reservations. He was very accommodating and professional.

We played a warm-up round at Cocotal Golf Club, which is a 27-hole course across the street from the resort. The course was in great shape.  The golf was free, but the golf cart rental was $70 per person.  LOL. We played three rounds at La Cana, which is near the airport. The PGA has a tour stop at its sister course Corales this year. The course is fabulous with many picturesque holes along the sea.  We always hire the same caddies Carlos and Gregory to help us navigate the course.

At the resort, the food is exceptional.  Although all of the restaurants are great, our favourites for dinner are Rare, The Palazzo, and the Winery with Naos being the breakfast and lunch spot.  We noticed that we are among the few guests that leave tips for the staff.  Honestly, a couple of dollars a head at breakfast/lunch and $5 at dinner goes along way towards getting fantastic service.

The courtyard is a great spot to socialize after dinner and have a couple of drinks.  We also spent hours at the craps table and suffered minimal damage.  

The rooms are good and the cleaning staff to a great job keeping things tidy.

The Yhi Spa at the Reserve for a steam bath, aqua therapy and massage is always a highlight.  This year we noted that two of the masseuses assigned to us were blind.  Extra marks to the resort for providing this type of employment opportunity.

All in all, we had a great time and look forward to coming back next year.

reviews.author: Dylan F
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: This place is unbelievable from the grounds of the hotel to the amazing restaurants, but what really made this place special are the employees. They were some of the nicest people I have ever met. Three employees that really stood out were Felix and Luis. Felix and Luis were two of the greatest people I have ever met. They made my friends and I feel like family. They did everything to make us feel at home. They were always asking if we were okay, and they always made sure we had something fun planned for the day. Without them this trip would be nothing but another trip, but they made this one special. I would recommend this hotel to anyone, but not because it is very beautiful, but because of the employees especially Felix and Luis.

reviews.author: L5640NVnancyr
reviews.title: We loved the Royal Service
reviews.text: The Royal Service was amazing along with the staff!  The resort and the beach are beautiful! A must "go to" location!  I would highly recommend going to the Paradisus Palma Real! It's extremely relaxing!

reviews.author: bubba636
reviews.title: Very nice resort for the price, we will be back!
reviews.text:
Traveled Jan14-21 2018, this was our first time at this resort. I will start with the cons as to leave you with the good things. First off, the cons are "picky" and WILL NOT deter us from returning!! We stay in room 3435 which was on the left side of the resort, facing the ocean, behind the restaurant Fuego. Arrived, checked in with no issues. Most of the other resorts we have stayed at offered drinks, little foods, towels when we were checking in, nothing here. We were escorted to our room, bags followed right behind us. We had an issue with the room card reader, our greeter tried different cards twice and the 3rd time I went back to the desk and got new cards. 3rd time was the charm. We tried the safe, no issues. opened the sliding door and the right side metal piece fell off. The greeter called for it to be fixed, within 5 mins a person arrived and fixed it, for the time being anyway. Opened it up the 2nd day, same thing happened so I went to the desk and told them, and the whole trip it was never fixed. In the bathroom we had a dead mosquito with a blood splatter, it was finally wiped off the wall on the 5th day. twice we did not get the bed turned down and once they came to turn it down at 10pm when we were in bed already. On the 6th day, sometime after 3pm, the entire resort lost water. We went up to wash for dinner and found this out. Called the front desk who told us by 6pm it will be fixed, we had 6pm dinner reservations. At about 550 we started to get water, but the hot water did not show up until sometime after 9am the next day. One thing that we got used to, but you may not ... every morning between 4-5 am the "garbage" truck would show up. We heard the back up alarm for the truck, the glass bottles and garbage bags being loaded into the truck and the workers "talking". For this reason alone you might want to request a different building. There is a window over the bed head board that must not be seated correctly in the opening, every night when the wind would blow, the window would rattle and the howl of the wind would come through. We were pretty tired each night and this did not effect us. The bathrooms around the resort could have used a little more timely attention. At times we found it difficult to communicate with some of the people who worked there, as their English was not that good, but we got through it pretty well..... and that is just about all the cons. 

Pro's: the rooms were very nice, a/c worked nice, never used the hot tub or "living or sitting" room in the room, king bed and pillows were nice, bathroom, shower and toilet no complaints. Just a nice room, nothing special. Food, NOTHING AT ALL BAD to say !!! From the breakfast and lunch buffet with plenty to choose from and the dinner restaurants .. the food was top notch!! The servers were very nice, especially Davidson who took care of us each morning!! Always knew I wanted coffee, my wife and friends O.J.. He ALWAYS had a smile, and took a few minutes to talk to us .. he made waking up on vacation that much better !!! Thank you !!! Everything was clean, the outside walk ways were not slippery during our short rain breaks. Unknown to us there was a company trip there and they had about 1400 people, these additional people did not make any difference in any way. We stayed at the main pool during the day, plenty of chairs to sit in and soak up the sun. Everyday we saw workers cleaning the pool. Swim up bar opened at 10am, and the waiters were always walking around asking if you wanted anything to drink. Drinks were good and beer was cold. The swim up bar was the active pool area, there were 2 guys trying to keep everyone busy with dancing, stretching, volleyball, and such. One guy was Felix, great kid, 25 years old, always asking trying to get us up but respectful enough to stop when we told him we were there to relax. He also took some time to talk to us before he got busy, good to know how he thought about Trump, Americans, the hurricane, Haiti, working at the resort. He was a very nice young man !!
We went in the ocean 2-3 times, 1 day was very nice, waves but not bad and no seaweed. The other 2 times there was plenty of seaweed and a little rougher. We live on Long Island and are used to the waves so this was not a problem, as for the seaweed .. not gross just not nice to swim in. Beach was large, pure white sand, plenty of chairs and huts to sit under. It is a public beach so the jewelry, hat, cigar, bag, shopping mall, parasail, jet ski .. etc... people were around and kept asking, even after saying no 2-3 times to the same people. We only stayed a short time on the beach, partly because of this. 
Again, I hope the cons I wrote about do not deter you from going here. They were only minor things to us and we hope to be back sooner then later !!!! Any questions, feel free to email me @ bubba636@optonline.net
Thank you all for making this a relaxing enjoyable vacation !!!!

reviews.author: beachgbr
reviews.title: If you like mice
reviews.text: If you like mice and bugs this is the hotel for you! First night the safe didn’t work and had cockroaches. We had to stay in the room while they worked on the safe so our first night was shot. Second night the mice came. The resort did nothing to resolve any issues they just pretend to not understand or say they are sending someone then no one shows. The spa lost our reservations so we had to pay twice, the spa receptionist was very rude. The WiFi in the rooms doesn’t work. And now we are at home with weird bites and having stomach issues.

reviews.author: mariagallardo95
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: My friends and I decided to take a vacation and we booked a trip and stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana. The service was over the top!! I couldn’t have asked for more. Everyone was friendly and attentive and made sure that our stay was amazing. Raynol made our night out unforgettable. He was hyping up everyone at Gabi Beach Bar and made everyone dance and have a good time. The facilities were all clean and the food was amazing. Specifically, the service by Licelot at breakfast was awesome. She made sure we were enjoying our food and brought us the best coffee ever. Honestly, the hotel was unforgettable and I would definitely recommend everyone to stay here.

reviews.author: Amanda A
reviews.title: I will be coming back
reviews.text: Raynold T.  made our trip a great experience. He informed us from the beginning  of our trip about tons of activities  and nightlife fun.  His friendliness stayed with us along our whole trip and we were able to conversate and enjoy each others company. He made us feel part of the Dominican family  and made the resort our home. My friends and I decided we definitely will be coming back to the resort and country after our AMAZING experience !!!

reviews.author: alohafromjersey
reviews.title: Paradisus = An AMAZING Vacation
reviews.text: This place is AWESOME!! From the friendly staff and the nightly entertainment this place has it all! The bartenders ( Luis Parra and Bladimir Heredia) that work at the hut on the beach are the BEST! 🍹

reviews.author: marchiorileandro
reviews.title: Férias em Punta Cana
reviews.text: Sem explicação esse fds resort. Tudo maravilhoso. Não tenho nada a reclamar . Voltarei com certeza. Funcionários atenciosos, limpeza impecável, boa comida, varias atrações para os hóspedes. Acomodação muito boa, limpeza dos quartos excelentes

reviews.author: Olyaall
reviews.title: Тройка за многое
reviews.text: На самом деле отмечали прошлый Новый год (2016-2017) компанией. Четверо взрослых и двое детей. Но отзыв в прошлом году не разместили из-за слова таракан в номере. Которого мы умудрились привезти домой. Что ж попробуем ещё раз. Минусы начались с заселения. Нам предоставили нормальный номер, нашим друзьям с двумя детьми, которые заказывали luxe- такой же как и нам. После трёх часовых выяснений им все же поменяли номер, однако люксом там и не пахло, а жутко воняло канализацией. Путешествуем много, бываем в разных отелях, от 3-х звёзд и далее. Но здесь пятёрку можно поставить только за еду и за территорию. Уборка не постоянная, практически нужно заставлять прийти убрать номер и поменять полотенца. Не подумайте, чай оставлялся и мы не вредные ))) . По мимо этого постоянный обман и желание содрать денег. Прослеживалось во всем. Заказали яхту на день, оплатили деньги - нам ее не предоставили ссылаясь на какие-то непредвиденные обстоятельства. Деньги вернули с трудом и через несколько дней. На выезде предъявили счёт за никогда не бравшуюся бутылку вина (без нашей подписи на счете, без ничего и учитывая, что весь подобный алкоголь был включён). Обман с такси / так же завышена цена, при гарантированной изначально. И так во всем и везде. В общем отель на трёшку. Из плюсов персонал в зоне ресторанов. Русский представитель (девушка) жирный минус.

reviews.author: Frigg R
reviews.title: Het was een fantastische ervaring!
reviews.text: Samen met mijn vriendinnen daar voor de feestdagen met een upgrade to royal service. Onze persoonlijke butler Nicolas was TOP!!! Deed alles om het naar onze zin te maken. Niets was hem teveel. Ik had daar ook ongelukje en werd volledig in de watten gelegd. Om het half uur vers ijs komen brengen voor mijn been en voet. Iedereen op de hoogte gesteld dat ze goed voor mij moesten zorgen. Toen ik terug naar de luchthaven moest stelde hij zelfs voor om mij te brengen (200km) maar alles was al geregeld met de verzekering zodat ik met een taxi kon gaan. Het was een TOP verblijf!!!

reviews.author: Shoegirlbear
reviews.title: Very nice hotel and awesome staff!
reviews.text: We went for New Years. Upgraded to royal service and our butler NIcolas was awesome!  He made reservation for all our evening dinners in different restaurant. We loved the restaurant passion with chef table. (Which is a extra charge but so worth it). He made arrangements for us the go on the buggies tour. Excellent too! After we return to the hotel from the buggies tour, he had our warm bath ready. And some chocolate strawberries. Very very very nice touch!  We love it! The royal service private pool and beach area has excellent staff as well. Pedro was my favorite. Love his piña colada natural. It is delicious!   Also Carlos, Raffie and Wanda are very friendly at the royal service pool bar.  New Year’s Eve party was excellent. Very well done! We will be back next year for New Years!

reviews.author: Deepak P
reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: When my wife and I arrived at the resort we were originally separated from our group. Marcos at the front counter made sure that we received a room that was close to our group. This resort was exceptional very beautiful and well maintained. The beach is beautiful!

reviews.author: Wayne S
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We found our experience to be absolutely fantastic. We rated the experience as a four only because of the booking and check-in issues we had. The Resort did not have a good line of communication between Melia (parent company) or vice verse. The issue was with payment and as a result the check in process took over an hour. The issue was ultimately resolved and it was all good from there. Our butlers Eduard and Alberto were fantastic with setting up our dinner reservations as well unexpected surprises. A special birthday dinner was also arranged which exceeded any expectation we had set for ourselves. The resort was very clean and well maintained but some construction was noted. We had an ocean view which in all honesty we didn’t really use but it was very nice. The private pool and beach access was also very nice. Carlos and Wanda made sure you never went thirsty. Great service! Beach seemed to be well groomed and very clean sand. The food quality was above average for an All-Inclusive and the Birthday Day dinner was definitely 5 star restaurant quality. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Silvana D
reviews.title: Mala relación calidad-precio
reviews.text: Ambiente del hotel tranquilo pero en general, los empleados no fueron muy atentos, por ejemplo en el buffet tardaban mucho tiempo en traer las bebidas. Sólo se esmeraban cuando pensaban que les iban a dar propina.

reviews.author: Enzo
reviews.title: EXCELENTE EM TUDO
reviews.text: Um hotel muito bom, limpo, ótima comida e atendimento. E ótima relação custo benefício.  Precisei usar o FAMILY CONCIERGE e os funcionários foram muito atenciosos e gostaria de citar os nomes: ELIZABETH PEREZ, DIOSMERY FRANCISCO, GUSTAVO VARGAS E ESFANYA RUIZ.  A eles meu agradecimento

reviews.author: Paco Gomez
reviews.title: NO NOS CANSAMOS DE IR AL PARAISO
reviews.text:
Un año más hemos vuelto a PARADISUS PALMA REAL y sigo sin poder describir lo que se siente estando allí: relax, tranquilidad, trato exquisito, gente encantadora...nada más entrando al hall ya te cambia la cara.
Además ya se está construyendo el hotel para CIRCLE que va a ser ESPECTACULAR (solo para socios); aconsejo que si váis por allí lo visitéis y permitáis que os informen en qué consiste el pertenecer a CIRCLE, si viajas, vale la pena y mucho.
No puedo acabar sin el apartado de agradecimientos.
JOEL: menudo Barman y qué cockteles tan espectaculares.
FRAN, RICHARD, EVELYN y las chicas del spa: el spa es una maravilla y sus masajes son increibles (gracias Evelyn). Y qué decir de Fran y Richard, siempre amables, pendientes del GYM y con unas clases de spinning que hacen que se pase 1h sin que te des cuenta; Fran, eres muy grande.
Mi gente de CIRCLE, Julio Moreno y Carlos San José o viceversa, menudo equipazo...con una calidad humana fuera de lo normal y AMIGOS por encima de todo.
Alberto Mercedes, la excelencia hecha atención al socio, siempre con una sonrisa en la boca, pendiente de que no falte de nada, subiendo y bajando siempre para que tengas todo lo que necesitas y no te falte de nada.
Dionizio, ese gerente de socios que hace que siempre haya algo que te sorprenda con detalles un día sí y otro también; espero verte por Circle.
Gran equipo el de los chicos que te atienden en la playa, gracias Junior por estar pendientes de nosotros y, sobretodo quiero destacar a alguien que para nosotros ya es de la familia: RAUL JIMENEZ, eres un tipo increible y se te quiere un montón.
El tema de agradecimientos puede parecer extenso pero, de verdad os digo que, si tenéis la suerte de visitar PALMA REAL lo entenderéis.

reviews.author: wlsteen
reviews.title: 50th Birthday Bash!!
reviews.text:
We have just concluded our stay here and what a Beautiful Birthday Bash/Anniversary Getaway for cousin and myself and Hubby!! We came as a party of 40 friends and family for my cousins 50th birthday from all over the country and what a beautiful, pleasant, friendly, hospitable destination. 
I read the reviews on the flight down and was a little scared of what we may have encountered upon arrival, but nothing could have been further from the truth. It made me question where those bad review clients could have stayed because it certainly was not the Paradises Palmer. The facility is absolutely gorgeous!!! I know that there are other hotels on the property and wonder if there was confusion as to their actual facility. This place is/was immaculate and gorgeous!!
Check in upon arrival was swift and flawless. Jose at the front desk was amazing and so was Yendi, our bellman. The rooms are beautifully furnished. We were in a junior suite that was gorgeous with a balcony, fully stocked frig and food selections were abundant and delicious. I read the reviews about the food not being good .... definitely not true and we ate at the buffet most days of our 4 day trip. 
There is an advantage if you speak Spanish because we did encounter a few non English speaking employees, but they were all smiles and a pleasure to easily locate someone speaking English. We were in room 1205 that was a hop skip and jump from pool and beach.
Upon sharing that we were also celebrating our anniversary, we were given a bottle of champagne.  3 nights and 4 days were just perfect for enjoying this place and there appeared to be several families on return stays, which was really pleasant to see. 
Jose hooked us up with plenty of excursions from Blue ? Travel 
I simply loved Everything about the Paridisus Palmer and hope to visit again soon.

reviews.author: Allison F
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Just spent 5 days at Paradisius Palma Real in Punta Cana, we selected Royal Service, and this is truly the only way to go, I’ve been here twice before and stayed without the Royal Service, and it was also lovely, but this by far was excellent. Our but,ears Luis Sanchez and Carlos Hinotroza were more than we could ask for, they were at our service and took care of all of our needs.  Wanda Correa the bar tender was fabulous as well, never needed a drink or had to ask, she was at our service all day. It was truly a fabulous vacation, and can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Eli P
reviews.title: Totalmente recomendable
reviews.text:
Estuvimos una semana en este hotel. Y todo fue perfecto. Destaco la atención del personal muy amable en todo momento y simpática, menciono a Raul Jiménez que se encargo que no nos faltara nunca de nada y de hacernos reír.
Por mejorar destacaría la animación nocturna puesto que es muy escasa y mejoraría los snacks entre horas ya que a media tarde no te apetece comer la misma comida que hay para cenar.. 
Por todo lo demás volvería encantada!

reviews.author: Kreese32
reviews.title: Not the resort advertised
reviews.text:
I have to say that there are some positives to the resort. I will start with that as the resort does deserve some credit.

Pros: Landscape is absolutely beautiful as well as the pools. Most of the staff are outstanding and happy to be there. The entertainment was fantastic and full of fun. The food options were good for us as we had a “special” level allowing us to eat at all the restaurants. I would research that prior to booking to ensure you can eat at the restaurants advertised. The maid did a good job cleaning our room each day. The walk to the beach was easy and very beautiful. The security guards did their best to keep the locals away from you as you are trying to enjoy the sun. We had a big room with an amazing view and patio.

Cons: For an all inclusive resort I was extremely disappointed with the room service as well as the “stocked” refrigerator. Upon arrival as our concierge was showing us our room she opened the mini fridge to show us our drinks and it was empty with two opened bottles of soda water. Our snack option included a bag of chips and a mini Oreo pack. We called on multiple occasions to ask for it to be restocked and it never was. We called room service and it was a miracle if they answered the phone. The room service menu was a joke in options. We ordered breakfast one day with room service, waited 2 hours and it never arrived. Our bath tub was a set base with a bath fitters insert so you could pull the tub out if you wanted. It was a bit scary because it moved when you were in the tub as it didn’t fit properly. We had made spa appointments and they didn’t have us down upon arrival (we did work this out and get a massage). If you go to the spa don’t forget your swimsuit as most of the amenities were coed (we had no idea so didn’t get to enjoy them). They did not use premium liquor. I asked for Grey Goose on multiple occasions to be told it was extra. Our table on our patio was not even on the base or the top. We didn’t know that an attempted a evening on the patio and everything spilt once we placed our items on it due to balance. They work really hard at trying to get you to write a positive trip advisor review in front of them saying it is a contest. We declined as we use this for traveling purposes and would never recommend to anyone.

In conclusion at the price point I hate to say that I would not go back nor send anyone there. There were some great people but they couldn’t make up for all the things that went wrong. Not stocking a mini fridge to me the entire 6 day stay as well as not giving us any snacks that are advertised in the room seems unacceptable. I could understand if we hadn’t told them the first day however we asked them repeatedly to please refill. Hope this helps someone.

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Excellent personalized service from check in to check out
reviews.text: Jose Salvador checked us into our room, supplied us with any type of alcohol, juices, beer, water, and snacks that we needed for our room, and then checked on us every day to see if we needed anything.  He made sure I had the WhatsApp app so he could text me to check, so it was easier.  He surprised us and fixed our jacuzi tub with hot water, bubbles and balloons!  It was so sweet and a nice surprise to come back to our room after a full day on an excursion.    He also got the taxi driver to come back (and he was from Porto Plata, 4 hours away) to bring my jacket that I left in the trunk when he took me to the airport and the stupid airport guy took my bag out but left my jacket, and then I realized it, two seconds after the taxi left and I couldn't do anything.  He got the jacket, and put it in my suite for my friend to take home for me.  The breakfasts were also good, excellent food and service.  At the main hotel, the only bad thing was their ATM broke, and when I went to the front desk to get cash, the guy was on a break and I couldn't sit around and wait for him to come back b/c I had a plane to catch.  But the shuttle guy took me to the plaza to the ATM so that was nice.  Loved that place!

reviews.author: MaineAlice
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text:
Had a nice visit at the Paradisus Palma Real.
The resort is rather lovely a lot of property. 
We were away Celebrating our Birthdays. 
The rooms are nothing to rave about kinda old looking. It was low season and we thought we would of been upgraded since the hotel felt like it was extremely empty. Our room was far from main area. Lots of walking!! 
I was not impressed with the restaurants that were included in our package. The buffet breakfast was the only one that was good. Since the Italian restaurant was closed they allowed us free of charge to go to the Italian restaurant that’s part of the reserve. That was really good.
They also have a french restaurant but only if your willing to pay an up charge or are staying at the reserve can u dine at Passions. 
They really need to improve on the restaurants that are included in all inclusive.
One other thing the gym is awful! Old machines and not somewhere you would want to work out!
All that being said we had a good stay.
The staff are so accommodating and so friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Pablo G
reviews.title: Muito bom
reviews.text: Estivemos em novembro durante uma semana e gostamos muito do hotel as acomodações são boas, a comida é muito boa especialmente os buffet os la carte achei mais ou menos. Os funcionarios são bem atenciosos, especialmente Germania, Sandra e Jhonatam alem de Emilio na praia.

reviews.author: Duchess329
reviews.title: Graduation/Birthday Trip
reviews.text:
As a gift for my niece's college graduation this year, we took a girls trip to celebrate.  My closest friend, who was celebrating a birthday that week, came along.  We booked directly with the hotel, getting the 2 BR suite on the ground floor for the end of October/beginning of November.

Pulling up to the hotel is breathtaking.  From the open air lobby, you are treated to a beautiful ocean view.  Check in was relatively quick, and as our bags were delivered to the room, we were escorted to our suite by a lovely woman from guest services, who gave us the lay of land as we walked.    Once we arrived, the room on the 3rd floow was stifling hot, so she adjusted the AC.  After waiting 20 minutes with no relief, we called the front desk to see about changing rooms.  They instead sent a maintenance man to try to fix the issue.  While waiting for him, we discovered that there was an issue with the fan in the freezer that made it sound as if there were a bird of a hampster wheel.   While he was able to fix the freezer, he banged around on the AC vents and told us it was just 'slow', and to wait 15 minutes.  As we waited, there was a complete power outage at the resort.  Calling back to inquire about this latest set-back, Gustavo assured us the power would return shortly.  We asked them to send the maintenance man back because the 'slow' AC was still not working, and to again request another room.  We were told that they were sold out (a convention at the hotel) and could not provide us with the same room category for 2 days.  They couldn't even provide us with any room until the following afternoon. 

Resigned to our fate, we showered and ventured out to dinner.  Determined to make the best of the situation despite the inconvenience, we were able to find the buffet still servicing dinner.  Our waiters, Yasoney and Nathaniel, could not have been more welcoming or helpful.  Yasoney seemed to be truly distressed about our room situation and promised to call guest services to see if he could assist.     He was very excited to come back to report exactly what we had already been told - we could have a new room - tomorrow.  But the room we booked would not be ready for 2 days.   We had a nice dinner and walked around a bit, had some drinks, but part of the resort was closed for the wedding.

We did move late afternoon on our first full day, and again the next afternoon to our final destination.  Everything was operable, most importantly the AC.   While this was a tremendous hassle, living out of our suitcases for 3 days and taking time away to move, we were more centrally located.  While we were close to the construction near Gabi beach, once you were up and about, it really wasn't an issue.     

On our first full day (before the numerous room changes) we headed to the beach.  It was as beautiful as it was pulling up the day before.  We were greeted by Obeidy "Primo" Rodriquez, who immediately set up a palapa close to the beach, spread out our towels and took our drink order.  He asked us our names, and became our 'Primo' amigo on the beach for the duration of our stay.   Every morning we were greeted by name, given extra towels, and were set up in a prime location on the beach.  When we moved to the pool in the late afternoon, he helped us break camp and set up in an area with both shade and sun.  He truly pampered us throughout our stay.

All of our breakfasts/lunches were had in the buffet. There was always something for everyone and in addition to Yasoney and Nathaniel, both Jose and Jorge took care of us on a daily basis - remembering our names, drink and coffee orders, etc.    

We did make reservations at 4 of the restaurants, and all were fine.   We went to the steakhouse twice (first time it appeared they were overbooked and service was slooow), but the food was great.  We also went to the Italian restaurant, but they neglected to tell us they had to drive us to the other area of the resort in a golf cart, so we had to run to make our reservation.  But again, the food was great and the wait staff fun and attentive.  We did go to Fuego one night, and the food was OK.  it was basically the buffet with service.

We went through the casino one night, and spent a little bit of time there.  It was small, and not crowded.   After killing some time, we all about broke even and left.  It was more for the slots crowd - there was no action at any of the tables.

We did go for massages to the spa one afternoon and it was great.  Very calming in a quiet area of the resort.    

We checked out the activities/tour desk and had fun talking with the team, but didn't book any excursions.  

We never made it to the disco or the shows - bad timing with dinner reservations - so spent most of our nights at the Gabi Beach bar.   We had a blast - until the bartender wanted to charge my niece $18 for a shot.  WHAT?   She had one earlier at dinner, no problem.  Now they were charging for drinks?  Sorry, but all inclusive should be all inclusive.  She wasn't looking for bottle service.  She was asking for one shot.  I don't know if it was that particularly bartender, but we went back the next night and was given a shot.  No charge.  As it should be.  The same bartender that wanted to charge my niece also put alcohol in my friend's drink, when for 3 nights she had explicitly told him that she didn't drink.   She was able to spit it out, but that was bad.

I don't know if it is normally slow at that time of year, but this wasn't really a big 'party' resort.   There seemed to be a lot of activity, with conventions and weddings, but never really felt crowded.  And best of all, you never had to get up at the crack of dawn to claim a beach chair.  

All that said, we did have a great time.  We relaxed, ate, drank, laughed and just enjoyed ourselves.  Yes, the room changing was a pain in the neck (but really not uncommon in my experience), the charges for alcohol was ridiculous, but the great staff that they do have made up for those annoyances.

reviews.author: Find Trou Techn... A
reviews.title: Maravilloso Hotel
reviews.text:
Estuvimos de visita solo un rato me encanto los detalles las vistas la atención del personal todo exquisito.  
Me pareció un Hotel maravilloso donde se cuida cada detalle.  
Quizás por decir alguna cosa que creo que le faltaba un poco de Animacion   
No puedo opinar más por qué no nos alojamos allí solo fuimos de paso un ratito.  
Pero los detalles y el personal me parecieron exquisitos.

reviews.author: Marta J
reviews.title: Bueno con peros
reviews.text:
después de una semana en el Paradisus Palma Real y mi cuarta vez en la República Dominicana me llevo la impresión de qué he estado más que en Punta Cana,la sensación de poder  haber estado en cualquier hotel de Noruega o Suecia Dinamarca pero con sol. Si ,es un hotel muy lujoso ,todas las instalaciones son maravillosas unos jardines muy bien cuidados una piscina espectacular encima del mar, unos restaurantes en los que se come de maravilla ,la comida, toda riquísimo ,todo perfecto la gente muy amable muy educada pero en mi opinión la esencia Dominicana no está presente en este hotel :carece de música, esas bachatas merengues ,esa salsa a la que estamos acostumbrados los que visitamos la República Dominicana en este hotel brilla por su ausencia, el bar de la piscina suena un poco de música pero tan  suave que en la playa apenas se escucha ,ya sé que todos que venimos a República Dominicana venimos buscando descanso pero también venimos buscando fiesta, alegría ,y ese carisma que hace de Dominicana un destino perfecto para unas fantásticas vacaciones.Este hotel carece de todo eso. A las 23 el hotel está casi desierto la música no suena ,el piano bar ,el lobby bar majestuoso ,grandioso tiene una luz tenue que lo único que te incita es a irte a tu habitación a dormir, posee un piano en el que no hay ningún pianista y en el que tú lógicamente tampoco  puedes tocar, la discoteca a la una de la mañana apaga la música , . Los bares que tiene el hotel si te sirven lo que tú le pidas, pero no disponen de cartas de cócteles ,ni de copas ni de cafés, tienes que armarte de paciencia y acordarte del nombre de algún cóctel para que te lo preparen. ellos nunca te lo van a ofrecer, es más por tener no tiene ni a la vista del cliente las  botellas, si quieres un ron especial lo tienes que pedir si quieres un cóctel lo tienes que pedir ellos no te lo van a ofrecer . Carecen de ceniceros por todo el hotel Hotel de fumadores en el que no se puede fumar! tienes que estar todo el rato pidiendo ceniceros en los bares, en los restaurantes, o sino hacer un poco el guarro y tirar las colillas al suelo cosa que no es mi caso; iba todo el día cargando con una botella de plástico con agua para poder tirar las colillas, igual que las papeleras ,si quieres tirar un papel o te lo comes o te recorres todo el complejo para encontrar una papelera,. Me llamó la atención los carteles de prohibido cañitas o pajitas para beber supuestamente me imagino que será por el tema del reciclaje pero si tú te pides un mojito y no te ponen una cañita o pajita como les llamen ya me puede explicar usted cómo se lo va a beber...en fin... La animación también brilla por su ausencia ,si ,te puedes hacer una clase de yoga o de pilates o de taller de velas ,taller de pintura ,pero en realidad no se dejan ver mucho ni te ofrecen actividades, si quieres hacer algo búscate la vida, ellos no te van a venir a buscar y no se van a molestar mucho en ofrecertelo . Me parece un buen sistema para la gente que busque relax ,tranquilidad, descanso ,ir a jugar al golf todo el día porque tiene unos campos de golf maravillosos y después, cenar ,acostarse y a dormir toda la noche como angelitos; pero si usted realmente está ofreciendo eso lo que debe de haceres  venderlo como un hotel de relax no como un hotel de Punta Cana cualquiera porque yo realmente he venido decepcionada en mi cuarta vez de República Dominicana.La persona l
 que me acompañaba era su primera vez y no le han quedado ningunas ganas de volver, se ha llevado un concepto equivocado de lo que realmente es viajar a  República Dominicana ,por eso le digo señor director del hotel ,que si su enfoque se dirige a esta clase de cliente lo que debería de hacer es venderlo y no engañar a la gente porque yo seguiré visitando República Dominicana pero no volveré a visitar ese hotel por muy bonito y maravilloso que sea. Aparte de todas mis críticas sólo decir qué ha sido una buena estadía me ha recibido muy bien todo el mundo han sido muy amable  todos,aunque se veía que estaban bastante no  reprimidos pero si muy  secos y lejanos con el cliente.Mencion especial para Antonio del lobby bar que me alegraba el día con sus deliciosos cafés en la mañana,su compañera de la tarde que no me acuerdo de su nombre,nos preparaba unos cócteles estupendos, Daniel en la piscina y en la playa muy atento.  también he conocido a la señora  María Patiño que a pesar de llevar pocos días en el hotel  nos trató muy cordialmente y con una gran profesionalidad .Un saludo y espero que tengan suerte en su nueva aventura.

reviews.author: Life as V
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text:
Recently, I traveled with my family to Punta Cana in Dominican Republic. The name of our resort was Paradisus Palma Real. It is an excellent resort. The staff is very friendly and teaches tourists a few words and songs in Spanish. The Resort is near the beach and the water is so clear. Different activities are provided near the beach such as riding banana boats, parasailing, swimming with dolphins and kayaking. There is a buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner and the food is amazing as well as unique. Each night, there is a different theme for dinner. Japanese night was my favorite. The sights outside of the resort are amazing too. Riding a golf cart to the kids club which was a few blocks away from the resort was a fun experience. The Kid's club was fun for toddlers and teenagers and movies, food and sports were provided. Also, the resort has many activities you can sign up for outside of the resort. Buggy riding in the mud is something I will never forget. The hotel rooms were spacious and clean. The pools were clean and the weather was amazing. If you are looking for a hotel to stay in Punta Cana, Paradisus Palma Real is really paradise.
​

reviews.author: 322happytraveler
reviews.title: Beautiful Vacation
reviews.text: Paddlebaord Yoga was an awesome experience our instructors were Franklin, Miguel, and Stephan - it was a lot of fun. Yoga on the beach was awesome too! I would definitely visit here again- the beaches were beautiful and the staff was wonderful!

reviews.author: Elyssa78
reviews.title: LOCK UP YOUR VALUABLES!!!
reviews.text:
Despite being a beautiful resort, there is a lot of ugliness behind the scenes. The servers, bartenders and entertainment crew are literally the best I've ever experienced but on my first day, the housekeeper entered my room during an evening turn-down service and stole more than $550 out of my wallet...leaving me with $7!!! The guest services management (Vladamir, Domingo and Malin) led me on everyday during my short stay that this was being investigated and the housekeeper was being interrogated but I came to conclude that they were just stalling until my check out date. They were able to show me a key-card report that only showed the housekeeper entering my room between the time i checked in and the time I reported it the next morning when I woke up to buy sunscreen. I had my money when I tipped the driver that brought me there...the next morning it was gone. Once home, and after calling and emailing multiple times, I finally received an email stating it was my own fault for not having it locked in the safe. The only reason it wasn't in the safe yet was because the front desk was going to be switching our room the next morning to be closer to friends we came with so i didn't even bother unpacking yet. Also, a turn-down service was not explained and I had no idea anyone would be coming in that evening. They claim all valuable should be put in the safe, but their safes are not big enough for even an IPad! 
Also while we were there, we witnessed two waiters pushing and shoving each other in one of their restaurants which was a little unsettling. After reporting that to the above mentioned guest services people as well, they did nothing about that either. 
I have since emailed their corporate offices as well as the hotel manager and no one has even tried to offering me any restitution for my stolen property or terrible service i experienced...not even simply an offer for a free night if I were to choose to come there again!
I am of the impression that they think we are rich spoiled americans and that the money we spend to come to their establishment is just a drop in the bucket for us. I've never in my life been more insulted and made to feel so taken advantage of then I did with this resort. I feel sorry for all those other great employees that I did encounter because all I wanted to be able to do was give them I nice tip at the end of my stay and because my money was stolen I could not.

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: Friends and fun!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real has been a great resort for our group trip (15 people including 7 kids) this year! The resort itself is beautiful, although there is quite a bit of construction going on presently.  The pool is massive, giving the kids plenty of room to explore.  The pool is very deep most of the way around, so that’s definitely something to keep an eye on!  The staff at the pool bar are so welcoming and happy!  Singing and dancing while making some really yummy drinks!  
The buffet is just ok, the original location is under construction so it is moved elsewhere for now, but the food lacked something for the kids.  
The restaurants that require a reservation are fantastic and you do not leave hungry!  We did Vento (Mediterranean ) and it was delicious!  The desserts were amazing too! 
Bana was the kids favorite!  Hibachi is always a winner with these kids!  
The activities staff is so helpful and engaging (especially “Shakey Shakey”!!!!!!  The kids loved him!). The nighttime shows are so much fun!  
The room is beautiful, with the bathroom area that has both a jacuzzi tub, a shower and a separate water closet.  We had a king sized bed, a seating area with a pull out couch and a porch with a lovely garden view.  
We are very much enjoying our time here at Paradisus.  Hoping to return in the future!

reviews.author: Mfp_getaways
reviews.title: Beach Relaxing and Golf
reviews.text: Nice Hotel , Friendly Staff ,Food and drinks above Average , Grounds are well kept and pools are nice , Wanda at the Beach Hut bar was the best Waitress , when at a dinner ask for the wine menu without the expensive bottles , they have some excellent wines at no extra cost

reviews.author: Gail S
reviews.title: Ugh!!!!
reviews.text:
Ok. Here goes.  This is like no because I want you to understand the poor rating.  

We went with friends who have a special type of “vacation” club to this resort.  They purchased over 200 Resort nights in advance and only need to pay the “all inclusive” fee.

They have used over 50 nights in past the 3 years bringing family and friends and have always been extremely happy with service and resort amenities.

Well they gave us 5 nights and then we were to pay the all inclusive rate for those nights to join them on vacation. Then we were adding 6 more nights on our own. But.  We got room and all inclusive rates for the same amount of $$ that we had to pay for the all inclusive rate on another website. So we told them about this.  What a total rip off this “deal” was. We tried to give our friends back their days but were not able to but they at least got some discount to amend the rip off all inclusive rate. 

Now we get there and our friends realized we are at the wrong resort.  They preferred the Paradisus Palma Real. Not Punta Cana.  Well after asking to be moved as soon as we got there and agreeing to pay the increase in the all inclusive fee.  Guess what.  Two plus days of excuses and more and “we are working on it.”  Etc.  our friend contacted everyone in the resort who should have been able to do this easily.  No one had the smarts to call corporate. Finally our friend did just that.  Guess what.  We are moved within the hour.  No problem.  Hope you enjoy the new resort.   We want you to be happy. This took 2 1/2 days.  The new resort is lovely we are having a great time

 

Here are more reasons we were happy to be moving. 

The hotel was doing major renovations in the buffet and around the resort.  Breaking the peaceful Caribbean atmosphere with the noise of power equipment as well as trucks and equipment driving along the walking paths.   

Communication was a joke.   No one knew anything.  We were never given activity schedules though we were told they were in our rooms, NOT!  We asked for copies of these and told they could not make copies, at the gym an attendant showed us the schedule but could not make copies we finally photoed the schedule and had it on our cell phones. 

The electric kept going out. Causing loss of air conditioning as well as refrigeration.  Lights along paths out. Etc.  off and on.  Apparently this problem was ongoing as we read about it in previous trip Advisor articles

There were dirty dishes and glasses sitting outside our rooms for 2 days before being cleaned up. 

Once electric back on our air conditioner would not work.  We called 3 times over 2 1/2 hours.   No one came in spite of promises and promises 
Our friends finally suggested turning off everything and then turning back on.  Which worked like rebooting a computer. So we called and said don’t send anyone it works now.   Then  20 minutes later a maintenance worker shows up.  
 
We were given dinner reservations in the Winery.  Told that although they try to sell up market wine you can have house wine NOT. When we got there we were told we had to purchase a bottle of wine per couple. We were ready to leave and go to the buffet but once the manager at this place realized we were not told about the place he let us stay and drink the bottle of Proseco we were given when we arrived. The manager invited us to a free wine tasting the next evening at 6 pm.  So we got ready, got there on time.  Wait for it...... to be told it was at 5 not 6 like the four of us were told.  Soooo screwed up. Luckily we got moved that evening and by 7 were in a cab to the nicer resort. 

Well. I guess that is enough. The resort is old. Not updated  and just tired looking. Staff not trained in customer service and management does not care or just don’t know,  I actually felt bad for staff because they took brunt of our displeasure but were not adequately trained 

So don’t waste your $$. It is not worth it.  Spend a little more and go to the Palma Real.  MUCH BETTER.  Nicer rooms. No electric issues. Staff very customer service oriented. Worth the little extra $$

Go to Paradisus Palma Real. A real 5.

reviews.author: mrlgator
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here
reviews.text: The most unprofessional hotel. Booked a room in March, paid in full, non refundable rate. Check in was fine, when I checked out of my room the front desk told us that we needed to pay for the room AGAIN because they made a mistake on the room rate. They held us hostage and refused to let us leave the hotel until we paid for the room a second time.  If the hotel made a mistake call us in advance and let us cancel our room before we fly thousands of miles.  They pretty much shook us down.

reviews.author: Ralphers
reviews.title: Extortion!
reviews.text: We visited this hotel with a large group of friends for a wedding. We all booked our hotel rooms at least 2 months prior to wedding. We paid in full a non refundable rate. Have an email confirmation saying it's paid in full. About a week before the wedding, all of our friends got phone calls from the hotel saying their website made a mistake and that we owed them more money (an extra 90$ per night). None of us were okay with this so we didn't pay any more money. When we checked into the hotel, nothing was brought up to the guests. However, 2 nights later, on the night of rehearsal dinner, they sent us an urgent letter saying we had to come down to reception. Nobody went down, as we knew they were just trying to collect more money from us. Well, the morning we were all flying home, the hotel told us we couldn't leave the hotel until we all paid them more money. They basically held us hostage (wouldn't give us checkout card that allowed us to get in a taxi to leave) until we paid them more money. We had no choice, and this is clearly extortion. If their website made an error, how is this our fault? We were told we paid in full. Very disappointed in how this large hotel chain could do this to at least 20 guests. For this reason (and others) I would not recommend this hotel. Save yourself the trouble of dealing with "men" like Wally who shake down guests while trying to enjoy a friends wedding. Disgraceful. I would avoid this hotel chain completely.

reviews.author: Traveler1
reviews.title: Will never come back here
reviews.text: I am one that reads a lot of reviews and understand some people have different experiences.  In my case, I was duped by a non US company and I think you all should know to stay away.  I booked my room online and paid in full for my reservation.  I had my receipt and all that said “paid in full.”  When I arrived, they told me this was only a 50% deposit and I owed another half.  No one would read my email or listen to me, all they wanted was my credit card.  There was nothing I can do, so I gave it to them and tried to enjoy my stay.  I have some positive things to say but I’m not because they ruined it.  This is total extortion and I will never return.  Go somewhere else or at least an American company who understands how things run.  Attached are some fun things I found in my room.  Not worth the expensive price paid.  Bug on bed, dirty sheet, someone’s leftover coffee grounds, ripped carpet, and patchy water damaged roof.  These people should be ashamed of themselves.  Spend your money elsewhere, please!!

reviews.author: Victoria O
reviews.title: Best Resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: My girlfriends and I take an annual trip each year.  This was our second time staying at the Paradisus Palma Real resort and once again it did not disappoint!  The rooms are very nice, the beach and the pools are spectacular. All the staff is very friendly.  We booked Royal Service this time and it was absolutely worth the extra money!  My butler, Alberto made it so I had nothing to do the entire week but relax. I will definitely request him the next time we come.  One more special shoutout goes out to “Looky Looky” This guy is such a talented entertainer but also a very nice person.  His Zumba classes are better than any I’ve ever seen in the states.  Let me tell you this guy can move!  But most of all he makes it fun and he’s so sweet that when you leave you’ll want to take him home with you.  If you’re going to Punta Cana, stay here!  You’ll love it!

Two areas to improve- get rid of the seaweed on the beach and try to keep the floors from being slippery when it rains!

reviews.author: eggness
reviews.title: Exclusive Beach paradise
reviews.text:
An idyllic getaway, the Paradisus Palma Real will take your breath away from the moment you walk through the hotel lobby with its view of the pool, fountains and beach. 

Firstly, I highly recommend upgrading to Royal Service for a worry-free experience. With our personal butler, we were given a dedicated mobile to call him, whenever and for whatever! Jose Salvador was brilliant - knowledgeable, attuned to our every need, friendly and engaging, even leaving us surprise cheese platters or chocolate plates in our room, always available and super efficient.  

The Royal service rooms had the beach practically on our doorstep, a private beach and exclusive pool area, great staff, there was Martin always smiling and keeping us comfortable. The bartenders were great with their delicious cocktails, always keeping them coming. Rooms were huge, clean, modern and had a large balcony overlooking the gardens. Loved the beach area, very quiet, not overrun with other tourists or kids. The only downside was the seaweed that ran amok (which I'd read about in previous reviews so I wasn't surprised). We were there in between Hurrican Irma and Maria (phew! dodged the big ones), but otherwise enjoyed spending time in the waters. 

For 4 days, we rarely stepped out of the hotel thanks to the sheer number of activities on offer. We had fun with pool yoga, salsa & bachata dance classes, zumba, evening shows, poolside bars. Dance and zumba was super fun with lively energised coaches that had us dancing and feeling like pros in no time. Parasailing is also on offer at the hotel, it's an experience you don't want to miss. But avoid the vendors who approach you on the beach, just ask your butler to guide you to the official vendor, who have higher standards of safety, and yes, you can bargain down the prices too. 

The hotel drowned us in unending supplies of drinks, cocktails, food and fresh tropical fruits, which were all delicious. Thanks to our butler, Jose's forethought, we were booked every night at the top restaurants, we particularly enjoyed the Hibachi grill and dining Italian at Palazzo (shout out to Richard, very friendly service). Royal service guests have exclusive access to breakfast at Palazzo, which is great if you want to avoid the crowds, but the buffet selection is limited so we preferred going to the common breakfast place which had a far wider selection. 

When we were picked up at the hotel for a yacht excursion, the guests on the bus waiting for us were stunned by this gorgeous hotel and a couple of them cancelled their own hotel stays, to rebook at the Paradisus Palma Real, they even thanked us for it (we did nothing lol!). 

Overall, this hotel is stunning and will definitely relax and rejuvenate your senses. You will leave feeling refreshed and loved. Must give due praise to the people - the staff throughout the hotel were friendly, genuine and warm. They reflected the kindness of Dominicans, while treating us like royalty but without pretentiousness. Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: JackieAnnT21
reviews.title: Lordco 2017
reviews.text: Excellent resort and the staff were exceptional! Our Butler, Faustino went above and beyond and made our stay that much more welcoming. Carlos Rosario made our pool time amazing.... always taking care of us and ensuring we were all having an enjoyable time. Entertainment was awesome thanks to Shaky Shaky, Happy Boy, Angel, Looky Looky and all the other wonderful staff. Pamela (towel staff) was always friendly and helpful.  Food was delicious at all the buffets and restaurants, and the beaches and pools were gorgeous and well maintained. We golfed a lot and can't say enough about the gorgeous courses and hard working Caddies. Thank you to all the staff - you all certainly know how to treat us well. Your resort is the best we have ever been to, and we highly recommend it to everyone.

reviews.author: BKTaylor17
reviews.title: first time at all inclusive
reviews.text:
First time in All-inclusive

We holiday every year and have never experienced an All-Inclusive - The resort is beautiful however the grounds/pool need some attention, the restaurants were decent with a variety of cuisine and the beach was spectacular!! The best part of our trip was the hotel staff - we met a variety of friendly happy people who always willing to make us feel welcome. A shout out to Luis at Naos who always had a smile on his face - super friendly - a BIG shout out to Felix at Olio - we dined there and Felix was our server - the best service ever!!! Thank you to all the staff made us feel welcome on our first trip to the DR.

reviews.author: kleake88
reviews.title: Lordco Trip 2017
reviews.text: We have nothing but wonderful things to say about this resort and vacation.  Beautiful location, amazing amenities, friendly staff and delicious food!  The resort is immaculate with attention being paid to keeping it that way always.  The staff bent over backwards for our group to make sure we were all comfortable and had what we needed.  Entertainment was never dull.  Nicolas, our butler, was there for all of our needs or requests and then some.  Even if we didn't ask for it, he had it there for us.  I would definitely recommend this resort and would go back in a heart beat as well!

reviews.author: mymeka
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation!
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Paradisus was a wonderful girls / friends get-away.  Plenty to do.  Large pool.  Great drinks/bartenders.  Lots of activities and nightly entertainment.  We moved here from Paradisus (another review, horrible room), and were very pleased with our vacation.

Shout out to Jonathon around the pool for his wonderful "signature" drinks and his infectious smile.  Germania Jose for her continual enthusiasm, Luis Florian for entertaining us daily, Emilia, who was a wonderfully warm waitress, and Chef Miguel Deano, who went above and beyond, making our experience even better!

reviews.author: Bri H
reviews.title: Lordco 2017
reviews.text:
We were here for 9 glorious days! Everything was exceptional and above par!! Right from the food to the booze to the service! 5 star the whole way!!! 

A huge shout out to Carlos H our butler who went above and beyond for us in every way! Carlos, thank you so, so very much!  And Wanda, the BEST bartender EVER!!! I will forever miss those "Wanda Specials", as they were to die for!!! All the staff were superb and super friendly! 

I can't wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Ron M
reviews.title: Wow what a great resort
reviews.text: i stayed in room 6020 had the worlds best Butler ask for her if you go there her name was Claury  Carela  did lots for me got us into the best restaurants really looked after us set us up with the best guy at the pool bar as well his name was Raul. One thing we enjoyed was our time at the Spa we were there quite regularly so if you want a deep message ask for Eudys L best massage ever and i mean ever call Yraima (she's the manager and has best english)at the spa she will set you up all great to deal with my wife had a lady named Wendy she was good as well cant wait for our return visit. And go to the Rare steak house see Johnny. Claury will arrange he's a waiter that gets it. i went there twice they have great grade A steaks and the best Lobster. Tell him you want a large its like 17 ounces. At his suggestion i got the 10 ounce ribeye covered with onion rings and the lobster with A1 steak sauce pretty darn good. Good food for the ladies as well. But trust me it all Starts with Claury she will probably be a manager soon but like i say ask for her and you will see she will set it up for you she takes all the stress out of your trip she gets it and great english. Even if you are booking i would call and ask for her. She will give you the straight goods on the best rooms restaurants etc. The best way i can explain it is she reminds me a lot of having a good casino host at Las Vegas

reviews.author: Sid K
reviews.title: Had a great time

The beaches are the best I have ever seen in the Caribbean the food was good but not great with the exception of the beach BBQ and the breakfast buffet. They were great. The beach staff are incredible our favourites were Ravel and Junior. But all were outstanding. Golf was very good. The course condition was great especially since hurricane Maria hit the week before we arrived. We don't normally go to all inclusive resorts but would recommend paradisus.

reviews.text: It was a great group trip with all friend and family, we did many activities and enjoy ourself every second! I can not thanks enough to the employees from the hotel. reviews.title: People/staff are great. Few issues with the room but fixed promptly.
