reviews.author: K I
reviews.title: Es hat gelungen
reviews.text: Einfach hammer hotel  sehr empfehlswert. Personal top. Sehr freundlicj sehr professionell. Würde kmmerwieder gerne hin. Müsste leider nach 3 tage wieder zurück, aber ein echter Abenteuer hotel. Sehr sehr zufrieden.

reviews.author: Svetlana S
reviews.title: Schönes Hotel
reviews.text:
Eine sehr schöne Hotel Anlage mit ein paar Abstriche. Im großen und ganzen wir hatten einen schönen Urlaub. Die Hotel Anlage hat einen wunderschönen Garten, schönen Strand, viele Restaurants und coole Bars. Gute Unterhaltung am Abend und 
sehr nettes Personal. Besonders vielen Dank möchten wir sagen an Ramon Ramirez der immer sehr lustig war und herzlich um uns gekümmert hat, Willi und Benita die beste Cocktail gemacht haben. 
Einzige was nicht gut funktioniert hat, wir haben nie Informationen über Tagesablauf bekommen, das ging hier nur durch die Mundpropaganda.

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Amazing and gorgeous!
reviews.text: Don't listen to all of the negative reviews.  I was just here 9/14 - 9/18 and it was amazing.  The resort is clean, staff was friendly, the food was great!  It is hard to get a reservation at the restaurants, you have to reserve the day before, but the buffet is always available and it is really good.  The pool is very clean and you can see them cleaning it if you get up early enough.  Our room was spotless and the mini bar was always stocked with what we asked for.  Some things do need some cosmetic work but it isn't anything major.  It is not a party type of resort, it is more for couples looking for a romantic getaway.  We went for a friend's wedding and they did a great job with the ceremony.  Also, I tried to ship some things home and FedEx was giving me problems and guest services is still working with me to get it resolved (and I'm not even a guest anymore).

reviews.author: Jonathan V
reviews.title: Nuestra estadía de 6 dias
reviews.text: Para comenzar queremos felicitar al hotel ya que nuestra estadía fue más que fantástica en este hotel, la infraestructura muy buena y el personal muy amable y siempre predispuesto a ayudarte! Se me vienen los nombres de claudia Garcia  del equipo de concierge que nos ayudó en todas las actividades que tuvimos, a Amelia de gabi club que desde el primer día nos atendió con mucha amabilidad y una gran sonrisa, a Germanía y a "Capuccino" del equipo de animación. Desde el check in nos hicieron sentir en casa y bien atendidos! Nuestras reservas en Bana y Fuego estuvieron muy bien, pero si tuviéramos que recomendar a ojos cerrados lo haríamos con Fuego! Como puntos de mejora creo que el servicio de transporte debe mejorar, casi perdemos una reserva por esperar los carritos que demoraban mucho a nuestro parecer. Así como el de recojo de maletas, tuvimos unos inconvenientes en nuestro check out. La música de la discoteca  debe ser más variada y el servicio de snack en la piscina the reserve podrían ser un pocos más amables. Definitivamente se merecen como puntuación excelente ya que dejando de lado algunos inconvenientes, en general el servicio de concierge, bar, room Service, transporte, comida y playa son excelentes!

reviews.author: pammydd2017
reviews.title: Great vacation - Royal Service is a must
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus from 9/8-12. Thank God the hurricane missed this part of the island. We had Royal Service which we felt was worth the extra money. Our butler, Argenis Romero, was fantastic. He took care of all our restaurant and cabana reservations as well as some great surprises in our room such as wine and champagne with cheese and fruit trays each day. The staff at the Palazzo RS including Fatima Diaz, Junior Joaquin, Richard Ortiz, Miguel Jimenez, Osvaldo Acosta and Felix Garcia were amazing. Best service ever and always with a smile. We enjoyed our breakfast every morning. Great selection. We also enjoyed dinner at Rave and Vento (the coconut pudding is to die for). Room service was also great. We really enjoyed the Royal Service pool (no kids were allowed in the RS area). Very relaxing. A few things that could be improved: took us 1 hr to get our luggage upon arrival, the pool bar staff was not very attentive (no one walking around asking if we needed a drink), and food was not served at the pool or beach. We did call the hotel before we came to check on status because of hurricane and asked about airport transportation. They told us to get a taxi. When we got to the hotel, we were told if we had called they would have set it up. They need to make sure their staff is trained appropriately. Overall a great stay. Everyone was courteous. We would definitely recommend Royal Service upgrade.

reviews.author: 806hugo
reviews.title: Vacaciones con amigos
reviews.text: El hotel es lo máximo, el servicio la gastronomia y el personal muy atento.  Destaco la atencion de Elvido , mesero del restaurante  ipanema. Tambien  Pedro pool  consierge en acompañarnos desde la llegada al hotel. Seguramente volvere por terceea vez

reviews.author: Maria H
reviews.title: Good Hotel with excellent Staff but definitely not 5-Stars
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus from August 27th through September 3rd.  The hotel's common areas are beautiful.  We paid for Royal Service so the check-in process was painless and our room was ready when we arrived.  The staff at the Royal Service Lounge was very polite and professional.  Our butler Francis Newton was absolutely outstanding.  He truly made a positive difference during our stay. He checked-in on us everyday, made our reservations and took care of any issues or requests.  He is professional, polite and efficient, a true asset to Paradisus.  We also want to recognize Martin Tineo, the pool butler.  He's amazing!  Such a positive attitude, we never had to ask him for anything.  After the first day, he knew all our likes.  Thank you Francis and Martin!  
The staff at the buffet were so amazing!  These employees work very hard and everyone we came in contact with was polite and happily took care of any requests although they were very busy.
The hotel however needs to address a some things.  The reservation process for the restaurants does not work.  It's almost impossible to get a reservation between 7:30 to 9:00 pm in any of the restaurants.  Even days ahead of time.  In all honesty, I don't think they are even worth the trouble since the menus are extremely limited.  We had dinner at the steak house and the experience was horrible.  Not enough staff, the waiter took forever to take our order, the orders were brought incomplete, the salads were awful, most of the steaks were tough and we ended up leaving without having dessert.  We tried Oleo and did not like the menu selections.  We also ate at the Peruvian restaurant.  Much better experience, the waiter was excellent, brought us several appetizers and brought our entrees just as we requested them.  The management also needs to address staff training on food handling and invest in better refrigeration/storage areas for food.  They should also offer hand sanitizer to guests in the buffet.  Both my husband and I were sick for an entire week from something we ate, starting the day before we left the hotel.  We were so sick we had to go to the doctor.
The rooms in the Royal Service area need to be remodeled.  Our room smelled musty, some of the furniture needed repair or replacement, needed painting and overall looked worn. Not what I expected from this hotel, specially in the Royal Service area.
We enjoyed our stay despite the issues I describe above, mostly because of the hard-working staff.  We finally decided to just have dinner at the buffet which was much easier than dealing with reservations and issues at the restaurants.  However, that back-fired when we got extremely ill.  I am not sure if I would return to the Paradisus Palma Real in light of the fact that the negatives outweigh the positives for us, at least at the current time.

reviews.author: Silvia Sita
reviews.title: Um verdadeiro paraíso
reviews.text: Tivemos uma semana de excelente diversão! O atendimento foi  impecável, pois a equipa estava sempre muito bem disposta e simpática! Agradecemos a Laura, Angel e ao Cheke-Cheke pela simpatia que sempre nos doaram! Aprendemos alguns toques de salsa com os mesmos, o nosso muito obrigada! O hotel é lindo, mas fica um pouco aquém quando ao entretenimento de noite! Esperamos voltar um dia!

reviews.author: mariag0816
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: Best vacation ever. The entertainment staff best ever always kept you busy...my favorite Alexander Pouriet. The rest of the hotel staff very friendly.  I was there during hurricane Irma and they did everything to keep us informed and had safety plan in place.  I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Jackie G
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text:
This was the best vacation, EVER!!
Our butlers, Angel and Carlos were magnificent. They were attentive to our every need. They made the best recommendations for restaurants and activities. 
Richard and team at Palazzo's were great!  Richard has the most positive and authentic demeanor of any employee at your establishment. He remembered our preferences from our 1st meal.  
Wanda and team at the Sunset Bar were great. She remembered our drink / snack preferences. The entire team remembered not only food but beach preferences as well. 
Lastly, the meals were great. However, the most memorable meal was the tasting menu at Passion. I have never had a food / service experience with sure precision and excellence as I had at Passion. 
Again, I enjoyed this vacation immensely.

reviews.author: B9361ADmonicac
reviews.title: Amazing resort and outstanding service
reviews.text: The gentlemen that helps throughout our entire stay was Julio Aponte. Great attitude and super attentive. He always made sure that the 3 of us were always comfortable. We are missing him all the way from Miami, FL

reviews.author: thannwil
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
Our best girls trip ever!  The resort was beautiful, the beach amazing, the staff was outstanding!

Our butlers Angel Monegro and Carlos Hinostroza made sure everything was perfect.  

Richard at the Palazzo restaurant took great care and made us feel like family.

Wanda at the Royal Service  Sunset Bar kept us happy at the beach and pool!

This has become our best Girl's Trip and will be a repeat destination without a doubt!!  

Thank you for a wonderful vacation!  See you again...😊

reviews.author: Shaindy S
reviews.title: BEST PLACE EVER!!!!
reviews.text: Looky Looky WOW!! Came here to visit with friends and it is literally the most amazing place on earth! The staff is incredibly nice and super helpful all day every day! They're at our service ALWAYS and do everything to make our stay as amazing and blissful as possible!!!! Special shoutout to our BFFs Estrella and Looky Looky Wow! Also, the chef Gonzalo was amazing! YEA BABY!

reviews.author: joanna k
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: This is my second time in Dominican but first time at the paradisus Punta Cana and I LOVE IT !! The music and the service is unbelievable. Everyone is so kind and welcoming. The beach is amazing and the rooms are always cleaned and beautiful. The workers named Luis Florian and Raymond Tamayo are the best!!! Amazing people to talk to and very good dancers!! They make you feel at home and always have a smile on their face which makes you always happy. Defiantly recommend coming here!! ♥️♥️♥️♥️ the best place ever !!

reviews.author: Marina Carestia
reviews.title: First time in Dominican!
reviews.text: The trip and stay was absolutely amazing!!! The entertainment was lovely, raynold tamayo was so much fun and he provided amazing service to everyone! He always made sure everyone around was so happy and having fun! Amazing employee you have! Definitely would come back, thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Kathy P
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text:
My friends and I decided to pick this resort for our vacation and it was one of the best decisions we've ever made. The minute we arrived, the staff were really friendly and welcoming. There were some staff members that stood out to us and made this trip amazing for us. 

First Raynold Tamayo made our entire trip great. and Jhordan Rosario our family concierge made sure that we had everything we need and went above and beyond for us. santos Frias, Ramon Ramirez, Luis Santana, our server at Gabi Club and Vento restaurant, and Rafael who brought our room service to us were all amazing as well.  Customer service was exceptional! 

The resort itself was really clean and the beach was extremely nice. I would recommend this resort to anyone who is looking for one to pick.

reviews.author: Julie Do
reviews.title: Amazing customer service!
reviews.text: The resort itself is very clean and the beach is AMAZING. But what made our trip the best was the outstanding customer service! Jhordan Rosario our family concierge went out of his way to make sure our stay was comfortable. He did everything for us! He booked all of our dinner reservations for our entire stay and even got us into vento on our first night. Liz our server at vento and gabi club was amazing and funny. Rafael our room service guy left us a fruit plate as a present with a nice handwritten note. Our beach crew, Luis Santana, Benita, Raynold Tamayo, Alexander pouriet, Santos frias and Silvio lantigua were the absolute best!!They were all so energetic and funny that we found ourselves spending every day on the beach just to hang out with our beach crew. If you're debating on staying here, don't. The service is worth it! You won't even need to leave the resort.

reviews.author: aimeeiscool
reviews.title: The employees here are the best!
reviews.text:
Customer service definitely makes your experience. Some key ppl to meet. Jhordan Rosario, Santos Frias, Luis Santana, Benita, Raynold Tamayo and Liz. 

Jhordan is our family concierge, he took care of us from the moment we checked in to when we checked out. He helped us reserve our cabana on the beach every single day and get our reservations for all of the restaurants. Super sweet and accommodating! 

Santos- our beach concierge. When you get on the beach he helps you get your towels and walks you over to your cabana. He then takes your drink orders and bring them to you. Always checking in to make sure you have everything you need! And he's hilarious as well!

Luis and Benita are the bartenders at the reserve beach. The drinks they create are phenomenal, can't even tell there is alcohol in it (which is trouble! Lol) they both are also very accommodating and friendly. They love to converse and learn about you. 

Raynold, aka sugar ray, aka ray. lol he's our event coordinator. He teaches daily classes like dance, yoga, water aerobics, etc. super friendly and hilarious! He's also considered an entertainer and constantly is singing and dancing. He goes out of his way daily to our cabana to check in on us and just hang out. Super fun and friendly! 

Liz- she's a server at gabi club and venmo. So sweet! Very good at her job and makes the best mimosas! 

Rafael- our room service waiter. We ordered so much he left us a cute note w/ a plate of fruit! 

Everyone at the resort are we sweet and always greet you when your paths cross but by far those people that I listed are the best and you should definitely search for when coming here! Beach here is very beautiful! Clear blue waters and white sand. Our room was very clean and well kept by room service. The resort is huge, so make sure you take the time to explore. And to make reservations to all of the restaurants if you can. Definitely worth the try!

reviews.author: Tony D
reviews.title: The staff here are great! Gorgeous resort too!
reviews.text:
So to make a very long story short, we accidentally booked The Reserve at Paradisus PUNTA CANA (not this resort, where all of our friends were staying). The Palma Real staff worked with us so hard to get us into their hotel even though the management is not the same and they had no rooms available. 

They let us stay in our friends room the first night, then they found us our own room the next day because of a no-show. Since the other hotel could not offer a refund, our stay at Palma Real should have cost us several thousand dollars but Glenys Martinez at the front desk made calls and somehow transferred the reservation FOR FREE.

On top of all this the resort was amazing, much better than other resorts we have stayed at.  The rooms are apartment size. Absolutely recommend.

reviews.author: alexisvinson
reviews.title: We'll be back!
reviews.text:
This was our first trip out of the U.S. and this resort exceeded our expectations! We stayed in the reserve portion of the resort which we were unaware of but we ended up really enjoying it. We never waited more than five minutes for a shuttle ride to the beach. Room service was excellent as well. 

Now to give some credit to all our favorite staff:

Enrique- Not sure of his exact title but he was our 'personal' concierge. He was great!! Very attentive and extremely helpful. Had great suggestions and went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed and more. We will be requesting him our next stay for sure! 

Jeanndra- She was an event promoter for the activities going on at the resort such as dinners on the beach with a circus show, shows in the theater, dance lessons by the pool, etc. She has great suggestions for what to attend and was super friendly. She went out of her way to make connections with all the guests and kept all vibes positive

Bar tenders- unfortunately we failed to learn all of the bar tenders names that served us throughout the trip but we have no complaints regarding any of them. They were all extremely friendly and made an effort to have friendly conversation with all of the guests. Some names that we do remember are Julio, Nestor, Every, and Edwin. We spent a bit of time at the bars ;) and so these guys made our time at the resort all the better.

reviews.author: Camilla G
reviews.title: Beautiful Place!!
reviews.text: My girlfriends and I stayed here for a girls trip and it was a blast!  The service was outstanding from check in to check out.  The beach waiters were super fast and attentive and the drinks were always delivered quickly.  Our butler took really good care of us from the moment we stepped foot on the property.  He booked all of our dinner reservations and came out to the beach every day to check on us.  He also sent over a birthday cake for me on the day of my birthday, which was super sweet.  I will say, the food wasn't great.  Neither the buffet, nor the restaurants... I have to add that I've never really had any great food in the Dominican Republic in general, and that is simply my opinion.  The food situation doesn't take away from the fact that this place is very well kept and the service is awesome.  The friendly staff and beautiful surroundings makes up for the food, in my opinion.  We had a wonderful trip, and I would recommend this hotel to friends!!

reviews.author: Pablo G
reviews.title: Una Gran Experiencia
reviews.text:
Esta es la segunda vez que vamos a este hotel, con mi esposa y un matrimonio de buenos amigos.  Volvimos en Agosto de este año,  por los gratos recuerdos que nos dejó la primera experiencia, hace dos años atrás. La vez anterior nos alojamos en el  Reserve, parte del mismo hotel con amplias y bellas instalaciones y hermosos jardines, pero que requería del servicio de transporte a la playa en carritos de golf, los que  en todo caso estaban siempre disponibles. 
Esta vez decidimos estar junto al mar y nos alojamos en Paradisus Palma Real, en una zona con Royal Service, junto al mar y en habitación con buena vista al mar. 
Destacable la excelente atención, el trato  siempre alegre y amistoso del personal, la gran variedad y calidad de las comidas, desde el desayuno hasta la cena. 
Párrafo aparte merece el trato especial que nos brindaron los empleados del Reserve, a quienes habíamos conocido en nuestro anterior viaje, y cuyos restaurantes y bares visitamos nuevamente. De este grupo quisiera destacar a Adenauer, siempre atento a ofrecernos la mejor experiencia en el hotel. Inolvidables fueron los almuerzos en el Hydrogrill, con nuestro anfitrión Erme y los gentiles Ramón, Edwin, Andy y Bolívar, que estuvieron atentos a complacer nuestros antojos gastronómicos, con una atención amistosa y de calidad. 
El único detalle, que puede ser molesto para algunos, es la presencia de sargazos en la playa, no obstante las diarias limpiezas con máquinas y las redes instaladas en los flotadores que delimitan la zona de baño. Para nosotros, que nos internábamos un poco más, no era un problema y disfrutamos mucho de los baños en este mar templado y de bellos colores. 

En resumen, una Gran Experiencia.

reviews.author: Than C
reviews.title: Celebrate Here!
reviews.text:
BACKGROUND:
We have been to PC a handful of times before: Hard Rock, Iberostar resorts

My wife and I booked a junior suite in this hotel to celebrate our anniversary.  A few friends booked several junior suites in the adjoining Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort to celebrate some birthdays.  This review is for both hotels and will be posted on both hotel's sites on Trip Advisor.

To begin, the attraction to the Melia property was due to the 1) restaurant reviews 2) availability of a swim-up bar 3) free non-motorized water sports and 4) general hotel reviews back in early Jan '17. We purposely booked our trip during the beginning of hurricane/off season.

As August '17 got closer, the reviews of the site began to sour.  More and more people were complaining about the staff/service they had received, condition of the rooms, (not getting) reservations at the popular restaurants for both hotels.  Due to many recommendations, we intended to upgrade our reservations to Royal Service.

Check-in:
PALMA REAL GOLF & SPA:

We had to check in at the Palma Real Golf & Spa first.  The majority of our party was at this location and we had purchase several of the rooms.  We arrived at 3:30PM.  Waiting in the small line to check-in took about 15 minutes.  There were 4 people checking in hotel guests.  We had some extenuating circumstances that included:  1) not having the same credit card on hand that was used to book the reservation 2) adding additional guest to an existing reservation 3) IMPORTANT: upgrading everyone to Royal Service/Family Concierge.  This took our party about an hour to resolve, but it made check in The Reserve FAST.

WHY UPGRADE?  [COST  ~$70/PP/per day...negotiable]
Initially, we wanted to upgrade everyone to Royal Service but our friendly host named Milton told us to just upgrade to Family Concierge.  The upgrade provided us with 1) GUARANTEED restaurant reservations for our entire party 2) access to every part of both hotels (except Royal Service pool area and Royal Service restaurant); this included reservations to both beach front chairs/bungalow and private Reserve pool reservations each and every day.  3) a dedicated concierge to work on our requests.

THE RESERVE:

My wife and I were escorted directly to the Family Concierge desk for check-in.  I guess normally you would have to go to the front check-in.  They processed our upgrade and we were off to building 40 in under 5 minutes.  We were also given a mobile phone that we used to call our concierge Jorge Tejeda.

Rooms:
THE RESERVE:
Our junior suite was gorgeous.  Third floor balcony pool/garden facing with a huge 2-person jacuzzi on the balcony.  This was our base of operation.  Super cold A/C, rain shower stand-up shower, king bed (semi-firm mattress) and pull out couch.  Our room would be considered modern.  Granite countertops, granite/marble floors and shower.  Now they provided us with bottled water to brush our teeth, but no where did we see signs that told us we couldn't use the sink water.  In fact, we both never used the bottled water to brush our teeth, only to drink at night. The mini-bar was stocked with beers and soda and juice.  

PALMA REAL GOLF & SPA:
Our different parties had different room styles which were modern.  One set of guests enjoyed their stay with a room that made them feel 'royal' with swept chiffon curtains everywhere.  The others stayed in room similar to one we had at The Reserve.  When asked, all said that the rooms felt modern.  Though, one of the rooms had an A/C problem mid trip that was quickly remedied by the hotel staff.  Interestingly enough, the rooms here had signs in the bathroom requesting guests use the bottled waters to brush their teeth.

FOOD/RESTAURANTS:
All our breakfasts took place at the Gabi Beach buffet @Palma Real.  Staff there were super attentive.  For breakfast, there were a variety of foods; eggs benedict station, 2 omelette stations, yogurt bar, bloody mary bar to name our favorites.  Nothing better than fresh fruit (mangos for me!) every day. Keep in mind buffet is only available from 8am-11am; 12:30P-4PM; 5PM-10PM.
 
We witnessed the Gabi Buffet @The Reserve, but never ate there.  The options seemed a bit less compared to the extensive Gabi Beach Buffet.

If you like latte or want a great cup of java, ask them for the 'cafe con leche' from their espresso bar.  This is the latte version at their resort.  It was awesome.  We all had this for breakfast and after dinner.

As for the specialty restaurants, we had reservations for 1) RARE steakhouse, skirt steak and rib-eye were spectacular; as well the table sprung for $30 lobster, which had to be 3lbs so we shared it; we also ordered the 2x-ribs dinner for appetizer 2) BANA - teppanyaki style show and dinner, appetizer was a bit limiting, so order double spring rolls or sushi; they are not stingy on the meats from which I ate up the leftover shrimp our chef cooked up; it was a fun dinner 3) PASSION; this was my wife and I's anniversary dinner location.  It is an added cost because the restaurant is not part of the hotel offerings.  It was well worth the $70PP to explore the 9 course tasting menu from a 4 Michelin star chef Martin Berasategui.  Talk about dining experience that rivals those that I have experienced in the past @ROBUCHONVegas and @ALINEAChicago.  We didn't get a chance to experience Fuego or Aqua@TheReserve or any of the dining offered beachside.

Keep in mind, I had leveraged our upgrades to Family Concierge and had our concierge Jorge Tejedas do our bookings.  Jorge setup the special birthday dinner celebrations as well with singing and custom cakes!  Well worth the upgrade to get exactly what we want for our group.

BEACH/POOL/BAR/ACTIVITIES:
While The Reserve had a very secluded multiple swimming pool setup with kids zone, we never used it.  We had always had concierge service at the Beach front pool/beach area. The mornings always started on the beach in our reserved beach chairs.  HINT: bring your own 32oz tumblers for chilled beverages.  If any of the reviews hold any merit it is this:  their pool/beach service was VERY lacking.  Sure we might have gotten our 1-2 cocktail refills in our big tumblers, but if we didn't have those, we might have died of dehydration.  Now around 1P, we switched to the main pool where the swim-up bar was located.  Here the service was always hitting the high marks with service.  Again, the service was non-existent if you waited in your chair; but for us this wasn't a problem.  We were always in the pool.  

Now my biggest complaint was the beach activities.  All inclusive here advertised free access to non-motorized activities, including catamaran, snorkeling, wind surfing, kayak etc.  These activities ARE NOT RUN by the hotel.  We were at the mercy of Scuba Aquatics company and they we completely stingy when it came to offering up the free activities to us.  2 days we were denied access to catamaran, excuses were no wind/too much wind/no one else is offering it.  I am an avid sailor on Lake Michigan and I can tell you the wind was perfect for this type of small boat sailing.  I made a complaint to the hotel management and they commented that sometimes $$ motivates those people.  I can't fault the hotel, since this type of thing was outsourced to a crappy company with a lack of 'services' knowledge.  The irony of it all is that the staff from Scuba Aquatics kept pestering my party about purchasing activities, including catamaran.

FAMILY CONCIERGE:
This alone took the worry out of everything that seemed to be a complaint about Melia Paradisus.  I recommend anyone booking this purchase/upgrade to Family Concierge or even Royal Service.  The dining requests were always honored.  There was no worrying when it came to available beach seats or pool side seats; all were reserved for our group.  Jorge Tejedas was always available via cell phone the resort gave us.  He was very attentive to our celebration needs, our in-room requests for alcohol and all the other details.  When it came to our anniversary, he set-up our room with rose petals, celebration cake, champagne, drew up the hot tub every night (with rose petals and balloons and decoration on our anniversary night).  Top notch in my eyes....making the wife happy was of highest importance.

OVERALL:
Melia Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa / The Reserve at Paradisus is a great place to vacation.  The property is HUGE and gorgeous. (So huge that they offer golf-cart transportation between the two properties)  We have been to other high-end PC properties that were much smaller, and since they were smaller, they were able to be more attentive to the guests beachside/poolside.  You just need to know how to work these all-inclusive places.

Purchasing the upgrade to Family Concierge for all guests secured our dining requirements, our choice of beach/pool needs and on top of that the special treatments for our birthday guests and my anniversary night.  I got everything checked-off for our vacation (except my desire to sail) with the help of Melia property and staff.

reviews.author: sharperadar
reviews.title: Amazing Food
reviews.text:
We had a great time at the Verandah in Antigua, but the Royal Service experience at the Paradisus Punta Cana has dethroned our beloved Verandah as our best all-inclusive resort experience thus far.  We were booked into the Reserve at Paradisus, and whether it was the fact that I am a Melia Rewards member, the fact that we were traveling with a group of six people in their thirties without any children and they wanted us out of the quite Reserve area, or the fact they overbooked, we were upgraded on arrival to the Royal Service at the Paradisus.  The Melia Rewards card is free, so you might as well sign up for that before visiting one of their properties, in case that was the trick to the free upgrade. 

The only complaint was that the check in process took a very, very long time without any communication.  At one point I went up to our check in agent to make sure everything was okay (and that they had not lost our reservation or were over booked).  There are snacks, a flat screen television, and computers in the Reserve front desk, but after a long plane ride and a short bus ride, and all of that time in the airport, we just wanted to get into our room and down to the beach.  The wait was worth it because we were transferred closer to the beach and received the access bracelets for both the Royal Service and the Reserve.  We had to wait again in the Royal Service lobby to meet our butler Miguel, but that lobby was stocked with a full bar and even more finger foods to keep us occupied. 

Miguel was great, though we were at a loss as to what we needed him to help us do.  He booked us our restaurant reservations, and was kind enough to re-schedule those reservations when we changed our plans.  At one point Miguel recommended that we utilize him more and ask for more perks. Our reply was, “what should we even ask for?”  He suggested champagne on ice in our rooms, which was a great idea. 

The Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana and the Paradisus itself are attached and a short walk away.  The Reserve was beautiful, and I would definitely recommend it for children.  I saw a number of families utilize their concierge to do family and baby photo shoots, which looked like they produced some great memories. 

The Royal Service portion of the Paradisus had a really nice small pool with in-water huts and loungers. There were day beds around the outside, and you could have your butler reserve them.   There were also daybeds on the beach, and a variety of shade and non-shade options.  They didn’t kick non-Royal Service people out of that area, and very nicely showed children and their families to one of the other pools.  If you are an adult, check it out even if you did not reserve Royal Service. 

The service was great at the pool bar, and for when they were busy they would put bottles of alcohol on ice with mixes in a “help yourself,” set up.  The liquor at the resort is all the usual high-end name brands.  The vodka was Grey Goose.  The whiskey was Johnny Walker Black Label or Red Label.  They had the knock off Bailey’s, but if you asked for the real stuff they would get it out of the fridge.  The beer was local but they also had Coors Lite and Heineken.

The food at this resort was amazing, even the breakfast buffet at the Gabi Beach restaurant.  The La Palapa was one our favourites.  We loved that you could go there for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  The Grill, Aqua, Mole, were all awesome as well. We tried most of the other restaurants, including “the Winery – Tapas and Wine Experience”, which is not included in the all-inclusive.  It was great too, but I probably would not pay for it again.  

In the front lobby there was nightly entertainment, including an awesome Queen cover band one night.  The Gabi Beach Bar was fun, with professional go-go dancers and DJs on the beach some nights.  We would always end our night in the M Bar where Alexis and another bartender, whose name is escaping me, would keep us entertained perhaps too late into the evenings.  Other bartenders of note are Junior, Juan, and Diogenes “Aye Aye Aye”!  I would highly recommend the Espresso Martinis at night!

The gym was well equipped.  There is a spinning studio with room to do cardio, pilates, yoga or anything else for which wide open space is good for to the left.  They put the spin bikes into the larger pool for in-water spinning classes, so they are a bit… abused.  But the place has a spin studio in the first place, so it is hard to complain about older bikes. To the right is a room with several treadmills, two spin bikes, several weight machines, and three benches with free weights.  The room to the right had a number of flat screen televisions which were usually programmed to sports to keep you entertained while you put in your kilometres.

The rooms we were in were very spacious with a small living room.  We would receive alcohol, water, pop, and snacks in the room each day.  The rooms also had what was essentially a private backyard with a daybed in the back. 

The beach was beautiful and white, a blue ribbon recipient, and it does not have any of the erosion issues some of the other Punta Cana resorts have. 

We definitely would return and we now pay more attention when booking to Melia owned properties, and specifically the Reserve and Paradisus options.  The Royal Service experience was so great, I am not sure I would pay more for a Sandals in the future at this stage in our lives.

reviews.author: Wendy M
reviews.title: Paradise, but service needs to be improved
reviews.text: Upgraded to the 'Royal Service' as we had no children, access to a restricted beach (beautiful!!) and adult pool (several over served loud  'adults' standing around in the pool by 6pm), and their lounge. Probably did not take enough advantage of our concierge - the family we were with had excellent service from their family concierge, helping book restaurants all week long.The Reserve is the place to be if you have kids, buildings appear newer than the Royal Service section which is right next to the beach and a bunch of restaurants. Only complaint is check in and checkout service is long and tedious, took about 90 minutes from arrival to finally getting to the room! A little pricey considering you have to pay extra for a half decent bottle of wine and some entree options at restaurants.

reviews.author: Roberto J
reviews.title: My favorite place. The people that works here make it my favorite.
reviews.text:
My family and I have stayed at many, many resorts. The best by far is The Reserve.
Specially because of the people here. Whoever wants to go to this place needs to know these names; 
Glenys Martínez. Carlos Rosado. Juan Tiren. These are the best people you can find to make your vacation a dream vacation. This is our second trip here and I can definitely say we found a second home.
We are coming back very soon.
Great food, great drinks, great infrastructure, great spa. 
Thank you so much: Glenys, Carlos and Juan. 
See you soon.

reviews.author: T L
reviews.title: Wedding/Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent resort, food was great, service was great, room was beautiful.. had a butler which took very good care of us... our room was on the adult side only, but the entire resort is nice, place is huge, very family friendly if you want to bring kids. The bars where conveniently located all over the resort, pools were kept very clean, & very large to occomadate plenty of guests, shows were fun, we aren't gamblers but looked in the casino & looked very nice, plenty of activities to do. Outside of the resort, there's vendors to do parasailing, banana boat, we did fishing, recommend as one of the best resorts in DR that we've been to.

reviews.author: Michelle A
reviews.title: Overall great resort!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a fantastic 6 night stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Looking back at my photos, they look enhanced, but they weren't. It was really that beautiful! We had a group of late-30s friends with couples and singles. We all had rooms in various areas & everyone seemed to have a great experience. We saw families, couples, friend groups, wedding parties...this resort seems to have something for all to enjoy.

Here were the pros: very beautiful property/beach, massages at the Reserve side Yhi Spa were amazing (Wendy did mine), the Yhi Spa relaxation area was an unexpected added bonus and I don't think they have that at the other spa, we didn't need to use bug spray (the relaxation beds that were out of the breeze at spa was the only place we saw mosquitos), bottled water was abundant so no worries about where to get drinking water, food was better than I expected at a resort this large, beach and poolside Bali beds and cabanas in Royal Service upgrade were heavenly, staff was accommodating & friendly and they helped us try to speak our limited Spanish but switched easily to English if we didn't understand, there was a security presence throughout the resort-especially at night, DJs are willing to play your songs at casino/club

Cons: unless you're in Royal Service there was a beach towel shortage daily, beer selection at bars was only Presidente (Heineken in mini fridge, ShockTop is sold down the beach at a market but not much variety otherwise), be aware of sales pitch from the Circle vacations "tour guides",  rooms could use updates (some things in our friends' rooms needed repair like a lamp with a duct taped cord/their room keys didn't work after multiple replacements), there were many kids near the swim up bar, long lines to make dinner reservations (tip: friend made all reservations right when she arrived & that helped. We upgraded to Royal Service our 2nd day & butler helps with reservations, but at that point we had already done it), hibachi food was so-so but our reservation time was not adhered to & we were extremely hungry by the time we ate, the buffet area for dinner/lunch didn't appeal to us because there seemed to be long waits, smoothie bar by Royal Service beach had great smoothies and bottled water was added to drinks but I did get nervous about where the water came from for the sink they used to wash the fruit/veggies & the blender, if you have vouchers with your vacation package be sure to get them right away, room service for breakfast was timely and always called to announce they were coming and when they arrived they were professional and always asked permission to enter the room. When I ran out of room service forms they still picked up my handwritten notes I skid under the door with my requests!

For us, the highlights of this resort were mainly things that were upgrades/extras: 
Our Royal Service Butler, Armando Minier, was attentive without hovering, and he helped make our anniversary special by having our room decorated, arranging a drawn bath with flower petals, & sending champagne/cake. We also had room appetizers/wine from Armando, beach Bali beds reserved, and help with our luggage and an easy departure arrangement. Thank you, Armando!

The extra cost of dinner at Passion was worth it. We did the preset "romantic dinner" with wine pairing option so we could use our voucher that came with our vacation package. We had attentive service, a knowledgeable and friendly sommelier (forgot his name, but he is from Lima, Peru), and the presentation/texture/taste/variety of the food was an excellent experience. We asked to thank the chef, and he made time to come out so we could thank him. Our friends went a different night and also loved it. We wish we could have eaten there every night! Thank you, Chef Martin Berasategui!

Overall, this resort was amazing, and I would recommend it!

reviews.author: lynnhY326AS
reviews.title: Overbooked, so disappointed
reviews.text: Our room was overbooked, we had to be moved to their "upgraded" hotel, room not ready their, one wasted day, next day on the beach, which was nice, then the next day we had to be moved back to our original hotel that was booked.  We lost two whole days, so really instead of a 7 night we should have paid for a 5 night trip.  This was a 30th retirement vacation, so disappointed.  Then got food poisoning, toilet broke in the "upscale hotel we were moved to first", just one thing after another.  Last year we went to the NOW Lamier and had a wonderful time/stay.  I thought Melia resorts were suppose to be great, not for us.

reviews.author: 443bobbym
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Average place food was ok services was great they didn't have the top shelf liquid out you had to ask for it the staff was great very friendly entertainment great really like the resort grounds was very clean l would go back didn't like melia they me one price and they said it was on hold the next day they charge me $479.00 more per person

reviews.author: Manuel S
reviews.title: It's okay
reviews.text:
It is a paradise. The beach is marvelous but it has its pros and contras as every single thing in the world.
The beach is nicely divided per section. Lifeguard all of the time, a bar close enough to stay in the beach to enjoy the sun. 
The transportation system was unsatisfactory. We had to wait maybe 20 mins for a car to arrive at the beach and hope that they would be empty. 
Very nice installations (GYM, restaurants)
We met very nice staff. For example: some of them from the Bana Asian
Tepoanyaki & Wok named Samuel Benitez and Rafael Espinosa that entertained us and fed us very nice quality food.
The things that can and should be improved is the service (which takes long), the transportation system and the buffet food that could be better.
Loved the trip.

reviews.author: lozanoc2017
reviews.title: Good Experience
reviews.text:
Overall hotel is good. Food is above average, bars are good , nightlife is great. Would recommend to friends and family
The beach is not what I expected, very dirty and many people offering deal to travel to other places.

reviews.author: ljgwjr
reviews.title: Seaweed, crowded, lack of air conditioning in restaurants and common area
reviews.text:
The seaweed was out of control! They were coming with dump trucks all day to pick it up. Unreal!!!  It was a disaster in the water and on the shore. Kids wouldn't even go in water. 
Too crowded and very slippery around property with tile. So hot in July and lack of aircondirioning  around property. 
If you have a family of 4, there is no privacy in your room. There are shutters and columns separating your room from bathroom. Clear doors on bathroom and showers. If you need to cover for privacy w/ teenage kids, never enough towels because housekeeping removes it and only leaves 4 towels. They do not leave washclothes ever and I would lock up your personal items!

reviews.author: Aisha T
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with flaws..bring a can of lysol, raid bug/roach spray, and clorox wipes.
reviews.text:
When you arrive, the views are simply breathtaking.  Things quickly changed during check-in.  The front desk staff at the resort specifically Milton, was totally disrespectful to my entire group during check-in.  We had three reservations booked through Costco travel with two people in each room and rooms were supposed to be next to one another.  
 
We were immediately instructed by Milton that the resort was totally sold out and booked to capacity.  We thought, OK no worries we booked and requested double beds, rooms in close proximity to one another so we didn’t think there would be an issue since our Costco booking specifically stated the details (we thought our rooms were being held until we arrived to the resort mid afternoon after a 4 hour flight).  

To our surprise, the rooms didn’t have double beds and the rooms weren’t close to each other (we were in different buildings).  We showed Milton our Costco booking itinerary to verify the details of our booking.  Milton stated “they” had no record of additional companions in the rooms and they could not and would not accommodate our request and that “it was not his problem”, basically take it or leave it.  From what we gathered, our booking for double beds and rooms on the same floor are considered "special requests" by the resort and subject to resort availability.  The members of my group and I were totally shocked and caught off guard with Milton’s response, lack of compassion and verbal disrespect during our conversation.  

To diffuse the situation, my group and I took the last few rooms offered.  My group and I were determined to enjoy ourselves despite the horrible exchange at the cheek-in desk.

Except for the main building, the buildings DO NOT have elevators; my room was located on the first floor and smelled of mildew and mold.  The room was older and decorated with dark/old wood furniture that appeared to have been repainted at some point.  The room was bug infested and at one point water streamed down the walls in the bathroom from upstairs.  We alerted the front desk of the water problem and they never came to address our concerns.  We also noticed puddles of water in the hallway every day in addition to the neighborhood cats roaming around. The hallways have very, very, very dim lighting (watch your steps) we even noticed one hallway without lights the entire 5 days we were there (no one changed the bulb).  Room key cards worked when they wanted, we had to have our keys changed 3 times.

Housekeeping did a good job cleaning our room each day however they did not leave washcloths, we had to call the front desk EVERYDAY to request washcloths be delivered. 

The buffet restaurant staff especially "Junior" went above and beyond each day to ensure our group had a nice table.  Junior made sure all drink requests were provided quickly and correctly. We can’t express our gratitude to the waiters, waitresses and bartenders who worked tirelessly each day to ensure we were happy, happy, happy (tips well deserved). 

My group did not have any problem making reservations at the other restaurants. Just a suggestion, make restaurant reservations as soon as you arrive to you get the time slots you want. Transportation to and from the restaurants on the Royal side are provided.

The onsite Blue travel agent, Ms. Emma Espinal provided exceptional customer service during our stay at the resort. Emma provided my group with helpful safety tips while abroad, she booked all of our excursions quickly and was on site each day during our stay to offer any assistance.  She was polite, courteous, and patient and provided a wealth of knowledge regarding the resort and history of Dominique Republic.

Yhi Spa was fantastic, keep in mind there is an 18% fee charged on all services that they don't tell you at the time of spa booking. 

Don't waste your time going to the mall; the bus leaves resort every 15 mins.  The mall  consists of extremely high price tourist shops. The best place to buy gifts is the resort gift shop they have daily specials or the local grocery store outside of the mall.  The mall also has a Pandora jewelry store that sells all Pandora bracelet charms in addition to Dominican Republic charms that you can only get there.  

Despite our horrible check-in experience and additional setbacks during our stay overall my group and I enjoyed our trip.  Honestly, we would not recommend this resort to anyone in the future.

reviews.title: BORING PLACE TO STAY
reviews.text: If the primary reason for your trip is to rest and relax and nothing else, then this is the place to stay. This is the most boring place I've ever been. Hotel is beautifull, rooms in the reserve are very nice, employees are the best, food is great but that's it.

reviews.author: Gerry208085
reviews.title: Paradisus, estupenda opción para vacaciones de relax
reviews.text:
The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real es una estupenda opción para unas vacaciones de relax y confort en la playa; el hotel está ubicado en Playa Bávaro, Punta Cana y sus instalaciones son fabulosas, al llegar se aprecia una maravillosa vista de la playa y de una de sus piscinas que le agregan un encanto especial al área del Lobby; cuentan con un servicio VIP para huéspedes identificado como "Royal service" que te permite desconectarte del resto del mundo y olvidarte de todo pues se tiene acceso a áreas privadas, exclusivas y solo para adultos, es como estar en un hotel boutique dentro de otro hotel, este servicio incluye además el servicio de mayordomo o consierge personal, en mi caso fui atendido por el Sr. José Lugo quien realmente realiza un trabajo impecable de consierge y en todo momento cumple sus labores de forma profesional y amable, José estaba pendiente de efectuar mis reservaciones en los restaurantes, preparar el jacuzzi, canalizar cualquier inquietud relativa a mi estadía, recomendaciones de tour, canalizar la preparación de las camas de playa o reservación del espacio en la piscina, traslado de maletas, en fin su labor es muy completa y quedé gratamente satisfecho de su trabajo ya que contribuyó en gran medida a que mi estadía fuera la que yo esperaba. Igualmente debo reconocer y agradecer el servicio de bar y atención al huésped que ofrece el Sr. Pedro, la Sra. Wuanda Correa, Carlos Rosario y todo su equipo de trabajo en la piscina privada del área "Royal Service", impecable la atención de todos y siempre atentos.
Sobre el servicio de comidas / restaurantes, la oferta es amplia y variada, cuentan con propuestas mediterráneas, latinoamericanas, asiáticas y americanas para escoger. Además de los restaurantes, a los que se tiene acceso dependiendo del tipo de régimen de hospedaje seleccionado, cuentan con un gran bufet central de acceso general en el que sirven desayunos, almuerzos y cenas, siempre con una gran variedad de platos y bebidas.
Mis vacaciones en Paradisus fueron muy buenas gracias a los detalles y al confort que recibí, lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: Debbie O
reviews.title: Heaven on earth - Adult get-away...
reviews.text:
Adult trip for 4, upgraded to the Royal Service and loved every minute of it. Alberto was our personal Butler during the stay and he was phenomenal at what he does, not obtrusive in any way, made great suggestions for dining then made reservations, drew us bubble baths in the evenings with oil scents sprayed on our pillows at night. We thoroughly enjoyed the private beach and Cabana boys to help set us up and bring us drinks and the private pool was perfect to cool off in with no crowds or loud, splashing children. The beach had white soft sand and a tropical greenish-blue tint and was warm to swim in, so we spent long days there and then got in the pool to be refreshed. F&B in phenomenal, our private restaurant was our favorite, Palazzo which is Italian and then Fuego by the beach was next offering fresh cerviches and a full menu. We tried Bano for the Benihana experience and really liked that for dinner. Blue Agave was perfect for burgers and fries and NAOS was the buffet when you wanted to try alittle bit of everything. We enjoyed each experience and loved the RED Lounge for after-hour dancing and drinks. We can't wait to go back!

Special recognition goes to Wanda at the Private Pool Bar and Pedro & Martin at the Private Beach. They anticipated our needs and made our stay more personalized each day. Alberto, our butler left wonderful treats in our room with special notes which really upped the luxury feel of our visit. It was truly unforgetable.

This is not the first time this has happened either please read other reviews.  The manager stated they could not do anything because they could not prove it was their staff. The mangers or supervisors also can never help you with any of your concerns.  It seems like that is their answer to all questions asked.

reviews.author: KB
reviews.title: Great Vacation, A Little Rough Around The Edges
reviews.text:
If you're curious about this property, and especially curious about this one compared to their Playa Del Carmen property in Mexico continue reading! I will answer all your burning questions. Let me break this down for you. 

My BFF and I just got back from a wonderful stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. We booked this trip back in February and got a great deal on a junior suite. The number of resort decisions was overwhelming and at that point in the decision process I had just stayed at the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen and was beyond impressed with that property. I knew choosing another Melia property was a smart move so we bypassed the anxiety of unlimited resort properties and picked this one. However, what can also be confusing is the number of options for bookings once you do choose this property. There is the main resort we stayed at, Royal Service (you get your own Butler), or The Reserve (it's a quick 3 minute golf cart ride away). The main rooms are closest to the beach, the large pool and all of the restaurants. The Reserve is separate from the main property but it's a very short golf cart ride away. We ate dinner there one night and it's definitely more modern with updated digs and more pool options. You are further from the beach if you stay at The Reserve but the golf carts are always running and it will seriously take you less than 5 minutes to get to the beach. Honestly, if I go back with my family I would pick The Reserve as it's a more modern space that is comparable to Paradisus Playa Del Carmen.

Prior to arrival, we did try to contact the hotel a few times to inquire about upgrading, dinner reservations, and spa reservations. Unfortunately, the hotel is very difficult to get a hold of on the phone and if you do get someone on the line the only speak Spanish. I had to have a native-Spanish speaking friend help me on the phone and she was basically told that all items we were inquiring about would best be handled upon check-in. 

Upon check-in, we were given our own personal concierge even though we didn't do Royal Service (shout out to Franklin!). This is because we booked directly on their website which I highly recommend doing. Franklin took care of us from the start. He gave us a tour, explained all of the facilities, how reservations worked, and answered any burning questions we had. One night he arranged for us to have champagne and fruit that was waiting in our room when we got back from a day at the beach. What a lovely surprise that was!  When we were checking out, Franklin also helped us by calling the transportation company and rearranged our travel to the appropriate time. 

Now let's get detailed...
Rooms:
My first impression of the room we were in was that it could use an update. It's nowhere near as modern as Paradisus Playa del Carmen. Also, the bathroom is super wonky. There's this weird wooden sliding door that sanctions off the bedroom from the bathroom and you can seriously hear and nearly see everything whatever the person in the bathroom is doing. Basically, don't take a first date here. 
Otherwise, the beds were super comfortable and we had a nice view of palm trees. We were barely in the room so as long as the beds are comfy and the bathroom is clean I'm usually pleased. 

Reservations:

We tried our darnedest to make reservations before arriving at the resort because that's what everyone tells you to do. Well, you can't. You won't be able to make dinner reservations until your first full day on the property. Franklin had us meet him in the AM the day after we checked in to make dinner reservations. The reservations open at 9:30 AM. Make sure you get there when the reservations open because they do fill up. However, my friend and I had absolutely no problem booking where we wanted to eat when we wanted to for the entirety of the trip. There were only 2 of us though and I can see how a larger group could have some issues getting a prime time rez. 
We also made a spa reservation that morning with the YHI spa representative. It was very easy to do and we were happily accommodated for the time and service we wanted. BY THE WAY the spa is one of the nicest I've been too, even better than the Yhi in Mexico. If you're on the fence about the service because it is pricey, do yourself a favor and book! Make sure to get there earlier than your reservation though to enjoy the other amenities. 

Beach & Pool Areas:

Oh man, the beach. It's fantastic. We spent most of our time here. The DR beaches are stunning. We barely spent time at the pool, plus the pool was far more crowded. This is where I would recommended doing Royal Service because you get your own pool/beach chairs so you will always have a spot. All of the non-royal pool chairs were claimed by 8:30 AM. My friend and I had no problems finding beach chairs every day, even the ones in the shade. However here lies my biggest complaint, Paradisus please institute a towel system!!!!!! In Mexico, you have to turn in a towel card to get towels and if you don't want to be charged $25 per towel you have to turn them back in and get the card back when you're done. At this resort, it's a free for all. Meaning, nobody has any incentive to return towels. Twice, the resort ran out (once at 10:00 AM!!) which is unacceptable at a beach resort. People are also lazy and rude and just leave their towels on chairs when they're done which means you also don't know if the chairs are actually taken or not. Paradisus, please just get a basic towel system. Guests, get your towels early in the morning.
Also, the bar service on the beach was awful. The staff maybe came by twice in an 8 hour day, if at all. We had this issue at the breakfast buffet too everywhere seemed to be a bit....short staffed. Secret Intel is that there is a new manager who isn't great and a lot of the staff are quitting, which would explain the slow/no service. I truly hope this gets fixed. But the staff that is working there is fantastic. Great group of some of the hardest working people I've ever met. Kudos to all of them, it's not their fault it's upper management's fault. 

Entertainment/Nightlife:
Go to the shows!!! I thought they'd be lame but the one circus show had me out of my chair for a standing ovation. Take your kids to these shows, the performers are top notch and it's great. 
We also did water aerobics and salsa/meringue lessons. Lookey Lookey and Shakey Shakey are my new best friends. Every night there is a dance party at Avenue Bar and they get everyone going and dancing. It was so.much.fun. Even if you hate dancing or are nervous, they will get you out there feeling like Beyoncé. The entertainment crew is one of the best parts of this resort. In Mexico, there wasn't much nightlife after dinner so this was wonderful to have something people of all ages could enjoy. 

This is getting really long so let me just give you some random/final thoughts and tips:

1) You have to book your own airport transportation! There are a bunch of options and most are cheaper than the hotel suggested company.

2) Buy your tourist card online before arriving! You NEED this to get into the DR and the line at the airport can be very, very long. Save yourself a ton of time by purchasing it online for $10. Just print it off and bring it with you on your trip. 

3) Tip your staff! It’s disappointing to see visitors who don't tip the hardworking staff at the resort! These people work so hard for very little and it's common courtesy to tip them. You don't have to tip every single employee you talk to but definitely tip the bartenders you got 12 drinks from, your maids, your concierge, and your servers at the restaurants. I'm just talking about a couple dollars here or there. Be sure to bring a lot of $1 and $5.

4) Bring bug spray

5) Do an excursion! The Dominican Republic is a breathtaking country with a rich history and beautiful culture. Take some time to get off the resort and experience it! 

6) Have a blast! Yes there will be hiccups, nothing is perfect but you're at a beautiful beach with awesome people! Enjoy it.

reviews.author: HenriqueTinoco
reviews.title: Experiência sem Royal Service
reviews.text:
Estamos no hotel neste momento, de 06 a 11/07. Como estamos em família, não teve como optar pelo royal service.
Então, filas e stress para achar vagas nos restaurantes está sendo uma constante.
Somos um grupo de 12 brasileiros. Todos tiveram algum tipo de problema, quarto com cheiro de mofo, confusão com os uogrades q ganhamos por comprar direto no Meliá.com, quartos com outros hóspedes quando entramos, ou seja, ocorrências bizarras para o padrão de serviços  vendido.
É importante entender que a estrutura do hotel eh boa, a praia muito bonita, embora com alga nesta época, as bebidas de primeira qualidade e os restaurantes (q precisam ser reservados) são bons. Falta maior eficiência na operação dado limitações que, na perspectiva de nós hóspedes, só comprometem nossa experiência, mas vamos lá:
- comida, só na área de restaurante. Os bares de praia e piscina não tem qualquer petiscos para vc aliviar o estômago!
- nossa experiência coma internet foi horrível;
- As atividades no hotel Sao  muito limitadas  (alta estação, hem!)
- não tínhamos acesso a outros hotéis do complexo, todos Meliá,
- alguns profissionais se esforçam para lhe propiciar uma expediências diferenciada, a exemplo de Lucia (atendente do bar no terraço central), Omar (um mensageiro,que cuida da bagagem) que devia ser gerente, pelo compromissos em buscar uma solução para todos os problemas que compartilhamos com ele, nossos camareiros também, muito solícitos.
Por fim, tentando ser o mais pragmático possível, reporto como REGULAR aa experiência no hotel, concluindo q vale a pena conhece-lo, imaginando que as ocorrências q reportei, podem ser um ponto fora da curva. 
Se puderem, vão de Royal Service, considerando os demais comentários aqui feitos.
Uma dica final, sempre q possível,  Busque alguma diferenciação nestes resorts, o padrão " mortal" pode nos trazer muito estresse, o que não combina com férias!
Ah, meu padrão de referencia, eh o Sun Palace de Cancun....

reviews.author: BAP1407
reviews.title: Office vacation
reviews.text: This was both a fun and relaxing trip.   The resort had many delicious restaurants to chose from.   The pools were accessible.  The grounds were maintained.   The staff was friendly and efficient.   My butler, Heriberto Martinez went above and beyond.  He had a treat awaiting me daily, such as chocolate covered strawberries or a predinner sushi tray.  He was continually asking what he could do to make our trip both great and individualized.   I will definitely recommend this resort to friends.

reviews.author: Sonia B
reviews.title: Royal service not worth the upgrade
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort for a wedding in early July. I decided to use our Amex points to upgrade to the "Royal service", with a little hesitation however for 3 days I thought it may be worth it. The reviews were all amazing and the points needed for one night were more than I've ever used (over 100k or $834) so with that being said I expected the experience to be one of a kind. Sadly we were very disappointed. 
We travel A LOT and have stayed at many different hotels from HoJo's to the Fairmont, and usually when one checks in after traveling your bags are taken from you, here we arrived to check in and were escorted to the "royal service" check in room which was on the other side of the property and not once did our escort offer to help with our bags. Not a huge deal but definitely not 5-star service. Check in was a little awkward and not well explained. I'd expect an exclusive upgrade would include a quick check in not a long drawn out one. Once our "butler" escorted us to our room and explained how everything worked he was kind enough to offer us a tour of the property. After our tour, we were ready for a late breakfast as we'd be traveling all morning. It was about 11/1130 am, our Butler recommended the Mexican restaurant. Once we arrived at the Mexican restaurant we noticed they only served burgers and hot dogs, because the resort was in between breakfast and lunch there was literally nowhere else to eat on the entire property! We tried the pool bars and were told they do not serve food, at all. FYI: there is no poolside food service and minimal poolside drink service. We went back to our rooms and ordered room service (this was included with our royal service) it did take about 30-40 minutes which by that point my husband had fallen asleep waiting. Needless to say, the meal was subpar. I was so disappointed even within the first hour of arriving, it was nothing we've ever experienced and with a price tag of over $800 a night it really put a damper on the trip. 

Anyhow, I'm mostly writing this so people don't expect more than what the hotel can actually offer. It is an all-inclusive resort and you are therefore at the mercy of the scheduled meals. Our Butler was sweet and as helpful as could be but quite frankly not worth the upgrade, through no fault of his own. 

Anyhow, I hope this helps if you are on the fence about the upgrade. We are pretty self-sufficient travelers and adjust well to other cultures. If you're not used to traveling abroad perhaps this would be a good option for you as your given a butler cell phone for you to call him with any needs or questions you may have. 

CONS: 
Royal service overrated 
Rooms only have 1 sink
Horrible wifi connection
Shower handle broke (no hot water for 2 days)
NO decent meal options outside of buffet times
Most meals were mediocre 
No food allowed at any of the bars, including pool bar
No beachside or poolside service 
Room service tag left on door for breakfast- it never arrived 
Dinner reservations must be made at one of the on-site restaurants.
Not all royal service rooms have an ocean view. 

PRO's
beautiful property
pleasant staff
pool activities and shows on property
skirt steak (at RARE restaurant) 
the wedding we attended was well taken care of by the staff
butler drew a nice bath for us without us even asking. Wine, cheese plate and chocolate covered strawberries and all. It was the highlight of the upgrade.

reviews.author: Ruty W
reviews.title: IF IT WASN'T FOR THE LOCAL's
reviews.text:
First I do wish to say, WE MAKE Our own GOOD Time's. BUT...Looking at these grounds here and the beach, pool. Who would expect to have a Luxury Suite room with patched up windows! We moved the taped down discolored blinds, And wat-view! I'm not one to give reviews, but since this is the first one our 16yr old came with us. I decided to really compliment the struggling staff. She really tried to create a type of mini bar for my son after he left her a short note in Spanish requesting snacks. And She left him some chips, candy bars and soda. This so called STOCKED, mini bar, had nothing but water, and diet soda when we arrived. The 2cans, of beer was Never-replaced for the rest of 7-days stay. I don't, know nor, am I sure if face cloth type towels are allowed here. Never seen but 2, each for the-3-of us..humm! Anyway I asked..and asked..again I asked. But forgot about it, cuz as I said we did make our money work as best we can and had fun. Some things they should have warned us about, like uhh, closing of a restaurant, yeah-guess we would like to know that before our long dressed up-sweaty walk to dinner. Come to find out part if the staff was not aware either. So off we go to the burger hut. Not bad veggie burgers, gets a bit tasteless after a day or 3. We did have a great time with activities set up by the activity desk..she set us up with the dolphins excursion, the 4-wheeler, and sailboat beach tour. The locals are the funniest fun, and these made our vaycay-all the better. I'm sorry I can't remember the activity clerk name. But, she's the only female on that desk and very sweet. 
As for the night life...LOL., well if you're 12 to 16, its great. Cuz it's over at 11pm. Wat a shame-Cuz, the staff, Dj's, and SHAKEY SHAKEY, would love to dance on that beautyfull court yard that shuts down :(... 
We did enjoy our nights as it was a group of us. We enjoy hearing local stories, experiences etc. But just as in Jamaica,they replaced the locals of the island, with foreign staff of either, Nepal, or Sri Lanka..so if you remove the local people, to save money, you remove what the vaycay is all about. Just as, if you would warn, staff, and people, honestly about renovations, then they Wouldn't Think The Worst..Or feel cheated...
I do want to say this...besides, the 20yr old tv, and moldy room. We had a SHAKEY SHAKEY aye aye-Good time... And we will return again Some day..Just for the beauty of the D.R.

reviews.author: Katey B
reviews.title: KB
reviews.text: Awesome had a great time would love to come back great food and entertainment!! Beautiful resort!! Raynold Tamayo was great he was very professional also my butler Anthony was amazing his service was spectacular!!!!

reviews.author: Tamara G
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Definately recommends coming to this resort! Everyone is so nice and welcoming here. Special shout out to our Butler Anthony and Herberto for their excellent service!! Also special shout out to Raynold Tamayo for his amazing dance skills getting the crowd going and enjoying their time!!! We will be back!!

reviews.author: otisb518
reviews.title: Why would you stay anywhere else!!!!
reviews.text: Prepare to be pampered from the moment of your arrival until departure. Extremely friendly resort employees willing to bend over backwards to make your trip enjoyable. Grounds and private beach areas extremely clean and cared for.

reviews.author: Isaac F
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Great time, great food. Would recommend this place to anyone. The golf course was in great shape. So many swimming pools. The burger bar was a great lunch location. My friend's wedding was absolutely beautiful!

reviews.author: KEBF
reviews.title: Great stay with my friends!
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. Luis Sanchez was an amazing butler/concierge-thoughtful and attentive to all our needs! We enjoyed every afternoon at the Sunset Bar with Wanda and her fantastic drinks. Rafael at the Palazzo Restaurant created a wonderful surprise menu for a memorable dinner. All in all it was a great overall experience and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Josheline G
reviews.title: Paradisus.. es el Paraiso
reviews.text: Si están buscando un lugar para relajarse, olvidarse de todo y sentirse engreido, este es el lugar! Fui hace unas semanas con mis amigas buscando salir del estrés y vaya que lo conseguimos. Recibimos un linda habitación y un trato vip. Mi restaurante favorito definitamente FUEGO, mis felicitaciones al Chef Avilez, un maestro de la cocina peruana. Tambien mi admiración al Chef Mayo y al Chef Juan del restaurante mexicano. Agradezco la amabilidad de los mayordomos Jose y Carlos, estuvimos en Royal Service. Recomendado!!!

reviews.author: teeny2012
reviews.title: Great mini vacation
reviews.text: I stayed at the Reserve at the Paradisus in DR for 3 nights. My friends and I had a great time. The room was clean and spacious. We had a private pool that we shared with 3 other rooms but the landscaping was beautiful. Golf cart drivers to the main hotel for the club, beach or for additional options for dining was always available. The staff was so friendly and accommodating. I mean from the wait staff to the maids to the bartenders were always so pleasant.I must shout out Gaberial/Gabby.. He was the most pleasent host ever. He assisted in coordinating a last minute 3 course lobster pool side private meal for my friends 40th b-day. He definitely catered to our needs. I would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.author: Jordi P
reviews.title: Esplendido hotel
reviews.text: Magnificas habitaciones, buenas prestaciones. Dentro del hotel hay unos magnificos restaurantes a los que puedes acceder, con la pulsera de todo incluido. La comida excelente, tanto las piscinas como la playa, cumplen con las mejores espectativas para disfrutar de unas vacaciones caribeñas. El personal encantador, si tienes en cuenta su ritmo caribeño.

reviews.author: Tamar N
reviews.title: Pure Paradise on the Beach
reviews.text:
Recently came back from a vacation at Paradisus Palma Real with Royal Service. We had the most relaxing vacation ever. From the time we got off the shuttle to the resort, to the time we got back on it to go home, everything was taken care of. We didn't have to wait in line to check in, our cabana was reserved for us every day, reservations were made for us every night, and the service was top notch. We heard from non-Royal Service guests that reservations were a bit challenging, but we didn't have to worry about it! Our butler left us snacks in the room when he knew we would be coming back from the beach, drew a bath for me, and even had a birthday cake waiting for us on the last night. He checked in every day and coordinated with other people (wait staff, room service) to make sure everything we wanted was addressed. 

The hotel itself is beautiful and well cared-for. There seemed to be hundreds of employees to attend to everyone, and all were very gracious. We had the roped-off beach area and exclusive pool access due to Royal Service, but we also spent some time in the main pool. The restaurants were good to amazing depending on which one. Passion, the restaurant that was an additional cost, was absolutely worth it. One of the best tasting menus I have ever had. 

We went on one excursion to a spa on the ocean, and I would recommend that as well. Two foot treatments, time sun bathing in the ocean, yoga, a massage, a scrub, and lunch at a floating restaurant!

Overall, the experience was a perfect way to celebrate turning 40. I could not have asked for more.

reviews.author: rougerivertravel
reviews.title: Dated Colonial styling with a few small issues
reviews.text:
The property is large and laid out both horizontal to the beach but also very deep and there are incredibly few golf carts considering the resort size. This means there will be a lot of walking between  each and room or to the lobby and everywhere else. Especially going anywhere from the beach.

The paths are 4 to 6 feet wide, stamped and painted cobbled looking cement, so while it looks lovely, it also means it is slippery when it rains. Which can be at least once daily but most likely 2 to 4 times, during the June through October peak season for hurricanes.

When it does rain, you will have clouds with torrential downpour for 30 minutes then the sun will come out again and it will be very hot. Over a few hours the humidity builds until there is another massive cloud burst. The weather is predictably unpredictable but the bad weather usually doesn't last. The benefit is incredibly lush tropical gardens. 

For this reason, bug spray is as important as sunscreen. You will need it. This doesn't mean mosquitos or sand fleas are an issue. It means it is their prime breeding season and you are walking through lush tropical areas and across beaches where they are completing their life cycle.

The beach and ocean are spectacular. The beach is powder white sand, 200 feet wide, with a smattering of palm trees dividing the beach from the grounds. The water is shades of blue providing some beautiful photo opportunities.

When there is a storm, this area of the Punta Cana beach is going to get more seaweed than some of the other properties. It can range from 6 inches to 3 feet wide along the shore line and there is no tractor or manual removal of it. This makes the water a bit murky a few feet from shore but won't detract from anything as you simply walk through it into clear water. It's an ocean. Meaning it's a living organism which changes with weather and over seasons.

The rooms are spacious, laid out well and have wonderfully comfortable beds and pillows. Things are clean and the maid service was impeccable all week. The room has quite a bit of wear and tear and there are some basic maintenance which has to be reported and taken care of.

The fixtures and material on sofa, chairs and lamps just made the room feel dated and in need of refreshing or updating, which is an easy fix and even if it stays the same until the resort renovated, doesn't actually detract from the vacation on a whole. There are a few areas where plaster work needs repairing and not just to be painted over.

There is a massive soaker tub in the bath area with frosted glass doors between the water closet, shower and vanity area. But the shuttered pass through behind the tub provides additional privacy for people who require more. The provided soap, lotion, shampoo and conditioner was a very nice quality. The hair dryer was a good one but was only used once due to a losing battle between hair and humidity. It was easier to accept curly hair for the week.

Bartending and wait staff at various venues were fast and accurate. The clean up staff afterwards, were much much slower. There is a surprising language barrier between many of the staff who interact with guests, especially concerning basic requests like someone asking for "black tea". This is an easy fix for hotel management management in the future  plus guests can pick up a few phrases before they leave home to mitigate the issue.

Room service was incredible. All week, food arrived between 20 and 40 minutes, was hot, prepared well and were generous portions. The food overall was plentiful and good. Nothing was exceptional but nothing was horrible either. It's far better than basic but not the same level as many comparably sized properties. The majority of families would be completely fine with it.

reviews.author: Maripi74
