reviews.title: Amazing Holiday, lovely hotel, lovely beach,amazing service! Family Concierge Service
reviews.text:
We just came back from a week at this resort, we were 3 adults travelling alone, but we stayed in the family concierge section sharing a one bedroom suite. ( they did not have rooms is in the adult section).
Hotel grounds are beautiful, food is really nice, the cocktails are great, and the service was spotless.
The family concierge building are the furthest away from the beach, so you need to wait for a little train to take you to the beach (make sure you do not forget anything) because you then have to do the trip back-wand it can easily take you 20 min or more if the car-trains are not there both ways.
In the end we got use to the scenery trip in the little trains daily, we had nothing else to do so no point in stressing about how far we were....
although if you are adults only, the rooms in this section are the closest ones to the beach.
The buffet and some restaurants were outdoor and you need to have a swimsuit cover or tshirt to go in, but the food is kept in an air conditioning room, so it all feels nice and fresh.
We had access to most buffers as we were staying the the reserve section,and we had a nice separate section for family concierge with huge beds, and great service for cocktails and drinks. there is no food available to eat in the beach (maybe some crisps etc) so if you peckish bring  some little nibbles from your mini bar , until lunch time.
We had lunch mainly in Gabi beach, and also Mole (really nice) ,as they do lunch and dinner there. We had access also to the adult section with the Royal Service bracelet, and the restaurant is very nice Lapalapa, and the pool is small and private,., we preferred the pool in the Reserve, as it its huge, with lots and lots areas to lay down, bali beds-big beds-loungers, and the Grill restaurant next to the pool where you can get burgers-hotdogs-quesadillas-chips-and ice cream cones on TAP!
The bar there is also bigger and seems to be always empty so no competing with other adults trying to get cocktails on the go all the time.it just had more of a chill out vibe.
Our family concierge was Sandra, and she was always answering the phone to our endless questions, gracefully and patiently, and was very helpful throughout the whole week. We also had Sofia with us a few days and she was also great sorting our bookings, or any extra things we needed.
Sandra organized for us a bubble bath with balloons (normally done for the kids) but why not?  and made us feel extra special.
The room service cleaner was also very nice and made sure we had everything we needed and brought up extra chocolates every night, extra towels or anything we needed.
Esthephanni, was the manager of the Family Concierge in The Reserve, and she answered all my emails and questions before our arrival, and during, and she also met us one night in a restaurant to give us a nice, unexpected surprise, and that was very kind of her.
Wifi was great anywhere in the hotel, our favourite restaurants were.
Aqua(italian),Vento (you need to have the chocolate brownie dessert)-Teppenyaki- Mole and the buffets.
we also had great room service in the last day because we were packing and did not have time to go for lunch downstairs.
The one comment I would say, is that ideally as an Eco resort, all the hotel car -trains should be battery powered, not only are they more silent (especially if you want to sleep in the morning- but much more eco friendly).
if you travel with children- do not forget anything in your room as it will take ages, but I am sure that if you have the Family Concierge Service they will sort it out for you.
We popped by the kids club (as we all had families with small children back home), and it looked very spacious, with lost of things to do, with an indoor and outdoor section with a complete schedule of activities.-they have a smaller kids pool also next to the main one in the reserve, and they will bring you cookies and milk every night if you have children.Maybe in this respect, it would be good to update the TV's and channels i the room for when you kids need to take a break from the sun at midday....
otherwise everything seems great.
Thanks for everything, we had an amazing time!!!

reviews.author: Carolina L
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: This was the perfect place for my bachelorette! We didn't want a party scene, we really wanted a place we could relax and enjoy the time with my friends. We stayed in a 2 bedroom swim up suite, which was perfect to have everyone in one suite. We had a private butler/concierge called Gustavo, who made our stay that much better. He was always super attentive and making sure we had everything we needed. The last night he planned a private dinner by the pool just for us, so we could really enjoy our last dinner together in the most special way. The restaurants were pretty great as well, especially for an all-inclusive. I just wished we could have stayed longer. But I'm definitely coming back!

reviews.author: delta327
reviews.title: Top notch all inclusive resort
reviews.text:
Resort grounds are spectacular. Impeccably maintained with beautiful landscapes and wildlife. Swim up pool bars, built in tiled lounge chairs in pool and plenty of cabanas to get out of sun when needed. Beach is a short walk ( or you can grab golf cart shuttle ride ). Beach is gorgeous. We had drinks at beach bar made by Bonita that were delicious!! Her service and attention were also perfect. 
The entertainment coordinator Reynaldo was a joy to be around. 
The buffet had plenty of options for every meal. If you got tired of buffet, you could make reservations at one of the many different restaurants. Enjoyed great meals at Mole, the Grill and Vento. Word of advice, make reservations on day 1. And you don't make them through restaurant. There is someone in hotel lobby solely responsible for this. Get a print out of your reservation schedule to avoid any confusion. We had a little challenge with this but the hotel manager Adrian couldn't have been more helpful in ensuring we got what we needed. 
I would definitely go back to this resort. Next time I will pack my Yeti drink holder as it was so hot and hard to keep drinks cold.

reviews.author: Julie N
reviews.title: A must stay!   Fun all-inclusive!
reviews.text:
I've stayed at several all-inclusive resorts over the years and this one ranks in my top three.   I will start by saying why it's not number one.   

Two things - 1) Food isn't served at any of the pools 2) Though I am sure there is a reason, the paper cups used at the pool bars were small and not durable so I highly recommend you bring your own cup.

NOW...  on to the fun stuff.  The room was pretty amazing!   Though I do have to say I've never seen a bed as big as the one my roomie and I had.  Usually, I prefer to have my own bed but this thing was like two kings together!  It was amazing!   When I first got to my room, there was water on the floor.   As you should know, marble and water don't mix!  I called and there was someone to fix the air conditioner leak within 20 minutes!  I appreciated the mini bar service.   I left a note letting them know what we wanted and what wasn't necessary.   They took care of it!   Turn-down service was nice!   Having clean towels after an afternoon shower was pretty cool!

Getting around the resort was fairly easy once you acclimated yourself.   The buildings really need numbers on them or names.   However, there was signage out in front of each.   In our case, when we saw spider man we knew we were there!

The restaurants were very good.   I'm not the best at remembering the names of them but I will say the teppanyaki restaurant was very good!  Lots of food!   The Aqua restaurant on the neighboring property was AMAZING!   Good enough to go twice!  

Nightlife was abundant there!    The Avenue bar was a lot of fun!   DJ music and plenty of dancing!  The Red Lounge was my favorite!   Again DJ music but stayed open later!  They had a big indoor performance nearly every night.   I watched Michael Jackson and Queen covers.   They were pretty phenomenal and included. 

The pools were of a great size and were a lot of fun.   Our group brought our own floaties so fun was had for sure.    What we like to do after our trip is gift them to other guests.   It is a sight to see!    Daniel our pool waiter was very attentive and never blinked at the sizes of our cups!!

The banquet staff did an amazing job as well!   We had nearly 400 in our group, if not more, and meals were served efficiently and we always had what we needed.  

On the 4th day, my roomie and I upgraded to the Royal Service with an Ocean View!  Took my breath away!   The room was nearly identical to the first room but the view was worth it!   If I were to reserve a room, I would do Royal Service.   Not just for the private pool and bar.   Not just for the private restaurant.   Not just for the ocean view...   I would do it all over again to have our butler Carlos Hinostroza!   From the moment he brought our bags to RS check-in and all the personal touches I knew we made the right choice!   Our wishes were truly his command!   From the mini-bar, snacks, checking in with us at the pool daily and returning a drunk dial from the night before!   Trina and I truly appreciated everything he did for us.   

RS restaurant was available for all meals.   Either menu or buffet.   Lots of choices and delicious!    The staff were very kind!   I only had two photos of staff but here's who deserves a mention...   Felix, Miguel, Fatima, Naironi, Edison and Luis

The lobby desk was very accommodating!   One specifically, I wish I got his name!   I needed to change pesos for smaller bills and joked about the counter being a bar and called him "bartender".    I had several questions which he addressed.   While in my room, I had to call the front desk and he answered "bartender"!    It was hilarious!   I hope he sees this review and knows I'm talking about him!     

I truly had a great time during my week here!   I highly recommend this resort.   Make sure to do your homework regarding pricing!  There are a lot of third party companies that may save you money.   However, we booked through Melia and were satisfied!

The pictures I post will have the names of the rest of the staff that made our trip memorable.

reviews.author: hdbuns119
reviews.title: Punta Cana 2017 Time of Our Life
reviews.text:
This was my second time in Punta Cana.  I went with my best friend (girls trip) and we absolutely loved this resort.  It's relaxing and beautiful.  The beach is breathtaking and the resort is well kept and very nice!  The food was excellent.  Every single restaurant had delicious options and great food.  The drinks were good too.  We stayed in the Royal Service Garden View Adults Only section and we liked that very much.  We had exclusive access to our own separate pool, cabanas, had our own butler, separate restaurants, upgrade on alcohol, all while having the same access to other pools and beaches too if we wanted.  
The beach is well kept.  Beautiful white sand, turquoise ocean...sounds great right?  It's like a scene from a movie!  What makes it better is the drink in your hand.  
Here's the best part. The staff!  These people are wonderful, hardworking, kind and want you to have a good time.  They work hard to make sure you are having a good time and are happy with your stay.  Here is a list of the wonderful people to see and why there are the best.
My favorites are Angel and Looky Looky from Activities and Entertainment.  They are wonderful!!!  They make sure you have a good time!  They did everything including water aerobics, dancing lessons, and my favorite night time entertainment (dancing entertaining, fun).  These guys work hard! They are very talented.
Angel is so kind and funny!  He is very entertaining...Get ready ladies to dance with this guy.  He's so fun! :)

Looky Looky is a very talented dancer.  All around a good time.  

Find Wanda (Royal Service Bartender) she will make the best drinks for you.  Ask for my favorite Coco Loco with rum....oh yummy!  

Juan Suarez is the Avenue Bartender at night.  Find him...he makes your drinks yummy and he is very nice.  

Gregory and Bictor were our paddle board yoga instructors.  This was so fun to do!  They make it very relaxing and fun.  

Best Restaurants to ask for reservations are: Fuego (Mexican food), Bana (Japanese Hibachi), Rare (Steak House), and Aqua (Mediterranean).  All were outstanding and delicious.   

Stop thinking about coming and JUST book your stay at Paradisus Palma.  It's so amazing and you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Jenna Y
reviews.title: Girls' Trip Punta Cana 2017
reviews.text:
I just returned from 5 nights in paradise in the Royal Service Garden View section of the Paradisus Palma Real Resort. I traveled with my best friend for our second annual girls' trip to Punta Cana. We spent the extra money and stayed in the Royal Service section and wouldn't have it any other way. From the minute we checked in we were treated like royalty being offered mimosa's and cool wet washcloths to clean up from our flight.  Our room was spectacular. We requested third floor, double beds, non-smoking and got everything we asked for. While ocean view would have been amazing, the garden view was great because honestly who's in their room that much during their trip to stare outside?  The royal service villas were just a few steps from the private royal service pool  and private beach. Both were amazing.  Our butler, Yohelvi, was awesome. He would have our first row beach cabanas reserved for us every morning, and would leave a cheese plate or chocolate covered strawberries in our room every afternoon. 

Wanda, the bartender at the royal service pool bar, was our favorite lady! She greeted us every morning and made the best Coco Loco we have ever had. She was awesome! Pedro, who would see us coming every morning, would greet us with a smile and lead us to our beach cabana without even having to tell him who we were each day! 

After spending a gorgeous day at the beach and in the pool, we went to dinner at many amazing places. Our favorites were Fuego, Bana, Rare, and Aqua. The food at this resort was fantastic. We are not picky eaters and know that resort food can vary in quality but we were blown away with one meal being better than the next each night. We had no problems with our butler making our reservations. He was attentive to our requests of where we wanted to go and always made reservations at the times we wanted to eat.

The night time entertainment was great. We spent a lot of time in the lobby at Avenue Bar. Juan Suarez made some great drinks. The entertainment crew was fabulous.  They loved getting people up to dance and show off their dancing talent. Angel was amazing and hilarious and loved getting people involved. He was a great dance instructor and so fun to talk to!  

We didn't do any excursions off the resort, but enjoyed taking part in the activities offered at the pool and on the beach.  My favorite was the paddle board yoga in the pool with Gregory. It sounds harder than it actually was, but felt amazing and I only fell off at the very end. Haha

I'm sure I'm forgetting a hundred other things that made this trip the best one yet, but I would highly recommend this resort. We plan on coming back here on a future girls' trip!

reviews.author: Anupama T
reviews.title: Vacation!!!
reviews.text: The Reserve is great place for vacation, good facilities... enjoyed pool by the bar. Staff was friendly most of the time. I enjoyed staying at resort, we got upgraded which was nice. Everything was good except I guess being vegetarian, I didn't have any food options. Surprisingly, resort didn't have options other than salad whereas i thought since many people turning vegetarian.. I will not have problem. The problem was they could not make any vegetarian dish on request. Personally, I would not prefer 'All inclusive' next time.

reviews.author: LawrenceB6r
reviews.title: Was expecting a little more...
reviews.text:
We attended a wedding at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort May 25-30 2017. The wedding was very nice. Well planned and the facility and staff orchestrated a wonderful service. At check in we upgrade to a higher service level, ‘Royal Service’. It included access to a private pool area, exclusive restaurant and premium liquor (Gray Goose), it was well worth the price.
 
The Good: 

The grounds are extremely well maintained and beautiful. There is a lot of seaweed on the beach but hey... its the ocean.

The food was very good thru out the resort. We never had a bad meal. One night in the buffet they served grilled lobster tails (outstanding). We ate at the steak house 2 nights, the ribeye steak was huge, tender and tasty. The last night we ate at the Japanese Steak house, another great meal.
The servers/staff were also outstanding. During the wedding reception, our server (Ezequiel Castillo) was fabulous. As soon as my drink looked like it was getting watery he was right there with another one. He took great care of our table, we wanted for nothing!
The Royal Service Private pool. Outstanding serving. We spent EVERY day at the pool. We’d get a cabana after breakfast and spend the day there, between the pool and the ocean.  
I played two rounds of golf during our stay at Cocotal Golf and Country Club. The shuttle bus runs every hour at 10 minutes till the top of the hour. The golf course is well maintained and fun. They have a grass tee driving range and a nice putting green. Staff was professional and helpful. I had my first hole in one, on the Benjamina course hole number 3. The staff was as excited for me as I was. The manager sent me an official course certificate to document to occasion.
 
The Bad:

Nightlife, what nightlife? They put on a themed show every evening, from a Michael Jackson show to a DR tribute. They were nice... Other than that you are left to walk around the grounds, mingle and drink more... that's about all there is to do after the sun goes down, unless you want to gamble in the casino. 

When we checked into our room, the toilet didn’t flush and a bulb was out in the shower. A call to the front desk quickly corrected these two issues.

Our room had mosquitos… and not just one or two… we spent the entire stay fighting them things. We talked to the front desk and they were to send to someone over to spray. Honestly we’re not sure if it ever happened or not… we made an effort not to be in the room that much. They were really bad. We have bits all over the place. I tried to sit on the patio one evening, that lasted all of 2 minutes before I was attacked… Weird thing is, we talked to other folks in our group and they had NO issues with mosquitos… seems to have just been our room/area. Note to self, don’t stay in the 3705.
The noise outside our room was an issue (and probably others on that side of the building), our bedroom window was adjacent to an area were the staff meets in the morning to get their supplies to maintain the building/grounds. Every morning we were awaken to the beeping sound of trucks backing up, people talking, etc. long before we were ready to wake up…

reviews.author: Ashley M
reviews.title: Not a thing I would change
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is absolutely breathtaking from the beach, pools, food, atmosphere, grounds, and rooms. Everything was wonderful and there wasn't a single thing I would change. Everyone there goes out of their way to make sure your needs are met. We had royal service and as soon as you check in they make sure they treat you like royalty. They bring you in and treat you to cold towels and mimosas, and explain everything to you from start to finish. Our butler Nicolas was so friendly and nice made our stay superb. He went out of his way to make sure all our needs were met and that we had reservations at restaurants and the beach everyday. We would also come in to little surprises everyday that included fruit, cheese, or our tub all decked out with flowers, bubbles, chocolate covered strawberries and champagne. I would recommend anyone doing the royal service in the future to request him. I promise you won't be disappointed. All the restaurants were wonderful. We only had one mishap at aqua, and that's because the guys in our group wore shorts and sandals (our fault btw, they tell you the dress code) and they sent them back to the room to change, so make sure you dress accordingly. I didn't have any food there I didn't like. Everything was so delicious and flavorful. My boyfriend and I had dinner on the beach on night under the stars and I can't even begin to explain how amazing it was. They let you pick from a list of different options for food and said they could change it up if you liked. They also had everything ready for us when we arrived at the beach. It was all beautiful and the setup made us feel so special. We had the lobster and beef filet and the lobster was the biggest I had ever. Overall, everything was absolutely wonderful. I would recommend this resort to anyone and will definitely be back. I had the best time and they made my vacation special.

reviews.author: Maeve J
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Raynold Tamayo was a great worker 5 stars excellence service. The massage place was very good plenty of space. Also the food was very good with a lot of variety. Plenty of places to dance and the pools were nice.

reviews.author: joyclark7
reviews.title: What a Joy!
reviews.text: Excellent time at Paradisus Resort. I will definitely return to the property for another vacation. Also, considering the location for a destination wedding. I was very satisfied with the food, activities, and beauty of the property.

reviews.author: DonKnowlton
reviews.title: Karlyn's wedding
reviews.text: Starky Valoy is the best bartender their is! Find him @ the M-Bar, tip him well! He is one of the kindest, and friendliest you'll meet. The bar is located at the entrance to Passion restaurant, which is the finest dining experience available!

reviews.author: Jenni O.
reviews.title: Beautiful place to stay
reviews.text: WOW!  What a beautiful property!  My husband and I recently stayed at this resort and was more than impressed!  The staff was very friendly and very accommodating.  The food was amazing from the buffet restaurant.  The food was constantly fresh and delicious.  A great variety at every meal time.  The pool and beach area was clean.  It was nice to see staff always on site cleaning and maintaining the property.  We loved the calming music that plays throughout the resort and the smell of the incense was nice. Our rooms were clean and fresh every day and our rooms were very pretty with a fabulous view. We are looking forward to our next visit at the Paradisus, and we hope that it will be soon.  We highly recommend this resort.  Top notch!

reviews.author: Renay S
reviews.title: Best Vacation EVER! Jimmy is the best!
reviews.text: This was our first time in Punta Cana and we had a great time!  We received Royal Service from start to finish with Jimmy Sosa as our butler.  I highly recommend this resort.  The food was great and all staff was very attentive from start to finish!  I am telling all my co workers next time they go to DR to stay here!  Thank you so much again. You have made our stay unforgettable and can't wait to visit again soon!

reviews.author: Adrienne M
reviews.title: Activity Program
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real offers a wonderful life enriching program throughout the day. Take advantage of the Aqua Fitness Class facilitated by Shaky Shaky Ay Yay Yay. He's a wonderful instructor and helps you get all the benefits of exercise in water.
Once your limbs are warmed up- Don't miss a chance to have this instructor show you steps from Merengue to salsa. Fantastic teacher. Learning should always be this fun!!

A from CA

reviews.author: MisoDolphins
reviews.title: 2nd time around
reviews.text: this is our second time visiting Paradisus Palma Real .it was a good stay not like the first time. We got the royal service which is the only way to stay there. Alberto the beach and pool waiter is the best hands down. He was on top of our drinks. Made sure we had a cabana ready by the beach every day. When you dine in at Palazzo  speak to the chef ask  him you want a special dinner made by him. You will not be disappointed. Next time I will stay on a different hotel. NOT Barcelo Bavaro its the worst.

reviews.author: jwgilbert3333
reviews.title: Greatest vacation
reviews.text: The butlers MIGUEL Abreu and Ariel Benzo  were absolutely the best.  They helped us and another couple we were traveling with for 8 days.  Every request was granted and they were at our beckoning call.  They even left lovely surprises in our rooms without us requesting.  If you come to this resort you must ask for either Miguel or Ariel!

reviews.author: 351MN
reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: Was the nicest resort I've ever stayed at. The resort, food, service & facility were all 1st class. Obeidy Rodriguez was our beach waiter, he was outstanding, took care of our every need! I have not one complaint.  Thanks! We'll be back!!

reviews.author: ANGIE P
reviews.title: I would not return...
reviews.text:
Just returning from an all expense paid incentive trip from my company that I earned, this was by far the worst property we have ever been to in my 20 years.  

The food was terrible & tasteless, and servers, especially in the Naos buffet and Blueagave Mexican restaurants were awful.  We basically had to beg for service every time at both places. And when we were able to get their attention and ask for something, we were looked at like we had the nerve to make a request.  There was even an occasion that when asked for a 2nd bowl of soup, we were told "no, only 1 per table".  Excuse  me?  All-Inclusive means ALL WE WANT!   That's what's paid for!  The one exception to that was with Gregory who served us exceptionally well both in Rare and Blueagave during the lunchtime hours.  BTW, Blueagave serves ONLY hamburgers (veggie & chicken included) and they are like hockey pucks! 

Poolside and beach service....well, unless you are will to drop a big tip into a servers hands (once you can actually find one), don't expect them to come looking for you.  We even had the Royal Service and on only 1 day did a server approach us to ask us if we wanted a drink.  Our butler thru the Royal Service, Angelo Mercedes, was very helpful to us during the trip, making our dinner reservations and getting us a cabanna each day that we asked.  Power went out 4-5 times during our stay as well.  Several others in our group had to change rooms because of issues with their beds, ants in the rooms, TV not working and more. 

Bottom line, if you're used to fantastic service and food from other all-inclusives (our best experiences have been with Hyatt Zivas in both Cabo and Jamaica) then you will be just as disappointed as we were if you go.

reviews.author: tilly450
reviews.title: Muy buenas instalaciones. Personal no muy amable,
reviews.text:
La atención a las mesas no es buena. Esperamos mucho cada día para que nos sirvieran el  café y luego tuvimos que pararnos y buscar los cubiertos, las servilletas, el azúcar... la espera es muy larga para que te alcancen cada cosa. Sugeriría que hubiera un servicio de bebidas (jugos, agua) para servirse uno mismo en el almuerzo en Naos. Además notamos una mala actitud hacia nosotros, nos atendían sin mucha cortesía.
Sugiero que para servir los postres que hayan 2 personas porque hay que hacer fila para que sirvan los postres. Tal vez uno podría servir los helados y otro los postres para agilizar el servicio.
En la habitación tampoco fue bueno el servicio pues encontramos una las camisas de dormir en la tina revuelta y faltaban toallas que tuvimos que pedir. 
El primer día no nos explicaron cómo funcionaba el aire acondicionado y tuvimos que dormir congeladas. Tampoco funcionó el control remoto de la TV. Nadie nos explicó cómo usarlo, 
En los restaurantes el personal sí muy amable, igual en la recepción.
Otra cosa: pedí un plano de República Dominicana y nos dijeron que lo podíamos ver en internet y sólo atendían en la Oficina de turismo, pero allí no nos quisieron dar nada,  Sugiero que puedan dar un pequeños plano de ubicación. 
En cuanto al sistema WIFI iba y venía, no había una conexión permanente en todo el local, Curiosamente en la playa es cuando había una mejor conexión.

reviews.author: Marcelo D
reviews.title: El mejor capital de un hotel es su personal en un excelente infraestructura y calidad gastronómica.
reviews.text:
Estuvimos alojados en el hotel desde el 19 de mayo al 29 de mayo de 2017. Las instalaciones son muy cuidadas desde la estética. Con una vista imponente.  Cuenta con una excelente oferta gastronómica. En cada uno de los restaurantes como así también en la calidad y variedad de la comida en el buffet. 
El personal del hotel se muestra siempre atento, solicito a las necesidades y con una muy buena disposición. Lo cual podría decir que es el personal en su totalidad es el mejor capital con el que cuenta el hotel 
Estuvimos en el Servicio Real, gran parte de la estadia.  Vale mencionar al  restaurante Palazzo para desayuno, almuerzo y cena El personal del mismo es excelente. Destacándose Juan de Aza, Juan Mejia, Fátima Diaz por el trato afectuoso natural y solicito a cada detalle. 
En el servicio de Playa por su excelente disposición Pedro Cedano.  
En el bar del Lobby la atención especial de Melvin.
La atención de nuestro mayordomo Faustino 
Y el personal del Front Desk en el Servicio Real
Excelente la atención del personal en las habitaciones.  Las junior suites necesitan ser cambiadas en algunos detalles.  El equipo de música resulta obsoleto al igual que la televisión. Los teléfonos y las duchas necesitan cambiarse. 
En todas las habitaciones incluidas las del Royal Service. Que son sin duda modernas y cuidadas.  Las toallas y toallones se notan viejos y ásperos al tacto. Necesitarían ser renovados. 
Tuvimos una circunstancia desafortunada a la vuelta.  El operador NEXUS, debía pasar a buscarnos 1445 para llevarnos al hotel.  Nunca vino, más allá del llamado que se hizo reclamándolo y la espera hasta las 1530. Solicitamos en el Front desk un comprobante que no había concurrido para poder hacer el reclamo correspondiente para que se devolviera el importe. Pero se negaron a hacerlo diciendo que no podían.  No recibiendo por parte del personal que estuvo en ese horario atendiendo una atención respetuosa y cordial.  Muy por el contrario.  Debemos destacar a ELVIS, quien nos acompaño durante todo el tiempo. Más allá de su tarea. Mostrándose solicito a pedir un taxi y atender nuestras necesidades.  Felicitaciones por su desempeño.

reviews.author: Claslp
reviews.title: Paradise 5 stars
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the beauty and architecture of the resort! The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The resort has a buffet available three times a day and as well as an excellent array of restaurants that require reservations. What a marvelous view of the ocean! I loved the columns and entryway! I would definitely return.

reviews.author: eileenf1320
reviews.title: Excellent Staff/ Service
reviews.text: This was my first time in Punta Cana and I had the best experience. We stayed in the royal service area which included a private pool and unlimited bar with a private side to the beach, unlimited in room service and more. The staff was wonderful, honestly the staff made my experience better. The hotel is beautiful and relaxing. I was expecting to have more options of Spanish food but there were not many. Nevertheless this doesn't change my mind to give this resort a 5 star. Two people that stood out the most were my butler Luis and my room service staff Albert Rodriguez, both staff members went beyond to make us comfortable. I recommend that you guys see and experience this service and resort for yourselves.

reviews.author: Jamie Y
reviews.title: very beautiful and wonderful staff
reviews.text: We were so pleased with the excellent service at Paradisus .  First of all, the grounds and rooms and restaurants were so beautiful, very well taken care of and so clean and pretty.  We had the misfortune of my husband getting sick the second day we were there. After 2 1/2 days, we called the guest services and asked for medical assistance.  Vladimir Rodriguez, the evening guest manager, was at our room within 10 minutes and assisted us to the clinic they had at the resort.   The doctor there wanted my husband to go to the hospital.  Vladimir was so quick to reassure us the the taxi service we needed to use was safe and reliable and to make sure and check in at the desk once we returned to the resort.   After hours at the hospital and our return to the resort, the night manager met us at our room to make sure everything was OK.  Then the next day,  Domingo Beltre, the Guest Service Manager met with us to see what had happened and what they could do to help us.    We were so pleased with the service.  Thank you so much

reviews.author: Nate S
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Fantastico es el paraiso recomiendo este hotel es el major servicio que puede brindar lo pasara feliz muy feliz mas con el encantador equipo como lo es el equipo de actidades la shorty,yubelkis,angel gracias chicos por hacer mis vacaciones felices gracias shorty por ensenarme a bailar

reviews.author: MariaS907
reviews.title: Revisit
reviews.text: We have traveled here before,and found it gets better with each return,the property is beautifully maintained.  The rooms were clean and comfortable and the housekeeping staff kept it that way Desiree Rodriquez, Dely Cueria, and Gladys Jimenez .Made sure everything was stocked and cleaned ,even the extras which were unexpected, rose petals on the bed , towel animals, made it enjoyable to return to the room. The food service was outstanding in quality, quantity, and most  importantly in service, there are to many to mention  but Luis Baez, Angelina Rosario, and Mario Arias made it special. Ramon Ramirez and his crew made the Reserve Beach area  relaxing and active. Sandra Cedeno made you feel  like you were at home her help in reservations for restaurants, activities and her insight was always helpful. We also found Makier Ramirez, who worked in outside excursions and tours  a fountain of information and did not steer you wrong. As for resort activities how could you go wrong with ,Chanl, Melvin, Luis, and Rainor  teaching us how to salsa and entertaining us in shows. These are just some of the people that we ran into, there were many more and each and everyone of them, make this resort one that I will always go back to

reviews.author: Paouri
reviews.title: Tranquilo
reviews.text:
Fui solo por el fin de semana, estuvo muy a gusto y tranquilo.  La playa no es lejos.

La comida estuvo deli, aunque los snacks algo tardados.

La habitación linda y la cama confortable

Es un hermoso lugar

reviews.author: arleneweil
reviews.title: Week in the Dominican
reviews.text: The hotel rooms, and property are beautiful. General service is outstanding. If you like to beach stay on the cabanas and ask for Santos Marren. This gentleman is gives superior service with a smile. Love seeing his smile everyday.

reviews.author: Screte2013
reviews.title: Excellent hôtel!
reviews.text: Magnifique et paradisiaque! Bonne nourriture, belles chambres! Le site est très propre. Pedro et Francisco qui travaillent à la plage sont gentils et souriant et voient à vous installer confortablement sur les beaux grands lits de plage! Grâce à eux, nous avons passé de magnifiques journées sur la plage! Les employés dans les différents restos sont tous aussi gentils et sympathiques...Georges, Martha, Félix dont je me souviens des noms. Merci à vous tous, vous avez rendu notre séjour inoubliable! Je vous dit à bientôt parce que certaine de revenir!

reviews.author: Ron V
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort staffed with amazingly friendly and helpful people. The room was great, location awesome, restaurants were very, very good , and the people were amazing. Estrella in customer service is the model employee for all resorts. So helpful, friendly, and happy that we felt like the was part of the family.The waiters and bartenders were also great! The few opportunities for the property to improve seem to lie in the maintenance service area. We tried three times to get a light bulb replaced in the shower with no success. We also tried four times to get someone to set the flaming bedside clock with the correct time, and no one could figure that one out. Minor nuisances to an amazing place. Our trip was planned and booked through Misty at Shining Light Travel in the US, and she is amazingly wonderful and thorough. We have used her many times and can't imagine using anyone any better.

reviews.author: Eugene D
reviews.title: LOVE Paradisus
reviews.text:
Always a perfect time staying at any of their hotels! Amazing food, strong drinks, beautiful atmosphere, gorgeous clean pools & fabulous helpful staff. 

Went with a large group & we were always accommodatied.

reviews.author: DonnaMarie20
reviews.title: Too quiet
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying the property was pretty, but not for me. Lacking in activities and fun! The theatre was ok. Comparing it to another hotel I stayed at last year, where I saw productions and not just shows at this place. Boring for people that don't won't to just sit around and listen to Zen music playing all day. The food, ehhh, good but not great! Need more gluten free options. I would like to give a shout out to a few people however...Looky Looky and Yeuburki sp? When they actually had some fun music playing for an hour at night, they made it so much fun!  A few of the bartenders A++ @ the pool bar and Gabi Beach Bar (during the day) Jose, Marcos, Fernando, (to name a few, forgot some of their names) friendly and courteous...always with smiles.   
Also, I celebrated my birthday there,  as I did last year at a different hotel.  No recognition here, what so ever!!! Nothing!!! So if you're celebrating a special occasion...not the place to go! Very disappointing!

reviews.author: Fran M
reviews.title: Wedding stay
reviews.text: Was there for my daughters wedding. Staff was attentive and friendly. The grounds were beautiful. Rooms were spacious and well stocked with toiletries and mini bar. We stayed in the Royal service and enjoyed many of the private features. We will return

reviews.author: BigSara32
reviews.title: Heaven!
reviews.text: What a resort! Gorgeous beaches, gorgeous pools, and the Royal Service treatment was great! Our butler, Francis, was simply AWESOME! He made our stay so enjoyable and stress-free! Definitely will return!

reviews.author: Suzanne-en-vacances
reviews.title: Vacances de rêve
reviews.text:
Restaurant passion.  Expérience extraordinaire.
Merci spécial  pour le service particulier , agréable avec Hector et JanCarlos Séverino.

Plage, avec lits de plage, jardins magnifique.

Sommes sur place commentaires autres a venir

reviews.author: Lorraine K
reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: From the disorganized and very long check-in to the food, this was a very disappointing resort. Stayed at this resort in February and was very excited based on outstanding reviews on TripAdvisor. After my stay, i can only wonder if the great reviews were astroturfing. The property and beach are beautiful. If you love walking on the beach, you can walk for miles and that is great. That being said, the service is lacking. Concierge could not be less helpful if she tried. Rooms are well appointed but in need of repair. Air conditioning was 24C when it was 25C outside. Spoke with other vacationers who had 20C and 11C in their rooms. Calls for repair were answered once (out of 3 calls), without any change. Roof leaked, safe wouldn't open even though was keying in right code. Finally problem solved with battery change. Turn down service was at 10:30 pm! For a family resort, far too late. Very noisy because of building materials. You can hear everyone in the hallways (stone stair case) and doors slam very loudly, shut. So when you are trying to sleep, all you hear is people and doors slamming shut. Shower door didn't close tight so had to either have bathroom floor flooded or jam the shampoo tube under the door to keep it closed. Water temp in shower was scalding. Had to let run for 10 minutes before entering. Never ran cool to cold. Food was terrible. Best food at Reseve only restaurant (not buffet or poolside) and room service. Ceviche at Mexican restaurant so salty it was inedible. Everywhere else, very salty too, and not good. Notwithstanding, have to say they had fresh coconut at buffeting the morning and very good oatmeal and yogurt, plus cold soups at lunch very notably good. The alarm clock in my room was set for 12 am and even though I looked and looked, and asked concierge to turn off 3 times, I could not figure out how to turn alarm off. Every morning, I asked concierge to get someone to turn alarm off, yet every night at 12 am, it went off. Finally, after mentioning to staff in Reserve lobby, the clock was turned off, not the alarm. No Do Not Disturb sign, so chamber maid knocked on door every night for turn down at 10:30pm. You have a limit of 4 restaurant reservations for a 7 day stay. Couldn't get steakhouse reservation, was told by other vacationer that they couldn't get steakhouse either, until they tipped their concierge. I have never written this bad of a review ever, of any resort, but after months of thinking about whether to do so or not, finally decided I had to say something. I cannot recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Ryan C
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text:
The kids zone is a great place for your kids to stay during the day. The staff was very helpful and all my kids said they had a great time. I felt very safe leaving my kids for the day. The staff that helped me the most were Nica, Luis, Onil, Adrian, Ynes, Arne, Francisca, Alexandria, Candy, Samantha, Dia and Grissel

The bars were also fantastic. The bartenders were always helpful and delivered drinks to us all day. Boni Ramos and Ravel Maldonado were great.

reviews.author: Camilla H
reviews.title: Awesome Butler! Bucket list!
reviews.text:
If you ever go here, upgrade to the Royal guest treatment when you get there and ask for Argenis! He made the trip so great for me and my friend. It would not have been the same without him! I would not say it would be worth it without him! Do not upgrade until you get there! Beautiful resort but I'm
Giving the trip a five stars because of Argenis!

reviews.author: Aleja G
reviews.title: Dominicana es lo mejor
reviews.text: Las mejores vacaciones la e pasado en paradisus palma real es bien bonito recomiendo este hotel me encanta el servicio gracias al equipo de actividades la shorty ,yubelkis,angel,Alejandro con su clase de pinturas regresaré el próximo año gracias a todos

reviews.author: Monica D
reviews.title: El Caribe es lo mejor
reviews.text: Waooo no tengo palabra para expresar la hermosura de este país tan encantador y más en este resort recomiendo este hotel tiene el mejor servicio en especial los chicos de actividades la shorty es un amor yubelkis,angel muy buena chicos ellos y siempre alegre gracias a todos ellos por los. Bailes la zumba que me gusta mucho la bachata gracias

reviews.author: Javier S
reviews.title: Descanso
reviews.text:
Hoy es mi última noche en el hotel, llegué hace 4 días. El hotel es muy lindo, limpio y las habitaciones super cómodas, me tocó la 1034 con vista al jardín en un primer piso (planta baja), cerca del lobby, con una cama espectacular y un jacuzzi delicioso. Particularmente felicito a Altagracia (la camarera de la habitación), que con mucha dedicación nos ordenaba y limpiaba la habitación. 
La comida del bufet es muy rica y variada, en cto al servicio tienen cosas para mejorar. En cuanto a los restaurantes hay varios ( dos no están incluidos para los pasajeros standars), pero los que están incluidos son muy buenos. 
Y a pesar de que tuve un problema, la gente siempre muy predispuesta a solucionarlo, y aquí  agradezco a La sra Sandra Blum (que escuchó mi queja), que rápida y eficientemente lo solucionó, con la predisposición y buena voluntad del sr Domingo Beltre y la colaboración de las srtas. Estrella García y Leydi  Espinal.  
Muchas gracias y seguramente nos volveremos a ver......

reviews.author: Ddaniel K
reviews.title: Gutes Hotel
reviews.text: Das Paradisus gehört zur Melia Gruppe, die Zimmer sind teils gleich dem Melia the Level. Die Anlage bietet zB auch den Royal Service am Strand, die Getränke sind überall super und das Buffet sehr lecker. Die Restaurants sind gegenüber dem Buffet allerdings schlechter und nicht zu empfehlen . Ohne Royal Service ist das Hotel auch ok, aber lange nicht so gut, wenn man auch Ruhe und nicht nur Party will.

reviews.author: allie4212
reviews.title: Trip to Paradise
reviews.text:
This was my 3rd trip to Punta Cana.  I found the Paradisus Palma Real absolutely lovely!  The property itself is meticulously maintained. It is smaller than some all inclusives but it adds to the intimacy of the property. We had an upgraded room 6014 and 6012 which are partial oceanview and came with our own butler Enrique.  The rooms are the newest on the property and stunning in white and grey marble....huge and gorgeous.  Everything was so close and beautifully set up.  The service was excellent. Enrique was the best!  He put up with demanding New Yorkers (nice ones though) and exceeded our every expectation with pleasure.  The one down side of the property which I had read was making dinner reservations.  They act like they are doing you a favor and it's almost impossible to get decent reservation times but when you arrive the restaurants are half empty. The solution was Enrique.  We told him what we wanted and at what time and he made it happen.  He made suggestions to us and he was honestly always right and never steered us wrong.  Hence why I would suggest upgrading to the rooms with a butler.  I would have taken him home with me if I could!  The food was very good.  Way better than the average all inclusive.  We did have one bad experience when a roach ran across the hibachi table edge just as we were being served our entrees but bugs are everywhere so it can happen.  We had great food at all restaurants honestly.  Our favorite bartender is Starkey at the M bar - you must go see him.  Making drinks is an art for him.  Ask for a Merry Rose.  It was incredible.  He takes such pride in his drinks. When you see the work and pride he puts in every drink you will be astounded.  And they tasted just as good as they looked. Junior was our favorite waiter at Naio the buffet, he is amazing and anticipated our every need.  Shakey Shakey led activities.  He has great energy and attitude.  They all work so hard and are so gracious.  The service was as good as I expected at a luxury property.  The spa at Xhi - I had the best massage I have ever had by Rebecca.  And I have had hundreds of massages all over the world.  She has magic hands and is truly amazing!  We all would go back again and definitely will.
Hope this helps someone......

reviews.author: erindanielles
reviews.title: Awesome resort and service
reviews.text: I would go back again, service was great, and facility was great.  The rooms were very private, could not hear neighbors, balcony on the room was very private.  Grounds were very well take care of and the pools were very clean.

reviews.author: Chelsea Driver
reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text: Raynold Tamayo is an amazing dancer and really loves engaging all the people here. He is very friendly and loves making all the guests feel welcomed! This resort was great! The weather was beautiful!! Don't listen to the weather forecast. I loved everything about this resort. Will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Trishcrna
reviews.title: Awesome stay!
reviews.text: We were relocated here after problems with our original hotel. We would definitely come back! We had a gorgeous ocean view room with our own butler.  Juan Castillo was his name and his level of service went beyond exemplary! Always smiling, quick to respond and attentive to our needs. The extra touches: balloons in the room for my friends birthday, running up extra room keys when we desensitized ours and even beach visits with ice for our drinks. It was truly a level of service like no other. The resort was beautiful, the water ritual/ hydrotherapy at the spa were also incredible and something we won't soon forget.

reviews.author: Marianne S
reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text:
Our trip was for our 50th birthday party. It was everything we were looking for. Service was wonderful the beaches are beautiful, drinks and food were great. 
Our Butler, Jose Salvatore made our stay extra special and treated us like queens. He made us feel like family. 
Francisco Cabrera had our beach priorities under control and made us comfortable every day with our beach chairs and "special drinks".
Fatima and Edison made our dinner and cocktail experience delightful.
We can't wait to return with each other and bring more friends and family along.
Thank you Punta Cana for a memorable 50th birthday!!!!
Marianne

reviews.author: Raspaini
reviews.title: Fantantico
reviews.text: Exelente, mis amigos y yo la pasamos exelente gracias. Regresaremos nuevamente a jugar golf, amamos este pais la simpatía de los chicos de actividades, la Shorty es encantadora shaky angel betty boop son exelente gracias chicos.

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Perfect vacation!
reviews.text: My fiancé and I blindly came here for the week to have our wedding.. we could not have chosen a better resort! Gorgeous resort, delicious food, kind people serving us and a heavy hand on the drinks! Our romance coordinator, Noelia, was absolutely FANTASTIC and made everything run flawlessly for us and our 70 guests for the entire week! Thanks so her, we didn't have to worry about a single thing! Would highly recommend for a destination wedding or any vacation!

reviews.author: deborahchristiner
reviews.title: Fun in the Sun
reviews.text: We had a great vacation for our first trip to the Dominican Republic and the first stay at a Melia resort. We were looking forward to a quiet time before attending a wedding in Santa Domingo.  There were always activities and music but we just chilled by the pool or in the Gabi Lounge with a drink and our books.  We ate at the Nao buffet nearly every day with 2 meals at Blue Agave at lunch when they serve a great cheeseburger! The buffet allowed us to try many new different foods and they had a great selection.

reviews.author: mhootie
reviews.title: Awesome resort!
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at the Paradisus Palma Real!  Food, drink and service was good!!  The on going saying there was "Happy Happy" from the staff. The restaurants and service were always good. The bartender at the bar was fantastic!!  He made anything you wanted and was very accommodating.  You have to visit him when you get there, his name is Louis!!  There is 24 room service but be ware that if you want that late night 1am snack you probably won't get it. Everyone and their brother wants to eat after drinking so the service was very busy (1 1/2 hours busy). No big deal though.  The man that refilled out fridge was pretty cool too. He would fill your fridge with whatever you wanted to drink. You want beer, wine, or mimosas you got it!!  Rancel Valdez was his name :). All in all we had a great time and I would love to visit this place again in the future​ :)

reviews.author: donnasclever
reviews.title: I want to go back!
reviews.text:
My husband and I were fortunate to earn this trip with my company. We had a wonderful time. The property is beautiful, and we found the staff to be extremely attentive and friendly. I had the most AMAZING Mango and Papaya facial in the YHI Spa - I HIGHLY recommend it!
Our room was clean and updated. Room Service was prompt, they even warmed the milk for my coffee!
Eduardo & his crew got us to do yoga on paddleboards - that was worth it alone! 
The resort never seemed overcrowded, there were plenty of places to lounge by the pool or on the beach, with fresh towels.
The best food we had was Teppanyaki - dinner AND a show!

reviews.author: Victoria G
reviews.title: Bachata on the beach
reviews.text: Went to the beach for some fun and sun and got an impromptu bachata lesson from Raynol. So much fun!!!! Juan Diego at the Gabi Club bar is the BEST!!!!!! The resort is beautiful and I cannot wait for what the rest of the week has in store.

reviews.author: Catiana P
reviews.title: Amazing trip!!
reviews.text: My best friend and I stayed at this resort for 5 days, 4 nights and we wish we never left! It was definitely family-friendly, so I highly recommend this resort for families. Although it wasn't party central, we still had an amazing time. There was always dancing and fun activities to do. We would always go to dinner, hang out at Gabi Bar after and then make our way to the Red Lounge. Everything was so so beautiful. Our room was so comfortable and clean. We had an issue with our television at some point, but we called and it was immediately taken care of. The staff was so nice and caring. Daniel was a server by the pool and beach area. He was amazing. He would make sure that we were never empty-handed when it came to drinks, and he made them so well!! We are so sad that we had to leave. We would definitely come back again.

reviews.author: becnanQc
reviews.title: Un gros WOW
reviews.text: Novembre 2014. Super site. Magestueux. Nourriture plus qu'excellente. Beaucoup de choix dans les buffets, qui étaient à mon avis, meilleurs que les restos à la carte. À la piscine le jour, catch of the day disponible et fraîchement cuite devant vous. Service irréprochable. Prise en charge personalisée à l'arrivée. Un 6 étoiles ! Chambre Master très grande et boiseries superbes. Grand bain à remous. Pièces séparées et grand balcon. Service de concierge super et voiturettes disponibles pour les déplacements, car le site est immence. Superbes allées pour marcher vers la plage. Belle plage. Lits de plage. Beaucoup d'ombre. Grandes piscines et animation. Un bel hôtel avec luxe. J'y retournerai un jour !

reviews.author: T B
reviews.title: Health concerns with cleanliness, food, & pest control.
reviews.text:
Beautiful beach clean and can always get a place under a hut. 

Top Resturant in main lobby, I got food poisoning from Seafood.  Pool bar so much foam and scum "urine" at the edges.  Make reservations and confirm them 10 times.  Some how ours were lost and we had to beg to get into one of their restaurants.  When we did I got sick and hardly anybody was in the restaurant.  Multiple empty tables.  Why did they consistently tell us "Sorry we are full?"  They want you to eat at the Buffet " it is a money loss for them to fill up the good restaurants."
Pest control went off sporadically so when walking a mile from Main restaurants/Lobby to room or beach prepare to get Sprayed with chemicals.  Hold breath and run. A family member got bit by something.  She was ill with rash from bite, her joints stiffened and she was down for a month.  Several dead pools of water "swampy" from main area to beach and rooms.  Pretty walk long walk with flamingos etc.., but beware of the bite.  They again spray, but only mid day when walking thru.  They will tell you they only spray at night.  Those pretty huts behind each room the minute you sit prepare to be attacked by bugs.
Lastly, one of the rooms the entire wall to the outside with sliding doors was lined in Mold.  If you have allergies beware.
Rooms only cleaned with 1 chemical "vinegar?" I searched for something since my bowels exploded for 4 days.  Maids cleaning closet scary.
First night, room was not available until 10:00pm.  Manager would not upgrade or compensate all restaurants stopped serving.  Starving we waited from 5:00pm to 10:00pm.  We were meeting up with a group, but wanted to clean up before seeing everyone.
Night life fun DJ and beach dance.  However, they dress in Drag and dance on countertops.  Entertaining, but highly offensive!  Not the Drag, but the Drag in USA red, white, and Blue.  Sexy tiny clothes with the USA flag all over.  Sorry, but I love my country.  I did not disrespect their Country.

I am not a fuzzy person and this is the first review I ever wrote on a resort.  In fact, I went a year ago.  I was searching for a new place and finally decided to write this.

Maybe they got their act together?  However, Manager & Melia Corporate acted as if they did nothing wrong.

Oh, I thought I was spending $1,600 for 5 nights (not including flight) It ended up being over $2,000.   Get the Travel insurance because they do have a busy Doctor at the resort.

reviews.author: Kat G
reviews.title: Great customer service, for the most part--Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
My husband was unfortunate and had a slight accident.  The staff promptly attended to his needs and called each night after to make sure he was okay. We are especially grateful to Mariely Amancio and Carolema Frameo from guest services.  She rode with us to the on site urgent care facility where my husband was promptly and professionally treated.  When it was found that his injury required stitches, the on site doctor arranged for his transfer to the local ER where he also received prompt and professional treatment.

The guys at the GABI bar are the absolute best!  Luis, Carlos and Marcos made sure our glasses were always full and our snack bowl never empty.  Luis looked for and found the recipe to make my friends favorite drink, a 57 Chevy.  All the bars have the best alcohol, with many very top shelf varieties.

The service at all the restaurants was wonderful.  The staff are very friendly and genuinely want you to enjoy your stay. 

I had the most relaxing massage at the spa and even though it was a little pricey, I would invest in the experience again.

As the official language of the Dominican Republic is Spanish, everyone speaks Spanish, and some speak English as well.  We did have a little trouble communicating especially over the phone, as we do not speak Spanish. My friend had a frustrating experience in the VIP lounge, once again because we do not speak Spanish and they spoke little English. He asked for help with the spelling of the names for the ladies in guest services and they told him to go to guest services to ask them to rewrite their names in larger letters.  It was especially frustrating as we wanted to ensure we had their names correctly spelled so that we could pay them the compliment that they truly deserve.

reviews.author: Gregory Curtis C
reviews.title: Fun for families
reviews.text: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was a fun place for vacation for our family.  The family concierge service that Yarol provided was outstanding!  We would highly recommend paying a bit more for the family concierge service.

reviews.author: Packageintheair
reviews.title: Consideration and Excellence
reviews.text: My review of my stay was delayed due a personal set of issues that the resort aided me in progression back home to immediately. There are great PEOPLE there that make The Reserve STAFF great examples of excellence. My experience with the excellence started before arriving. Let's be clear, I am not indicating perfection...I don't believe perfection can be manifested in this realm. What can be achieve is the "pursuit and deliverance of excellence" in actions for providing service, consideration and empathy for others. As I mentioned, my trip started off rocky because wires were crossed in the setting up of reservations between my friends and I. Once we were able to reach the leadership at the resort, extra efforts were done prior to- and while there to enable us to feel extremely important and well taken care of by ALL.  WHO was the daily administrator of that excellence...a Ms. Rudelania (a.k.a. Rudy). Started with a great reservation check-in team that was filled with smiles and LAUGHTER. From Rudy to Santos in the restaurant...to the bar staff by the pool...to the early morning team that aided me when I had a personal emergency that required I immediately return home stateside. They...Them...ALL of the people we met onsite and at the main hotel were extremely generous with time...attention..laughter...music...SURPRISE CHOCOLATE COVERED STRAWBERRIES IN OUR ROOMS...and lots of FUN through relaxation. If you are considering this location, don't think long. The accommodations are beautiful, large and immaculate landscaping. The bartenders will excite you with the fun antics/production of their concoctions. The FOOD will have you gaining all the weight you lost just to get there...but don't worry, the time on the beach will be just as beautiful. The money invested here will be well worth the experience and thoroughly enjoyed!  Thanks again The Reserve Staff for all that you do above and beyond what is called for in your daily duties.

reviews.author: Melanie P
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: Visited this resort with my friend in the first week of April and it was wonderful! Beautiful resort, good food and staff! Highly recommend this resort!  Would like to thank Daniel, Nathan Fernandez and Kung fu panda for your excellent service while we were your guests!

reviews.author: MARYROGERS176
reviews.title: No way except for Jose
reviews.text: Leaving here tomorrow, will write a detailed review when I get home.  If you are considering coming here I suggest you pay the extra $$$ and book Royal.  We did not book Royal and we had to almost beg for dinner reservations, a pad for lounger... This said our trip was still great thanks to Jose Rigo, he was wonderful to us and helped in any way he could.  There were also many other terrific staff members whom I will mention in next review .

reviews.author: lrtocan
reviews.title: Royal Service Amazing
reviews.text: Lying on the beach on one of the amazing beach beds at the end of a great week at the Paradisus Palma Real. We were in the Royal Service area and our butler Carlos Hinostroza was wonderful, reserving our beach bed for us every day, making all our dinner reservations and taking care of all our requests including stepping in at the smoothie bar one day.  He also arranged little treats when we would get back to our room at days end - cheeses, fruits, chocolate covered strawberries and wine. We particularly enjoyed the Palazzo restaurant in the Royal Service area which had great service and food. The resort is beautiful with plenty of activities (paddle board fitness was great) and nighttime entertainment (loved the Queen tribute) and lots of bars depending on your mood.  The resort was very clean and housekeeping did a great job in our room coming in twice a day to clean and ensure our fridge was stocked. We also had great massages at the Oriental Garden Spa - a great kickoff to the week. Another highlight was Passion restaurant, not included in the all-inclusive but definitely worth the extra cost. It's been a great and relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: armenioar
reviews.title: Excelente atencion
reviews.text: Fui excelentemente atendida por RUTH ANGELA MERCEDES, mi nombre es Amelia Casazza, mi mejores deseos para todos y en especial para Ruth. Esta chica estuvo absolutamente en todos los detalles, de hecho mi amiga se sintió mal después de una excursion, y Ruth se preocupo y se ocupo de todo, una excelente persona, mis mejores deseos para ella y todos.

reviews.author: Christiane G
reviews.title: Real service
reviews.text: Nous sommes allés au Paradisus PR , section  Royal service ,en mars 2017, Notre majordome Miguel , tout sourire ,  venait nous visiter à  la plage pour nous demandé  si on avait besoin de quelques choses....toujours efficaces dans nos demandes ..la partie qui fait du Royal service un grd plus,  est qu'il nous assigne une place à  la piscine ou à  la plage pour la semaine...Francisco est à  la plage, nous assigne  une place dispo à  note arrivé  et la prépare  toute la semaine...pas de stress le matin pour ce trouver une place avec parasol....le seul pt négatif est le choix des restaurants, différent mais pas pour tout les goûts  , mais de qualité. .......Christiane

reviews.author: Nora D
reviews.title: Descanso
reviews.text: Un lugar soñado . Nuestro camarero Logan nos atendió de maravillas . Atento y dispuesto toda nuestra estadía . Gastronomía de alto nivel . Paraíso encantado .Un lugar para descansar y disfrutar tanto para parejas como familias .Lo recomiendo totalmente .

reviews.author: Grace D
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Shorty is THE BEST!! She was so much fun all day during the day and then at night at the bars she was dancing with everyone and we had the best time ever! She was teaching us dance moves and my friends and I were loving it.

reviews.author: Perri M
reviews.title: Dahiana dahiana is my love
reviews.text: Dahiana is the best person I've ever met. She was extremely friendly and she made us feel so welcome and comfortable. She was a very nice host of the hotel and we all had an amazing time with her over our vacation.

reviews.author: Nick G
reviews.title: Dahiana she is the best
reviews.text: Dahiana is the best worker at this place. She is always dancing and partying with us. She always cares about us. She has great vibes. Her and angel are the two best workers at this resort. I'm going to miss her so much when I leave.

reviews.author: Mia R
reviews.title: AMAZING!! Dahiana Moreno is my fav!! She's awesome!!
reviews.text: I love my trip! I had the best time at the pool and hanging out with my friends at night!! Dahiana really made me trip so fun!! Love it!!! You all need to vacation here now!!! Angel is also awesome!! Love them!!!!!!

reviews.author: jason s
reviews.title: Shorty shorty
reviews.text: Shorty is the best! She is very fun and very beautiful. I loved spending time and dancing with her. She's got the moves! She's very kind and caring and knows how to have fun. She is very cool and always putting a smile on everyone's face.

reviews.author: Ryan R
reviews.title: Great Vacation with Friends
reviews.text: Dahiana and Angel are fantastic. They made my vacation so much better than it already was. They were extremely fun, caring, and nice. They were very nice to have around and I enjoyed the time I spent with them. Dahiana spent time with my friends and me at the pool, the beach, the bar, and the dance floor. Everywhere she was made for an amazing time. I loved her energy and enthusiasm as well. I will never forget her and the great time I shared with her in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Paula S
reviews.title: Servicio Real lo peor!
reviews.text: Decidimos pasar 7 días en Paradisus con una pareja de amigos. Elegimos el servicio Real, ya que queríamos una atención de lujo, por lo cual pagamos un gran cargo extra. Este servicio consiste en una serie de instalaciones exclusivas y un mayordomo que se supone te tiene que hacer la estancia más agradable. A nosotros y a nuestros amigos nos tocó uno de nombre Ariel. La verdad es que la atención de dicho mayordomo fue pésima, con una falta de detslles y profesionalismo, que nos echó a perder la semana completa gracias a sus mentiras, errores y excusas. Como ejemplo un día estuvimos varias horas afuera de nuestra habitación, todos mojados y de noche, porque nuestro mayordomo y nadie del servicio Real era capaz de arreglar nuestras llaves, perdimos una serie de descuentos que el nunca nos notificó y cuando se lo dijimos, se excusó con tonterías, a nuestros amigos los tuvo durante un día completo sin su maleta, tenía un trato displicente desde que noto que los latinos no dábamos tanta propina como los norteamericanos . La verdad es que el hotel tiene instalaciones correctas pero la atención del personal es pésimo, nunca más vuelvo a servicio Real de Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: holidayaddy
reviews.title: First visit to Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
It was our first visit to DR. I struggled to select a clear rating for this beautiful hotel resort, with beautiful white sand beaches. The star rating I selected is a maximum of 5 being the highest rating. 
5* For surrounding gardens, beautiful walkways, well maintained gardens. Miles of beautiful beaches with soft white sand. A private beach for guests staying at the Reserve or with Royal Service. Plenty of sunbeds, sundeck chaise chairs, shade. Bar service available at the beach. Washrooms on the beach.

We checked in on a Wednesday. After our flight and transfer to the hotel, we arrived at 1:46pm, and check-in is at 3pm.  The front desk was very friendly. We were offered a welcome beverage. Front desk suggested that we head for lunch and return in an hour. Before we could head to lunch, our concierge intercepted us and we followed the concierge gullibly. Our concierge introduced himself and explained that tomorrow we would not be having breakfast in this hotel, but that he would meet us and bring us by catamaran to the Palma Real for breakfast and we would have a tour of the bay. He brought out a map of the Paradisus hotel layout and explained briefly, hotels along the coast, the restaurants, and that he had a gift for us of three free nights to be used at any of the Paradisus hotel resorts in DR and Mexico. Then he held onto the map and the hotel envelope and brought us to Gabi Beach by shuttle for the lunch buffet. We were seated immediately for the lunch buffet. Service at the lunch buffet was excellent. After the lunch buffet, we decided to walk back to the main lobby and check on our room. 

5* High rating because we were upgraded to The Reserve to a one-bedroom suite. We would be in Block 42 on the third floor, with a partial garden/road path/parking view. Note there are no elevators. If you have a young family and strollers, the main floor may be better for your family. Laundry facilities if needed are on the ground floor. We liked being on the 3rd floor. 

We had requested one bed at check-in. The front desk advised that when we get to the room, if it is not one bed, to let them know and they would push the beds together. We get to the suite and it is two double beds. We call housekeeping but the phone does not work. We have to walk back to the main hotel lobby to make the request. The beds are firm and provide a good comfortable sleep. The suite although facing the road and parking lot is actually quiet.
3.5* I downgraded the accommodations because of the phone did not work for the first 3 days out of 5 days. The TV in the living room did not work. Some days there were no bath mats. It would be taken away and not replaced. Some days there were no hand towels. Turn down service and tidying up was inconsistent. Sometimes they appeared at 9:45pm. We were really surprised that they would appear so late and then offered us chocolates at the door. The mini-bar fridge beverage selection is quite lacking. Soda, diet soda, beer, no other liquor; crushed crackers and crushed cookies. It was nice to see chips in the fridge but these were not replenished daily. 

Our package said there would be a welcome bottle of rum and a welcome basket. Nothing arrived for the first 3 days. At the Reserve, there is a concierge in each building. We spoke with the concierge on the 4th day, and our concierge apologized and said that it is like a champagne (not a bottle of rum.) On that day when we returned to the room, there was a fruit platter with beautifully carved fruit, plates, cloth napkins and a bottle of Merlot. How beautiful to walk into your suite and be greeted by this. 

Recommend staying in The Reserve if you are staying at this hotel resort. 
Plus’s for The Reserve:
Priority check-in and checkout in the Reserve lobby, and offers its own refreshments.
Own pool; swim up bar, buffet (Gabi Club) and a la carte dining (Vento) only for Reserve guests. Live music is performed in Gabi Club in the dinner hour. 

Resort likes-
Beautiful property well maintained;
Beautiful sitting areas in the main lobby; swing chairs for two in the main lobby;
Surrounds of miles of green and flowering vegetation;
Shuttles between lobbies and the beach ran approximately every 10-12 minutes. 
Upgrade to a one-bedroom suite in the Reserve.
Suite had lots of wardrobe space-one closet with hanging space, bathrobes and slippers. An adjacent closet with lots of deep shelf space, plus the chest in the bedroom, and two closets in the entranceway and living room. Digital safe in the closet. Long umbrella provided in the closet. One of the sofa's is a pullout sofabed. 
3 wash basins in the bathroom (double sink vanity in the double Jacuzzi bathroom) and a single sink in the adjoining bathroom, separate toilet and separate standup shower. Two entrances to the bathroom. 
Washrooms avail at The Reserve beach.
Sunbeds, deck chairs, shade areas at The Reserve beach.
We arrived at the beach late one morning and could still find a sunbed in the shade.
Pick up beach towels at the reserved beach area.
Wi-Fi throughout the resort is free.
Firm beds. 
Lots of bath sheets. 
Bar on the beach-we picked up our own beverages from the beach bar.
Preferred the dining service and choices at the buffets. Beverage service at the buffet was also really more enjoyable than at the a la carte's except for Bana where the service was excellent. 

The hotel main lobby is a two-minute walk from The Reserve. 
Recommend Bana, a la carte Japanese fusion dining is a one-minute walk from the main hotel lobby. Entertaining meal, teppanyaki style, dine with others/meet other travelers and food service was quick. 

3* Dinner reservations can be booked by your concierge in The Reserve, however dining reservations close at 5pm. You will be asked for your Wishes which restaurants and preferred dining time of either 6-730pm or 8-930pm. We asked for early dining and were told they can reserve 2 restaurants because we would be staying for 4 nights. Our dinner reservations could be confirmed the next day only between 3pm-4pm. This would mean we could not map out our day because we would only find out about our dining time by 4pm. 
Dress code at buffet or a la carte dining is casual. 

Be aware. We were given 3 dinner confirmations at 3 restaurants. 8pm, 830pm and 6pm. We cancelled the 830pm at The Grill, a steakhouse with our building concierge. The next evening, we received a phone call and were asked why did we not arrive for our 830pm reservation. When we told them we had cancelled with the concierge, they wanted to know why we cancelled, and we said because it was too late. We were then told that we should have just gone to the restaurant directly and asked for an earlier time. Please note, The Grill is at the beach, a good ten-minute walk from your hotel, or a ten-minute wait for a shuttle to the beach. It’s not as simple to see if the restaurant can take you earlier. I had read other reviews, which showed they would be turned away.

3* Daily entertainment shows are at 830pm. We only saw a show on the first night because we had dinner at the buffet. The performers were good, and really danced the full 35-40 minutes, what energy! We missed the show the other nights because we tried the a la carte dinner at Vento, which was at 8pm, but the food arrived after 9pm. We are not accustomed to eating so late, and left immediately after the main entrée. 

There are no dining facilities at the main Paradisus hotel lobby. All 
dining facilities are near the beach. The main pool with activities is also near the beach. Ie. 10-12 minutes walk from the hotel lobbies.

By the end of our vacation, our phone was working and we received several phone calls in the evening asking how our stay was. 

Dining:
There is not a lot of vegetables offered, except for daily salads. Fruit is in abundance. 

Be aware:
Of the timeshare ploys in the hotel. We had friends staying at the Paradisus and they warned us about not going on the catamaran boat tour as it would takes 2 hours away from our mini-vacation. This is being done by the hotel staff in the main lobby and in The Reserve lobby. Hotel staff would politely enquire about our plans for the day, and then suggest that we participate on a catamaran tour of the bay. The word catamaran became a key word on our visit to avoid any of these ploys.

The exchange rate is better at the airport than at the hotel. 
There is a gift store in the hotel. Another hotel guest told us to negotiate the price. 

Be aware of mosquitoes after 530pm. Even with the anti-mosquito spray, those no-seeims will catch up.

reviews.author: asjohns1986
reviews.title: A Much Needed Vacation
reviews.text: Visited April 1-8 (tomorrow), 2017. This was our first trip to Punta Cana. We will definitely be back after our experience this week at the resort. We were initially concerned about the Zika virus but we didn't see any mosquitoes the entire trip at the resort or even while playing golf at Cocotal. The service we received from the staff was great as well, especially from Francis N. our butler - Rafael, Carlos and Pedro (Grande) at the Royal Service pool - Lee and Wanda at the Sunset bar - Jose H. at the juice bar on the beach - Carlo who arranged our airport shuttle and worked with our work group during our trip. Thank you all very much.  Wish we didn't have to go back home so soon.

reviews.author: Gwenn C
reviews.title: The Minkoff Experience
reviews.text: The people couldn't have been nicer. Everyone was super friendly and very accommodating. The food was fresh and fantastic. The restaurants were extremely clean and everyone was right there to assist in anything that you wanted.

reviews.author: Nicole Danielle
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
This was my second island trip I took way back in Sept 2015. This was by far the best resort I have been to regarding the Caribbean. This resort is next to its sister resort which golf carts are provided to transport you back and forth. This is a wonderful option as this gives you a change of scenery when desired. The palma real was the more affordable options, the pool side was awesome but the beach side at the main hotel ( I believe paradisus) was breath taking. The cabanas on the white beach were amazing. The bars were great. The whole property of the entire hotel were beautiful and extremely island vibe. I can't recall most of the food. We did a hibachi which was actually really good and lunch at i believe Fire? which was really good too. We did some awesome excursions, including a catermaren which was great and the azul tour with atv. Sorry i don't remember all details as the was almost two years ago, but this place deserves a review.

Also there was a cool "night lounge/club" that was very empty at first but filled up quick. It played good hiphop/spanish music. We enjoyed plenty of mamajuana our whole trip. There was also a cool area downstairs by the bar where everyone was dancing, all age groups but this ended early. ( well were from NY so early to us is about 10 pm) haha. But for an all inclusive it was good. 

I know I was contemplating between here or the hard rock prior to my trip andI was very pleased with our decision.
