Also, our room was fantastic. It was huge with an awesome balcony. We were able to order breakfast to the room every morning and was ready at whichever time was selected. This was a great option. Would defiantly go back.

reviews.author: KarenReck
reviews.title: Fabulous Vacation with Royal Service!!!
reviews.text: Just returned from a much needed vacation and enjoyed every minute!  The hotel and grounds are kept up very well.  Our Royal Service included butler service and Francis was OUTSTANDING!!  He was knowledgable, caring and what a great personality too.  He ensured our stay was top notch!  I am happy to have made a new friend and will definitely ask for only Francis specifically when we go back!   The only issue we had was with the room safe and that the mechanics failed, but it certainly was not a deal breaker and Francis was on hand to help us work thru the issue with hotel security.  Gorgeous views, lobby and grounds.  Would highly recommend!  Be sure to stop at the RS pool bar and see Lee and Wanda behind the bar too - they make it fun to hang out there.   😀

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.title: Worst vacation ever!
reviews.text:
I have never written a review in my life but felt compelled to share my thoughts here so others can avoid making the mistake I made in booking this resort.  The treatment and service we received by this resort was criminal.  Parent company Melia overbooked hotel by 160 rooms. It took 24 hours for them to give me my room at check in. Yes 24 hours! 
Screwed us out of our upgraded rooms yet still charged us for them. Rooms not cleaned each day. Reservations at restaurants denied every night.  Rat droppings in rooms. Rude and disrespectful management.  We did not agree with any of their charges but when it comes time to checking out they hold you hostage and won't give you your luggage or allow you to get on any transportation until you pay them whatever charges they demand. Criminal!!

reviews.author: thiesca
reviews.title: AMAZING vacation!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 5 day trip to Paradisus Palma Real, which we booked through a travel agent.  I must have read 200+ reviews of this property on Trip Advisor before we arrived.  We traveled with 2 other couples and we didn't book the Royal Service option but we were given VIP treatment throughout our entire stay!!!!  Everything exceeded our expectations...... ESPECIALLY the service from all the employees!!!!  

The view when you walk in the lobby of this resort is nothing sort of magnificent.  In searching for a resort for our trip, I finally decided on Paradisus based on the pictures of the beach/pool area.  The view when you walk in will truly take your breath away!!!

Check In was somewhat time consuming with 3 separate rooms.  We did ask upon arrival for a room upgrade, but were told the hotel was completely booked.   The hotel does get 5 stars for accommodating our request to have 3 rooms close together all with king beds.  With this large resort, our 3 rooms could have been spread out all over.  Kudos to the gentleman who checked us in and got our rooms located by each other (I'm so sorry I didn't get his name).  Our Junior Suite garden view rooms were located all in a row on the first floor of the main building.  We were RIGHT next to the pool and the location couldn't have been more perfect!!  Pedros and Elvis showed us to our rooms and delivered our luggage and they were extremely hospitable in getting us situated.  THANK YOU!!  Were our rooms musty smelling???... YES - but thanks to all the Trip Advisor reviews, we brought our plug-in air freshners that helped immensely.  

Housekeeping - Did a good job....  Some of us received fresh wash cloths - others of us didn't.  But, again, thanks to Trip Advisor, we had packed extra, so it wasn't an issue.  Housekeeping always came in our rooms twice every day.

Food - AMAZING!!  The buffet would have seriously been sufficient for our entire stay.  Always something different to try.  I have read many reviews about poor service in the buffet.  This was never an issue for us.  We always looked for the employees in the beige colored shirts and got their attention.  They promptly would find a place for us to sit - and remember - there was 6 of us!  They were always there with coffee for us in the morning and refilled our water throughout all meals.  One of the waiters at the buffet, Ronald, even went and grabbed an umbrella and personally walked my husband back from the restroom when it started downpouring one evening!!!  We were able to get reservations in the restaurants for 3 nights.  It is a crazy system they have in place for reservations, but it is similar to another all-inclusive we have stayed at.  It took my husband 45 minutes to book one restaurant.  I went back later that morning and was able to book 2 others for us without too much difficulty.  Just be patient.. you are on vacation.  We ate at Bana, Blue Agave and Rare.  Rare was by far our favorite, with Angel, our waiter, giving us his full attention and telling us every trivia tidbit he knew about Wisconsin (once he found out where we were from).  Food was delicious at Rare, and believe me, we have picky meat eaters in our group!!  Bana - the food was good, atmosphere could have been a little more energetic, compared to other Hibachi experiences we have had.  Blue Agave was just OK - the service there was the worst we had at ANY point during our stay.

Pool/Beach/Gabi Beach Bar/Swim-Up Bar - this is where Paradisus really is exceptional!  The beach is AMAZING, with beautiful sand and an unbelievable view of the ocean. We would get up early each morning and throw some towels on a few chairs under a tiki.  We could always get in the front row of chairs when we did this.  Waiters were regularly out there serving us and this is where we met our favorite waiter, Daniel del Carmen.  He truly went out of his way to meet our every request - from top shelf rum and whiskey to toothpicks!!  He was extremely friendly and provided service with a smile for our 3 days on the beach.  THANK YOU, Daniel for truly making our trip special!! The other staff at the swim-up bar provided LOTS of laughs for us - especially during the rainy times when we would move from the beach to the swim up bar.  Special shout-outs go to Jheri, Gilberto and Leo for all the great shots of Mama Juana and all the awesome toasts!!  We truly had a great time interacting with all of these employees!!  The Gabi Beach area is awesome - a great place to relax any time of day and enjoy a drink.  We always asked for top shelf liquor at any of the bars and we were always accommodated.  

Many reviews talk about the language barrier.  No one in our group spoke Spanish and we only had one issue with a waitress at the Blue Agave who couldn't understand us.  NO WHERE ELSE was this an issue.  ALL the employees were friendly and courteous. You could be guaranteed to be greeted with hola!!

The non-hotel employees selling stuff on the beach can be annoying.  But a simple "no thank-you" and they will leave you alone.  

We tipped wherever we went.  It was never expected, but it was absolutely appreciated.  Imagine our surprise on our last morning when Daniel our waiter was in the lobby waiting to meet us to say good-bye!!! As we were waiting for our transfer back to the airport, we saw Pedros and Elvis again.. and when Pedros discovered our ride was 15 minutes late, he promptly made a phone call to check on our transfer.  MUCH appreciated!!

Thank you, Paradisus Palma Real for a truly memorable vacation.  Our only regret, is that we didn't stay longer...  we look forward to our next visit!!!

reviews.author: Daisy F
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Came here for Spring Break and really enjoyed it! It was so nice and relaxing, like a 5 minute walk from the beach! The people here were great, especially Reynold Tamayo!! Super cool, definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Wanderer777750
reviews.title: Great vacation, great people
reviews.text: Was at The Reserve in March with friends. I would like to know where the people normally vacation that have complaints about this Resort. It was fantastic. The rooms were great the food was excellent. Five stars for Emilio also.  Yes the service was sometimes slower than you want but you are on island time people!!! I also met a teacher from Toronto at the bar near the beach late one night, she spoke Spanish very well.

reviews.author: skier621
reviews.title: Nice Resort with Terrible Front desk and reservation service - OVERBOOKED Rooms??
reviews.text:
We just returned today and I had to write this asap. 

1) When we arrived we were told that they were overbooked by 50 rooms and wanted to ship us over to their sister resort called the Melia next door.   I stood my ground and said we paid for the nicer resort and why would we do that.  This was UNBELIEVABLE.   We had prepaid for our Junior Suite 1 bedroom room months ago and they didn't have a room for us?
ARE YOU KIDDING ME?  Unbelievable.  Then they shipped us over on the same property to their upgraded area called "The Reserve"  which does have nice rooms however, so dead over there. Also NO direct beach access.   You have to take a golf cart to the main area to get to the beach.    We had to unpack and then pack again to have our suitcases brought back over to spend the next 5 nights on the main property which we originally paid for.   We heard from another 5  couples  who complained to us over the next 2 days that they also had similar experiences.   I have never encountered this in all the years I have gone to many different resorts.  In addition, the front desk did not explain anything about the property , they let you figure it our on your own and had an attitude that they were overbooked and offered no apology.  We were with 2 other couples and were appalled.   We wasted so much time the first two days at the front desk.    

2) The dinner reservation system is a nightmare.   They say each one is booked for the next amount of days for reasonable eating times  but when you peek in half the tables are empty just like a previous review stated. We actually paid staff off to get into the places we wanted which of course was no problem as I stated above since 1/2 to 1/3 of the restaurant seemed to be empty.  PAID THEM OFF.  I thought this was supposed to be an inclusive place!   This  also makes it stressful and we paid good money to be relaxed.  

3) Our Junior 1 bedroom suite that we finally got into the second night was very roomy and nice with a garden view.  We all agreed that beds were very comfortable. Only item was mold at the bottom of the shower.

4) Anytime we wanted to call the front desk from our room NO ONE EVER picked up.
So if you have an emergency you can forget it there!

5) After dinner it is very dead,  they need to have some disco, or band later as there is a paltry tiny casino the size of a living room and some dead bars open and that is it!

The good part is that the property grounds are very well maintained and the beach area and pools are lovely.   Also the bar tenders and waiters were all very professional and hard working.   

Based on the amount we paid and horrible front service help and no room available upon arrival  I will never go back there.

reviews.author: SSouvenir
reviews.title: Good food, great beaches, awesome staff
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: I got to join my friend for her work's reward trip. Therefore I can't speak on price and worth. However, I did have an amazing time.

We flew in on a Wed and left on a Monday.  This property was postcard worthy and the staff is amazing. While I wasn't involved in any of the behind the scenes activities that my friend was for her work event, I saw her working a lot with Niela Eugenio. Niela and her staff seemed to do an AMAZING job ensuring the receptions, activities, food/drink and rooms were perfect. If I ever need to plan an event there, I would totally request to work with Niela.

We stayed in the Royal Service area for duration of our stay. Jose Salvador was our butler and he made the experience even more enjoyable. I got to hold onto the private phone since my friend had to do work stuff from time to time. He was great! He was very kind and caring and would regularly check in to make sure our stay was going well and see if we needed anything.  He was never overwhelming but was never hard to get a hold of.  We got a  bottle of wine and fresh plate of fruit or cheese almost every night. Typically they do a jacuzzi treatment during the stay b/c most ppl in the Royal service are couples. My friend and I are not a couple but he asked to do one for us anyways. Jose was great. If I go back, I am requesting him. 

At the Gabi Bar the bartenders were attentive and quick. The dance floor had Shaky Shake(he wouldn't give us his acutal name) and another tall dark good looking gentleman keeping the crowd going. Super fun atmosphere and Shakey and the crew did an amazing job getting people dancing. My friend and I stayed on the outskirts of the dance floor yet Shakey remembered us whenever we saw him throughout our stay.

The Avenue Bar was a great place to stop for a laid back drink and fun conversation with the bartenders. I am so mad that we only interacted with the staff here on our 2nd to last day of our 6-day stay. They were awesome! We closed down the bar 2 nights in a row. Juan Suarez, Nicolas Severino, Ruth, & Rosita did an amazing job keeping us happy.  They all were very polite as I tried to practice my broken Spanish with them. We actually first met Juan on our first day.  He was shadowing Jose, our butler.  If his service at the bar is anything like what he will be as a butler, then he will be amazing!   When Avenue bar closed(1am) we went to the night club(til 3am?) that was fun. The last night we went to the bar at Rare which is open til 5am! Osiris Bello Rosario & Sandy Cueto did a wonderful job interacting with us. They had to tolerate even more drunken broken Spanish and once again, were super nice about it. Osiris made some awesome drinks. If you are up late, definitely recommend heading out to see him. We were even given a geography lesson of the island. Very informative! 

All the restaurants on the property were good. I never had a bad meal but I didn't have any 5 star meals either. The plantain chips were my fave! My only complaint was that I was kinda annoyed that I was there for 5 days and never once had a traditional Dominican dish.  I love to experience the culture that I am in. The restaurants were pretty Americanized.  But that's just me.  I was thoroughly full every day with drinks and food.
 
Great property, great staff, great experience! Thanks for everything!

PS - For those who reviewed who said you needed to speak Spanish to get by... don't know WHAT they were talking about or who are they talking to?!?!? The only time I ever spoke Spanish was at night time and that's because I forced myself to practice with the bartenders but never out of necessity.  And even if that was the case... i mean.. you DID decided to travel to the Dominican Republic

PPS- What is in the water here? The entire staff was super helpful and kind.  But most importantly they were all gorgeous and all looked deceivingly young. Please sell whatever they take bc I will buy it!

reviews.author: GreenEB
reviews.title: Beautiful property but needs care and more staff
reviews.text:
Let's get this out of the way first. The weather in PC is PERFECT. It was in the 
Check in was fine. The lobby is nice, clean, has some snacks, water and a Nespresso machine (which I ended up using every morning until the last two days because they ran out of Nespresso pods.)

Honestly, the front desk staff was friendly, but really didn't care about being helpful or efficient. The hotel is LOUD. It's just the set up of the place. All rooms face an open-air atrium and noise bounces all over the place. We were next to a screaming baby for two nights too, and there was really no motivation to move us. We were staying on the Reserve side and were willing to be "downgraded" to the regular side in order to move as well. I had to get kind of spicy in order to get things done. (I was pretty cranky after two nights of no sleep. Sorry.)

Note that the Reserve side is also the family/kid side. If you want a quieter vacation, don't book over there. 

The bartenders and wait staff at the main Reserve buffet area were phenomal. So friendly and so attentive.They remembered us and even knew what drinks we liked (and we had a huge group.) The buffet food was fine. Not great but not bad. The food from the Reserve Pool grill was the best on the resort! Again, the chefs there were fantastic. The pizza, burgers, nachos, etc. were all freshly made and delicious. I wished that grill was open more hours than it was. We were there during the Super Bowl, and their set up and tailgating food for the night was great too!

Do not believe they have 24-hr room service. If we did actually get through, service WAS quick to get to our room. However, more often than not, you couldn't actually reach room service. No one answered the phone. Then, we tried the front desk and told them about it, and were again received with no hint of motivation to get anything done. On times we did get through, they were usually out of everything we asked for on the menu. (And honestly, we are not picky eaters so we were flexible, but they literally had no food left.) 

The main pool snack bar/lunch place was honestly horrible and unsafe. Food was cold and the burgers were raw. Not like rare...raw. It was also the only option at around 1:00 that day because 2 of the lunch restaurants were closed. I think this goes back to the understaffed problem. 

Main bar and beach bars were both busy so it took a bit to get drinks, but the bartenders were trying their hardest and drinks were good.

We were there for a wedding, and I have to say that the wedding setup was beautiful on that pristine beach! The wedding meal was also the best we had by far, set up in a little area just off from the restaurants. We had freshly grilled seafood and meats, and all the sides I tried were great. We lost power for about 20 minutes during the dance. I kind of felt like they would try to make up for that...but they didn't.

We had one guy, by himself, get jumped at the casino right off the resort, and lots of money taken from him (which, logically, he shouldn't have had on him.) The whole story ended up involving corrupt police and was pretty scary. If you are going out on the town, stay in a group and don't be naive. Don't carry a lot of cash. Don't buy anything on the street you wouldn't normally do where you live. (We did go out one night and the street food was AMAZING! Staff at bars and restaurants and locals were also so nice.) We also had theft on the resort with things taken from rooms, that magically appeared in a room safe a few hours after being reported. There was some story about security having gone into the room earlier and moving the items into the same. Um...why would security just randomly go into someone's room and move things to a safe. I have never, ever heard of something like that before.

All in all, I want to say that this was one of the best vacations I've ever been on because of the people who were surrounding me. We never let any of the downfalls ruin our good time. My stomach hurt from laughing! I wouldn't go back to this particular resort, but I can't wait to give PC another try.

reviews.author: JazzyJiton

reviews.text:
Wilson wilson wilson 
He worked at the hydro grill at the RESERVE side in the paradisus. He grave excellent service ! I felt waited on hand & foot . The hotel over all is

reviews.author: P7649AKjane
