reviews.author: SteveLewi
reviews.title: Exquisite Resort
reviews.text: No kids? Royal Service is the optimum way to go, having immaculate and dedicated adults only lounging area, pool, bar, restaurant and beach provides for a quiet & intimate experience. Butler Francis and Pool/Bar Manager Francisco provided exquisite personal service, ensuring we'll be coming back for a 3rd time!!

reviews.author: sdurkin24
reviews.title: Impressive Property
reviews.text:
My friend and I booked this resort on a last minute cheapcaribbean.com. The booking was fairly easy/simple online, included airfare, etc. We got the to and from the airport to resort and back via Amstar service, which was super easy and convenient, and reasonably priced. It was ~ 25 minutes from the airport to the resort, so you get to see some of the countryside.

When we first got to the resort we were very visually impressed. The property really is gorgeous. It's like Europe meets Vegas. The room was also beautiful and very comfortable. They overbooked their double bed rooms so upgraded us to a King with a cot. It wasn't ideal, but we made it work. The bed was very very comfortable, the room was clean, organized, quiet, fancy but comfortable. They have satellite TV available - the signal was out half the time - but honestly who goes here to watch tv right? 

One complaint was the shower - they have these showers that are incredibly complicated to figure out how to use, and then half the time were were there there was no hot water (we tried to shower at different times in the day, same problem). 

The pool areas are very nice, and you can walk the property and check out the Reserve portion of Melia properties while you are there. It's a much quieter area vs. Paradisus palma real. The beaches are pristine - it's clear they've put effort into creating a luxurious beach area. It was easy for us to get towels, and chairs for the most part, as long as you don't mind being in the sun all day - most of the shades chairs are taken early and kept throughout the day. The closed cabana bed areas are pretty much taken the whole day, so if you want one of those get out like before 8 am, maybe even earlier. 

They have restaurants on the property, most of which are included with the all inclusive, but you have to make a reservation early. This was one of the not perfect aspects of the resort - they only take reservations same day, and starting @ 9 am. But by 9 am basically all restaurants are full and you're put on a waiting list. The upside is most places, if you're wiling to wait, can seat you regardless ~ 815. Also, they have restaurants in which reservations are not required, so you can still eat any time. The BlueAgave was ok - very good chips and salsa, otherwise food was ok. Bana - their hibachi grill - food wise was not super impressive, but still a fun experience. Rare, their steakhouse, was phenomenal. The shrimp cocktail, tomato bisque, ribs were delicious. The interior and ambiance of Rare was very nice as well. Highly recommend you eat here at least one night out of your trip. Their buffet, Nano I believe it was called, was also very impressive. Very clean and organized, with a nice selection and variety of different foods. The food quality here was great as well. 

The service was hit or miss. I don't want to knock the whole resort just because of one or two people. For the most part everyone was very nice and helpful. I believe more oversight by management particularly in the reservation check-in and guest services would benefit to make their quality of customer service more consistent.  

Overall a very nice resort and we had a great time. Probably best for couples or families vs. singles looking to meet people. 

One last thing - they have a drink called the Caparissima - it's a MUST drink, and quickly became one of my all time favorites. My recommendation is to get it from Luis Diaz, one of the bar tenders at the tiki pool bar - he's awesome, super friendly and helpful, and really added some flavor to our trip. He was one of our favorite parts of our trip and we made sure we ordered from him every day. El es lo mejor!!

reviews.author: cecemo2016
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation spot!
reviews.text:
Lovely stay at this hotel. Buffet was very good and grounds are beautiful.
A special thank you to Gregori Arias that was so thoughtful and extremely helpful.
We did not book the Royal Service and we had very good service. The only difficulty was trying to book restaurants, they could only offer us 6pm or 930pm. We did go to two of them at 6, it was a nice change and food was also very good.

reviews.author: kristibt
reviews.title: Amazing Trip
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Dominican Republic and I had a fantastic time. I went with a group of girls celebrating our 40th birthdays. The beaches, water, sunsets and resort were beautiful. The staff was amazing. In my travels, I have never been to a  place where all the workers are so friendly. I truly felt that all the employees love their job. Great experience. 

I highly recommend the Royal Service. You get great rooms, dinner reservations and a 24-hour butler. I must say that our butler, Jose Lugo, was fantastic. He was so friendly, helpful and got us everything we needed. Our friends had Faustino and they loved them too. They arranged a surprise party for my roommate and it was great. These two are top notch!

We loved the restaurant Vento so much that we went there twice! The food was outstanding and I am a picky eater. We loved our server, Yuderqui Javier. She was amazing, even with our crazy group of 8 ladies!

With the Royal Service, you get a private beach area away from the rest of the resort. We laid on beds, relaxed and got the best service from Pedro Cedano. He kept us entertained and well hydrated all day. You will also get the juice bar on the beach. Hebreo Jose works at the juice bar and he makes the best pina coladas you will ever have. They were so fresh! I wanted to just put my bed right next to the bar! He is very sweet too.

You can't go wrong with this place. We had the best time. Several bar areas and the dance club was fun. The DJ is very accommodating. I normally like to go to new places each time I travel but I know I will go back.

reviews.author: Aimi N
reviews.title: Relaxing spring break
reviews.text:
Had a great time coming here for spring break after a rough first year of grad school. Spent most of the days relaxing by the beach. The beach was beautiful with lots of chair and umbrella spots to relax under and servers coming through constantly to take drink orders. Would definitely recommend trying to make all your reservations for dinner in advance. Vento was my favorite of the restaurants. Fridge was constantly stocked with whatever we requested, don't be afraid to ask for a bottle of champagne here and there for morning mimosas.

However, what really made our trip was the bartender at Bargarita's, Lillian Aquino! The margaritas were always amazing with freshly muddled fruit or infused tequilas. She was always so fun and friendly behind the bar and constantly went above and beyond when it came to service.

reviews.author: Rob8343
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: The best vacation ever. Beautiful suite and wonderful warm and friendly staff. The beach was breathtaking. The beach staff was the best. If you visit be sure to ask for Santos Frias, Ramon Ramires,Jose De los santo,Jairo minier ,Oneida zorrilla. Fun times with fun people they were a perfect fit for our group.

reviews.author: ramimperry
reviews.title: Great place to ring in 40
reviews.text: I went with 7 high school girl friends to celebrate our 40th birthdays. What a great choice of location! Royal service was fantastic. Faustino and Jose Lugo took amazing care of us. Can't wait to go back soon!

reviews.author: cbisping91
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Very hospitable staff that went out of their way to make your vacation exactly what we were looking for. Our butler, Victor set up all of the logistics and meal reservations so we were able to just focus on relaxing! Victor made our trip so amazing and would recommend royal service to other guests coming to visit.

reviews.author: Shea D
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Our visit was phenomenal from start to finish. Argenis, our personal butler ensured our happiness every day. They truly know how to let you relax. Great restaurants, bars, beaches. The beach chairs were definitely the best on the beach. I'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Dee
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text: We've been to Punta Cana numerous times and this is one of the best places.  You're never too far from anything.  Check-in was okay.  Seems like no one seems to get their room earlier than 3 and many had to wait until after 3 to get their rooms.  The rooms are spacious and ours was very clean.  Wanda always did an outstanding job.  The food is delicious.  Never had such good food at a resort.  Almost all of our servers were outstanding.  A few were lacking in that they didn't even smile.  The beach is one of the best and although we're early beach people, there didn't seem to be any lack of chairs.  You have to get there early for a palapa, but not a chair.  I felt there was more choice at the buffet than some of the specialty restaurants.  We didn't do the Reserve or Royal Service and it did seem like we couldn't go here or there because it was for them, when I peeked, didn't look like anything special.  I like the big pool rather than my own small one anyway.  I'd rather save the money and go without special treatment.  Had no complaints.  I'd come back here in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: catkearney
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation spot
reviews.text: Just spent my 40th birthday at the Palma Real. It was an amazing experience. We upgraded to the Royal Service and our Butler Jose Lugo was the best! He helped us with everything we needed and also planned the best surprise party for my birthday. Very thoughtful and so sweet. Also our bartender on the beach, Pedro Cedano, was amazing! He brought us exactly what we wanted before we even asked. I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Andrew T
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: This resort is very nice for families and friends. The entertainment is second to none, especially with Melvin Concepcion and Raynold tamayo who are extremely friendly. Food and drinks all inclusive. A+

reviews.author: Neelam P
reviews.title: Sol playa y arena
reviews.text: Fue una esperiencia vivida lo que pasamos en the reserve at paradisus punta cana,todo fue fenomenal,el restaurante vento fue el que mas nos gusto, la playa muy hermosa los servicios de primera,personas super geniales y educadas,como lo es el chico de servicio al cliente de la villa 36 Jose Fernandez,muy atento y educado y siempre se preocupo de que todo este bien en nuestro viaje,gracias por todo Jose y pronto regresaremos

reviews.author: meredithhalko
reviews.title: Fantastic Visit!
reviews.text:
This was my second trip to the Dominican Republic, and I was extremely nervous going back.  The food at the resort of my first trip was barely edible, and I was nervous that I'd have a similar experience.  Boy was I wrong!  The food at Paradisus was incredible; great quality, and a huge variety of cuisines.  We were never hungry and enjoyed every meal.

The house wine and champagne were probably the best I've ever had at an all-inclusive resort.  The resort also offered an extensive wine list, and a shop where you could purchase other wines not offered by the glass; some bottles were a bit pricey, but that's to be expected.

We frequented the Lobby Bar each night before dinner.  Malvin Mercedes was our bartender, and it was evident that he was passionate about his work, and took great pride in each drink he made. The cocktails offered on the menu were inventive and unique (including one made with fresh beet juice and hazelnut liquor) - certainly a step above the usual sugary, basic, watered-down drinks I've had at other resorts.

The only reason I couldn't rate the resort as "Excellent" was due to the different levels offered. For example, several sections of the resort, including pools, bars, the beach and restaurants were off limits to us because we were not Club Members/Royal Service guests.  I understand butler service is more exclusive, and that some guests will get preference to restaurants, but closing off entire sections of the pool and beach seemed a bit extreme to me -- especially when those reserved sections were empty, and we had to scour for pool chairs. I've never stayed at another resort where this was done, so it was a bit of a shock to me.  Disclaimer: I did NOT book this trip, so perhaps this was disclosed beforehand, and I wasn't aware of it.  I would advise looking into this before going if the freedom to wander the resort is important to you.

Overall, the resort itself is beautiful. The beaches in Dominican Republic are some of the best in the world -- you cannot go wrong staying here!

reviews.author: Sunnydaze35
reviews.title: Fantastic resort
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Reserve Paridisus Punta Cana from February 21 - 28/17 and enjoyed every minute at this great resort.  Check in was a breeze and our rooms were lovely -- large balcony overlooking palm trees and the pool, a separate bedroom area with a TV, living area with TV, kitchenette space and large bathroom with very well kept amenities. The fridge was stocked every day with water, beer and soft drinks and all kinds of snacks.   The pool area is very nicely laid out with lots of curves and bends with private spots for a group.  Lovely sun beds, cabanas and lounge chairs throughout.  The buffet area at The Reserve and at the main Paridisus area were very well maintained, with enclosed areas where the food is set out.  It would seem that the buffet areas are small for the size of the resort, but the food offered was great at every meal.  Variety was endless.  We enjoyed several of the al a carte restaurants - Italian, Mexican, Mediterranean  to name a few.  They were all excellent meals.  With staying at The Reserve we were able have the concierge services book our dinners on our behalf.  Our first attempt at this was not successful with the two gals at the desk not being of much assistance -- and this was on our first full day there --- they were not able to find us any available restaurants throughout our stay.  However, when Yarrow and Estepania were at that desk they were able to make things happen.  These two young people were of great assistance to us throughout our vacation. Our first helpers at the concierge booked us into a BBQ night in the main area of the resort.  We would not recommend this meal.  We were expecting a BBQ buffet but it wasn't that at all.  It seemed to us that it was a compilation of left overs put into hot dishes and passed off as a BBQ!   
We spent a great deal of our time on the beautiful beach -- it is spectacular and when walking the shoreline it is obvious that Paridisus has the best beach area in comparison to the other resorts in the area. The ocean waves were strong and it was fun to challenge them!  The beach area has many sun beds, lounges and towels. It is a large beach area so there was lots of space between groups.  To get a spot with sun and shade (and we did need shelter from the hot sun every day) it is wise to get to the beach early.  The bar service on the beach was fantastic and the servers were lots of fun.  A shout out to Luis Santana, Santos Frias, Ramon Ramirg, Jairo Minier and Benita Mercedes for making our beach days so enjoyable!   It is about a 10 minute walk from The Reserve to the beach, but with the warmth of the sun on us and the grounds that were just so beautiful to walk through the whole way, we enjoyed the walks very much.  It was the only exercise we got all week long and after eating and eating and indulging in all the great bevvies, the walks were good to have!  There were always trolleys rolling along taking people wherever they wanted to go if people were looking for a ride.
We would recommend this resort to everyone looking for a stay in paradise in the DR.

reviews.author: Noddydude
reviews.title: Punta Canna Feb 2017
reviews.text:
We were very pleased with the Royal Service and especially our butler Louis. If you want exceptional service the Royal Service is a must. The food at the resort was very good for the DR. Room service was included  which we took advantage of. The Plazzo Restaurant was exclusive to Royal Service clients and Magill was especially great at looking after us. The Beach and private pool area was also a great experience. Fernando was exceptional looking after us with the cabana's and beach chairs. 
We would definitely recommend this experience.

reviews.author: DCJohnnie
reviews.title: Great staff and awesome facility!
reviews.text:
The staff at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort are great. They always went out of their way to ensure that we had an enjoyable experience. The gym started our day nicely with great service and attention. The buffet is absolute lovely and I am sure the multiple restaurants are also but due to my dietary restrictions I stuck to the buffet and I was always satisfied.

The ladies cleaning our rooms were so warm, helpful and accommodating. Cesar did a great job with our fridge as it was restocked properly based on our needs.

The highlight of our day would be to stop at ``The Avenue`` after playing golf and chat with Luis, Nicholas and Juan. They really made us feel welcome. On Dominican night, the activity staff were great as Laura and Carmen and kept us occupied dancing and laughing.

We also enjoyed the Michael Jackson show and smiled as Carmen really wanted to show off her moves! The band that played on Thursday night was interesting departing from the island vibe and was really enjoyable.

In terms of the golf course they have three 9 holes courses and they are okay. There were so many leaves on the course that it was difficult to find the ball at times but it was very windy so under normal circumstances it would be fine. Course was a bit dry  in areas and very soggy in others. The sand traps did not appear to be racked daily. I must say the staff in Pro shop are very nice.

The ladies at the reservation desks were warm hearted and I even got Sue to open up and smile. At every turn there was someone willing to take a few minutes out of their day to chat with us and it was so nice to hear about the staff, their kids, lives and what they do at the hotel.

There was a huge issue at check in which took 5 hours on Saturday but still they remained calm and tried to ensure everyone was happy. That was a tough day for all who checked and i am glad that cool heads prevailed.

Definitely a place to come back to in the future!

reviews.author: Anita767
reviews.title: If you are looking for Paradise - You will find it here!
reviews.text:
5 star resort on one of the top two beaches in the Dominica Republic. Bravo Beach is breathtaking.  Pristine beach that stretches on for miles with some of the most beautiful water in the Caribbean. Sunrises and sunsets are gorgeous.  
Took a girls trip with three great friends. We all agreed that this was one of the nicest resorts we have every stayed. Food is fabulous with a wide variety of culinary options. The grounds are spectacular with several large size pools and lounging areas sprinkled throughout this amazing property. They have regular fitness activities scheduled during the day and evening entertainment on the beach. Suites are spacious and decorated elegantly. Kid friendly too. Great service. Cannot say enough good things about this resort. Would return again in a heartbeat.  They have a good variety of adventure and day trip options. Took a day trip to Santo Domingo which I would highly recommend. Rich is history and interesting.

reviews.author: MissJenn210
reviews.title: February 2017 Wedding Week
reviews.text:
We just returned from a week at the Paradisus Palma Real for our wedding - so this review is two fold, the resort itself and then the Romance Department.

The Romance Department Team is amazing!  Special shout out to Raquel Vega and the entire romance team.  They did an amazing job and did not miss a beat when it came to our wedding.  They went above and beyond to make our wedding day perfect.  I would consider myself to be an extremely detailed person, and I spent the past year sending various emails to Raquel and the team and they were always so quick to response and always so friendly.  Thank you to Raquel and Nadia Vasquez from Caribbean Celebrations for all of their hard work!!!!!!  I brought 12 of my own suitcases full of decorations for the BBQ and Reception, but in hindsight I should have let them handle it because they truly do amazing work.

The servers/bartenders at our Welcome BBQ and Wedding Reception went above and beyond!  Special thank you to Joel, who waited on my fiance and I hand and foot.  Our glasses were never empty!  Unfortunately I did not get everyone's names that worked our event, however every single one of our guests commented on how wonderful the service was.  

Luis was our Royal Service concierge for the week and he was happy to do anything that we asked - from setting up a golf outing for the guys, making dinner reservations, and even decorating our room on our wedding night!  Luis was so friendly and we truly enjoyed spending the week with him.  He was even kind enough to find us on the beach while we were taking wedding photos to bring us a bottle of champagne!  Luis we hope to see you again soon!

Alexis, the gentleman who refilled our minibar every day, also did an amazing job.  Our fridge was never empty and he even checked in with us to see if there was anything in particular we wanted in our fridge.  Thank you Alexis!

Luz (I apologize for the spelling) was our housekeeper and she did an amazing job cleaning our room and providing turn down service every night.  We made quite a mess in our room the day of the wedding but when we got back to our room that night - everything was spotless and put away so nicely!  She provided fresh towels for us every day and always did such a nice job cleaning our room.  

Regarding the resort itself - there were a few minor hiccups:
1) Dinner Reservations are very annoying.  Reservations are reserved for Royal Service and The Reserve customers only.  If you are not a Royal Service or Reserve customer, be prepared to possibly eat at the Buffet every night.  Luckily our wedding coordinator was able to make dinner reservations for all of our guests for our entire stay, however we did have a few guests that arrived several days before we did and unfortunately they had to eat at the buffet both nights as they were unable to make reservations.

2) For some reason the resort requires the original credit card/form of payment upon checking it.  It was actually very surprising to me that this was not mentioned in any of the other reviews.  We had 80 guests attend this resort for our wedding and close to half of us didn't have our original form of payment (either the credit card expired, was stolen, left at home, etc).  The resort absolutely will not let you check in without the original form of payment, which is bizarre considering the hotel was obviously already paid for with the original card.  The hotel made all of the guests rebook NEW reservations at a higher rate to a NEW credit card! So certain guests now have two hotel charges on their credit cards - the one they originally made several months in advance and the one that they had to put on a new card upon arrival.  We even called corporate headquarters while we were there and were told that as long as we have the original email confirmation confirming that the room had been paid for, we would have no problem.  However the front desk kept saying that Corporate Headquarters has no relation to each individual resort... it was odd, and not necessarily a deal beaker however it did cause a lot of frustration and chaos upon checkin.  I just wish it would have said on the email confirmation that you needed the original form of payment.  It would have solved a lot of problems.

Overall, we had a great stay at the Paradisus Palma Real!  We would get married there again in a heartbeat if given the option!!  The service, food, and resort were top notch.  The staff were always willing to go above and beyond for anything that we needed.

THANK YOU!!!!

reviews.author: kevrod44
reviews.title: Best Birthday Ever
reviews.text: Came to this resort for my 25th Birthday with a group of my closest friends and it was an amazing time. We were all treated with spectacular service that went above and beyond. Rumardo Mercedes stood out among all of the great people that accommodated us. He helped us out with anything that we needed during our stay and was able to guide us to all the right people who could be of assistance.If it weren't for him and his team we probably would have a had a completely different experience and we wouldn't have been able to take advantage of all the wonderful things this resort has to offer.

reviews.author: sammyh222017
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text:
This is our 3rd time at this resort and it is always a first class experience. The setting is perfection and the staff provides the best service possible. Our butler's name is Angelo Mercedes. He is professional, kind and anticipates our every need before we even think about asking. He finds us whether we are on the beach, our room, or anywhere on the resort to ensure we are taken care of. This includes having a fresh bottle of wine and cheese platter waiting for before going to dinner every evening.  
Francisco Cabrero has brought us drinks on the beach since we first started coming 3 years ago. It would not be the same without him. He brings refreshments to our beach chairs all day long, and without fail, every morning Francisco has our chairs and towels set up on the beach in prime location. 
Juana's massage was pure bliss. Fatima, Junior and Miguel, and all the staff at Palazzo are consistently in keeping with dining at a 5 star restaurant.  Carlos, at Japanese restaurant took care of my husband who became ill during the show in the most discreet, kind way and simultaneously running the show.  Santa, in the royal Palace lounge is a delight. 
The service is exemplary.

reviews.author: clearwater103
reviews.title: très beau séjour
reviews.text: À la hauteur de nos attentes, très beau site propre, chaleureux, on y manque de rien, juste à demander et c'est fait, autant le service aux chambres, qu'à la plage et dans les restos.  Ceux qui aiment bien les restaurants à la carte seront peut-être un peu déçus, car à mon avis le buffet est à privilégier vu la variété des mets qui s'y retrouvent.  L'accueil, avec plateau de fruits et bouteille de vin dans la chambre et le dernier soir également, font que de petites attentions comme ça agrémentent toujours le séjour.  Et que dire du service sur la plage, très bien, c'est non stop, toujours un serveur attentionné.  Bref je recommande et y retournerai si possible.

reviews.author: Cathy S
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
I vacationed here for 7 days Feb 2016 and again for 9 days Feb 2017 and this luxury resort is like paradise.  I hope to return again soon.  All staff go over and above to accommodate and do it all with beautiful smiles.  In particular, these are the people I dearly miss:
Eslair Jean Pierre, aka "nene" - The wonderful gardener who provided me with a fresh coconut and a beautiful smile every morning in the gardens. He started every day for me with a wonderfully welcoming smile and chat.
Luis - The best bartender ever!  At the pool bar.  He knows your name and your favorite drink after the first hour. Always ready with a warm happy greeting and a smile.
Daniel Del Carmen - You'll find him serving drinks at the pool and beach area.  He has the biggest most beautiful smile that will brighten your day, and a warm, pleasant voice and laugh.  He might even sing to you.  He is so very handsome with a very sweet heart and soul.  Love him.   :) 
Magic Miquel - The amazing magician and bartender between Bana and Rare restaurants.  Go see him!  You'll be impressed! You'll be amazed!  You'll want more!
Shakey Shakey - OMG, wait until you see this guy!  The smile!  The dancing!  The social interaction!  The fun!  The energy! He has it all!  He does it all! So entertaining!  So welcoming! Downright amazing! I wouldn't want to be there without Shakey Shakey!
Chocolate - He is so entertaining and so much fun.  Exercise, dance, greetings, entertainment, smiles, hugs, energy...  amazing!
Kung Fu Panda (Oliver) - Another great guy on the entertainment committee.  Wow! Dance, exercise, energy, excitement, fun, smiles, etc!  
Antonio & Victor - Try a great yoga class on a paddle board in the pool with Antonio instructing and Victor helping. Good times! Very nice!  

Thank you for an exceptional vacation!

reviews.author: Robin S
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Our stay at the Paradisius Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort was wonderful. The property is beautiful only to be outdone by the exceptional and personal service by our butler, Ariel Benzo and the fabulous and unbelievable service from beach concierge Francisco Cabrera! If you ever visit this resort I strongly recommend you request the service of these men.

reviews.author: Kewis S
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: My friends and I had a great experience at Paradisus and the staff was really humble and always willing to help us out with any of our request and concerns with a smile on their faces. Nothing but the best was offered to us.

reviews.author: joanng408
reviews.title: Welcome to Paradise
reviews.text: I just got back 2 days ago and cannot wait to return to the Dominican Republic and Paradisus Palma Real!! It was fun and relaxing all in one resort!!  My friend and I had a room in one of the villas.  The room was very clean and nicely laid out.  We had a small balcony with two chairs that overlooked the Oriental Garden, with a pond with two flamingos.  At night, there was turndown service and a little piece of chocolate to end the day.The buffet was the nicest I have ever seen at an all inclusive.  There were even langostinas one day at lunch.  There was a great little place with cappuccino, espresso, gelato and desserts open from 11am to 4pm.  At the pool bar, Leonardo was always smiling and eager to get a drink for me!  The bartenders at the main bar just rocked!! They were incredible mixologists--making watermelon drinks, hot tea (to help my head cold) and various rum drinks!  Malvin Mercedes, Rafael Santana and Jose M. Cruz were all amazing!! They made my trip so enjoyable! I miss these guys already!  They were assisted by two wonderful servers, Angelita and Yorcaris--both ladies were so kind and always smiling!  The main bar staff was truly a great group of people who knew how to work as a team!  The entertainers/activities coordinators were also just wonderful.  Shaky Shaky, Caramello, Coco Loco, and Shanty knew how to get the crowd involved in dance lessons, water aerobics, painting classes, volleyball and so many other activities.  On Oscar night, one of these guys was covered in gold from head to toe and stood in the lobby as an "Oscar" statute with Charlie Chaplin too! There was a large screen in the lobby for the guests to watch the award show.  So many nice guests from all over the world.  Great memories.  My goal is to bring back my friends and family in the next year!!

reviews.author: Piero I
reviews.title: World class service
reviews.text: The service provided by Rumardo Mercedes V was nothing short of outstanding. He went out of his way plenty of times to make sure my trip was everything it should be. Really friendly and hardworking. Everytime i would run into him, i instantley knew he would take care of me and my friends.

reviews.author: Mary-Jane M
reviews.title: Incredible staff and resort
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I decided to take a week away from our busy lives and families and decided on booking at Paradisus.  It was as advertised!  We have a wonderful time at The Reserve and made our way to the beach several times.  The entertainment was surprisingly great too!  You've heard of Michael Jackson impersonators?  Well, no joke, this guy was amazing.  He looked JUST like him.  We thought MJ is alive and well at Paradisus!

The resort is beautiful, so lush and so well manicured and looked after.  The people... the staff from gardener to concierge, they people were amazing.  They are all beautiful too.  No, they really are and happy!  Always a big smile and a greeting of Hola!  A great big shout out to Jose Drinkie Drinkie!  From the poolside in The Reserve.  I loved that guy.  Wakey, wakey, drinkie drinkie!  So fun.

The food was very fresh in the buffets and the a la cartes.  I don't know where they get their yogurt or how they make it, but it was the best yogurt ever.

I will definitely return with my husband hopefully next year.

reviews.author: Jenna M
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: We had an amazing time here at the royal service resort! Our Butler Jose Salvador was the most polite and respectful man, he made sure we had everything all day and took great care of us from making our dinner reservations to drawing up a bubble bath for us girls! Rafael Guerro was our pool boy and he was great, had our Bali beds ready for us at the beach and made sure we never went thirsty all week! The restaurants were great service and great tasting, all different cultured throughout the resort. Very relaxing and best place to get away. Just beautiful highly suggested

reviews.author: Anthony P
reviews.title: Best place I've been outside the country
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time here at the resort. Food and service was wonderful. Our butler Jose Salvador did a excellent job keeping us up with events and reservations. Also Rafael Guerrero did a wonderful job setting us up on the beach every morning and keeping the drinks coming! 

Thanks,
Anthony aka Antonio

reviews.author: susanadelaney
reviews.title: Paradisus Truly Means Paradise
reviews.text: From the moment you enter this sprawling resort with its picturesque fountains and lush green tropical palm trees abounding, you feel as if you have entered a beautiful forbidden paradise on earth. There are few words to describe these breathtaking surroundings. That is the first pro for this all inclusive resort. The second is the hard working friendly staff. I took plenty of singles with me because I knew I would use them generously on the staff for whatever little thing they did to make our stay that much more enjoyable. There were far too many to mention and thank for all they did. This was a special occasion because I took my sister to Punta Cana to celebrate her birthday. And celebrate was what we did from start to finish. Although she is not a drinker, we made up for it at all the restaurants and the buffet which displayed more varieties of scrumptious foods than you could ever imagine. The 3 specialty restaurants that we dined at were Japanese Bana, Vento and Aqua. The best was Aqua for both food and ambiance. The Japanese Hibachi was just ok (our cook was not that entertaining) and Vento's was the second best. If you do your homework and read tripadvisor prior to your vacation, you will have several helpful tips such as making dinner reservations with the Concierge immediately after you arrive to ensure the restaurants of your choice. Even then, there is no guarantee you'll get them. But you must be persistent and not back down because there was always space available when we got to the restaurants that they claimed were full. The other pro with the Paradisus was the beach. You could sit almost anywhere and enjoy the warm sun during the day and the cool breezes in the evening. Our bedroom was somewhat classic traditional style and not too modern which was great. We enjoyed sitting on the balcony and did not have any problems with mosquitoes ( but we did use repellent). Because our stay was so short, we did not have a chance to see any of the shows since dinner reservations usually conflicted. But there was music and festivities throughout  the resort at almost any given time. For me one of the highlights of this short trip was the Japanese massage. I cannot say enough about how relaxing this made me  feel after enduring a stressful life back home. I feel this is a must! We did not have the Royal service simply because of our short stay, but we felt  we were treated like royalty anyway. Perhaps if I were to return I may stay a day or 2 longer because it is definitely worth it. Another word to the wise, be careful not to over indulge on too many different types of foods at once because your system really can't handle it and you may spend precious time near your bathroom. All in all this was a fabulous all inclusive resort experience and would have gotten a 5 if making dinner reservations had not been so complicated. If you choose to stay at this resort as a single, couple, friends and family, you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Julie B
reviews.title: Gorgeous Resort
reviews.text:
The property and grounds are gorgeous, clean and well tended.  Our room, a junior suite was spacious and nicely decorated.  At first we were concerned being assigned a room on the back side of the resort furthest from the beach, but we found this gave us a frequent opportunity to wander the Oriental garden and admire the flamingos that lived in the pond.  The staff are consistently friendly and helpful.  The beach is beautiful and well maintained.  For the most part even though the resort was full it did not seem crowded.  We only felt the congestion in the buffet at dinner and breakfast, and trying to get chairs on the beach.  We were traveling in high season.  
If only we could have figured out how to keep the bathroom lights on.  It was a strange sensor based system and some switches controlled all the lights and fan in the room.  We never fully mastered it.  This was only a small inconvenience and cause of much laughter.  We were too excited to get to the beach to call and wait for a tutorial.

reviews.author: Lynn P
reviews.title: MERVEILLEUX
reviews.text: la chambre était grande, propre, seul bémol nous étions 3 filles, la chambre avec la salle de bain, manquait un peu d'intimité séparation pas très intime, mais pour le reste, le site, nourriture, le personnel,,,,merveilleux, excellent je vais y retourner et conseille aux gens d'aller s'y séjourner,,,,très bien.

reviews.author: pboy266
reviews.title: Amazing girls' trip....
reviews.text: Highly recommend getting Royal Service! Our personal butler Argenis took care of reservations at restaurants, booking our cabana by the pool and checking on us everyday. The property and rooms are beautiful, clean and well-kept. I had two massages at the spa with Lilete and Marcia that were amazing. Pedro, Francisco and Wanda tool care of us at the Royal Service beach and pool. I highly recommend this property - fantastic for a girls' getaway! Service was superb!

reviews.author: SanPac17
reviews.title: Ultimate Paradise
reviews.text:
First time here but won't be the last time. It's beautiful with beds on the beach. Beds in the pools. 
Nightlife is fun-filled with shows, dancing, music. Thanks to Raynold Tamayo for the AMAZING customer service, yoga on the beach and batacha lesson!! Find him and he will show you a great time!!!!

reviews.author: Scipdi
reviews.title: Amazing Ladies Getaway
reviews.text: We came to Paradisus Palma Real for two special friends' birthday celebrations.  The resort is absolutley beautiful on a gorgeous beach.  We had the Royal Service which made our stay there amazing.  Our Royal Service butler, Yohelvi was the best.  He asked us each day what we wanted to do, arranged excursions for us, made dinner reservations for us and made all of us and especially the birthday girls feel like princesses.  On the beach we were fortunate to have Pedro serve us each day.  He was so kind and catered to all of our needs on the beach.  We each had great messages in the most serene setting you could imagine.  I would highly recommend Kharen for your message.  Thank you all especially Yohelvi, for making this an unforgettable trip.  We are looking forward to coming to Paradisus again!

reviews.author: Andi G
reviews.title: Best vacation thanks to royal service  and Yohelvi the most amazing butler!
reviews.text: Just came back from one of the best girls weekend ever! Royal service was the way to go!  We felt so pampered and well taken care by our Butler  Yohelvi Aracena. From the minute we arrived with personalized check-in with mimosas, to decorated rooms and decorated birthday beach chairs , reservations for dinner, and answers to our endless questions, special,treats in our hotel rooms, etc, Yohelvi made each day simple and fantastic. And just as wonderful was Pedro at the Royal service beach. He had our Bali beds ready for us no matter how early or late we showed up at the beach, and was so attentive to all of our drinks needs!  So sad this wonderful vacation is over!

reviews.author: mtucker333
reviews.title: Wonderful Service
reviews.text: Just returned home from a fabulous vacation at Paradisus Palma Real.   When booking we were not sure if we should "splurge" for the Royal Service.   However, thanks to the attentive care we received from Yohelvi, our butler, it was well worth the nominal cost.  We saw him often as he attended to our needs, and if not in the immediate vicinity, he was a quick call away.   Thank you Yohelvi for making our vacation SPECTACULAR!!

reviews.author: jenmac1972
reviews.title: Loved  the Royal Service and especially the royal treatment we received from Yohelvi
reviews.text: We stayed in the Royal Service section of the hotel and received Royal treatment from all the staff but especially from Yohelvi.  He was very attentive and really helped make our trip memorable.  We did not have to worry about anything the entire vacation because Yohelvi took care of everything from dinner reservations, spa treatments, beach activities and room questions.  He was the best and we would definitely request him next time we come back.   The beach and grounds are so beautiful at this hotel and we would love to come back again!

reviews.author: Adenau1
reviews.title: Great Girls Getaway!
reviews.text: We had THE best time at this resort.  The grounds are absolutely lush.   We were able to explore the grounds each day as we headed to dinner.  There are a million different classes and activities that you can take part in.  We did a poolside candle making class and a tasting.  The biggest decision we made each day was whether or not to head to the pool or the beach.  Fantastic trip!

reviews.author: Cecelia S
reviews.title: Best 50th Birthday Celebration ...thanks to Yohelvi
reviews.text: Came to Paradisus to celebrate our 50th Birthdays. The beach and hotel were beautiful but what really made out trip the absolute best was the Royal Service and the attention that we received from Yohelvi. He paid special attention to all of our needs..for all six of us! From reservations for dinner..excursions...speciality wine and drinks. He arranged birthday decorations in our room and at the beach.  He took excellent care of us and we wanted for nothing. We can't thank Yohelvi enough for the most awesome birthday celebration!

reviews.author: Colette M
reviews.title: The best resort 👍👍👍
reviews.text: 100% will return! As two girls travelling we were so cared for. The people are so kind and do everything to speak English!  Thank you Raynol Tamayo and wander Roa. They were amazing and attentive. We never wanted for anything. Can't wait to return.😍😍🌴🌴🌴🌴🕶🕶🕶😘😘👍👍🍾🍾

reviews.author: Tim R
reviews.title: Great trip!!
reviews.text: Amazing time at this resort. Beautiful resort with fantastic service from all staff. Eduard Mendez was our personal butler. Incredibly helpful and friendly. He took great care of us! The food was great, the beach is stunning and the facilities are first rate. The Royal Service package is the way to go.

reviews.author: nancy29556
reviews.title: Spectacular!
reviews.text: This was my first trip to an all inclusive vacation in the Caribbean, but if you go here and there are any properties better than this one, do write a review about it. This is a spectacular resort. Spacious, beautiful grounds, gorgeous beach with in-sun and in-shade seating, numerous well-appointed restaurants with excellent cuisine choices, two beautiful pools, smiling, very attentive staff. Our room was a condo, actually, with full kitchen (not sure why needed), dining area, living room with sleeper sofa, separate bedroom, luxurious bathroom, enclosed patio for breakfast (or anytime) room service if you desire.  There are a number of accomodation choices.  Be aware: (1) Don't drink water from the tap. Bottled water is everywhere. (2) Ask your butler to make restaurant reservations for you on arrival, They are a must. (3) If you're unable to walk fairly long distances, consider renting a scooter (info@scootersdr,com). You can do this when you arrive, but best to inquire before you leave. (4) If you decide to take one of the boating excursions, the one I took had three hours of loud R&R music and stairs on to the boat with virtually nothing to hang on to. When I managed to make it to the top there was no one to help and I fell, now nursing sore ribs and a bruised foot and shin. So if you need stairs with railings and no music, be sure to ask.   Ola!!

reviews.author: Sharon B
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation!!
reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful vacation!! We did the Royal service and Miguel was our butler and he was so great and helpful!! Miguel's service was exemplary with all of dinner reservations and anything else we needed! 

Also Carlos at the beach was so great in reserving us the best beach chairs and beach beds every day!

Also the food was so delicious and the resort was beautiful and fun! I highly recommend and would density come back!!

reviews.author: JRK20
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go
reviews.text: Finishing up a great stay with great service from our butler Miguel.  He took care of all of our needs and made this a memorable stay.  The Royal Service is worth it providing access to the adult only areas and the Palazzo restaurant with full service for all 3 daily meals.  The food on property has been very good including Aqua, Fuego, the hibachi restaurant and Blue Agave.  If I return to DR I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: maureengny
reviews.title: Staff members to be recognize.
reviews.text:
I would like to recognize staff members who went above and beyond.
Francisco Estrello and Ruben Bacha. Can't thank you enough for your outstanding service and friendly smiles everyday. They made our trip more enjoyable.
Again Thank you

reviews.author: Steve G
reviews.title: Great Vacation, Amazing Service!
reviews.text:
Traveled with a small group - Royal Service Gardenview Room - 7 Days

Had an amazing week.  Our butler Carlos Hinostroza was fantastic! He took care of all our dinner reservations and booking of off site excursions and was always available to assist with whatever we needed.  Often arranged for special deliveries to our room (cheese plates, fruit plates, etc.) which were great when you got back from a day at the beach.

Food at this resort was among the best we have had at a resort.  Our group has a seafood allergy which can make food at Caribbean resorts problematic but there were lots of options here, and all very good.  Vento (Mediterranean cuisine) was the best and a highlight of our trip.  Resort has a great room service menu which we took advantage of often - makes for a great post beach pre dinner option!

Royal service beach area was great.  Sometimes hard to find daybeds if you don't get up at 8am but we only had one day we couldn't find a spot for all four of us.  The royal service beach smoothie bar is a nice plus!!!

Main pool is great, has a large swim up bar that catches a good amount of later afternoon/evening sun so we often switched to the pool late in the day to take advantage!

Overall the resort has lots of great evening options to both sit outdoors and enjoy a drink, or take in the nightly entertainment.  We did encounter a lot of people smoking (we are nonsmokers).  As far as we could see smoking was permitted everywhere except in nonsmoking rooms and the restaurants.  Not really the resort's fault but some non smoking areas would likely be popular as we witnessed many people moving seats and actively trying to avoid the smoke.

Rooms were clean and well taken care of.  Members of our group arrived to some minor room issues (small leak from the AC unit) and were re-assigned immediately.  Rooms have bathrooms that are not fully separated from the main room.  Its something I've only ever seen in the DR.  Not a big deal but could be kind of strange if you were sharing a room with somebody you weren't fully familiar with.

Overall a great experience and a wonderful resort.  Would be great for both small and large groups with lots of options for a variety of preferences and price points.  Would definitely go back.

reviews.author: 887charlened
reviews.title: Exceptional service
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the great opportunity to have Jeuri as our butler during our time at this  resort.  He took care of our every need with exceptional care and expertise. His recommendation of the steak house for dinner on our third night proved to be the charm. Our best dining experience yet. We had Johnnie as our server and couldn't have asked for more.  With these two men at our service the relaxing time.
 we craved came to fruition at Paridisus.  Also Eduard ans samuel were very helpful.

reviews.author: lurudelich
reviews.title: My vacation
reviews.text: We loved our visit, the hotel was beautiful and very clean. Lots of choices for our meals. We especially enjoyed our personal butler jeuri Ferreira. He was very attentive. He kept surprising us with fun, thoughtful ideas. The romantic bubble bath was great!!!  Jeuri made the trip the best.

reviews.author: themightyyohanne
reviews.title: First Time in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We traveled over the Valentine's Day week.  We had a wonderful time and will definitely be going back. I gave this a 4 star rating because the food was not great.  I wouldn't say it was horrible, but everything was very bland.  We ate at Rare, Palazzo, Vento, Blue Agave, Room Service and the Buffet. The best was the buffet. We chose the Royal Service Garden View Suite - it was beautiful and the bed was awesome! We had a few minor issues with the room but they were resolved quickly. The customer service from everyone we came in contact with was very good and definitely 5+ stars but I will mention a few who provided phenomenal service.  Our butler was Jose Salvador - the trip wouldn't have been the same without him, Thank you for all you did for us and for truly enjoying your job. Malvin and Jose at the Lobby Bar - Wow I have never in my life had drinks made with the love and care you guys have and put into your work, truly a pleasure seeing you guys every evening!! Judy our server at Vento, your smile just brightens up everything!! Thank you for taking care of us with that beautiful smile even though we didn't care for much of the food. Thanks to Bayu at Olio for those special pizzas! Lilete and Juana for those wonderful massages, definitely worth the money!!  Thank you Elizabeth for printing our boarding passes and making our check out quick and smooth. 
A wonderful beautiful resort with wonderful staff.  Royal Service all the way is my advice!

reviews.author: Angie19662016
reviews.title: Stunning grounds
reviews.text:
We just spent a week here at the resort and the grounds are just stunning. Everything about this resort was beautiful from the rooms, the beach, pool, even the public washrooms.  The resort is so clean and well maintained and the staff are so friendly and helpful. We didn't do Royal service but also felt it wasn't needed. Our maid was so sweet and did an amazing job of making us feel welcome.  The nightly entertainment was great for all ages and the Gabi club music every night was perfect. I would have given it a 5 star rating but the food was just so so.  
There were not enough lunch options as you could only go to the buffet or the burger restaurant at the beach.  The burger bar menu was very limited and you had to sit and wait.  The buffet was very repetitive and there were no beach grills to just grab a nachos or burger to eat at the beach. 
It was difficult to get reservations for the a la carte restaurants and we were only able to get 3 for the entire week. The Japanese was amazing but the Italian was just so so and the steakhouse was awful. This resort is 5 star on everything but the food.

reviews.author: Kelly D
reviews.title: Punta Cana
reviews.text: This was our first time in Punta Cana and Paradisus Palma resort was amazing! If you stay at this resort make sure you get Royal Service!! Services was great.. Jose is the best always on top of everything all you have to do is sit back and enjoy. Make sure you go to the lobby bar for your drinks. Malvin, is the best. The spa is nice and relaxing also. People are very friendly. This is a very quite resort not much nightlife which was ok with us.

reviews.author: cindyerhardt
reviews.title: Need better service
reviews.text:
It is a HUGE resort. You can not get food anytime of the day from either the pool bar or restaurants, very disappointing! But you could get room service. And I have never paid for an upgrade and never had problems with getting drinks on the beach, you had to walk up to the bar. Other people in our group were very upset also.
My husband had his dress pants hanging up in the bathroom so they wouldn't get wrinkled, and the maid spilled bleach on them!

reviews.author: yaroslav2016
reviews.title: Great Vacation!!!!!
reviews.text:
Great Vacation at Paradisus Palma Real. We stayed at Royal Service. It's a second time that we are here. Our butler Ariel Bongo offered as always great service 2 years in row. We requested him after the first trip. I strongly recommend him if you want to get a great experience at Royal Service. 

We had a great experience at the Spa. I would like to thank you people that work there: Ruth (reservations), America Rodriguez (reception), Isabel (therapist), Omar, Carlos, Soribel (personal assistants).

I WOULD LIKE TO SAY THE BIGGEST "THANK YOU" TO REBECCA (Massage Therapist). She delivered the BEST massages ever. We were getting 3-4 massages a day with her. Trust me! If you want to have a great massage ever, choose REBECCA. 
I will come back to this resort again because of REBECCA. You need to have massage with her and than you can write in my comments. I am sure this review will help.

Also, we visited Rare restaurant. Sobet Esteban was our waiter. He was very knowledgeable regarding the menu. Very polite and always he listened to your request. We enjoyed a dinner! Thanks Esteban.

We had a great night at Vento restaurant. Thank you for the great service from Richard Ortiz. Great work!

Thank you to all people at the resort!

We will be back again soon!

reviews.author: Kimberly H
reviews.title: The Hutzels
reviews.text: We came to Paradisus to escape our cold winter in VA for a warm get away with good friends ! We used the Royal service and our butler was Argenis Romero! Argenis was a delight! He was very sweet, caring and genuine. He helped us with all of our dinner reservations and any question we had he was there to help us. We will always remember him and his warm smile. When we return we will surely ask for him! Thank you Argenis. We wish you well and know you will have an amazing future!

reviews.author: Kate C
reviews.title: Nice but expensive
reviews.text: Great service from all staff, especially at Palazzo Restaurant and the smoothie bar on the beach.  Amazing beach, nice cabanas for shade.  Nice room with jacuzzi tub and balcony.  Only complaint is that the wifi is extremely weak - just pay for international service on cell if you need to stay connected.  We were the first people picked up for all excursions - sometimes as early as 6:45, due to location of hotel.

reviews.author: annpaq
reviews.title: Très beau séjour!
reviews.text: C'était notre première fois au Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort et nous avons adoré notre expérience. Pour plusieurs raisons: la qualité de la nourriture et du service, la propreté dans les chambres et sur le site, accès à la plage ou à la piscine sans se préoccuper s'il y aura de la place (pas besoin de se lever aux aurores pour trouver une chaise), respect aussi de la clientèle. Pour ceux qui aiment le golf, il y a un terrain de 27 trous à proximité en excellente condition. Mention spéciale au serveur sur la plage Jesus Padma et tout particulièrement au directeur M. Juan De Dios. Nous y retournerons sûrement.

reviews.author: Terry B
reviews.title: Wtvm group vacations with 30 friends
reviews.text: Jose Lugo our butler made made this one our best vacations ever! Not too pushy put always helping out in any way. Help set up a great snorkeling trip we even got to see some whales!!! He is a great asset to your team. He has a job if he ever wants to come to the states with my company👍👍👏👏

reviews.author: skyetucker4
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Overall it was an amazing experience. The workers definalty set the mood for a great atmosphere, always being willing to help out when needed. You are able to shape your experience to whatever type of vacation you're looking for; relaxing, spending your time lounging by the pool and at the spa, or outgoing, taking advantage of all the excursions the resort has to offer. However, the food and drinks were not up to par with the rest of the resort.

reviews.author: Saraahmadi99
reviews.title: Another Great Vacation.....
reviews.text: Had a great time!!! Thanks to Eduard Mendez everything went smoothly!!! The food was pretty good overall. We very impressed with the service and the quality of the food. Will def. come back again!!! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Amir P
reviews.title: Another great Vacation!
reviews.text:
We were here for 7 days. Had a great time...everything was great. We were super impressed with the service we received from our butler Eduard Mendez and his team. Thanks to him everything went great! Fernando and Juan at the bar were also super great! They took care of us everyday at the beach! The juice guy fredurde always cheered us up with the  best fresh fruit smoothies. The buffet was exceptional. Overall, we are very pleased! This was my second stay with the Paradisus brand royal service (Punta Cana and Palma Real) . I will definitely recommend this place! 

Thank you again Royal Service team. 

AP

reviews.author: MARIA
reviews.title: Impresionante!!
reviews.text:
Nos fuimos un grupo de amigos y la verdad que de 10
Todo el equipo que trabaja allí, desde el equipo de animación, el de la piscina, playa y restaurantes es inmejorable te hacen sentir súper bien y que decir de nuestro mayordomo Faustino que estuvo súper pendiente en todo momento, muy amable.
Lo recomiendo 100% en todo.
Gracias ser parte de que lo pasáramos tan bien!!!

reviews.author: Kohl0002
reviews.title: Very disappointing resort
reviews.text:
First night needed bedding for the pull out bed. Called 3 times for bedding/pillows starting at 9:00 pm. At 11:30 pm still no bedding, walked to the reserve lobby and told them what happened and  asked again. Finally at 11:45pm got bedding, BUT NO PILLOWS. When someone turns water on in their room, you can hear it running in your room. You can hear the motorized carts going outside your room. It's 8:16 am and I just got woke up to the maids making lots if noise outside the room, so may as well get up. 

If you are thinking this is an all inclusive resort, then be prepared to get your own drinks on the beach. Went to the beach 3 times and 3 hours each time, no one came by to see if we needed drinks. It seems they don't want to serve drinks. It wasn't until I went to the Gabi bar and complained that someone actually came and waited on us. 

They have no dressers to unpack clothing, so be prepared to not unpack your suitcase for a week.

I have never paid this much to stay somewhere and WILL NEVER RECOMMEND THIS PLACE to anyone.

The food is average to below average. You can't get
Something to eat between 11:30 am and 12:30 pm. The food is the same every day so it gets old to eat the same thing every day.

Went to Pfuego and food was not good. We had an 8:00 reservation, arrived at 7:45 pm, we had friends who couldn't get a table to join us, when we got to the restaurant their were 16 open seats with no one getting seated in those seats until 9:30 when we left, so they had plenty of open seats.

I wish I had the money to leave and go stay at another resort as nothing is good hear. I expect to be waited on, and that never happens to our group.

We did have an event where Jose Moreno was working, and he was awesome.

Now as soon as the maids quiet down, I m going to take a nap and countdown the days to get out of this place.

Also this resort is so spread out, so don't buy the reserve package as your half mile walk to the beach.

reviews.author: April B
reviews.title: We had a blast!!!!!
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic. We read multiple reviews before choosing this resort. Long story short We fell in love with this place! I will tell you exactly why... The resort grounds are Gorgeous! It's stunning day and night. The view from the main lobby, lunch views, the pool views... amazing! Next- their beach set up is the bomb! We walked the whole beach all the way up and down and none of the other resorts even come close to the beach setup they have here. The chairs with the little palm tree shade. The white shade beds & the big white beds beach front. The view is THE best and the seating was unmatched. The staff was awesome at reserving our cabana daily. We loved the staff!!! That also makes a huge difference. Everyone was happy to answer questions & help in anyway possible. They were so friendly. Speaking of the staff... This place has the BEST Entertainment staff!!!! I've traveled to over 20 countries & the daily activities, evening shows & nightlife at this resort is unmatched! We truly had a ball & enjoyed every second of this trip. These guys are hilarious... They made everyday actives so much FUN! I loved the Zumba classes & dance lessons. They would come up to you at the pool and joke around. Somehow they even manage to remember everyone name. So now let me list all my favorite people by name! 

Jose Rijo- best concierge ever!
Very friendly! He consistently went above and beyond to assist us during our 7 night stay. 

The entertainers -
Luis Peguero (gasolina)
Argenis De La Rose (lookey lookey)
The 3rd guy is in the same picture above - but I can't read the name badge ... I think his stage name was "Aye yi yi" haha 
These men can dance like you've never seen before! Their positive energy and upbeat spirit make these three the life of the party & believe me they will have you coming back for more vacations at this resort! 

The waiters at the pool/ beach-
These guys would wait on us hand and foot brining buckets of ice waters, drinks, towels whatever we needed. They were very sweet! 
Philippe
Hector Rodgers 
Gabriel Polanco 

Wait staff at the restaurants -
Angel - 
Richard- 
Andis Herrera - the reserve (aqua)

Thursday night we went to the mediterranean restaurant at The Reserve- I think it was called Aqua? Everything is blue & silver inside. Lots of mirrors. Hands down this was the best food for the whole trip. We liked it so much & enjoyed our waiter & his recommendations we went back again Friday night. 
  Andis Herrera was our waiter - he was so friendly, so attentive & knew that menu like the back of his hand. He went out of his way to accommodate our special request. He was a delight! This restaurant was also very sheik looking. We enjoyed it very much.  

Guest services at the reserve beach-
Ladie
Danny 
These two are so sweet & booked our dinner reservations every night. Left us notes & surprises in the room. Booked our beach cabanas daily. They were awesome!  

The lady who made fresh juice margarita's everyday at a small bar near the snacks-  I included her picture but can't zoom in enough on her name badge - she was always so upbeat with a big smile on her face & did the cutest dance when she would shake the margarita! Haha

The only negative thing I would say is the food is just OK. It's not bad, it's just not remarkable. The initial room we had wasn't very impressive either- it seemed kind of older- like a smell of mildew ... sort of dark inside. I don't know it wasn't great for the price. But we dedicated to upgrade the room & it was very impressive! A brand new condo with a beach view & we loved everything about it! We will definitely be making this a annual girls trip. We had such a wonderful time.

reviews.author: mzleah
reviews.title: Go for the Beach, not for the food.
reviews.text:
go for the beach, not for the food.  best meals are at the buffet;  skip the specialty restaurants altogether.
Be prepared for over-eager welcome staff, who's main goal is to get you to attend a sales presentation.  My person tracked me down through days 1 and 2 of my vacation to get me to attend.

reviews.author: 4ladiesfromToronto
reviews.title: Great trip at the Paradisus!
reviews.text: Just came back from this resort after a week long trip with my girlfriends.  We stayed for a week and golfed 3 days.  This was my 3rd trip to the Dominican and definitely the nicest resort I had stayed at.  The resort was beautiful.  Service was excellent.  The beach was beautiful and plenty of space and chairs by the pool and the beach so no fighting over that!  Food was good...Japanese, Steak House and buffet were great.  Definitely an older crowd so no foam pool parties which was fine.  Booking our golf for across the street was seamless and quite inexpensive. Stored our clubs for us too.  Particular thanks to Jose at the lobby bar.  Was always fun and a very patient guy.  We didn't stay in Royal Service but one day we were having issues trying to sort something out and one of the butlers, Carlos, noticed.  He helped us out tremendously  and was more than happy to help us after that as well.  Depending on your needs, I would say Royal service would be a nice added value but not necessary as the service overall was great regardless.  Beautiful facility too on a great location on the beach.  Hope to visit again sometime soon.  Would definitely recommend this as a great all inclusive choice.

reviews.author: Leon G
reviews.title: Mejorable
reviews.text: Muy buena playa con suficiente cantidad de reposeras. Ediliciamente muy lindo. Bellos y cuidados jardines. El personal bastante amable pero quizas poco capacitado. Room service excelente. Habitaciones impecables. Quizas tendrian que tener mayor control en mantenimiento. La comida del buffet buena. De los restaurantes a la carta mala. Check in con dificultad. A pesar de haber cobrado toda la estadia, al no haber traido la misma tarjeta con la que se hizo el pago, volvieron a cobrarme con la nueva y quedaron en acreditar el pago anterior. Aun no fue realizado pasados cinco dias.

reviews.author: EkaterinaPanfilova
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text:
Writing as still in a hotel. Nothing but good I can say. Im staying under a membership of my friend, with a royal service included. How about not being worried about anything? All you have to do is enjoy, the biggest problem while your stay is to decide what you want to eat or drink! And you ask- you get.
Beach service. Pedro Cedano exceeded all my expectations, he knows exactly what you are in a mood for, he'll get your beach bed ready for you, get your drinks, he knows when is time to refresh you giving you a bottle of water, he knows how to heel your headache from last night and how to surprise you with a yummy cocktail, goes out of his way to make you feel Royal. Nowhere to find the same. 
Bars. I like Element the best, they play national music, and in seconds will make your drink. Also, best service you can ask for.
Room. Beds are super comfortable, the only negative about that would be that you don't want to get up. Housekeeping is doing their job just excellent, from early morning till the time you are ready to go to bed. Immaculate.
People. Dominicans are happy no matter what and they pass it around.
Don't forget to appreciate it all.

reviews.author: KKonthelake
reviews.title: Royal Service is worth the splurge!
reviews.text:
We enjoyed this resort from Jan 12-19 and went for the Royal Service upgrade.....I've never done this before and it was worth every penny. Made things so much easier, especially when it came to booking hotel reservations and palapas. And it includes room service which is such a treat. Carlos Hinostroza was our butler and he was great.....as was Ralphael at the pool. Both guys ensured we were always taken care of!
This is a lovely property, lots of gardens, beautiful pools and and very well maintained.

reviews.author: Austin2530
reviews.title: What a Great Time!!
reviews.text: From the moment you arrive you are you are impressed with the facilities and the people. the beach is just a short walk from your suite with a great pool area. The Food and drinks were the best!! The Spa was relaxing.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Awesome Venue, Mediocre Service
reviews.text:
The resort itself from a venue and location standpoint is awesome- nice rooms, nice pool, nice beach and lounge chairs and cabanas and all that happy stuff you'd hope to find. Before I speak negative about the staff I would just like to note that if your guy is Junior, he's the man and will help you with any and everything you could want. 

The whole place is smoke and mirrors. No matter how much research you do, you'll never actually know what you need to book to be in an optimal spot unless you read this tell-all review.  We originally booked The Reserve thinking that was the best of the best. Wrong. This resort is something around 90 acres... while The Reserve is the newest part of the resort, it is at the furthest most point from the beach and also in the kids section of the resort. In order to get down to the beach you're looking at a legit 10-15min walk or a golf cart shuttle ride if the service is kind enough to pick you up (4 out of 5 times they won't). Then while you're waiting for them to get your room ready they'll bring you to the bar where you'll soon find out that even in the Reserve section you don't get premium booze. So now you're a mile away from the beach and you can't have premium booze- guess you'll need to look into the upgrade. The "Royal Service" section of the resort, its highest and most prestigeous section, will put you within a pitching wedge to the beach, exclusive access to la palapa restaurant (meh), the sunset bar (nothing more than a bar) the royal service pool (nice pool), your own personal "butler" (Junior) and top shelf booze... HOWEVER, top shelf booze-ketel, goose, patron, Johnnie, etc- if you upgrade to "Royal Service", while the premium booze sits around most bars throughout the resort, you can only access it for free in two bars- Sunset Bar and La Palapa bar- of which the sunset bar closes around sunset. The other bars will have the booze you want and paid for but you can't get it without paying more for it. 

Your fridge will have two Budweiser in it and they won't provide you with any hard alcohol for your room. Not quite sure what kind of all-inclusive this is supposed to be. 

With that forewarning being thrown out there- beautiful resort, nice accommodations, food is eh- as expected for an all-inclusive, and if you buddy up with a staff or two, maybe they'll take a little better care of you. With better service and a little less smoke and mirror feel, this is a 4.5-5 star resort every day.

reviews.author: Rickyusa33
reviews.title: Keeps Getting Better!
reviews.text:
This is the 7th time we have visited Paradisus Punta Cana and the 3rd time we have stayed in The Reserve. This is a two week vacation for us and we couldn't be happier with the resort, employees, and activities.  We were here last year during January and had some issues with the resort some conventions that were going on and considered looking somewhere else this year.  I am so glad we decided to come back and give this fabulous resort another try!!! 

The grounds are beautiful and we have noticed some changes in the year since we have been here.  The Winery is a new addition in a space near Naos.  You can buy different types of wine and even have dinner served from a neighboring restaurant (Mole, Aqua, The Grille).  I love this new option since I am a bit of a white wine snob ...even though wine is included in the all-inclusive price  

The staff has become even more attentive and genuinely seem happy in their roles.  There are poolside activities in the afternoon and you can essentially do as much or as little as you like!

reviews.author: Duncan K
reviews.title: Book a suite - its worth the extra
reviews.text:
We had a 1BR master suite, which also had a really comfortable pullout couch. We were two sharing. 
Really large bathroom which was perfect for sharing, with two vanities. Perfect for sharing. Room was really clean - thanks to Isabella Mendez. 

The resort has two areas, the main hotel and and the reserve - we hung out at both - both had spas which was great. Really nice beach - though it was hard to get service at your beach chair. Not a big deal.
The buffets were great - we did not use the prime restaurants though through connecting with other guests i did hear they were v good. Reservations are required for those. 
The ever smiling and helpful Fernanda Gil was our concierge - she was a delight to deal with. 
The staff at the resort are very friendly, and are excellent hosts. 

I'd definitely recommend this property.

reviews.author: Othmar O
reviews.title: Urlaub
reviews.text:
Wir haben einen super Urlaub erlebt.
Die Betreuung durch unsern Butler
Yohelvi war sehr sehr gut. Alle Sorgen hat er erkannt und bestens organisiert.
Er hat mir den Zahnarzt organisiert der mir am Sonntag die Schmerzen behoben hat.
Yohelvi ist sehr kompetent mit viel Erfahrung.
Aufenthalt im Hotel war spitze. Restaurants überwiegend gut. Das Beste war das Passion mit einem überragenden Menü.
Poolanlagen sind sehr gepflegt.
Betreuung im Royal Service war sehr zufriedenstellend. Die Liegen am Strand waren immer reserviert.

Verbesserungen würde ich mir beim Wein wünschen. Dieser hat erheblich gegenüber früher nachgelassen.

Hotel ist sehr zu empfehlen!

reviews.author: Sabine O
reviews.title: Urlaub
reviews.text: Super Betreuung durch Butler yohelvi - Hotel, Strand und Meer waren perfekt! Golfplatz in der Hotelanlage - sehr zu empfehlen! Sternelokal "Passion" war ein Highlight - super Service und tolles 7-Gängemenü!

reviews.author: jgt7448
reviews.title: Girls Getaway!!!
reviews.text:
Just returned from my 3rd trip to the Paradisus Palma Real.  I am a Club Melia member and took this trip with four other girlfriends.  
Our experience was phenomenal from start to finish!  
Now, I would say that we are all quite well travelled, but all people value different things.
This resort is well designed, spacious, well-appointed, and well-cared for....each day groups were out working to keep up the resort.
We had a Two Bedroom Lock off and it was just as I expected.  This was my first time back since the new construction at Naos/Gabi Beach/new Reserve Ocean front rooms.  I loved the improvements.  My guests were clear to say they felt the buffet was the best they had ever experienced!  
I must shout out to all who made each day fun:  Gabriel Dalusma took good care of us, and did check in during out stay.  He readily helped us get laundry detergent, sent Cava and a cheese plate to the room....and had we needed more would have done it with a smile.  I knew all we had to do was ask.
Number One was our quick host at the beach....set us off to a great stay after 5 minutes at the beach!  The staff at Gabi Beach bar made wonderful cocktails...and again, were there with a smile.  Leonardo (DiCaprio!!!) at Naos....very friendly, funny guy!  We ADORED our lunches at Fuego....on top of the menu there is a separate menu of just freshly prepared ceviches.  We all LOVED it and could not stop ordering.  Thank you to Ramon Ramos, Mario Diandra, Kelvin...Juan de Azul, and Luis Viante.   Great food and drinks.  
We are at Rare, Bana, and Aqua. 
All were enjoyable, but we did like Aqua the best...as it is simply a bit more upscale.  Now....if you are expecting the BEST steak you have ever had, and the BEST Hibachi you have ever had...this may not be your experience.  But everything was good, fresh, lovely, and well presented, and fun. We did have several fish dishes during out stay that were PHENOMENAL.  
I always enjoy the YHI Spa...my massage with Evelyn was utter relaxation and I do recommend the water circuit.  I came down many notches.
Without a doubt this trip was set apart by the ENTIRE Lifestyle staff.  ALL OF THEM.  Shaky Shaky makes himself known, and we send our love....but please know that they were all a blast...and will always be part of memories of this trip!  The bartenders at The Avenue Bar - THANK YOU!!!!  Thank for these memories.
I think when you travel you do get out what you put in.....everyone at The Paradisus had a smile for me and willingness to make our trip memorable.  And all of it continues to make me (and my husband) very pleased with our club membership.  We have gone to five Melia properties now, all have notable qualities.  But our Home Resort at The Palma Real remains our favorite!!

reviews.title: Excellent stay, so, so on food
reviews.text:
I can't say more about how much we enjoyed the Paradisus Punta Cana, the Reserve, beach access and service. We were always enjoying the staff that covered the bar area, specifically Ramon Ramirez, Emilio Valdez and Benita Mercedez. Not only did they bring us drinks that we ordered but continually brought us water to keep us hydrated! They also entertained us for hours while we sat at the bar with discussions about their lives, their culture and their families. 

I also want to mention the great service we had from our butlers, Junior Segura and Lois Amarante, and also our concierge, Angie Parra.  They all went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect;  always happy and in a good mood!!

The only thing we were disappointed on were the restaurants.  And this is a big part of the experience and all inclusive price.  This is our 10th year staying at a Melia resort and we’ve always had superb food at most of the restaurants but we were not impressed this year at this particular resort.  Fish was fishy, octopus was hard like rubber, etc., not impressed with selections at the buffets either.  The only great restaurant was Vento so stick and stay at that one each night!

Overall, we highly recommend this resort – please work on the food! Thank you and keep up the great work!
