reviews.author: Andrea P
reviews.title: Royal Service and Staff are top notch!
reviews.text:
Wow, what a visit we had!  The Royal Service was a fantastic addition to our trip.  Our butler, Lugo, was fantastic and highly attentive and helpful.  We were there for a wedding and the bride's butler Miguel went above and beyond to help keep her sane. If considering whether or not to go for this service, definitely do it and prepare to feel special - from the mimosas and private check in lounge, to the private restaurant Palazzo (with a wonderful hostess Zenovia!), private pool/lounge areas/bar/smoothie hut and private beach, as well as the wonderful rooms and cell phone that takes you directly to your butler. Note, if you happen to be travelling with others in Royal Service, you can also call them using the phones as well!  Even though I wasn't the bride, I can attest that Maria Queuedo was highly attentive and I appreciated working with her as part of the bridal party.  One particular instance where Lugo was incredibly helpful was when one of our cell phones got wet and he took it from us to put in rice overnight.  The salt water ended up destroying the phone, but he tried his best and it was really appreciated! 

We dined at Aqua, Fuego, Rare, Bana and Palazzo, and enjoyed it all tremendously. The ceviche at Fuego was fantastic. Breakfast at Palazzo - a great start to the day. 

If it's in your budget, consider a service from the spa. We did a couple's oriental fusion massage and really enjoyed the experience. I believe the more traditional massages (located at the spa on the reserve side of the property) also include a water treatment of hot and cold, that other members in our party really enjoyed. 

We participated in a lot of the dancing and I miss it so much. The staff is great about encouraging people to dance with them - and you'll feel like an amazing dancer when led by these guys! We also took a bachata dance class that was so much fun. The night life entertainment from the Michael Jackson show to Latin night and general dancing was a blast. 

We don't tend to go for beach or tropical experiences, but this could really tip the scales for us.  I highly recommend this property!

reviews.author: biancahATX
reviews.title: Epic Wedding Week @ Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
My (now) husband & I narrowed down our destination wedding to the Paradisus Palma Real at the recommendation of a family friend in the hotel business. We are so glad we listened because we couldn't be happier with our decision. (BTW - neither of us had ever visited the DR and planned everything by email with less then 5 phone calls). Writing this review one year after our visit because we are still so happy and continue to hear from our 93 guests who traveled from the US to join us for the week celebration that it was the most fun and beautiful destination and it's going down in the record books.

From the initial wedding package consult with Jina in Florida (via phone/email) to our planning every tiny detail (we are very picky) with our wedding planning coordinator Laura Santana also by email & phone to finally arriving at the destination and greeted by our primary onsite wedding coordinator Raquel and helpers Claribel & Natalia we were absolutely blown away by the friendliness, genuine care, efficiency and professionalism of checking into our room to our only onsite wedding meeting to our "white party" to helping charter a yacht (surprisingly affordable) for our guests for a day excursion to the actual wedding day ceremony/reception to our last day and check out. The only bad part of our stay was having to say goodbye to the all the staff that we felt was like our family by the time our stay had ended.

Our room was in the adults only section of the hotel with the Royal Service Butler upgrade which I highly recommend!!! Ariel, our butler, was on point the entire time and had been blessed with booking reservations at one of the many restaurants at the resort on the nights we didn't have an event planned for the bridal party and family our entire stay (We had quite a large group every evening and I am sure he had to have felt a bit of stress but he never showed it. Poor guy - we run him ragged) Additionally Ariel reserved us a cabana on the beach every morning and went over that days schedule making sure we knew where and what time we had to be ready for something we had planned. This was great because it allowed us to relax and not worry about having to remember anything. Ariel also surprised us during the day and at night when we came back from dinner - he would leave us little surprises in our room - champagne, fresh fruit, scented pillows, chocolates, bubble baths with rose petals - all the most romantic stuff! After our wedding week/day - Ariel's vacation days came up and we were happy to meet, our final butler who finished out our stay and continued to leave surprises in our room similiar to Ariel.

So the FOOD - AMAZING - our first night we ate at PALAZZO - mouth watering and romantic, our server was Alessandro and he really should be upgraded to a butler because he was perfection. (My husband & I go out to eat A LOT -it's our fave thing - always trying the newest latest place that pops up in Austin, and when we travel we make a point to pick the hottest restaurant of that city - be it Morimoto's in NYC or Umi Sake House in Seattle for example). We also went to RARE two nights - my husband got the Tomahawk steak both nights - WORTH IT watching him try to finish it by himself. We also got to meet Christian, the sommelier of the resort. Did I mention my husband and I LOVE CHAMPAGNE! The selection of wine, champagne during our entire stay was phenomenal - it's not part of the inclusive package but since the whole stay was a great deal it really was the only time we shelled out extra dough - and gladly done! The only sad part was that we found out that the resort was opening up a wine bar the day after we were scheduled to leave - but Christian walked us through it and his knowledge of spirits continued to shine through his beaming smile as he showed us several vintage bottles he had curated. He even let us sign and date our champagne cork to drop in the glass bucket - which I'm sure has been filled by now. Sergio, Wander & Rodney were all part of the excellent staff that helped as well. In between meals/waiting to be sat at either Rare or the restaurant opposite it there is a secret bar where you can find Miguel the bartender who doubles as a magician - No joke - our whole wedding party was wowed by him through the stay. During the day we ate at Naos - the beach buffet - excellent selections and very convenient!! The Our final two nights at the resort once our guests departed we found ourselves at Passion and I couldn't say more wonderful things about this restaurant- it continues to be one of the top meals of all time for both my husband and I - the service was over 100% perfect and every mouthwatering morsel of heaven was gobbled up. Each course was better then the last - even the butter for the hot baked bread is still remembered to this day. The only reason we didn't eat at Fuego was because we had limited nights and it's who hosted our wedding reception party!!..

Included with our wedding package was a "white party" which doubled as a meet and greet and welcome to our guests. Originally it was planned to be on the beach but the day of we were urged to relocate to an indoor location as a rain storm was expected and all our food would have been destroyed. (We could have cared less about getting wet although all our guest were dressed in white.) Anyway we are sure glad Raquel knew her stuff because sure enough a torrential downpour took place during our entire party - our beach party was recreated inside and we had a blast. 

Day of wedding: EVERY SINGLE DETAIL WAS PERFECT. WAS COMPLETELY STRESS FREE. The wedding staff at Paradisus are experts in making sure everything was flawless!! Couldn't say enough good things about Raquel, Claribel and Natalia. So one thing not planned for - right before the bridal party was about to walk out to the beach ceremony it started raining!! Anyway we were lucky enough that it stopped for a brief time for us to have our ceremony the party later at the Fuego which we also utilized the beach space around for an LED dance floor to boogey down in the drizzle. All the food was amazing. Our DJ was given a list of songs by us and was great about spontaneous requests as long as we could find on you tube. We also had packed special surprises and a second line dance that was planned for our guests and was a huge hit during the "crazy hour".  Our photographers Juan Carlos & Rodrigo were fantasic. Our photos (the thing I cared about the most) were breathtaking!! Anyway I should prob write a separate review for just the wedding day because so much awesomeness happened.

Strongly recommend Paradisus Palma Real whether its for a short vacation or the place to host your destination wedding!!

reviews.author: LaurLaur29
reviews.title: Unsatisfied traveler
reviews.text:
Let start by saying I was there for a wedding and it was absolutely perfect. The Bridal Attendant (Raquel?) and her team were on point and helped in making my best friend's wedding an unforgettable day!
The resort itself is beautiful but it is very big. Easy to get lost and pack your walking shoes... There are golf carts to bring to you the main part of the hotel but it isn't always easy to find one. So don't worry about the all you can eat & drink because unless you will get your steps in if you are on staying close to the main pool. 

The main reason I am giving this hotel a poor rating is because I had a terrible experience with the front desk and it is unfortunate because up until this point I was enjoying my vacation. In fact up until this point I would have given it a rating of Very Good. 
I was sharing the room with a friend but she was checking out a day earlier than I was. Upon her checking out, they told her that I needed to leave as well. Luckily I was in my room when they called me. I went to the front desk with all of my paperwork stating that I had the room until the following day. They told me I had to check out of that room & into another room, that was on a different part of the resort. They said it was a separate reservation. I asked if my room was going to another guest checking in that day. They said maybe but they were not sure. I asked if I could just stay in my room for the last night. I was told no.. I asked why I wasn't told when I was checking in that I would have to change rooms. There was no answer or explanation given. Just a shrug of the shoulders. It was now almost 11am and I had until noon to go back to my room, pack everything up, return to the front desk to check out. And then check in for the new rooms wasn't until 3pm. I also had an 11:00 massage appointment that I needed to cancel due to this mess. There was zero help from the front desk and by the time I did everything I had to do, more than half of my last day was wasted. I was so stressed out & full of anxiety that I was actually crying when I finally got to my new room. What started out as an amazing trip ended as a terrible experience and for that reason I don't know if I would return to this resort. Left a very bad taste in my mouth.
Also, just a note - use the in room safe for everything, not just money. A pair of Ray Ban's went walking. My fault because I didn't think I had to lock up my sunglasses, but just a warning to the next traveler. Lesson learned.

reviews.author: Catherine L
reviews.title: hotel paradisiaque
reviews.text: nous sommes partis 10 nuits en novembre 2016 . Nous avons passé 2 nuits au paradisus punta cana service royal . Malheureusement cet hôtel à été vite inondé par les pluies diluviennes et les routes impraticables à l intérieur. Il fallait prendre un camion pour se rendre au lobby. La télé, la wifi étaient en panne . Après discussion, nous avons été transféré au paradisiaque palma réal service royal et enfin au sec. Nous avons préféré la chambre de ce dernier, plus romantique et avec baignoire balneo. Cet hôtel est majestueux . Le service royal est à conseiller, piscine, plage, spa,  restaurant privatisés. Tout était calme et divin. Merci à notre majordome Fermin, qui s occupait de nos réservations et avait de l attention à notre égard. Ça peut être prétentieux mais ça fait du bien d être Vip et de se sentir considéré. Nos restaurants préférés étaient le palazzo et le fuego dignes de très bons restaurants en France.  Les excursions  sur l île de de Catalina et le réel explorer sont géniales.Merci à Melia de nous avoir permis de changer d hotel et d avoir passé des vacances inoubliables malgré une météo pluvieuse au départ  . Un conseil pour les français, prenez des dollars en France car les comissions du taux de change sont excessives.  Tout est payable en dollars et n oubliez pas les petits pourboires pour le personnel, vous serez plus vite servis et choyés,

reviews.author: Bozenka
reviews.title: Perfect hotel with few areas for improvement
reviews.text: My friend and I just came back from 5 days beach gateway. We had amazing time! Hotel has great beautiful well maintained grounds, clean, nice beach (although there were few rainy days before we came so there was a lot of sewage on the beach) but the ocean was clean and warm. Food was the best in the buffets although after a while you get tired of the same food but I am guessing this is the case for all of the resorts. The staff was extremely friendly and actually that was what really made our vacation special. But there were few items that I want to mention that need some improvement. The check in was kind of long, we had to wait for our room for over 2 hours but we were granted late check out for this lost time. The rooms are nice, but have some dated feel. I think soon it will be time to make some renovations. We wanted to get the massages but the prices are way too much - one hour signature massage is $165, in Manhattan I can easily find for more than half of this price. The Mexican restaurant, please skip this one! After seeing the appetizers, we just got up and leave, it was horrible! Rare restaurant was the best in my opinion. Also, we ordered breakfast to the room and it is wasn't so good. The quality of their food it is not really of the standard of 5 star hotel. I also wish that they would have more activities and there would be more advertised..If you are into yoga, we went for one class in their spa, amazing breathtaking scenery, really recommend! Shortly, the property i great, people that work there are super nice,  and if you are looking for a good time, this is the place to be!

reviews.author: Jossie L

reviews.author: Bill L
reviews.title: Even better than before
reviews.text:
we recently returned from Paradisus Palma Real in the Dominican Republic.  This is an annual trip for us and it continues to get better and better every time.    We stayed in the world service's which is amazing.   The Royal Services managed by young lady named Gabriella.  Along with her assistant Victoria you could not ask for a better team.  Our butler's name with Jerry he was also the butler for the 6 friends that went with it.   Everyday we spoke about him and the way he made sure we were taken care of like only the Royal Services can take care of people at paradisus Palma Real.   
We had an opportunity to speak to Conrad the director of hotels at paradisus in the Dominican Republic.   We could not say enough about his staff headed up by Sandra the hotel manager.  As I said earlier we go every year Sandra knew exactly what we wanted where we wanted to stay and make sure everything was done first class.   Throughout the eight days we were there she would always contact us to see if there was anything else we needed and of course the answer was always no because they had it done perfectly.   
This year was kind of special we took friends from Chicago and with the Cubs being in the World Series they made sure there were several TVs turned on everywhere watching the game.   Not only did they have the games on but they make sure there are plenty of snacks and enough attendance to make sure if you wanted to drink you never had to wait.   As for the restaurants Juan de Dios seems like he was at every one to greet us by name which really makes you feel comfortable.   This year they opened a new wine room which was amazing.  Make sure when you go there you eat it rare it is a steakhouse but the main thing is that the bar you can be entertained by a magician who we have seen several years in a row and continues to do things that we cannot follow him with our eyes.  
We will be making sure that we go back again in October of 2017 looking forward to more changes but then again I don't know how you can improve on perfection.   I cannot emphasize enough if you are looking for a place to go with friends or just with you and your loved ones go to paradisus Palma Real in the Dominican Republic I promise you you will continue to return as we do

reviews.author: sorrenta205
reviews.title: Recomendado!!
reviews.text:
Desde el momento en que uno es recibido en este hermoso resort, nota la calidez, familiaridad y hospitalidad de todos los que ahí trabajan. Fuí recibida casi de inmediato por Estrella García, de Guest Services, quién con mucha alegría me presentó los alrededores y diferentes áreas del resort. Además, me acompañó hasta mi habitación y se puso a mi disposición para cualquier cosa que necesitara. Cabe destacar que durante toda nuestra estadía, Estrella ayudó a resolver cualquier problema, desde reservaciones a los restaurantes, separación de tours, hasta cualquier pequeño detalle o duda. Siempre disponible para facilitar el que estuviéramos cómodas. Les recomiendo que pregunten por ella cuando visiten el resort, pues recibirán un servicio de primera. De esa misma área, fuimos atendidas en varias ocasiones por Carolina, quien fue muy servicial y paciente a la hora de reservar y luego cancelar una visita a la discoteca Coco Bongo, por ejemplo. Fue muy amable y hasta nos regaló una rosa. Muy bonito gesto. 
       Como íbamos a estar varios días en Punta Cana, decidimos realizar varios "tours" para conocer más lugares. Allí, en el mismo resort, de la compañía Blue, nos atendió excelentemente y con mucho profesionalismo, Iván. No solo tuvo la paciencia para explicarnos en detalle cada excursión, sino que lo hizo con muy buena disposición y ánimo. Nos ayudó también en otros detalles adicionales, por los cuales le estaremos siempre muy agradecidas. Recomiendo especialmente el tour a Santo Domingo, la capital. Y si les toca de guía el gran Johnny, pues lo van a pasar muy bien. Es excelente y más. También hay excursiones que incluyen experiencias con delfines, donde se ven lobos marinos, aves exóticas, etc. Muy recomendada también. 
        Les invito a visitar el restaurante Fuego en el mismo complejo. La atención y los platos son exquisitos, con especialidad en comida peruana.  Hacen un salmón espectacular y un "suspiro limeño" muy rico. Desde que entramos, nos recibieron muy bien y con enorme cortesía. Todos muy amables. Destaco a Richard, quién nos atendió como reinas y a Kelvin (que también está en "The Winery"), que nos habló sobre los vinos. 
         En algunas áreas y pasillos del resort, se disfruta de una ambientación con una fragancia muy agradable gracias a palitos de incienso estratégicamente colocados... Quedamos tan encantadas, que decidimos comprarlos para llevarnos unos cuantos. Los compramos en la tiendita del Spa,  hacia donde fuimos dirigidas y atendidas por Ruth Tejada. Jovial y con mucha amabilidad, nos presentó varias opciones de fragancias, lo que nos facilitó la selección. 
        Todo el personal de "Room Services", especialmente José y Alexis, nos ofrecieron un gran servicio. Y nos llamó la atención la jovialidad de Alejandrina Feliz, quién se encargaba de parte de la limpieza de la habitación. Muy amable también. 
       En general, recomiendo, sin lugar a dudas, la estadía en este resort "All Inclusive". Se sentirán acogidos, muy bien tratados y relajados, que es lo que se pretende. En un ambiente visualmente especial, con playas majestuosas de arena blanca, piscinas preciosas y rodeados de seres que tienen como finalidad el garantizar el disfrute de un tiempo de vacaciones inolvidable en una tierra innegablemente hospitalaria.

reviews.author: jenkanlin
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation!  Excellent all-inclusive resort and service!
reviews.text:
Just came back from this wonderful resort that has lots to do and eat with a variety of activities and restaurants to choose from.

Special people to thank you for their excellent and friendly service to ensure we all had a good time are:

Angel, Shaky Shaky, Caramello, Gasolina, Looky Looky, Dee Dee, Shorty, Shanty and Miguel - for their boundless energy and joy in their daily dance and aero dance classes.  They kept everyone informed and welcomed all to join in!  They kept us entertained and busy on those rainy days.

Gustavo Vasquez and other Naos staff - for their daily food service in getting our drinks and clearing used plates.  Also for giving me the cup of coffee to go each morning!

Obeidi Rodriguez, Raoul and other beach staff - for finding dry lounge chairs, putting clean towels on them and getting our drinks with an ice bucket.

Rodny, Marcos, Junior, Yelitza and Domingo - for their fast, attentive and courteous service at Passion restaurant.

Andres - for his very attentive service at Rare restaurant constantly letting us know the status of our food.

Ricardo Alcantara - for the smiles and making sure you have a clean towel and water at the Health Club.

Juan Carlos, Andy and Carlos - for rallying with me and their drills on the tennis courts.  It was too bad that the other resort activities clashed with their classes!

Muay Thai instructors - for their patience and instruction to us who have never tried this before.  It was really tiring but extremely interesting and fun!

Room attendants and security personnel - for following their protocol when finding an unlocked safe in the room.  Attendant called security who locked safe then opened when you were there to check contents.  A very big thank you to them because everything was okay!  Thank you to that nice elderly lady that came to turn down our beds!

Gabriel Dalusma - for being our butler to help us check in and out.  Thanks for all the nice surprises - bottles of wine and preparing the Jacuzzis with fresh rose petals!

This was my second time at the resort and it was as great as it was the first time!

reviews.author: Jen C
reviews.title: Another great vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
This is my third stay at the Palma Real with my friends.  We had a 2 bedroom suite which was way too big for three.  Rooms were cleaned daily, we had the sweetest elderly woman who turned down the beds and our butler Gabriel Dalusma was fantastic.  He surprised us one night with a bottle of wine, and the night before we left he surprised us again with chocolate covered strawberries, and a drawn bubble bath with rose petals around the tub.  It was a beautiful sight!!!
The entertainment crew, Shaky Shaky, Caramello, Angel, Gasolina, Looky Looky, Dee Dee, Shanty, Miguel, Shorty, and Leo Boy was outstanding as usual. They got us involved with daily activities and reminded us of the daily shows which I have to admit wasn't quite bad.  I especially liked the Dominican Show, Michael Jackson and Tribute to Queen. The entertainment crew also did one hell of a job keeping us entertained even  on those rainy days. They found a dry area and had dance and zumba classes which was quite a workout. But the hardest workout came from the two guys who gave us a muay thai (thai boxing) lesson on the beach. The lesson was not 25 mins long as was told but rather 40 mins long. If I was 20 years younger I may consider taking it up. It was a hard but good workout.  My thighs  burned for 3 days.
Restaurants were all good, except Olio, Italian restaurant that served pizza and pasta. Service at the restaurants were all excellent, the staff were all willing to please the guests.  The staff at Naos were friendly and very attentive, especially Gustavo Vasquez and Leornado.  Andres from Rare restaurant must be the happiest man I have ever seen.  He always had a smile, he was very attentive, and he gave us a minute by minute update on when the food was coming out, even though he running all over the place. Rodny, Marcos, Junior, Yelitzal and Domingo (sommelier) at Passion were great. The guys at the beach especially Obeidy Rodriguez and Raoul always made sure we received dry cushions for the lounge chairs and they kept us cool by constantly supplying us with an ice bucket and cool drinks.

But the biggest surprise happened on our 2nd day at the resort when the cleaning staff found my friend's safe opened.  It appears that the resort's protocol is to contact management and security. The staff member who discovers the opened safe, management and security stays in the room until they reach you.  If you cannot be reached, they reset the safe until you contact them and the safe is then reopened with security present and management to make sure that nothing is missing.  I for one never thought about security in the resort, but after this occurrence it made my friends and I think more highly about the security and the personnel at the resort.

Paradisus Palma Real is one of the best all inclusive resorts and I always enjoy my stay there.

reviews.title: The best of Punta Cana
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful property with large, airy rooms.  Very spread out so choose your location based on what you will do the most!  Lots of food choices, with a buffet for every fancy.  The steakhouse Rare was excellent and the Italian choice has really good fresh pasta and pizzas.
The staff is friendly and available.  Bars serve really good drinks and don't skimp on the booze.  Wanda at Royal Service pool bar quickly became our favorite bartender.  
If you are looking to relax and soak up the sun, this is a great place.  If you are looking for lots of nightlife, I didn't see it.

The food is delicious, hotels are clean and the staff is very professional and go out of their way to make you feel like royalty.  Luis and Hidalgo are the best butlers we wish we had staff like them on our team at home. reviews.text: The grounds on this property are beautiful. I went for a wedding that was being held on the property. Habría que exigir a determinados clientes un mínimo de etiqueta o educación en el uso y abuso de las mismas.

reviews.author: Laura W
reviews.title: Exceeding expectations for our wedding group!!
reviews.text:
All I can say is WOW. We came to Punta Cana to get married and choose this property for us and our 60 guests. Noelia was an absolute dream helping me prior to arriving. From the moment we got on property we were blown away. I use to have negative feelings about all inclusive, but with 60 guest it just made sense. The Paradisus immediately changed by view and I will be coming back. The grounds, rooms, SERVICE, and beaches were impeccable. When choosing between resorts there was about a $40 swing depending on resort, but for just a bit more you entire vacation experience changes. We stayed a total of 8 nights. 

Property: The property is beautiful and very well kept. My (now) husband and I love to travel and were nervous this would not hold a candle to Greece or Italy, however we were wrong. The grounds are lush and spacious. The pool was fantastic and the beach was stunning. Fine white sand and that clear blue Caribbean you are expecting.

Service was hands down the best I have ever experienced. I think this made our entire experience. It was above and beyond any five star hotel that we have stayed before, we felt like friends and family. Everyone had a smile but above all, the staff thoroughly seemed to enjoy what they do. Our "butler" (I say that loosely, more like our friend) Miguel went above and beyond on every detail of our stay. Even our guests got excited when he would find our group at the pool to check on us. The morning of the wedding he made sure we had food, champagne and everything we needed to get ready. He even stopped by midway to make sure there was nothing more we needed. After deep sea fishing, he coordinated with the chef to cook the Mahi that was caught for our last night. We would come back to this property solely to see Miguel again!

Also shout out to Gustavo, Luis and everyone at the pool bar. Antonio at the lobby bar. Julio at the buffet and Fernando and the guys at the Royal Services Pool bar. To name a few, the staff always made us feel so at home, going above and beyond.

Rooms: A dream. We started in the Royal Services Ocean Front Suite. It was gorgeous. The decor has been updated from the photos online. The views were amazing, waking up to beautiful sunrises. We were then upgraded to the presidential suite for the rest of our 8 night stay. Words cant even describe how fantastic that suite is. Forever grateful to whoever made that happen for us! Our guests all stayed in the Jr Garden Suites and were extremely impressed with how spacious and great the rooms were. 

Food: This is where I was really surprised. The buffet was actually really good. Always hot, great selection and flavorful. Restaurants were delicious as well. With 60 guests we spent most of our meals at the buffet and I was not upset about that. 

Overall, this experience helped make our wedding week the best week of our lives. Our guests couldn't stop commenting on the service and how great the property was. We were treated impeccably, and we didn't even get married on resort. We will definitely be celebrating many anniversaries back at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Camila L
reviews.title: Vacaciones con amigas
reviews.text:
Fuimos un grupo de 7 amigas a la parte The Reserve del hotel, que tiene como beneficios piscina exclusiva, camas en la playa con servicio de bar con mozo y 2 restaurante más a la carta. La verdad es que no se si vale la pena pagar el doble por esas cosas, lo que si marca la diferencia son las piezas que vienen con comedor living y jacuzzi. 
La piscina normal tiene la ventaja de tener papas fritas ,hamburgesas y fruta que pueden ser llevado a las mesas y reposerss, que a diferencia de la piscina the reserve solo se puede comer en un área asignada y hay que esperar que te cocinen lo solicitado. 
Segundo el buffet en the reserve realmente es más malo que para el general, tiene poca variedad y moscas

Hay que destacar a Josué Camilo el Barman de la playa y sus dos acompañantes que llevan los tragos a la repostera que no me acuerdo sus nombre por su alegría , buena disposicion, y atención de calidad

reviews.author: sgtpricek11
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
I recently vacationed with my friend at the Paradisus Palma Real. The best way to describe my trip is "amazing!" Our butler, Jeuri, was an absolute gem! He made dinner reservations for us every night and helped us reserve our massages as well. He called us every day to make sure we had what we needed and even left us a couple surprises in our room. He went above and beyond and made our trip fun and rememberable. 

The resort itself is beautiful and they have so many fun activities. We were able to paint a picture (finger painting) and watched several shows (Michael Jackson and a circus to name a few.) The night life was amazing and the entertainment staff were extremely lively and friendly. The staff (Diana, Didi, Chanty, Coco Loco, Luky Luky, Caramelo and Gasolina) were so much fun to be around and they are all fantastic dancers!! They made sure everyone was having a great time.

If you are thinking of staying at the Paradisus Palma Real, do so quickly! It is an amazing resort with so many things to see and do. I plan on returning for another vacation as soon as possible!

reviews.author: Aubrey O
reviews.title: Wedding & 10 day stay in Royal Service
reviews.text:
My new husband and I recently hosted 56 of our friends and family at Palma Real for our wedding. We had an amazing experience and couldn't have asked for anything more. From pre-wedding planning through the whole 10 day stay, we had top notch service all around. This is long but if you're considering a vacation OR wedding at Palma Real, I hope it's worth your time to read.

Romance team: Raquel and Claribel in the romance department were absolutely wonderful. We took advantage of the love at first sight package to check out the resort and all it had to offer. I highly recommend doing the LAFS package of you can. We were able to scope out locations, taste the wedding menus and experience the resort as a guest before committing to the resort. They set up dinners at some of the restaurants and they had us meet with he decor and photography company. We chose the Tailor Made package so we could have more flexibility with decor and could include 40 people off the bat. At the beginning of our wedding week, the romance team met with us to review all of our wedding events and options. There were some last minute changes due to weather for our welcome bbq and we were glad we moved it inside as it down poured that night. They seamlessly moved everything for us and there wasn't a worry once we committed to moving the even inside.

Royal Service: Jose Salvador was our butler for Royal Service experience. He is AMAZING and made sure all of our needs were met and exceeded. He even helped my family and some of our friends with dinner reservations. Jose knew what we wanted/needed even before we knew, which was something I'll never forget. He always came to check and make sure we were set for dinners, beach/pool spots, after dinner arrangements (we had him draw baths for us a couple nights). We had Jose during our LAFS visit and from then on, we knew we would be requesting him again for our wedding stay! RS was especially worth it for our wedding stay because Jose took excellent care of us and our guests. Jose even set us up to watch the Vikings game on Sunday so our friends (and also other guests of the resort) could watch on a big screen in the lobby bar - this was AWESOME!

Spa: We loved our spa services from massages to facials to wedding day makeup & hair! Anny Bautista was absolutely phenomenal. Her entire team did such a great job for my bridal updo and makeup and all of my bridesmaids, personal attendants and my mother and mother-in-law. The spas are beautiful, serene, and absolutely breathtaking. Loved all our services!

Bar service: Antonio at the lobby bar was incredible, always greeting us even if we were just walking by the bar. Leonardo Mota at the Sunset bar is also another of our favorites! He was always on top of our orders (also knew what we wanted before we did)! 

Beach/pool service: Pedro who took care of us at the beach and pool on the Royal Service side was absolutely wonderful! He had Bali beds by the pool set aside for us and our guests everyday. He also had beach palapas set aside for us so we could bounce between both the pool and the ocean. Pedro was seriously our go-to guy for everything outdoors at Palma Real. 

Restaurants: Our favorite restaurants had to be Bana and Palazzo. We liked Bana for dinner (it even stays open until 5am under a different name) and would get sushi beforehand! We like Palazzo for breakfast, though the selection wasn't nearly as vast as Naos, because it is quieter and air conditioned. 

The rooms/reservations: We were in an oceanview suite on the Royal Service side of the resort. This was wonderful because we were a little further from the rest of our group but close enough to meet everyone when we wanted. I had a hard time with reservations for some of our group because the hotel imposed a 7 night minimum over the weekend of our wedding. We ended up reserving rooms at the Reserve for the guests that couldn't make it for that long and it turned out just fine. 

Additional Comments: The resort itself is modern and classy. We loved the look and feel of the restaurants, lobbies, walkways, and especially the beach/ocean areas. We loved the service we had at almost every restaurant! Just be careful with the dress codes as depending on who you get at the front of the house, you may be turned away...this was really the only issue we had for ONE night with a friend who lost his luggage and literally only had the clothes on his back. 

Value: For what we paid, both for the wedding and our trip, I would say the overall value of Palma Real was really great! The rooms, the service, the food selection, the activities, really everything exceeded our expectations and all of our guests. 

THANK YOU PALMA REAL FOR THE TRIP & WEDDING OF OUR LIFETIME!!!

reviews.author: donnabrown135
reviews.title: Spa treatment
reviews.text: Rosie Rommus was great at the spa. Very nice spa with nice amenities to include warm and cold pool, outside showers, jacuzzis, sauna and steam room.  The hotel staff were very friendly and beach was beautiful.  Would definitely recommend this hotel and spa to others.

reviews.author: Camila
reviews.title: El mejor hotel que podriamos haber elegido
reviews.text: El hotel es espectacular, realmente uno se siente en el paraiso! Muchas actividades entretenidas, las piezas impecables, las instalaciones eran impresionantes, muy buenos restaurantes. El staff muy atento, todos con una sonrisa siempre, sobre todo los de la playa, drinki' drinki' vamo' a hacerlo! Ramon, Naomi, Raynol muuchas gracias por todo!

reviews.author: miketerri2016
reviews.title: Just What the Doctor Ordered
reviews.text: Super busy mom, wife, daughter, dental hygienist, youth counselor needed this break!  What a lovely resort.  This is the ticket for all those who want a cruise experience with out the ship.  Weather was great, though we know we took a risk with Oct.  Make sure to hit the Bana hibachi grill and the bartender there does the most amazing illusions.  And the Espresso Gelato bar was awesome...as was the main buffet.

reviews.author: Mollyana W
reviews.title: Gorgeous locale, super friendly staff, delicious food
reviews.text: The open air feel of this hotel was fabulous. The gardens, the beach, the swimming areas, the spa, the food, the staff, I just can't say enough good things about the whole experience. Two people in fact stick out in my mind, first our butler José Salvador was beyond amazing. He was attentive, friendly, kind, and professional. He went above and beyond our expectation. Also, a shout out to Leo Boy, who was a great and patient dance partner. He made the dance nights so much fun!

reviews.author: girlsweekend96
reviews.title: Wonderful staff, beautiful beach
reviews.text: We had a girls weekend at the reserve and paid for the concierge level family suite.  Sandra was our concierge and she was wonderful.  She booked our dinner reservations and reserved our cabanas on the beach.  She was pleasant, professional, courteous and accessible and she did a wonderful job. With that said, we realized when we arrived that October is an extremely slow period for the hotel so if I were to do it all again, I don't think I would have paid the higher price for the concierge access.  It's definitely worth it during peak season (November through May we were told), but we didn't need it in October. Initially we were disappointed at how far the reserve is from the beach but we got over that pretty quickly.  It's only a five minute walk and it's a pretty walk.  Plus, the bar and the casino at the reserve are where we spent most of our time so I would definitely opt to stay there again.  There is a section of the beach that is only for those staying at the reserve and it's fantastic.  Ramon was our waiter on the beach and he totally made our day every day.  Fantastic service.  Another standout was the bartender (Jose) at the casino.  He was friendly, polite and fun to hang out at the bar with!  The food on the property leaves a little to be desired.  We wished there was a late night dining option at the reserve other than room service...however..room service was good and fast so it was fine.  We ate a lot of pizza and French fries for fear of branching out and getting sick but we should have lightened up a bit because none of us had any issues.  The food and service at Vento were bad.  It seemed like the food had been cooked for hours and the service is slow.  Aqua was decent, Bana was decent but I did not appreciate the hibachi chef saying "meow" every time he put a piece of meat on the grill.  That's gross.  For that reason, I couldn't bring myself to eat any of the meat...particularly since there are stray cats all over the place.  My only other complaints are that the all inclusive did not include top shelf liquor, the casino needs updating, and the music in the club is bad.  We had a great time at the beach party on our first night there and wished that was something we could do every night (they only do it 2x per week).  Overall we had an awesome weekend and didn't want to leave.  I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Brittany H
reviews.title: Marvelous Monday
reviews.text: Arrived late last night and Spent the the day exploring and enjoying our resort, it is absolutely amazing. Part of our amazing first day is Raynol Tamayo. He started our day with a water aerobics class and checked on us all day long. He even remembered my name and invited me back for a painting class. If this is only one of our days, I feel lucky to be here!

reviews.author: cgtorres2016
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text: Llegamos hace dos días con una amiga, y definitivamente han sido las mejores vacaciones que hemos tenido, al llegr nos hicieron un upgrade, lo que nos permitió quedarnos en "the reserve", es lejos el mejor hotel de punta cana, tiene la mejor playa, las habitaciones son muy buenas, nos han atendido excelente, muy bueno el equipo de entretenimiento, siempre con una sonrisa, todos muy gentiles y serviciales. Espero volver luego!!

reviews.author: Sara A
reviews.title: Wow- Royal Service
reviews.text: We were so lucky to have decided upon the Royal Service option. Our Butler was Jeuri and what a true blessing he was...and still is. He was by far everything we could have imagined and more. Jeuri not only made reservations for us at all of the different restaurants, but he also reserved our massages, excursions, cabana's and spent time answering questions we had about Dominican Republic culture. He called us on a daily basis throughout the day to ensure everything was going great for us. We had special surprises in our room when we returned from the day and we even convinced him to take a picture with us! Not only is he amazing at what he does for the resort, but he is a wonderful person in general. We will miss him and all of the staff at the Palma Real. We made some life long friends there.

reviews.author: Ciro G
reviews.title: Paradisus is truly Paradise
reviews.text:
This was our 4th trip to this magnificent hotel. The food is good. The entertainment staff keeps you having fun.  Hats of to Shaky Shaky, Gasolina, Looky Looky, Shorty, Shanty, Carmelo and Betty Boo. They make you feel welcome and help you to have fun.  
Great Sail Boating, kayaking and paddle boarding.which we did every day  My wife and I were invited to a special Lobster dinner on the beach.  Twice. YUM, Yum. Then to top it off, on the night before departure, the hotel invited everyone to a dinner on the beach. The food was excellenta.... 
Its a great place to go and I'm sure we'll be back again.

CG & DG

reviews.author: awollak
reviews.title: Jose made the trip
reviews.text: Such a great place, especially for a group! You can be together when you want, but very easy to separate yourselves ! Jose Salvador made everything so easy, and thought about everything before we did! He checked early in the day to make dinner reservations and had our beds and drinks ready every morning at the pool! Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: sylviadiaz2016
reviews.title: Mi primer vez..en Punta Cana, Republica Dominicana.
reviews.text: Excelente Servicio por parte de todo el personal desde la recepcion por parte de Tammy, Angie y Joe siempre con una sonrisa y profesionalismo,  HIlario  mas que ejecutar a la perfeccion su puesto como Mayordomo es una persona calida las cual nos hizo sentir como en casa, cada uno de los integrantes del staff mostraron la calidad del servicio que caracteriza a la cadena Melia.

reviews.author: Nikki H
reviews.title: Everything I wanted....and SO MUCH MORE!
reviews.text:
I spent 4 glorious nights at this beautiful resort on a "girls getaway". All I wanted was some sand and sun but I got SO MUCH MORE!. First, let me just say thank you to Mikey-Mikey for being one of the most gracious and hospitable concierge. Many thanks to  Angelica for making all the arrangements (hotel and restaurant reservations). Everything was outstanding!  5 star excellence rating.
I must also say "thank you" to Jose Luis Soto and Alejandro at Link DMC Event Management who provided our transportation to and from the airport to the resort (only $20 US per/person each way). They were true professionals and  "punctual" (very important when operating on 'island time'...trust me I know! :)
Last but certainly not least, THANK YOU to all the concierge staff at The Reserve that took such excellent care of us. Thanks to all the ladies at the Yhi Spa.. and a special that you to my masseuse 'Wendy', for that wonderful massage on the beach. 
Needless to say, I would HIGHLY recommend anyone considering taking a trip to Punta Cana to consider the Paradisus Punta Cana Resort (or any of their hotels in general). You won't be disappointed.

Nicole from New York

reviews.author: Alejandro Sarria
reviews.title: EXCELENTE SERVICIO, TRATO, CORDIALIDAD!
reviews.text: Un excelente servicio de esta propiedad, todo el personal muy preocupado por las necesidades del huésped, quiero felicitar especialmente al equipo: Angie Pana, Hilario Vasquez, Tammy, José (Cocina Rest Gaby-Beach), Yasiere,Joe y Luis. Gracias por hacer una experiencia inolvidable.  MIL GRACIAS!  Atte. Marisol Montes de Oca

reviews.author: Pawan G
reviews.title: Big promises but poor quality all the way
reviews.text:
We booked 10 rooms seeing big promises and big rooms fantastic service good overall experience great ratings but when we landed in hotel our experience was horrible. 1 of our room
Was booked by the son and proper authorization paper were there. Still he was not allowed to check in unless he paid full amount again. After that we went for having tea at Mexican restaurant where we left 1 I phone which was vanished in 10 minutes and nobody was even ready to listen. When wanted to give laundry they did not accept unless 
deposit money or block your card again separately. We booked one bed room master suite. Leaving area which is 60% of total room is complete waste. Pantry is not equipped. All the appliances either taken out or not functional. Sofa is soiled, it's not usable. Furniture is too old. All in all very bad impression of the hotel. Service is pathetic be it room service house keeping or calling a cart. Barring few in front desk and guest relation.

reviews.author: Irma D
reviews.title: La mejor estadia
reviews.text: I really like this hotel. It is very ecofriendly specially  the staff. They are very friendly and helpful. Lovely beaches and pools  love the food.  Luis Florian and Ruber Perez, they are very sweet and helpful. They made this an inolvidable experience!!

reviews.author: Monica P
reviews.title: Girls getaway
reviews.text: After checking the weather before getting on our plane and hearing hurricane Mathew was going to touch down about the same time as we were, we were very apprehensive, we arrived to sunny skies and extreme heat, this is what we came for. A short drive to the resort from the airport and we arrived in Paradisus.  The people, the resort , the food ....all exceptionable !!! We had a lovely, nice and clean and fairly large suite , Jose our butler took very good care of us insuring we had wine and cheese waiting for us everyday after a day at the beach or pool. There were a few definite standouts Marten, Jorge and Wanda provided exceptional service at our pool. Frankin at the Italian restaurant and another young gentleman at the buffet were such attentive and very kind waiters. All in all our experience at Paradisus was A++

reviews.author: Jon S
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Reynold tomayo has been excellent. Has made sure we have been taken care of and always asks if we are doing excellent.  Been great meet him and every one else at this resort. Service excellent and every has waited hand and foot for every one in our party  will definitely be back for sure real soon

reviews.author: Hoochiesmama
reviews.title: Breathtaking View
reviews.text:
When you walk into the lobby to check in, you are amazed at the breathtaking view, and the off coming ocean breeze. Wonderful to know that as soon as they put your trendy coconut bracelet on, you can experience the food and drink that is offered. 
Wait staff is friendly. The grounds are well kempt-with little alcoves and greenery everywhere. 
The little pond even has it's own resident pink flamingos. 
The restuarants are varied.  I was not able to experience them all. The purpose of the visit was a destination wedding. The details were well thought out, and the food and presentation were very pleasing. 
The outdoor Gabi beach bar seemed to close early..granted they were tyring to consolidate and move everyone to the lobby or the disco dance club. 
All in all, the rooms (junior suite) were delicious to look at, and the grounds were pristine. Staff was accomidating-and the food very palatable. 
I would come again.

reviews.author: Dalinaf
reviews.title: At the reserve!
reviews.text:
Ate at Vento tonight. Julio Aponte and Raneilli were the best! Just got here today and can't say enough of these guys, best service ever!!! Can't wait to see what the rest of the week will bring.
Thanks to these two. I will add more as the week goes on.

reviews.author: camillaf45
reviews.title: Algumas coisas não são verdadeiras
reviews.text:
Fiquei hospedada em setembro de 2016, e assim que fechamos nossa hospedagem diretamente com a Melia, recebemos um "Gift" de $1500,00 nele dizia que poderia utrilizar para diversos beneficios, sem nenhum tipo de observção, apenas diz, sujeito a disponibilidade (isso me da a entender se apenas não tiver horário).
Chegando no hotel na hora do check in questionamos se poderíamos utilizar esse gift para alguns itens e para a nossa infelicidade, descobrimos que se trata de um presente falso, pois por exemplo você quer usar o presente no SPA a massagem custa $150,00 você só pode usar $50,00  do GIFT e tem que arcar com $100,00 restantes, um absurdo, questionamos a recepcionista que não seria um presente, já que se você ganha um presente de aniversário você não deve pagar a outra parte do presente. Achamos um absurdo e pedimos explicações mais nada foi resolvido, então não caia, eles divulgarem como se fosse um benefício e na verdade é um pega trouxa. 
O hotel em si é bem confortável, os restaurantes são gostosos, mas fomos mau tratados no restaurante El Fuego por um funcionário que ficou nos olhando e rindo de nós.
No restaurante Aqua pedimos para repetir os pratos, os graçons tiveram que ir perguntar para o chefe se poderíamos repeti (LEMBRANDO QUE É UM HOTEL ALL INCLUSIVE), sem contar que o atendimento desse restaurante é péssimo.

reviews.author: E2239YTsabrinab
reviews.title: Punta Cana Stay
reviews.text: Overall stay was very good. Wish I could have experienced each restaurant. The entertainment was good. Loved the jewelry vendors. Just wish I didn't have to walk so far back and forth to the room. Bye

reviews.author: roshanda l
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: The service was great. The staff was great. The good was delicious and plentiful. Gaby Beach Bar was on point my entire stay. The beach bar has awesome people that takes pride in serving you! Luis, he was the BEST. The entertainment staff was awesome too. Gasolina and Shaky Shaky

reviews.author: Cruz R
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio al huesped de parte de todos los empleados del hotel, en especial quiero reconocer la excelente labor del Sr. Luis Amarante estuvo encargado de nuestras habitaciones. Proximo ano alla estaremos nuevamente. Buenas tardes. 
You are awesome!!!!

reviews.author: LEOOFELIXX
reviews.title: RESORT DE LUXO! Uma experiência Incrível
reviews.text:
Estivemos pela segunda vez em Punta Cana de 3 a 9 de Setembro, a decisão de repetir o destino é simples, compensa muito mais ir para fora do Brasil em um bom sistema all inclusive que ficar por aqui e pagar caríssimo para comer e beber muito bem, sem falar que a praia de Punta Cana é lindíssima! Apesar das algas (típicas do local), ainda sim a praia de bávaro (onde fica o resort) é muito linda.
Eu pesquisei meses antes de decidir em qual resort  ficar, e digo que sou muito exigente e criterioso quando o assunto é viagem, na verdade quando o assunto é o bom uso do meu tão suado dinheiro rs...  E depois de enviar mensagens para diversas pessoas que estiveram no Resort, decidi pelo Paradisus Palma Real, embora, logo após fechar li diversos comentários negativos então veio a preocupação, pois eu decidi o resort por mais 4 pessoas que foram junto.
Ao chegar no Paradisus... UAL, fiquei boquiaberto, lindo, suntuoso, e posso dizer isso com propriedade pois já tive a oportunidade de estar em hotéis tops aqui no Brasil (São Paulo) em Cancun e no ano passado em Punta Cana, esse resort é realmente luxuoso! Especialmente a noite, com a iluminação e cenografia fica tudo muito lindo!

Os quartos são imensos, tem uma decoração mais clássica e colonial, embora não seja muito meu estilo preferido, são lindos e muito aconchegantes, a cama imensa e bem confortável!

Os restaurantes a la carte são belíssimos, muito bem decorados, comidas deliciosas e pratos bem apresentados, embora o restaurante buffet sempre tivesse comidas frescas, opções diversas, de massas à comida japonesa, inclusive mexilhões, em alguns dias tinha lagostim, tudo com muita fartura! São diversos restaurantes, se não me engano 6, o restaurante que mais gostamos foi o FUEGO (fique atento a categoria de quarto pois nem todos tem acesso), lindo, um estilho praia chic despojado, com muitas opções de frutos do mar, lá comemos uma lagosta incrível, destaque para o garçom Carlos, sempre muito atencioso e simpático! Se for ao FUEGO procure pelo Carlos. Outro restaurante que merece ser visitado é o PALLAZO, incrível! Belíssima decoração, um atendimento primoroso e muito elegante, a comida maravilhosa, alta gastronomia.

O sistema all inclusive é de muita qualidade, champanhe o tempo todo, inclusive logo pela manhã, boa cerveja, vinhos bons! Comidas de boa qualidade, com bela  apresentação e saborosa, para quem nunca esteve no Caribe, não estranhem os doces não são bons, isso em todo o Caribe rsss... não sei porque mas não é bom.

O entretenimento, que era uma das minhas preocupações, não decepcionou, durante o dia tem atividades esportivas, muita música, finalzinho da tarde tem sempre alguma coisa no GABI BEACH (um bar praticamente pé na areia), teve desfile, banda de rock, banda de música caribenha, DJ... que vai até às 23h de lá as pessoas vão para a balada, que apesar de não se grande, é um luxo,  e som é top!
A única coisa que não gostamos é o teatro, os “espetáculos” são bem fraquinhos, mas isso a gente já sabia, no ano passado os shows no teatro do outro resort também não era bons, mas sinceramente, não faz falta. 

Dois funcionários fizeram toda a diferença em nossa estadia HAPPYBOY e GASOLINA, eles  são foram as pessoas responsáveis pela nossa animação! Sem eles as férias não teriam sido tão boas.

IMPORTANTE: 
Antes de fechar o seu pacote, verifique quais os restaurantes estão inclusos na sua categoria de quarto, no meu caso, o PALLAZO supostamente estava incluso, dias antes eu soube que não, então depois de muita negociação com a CVC eu consegui um jantar neste restaurante e como eu disse acima valeu a pena
Reserve sempre antes os restaurantes, se possível quando chegar
O Wifi não é cobrado a parte e isso é ótimo, a maioria dos resorts cobram e não é barato, então leve isso em consideração quando for comprar preço

DICA
Se for para o Caribe em sistema all inclusive, tente investir um pouco mais para ter uma experiência incrível, faz toda a diferença!

reviews.author: Mary R
reviews.title: Great Vacation!
reviews.text:
Energetic and happy staff.  

Thanks to Shaky Shaky and all the staff for keeping us entertained.

 Resort was clean and tidy.

Staff all fully available to assist at all times. 

Food: Buffets were all organized and had vast amounts of food to choose from. The desserts at "Rare" and the "Sushi" restaurants could use some improvement.  The tomato bisque at Rare was not worth eating.  I would rather have Amy's Organic Tomato Bisque from a can.   

I hope to be back to visit again real soon.

reviews.author: jazolciak
reviews.title: Fun in the sun with great service
reviews.text:
Excellent service from all the restaurant/bar staff and Life Enrichment Group. They all went above and beyond with being very  friendly, always welcoming, Over the top. Toma's waited on us for breakfast and lunch at the Gabi buffet everyday and as always went above and beyond for our 8 person group. He even made two birthday girls we celebrated on Tuesday and Thursday of our stay feel extra special on their day with beverages and cakes. The bartenders at the swim up pool bar were fabulous, they made awesome cocktails, and they felt more like friends than servers. They are Luis, Leonardo, Gilberto, Jesus, and my favorite Gregory Colon....they all made my days their special and rememberable. Finally, the Life Enrichment Team, AMAZING!!!!
Dahiana Moreno (Shorty shorty), Shakey Shakey (Ay-ya-ay), Looky Looky (si si si) Gasolina (ra ta ta), and Shanti hosted fun activities everyday for everyone to enjoy. All of these wonderful people made my stay their one that I will never forget. Thanks to my BFF husband to plan his wife's birthday at Punta Cana for a great vacation/celebration one we will all talk about forever...bringing old and new friends together.

reviews.author: RRJackson
reviews.title: Great location for couples or girls trip
reviews.text: There were 8 women on this, our annual girls trip, with widely varying standards and expectations.  This resort met or exceeded all expectations.  For the price, it was a great value.  We could not have ate and drank and stayed so reasonably with decent quality food and beverage at a resort that wasn't an all-inclusive.

reviews.author: Eloygm
reviews.title: Hotel was really nice but not our cup of tea!
reviews.text: Overall the hotel was ok and the service was fine. However,  it just did not match the price tag. Nothing for us stood out during our stay and although the staff were really friendly they do need training on how to address guests respectfully. The check-in process was painful and lengthy so not the best experience to walk into.

reviews.author: Duedishar J
reviews.title: One of my favorite places
reviews.text: My experience here last week was over the top.  I took this trip with about 175 other women we had a ball.  I am sure the resort will never be the same. The staff was very accommodating no mater if you just ask were is the banos instead of directing you there they would take you.  I will never forget the experience and I will tell all my friends and family.

reviews.author: Colleen M
reviews.title: Royal Service is the key to exceptional experience!
reviews.text: Royal service is worth the extra money for exclusive pool, butler service and priority seating at dinner.  If you are at the Royal Service pool Wanda Correa will make you laugh and take great care of you.  Argenis Romero was the most courteous and attentive butler!

reviews.author: DevinElle J
reviews.title: 1st visit out the country a BLAST
reviews.text: Definitely a fun time. They know how to party during night life and the staff is very entertaining especially Salvio! Views are stunning and the food delicious especially the buffet. I would love to come back during the busier season if it was this fun during their off time.

reviews.author: btidwell93
reviews.title: The Paradisus was amazing!
reviews.text: I stayed for four days with a friend while our husbands were on a hunting trip.  We were looking for a peaceful and relaxing time.  We definitely found it here!  We felt totally safe and taken care of. The spa was wonderful!  It was such a treat to have our bali beds under our private umbrella on the beach ready for us every morning.  Wanda was so sweet and fun and made amazing drinks for us whenever we wanted them. Jeri, our butler, was the best! He was so helpful, took good care of us, and was so enjoyable to visit with!  The security on the beaches enabled us to not worry about a thing!  Can't wait to go back! Food was o.k., nothing great but other than that, no complaints!

reviews.author: Angelica F
reviews.title: La mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Bueno en lo general emos pasado una vacation inolvidable ,recordamos este hotel 100 porciento la pasamos de maravilla con Luis florian,raynold tamayo,esto chico son una máquina muy buena persona wander road .

reviews.author: atlblack5
reviews.title: DR at its best
reviews.text: First time here and it was great.  The staff was excellent.  Tomas at the Gabi Resturant was always there for us and kept the mimosas coming.   Very clean resort, great staff and beautiful beaches.   Leonardo and Luis at the swim up bar were excellent also.  Plan your trip, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jessica L
reviews.title: Geeat vacation
reviews.text: Thanks raynold tamayo and melvin concepcion. I came to Dominican Republic on a Bachelorette party with 9 girls. Our stay so far is amazing. These two gentleman are the best. Very helpful respectful and would recommend them to anyone traveling to the Dominican Republic Punta Cana and staying at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Amanda F
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Raynol tamayo was nothing but helpful and catered to every need we had. Accommodating a big group is not always easy, but Raynol made it look effortless. All of the staff at Paridisus were always willing to help and assist in any way we needed.

reviews.author: Marjan de Ruiter
reviews.title: GEWELDIG!!!!
reviews.text:
Beste hotel wat er bestaat..... echt super.
Heel de wereld al rond geweest, maar dit nog nooit mee gemaakt, wat een service.
Hollandse directeur kwam nog vragen of wij nog iets nodig hadden en of alles naar wens was...... dit maak je toch nooit mee.
Zeker voor iedereen aan te raden.
Eten , kamer allemaal top.
Personeel super.

reviews.author: Ramiro M
reviews.title: Paradise...
reviews.text:
Been here 3 days of our 5 day trip and can say we are having a great time. The resort is really beautiful. Weather is warm and humid but the ocean breeze definitely helps. Came with a group of friends to celebrate a milestone birthday. The staff is great, everyone is really friendly and accommodating. They are all willing to do whatever to make your stay more comfortable. The rooms are nicely decorated and are cleaned daily. Food is good, buffet opens for breakfast and lunch has a good selection to appease even the pickiest eater. Is the food fantastic?  I don't think so, but what is made fresh to order is definitely better than the other items. The fruit is great, definitely eat the locally grown stuff that you can't get at home. 
The restaurants on site that we have as dinner options are good, Fuego has a limited selection and the portions are small but it's definitely enough. Blue Agave was nothing to write home about. Rare steakhouse was great. But I'm a meat and potatoes kind of guy, so I may be partial to this one. Good portions and very tasty food. Trying the Italian place tonight, Olio. So we'll see. 
Definitely need to give a shout out to the staff who have stood out to us on this trip: Alexis Angomas, the mini bar guy, has been great. Mini bar gets stocked only once a day but he makes sure you have what you need. Super outgoing and accommodating.
Leo the pool bar bartender has been outstanding. He's dealt with all our shenanigans and craziness and has also kept us highly entertained. Good sport and super funny. When he sees us out and about, he comes right up to us and gives us a hug. 
Then you have the dance instructors: Loki Loki, Shaky Shaky, Shorty and Shanty, they are hysterical and super fun! They can teach anyone how to dance and it helps that they have great moves. All have super outgoing personalities and a great demeanor. 
Will update later with the remainder of our trip. This place is definitely a place you should see. The definition of paradise.

reviews.author: trinitygirls
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The property is absolutely breathtaking. The entertainment was awesome. We looked forward to the show each night. Shorty was awesome in the Lion King as Leona and such a nice person. Shaky shaky was just like a family member. Betty Boop at towel spot was extremely nice. Great job Guys. You made our trip more memorable!!!

reviews.author: PaoES
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable!
reviews.text: A inicios de año tuve la oportunidad de viajar a Punta Cana con un grupo de amigos y nos hospedamos aquí. Personalmente, creo que a sido uno de mis mejore viajes. Las instalaciones de lujo, la atención y el servicio de l@s chic@s que trabajan ahí también al 100%. Recuerdo mucho a Niela, Calín y David, quienes hicieron que nuestra estancia sea casi perfecta. Se los recomiendo!! y espero volver pronto! :)

reviews.author: Alberto E
reviews.title: Vacaciones 2015
reviews.text: Una de las mejores experiencias vividas, una perfecta atencion a nuestro grupo de amigos de parte del staff de grupos y convenciones, la estadia super relajante y las instalaciones permiten que uno la pase de maravilla... gracias

reviews.author: Jose_Campos_8
reviews.title: Cumpleaños en el Paraiso
reviews.text: Mis amigos y yo estuvimos en el hotel celebrando 2 de nuestros cumpleaños y decidimos hacer una pequeña fiesta en la playa con cena buffet, rentamos un equipo de música y luces. Puedo decir que fue un cumpleaños diferente y de los mejores que hemos tenido. Niela Eugenio nos ayudo con la planificación de la fiesta, es muy atenta y dedicada. Nuestro capitán Sandy fue excelente!...  El hotel es increíble, la comida y el servicio. Esperamos regresar a fines de año con la familia.

reviews.author: Teneika
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: I spent time at both resorts, Paradisus and The Reserve. I will say the service is impeccable. The pools at the resort were amazing and the service at the bar was excellent. For the Royal Service I had Juan Cruz as my bartender and he made the best drinks and had great jokes. Whatever you wanted or needed he had it. For the bar at the main pool, I only went to Gabriel Castillo because he ensured that our drinks were to our liking. I asked many bartender if they would cut fruit up and make a daiquiri or smoothie style drink and always got a bland "we don't have that fruit" response. I went one day and asked Gabriel in hope of getting this drink and with no hesitation he said he could do it! We had our drinks and loved them, we had him making that drink for other after they seen ours! Truly amazing bartenders and customer service. When Gabriel came to the roya service bar/pool it was never a need to visit the other pool.

reviews.author: Terri D
reviews.title: My 2nd Home
reviews.text: We visited the Reserve again and didn't want to go home.  As always, the food and drinks are great, and the rooms are really spacious. I would however suggest that they clean the furniture, as it is looking a bit worn.  The staff are some of the most friendliest people you will ever meet.  Special thanks to Jose Reinoso, Emilio Valdez, Wander Roq and Antony Cid Octavio, who always went above and beyond!  We will definitely be back again next year.

reviews.author: Juan P
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente hotel en especial actividades!!! La playa y las instalaciones son espectaculares. La atención y servicio de los empleados es estupenda. Wanda es una excelente bar tender y la shorty de actividades es lo máximo en el baile!

reviews.author: machellelenae
reviews.title: Friends wedding
reviews.text: Arrived on a Monday and the hotel was not very busy. Beautiful resort friendly staff, clean rooms, turn down service each night. Our stay was for 7 days and did not have a disappointing day. Swim up bar at pool had great staff!! Juan Gabriel Polanco (pretty eyes) is amazing! He was always smiling and helpful even when helping an elderly family member with a chair that she could get in and out of easily. He didn't hesitate to grab her a chair and help her up and into the chair.  Juan definitely made our friends wedding week amazing! Thanks for the amazing stay it left our large group wanting to go back soon!!

reviews.author: Dolores Ríos
reviews.title: Festejo de cumpleaños
reviews.text:
Dahiana alias chorty, Caramelo.yGasolina.
Se han portado de maravilla y el trato ha sido muy cálido, divertido y sobre todo su atención a sido maravillosa. Por supuesto que regresaría por volver a convivir con ellos ya que hacen de la vacacion un ambiente formidable.
Recomiendo ampliamente este destino.

reviews.author: Dotty P
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Hotel divino, mexe com seus sentidos pq onde vc anda um aroma maravilhoso lhe acompanha, desde a chegada na recepção aos banheiros. ..quero esse cheirinho na minha casa... Comida ótima, bebidas e drinks muito bem feitos. A equipe fantástica, sempre alegres, sorridente e bem dispostos, fazem o possível para lhe atender bem... Queria agradecer ao  Rafi que nos atendeu todas e aos monitores: Gasolina que tem uma energia cotagiante e ao Caramelo que é super simpático.

reviews.author: Tracy W
reviews.title: Amazing service and cocktails at the lobby bar with Antonio and Angelica.❤️❤️❤️❤️
reviews.text:
Antonio has to be one of the most amazing  folks we met while on vacay and this personal touch when making drinks was without a doubt the best part of our day!!!

Antonio's Caipirinhas gave me LIFE!!!  Thx for your kindness and sweet spirit Antonio and Angelica!

These folks deserve a gold star and when you visit this property be sure to visit with them.  Antonio is there daily from 8-4...promise you won't regret it! #you'reWELCOME!

Gracious sweet friend and much ❤️& life to you and your familia

XXXXX
TRACY

reviews.author: 382dianan
reviews.title: excelente hotel
reviews.text: muy buena ubicacion que te permite disfrutar el hotel y pasear por los alrededores, la comida excelente, servicios de primer nivel, todo el personal muy amable y cálido, su playa es preciosa con colores preciosos y de arena blanca, para grupos es una extraordinaria opción ya que cuenta con todas las facilidades que requieran para una visita de trabajo, incentivos o familiares.

reviews.author: Eddyson M
reviews.title: Fin de semana jevi y loka
reviews.text: El hotel muy chevere con una hermosa vista y hermosa playa con la gran ayuda de eduard mendez que gracias a sus atenciones se nos hiso mas facil conocer y perseguir las cosas del hotel muy chevere y lindo el hotel

reviews.author: Lenin K
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text: Es nuestra primera ves en el paradisus palma real. Desde que llegamos fue todo perfecto nos recivieron en el royal service nos presentaron a nuestro mayordomos eduard mendez nos ayudo en todo en el hotel nos encantó la comida del Rare y del tenpayaki. los chicos de la picina y la playa son muy atentos. Eduard siempre estaba cada ves que los llamábamos y su amigo jeury de royal service fue muy amable. En cunclucion el hotel muy limpio y todo muy lindo.

reviews.author: Jose M
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
Raynold Tamayo and Raneli Polanco

My second time in this hotel and definitely glad i cam back. Service is still great and the staff is fantastic, especially Raymond and Ranelly. These two are great and always smiling. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: 488ally
reviews.title: True Paradise
reviews.text: I had the most amazing time at this resort. Everyone was so friendly and happy. The grounds were immaculate and absolutely gorgeous. I think we spent the majority of our vacation in the pool at the swim up bar. We had so much fun meeting new people and the bartender Leandro Sanchez was absolutely the best bartender at the resort. He had such a fun and easy going personality and made sure we were all well taken care of. Naomi and Luis with the activities were a blast as well. The only bummer thing was we had so much fun at the pool we only made it to the beach once which is normally where I like to spend all my time on vacation. The buffet was just fine for breakfast but the dinner buffet was not the best. The little grill outside of the pool was very good for lunch and all of the restaurants were very good for dinner...it was just sometimes difficult to get a reservation. I will definitely be back at this resort, hopefully in the near future.

reviews.author: jamie384
reviews.title: Amazing Resort & people!
reviews.text: I was able to stay at the Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana last week and had an amazing experience. The staff made it so much more memorable! Naomi Campbell (Germainia) & Luis were so entertaining and made the activities all the more fun! Hermes Martinez at the Gabi CLub was a great bartender & Leandro Sanchez rocked the pool bar. We spend a large majority of the week there having Leandro made us the best drinks and provide great entertainment! I cannot wait to visit the Reserve again! Best week ever - I recommend this over and over!

reviews.author: Anabela R
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: Estuve una semana en el paraiso. Este hotel lo tiene todo! La comida es muy buena y variada. Las instalaciones del hotel, bellisimas. La playa, espectacular! pero lo mejor de todo son sus empleados, siempre atentos y amables. En el bar del lobby, Jose se excedio en atenciones y simpatia, sin dejar de nombrar a Popeye, del grupo de animaciin y baile, siempre energico y simpatico, nos puso a bailar todos los dias en el Gaby Beach. Volvere.....

reviews.author: Lyne R
reviews.title: magnifique semaine au Paradisus
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une magnifique semaine au Paradisus. La beauté de ce site
est incroyable. La végétation qui est présente partout où on se promène de toute beauté. La nourriture est excellente, chambre très propre. Nous tenons à remercier Juan Carlos et Franklin pour les délicates attention à notre égard. Que dire du magnifique sourire et service de Louisa oni. C est notre 2ieme voyage au Paradisus et nous recommendons cet hôtel. Lyne et Jean Montréal

reviews.author: Elena D
reviews.title: An excellent hotel where you can have lots of fun
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, and excellent beach and lots of all inclusive restaurants the pools is very large with a very nice bar inside, the rooms are large with a jacuzzi. Since this is an all inclusive hotel most of the restaurants are included along with beer, hard liquor and sodas.

reviews.author: MarcioZanini
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text: O hotel cumpre as expectativas para um resort 5 estrelas com regime all inclusive. Possui um piscinas grandes, sempre limpas, uma boa academia, além de spa e bares espalhados pelo complexo. Os restaurantes servem refeições saborosas e bem preparadas, incluindo o buffet. A maioria dos funcionários é gentil e sempre prestativos com raras excessões, sendo uma delas o funcionário da recepção chamado Fausto Almond que em mais de uma ocasião foi ríspido e de má vontade.

reviews.author: Yeseniaqui28
reviews.title: OLIO en Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Recomiendo el restaurante OLIO en Paradisus Palma Real, muy buena las pastas y salsas. En especial la atención de Antony Maesta  súper amable y preocupado por hacerte sentir como en casa. Mil puntos 

En actividades: busquen a Happy boy, Gasoline, y a Chanty súper alegres siempre preocupándose por mantenerte sintonizado con todas las actividades

reviews.author: JMS228
reviews.title: Bien pour Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Très grand hôtel à Punta Cana. Quasiment pas d'Européens contrairement aux hôtels voisins.
Les plus : la grande chambre, la belle plage avec ses transats et ses parasols, la qualité de la nourriture dans l'ensemble variée et très correcte au buffet + menu dégustation au restaurant gastronomique.
Les moins : c'est pas chic (ambiance parfois un peu trop "cantine", personnes dans la piscine avec boissons alcoolisées ou sur la plage avec poste radio) ; certains restos sans intérêt par rapport au buffet (voire pas bons).

Dans l'ensemble, très bien pour Punta Cana

reviews.author: Jamie K
reviews.title: Fantastic vacatio
reviews.text: This place takes care of everything - A++ service! The grounds are impeccable, and Melvin Concepcion is the number #1 ,Santos Frias, Josue Camilo, Benita Star, Nilcia Cotorreal, Jairo Minier, Luis Santana, Randy Acosta, Ramon Santana, Naomi Jose , Pedro Mota,

reviews.author: nelsonhortareporta
reviews.title: Fue una semana, pero preferimos dos
reviews.text:
Fue por una semana, pero preferíamos 2, sin embargo las obligaciones en esa ciudad no nos dio para mas, pero lo disfrutamos al máximo. 

 Fuimos un grupo de 21 y llegamos a Punta Cana, específicamente Paradisus Reserva, de la compañía hotelera española Meliá, este es el segundo año que tomamos turísticamente ese “Resort”, creemos el mejor en Punta Cana, y ya hacemos planes para el próximo año. 
 Desde que llegas a la recepción, hasta su pastelero Jose Luis Aguilera que tuvo magnifica atenciones con nosotros, y tenemos que mencionar a sus empleados, Juan Carlos Peña, Danilo Castillo, Erika Trinidad, Teuris Pelez Rubio, Gabriela Martínez Acevedo, José Marmol, Yasksmiry Pache, Jhon Santiago, Pedro Amparo, Junior Rosario uno de los barteder mas complaciente y calificado sin menospreciar al Pinareño dominicano, no podemos dejar fuera a Celso Peralta y Ramón el Chef de la piscina y su ayudante Raneli les hacen pasar las mas estupendas vacaciones.

reviews.author: Robin_Nomaaea
reviews.title: Great get away to disconnect!!!
reviews.text: I needed to disconnect and rejuvenate myself and going to Paradisus Palma Real was the perfect getaway!  The food was amazing and the variety was endless.  My favorite part was the butler service!  Sammy made us feel so special and pampered!

reviews.author: Humberto M
reviews.title: Robo de lentes correctivos en habitación. Notificado al momento del Check Out. El check in fue muy lento.
reviews.text: Fueron robados Lentes correctivos dejados en una de las habitaciones de la reserva. Se notificó pero no se recibió colaboración sobre el problema. No se aprecian los beneficios de Melia Rewards a pesar se que poseo el mayor estatus posible. Check in muy tardío. Una de las habitaciones se entregó pasadas las 4:00 pm.

reviews.author: davidmarkb
reviews.title: A great place to stay
reviews.text: The Reserve was a wonderful experience. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Jasson at the front counter helped me with my booking information and was very considerate.
