I do recommend if you booked online and not directly through the property's web site, to obtain confirmation from them also of your stay. The food and service was great. I will go back again and I recommend staying here.

reviews.author: lorisfree02
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text: If you are looking for a beautiful location with the best staff you can hope for as well as great food, visit Paradisus!  It truly is heaven on Earth!  I visited Paradisus for a destination wedding.  From start to finish every detail was addressed, they are systematic, precise in what needs to be done and everything comes out perfectly!  What better backdrop to watching two people in love get married than the beauty of the sand, ocean and magnificent blue skies behind them.  Paradisus is great for friends, family, kids, or romance!  You name it, they can accommodate it!  And most of all, their staff goes above and beyond to make your experience the best it can be!  They truly are the happiest people I've ever met!  Until we meet again my friends!

reviews.author: Aniela M
reviews.title: Best Resort Ever!
reviews.text:
This resort is absolutely breathtaking! From the service, to the food and drinks, as well as the grounds. Everything is immaculate and the people are very friendly! Never had a bad meal or a bad drink! 

Would definitely recommend for families or couples. There is something to do for everyone! Don't forget to make reservations for the a la carte restaurants. But if you forget, the buffet has EVERYTHING you could want.

reviews.author: FabulousatFifty
reviews.title: Amazing Get Away!
reviews.text:
My family and 30 of our closest friends stayed at Paradisus to celebrate a milestone birthday.  We had a wonderful experience.  The hotel is amazing!  It is beautifully decorated the amenities are great.  Our check in was done in an orderly fashion, everyone who greeted us was very welcoming and friendly.  

Amna Fraden - the Convention Service Manager was a star from beginning to end.  She was extremely helpful in the planning of our stay and coordinating the dining for our large group.  She checked in every day to ensure that everything was going as it should.  A definite Plus to your organization.

We were very satisfied with our rooms, the facilities, the restaurant, the spa and the staff.  The only things that need a little improvement is the drinks at the bars are a little light, and the house red wine at the time of our stay was not too good.  Also, the bar service out on the beach needs to be a little more consistent, but once we became familiar with the bartenders and the servers we showed them what we liked, and they were then very helpful and accommodating.

We would definitely recommend Paradisus and would like to visit once again in the future!!

reviews.author: MARIAGA
reviews.title: Fantastico hotel
reviews.text: Para nosotros es nuestra segunda casa. Hotel fantástico con unas instalaciones muy cómodas y bonitas. Habitación muy limpia y amplia, con una cama estupenda. El servicio de mayordomía en royal Service muy cordial y correcto. Todos los empleados del hotel siempre con una sonrisa. En la zona de la playa nuestro amigo Pedro nos recibió con los brazos abiertos como en todas las ocasiones. Gracias Pedro por ser tan buena persona y por supuesto excelente profesional.  Lo recomiendo 100%. Volveremos sin ninguna duda. Familia Dalmau (Gran Canaria)

reviews.author: ladylou5
reviews.title: Birthday celebration Vacation
reviews.text: I am ending my stay here at the Paradisus Palma Real.  I'm here with my friends celebrating a birthday.  This is my first visit here at Palma Real, but my second Melia resort here in Punta Cana. The property is amazingly clean.  The staff is friendly and helpful and truly make you feel your happiness is there pleasure.  The food is amazing at the buffet and the restaurants.  We ate 2 meals at the Hibachi Grill 2 meals at Fuego and the fried fish at the Agave Grill was excellent.  I ate breakfast at the Palazzo restaurant   My hostess Zenovia and the  other staff Hova, Junior, Petronila and Rafael were attentive and professional.  I upgraded to the Royal Service and had a butler Arjenis who was kind and attentive and professional.  I was given a cell phone to contact him and he answered immediately he made my reservations for the restaurants, brought me wine and strawberries, ran bubble bath jacuzzi for me, he sat up my friends b-day celebration in my room and was always available to me.  Arjenis would check on me to see if I had any needs and would make suggestions regarding services available, I took advantage of the pillow service after his suggestion.  When I checked in Carlos told me I am the Queen and I must say I felt special with the treatment I received.   I would suggest if you come to this resort and don't have children with you the upgrade to Royal Services it is well worth your money.  Honorable mentions Francisco at the Royal service pool and beach was extremely helpful and attentive, Orlando is a cheerful and fun bartender and make wonderful drinks and the entertainment crew kept the party rocking nightly kudos to Luis and Johanna Banana. The reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the cart transportation on the property is slow to non existent at times and secondly I made a reservation for a massage  at a booth near the lobby, (which by the way was amazing Kudos to Rebeca) I was not told the location of the massage so I went to the spa across from my room, when I got there I was scheduled for a different spa, which made me 10 minutes late.  I would suggest that if a guest make a reservation that someone call the guest and inform them of location of their services your spa experience should be stress free, but I felt irritated to arrive at one site and be told to go to the lobby and take a transport to another location.  After my massage the spa called for transportation and it took 25 minutes before someone picked us up. I would come back to this resort in a heart beat and plan on returning early next year.

reviews.author: hasiko424
reviews.title: Perfect GetAway & Friendly Saff
reviews.text:
Just got back from my 6 nights of heaven on earth, the rooms are clean and beautiful.
the staff & Service was priceless. My Bartender Juan Batista who was at the Beach Bar when you needed him...and believe me I needed him :) he was very kind, respectful, attentive.. I was working from there a few hours a day and watched him how pleasant he was with everyone. Also have to mention the maid Paula Sanchez with her beautiful personality. I am definitely going back!!!

reviews.author: Papa1967
reviews.title: Bad Hotel Management
reviews.text:
First of all I stayed at the resort with my wife and 9 year old son for a week in August. Myself and my family had a great time we had a master one bedroom garden room, I would highly recommend this room type it was like a one bedroom apartment.
We brought our best friends who are older and he has some health issues. So the problem that occurred for them started within the first hour of getting to there room! There AC didn't  work and there room ran a average of 80-85 degrees in there room! So they called the front desk and the front desk sent maintenance and the maintenance said ok all fixed well that was not the case! The calling and having no Ac went on for 3 Days!! I went with my friend finally and Franklin who is from club Melia ( who by the way was the only person that tried to help my friends) Franklin went in the back of the front desk and went and got the General Manager who came out and sat with us 3 as we explained everything that has occurred and there has been at least 6 maintenance man come into there room and they all have said they fixed it but it's still in the 80's in the room and the maintenance department even said at one time blamed my buddy in saying they must be leaving the balcony door open! So as we explaned to the General Manager ( I believe his name was Domingo) he was writing everything down and said to us I have another room for you but it will not be vacated until 12 and it should be ready by 1 pm! The general manager asked my buddy how can I get a hold of u and that he would personally call him when it ready! So my buddy gave him his cell phone number and the general manager said He would see to it that they got a new room so they can start to enjoy there vacation! So we felt good after we thought someone is going to help and finally move them to a room ! Well let me to tell you this is where the POOR Management happened !! So my buddy and I hung out at the pool that day so when we get the phone call the room is ready we can go move him to a new cool room!!! Needless to say our conversation with the General Manager went no further than as Only as a conversation !!!  We never heard from him again!!!! He Never called my buddy or text him or even got him another room!!!! This is the sad part!!!! So by 4 o'clock this is when my wife had enough!! She went to the front desk with her girlfriend and said could u tell us what is going on with there room ??? The response was we don,t know what your talking about it says by the maintenance department that there Ac is working!! Well my wife asked isn't there any notes from the General Manager about getting a new room?? The front desk worker said NO!!!! Well then my wife lost it!!! They got another manager a lady one( to verify management we talked to the General Manager at 930 am and the ladies talked to the female manager around 415 pm on Sunday July 31st) So the female manager sat with my wife and her girlfriend and my wife laid it all out demanding a new room and to for them to move right then!!  So finally they did get moved and they where able to finally start to enjoy there vacation after not being able to sleep for 3 days because of the room was so hot!! The sad part of this whole story is that my friends who r older and he has a bad heart and has a pacemaker where never contacted by any hotel management !!! There was no follow up or not even a Sorry or even a token of apology from any management!! So because of the lack of customer service by the top of the hotel management I would not recommend this hotel to anyone!! That's really bother some to me because the hotel is beautiful !

reviews.author: Sandy M
reviews.title: Paradisus is just that, paradise.
reviews.text:
Wonderful vacation with the entertainment staff. Shout out a to Shaky Shaky ay ay ay, Leo dancer, and many more.

The wait staff at the Gabi Beach was awesome especially Oscar, Miguel, Jhonny and many more (whose names we didn't remember 😝)

Honestly the hotel is beautiful and peaceful. There are many children but they are never annoying or in the way. The hotel is right on the beach and there are always seats available to use. 

Shout out to Luiz and everyone at Avenue Bar for all the fun times. Definitely a fun place to stay and very clean. Great staff and good music 😝

reviews.author: thecoolgeek
reviews.title: It's a great place if you are feeling like a resort holiday.
reviews.text:
Resort is quite pretty and very clean. A lot of restaurants with different cuisines and relatively good food for an all-inclusive hotel.

Room was a Master Suite which is good size for 2 people. Could have had better closets. WiFi worked well. 

The staff was generally very friendly and upbeat. I particularly liked Gabriela the hostess of the Gabby Club restaurant. She knew our favourite spot and always welcomed us with a smile.

reviews.author: fernanleandryr
reviews.title: Deben renovar los espacios y lograr una mayor proporción entre el precio y la calidad que ofrecen.
reviews.text: He tenido la experiencia de estar en los hoteles Paradisus Punta Cana y Paradisus Palma Real de Meliá Hotels. Este último fue en el que me quedé en mi última estadía el cual es un poco más caro que el primero, pero de una calidad inferior. El Palma Real me dio una habitación que no estaba renovada, con un olor desagradable a humedad. La habitación tiene un aspecto desagradable, oscura, no está a la altura del precio. A pesar de que tenía un upgrade que me habían dado en una visita anterior al Paradisus, tuve que quedarme en esta habitación toda una noche porque nadie fue capaz de tomar la decisión de darme el upgrade inmediatamente, debían esperar a que algún director viniera al otro día (eso no puede ser posible). Ya, de por sí, mudarnos de habitación fue una tragedia, empacar las cosas, volver al check in para el cambio, sobre todo cuando la estadía iba a ser breve. Al llegar a nuestra habitación "renovada", nos damos cuenta que la diferencia era que los muebles oscuros fueron pintados de blanco y que las bolsas plásticas de lavandería fueron cambiadas por bolsas de tela que decían "Royal Service". La verdad lo único interesante de esta habitación era la vista parcial al mar y que era más clara por la pintura blanca en las paredes, pero nada que ver con las habitaciones de otros hoteles que ofrecen tarifas similares. Creo que deben mejorar mucho en cuanto a habitaciones y algunos espacios que no han sido renovados desde que el hotel empezó a operar.

reviews.author: alban
reviews.title: Take me back!!
reviews.text: This resort was exceptional I will be returning next year. They make you feel so welcome very attentive. The rooms are kept very clean room service twice a day. The beach is clean food was great. Made many friends ask for josue the bartender he's amazing . Has many great restaurants to dine in or a main buffet with so many choices .The night life near by is awesome you can walk right into a safe local bar strip . Overall you and your family will love this place there's something for everyone. Definitely beats Palma real by a lot!

reviews.author: Teresa S
reviews.title: Annual Trip with Friends
reviews.text: The grounds were kept so beautiful and the lobbies and bars.  We go to the DR every year with friends and I will say this was the best we have ever stayed at.  The rooms were very spacious and the air condition worked very well.  We will return to this resort in the future.

reviews.author: Ambrosia S
reviews.title: Bana Sushi & Teppanyaki Restaurant
reviews.text:
If you are seeking delicious drinks and meal with ambiance and great service, be sure to stop in at Bana!Whether you are in the mood for a sushi night, tempura, or sitting in for Teppanyaki, consider yourself lucky if you get to have Roberto as your sushi chef or "cocinero." Roberto's lively friendly energy and passion is expressed through his art of cooking and I must say the taste of his tempura shrimp or "Teppanyaki mixto" of steak, shrimp, and chicken kept us coming back for more! It was a great experience and he went or his way to make sure that his tables were happy with his service. 

Other great perks of Bana include: the bar tender service at the front of the restaurant, delicious fried ice cream for dessert "helado frito," and best of all when the hostess Marleny   Is there she is super friendly, helpful, and she is willing to help make sure your dinner reservation is working well for you or when she can adjust it to accommodate you, she will definitely try. Great vibes. 

Dream team at Bana: 
Marleny+Roberto(the waiter)+Roberto the Chef = guaranteed good time.

reviews.author: Fjassadi
reviews.title: Buena atención e infraestructura
reviews.text:
Todo muy bueno. La comida muy rica y mucha variedad. Las playas y las instalaciones son excelentes.
Destaco sobre todo la atención, en particular de Marco Moreno, Juan Feliz y Wilkin Encarnación.
Muy recomendable.
....................

reviews.author: Carrie H
reviews.title: Relaxation
reviews.text: Stayed with a friend in Royal Service which was worth it! Had great service the entire time at the pool and beach! Drinks at the Royal service pool were tasty and always easy to get - we brought our own glasses and she would fill it right on up to the top! Butler service was great for dinner reservations as we had one every night! Music by the Royal service adult only pool was way to mellow.  Not much entertainment going on as it felt more like an upscale couples hotel. Would not stay here again for a friend trip but would come back with my husband for the Royal Service. Bring about $50 in singles for tipping purposes as the staff will appreciate it! Food in buffets were delicious as were the restaurants - no complaints at all...

reviews.author: Anthony T
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana
reviews.text: This was our second visit to Paradisus Palma Real. The first time was fantastic and I can vouch that they have made great improvements since 2011. You will not find a more beautiful beach in the world and the pool at the Palma Real is the best and is located right on the beach. Outstanding food , wonderful accommodations and service above are what you get at Paradisus. I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Joharlen C
reviews.title: Muy buenas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Muy satisfecha

Un exelnte servicio  muy en especial a mi mayordomo Samuel y todo su equipo a educar menees y a jurídica. Nos sentimos muy bien atendidos y estamos muy satisfechos con todo el servicio. Es un exelente hotel en todos los sentidos. La comida, lo bebida y el staff de animación.

reviews.author: FLmom19
reviews.title: Beautiful with problems
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful! Our room was just like the pictures. The pools, bars, restaurants are all wonderful. Here is the but...make sure you have resturant reservations before you arrive. We were told all the restaurants were booked & after speaking with 3 different people finally reservations were given to us. Their is a language barrier if you don't speak Spanish but everyone is very nice & helpful. Make sure you get a towel at the pool early! After a while they run out and forget about getting a new one later in the day. On the positive- the food is delicious. Alcohol that is included is great & nighly activities make this a great family resort.

reviews.author: Andrea L
reviews.title: Raynol Tamayo
reviews.text: Raynol is a great entertainer! He always has a smile and welcomes everyone! He is a great dancer! This is my second time visiting and was so happy to see him! He gets the guests engaged and makes me feel at home when I'm here. I hope to visit again and certainly hope Ray is here!

reviews.author: Sandyof
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Muy bello todo y excelente servicio. Muy tranquilo y el personal es muy respetuoso y agradable. Buenos restaurantes.

Gracias por su atención y buen servicio equipo entero de recepción. Cameros y los demás.

reviews.author: Jeff G
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text:
Just wrapping up trip here this week 
Very mixed of a few things
Communicating with people in DR is a challenge
The resort did an awful job checking us in and overall did not make us feel welcome at their property
The friendliest people were the waiters at the pool and  but most seemed to care less
The chairs at the pool are very uncomfortable and many need to be replaced
The pool is nice but 5 feet deep everywhere which make it tough for some of the kids
I felt the rooms needed a facelift as well
The shower was terrible with poor water pressure
They are constantly trying to sell you excursions which gets annoying

The food was very good overall and the property is very nice
It's not too big like other resorts we have been to
The beach is nice but there is seaweed 

Overall the service at the front desk and concierge is poor, property is nice and food was good
Would definitely not come back here or to DR in general

reviews.author: LaDivaDivina
reviews.title: Most amazing wedding weekend
reviews.text: We were invited to the Paradisus for a wedding in June of 2015 and it was fantastic. We paid for the royal service which means you get a little extra attention and access to private pool area. The rooms were clean and very modern looking. The only thing I didn't like about the room were those weird steps inside the room. If you're not careful you can really take a tumble.  The other weird thing was the light switches in the room. One night I had the worse time trying to figure out which switch controlled what. It was like someone was playing a joke on me.  At any rate those things are minor compared to the beauty of the resort.  The food here is excellent. If you can't find something to get here, you're crazy.  The pools and beach were beautiful. I would definitely go again.

reviews.author: Jrtuned
reviews.title: Very expensive for what you get
reviews.text: I had the misfortune of being put a room that was very far from the main are, it was noisy, broken bathroom and had no wifi access. I asked to be swapped and was told no rooms where available, yet when I went online I could easily book a room that night. Also the words mini bar should not be used when describing the barely there fridge with 2 beers, 2 waters and 2 sodas in it.

reviews.author: lisafK916DH
reviews.title: Girls Trip 2016
reviews.text: The hotel was absolutely amazing. It would have been helpful if the staff spoke English, otherwise everything was beautiful. The dining experience was excellent except for the Blue Agave Mexican restaurant. I don't know how you have a Mexican restaurant that does not have tacos or burritos.

reviews.author: stephensonmk
reviews.title: Great Trip!
reviews.text: We just returned from a 5 night stay at this resort with another couple. I had seen some not-so-great reviews before we left, so I was a little nervous. However, we had a great trip! The resort is pretty and clean and well-maintained. Every staff person that we came in contact with was friendly and helpful. It started with  Betty at the reception desk. She was wonderful! When we checked in our friends' room had a strong odor of varnish. We learned that there were renovations going on in the room directly above theirs. We all thought the odor would dissipate, but it did not. The next morning, they went to Betty and told her the problem and she moved them without question. Some of the frozen drinks (strawberry ones) were not great, but most drinks that we ordered were fine. Luis at the pool bar was awesome! The food was good, especially for an all-inclusive resort of this size. We ate the buffet for breakfast everyday and a lunch and dinner or two. The restaurants we ate at were good, and the service was good. We especially enjoyed the Gabi Beach Bar at night because drinks were served in glasses! Yessie (Yesenia) is a server there and we loved her! We sat on the beach everyday. There is a good amount of seaweed in the water, but the water is beautiful and feels great, so we got over the seaweed. Argenia (sp?) was our favorite beach server! He remembered us everyday! We did not offer money for anything, but we did give appropriate  tips to most servers, etc. We are all friendly people anyway,  but maybe this helped staff remember us.  I would recommend this property to friends and would stay there again if we ever return to Punta Cana!

reviews.author: map20rose
reviews.title: "Beautiful resort and beach, great staff"
reviews.text: 1st time here, very nice room, AC could off been better, but not bad. Our cleaning lady was very accommodating and room service was on point, friendly and efficient staff. Sotero Castillo was super friendly and professional, made sure we got anything we wanted!! The buffet was excellent, so much to  choose from, and the staff super attentive and courteous, Thanks to Tomas, Juan and Antony, you guys were awesome. The pool was really nice, and the beach area was fantastic, too much sea wee but the hotel tried to keep it as clean as possible. Two things that I would off like better was more Spanish music around the resort and Presidente Beer in the rooms instead of Budweiser.  However, in overall, beautiful resort and even more so the people.

reviews.author: Bethany Z
reviews.title: LOVED LOVED LOVED
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely stunning!  The beach is amazing, the resort is amazing, the food is amazing. Nathaniel is the best and we never had an empty drink. I would def go back again and again. Went for a girls trip and it was def a blast! The weather was beautiful the entire time. It truly was paradise.

reviews.author: Laura N
reviews.title: First Timer, Very Impressed!
reviews.text: We went to the Paradisus Palma Real after much research on Trip Advisor and other sites.  It's so hard to choose when you have never been somewhere, but we were very impressed by this resort.  We had the Royal Service, which I would highly recommend if you are traveling without kids.  This gives you access to an adults only pool, restaurant, and beach...so you can choose to go with the activity by the main pool or relax in a more secluded atmosphere.  We had an extraordinary butler, Luis Sanchez, who went out of his way to ensure our needs were met!  He was awesome!  Wanda and Carlos at the Royal Service bar and beach were exceptional too...always singing and having a good time.  It was contagious!  Frances and Luis in the Lobby bar always had a smile and remembered what we liked to drink...the customer service by these 5 special employees will definitely bring us back!  I will say, the hotel is a stickler for reservations at dinner time, so be sure to make them so you can eat where you want (our butler took care of that for us, so we were set!).  The casino is small so don't expect a lot from it but everyone in there was friendly when we walked through.  There were daily activities by the pool,  cool shows each evening, nightly parties by the Gabi Beach and it was a beautifully maintained property!  I am excited to visit again!

reviews.author: Jocelyne J
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text:
My husband and I were joined by 3 other couples - we were total 8 people.  We were celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary.  We stayed for 8 days (7/8 to 7/16/16).  We have been going to the Paradisus for 20 years and have always enjoyed the people.  Specifically, Luis Santana and Ramon Ramirez were the most friendly beach attendants who made our experience at the beach "exceptional".  They had our beach chairs ready for us in the morning and kept us well hydrated through the day with a wide variety of tropical drinks.  Always with a smile.  Thank you both for making a difference!  Gracias!
The reason for low rating on service is because, despite the spectacular service we received at the beach, the other areas were very inconsistent.  The transportation from hotel to beach was frustrating at best.  They didn't have enough "wagons" or "golf carts" taking people around.  The Melia Vacation Club golf carts prefer zooming around by themselves or with other staff members than to offer rides to patrons.  Restaurant reservations were terrible.  I understand a group of 8 is more difficult to accommodate, but they have fewer restaurants to accommodate the guests, therefore I believe that is the issue.  The quality and quantity of food at the restaurants has also diminished over the years.  We had a few nights without reservations where we could only go to the buffet at the Gabi Club and sometimes, there was no food left... until someone started screaming which prompted some food to come out of the kitchen.  Still nothing special.  Go there for the beach and accommodations.  Hopefully the food and services will improve with this type of feedback.

reviews.author: chestnutangel
reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.text: This was truly one of the best vacations I've been on. I travel a lot but something about this vacation was different. I went with a group of 3 families including my own and there was never a dull moment. All the staff is so friendly and welcoming which really helps you relax. The activities they offer are outstanding. These activities include morning stretching, volleyball, cycling in the water, paddle board yoga, Zumba, dance class, painting classes, sushi making class, and many more! The instructors make each activity the best it can be. They are all so talented and can teach you a lot (Coco loco, shakey shakey, caremelo,Luis, Miguel and more) They offer shows every night at 8:30 and dance parties after that make you feel like your in a miami club! The rooms and amenities here are all superb. The pool is amazing along with the beach. Leaving this place was one of the hardest goodbyes in my life. Highly recommend this place over any other!

reviews.author: imone2luv
reviews.title: Amazing resort and staff
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, well maintained, the staff are wonderful and accommodating. Cruz at the front desk has a great personality, upbeat, personable. The onsite restaurants were great. I will definitely return to this property again.

reviews.author: Marcela M
reviews.title: Luxuoso e aconchegante
reviews.text: O Hotel possui excelente instalação, o staff é excelente e falam espanhol, inglês e francês, mas não tivemos problemas para comunicação  em português. A praia em frente ao hotel é bem calma, sua rede de restaurantes é magnífica e ainda oferece diversão garantida à noite.

reviews.author: sarahsue007
reviews.title: Perfect vacation! So relaxing!
reviews.text: This was a beautiful resort on the beach with wonderful customer service, spacious, comfy rooms, and delicious meals/drinks/everything! It's also walking distance to the strip if you're looking for a night on the town. Thanks for an amazing time!

reviews.author: Beth B
reviews.title: Great trip & value
reviews.text: Great place and amazing value.  I was confused from the website about the different hotels. I asked to go Melia and the taxi took us to another hotel (same property) but then they took us to Paradisus in the golf carts.  I suggest upgrading - well worth the money.

reviews.author: The1bp
reviews.title: I'm going Back!
reviews.text: From the moment of Check-In (Senorita Cruz) we were treated like family on the resort. Our rooms weren't quite ready because we arrived early, however Cruz then introduced us to our concierge Senorita Adrianna (gorgeous outside and inside). Adrianna gave us a warm welcome, asked if we were interested in a complete tour of the resort and of course we obliged. Our first stop was the bar near the atrium, she made sure she introduced us to the native drinks that they are popular for and we then toured the many amenities of the resort. By the time we concluded our tour we were ready to eat, I would definitely recommend the Taco bar first. Great beef and chicken tacos made to order, they also fry fresh fish that you give to them while you're in line waiting. I enjoyed every restaurant on site with Rare being my favorite. Be sure to make reservations early on each day for your dinner food. I would also recommend room service in the morning, as I found that the food is better made directly for you than it is at the buffet. Our rooms were very nice and clean, we stayed on the first floor and it was ideal without having to wait on elevators and taking stairs after long days at the pool and beach. Be sure to ask for multiple towels initially(including face towels), the people who clean the rooms do not bring the towels (they come afterwards). The pools are awesome, simply awesome! The cabanas were my favorite, each day we met great people out there. For parents please be sure to not let your children play with the water fountain and spray it at other families or people relaxing, nor let your children be rude to the bartenders. Speaking of bartenders be sure to ask for 'Gustavo' at the main pool. He is a phenomenal guy who works hard and made sure his guests enjoyed themselves, he makes excellent drinks too! I loved everything about my stay and I will definitely be coming back! Thank you Paradisus Palma real for showing myself and my party an amazing time! I can't say it enough, "we will be back and with more people" {Hats off and round of applause}

reviews.author: pamella1
reviews.title: All Inclusive ....NOT!!!
reviews.text: The Good --location, beach, pools.  The Bad -- everything good is extra -- even in the Royal Service which you definitely want if you don't enjoy all the kiddos.  The only place to get premium alcohol without paying $12 for a drink is in the royal service lounge -- where the service is mediocre at best.  Your butler constantly tries to book services that cost extra.  Every bartender, waiter, maid, butler, etc. is only interested in your wallet..not you.  Food at the restaurants is okay...breakfast is the best. For beach side drink service -- better go to the pool bar yourself.  Obviously, "all Inclusive" in this place has a completely different meaning than other resorts we have visited.  We will never return to another Melia/Paradisus property.  There are better choices.

reviews.author: Xonia1
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I had previously stayed at this hotel when they first opened and I always wanted to come back...
The hotel itself is a beautiful property and the staff is wonderful and helpful and the food is amazing, however if you want a peaceful gate away this is not for you... 
In the summer till November they allow kids for free, so you can imagine all the kids running around and screaming and taking over the facilities...
Also music was very loud at the buffet area and I enjoy dancing and listening to music but I think it was a bit much..
So for those reasons only I have to give them two stars...

reviews.author: Renee L
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We felt like royalty the entire trip.  Our butler Luis Sanchez spoiled us to death & we could not have asked for better service from our bartender Wanda Correa.  Carlos Rosario and Jorge Acevedo were also very attentive to our every need, we absolutely loved the staff & will be back next year.  This was our first time in DR and we can't wait to return to this resort. The food was also amazing. Great time in the clubs, bars, beaches... I miss it already!!

reviews.author: IntheSand4Fun
reviews.title: Good Time
reviews.text: The hotel was lovely and my vacation was an all around super experience. There was a different show every night at the resort and always great music or entertainment at Gabi Beach after the show. The hotel guests were also very nice and seem to be having a good time. I would go back  to the Paradisus and bring others with me. The food and the waitstaff at Naos was great. The dance instructors in the resort were good teachers, energetic, and friendly. Thumbs up!

reviews.author: sltabja
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel
reviews.text:
Excelente Hotel. Habitaciones comodas y servicio muy bueno. Restaurantes buenos y sobre todo la atencion del personal, en especial de Juan de Dios quien nos ayudo con las reservas para las cenas en los diferentes restaurantes.
Grupo de 13 amigas!!

reviews.author: aliciahylton
reviews.title: relaxing getaway
reviews.text: The reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was better than expected. The room was spacious, clean, and beautiful. The resort is very big so be prepared to do some walking. The food was good with good options. The beach was beautiful, we had our own section for the reserve guest which was nice. This is not a party place, but if your looking for relaxation this is the perfect place. Staff was very nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Elizabeth C
reviews.title: Group Trip
reviews.text: This was an amazing trip. The Service was fantastic. It was very clean and well kept. My bulter Francis Sautos was phenomenal. He was very helpful made me feel like I was in heaven. Always there when I need him. My room had everything I needed. You really don't have to bring any amenities and they smell great. The room was very big and beautiful, the view was perfect and peaceful. The men out there were just handsome. Far as the restaurants the could have been better, not too happy about it.  Overall it was a nice relaxing resort and definitely worth the money.

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: great time
reviews.text: I had an amazing time here. Not as many girls as I would have liked but the people were friendly, my butler Samuel Rodriguez was the best. Just a real good trip all around. Beautiful resort, great food, great drinks, great golf, great times! I suggest you stay at the reserve so you get the butler service.

reviews.author: 364sherryc
reviews.title: Our 70th birthday trip
reviews.text:
The place exceeded our expectations is the buildings and pool areas. The buffet was excellent. 
The restaurants leave a lot to be desired, very disappointing. 
The staff were outstanding, friendly, outgoing, fun, engaging,and very accommodating.

reviews.author: kacraze35
reviews.title: WORST HOSPITALITY EVER
reviews.text:
Worst hospitality EVER! Have sworn to never return again.
 
To begin with let me first state that the property itself is beautiful. It is massive and there is much to do (so I hear). Having said that I think I can safely say that this has been my worst experience in any hotel as far as the service goes. I have never been this disappointed or annoyed with any hotel, ever! Brace yourselves; this is going to be long.
 
We checked into the hotel at about 6pm and were given a green wristband (all inclusive resort) indicating our package. Once the check-in formalities had been fulfilled we asked Cruz, the lady at the reception, what was in our package, about the property and if there was someone who could show us around. We were told that Juan would escort us to our room and will give us the necessary information. When we ask Juan the same thing, he told us since the guest services desk had left for the day, we would be taken around tomorrow. He would meet us for breakfast at 10 am and would show us around then. At this point we remembered that we read at the time of booking that we were to get resort credits, no one at the hotel mentioned anything to us. We asked Juan about this, he said the staff had left and that again, we could only get it the next day.  We ordered some dinner and retired for the night.
 
The next day we woke up to lovely weather, famished we were looking forward to having a quick bite to eat, be shown around our own resort and spending the afternoon at the beach. We caught up with Juan at about 10:15 he said we would be taken for breakfast shortly, we were made to sit at the lobby, sign a few papers saying that we are agreeing to be shown around and be told about the “Melia” rewards club. I am sorry to say but this was an emotional blackmail on his part as he coaxed us into signing our session for 90 mins as he would only then get his points, we weren’t even sure if we had an option to sit for less time. Just to be clear, I have no complaints against Juan, he just seemed to be doing his job.
 
We were then taken to a separate room and introduced to Ari who was to tell us about the Melia club membership, take us around the property and take us for breakfast. By the time we were made to sign and fill multiple papers and asked about our vacationing it was past 11am. And guess what, the breakfast buffet was on only till 11am. By this time we were extremely hungry. Ari took us to a snack bar and well in short I was having nachos for breakfast, I didn’t even get to eat till I was full as we had to move on with the “tour”. Again, no complaints against Ari, she was just doing her job. For the next 2 hours we were taken around the premium property (Reserve) not even our own and shown what we COULD benefit from, from joining the Melia Membership. We have still not been told what our green band (package) gives us access to or what’s in and around about our property. After this long tour that has already eaten up into our day we are brought back to the Club membership room and are asked about our interest in signing up. All in all they ate up 3.5 hours of our vacation time. Finally at 1:30pm I was too hungry to be polite any more and asked to be excused for Lunch. So relieved at the chance of a proper meal and to finally get on with our day. Its no wonder they hound you on your first day, as if you stay any longer you would realize what a big mistake it is to even think of signing up. Lunch was great. A special mention here for Chef Besant (I hope I am spelling his name correct) and the wait staff. Being vegetarian is tough but they went out of their way to accommodate us.
 
At this point it has been almost a day we have been here and we still don’t know anything about our resort (which is massive and the multiple coloured bands leave you wondering what you have access to). We scouted out the counter for our resort credits by ourselves, no one seemed interested to assist us in anyway and we knew if we waited any longer the guest services staff would have left for the day.

THE RESORT CREDITS ARE NOT CREDITS THEY ARE COUPONS which have numerous terms and conditions and you are only allowed to use a certain amount for one particular item.
 
A special mention here about the keycards. They were getting discharged whether we kept them with the phones or not. It did not matter. Later we realised they were only charging our card for a one time use!!!!!!! The resort is huge and just walking from the room to the reception takes a full 6 minutes (I timed it). Can you imagine how much time we wasted just going up and down to re charge the key card every single time we wanted to get to our room! By the second day we figured this out so we used to stop by the reception to get our card charged before we headed down to our room. Only after we complained, for our very last day there, our key card worked for the full day.
 
We spent the rest of the day out with our friends. When we got back at about 11pm the gentleman at the reception said that at check-in our credit card details weren’t taken (goof up at their end) and therefore we needed to give him our cards details instantly. While all this was happening since we were at the reception we decided to ask (since no one was interested in helping us anyway) about what benefits our green band gave us and what the different colours indicated.  We were told the black band was for people who had booked via the Melia website and gave guests access to many more areas than the green. And guess what, of course we had booked through the website and had been given the wrong band this whole while. (Reiterating here that had we not asked we would have been with the green band for our whole stay here)
 
Oh by the way, the dirty plates from our first night here are still lying outside our room and continued to stay there for two full days (I have pictures!).
 
Again we were out all day the next day got back at about 5pm, tried to make dinner reservations for 7pm but the guest services counter was closed (how would we know when no one has bothered to tell us anything anyway) and they said our best bet would be to go directly to the restaurant. We went and ate a lovely meal ordered wine and since we couldn’t finish the bottle we asked them to send the bottle to our room. We got back to the room, waited for a while, the wine didn’t reach, and we had plans so we left. The bottle only reached the next evening 7pm after I called room service.
 
The next morning we called for breakfast in the room, I asked for a cappuccino, they out rightly said no, and that they were too busy and I needed to go down to the bar to get it. I requested a little harder saying I don’t mind if the froth disappears, then after thinking about it they said okay (I must mention here that I was sick with a stuffy nose and just wanted to drink my coffee in bed). What I got was watery coffee with split milk (I have a picture). What a wonderful way to wake up right? (Just to add here, the next day I went down to the bar for a cappuccino and was told I would only get it at the buffet restaurant so I went there next and was given machine dispensed coffee, I cannot believe a resort this big does not own a cappuccino machine)
 
At this point we decided to speak to the manager. We went to the reception and asked to speak to the manager and were told to wait 10 mins. 10 mins turned to 30mins with no sign of the manager. When we went back to the reception she tells us that he is in a meeting and is not sure how long he will be! Like jeez, how about you inform the person waiting.
 
At this point I was so over this hotel, I barely wanted to spend anytime here (so much for the all inclusive) so we were out pretty much the whole day. When we got back I immediately went to the reception to get the key card charged for the Nth time (since we figured the drill to save us the long walk back and forth) The cheeky receptionist decided he wanted to interrogate me (and when I say interrogate I mean Interrogate), what my names was, who was saying with me, what my room number was, when did I check in, when do I check out etc etc made me sign some stupid register apparently stating it was protocol (protocol that was not being followed the past 8-9 times we had recharged our cards or for anyone else that was asking for their card to be recharged) despite the fact that I did not ask for a NEW CARD but was RECHARGING a card that was discharged. This was the last straw for me.  I have never been so humiliated or have ever had such trouble getting to my own room before (a place I have already spent 2 nights and 3 days!)
 
I got back to the room very upset and ask to be told when the manager (I have to hunt for his name) was around. The manager arrived. He heard us out said that no one has ever had such a bad time at their resort and so many things have never gone wrong all at once. He said he would look into the matter and investigate to see what was going on. Believe it or not, till the time we checked out (which was 2 days from then) we never heard back from him. Ridiculous!
 
Oh and did I mention, I was celebrating my 30th birthday here and despite the fact that the receptionist, the guest services desk, the manager, the room service attendant and the Melia Rewards Membership desk knowing it was my birthday not one person bothered to wish me. Just to be very clear this is not something I expect, it is just called courtesy. The so called all-inclusive super exclusive hotel did nothing but ruin my stay and my birthday whereas a tiny corner restaurant just down the street where I only had a couple of drinks managed to make it so much more special.

At check out, I am still confused at to what areas my band allows me access to and I realise that not one person ever game me a straight answer when I asked them.

Let it be said that with the experience that I have had here, I don’t understand why anyone in their right mind would ever want to be a part of the Melia Club. Never ever again. I am disgusted beyond words. This is the very reason I believe properties have no value without exceptional service.

reviews.author: lynnlongbeach
reviews.title: Destination wedding
reviews.text: We recently attended the wedding of a good friend. The beach was spectacular. The wedding was amazing. Weather for 5 days was perfect Casino was fun. Palazzo restaurant was the best. Has breakfast and lunch there everyday would like to mention some of the staff in the restaurant. Junior Osusudo Jhoedy Felix Miquel Richard. Very efficient friendly and attentive. Our Butler Edward was top notch. There is even free wifi on the beach. The pools are amazing  the bartender at Fuego. Diego made delicious shots

reviews.author: Ingrid B
reviews.title: Bachelorette celebration
reviews.text: We came to the reserve to celebrate my bachelorette, and it was an AMAZING experience. I would recommend it to anyone who is looking to have a fun and relaxin time. We went to the Fuego club and danced all night. The drinks and food were very very good. We were specially pleased with Ambiorix Mesa, Daniela Castillo from the club melia, Raynold tamayo, and Eddy Wilson.

reviews.author: KayLK05
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!!
reviews.text: Raynold  Tamayo was great! From the time we got there he made sure we were taken care of and Ranelly  Polanco was very attentive at the Hydro Grill. The rooms were comfortable, spacious, and clean and the beach access and pools were just what we were looking for on our mini vacation.

reviews.author: pnations
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
My girlfriends and I came to the reserve for a getaway and had a wonderful time. The beach is beautiful, soft white sand and warm turquoise water. We spent every day on the beach and did not get tired of it. The beachside servers, Hector Rogers and Edwin Santana  did a wonderful job. They were super friendly and always made sure we had what we needed. One of my friends celebrated a birthday while we there and we even got cake on the beach! 
The  food was great, especially the restaurant Fuego. The buffet had everything you can think of and it was all tasty. 
But what really made this trip so fantastic was the service! From our bartenders Rosa and Dominga to the doorman at the casino Hector, everyone was so friendly and accommodating. "Anything is possible" is their mantra. Juan Castillo was our concierge and he took care of everything! He was fabulous!! When, not if, I go back I will definitely ask for him!

reviews.author: ambiaris
reviews.title: Las mejore vacaciones
reviews.text: Gracia a le doy a dios por mandarme a vacacional a un hotel tan bella y tan servicial como este .lo empleado son los mejores especial el maletero Ambiorix mesa y el señor Eddy Wilson persona como esta se goza .pork si k tiene calidad en cuanto hotel se requiere .gracia beso

reviews.author: TravelingVee
reviews.title: Fun times
reviews.text: We had a great time, despite the fact that they overbooked (of course) and gave us a room at The Reserve next door. Very inconvenient when the rest of our party wasn't there so we had to ride a shuttle to get anywhere! So annoying. Also, we tried to get room service there around 11:30pm, supposed to be 24 hours but no one ever answered after lots of calls!  But the room was fine so we pulled through and the next day we got a room at the resort with our friends and it was all good. The buffet is great- wonderful seafood choices! Of course the typical American food I did not try since I was on vacation from burgers, pizza, and blah! My friends said it was decent though. You HAVE to make a reservation to eat at the 3 all inclusive restaurants. Despite non of the restaurants ever being crowded, they wouldn't let us eat without a reservation. So be sure to do that! If not, it's just the buffet as your only option. There are a couple restaurants and a wine place you have to pay for- so not really ALL inclusive! Drinks were good at the beach but bar service is very sloooooow. It's hit or miss with good service, some days were great, friendly faces, other days no smiles and hating-life faces. The lobby bar has the best drinks by far!!! Great service and drinks were different than the usual mojito, Margarita, or piña colada. The beach and water were beautiful so bring your own 32oz tumbler to fill up at the bar and stay in the ocean as long as you can!! So relaxing! We did room service and in our new room it was pretty quick and pretty great!

reviews.author: atlconvo
reviews.title: Pure Paridise
reviews.text:
I have been traveling for over 15 years and this resort is by far one of the most top of the line experiences I have ever had. It was just two females traveling. From the moment you walk in, you are greeted with smiles, a very tasty drink while your reservations are taken care of. The room and facility is just as beautiful as the pictures make them out to be, you will not at all be disappointed in what you get. All of the staff goes above and beyond making sure all of your needs are met, that you are comfortable and that you have anything that you want. It was truly a pampering experience. The staff is very well trained in providing excellent service.  My most impressive  experience was offered by Sandi Gil, he offered top of the line service during our entire stay, making sure my room was to my satisfaction, that everything worked and was in proper order and when the TV was a little fuzzy, he had it repaired immediately! The mini bar was stocked with beer and I when I let him know that I do not drink beer, he made sure that I had three bottles of my favorite liquor waiting in my room when I returned back from dinner. I had ice in my bucket every night with turn down service. Sandi made sure I had optimum dinner reservations every night, even when I was out and about all day, I could count on him to take care of us every evening. While all the employees were excellent he stood out as the best and very good at what he does. I would personally request Sandi to anyone who stays at the resort and when I return.
The YHI spa was also very nice and beautiful, and pampering. Maria gave me one of the best massages that I have ever had! ( and I have had many). While the services were pricey ($190 for 80 min massage), I enjoyed my experience so much, it was worth it. 

The hotel employs many beautiful people which adds to the paradise experience. Rafi at the Gabi beach club is gorgeous, very sweet and a great waiter, ladies you will want to go back each night just to waited on by him. Orlando in reception is very handsome and very nice way to start your vacation. You will also want as many private lessons with Ricardo, the personal trainer as you can get as well!! 

The food was all very good, but a must try is the fresh fish at Agave bar and grill near the beach at the Pardisus, I could not get enough of that fish, wanted it every day!!

MY ONLY disappointment is with it being so hot at night, I really wanted to go swimming. The pools close too early 7 pm. It would be really nice if there was an adult swim time in the evenings from 7-11pm.

reviews.author: Maria1602016
reviews.title: ROYAL SERVICE
reviews.text:
Tirando o serviço na praia,  na piscina e no restaurante "Palazzo" que é exclusivo do Royal Service, o restante é fraco quando comparado com outros hotéis do Mélia com o mesmo tipo de serviço.
Diversas vezes chegamos ao quarto às 19h e o quarto ainda não estava limpo ou ainda não tinham posto toalhas, quando colocávamos as toalhas de banho no chão para lavar voltavam a colocar em cima para as utilizarmos novamente. Houve um dia que chegamos ao quarto e tínhamos fezes de gato à porta, passaram pelo local 3 mordomos e 2 funcionários do hotel, desviaram-se,  nenhum foi capaz de chamar alguém para limpar, no dia seguinte de manha cheirava mal, e quando passou um empregado do hotel tivemos de pedir para limpar. 
A água acabava no mini-bar e por vezes não repunham.
Solicitamos ao n/ mordomo que reservasse um restaurante diferente todos os dias para o jantar, houve 2 vezes que chegamos ao restaurante e não tínhamos qualquer reserva. 
No dia em que tínhamos reserva no "Blue Agove" junto a este restaurante estava a decorrer um casamento em que a musica estava exageradamente alta, não se conseguia falar nem conseguíamos ouvir os empregados a falar connosco, tivemos de sair sem jantar.
Sendo o restaurante "Passion" galardoado com 7 estrelas Michelin, em que se paga 70 usd por pessoa sem bebidas, devia de ter um serviço melhor.
Para o preço que se paga no Royal Service devia de ter um "Serviço de  Excelência"

reviews.author: johnhA5773KA
reviews.title: Dominican Republic
reviews.text: Overall experience was phenomenally average. Other than breakfast, food was average. Passion restaurant was the exception. Dinner reservation were problematic, even when CONSIDERABLE space was available. Problems checking in and out.  Nothing significant just took a long time and a hassle.  Discounts that resort offered were a joke (if you spent $100 EXTRA you received $10 off. Free green fees are not free need to spend at least $65/person for cart and $55/person for clubs. Golf course was in good shape and challenging.

reviews.author: Nicole K
reviews.title: Georgia Girls' Vacation
reviews.text:
We had a blast at the Paradisus Palma Real. This was a girls' vacation and we are kind of high maintenance.  We took two to three showers daily and we like fresh towels for each in the beginning they brought the towels quickly towards the end they didn't.  

All of the restaurants except Blue Agave were not available and we were not able to secure a reservation upon our arrival.  On the last night we just showed up at Bana and we luckily were able to eat. The restaurants were okay and the staff was excellent.  

Room service was excellent!!!! The house keeper was excellent.  Our main complaint was the food.  However, my friends really loved the bar with Juan.

reviews.author: Grace W
reviews.title: simply lovely
reviews.text: it was so, so gorgeous! one of my best trips ever, by far. the employees are friendly and fun, and they can dance:) i enjoyed everything quite a bit. the food was okay, and i absolutely recommend going to fuego at least once. the grounds are very pretty and well kept, and the beach is very lovely.

reviews.author: Margot082013
reviews.title: ENFIM TUDO PERFEITO!
reviews.text: Complexo absolutamente perfeito! Apesar dos contratempos que tivemos quanto a reserva feita num determinado resort da rede e que não se cumpriu, nos enviando para outro resort  da rede que nos deixou muito contrariadas não fosse a atenção e paciencia do funcionario Oscar Mateo que conseguiu contornar a situação com maestria. Ao final foi tudo de melhor, acomodação, refeições, entretenimentos...Somos agradecidas também a todo pessoal dos restaurantes super amaveis!

reviews.author: Mari Dalva P
reviews.title: Natal e réveillon.
reviews.text:
Exelente!!!!!
Ficamos no Royal Serviçe,  estávamos em três casais e fomos muito bem servidos pelo nosso mordomo.
A comida em todos os restaurantes e exelente, bebida a vontade e de boa qualidade. Ficamos 10 dias no hotel, foi maravilhoso , nem foi necessário fazer passeios externos.
Festa de réveillon fantástica !!!! Recomendo.

reviews.author: Ingrid P
reviews.title: Tranquilidade
reviews.text: Hotel destinado a descanso ....muita tranquilidade em todo resort e muita simpatia em todos que trabalham lá...buffet com muita opção e jantares especiais. ...só achei errado não ter reserva toda noite em pelo menos uma opção. ...

reviews.author: Kristen R
reviews.title: Not friendly
reviews.text: Our rooms smelled musty, and 3 weeks later still trying to get smell out of my clothes after 4 washes. Staff act like they are doing you a favor. Grounds nice, spa is the best part. Could never get dinner reservation, yet when you showed up restaurants were empty.

reviews.author: Nanchula
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text: I spent 8 days at Paradisus Palma Real, in Punta Cana. The hotel was very nice, food was good, and the staff was very friendly and attentive. I want to thank, the staff at Avenue Bar, Juan Suarez, Julio Castro, Lucia Diaz and Lilian Aquino.  They were always very friendly, attentive, and made great tasting drinks.  Room service was also enjoyable and convenient for late night hunger. Having access to free WIFI was a Plus! It was even accessible at the beach.

reviews.author: rflora2
reviews.title: Rflora2
reviews.text:
Juan Suarez at the Avenue Bar was the most personal employee at the resort. You can tell he loves his job. 
The resort as a whole is a beautiful place and the food is fantastic. 
There are many fun excursions you can take to make fun memories for you and your family. 
Or if you like you can make it a relaxing calming vacation with massages and workouts. If that's your thing.

reviews.author: Judy B
reviews.title: second stay at a melia - also a melia member
reviews.text:
First, Punta Cana is by far my favorite beach destination. Probably because I speak the language (so communication is easy not that they don't speak fluent english) and it's a short flight away. This is my 4th time to DR and first to the Reserve. I was very happy with my master bedroom suite and proximity to the pool. The beach was about a 5-7 minute walk but trolleys were always available. 

Food was good. Better options at the Gabi Beach. I like the restaurants but really wish they were air-conditioned. I also ordered a lot of room serve late nights and mornings, can't complain about the food or timing. 

Have to give a special note to Jhoon Santiago who went above and beyond to provide us great service. He remembered our drink requests immediately and always had a smile for us. No request was out of his reach, he made sure we were taken care of.

reviews.author: Kerianne I
reviews.title: Obama time
reviews.text: Amazing time wish I could have stayed longer. Food at the grill was great and beaches and pools were amazing can't wait to go josias inirio(Obama) and marionell always ask for them when your there. Paradisus punts Cana great hotel to stay at during your DR stay 🙌🏾🙌🏾

reviews.author: Gladys P
reviews.title: Truly pampering
reviews.text:
Our greatest gratitude to the staff who made our stay to exceed our expectations: Our butler Alexander was EXTRAORDINARY. Checked with us  several times daily, surprised us with special treats in the room for special celebration, made sure our needs were met and went beyond to always suceed at surpassing our expectations, always ahead of the game planning our meals. The staff at the Palazzo where we had most of our meals was simply FANTASTIC! Alexis Francisco, the greatest chef we could ever had...satistied our wish to enjoy Dominican food for every lunch during our stay; Felix, Osvaldo and Jhoneidy pampered us every breakfast with our pineapple and oats juice and their exceptional service; Miguel, Oscar and Richard took over Felix and Jhoneidy few days and took care of us equally, with prompt attention to even minor details, remembering our likes; Zenovia Nova, the greeting smile at the entrance that set us right into the perfect mood for a great meal time; and then at evening time we enjoyed every night drinks at the bar where Marino Payans exceptionally talented to prepare just the right drink...whatever the mood was. My favorite: Meet the Greek. Gracias de corazon! Then at the Royal Service
 pool, Francisco and Wanda were always attentive and taking care of all of our needs.

reviews.author: Sandy S
reviews.title: Beatiful Hotel, simply paradise
reviews.text: First time in Punta Cana, best vacation ever. Resort is very beautiful and just perfect. Great food, amazing staff, continuous drinks. Gabi Beach Bar after dinner was amazing, it felt like the turn up before the main turn up.lol. The best entertainment staff  SHAKY SHAKY, omg, alway hyped from morning to evening pumping people up and keeping us entertained. Overall everything was perfect.

reviews.author: dbonomo
reviews.title: Personal espectacular , instalaciones en deterioro.
reviews.text: El lugar sigue siendo muy lindo a pesar que se han quitado determinados privilegios y atenciones que existian anteriormente. El personal en el Resort y su amabilidad es extraordinaria.   Debe haber mayor preocupacion por su mantencion de instalaciones y limpieza en los baños publicos.

reviews.author: allieprib
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort-Unfriendly Staff
reviews.text: I recently went on a girls trip to Paradisus Palma Real. The property and views are amazing, as well as the cleanliness. The workers and the service was one of the worst I have experienced. Unfriendly staff, unwilling to assist on any questions or concerns we had, or just upright rude. There was one bartender in particular that made this trip worthwhile- Marino Payans. He went out out of his way to talk to us and make us comfortable and make us specialty drinks. (Whereas other bartenders were asking for our room number/phone number/Facebook). The service of this resort made it go from a 5 star to a 3. Luckily there were a few that still made it worthwhile.

reviews.author: Jood A
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: I went with 3 of my friends and it was so relaxing and tranquil but at the same time we were so active in all the excursions possible. What truly made trip spectacular was the staff, specifically Gasolina and Coco Loco. They made our trip extremely memorable and brought an energy to the resort that would not be present without them!

reviews.author: Jose A
reviews.title: Great hotel, amazing rooms
reviews.text: I took advantage of a golf tournament in cocotal that included two nights in this hotel and after my first day here I said to my self that this had been the best oney I had paid for a golf tournament as I plaid three days of golf and enjoyed this hotel so much that just the hotel was worth the money. I upgraded to the Royal service and was treated like a king. Miguel was my butler and he was on top of everything I needed, including bringing my golf clubs to the front. The beach here is just amazing, white sand, restaurants are beautiful and the food is really good. Passion was very romantic and nice. Tennis courts were clean and good too. The tennis pro was good. Bartenders in the lobby bar served me jack daniels every time I was there after asked for the first one. Special thanks to Leticia del Rosario, I guess she works in sales. I needed some help with calling a representative and she stopped and contacted the person for me. I could tell she did not have to do anything with it, however she just took care of it quick and impressed me with her service attitute.

reviews.author: Carlos Alberto R
reviews.title: MUY RECOMENDABLE
reviews.text: Pasamos una semana con mi esposa en el sector Royal Service del Hotel. Disfrutamos a pleno de la playa las instalaciones de piletas del sector con una Excelente atención del Sr Francisco. Y para recomendar el Restaurante Palazzo con una amplia gastronomía, tanto para desayunos y almuerzos. Renglón aparte la cálida y esmerada atención personalizada de: Petronila, Zenovia, Richard, Miguel, Osvaldo Alexis, Rafael. Todos ellos conforman un gran equipo  que lo hacen sentir a uno mejor que en casa!

reviews.author: Hduque
reviews.title: EXCELENTE EXPERIENCIA
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia increible!!! que amabilidad de personal, el hotel espectacular, la mejor playa de punta cana, nos hicieron sentir mejor que en nuestra casa, el ambiente super y nos atendio y ayudo siempre a todo momento la empleada " su".

reviews.author: yaroslav2016
reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text:
Great service at Spa. 
Thank you Aracolis, Columna, Milly, Soribel, Marlene, Rosanda, Omar and Beralisis.

Thank you to our butler Ariel.

Great service at Palazzo. Thank you Zenovia, Richard, Felix, Miguel, Ingrid, DeAza.

Great service at the beach area.
Thank you Francisco Cabrera, Angel Fria and Jorge Acevedo.

You are the best all!

I will come back because of you.

Yaroslav

reviews.author: Pablo H
reviews.title: Inolvidables vacaciones!!
reviews.text: Excelente calidad de servicio, un lujo cada rincon del hotel, buenas bebidas, sobre todo una carta internacional. La pase super bien. Buen equipo de animacion, especialmente LA CHANTY una genia!! Muy copados caramelo, shaky shaky, gasolina y coco loco.

reviews.author: Justyn D
reviews.title: First class resorts, great employees service, nothing but the best
reviews.text: Nothing negatives, I loved everything about this resorts offer, the foodies great friendly staffs, wonderful experienced. I would recommend anyone to come here and see it for themselves. Nothing but first class service.

reviews.author: Kayla O
reviews.title: A Touch of Paradise
reviews.text: Honestly I can say that this is the best resort that I have ever been to. From the rooms, to the service, to the drinks, to the amenities, everything is so amazing. There is always something to do, like take a dance lesson, play volleyball, water aerobics and much more! The entertainment staff is SO MUCH FUN! Shaky Shaky is one of the coolest characters  I have ever met, and he never failed to put a huge smile on my face. He is very social and genuinely cares about getting people involved and having fun at the resort. Shaky Shaky is one of the many staff members who is very vibrant and full of life. The service overall was amazing because everyone was so nice and fun. It was so hard to leave because I made so many friends with the workers, and I can't wait to go back and see them again. Overall, this is a really fun place to stay and it is absolutely gorgeous with endless activities.

reviews.author: Mike W
reviews.title: Great time in Punta Cana
reviews.text: This is a great resort. The service was great, the rooms were spacious and comfortable. The restaurants offered international food and the food was delicious. The resort is right in the beach; the large pool had room for everyone. We were there for a week and the resort was never crowded. It was nearly full, but not crowded. This is a great place to stay if you want a relaxing stay on the beach and near the pool. The food and service were excellent. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: MMal0ne
reviews.title: Sensacional
reviews.text: Esse resort é fantástico! Além de ser lindo e muito bem decorado, também tem quartos dignos de sua imponência. O atendimento dos funcionários é exemplar e eles sempre estão de ótimo humor. É muito completo, com teatro, bares bem localizados, banheiros sempre limpos, adega com vinhos do mundo todo e com aulas de degustação, restaurantes muito bem decorados e cardápios muitos bons. A praia em frente é calma e com visual de encantar. A água tem temperatura agradável e é transparente. Em algumas épocas do ano algas se soltam, mas não senti incômodo algum por isso. Todos os dias é feita uma limpeza na areia. As bebidas, as opções variadas de comida e com ótima qualidade me fazem recomendar muito esse resort.

reviews.author: clarkin724
reviews.title: Jan and Juan at the Avenue are top notch
reviews.text: The experience in entirety was wonderful. The resort is beautiful, food is pretty good, and the staff is very friendly and accommodating. My boyfriend and I spent a good 2 hours at the Avenue bar multiple nights. Not because we are alcoholics, although I do like a well-made cocktail, but because Jan and Juan made us feel welcome. Both extremely friendly, respectful (while fun), and make excellent drinks. Great guys! Great place!

reviews.author: winnip2016
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We has a wonderful vacation here, which was enhanced by the outstanding service provided by Davidson Germain and Gustavo Vasquez at the buffet; and we enjoyed participating in the activities led by Elvis, La Manta,Gasolina, Caramelo,Didi, Laura, Johana, and Nina. The beach and pool were great, and the grounds of the property are lovely.

reviews.author: Pierre M
reviews.title: Un vrai paradis en service royal !!!
reviews.text:
En premier lieu, je tiens à dire un GROS Merci à mon Majordorme Samule Rodriguez qui a toujours été là pour nous. Dès notre arrivée, il nous a fait visiter le complexe hôtelier, si vous prenez le service royal demandez Samuel Rodriguez.

Parlant de l'hôtel : Très beau complexe, une équipe vraiment sympathique. Les chambres en service royal sont vraiment près de tout que ce soit des restaurants, de la plage ou de la piscine.

Service Royal : Outre un majordorme vraiment sympathique et dévoué. C'est un effet WOW ce service, avec un check-in privé, ou l'on y retrouve un lobby simplement pour nous avec bouchés, alcool. internet.Un restautant exclusif au membre du service royal. Une section de la plage réservé pour nous avec service de majordorme et une piscine pour le service royal que je n'ai jamais utilisé puisqu'il y avait un peu plus d'action dans la piscine principale.

Restaurants : Aucun négatif à dire, il était vraiment excellent et un PLUS pour le vin qui était quand même très bien.

Hôtel fortement à recommander et si vous voulez le petit WOW, service royal saura vous le donner.

reviews.author: Vincent L
reviews.title: Un petit coin de Paradis
reviews.text:
Hôtel très bien situé, tout est fait pour passer un excellent séjour. Les chambres sont spacieuses, le complexe très beau et entretenu. Les restaurants à la carte sont à découvrir, sinon le restaurant principal est fabuleux. Le personnel est très sympathique mais ne parle pas beaucoup le Français. D'ailleurs il n'y a pas beaucoup de français. Cet hôtel est a privilégié pour les Américains. 
Très bon séjour dans ce décor paradisiaque.

reviews.author: deirdres506
reviews.title: Very good but not great due to a couple of things
reviews.text:
Two bad things: 
1. too many locals approaching on the beach with offers to find boyfriends (I am a woman)
2. it was sad to see all the important jobs at the hotel held by light skinned people and all the lesser jobs held by darker skinned people (felt racist)
The great things:
1. great beach and ocean
2. great pool
3. great hotel room
4. great food and drink

reviews.author: D7934ROnicoleb
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text:
My best friend and I took a girls trip here at the beginning of May and we absolutely loved our experience. The view from the moment you set foot in the resort is amazing. The staff really made our experience so great from the very beginning. Check in process was quick and easy and then we were escorted to our room with our luggage by a staff member who summerized everything we needed to know about the resort and our room. The room was nice but kind of a strange set up with little privacy since the bath room and bedroom are only partially closed off from each other. It didn't bother us, but I could see some people being uncomfortable with that. Beds were comfy and cleaning staff were constantly keeping our rooms cleaned and stocked with towels, drinks, and toiletries. 
The entertainment staff were top notch. Gasolina, Carmello, and all the other staff by the pool kept us entertained and involved every day. Our favorite part were the dance lessons by the pool. Anotonio and Leonardo at the swim up bar were awesome! They made sure our cups were always filled with some type of fresh fruity beverage. We also loved the staff at the Avenue bar. Juan, Lucia, and Lillian are amazing bartenders and kept the drinks coming all night while smiling and dancing.
