reviews.author: Issie B
reviews.title: Expected better service.
reviews.text: This was my 3rd visit to Punta Cana.  Each visit I've stayed at a different resort.  This year I stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and while the resort is beautiful and very clean, I was a little disappointed in the service.  The check-in took longer than a check-in should take, and not all the rooms were ready by the 3:00 pm  check-in time.  We had concierge service in our building, and while some were very good, some were not very helpful.  I was also disappointed by the rules regarding  restaurant reservations.  We were only able to make reservations at 4 restaurants during our 7 day stay - 1 every other day.  The other nights we had dinner at the buffet... which got old quickly.

reviews.author: charlie p
reviews.title: An excellent all-inclusive experience with Royal Service!
reviews.text:
I went along on a trip to celebrate a big birthday shared by four ladies, who have known each other for years. They all left their kids at home. One couple had been to several resorts in Punta Cana (over several years) and said this was the best. Which one is the best? I write this jokingly, as the names of three resorts are nearly identical, lending to major confusion for one of the couples who mis-booked at the Paradisus Punta Cana. Since Melia owns all three, they were able to switch to Palma Real, paying the difference in price (ouch). If it doesn't have "Golf & Spa Resort" in the name, it's not the right one. 

First: Book straight through Melia.com. Booking through travel services works fine, but you won't accrue Melia Rewards points and you won't get any discount coupons. We got a stack upon checking in. Though nearly all of them require you to spend to save, some are worth it, like the (3) $50 spa discount coupons. Speaking of checking in, as Royal Service guests, you are welcomed in a VIP space, sitting at a table with a staff member amid high-end snacks and served drinks. Not a bad way to start! They issue you a wrist band you'll be wearing throughout your trip. Note: Bring the credit card you booked with. We forgot to do this, and had to pay a second time while waiting for my original card to be refunded. The card I used incurred a 3% foreign transaction fee, too. Doh! I would recommend you check ahead of time with your financial institution to ensure this doesn't happen to you. 

After checking in, you'll be introduced to your personal butler. We had the good luck of getting Jose. He showed us around, introduced us to the bartenders, showed us our room and made a dinner reservation for us that night. More about food later. The rooms we all booked were suites just steps from the pool. This would be a Royal Service only area. The ocean was about a hundred paces away, so you can walk from your room to the ocean in about two minutes. The room itself was large with a comfortable king size bed, a living room setup, and beyond that a private balcony. Our bathrooms all had shutters and banisters, not providing much privacy from the rest of the room. The bed is just on the other side of this almost-wall. The toilet's somewhat isolated by a glass door which falls short of both the floor and ceiling by about a foot. One of the ladies had her husband leave the room when it was time to do her business. Besides this, the bathroom is large, with a grand jacuzzi tub and separate rain head shower. We were in the room about as much as you'd expect. Besides sleeping and other bed-related activities, we were there to shower, change clothes and get what we needed for our next activity. When a place is this beautiful, you don't want to spend all your time inside. 

As far as things to do, you can spend all day at the pool or at the beach if you want. You can take dance or fitness classes - there's a daily schedule showing what's available when. There are shows every night, though we got the impression from our friends the shows are watered-down family friendly affairs. You can book massages in their zen garden area, which is truly something to behold. There are outdoor jacuzzis in the pools, though the one in the Royal Service area wasn't working during our trip. There's an indoor / outdoor hydro spa, which we believe is available to RS guests whether you've booked a massage or not. Your personal butler can coordinate with the excursion desk near the lobby to book a trip to go snorkeling, scuba diving, dune buggy-ing ('dun boogies' as they pronounce it), zip lining, and probably many other things in and around beautiful Punta Cana. 

When it's time to eat, there are many options. For dinner, there are six restaurants covering different fare, including two in the neighboring family-friendly Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. Sadly there are no Dominican food options. For both breakfast and lunch, options vary from menu items to buffet. The menu-plus-buffet breakfast at Palazzo is excellent - for food and especially the service! This is also the closest restaurant to the Royal Service rooms. For lunch, we tended to visit Gabi Beach, which has full-on buffet with stations for Japanese sushi, cured meats and cheeses, American, BBQ, ceviches, seafood, salads, breads and desserts among other things. If you can't find something to eat here, you've got a problem. The ceviche here and everywhere was excellent, and I find my mouth watering thinking about it just a few days later. If you're into local food, you can find typical Dominican food at the buffets. I ate plenty of tostones, platano cooked several different ways, rice and beans, yucca, taro chips, etc. You'd be wise to eat all the beautiful tropical fruit offerings too. Everywhere you look you'll find sliced mango, pineapple, melon, watermelon, apples and bananas. "What are those large bright-colored seeds?" another guest asked me. Passion fruit! 

That's enough about food. Clearly I'm getting hungry. How about drink, you ask? Being Royal Service guests, you can lay on a chaise lounge or a palapa (think cabana) either poolside or at the beach and be served cold drinks for hours. I recommend you bring a large mug to accommodate more than what their small paper cups hold. We found plastic mason jars with gel to keep drinks cold, lids and straws at Bed Bath and Beyond for $4 on clearance. Almost anything would work for these purposes, including Nalgene bottles or those cheap mugs you find at grocery stores during summer. For alcohol you can drink nearly whatever you want. There are six bars I can think of just off the top of my head. All had top shelf brands including Absolut, Jack Daniels, Tanqueray, Bombay, etc. 

For beer, you can drink the local Presidente or more likely Presidente Light when served from tap. I'm an IPA kinda guy, but enjoyed drinking Presidente in an environment like this, when you're in the sun and drinking many beers. I would not last long drinking IPA in the hot sun! I was surprised there weren't more options but it is substantially better than American pilsners (to the point of where I may start drinking it at home for those nights I want a beer or two without getting too far gone). For wine, well, you have coupons to upgrade when at a meal. Keep an eye out for whites that have turned (looks like urine)! The bartenders aren't trained well for this and we saw it happen twice with unopened bottles. It's not their fault. 

Overall I can't speak highly enough of the service. I will be updating this review soon with the names of people who stood out. For starters, our butler Jose; Martin, Francisco and Rafael at the Sunset bar; Felix, Junior and everyone at Palazzo; Rafael (same one from the pool/beach bar!) at Gabi Beach. Bring a pile of singles and other smaller bills for tipping. Seriously, singles are a precious commodity here, and you will struggle to get change when you run out. The dollar reigns supreme here; evidently no one wants DR pesos. If you run out of cash, you'll have to withdraw DR pesos from an ATM machine (I don't want to think about that fee), then exchange it for dollars at a 15% loss. Bring a least $200 in singles. Remember, everyone from bellhops to bartenders to the guy who brings you towels should get a least a couple of dollars. For meals, we tipped at least a few dollars for breakfast and lunch, and $10-20 per person at dinner. These guys work hard and deserve a little extra. 

Thanks for reading my review. Comments are welcome!

reviews.title: DR trip

reviews.author: drkkw
reviews.title: Nice, but average!
reviews.text:
I am not here to bash the Paradisus.  However, I believe that many people review a place, but have not been to many other places.  Having been to many resorts around the world, you can't but help, to compare.  I believe that is where ratings and reviews can really help.
The Paradisus is a very large complex.  That can seem to be amazing when you first drive up, but you also must remember that you will walking a much greater distance to get from one side of the property to another.  (Just something to think about)
I love exercise, but on a vacation, I'm also there to relax and necessarily to break my record on my fitbit.  (ha)
If you have ever been to a good number of all-inclusive resorts, you start to pick up the fact that they all start to look the same.  I have often wondered if the same designer has been hired throughout the world to design every single all-inclusive.
That doesn't make it bad, but then I guess it really doesn't matter which one you pick; it's a bit boring seeing the same 'ole thing.
With all-inclusives, you are subject to the daily buffet.  As far as choice, or options, that seems wonderful.  However, I have yet to be "wowed" with the overall enjoyment of the food at anyone's buffet.  I realize it is hard to prepare all those dishes in big masses and make them all taste wonderful, but isn't that part of the reason you pay extra at all-inclusives?  You are prepaying for the food and drink that they estimate you will consume.
Your other option for dinner, is to get a reservation at one of their Premium restaurants.  Unfortunately for us, we were told on Wednesday when we arrived, that there was no availability for us at any of their premium restaurants for the next 4 nights, and that was all we were going to be there.

I will say, the staff is very friendly, and I found very helpful.

As far as weather goes, can someone tell me if the wind ever stops?  It seems to blow hard 24-7.  Honestly, not a wind fan!  Also, it was super cloudy 3 out of the 4 days.
Again, since comparisons help, the Dominican doesn't hold a candle to the consistency of weather in Ixtapa or Cabo San Lucas, Mexico.  (2 of my faves)

I guess overall, the Paradisus Palma Real is good, just not great.  Also, you can probably tell that I am NOT a fan of all-inclusives.  I only go when the situation or the group I'm with dictate it.
For my money, there are many other wonderful gems to stay at and make memories that will be different from the same 'ole thing.

Some things the hotel should improve on are dinner reservations at the restaurants (a little confusing) and housekeeping at appropriate hours and not late in the afternoon. But beautiful resort overall, I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Jeri D
reviews.title: What a wonderful trip!
reviews.text: Our experience at the Paradisus in Punta Cana was wonderful.  Mostly due to the amazing staff.  No matter where we went we were taken care of in a genuinely  friendly way.  On the beach our days were taken care of by Juan and Mario, they were fast and friendly even though we had a very large group most days. Most memorably at a catered function we had a waiter named  who never let our drinks go empty. We barely had to stop dancing, and then we were at the Gabi bar where he handed us waters on the dance floor even without us asking!   I can't say enough great things about YoYo in the casino. With her wonderful smile and attitude, she made the evening so enjoyable...BOOM!!!   Our room was great no complaints. There was some construction going on in the garden areas near our rooms. It would have been beautiful to have the lagoons filled and our fountain going in the courtyard, but don't get me wrong this did not make our stay bad at all. We stayed in the Royal Suites, which was such a nice upgrade. Loved the Royal lounge and Pool/Beach areas.  The butler was a nice touch, but we really didnt need his assistance that much.  We were traveling with a group and most of our plans were already made for us.  It was nice to have him available just in case. The grounds of the Resort are absolutely stunning!!  The Beach area is one of the best beach experiences we've ever had.  We would love to return to this location for a family trip someday.

The waiters at Fuego made both or lunch and dinner experience one to remember. Jesus Evangelista from Vento was an awesome waiter. Visit M-bar for the best bar and bartender. Food was above average at the Buffett but not as good at the only restaurant that we could make reservations (Mediterranean). The main opportunity was the reservation process that they use for the restaurants. We have to insist about 3 or 4 times per day to be able to get reservation for 7 people. Also, several restaurants were closed for guests apparently for private events. I encourage all visitors to try to make their reservations the first day when they arrive, you will have a higher probability to eat at the best restaurants. I probably will be back, but I hope they organize the reservation process better.

reviews.text:
What an amazing experience!! The beach was gorgeous! We did tons of excursions including the Floating Spa, Speed Boats, Snuba Diving, 90 min massage (best I've ever had) and more. As a Royal Service guest we had the luxury of receiving top notch service all around. Our butler, Samuel Rodriguez was extraordinary! He was extremely attentive, helpful, suggestive, kind, professional, and he set up our dinner reservations every evening. We were pretty low maintenance but his attentiveness was much appreciated. 

We ate breakfast most mornings at the Palazzo restaurant (best dinner spot) which was much better than the general buffet. The entire staff there was amazing but two people stood out the most. The hostess Zenovia made us smile every single day! We would literally chat it up and laugh with her for several minutes every morning before being seated. She has such a welcoming personality and is a pleasure to be around. Richard was our server for most days and although we always opted for the buffet, he still managed to make sure we were taken care of. I couldn't take more than two steps away from the buffet without him generously taking my plate from hand and dancing his way to my table to place it down...every time! Such a remarkable personality!

"Shaky, Shaky" is hilariously entertaining (you'll know what I mean when you go) and Carlos was extremely helpful. 

I could go on and on but I digress. My overall experience was fabulous! I would recommend this resort to anyone. My only issues were the lack of authentic food and the lack of variety pertaining to late night entertainment (i.e. bars, clubs, etc). But that wouldn't stop me from returning!

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Paradisus is real slice of Paradise
reviews.text: My wife and I spend five great days & nights at Paradisus Palma Real and enjoyed every aspect of this magnificent resort. The grounds were manicured ,the beach was spacious & exciting the variety of bars and cafes were great for a variety of drinking and dining experiences. Some special servers we enjoyed interacting with were Davidson , Horacio & Clairebell : all made the dining experience extraordinary. amazing service and attention to detail. We would highly recommend Paradisus to anyone. W

reviews.author: sps34dfs
reviews.title: Would go back tomorrow
reviews.text: The room was spacious with a good size patio with a garden view.  Service was quite good and very member of the staff was quite friendly.  The grounds are well maintained and our stay was very relaxing.  We highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real for a family vacation.

reviews.author: Kim M
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text: This trip was really great.   We traveled with a few more friends than usual and we all had a blast.   The new Naos restaurant is awesome.   Food from all restaurants was very good .  Everyone is always so friendly and helpful.   We met alot of nice people on this trip.   As always, the staff goes above and beyiond.   I would like to give a special shout out to some of the staff that really outdone themselves....Shaky Shaky,  you rock., Luis Peguero, Caramelo, Beyonce and at the pool bar, Luis Diaz and Leonardo Moto.   These people make your trip so much more fun.   Can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: sh02131
reviews.title: Loving the reserve!
reviews.text:
Luis is treating us so well! Thebeach is gorgeous and the huts are a nice way to enjoy the breeze. Coco locos are the best!!
Reinold has been a pleasure too. All the staff are friendly and helpful. I look forward to coming back next year. The breakfast buffet at The Reserve has everything you'd want.

reviews.author: jose luis f
reviews.title: Mal servicio. Responsables actividades acuáticas maleducado
reviews.text:
Mal. Nada más entrar nos dieron una habitación usada después de 12 horas de viaje
Tuvimos que reclamar varias veces
El servicio de actividades acuáticas esta regentado por un suizo con muy pocos modales.  Nada recomendable
Muy caro para lo que es

reviews.author: Sequana J
reviews.title: Very Relaxing
reviews.text: I really enjoyed myself on this trip. Relaxing on the beach was all I needed. The staff at the Paradisus was exceptional. Everyone was very friendly and extremely accommodating. I have to give a huge shout out to Argenis Rijo, a server in the Naos Buffet. Oh my goodness, he made me want to stay at the resort forever. My friend and I sat in his section every time we ate breakfast and lunch. He always had our drink orders ready when we sat down and checked back in on us constantly. He always put pretty flowers on our table for us. Oh and Shaky Shaky (from entertainment) was extremely helpful as well. They both really seem to love their jobs. I really also loved the night entertainment. The Micheal Jackson and Lion King shows were fantastic! Oh my goodness and the casino. I won so much money using the free slot vouchers that the young lady kept giving out from playing bingo. It was great! The only negative I had (and why I didn't give 5 stars for service) is because of the housekeeper. For whatever reason our lady forgot to restock at least one item every single day (towel, wash cloth, hand towel). It was pretty insane. It got to be a little funny after awhile. Besides that everything was awesome!

reviews.author: H3881IErichardl
reviews.title: Great Vacation Spot
reviews.text: One of the best vacations spots ever. Beautiful and very well kept resort. I was told that the food in the Dominican was not that good, but the food here was excellent. Our Butler Johnfi Rivera took outstanding care of us and was a pleasure to work with, would defiantly request him again. Also Carlos Rosard  at the royal services sunset bar was outstanding very attentive and funny. Would defiantly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.title: Gold Canyon Annual Achievers Trip
reviews.text: I was blessed to have earned an all-expense paid trip for my husband and I, to the Paradisus Palma Real, with my side little candle business, Gold Canyon.  This is an amazing resort, with gorgeous rooms, beautifully manicured grounds, and phenomenal beaches!  It was exceptionally clean, wonderful food, and incredible service. All of the employees were so friendly, helpful, and engaging, even though I spoke minimal Spanish, and they spoke little English. They always greeted us and made an effort to hold a conversation!  We especially loved Juan Peralta, our beach server, who took such fabulous care of our group, several days in a row.  He was kind, attentive, and has the absolute greatest smile! If you go, look for him on the beach! He is THE BEST! We cannot wait to go back to this beautiful island, and visit this PHENOMENAL resort again! Thanks Gold Canyon and Paradisus Palma Real for an a wonderfully memorable vacation!

reviews.author: Jcarter0729
reviews.title: My best vacation
reviews.text: (Raynold Tamayo) Luis florian y naomi y todo el equipo de actividades Ellos nos regalaron unas maravillosa vacaciones con su carisma y amistad en especial Raynol mi profesor de baile muy atento y buena persona a el igual ranelly polanco son super las personas de the reserve con gusto regresamos

reviews.author: Carol D
reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text: Start to finish perfection. Prime beach location in the middle of two other resorts, and ours was by far the best. The buffets were almost always open and the food was a delicious mix of American favorites, gourmet options, and Dominican favorites. The dancing with hotel staff was both entertaining and so much fun, our favorite staffer was dubbed "Shaky Shaky" and was so accommodating with everything we needed. Beach had ample wait staff for drinks and every surface was spotless. I have never seen a hotel so well staffed and prepared, they had everything!

reviews.author: Chandafromchhicagp
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: This is a review from 2012. Paradisus is the beautiful resort I've ever visited. Rooms, pool, beaches, restaurants, lobby, and lounge spaces were all immaculate and tasteful. Food wasn't amazing but it wasn't bad. Great options for excursions.

reviews.author: Nancy J
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
A group of 8 high school seniors and their moms (and two dads!) enjoyed Spring Break.  I'm not sure if kids or adults had more fun!  Lobby, pool, beach are incredible!  All activities staff was fun, energetic.  Special kudos to Didi and Popeye.  Luis,,,,happiest bartender out there!
Probably the most comfortable beds and pillows I've had in a hotel.  Grounds are lush and extremely well-kept.  Food was not "out of this world," but variety and quality definitely above what we expected for an all-inclusive.

reviews.author: Leonard R
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: We had a great trip to Palma Real. The food was excellent & the staff was very friendly. We would definitely recommend this resort to anyone. We stayed in April 2016 and loved every minute of it. The beach was amazing!

reviews.author: Murphy O
reviews.title: Best workers!
reviews.text: I was just recently at the Paradisus in Punta Cana and had the best time! The workers really went above and beyond to make my stay as memorable, relaxing and fun as possible!! My by far favorite was Ravel at the Swim Up Bar!!! He taught me how to speak Spanish and was always making the best piña coladas for us!!! The entire Swim Up Bar was overall amazing and super friendly... I spent a majority of my time at the Swim up bar talking to these great guys! Super Mario we love you! Luis Castillo, Nelson, Edwin, Wander, Anthony and Sandy! Zumba was another really fun activity run by the one and only Shaky Shaky, it's hard not to love him! "Shaky shaky no nappy nappy!!" Thanks for always bringing a smile to our faces Shaky Shaky. Also Yudy your our girl and we love you 2!!! Caramelo thanks for teaching me how to dance!!! Another great bar that is kind of hidden is the Bargarita... Carlos Pie is our man, always there for us with his killer drinks, endless story's and always teaching us more español. We miss you Carlos!!! Red Lounge is also a party every night!!! Juan Suarez, Lilian Aquino and Junior Marte are also great bartenders. They always brought the party to Avenue (great bar, great people, great drinks!) These amazing people touched our hearts and helped make our experience at the Paradisus 10x better! We will be back to visit you all!!! Shout out again to RAVEL for being the best of the best. We miss you and your discooooo stories. Love you all and thanks for a great week in paradise.

reviews.author: ericmJ1448KM
reviews.title: Great property but a lot needs to be worked out.
reviews.text:
Great place and good food.  Make sure everything they promise is in writing or it never happened. 
Make your dinner reservations beginning of the week or you will never get in.  Dinner at the buffet everynight can get stale.  All staff are very nice until you actually need something.  Then it can get frusterating.   We called 6 times for additional towels and got nada until we walked to the front desk.

reviews.author: Violeta G
reviews.title: Calidad excelente
reviews.text: El hotel nos encantó. La ubicación, las habitaciones, el resort, la comida, y sobre todo el trato del personal. Me gustaría sobre todo destacar la profesionalidad y amabilidad de Caramelo, Judy, Agripina, Luis y Angel. Todo en general excelente, lo que nos hizo disfrutar de unos días inolvidables.

reviews.author: S6770DKleew
reviews.title: Best All Inclusive ever
reviews.text: Be sure to get the Royal Sevice package if possible. We almost didn't and it's worth the extra. Food was excellent. Service was outstanding. Avoid the Japanese restaurant and go to Palazzo often. We were surprised by the shows each night, not expecting that. Fun.

reviews.author: Nicole McGeehan
reviews.title: Most amazing vacation ever!!!
reviews.text: From the minute we stepped off the plane until we left Punta Cana, our experience was unbelievable! This resort is top notch and we will definitely return!! The food was excellent, beach was beautiful, and the entertainment was incredible!! The shows each night were worth so much more than we paid! These men and women have amazing talent!! Impressed beyond belief!! We will be back!! Thanks so much for the great memories!! Luis Florian, Jose Fernandez and Yordan Rosario were especially awesome!!!

reviews.author: olgagisellea
reviews.title: Calidad y excelente servicio
reviews.text: Me encanto este hotel. Ya es la cuarta vez que lo visito. Me encanta su personal. Domingo beltre es lo maximo, antonio en el area del bar decla piscina es otra joya de persona. Cada visita que hago me sorprenden mas y mas pues en general todos me hacen sentir como en casa pero ellos dos , definitivamente son los maximos!

reviews.author: CarlaChriste
reviews.title: Incrível!!!
reviews.text: Resort completo com todas as regalias e com um serviço de primeira, todos os restaurantes no complexo são incríveis, o atendimento é sensacional. A suíte é um arraso, as noites são super animadas e temos a opção de irmos para o outro complexo da rede que tem cassino e mais atrações, inúmeras formas de divertimento, apenas deve-se prestar atenção aos passeios oferecidos por agências dentro do resort, saber mais detalhes para não ficar o dia todo fora! O Restaurante Mizu é muito divertido! Amei!

reviews.author: Jason H
reviews.title: Paradisus review
reviews.text: Nice hotel overall and great beach.  OK selection of restaurants.  Golf courses on site and nearby.  But  very crowded.  Not much service.  Room has moldy smell.  Bath shower leaked badly to the hallway.  Slippery and dangerous!

reviews.author: ina322016
reviews.title: Traumferien!
reviews.text:
Das Hotel war wunderschön. Wir buchten den Royal-Service, was wir nur empfehlen können. Dazu gehören ein separates Restaurant, einen separaten Pool und einen separaten Strandabschnitt. Die riesengrossen Liegen am Stand laden wirklich zum Entspannen ein.
Der Royal Service ist um einiges ruhiger, als der "normale" Bereich. Dort hat es viel mehr Gäste, welche gerne den ganzen Tag Party machen. 
Unser Buttler Emilio war sehr zuvorkommend und reservierte uns sämtliche Restaurants im Voraus. Er erkundigte sich immer nach seinen Gästen und schaute, dass es uns an nichts fehlte. Er machte wirklich einen sehr guten Job!

reviews.author: Parivash B
reviews.title: Spring Break trip
reviews.text: Place was beautiful did not like that we had to make a reservation for every night and on the first night making all reservations we couldn't get seated until 9:00pm at every place which is late.  Otherwise nice

reviews.author: 734donald
reviews.title: satisfaction
reviews.text:
satisfied
nice people 
caring 
happy staff
you should put mosquito screens in royal service  rooms save on energy enjoy breeze of island 
make sure all vegetables are well cleaned with disinfectant repeatedly avoid gastric problems

reviews.author: joyandlaughter1
reviews.title: Fun girls trip
reviews.text: I am not a huge all- inclusive fan so, it was a nice surprise to arrive here and have good food/restaurant options.  Rooms were nice- it helped to be upgraded to the presidential suite.  Great Butler service, our butler took care of all the details making it easy for us to relax and enjoy.

reviews.author: Stephjyoung
reviews.title: Carlson Wedding Weekend
reviews.text: We had the best time! This was my husband and my second trip to Paradisus and it was just as great, if not better than our first trip. We went with a group of friends for a wedding. The resort is absolutely beautiful! The rooms are amazing. The food is great, there are so many choices. Daily activities are non-stop and so much fun! The employees make your stay even better. Our daily bartenders Gilberto Mejia, Antonio Ramirez, and Luis Dias at the swim-up pool bar, were excellent! By the second day, they remembered all of our favorite drinks and made sure they were always full!! We had the best time and the guys made it even better! We can't wait to visit again.

reviews.author: cindy1034ttj
reviews.title: Girls trip to Punta Cana!
reviews.text: The resort is fabulous! The Royal service with Angelo was so worth it! We were given a phone to contact him. He made all of our dinner reservations ( we tried every restaurant- all had delicious food & service). He found someone to help book all of our excursions (swimming with dolphins, zip lining & dune buggy outing). The room had two oversized queen beds. Almost every night there was a delicious goodies waiting for us in the room prior to dinner (chocolate covered strawberries). Each night our bed was turned down along with our robes & slippers set out. We had an adult only bar/pool/beach area which was very nice. We had a palapa & a bali bed everyday reserved for us.The private restaurant -Palazzo had excellent food & service (guess this was my favorite) Rafael, Marino & Carlos served us up great drinks & food. We even golfed which was fun!  The 9 hole course we did was very nice. Thank you everyone at the Paradisus Palma real for making this a even more wonderful vacation!

reviews.author: Laurita B
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente estadía y excelente servicio departe de su equipo .. Especialmente de Raúl Jiménez que nos atendió los 10 días.. Muchas gracias. Todo nuestro grupo de amigos opina lo mismo.   Y el hotel está hermoso, también la playa es bellisimaaaa.

reviews.author: shocker014
reviews.title: More family than adult oriented
reviews.text: The first thing you will notice when you arrive is the amazing view. The resort has several large pools as well as a few smaller pools for kids and infants. Every night there is entertainment provided by the resort in the form of themed dinners/parties, bands, and performances (acts, dancers, magic shows, etc.). There are also 3 bars located throughout the pool area. Be sure to stop by and say hello to Kenia and Miguel. They will take excellent care of you. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are all-you-can-eat buffet style and available from 6am to 11pm. Room-service is also available 24 hours a day. Definitely the most accommodating resort I have ever visited.

reviews.author: cdekoff7
reviews.title: Great Trip!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus resort and it was a great trip! The service was incredible, everyone was so nice and pleasant! Had an amazing time and definitely will be coming back to this resort. Luis Santana and Ramón were especially great they checked in a lot and made sure me and my friend were very happy! ( you have to try the coconuts with sugar it was the best!)

reviews.author: Roving552470
reviews.title: Excellent time!!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus for our spring break. The service was phenomenal especially Luis and Ramon santos frias and Jose Reyes Benita Mercedes ! They took great care of my friend and I!They gave us endless coconuts on the beach. The resort was super relaxing and well kept. Will definitely go back.

reviews.author: Viajero0508
reviews.title: Inmejorable estancia
reviews.text: Un lugar lleno de detalles , arquitectura de las habitaciones hasta los restaurantes hermosa, comida deliciosa y bebidas muy variadas, eventos entretenidos, el lugar es muy grande , dan preferencia a los europeos que a los latinos es lo único que no me gusto, pero puse en su lugar a las tres personas que mostraron su preferencia por otros, de manera educada y enérgica

reviews.author: J445VBrichardk
reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.text: The resort would not accept payment from our company upon our arrival. Although, they did allow the company to make the reservation the previous day and guaranteed the rooms via company payment. Upon our arrival, the front desk staff was very unfriendly and advised we would be charged $100.00 extra for early check in. They indicated the day before that they would allow one room to check in without the early check in fee. They demanded full payment at the time of check in and refused to accept the company's payment. Our company has a local person to assist with our travels. The resort would not even accept payment from them. Our company tried, more than 10 times to contact the front desk manager as instructed. His name, we were told, was José. He either refused to answer the call or the Concierge refused to put the call through to him. We had signed up for a dive class at The Palma Real and when we went to the dive shop, we were taken two or three resorts away to take the class. This required a walk to the different resort area each morning for the class. We had to pick up an apple and a banana from the breakfast buffet to take with us for lunch because we were not allowed to have lunch in the other resorts area. Walking down the beach with apple and a banana in the morning is certainly not a problem. However, it is when you are 3 resorts away with no facilities and they place you are staying cannot provide the advertised services. Also, unfortunately, I forgot my dive log book in the room. (My fault). I have emailed and called this resort in an effort to recover the book. No email reply and cannot reach anyone at the resort by phone. We actually left a different resort to come here because it was described as better. The facilities were a bit better but the people were not and the service is terrible.

reviews.author: 357cliffords
reviews.title: Vacation 2016
reviews.text:
I would recommend this resort to Friends and Family.  Have  been going to this resort for 4 years and very satisfied. Staff is very friendly and remember you from year to year.
Grounds are very well kept.

reviews.author: jasi031
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text: (RaynoI Tamayo )is one of the coolest people. He can help you with anything you need. I really enjoyed the staff. The food was also very good. The resort is very peaceful and relaxing. The best part was the beach and the pool. The drinks were very good as well. They are able to accommodate you with anything that you need and desire to have.

reviews.author: kyager
reviews.title: Great Vacation!!!
reviews.text: (Raynold Tamayo) thanks for u service We had a great time!!! The beach is very pretty and fun! lots and lots to do like parasailing, scuba, and snorkeling. there are lots of beach chairs and cabanas on the beach and there are also nice cabanas by the pool that are a good place to relax during the day.

reviews.author: Mike P
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, great rooms, and great service. Everyone there did a great job. Juan Gabriel (our beach waiter) was fun, pleasant, and took great care of us. We walked the beach and checked out a lot of other resorts... I think this one is the best in the area.

reviews.author: alyssarae2016
reviews.title: Awesome vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed at the royal service and it was beautiful.  Our personal butler, Jeuri, was simply the best! He was always polite and sweet and made sure that our time at Paradisus Palma Real exceeded our expectations, which it most definitely did.  Angel, our bartender at the royal service private pool and beach, was always attentive and made sure we had everything we needed.  Overall, our experience at Paradisus Palma Real was marvelous (with a special thanks to Jeuri Ferreira)!

reviews.author: colleentraveler
reviews.title: Relaxation in the Sun
reviews.text:
Just back from trip. Traveled March 12-17th, wish I could have had another night or two. Had an excellent trip and stayed at the Royal Service side of the resort. Food was great at most restaurants, but lacked at Fuergo. Staff at Palazzo absolutely the best... Olsipio (sp) so kind, accommodating and attentive.  He gladly filled our glasses each time so that we had cold wine. We loved Angel at the beach. Attentive and always there with a smile.He made sure you were relaxed and made sure you knew you were on vacation and that it was ok to serve you...which sometimes takes some getting used to when you are the person catering to others in your life. Wanda did a great job making my "Dirty Monkey" daily. Miguel was our butler and did a fine job with our needs.  Angelo was our butler on the last day and he made the transition for leaving very smooth.The lobby bar was our haunt at night. It has it's own drinks menu and I personally loved the Watermelon Crush.  The bartenders at the Lobby bar were the best and a special shout out to Lenny, Francis and Luiz for being masters at mixology and their constant smiles. There were plenty of staff who went out of their way to help us enjoy our time, Willy Mercado and Jorge Castillo our servers at Rare did a great job.   Reynaldo (Big Papi fan) the bartender outside the Rare restaurant was so funny and fast and once again with a smile on his face we just enjoyed joking with him.

     I really have nothing negative to say about the Resort and really did enjoy the Royal Service. The upgrade is worth it to have you restaurants booked for you and have you towels laid out and a spot reserved for you at the pool. We received several fruit trays, but we did hear that some of others received a cheese and wine tray which would have been nice. We did avail ourselves of the pillow service which is nice if you like a feather pillow. We did not get the bubblebath treatment as this was a girl's trip,but some of the couples that we met said it was a welcome surprise when they got home from the beach. I loved the quietness of the Royal Side. The pool was spotless and as I said before Angel would just appear to ask if you needed anything, water, drink. What more could you ask for. We had a couple of glitches from the management side regarding upgrades and courtesies that our credit card company had compted. Figuring out the details of this was slightly painful and time consuming, but in the end was worked out, but no without some perseverance of my cotravleler.

We loved the food at Palazzo, Rare and the (can't remember)Tapinaki restaurant. Naos the buffet has plenty of options and the pizza was really good. Blue Agave was good for lunch...burgers off the grill and the chicken off the grill and guacamole was delish. Fuergo was not my cup of tea, food was OK, however our waiter tried to improve our meal by offering us lobster off the grill which was appreciated. 

Overall, great experience and would highly recommend this resort. We met some lovely people staying there and really did have a enjoyable time.

reviews.author: MariaE
reviews.title: Most Amazing Wedding Weekend!
reviews.text:
We had the most amazing wedding at Palma Real with 85 guests in February. It was everything we ever wished for and so much more! 

The resort itself is unbelievable. We have stayed at MANY all inclusive "luxury" resorts throughout the Caribbean as well as Punta Cana, and nothing compares to Palma Real. It is beautiful, well kept, big enough to never feel crowded or clustered, yet small enough where everything is in "one place". You can relax on the beach, have the most amazing gourmet dinners (throughout Palma Real and the Reserve - Aqua was by far our favorite restaurant), or you can dance the night away at one of the bars. You never get bored and the drinks and food are always flowing. Everything is extremely clean and luxurious. The rooms may need a bit of updating, especially the ones close to the ocean (not the brand new building, of course) as there is a ton of humidity getting into the rooms (our wedding posters and papers would get curled up). One of the guests did not have hot water, and the workers tried fixing it several times without success. We stayed in the royal service section, which we highly recommend and think its worth the money especially if you are traveling as a couple or a small group and can take advantage of the royal service pool and beach section. But we do think the rooms should get updated just a bit, as the new family concierge section is a thousand times nicer. Don't discount the lobby bar - they have by far the best drinks out of all the bars on the property. The staff is also great throughout the resort, the service from the bartenders, to the butlers, is second to none. For our mini moon we stayed at 2 other "luxury all inclusives" and we wished we never left Palma Real! Could not recommend the resort more. It will forever have a special place in our hearts and we plan on coming back all the time. 

All of our wedding events were unbelievable. Thank you to Raquel and the Romance Department team for putting up the wedding of our dreams. Raquel brought my very-particular vision to life, and succeeded all of my expectations. We had several events throughout 3 days and they were all exceptional. She organized all of our decor exactly the way we imagined it, managed all of our vendors and guests, and kept me calm throughout the whole process. She answered my endless emails and phone calls without hesitation and always with a smile. I could not recommend Raquel and the Romance Department more - they were the best. The food was also incredible at all the events and all of our guests had the time of their lives. The compliments are still pouring a month later. The only real issue we had was with the salon. I booked the bridal suite for myself and my 9 bridesmaids, confirming 4 stylists several times via email before arrival (with a full schedule for each stylist/bridesmaid), but only 3 showed up on the day of the wedding, which made us late for pictures and caused unnecessary anxiety. Unfortunately, there was nothing we could have done about it, as they had a stupid excuse of an "injury", but for future brides i would maybe require a contract from the salon to avoid such issues. Raquel was also furious with them, and it was not on the Romance Department at all, they have nothing to do with the salon. Away from that, everything was unbelievable, and so much better then we could have ever imagined. 

Thank you Palma Real and the Romance Department for the best week of our lives! See you all very soon!

reviews.author: annronnieb
reviews.title: Exceeded my expectations
reviews.text: Just back from Paradisus Palma Real and really enjoyed it!  Weather was amazing and upgrade to Royal Service was worth every penny.  This was a girls trip and all we wanted was to be pampered and they delivered.  Special shout out to Angel at the pool/beach bar and our butler Miguel.  Both always had a smile and couldn't do enough for us.  Literally, we didn't want for anything.  Angel spoiled us rotten and we so appreciated him - he was amazing!  We never once looked for him, he was just there ready to get us a cool drink or set us up in the shade when it was too hot. There were many others that spoiled us as well including Lenny from the lobby bar.   Food was excellent and entire resort was gorgeous - highly recommend Royal service as it provided a quiet atmosphere if you wanted and a couple more options for restaurants.

reviews.author: Delia K
reviews.title: Best Experience
reviews.text:
Although we have stayed at other 5 star resorts, as well as the other Paradisus Resort at Punta Cana a number of times, we would say this is one was the best of them all.  The service, food, and beach facilities were all excellent.
Our butler Emilio Adonis was very attentive to our daily needs, and looked after our requests very efficiently.
The beach concierge Francisco Cabrera was excellent in providing our beach beds/lounges every day, and looked after our drink orders on the beach.
We would like to specially thank our server at the breakfast restaurant Pollazzio, Felix Garcia, and our server Jhonny at the luncheon buffet, for always getting us a good table and remembering our drink order.
The individuals at the Royal Service, together with the facilities this provides, are a compliment to this resort, and we would definitely recommend them to anyone who decides to stay at this resort.

reviews.author: edielloyd
reviews.title: Coming Back
reviews.text: Resort spotless. Food 100%. Service 200%. Luis Sanchez Best Butler ever. We were spoiled. Gabriella Royal Service Manager the Best. Everyone worked very very hard to make this a once in a lifetime trip. Ok maybe twice or three times.

reviews.author: dcc321
reviews.title: Average stay
reviews.text: I have stayed at this property before and enjoyed it much more last time.  Maybe it was just an off week.  No major problems, just a lot of smaller ones.  The majority of the staff is extremely friendly.  Most of the food was very good.  Spa staff is great.  I would stay here again if I come back to Punta Cana - but would not come to Punta Cana just for the resort.

reviews.author: charcome
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: Julio from naos was extremely accommodating . He went above and beyond . He fixed us a plate with munchies at the restaurant when it was closed . We were late getting there after lunch . He even offered to make us a Hamburger . At the bargrita , Carlos Pie served us some tasty margaritas . We spent a lot of time visiting with Carlos . We had good conversation and a lot of laughs . He made me this  fancy flower  out of straws and drew me a picture of a flower .He helped to add to good memories of my best trip yet . When we were at breakfast Daniel Espinosa would come over and greet us and welcome us with open arms of course and Salvador Siguredad was also very nice

reviews.author: charcome
reviews.title: Best trip ever
reviews.text: From serving us at breakfast and lunch to serving us at dinner Jesus Pereyra and Alexander went above and beyond . They were so accommodating and always very friendly . Jesus made suggestions of different dishes and food choices to try which I did . They even brought an ice bucket to our table for our wine. Excellent!! I can not say enough good things . Too many to mention .cant wait to return . Two of many that l met that I consider friends always. To help make my trip unforgettable and hard to top

reviews.author: Tina K
reviews.title: Everything you could want in an all inclusive resort.
reviews.text:
My BFF and I just returned from a one week stay in a suite in the Royal Service wing, in an ocean view suite. Our personal butler Miguel Abreu was all we could ask for. And the service we received on the beach from Martin Tineo was spot on. When we dined at the buffet restaurant Naos, we requested to sit in the section Juan Suarez was attending to, along with Yuderkis Javier, as they both went beyond to make us comfortable. And the food selection was exceptional.
And each of us enjoyed a massage at the Yhi Spa in The Reserve, mine was administered by Maria and my friend had Carmen. We were greeted by Marlene Andres who was all smiles. And Beralisis was a charmer.
I must admit that I won this trip, so other than extra gratuity all around we didn't have to spend a dime, but I could not believe how wonderfully we were treated in all areas of the resort.
Maid service was always friendly and perfectly planned. And the mini bar was stocked daily with our preferred drinks.
The only thing we found lacking was the room service food. It had to travel quite a ways to get to us and was not as fresh as we would have liked. But the restaurants more than made up for that, with excellent food and service.
I will, and have already, recommend this resort to friends.

reviews.author: Veronica B
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real Resort is AMAZING!
reviews.text: If you are planning a beach vacation to Punta Cana, stay at the Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real Resort and you won't be disappointed. We were there earlier in March and it was fabulous! The Reserve is separate from the main hotel and you feel like you are in your own private resort. We had a garden room, which was the size of an apartment, with a hot tub and garden lounge area outside. Our conceirge, Keren Morel, was fantastic! She did everything for us from making dinner reservations to sending wine and a cheese/appetizer plate to our room to having the chef prepare us an authentic Dominican lunch! Beautiful beach, lots of activities or

reviews.author: islozada@yahoo.com
reviews.title: Fabuloso Viaje con Amigas
reviews.text:
Dionisio Rodriguez - Gerente de Servicios al Cliente Club Melia - Gracias por sus atenciones y diligencia durante nuestra estadia Enero 17 al 27 - Profesionales con esta capacidad son muy importantes en cada institucion de renombre.

reviews.author: alk
reviews.title: Great girls trip at Paradisus Palma Real!
reviews.text:
Went to Paradisus Palma Real for a Girls weekend for 3 nights in March. There were 6 of us (all in our 40's).  We stayed in the Royal Service section of the hotel so this review is for Royal Service. After arriving at the hotel by private transfer that the hotel arranged in advance (this is extra), we were warmly greeted and taken to the Royal Service lounge. Waiting for us were some snacks and drinks. After checking in, we were introduced to our butler Jose Lugo. We can’t say enough great things about Jose. He is super sweet with an adorable smile. He could not do enough for us to make us happy. He took us on a tour of the resort and then took us to our rooms. He made our dinner reservations.  Each room received a phone where we could call Jose whenever we needed anything. He even surprised my friend and filled the room with balloons on her birthday. 

The rooms: beautiful, quiet and updated. The bed was very comfortable and we slept very well. You can control the thermostat and the room was a great temperature. The bathroom was marble with a rain shower. The only problem with the room is the bathroom has shutters to the bedroom so it is not so private. 

Food: This was my first experience at an all inclusive. The dinner buffet had a large selection including grilled lobster. The Royal service has a private restaurant for breakfast and lunch. We ate there for breakfast. While the buffet was not as large as the main buffet, it was good and the service was more intimate. For lunches we ate at the main buffet. The pizza is amazing. They make all different kinds right there in the wood burning oven. There is a nice salad bar and lots of grilled fish and meats, cheeses, ceviche, salads, desserts, etc. The food was OK not great. Our best dinner was at Rare and our dinner at Vento as ok as well. Service is excellent at the restaurants. The alcohol is not top shelf. If you want top shelf you pay additional. The wine is ok not great. 

Beach- When you stay in Royal Service you have your own section of the beach. You are assigned someone at the beach that will reserve chairs for you. Our person was Pedro and he was a very jolly man and so helpful and kind. 

Pools- the Royal Service has its own pool. There is a very large pool with a swim up bar as well. My only complaint is that the pools aren’t heated so they were a little cold. 

Spa- we went to the Spa at the Reserve which was a really beautiful spa and bigger than the spa at the regular part of the hotel. The spa was great but very expensive. Too expensive in my opinion.

Service at the Royal Service is really exceptional and we are a group of very picky women that are used to traveling to fine hotels. 

The resort is beautiful and clean. I would come back to this resort but I would only stay at the Royal Service which is adult only. If I come back with kids I would stay at the Reserve and they have something similar to the royal service called Family Concierge. The extra fee is worth it.

reviews.author: Haleigh C
reviews.title: Excellent service and facilities
reviews.text: I love to lounge at the pool all day with a drink in my hand. Raul Jimenez and Andy De La Cruz were instrumental in achieving this. They are excellent! Raul always helped us get a nice cabana and Andy makes great drinks fast. I would love it if I could live like this every day.

reviews.author: Jennifer T
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation with Excellent Service
reviews.text:
I would highly recommend the Royal Service, our butler, Luis Sanchez, was fantastic!!! Very helpful, and took care of all of our details, which allowed us to truly enjoy the resort. 
All of the restaurants had delicious food and of course great service. The Palazo had the best fish and Felix Garcia is one of the best waiters, and always right on with the recommendations.
For a special dinner and to experience service that is truly second to none, you have to go to Passion!!!! Ask for Sergio and Rodny, they will astound you with their flare for creating an amazing evening.
As if all of this wasn't blissful enough...take it to the next level and visit the spa.  Anny Adams will take away any lingering cares you might have.  
Warm winds, beautiful beaches and generous people make this an ideal vacation spot!!

reviews.author: Jamsan24
reviews.title: Buenos tiempos
reviews.text: (RAYNOLD Tamayo) gracias por su atencion muy buen colaborador  a el igual juan cruz, emilio baldez, luis florian, naomi son personas  que hacen este hotel mejor con su  atencion buenas personas que hacen de nosotros muy buenas vacaiones super exelente resort ademas u buen servicio y un equipode actividades exelente  sin dudas regresamos

reviews.author: Rick Z
reviews.title: Excellent Service and beautiful setting!
reviews.text: Definitely choose the Royal Service as its worth the extra money.  Our butler, Jose Lugo was excellent and very attentive.  He took great care of us!!  The food at all of the restaurants was excellent and the property itself was immaculate and very well kept.  This was our 3rd time to this same resort and this coming from someone who said they would never go to an all inclusive.  Its just too easy and relaxing that it keeps me going back.

reviews.author: Lorene68
reviews.title: Excellent Staff
reviews.text:
I stayed at the resort with a group of friends, and we received the Royal Service treatment.  Our butler was Faustino, and outside at the pool and beach we were taken care of by Carlos Rosario.  They were EXCELLENT, very attentive, friendly, and willing to bend over backwards for us.  Faustino took care of all our dinner reservations.  They ensured we had space reserved at the beach or pool everyday.  We were really sad to say good-bye to them - they were so great.

At the spa, I received two massages throughout the week. I did not request anyone in particular either time, but ironically I got the same person both times - Rosa Rombero.  She was amazing.  So kind, and worked out some knots that were bothering me.  

The entertainment staff went above and beyond to ensure we had fun.  Angel is EVERYWHERE - pool at mid-day, beach party at night.  We loved him.  He was engaging and always smiling.  Rey was our Zumba instructor - full of life, fun, eager to get us all involved.  Ruben headed up our fingerpainting class - excellent teacher, and talented painter.

I would come back to this resort in a heartbeat, no questions asked.  One of the best vacations I've ever had.

reviews.author: Danielle P
reviews.title: Vacation of a lifetime
reviews.text: This resort is stunning - very clean, incredible service, hugely positive atmosphere and very comfortable room (air-conditioned). We had Royal Service and I really did feel like royalty - our butler, Luis Sanchez, was wonderful. All of the employees we had occasion to speak with were lovely. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a luxury, relaxation based vacation.

reviews.author: Emily L
reviews.title: A great experience with fantastic staff
reviews.text: We stayed in one of the Royal Suites which was such a great experience! Our butlers Samuel and Miguel were so friendly and helpful and really made the experience what it was. They would come and look for our group every day to check in on us, see what our plans were for the day and relay messages and information between other group members. Martin on the beach was so lovely, reserving our beds every day for us and Wanda at the bar made sure we were never thirsty! The food was fantastic, with chefs making most food to order a the buffet. Facilities are 10/10 too! The reserve suite had Thierry Mugler toiletries, one of the most comfortable beds I have ever experienced, and house cleaning that made sure our beds were turned down every night and the room was spotless every morning. Thank you so much for a gorgeous stay.

reviews.author: Tracy W
reviews.title: Great Girls Trip!
reviews.text:
Just got back from Paradisus Palma Real.  There were 6 of us and we stayed in the adults only Royal Service section which exceeded our expectations in every way.  The hotel was gorgeous, well maintained, clean, beautiful grounds.  We had a standard garden view and our room was large and updated.  Our butler Jose was very attentive and helped make our trip even more special.  Jose was always there when we had a request, took care of any concerns, and made sure we were always happy.  He found out it was my birthday and surprised me with decorating my room with balloons and even getting a special cake for me at dinner.  We never worried about dinner reservations,Jose took care of everything.  

Another stand out staff member who stood pout was Pedro at the Royal Service pool.  He made sure  our chairs were set up by the beach every morning, and always made sure we had fresh fruit and drinks.  His personality was so pleasing, so warm and friendly and always cheerful.  Great guy! 

This is my fourth all-inclusive and was by far the best.   Food was good and we are a picky group and not so easy to please so we were pleasantly surprised.  We ate breakfast at Palazzo which was very good.  We ate lunch at the buffet at the main pool and it was good as well.   Fruit was amazing. Our best dinner was at Rare. 

We made our spa reservations at The Reserve - wow.  This spa was one of the nicest I have been to and I have been to Four Seasons and Ritz Carlton spas.  Get there early to experience the "water ritual".  50 minute massage was very expensive but I loved it and would do it again.   

I would recommend this place but will say that upgrading to Royal Service is imperative if you want guaranteed amazing service, updated room, quiet pool and beach.

reviews.author: jewelz2016
reviews.title: Amazing long weekend in paradise
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real was wonderful. We stayed there for a wedding and long weekend, and couldn't have been happier.  Delicious food, good quality drinks, beautiful property, and friendly staff.  Overall an extremely pleasant experience. Would definitely recommend to others and hope to return someday.

reviews.author: 513Bubbles
reviews.title: 8 days in paradise
reviews.text: We would like to thank and give praise to Restaurant Palazzo for Royal Service guests only.  We would also like to compliment Felix Garcia (our waiter), Zenovia (our hostess) and Angel (our butler) for their outstanding services.  The people, food and weather were spectacular - see you next year.

reviews.author: nicklap
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: The hotel and beach were beautiful. Every one of the staff members had smiles on their faces at all times. Special thanks to our poolside bartenders. Hanging out with Paudua, Wellington Reyes, Antonio, Gustavo Pequero and Leonardo Reyes is a must.

reviews.author: Maribel F
reviews.title: Mis vacaciones preferidas
reviews.text: Me encantó el hotel, volvería sin dudarlo. Todo limpio y la comida buena, lo mejor la animación y Miguel cedaño muy simpático y profesional. He ido varias veces por allí a otros hoteles y siempre me vuelvo encantada, será que aquello me encanta.

reviews.author: Gail R
reviews.title: Another wonderful experience
reviews.text: I have just returned from a five day stay at this resort, visiting with friends at the Members  Club.   Since my last trip the resort has undergone some refreshing and remodelling all of which serves only to increase the enjoyment factor.  As always, though, it is the care and attention of particular staff members that make the vacation experience both excellent and memorable.   Many of them have been there for years, remember you, and go out of their way to welcome you back. would particularly commend and thank Francisco Estrella of the Members Pool for his hard work, ready smile and willingness to assist at every turn, as well as Wily Mercado at Rare, Franklin de la Rosa at Olio, and Wisly Fortune at the Mexican/Luncheon Cafe, for their stellar service and for making our dining experiences totally enjoyable.  I highly recommend this resort and know that these individuals, particularly, will go out of their way to ensure that you have the best possible vacation experience.

reviews.author: laurenl40
reviews.title: A satisfied guest!
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort for a friends wedding.  The ceremony and reception was nothing short of amazing.  As for the resort itself the staff extremely friendly and helpful!  Activities were great and the entire resort was beautifully kept.

reviews.author: MABL_13
reviews.title: Deseando volver...
reviews.text:
Hace unos días que he vuelto de Punta Cana y como siempre la experiencia ha sido maravillosa. Somos un grupo de amigos que  llevamos varios años escapándonos una semana de febrero al Royal Service de este hotel increíble.
Nada más llegar ya sientes esa hospitalidad y simpatía propia de los dominicanos, aunque nada es  comparable como reencontrarnos con nuestro querido Pedro, que año tras año nos atiende en la playa y nos hace sentirnos como reyes. Sin duda, no hay otro como él.
El hotel es fantástico, tiene una zona de playa paradisíaca, las instalaciones son estupendas, las habitaciones son espaciosas y bonitas, las camas enormes y comdísimas, el buffet ha mejorado mucho y es excelente. Aunque por poner alguna pega, los zumos del desayuno me gustaban más en años anteriores, ya que aunque 
ahora hay una amplia variedad ya hechos, antes te los hacían en el momento a tu gusto.
A pesar de todo lo bueno del hotel que he comentado, lo mejor es su personal, que es el que marca la diferencia con otros hoteles de la misma categoría. Este año hemos tenido la suerte de contar con Thomas Newton como mayordomo que se ha desvivido por hacernos la estancia aún más agradable y no quiero dejar de mencionar a todo el personal del buffet que tan bien nos ha tratado.
Lo único que me queda por decir es que ¡estoy deseando volver!

reviews.author: Alicia K
reviews.title: Luxurious & Beautiful while treated like royalty
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd trip to this resort. For 9 yrs we have gone to Mexico,Jamaica, Aruba or here. This is by far the best. We were in the upgraded area which is a must because families are on property. But the Palazzo is adult only private dining and above expectations. We had a butler, Luis Sanchez, very polite, attentive and made it happen. Whatever we asked. Our cabana man, Carlos Rosaria, was able to secure a lounger under the umbrella every day. There is water spin class, water aerobics, and paddle board  yoga in the pool. Young energetic staff which kept us having fun. Yudi was very bubbly and knew how to do proper exercises.
The beach walk is breathtaking and very safe. There are many activites available off site and on property.
Thank you so much for a wonderful week!!

reviews.author: ronconway
reviews.title: Excellent resort - The staff made this the perfect trip!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the staff was wonderful!  We traveled with 7 of our friends and enjoyed every minute.  If traveling with adults only and want to schedule an off property excursion make sure to state "adults only"! We booked a 4 hour catamaran excursion unfortunately there were children aboard.  I love children however there was drinking and loud music that I wouldn't want my children exposed to. Other than that it was perfect!

reviews.author: Katie D
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: This hotel offered great service and beautiful surroundings. Our room was immaculate daily, and when healthier snacks were requested, apples and peanut butter were immediately brought to the room. There were plenty of activities offered, and the restaurants were delicious. Naomi, in particular, was very helpful and offered wonderful suggestions and service.

reviews.author: Lori M
reviews.title: A great vacation!
reviews.text: My stay here has been the vacation of a lifetime. Some highlights include getting to know the dancers in the show Johanna, Kenya and Katerina. They went out if their way to make this vacation the best it could be. They have amazing talent!  Our butler, Gabrielle took care of our every need.  Other highlights include the amazing coffee at the coffee gelato bar and the food especially at Vento. It was truly exceptional. Thanks to all the that made the trip memorable.  I will defenitly be back!

reviews.author: daniel v
reviews.title: Excelente antención
reviews.text:
Quiero agradecer a todos quienes nos atendieron en nuestra estancia en el Hotel. Como parte del Club Melia fue un agrado ser atendidos de manera tan cordial y atenta por parte de todos.
Especialmente quiero agradecer a Raul Jimenez que nos atendió en la playa, fue super atento y disponible para todas nuestras necesidades.
Las personas de Aseo de la habitación, muy amables y eficientes en su trabajo.
A Hector Encarnación y a los Sommeliers del Restaurant Passion por su servicio y amabilidad en explicarnos cada uno de los platos.
A Wander del Restaurant Vento que nos atendió nuestra ultima noche en el hotel y fue muy simpatico.
Por último al personal del Yhi Spa, en especial a Andris, Evelin, Ana Miguelina y Carmen Nuris por su excelente atención y trato.
Por últimos a quienes nos recibieron en el Lobby del Club muchas gracias por su preocupación y simpatía durante nuestra estancia.
Muchas Gracias

Daniel Vargas

reviews.author: sgibbons2016
reviews.title: Fabulous trip with good friends!
reviews.text: From the minute you walk in this resort, you will fall in love.  The property is amazing and immaculate.  We stayed in the Royal Service section which is the only way to go in my opinion if you do not have children. The oceanfront rooms were lovely, clean and updated.  Our butler, Thomas, was great.  Always there when we needed him for anything from dinner reservations or stocking our bar.  Carlos, at the private beach, had our lounges set up and was always there to refill our cocktails. The restaurants exceeded our expectations, although the private( for Royal Service) restaurant was our favorite. I have stayed in many All-inclusive resorts and this is now one of my favorites. My only negative would be they serve drinks at the pool and beach in paper cups.  I had read another review, so I was prepared with my Tervis tumbler from home.

reviews.author: tishab930
reviews.title: Too large of a result to give good service
reviews.text:
Would not recommend this resort if you are planning a trip to the Dominican. This is a large resort with close to 500 rooms and it is hard to navigate due to the size. We had "Royal Service" so were expecting a lot based on the website. My biggest complaint was with the maid service. On day 1 we had 4 towels, 2 hand towels, 2 wash cloths, and 4 pillows (two double beds). By day 2 we were down to only 2 towels after room cleaning. We were not able to get anymore hand towels or wash cloths except for 1 hand towel which was obtained by a friends butler for me. And then on the last night there they took two of our pillows! 
My butler was my second biggest complaint. We saw him twice during our stay. We didn't need much but he didn't show up until the last day when it was tipping time.
The main buffet was were we ate breakfast and lunch. They do not require hand gel at the front, which I have seen at multiple resorts so they are just asking for an illness outbreak. Food was okay, nothing special. Eat at the restaurants if you want better food choices. There was a specialty restaurant but it was $70pp and a winery that was $80pp.
Spa was overpriced ($160 for 50 minute massage) and it was a terrible massage. They clearly don't require certification like they do in the states.
Our toilet leaked so we had to turn off the water at night. Maintenance didn't seem concerned when we mentioned it after a call to have them unclog it. It was never fixed during our stay.
The air conditioner in the room was soooo loud! We wore earplugs at night because of this and because of golf carts driving by for hours and because the maids carts running loudly across the tile floors first thing in the morning.
Overall, the service and food we received were NOT worth the money we spent by any standards! We paid $3400 for 4 nights. We had stayed in Punta Cana several weeks before this trip and stayed at CHIC ($2000 for 5 nights during a special they had running, which they do frequently if you get on their email list), which is a smaller resort but was half the price, newer, and we had a great experience with the service ("Diamond Club" - get Rolondo as your butler!) and proximity of everything you could need for a great vacation. If we go back, we will be staying at CHIC again.
Hope this review helps someone save some money!

reviews.author: Delilah N
reviews.title: EXCELLENT !!!
reviews.text: The place was AMAZING ! The staff was friendly, hospitable and funny. My favorite bartenders were Jeffrey, Jan and Lilian (male), on the excursion Side by Side Reyes was awesome and the young guy with green eyes (I forgot his name). The rooms were clean and spacious. the water was turquoise, warm and clean as the sand was also clean and white. I will definitely be coming back to this hotel asap !!!

reviews.author: MegGQ
reviews.title: Well-kept grounds, but otherwise very average
reviews.text: Overall it was a convenient trip during a 4-day weekend. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the grounds of the resort were beautiful and well maintained. The food presented at the buffet exceeded my expectations, however the other restaurants were below average and provided nothing special. The adult beverages were also lackluster, but that is to be expected from an all-inclusive. Our room was sufficient, however, it needed some TLC - chipped paint and furniture; the door knob on our main entry door was detached; housekeeping forgot to replace our pillow cases on a daily basis; and our water never got hot, only lukewarm. These are not game-changers, but should be addressed. I would not recommend this resort for a quiet couples weekend, as it's busy with children and other events (weddings, conferences, etc.).

reviews.author: Marie424
reviews.title: Annual Tradition not to be Missed!
reviews.text: I came here for a wedding a year ago and HAD to come back. My three girlfriends humored me (after a few of them showing cheaper option in Punta Cana) they finally said "ok" to spending extra $$. I told them it would be worth it. And boy were they happy!! This hotel is gorgeous. The drinks are to die for and the food is amazing. Fresh and so many selections. Make you own ceviche...YES PLEASE! Grilled calamari, pork shops, Paella to die for...We ate at the buffet and at the restaurants as well everywhere we went it was good food. I am a celiac and there were a million options for me at the buffet. We went to Fuego one night and they have allergies lists on the menu! The Mexican place did not, but they accommodated me easily.   We did have some rain one of the days, but after going to the buffet we ended up having the best time with Ferden de Los Santos our server. He made us forget all about the rain and we had a wonderful time. The bar upstairs has some of the best mixologists that make fresh amazing drinks. (I am from NYC and know the top mixologits in the city these guys can compete). Watermelon Crush is in my dreams.  Everything about this hotel is perfection. The only thing I would complain about it that the hot tubs at the spa are not really hot at all and the steam room was not working. Besides that I will be coming here every year until I die. It is a paradise that should not be missed.

reviews.author: lndsy213
reviews.title: Greatness
reviews.text:
The hotel was amazing! Beautiful and clean. Everything was accessible. It wasn't to busy.
The entertainment was very energetic and got everyone excited to participate. They also had great night shows. Thanks Luis pegaro, Carmello and Big Mac:)
Food was exceptional. Everyone always remembered us and made us feel so welcomed. The manager of the buffet was super friendly and have everything running so smooth. We met Cristian Castro who was always greeting us with a smile. Thanks all for te great trip. It was sad to leave.

reviews.author: kck22
reviews.title: Royal service with butler Francisco P was the best!
reviews.text: We never stayed at a Royal service hotel before, it was absolutely wonderful, our butler Francisco Pwas fabulous. He made reservations at great restaurants and the food everywhere was great. The rooms were gorgeous and the outdoor spaces were breathtaking and well maintained. The staff was fun, accommodating and competent. The pool areas and beach areas were top notch. And no mosquitos! Discovery dolphins was great. Best excursion ever!

reviews.author: Iluvacas
reviews.title: Turn down for what
reviews.text: I've been at paridisus since yesterday and I'm so happy with the choice I made, the reviews aren't lying! Best food, best staff and beautiful hotel. Shout-outs to all my faves josias (Obama) and Luis florian--- amazing at every activity scene

reviews.author: auds2016
reviews.title: highly recommended resort
reviews.text: A VERY beautiful resort.  Well maintained and designed...  the view of the beach from the lobby is like from a post-card.  I spent 5 days with my highschool friends Suzanne and Audrey and that was the icing on the cake as we took in the sights and sounds of this spectacular paradise.   A big thank you to the staff who made the trip even more memorable.   Thank you to Vladimir Rodriguez and Liliana/Domingo Bethe who helped us when we were told we did not have a voucher to travel on the bus from the hotel to the airport.   Vladimir personally drove us to the airport and refused to take any money.  Professional service at its best is what it is.  Yudy Mercedes gave us personal attention on the entertainment scene.  A warm hearted soul and we hope that we will be able to come and visit you all once again if not more.  A holiday I will surely never forget and thanks to my friends Audrey and Suzanne whose company I thoroughly enjoyed.

reviews.author: frannie a.
reviews.title: still the best in punta cana!
reviews.text: i came to visit the resort 3 years ago with a good friend of mine and stayed at The Reserve. the service, amenities, food, accommodations, and overall vibe of the resort was already impeccable. we never lifted a finger and were pampered hand-and-foot during our whole stay. fast forward to winter 2016 and when i returned this time (with friends who haven't been to the resort prior), i was even more pleasantly surprised by how Melia/Paradisus stepped up their game! everything was of top quality - the service, most especially! to top it all off, the food, drinks, amenities, and ambiance have definitely gotten an upgrade. not that they needed an upgrade at all, but it's nice to know that Melia/Paradisus has become one of the names i trust when it comes to having a very laid-back, relaxing, and fun vacation! i'm already planning on going back to this resort and even more excited to explore the different melia properties in the caribbean!!! special thanks to our lovely wait staff and crew - lisange, luis, jose, alex, george, super mario, raynaldo, saidy, mencia!

reviews.author: Nathan S
reviews.title: Good time
reviews.text: Great place. Great service. Everyone is friendly. Rooms are beautiful!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Only negative is food isn't great.  Would have stayed longer if possible. Also no jacuzzi tubs unless you get a spa treatment.

reviews.author: KLE0417
reviews.title: Return to Paradise
reviews.text:
Our 8th trip to the Palma Real gives you some indication of our love for this beautiful resort. From the spectacular view as you first enter to the white sand beach it is everything you expect a Caribbean vacation to be. Because we have vacationed there so often we are treated like family and always look forward to seeing familiar faces. We travel with another couple and share a 2 bedroom lock off; perfect for us.

Breakfast and lunch at Naos is always a treat with a wide variety of dishes to tempt you. We enjoyed outstanding service from Alexander David, Davison Germaine, Carlos, Gustavo and Argenis. 

Francisco Estrella and his staff at the member's pool always see to our every need.

One of our favorite restaurants is Fuego where we enjoyed Dominican Prawns which taste just like lobster! Kelvin, Marcos, Jhonatan, and Jorge kept our wine glasses filled and the food coming - all of which is beautifully presented and perfectly cooked. 

We also enjoyed the food and service at Rare, Blue Agavae, and Aqua.

Dionisio Rodriguez, Juan Domingo, Malvis and the rest of the member services staff always go above and beyond to ensure we are happy with our accommodations and assist us in any way possible.

Jorge Mabte is a joy, always a smile and a willingness to help.

reviews.author: judylu2016
reviews.title: One of the best resorts I've ever stayed at!
reviews.text:
A friend and I stayed in the Royal Service section of the hotel.  We had a wonderful room on the third floor, where we had an ocean view on one side of the balcony.  The room had plenty of space and was spotlessly maintained.  We appreciated the adults only setting, with far less crowding than the main area of the resort.  One great amenity was the personal butler.  Our butler for the first 8 days was Angel Monegro, and for the last 3 days was Jose Salvador.  They were both very professional, friendly and helpful, and available whenever we needed help (we were given a cellphone for contacting them).  Among other things, they'd make recommendations & reservations for the various resort restaurants as well as restaurants outside the resort.
