It was great to have one individual to go to whenever you needed help or advice. 

The beach and pool areas were gorgeous (loved the Bali beds by the pools!).  Martin Tineo, the Beach/Pool Concierge, was always very accommodating in setting up places for us on the beach or by the pools.  The staff always walked around both areas to see if we needed anything.  At the Sunset Bar, head bartender Wanda Correa was so friendly & would offer suggestions if we wanted a tropical specialty drink.

Royal Service had its own restaurant, Palazzo, open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  We enjoyed this restaurant more than any of the other specialty restaurants at the resort.  The breakfast buffet offered many choices, and dinners were fabulous!  We loved everyone working there:  Zenova Nova (hostess), Marino Payans (manager), Juan de Aza, Osualdo, Miguel, Jhoneidy (serving staff), and our favorite servers Richard and Felix.

We both thought this was the best resort we've been to, and would definitely return -- even asking for the same butler and room!  The beaches had beautiful fine white sand, which never felt hot on bare feet.

Only two negatives to report, which would not keep us from returning:  1) There are no elevators, so that if you want a room with the best view (3rd floor) you'll need to be able to climb that frequently.  2)  We were told that the mini-bar in our room would be automatically restocked every day (water, juice, soda).  It never was, without us having to  call Room Service or ask our butler.

Bottom line:  What a wonderful place to vacation at -- beautiful room, beach, pool, very friendly staff!

reviews.author: S M
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation with friends!
reviews.text: Gorgeous weather, Beautiful Beaches, Wonderful staff...Gracias Hilario y Unavi!  Played on clay tennis courts daily. Pools were perfect and not crowded. Cocktails and vino flowed and complemented beautiful dinners and deserts. Great entertainment at Gaby Beach during evenings. We will be returning again next year with more friends and family.   Recommend with friends and/or family. Kids Club is #1!

reviews.author: Nathan S
reviews.title: Amazing! (Jose and Raynol)
reviews.text:
I recently wrote a great review for this place, and when I left I realized I loved it so much I needed to talk about it more! 

The first day at the resort I met two employees of the entertainment department. Jose Fernandez and Raynol Tamayo. These two amazing gentlemen instantly made my vacation memorable. The entire time they made each minute fun! I made a relationship with them that will be with me for the rest of my life. They have really inspired me and have changed my life. When I left the resort I suddenly started to tear up because I missed them already. I am gonna do my best to keep in contact with them! Hopefully I can go back to this amazing resort and be with them again! 

Many thanks to Jose and Raynol!

reviews.author: Victor_Nessytov
reviews.title: Awesome vacation and relax!
reviews.text:
My dear friends and readers!  If you either decide to have a vacation in Dominicans and you are looking for not just good, but for over expectations Hotel, put your attention to this Hotel.
to be honesty it was my first trip to Dominicans, our friends recommended us this hotel , and I have never regret about the decision to go there.
The area of the hotel just HUGE. and it always clean.
There are several big and equipped swimming pools with the bars either connected with the pools or next to it.
the staff is very warm, helpful and friendly.
you ALWAYS get whatever you need.
the room was very good. Honestly we got the room with the leak in air condition system in bathroom , but once we claimed the case, we were offered another better room, or they promised us to fix it immediately. we were tired after long trip, so decided to stay in the room on condition this leak is fixed asap. And they did it. in half of hour.
That was only one unpleasant thing for all our 2 weeks stay there ( but we understand and appreciate to fast reaction ).
there are several restaurants you need to order Ala card, and all the rest just opened without pre-order.
the kitchen - very tasty, always something new , any kind of food are always fresh. you have a lot of the options all the time.
there are some activities like concerts, dancing etc.
and very clean beach.
I suggest:
1. if you want to have 1-st line on beach - do reserve day before.
2. Go to the restaurant from the opening hours and you will not wait in line to take fantastic food from cook, who cooked it in front of you especially for you :-)
3.have with you small money ( exchanges by 1 dollar banknotes ) so you will enjoy to give a tips to staff whenever you are and you will get than extra service with a lot of impression.
Thank you guys of Hotel. we will come back again!

reviews.author: Cunningk50
reviews.title: Amazing and luxurious
reviews.text: My husband and I came to Paradisus for a destination wedding one of our friends was having and a mini honeymoon for ourselves.   We upgraded to the Royal Service option and we had a butler, Jose Salvador.  He was fabulous and he took excellent care of us. Jose made sure we had reservations at the dining places we wanted.  He reserved the cabanas for us at the pool and if we had any questions he was right there to answer them for us.   If we were at the pool or at the beach, Carlos Rosario made sure we wanted for nothing.  The level of service we received will definitely bring us back.  The restaurants that Jose recommended were the best!  I was not disappointed at all.  If we wanted a quick bite to eat at the buffet Alexander Guzman made sure we had everything we needed.  I have been to another resort in Punta Cana and the food was just so so and the staff was nice, but Paradisus exceeded my expectations at every level.  Even when we were leaving everyone was still quiet attentive.  Our bag handler Emmanuel Bautista made sure we got in our last photos of the lovely views and even taught us a few local sayings.  I would recommend this place to anyone who wanted a nice relaxing get away, if you wanted to party with friends, and if you wanted to bring the family.  There was a place for everyone.  Thank you for the wonderful memories!

reviews.author: TTravel33
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel!
reviews.text: Best hotel in the area. I would only stay in a 5 star in Punta Cana. The beaches were a little disappointing but the pool made up for it!  The people and service were 5 star!!! Attend the shows at night- definitely wonderful and entertaining!

reviews.author: erniedickens
reviews.title: Nice, nice, nice
reviews.text: We had a very big room with a humongus bed, and a nice balcony.  We were there with three other couples, and we would have breakfast together at the great buffet, and then go on excursions together, or not (maybe just hang around the resort and hit the beach or a pool and have a nice lunch someplace at the resort), and then gather in the lobby for drinks, and then go to a very nice dinner at one of the many really good restaurants, and then take in some entertainment - all included!  In addition, there were also some nice shops.  Our excursions were great fun also.  Our group was all adults, but we think this would be a really great destination for a family vacation.

reviews.author: gxarchu
reviews.title: Vacation in Paradise
reviews.text: Paradisus did not disappoint.  We travelled to celebrate our friend's 40th birthday and wanted nothing but friends, fun, sun and comfort.  We booked the Royal Service and it delivered.  Our butler, Argenis Romero, did an outstanding job making sure we could everything we ever needed.  He went above and beyond to make the actual birthday special with a decorated poolside cabana complete with balloons, chocolates and a birthday greeting in flower petals.  He then got a personalized birthday cake delivered to the room.  The trip was everything we wanted and more!  I highly recommend the resort and the Royal Service.  It was worth it.  Thanks Argenis and the many other staff members who made our stay enjoyable.

reviews.author: Susan K
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
Royal Service at hotel Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa -adults only all inclusive was amazing. Our butler JOSE SALVADOR was excellent, polite, courteous, friendly and could not do enough for us, making our visit so enjoyable, dinner reservations, favorite wine in our room, etc. our friends had Fermin Mota who was equally as excellent. Ocean view suite beautiful, all restaurants great, beach and pool huts and beds great. Cannot wait to go back.
Susan from Great Neck!

reviews.author: briannaanidep
reviews.title: LOVE THE BEACH
reviews.text: AWESOME last minute FUN in the SUN trip with the GIRLS! The hotel and grounds were beautiful! The beach was beautiful! The food and drinks were great! The staff was all very friendly & fun!  Elizabeth from the Reserve makes sure all your needs are met.  Jose and Ramon from the beach go above and beyond with many laughs! My girls and I had so much fun with the gentleman who gives the dance lessons on the beach and does many activities throughout the day!

reviews.author: linda z
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: My girlfriends and myself go on a winter getaway yearly and have been going to aruba for the past 10 years ,we decided to try an all inclusive in Punta Cana .We  researched different resorts and  decided on Paradisus.Our first impression was the beautiful grounds,the smiling faces ,wewere  wisked away to VIP check in and told we were upgraded to the Reserve .WOW!!!! We were beyond thrilled w the beautiful suite ! I can honestly say every employee of the resort was beyond helpful.Any negative reviews about this resort or employees have to be written by impossible people ,the type that will find some thing negative in any situation.Every person we came in contact had a smile and kind word! We love the beach and were not disappointed    Beautiful Beach Area! The staff was great ,our favorites Louis and Ramone were beyond Great! All in all a fabulous resort w great food, drinks, staff .Hope to be lucky enough to visit this wonderful resort again!!!!!

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Pool Service
reviews.text: Louis at the pool is awesome.  i watched him one morning walk around an have conversations with every single person or groups sitting at the pool.  Very friendly & personable.  Great addition to the staff

reviews.author: rocco c
reviews.title: Great Time Great Food
reviews.text:
Been to Punta Cana a few times always choosing all inclusives. Most of them the food always feel short. Recently gave Paridisus a try after reading the great reviews. Couldn't be happier and planing a return visit. Definitely spring for the Royal Service. You will be given a butler who i used to make sure all my dinner plans, beach chairs, etc are planned for you the entire trip so you can actually worry about relaxing. 

Food was also on point at several of the restaurants which is hard to get in all inclusive. 

Hotel is more low key at night and not a party hotel. They have an awesome mini lounge with a cool vibe and drinks to relax at night.

My only negative was the casino. It was small in size but the real issue was there shady practices when you start winning. They will change rules to games, limits, even how they deal the cards to mess up any flow of winnings from guests. I was playing with a lot of money and just felt it was very unprofessional and shady and not good practice to keep guests happy coming back for more. I never mind losing but needs to be fair as well. STRONGLY SUGGEST SKIPPING CASINO.

Other than that the place, food, beach, pool, drinks, and service were great.

reviews.author: 272marcellea
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Everything was great food, room was very comfortable, the staff was very friendly. Very clean offered different options as far as rooms and even food. Will definitely return in the future and let my friends and family know about Paradisus Punta Cana!!

reviews.author: mariee448
reviews.title: My Reserve in the Paradise!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I escaped the cold for 6 nights with another couple and had an absolutely great time at the Paradisus. We have been to several other Carribean islands and have done all inclusive vacations again and would definately return to The Reserve Punta Cana. The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable. We never once had to fight for or wait for a spot on the beach or by the pool and both were beautiful. As far as the restaurants go, there are many to choose from and we did not go to all of them. We had breakfast every day at the Gabi, which is the Reserve's buffet, and it was great. Lunch you can choose from several buffet spots or a la carte restaurants....our favorite was Vento followed by Fuego and The Grill....bottomless glasses of wine in them all. The service varied depending on where you are but on the whole it is a bit slower than we are used to in the states...if you've been to the carribbean before it is nothing suprising. You are never far from a bar and can always get what you need. 
 
We would all recommend this beautiful resort for a great time with friends or family!

Special mention to Mr. Adrian Alonso, The Hotel Manager; you can see him everyday talking with his guests taking care that you are having a great experience at the Reserve.

reviews.author: Jean-Luc L
reviews.title: La réserve Paradisus signifie le paradis reserve pour nous
reviews.text:
Le titre est en fait un jeu de mots mais oh combien vrai pour nous qui sommes fidèle à cet hôtel.
A chaque fois, c'est la même chose:
-un lieu paradisiaque, à notre avis l'hôtel le mieux placé dans la baie
-un hôtel fait de petits bâtiments construit dans un jardin d'une beauté incroyable tellement grand que l'on a l'impression d'être dans un parc nature en permanence
-9 restaurants tous différents et de qualité qui vous permettent de changer tous les soirs
-une direction très présente et disponible à ses clients
-un service incroyable, mais comment font ils pour être tous, toujours aussi souriant
S'ils peuvent me lire, je souhaiterai faire un petit coucou à:
*Juanilin, Ceslso, Anthony Cid pour leur sourire et leur gentillesse le matin au petit déjeuner et le soir au restaurant "Le Vento"
*Santos le serveur de la plage de la réserve pour sa bonne humeur quotidienne 
* Amby, Domingo et José au sport pour leur disponibilité et la qualité de leur jeu
* notre charmante hôtesse qui prend les commandes à l'Aqua
*notre femme de chambre et sa petite sculuture en serviette quotidienne
*enfin, la jeune femme qui nous a accompagné tous les soirs dans les restaurants pour notre plus grande satisfaction
on vous embrasse tous, ne changez rien

reviews.author: Charles S
reviews.title: Group vacation
reviews.text: I went with four friends and everyone of us loved the resort, and we all took part in different aspects: the gym, tennis, the beach, the spa, the pools, and the meals were terrific. We would all highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: P2P
reviews.title: FABULOUS Resort & Service
reviews.text: I just want to give a shout out to our personal Butler, Thomas Newton.  Thomas was absolutely incredible!!!  We splurged for Royal Service and I'm so glad we did.  Thomas tended to our every need and many extra special touches.  He was kind, attentive, professional and went out of his way to make sure we were happy.  I also want to express my gratitude for all of the staff at Paradisus, everyone was awesome!

reviews.author: advtravel
reviews.title: Good for a large, all-inclusive resort
reviews.text:
The resort and beach are beautiful. We were there at the end of January which was a relatively slow time.  We stayed in the Royal Service area which was well worth it for the private pool, private bar, restaurant and private beach areas. Our "butler" was very helpful and friendly and checked-in with us each day.

I admit to being a bit of a snobby traveler but still found the rooms beautiful and the grounds nice. The large spa in the Reserve section of the hotel was well worth a visit.  Our only disappointment was the quality and selection of food.  Who wants to eat lasagna, spaghetti or huge slabs of beef for lunch on an 85 degree day?? While there were other options, they didn't have any fun and easy pool fare (sandwiches, chips and salsa, etc...).  You can't order food poolside (which I understand). When we finally found chips and guac at a mexican restaurant: We were pretty disappointed to find they were the equivalent of Tostito's. How do you mess up chips and guac?!

Our only other complaint was the quality of music at the sunset bar and around the pool in the Royal Service section.  It was total elevator music and all of the guests were making fun/complaining about it.  The music killed any vibe.  The staff said they hear about it all the time but management refuses to change the music.  When some of us called guest services to request more fun Caribbean music, we were told someone would be right over.  No one ever showed up. 

Overall: We paid $1,800 for three nights of Royal Service and were happy with our visit.  We probably won't return due to the food quality but the trip itself was good, the alcohol flowed freely and the price was fair.

reviews.author: Dalinaf
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text:
Still here ,loving every minute. Started in Royal service which is great, moved to The Reserve for more room. Jasson, "AKA" Alex Rodriguez at the checkin
was very personable and treated us like family. It was smooth and quick.
Our butler is Hector who is the best butler I've ever had here, been coming here many times. Will post a final report.

reviews.author: Martha B
reviews.title: Wonderful Winter relaxation
reviews.text:
We traveled in January 2016 (21-26)- Transportation from the airport to the Paradisus complex was waiting and ready to take us to our hotel. We were greeted by very friendly staff at the hotel. Bags were delivered directly to a spacious room-we had chosen a king bed which was very comfortable. The was a separate living room with tv and filled mini-bar (refilled every day) and a small terrace (we were on the ground floor) . There was also a smaller tv in the bedroom. The bath area had a big Jacuzzi tub and a separate shower. Everything was very clean and comfortable.

There are about 12 different restaurants in the complex and open shuttle cars came by each location about every 15 minutes or so and would have routes to take you to the beautiful beach or any of the restaurants or activity sites in the complex.We did as recommended and chose our restaurants and preferred seating and gave that to the concierge the first day. We enjoyed all the restaurants we tried with the exception of the one offering Italian food-that was the one unpleasant meal the whole trip as our waitress must have had a bad day and was impolite, almost to rudeness, and our particular dishes there were not well prepared. That being said, all other staff we met were so kind and friendly and the food delicious. We felt welcome and at home.

We, as many people were, traveling on an all inclusive package and had our choice for any restaurant (There were 2 that were not included in the all-inclusive package but these were pointed out to us when we gave gave the concierge our preferred restaurants and preferred seating times.) We were close to the pool the Gabi Club and found it easier to have breakfast buffet and lunch there. The food was excellent and varied. Plenty of wonderful tropical fruits and salads, fish and seafood prepared in several ways, beef, pork, a nice selection of cheeses and beautiful desserts. Staff were very friendly and attentive.

There were many convenient bar stations located in the various restaurant areas with non-alcoholic and alcoholic drinks-no need to ever go thirsty.

Various activities were offered during the day like water aerobics, painting,candle making, paddle boarding, etc.--all directed by enthusiastic young staff.Of course there were cozy thatch palapas by the pool to enjoy being outside but not directly in the sun and plenty of chaises for the sun worshipers by the pools and on the beautiful white sand beach.

We opted for two extra tours- the Reef where we took a short boat ride to a floating 
dock and were able to swim and snorkel in fenced in areas with sharks (nurse sharks) and sting rays. We even tried the power snorkeling but found, for us, going on our own power was best. Kayaks and paddle board were also available.The trip even included a spa massage. Super!
The second tour we chose was an Eco tour in a large open air converted military truck drive through the rural areas and get a chance to see a bit the less touristic part of the Dominican Republic.--to visit a sugar can plantation, a beautiful church, a typical family home, a school and a ranch where we also got in a short bit of horseback-riding and lunch-then a visit to another beautiful beach to finish up the day. 

This was truly a wonderful vacation and if we can we will repeat the visit another winter.

reviews.author: SIJT
reviews.title: Nice Place, That's It, Royal Service Ok
reviews.text:
We have been travelling to Punta Cana every year and have stayed at the Melia Tropical Level. We were excited to check out the Palma Real this year and are pleased but not blown away. 
The hotel seemed rather empty and the Melia next door upgraded many people to make it seem busier.  The main lobby and main area are very nice with ocean views and plenty of places to relax during the day and evenings. Most restaurants are in the main areas and easy to access from any lounge or bar on the property.
If you are looking for a casino it is extreme small and a bit outdated with not a lot of gaming options. 
The Gabi Beach bar on the beach is a great hangout day or night and the service is excellent.  While the alcohol isn't premium it is good quality. The staff is friendly and they take good care of you and even remember your drink of choice which is a nice touch. It is nice to have a lounge/seating area by the beach.
The main buffet is actually quite good with lots of choices for every palate. It is clean, the service is good and there really is a type of food for everyone. It is actually a nice option for dinner. There was a "lobster night" and the food was excellent. 
The a la carte restaurants are hit and miss. We have dined at the Aqua at the Reserve: while a nice locale and good service, the food was not very good. No one left particularly pleased or full. We were surprised that we were able to get premium alcohol without paying extra as it is not available in the main Palma Real unless you have access to the Royal Service Lounge. 
The Mexican restaurant while casual and on the beach was not up to par either. Each soup came out cold and the dishes weren't very tasty. The best part was the chips and guacamole. 
One highlight was the RARE steakhouse. Each meal was served on time, cooked as requested and the meat was very good quality. However, if you are looking to dine at an upscale steakhouse beware; this place sounds like a cafeteria, there are many young children allowed to disturb the diners with crying and video games which made it very loud. The staff didn't seem interested in asking the parents to lower the children's devices so we had a symphony of cartoons and video games as we ate. 
The Teppanyaki restaurant had good food but seemed very unorganized and patrons had to wait more than a half hour to be seated. 

We cancelled our a la Carter dinner at Passions with the Michelin star chef as we didn't expect or feel we would get Michelin star food and surroundings for an extra 70$ US per person .

The house wine is very good and unlike other resorts in the area, there really is no need to buy wine off the menu.

If you choose Royal Service you get access to two a la carte restaurants without charge that the rest of the resort has no access to. I'm not sure that should be a factor in deciding to choose Royal Service as the main restaurants are overall very good. You also get access to the spa amenities including the thermal baths without charge. 
Unfortunately the thermal baths and spa location was a disappointment. The steam room did not work.  The "dressing room" is a small space with a bunch of old lockers and if there are more than two people in there at the same time it gets crowded.  
However, if you book a spa treatment you are escorted to a separate area and it is very pleasant .

There is a separate Royal Service lounge and checkin and checkout are quick and efficient which is helpful in such a large resort.  You also get assigned a personal butler to take care of all your questions and personal needs through your stay. They provide extra touches like afternoon snacks in the room and personal baths. They also make any arrangement you want. 
However, if you are expecting ROYAL ROOMS beware. Our room was exactly the same as a regular room at the Melia or Paradisus or the other sections as of 8-9 years ago.  There doesn't seem to be any upgrades. The bathrooms are outdated and some things need replacement. 

We were a bit disappointed in The Royal Service Pool and Beach area.  We were never offered help or a drink during our entire stay.  It seemed there were lots of staff around the bar area but not serving. 

If we decide to go back to the Palma Real again we definitely would not choose to spend the extra money on Royal Service. The only real extra value we feel we got was our dinner reservations taken care of.  It is a lot of extra cost for not much more.   
The resort itself is very nice and we felt no need for the extra service that we thought we would receive.  Don't expect five star.

reviews.author: SALOCINDARDILLY
reviews.title: UN HOTEL 3 ETOILES SUPERIEUR PAS PLUS
reviews.text: État des chambres avec beaucoup de problèmes, coffre fort en panne, électricité en panne,pas de piles dans la télécommande, ventilateur au ,plafond non réglable,porte fenetre bloquée, changement de serviettes le soir pas régulier, propreté moyenne,des boissons aux bar des piscines danbs des gobelets en carton,un majordhomme qui ne parle pas un mot de français,des musiques assourdissantes au restaurant, un restaurant qui ressemble à une cantine, chaises inconfortables etc..... Et pour le golf une escoquerie green fee gratuit mais voiturette à 150 dollars pour 2.....

reviews.author: Lin4419
reviews.title: A great vacation
reviews.text: We visited this resort through an RCI exchange.  It was wonderful. The staff was amazing. The room was spacious and comfortable.  We were their with friends for a wedding, and everything was great.  The pools were all nice, the beach was great.  The only drawback was the rough water, but that can't be controlled.  The resort was extremely large and we walked everywhere. Many great restaurants.  Our concierge was great be sure to take advantage of what they can offer you.  Can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Carrie H
reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful Property
reviews.text: Went here with my friend in January for a 4 night 5 day stay with Royal Service.  Royal Service is more for couples and not for two friends traveling together.  Our butler, Juan looked shell shocked when he saw two women, and seemed uncomfortable trying to communicate with us during our stay.  He did not know how to communicate with us, and hardly ever showed any facial expressions.  He did make all our dinner reservations, and each morning checked in to make sure our dining experience was positive.  We did tip him upon arrival in hopes to have a better experience, but he did not go out of his way for us during our stay.  Other couples we met with Royal Service had a nice experience - a newspaper every morning, their butler would find them during the day to bring them a special cocktail or special arrangement of cheese/crackers/fruit.  We got a plate of truffles delivered to our room during the day from Juan which we did not know about until we returned later on in the evening.  By then the truffles were warm and slightly melted.  Sadly, we could not eat the truffles.  Same thing happened another day with a plate of fruit.  Food was left in our room without us knowing, Juan did not bring them to us at the pool or beach, and just left them in our room early in the day. So by the time we finally came back to our room in the early evening the items were old, warm and not looking too tasty.  We ended up getting a new butler on the day of our departure as it was Juan's day off.   He was actually really nice, friendly and spoke to us without looking nervous.  The property is gorgeous, well kept and calm.  Music by the Royal Service pool needs to be improved.  They play spa music which is calming but you are outside, by a pool, drinking cocktails and the music is way too calming.  A lot of other Royal Service guests made the same comment.  We brought our phone to the pool and played our own music to drown out the pool music. Service at the pool and beach is top notch.  The staff is very attentive and tends to your needs.  Royal Service is great - I just wish our butler was more comfortable with us in order to make our stay more enjoyable like the other couples we met.

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.title: A vacation to remember
reviews.text: We had a great 5 days at this fantastic resort! Friendly staff, relaxed atmosphere, and great food!! The beach and pools combined to make this a water paradise. We ate at only 2 of the 7(I believe) restaurants on the property and they were first class. We will go back some day!

reviews.author: timetotravel81
reviews.title: All I can say is wow!!!
reviews.text: What a resort! First off the upgrade to the reserve side was so  worth it. The rest of the hotel is also beautiful, but I do love the added luxury in the Reserve area. Hotel is large but they have trolleys everywhere you go and you can even call them to your section to avoid walking. Hotel was clean and well kept. Grounds were beautiful and beach was amazing. The pools are great and so was all the food. I recommend getting an al a carte at the hibachi restaurant (amazing), all the al a cartes were great with the exception of the Italian one (reminded me of east side Marios) but then again it's good for Dominican :). I loved all the lounge and sun beds spread around the resort and entertainment was super! I would say this is not a party resort, but that was totally okay with me. Drinks were fantastic and never had to wait. Worth the money and will go again we punta Cana is on my radar once more.

reviews.author: Mindy O
reviews.title: One of the best all inclusive resorts
reviews.text: The Reserve vs the main Hotel is more quiet, selective and peaceful. They say that the Reserve is mainly for families but I stayed there with 4 adults. There's always a golf cart to shuttle you to the main hotel which has the beach and the best buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The service was top notch. I usually stay at all Ritz Carlton's when I'm in the Carribean but I have to say, this was almost comparable but a lot less expensive.  We were allocated a family concierge who helped to reserve chairs at the beach exclusive for the Reserve hotel guests and helped with making dinner reservations at the restaurants which I have to say...food wasn't as good as the Buffet at the main hotel. The Reserve section has a great gym and spa...the buffet restaurant called Gabi wasn't so good. I would recommend eating the buffet at the main hotel. I would definitely go back again but this time with my family!

reviews.author: Rebecca H
reviews.title: November getaway
reviews.text: This resort is one of the best ever; the staff are wonderful and immediately remember who you are, what you like, and are always paying attention to the details.  Often they gave me what I wanted or needed before I ever asked.  The Beach is the best; the evening dinner choices are 5 star!  The buffet is above average and if you ask any of the chefs to prepare something fresh they are ON IT!!! they seem to love to please their guests; the entertainment was fun; the activities available are continuous or you can just sleep on the beach in the wonderful beds or lounge chairs; their are numerous pools and bars everywhere.  When they say All inclusive, they mean it.  Everything was included except souvenirs.  Easy check-in; beautiful condos and grounds.

reviews.author: Dawn D
reviews.title: Perfect choice
reviews.text: If you're thinking about spending time alone together in a romantic hotel this is definitely not the hotel for you. This hotel is full of life. The food is very good, both buffet and a' la carte restaurants. Staff is helpful and friendly. Lots of attractions at the hotel: dance shows, water fitness etc. Rooms are clean and very spacious. For me the ideal choice.

reviews.author: Michelle W
reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: This was my first time to the Dominican. There were a total of 34 of us there for this 5 day/4 night vacation from January 8th until the 12th. We had a blast! The accommodations were wonderful. The food and service was excellent. The staff was very friendly and went out of their way to make sure we were having a great time. There were many activities to participate in during the time we were there. One of my favorite was the Latin dance and zumba class at 4pm each day. Several of us participated every day we were there and the instructors were fantastic! Big "shout-outs" to:  "Carlos", "Snoopy", "Boom Boom", "Shaky Shaky", "Angel", "Yudy", "Agripina" and "Caramelo".  They were so much fun...we wanted to bring them all home with us when we left!  Each night they joined us at either the Gabi or Avenue bars to help us "show off" what we learned at class that day during the Latin Dance nights. They are amazing dancers and made our trip so enjoyable! Their energy is contagious! My only regrets were not taking an opportunity to go dancing at the clubs downtown and not getting Facebook or Whatsapp information from some of the wonderful people we met so we could keep in touch. I guess this just means I need to make another trip back to Punta Cana and this resort and do all the things I wasn't able to do the first time around! I highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real Resort to anyone looking for delicious food, excellent service, and lots of fun!

reviews.author: Rosario1969
reviews.title: Excelente atención y servicio cumple las espectativas
reviews.text: Pertenece a la cadena Melia ,  dentro de los segmentos o categortias de hoteles de esta cadena, Parasisus es lujo o 5 estrellas. Bien ubicado , buena playa, amplia gama de restaurantes y buen equipo de animación. Lo recomiendo, aunque no es económico, vale la pena.

reviews.author: cbn456
reviews.title: Outdated
reviews.text: The rooms need an update--I feel like ours hadn't been touched since the '80s.  Food is generic all-inclusive buffet except for the Japanese and the restaurant that is not included.  Drinks are watered down.

reviews.author: roberts04
reviews.title: Nice, but room for improvement
reviews.text: Probably best to state upfront that my review of The Reserve is largely based on the very high price I paid during peak holiday season.  That aside, this resort did not entirely live up to my expectations. On the positive side, the resort is large, very well maintained, and the hotel employees were very welcoming and friendly.  The property is beautiful and offers just about everything one would expect from a resort at this price level.  Our room was spacious, clean, and well-appointed, though there were mosquitos in the room each day.Where the resort falls short, in my view, are in the areas of food and fitness center services.  Though there are many restaurants, we found the food selection to be very limited and not of high quality.  Buffet breakfast was rather ordinary and not up to the level of the price point of this hotel.  The fitness center is small, and a fair amount of the equipment was not working properly.  There did not seem to be any effort to recognize the shortfall in the equipment or to suggest that repairs were on the way.  Understanding that most visitors don't put fitness centers at the top of the must have list, I do, and I was disappointed. Finally, the hotel wifi signal is weak. Overall, I'd recommend this resort but only during periods when the rates are more reasonable.

reviews.author: 388lawrencey
reviews.title: Royal Service was worth every penny!
reviews.text: Our stay at the Paradisus was fabulous and our butler Luis Sanchez seemed to appear out of thin air whenever we needed something. The market place shops off the beach was a bit dodgy but safe and you could haggle a good bargain. We'll definitely come back.

reviews.author: 362junea
reviews.title: Amazing Service, Great Accommodations
reviews.text:
First all inclusive.  Completely satisfied.  Spend the extra and do the romantic dinner on the beach!  Tips well deserved.  Fun to return to room each day to see the room surprises...champagne and chocolate strawberries...bubble bath drawn.
Great meals covered in the all inclusive fees.  Beautiful beach, awesome pool.  Complimentary snorkel trip.  Life enriching activities were fun, especially finger painting.  Staff happy and helpful.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: CheminNantel
reviews.title: Dissappointing
reviews.text:
Our experience was very dissappointing.
Most of the staff seemed very unhappy.
Not enough staff.  We found if we asked for anything, the waiters were rude or looked annoyed, but I think is was because they were over worked.
Most of the food was cold or luke warm.
We were part of a large group, 8 of us had upset stomachs a lot of the time, we were only there for 7 days.
Our room was not as clean as we expected.
Poor hygiene standards.
The Only Positives:-
Beautiful beach area and pool area.

reviews.author: Gisele A
reviews.title: The Reserve
reviews.text: Great place to relax, great food, the staff is very friendly always reaching out to make sure nothing is missing, good drinks,rooms were very clean, and was very nice to have our own concierge to assist on our needs

reviews.author: Andrei M
reviews.title: Férias excelentes
reviews.text:
Hotel excelente e all inclusive top!!
Vamos lá:
Bebidas: Absolut, stolichnaya, black label, jack Daniels e Chivas 12.
Restaurante Buffet com 10 ilhas pra escolher o que quiser; snack bar com hambúrguer, cachorro quente, fritas, salada e comida mexicana
8 restaurantes a lacarte inclusos no all inclusive, apenas 2 são fracos (vento e o mexicano)
Wi-Fi incluso quartos, lobby e na areia da praia!!
Toalhas de sobra sem horas pra devolver! 
Staff muito bom e simpáticos mesmo sem pagar gorjeta! 
Praia muito boa com algumas algas, cor do Caribe e temperatura agradável (não eh nem quente como o nordeste do Brasil, nem fria como o Sudeste) 
Indicado para família, amigos, romance, lua de mel
O ponto fraco do hotel e que deve tomar cuidado são os cupons que entregam na recepção, pois não consegue usar nenhum sem ter que pagar um complemento.
VOLTARIA COM CERTEZA!!!

reviews.author: Roeseler1
reviews.title: This place was amazing!
reviews.text:
The entertainment staff was amazing!!! Obama (Josias) and Anthony were so much fun and did a great job making everyone around them smile. Luis, Noel, Yesfreisi, Rhino, and Jose were wonderful also. The entertainment staff made my trip so much fun. There were a ton of activities and all of the dancing was great. The bartenders Danny, Pedro, and Stephanie were great and always made me feel welcome. 
The food was good at the buffets and the food at Mole was the best. The beach area was very relaxing and nice. The rooms were kept very clean and had everthing we needed for a wonderful stay. I will definitely come back to this resort again.

reviews.author: Antoneo1205
reviews.title: Wedding Bliss
reviews.text:
My butler Juan de Leon made my entire experience. He was always ready and willing to assist for whatever I needed. When I broke my butler phone, he still found a way to check on me to ensure I was ok. 

The bridal department has a staff the is efficient perfection. The were patient, understanding and prepared for anything that came their way...even weather. 

The resort is beautiful. The grounds are well kept. The staff is polite and helpful. If someone doesn't know something or they can't completely understand, they will find someone who does and do. 

The food wasn't to die for but it was good. 

I did have a problem with a  beach attendant holding chairs for other people "who come daily" and not wanting to assist my friend and I but everything else overshadowed that incident.

reviews.author: Annette N
reviews.title: OBEIDY "RODRIGUEZ"
reviews.text: We visited the DR in November to celebrate my sisters 50th and had the absolute best time.  O. "Rodriguez" was our attendant each day at the beach.  Immediately upon seeing the group of 5 women in their 40s-50s....he welcomed us with arms wide exclaiming "mi familia".  He was most attentive....everything from drinks, beach chairs, beach towels, following up with the hotel concierge regarding dinner reservations, coordinated excursions, hooked us up with the party man, met us at CocoBongo to make sure we were having a great time.....Obidy "RODRIGUEZ"...YOU'RE THE BEST!!!!

reviews.author: Yv7
reviews.title: Get Pampered in Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
Room: The Reserve suite is extra roomy and has a living room area which can be used as a second bedroom. The bath area has a private bath tub and separate shower and toilet, which was a nice surprise. 
Food: Above average for an all inclusive. Try to book the specialty restaurants as it feels really extraordinary with the service and attention to detail. 
Beach: The waves are really strong and the sands are gray. The resort is incredibly huge so you need to take the shuttle to get to the beach from the Reserve, not too ideal when you're in a hurry. 
Spa: Nothing to write home about...massage was just average and the ambience can be improved.

reviews.author: Victoria R
reviews.title: No volvere
reviews.text:
Hotel malisimo no parece que sea un Melia,  los siete dias que estuvimos la cisterna rota y saliendose el agua, ni ponen ni reponen los detalles del cuarto de baño, eso si teniamos nuestra cucaracha, la bebida malisima todo marcas de alli y poco profesionales los camaremos, la comida lo mismo los siete dias lo mismo y los restaurantes muy justitos, un hotel aburrido y el arquitecto se lucio con su obra maestra y el mobiliario de todo a 100 o de Ikea, no veo nada positivo.
No Volvere.

reviews.author: Michelle F
reviews.title: One of the best all inclusive resorts in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Overall the experience was amazing at the Paradisus Palma Real. The grounds were extremely well maintained, the staff was very friendly, and the food was excellent.

Staff: This was the absolute best part of our stay. Whether it was the food staff in the main dining room or the activities crew.. everyone was soo friendly and accomodating. Shout out to Boom Boom (Juan), Caramello (Renaldo) and Angel! They take the time to remember your name and make each and every day/night enjoyable. My friends and I had a great time!

Food: Really incredible.. even the buffet! Everything was fresh, well maintained, and delicious. The specialty restaurants were also great.. my favorite was Aqua, Bana, and Rare. Passion is one of the restaurants that cost extra ($70/pp) and is worth every penny! The chef is Michelin star rated and the tasting menu was NYC quality.

Pool/Beach area: The pool is massive and is equipped with a Swim up bar, mosaic lounge chairs in the water, and plenty of space for adults and kids to play. The beach was also very nice and had great chairs/huts. The only problem with the beach was that it was full of seaweed during this time of year (November). 

Overall, very impressed with the experience at this resort.. and will probably go back next year!

reviews.author: EMNP1031
reviews.title: Amazing all inclusive experience!
reviews.text:
We chose the perfect week to travel to this all inclusive resort. I had never been to the DR before and this place did not disappoint. The resort was only at 50% capacity and it really made a difference. The resort itself is beautiful and spacious. The pools are amazing and the staff is very involved, friendly and makes your stay even better. We tried almost all of the restaurants: our favorites were Rare, Aqua and the Hibachi place. The buffet also was top notch. For an all inclusive, we really enjoyed all the food. They had lobster tails at the buffet for dinner! There's food for all types of eaters. We did splurge on our last night and paid extra for Passion, the tasting menu Michelin starred restaurant and that was also worth it. The food was so good and the experience was great. 

The only negative was the seaweed on the beach but we spent most of our time at the pool and enjoyed the beach during sundown, to relax and enjoy the breeze. 

The night entertainment was also great. The Lion King show, beach party and just enjoying some wine on the rocking chairs by the beach made our nights really enjoyable. The casino was small but we still managed to end up there every night. Make sure to make all your dinner reservations right when you get there but again, the buffet is really good for dinner too. 

The activities, and endless list. Enough for you to do some of keep busy all the time. We took part in the water aerobics and aqua spinning each day. There are dance classes, sushi making, wine tasting, volleyball, kids events, etc. We didn't do any of the extras like snorkeling trips or parasailing but they offer everything. 

The staff really also makes the resort even better. Boom Boom, Reynaldo (Caramelo), Angel, Milky Way and Shakey Shakey really just made our days more enjoyable. They were so nice, friendly and fun and remembered us each day for the entire week. When you have staff that cares and goes out of their way to make you enjoy your trip, it makes the world of a difference. Also, all the bartenders and waiters really were great too, especially at the swim up bar at the pool. We made sure to tip everyone as well as a thank you. 

Overall, the resort and everything included was worth every penny. I would go back here in a heartbeat. I went with 2 other friends but would also consider the place great for couples. If it was at more capacity, i would have taken advantage of royal service (pay extra private accomodations at the pool, etc) or stayed at the reserve to avoid to crowdedness and amount of kids (from what we have heard) but we got really lucky with the week we went. Everything is also very clean, and the rooms are big. Only awkward thing about the room was the bathroom. There's a door but one side is very open and you can see in through the shutters and side area so we had to cover as much as we could since I was there with friends. There's really not much privacy in the bathroom! There is a glass door inside for both the toiler and shower area but its not completely frosted.

reviews.author: Felipe B
reviews.title: Temporada excelente
reviews.text: Tivemos uma ótima semana! O hotel tem excelente infraestrutura, restaurantes muito bons, com destaque para o Vento e o Aqua. Fomos sempre bem atendidos pelo staff do hotel com destaque para o Jonathan, do bar da piscina e o Acosta, do buffet Gabi Beach. O Josias (Obama) também é sempre muito animado.

reviews.author: user13332
reviews.title: Successful trip
reviews.text: The resort was very well kept. The employees were really nice. Jose is the best butler I could have ever asked for! I was able to relax and enjoy my stay without any stress. The food was not bad either, the buffet was amazing. I would recommend the place to anyone.

reviews.author: 22shadow
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: We were there for a wedding. Beach is good, food was excellent and bar staff are excellent. Only complaint was house keeping, they had a hard time keeping the room stocked with towels and wash cloths. We had a Jr. Suite after 2 days they left slippers on the 3rd day more slippers, after 4 days they delivered bath robes. On the last day, day 9 we got a bunch of towels and we were going home.

reviews.author: Panchotm
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Destacar de sobre manera a 3 personas:
Liliana de Guest Services.
Wander de restaurant Palazzo
Juan de restaurant Naos
Y todo el personal de animación. 
Todo el personal muy agradable y en pro al servicio de los pasajeros.
Falta comida tradicional Dominicana.

reviews.author: sroman46
reviews.title: Una experiencia para repetir  !!
reviews.text:
Me gustó mucho la arquitectura de las áreas comunes del hotel. Muy abierto y hermosas vistas que permitían disfrutar de la hermosa brisa marina. 
La pulcritud y constante limpieza es algo que quisiera destacar así como la atención del personal en todas las aéreas y todos los cargos ya que hacen que el cliente se sienta de manera especial. No se dejan cosas al azar, pero el huésped no siente el agobio de la cantidad de personas que se esmeran para que pasemos unas exclentes vacaciones. A todos ellos mi cariño y agradecimiento.

reviews.author: Naomi M
reviews.title: AMAZING stay!
reviews.text: Most wonderful vacation ever! The setting is beautiful. The hotel decor is fabulous. The staff is extraordinarily friendly. The food is delicious. The rooms are comfortable and elegant. Simply put - out vacation was wonderful.

reviews.author: scirtiball
reviews.title: La vacanza che ti aspetti.
reviews.text: Camere belle, pulizia e servizi impeccabili. Giardini curati e spiaggia pulita. Personale gentile e disponibile. Ottima cucina, sia al buffet che nei vari ristoranti a tema compresi nel pacchetto, con possibilità (a pagamento) di andare in un ristorante  pluri stellato. Unica pecca. Il disc jockey della piccola (ma carinissima) discoteca interna era poco professionale e non curava a dovere sia il missaggio che la scelta della musica. Mi sento di segnalare la professionalità e gentilezza di tre barman. Luiz Hernandez(?) e Leony Familia (del bar adiacente il red lounge) e Yovani Montilla del Gabinetto Beach. Buona l'animazione, sia diurna che serale.

reviews.author: Lisa N
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: My friend and I had a wonderful week at the Reserve Paradisius. The room was very spacious, the food excellent, and the garden absolutely beautiful. The activities and the staff were great as well. Big thank you to Raynold, Anthony and Luis for the great sport classes. We'll be back!

reviews.author: Mataro01
reviews.title: Excelente sitio
reviews.text:
El viaje ha sido con amigos y la verdad que cualquiera de las estancias es una maravilla. 
Nosotros cogimos servicio real, el cual recomiendo encarecidamente. Debo hacer mencion del muy buen servicio prestado por Johnfi. Desde el primer dia nos preparo las cenas, desplazamientos al aeropuerto y entradas entre otras cosas.
Dentro de este servio la piscina y la playa contaban con personal para que constantemente fueras  atendido y además se disponía de actividades como el catamaran o el snorkel 8los recomiendo porque son super divertidos). En la piscina genial la atención de Pedro, el cual siempre se cuidaba de guardarnos una hamaca y no estar desprovistos de bebidas.
Los restaurantes estan bastante bien, incluso el bufet. En el bar Gabi pasamos muchas tardes y el ambiente y paisaje incomparables. Incluso tiene discoteca que de ella lo unico que puedo reprochar es que la musica era demasiado rap americano...
para el desayuno recominedo el Palazzio donde Miguel Jimenez estuvo pendientes de nosotros desde el primer al ultimo dia. las vistas a la piscina desde alli hacen que el despertar se lleve mejor.

En general un sitio precioso y muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Jonanmartin
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Raynold tamayo, Anthony contreras, Julito , Ramon Ramirez  made our trip so much fun! The service was excellent! We loved the having someone check on us all the time, we always had a towels and drinks! The restaurants were delicious and everyone was incredibly friendly!

reviews.author: Starward H
reviews.title: GO JAYS GO!!!  Canadian Friends!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience!! First time visiting Punta Cana and we highly recommend it. We paid a little more for the Royal Service section and it was worth the extra.  I would like to send out a big THANK YOU to a few people that made our stay even better.  First, Fernanda Gil who greeted us in the lounge with professionalism and guided us though out our trip.  Second, our personal Butler Juan De Leon, who checked in with us daily and always, did the extra to make us feel special.  Lastly, Martin couldn't have done more for us, from reserving our section on the beach daily to catering to our beckon call with drink orders!!  Thank you to all of you who made our week with you, the BEST EVER!!!

reviews.author: Eugenia C
reviews.title: Inmejorable servicio
reviews.text:
Estuve hace una semana en el hotel con unos amigos. Puesto que era un viaje de celebración especial, decidimos alojarnos en la parte de Royal Service.
Todas las instalaciones del hotel estaban muy bien, pero mi mención más especial va para el servicio del hotel, que fue impecable en todos los ámbitos, desde las habitaciones, restaurantes, animación del hotel....
Quiero nombrar especialmente a Pedro Cedano, la persona que se encargaba de que estuviéramos lo mejor posible en las hamacas de la playa y por supuesto a Johnfi Rivera, la persona que durante toda la estancia se preocupó de que todo estuviera bien, nos ayudó con todas las gestiones e hizo que la experiencia fuera inmejorable. Muchas gracias por hacer que esta experiencia sea inolvidable!!

reviews.author: jppk1
reviews.title: Royal service con Johnfi rivera como mayordomo de gran nivel y Pedro Cedan oen el servicio de hamacas es EXCELENTE
reviews.text: Hemos estado 10 parejas una semana con un trato excepcional desde el primer día. Tanto Johnfi el mayordomo, muy resolutibo y amable, como Pedro tuvieron una actitud excelente y un servicio inmejorable. Un lugar relajante, si quieres, y tremendametne recomendable

reviews.author: Robin L
reviews.title: Disaster after disaster after disaster. No replies to emails, run the other way, FAST!
reviews.text:
Hotel: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort (5910)
After four attempts to contact there complaints department. We have given up trying. Maybe they will respond to this.
My wife and I have just returned from a disastrous stay at the Paradisus Palma Real and below is a summary. This was not a good experience. 14 nights/days of problems. First room 1044 shower had no no hot water it took two days to fix, no plug in sink, when it was replaced it did not work. Patio door of its runners. Toilet flush came off in my hand, tried to iron a dress the iron dumped water all over my wife's dress, again two days to replace the iron. Tv would not turn off at night.... They have hidden the power cables so you cannot even un plug it! Hairdryer was faulty. 
After 4 days they moved us to room 1065. We had a group of friends in for 7 days from the USA ,so they roomed us close together. Back to our room 1065, noisiest room ever there is a service area beside it, and a service road behind it, and Dom Rep vehicles believe me are never the quietest!!!! Again we had problems with hot water, we had to run all the cold taps for 10 minutes before the hot water would run hot, this was typical for all our group 6 rooms in total. 1064/1069/1053/1068/1074 Also our new room was smaller than our first. Bare in mind Our trip from the Uk cost us $6000 with airfare. Our group was also beset with problems, one room had $50 stolen, another had bleach left on the dresser, leading to a ruined dress. Another had a water leak through its ceiling and when they moved them, the alarm clock in the room next to them went of for an hour at 2.30am..... That's just the rooms. The first weekend we were there the place seemed nice and lively, 6 restaurants open and all bars open. Apparently there were 250 insurance agents in from Michigan. Unfortunately they left after 3 days and the resort died! When I enquired with the guest services manager Domingo, he said, because of low occupancy they do not open all the restaurants and bars......where does it say that in the brochure. Most nights we had to beg to be able to eat in an air conditioned restaurant, as most we were told were closed for maintainence. Believe me the novelty of sweating while eating soon wears off. Three nights we did not eat, seeking  the sanctuary of our rooms air con, that did work well. There was a bar called the Avenue bar, open our first three nights, lively, dancing, in a breezeway, comfortable, some great cocktails guess what........never opened again! Closed for 10nights straight. One night they allowed us to eat in the Royal service restaurant, an upgrade area as a sorry they did not do very well, sort of thing. When we arrived the lady on the front desk could not find our reservation. We had to stand there like the poor relations for 10 minutes while it was sorted out, thanks a lot. We ate in one restaurant called Rare, my partner became ill. We ate in restaurant Fuego a restaurant with no air con, the fans do not work properly. The beach was deluged in sea weed (2ft high) and was not cleared properly till the last day of our stay. On check out I was presented with a $1080 up charge for the room change, when I disputed this I was told by the only guest services person on duty Vladimir that if I did not pay it then the reception staff would have to pay it instead. Blackmail or what! I asked to speak to a senior manager only to be told none were available, at lunch I believe. If you don't get a check out slip then you can't get your case. ......! Vladimir promised me he would organise a credit from Melia, just email him when I get home. Again I have done this 3 times, and wow no reply. My last meal lunch in the beachside buffet. I had a hamburger, the last thing I ate for 24 hours as I never eat when I fly, guess what food poisoning, and so it goes on and on One of the towel supervisors called me in Spanish, Seinora, I am a married male, she giggled with a co worker thinking I did not know what it means. It means a un manly man. Generally though the staff were great, trying there best to help. I have tried to find someone to complain to everywhere to no avail. If anyone can help, please get in touch. Our group of 12 payed almost $30,000 it's just not good enough, Thomson, Costco's and Melia should be embarrassed. I await your response Robin Lewis

reviews.author: SergioJr
reviews.title: El mejor del país
reviews.text:
Conozco muy bien el país y creo que es el mejor resort, quizá no el mejor en todos los aspectos, pero globalmente, sí. Es muy bueno para todos los públicos: desde el que va buscando absoluta tranquilidad hasta el que busca fiesta, pasando por familias. Cada perfil tiene su zona y sus servicios específicos. Entro en detalle:
La ubicación es excelente, en una de las mejores playas del planeta. Lástima el problema de algas que hay ahora mismo, pero que me consta que están trabajando por arreglarlo cuanto antes con medios técnicos. Aún así, sigue siendo una gran playa, poco concurrida, de arena blanca coralina y con unas fantásticas hamacas y servicio a pie de hamaca. Las camas y palapas de Royal Service, dobles, increíblemente cómodas y totalmente regulables, con el inmejorable servicio de Pedro Cedano, un auténtico profesional que merece mención especial: simpático, amable, con una gran psicología para anticiparse a las necesidades de los huéspedes, servicial de corazón, siempre está y además no se nota, inmejorable.
La habitación es muy buena, muy amplia, camas grandes y cómodas, jacuzzi doble, amenities de primera calidad, todo excelente. Sólo faltaría un pequeño accesorio que, por el momento, el hotel no dispone de él: un cable jack que pueda conectar el iPhone o iPad con el hi-fi.
El precio es correcto, pero la diferencia de precio entre las suites garden view y las ocean view la veo excesiva, aunque supongo que obedecerá a una demanda real de estas habitaciones.
Los restaurantes son muy buenos en general (materia prima, cocina y servicio) y claramente mejores que los de la competencia. A destacar:
- Fuego, de especialidad peruana, cocina de alto nivel. Muy bueno.
- Rare, especialidad en carnes, materia prima de primerísima calidad. Muy bueno.
- El buffet. El mejor que he visto en mi vida. Imposible que se te ocurra algo que falte, y todo de muy buena calidad.
Los bares, cada uno en su estilo, están muy bien atendidos y sirven bebidas y cócteles de primera calidad.
Las instalaciones son espectaculares y los jardines inmensos y sofisticados, con gran variedad de árboles, plantas, flores... una obra de arte, tanto de diseño como de mantenimiento.
Pero hay un aspecto que es donde Palma Real es mejor definitivamente que sus competidores: el Royal Service.
Este upgrade dentro del hotel afecta básicamente a tres cosas: las desventajas que puede tener alojarse en un hotel grande desaparecen y los huéspedes de SR pasan a tener todas las ventajas de un hotel grande (variedad de instalaciones y servicios) y todas las ventajas de un hotel pequeño y lujoso: atención personalizada durante la estancia por un butler de gran profesionalidad; lobby separado sumamente agradable como recepción, bar y zona de trabajo; zona separada tanto en habitaciones como en la playa y piscina diferente (aquí la principal diferencia con la zona estándar es que es sólo adultos). Y para el desayuno o comidas, quien guste de un lugar especialmente tranquilo, tiene el restaurante Palazzo, exquisitamente decorado y atendido.
En este punto de Royal Service, merece una referencia muy especial el butler que nos atendió, que realmente fue el pilar de la estancia: Johnfi Rivera, un auténtico profesional, siempre disponible, siempre pendiente, con detalles inesperados y con el perfil y la discrección que lo hacen imperceptible. Muy eficaz en todo lo que gestionó (excursiones, transfers, cenas especiales, reservas en restaurantes, de actividades, etc...), lo dicho, crucial en el gran éxito que fue nuestra estancia.
Esta vez íbamos sólo adultos, pero pedimos a Johnfi que nos enseñase The Reserve, que es una zona especial para familias y quedamos muy bien impresionados y deseosos de volver en otra fecha con niños.
Una sincera y cordial enhorabuena a los mencionados, pero extensible desde la dirección hasta el último ayudante de jardinería y de manera especial a un personaje que descubrimos allí su existencia: la arquitecta sensorial, persona que se ocupa del diseño y mantenimiento de Palma Real a nivel de los cinco sentidos: vista, olor, tacto, oído y gusto. Se nota que este empleo existe y está desempeñado brillantemente.
Debo añadir que este mismo hotel, en otro país, aunque fuera el mismo paisaje, no sería lo mismo. La cordialidad y hospitalidad dominicana es dificilmente superable.
Enhorabuena a todos. Volveremos seguro.

reviews.author: Leuys Taveras
reviews.title: Buen hotel con sus contras

En cuanto a atención y comida es excelente, excelente atención de la joven reyes del lobby.

Desde mi punto de vista y de unas 16 personas que somos los que viajamos juntos nos parece mal que no aya musica en la piscina donde esta el bar, el que quiere tranquilidad puede visitar otra piscina o la playa.

Las habitaciones nosotros escogimos master suite real pero en realidad no entiendo para que pagamos mas que los demás no teníamos ningún privilegio distinto a los demás por una nevera y un comedor no es suficiente para uno pagar mas que una habitación estándar, el radio de la habitación muy obsoleto no pudimos hacer uso de el ya que no cuenta con bluetooth ni un cable auxiliar.

No hay ascensores en los edificios algo muy incomodo para mi y algunas personas subir tantas escaleras con unos escalones tan altos.

Pero como dije la calidad de la comida y bebida es de 1ra igual que su personal que es muy atento y amable.

Espero que mi opinión sea tomada en cuenta desde un buen punto de vista y que mejoren mucho mas!

La discoteca nos encanto pero su horario no demasiado poco hasta las 2 de la mañana.

reviews.title: Totalmente satisfecho y no veo la hora de poder volver !!!

Llegamos por la tarde y nuestra reserva no estaba .. ( imaginen la decepcion que tenía  y sobre todo la preocupación ya que era temporada alta y no habia plan B ..), en cuestión de minutos ya tenia una habitación asignada y mi problema resuelto. 
El problema fue de booking que por algún motivo extraño no confirmo.
De ahí en mas solo nos dedicamos a disfrutar.
La playa muy bonita llena de reposeras y servicio del bar atentos a cualquier cosa que necesites.  ( algo de algas en el mar pero las sacaban cada mañana, igual entiendo que es algo que no pueden manejar )
La pileta divina, agua cristalina y al ser inmensa imposible chocarte con alguien.
Especial mención al wifi ... desde las habitaciones , pileta y hasta en la playa inmejorable señal y velocidad .
Buffet y restaurantes y bares 11 puntos !! Gran variedad, muy buena calidad y siempre ofreciendote mas.
Animacion excelente y a toda hora muy divertidos y muy buena onda. 
La atencion del personal es fabulosa ojala uno se podría acordar de todos sus nombres para poder hacer una lista y publicarla aca. Un gran abrazo a Su, Juan Pablo y Julio como dije antes queremos volver lo antes posible.
Lejos el mejor hotel donde he estado.
100% recomendable.

reviews.text:
Our stay was a very nice vacation. The staff was beyond amazing. Our stay included the Royal service. Our Butler, Elvis, was very sweet, attentive, and helpful. In the Royal service area, Carlos Rosario was there tending to us all every day and always had a smile on his face and made sure we were taken care of. He also had a great sense of humor! 
One afternoon we ate at the Blue Agave for lunch. We were a few minutes early before the area started serving Mexican. Jose, went out of his way to provide us with more than enough food. 
You must try the Dirty Monkey at the bar. You'll be hooked. 
The service and property were top notch. In my opinion, the food could use some improvement. The desserts were just ok and the bread was always hard. We did not like Rare at all. The Italian restaurant was amazing. The last night we had surf and turf at a private party and it was also amazing.

reviews.author: Dean D
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go
reviews.text:
How can you go wrong when you get to the breath taking view upon arrival of the Paradisus Palma Real hotel? You can see through the beautiful and massive lobby area to the pool and beach beyond it. Spectacular, really.

My friends and I opted for the Royal Service, which has it's own lounge in which the guests are checked into. Here is where you are introduced to the property, as well as your butler for your stay.  We were lucky enough to be have been paired with Juan de Leon.  He was amazing to our small group.  The attention that he provided in helping us with reservations, sorting out an excursion, helping to plan a birthday surprise, and setting up some golf time was nothing less than professional, while also showing a personal investment in our happiness with our vacation.

All the staff that we dealt with were just as great, though.  Particularly on our first night, when the air conditioning went out for the whole property.  We were fortunate enough to be placed for the evening in the The Reserve property for the evening, which was not having the same issue.  Francesco, back at our Royal Service beach was wonderful enough to save us our same spot each day of our trip so that we didn't have to wander the beach looking for a place to settle.

The restaurants were also fantastic and provided such different dining experiences. During the day, we mostly stayed with the Palazzo, which is only available to Royal Service clients. This made our daytime meals peaceful and un-rushed.  Among the restaurants that we tried were Mizo, over at The Reserve, Passion, Blue Agave, Rare, and Vento.  

The room was large and beautiful, if a little dated.  My complaint was that the bathroom was fairly open to the rest of the room.  I'm sure it's fine for some couples, but when traveling with friends, it is very awkward to not have privacy.

The property itself is expansive and gorgeous. The sand on the beach is fantastically soft and wasn't too hot to walk on.  The temperature of the ocean and pools was perfect.  They weren't too cold or too warm, respectively.

By the end of our stay, we were all contemplating a return visit, which is rare for our group.

Tal ves en este sentido algunas cosas pudieran mejorar, de acuerdo a sus posibilidades y acercarnos asi, a la plenitud. Esto es un legado cultural,logrado por ustedes y eso merece ser protegido. Muchas gracias.
