reviews.title: Красиво и профессионально
reviews.text: Самый красивый отель в этой части пляжа Баваро. Огромная территория, похожая на ботанический сад. Красивый пляж и бассейн в части Paradisus, хотя и в обычной части отеля тоже красиво. Не все рестораны понравились, но с учетом их количества питание получается разноообразным.  В принципе нам все очень понравилось кроме спа центра. Это конечно очень индивидуально, но я лично не рекомендую. Воспоминания в целом самые положительные.

reviews.author: Kristie S
reviews.title: Amazing Destination Wedding during hurricane season
reviews.text:
Warning: This will be lengthy but informational for future brides who are looking to have their wedding at the Paradisus Palma Real.

We chose the Palma Real location over the Punta Cana resort as our travel agent stated it was a little grander and busier; however, we chose it over the Hard Rock as it wasn't as big and not as busy!

Planning began immediately through our USA coordinator, Jinayada.  She handled all questions and fee transactions regarding the wedding packages, catering/food, photography, DJ, and decor.   All vendors are given to you and communication is handled by email which was so simple.  I never had any issues with getting a prompt response.  We chose the Chill Out Chic package, because it was a package that included all the basics we needed-ceremony, chairs, linens, tables, 3 hour reception.  We opted out of a package for a cocktail hour, because our travel agent got the resort to provide a private cocktail hour the day before the wedding which we used as a welcome party, and quite honestly, our guests enjoyed the lobby bar in between our ceremony and reception. I also brought a few decorations of my own that really made the COC package look very elaborate, and you have the option to upgrade or change much of the decor of this package which can actually be cheaper than choosing a large package.  We also extended the DJ and the reception by one extra hour for a 4 hour reception.
The decor company, Caribbean Celebrations do a great job recreating anything you ask.  I used a lot of pictures from Pinterest and the decor company gave me a quote on everything before I confirmed.

About a 45 days prior to the wedding we were then set up in communication with our onsite Romance coordinator.  By this time, much of the planning was done, so not much communication by email was needed during this time.  I was to meet the Romance team, DJ, photographer, and decor team a couple of days prior to the event.  

We were greeted with champagne and roses by our shuttle driver to the resort.  Upon arriving to the resort, we were greeted by a member of the Romance department who took us to the check in desk to make sure we were accommodated immediately.  They had already made reservations for our us and the amount of our guests that were also coming in that day to two of the restaurants that night.  The view of the lobby is amazing. Everything is very open and the lobby overlooks the pool and the beach.

We were then escorted to our suite which we were upgraded to without fee.  They offered the Royal Service but we declined as we knew were wouldn't be spending much time in our room or with need of a butler. The suite was huge with a full kitchen, full living room, and large bathroom with a separate room with a large bathtub connected to our bedroom.  This worked perfectly during the day of the wedding, as I had the photographers and my wedding party and family come take pictures prior to the ceremony here. Immediately room service came in with complimentary champagne and a fruit platter.

The resort itself is very nice.  Our guests spent much of their time on the beach or at the pool by the pool swim up bar.  We did sign up for one group excursion, a catamaran trip through Hispanola Punta Cana adventures; however, the weather was very rainy that day, so Fernando the owner refunded us immediately.  We did do a smaller group excursion with speed boats and snorkeling which was cheaper than the catamaran, but not as long of an excursion.

Wedding day was a breeze. My wedding coordinator onsite, Natalia, was awesome! She tended to every need.  i had met with her, the DJ, photographer and decor team 2 days prior to the wedding to confirm everything.  I handed off all the decorations I brought with me, and Natalia made sure she took notes on how I wanted everything to look-which it looked exactly the way I had asked. I had my hair and make up as well as the moms and bridesmaids done at the salon which is actually located at the sister resort, The Reserve.  They did a great job with hair and make up. Definitely plan for longer than you anticipate as we were almost late for our pictures. Hurricane Danny (turned into tropical storm) didn't bother us during our stay, but Hurricane Erika (turned into tropical storm as well) had led to the prediction of a high chance of rain that night. At the time, our ceremony was in the garden, BESIDE the garden gazebo (we didn't use the gazebo for the ceremony because the chair placement was very odd), and our reception was scheduled to be on the Olympic terrace outside.  Natalia came to me about 6 hours before and offered to move the reception into an inside venue.  She showed me one of the ballrooms which was very nice, and also upgraded our bistro lights to LED lights throughout the room and provided a dance floor!  The ballroom actually worked better for our guests because of the heat and because of the rain that did come.  

The staff during the reception was awesome.  They were on the dance floor handing people refills on their drinks.  The DJ played every song we requested.  The MC was awesome too.  The food was great and PLENTIFUL.  And our wedding cake was designed exactly the way I asked and tasted amazing.  We kept the 2 tiered cake included in the package which was made to fit the size of our party.  Everything went without a hitch, and Natalia stayed throughout the entire time to make sure I had everything I needed.  At the end of the ceremony, she packed up all the decor I had brought and made sure they were given back to me the following day.  Our photographers with Tropic One Studio were also great! We received about 500 pictures for a period of 5 hours including some of the bride/groom pre ceremony and bride/groom after ceremony pictures which were amazing.  
Make sure you tip the wait staff, DJ, and wedding staff-they truly deserve it!

reviews.author: Susan W
reviews.title: Middle of the Road
reviews.text: Spent 7 days at this resort.  Though very beautiful,  it sits on the rough Atlantic Ocean with mass amounts of seaweed...not what one is expecting traveling to "paradise!" The resort is an "armband resort." This ment that everyone didn't have access to all pools, quality liquor, and restaurants. This idea doesn't sit well with me.  Too much money was spent to feel like an outcast. The service was hit or miss.  I am blaming the lack of minimal service on upper management.  These people are willing to help just not properly trained.

reviews.author: Kymberly J
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: We had a girlfriends weekend and the resort was very nice. The food, drinks and nightly shows/entertainment made this a very enjoyable trip. Had a massage at the spa that was amazing as well. Would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Melli22631
reviews.title: Fantastic family concierge service!
reviews.text: We were at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for a week and friends of ours had suggested the family concierge service when we were booking. So glad that we did! We were assigned a concierge (Nikel) at check-in who was available to us the whole week. Nikel made our stay very memorable with his nightly treats delivered to the room including champagne, chocolate covered strawberries, cookies, wine, gifts for the kids including a balloon bubble bath that was ready one late afternoon when we came back from the pool. Nikel checked on us several times during each day to make sure we had everything we needed and arranged all of our activities. I would highly recommend the family concierge service and requesting Nikel if you are considering a vacation here. Wonderful stay!

reviews.author: mwosis
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: The property and resort are beautiful! The rooms are also very nice. Restaurants on the property are very good and the hotel staff are very attentive and accommodating. The ONLY issue we had was the beach -- the overgrowth of seaweed in the DR makes the beach unusable. But this seems to be a problem on most of the island.

reviews.author: Barbara Queen
reviews.title: INCREIBLE
reviews.text: servicio inmejorable, trabajadores super agradables, todo a tu disposicion, calidad de comida, bebida y servicio fantastico, prefiero pagar un poco más y tomarme unos buenos cocolocos o una buena comida con comida buena y alcohol de calidad, trato increible. de verdad un 10 y mi mayordomo Narciso impolutamente bueno! no os gasteis 800€ en ir a punta cana! vale la pena gastarse mas y alucinar como reyes, el mejor resort de punta cana, sale en muchos videoclips por lo bonito e increible que es tanto de dia como de noche

reviews.author: María Fernanda E
reviews.title: Totalmente recomendado
reviews.text: Excelente atención de principio a fin, el hotel es hermoso, tranquilo, la comida es excelente, en especial la del Gabi Club y la atención del personal del mismo es excelente (nuestro mesero oficial Cristian Fernandez )....recomendadísimo este hotel.

reviews.author: 932catherinef
reviews.title: Paridise at Paradisus
reviews.text: We went for wedding and turned it into an amazing vacation.  The hotel was great, staff was wonderful we had an amazing time.  The room was comfortable, the hotel and grounds was very clean.  Top notch!!

reviews.author: l0la755
reviews.title: Very satisfied
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the service I received at Paradisus Palma real. I attend this resort for a weddind and I enjoyed my stay very much. The food was delicious the drinks were great. I would defenately return.

reviews.author: jeromek128
reviews.title: 5 day getaway
reviews.text: Our second visit in the last three years. The first was at Melia Tropical which we enjoyed. This trip was at Paridisus Palma Real. We found Paradisus to be a far superior facility and had a great vacation experience. Our Pool Bartender Louise was both friendly and service oriented.

reviews.author: Linda S
reviews.title: Paradise At The Paradisus
reviews.text:
We had the pleasure of spending a week at this beautiful resort with a group of friends. We chose the Royal Service and everything was just wonderful....the rooms were very nice ...our private section of the beach was beautiful and the royal bar and pool was also great but most notable was the services of our butler Jose Salvadore. Jose made sure he checked in with us everyday, several times a day to make sure everything was ok, he made our dinner reservations every night, he made the golf arrangements for the guys and he even had reps from the spa meet us girls at the beach to plan our spa day and even a mini massage on the beach. He also left nice surprises in our room, fresh fruit and cheeses and even candlelit bubble baths. We were also pleased with with our pool and beach server Angel Frias, very attentive and just a super nice young man. Both Jose and Angel were just Great. Louis at the swim up pool bar was also great, very friendly and entertaining, we enjoyed our time at the pool thanks to Louis. I have to say we thought all of the employees were very nice and friendly...the servers in all of the restaurants, especially Wander at the buffet every morning, the activities staff even the pool maintenance staff and gardeners always greeted us "hola". A beautiful well maintained, clean resort ...very good food and very friendly accommodating staff. We hope to go back some day. 
....but I do have to mention that we chose an excursion offered by Olympus tours at the resort that was absolutely horrible...do not go on the dune buggy/jeep tour. Such a tourist trap. It was not about touring the villages and enjoying the adventure, it was taking you to places where venders were trying to sell you stuff and children chasing and running along side the buggies begging for money, very dangerous and stressful. I don't think the resort shoud have this excursion as an option. I wish we had just stayed at the resort and not wasted our time and money.

reviews.author: roseandrey l
reviews.title: Think twice
reviews.text: Was not happy at all!!!!! Worse stay ever... I was there five days to long. Food was gross, everything took to long to make it to the. Room. My  transportation was messed up from beginning when I called for Assistance at the hotel they did not want to assist I told them I did not speak Spanish and they sent me the same information in Spanish I have to call for times then did a conference call with a friend of mine so then they could assist me

reviews.author: Alberta O
reviews.title: Jr suite problems
reviews.text: We recently returned from this resort having stayed there previously but at the Reserve. The hotel jr suite we received was in dire need of refurbishing. The shower leaked , even after calling to repair it. The toilet didn't always flush. Room was very dim and not all the lights worked. Flies in room. Not enough towels. Mildew smell in the room. Most of the staff were very friendly especially Georges Alrich who worked the pool and beach. The food and liquor served were excellent. We will return to Punta Cana again but not this hotel.

reviews.author: luxonly15
reviews.title: PARADISE AT PARADISUS
reviews.text: The property is first and foremost a tribute to attention to detail from the welcoming of the staff to the special attention paid to the candles in the room for the aroma senses. The location to the beach from the adult section is no more than a 9 iron for the golfers! The dining works and highly recommend the Italian restaurant but all were great.

reviews.author: kg482015
reviews.title: Amazing Staff!!!
reviews.text: I had the wonderful opportunity to stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort a few weeks ago.  It was one of the most amazing vacations of my life!  The property is gorgeous but we all know that it is the staff that makes the visit for most tourist! We traveled 7 deep and we are kind of hard to please but your staff was ready for action.  Junior Martinez is the best pool waiter on earth!!!!  His anticipation to all of our needs was outstanding.  He knew when we sat down what we wanted to drink and made sure we were taken care of all week.  We felt so special!!  Junior Martinez deserves a raise!!  Then if that was not good enough, the red lounge was so much fun and Rolfi Martinez was such a great security/door man.  He is a gentleman and made sure we all felt at home while dancing in the club.  Your staff must really like working there because I can see it in the way they treat the guest!  These two guys deserve a raise!!  And shaky shaky, our dance teacher and all around pulse for the resort was outstanding as well!  I will definitely be back!!!!  Thanks again for a wonderful vacation!!!

reviews.author: Jasmin L
reviews.title: DR Trip
reviews.text: great hotel and experience, the pictures don't do it justice. lots of space for relaxation especially by the pool. lots of activities during the night by the pool. lots of excursions that were offered, some a little pricey but was negotiable.

reviews.author: Mark N
reviews.title: Friends Retreat
reviews.text: Top notch. Couldn't ask for anything better. Great time and value! We stayed in the Royal Services section and were pampered beyond our dreams. Our butler was fabulous. the men enjoyed the golf course while the ladies loved the services at the spa. This has been our best vacation ever. We plan to return.

reviews.author: Sandra J
reviews.title: Overall Experience
reviews.text: Great 7 day trip.  3rd visit in 5 years.  Staff always helpful friendly and respectful.. Extra kudos to Diego Gonazlez at the members pool bar ..always accommodating.  Elie was assigned as my Members Guest contact.  He was wonderful along with Brian.  They made sure we had everything.  The entertainment crew always upbeat, Yaziboo, Happy Face, Carmello (Ray Ray), manager, Shakey Shakey, great classes both dance and aerobics.  Housekeepers did excellent job everyday.  Food was fabulous everyday.  Something for everyone. Thanks everyone, Sandra J, Kat, Lecie and Aisha.

reviews.author: Philippe R
reviews.title: le reve pour 15 jours de détente et farniente
reviews.text: nous avons passé 15 jours au service royale le service y est parfait ,le parc de l'hotel est superbe ,les chambres sont très jolies et pratique en résumé le luxe tropical .hotel parfaitement sécurisé ça n'est pas forcement le cas dans tous ,grand choix de restaurants très bon à  part le français ou les plats pour des français sont décevants mais peuetre" so chic" pour les americains .,nous sommes repartis du paradisius avec beaucoup de regrets et de nostalgie

reviews.author: Elle D
reviews.title: Royal Service is a Must
reviews.text:
We  booked Royal Service & it was so worth it from start to finish 
Once we arrived at the Paradisus they took us over to Royal Service check in where we met Jose Valverde (our butler)  he made sure we had a dinner reservation the first night we arrived & each night after that.. you have a cell phone with his number in case you need something he's always on call even when he leaves  & is home ; he's making sure you're enjoying you stay.  On the day I became ill from  too much sun he went to the pharmacy to get me something & continued to check that I was ok.
My cousin & I had the best time  & are planning on going back ... You can bet we're going to request Jose again;  he became family by the end of the week

reviews.author: Calvin B
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: I had a great experience at the paradisus Palma real. The workers were always so accommodating, especially the two pool side bartenders Antonio and Gilberto. They always made sure the drinks were flowing and cold. Overall great service and atmosphere. I will definitely be coming back again.

reviews.author: Allecia K
reviews.title: This Place is Paradise
reviews.text: This resort was wonderful I did have Royal Services and my butler, Ferman was wonderful and made my stay great! We ate at Palazzo's every morning and for lunch Alexander Guzman was our waiter and he was great!! Alexander made our experience at Palazzo's wonderful and we wanted to keep coming back to see him! Shake Shake made Gabby Beach the fun place to be every night ! I will miss him!

reviews.author: 765guilhermep
reviews.title: The perfect week
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my time at Paradisus, it was really amazing! The services were really good, the beach, food, drinks and facilities of the Resort were perfect. I will recommend to other friends and I really hope to comeback

reviews.author: laurafusion
reviews.title: Again a great trip! How do they remember my name from years ago?
reviews.text: The fact that I and a friend (when she can) keep doing back from the East Coast says it all (my 4th time here). This resort can't be beat as long as you stay in Royal Service (feel all of the resort is good, but always stay in Royal Service so cannot comment otherwise). Tops on this trip - Martin at the beach and pool making sure we never needed to ask for anything is the absolute BEST, Wanda at the Sunset Bar making amazing drinks and remembering my favorite concontion, my FABULOUS butler Sandy creating relaxing jacuzzis to come home to before our dinner reservations, and the help from past fabulous butlers like Angelo and Juan. I still can't figure out how these great professionals remember me from years ago and still want to make an experience so great. Hope to be back for my annual December trip as I know I will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: jiggi86
reviews.title: Beautiful but not worth quality
reviews.text:
This resort is stunning. Gorgeous views, comfortable accommodations and the friendliest staff.

However, their food is simply not good. Nothing tastes as it should and will most likely make you sick or nauseous at least once. Even the nicer restaurants had sub par food. Nothing to be impressed about. The drinks are very watered down and also taste 'off.' For the amount you're paying for the all inclusive experience, it's definitely not worth it. There are many other cheaper resorts that are still beautiful and cost half as much. Or better yet, take a cruise, you'll get the all inclusive and paradise experience but with excellent dining.

The beach was also very dirty, tons of algae everywhere that you had to trudge through just to get into the water. But obviously that's Mother Nature not the resort's fault ;)

reviews.author: Nora B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - followed by disgust
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful.  The pool is very large and clean.  The beach could use some cleaning as there was a lot of seaweed at the shore that couldn't easily been cleaned.

The food was just okay and the drink were very weak - practically no alcohol.  Service was a bit slow at times, but overall it was great.  The people were really nice.

The entire resort has free wi-fi, which is a nice little perk.

I would've said that the overall experience was great.  However, after returning from my trip, everything smelled horrible- clothes, shoes, toiletries, purse, blowdryer, etc.  I had to wash everything multiple times in order to get the odar out.  I even had to soak my shoes and toiletries in Downy to get the smell out.  I had to throw out my suitcase, blowdryer, phone case, and charger because of it.  I have been back from the trip a week already and I'm still dealing with all of this and am very frustrated.  The smell is almost like a moldy/mildewy smell...which makes me wonder if there was mold in the room.  I had a great time on the trip, but this experience makes me wish that I had never gone.  I have never experienced anything like this before.  We chose this resort because of the 5 star rating and all the great reviews, but honestly, I would never stay at this resort again.  The time and money that was wasted when I returned makes it not worth it at all.  I will not be recommending this resort.

reviews.author: Colleen N
reviews.title: The property is simply stunning!
reviews.text: We were a large group of friends travelling together and all had a fabulous time.  The entire staff were so helpful and friendly from check-in to check-out.  We stayed in the Royal Service accommodations and our butler (Jose Salvador) went above and beyond our expectations in taking care of us.  We were truly pampered.  We had our own pool and beach service daily from Angel Frias .... we were never in need of a drink!  The aqua-aerobics in the pool were so much fun (Mini Mi was a joy) as was the daily dance lessons....even our husbands enjoyed the Salsa!  They also had a wonderful time on the golf course at the Paradisus and a surrounding course.  While we ladies took in the YHI Spa...it was heaven!!!!!  Then there was Luis at the pool bar entertaining us by delivering drinks on his head.  Our entire stay was one we will not forget because for a week we got to experience paradise!!!

reviews.author: julietT9008BX
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: Lovely and relaxing atmosphere. I was pampered and made to feel very welcome. I am planning to take this trip again. Thank you all for the lovely experience and our butler Fastivo was wonderful and very attentive to our needs

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: Amazing Visit to the Dominican Republic!
reviews.text: Our trip to the Paradisus Palma Resort was a dream!  We can not stop talking about it.  We made some friends on the plane ride over and on the way home they were "iffy" about ever coming back to the Dominican.  They stayed at different resorts than us.  We are definitely planning to come back! The resort and the people there made all the difference.  Luz Franco and Liliana deLeon were so wonderful in making sure that our trip and travel plans were easy and relaxing.  The food and service was phenomenal!  We enjoyed every minute of our vacation!

reviews.author: bcnowbr
reviews.title: Excellent Girl's Getaway - Birthday Celebration !
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort -- not too big but with a lot of restaurant selection on-site and shopping, beaches & fabulous pool.  Every day there were events from a beach party to salsa dancing.  The service and staff were very helpful and accommodating.  We stayed in a 2-bedroom suite which was beautifully decorated and had everything we needed.  Special hugs and thank you's to:  Kelvin at Mizu (hibachi) - very attentive and loves Michael Bolton (we do too!); Junior Marte in the buffet always looked out for us and greeted you with a  smile (and a mimosa!) and lastly our evening with Jhonny Acevedo at Rare was the best ever !!!  He kept us laughing and entertained and overall treated us so special on our last night -- recommend this resort highly !!   Elegante!  :o)

reviews.author: TanT80
reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful!
reviews.text: I just got back from my 5 night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real with a friend for a girls trip and am already missing this place! This resort is absolutely stunning! The property is immaculate and is so beautifully and tastefully decorated. My favorite spot to sit and relax was at Gabi Beach. They have tons of seating (sofas, rockers, pillows) and a bar within steps of wherever you sit, along with an amazing view of the ocean and pool. The pool is amazing! Its huge and was always clean and the perfect temperature. We never had issues with it being over crowded. The chairs do tend to fill up fast, but the space is so big that you will definitely find a spot weather it be near the pool or on the beach. The beach lounge area was also very clean, with servers coming to take drink orders and check on you. I would always see them cleaning extra cups and bottles too. I would rate the food as good for an all inclusive place, some places better than others. We did not go with the Royal Services option, so there are some restaurants you can not eat at. You do have to make reservations for dinner every night, which I would definitely recommend doing as soon as you arrive. This system was a bit frustrating, it took too long to do and some places were booked up. I would like to see them improve this system, it should be done in a better and more organized way. That being said,our favorite places were Vento (Italian), Blue Agave (Mexican), and Mizu (Hibachi style). If you do not have the Royal Service, make sure you ask all the places you can eat at because there are a few at other resorts that you can go to. The drinks were hit or miss. Sometimes they were stronger than others but were mostly on the weaker side. It may depend on the bartender but they should be using a little bit more alcohol in the drinks. Some of the mixed drinks just tasted like juice, like there was no alcohol in it. For paying an all inclusive rate, you should be able to tell if there is liquor in your drink. I liked that there are drivers in golf carts that can take you all around the resort if you choose not to walk. Our room wasn't a bad walk to and from the pool/beach area, but this resort is HUGE so its nice you have that option if you ever want it. As far as the staff,  basically everyone we came across was friendly and helpful. They all spoke both Spanish and English which is a huge plus. A few staff members that stood out to us were Jerry on our first day-who drove us to our room and got us settled. He even gave us a little tour of the property and a lot of helpful info for the week. If you dine at Gabi Club, look for Yaneira. She was a great hostess and took great care of us. Also, in the lobby bar, right next to the Red Room, the bartender Francis was wonderful. We went back to that bar several times just to see him--he was so friendly and great to talk to aside from making excellent drinks. Our room was nice, we had a suite with a garden view. The fridge is always stocked with water, soda and beer. The only complaint would be the mosquitoes. There was always 2-3 in the room which I assume came in during the time it was being cleaned. They probably keep the door open while cleaning and that's how they get in because we never saw mosquitoes any where else on the resort. Other than that the room was great. Sometimes it would take a while to get things delivered to the room like towels or room service, but overall not bad.  The only thing we found to be a let down is that there is not much to do after 10pm. This seems to be more of a resort for families and couples. There aren't many singles groups or a younger crowd. We met some people while we were there which made it more fun but I would definitely suggest they try to target the single crowd more and maybe have a place open later with modern music/DJ club type atmosphere. A few of the staff members said there are 'discos' off the property--but we didn't want to leave the resort. So really that was the only thing I would rate low. Overall, this is a gorgeous property and we had a wonderful stay. I would definitely recommend it to anyone going to the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: donnellas2015
reviews.title: My stay at your resort.
reviews.text: the facility is beautiful, grounds well kept, beach was wonderful.  My main issue is the poor quality of customer service, staff seemed too confused in most situations.  Being polite and friendly doesn't count for much if it takes too long to get anything done.

reviews.author: Karen G
reviews.title: Had a wonderful vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Resort
reviews.text: This place exceeded my expectations!  The place is absolutely beautiful and the people were so nice and customer focus.  We even had own butler...Thank you Samuel Rodriquez...GREAT service!  Also thanks to Juan Perez for the great drinks and service!  And also to Sergie, Luis Bubio y Zoris (the Passion Team!).  The rooms were very very clean and beds were very comfortable.  I will come back to the place in the future!

reviews.author: T2265KCangela
reviews.title: Paradisus is a magical place with a hidden floss...
reviews.text: I love my stay at this resort. The staff was friendly, especially the  diner staff and the activity staff. However, The front desk staff are one of the most unfriendliness  group of people that I have come across. I'm  only recommending  this place because  my overall stay was excellent and I had lovely time -but stay away from the front desk.

reviews.author: Luis R D
reviews.title: Great and exciting vacation
reviews.text:
A group of 20 persons stayed at this all inclusive resort and had a great and enjoyable stay. Lodging was first rate and the food excellent. There are numerous restaurants to be had, but The Gabi Club's chefs were brilliant. Getting to know them was a great blessing. They got to know us and understood our needs. Chef Silverio del Rio was outstanding in preparing our special needs menus. Always cheerful and looking for ways to please us and make us feel special. Tuery (maitre D) and his servers catered to all our needs insuring that we were treated well. Sandra Cedeno handled our restaurants reservations and made sure we were informed of all daily activities including childrem's events.
Overall, our stay was great and the Dominican Republic workers made the stay a memorable one.

reviews.author: Julie M
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!!
reviews.text:
I recently vacationed with two friends at the Paradisus Palma Real resort from July 10-16.  From the moment we entered the resort we were in awe of how beautiful it was.  From the check-in area you could see all the way through the main part of the resort to the ocean.  Upon checking in we were upgraded to the Royal Service area of the resort.  Our building was extremely close to the beach, main pool and the main building of the resort.  

I've stayed at several all-inclusive resorts in the past and this was, by far, the best in regards to atmosphere, food and drink.  We did not have any bad food while staying at the resort.  The main buffet was always well stocked with a great variety of good food to choose from and the restaurants that we dined at were really impressive.  The only thing that was a little disappointing was that it was hard to get early reservations.  We were told by the woman at the reservation desk that we could show up early and they might be able to seat us, but that it was not a guarantee.  We did try that and it worked for us at one of the restaurants.  I highly recommend the Sushi restaurant; it was beyond delicious!!

We spent the majority of our day laying out on beach chairs.  It's true, the beach does have seaweed on it, but the crews were out there cleaning it up everyday.  The waiters come around and take your drink orders so you don't have to get up off your chair if you don't want to!  We preferred to stop at the pool bar so that our favorite day bartender, Gustavo Pequelo could make us a Dirty Monkey (Mono Sucio) or two!!   Honestly, if there is one piece of advice I can give you...STOP AT THE POOL BAR AND ASK GUSTAVO TO MAKE YOU A MONO SUCIO!!!  You will not be disappointed!  He was our go-to guy and made us so many of those drinks and a few of his speciality frozen drinks as well.  Gustavo really was an all-around great guy and went above and beyond when our vacation mascot fell down a hole behind the bar.  He stopped at nothing to get Esteban out of the hole and back in our hands!  

After the pool bar closes at 6pm head over to the Avenue Bar and meet Luis Rosario and Eddy Mercedes.  These two are a hoot and they'll make a good dirty monkey too.  They put up with the three of us (and Esteban the turtle) almost every single night and made us whatever we wanted.  They even went so far as to hunt down bananas when they needed them for our drinks.  

If you are into dancing, stop over at the Gabi Beach Bar and strut your stuff.  They are open until 11:00 and play some pretty good music.  You'll definitely see Ray Ray there dancing and he'll most likely try to get you on the dance floor!!  After the Gabi closed down we'd head back to the Avenue Bar for another drink (or two!!) before heading upstairs to the Red Lounge. You'll most likely be greeted by Rolfi Martinez at the door, you'll know because he's the tall, dark, handsome guy that looks like he should be in a magazine.  Juan Suarez, the bartender makes some killer drinks and can show you some killer dance moves.  The Red Lounge was hit or miss, some nights it was packed and others it was pretty dead.  

Overall, we had an unforgettable time.  The resort itself, the service, the room, the people, the food, the drinks...all amazing!  I would not hesitate to go back to the Paradisus Palma Real Resort!!!

reviews.author: Michelewag
reviews.title: MW-Punta Canta Divas
reviews.text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my trip at the paradisus palma real and would return. The only concerns were there weren't enough towels to accompany the visitors and had to constantly make request and our butler failed to carryout our requests. We had to remind our butler or contact him several times. 

The resort was absolutely emaculate and beautiful, the food in all restaurants was scrumptious, beautiful bathrooms, great activities. I'd definitely go again.

reviews.author: MegPell3
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience!!!
reviews.text: This was quite an experience! It was the first time I had ever booked an all-inclusive and it was well worth it. From the moment we got there till the time we left, everything was great. We met several people that became great friends, and the service was spectacular. The first day we met Onardo Marino, who is so friendly. He helped us every single day we were there, no matter if we were on the beach or at the pool! The entire staff was amazing, especially when it was raining. Andy de la Cruz was the sweetest and nicest bartender! He served us delicious drinks with fresh fruit in it, and made a huge attempt to satisfy us since the weather was awful. He even had recommendations for drinks! The rooms were nice, but if you are looking to go to the bathroom or shower privately, than this is not the place for you. Shutters separated the bathroom from the bedroom. We were ok with that, but some people are not. Also, they cleaned our rooms but forgot to stock the bath towels!! They took the dirty ones and left us with none. Thankfully, once we called they ran over real quick with a few. Wifi was on and off depending where you were, but free. The YHI Spa and hydrotherapy were AMAZING!!!!! Definitely recommend to anyone who needs some relaxation, and it was included! The food was the only weakness about our stay. It was just alright, but we couldn't complain. The hibachi restaurant was phenomenal and they catered to our friends birthday and brought him a cake. LOVED the 24 hour room service. Lovely pools and views. Some people may say there was too much seaweed, but that is not the hotels fault. They attempt to clean it up everyday so kuddos to them for trying!! I would highly recommend this hotel to any/everyone!!! We will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Avid Traveler
reviews.title: Not as good as advertised
reviews.text: Rooms not cleaned, only ate at the buffet because if you don't have royal service, you get no service. If you need anything, ask Marco Florentino at the check in desk. He's the only one that knows what he's doing.

reviews.author: Judy N
reviews.title: Classy Honeymoons Review
reviews.text:
I send many of my clients to the Paradisus Palma Real because you actually get what you pay for there.  It is a very good value for the beautiful rooms, good food, fabulous atmosphere and surroundings.  It is one of the prettiest properties that I have seen and there is always something to do there. The grounds are beautiful and always well kept.  I recently took a group of high end clients that stayed in the Royal Service area.   The food in Palazzo and the top shelf liquors were very impressive to them. I would definitely recommend setting your dinner reservations immediately upon arrival however because the restaurants fill up quickly.  You are not allowed to pre-book reservations so this should be your first stop to be sure you are able to experience all of the wonderful options. I am asked many times if the Royal service is worth the extra money,  The guests that I have sent in the past that did not purchase Royal Service were also very happy.  I would recommend Royal Service for my honeymooners because their rooms are next to the beach and they have their own private pool with balinese beds surrounding it. No children are allowed in this area. Great beds in the pool as well.  It  is nice for their butler to make them feel special. I would also recommend it for discerning clients that are only top shelf liquor drinkers and very picky about their food.  The food in all the other areas is very good also- but Palazzo offers a tad higher qualify and it is easy to get reservations there because it is only for Royal Service guests. Martin (your beach server) is very attentive and caters to your every whim in the Royal Service beach area. 
The water has much seaweed in it.  The property is very good at raking the beach in front every morning.  I am very glad they have a standard rule that locals are not allowed to approach the guests within a certain footage of the property to try to sell them items.  That has been an issue with me in the past with other properties.... you are there to relax - not to be bothered with people selling items.
One thing that I would recommend is that the property properly train the staff to teach the guests how to work the nice sound systems in the rooms.  They should make sure each one has a remote and properly functioning.
  
When clients call me with a certain budget in mind and tell me they want a beautiful all-inclusive tropical experience with good drinks, food, and entertainment this is THE place I immediately think of.

reviews.author: 858crystalm
reviews.title: The perfect getaway
reviews.text: I do not have much to say! My stay was excellent! I only had to ask for small towels, but the service, food and atmosphere was exceptional. This experience was definitely worth the money. I will bring my family back.

reviews.author: Carol P
reviews.title: 7/2015 family vacation
reviews.text: Just returned from vacation with my mother in law, brothers in law,husband and son at the Paradisus Palma Real.I LOVED it. Very relaxing, beautiful grounds and friendly and accommodating staff. The food was very good. We stayed in the main part of the hotel and even without the concierge or royal service we were well provided for ( though my mother in law was disappointed about not getting reservations at one restaurant this did not hinder the good time) i would recommend this resort to anyone whose main goal is relaxing in  lovely soroundings.

reviews.author: Aurora G
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This place is beyond beautiful.... South West Georgia Dental Society, had their continuing education classes.... stay for a week... and didn't want to leave!!.... The restaurants were great!!!  Ate at a different restaurant every night... staff and everyone was very friendly  and so sweet  the beach was beautiful. The pool was fun the spa was relaxing... you won't be disappointed coming here... its Paradise

reviews.author: 808dwayneg
reviews.title: DP
reviews.text: Very nice place that was clean. All the resturants servered great food. I really enjoyed the breakfast the most. That is a place I would stay again if i vacation in the DR. The staff was top notch and the view was great also, You cant go wrong there.

reviews.author: Liza M
reviews.title: Awesome Time
reviews.text:
Three of my friends and I recently went on vacation to Paradisus Palma Real Resort in the Dominican Republic. What an AWESOME resort!! The grounds were absolutely beautiful! The rooms, restaurants, and bars were wonderful. Clean, updated, and comfortable. The people were SO friendly!!

We would like to mention some of the employees who served us to the max!! Our morning waiter, Wander was so accommodating, friendly and humble. He met our every need, and made all our breakfasts memorable.
Edgard Dose was also very friendly and helpful. What a great sense of humor he has!

We all really enjoyed the entertainment staff. Angel was a wonderful instructor for dance classes and water aerobics. He was a lot of fun and really knew how to motivate us and help us focus on improving our health.

One of the other instructors whom we loved was Shakey Shakey!! He was a great Zumba instructor and very energetic!!
Both Angel and Shakey Shakey always made us feel excited to join the activities around the pool.

Thank you to Salvador, our guy who helped to set up our excursions. We enjoyed our visit to Soana Island. Our tour guides, Carlos and Francisco were very knowledgeable about the country and helped to make it a great day!

We want to give a huge "thank you" to our personal poolside and beachfront waiter, George Alriche!! He was always watching out for us to be sure he met our EVERY need! He brought us all our water, soda, mas fuerte drinks, plantain chips, and towels when we needed them!! He was the best!!!

All in all, Paradisus Palma Real Resort was a wonderful all-inclusive resort, and between the four of us, we have been to many. However, the best part about our trip were the people we met -- Wander, Edgard, Angel, Shakey Shakey, Salvador, Carlos, Francisco, and George!! Thank you all for making our trip so memorable. Be sure to look for all of them when you get there!!

Adria, Diana, Liza and Renee

reviews.author: Gina S
reviews.title: Great Trip with Friends!
reviews.text: My two friends and I took a trip to the Paradisis Palma Real from July 10-16. This was my first all inclusive resort. My friends have been to several in the past. We all loved the grounds, service, and food! We were upgraded to theRoyal Rooms without any prompting. I would highly recommend those rooms! Yes, the beach was full of seaweed but this is normal in July. The crews were out daily cleaning it up. We spent hours on the beach in lovely chairs soaking up the sun. We found that making reservations could have been better. We got late times but found if we went to the restaurants early when we wanted to eat we got sat. Service from all workers was excellent. Super friendly and wanting to make our stay as great as possible. We loved the Gabi Bar which had music and dancing from 8:30-11:00. The staff on hand to dance and interact with us were so fun. Ray Ray was so friendly and entertaining. We also loved the bartenders at the Avenue Bar. Eddy and Luis were the best! They made any drinks we wanted and even took directions on how to make some drinks that they didnt know how to make. At one point they left to find us bananas for a drink. They went above and beyond. We looked forward to seeing them each night. Since the beach was not the best for swimming we went to the pool which was big. The highlight there was the pool bar. We absolutely loved Gustavo!  Search him out. He made a drink my friends were addicted to the entire trip called the Dirty Monkey. He also made some of his own. He was friendly and put up with our silly antics. The Red Lounge is the resort's club that opens at 11-2am. It was hit or miss on the amount of people present. Music was good and the staff their was so fun as well. Juan, one of the bartenders, and Rolfi the door guy were good sports! Overall, I would recommend this resort to anyone looking to relax, have good food, and have excellent service.

reviews.author: Dave K
reviews.title: We c am to the Dominican Rebublic for our summer vacation.
reviews.text: We have had a wonderful experience at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The Service has been top notch. In particular Angelo De Aza made our stay most pleasurable by keep the room perfectly stock with the things we needed at all times.  All the best form room 3931.

reviews.author: kristens464
reviews.title: Paradises Palma Real is incredible!
reviews.text: Loved staying at the resort!  It was the most beautiful resort I have ever stayed at.  As I walked around, I just could believe how beautiful the resort was.  I also felt extremely well taken care of and welcomed at the resort by the staff.  I would absolutely recommend this hotel to anyone.  I had an amazing time here!

reviews.author: Devyn B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort Great Staff
reviews.text: My experience here was great thanks to our personal attendant Eliezel Ruiz. If your a club member request him he made our stay so much more enjoyable. I highly recommend Eli! The food was nice room was great also!

reviews.author: Lucienrvaz
reviews.title: Ótima escolha!
reviews.text:
O hotel está muito bem localizado,a praia é ótima e a estrutura impressiona!Ficamos hospedado por 5 noites no Royal Service,estivemos aos cuidados do Mordomo Miguel que foi muito atencioso e nos atendeu muito bem!Na praia quem nos atendeu foi o Angel que foi fantástico em todos os momentos,sempre agilizado e nos servindo da melhor maneira possível durante todos os dias!No Gabi Beach fomos atendido pela Rosa Félix que também foi fantastica em todos os drinks e o atendimento!Chegamos as 10:00h da manhã no hotel e após o check in ja liberaram a piscina,também ja fomos para o Palazzo almoçar ,o nosso quarto ficava a poucos passos da praia e da piscina,o único inconveniente da estadia foi o cheiro de mofo e a humidade que surgia do piso pois estávamos num quarto térreo,o mesmo já li relatos de outros hotéis que possuem o mesmo
Problema!

reviews.author: RUBEN F
reviews.title: Great All incluseve complex
reviews.text: A wonderful place to go for any occasion, for business, couples, family or even solo. You will find something interesting to do at all time. The premises are up to date and exquisite, rooms are spacious and with what ever you need to feel at home. For family traveling with kids they offer babysitting with a lot of activities cater for the littler ones. The staff is welcoming and make you feel like royalty, really accommodating people. The food is supreme they have almost everything to please their guesses. Try the grill by the pool, tell them that Ruben send you there and don't forget to tip. The beach is really gorgeous and you can even sleep there if you wish, yes they have beds there. If by a chance you want to buy alcohol other that the one included in the room they have it at a good price no need to go out to buy them. One thing to let you know it is not easy to find on your own.

reviews.author: FruGabestad
reviews.title: Best Royal Service ever
reviews.text: Emanuel Sanchez gave us a great experience at the Royal Service! He called us every day to see that we vere ok. Booking everything we wanted to do, and restaurants at night. I would recomend anyone who want's a relaxing and romantic vacation to book now!!!

reviews.author: Michelle B
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: My husband and I went to a wedding and stayed at this resort. The employees at the resort were very helpful and kind. The rooms were nice but the only thing i did not like was the garden view. Hotel was very clean and inviting. Entertainment was great during the day and night. Our bar tender Luis Diaz At the swamp bar was amazing. He was always making sure we were well taken care of. I would highly recommend this resort to all my family and friends. My husband and i are looking forward to going back.

reviews.author: 210tamikab
reviews.title: Customer NO service
reviews.text: The hotel is breathtaking ! The food was pretty good but the customer service desk was very rude and non accommodating. For any issues, you must go to customer service for NO help. Getting reservations to restaurants was basically impossible and of course you have to go to customer NO service. A waste of time!

reviews.author: GoSouthbound
reviews.title: Fantastic !!!
reviews.text:
Impeccable Service !!!!!!
Very upbeat atmosphere from workers who always have a smile on there face.
This is our first time at this resort & is by far the best we have ever experienced. Our stay was only for five days but was fantastic from start to finish. I can't say enough about the staff & everyone goes out of there way to make the customer happy. Everything was clean & the workers seem to enjoy there job. We will stay longer next time.
  This is a vacation you will enjoy & remember for a lifetime!!!!

reviews.author: sparkadoodles
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We were three seniors from New Jersey who stayed for 6 nights. 3/21-4/1. This resort is beautiful.  .  All the workers were terrific.  The grounds are gorgeous as well as the rooms.  Would caution the beds are not queen they are double.  The food was terrific in all places.  This was my second time there and can't wait for my third.

reviews.author: JeromeAvalon_NJ
reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: This resort only lacks the ability to drink the water and/or brush your teeth with tap water! Other than that the 24/7 room service is first class. The wait staff will bring you Anything you request at anytime of the day! The property Is beautiful, lush, has a fantastic location, plenty of top notch restaurants, bars and nightclubs. You will lack for nothing.

reviews.author: Annamarie507
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Staff
reviews.text:
My vacation stay at the Paradisus Palma Real was from June 16-23.  I would be remiss not to write this letter of recommendation for the following staff: 

      Angel Alcantara.             Jose Bravo
      Osvaldo Macdonna.        Altagracia Pio
      Renaldo Gonzalez          Angelo de 
      Wanda Correa                Wander (waiter/Vento)
       Eddy Mercedes.              Luis (bartender/Pool)

     The above mentioned staff work long, hard hours and are ALWAYS courteous, 
well-mannered, energetic people.  As far as I am concerned they ARE the Paradisus Palma Real.and kudos go out to all of them.  It is because of this staff I would not think twice to come back to the Paradisus.  
    I want to thank each and everyone for making my vacation a memorable one.  If I forgot anyone, please forgive me.
    Once again, thank you from my heart......Anna Marie Parasole

reviews.author: Tiffany H
reviews.title: True Paradise at Paradisus Palma Real!
reviews.text:
This resort is true paradise!  I went as a group of 3 girls and we had a blast!  There are so many restaurant options, and whether you are laying by the pool or out on the beach, it's sure to be a good time.  We did not have the Royal Service and don't feel like we missed out on anything by not having it.  Staying at the Palma Real, you can also go to the Reserve hotel (free transport via golf cart).  We only went there once for dinner (Aqua restaurant...very good!), but that hotel seems to be more of a romantic Place vs. the Palma Real which seems to be more family oriented and better for night time activities.  Speaking of night time activities, we absolutely loved going to the Red Lounge! The music is awesome and it's a great place for dancing!  The Gabi Beach also has some great nightly entertainment!   

The pool and swim up bar became our regular hang out and we quickly became drawn to Antonio Ramirez.  He is truly the best!  Every day when we got to the pool, Antonio greed us by name, making us feel like we were VIP guests.  His drinks are super tasty and his service is superior!  Make sure you get out super early if you want a cabana by the pool. They fill up quick!     

Rey Ray, Mini Me, and Big Mac were true entertainers! We met them on our first day and whether we were taking dance lessons, stretching, or just passing by them on our way to the pool, they always called us by name and made us feel like we were VIP guests too! 

There are several restaurants to choose from, but some of them fill up early.  I'd recommend reserving in advance.  Also, as hard as it may be to leave the resort, take a day and do an excursion!  We did a day trip to Limon Falls and it was well worth it!  

If you're looking for an all inclusive, this place has it all!  I'd definitely go back, or even try one of the properties in Mexico.

reviews.author: bwheelday2
reviews.title: Employees and Excursions
reviews.text: The employees at this resort are amazing!  From the front desk, to servers, to housekeepers, to grounds, to bartenders, to groundskeepers, to maintenance, to entertainment we cannot compliment each one more!  Everyone was friendly, hard working, and wanted us to feel special the entire trip.  Some of the stand out employees are Rey Reh, Mini Me, and Big Mac.  They have stretches on the beach, dance lessons, water aerobics, dance parties, and daily entertainment.  They always saw us and called us by name, encouraged us to have fun, and even danced with us in the evenings.  They really made the trip!  Another standout empoyee is Antonio, the bartender at the swim up bar!  Be sure to have him make you a Daiquiri, they are the best!  A great excursion is the trip to Limon Falls.  Have Juan Carlo book the excursion for you, he's very friendly and will give you a great price!

reviews.author: cyclingman101
reviews.title: Wonderful Place
reviews.text: Wonderful, Relaxing and great service. Our Royal Service Butlers Juan De Leon and Nicolas  Maracallo are awesome. They worked hard at making sure our every need was met. Also our Royal Service pool and beach conceirge Carlos Rosario met all our needs with a smile while on the beach. I can highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real in the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Cycleman101
reviews.title: Wonderful Place to Stay
reviews.text: Beautiful, Relaxing and great service. Our Royal service Butlers Juan De Leon and Nicolas Maracallo are awesome. I can't say enough about their wonderful service. They made our stay most relaxing. Also our Royal service pool and beach concierge Carlos Rosario was always  ready to meet our needs while on the beach. I highly recommend a stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: MoMendes
reviews.title: Great place to vacation.
reviews.text: If you're looking for somewhere to stay on your next vacation look no further. People are great and the resort is gorgeous. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a true vacation spot. If you have children and they love the water, this is your place.

reviews.author: Kechia B
reviews.title: Things to know
reviews.text:
I am currently sitting on the beach at the Paradisus Palma Real. It is my last day here and I want to make sure to thank several people who made
Our stay wonderful. First is Juan De Leon our Royal Service Butler. I cannot say enough good things about him. He did everything he could to make sure we were happy. Another Royal Service Butler who worked right along side Juan was Nicolas Maracallo (we had a group of 18) and he too made sure our
Trip was wonderful. Our time on the beach was exceptional due to our service from our Pool and Beach Concierge Carlos Rosario. Finally, at the Spa we were pampered by Maria Pilier. I will write a more detailed description when I return home, but for anyone arriving in the next few days ask for
These individuals and enjoy your stay.

reviews.author: Jay M
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Excellent resort! Made my first international experience one to remember! The staff was friendly, the resort was beautiful and I couldn't have asked for much more. I do, however wish that the staff informed us that we had to make reservations for certain restaurants in advance. I was not aware of this and did not get to eat at any of the "nicer" places on the resort.

reviews.author: B1678YVangelad
reviews.title: Great Get Away to a Wonderful Place
reviews.text: The Staff was very helpful, especially Onardo Marin & Wilkin Joseph at the Beach and towel section. They were just Great Customer Service Providers!  Gregory as a waiter was wonderful at the Blue Agave.  Big Mac was the life of the Party, so enjoyed him! He is a highlight and Energy of the Hotel. What a treasure he is for Paradisus!   Beautiful Place to visit. We just wished we could have stayed a few more days. We Enjoyed the Reef Excursion, it had it all.

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: Great sistermoon vacation
reviews.text: My sister and I had a great time visiting Punta Cana for the first time. We loved the property and the food. Vento and Rare are the best on the property. The buffet Naos was also very good. The pool was so wonderful. Definitely would recommend this property to everyone!

reviews.author: Mayra A
reviews.title: So happy we stayed here and very impressed!!
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough great things about this resort. Since the moment we arrived it was a world class place. The rooms were very clean and super nice. There were several restaurants to eat, all day! Drinks at the beach, a huge thank you to Santos who was our waiter at the beach. He made sure we always had a drink in our hands. He was very fun and happy!! Sofia was amazing too, such a sweetheart, Carlos, Ramon and Pedro and many other people who were so great. They really make sure you have a pleasant stay there and enjoy your vacation!!
The restaurants were very good and fancy. There's everything to do in this place. I absolutely loved this place and everything about it!

reviews.author: Jean-Éric B
reviews.title: Mon Petit Paradis à moi...!
reviews.text:
Depuis 10 ans nous y revenons régulièrement et c'est toujours aussi agréable, voire merveilleux (entrecoupé de quelques escapades dans d'autres destinations qui ont eu le mérite de nous convaincre à chaque tentative ailleurs que c'était le meilleur rapport qualité/plaisir/prix du monde) . Outre l'infrastructure noyée dans un parc manucuré, la réussite est certainement due à un staff (de la directrice général de l'hotel jusqu'au plagiste) qui a pour seule préoccupation de satisfaire votre moindre désir et de rendre votre séjour un délicieux souvenir quand vous serez rentré.
Certes, le fait d'y revenir tous les ans fait qu'on y a ses habitudes et que le personnel vous reconnaît, ce qui rend le séjour encore plus agréable mais ce serait faire injure aux employés nouveaux chaque année, qui font preuve du même empressement alors qu'ils ne nous connaissent pas; 
Je lis quelques commentaires sur l'aspect linguistique et je suis en désaccord: on trouve toujours quelqu'un qui parle français car parmi les employés il y a énormément d'Haîtiens, mais n'oublions pas que nous sommes dans un pays hispanique où le tourisme est principalement Nord-Americain, donc le Français est une langue minoritaire et si on veut pas faire d'efforts, alors restez en France.
Si je devais retenir un point négatif (et il est tout relatif) c'est le "service maintenance" et le suivi des "demandes": on vous répond toujours "oui" alors même que l'interlocuteur n'a pas compris ou ne sait pas, ce qui fait qu'il faut souvent demander plusieurs fois avant d'obtenir la réparation ou l'objet demandé (mais c'est vraiment pour trouver un point negatif)
Enfin, comme habitués, vous trouverez ci-après le nom des salariés par service auxquels nous vous recommandons de vous adresser car ils sont toujours souriants et...surtout... efficaces:
grill piscine: Ramon Simbert et Ranelli Polanco
resto Gabi (piscine): Aronis Cristoforo et Frank Felix Martinez
concierge: Sandra Cedeno
plagistes piscine: José François Renoso et Emilio Baldes 

Un dernier point et non des moindres: comme cet hôtel est situé en zone américaine, évidemment ces touristes US ou Canadiens donnent un pourboire pour tout (c'est leur culture). Ne vous croyez pas obligé de suivre leur tradition, tous les employés sont irréprochables dans leur traitement du client et ce n''est pas parce que vous n'aurez pas donné 1 $ à chaque fois que vous serez moins bien traités. En revanche, c'est vrai qu'à la fin du séjour, un pourboire à ceux que vous avez particulièrement apprécié est une juste récompense pour les efforts fournis

reviews.author: josefinas262
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Fue un viaje muy placentero, es el mejor hotel que haya visitado en mi pais Rep. Dom.  Felicitaciones.  Lo he estado promoviendo entre mis amistades.  Las instalaciones ofrecen una apariencia regia, excelente servicio de todos sus empleados, limpieza muy minuciosa.  Percibí un alto sentido de trabajo en equipo de todo su personal así como un alto nivel de seguridad en todas las instalaciones.

reviews.author: Jonathan F
reviews.title: 10 year anniversary
reviews.text: Excellent service, food and entertainment. The butler service is a must. Please request Ariel Benzo. He is the best of the best. He is the most attentive, accommodating knowledgable service man around. He went above and beyond to make sure our stay was 5 star worthy. He catered to our every need even when it wasn't asked of him. I rate my stay at the Paradius at 5 but I rate the butler service of Ariel Benzo a 10 plus. Please request this man. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Temistocles B
reviews.title: Buen recuerdo
reviews.text: El hotel bueno junto con la atencion. Las comidas buenas. Los trip no fueron de mi complacencia por lo q les sugiero no permitir ventas de trip como el de la isla donde la comida fue apenas regular. Por lo demas bien.

reviews.author: Vivi62015
reviews.title: Relajo total
reviews.text:
Viajé en junio y la temperatura fue precisa caluroso, pero soportable , la atención buenísima. La gente muy amable, la paya con un poco de algas, pero maravilloso el entorno. 
El hotel bonito y las habitaciones amplias y cómodas. 

Lo mejor de todo fue la cena en Mizu con el chef Luis Concepción. (Mister Miyagi) cocinó maravilloso los mejores camarones que he comido en mi vida. 
Me voy feliz y con ganas de volver.

reviews.author: 210Patg210
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana
reviews.text: This was the first vacation that I had been able to take in several years and I had a great time.  We had Royal Service and the staff at the resort, with only a few exceptions, were gracious and helpful.  Our butler was Nicholas Maracallo.  Nicholas has set the bar high for my expectations in the future.  He was very friendly, professional, and made sure that any need was meet and concern was handled expeditiously.  Nicholas made sure that we had reservations at the restaurant of our choice.  The resort was very well maintained and appealing to the eye.  However, I would recommend spraying the grounds for mosquitos and cleaning the sea weed from the beach.  I have vacationed at large resorts in the past that actually raked the sand daily to remove debris.  The general rating for the food was average and not very impressive,  but the room service staff was great.  The food was always delivered promptly and hot.  I can't give this resort five stars because there are a few areas that could be improved upon, but I would possible return to this resort if I could be assured that Nicholas would be our butler.

reviews.author: Beatriz C
reviews.title: Vacaciones perfectas
reviews.text: Todo excelente tanto el personal súper preparados los chicos de la playa el comedor todos muy atentos con nosotros especialmente Elvis López nuestro concierge siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros y nuestras necesidades

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Best Girls Vacation ever!
reviews.text: I just came back from Paradisus Palma Real with 2 of my friends and I cannot say enough to the quality of service we had. The rooms was beautiful and walking through the Zen Garden to get back and forth to the beach and pool area was relaxing and calming. The food was very good, drinks were not your typical watered down drinks you usually get from an all inclusive and if you like activities there is plenty to do if you choose to participate. I loved the included snorkeling, saw so many bright and different fish. The best part of Paradisus Palma Real is their staff, they are truly outstanding. Ray Ray, Big Mac and Angel were always there to make sure we had fun with activities and we always had a dance partner at night. They truly made the party at night and work so hard to keep everyone happy. Frank Sanchez and Argenis were great waitstaff and remembered what we drank even before sitting down and I cannot forget Edwin Santana who made sure we were never thirsty on the beach. It was a fabulous vacation and I can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Jenn S
reviews.title: The Paradisus is Paradise!
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort last week for a week long trip.  Everything about the resort was seamless. The second you step on to the property you feel welcomed as well as amazed at how beautiful everything is. The staff was extremely accommodating, and always available if I had a question or a need.  I traveled with a large group, and we were completely taken care of.  I also had to be on my laptop quite a bit for work and the wifi worked well. The resort is so peaceful, but also fun at the same time.  It is great for both families and couples/adults alike.  There is plenty to do, including great restaurants, but there are also so many places to relax...such as beautiful lounge chairs and cabanas right on the beach.  The rooms, food, and every facility was exquisite.  I will definitely come back to the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Mary Ann J
reviews.title: Second to none!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is heaven on earth. The resort is stunning, the beach is beautiful, and the food and restaurants are five-star. That being said, I think what really makes this place to the next level are the employees. They really go out of their way to make this place your home, ensuring that you are comfortable and cared for around the clock. Exceeded my expectations, couldn't have asked for a better experience! If you're looking for a place to stay in Punta Cana LOOK NO FURTHER. Can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Cindy B
reviews.title: Sister Summer Getaway (Straight Talk No Chaser)
reviews.text:
First off let me start off by saying that this was my first time to DR and the property is absolutely beautiful so my 3 star rating is highly based on the beauty and cleanliness of the resort.  Now on to the other things.  I guess my first mistake was comparing everything about this trip to my Jamaica trip last year and this doesn't even come close. 

1. We arrive at the hotel at 4pm (mind you check in is at 3) our room was not ready and we were given our wrist bands and told to come back in about 35 minutes and our room should be ready. Well we do that and its still not ready but we weren't leaving until it was so they decided to give us a good room. The room was sooooo far from everything so once we took the golf cart to the room it was beautiful as well but it was a King bed and we asked fro double beds...so we had to track all the way back to the front desk to ask why we didn't have double beds...They told us that we were given a better room than the double bed and that we could move but not until the next day...Well to make a long story short we ended up keeping the room and being upgraded to VIP level for our trouble. 

2. The food was OK. I ate the same thing pretty much everyday (omelet, fruit for breakfast, nachos rice and beef for lunch and whatever they had in the buffet for dinner) this was at the Gabi Beach area.

3. I guess i should have started with this but if you are looking for nightlife THIS IS NOT THE PLACE FOR YOU...i repeat THIS IS NOT THE PLACE FOR YOU! Their idea of night life is a "beach party" where infants are leading the dancing on the floor. There was hardly no music playing by the pool and the pool bar was dead. 

4. Speaking of Bars, the drinks were horrible. I stuck with rum and coke the entire time. When asked if there was a specialty drink of the day, there wasn't one. Dont even think about asking for a drink in a coconut those are reserved for the high rollers i guess my VIP status wasn't good enough...lol OH and the Bartender thought it was ok since they ran out of glasses to dump out someones old drink and rinse the cup and wipe the rim off with her hands and fix my drink...it was paper cups from then on out...

5. The Excursion was awesome I suggest the Side by Side (buggy, natural spring, lunch drinks, catamaran natural pool in the middle of the ocean) The crew was so nice and fun and the food was amazing. WAY BETTER THAN THE RESORT!

6. There are lots of people trying to sell you things all you have to do is say no thank you and keep moving. It was nice to have a free shuttle from the resort to the mall. That got us off property for a few hours. 

7. Finally Resort credits are a joke. How can you have 550.00 in credits and cant use them with spending just a much...we left them in the room since we couldn't use them. 

All in all if you want to just go to the beach and thats it then this is the place for you. If you are looking for tons of fun and partying and nightlife look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Xavi V
reviews.title: Lujo en el caribe
reviews.text: Fui para un boda y estuve una semana difícilmente mejorable . Calidad en cada rincón del complejo, gran buffet temático , instalaciones muy cuidadas y en definitiva un lugar donde todo va a la perfección. Las habitaciones son impresionantes .

reviews.author: Sandy S
reviews.title: Our fun stay
reviews.text: Beautiful grouds, super friendly and helpful staff. especially Alvan R.Caswtillo (AC) Omar Hernandez, Jimmy Sosa from room service,super friendly and courteus Frank Sanchez restaurant Waiter and Jose Liriano.dotivn.

reviews.author: Cosas de C
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones de mi vida
reviews.text: Vinimos la semana pasada, si pudiera volvía ahora mismo. El buffet excelente en la zona de la reserve q nos alojamos y en el hotel principal. Los restaurantes temáticos geniales. La atención excelente.  Felipe Morla nuestro camarero en la playa un encanto. Un beso Felipe nos hiciste sentir unos reyes. Habitaciones geniales. Servicio de limpieza buenisimo.
