reviews.author: Dihjordao
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!!!!
reviews.text: Praia maravilhosa!!! Hotel maravilhoso! Gostaria de agradecer o excelente atendimento de Ramon Ramirez, muito gentil, educado, cortês e também Benita Mercede e Santo Frias com seus excelentes drinks! Não deixem de conhecer! O hotel é um sonho real. Vale super a pena conhecer. Os restaurantes são deliciosos. O chefe Alejandro do restaurante Bana é muito simpático e fez um jantar maravilhoso. Os recepcionistas da área reserve são super atenciosos e dispostos a ajudar. A piscina é deslumbrante!! Realmente estamos em outro mundo! O quarto é enoooorme, e a hidro que tem nele é excelente. Paradisus é realmente um paraíso.

reviews.author: Joann B
reviews.title: Exquisite  resort with a WOW factor
reviews.text:
Just got back!  As you enter the lobby, the view of the ocean, the horizon and the pools are stunning.  It makes you feel good that you picked this property.  It's exquisite, modern and newer than most properties down Punta Cana.  I'm a travel agent and did a site inspection of other hotels but I stayed here.  
    At first, I was going to take my twin grandsons ages 6 yrs. But I didn't want to be at The Reserve-where the children pool is because its too far from the beach. But others stayed at the main property and shuttled the kids to The Reserve with no problem.  
   We had a Royal Service room. Which wasn't really necessary.  You would do fine without it. They had a separate check in, that wasn't air conditioned and it was more crowded than the lobby registration desk. We had to wait for a room when we checked in at 1PM.  The garden view was very nice, but the screen separating the bathroom from the bedroom is a problem. NO PRIVACY. Many other resorts in Punta Cana have this also! I just don't understand this concept. The high tech shower is very complicated-it took 10 minutes and a soaked floor to finally figure it out. We also had a problem with the safe and thermostat in the room. We called and someone came within 5 minutes.
  The grounds are pretty. But Bavaro Beach is the big draw with its  wide powdery white sand and the palm trees.  We always found a spot to sit.  There is about a foot of seaweed that you have to step over in order to get into the water. This should not be, since the IBEROSTAR COMPLEX and RIU COMPLEX  cleans their beach every morning and rakes it.  Paradisus needs to address this issue. 
  Meals: you don't go to the Caribbean for fine food.You go to Paris, Rome, NY.  So that being said, some of the restaurants such as Vento were very good. Others like the Japanese hibachi were not.  You need to make dinner reservations -since they only accommodate 15 people per hour this can be a challenge. Make sure you have reservations  for the week for the specialty restaurants immediately after you check into the resort. 
   GABI BEACH. was great in the evening.  Big fluffy sofas and flowing white sheer drapes, lots of candles, listening to the ocean and the cool evening breeze. What's not to like.!  We caught a great band that had a techno light show one night. It was a happening place.  Other nights it was more low keyed.  The Boston Patriot Cheerleaders were at the resort for a photo shoot. It was interesting watching them. In the evening they had a show, which was very lame. We ended up walking out of the theatre.. The resort also had vendors with jewelry, wood carvings, and crafts set up booths one evening.If you couldn't find a gift there, they also had a free shuttle to an upscale mall down the road.  But the rum prices at the resort shop was cheaper than Duty Free at the airport & at the local vendor "beach mall" Make sure you know your prices before  for rum, cigars, coffee, amber and vanilla. Also know about the danger of Coumarin in Vanilla products.  This vanilla is dark and thick and has certain red dye banned by the FDA in the U.S..
   Getting back the resort review:  What makes this resort very special is the staff.  Everyone is happy or smiles at you. They knew my name, they are friendly and go out of their way to help and they want you to have a wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: Tatiana W
reviews.title: Unbelievably Great Service!
reviews.text:
(Disclaimer, long review) 
I traveled with five other ladies and with each bringing a daughter for a graduation getaway.  We (12 of us) arrived at the hotel and were taken to a wonderfully air conditioned lounge where were were served drinks and had snacks while the passports and etc were processed.  Then our luggage was taken up to five perfect rooms. Everything was super clean, the temp was set right and we had tons of space.  Each mom shared with another mom and then three girls to two rooms.  (teens can fit in a king size bed!)
The hotel realized during check in that it was my birthday and all stops were made to sing (all of the servers) and bring cake.  Later when I got back to my room, there was another cake and balloons.  Very nice touch. Juan and Raul(?) were both great attendants there. 
Our concierge ( Yeuri Beltre) was very helpful to book dinners and anything else needed.  We walked to the beach but could take a tram if needed.  The walk is really nothing and with all the food and drink, it is a nice quick way to work off the food. 

We ate at the buffet every morning and at the different buffets at the beach for lunch.  The food was fresh and the service was outstanding. All the restaurants were good too.  Fuego was the least favorite as the Red Snapper ordered by a bunch of us was just bland. The Italian place was good and the Hibachi was also a hit.  Best to steer way from beef meals and stick with seafood and pork dishes.  Some of us also really enjoyed the Red Tuna. 

The Beach:  Really?  Omg AMAZING!  We lounged in the Reserve blocked off area, but really anywhere on the property of the beach was fantastic.  The beach for the hotel is very, very large. Our waiters, Ramon Rameriz and Juan De la Soto were excellent waiters.  Both were funny, very attentive and made excellent drinks and suggestions for fun drinks.  They made us laugh at their "Drinky Drinky! suggestions.  Some of the days, we just wanted water in the morning and we never felt pushed by them. In the afternoon, when we wanted drinks, the two waiters were happy to supply.  They always made the extra effort for us. Every. Day. The beach is very clean.  We walked both sides off the Paradisus property and you could tell this was the nicest hotel.  Every morning, someone is out there before 8 am cleaning up the seaweed.  All of the other hotels had piles of it that people had to walk thru or jump over.  We had none to minimal.  Made a difference.  The water is clear and the waves were perfect. The girls went snorkeling and had a blast. 

The Reserve and the Paradisus property is huge!  They must employ 1000 people and if you walk by one, they always acknowledge you and said Hola!  Always with a smile. From the tram drivers to the cleaning ladies to the bartenders. Not one time did I every feel like they were just biding their time until the end of the day.  I felt like very single employee felt valued and therefore happy to have this job. 

The nightlife in the main club/lobby were fun and the shows were entertaining. Though they were the same performers every night, you could tell they put their all into the performance.  The Red Lounge was fun and got going after 10:30.  Our six 18 year olds had a blast for two of the nights we partied there.  Paradisus also had a fun beach party with dancing and there was always music somewhere on the property every night.

Security:  Also fantastic!  With six, young beautiful girls, we got a lot of attention.  But if anyone got a bit too close at the dance floor or was just gawking awkwardly, it was amazing how someone from security very casually stood by the offender.  Not saying anything, but making sure all was okay.  This happened a few times over the week.  Also, once when one of the moms walked home by herself, she went the wrong way and the security people quickly guided her the right way.  We walked home at 1:30am a few nights as a group and never felt unsafe as we would casually see security greet us.  
At the beach, when vendors walked by, they were quickly shooed off so as not to bother.  
Spa: We all went at different times and each had a good, tough massage. Laila(sp?)was very nice.  The sauna was relaxing and the jacuzzi was nice and clean. 
  
As is apparent, I cannot praise this hotel enough and hope to return someday again.  Maybe not "herding cats" (18 year olds) but with the rest of the family!

Bring bug spray if you are prone. But I never had a problem. 
Bring tips too.  Though not expected, these workers greatly appreciate them I bet, and we are all privileged to visit there, so why not share and help out.

reviews.author: Corbeiroa
reviews.title: Excepcional!!!
reviews.text:
Estuve en el Paradisus Punta Cana la pasada Semana Santa. Todo es perfecto en este hotel, te hacen sentir en todo momento como en tu casa, pero en el Caribe.
La comida es de muy alto nivel. Se han incluido alimentos muy saludables, platos de alta cocina, todo en unos espacios encantadores.
Recomiendo sobre todo La Palapa y el restaurante Martín Berasategui.
Dentro de que todo el personal es encantador, quiero destacar sobre todos ellos a NELSON Y RICARDO DEL GIMNASIO, fui a hacer deporte todos los días y he de decir que son fantásticos, encantadores y buenos profesionales. NELSON además de sus labores ayudó a mi hermana curándole de una lesión, eso no tiene precio.
Desde aquí les quiero mandar un fuerte abrazo a los dos.
Igualmente quiero destacar la impecable profesionalidad de Claribel, miembro del personal del Club Vacacional. Todos los trabajadores del club son maravillosos pero ella es muy muy especial.
Volveremos sin dudarlo

reviews.author: seveenh
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: We've done many all inclusive resorts all over the Caribbean and this was the worst of them all.  Not recommended at all.  There are a lot better places around the Caribbean to stay for the same amount of money.  Poor service,  wasn't made to feel important.

reviews.author: Jackie R
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: The view when you arrive here is WOW! The fountain, pool and ocean all in one look. Alvaro R Castillo (AC) was our family concierge.  He handled everything.  I don't think you need the royal service.  Everyone from, Jimmy Sosa who happily brought us room service breakfast everyday to Alfredo Eltoro, who had our drink order ready when we came to the buffet for lunch , Frank Sanchez who served us dinner , Francis who was at Rare(the best restaurant)Gregorio Sosa hibachi chef at Mizu(2nd best restaurant)to Omar Hernandez who helped me print my boarding pass, could not have been more helpful or friendly! Pool bartenders, activities people (aroebics in pool everyday super fun) towel girls and Jose with excursions all great! Beautiful hotel with an outstanding staff!

reviews.author: Elaine S
reviews.title: Relaxing and Beautiful
reviews.text:
This has to be one of my favorite vacations for the price.  The resort itself is absolutely beautiful.  Someone was looking at my pictures and actually said, "These do not even look real; this place looks like a postcard."  

There are a variety of restaurants from which to choose and I did not have one single bad meal while I was there.  The staff was very friendly and quick to respond to any problems I had (and there were not a lot).  

Great value!

reviews.author: Maria Yolanda A
reviews.title: EXCELENTE LUGAR PARA ESTAR EN FAMILIA
reviews.text: El hospedaje e instalación del Hotel es de primera clase, excelente servicio  del equipo de ama de llaves la Señoras: Dely cuevas, Cleybi Rosario y Gina Vilorio y la atención del joven Ezequiel Álvarez

reviews.author: Patricia L
reviews.title: Sister's Trip
reviews.text: Hotel was Beautiful, staff was excellent. We just wished that the pools where open a little later. All restaurants where good that we ate at except the Hibachi grill-could use improvement in staff cooking food was over cooked.

reviews.author: Rita0821
reviews.title: A tener en cuenta
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, su atención, la comida, el servicio, los espacios comunes amplios y muy bien distribuidos, recomendable 100%.
La gente es muy amable todo el tiempo y siempre están a disposición del huésped......

reviews.author: Misspeachybelle
reviews.title: Paradisus = Paradise
reviews.text:
I spent 5 days and 4 nights in absolute Dominican heaven. This resort was recommend to us by friends that traveled with us. We couldn't have asked for a better vacation, the resort was beautiful, staff was friendly and food always hot.

We had a garden room which was perfect for us, I wanted to spend most of my time in the water so I didn't need a luxury room. I was very impressed with the bath tub was large enough for us to enjoy if we chose.

There was always plenty to do around the resort. On our first night there was a beach party and my husband ended up being the life of the party thanks to Ray Ray and Big Mac. There was a Michael Jackson tribute show that was better than expected on Saturday night. Sunday night there was a Fiesta which was nice but not as nice as the beach party on Thursday.

Overall: the resort was great. The restaurants were tasty and the buffet didn't get "old".

reviews.title: Palazzo restaurant
reviews.text: I recently took a few days of R&R at the hotel. I was impressed with everything the property had to offer. The most pleasurable experience was the head captain of Palazzo Juan De Aza. In all my travel experiences have I met a true professional. His dedication to his customers are second to none. He is a gentle man of few words however commands the respect of his staff by leading through example. When in Paradisus Palma real, you would be remised if you don't dine  with Juan at Palazzo. Fantastic food and world class service direct by one of the nicest man I have ever met.

reviews.author: Kimberly G
reviews.title: Blown Away!! I love Punta Cana!!
reviews.text: Where to start with this amazing resort. After many hours of research I book this resort for a fives days and let me tell you I am so happy I did. Whe we arrived at the hotel we were greeted with smiles and direction to the lobby. They took my bags gave me a tag. We were early for check-in so the clerk at the desk gave us our bands and told us feel free to explore the resort. Once we got into our suite it was live at first site. The room setup is great in the junior suite. The buffet area was nice and very clean. The food was good with all sorts of variety. The pools were nice and the beach sitting was great. Everyday at the buffet we had an absolute wonderful waiter name Wander Y (can't remember the spelling his last name). He made sure me and my friend had everything we wanted. Guest services at the hotel were very accommodating as well with booking restaurants and other services. All around I loved this resort and I will return. Oh I almost forgot about Jose at the bar by the Michael Jackson show he makes great drinks. Oh oh and the midnight restaurant crew were great as well. Man I really don't have anything bad to say about this resort.  Last thing FREE WI-FI!!!

reviews.author: acasasnovasg
reviews.title: A WONDERFUL PARADISUS PARADISE !
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real
Royal Section 

Paradisus Part One
of three

Last weekend we stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real located at Bavaro Beach in the beautiful Eastern Coast of Dominican Republic...an unforgettable, superb experience ! 
Maribel Lazala, Editor of well a known- prestigious Dominican Magazine "En Sociedad", close cousin to my wife and long time friend of mine invited us, as she was writing an article about the successful high-end property of Melia hotels.  
Bavaro Beach area is "the" Caribbean heaven for All-Inclusive ; best white sandy beaches and water sports, finest Resorts, multiple attractions in and around, excellent Airport on-site and the very best viability and intercommunication within the area and to the rest of the Island, including beautiful Colonial and Modern Santo Domingo, capital city of Dominican Republic. 
As we entered Paradisus, we noticed it's gorgeous well kept grounds making a statement of its 5 stars resort rating. 
At the main entrance we were escorted, bypassing regular reception, to an exclusive Royal Service Concierge and Reception Area were a Guest Service representative took care of us all. While we were sipping a nice Cava we were greeted by the resorts Assistant Manager who introduced us to our personal "mayordomo" (butler) and he would take care of all four of us at all times and all places - and pampered all our needs throughout our entire stay at Paradisus Royal Area.  
As an Architect and Tourism "expert", need to note that not only the buildings, but general layout, deco details, gorgeous pools with integrated Jaccuzis, bars, restaurants and all facilities and locations, were meticulously designed for the guests enjoyment. 
Service and all-personnel are extremely well trained and the friendliest you can find in any all-inclusive resort. 
We particularly enjoyed the large beautiful white sandy beach and swimming pools. The Spa facilities are second to none with its location overlooking the pools, but separated from its activities. 
Restaurants would merit a review by themselves as they are many and all of them offering top quality diversified options. First day, we enjoyed "Vento" the Mediterranean option, then we had "Palazzo", an exclusive option for Royal Service Section, with its nice italian pastas and recipes and, of course, "PASSION" by Martin Berasategui, well known Basque Spaniard chef, which holds seven (7) Michelin stars worldwide. 
As we were slowly enjoying all Resort we had an excellent All Included Room Service at our Suites by the terraces overlooking the beach were guests were either resting having fresh island fruits or enjoying all water-sports and attractions available, including a couple of nice antique Caravels (old Spaniard ships) reproductions for guests entertainment. 
Sitting and sipping a nice Cava or after dinner drinks by night at the very large but cozy Grand Patio with a "parade" of ever changing illuminated sculptures is an experience...A MUST!!!
I could keep going for a long time all over those splendid Paradisus details, but I will saved those and its many Restaurants for other reviews. 
We had the opportunity to meet with Olquidea from Public Relations and Conrad (Paradisus GM), who is a young intellectual, but nice well-top trained professional hotelier.  We also had an excellent impression from Conrad and agreed to meet in Santo Domingo in the near future to continue our interesting food and wine conversation. 
Our butler, Johnfi...took excellent care of all our requests and needs, everywhere at any time as he seems to be all over the resort, just for us. 
At our departure time he took care of our luggage fluently and faultless  throughout Concierge to lobby to our SUV, where we were sadly off, to Autovia del Este, back to Santo Domingo...after this time in PARADISE !

reviews.author: Beautiful W
reviews.title: Excellent customer service!
reviews.text:
This hotel was beautiful and food was excellent!  However, I wanted to take the time to acknowledge the staff in hopes that this resort will recognize the following:

Luis Rosario, Jan Erick German, Oscar Burgos, Anabelis, Wander, Robison (Gabi Beach Bar) and Cruz (Mexican Restaurant)!  

Concerns:  (1) The shower drain was backed up my entire stay.   We had to wait 10 minutes between showers, for the water to go down. The announcement of activities and shows.  There weren't daily schedules sent to your room with the list of activities, which did not seem like many.  You had to walk up to the lobby each day to read a board.  Another guest told me that they saw a show, but I never saw it posted anywhere... However, these observations do not prevent me from providing an overall rating of "Excellent".  This was my third time to Punta Cana, DR.  This is a very nice resort!

Lastly, I've never taken the time out to right a review on trip advisor. Please take the time to recognize your employees, who work so hard!

reviews.author: Wildcatviv
reviews.title: Beautiful property, but the service wasn't so beautiful
reviews.text:
1) 
I gave my concierge Elvis  three restaurants for the three upcoming nights the second morning that we arrived , and from then , we felt we have to chase down to the concierge for the reservation paper everyday (restaurants wont let you in without the paper) . And at the last evening we stayed, when we asked him for our reservation paper around 5pm ,he said he doesnt have the record for our reservation,  and finally he called us 30 mins later than he promised, he got us the reservation at 7pm (we eat our dinner at 6:30pm everyday). but we ended up in the buffet. because we lost the mood to walk all the way to the restaurant.
2)We reported to Elvis about our water running problem in the shower at the first night,
the water is going down very slowly. And we had to make arrangement with our shower time schedule. My friend would shower first, the I would shower 2 hours later. (Afraid that the water would overflow). and IT NEVER GOT FIXED DURING OUR ENTIRE STAY !!!
3)What really disappointed us was that on the day we had to check out, we asked the concierge if they can send someone to help us carry our luggage from the second floor, we asked them to come a little bit before 9:20am because our pick up time is 9:30am at the lobby. We waited till 9:25am and no one came. We decided to carry our luggage on our own and had to bump it all the way down.

I thought the concierge thing should make us lay back and relax ,but it was  not the story.

The pool was beautiful, and life enriching classes were fun. But the service still need to be work on.

reviews.author: 976augustinec
reviews.title: Excellent layout and grounds well taken care of
reviews.text: Martin Lineo was a tremendous asset and took care of all our needs at the Beach and in the Pool area. A really dedicated employee that obviously enjoys his job and his overall concern for our well being was refreshing and greatly appreciated.

reviews.author: ShaylaKayla
reviews.title: All in all a great girlfriends' getaway!
reviews.text:
Well overall it was a lovely trip, some of the stand out service persons where Rosa Marie the concierge, Jose the cabana waiter, and Danger the bartender. The room itself was nice, there was a mini rainforest in the hallway, which was pretty cool, until I saw a lizard amongst the greenery, which freaked me out, The food was pretty good although I would have prefered more American food, there was a lot of opportunty to try new foods and drinks from all over the world. I was impressed how talented the workers there were most spoke several languages.
My critic was that for some reason they were shy about giving us more than three towels. At one point the housekeeper went into the empty room next door and grabbed us a few extras, which is very weird. But I definately plan on returning next year and bringing my own towels!

reviews.author: Marsha B
reviews.title: The beach service is great!
reviews.text:
Beach and water are the best.  Great drinks and service. Incredible grounds.  I love my room.  Lots of restaurants to choose from.  Incredible beach dance parties at night.  Good entertainment.  This is my sixth trip here. Talk to Luis Santana and Santos Frias at the beach. Be sure to say hello to Mikey Mike .
.

reviews.author: debd601
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus for 5 days and 4 night and it was one of the most rewarding vacations I've had.  The resort was amazing.  The staff was professional, attentive and very nice.  The food was great with great options.  The property is very well maintained and the rooms were immaculate.  It was obvious that the resort staff took pride in their work.  Loved it!!!

reviews.author: Ellienaff
reviews.title: ¡Excelente!
reviews.text: The Reserve was great!! The service was great. All of the workers are so nice and gracious, especially Luis Santana and Marcus. Definitely try to get to know them when you come! The food is also incredible. Would definitely recommend it!!

reviews.author: KelseyMP
reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: We love Luis Santana!!! He was so great when he was bringing our friends drinks on the beach and talking to us! The beach is beautiful and the pool is AMAZING!!!! The water is the perfect temperature!!! Food is amazinggggggg!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Maganastasio
reviews.title: Best beach weather and beautiful paradise vacation
reviews.text: This is the second time I've been to Punta Cana and stayed at Paradisus. The beach service is always on point and the servers are so friendly and love to make sure you are having a good time. My favorite beach servers are Luis Santana and Santos Frias. I would recommend this hotel hands down to any of my friends and anyone looking to relax and get a great tan. Enjoy!!

reviews.author: Blankcb26
reviews.title: Vacation at Paradisus
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus Punta Cana and had an amazing time at the beach. Had amazing service from Santos Frias and Luis Sanatanas and Ramon Ramirez! They really took care of us at the beach and made sure we had an amazing time. The restaurants were great and had an overall amazing experience. I look forward to coming back next year!

reviews.author: Janice L
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This resort was so much more than we anticipated.  We felt very pampered from the staff and the food was amazing.  We also enjoyed the activities and shows each night.  Our room was the junior luxury suite and it was very comfortable for 3 people. The pool was always clean and not too crowded.   The all inclusive fees were well worth the service provided.  We will be staying here if we go to the Dominican again.

reviews.author: deedee2015202
reviews.title: Totally Pampered @ Paradisus Palma Real Resort
reviews.text: My boyfriend & I  can't say enough about the spectacular time we had at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort. We truly had an experience of a life time. The resort was beyond gorgeous and the beaches were beautiful and Martin Tineo was fantastic everyday getting our drinks, chairs, towels and he always had a smile.  We had Johnfi Rivera as our butler and talk about Royal Service we definitely had all of that he went above & beyond we were treated like a king & queen for week.  Thank you Paradisus, Johnfi & Martin for a fantastic week

reviews.author: JimmyJam1455
reviews.title: BEST VACATION EVER!
reviews.text: This was my second visit to Punta Cana and by far the best!  I traveled with a friend and the service was amazing, along with the atmosphere.  One employee really stood out to both of us.  He calls himself Big Mac, Double Cheese.  What a personality and hard worker.  Thanks for making our trip so memorable.  And...thanks to all the staff, what a wonderful vacation!

reviews.author: DennisMitchell
reviews.title: ENJOY THE MOMENT
reviews.text: Stayed here from Thursday to Monday, one of the best experiences I've had thus far. The workers there was amazing, me and two other friends came across Josias Inirio (one of the workers)who kept us well entertained. Don't bother to leave the Resort the food was extravagant

reviews.author: Farrah B
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: This resort is nothing short of amazing. Josias Inirio and Rapheal Diaz and luis florian was a wonderful host who kept us laughing all throughout our stay. The food was wonderful and made the vacation worth every penny. Carmen was a wonderful host at the Gabi Beach. Great alcohol selection as well.

reviews.author: Damitria B
reviews.title: Definitely recommend
reviews.text: Loved this place. Very clean. Strong drinks. Good performances and activities. Good shuttle service around the resort. The male workers are really nice. Females...not so much. My favorite was Manuel on The Reserve. He served our room #2427 & #2428 and did a great job!!! Very friendly and very informative. I'd definitely come back.

reviews.author: angelb792
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: This resort was absolutely exquisite and beautiful.  Royal service was a nice feature.  Our Butler Elvis was very kind, attentive and accommodating.  Excursions were arranged at the hotel.  Polaris Buggy rides and a trip to Saona Island via speed boat to return on a catamaran should not be missed.  We had a fabulous time.

reviews.author: andreita201
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text: Me voy super feliz de haber estado en este lugar tan maravilloso como es paradisus punta cana.Bello recuerdo en todo los sentidos mi gente bella de república Dominicana gracias y mil gracias por todo luis Santana, santos frías, Jose de lo santos,benita Mercedes,rey de actividades,

reviews.author: blankis2
reviews.title: La mejore vacasiones
reviews.text: Estas vacaciones han sido la mas espectaculares, nos hospedamos en el área de la reserva, dónde nos ofrecieron un servicios de primera, el equipo complecto de reserva es una maravilla los chicos de las playas y piscina son un amor santos frias, luis santanas ramon ramirez, emilio valdez, jose reinoso, jose luis de los santos, wander roas, bebita mercedes... Gracias por hacer mis vacación inolvidables

reviews.author: Susan L
reviews.title: Good vacation but not perfect!
reviews.text: We loved everything about this place except the fact that we didn't feel welcomed by our conceirge in building 39. First night, we had issue with our shower, the water doesn't go down. We told the conceirge, and he told us he fixed it. After that, the water is going down very slowly. And we had to make arrangement with our shower time schedule. My friend would shower first, the I would shower 2 hours later. (Afraid that the water would overflow). We managed that ourselves and many other stuff. What really disappointed us was that on the day we had to check out, we asked the conceirge if they can send someone to help us carry our luggage from the second floor, we asked them to come a little bit before 9:30am because our pick up time is 9:30am at the lobby. We waited till 9:25am and no one came. We decided to carry our luggage on our own and had to bump it all the way down. I mean, we are two girls, if we could do it on our own, we wouldn't even bother to ask. When we finally made it down, there were three of the staffs talking and laughing and no one helped. And that really disappointed us. We had been reading alot of good reviews about their concierge, but we didnt feel the same.  There were no greetings/smiles each time we walked back in to the building and we were unhappy about it but it was fine. He could be shy or something. Everyone is different. But I was really upset when I asked for help and the conceirge didn't help at all. I dont want to post any names here but I would like you guys to know the situation. Probably it is my bad luck that we were assigned to this conceirge.

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Impresionante!!
reviews.text: I was invited to join a childhood girlfriend on a sales award trip to Punta Cana and our experience at Paradisus Palma Real Resort was outstanding!  The resort is gorgeous and staff provided exceptional service. Our package included Royal Service which included access to a Butler named Luis Sanchez.  Luis did a wonderful job taking care of our every need and making our trip a wonderful experience!!

reviews.author: Jinah P
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort and incredible hospitality staff!
In particular to one individual, Omar Hernandez, he was so kind and willing to help.  We were trying to check-in for our flight and print our boarding pass but the computers in the business center were being a little wonky so he helped us troubleshoot for over 30 minutes and was so patient - thanks to him, everything worked out.  Thanks again Omar!  He deserves a promotion :)

reviews.author: Al D
reviews.title: Gabriel Dalusma
reviews.text:
Although my stay was brief it was fabulous. My personal butler Gabriel was tremendous. He was extremely attentive and well mannered. I was issued a mobile phone with direct connect to him if I needed anything at anytime. He even called to see if I was content. The resort itself is topnotch and the food was delicious. I highly recommend it here.
-AD the constant traveler.

reviews.author: Shay S
reviews.title: Stunning and Gorgeous -- all of it!  From the rooms to the food to the people...
reviews.text: We are absolutely IN LOVE with The Reserve at Paradisus, Punta Cana! My niece and I traveled there to celebrate her graduation from college and a fun girl's getaway. The resort and beach were stunning and very well maintained. From the greeting when we arrived until the goodbyes on the day of our departure, we were treated so kindly. They created a very comfortable and relaxing atmosphere.  These folks are amazing at their jobs -- entertaining guests.  We always felt we got "special" treatment (though I'm sure we didn't!). There were plenty of choices in restaurants -- the food was great and always attractively presented.  There were quite a few staff members who were incredibly sweet and made our stay spectacular -- Hazael Reyez, Ambiorix Mesa, Danger Fully, Porfirio Casado, Danger, Maria, Danger, Diego, Danger, Luis, Danger, Aronis, Rafael, Santos and not to forget -- Danger Fully (seriously, that dude freaking rocked! \m/ ). Some recommendations -- don't believe everything you read on the reviews. We felt very safe there and found the beach vendors to be very respectful. Take plenty of sunblock and aloe.  We found it helpful to have a few over-the-counter meds like Immodium and Pepto (rarely needed, but highly appreciated when we did). Take a couple of nice things to wear to dinner. Otherwise, don't over pack. You are going to be in your swim suit 80% of the time. We would highly recommend a stay here and plan to return.

reviews.author: wowsmart
reviews.title: The Good and the Bad
reviews.text:
I was there in Jan and found the place to be great.   We were on the side with a butler. The beach and the Martin running the beach was great.  The private pool area was also great.  I would grade the food at an A.   There were a few things in the food area then needed help, but overall it was good.   The two biggest problems were the entertainment and the casino.   The entertainment was not worth even going too.   The Michel Jackson guy just danced,  he did not sing.   The Lion King was a group with hats on.   The casino was so small.  About 20 old slot machines.   If you won 20 cents you would have to wait for someone to come and cash you out.  Only about 4 tables.  Unless you want to drink every night the night life was a little sad.   I would go back, but my wife who doesn't drink does not want to go. 
The service was pretty good.  However, with over 80% of the visitors from N America, the English should be better.

reviews.author: Josefina P
reviews.title: Vacaciones Perfectas!!
reviews.text:
Recomiendo mucho el hotel Paradisus, la verdad que tuvimos una estadía inolvidable. Vale mucho la pena pagar el extra por la pulsera Royal si uno va sin niños. La atención fue fantástica, la acogida que tuvimos de oscar de la cruz, de tony guerrero, de Quintina en el restauran la Palapa y de Jeremias que nos atendía en la playa, hizo que nuestras vacaciones fueran perfectas!
Gracias por tan excelente servicio!!!
Muy recomendable!

reviews.author: susanbA5910PL
reviews.title: A Trip to Paradise
reviews.text: We were a group of 9 women between the ages of 79 down to 48 from Arizona and Washington state who were privileged to experience the amazing hospitality of your Resort Paradisus Palma Real for a week in May  of 2015. Everyone of us had a relaxing, fun, pampered week enjoying almost all of the amenities your resort offers.  Am recommending to everyone I talk to to visit you and we will be back in the future.  Velda Miller, Arizona

reviews.author: KPett06
reviews.title: What a fabulous place!
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful! The facilities were exceptionally clean & well taken care of. The staff provided great entertainment every night of our stay; from a performance of The Lion King to an outstanding tribute to Micheal Jackson. The service here is unmatched- choose Paradisus! The activities staff it's great- Jhordan Rosario, Daniel Spinal, Warlin Peralta, Noel Vasquez, Jose, Elica, Cesar Cuevas, Raynold, Elisabeth, Richard , Laysa- to name a few were simply amazing!

reviews.author: consuelo correa
reviews.title: Excelente hotel con un personal maravilloso
reviews.text:
fue un viaje realmente maravilloso gracias al servicio amable y alegre que nos entregaron Argenis de los santos, Tony, Quintina en el restaurante y Jeremías en la playa. David Contreras con una gran clase de spinning. La playa maravillosa, el hotel con todas las comodidades necesarias para poder descansar y tener unas vacaciones soñadas.
Además de Oscar de la Cruz, Ladys Amaranta, Jennifer Alvarez y Rodrigo Silveyra, un hotel con profesionales de primera.
Muchas gracias

reviews.author: daniela36373
reviews.title: Amazing.
reviews.text: Just came back from the Paradisus in Punta Cana. It was by far the best vacation of my life. very luxurious. The staff was incredible. Jesus and jensy rijoo at the pool go above and beyond. I told jensy I was craving mango, the next day he brought out a plate of it for my in the shape of a flower. Amazing. Miguel angel in the red lounge bar made amazing drinks. Alberto gutierrez in the lobby was very sweet and accommodating at all times, he's an angel ;) my only complaint is the wifi is either really good or does not work! also play more music poolside. Thank.you for the unforgettable vacation

reviews.author: AlbertOlivar
reviews.title: Genial hotel todo incluido
reviews.text:
Gran hotel para disfrutar de Dominicana, aquí algunos puntos:

Playas lindas
