reviews.author: Onthego16
reviews.title: Punta Cana fun
reviews.text:
We were in Punta Cana for a wedding and really enjoyed our stay at the Palma Real.  The staff was kind and helpful.  Had particularly great service from Emilio Lacourt (sp?) and Frank Sanchez Contreras - they made the stay even more memorable for us!  

Unfortunately, because I've waited almost a year to write this review, some of the details have faded.

The food was pretty good - particularly if you can get a reservation at one of the restaurants.  The main dining room had a nice variety of items.

Would definitely go back again!

reviews.author: Steven A
reviews.title: WATERED DOWN ALCOHOL
reviews.text:
*This is less a review of the resort than an advisory to the public (the hotel, grounds, and staff all are wonderful)*

If you look at my tripadviosr profile, I hardly leave bad reviews, but I think the behavior at the Palma real resort was so egregious that it was necessary to point out.  

This resort unequivocally adds water to their liqueur bottles. Now you may think this is acceptable and maybe par for the course as far as all inclusive's go, but at this price range - when you're spending close to $500 a night - to have the resort nickel and dime you (an insult) in such a manner is unacceptable. 

This is the case at all bars at the resort - reaffirmed by a taste test from two seperate bottles of the same liqueur - I would sip a pre opened bottle and then ask the bartender to open a brand new bottle - where it was abundantly clear what was going on. 

I assume management will respond here and apologize but quite frankly, this stuff doesn't happen without management knowing and abating. 

Furthermore, the bartenders at the resort are fabulously skilled at making cocktails but this talent is wasted, as most taste like sugar water due to the aforementioned shenanigans.

It's just insulting and embarrassing for a premium brand resort to stoop to that level.

reviews.author: Niecy J
reviews.title: Felt like I was at home "only better!!"
reviews.text:
I absolutely loved my visit to this resort!  Everyone there is extremely helpful and made it their business to ensure I was happy.  A special "thank you" to my new-found friend "Yanit Hernandez".  Yanit seemed to always be there when we needed her assistance and I made a promise to her that I'd be back annually!  The resort was clean, the room was well stocked with sodas, snacks etc.  The beach was perfect, and the restaurants had great food.  I went on a girlfriends trip, but there appears to be enough to do for children and couples.  Our final night there  they had a beach party which was very nice.

Everywhere you go you hear "hola" and I was so sad to say "adios" - but again, I'll be back!  Yanit, see you in 2016!!

reviews.author: kle65
reviews.title: Amazing girls' trip!
reviews.text:
This was the perfect place for our 50th birthday celebration!  Six sorority sisters from six different cities celebrated in style.  We LOVED our butler, Jeuri Ferreira.  To say that he treated us royally is an understatement!  He was professional, friendly, accommodating - we wanted to bring him home with us!  He made our dinner reservations, filled a cooler with Presidente Lite every day on the beach, and basically did anything we asked and always with a smile.  The beaches are wide, clean and beautiful. Royal Service with Jeuri is the only way to vacation!

The food is excellent. Breakfast buffet had made to order eggs, fabulous fresh fruit and everything in between.  Fuego has good nachos at lunch.  Only bad dinner was our first night at Pallaso - terrible service and food was not good.  We asked that they leave our wine on the table, and they kept taking it!  We complained to Jeuri the next day, and our food and service the other nights was great.  We liked Fuego and Vento the best. We did use our vouchers to upgrade the white wine because the one included was not so great.  The Cabernet that was included was more in line with a Pinot Noir, so it worked for us.  Skip the spa if you are used to really nice ones - not worth the money.

This was a perfect vacation for us.  We just wanted a getaway to catch up, relax, and not have to think about anything.  Jeuri made sure that all of that happened.  Cannot say enough nice things about this place.  We're going back...55?

reviews.author: 67beachbum
reviews.title: Grand!
reviews.text: It was amazing! And the staff was helpful. Inés Ruiz was one of the gals who I remember was most helpful. We had reservations and she bodily helped us get to our location and made sure we were sat and satisfied before continuing her day. I thought that was pretty awesome.

reviews.author: BenAustin88
reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to this resort and it was perfect... again. Everything from the room and restaurants, to the pool, beach and service was amazing. There is no better family oriented luxury resort in Punta Cana. 

There were a few individuals who went out of their way to make our trip spectacular. At the beach, Luis Santana and Santos Frias always ensured our family had everything they needed. At the pool, Ramon Ramirez, Wander Roas, Emilio Valdez, Jose Luis, Jose Reinoso, Katiuska Fulguecio, and Jonathan Reyes were excellent - drinkey drinkey!

Family Concierge is a must for families too - your concierge takes care of everything... yes, everything. Silvio Antigua and Yasley helped us out even before we arrived, and Estefaia Ruiz and Nichael treated us like family. Elizabeth did a thorough job with housekeeping as well. 

We visited Passions one night. The dining experience was great thanks to Carlos, Ruth, Wanda, Bilis, Manuel, Nicole and the chef (who visited our table).

My only constructive criticism, just because I'm being picky now and I experienced this at one other resort in Punta Cana, would be the addition of a beach side grill (and closer washrooms) for the reserve guests. There is plenty of good food nearby, however a grill of this type would be awesome. 

Thanks again The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, we will be back!

Ben Austin
London Ontario

reviews.author: jeffreyr270
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, the service amazing, and the food at the restaurants was great.  Highly recommend the upgrade to Royal Service as the attention provided is worth it.  From Michael in the Palazzo Restaurant, to Pedro on the beach, to Leo at the pool bar, to our butler Miguel, the service provided was outstanding.  Can't wait to go back next year!

reviews.author: Will0099
reviews.title: Overall beautiful property, fun & relaxing
reviews.text:
I vowed to never go back to Punta Cana because of the last few times the food was just horrendous, the hotel (Majestic) not so impressive- service horrible.
But,
Family 50th party brought me back here and now I will be returning. If your looking for an overall great punta cana hotel choose here. The hotel is gorgeous from the lobby to spacious rooms. The pools are its best asset, as well as the beach. My favorite beach front in punta cana. The water however is a little dense with seaweed. The courtyard area is great for after dinner drinks and hanging out. Staff was extremely friendly and food was OK. Ok is the best you will get in punta cana as no other resort's food options are pleasing. There was night entertainment which kept the total of 30 of us busy at night. Overall great hotel, from couples to groups to families.. this is the best option. (Hard rock is a bit commericial... Iberostar Grand for adults-pro for some).

reviews.author: robertv602
reviews.title: Third time back
reviews.text: Excellent resort. Staff really seems to care and work at making your stay an experience. They are very detail -oriented. The beach spa was great for a massage. Would highly recommend the Reserve. Facility is extremely well maintained and manicured.

reviews.author: ShawnS88
reviews.title: The All-Inclusive for Rest & Relaxation
reviews.text:
The Dominican Republic has a lot to offer travelers from culture, to history, and to activities. But, if you're planning to just relax and take it easy, then I suggest Paradisus Palma Real. This beachfront all-inclusive offers an ideal environment to enjoy your time away from the hustle and bustle of everyday. We ate dinner in a different restaurant each night and found the food, service and atmosphere was great everywhere. During the days, we relaxed poolside a few days and on the beach the others and both were wonderful. 
To make the most out of your stay, I suggest upgrading to Royal Service (adults only) and, the day you arrive, plan your daily activities and reservations for your entire stay. This gives you the best chance to try various restaurants and eat when you'd prefer. Also, many of the daytime activities and amenities, such as snorkeling and beach cabanas, require reservations 48-hours in advance. Royal Service comes with butler to handle all your reservations and offer suggestions. This saves time, reduces stress, avoids hassles and raises the pampering effect, all important for a truly relaxing vacation.
Lastly, I suggest you take advantage of every activity and amenity the resort offers before heading off-resort because of the travel time required between the resort and off-site activities.

reviews.author: Melissa S
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and so is the beach. The staff was outstanding. For an all inclusive resort I thought the food was very good and even the shows were entertaining. At first we were put into a new room but 2 days later they started to do construction in the building so they had to move us and that room was not as nice. We were told we have butler service but that never happened. The health club had no air condtioning the whole time I was there even though they said it would be fixed everyday.even so I would recommend this resort

reviews.author: RetireeGirl2014
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Just got back from D.R. with friends and had a nice time.  The resort was beautiful and the staff was wonderful especially the activities crew (Angel, ReyRey, Rony, and Jazz), they were awesome!!  The only thing that was disappointing to me (sightseeing outside the resort) was seeing many weak dogs running around, it seemed the locals don't really care and it broke my heart seeing this!!

reviews.author: Jul B
reviews.title: Thanks josias & luis !!!
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing and the staff available and dedicated. I had the best of times. Thanks to josias inero and luis florian for their dedication and good spirits. I will definitely come back very soon :)

reviews.author: Dalia R
reviews.title: Beautiful and Clean Hotel
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel that was recommended by the travel agent and it turned out to be a wonderful experience.  Our room was in the Royal Service area and it was spacious and clean.  The food in some of the restaurants was good and in others excellent.  The buffet area always had excellent selections, so if you don't enjoy your meal at the restaurant, you can always go there.  My favorite restaurant was Fuego.  My least favorite was Rare.  As for the hotel employees, they were all super nice, especially Jose Ramos.  He went out of his way to make sure we were happy and satisfied to the point where he would heat cream for my coffee, which I will not drink with regular milk.

We visited YHI spa and had an amazing experience.  Milly and Maria C. gave us the most relaxing massages ever!  The facility was clean, quiet and very soothing.

Marisol our housekeeping person, kept us fully supplied with towels, a tidy room and she was very nice too!

If I had to give them any advice to make the hotel even better, it would be to ensure that the food at ALL the restaurants was excellent, but I couldn't rate them less than 'Excellent' because everything else was superb.

I went to this hotel with no expectations and was pleasantly surprised.  I will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Lisa50207
reviews.title: Beautiful! Relaxing! Quiet.  But not much to do.  Staff just OK.
reviews.text:
Definitely a nice vacation. Was with a small group.  Absolutely stunning property. Exactly what you'd expect!  The staff was very friendly and professional upon check in.  We were assigned a personal butler who showed us to our room, showed us how the room worked and presented us with a cell phone to contact him with anything we'd need.  The first day he called us several times.  After that, it was hard to find him and anything we asked for was a crap shoot if he'd follow through.  The Royal pool was cold but very pretty. Far too quiet.  No music being played.  There were not very many activities to participate in except first thing in the day.  The restaurants and buffet were nice but nothing to brag about.  When we went to get a bite to eat around 2:30 there was nothing open except a very small bar where we could get chips, salsa, fruit and guacamole and make a taco.  The casino was more like a very small poker room and the staff seemed annoyed when people wanted to stay later than midnight.  

I went to the spa with a small group.  It was beautiful.  However, you have to hop on a golf cart to get to the spa so arrive with plenty of time because we had to wait almost 20 minutes to get there and over 45 minutes to get back.  Someone at the spa told us we could go to another building to eat as part of the Royal area but when we got there we were told we could not have lunch there and had to go back to the main building.  Seemed as if the employees didn't all know what the agendas and hours of things were.  

One night there were a bunch of little shops set up in the center selling little crafts. Kind of pricey and when you'd walk away they'd make comments to you about not buying something.  A few vendors tried to braid my hair or put a bracelet on my arm. When I refused they'd get upset.  When you'd ask a price about something they would hand you a little basket and tell you to fill the basket up and they'd give you a price.  Then when you'd say no thank you they'd say why don't you think about it and I'll have it sent to your room to enjoy until you decide.  We obviously said no.

The room was comfortable. The robes and slippers were so nice and the Jacuzzi tub was fabulous.  however, the lack of bathroom privacy is a little strange.  There's a barely frosted glass door that separates you from the sink area and a folding wall with slats that separates you from the rest of the bedroom / room.  The bed was comfy. I ordered a lavender pillow which was fabulous. However, when I requested one for every night my butler said he would take care of it.  But after the first night we received a knock on the door and someone asking for the pillow back so they could prepare it for other guests.  When I told them that I had ordered one for each night they said that wasn't possible because other guests had orders.  When I complained, they did bring it back but never refreshed it for the rest of the stay.

The exercise area is very nice.  We also ordered breakfast in the room twice and it arrived quickly.  VERY limited selection on breakfast foods to order to the room.  The buffet was very good for breakfast though.  Some of our friends ordered the pizza to their rooms each night and said it was very good.  

My husband and I are very active people.  We like to relax on vacation but also to do activities and site see and shop.  There was really not much to do besides swim, drink and eat.  The pools, although stunning, were very quiet and boring.

It is an absolutely beautiful location!  We saw two weddings there and the staff did a great job of taking care of them and their guests.  

However, the staff left a lot to be desired.  The bartenders would speak Spanish and laugh a lot and spent more time on serving each other and the girls with bikinis then the rest of the group.  For the money and based on previous reviews and such we had expected similar service to what you'd receive on a cruise ship.  We were very disappointed that it was not even close.

reviews.author: BenoCosta
reviews.title: Paradisus como o próprio nome diz!
reviews.text: A experiencia no The Reserve do Hotel Paradisus foi realmente fantástica. Minha expectativa em relação ao lugar era muito alta, mais eles conseguiram de longe superá-la. Além da infra-estrutura excelente do Hotel, e a praia paradisíaca em frente, o que mais meu surpreendeu foi a cordialidade de todos os colaboradores, com o usual "Muito Gusto" que realmente me tocou. Me senti extremamente de servido por todos.

reviews.author: Renee H
reviews.title: Beautiful and thoroughly satisfied with our service!!
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived we were attended to and made to feel as if we were the only ones important at that time. The service was superb and we never felt like we needed to tip although we did at times. Everyone was cordial and I noticed that the staffed prayed together before servicing us which I thought was great. I don't have any complaints. The grounds were beautiful and well manicured. I never heard yard work or tools at any time during the day to disrupt our quiet room/space. Housekeeping came several times a day to check our room and check on us. Everyone's response was 'it's my pleasure'..... It sure was for me! Mindy Sanchez, Yeison, Tejada,  Cappiccino, Brenda, Samuel, Alturo, Julio, Silver Billy, Tianna, and Yeuri were all great!

reviews.author: casalnewyork
reviews.title: Best All-Inclusive To Date
reviews.text: I would rate this hotel Very Good to Excellent.  Went with a group of girlfriends to celebrate a big birthday.  The rooms were beautiful and large.  The food at the buffet was very good, the food at some of the other places were decent enough and very pretty.  The VIP section of the beach was amazing.  Orlando helped us every day making sure all 13 of us had seats together, towels and cool drinks.  The entertainment was ok.  The only issue is we never knew what type of activities were going on.  It would be nice if they stuck a daily newsletter under our doors.  Overall a B+ and I would go again.

reviews.author: SteveRose479
reviews.title: Fantastic place & space! Royal Service!
reviews.text:
We just recently spent 6 days at this fantastic resort.  If you are unable to enjoy yourself at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, DR - I would suspect you are simply not enjoyable!  Stunningly beautiful well and maintained large property, really nice white sandy beach with the gorgeous Caribbean waters you would expect.

 I would recommend upgrading to the Royal Service!  The Royal Service offers some seclusion from main resort with a private pool & pool bar, private beach with terrific service at both.  You will enjoy a private butler that will "handle all the details" of your stay, ensuring you are well cared for in nearly every aspect.  Our butler was an extraordinarily quality person in general, very caring and genuinely concerned with our happiness under his watch!  Great guy!  His name is JOSE SALVADOR.  He was sincerely focused on making certain that we had everything that we wished for and he went beyond the call of duty.  Jose Salvador's fantastic service appreciated our trip considerably!  Kudos to Jose from Steve and Diane! You would be lucky to fall into his care during your stay!

  A recommendation to the resort would be to have food available at the pool and beach to Royal Service guests.  If you are hungry, it's quite a walk to get to food if you are staying in the Royal Service area.  Room service is available 24/7, so it's not that you can't eat, but it's not convenient to eat either.  On one occasion, we walked to the main buffet, got food and carried it to the pool.  On another we ordered room service, then carried it out to the beach.  The staff would have loved to have taken care of this for us but they were simply not allowed to do so.

  Overall, great service staff, wonderful property and pretty good food.  I would gladly return to this resort.....like tomorrow!  Enjoy!

reviews.author: 908sylviam
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: I believe this resort has something for everyone. Great atmosphere, lovely rooms, restaurants and nightly entertainment. The views are breath taking. Beautiful beach and accommodations. This is our second visit, but not our last.

reviews.author: Martin L
reviews.title: Best Place Ever
reviews.text:
We enjoy going to Paradisus Punta Cana because the property is amazing and the people are great.  They pamper to all your requests.  We stayed at the Reserve.  Here are a few that made our vacation one to remember.   
Anuvi Aquino, Vianka Vasquez, Luis Amarante, Aura De la Cruz all at reserve.  Took such great care of us.  
Ramone, Luis, Santos  The men at the Reserve Beach area.  So much fun talking and laughing with them.
Emilio and Santos at the reserve pool   "drinki drinki"  they sing
Jose  our server for "Diner on the Beach"  made that night very special
There are so many more.  It is because of these nice people that we vacation there every year.

reviews.author: Maria A
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: Excelente hotel e instalaciones. La comida muy buena y variada. Lo mejor fue la atención del personal, todos muy amables y dispuestos a ayudarte en todo momento, en especial Johnfi Rivera y Jeury Ferreira. Mis aplausos para ellos!!!

reviews.author: Carola P
reviews.title: Muy buen servicio
reviews.text:
Todo excelente, sobresaliente la calidad de las personas que nos atendieron, en especial:
Johnfi Rivera
Jeuri Fereira
Felix García
Miguel Jimenez
Jesus Pereira
Franklin de la Rosa

Totalmente recomendable

reviews.author: Beatriz M
reviews.title: detalles cuidadosamente pensados
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene excelentes instalaciones, muy cómodas, buena comida y la gente es muy atenta y cuidadosa cuando se trata de servir a los turistas. Nuestro servicio fue impecable en todo sentido.
Las playa es maravillosa, siempre limpia y muy bien atendida.
Todos los detalles están cuidadosamente pensados.
Especial fue la atención de nuestros anfitriones Johnfi Rivera y Jeuri Ferreira y el equipo que lo apoya. 
Fue una estadía inolvidable!!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer T
reviews.title: Other than the Agressive Melia Club Sales Associates, I had a great time!
reviews.text:
Our stay was nice.  My only complaint are the aggressive Melia Club Sales Associates.  I was not warned they stalk you from the moment you check in, at the beach, in the lobbies of the buildings and everywhere in between.  It was very aggravating.   

Overall I would recommend.  When you go to the beach, ask for Ramon.  He will make sure you have a cool drink in your hand at all times.   Thank you for a wonderful time.  See you soon!

reviews.author: LuciClau
reviews.title: Paraíso!
reviews.text: Lindo hotel, praia deliciosa, inúmeras opções de alimentação (para todos os gostos!) bebidas e diversão (bares, boate, shows) e, o melhor de tudo, atendimento sem igual! O pessoal do hotel é muito atencioso e se desdobra para agradar. Para não dizer que é o hotel não tem defeitos, o quarto em que ficamos tinha cheiro de casa de praia fechada, mas ninguém mais no nosso grupo teve esse problema (fomos os azarados). Mas isso não atrapalhou a nossa estada, que foi deliciosa!

reviews.author: espiritu_nomade
reviews.title: Muy buen Servicio
reviews.text:
Muy buen hotel e instalaciones, pero lo más sobresaliente es la calidad de las personas que nos atendieron, muy amables y acogedoras. 
La comida de excelente; gracias a Felix García, Miguel Jiménez, Jesus Pereira y Franklin de la Rosa por tanta preocupación.
Las habitaciones impecables y todos los detalles muy cuidados. Gracias a Johnfi Rivera y Jeuri Ferreira que hicieron de nuestra estadía un agrado.
Absolutamente recomendable.

reviews.author: analia t
reviews.title: Paraíso terrenal
reviews.text: excelente infraestructura, servicio y atención tanto para quienes quieren paz y tranquilidad como para los que gusten de la actividad diurna y nocturna...un gran complejo que satisface las necesidades de todos sus huesoedes

reviews.author: Anyuta02
reviews.title: Unforgettable wedding at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
We just got married at PPR this past April.. All I can say is that it was absolutely perfect - everything was just flawless. The Romance department at the hotel is so wonderful - Raquel, Natalia and Claribel really did an amazing job. The food was very good, the decor was even better than expected, the DJ & MC were great and everyone was dancing for 4 hours straight. The service was impecable during the wedding as well with the staff being very nice and attentive to everyone.
We also did a welcome bbq dinner on the beach for all our guests the night before - it was excellent as well and highly recommend doing it. Everyone is still talking about our wedding weekend and how fantastic it was. 
The only negative I would add is the contract part - didn't catch all the 'small print' so were in for some unpleasant surprises.. like the included '3 course dinner' includes only 1 thing for everyone so for guests to have options it's extra $$ (and not a small amount). Really felt like they were 'sticking it' to us thorughout that process. After we've added on a lot of extras, we were told that to put wedding favors on a table (which we were bringing with us) we would also be charged (which I found just really in bad taste considering the amount of money we were spending on the wedding AND having 45 of our guests stay at the hotel). So that is something we did note in our evaluation form - something the corporate office can definitely improve on since the initial wedding planning experience should also be enjoyable and can't say that it was.

reviews.author: alysia78
reviews.title: Excellent trip!
reviews.text: Me and my friend stayed for the first time at the Paradisus reserve. I cant say enough how beautiful the resort is and the friendly and excellent service. Especially Ramon Ramirez, Santos Frias, Emilio Valdez, Luis Santana, Jose Luis, Jose Reinoso, Oneida and Wander Roa

reviews.author: Norzamp
reviews.title: fantastico
reviews.text: Fuimos en abril 2015, con amigos, sumamente bello, no ibamos desde el 2010, realmente sorprendidos con la renovacion que ha tenido en estos años, atendidos de maravillas en el NAOS por el camarero Frank Sanchez, super simpatico y servicial , psamos una semana maravillosa, relax total, disfrutamos de la pileta, la playa y todas las instalaciones de ese excelente hotel

reviews.author: Brian B
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: This was my best vacation ever, from the time I arrived the RCI rep Luis Munoz was excellent. The waitress staff Martha Santana provided excellent service always  greeted you with a smile. The entertainment staff Bigmac, Rey-Rey and Mini Mini was off the chain job well done guys....can't wait to go back!!!!!!!

reviews.author: peacelilly811
reviews.title: Prob won't return
reviews.text:
our room in the Royal Service area was spacious for the 2 of us, excellent comfortable bed, housekeeping did great job, resort grounds are beautiful and well maintained, the beach panaplas were comfortable, beach area was clean. The seaweed is a problem in the water, but not the fault of the resort.  We ate mostly at the Gabi buffet. Daniel was the best! The first couple of days we loved the food, then it became the same overall, just cooked different ways, and we couldn't wait to get home to eat healthier. My stomach is still queasy after 4 days now home. The papaya though was excellent! Loved the woman who made the delicious omelettes in the mornings. 

In no special order: Big Mac and his crew are excellent entertainers. Dancing music could be better though. The painting class was fun, but the fingerprinting class we did not enjoy bc the teacher criticized the people and was quite sarcastic most of the 40 min. Was not enjoyable at all.

our 'butler' was AWOL for a day or two, the pager didn't work, the bathroom sink had a foul odor most mornings, the water pressure in the shower most evenings was very low. Took me several times to figure out the shower knobs. Much water leaked on the floor. One night there was a knock at the door and it was a housekeeper mentioning that she'd be on holiday the next day, apparently wanting her tip to which we didn't give her! 

Our 'butler' could have done a better job. I think we sought him out more than he sought us out. Although he was very nice, with always a smile when he did show up. The beach butler also did not come around much. I did a lot of seeking him out as well. I had no problems with the transportation to and from the resort. The dinner meal at the Reserve was just okay. I enjoyed a massage by Silvery, very relaxing. Spa area quite beautiful.

I don't think I'd return to this resort, but just wanted a short beach vacation out of the States. I prefer small, quieter resort's, with healthier food/organic choices.

reviews.author: Taylerrenee N
reviews.title: Best resort for wedding and to be pampered!
reviews.text:
My husband and I got married at the resort. The experience was more than we could have ever asked for thanks to Raquel Vega, our Romance Coordinator. She went over and beyond her scope to make our special day perfect. We had Royal Service while staying at the resort and our Butler, Sandy Gill treated us like royalty. Will definitely request him on our next stay at Palma Real. Our days spent at the beach continued with pampering and fun with Ornado, one of the many great servers on the beach. He kept us laughing and the drinks flowing. Another employee, Big Mac, who headed up social activities, like beach yoga and water aerobics was one of the funniest people we had never met. He always remembered my husband and I and would greet us every time we passed him at the resort. Overall experience was excellent. 

Thanks everyone who made our trip so special!

The McCloud's

reviews.author: Dalemandy
reviews.title: Vacations w Friends
reviews.text: 2nd visit to the reserve! Best beaches, pools and staff. Meet Mike Ramirez when we arrived. Friendly face from last year! Great service on beach w Luis Santana and Ramon Ramirez best beach runners. Did everything w 100%. Would highly recommend the stay here. Best place in to go in Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: BillDugan
reviews.title: Great Vacation!!!!
reviews.text: Great time at the beach with. Luis Santana and Raymond Ramirez.  Great service.....awesome!   They took great care of us every day!!!!  The beach was great.....weather was fantastical and the services in the Reserve were top notch!

reviews.author: Bartb33
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: Great trip. Coming back again. Beach staff is wonderful. Luis Santana ,Ramon Ramirez , santos frias, Jose Luis , Emilio Valdez ,silvio lantigua, Oneida zorilla. Rooms are excellent, many fine dining establishments, entertainment nightly. Don't hesitate to book today.

reviews.author: 54CKY
reviews.title: Better Than Expected
reviews.text:
I came here with low expectations after looking at previous reviews- especially of the food.  Came with several other couples and we all thought the food wasn't all that bad.  Decent variety and you just have to use common sense if something doesn't look good - don't eat it.  Specialty restaurants were good and good variety as well, even those with the fixed menu.  We all had Deluxe rooms towards back of resort.  Rooms were nice, good size.  The only thing is they are by the main service entrance, so noise could wake you up at night and early morning.  

Staff was nice and bar tenders very attentive.  Other than the noise the only thing you should know is the liquor is terrible and beer sometimes had a sulfur smell at times, and drinks were very sweet.  I know it defeats the all inclusive you pay for, but suggest you buy alcohol at airport duty free before coming to resort if you want a better cocktail.

Beach was wonderful and probably the best attribute of the resort.

reviews.author: Melina C
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Fernando geronimo made our stay a pleasure. He was so happy and cheerful. We were so lucky to have him for our room server. He was very special, he made the whole experience pleasurable.  Make sure you request him as your server, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Winslow Y
reviews.title: Perfection in every way
reviews.text:
Just came back from Paradisus Palma Real, Punta Cana. I loved, loved, loved the resort and service. If I go back to Punta Cana, I would stay here again, and again, and again.

Our RCI rep and concierge was Luis Munoz, he was Awesome. He speaks perfect English, and was super nice. He came looking for us around the resort on a daily basis. He planned all of our dinners at there 6 restaurants. Luis Munoz provides A plus service and is a great person. We welcomed Luis into our family, because he treated us like family. 

Martha Santana the waitress at Naos buffet, is very hardworking. She always has a smile on her face.She made sure we had everything we needed. She was definitely the nicest waitress, and she had a sense of urgency. She was always busy taking care of the guests. I never saw her stop to take a break. Martha Santana should get a raise. If ever at Naos, sit in Martha's section. 

Big Mac and his crew provided great entertainment. Big Mac is high energy, fun, talented, friendly and loves what he does. Most importantly, he actually remembers everyone's name. Hundreds of people he meets, but he walks up to you and greets you by name. The entertainment which Big Mac and his crew provides is family oriented but still has a club vibe. No need to leave the resort to Party when you have Big Mac.

reviews.author: Olya M
reviews.title: Do not forget anything there. You will never see it again.
reviews.text:
Overall a good resort with good food, plenty of shade to hide from a sun and people if you want to. If you like company and swim in the ocean it is better not to stay at a Reserve. It is a good 10 min walk or need to take gulf cart.
Did not have good experience connecting to any of their representatives on a phone or email. They just do not answer any emails and with a phone bounce you around to different people. My first experience trying to book a shuttle to get from the airport to the hotel ended with just getting my own taxi.
Unfortunately. I forgot several pieces of clothes in my room and the same day reached out to the resort. Several emails later, phone calls, sending my friends who stayed behind to speak to the Managers did not produce any response. The same happened to 2 of my friends and they had identical experience so make sure do not forget anything and book  your own transportation.

reviews.author: AS1205
reviews.title: Teacher
reviews.text:
This resort was beautiful!!!!! The staff and the entertainment staff were so friendly, entertaining and accommodating.  Jose was our server for breakfast and lunch at the a buffet. Antonio was the best bartender near the pool and truly the most comical and entertaining person on the resort was little Big Mac, he was able to get everyone involved no matter the activity. I was very impressed with the food and the number of choices.  The only restaurant we did not like was Fuego, the seafood was very over cooked and the lobster was much different than what we are used to in RI.  

Overall, very satisfied, weather was great, room was clean and spacious.. A great experience!!! We will be back!

reviews.author: Gwen S
reviews.title: Best food, best service (Samuel), and best beach
reviews.text: A gorgeous property with personalized service.   The butler (Samuel) was awesome, friendly, attentitive.  The beach had the softest sand and plenty of chairs and covered spaces to tan and lounge.  There were more restaurants than we could try in our stay.  The meals were delicious.   My time at the spa was perfect.  Have been in many spas all over and this was the nicest I have had the pleasure of experiencing.

reviews.author: jon s
reviews.title: Great Property Great Staff
reviews.text: My wife and I spent seven wonderful days in the luxury of Royal Service in your resort. A rating of overall experience would be excellent, great rooms, pristine beaches, better food than expected for all inclusive, good bars and bartenders and super staff especially Angel at the Blue Agave.  But the Star of the show is without a doubt Nicolas, our butler. Your management should be aware of his value and any future guest that might read this should request his services!!!

reviews.author: Estelle S
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Vacation
reviews.text: Went to this resort for a friend's wedding.  Beautiful resort, nice rooms.  Had a great time.  The service at the hotel is great.  I forgot an item after i checked out and guest services did a great job finding the item for me and making sure I could get it back.  I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Alayna790
reviews.title: Highly recommend!!
reviews.text: Amazing time at the paradisus palma real in punta cana! Hughly recommend staying at the main hotel vs reserve which is further from beach, and upgrading to family concierge which was a huge help with dinner reservations etc! Both Kenya and Luis Sanchez (royal service) were extremely friendly and helpful! Kenya had the best energy about her and Luis was very attentive. Loved the activities the resort had going on especially the shows, zumba, and pool party! BIG MAC was one of the highlights of the trip and the resort! He was so entertaining in each role he plays at the paradisus from water spin class, zumba, etc. His fun spirit was contagious and brought everyones mood up around him! The last major thing I would say about this resort was the food! I ate from the buffet often and we all loved it! Every dinner we went to was VERY good! Especially Rare steak house and Fuego latin fusion...the hibachi was great too! Noone in our party of 6 ever got sick which I know is often a concern for people travleing and being nervous about what they eat/drink. Great trip and look forward to booking paradisus palma real in playa del carmen this fall!!!

reviews.author: VRBG
reviews.title: Amazing 4 Day Bachelorette Trip
reviews.text:
My 4 girlfriends and I had the most incredible time here. The resort grounds were amazing -- well maintained, clean, lush and beautiful with greenery. The beach area was serene -- from beach chairs to cabanas to hammocks. The pool/swim up bar was large enough so that it felt exclusive to everyone who was in it -- never overcrowded. The restaurants/buffet were comparable to NYC dining (make your dinner reservations early). The rooms were clean and modern with round the clock housekeeping (we had a 2 bedroom suite). And the Yhi spa at the reserve felt like you were transported to a zen garden -- insanely calm and relaxing. 

But the best part about the entire resort was the friendly, helpful service and staff. Everyone was attentive to our needs, and always had a smile on their face. There was never a time that we didn't feel like we were in good/safe hands.

In regards to nightlife -- it's literally a non-stop party. It starts at 9pm on Gabi Beach, with music and dancing, then moves to the Avenue Bar, then to the casino, then ends at the Jewel Nightclub at 4am.

I have to give a special shoutout to Big Mac, Johan + friends -- aka the hype crew. If you want to party, these are the guys to be around. The bachelorette trip wouldn't have been the same without them!!!

Overall, a 5 star staff in a 5 star resort. The best all-inclusive resort I've ever been to.

P.s. The wifi here is BOMB. We never had a problem finding reception.

reviews.author: thomas k
reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: The personnel at the hotel were tremendous, especially our pool attendant Pedro, and bartender Leonardo. The hotel is beautiful and the room was luxurious, however the food was just okay.  Overall, if I go back to Punta Cana, I would stay at the Paradisus Palma Real again.

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.title: Five Star resort with Five Star Service!
reviews.text:
This place is paradise. We traveled in a large group (18 total) for 9 days to celebrate a friend's birthday. The majority of the group were Royal Service which I highly recommend given all the amazing amenities that come with it. Upon check-in you are taken to the Royal Service lounge for VIP service while they walk you through everything then give you a private tour of the resort. We were exhausted from traveling all day so the check-in process was a bit extensive although a nice perk. 

Across our entire group we had two butlers who went above and beyond every single day to make us feel special and well taken care of. Our trip wouldn't have been the same without Nicholas and Omar, our butlers who did everything from checking in on us multiple times a day at the beach to making dinner reservations for 18 each night. Every day we'd return from the beach or pool to find a special treat in all our rooms personally delivered by our butlers. For our friend's birthday, Nicholas coordinated a private catamaran for our entire group equipped with food, beverages and a crew who took great care of us. Nicholas and Omar took the time to get to know us all and truly understand how to make the experience the best it could be.

Every day at the beach we were treated like kings and queens all thanks to Francisco Gil, our waiter. He had our "spot" prepared for us each day with beds and chairs and made sure we were never without beverages. We were in awe by the impeccable service he provided and also incredibly grateful. 

Each evening our group met for cocktails at Gabi Beach Bar before dinner. A beautiful ocean view with live music on most nights. We had outstanding service from Rosa, who became a friend to all of us. 

I can't recommend this resort more. Five star service surrounded by five star views. We will definitely be back (soon I hope). Nicholas and Omar definitely made sure our friend's birthday was one she will never forget!

reviews.author: Tee J
reviews.title: NO DOMINICAN FOOD?!?!
reviews.text:
Traveled for birthday celebration April 2015
AIRPORT 
1- no signage or direction and a Spanish speaking country
2- you have to pay $10 when entering airport for "tourist card"! No ID required and you only get a receipt...no card...I guess that's the government hustle.
3- "helpers" are swarming luggage area to help you get to transportation area...which is just around the corner...another hustle
THE RESORT 
1- beautiful property. Opt for VIP service with butler. I am sure it's great bu I never called him..LOL!
2- I assumed the staff was African American, like me, carrying on a full conversation and realized they mostly speak Spanish..LMAO! Hey...my bad! The staff was amazing, greeting you throughout the day.
3-  I stayed inThe Reserve #40. It's near main lobby, but far from beach. Had to take ride from shuttle, which can take 30 mins...boooooo!
4- none of the restaurant serve Dominican food...which is strange!!! Mole is a Mexican restaurant that is not great., very commercial...small portion ... A tablespoon of beans and the same fried rice you get at the buffet. Guacamole is watery, chips are red/ green...no Bueno. The buffets were just OK, served the same food 4 days...desserts were not great. Fresh juice and fruit good.
5- bars were good, no la king of liquor. The Mamajuana drink shots can really get you going..
6- there are no inclusive water sports, so you have to pay at the place on the beach
7- to me it seems there would be Dominican music going, but no!. They play remixed versions of American classics and a few Spanish tunes...disappointed me greatly 
8- not much night life on the resort, one club and they seem to only have Pit Bull and Rihanna on rotation. 
9- there are kids who may get whiny, so get ready for that
10- nice resort, quiet and relaxed...wifi can be sketchy 
11- get the Outback tour excursion to see the locals, get some Dominican food and goods
12- the mall is like any other in US..avoid if you want local items
13- for local shopping go to beach and walk to your left and you will find about 3 cool shops with gifts, art, hair braiding, t-shirts and great sundresses. It is next to a black and white beachouse abou a 1/2 mile nice walk!!

reviews.author: T L
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: Our overall experience at Paradisus was a very pleasant one. The property and grounds were really nice and clean.  The staff was exceptionally friendly, especially our butler Luis.  Nice pool and beach areas.  Nightlife and activities were also good!  The food at the resort seemed to be hit or miss (mostly miss unfortunately).  We did have issues with our toilet breaking twice, but maintenance was quick to come and fix it. The wifi was exceptionally reliable.

reviews.author: Justine H
reviews.title: Amazing and unforgettable experience!
reviews.text:
I have traveled to many destinations around the world and I have to say that this hotel and the experience as a whole was one of my top 3. I went down to Punta Cana to celebrate my 40th birthday with no less then 18 friends (not a quiet and timid group either).  A few of us had the Royal Service and others had one of the different levels of service offered.  We all experienced amazing service from the staff and no one felt treated any worse for not having the Royal Service. 

The grounds of the hotel are gorgeous, the beach is ridiculously clean with even a daily early morning clean up of the seaweed that collects on the shore, the staff is beyond friendly and goes out of their way to make sure you are having a great time, the restaurant selection was nicely varied (although some were better then others), surprisingly, the buffet was excellent, and Avenue Bar, Gabi Beach Bar, the lobby bar and the mini discotheque were fun late night venues for those who aren't ready for bed just yet. The rooms are all very spacious, clean and updated and even if you do not have an ocean front room like I did (amazing view) the other room views my friends had were all really scenic (facing the gardens) and each had their own balconies which are a necessity.  

I have to really commend and applaud Francisco Gil who was our go-to-guy at the Royal Service beach area for the 9 days we were there. He not only had our designated ocean front beach area saved for all of us daily before we even awoke (not easy to do with 18 people) but he always knew when we needed cervesas, pina coladas and even bottles of wine and champagne. He was always in a good mood, smiling and encouraging us to keep having fun. His service was impeccable and one of the main reasons our days spent on the beach were so relaxing, fun and memorable. I knew I never had to worry about whether or not we would have a place to sit on the beach and if everyone would be able to be together. Again, not an easy thing to organize with 18 people. Thank you Francisco! 

The second person who made our trip amazing was our butler Nicolas Maracallo. Dealing with a pretty demanding birthday girl and her "ready to party" friends could not have been easy but he went above and beyond to make sure I worried about nothing. He even sowed my beach hat back together when it broke the first day we arrived. He made all our dinner reservations (again for 18 people) and organized an awesome boat day. On my birthday he surprised me with flowers, a personalized cake, a breakfast champagne toast with a few singing staff members, a hot tub with "Happy Birthday" and my name spelled out in roses and even decorated my door with balloons. Everyone should be able to celebrate their birthday like this! Muchas gracias Nicolas!

Lastly, a thank you to the gorgeous and sweet Rosa at Gabi Beach who took great care of us on multiple nights. You are the best!

The resort and staff exceeded my expectations and I know my friends feel the same way. We are all already planning our next trip back.

The only two complaints we had were that check in took longer then necessary....give us our room already we want to go to the beach!!!!! And that periodically our room keys would not work and we would have to go to the lobby to get new ones. This process was fairly quick but there is nothing more annoying then coming home late at night and not having a key that works and having to trek to the lobby for a new one.  Minor issues but worth mentioning.

Can't wait to go back next year! Thank you for an amazing time.

reviews.author: KAPA0129
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with Phenomenal Service at Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort & Spa!
reviews.text:
I just returned from a 9-day vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort and Spa with a large group of friends to celebrate a friend's birthday.  The resort itself is beautiful and only a 15-20 minute drive from the airport.  The grounds are well maintained and I felt very secure with the amount of security and staff on-site.  For the most part, the restaurants were very good.  My favorite was Palazzo and least favorite was Vento.  Thee buffet was good also.  Gabi Beach Bar was my favorite place for a pre-dinner cocktail (we loved Rosa, who was our server most nights).  Most of us had Royal Sevice and I would highly recommend it - it gives you access to additional areas and restaurants within the resort and also sets  you up with a butler.  

Nicolas was our butler and coordinated dinners for our group every night (which included 18 people on several nights).  He also did so much for us throughout the week including daily snacks and treats.  On my friend's birthday, he coordinated a fun breakfast (complete with the singing of happy birthday by several staff members), he decorated the room, ordered not one but two cakes for her, gave her flowers and coordinated a boat excursion for our group which included decorations and cake!  He exeeded all expectations we had and we could not have asked for more.  I would request Nicolas as our butler when we return!

Omar served as the Butler for several of our friends and was also very helpful a and very friendly.  Francisco coordinated our daily beach area and served us cocktails and water throughout the day.  Francico was always kind and friendly.  He was great to us and truly helped out so much throughout the week.  

The experience was a great one.  I was a little leary of the all-inclusive aspect (my first time) but it served our group really well.  Some things to note: if you can afford the Royal Service option, do it, without question.  Be forewarned, check in takes longer than average, which was a bit frustrating, but had I expected it, I might not have been as frustrated.  Also, if you leave valuables out and/or your safe unlocked and housekeeping comes, it is my understanding that they have to call security, put items in the safe, and reset the safe. You will need to call to have them open the safe and let you reset the code for the safe.

reviews.author: Deb2q
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and service!
reviews.text: Onardo Marino is fantastic! The best service - wonderful English, Russian, French and of course Spanish. The best personality and person and he made our vacation extremely special! A wonderful experience. We highly recommend him and the resort! He is the reason we chose this place for our vacation in the Domincan Republic! -Deb

reviews.author: aimeetravels6
reviews.title: 18 friends had one spectacular time
reviews.text:
The hotel is very lovely.  The gardens are lush and well kept and the rooms are also nice and well maintained.  The food is good, it is an all inclusive resort so I don't expect it to be michelin star quality.  Certainly plenty of options. 
Service was impeccable from our incredible pool/beach server Francisco to the staff that went to my room to help me find my passport.  Every person who works here cares that you are well taken care of and enjoy your stay. 
I would recommend getting Royal Service.  I did not, but my friends did so it did not matter but I would have been missing out without it.  
This is a really lovely resort with an amazing staff, a beautiful beach and grounds/pools.  I have no complaints and would go back.

reviews.author: Shay R
reviews.title: Shay C. "Service Above and Beyond"
reviews.text: Our arrival was breathtaking, walking in to such a beautiful view of the ocean and the openness of the whole Resort was lovely.  We were greeted by a guide that escorted us to the Royal Service.  Once we walked in the lounge I thought I was in heaven.  The décor was gorgeous the staff was so friendly and not to mention the wonderful dishes and cocktails they had waiting for us.  I thought they would just give us our room key and then we would be on our way.  However, it was a process...but it was very professional and caring and made us feel like royalty. We were then introduced to our Butler Juan De Leon.  He walked us to our room and then provided us with our personal cell phone to contact him when needed.  I have to tell you this was something I had never experienced.   Juan  would call us in the morning to see what our daily activities would be and set everything up for us.  Before he got off work for the night he would contact us to see if there was anything we needed before he left.  Everyday was so carefree we didn't have to worry about doing anything but relaxing, whether it was just hanging out on the beach or dining in the amazing restaurants... Unfortunately about the fourth day of our vacation I got really sick and had to go to the hospital.  Juan was already off work by this time.  He called us to find out what hospital I was going to and he came there and stayed until I was released.  This was by far not in his job description and service above and beyond.  We were so appreciative to him for this.  Juan, our bartender Leonardo, and our beach server Fransisco checked on me constantly to make sure I was comfortable and feeling better.  I did recover and was able to enjoy the remainder of the trip.  I recommend Paradisus Palma Real to anyone traveling to the DR. The professionalism, care, and service was something I will never forget and beyond what I ever experienced!  My boyfriend and I will be visiting again soon!

reviews.author: Ryan Y
reviews.title: Paradise Found
reviews.text: I just returned from my fourth time staying at the Paradisus Palma Real-Punta Cana.  I am never disappointed.  This time I was with 18 close friends for a birthday milestone.  There are two Paradisus resorts in Punta Cana.  Be sure and stay at the Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort.  It is the largest and nicest of the two.  I have always done the Royal Service all-inclusive package and highly recommend it-it is definitely the way to go.  The Royal Service comes with butler service which is truly a an appreciated luxury.  Our butlers on this recent trip were Omar and Nicholas.  They were both amazing!  From making sure our favorite spot on the beach was reserved and we were never with out cocktail in hand, to making sure our group always had a dinner reservation at our desired restaurant, to booking a fabulous catamaran excursion, our butlers never disappointed and truly made our trip a memorable one!

reviews.author: Valery B
reviews.title: Simply amazing
reviews.text:
Resort is amazing. Food is delicious, beach is perfect. Our butler Francisco Estrella made our stay extra special by taking extra special care of us, by having our chairs ready, bringing us water after our walks, special drinks all day, and mostly by being very friendly.
Thank you Francisco! :)

reviews.author: Cristiano C
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: Tudo perfeito, otimas opções de restaurantes inclusive um estrelado pelo guia Michelin (Passion), para todos os gostos. Área de lazer excelente com piscinas enormes e bares completos. O quarto nem se fala, amplo e superconfortável.

reviews.author: Kathy L
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!!
reviews.text: This is the most amazing all inclusive I've been to. The resort is unbelievable, beyond words really. Beach is beautiful, food fantastic, rooms are beyond expectation. Fabulous all around well worth every penny. Special mention to the great staff especially "Big Mac", Yazmerlyn Fernin and to Ornado Marino for all the great drinks and daily Spanish lesson! Would go back in a heartbeat!💓

reviews.author: jvanegmond
reviews.title: Dream Vacation
reviews.text: We came for a wedding and had a wonderful time.  Buffet, Resturants and Room Service were excellent and afternoon and evening activities and shows were great! All the staff were very welcoming and engaging. In particular Wilkin, Yazz and Big Mac made our trip extra special with all of their special touches and fun personalities.  We look forward to coming back again!

reviews.author: Karla Andrea G
reviews.title: Espectacular!!!
reviews.text: Me encanto todo.  El servicio (todos muy amables y serviciales), la comida, el ambiente, las actividades del hotel, los show de noche,  el hotel en general es perfecto!!!  Lo recomiendo!!!  Unas de las experiencias más lindas!!

reviews.author: Eloir S
reviews.title: relax y calidad total
reviews.text: Me hospede en los dos hoteles y llene esta encuesta pensando sobre los dos. aclaro, el Palma Real no tiene pero alguno, todo estuvo excelente. La comida es increíble y me encanta el ambiente de la noche. El servicio de primer nivel. Amo Paradisus Palma Real

reviews.author: Peter K
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time.  There isn't one bad thing that I could say about this resort.  Food was excellent, Room Service was excellent and we had a personal Butler.  His name was Johnfi Rivera and he was so welcoming and wonderful.  He made our trip extra special with all of his special touches.  We look forward to having him again as our Butler when we return in November.

reviews.author: Noel B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort and Great Staff
reviews.text: We have been visiting Punta Cana for over 10 years for our annual golf trip and Paradisus is our favorite resort by far.  They have a beautiful resort with easy access to the pool and beach.  Good food and a great staff.  From the time you check in to the that last sad day that you have to head out the staff is friendly and always looking to be helpful.  Luz Franco checked us in and got us into the vacation mode and was there to check us and make sure that our stay went as planned.  She with the rest of staff made sure we had a great stay.

reviews.author: LawMatta
reviews.title: Awsome vacation!!! Loved the people
reviews.text: Best vacation ever. Excellent food and service. Yasmerlyn, Big Mac and all the crew did a stupendous job making us feel comfortable. They became our friends. I will certainly return this year. Thank you for everything.

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: Stayed here instead of booked hotel
reviews.text: Our original hotel could not take us so they swapped us to this hotel. On checking in we were supposed to given $100/p compensation for the booked hotel failing to honour a guaranteed booking, this didn't happen. The rooms are large, large double bath, separate shower and toilet cubicles, large seating area, large comfortable bed, yes I think the word is large!!! There are good facilities in the room and fridge. The staff are generally very good, although they didn't sort out the compensation issue. The grounds are very smart and well kept. We only used the buffet restaurant, this being very good, varied choice and quite often freshly made in front of you (steaks, chicken, etc). The one issue we had with the place was that some areas, including the beach, were split into sections for the different types of booking. On the first day on the beach there was no sunbed available in the ordinary section, in the Royal section, barely any of them used, similar in the other area (can't remember the name of this section), we weren't aloud to use these, disappointing. This was the same with the sunbeds around the pool. We only used the hobbycat sailing boat but other facilities are available. I would recommend this hotels to others, just sort out the sunbed issue.

reviews.author: caridur
reviews.title: Yasmerlyn is the best
reviews.text: The hotel is very beautiful with good people. I want to say that Yasmerlyn is one of the best employee at the hotel. The rooms are beautiful the rest of the staff are friendly. I will go again to the Paradisus Palma Real. Muchas gracias.

Big mac en

reviews.author: stuka_1939
reviews.title: Piscina family concierge
reviews.text: Por este medio quiero agradecer sobremanera la hospitalidad, recibimiento,  cordialidad, profesionalismo y siempre predispuesto a evacuar cualquier duda de los clientes del hotel al señor FRANCISCO ESTRELLA. A pesar que hacía dos años que no veníamos se acordaba perfectamente de nosotros y eso es muy importante para los miembros del club ya que nos sentimos más a gusto.  Gracias

reviews.author: Rick L
reviews.title: High School Seniors Group Trip - Just Perfect
reviews.text: A group of parents traveled with their kids (all were high school seniors) and couldn't have asked for a better experience. From the time we woke up each day and enjoyed the elaborate breakfast buffet until we called it a night after dropping a few $$$ in the casino it was a perfect vacation. The rooms were just fine. If you're worried about certain luxuries missing then you're spending too much time in the room. If you're in a large group arrange to have someone like George Alriche set your lounge chairs up before you arrive and then the drinks will keep coming non stop. Trust me - look for George. He was well worth the extra we paid him. Food at the restaurants far exceeded the typical fare at all inclusives. Fresh fish, beef and fruits. Never left any one in our group hungry. Stayed 4 nights and that was ideal. Oh and the kids loved it all too.

reviews.author: Nikkkkkkki
reviews.title: Awesome time!!!
reviews.text: Everyone was so accommodating and friendly ! The bartenders at the pool bar, Antonio and Wellington were awesome! They always had our drinks ready for us and were so fun and personable! Big Mac and Jazz put on a great show and knew how to get the audience hyped! Our mini bar attendant, Angelo was so welcoming and happy to help us! Loved everything about the resort and can't wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Arlene L
reviews.title: Second stay even better than the first!
reviews.text: Just returned from Paradisus Palma Real. Second stay there on a group trip with friends and our high school senior kids. Property is amazing! Rooms are luxurious and immaculate. Gorgeous beach, pool. The layout never makes it feel crowded. Food was excellent for an all-inclusive. Breakfast/lunch area was a major improvement from last trip...completely renovated. Dinners were mostly good. Didn't like food at Vento (Italian) as much. AQUA restaurant was excellent. This review wouldn't be complete without praising one employee... Georges Alriche. Although the entire staff was extremely courteous, George, as we called him went above and beyond to have beach chairs set up for our group, brought us drinks all day, and was just so pleasant and professional! Would definitely recommend this property for vacation!

reviews.author: LuVenia W
reviews.title: Felt like princess!
reviews.text:
This resort makes you feel like you are so special. I was given a butler when i arrived. He was super amazing. I know he gets paid to make my stay easy and pleasurable, but he went over and beyond to make my stay one to remember. He checked on us every day. made all of our reservations to restaurants and various activities. He even helped me learn a little bit of Spanish while I was there. He was awesome! Go Francisco! 
I also enjoyed the entertainment. They were very professional and energetic. I loved the activities that were available. The staff was very lively. I loved Yas, Angel, Rony, and Rey Rey. They were super good dancers and so friendly.

reviews.author: Andrea E
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: I want to thanks Francisco Cabrera aND Leonardo  Mota angel frias for they service l hope to be back soon drinks are the best we be back. Soon our room always clean y beatiful place pool is beatiful and clean my friends has fun so much

reviews.author: Noiseanddkisses
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: I was legitimately happy with every second of my stay at Paradisus Palma Real. If you can opt for Royal Service, do just that! Alvaro made sure all of our reservations were made and questions were answered. Spending each day at the pool with guys like Francisco Cabrera to set up your sun beds and take care of everything you need and Leonardo Mota to mix delicious drinks made every day truly paradise! These guys are the best! I am already looking forward to coming back for another visit to his beautiful resort!

reviews.author: rezinha_rtv
reviews.title: Bom serviço
reviews.text: Sr Leonardo Mota e Francisco Cabrera, ótimo atendimento. Muitos simpáticos, tentam falar nossa ligua (português). Francisco Santo muito atencioso. Nos ajudou muito, não deixando nos faltar nada. Os driks muito bons e bem feitos. Sempre nos fazendo bebidas diferentes.

reviews.author: Bruno P
reviews.title: Bom serviço
reviews.text:
Leonardo Mota e Francisco Cabrera nos fizeram um ótimo atendimento em quiosque de piscina e praia em nossa hostadia em Paradisus.
Sr. Mordono Francisco Santo nos atendeu também de forma prestativa e sempre muito simpático.

reviews.author: Samantha V
reviews.title: Surpassed our expectations, can't wait to go back!
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus Palma Real with two friends in March 2015. We shared a Royal Service Garden View Suite. In short, everything surpassed our expectations and the low point of the trip was having to go home at the end! Some highlights:
Royal Service: absolutely worth it if you're looking for an adults-only experience. Our butler, Yohalvi (Jo), was the best. He made sure all of our reservations at the pool and for meals were taken care of, and he gave us great advice on activities and things to do during our trip. The Royal Service pool tended to get a bit crowded at times, so we spent our time on the Royal Service side of the main pool--this gave us access to the swim up bar, so we were very happy! Angel, the pool concierge, was very attentive and made sure all our needs were taken care of promptly. We ate at the Royal Service restaurant, Palazzo, on a daily basis. The food there was great regardless of whether you ate off the menu or chose the buffet. The service was especially skilled, and we are very grateful to Alexander and Lorraine (server and host, respectively) for always making us feel like the only patrons in the place. Overall, the Royal Service adults-only experience wasn't excessively couple-y or romantic, so my group felt comfortable, though I could tell that the couples there were satisfied too. We hope to go back to Paradisus next year, and we'll definitely use the Royal Service again!
Passion: We went to Passion the last night of our trip. We chose the seven-course tasting menu with the wine pairings. I'm a foodie, so it's a big deal when I truly feel that I've had a memorable meal. This one absolutely nailed it and ranks among my top ten meals of all time. I'm so glad we went, and I can't recommend it highly enough. Special thanks to Julio Cesar, Hector, and Zoris for taking such good care of us!
Blue Agave: We had lunch and dinner at Blue Agave on separate days, and I'd say this is the one restaurant to skip. The lunch selection is limited and the dinner quality is nothing remarkable--the staff is great, but you'd be better off eating next door at Naos if you're looking for something more casual.
Booking: I recommend booking the hotel online through the Melia website. If you register for the (free) Melia rewards program, you automatically get access to better nightly rates. Our booking even came with free airport transfers. You can also save ~$20 per person on the tasting menu at Passion by pre-purchasing it during your booking.

reviews.author: Ohjodi
reviews.title: One more day...
reviews.text: Just one more day pleeeeeease! This was my second visit (first was five years ago) and second time at an all inclusive. You have to understand that I am not someone that sits still well, so a vacation like this is good for the soul. You are forced to sit back and relax. Just relax... This property is gorgeous! Perfectly manicured and constantly maintained. I do have to admit that check in was less than wonderful. Our request for joining rooms was not fulfilled and we were put in separate buildings. We could have let that ruin our experience, however we were on vacation in Punta Cana...don't sweat the small stuff! The staff in the resort definitely make the experience. (I do have to point out that we properly tipped through the entire trip. They deserve it!) We had such a great time at the beach with Santos, Luis, and the rest of the guys. Talk about hard working...sweltering heat and they are still laughing, smiling, and making sure that you are enjoying yourself! The pool staff was equally wonderful (I learned too many names to mention)! Elvis was our go to guy for reservations and Gorge and Edward made sure we had our favorite drinks! Tip: you need to get to the pool or beach early to get your seat, even earlier to first reserve it. We reserved a seat at the beach and lost it b/c it was busy and we didn't get there until almost 10. No need to stress, the guys helped us figure out another option!  Overall... the food is okay- you will figure out the places you like the best, the staff is kind and they want you to have a great time, and this trip will be what you make of it. Brush up on your Spanish, you are visiting another country and you can't expect that everyone here is going to speak fluent English. Don't be uptight, you are on an Island... Enjoy yourself!!

reviews.author: oliviaviolet15
reviews.title: Best resort!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Paradisus has the best service! Anything you order comes immediately and all of the staff are so welcoming, friendly, energetic, and passionate! Normally i would be too shy to try any dancing but Ronny and Bigmac are very convincing and i ended up having one of best nights of my life! I would seriously recommend this resort to anyone considering traveling to the Dominican Republic, and i will definitely be visiting again. Glad to know that when i come back i will already have some friends here!

reviews.author: donnaw666
reviews.title: Royal Service is truly Royal!
reviews.text: We had the most adorable Room Service guy and his name was Hegel Zabalo! He made sure we had a fully stocked bar every night even leaving us a little extra of what we requested.  Our last night there he brought us the most awesome bottle of champagne and chocolates. I can't wait to visit this resort again and I hope I have this guy treating me like royal again!

reviews.author: Hector T
reviews.title: Bonitas Comida, debe Mejorar Limpieza
reviews.text:
Llegue a las 12:00pm al Hotel. La habitación fué entregada a las 4:10, la misma no era cama King, solicitamos el cambio y a las 4:30 nos entregan la habitación 2009 con cama matrimonial, el polvo y la humedad que tenía era increíble. Nos acercamos a recepción y  nuevamente nos pusieron a esperar. A las 5:20pm nos asignaron una habitación similar a la reservada. La Encargada de Host Adriana manejó el caso. Estoy muy inconforme con el trato recibido. El hotel no está preparado para estas fechas de mucho tránsito de huésped. No obstante la comida hasta el momento ha sido excepcional. 

Para una persona mínimamente asmática no recomiendo la higiene del hotel. Mi pareja que no lo es no lo soportaba. Los servicios de Salud son muy caros por esta zona y si viene de vacaciones es algo que debe de sopesar.

reviews.author: Justo G
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text:
I'm here at Paradisus Palma Real, this is a great hotel, I recommend Royal Service for adults, food is great, property is clean and we'll kept, staff is very friendly  and willing to accommodate all your needs, special mention to the team at Sunset Bar ( Leonardo Mota. Francisco Cabrera, Martin Tineo) also my buttler Eduard. 
I strongly recommend  this hotel, planning to come back for the summer

reviews.author: weissdj
reviews.title: "Perfect Stay"
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, Great service, great hospitality, staff very helpful and courteous. Our butler, Johnfi Rivera, was very attentive to details, made us feel at home and personally took care of arrangements at the restaurant to make a "perfect" birthday surprise for one of my friends. Very enjoyable, cant wait to return next year. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this hotel to everyone !!!!!!!  And ask for JohnFi !!

reviews.author: Jeremee P
reviews.title: Dream Weddings Do Come True
reviews.text:
Having a wedding is stressful enough, and a destination wedding takes that to a whole other level. Not only do you have to worry about the wedding ceremony and reception, but you also have to send dozens and dozens of your friends and family on vacation (in our case about 130 people) and need to take into account each and every single person's likes, dislikes, special requests, dietary requirements and pickiness, age ranges, etc. After doing research on various locations and resorts you basically come to accept that you can't please everyone, you're going to have to make some sacrifices somewhere, and there's no such thing as the perfect place for everyone, it's just impossible. Well I can speak for 130 people when I say that Paradisus Palma Real just pulled off the impossible. From age 1 to 80 on our guestlist and everything in between, from toddlers, grammar schoolers, teenagers, singles, couples, families, parents and grandparents, everyone across the board had the time of their lives. Many of our guests had never been to DR and others had previously visited but never returned due to poor experiences at other resorts, and at the end of the day Paradisus made believers out of everyone and shot the DR to the top of everyone's vacation destination list. 

I won't get in to too much detail, but in short: 1. Accommodations: Everyone loved their rooms regardless of the room level, from the standard Junior Suite, to Royal Service, and the gigantic 2 room swim-up suites at The Reserve. When there were issues (e.g. no hot water, air conditioning issues) people were astonished at how quickly and effectively the problems were addressed. The issues were either fixed within minutes or new rooms were given with no questions asked, sometimes even at an upgraded level.

2. Dining: This was something we were very concerned about since it's so hard to please everyone's taste, but the unanimous consensus was that Paradisus has the best food of any resort, especially in the DR. Yes there are hits and misses here and there but overall the sentiment was sheer satisfaction. The newly built beachfront buffet Naos seemed to be everyone's favorite along with the surprisingly delicious burgers on the room service menu. Just a tip, there's also a "secret" late night buffet at the Japanese restaurant Bana that was perfect for those midnight snack attacks. 

3. Service: Amazing across the board, from waitstaff, housekeeping, to security. Our guests told us countless stories of their great service experiences, and some even concluded that the staff must somehow know the names on the wedding guest list and were giving us special treatment, because to pull off that level of service for everyone just doesn't make sense. The waitstaff is extremely friendly and always a step ahead. After the first day they seem to remember your favorite drink and are ready with another once you've reached the halfway point. Housekeeping was impeccable, and as for security one friend told us how she left her room safe open one morning and when she returned to her room someone was there waiting outside her door to verify that she had in fact left it open herself and it hadn't been tampered with. 

4. Resort grounds/beach: I think the pictures and other reviews cover this, even the negative reviews admit that the resort is absolutely gorgeous and perfectly maintained. It's very elegant and modern throughout but manages to maintain the Dominican Republic's essence. This was very important to us because we didn't want to stay in a place that was beautifully decorated and designed but could've been anywhere in America, we wanted to feel like we were in the DR. The garden areas, walkways, seating and lounge spaces, pool area, and beach are all stunning. 

5. The Wedding: Obviously for my new wife and I this was the most important and stressful part, and our exceptional wedding coordinator Raquel Vega along with the constant help of Caribel De Los Santos worked so hard every single minute to make sure we were taken care of every step of the way. I don't think we anticipated how hands-on Raquel would be throughout the week leading up to the wedding and of course on the day itself. From our very first meeting with her she was on point, organized, and extremely efficient and professional. We never had to repeat ourselves with her, once we asked a question or made a request she made made note of it and it was taken care of perfectly every time, whether it related to wedding decorations, ceremony details, or reception concerns. This was also true in the months leading up to the wedding - Raquel was extremely prompt and thorough in responding to emails, which we came to realize was a rare thing after dealing with so many others in the wedding planning process. During our Welcome BBQ she was there hours beforehand supervising the set up and staff, and she and Claribel stayed throughout the entire event working to ensure no issues arose. Raquel even managed to track down some gifts and other things we had left behind that night and she hand delivered them back to us the next day. On the Wedding Day this service and dedication was multiplied by a thousand, with Raquel attending to both me and my wife (getting ready on opposite ends of the resort no less), and she and Claribel were on top of every single detail from organizing the guests, coordinating the bridal party timing, ensuring the cold water was stocked for the guests, and even personally overseeing that our wedding music was played precisely to the second and on queue as we intended. Our ceremony was at the Wedding Gazebo in the Oriental Garden and it turned out even more gorgeous than we ever anticipated. As for the reception, it took place at Fuego Restaurant (formerly called Gabi Beach) and the room was spectacular. Again, throughout the reception Raquel and Claribel were constantly working and would ask us if we needed or wanted anything. In the hundreds of pictures we've seen of the reception you can often spot Raquel or Claribel in the background addressing staff or working on some issue we didn't even know about. At one point late in the night Raquel even hand delivered a freshly rolled cigar to me in the middle of the dance floor and again asked if we needed anything. 

Going into the wedding I think we had a realistic expectation of how it could be, then we had the ideal best-case-scenario version of how it could be, but never actually expected it could happen. Raquel, Claribel, and the entire staff truly managed to surpass even that most perfect, unrealistic standard and we couldn't have asked or wished for anything more.
