We hoped our guests were have a good time, and to hear so many of them say it was the "Best Wedding Ever" just blew us away and made everything worth it.

Yes, Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful and surreal place but at the end of the day it's about the staff and execution. I've been to weddings at picturesque places that didn't turn out very well at all, and on the other hand I've been to industrial warehouse or barn weddings that turned out amazing. If this review turned out to be more about the staff than the resort, then that's the reason. It's just as much (if not more) about the staff as it is the location. Luckily, as I said at the start of the review, at Paradisus you don't need to sacrifice one or the other. You can have the perfect setting with an amazingly hardworking staff and you can pull off your dream wedding like we did.

reviews.author: Tim P
reviews.title: Great but some issues
reviews.text:
Firstly, as most people looking at reviews want to know should they book this hotel or if they have booked will they have a good time then the good news is this is overall a great resort and one of the nicest places myself and friends have visited.

Check in was smooth (as was check out), the service is friendly and as mentioned in many reviews the grounds and reception areas are fantastic.

The Reserve area is not on the beach but the 7-10 minutes walk to it is so nice we rarely used the shuttle.

We had a one bed master suite and this was a very decent sized room with all the amenities we needed and was cleaned to a high standard. We did have a few issues with a cold shower and non working appliances that were sorted out but not speedily (see comments about Concierge)

Food was generally good although some of the buffet food was not as hot as we would have liked.

So why not a 5* review?

We payed a lot of money for this holiday (although still a very good price direct with Melia) and found that the Concierge service was confusing and family orientated - the worst example is the Concierge who introduces himself as such and asks if he can book restaurant reservations etc and says join him for breakfast so he can explain about the resort - he was not our Concierge but a Vacations person who wanted to sell us timeshare using 3 hours of our valuable holiday time. Worse, when we went to the breakfast at the beach area and we refused to take the presentation he called his boss over who tried to say this reflects badly on the guy! This is completely out of order for a prestigious resort and looking at other reviews it seems common place. I was tempted to give 1* because of this but on second thoughts just make it clear your not interested at the start (unless you are then fine!) The guy never spoke to us again and this put a dampener on a stress free holiday.

Our actual Concierge located in the block was not always there and didn't really help with restaurant bookings which is another issue - booking them was a nightmare and we never got confirmations all the time and ended up at the buffet sometimes. The Family Concierge block seemed to have 2-3 people there and they got pool side Cabanas (fantastic) but we never got them reserved as it was never explained properly how it was done (tipping the pool man?, only for families? who knows).

This could be a fantastic resort if they sort out some of the issues highlighted in reviews but one worrying trend is all the 5* reviews get the management thanks from sunny.....but look for comments on negative reviews and nothing - bit of a shame really.

Bottom line? We would most probably return in the future if the price is right but maybe try the Palma Real Royal Secret adult only and hope they do sort out some of the issues.

reviews.author: bigcat1981
reviews.title: Not the greatest place.
reviews.text:
The resort itself  was beautiful, usually any are in Mexico or on any island. It's what comes with the scenery that you don't see in the brochures. 

First and last time to Dominican Republic. Huge language barrier with hotel staff that actually interacted with you, let alone asking cleaning staff for extra towels. It was like pulling teeth. 

Staff wasn't rude, but basically you could have got the same experience  from people at a Motel 6 in Albuquerque. This doesn't apply to all staff by the way. You always get a few that go above and beyond for you.

No real wait staff on the beach. You are paying money for this kind of stuff, its kind of expected. 

Restaurants were mediocre at best. Buffet actually was very good! You can never go wrong with a buffet. 

Rooms were nice with the exception of floor mounted door stops. They really hurt when you stub your toe on one coming out of the shower. 

They never restocked the mini bar in the room either. It took til the fourth afternoon when I saw the guy with the cart and flagged him down.

All in all, I'm a Riviera Maya guy. 2.5 stars out of 5 for me.

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Han sido unas vacaciones geniales. Las instalaciones son impresionantes, tanto las piscinas como las camas en la playa. El personal es excepcional, siempre atentos de que no te falte de nada.
Lo unico mejorable es la comida, en los restaurantes se come mejor pero los buffets son muy mejorables.
No obstante si tuviera que elegir de nuevo, volveria a elegir The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana

reviews.author: Alabama32
reviews.title: Maravillosas
reviews.text: Un hotel impresionante con unas instalaciones insuperables, cerca de la playa y con una piscina preciosa por lo que es dificil elegir donde pasar el día. Gracias a Ramón Ramírez, luis Santana, wander roa oneida Zorrilla por su amabilidad en la playa. Como punto flaco: la comida puede mejorar bastante

reviews.author: Lisibeth H
reviews.title: Excelente !!!!!
reviews.text:
No me puedo quejar, excelentes atenciones.. 
Recibimiento especial gracias Jason Tejeda en el Lobby The Reserve, habitación hermosa 3417, restaurante Ventos fenomenal y la atención increíble.. Pasamos un fin de semana espectacular. Para terminar de pasarla bien en la playa con la atención de Luis Santana. De verdad que lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Not a premium experience...of good
reviews.text:
We are currently vacationing at Paradisus Punta Cana and are only hours into a really bad start. Check in process was horrible. 2 hours to check in and fill out paperwork, almost every part was a complete cluster. We called to make reservations ahead of time 3 times and after getting hung up on twice, the third was confirmed by Ignatio and we sent emails to confirm and never received anything back. Sure enough none of the reservations were made and the only dinner reservation at any restaurant was for 6:45 and it was our friends birthday.  We also called and confirmed that the the families coming would all be in the same area- also didn't happen. After much discussion we got us close together.  

The beach is nice, but like everyone says, it's rather far away. The really bad part is there is no food at the beach and no one sets up an area for you which would be expected in the Reserve.  They allow people to come up and down the beach selling cigars, bags, etc and they keep coming. 

High end alcohol is not included in any package, which we thought would be as we picked the premium area- The Reserve. 

I hope it gets better.

reviews.author: Faron H
reviews.title: DON'T DO IT!!!!!
reviews.text: IF YOU DECIDE TO DO IT, please print every single piece of documentation and take it with you to the property.  They will screw up everything from your trip to the hotel (ground transportation) to the room rate, location and quality!  If you do not have written documentation you're screwed.

reviews.author: Heather N
reviews.title: Royal Service all the way!
reviews.text: Our first time to Punta Cana was part of a larger group staying at the Paradisus for a wedding.  The hotel was fabulous, rooms were spacious and updated.  Pools were lovely and the on-ground activities were quite fun/entertaining.   We splurged for the Royal Service and it exceeded our expectations...  Our butler, Faustino was so incredibly attentive and his impeccable services really enhanced our overall stay!  Always service with a smile and always anticipating what we may need, he was FANTASTIC!  If we book another trip to the Paradisus, we will for sure be requesting Faustino!   I took advantage of the spa services for a facial and massage - HIGHLY recommend making use of the relaxing, clean and phenomenal spa.  The restaurant for Royal Service guests only was by far the best restaurant at the resort and the staff there were so attentive as we went for breakfast/lunch daily.

reviews.author: Lcbyrd1
reviews.title: WOW!!!
reviews.text: first thing when we got there, they took our bags and delivered them to our rooms. to check in they, sat us down in a nice room and gave us a glass of Champaign. once we got checked in they showed us to our rooms. the room was amazing! great view of the pool. the service was one of the BEST services I have ever experienced!! staff was excellent. breakfast, lunch, dinner and drinks where all delicious! and a lot of varieties. Cant wait to go back again!! Beautiful place all around. so many activities to do in the resort itself!

reviews.author: Kevin T
reviews.title: excellent resort
reviews.text: Luis santana, Ramon ramirez,santos frias,silvio antigue were super friendly and treated us like family. We went in march and the weather was perfect. Beach is a little dirty with seaweed but hotel staff clean it often

reviews.author: Anh-Tuan L
reviews.title: Good times
reviews.text:
Had a blast. Great place. Service on the beach is awesome. The team of Luis Santana, Ramon Ramirez, Santos Frias, Wander Roas, and Oneida Zorrilla took good care of us.

One bad note is the heavy marketing. It's an inclusive resort, but there's always somebody selling you something, whether it's additional access to different beach areas or clubs. But I guess that's how it goes in the DR.

Overall, it's a great experience. We are very happy with our stay here.

reviews.author: KJFXKE77
reviews.title: Excellent family resort
reviews.text:
We contacted the hotel before arrival and Domingo Beltre, the Guest Service Manager got in touch with us by email and phone.  He worked through a number of questions and issues we had for our family of 14 who were taking this vacation.  Upon arrival he was there to assist on check-in and any other questions we had during our time at the resort.  
     This is the first truly "all inclusive" hotel we have stayed at (and that includes Club Med; Sandals, and others), includlng wines, any hard liquor (if you are of that bent) and there is a 24/7 buffet open (with excellent food and chocies) and several other restaurants included in the package.
      The hotel is the most "kid friendly" place we have been at, with multiple activites in their "kid zone" and other things nearby (not hotel items such as "swim with the Dolphins;" Zip Lines, etc.  The beach is excellent and the pool large.  Each night there is a different show (many of which are for children) and the casino is quite manageable with even penny slots for those who want the experience at virtually no cost.
      27 holes of golf are within 5 minutes and although golf was included, the carts (at $75) were not- virtually the only bug in the ointment - the cost was too high for carts.  However, the pro shop was excellent and reasonable and well stocked.
     All in all, an excellent choice, made more enjoyable by Mr. Beltre.

reviews.author: TamOhio99
reviews.title: Great Dancers & workers
reviews.text:
The dancers were wonderful.  Rhachel & Sandy are two of the nicest and talented dancers.  We got to know them and they are both very gracious and terrific dancers.  We just fell in love with both of them. 
Luis Taveras & Gustavo at the Pool Bar treated us with respect and wonderful service.  Luis is very funny and very nice and just a wonderful person..
Thank all of you.

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: They give a whole new meaning to all inclusive. I have just returned from a four night five day stay and brought home bed bugs. The service, staff, food and overall experience was by far the worse experience I've had in years.  Trying to get assistance with reservations, basic first aid and table service was next to impossible. The wifi was turned on at 8am and off in the evening. Asked for no first floor room but that is what I received. We asked to have rooms located next to each other, didn't receive that. Was pressured to join rewards program even after declining several times.

reviews.author: Claudia P
reviews.title: Excelente lugar
reviews.text: La atención muy buena...excelente lugar para descansar. Comida deliciosa y muy buen servicio. Muy buen servicio en la piscina por Jency Rico... y Rico Polanco...Las habitaciones y el servicio es muy bueno y el hotel es inmenso

reviews.author: Brookelynne222
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel !!
reviews.text: One of the best all inclusive trips I had ever taken thanks to this beautiful & clean & extremely relaxing  hotel ! I will stay here again at some point ! The staff was great food was just fine I am a vegetarian & I felt I had many choices ! Rooms were very clean & the pool was so nice !

reviews.author: Lkrenger
reviews.title: No "Royal Service" Here!
reviews.text:
Don't get me wrong this is a beautiful resort and the staff was friendly and grounds pristine... But they were not accommodating at all. We were traveling with a large group for Spring Break - 29 adults and 24 kids. We were encouraged to upgrade to "Royal Service" when we arrived and, for an additional $50 per person, we all did.  This supposedly gave us access to the Royal Service facilities and premium liquor/wine and restaurants. There was a private pool and beach area but true premium liquor and wine was additional. The special restaurant was also an additional charge of $70 per person. When we tried to make a reservation for the 29 adults, we were told the max was 24, even if we agreed to be sat at multiple tables, so we were never able to all eat together. We did have a nice beach party where they set up tables, a buffet and bar and decorated it beautifully. This was $40 extra per person but given the set-up that was more reasonable. At one point, the adults were all in the "Royal Service" lounge
and when several people ordered white wine we were told "No, not serving white
wine tonight, just red". They had served white wine the night before and there was
white wine at every other bar. One of the guests went and got all the people a glass who wanted one. We were there for one glass of wine before our $70 dinner and were just told "nope, only red wine?!"  They just were never able to fill any requests. We spent a lot of money and still felt like they were charging us at every turn. Despite us paying all the upcharges, they still weren't accommodating of any kind of request. Again, it was beautiful and pristine but never again and certainly not with any kind of large group like a wedding.

reviews.author: Mitch M
reviews.title: Nice Place But Still Lacking
reviews.text: I don't have high expectations for all-inclusive resorts so I'm not really complaining.  The grounds were beautiful and clean and the food was good,  but the place seemed like it was being run by high school kids. Hardly anybody understood English.  The rooms were okay but the bathroom design was stupid.  A glass door for the toilet room, a toilet you had to flush twice to work properly, a shower that needed an owner's manual to operate.  I took a bath every night because I could figure out the shower.  My big complaint was the restuarant scam.  They force you to eat at the buffets which were good but if you wanted to eat at the nicer restuarants you couldn't.  They had some excuse about not having any avialability but all the nice restuarants were either vacant or sparsely populated every night all night.  We did complain and they miraculously found us a table.  I don't know why they even have the nice restuarants if they won't let people use them.  Other than that, it was a typical all-inclusive resort.  A cruise ship on land.

reviews.author: Cindy1234567890
reviews.title: FUN ACTIVITIES, DONT BE SHY!
reviews.text: I recently spent a few days at the Paradisus and had a wonderful time.  The grounds were beautiful, the rooms clean, but what really made our vacation stand out was the entertainment staff at the pool.  I want to give a shout out to Reyrey, Rony (aka mini me), Queen and Yazz.  Their motivation and smiles made our vacation memorable!

reviews.author: ffaccin
reviews.title: Hotel Sensacional, porém cuidado no aeroporto de Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
Viajei com a minha namorada para o casamento de um amigo. 
Na reserva optamos pelo Royal Service que possui um diferencial no atendimento e acesso algumas áreas privativas do hotel (eu recomendo).
O hotel é sensacional! O atendimento (todos os funcionários são atenciosos), a comida, o ambiente, tudo!
Muito cuidado no aeroporto! Alguns funcionários do aeroporto se oferecem para levar a sua bagagem para o transfer ou do transfer para a fila do check in. Na ocasião, decidimos aceitar a "ajuda". Após o funcionário, levar nossa pagagem para a van, este nos pediu dinheiro. Temos uma quantia de 10 dólares a entramos na van para o hotel. Quando chegamos no hotel, a bolsa contendo todo o nosso dinheiro tinha desaparecido.
Infelizmente, não conseguimos reaver esta bolsa e nem os dólares até hoje (não temos como provar que foi este funcionário do aeroporto, mas tudo indica que foi ele).

reviews.author: Whitney F
reviews.title: Will Be Back!
reviews.text: Lovely property, very clean, great food!  Our concierge at The Reserve, Agustin Nunez, was very attentive and helpful with reservations and change of plans.  Staff was very friendly and accommodating.  Had a wonderful vacation!

reviews.author: Chimechi O
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text: Luis German and Fernando  Geronimo were fantastic waiters they were very nice people. They were the fastest out of any resort that I've ever been to. Next time I come I would love to see them!!! Thank for everything...

reviews.author: Simon S
reviews.title: Amazing time (3rd time here)
reviews.text:
I can't get enough!?! of this beautiful resort….
There's been a few restaurant changes but again they are very nice! Naos buffet is back up and running which is amazing.
Excellent service from all staff… huge thanks to Jorge Mora,
Big Mac & the girls from the animation team, our butlers Jose Salvador and Johnfi….. beach/pool attendant Francisco, Leonardo behind the pool bar, & lucia, ana & eddy at the avenue bar in the main square.
It's great seeing you all again, and even nicer to be recognised each time I come back!…
I hope to be back very soon!!!! :)

reviews.author: Roseann M
reviews.title: GIRLS TRIP
reviews.text:
we thought this place was very beautiful the service was outstanding 
everyone was so pleasant and helpful i can say the only negative i can say was the food it was average
 i never expect the food at an all inclusive to be great every restaurant was just ok except for passion which was an excellent meal but you have to pay extra for but well worth it i just wish all the restaurants were as good

reviews.author: WirelessPimp
reviews.title: Good But Not Great For The Price...
reviews.text:
I have visited this hotel 3-4 times over the years.  Here is what I found in our latest trip:
Pros
+ Excellent Beach and Access to Beach
+ Super Friendly Waiter Staff both at poolside and Buffet (Ariel Rodriguez is an excellent host, above and beyond)
+ Re-Modeled Buffet Area with excellent quality of food for a buffet.
Cons:
- No late check out given even even though we arrived very late in the afternoon.
- Not the friendliest from desk staff.
- Prices are above average for the rooms, half of the hotel has been remodeled but we had an older room and you can definitely see the usage.
- Only the VIP Rooms have been remodeled.

reviews.author: Shalanda M
reviews.title: Staff needs more training
reviews.text:
The resort itself is beautiful and could be a permanent fixture in my vacation plans if they get a few things resolved.   Check in was horrible but the staff was nice.  The lines were long and our rooms weren't ready to hours after 3pm.  There were so many issues with rooms and no one could move to other rooms since the hotel was booked.  My keys did not work and I had to ask someone to meet me over to get new ones.  The staff at first requested I walk back over to the lobby.  When is it appropriate to ask your guest to come fix your problems?  

The rooms were nice but need some do need upgrading.  The resort is really for relaxation even though there is a lounge and casino.  Overall, I enjoyed my staff but hope the resort takes my comments seriously or they will lose interest of potential future guests.

reviews.author: Linda D
reviews.title: Expérience extraordinaire!
reviews.text:
Une semaine extraordinaire avec la famille et un groupe d'amis (12).  Nous avions des réservations dans les restaurants, tous aussi merveilleux et délicieux les uns que les autres.  Le restaurant Passion est réellement un délice.  Le coût en surplus en vaut définitivement la peine et il faut prendre le duo avec le vin.  
Les serveurs aux bars sont vraiment gentils et serviables, surtout Juan Perez au bar de Martinis avec ses spécialités.
Les lieux sont beaux et propres.
La plage est belle, on peut y marcher longtemps.  Le seul bémol serait les algues, on pourrait les nettoyer plus régulièrement.
Voyage absolument à refaire en famille ou en amoureux.

reviews.author: meeta24
reviews.title: Great resort!!
reviews.text: This resort is great! Seven of us went on a girls trip for 3 nights, 4 days (end of Feb-early March) and stayed at this beautiful resort. We had three 1 bedroom suites and the rooms were modern, clean, and very spacious. We had the concierge level with an amazing concierge Yarol Rijo, who attended to our every need. All of the restaurants, lobbies, and bars were beautiful decorated, and there was a good selection of various dishes at the restaurants for each of our meals. We spent most of the time at the beach, and had amazing beachside service from Ramon. It was a great trip and I would definitely visit again - with my husband, family, or friends again!

reviews.author: Jose T
reviews.title: En general muy bueno pero se podrìan renovar algunas instalaciones
reviews.text: Buena organizaciòn en general y buena atenciòn en el Royal SErvice.  El servicio de mayordomìa es muy bueno y nuestro mayordomo muy eficiente y servicial y educado.  Estoy satisfecho con el servicio y la atenciòn y la calidad de los alimentos.

reviews.author: Kathy G
reviews.title: Great  week away from he cold and snow
reviews.text:
Very nice accommodations and service.
Our beach server George Alriche, was so attentive to our needs and wants.  So friendly.
Our breakfast server Dionis Paredes kept my coffee cup full and quite pleasant and was eager to please.
The entertainment staff were great and tried veryhard  to engage the guests in activities, especially "big Mac" and "queen" . We did participate in some pool activities with tem and had fun.

reviews.author: Kathleen D
reviews.title: Friendly, helpful staff
reviews.text: Enjoyed the stay very much, the people working the beach were very attentive, especially Onardo Marino and Francisco Estrella, at restaurant Paola Santana was very  friendly and fun to talk to, great service from these employees. However, the housekeeping staff was a little disappointing. Our coffee pot did not work, and it tokk 3 phone calls and 2 days to get it replaced. The resort is beautiful and the food at the restaurants was outstanding.

reviews.author: Elizabeth M
reviews.title: L/M from NJ
reviews.text: One of the best vacation we ever experienced to the food the people and the very best was the staff of Palma real resort we were here for 10 days the actives department can't thank enough for all the fun they brought to this visit Yess, Ronny , Pamela, Angel, Queen,     Rey Rey ,and if course my favorite Mr big Mac, the Restaurant Naos has one I'd the best hostess Francisca Acosta  and our waiter Henry Romero can't thank you enough for the the time we had here

reviews.author: Lavina D
reviews.title: Beautiful decor and exceptional service!
reviews.text: I recently went on a girls trip to The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana (Feb. 27-Mar. 2).  We were 7 of us in all.   We had 3 master bedroom family concierge suites.  Each room was given a cell phone to get in touch with our concierge service.  We were fortunate to be taken care of by Yarol Rijo on this trip.  He had a warm and welcoming smile and a "yes I can" attitude throughout our stay.  The resort is beautiful and quite large.  There and plenty of dining options and beautiful beachside bars.  The view was a feast for the eyes.  My favorite restaurant was Bana where we had a delicious Hibachi dinner.  There are adult and kids pools so it's great for families too.  I would love to come back with my family!

reviews.author: Brian K
reviews.title: First Time to Dominican Republic
reviews.text: My wife and I recently returned from the DR. We had a great time at the Paradisus Palma Real. When we first pulled up, we were amazed instantly by the view. You are able to see through the open courtyard and out to the ocean. All of the staff we encountered were very hospitable, of course some were amazing and went way above and beyond. The beach was very nice. We had read reviews about the wind there, but it did not bother us. In fact, sometimes it was even nice. If you want more of a breeze and less wind, opt for the pool. The food was really good. If you have gluten issues, there a quite a few options. One restaurant even has many gluten free options listed on the menu (Vento). Overall we were very pleased and plan to return with our kids.

reviews.author: MisaSantos_Brasil
reviews.title: Paraiso
reviews.text:
Lugar maravilhoso! Excelente experiencia! Optamos pelo Royal Service, perfeito. O apartamento era amplo e muito agradavel, com vista para um belissimo jardim, infraestrutura fantastica. O restaurante que mais gostamos foi o Pallazo, excelente comida e atendimento. O room service tambem e rapido e eficiente! Ainda vale citar o conforto da praia privativa.
O atendimento , perfeito. O pessoal fazia o possivel para tender a todos os nossos desejos. As noites eram sempre animadas com diversas atrações e ate uma feira de artesanato.

reviews.author: Chantel D
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
We spent one week at this hotel was it was amazing...a true paradise.  We had Royal Service and our butler Faustino was great...very helpful and thoughtful.  He took very good care of us and looked after anything we wanted.  During the day we spent most of our time on the Bali beds on the beach...Francisco Cabrera accommodated us every day, setting up our spot and catering to us all day with great drinks!  All staff members are very eager to help!
I have been here twice in total (this was first royal service experience), and I will definitely be returning again.

reviews.author: ignazio2015
reviews.title: Vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
I was on vacation with my wife and friends at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana Dominican Republic February 2015. The weather was great, the people were friendly and the service was excellent.
I would like to commend the following people who have made my staying at the Palma Real Resort very enjoyable. 
1. Mr. Ricardo Soler  made my experience at the restaurant "RARE" very unique  with his suggestions, knowledge and composure.
2. Mr. Jose' Rivera is an outstanding element in Palma Real food court area. Morning ,afternoon or night, whenever he was present, the outcome was excellent.  
Also Mr. Franklin Cueva was very helpful in solving any issues about food or bar. He has a natural talent in problem solving to make a vacationer at home.
My overall experience with the place, accommodation and service  was outstanding.  
Thank you very much
Ignazio Gadaleta

reviews.author: Vacasarg
reviews.title: Inolvidable
reviews.text: Es un hotel de ensueño los restaurantes las actividades y las habitaciones son increíble, el personal es muy atento y siempre dispuesto a ayudar saludo al equipo de servicios al cliente son bien atento y amable saludos a todos  Silvio la antigua, yanit, yeury, cheila, Jennifer, nicía, ezequias, Elvis López, y los chicos de la playa son increíble ramón Ramírez, Luis Santana.

reviews.author: Cheila R
reviews.title: Vacaciones increibles
reviews.text: Nos estuvimos quedando unos amigos en the reserve y fue increible pasamos las mejores vacaciones de nuestras vidas desde la habitacion, los jardines son preciosas. El personal de guest services son fantasticos en especial Cheila, Ezquiel, Elvis Jeuri, Nicia todos hacen siempre un poco mas por hacer de tu estadia la mejory no se puede dejar a Silvio excelente persona simpre muy atento. Gracias a todos no podemos esperar para volver!!!

reviews.author: Maina_Pietrobelli
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text:
Resort impecável, com tudo o que você possa imaginar. Estrutura de restaurantes super completa, com inúmeras opções para o jantar: comida mexicana, japonesa, contemporânea, chinesa, steak, italiana... O restaurante principal, que serve o café da manhã e o almoço, é enorme e também tem muitas opções. Além disso, todos os itens do Room Service (que não são poucos) também estão inclusos.
Praia SENSACIONAL, com serviço impecável na areia, tudo muito bem servido e com uma estrutura fantástica. Superou MUITO minhas expectativas.
Quarto enorme, com jacuzzi, varanda e cama king size extremamente confortável. Os inúmeros jardins são lindos, enormes e muito bem cuidados.
Não utilizamos o Royal Service, mas dava pra ver que tinham espreguiçadeiras mais bacanas na areia, além de um mordomo exclusivo (nós tínhamos que dividir o nosso com outras pessoas, mas, mesmo assim, é um mordomo levando chopp ou champagne na areia sempre que você quiser!).
Destaque especial ao George, que nos tratou com muito respeito e cordialidade, se antecipando sempre às nossas necessidades enquanto estávamos na praia. Teve um dia que eu passei mal e ele foi fazer uma bebida com chá e algumas ervas para me ajudar. Realmente um excelente profissional!

reviews.author: Valerie R
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely beautiful!  I was there for 4 nights celebrating my birthday with friends.. just got back yesterday.. we all loved it and had such a wonderful time! The friendly staff was one of the highlights of the trip... everyone was just so friendly and helpful.. there were two young ladies in particular, Yass and Pam who we really took to... they were just too cute and very sweet... they had us doing fun activities daily... all of the staff members we encountered was very friendly, too many names to list, don't want to leave out anyone, but it just made our trip that much more pleasant.  Every night was something to do on the resort, the nightly entertainment was awesome... and I loved just sitting and relaxing at the bar... the food was great, the drinks were decorative and delicious.  I have no complaints about this resort... I highly recommend, will be going back.

reviews.author: NatiCzar
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - Top Notch Service and Experience
reviews.text:
We traveled to this property as part of a large group during Super Bowl Week 2015. Our second time to Punta Cana was a great time in a great resort. We have done nearly 50 all inclusives over the years throught Mexico and Caribbean and Paradisus delivered. 

Well appointed rooms. SPECTACULAR grounds and a stunning beach. First Class all the way.

The main buffet was above average and they did a decent job of mixing up the types of foods available daily with the exception of breakfast. Still, very good for lunch and dinner as well.

We did the Japanese Hibachi Grill (Mizu)located at The Reserve and that was by far our favorite. Many thanks to the entertainment and great time provided by our chef "Luis Concepcion" and his wing man "Ricardo Encarnacion". They made our dining experience fun and most enjoyable with their antics and eagerness to talk about baseball and Johnny Cueto!

We also did an optional high end dining experience which had an additional fee. It was a 7 course wine pairing dinner which was exquisite and rivaled any upper end fine dining establishment in a large city.

The casino is small and if you like slots good for you. We loved that they had Caribbean Stud poker (which I did rather well for the week). Also a BlackJack table and a Texas Hold 'Em Table. 

Great lobby bar and lounge area. But we spent most of our time at the Swim Up Bar pool area where I must say that "Antonio" the bartender worked and slaved away for all of us Americans and Canadians shouting in his face and not once did he ever garner an attitude. He was just smiling and calm the entire time he worked. A consumate professional. Cheers, Antonio! Also at the pool bar was "Pedro" who greeted us every morning with our obligatory mudslide - good people that work very hard.

Like at any resort tipping goes a long way. We know that tipping is "included" at an All Inclusive but it elevates your experience when you put a little sugar on top and we're happy to do it.

the beach is absolutely beautiful and huge! White sand and deep with a palapa or lounger seemingly always available. Granted we arrived after a major storm and we witnessed the largest amounts of piled seaweed we've ever encountered for the first few days. It was a monumental mess and task to get it cleared. They eventually did and did a great job. I noticed many complaining about it - how do you blame the resort for Mother Nature? I digress...

I have read some reviews that were not as kind as me and I scratch my head wondering if they were at the same resort. Reports of lack of room cleanliness and staff attitudes seem fairly common. I simply do not concur with those stories. 

Would we return to Paradisus Palma Real? Probably so. It is a bit pricier than many similar resorts but you weed out a lot of "undesirables" that can otherwise ruin a beautiful place with constant drunken debauchery. (Not that drunken debauchery is such a bad thing! ) It's just done with far more class :) ENJOY PARADISE!

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Awesome resort!
reviews.text:
I love this resort. It's beautiful and the staff is friendly, for the most part.

The things I would change...tone down the activities sales guy...very agressive. I would also expect excellent service whether or not I am tipping with every service. If you are not putting out cash, you ate not getting attention.

reviews.author: Pcarmen2013
reviews.title: Punta Cana Vacation
reviews.text:
I will tell you the food for the most part was very good.  The amenities were excellent.  The bar service was somewhat slow, we've been told in the D.R. they only have two speeds slow and stop.  There were three staff members that really went out of their way to make our vacation extremely memorable.  The first was Felipe Morla Contreras on the beach, everyday he had our lounge chairs ready for us on the and made sure we were always well served via drinks on the beach.  The hostess Carolina Franco was phenomenal she always made us feel so welcome and went out of way to accommodate us and our friends.  Finally, Luis Martinez, he was our go to guy for all of our dinner reservations and always gave us great advice as what we should and shouldn't be doing.  He even gave all of us (four couples) a surprise in our room on our final evening of a wonderful Jacuzzi bath along with chocolate covered strawberries.  One disappointing item on the vacation was the fact that the all inclusive wasn't really all inclusive when it came to the alcoholic beverages for example when it came to vodka, Absolute & Stolis were included, Grey Goose, Belvedere, Kettle One were offered at a $12.00 upcharge per drink.  The other draw back was the service at the bar was slow.  

With that being said I would definitely return to this location it was very clean and the amenities were beautiful.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: From bad to worse
reviews.text:
I apologize, this is a little long but it's with good reason.  I was recently at the Paradisus Palma Real for one of my best friend's wedding.  Our flight got in a little late and since I didn't want to miss any of the wedding festivities already in play we darted through the airport, got to our airport transfer desk where they took all of my to and from vouchers and told us to show up the next morning of our VACATION at 9 am for a “meeting” in the lobby in order to get our return trip sorted out.  Yeah, we didn’t go because they have an office onsite that is staffed for that.  But we heard from others it was a timeshare/excursion sales pitch.  We slept through it and had no issues getting our transfer home.  Such a waste of time.  We were then taken to a minivan then there was some sort of confusion while the drivers argued among themselves.  I was told we were waiting for someone I don’t know  who...and waiting....and waiting.  After about 15 minutes I stuck my head out of the van and asked that we go, this was supposed to be a private ride.  The drivers then made us get out and move to another van.  Shouldn't have been a big deal, right?  This was only the beginning of the confusion that would continue to plague our stay.  

We got to the Paradisus and immediately were greeted by a woman who started to tell us that our room might not be ready (great first impression) and tried to give away our luggage to the bellmen.  I told everyone who would listen that a) it was after 6 pm and check in was at 3, there should be a room for us, we had confirmed, b) I wanted to keep my luggage with me and c) we needed a room ASAP to change and get to a wedding related event.  In retrospect, being extremely vocal about it was the only thing that saved us hours of waiting and lots of confusion. I held onto my luggage for dear life and we were taken to the check in desk where they started to try to tell us that they didn’t have a room and then to sell us an upgraded room.  When I protested that I didn’t really care and needed to go (it’s been well over an hour since we touched down and I’m beyond late at this point thanks to the minivan wait and trying to explain to a large host of people not to touch my luggage) he reluctantly gave us an upgraded room for free.  You would think this is a nice gesture but knowing what I know now, they shouldn’t have done it as it caused massive confusion for other guests.  They again tried to take our luggage and I literally had to just walk off.  The reason they do this is, they hold your luggage hostage while they pile you into a golf cart, tote you around the property and try to sell you stuff.  This was not my first time at this rodeo.  

We got to our room and it was nice but as soon as I touched the bathroom door, it came off the hinges, there were signs of poor construction and the AC sounded like a leaf blower.  We couldn’t run it during the night and had to just leave the fan on to circulate the air in order to sleep.  Gorgeous view or not sometimes you just need a quiet clean room.  The rest of the visit for us was plagued with gross food (I had an upset tummy from everything except the room service pizza I got) power outages and lack of warm water which was especially rough when trying to shower to get ready for the wedding.  On the last night I finally called and begged them to come and bring us some minibar provisions ie water, something that was supposed to be refilled daily but never was.    Our other party guests were plagued with constant room changes (they were upgraded at first and then told to move to a non-renovated room later), dirty rooms, sinks and showers clogged, roaches in their rooms and the spa, transfer issues for pick up ie no one was there to pick them up and drop off, unresponsive staff, provided a room that was already given to someone else, lack of beds, stolen items, broken safes, and a couple was sent to stay at the resort next door instead of with us, etc.  The list goes on and on.  

All of that to say the trip was only positive because my beautiful friend got married and we were among a great group of people.  However, I have never been to a more distasteful hotel.  The staff and administration of this resort was just ridiculously unorganized and thought we were insane for wanting them to get things right.  The matron of honor spent her entire vacation trying to solve issues and begging for senior leadership attention to our issues.  Let’s just say, none of us will be back.

reviews.author: Gilbi65
reviews.title: A real Paradise!!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma real Hotel for 6 days. It was more than a dream!!! Everything was wonderful. There was not even one thing to complain about! Simply the best hotel in the Dominican !!!

reviews.author: Claudia3573
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Royal Service
reviews.text:
Excellent service, perfect holiday stay, especially Royal service area.
If you want to be by your own, enjoy a very special 5 star kitchen, this should be one of your first choices. It starts with check in, so relaxing, you just wait with a glass of champaign during the staff is organizing everything. The team of Paradisus Palma Real did a perfect job to grant a perfect holiday stay. Have seen many places in this world, but this hotel offered just everything.

reviews.author: 870mch
reviews.title: Agradecimiento por tan agradable estadia
reviews.text:
Estimado Sr. Bergwerf, no puedo dejar pasar esta oportunidad sin agradecer a Ud. y su maravilloso personal por haber hecho de nuestra estancia en este precioso hotel Paradisus Palma Real en Punta Cana, una experiencia inolvidable.

Quisiera hacer una especial mencion a las personas que mas cerca de nosotros han estado,demostrando un gran profesionalismo, identificacion completa con la compania e impecabilidad de comportamiento:
 
Sra. Maria Richardson - por su recibimiento tan agradable, haciendonos sentir muy bienvenidas.
Sr. Elvis Hidalgo, nuestro mayordomo, estuvo pendiente en todo momento dandonos gusto y atendiendo todas nuestras necesidades.
Sra Carmencita Paulino tambien tratando que disfrutemos a totalidad nuestra estadia.
Sr. Juan Perez, bartender,sorprendiendonos cada dia en el Palazzo Restaurant  con un traguito especial como para nosotras.
 
En realidad, en general todo el personal,  siempre atentos y muy amables, sonriendo y dando mas de lo esperado.

Mis felicitaciones a Ud.  Sr. Bergwerf por tan excelente manejo del hotel.

Sinceramente,

 
CECILIA HALPERT

reviews.author: DaveThornbury
reviews.title: Service nightmare in the Caribbean
reviews.text:
My wife and I along with two other couples decided to spend a week at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Our stay was from February 14-21, rooms 2421, 2422 and 2423.
 
The nightmare begins upon check in which took almost two hours. Our friends ended up getting our suite (which got corrected the following day). We weren’t given any orientation of the property just a lousy map and told our concierge could book our dinner reservations, reserve cabanas for us and so on.
 
We go to our room and then immediately head to our concierge to have her book dinner reservations for us since it’s Valentines Day. She tells us our concierge is not here and she handles the other half of our building. It’s now 5:30 and she finally says it really doesn’t matter because dinner reservations needed to be made by 5 and our only choice now is the buffet. Not a happy camper so we head to the bar.
 
The following morning our wives go to make dinner reservations for the week. They are first told you have to make them day-by-day and had to give a time range. They requested between 7 and 8:30 but were told they had to make the range to 9. They explain 9 is too late for the 6 of us. They check back at 5 p.m. and nothing had been booked at that point and was told to check back in an hour or so. Finally get all our reservations and everyone was at 9 p.m. This took several days to correct and yet we still had a few at 9 and couldn’t get into some.
 
Our concierge was rarely there and when she was she wasn’t helpful at all. We tried to reserve a cabana at the pool or the beach and were told only families could reserve them. When we explained that upon check in we were told that she could reserve them for us she stated that wrong. We are now all a little frosted in the 80-degree weather.
 
Now understand the Reserve is the most expensive part of the resort so we expected superior service. One of the couples with us switched from Paradisus luxury junior suite with Royal Service to the Reserve to be near us at an increase of three thousand dollars. Where they originally had booked they would have been able to reserve cabanas and so much more.
 
Over the next several days we had nightmare after nightmare with service at the various restaurants. They would forget our drinks orders, forget the wine we ordered, forget wine glasses, forget to open the wine, and this includes one of the restaurants that has an upcharge to eat at. It gets worse, we showed up for a 7 p.m. dinner reservation with the reservation card in hand. Remember it took us days to correct all the 9 p.m. seating’s we were booked. The receptionist said they didn’t have us at 7 but at 9 and come back then. We again showed her the reservation card and she really didn’t care. We asked for a manager whom came and started with the same crap and then finally sat us. We asked to speak with the general manager of the resort (which we had asked on several occasion to no avail). The night manager of the resort did come and visit, we explain all our problems and she stated she’d get them all correct (never happened).
 
The next evening we had reservations at the Grill at 8:30 not where we had wanted to go but they could not move up our 9 p.m. reservation at our first choice (booked 5 days earlier). The Grill is a crossed between a restaurant and a buffet. After waiting for over a half hour and still not seated (and they couldn’t tell us when we would be seated) one of the guys in our party gave the hostess $20 to get us seated, final around 8:45 we got seated. Bare in mind our first choice our reservations were originally at 9.
 
Not all experiences were bad, some good restaurants in the mix but it was clear service overall was lacking, no one could ever give us a straight answer or the same answer through the resort.
 
Our last day there we discover there was many water activities included- sure would have been nice to know about them early on so we had a chance to used them.
 
Now for the good, the rooms are very nice and the resort property is amazing. If they can ever get service issues corrected we would consider returning but not now.

reviews.author: 18Sally
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Just returned from a beautiful 8 days at the Paradisus Palma Real Dominican Republic. Others had posted that you did not get service if you did not upgrade to Royal Service. This was not the case. Every day at the buffet we received prompt service. Dinner reservations were easy to book. Some nights were full but if you went to the restaurant and asked if they had room all but one was able to seat us.The drink service on the beach from our new friend Onardo was excellent and fun. He taught us many things about his country. We also had excellent attention at the buffet from Juana and Franklin. The staff at Blue Agave always remembered us and gave us great service. All  staff were helpful and courteous from check in to check out. Check in took a bit of time but the hotel was busy. We needed 2 beds and they accommodated our request. It took some time but was done in less than an hour.They put our friends in the royal service area of the hotel. Our rooms were exactly the same. When you go to another country you should be patient, don't be demanding and you will get what you ask for. The four best Friends.

reviews.author: Jennifer P
reviews.title: 5 Star
reviews.text:
This is our second trip to the Paradisus in as many years (we are already planning our trip back!).
We stayed in the Royal Service area of the hotel and it was Amazing. Last year only myself and husband went as a second honeymoon, but this year we took 3 more couples and had a blast! Our Butler, Juan Salvador took care of all 8 of us and did an awesome job! Leo the bartender created drinks to remember and one of my favorite people, Fernando, took care of all of our beach needs. They are constantly thinking ahead to go above and beyond what their job requires of them. They even set up a 'birthday party' for me (40) on the beach with cake and a cooler full of champagne and beer! We made special requests to all be int he same building and they were honored! The entertainment is incredible! Our room was also very clean, quiet and wonderful to come 'home' to after a day at the beach! Thanks again Juan, Fernando, Leo, Queene, Big Mac, and all the other family at the Paradisus! See you next February!

reviews.author: Cheryl g
reviews.title: Trip with friends
reviews.text:
The butler service was outstanding.  They arranged transports, dinner reservations and outings.  There was a special treat everyday!  
All staff members very friendly and they all seemed like they enjoyed working there and enjoyed the company of their colleagues.
Food was very good, buffet offered a lot of healthy options.  
Lots of seaweed on the beach.  I don't know if it just happened due to the currents or it occurs all the time.
Spa not impressive at all

reviews.author: MValetta
reviews.title: Thank Goodness for Royal Service- ASK FOR LUIS the Butler
reviews.text:
A few overall words to describe the hotel and the grounds: Busy, unromantic, mediocre food, sugary drinks, seaweed covered beaches, untrained service staff, lacking luxury.

Therefore, ROYAL SERVICE is NECESSARY!

There were however, 2 people and one special restaurant that made our stay memorable.
 LUIS SANCHEZ, our Royal Service Butler, and LEONARDO MOTA our royal service pool bartender know what the word SERVICE means! They are amazing in every way and they should be in charge of training all of the other staff members. 

Even though he was stationed behind the bar, Leonardo would still com down to the beach to see us, and ask what we wanted to drink. AND, he remembered all of our drinks every time and even brought them out to us at the beach. 

Luis, made sure everything was arranged for us: Pool cabanas, beach lounge chairs reserved, restaurant reservations secured, and transportation back to the airport arranged. He had wine delivered nightly along with cheese plates, chocolate covered strawberries, and other fruits. He also surprised the birthday girls of our group with a special Butler-Drawn-Bath complete with flowers and candles and birthday wishes "written" with the flower petals. On top of that he arranged for a special Birthday Cake one night that was so incredibly delicious, I think it was the best dessert we had on the entire trip! INCREDIBLE.

The one restaurant that really made our stay is PASSION. The only problem is, it costs extra. A lot extra. $70 a person plus beverages. However it was worth it. If only all the other restaurants had half that in food quality or service it would make a big difference. I loved every course and it truly reminded me of some of the amazing Michelin star restaurants I enjoyed in Spain.

Rooms are nice in the Royal Service section, although a little small for a resort. If you don't mind walking stairs (there are no elevators) ask to be on floor 2 or above so you can see the water from your bed when you awake. Ocean Views are worth it. Showers are a little intricate and unnecessary - we never once used all of those crazy jets and it was hard to get the thing to turn off and on with out spraying water everywhere. Mattresses are very comfy, BUT I wish they had King-size pillows instead of the tiny pillows they use.

Be warned that the beaches in the DR always seem to be strewn with seaweed and it is everywhere.  It is not fun to swim with! I get it, it is nature what can you do?

The Royal Service pool is nice and we didn't once go to the crazy overcrowded main pool with all the "Normal service" guests. It was nice to have a space to relax without kids and with a more civilized adult crowd.

Palazzo restaurant is reserved for just Royal Service guests and it offers a la carte ordering for breakfast and lunch (along with a small buffet option). TRUST ME, it is easy to get sick of buffet style food. The eggplant appetizer at dinner was so delicious.

THE SPA: disorganized. We had to select services and set up massage times THREE DIFFERENT TIMES to confirm an appointment because they just could not get it. The first time we requested was before our trip via email, but when we arrived, nothing was set up because that employee who set it up ANNA was not working that week, or had left... we never got the real story. SO, on the beach the day before our spa day, our butler along with a spa coordinator came to the beach and had us reselect services. We all WROTE DOWN on a piece of paper our selected services, along with our names and room numbers. We were supposed to have been set up for 11:30 am on Friday.  WELL, when we arrived Friday morning around 11am, SURPRISE! Nothing was set up. The paper got lost and nothing got entered into the system.... We had to start over AGAIN. NOT RELAXING.  

BE AWARE also, that the so-called FACIALS they offer are really not facials. I booked a 25 minute Shine facial that was supposed to be CUSTOMIZED to my skin-type. The therapist never asked me what type of skin I had, did not offer a selection of products and didn't even tell me exactly what she was putting on my face. She just kept slathering stuff on and wiping it off and repeating it over and over. NO steam, no extractions. VERY STRANGE. And for the high prices the charge, this is just UNACCEPTABLE. 

Overall we had a very nice trip because we were a group of 6 fun girls, but also because we came across a few great service staff members. But would I go back? NO. I would rather choose Mexico where the resorts can be higher-end, the beaches more beautiful and all the service staff rocks.

FYI, the Punta Cana airport has no AC and can be brutally hot!

reviews.author: Cheryl P
reviews.title: Great value, great food and great service!
reviews.text:
I just spent a week with 4 girl friends celebrating our 50th birthday year in the Royal Service. (adult only) with butler service!  Great extra spend for a trip! What a great week!
Many all inclusive hotels don't have exceptional food -food here is great. 
Be sure to try Passion the special a la carte restaurant with a 7 course meal exquisite food and service! Worth spending the extra pp $. All the a la carte restaurants are great. Book your restaurant reservations as soon as you arrive with your butler.
Hotel has a complimentary shuttle service to a little mall with great shops about 5 minutes away.  Great spa bring your bathing suit for the pools as this area is co-ed.
Family Concierge the new building in the resort is exceptional. (opened in Dec. 2014). Olio is restaurant here and food is amazing (Italian pasta, pizza).  Kimberly the manager here will take exceptional care of you.  
Book Claury for your butler in Family Concierge. She was amazing!

reviews.author: Janet E
reviews.title: As Close To Paradise as You Can Get
reviews.text:
Just returned from a fantastic week at Paradisus Palma Real.  Travelled with 4 other women celebrating our 50th birthdays. The location, setting, facilities while all excellent was made luxurious  by the outstanding care and service by Claury our lovely concierge/butler.  She worked so hard to make our week special.  From champagne in the room to special birthday decorations in our room, on top of the dinner and bally bed reservations, excellent check out service.....the list goes on an on.
Our beach experience was great thanks to Angel who was so attentive - thank you! Pedro always had kind words and big smile and of course Leonardo at the bar.
Dinners were at Olio (thank you Kimberly),  Vento, Fuego, Palazzo, Rare and Passion where we had a fantastic 7 course dinner with wine pairings.  Rodney and Domingo's service was top notch and really made our night special.  Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: DISNEYCHICKS
reviews.title: The stars were kind of stacked against us ...
reviews.text:
Travel dates October 21st through October 30, 2014..

Our vacation started on a rough note and ended on a rougher one...

Trying to depart on time from ATW was not in the stars. Arriving at airport about 3:00 AM and not departing till 10ish can make for a long morning.  Our Delta fight had mechanical problem.  But the people at ATW and Delta took phenomenal care of us.  Keeping us up to date with the latest information.  The care that they gave us ... I have never seen at any other airport. Granted ATW is a smaller airport. Delta had supplied us with coffee and muffins in the early hours. Another delay time was added. They had to have a part flown in from another state ...round 2 .. Sub sandwiches, chip and drinks were supplied.  Bellies full and flight left around 10.  Again thank-you Delta for taking good care of your "cargo" ...Bad part, we missed our connecting flight in Atlanta :( had to do an unexpected sleep over. Delta put us up in a hotel in Atlanta (see my Atlanta review of hotel)  and gave us a small travel pouch with some necessities, since our luggage was sent to the international part of the airport it was locked up supposedly it would take hours to find.  Hotel was great and serves a wonderful hot breakfast to get us started on the right foot...

Airport was a breeze...and arrived quickly to our resort.

Arrived one day late but, we finally arrive to start our vacation.
Check-in ...the only thing I really remember them saying to me was ... You look very tired and not happy (Oh, OK). Thinking, just get us to our room so we can unpack and get this vacation started.

Room was wonderful, clean, and huge with a partial view of the pool. We unpacked and set off to start our new adventure.
For some reason it seemed like we were walking around blindly ... Having a hard time getting information out of people and felt like no one wanted to help ?!?!?!  Just a strange feeling.  A few days later we figured out we never received our information packet :( 

Resort ... Beautiful, lush and breath taking. Well maintained in all aspects.
I'm not sure why ... But both my friend  and myself felt ... Like we were a bit invisible to employees ... Finding the people at this resort very much on the cold side, not warm and inviting at all ....very disappointing.  Neither my friend nor I are the demanding, pushy cater to me type...

The only time that people seemed remotely interested in us ...I have a TA luggage tag attached on my back pack that I carry around during the day ...the employees would come right up to us and ask us to do a review on TA about them. Sure you delivered me one drink  ... I will give you a raving review ... Really ...Some came right up to us and asked that we never even met . I have never been to a resort were the employees are constantly asking you if you will/did write a review on them yet ...as they would point in the direction of the nearest computer we could use ...why sure, thank-you, not a problem ... I'll run right over there to do it ....  After a few days I took the tag off my backpack...so we wouldn't get bothered any more... Yes I know their sole purpose of wanting to see their name in a review... is to get time off ... But really ... STOP hounding the guest.  There were a few that were pretty good to us ..but the constant asking, I decided not to say their names (sorry). We saw this happening with many of the guest. Don't get me wrong I enjoy TA immensely and is a wealth of information and give credit were credit is due... but.

About our 3rd day we decided to book a spa treatment ...  We were so bummed to find out that the main spa building was closed down and being refurbished. They were using one of the buildings for makeshift spas. Both of us booked facials ...oh Dear God and Baby Jesus ...Was not sure about my gal right off the bat. First of all she wanted me to lay on the table with my street clothes on… Don't you usually get undressed and cover up with a sheets ... She was not liking it but I ended doing it anyways...Then the music came on, over the top loud...it sounded like 2 sea animals trying to "get it on" ....while mixing up her different lotions and potions to apply on my face...it sounded like she was more in a kitchen... she was clanging and banging things together.... So relaxing… NOT. Now for the application of the product to my face  ... Can you say let's "frost a cake" with a spatula... Now comes the middle part where they "usually" gently with flowing motions work on your neck shoulders (this is why I was wondering why I was supposed to keep my street clothes on) arms, hands, legs and feet ... This lady “motions” we from a beat of a different drum. Now the smell of cigarette smoke is wafting into my room. Can it really get any better ??? Now it is time to un-frost the cake ....you got it ... Clang banging in the sink...the noise, the smoke, the animals getting it on and the lady un-frosting the cake.... Can I please just be done and have a stiff drink...

My friend came out of her room. And she her experience was OK ... What, no special treatment for her… What's the deal !!! 

So now I'm excited we get to go to the bar . Have a drink and I get to tell her all about magical experience. That she would be extremely jealous about.
While standing by the bar area ... My BFF said ... "You know what, my belly kind of feels weird, icky, bloated and rumbling noises ( she should of been in by me ...and heard my sea creatures noises) would you mind if went back to the room and call it a night"....it just can't get any better than this ... Right ?!? I grab a night cap on off we go back to our room...remember when I said  "it couldn't get any better ...well...got in the door and that poor girl lost her innards right in the toilet :( Thank God she just  got her hair cut short, so I didn't have to hold it out of the toilet :) score 1 for me ...well my friend had permanent toilet seat marks on her  derrière for the next 5 dayz :( 

It's alive ... She came out of the room after 2 days of being confined. I love it .She goes to a AI resort to have the "BRAT" diet.  Which consist of bananas, rice and toast.  Found a lounger for her out by the pool next the restroom for parts of the day. Poor girl :(  We do not know what caused this problem for her ... Not blaming anyone ...just have no idea what caused it. 

I did get to take in a couple shows by myself… This was the highlight of my evenings for as my friend was tucked into bed or stuck to the toilet...absolutely love the Michael Jackson show and Bounce!!!  These performers are absolutely wonderful. The main lobby of these two complexes...beautiful…I could've hung out in this area for days.

For us the Wi-Fi  was great... pool, beach and room.

I did get to enjoy a few a la carte meals, alone. For the most part all in all ...the restaurants and buffets I would rate a seven or eight out of the 10. I loved have breakfast, early morning coffee and the lovely morning sunshine.

Bars and drinks, Tried an array of different cocktail and pretty much enjoyed them all.

Enjoyed the walk to the beach, all of the beautiful landscaping and flower, this is always a treat for me. Only took the tram a few times  I believe there are 3 different paths to get there. 

Beach was very maintained and groomed. We had our own beach area for  "reserve" people. Enjoyed the beach/bar service.  Lots of shade if needed with plenty of towels.

The second day of our trip, we went parasailing… This is a first for me and her!  We had 2 gentlemen join us on our flight out to the main boat… It was hard for them to get into the boat from land because of the large waves, then the one said to his friend "mind you're nuts Nelly" in their English accent (love it).  For the duration of the trip  this was our saying  :)
 
Somewhere along the line here… My face was exposed to too much sun or broke out from the day the lady decorating my face with frosting... it looked like I had the chickenpox… or a nail gun went ballistic on my face....does the fun never end.

The only person that I am going to knowledge on this trip is,  Annabel a concierge in our building....Annabelle was always checking on my friend and checking with me when I would meet up with her and asking about how my friend was doing. Annabella even took it upon herself to send up room service for my BFF. Consisting of crackers, water bananas… What a wonderful lady!!

This was probably one of the larger resorts that I've stayed at. Lots of things going on day or night or you could have you quiet space.  I personally enjoy a smaller quaint resort instead.  If the "Reserve" area would have been on the beach..it would of just been more of a bonus...So relaxing to be by the water.

With all this unplanned adventures we had… We sat at the resort and laughed about them… As we still do today. What else can could we do ... But laugh.

Off to find my next adventure...

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: Recommend!
reviews.text:
Great all inclusive resort! Right on the beach, plenty of bars, huge pool, restaurants are good. Rooms are very nice, large with balcony and huge bath tub. No need to leave the resort, everything you need is there. They have activities if you want but they don't bother you if you want to relax.
Will definitely go back!

reviews.author: bugsmomtoo
reviews.title: Pretty, but not so great aside from that...
reviews.text: Returned one week ago.  The good news (for us anyway) is that this was a reward trip, so we weren't paying for it. The resort is very pretty to look at and hopefully the huge amount of seaweed on the beach is just a temporary problem because the sand is very soft.  We had a great bartender at the pool bar and pretty good service on the beach if you tip. Now for the not so great stuff:  Upon arriving at our room (3721), we walked in and were immediately assaulted by a VERY strong musty smell.  I alerted the front desk and they sent someone with some kind of spray and lit some incense, which made the situation more tolerable.  My sister in law was directly above us in 3731 and had the same problem.  Upon arriving home, I have laundered our clothing 3 times and still cannot get the musty smell out.  I'm going to have to send everything to the dry cleaners and hope for the best. The rooms on that side of the resort are dated and strangely laid out.  Others from our company that were in the 1000 numbered rooms on the other side of the resort said their rooms were fine and nicely laid out. Maybe our side was the original and the other rooms were added later?  Definitely need serious remodeling on the one side for sure.  The food at the restaurants is average at best, with, in my opinion, the best being the breakfast buffet.  Played Black Jack at the casino and the dealers do not check for a blackjack when they are showing an ace or face card, thereby letting others split or double down their money when they cannot beat the dealer if he/she has blackjack. Every other casino I've gone to has the dealer  check first.  Our friend played slots and won the 5 coin line and they would only pay him as if he played one coin. We didn't gamble again on our trip. We have traveled many times to the Caribbean and throughout Mexico, and this was our least favorite trip. We will not return to this resort.

reviews.author: JOSE S
reviews.title: FIM DE ANO COM AMIGOS
reviews.text: O hotel é lindo, seus resturantes são maravilhosos, estivemos em dezembro de 2015. Parabéns ao excelente serviço do mordomo Ariel, do Franklin do Rest.Palazzo e o Francisco e Pedro do Bar da Piscina Royal Service.

reviews.author: james m
reviews.title: great place
reviews.text: i stayed a week at this resort and it was excellent the service was superb especially johnathan felix and hector anything i needed they took care of  very respectful people the cleaning crew was very good as well with the facilities being spotless  my friends and i could not be happier with the employees at the hotel they treat you repect

reviews.author: Christine H
reviews.title: A FABulous 50th birthday vacation in paradise!!!
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely FABulous vacation!! A portion of my FABulous stay is credited to our Royal Service's pool bartender, Leonardo Mota. He went out of his way to ensure my glass was always filled and I had a smile on my face at all times when I was at the pool and on the beach.

The largest portion of credit for my FABulous stay goes to my awesome butler, Luis Sanchez. He was very responsive and accommodating to my every need. He also made my stay a little bit special for me... I was with a group of friends celebrating one girlfriend's 50th birthday, but my own 50th was a month earlier and Luis made sure I received special treatment at the restaurants too. He also surprised me with a lovely 50th celebration jacuzzi with flowers and candles to continue my relaxation after a day at the exclusive Royal Service's pool and beach. Luis made dinner reservations for me and my friends every night and treated me to fresh fruit, cheese and wine in my room in the afternoon. And to finish each FABulous day, Luis brought to my room freshly lavendar-scented feather pillows to rest my head on and ensure a great night sleep!. I can not say enough about the professionalism, hospitality, and kindness Luis showed me every day of my stay in paradise!

The Paradisus Palma Real was an experience I will never forget and hope to enjoy again very soon!!

reviews.author: Maggie H
reviews.title: An unforgettable vacation - exceptional staff
reviews.text: I recently stayed at this magnificent resort with my best friend.  It was recommended that we book the Royal Service and we are happy that we did.  The accommodations were fabulous.  She had an ocean view and I a garden view.  The Royal Service comes with many great features, including an exclusive private check-in process (made us feel very special), a private pool area with cabanas, a private beach areas with the most amazing lounge beds, a private restaurant called Palazzo that we enjoyed many meals at but most importantly above anything else what made the experience unforgettable was the service from all the staff that took care of us.  While I refer to them as staff, by day two, they were more like family.  My friend and I shared a Butler (which comes with the Royal Service).  His name was Johel.  He was exceptional and made sure that my friend and I always had everything that we needed and was so responsive and courteous to our every need and request.  We celebrated my birthday and Johel helped to make that day incredibly special. In addition to Johel, there was Richard Ortiz and Pasquel Rodriguez at Palazzo.  Their warm smiles welcomed us in each day for breakfast and lunch.  They knew by day two what we enjoyed to eat and drink and we didn't even have to ask once.  They just knew.  Then there was sweet Carlos Rosario who made sure he arranged for our beach lounges every morning and kindly escorted us to our beach heaven daily.  He always made sure he stopped by often to keep us hydrated with plenty of water.  Leo Mota at pool bar was sweet as pie.  It as always a pleasure to watch him engage with the guests and how much they likewise enjoyed his company. Made for a great, warm and fun environment, while at the same time keeping the tranquility of the space.  The resort has many different options for dining and my friend and I experienced just about all of the restaurants.  Great food and again great service.  The amenities offered are many however since our vacation was more geared toward relaxation and down time, we mostly enjoyed the spa and fitness facilities.  Amazing YHI spas both at the main hotel but also at the Reserve.  I could go on and on but I don't have enough space to write it all down.  We were so pleased with our experience that we are booking the same trip, for the same time in the same Royal Service again next year.  The people and the staff there is what made the experience what it was.  Thank you to all of them.

reviews.author: KatyBoston
reviews.title: Even better over time!
reviews.text:
A new year, upgraded quality!  We have visited this resort countless times, it's getting better over time. Aura, thanks for a smooth check-in experience. Anuvi, thank you for all your help, you always come through. Best guest service agent if you speak primarily English. She deserves to be promoted!

We mostly ate breakfast and lunch at the Gabi reserve buffet. The service and quality of the food is exceptional for a Caribbean all inclusive. We really loved the sushi this year.  A nice addition. The tapas style dishes are also excellent, especially for trying things you may not otherwise. Dessert quality was certainly upgraded especially the chocolate desserts. Our thanks to our favorite waiter Luis Vasquez, he is extremely attentive in a quiet, respectful way. He remembered us, as did many, from our previous years. Kudos to Celso Peralta, Adalberto Herrera and Rannelly Polanco. They were a pleasure to see and we felt welcomed like family! 

I play tennis every morning and paddle ball in the afternoon. Ambi, Jose and Domingo are my favorite team of players. They are professional and fun and work hard to accommodate their customers from all over world. My husband loves the camaraderie and banter that we have with them. Laughter is the best and we share many laughs with them. We are all a competitive group! 

Our housekeeper Altagracia Figueroa did a wonderful job cleaning up after us. She made some wonderful towel designs that were fun to come back to. The rooms are stylish, clean and well equipped. 

Although last year the Bana Japanese was one of our favorite restaurants, it fell somewhat short this year. The food was not quite as good and our table was overcrowded. A table that fits a maximum of 12 had 15 and a baby. It was an uncomfortable seating arrangement as not everyone could get close to the table while eating. The Bana Wok was a nice new addition. We all loved the shrimp tempura sushi, we highly recommend it. 

The wifi was much better than the previous years and according to  Cesar (activities manager) who I had the pleasure of playing ping pong with, it will be greatly improved next year as that is an area they are devoting some resources to this year. Thanks Jose de la Cruz for our ping pong games, it was such fun. Cesar, a rubber match next year?

We frequented both the pool and the beach, the service was terrific. I compliment all of you, and if I spell your name wrong, I apologize as spell check does have a way of getting the best if me. Luis Santana, Ramon Ramirez and Oneida Zorilla Wander Roa were at the beach most of the time. Emilio (there's only one at the reserve pool!) Jose de Los Santos (fabulous sense of humor) Santo Polanco and Santos Frias came up with vino, champagne and honey with lime for my sore throat. Thank you for that, it was greatly appreciated.  

This year Mole was much improved over last year, the food quality as well as the dishes offered were a step-up from last year. 

Our last full day there, the golf bus arrived early and failed to pick up our 2 golfers. It was not the hotels fault or responsibility, but to make up for the additional taxi expense, the hotel made us reservations at La Palapa which is an additional expense normally. They picked up the tab. Again, thanks to Anuvi we enjoyed a wonderful meal and experience!  Dinner was excellent!  

So thanks to all for a wonderful 2 weeks. Looking forward to next year as we came home to more snow!

reviews.author: tim b
reviews.title: nothing but the best
reviews.text: This is my second trip in as many years to the Reserve, and I have to say am being treated as well as any King!  The people here are nothing short of excellent. I would like to mention there names so if you do come here for a vacation, you can look them up and get the same treatment as myself, starting With Mildrid Carvajal, Little Leidy Elizabeth Perez (shes a darling), Nikel Lendor, Estefania Ruiz, Elaine Rodriguez, Diosmery Franciso, Sandra Villa Nueva, Sofia Paternina, Yarol Rijo and Yoel Monegro.  Hope I Didnt miss anyone. A vacation with this staff looking after you, is fantastic!  ill be booking here again next year and like the saying goes, everything happens in threes but it ll be alot more than that. Thanks again. Pappagallo says thanks again, Little Leidy

reviews.author: Robert P
reviews.title: Upgrade to Royal Service is Awesome
reviews.text:
My wife and I were invited to a destination wedding (December 2014) Paradisius Palma Real in Punta Cana for a neighbor's son with whom our children grew up and remain friends today. As it was also our 40th wedding anniversary in December, I upgraded us to Royal Service as a surprise to my wife.

What a fabulous idea it turned out to be. 

**You are greeeted at the entrance to the hotel and taken away from the masses immediately and taken over to the Royal Service section of the property, where have your own Private Registration area and Lounge. 
** While the property has many restaurants - including an amazing (too large) buffet - immediately downstairs from the Royal Service Lounge is a private restaurant, Palazzo, for Royal Service  guests only.  We ate breakfast there every day, and lunch every day but one and had a fabulous dinner there as well. 
**There is a private Royal Service Pool and beach, run by the wonderful, gentle giant of a man, Pedro.  He took very good care of us and made sure we had a Bali Bed (thatched roof-covered lounge) on the beach every day.
**And the topper of the experience was you are assigned a Butler for your stay who has as their sole objective to make you have a wonderful, romantic stay. Our Butler, Ariel Benzo, was AMAZING!!! Warm, friendly, caring, dedicated.  The butler will make dinner reservations, iron clothes if you want (we didn't), bring you drinks on the beach (if your that lazy or needy).  And they bring afternoon snacks to your room (cheese/crackers, fruit plates). But the most amazing thing Ariel did was, after figuring out our afternoon schedule one day.....we came back from the beach to find he had drawn us a bath in the real two-person Jacuzzi tub, had a bottle of iced champagne in a bucket with two glasses on the tub, there was a plate of chocolate dipped strawberries and he had decorated the tub and the bath with rose petals.

Extremely romantic!!

Great venue!!

Great Butler, Ariel Benzo!!

reviews.author: andrea marisol m
reviews.title: unas vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text: La verdad estoy super agradecida por el trato para con nosotras de toda la gente que trabaja en el hotel Paradisus Punta Cana ,FUE UNA EXPERIENCIA INOLVIDABLE .....lo bien que nos hicieron sentir, super simpáticos y amables .
