Espero poder tener la posibilidad de volver pronto. Ante todo quiero destacar la amabilidad de Yesica de la Cruz del resto Gaby beach ,que fue super amable con nosotras y de David contreras el chico de animación que no hizo pasar unas tardes espectaculares con sus clases de baile.

reviews.author: Michel D
reviews.title: Un PARADIS SUR TERRE
reviews.text:
10 jours de rêve à la Réserve . Une chambre immense avec une pièce comprenant un jacuzzi .Des produits de toilette renouvelés tous les jours  Des buffets variés et de qualité De très bons restaurants .Le personnel est souriant et toujours disponible .Un jardin immense ou' il fait bon se promener ( à pied ou en train ) Tout est conçu pour que vous soyez bien !
Promenades en bateau, padel avec Domingo et José,baignades 
dans une eau chaude, cocktails dans les transats . Les journées passent...trop vite !
Et certains soirs le chant des abeilles par un groupe venu du Nord de la France
A ne pas manquer !!!

reviews.author: Edith S
reviews.title: Un paradis sur terre Luxe Repos et cuisine gastronomique
reviews.text:
Nous venons de rentrer de Punta Cana ou nous avons passé dix jours formidables en compagnie de couples d'amis 
Les jardins sont magnifiques,très agréables à regarder et où il fait bon s'y promener
Les chambres sont magnifiquement décorées et très spacieuses
Rien a redire en ce qui concerne la restauration Les buffets sont variés et pour tous les goûts 
Quand aux restaurants il s'agit de véritable cuisine gastronomique et nous avons beaucoup apprécié le vento et le palapa ou nous avons dégusté de succulentes langoustes 
L'accueil à notre arrivée et au départ a été très chaleureux et le personnel a toujours été disponible et aux petits soins pour nous faire plaisir (personnel toujours très souriant) 
Cet hotel dispose de plus d'une très grande et large plage  superbement aménagée ainsi qu'une belle piscine ou nous pouvons siroter un cocktail les pieds dans l'eau
En bref nous revenons ravis de notre séjour dans cet hotel et espérons y revenir le plus rapidement possible 
Edith et Jean Luc (les amis des abeilles)

reviews.author: Michael H
reviews.title: Gran servicio
reviews.text: Un gran hotel, con una excelente calidad de servicio. Se destaca por ser un lugar poco "crowded" y por si impecable atención. Nosotros tenemos como jefa a Sandra Villanuevas, que es una excelente profesional y ha cumplido todas nuestras expectativas. No queda nada mas que felicitarla a ella y a su equipo por hacer unas vacaciones muy agradables!

reviews.author: Vincent MARTIN
reviews.title: Exceptionnel
reviews.text:
J ai passé 15 jours au palma réal punta cana  un endroit exceptionnel
Que dire tout est parfait  je cherche un.un point négatif mais n en trouve pas
Très propre 
Le personnel très souriant très dévoué parle de nombreuses langues très professionnel
Tous les restaurants de l hotel sont fabuleux c est bon c est frais  les buffets sur 15 jours sont très diversifié 
Peut être un tout petit point à améliorer au niveau de la partie sushi sashimi 
Les sashimi doivent être coupé en fine tranche et non en cube  mais à part ça tout est parfait 
Du domaine de l exception 
Le restaurant gastronomique le passion exceptionnel aussi 
Notre suite junior en royal service super
Bravo au groupe melia   fantastique

reviews.author: Von N
reviews.title: Great Visit
reviews.text:
Our group host Asia Mateo was awesome.  She was fun and extremely helpful.  The service was great.  We did have some wifi issues in room 1375 but out butlers Elvis and Ezequiel quickly addressed the concern.  The resort was extremely well kept.  I love waking up in the morning and seeing the cleaning crew scurbbing.  

We travel often and this is one of my favorite places to visit.  Paradisus in Costa Rico is awesome too but the service here was so much better in my opinion.  One down side was no jet skiing.  It's okay I can visit South Beach for that.

reviews.author: sophie a
reviews.title: superbe séjour, à recommander
reviews.text:
Avec deux couples amis, nous avons passé 8 jours début janvier dans ce grand et bel hôtel. Un séjour très agréable. 
Grand confort, belle chambre avec vue sur le jardin, au 2éme étage.Dans tout l'hôtel,le personnel est  souriant, serviable, à l'écoute. Le restaurant Naos offre beaucoup de choix et de variétés de produits de qualité, et le service est parfait. Les restaurants à la carte sont corrects avec un bon service.   
Magnifiques et somptueuses  piscines, jardins tropicaux...    
La plage est magnifique, calme, merci à George pour le service de plage, toujours attentif, présent et réservé. Merci à Jonathan sympathique et efficace qui veille sur notre confort.
 Un peu trop de vent et des vagues pendant deux jours qui n'a pas du tout entamé le plaisir que nous avons eu durant ces huit jours.

reviews.author: Sergey B
reviews.title: Amazing Resort and Wedding Destination
reviews.text:
I can't find enough words to explain our feelings about this resort and Paradise we have seen!

Simply amazing! Starting with food (we have tried all restaurants, and had no complains at all, but having big choice of dishes and lots of food); employees are always welcoming and super helpfull; service they offer is outstanding and will accommodate any request you may have; overall standard of this resort is very high and I would highly recommend.     
Resort Decor is very modern and always super shine clean!

Bavaro Beach is very beautiful having white and clean sand thru-out. 

We had our wedding on Sept 30th, 2014 with over 35 guests with us. Half of my family members already planning their next trip to this Paradise!!! 

Special Thank you to our wedding coordinators Raquel Vega, Marisol, and Bianca (Miami Office). They made our big day special and unforgettable! 

Also, we would like to thank our photographer and videographer at Tropic One. Pictures and Video were amazing!!! 

Thank you all!!! 
Sergey and Anastasiya!

reviews.author: antonioribeirosilva
reviews.title: Supera todas expectativas nota 20
reviews.text: Nunca tinha estado em punta cana , escolhi o paradisus the reserve para ter luxo, boa comida e bons quartos....Contudo devo confessar que supera as expectativas de qualquer europeu ,todos têm suites poderia dizer quase presidenciais , e o funcionários são do mais simpáticos e prestáveis que já conheci ! Destaco a minha concierge  Rosemary de Jesus do club Melia , k está sempre atenta e disponível sem stress e sempre sorridente para todas as dúvidas ,etc... Aconselho este resort ! Já tinha estado 2 x no México e fiquei rendido a punta cana e ao luxo do paradisus the reserve

reviews.author: Jazzie22
reviews.title: Exceeding Expectations
reviews.text:
My husband treated me and one of my best friends on a long weekend trip to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana Jan. 16-19, 2015 - celebrating our 50th birthdays.  I have very high expectations for vacations and this resort exceeded them.  This resort is palatial, clean, not crowded and there are activities for travelers of all ages!  The food is very good.  The Paradisus Palma Real was incredible especially because of our Royal Service Butler Nicholas!  Nicholas made our stay at the resort wonderful!  He helped us with so many details:
* Dinner reservations (showed up table side to check on us our first night at the resort)
* Nicholas arranged 75 minutes of calling for $10 on the Paradisus cell phone they gave us at check in as a Royal Service Guests so we could call our families back home in Pennsylvania
* He escorted one of us back to the room when we had to check something in our safe on our first night at the resort
* Along with our wonderful new friend, Carlos aka Slim Jim, he made cabana reservations at the pool or beach
* He had a special birthday cake made along with chocolate covered strawberries and champagne that was waiting for us in the room one afternoon.
* Nicholas surprised us with cheese and crackers and called us on our Paradisus cell phone (that he gave us at check-in) to tell us to check our refrigerator... Nicholas had remembered how much we enjoyed our mimosas in the Royal Service check in lounge.  He had made up a large bottle filled with mimosas!
* Nicholas made our parasailing reservations
* He guided us through the check out process and personally made sure we were safely on our Amstar shuttle back to the airport
Nicholas' service, attention to detail and very pleasant personality made our trip extra, extra, extra special and exceeded any and all expectations we had!
A review of the resort and property:
Pros
Royal Service check in lounge was impressive!
The food was very good.  The dinner at Palazzo was our favorite. 
The property was very well kept and very clean!
The service, overall, was exceptional.
The room was spacious but do bring a couple of air fresheners... they do help with the humidity and moist smell.  We never noticed it after our first trip into the room.
Safe area
Well kept beach and pool!
Fun dance lessons/aerobics on the beach and in the pool
Lots of activities to choose from - be sure to check out Scuba Aquatics near the Fuego Restaurant... many fun water adventures to choose from... a lot of them are complimentary and others are a la carte.
Great drinks and service at the bars
Overall... exceptional service.  Be sure to brush up on your Spanish or load a translator app or two on your phone (if you can access wifi)
Lucia gives a terrific massage.  We enjoyed our massages in a cabana on the beach.
Tipping is greatly appreciated!  We brought quite a few $1, $5 and 200 peso bills with us
We never noticed a problem with the bugs but we did apply bug spray on top of our suntan lotion and we made sure to use it on exposed skin at night
We followed other travelers' advice and brought a wide selection of over the counter meds but luckily never needed them.
We enjoyed drinks with ice, fruit, et al and never had a problem.  We did make sure to drink bottled water at all times. 

Areas for improvement and what makes this a 4-star vs. 5-star property:
The sheets were "pillie" 
The bathrobes were not comfortable and soft
The waiting room in the spa is too small and not decorated with a spa feel to it.  But we loved our massages out at the cabana with Lucia!  Overall the spa area was nice but could use different décor and needs to be updated.
Live music ended quite early and was only in one spot each night.  The property is large enough with many bars and they could benefit from having live entertainers in the main areas.  The live music ended at 10pm.  The Red Lounge was for a younger crowd so there was not a fun dance spot for 40+... and we opted not to leave the property because of safety concerns.
The language barrier was noticeable.  Luckily we knew a good amount of Spanish and could get by ok.. but the staff should be better trained in English especially food servers.  However, please know that the staff was pleasant, positive and very accommodating.

Overall rating is excellent and we highly recommend this resort to other travelers!

reviews.author: Jay V
reviews.title: AMAZING SERVICE!!! Will be back...
reviews.text: Myself and my friend stayed for one week at the Reserve of the Paradisus Punta Cana hotel. I have travelled extensivley through the years and never have i had such wonderful, sincere, amazing service as we had during our stay. The resort is exceptionally clean, the food, in all the restaurants, not only the Reserve was awesome. Plenty of variety and well made dishes. Beach service at the Reserve? WOW!!! Ramon Ramirez and his team, OUTSTANDING! So helpful, they knew what we needed before we did...they truly went out of thier way to ensure that we were looked after. Jose Reinoso the server at the reserve restaurant grill really did it for us...even up to our relectant check out he brought us the delishious coffees we so enjoyed. Santos Polanco did a great job ensuring that we were served by the pool area. All in all i HIGHLY reccommend this property.

reviews.author: Valeria S
reviews.title: Excelente atención al cliente
reviews.text: Yo, mi esposo y mis dos hijas nos quedamos en este Hotel por 10 días, nos quedamos en la parte del Reserve y tengo que decir que para ser todo incluido superaron todas mis expectativas. Todos los ambientes son hermosos e inmaculadamente limpios, la mayoría de los restaurantes con comidas exquisitas, especialmente el "Bana" y todas las personas del Kids Zone fueron mas que amables y siempre felices y de buen humor. Pero tengo que decir que la vacación no hubiera sido tan excepcional si no fuera por que teníamos el "Family Concierge", nuestra conserje Estefania se encargo de que tuviéramos una vacación perfecta, recomendando restaurantes, haciendo las reservaciones e inclusive haciendo baby sitting siempre que fuera necesario, no tuvimos que preocuparnos por nada, por que sabíamos que ella estaba ahi para resolver cualquier problema o pregunta en cuestión de segundos!! Gracias al Reserve por una hermosa vacación familiar y MUCHAS gracias Estefania por hacer esta vacación mucho mas especial!!

reviews.author: Adrienne H
reviews.title: Excellent Accommodations and Service
reviews.text:
We originally had made reservations at the Catolonia Punta Cana. Probably should have realized that we were going to get what we paid for which was horrifying. After two hours at this resort I made a few calls and we were transferred to the Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. Upon arrival we realized we had made the right choice. 
We were greeted with a  professional, friendly staff. We were introduced to Sarah at the Reserve and decided we wanted to upgrade to the Family Concierge Ocean Front Suites.
Dalliance, who was wonderful showed us 4 different options of rooms. Two at the Reserve and two at Family Concierge/Ocean Front Suites. 
Upon deciding to go with the Ocean front Suite in their brand new facility and with Family Concierge our vacation went to another level. We were checked in by Nicole Gerdison. What polish and service. She treated us so kindly and made our nightmare at the Catalonia disappear. Next, we were partnered with Juan Castillo who was just fabulous. I am a GM of a private Country Club and understand customer service. This hotel has it down. From the smallest detail. Not only did Juan take care of every need, reservation, interest we had, we enjoyed getting to know him. From the chocolates, candles, flower petals, bubble bath to the constant checking on us, he should be commended and promoted. He understands how to make guests feel special and pampered. I should mention the other staff that made our stay so unforgettable. 
Alfredo-who we so enjoyed our daily lunch chats with. He is excellent.
Junior Ramirez - excellent
Anthony- who served us at Rare. He is excellent
Francisco Estrella- Excellent
Felipe Morla Contreras -Excellent
Rosa-house keeping Excellent

Again, I cant say enough how fabulous our experience was. The room was exquisite, the service staff extraordinary, the beach, food, and grounds were breathtaking. Pricing is at a premium for family concierge ocean front suite but it is most definitely worth it.

Our tasting at Passion was wonderful. Cheers to them.

I will be back.

reviews.author: Rosangelars1003
reviews.title: Ótimo Resort em Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Excelente resort, atendimento perfeito, quartos amplos e arejados com banheira de hidromassagem, restaurantes de alto nível.
Recreacionistas atenciosos e com várias atrações tanto para adultos como para crianças

reviews.author: Silviahid72
reviews.title: Excepcional!
reviews.text: Solo tengo buenas palabras para nuestra estancia en el hotel. Magníficas instalaciones, limpieza y mantenimiento perfecto, restauración variada y satisfactoria, cocktails excelentes ( se nota el trabajo del gran Miguel F. Lancha), ubicación de ensueño pero realmente lo destacable es el carisma, la atención, la amabilidad.... ( me faltan adjetivos..) de su equipo humano. Melià tiene un tesoro con nombres propios :  Fermin , el mayordomo, amable , atento y detallista, y los camareros de la zona de la piscina del Royal Service : Pedro, Angel, Carlos, Francisco y Leo, sois magníficos !

reviews.author: 234familyfun
reviews.title: Carlos Rosario
reviews.text: Carlos is a great help on the beach making our stay very rewarding and enjoyable.  He made sure we had a great spot on the beach and was very quick to provide drinks and general hospitality; our day would not of been the same without him.

reviews.author: Dena G
reviews.title: Amazing vacation due to amazing staff and perfect weather
reviews.text: The hotel was great!  Room was clean and looked to have been recently renovated.  The property grounds were beautiful and well maintained.  All of the guest interfacing staff spoke English well and they had so much patience with me as I tried to practice my Spanish.  One highlight I must mention was the service provided by Onardo Marino who is one of the beach waiters.  Onardo was so attentive to me and my friends during our New Year's trip to the resort.  He always greeted us with a smile and remembered our drinks and popcorn snacking needs and kept our drinks full.  I went on a scuba diving excursion one day and the next morning Onardo Marino walked up to me and said, "where were you yesterday, I was looking for you and your friends".  Now that's wonderful service as he was looking for us to ensure our wonderful vacation continued.  We'd absolutely return to the Paradisus Palma Real if they can retain Onardo and the other wonderful staff members who helped make our vacation so memorable.

reviews.author: Sonya T
reviews.title: Couldn't have been better!
reviews.text:
The service, amenities, and relaxing locale were better than I could have imagined.  Jhonny Acevedo, Jorge Martes, and Jennika Ortega were some of the staff that made this stay more than awesome!

One piece of advice that has nothing to do with the accommodations is to bring insect repellant.  We were not ready for those mosquitos! :)

reviews.author: Eleanor I
reviews.title: Outstanding experience
reviews.text:
I have never written a review before good or bad. But this time I couldn't keep my emotions to myself and would like to share them with my fellow vacationers, who appreciate world class service and great entertainment. I went to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, expecting a quiet, flat vacation as I usually have at all-inclusive resorts. Meaning - good food, ok entertainment, and clean overall place, but nothing to remember. This time I experienced a culture shock, the good kind. Firstly, the people that work in this resort are exceptionally warm, polite and courteous. Food was fantastic and the entire resort was spotless. 
One of the greatest impression on me was made by Life Enrichment Program. It was amazing and offered a large variety of activities to do from the morning until night. So I truly recommend this place to people who appreciate quality vacationing, and want to experience something well done. 
I would like to give a special thanks to the following people who made me understand why many people love resorts so much, and keep coming back year after year. The Powerhouse Big Mac is an outstanding entertainer, who never stops dancing and is one of my Stars. My charmer, aqua aerobic and kick boxing instructor, and also my dance partner Francisco Reynoso who made me feel like salsa world champion. Queen Reyna captured my heart with her sweetness, graciousness and beauty all around. Angel, Rey Rey, Luis and Rachel tirelessly worked on keeping me in shape. At the clubhouse, always cheerful and sweet Angel was greeting me with his smile, offering clean beach towels. I also would like to extend my gratitude to the Guest Service assistant manager in the VIP room Vladimir Rodriguez who was always helpful and highly professional. 
Thanks to all the staff for their hard work and effort in making my stay in Paradisus Palma Real joyful and memorable!

reviews.author: Ignacio E
reviews.title: Something way above average
reviews.text:
I would like to start by saying THANK YOU to the restaurants and the general staff of the hotel, this group of people are making an exceptional work in this hotel, they all are always willing to help and to be there for their guest. Aside from that i would say that whoever design the rooms for the hotel knew what needed to be done, these are very well distributed and the furniture wasn't any less than impeccable, another thing to point out of the structure of the hotel is that the rooms are far enough to not be disturbed by the daily pool/beach activities yet not far enough for you to feel like you are in a marathon.

The pool is very nicely structure since even in the deep areas you have some gaps where you can sit or play with small children without having to stay in the babies pool with the water up to you heels.

The food at the buffet was repetitive at the point that after the first day you could roam the place with your eyes closes and you could find what you saw the day before, the good thing thought is that the food is as tasty as you can imagine so if you are staying 2-3 nights the buffet at least for breakfast and lunch ain't bad at all, i wont say a thing about the A La Carte restaurant cause i didn't had a good experience but it was due to an outside situation. Nothing to do with the food in there, by the way, kudos to the staff being great as usual through the whole experience with them.

One thing to have in mind is the room service, they take from 40-55 minutes to deliver your request so have that present at the moment of ordering the meal, it wont be a good idea to wait until you are starving to make an order.

One more thing is that the hotel apparently doesn't have an animation group so the days i spend there were quite quiet, you will hear some loud music from time to time but nothing that big.

Either way this hotel was great and is a very enjoyable destiny to go with family and friends even for couples if you like.

reviews.author: kit W
reviews.title: Dioni cuerto
reviews.text: FIVE SuTAR SERVICE best bartender here. Remembered my drink from the start n always welcomed me with my drink. Said my drink is strong n for men. Even thoufh its a dirty martini. Makes me feel liie.its my home.

reviews.author: Sarah B
reviews.title: Un Dia Maravilloso
reviews.text:
Estuve Hospedada por una noche en el Hotel Paradissus Punta Cana,en una actividad de la empresa en la que laboro.Es la primera vez que visito dicho Hotel,y la verdad fue maravilloso,el servicio excelente,las chicas que nos recibieron en el área de grupo,fueron muy servicial,recuerdo el nombre de Asia,no recuerdo el de las demás,pero todas ellas nos dieron un trato excelente.Las comidas muy buena,las bebidas.
Yo recomendaría este hotel,quede encantada y me gustaría volver con mi Familia.

reviews.author: Sam L
reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT
reviews.text: By far the best vacation My wife and I have ever taken. ELIS the bell man is the best, made us feel so welcomed from the time we got out of our taxi. The staff make you feel like family. THE FOOD is BETTER THAN ANY restuarnts in the states! We recommend taking the all in clusive route.

reviews.author: Chrissy825
reviews.title: "Amazing experience!!!!"
reviews.text: My husband and I recently stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real with Royal service to celebrate his 40th Birthday.  We had 9 other friends join us as a surprise trip.  From time we made the reservation to the end of the trip the service was outstanding.  All of the staff was very attentive and prompt.  The food was delicious with a variety to choose from and the selection of alcohol was top of the line.  The food and staff at the Palazzo were exceptional.  If you enjoy being pampered I highly recommend having a spa treatment.  Their massage therapists and the spa amenities are wonderful.  Everyone in our group had an unforgettable experience.  As part of the royal service package we were assigned Elvis Hidalgo as our personal butler, who I must say was outstanding!  He was incredibly attentive, thoughtful and thorough.  His customer service skills was everything you would expect from a five star resort and more.  If you are doing Royal service and able to request a specific butler, I highly recommend requesting him, you would not regret it.  I have stayed at other resorts in Punta Cana, and this by far exceeded the other ones I have stayed at on all levels.  We look forward to revisiting this resort on future vacations.

reviews.author: Denise S
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
After reading the reviews and vacating at the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, we decided to spend our winter girlfriends get away in Punta Cana.  Let me start with the good:  The property is absolutely beautiful, the staff that we encountered were wonderful -- Jonathan Douglass at check-in; Big Mac, Reyna de Paula "Queen", Mr. OMG for Zumba;  the YHI Spa is so serene and amazing-- ask for Quintina or Rosa; nightly entertainment is excellent, and it's about a 20 minute ride from the airport. The bad:  Check-in was chaotic! resort was booked to capacity and it was apparent that the staff was overwhelmed with the many issues that were taking place; day 2- bellmen entered our room to drop off someone else's luggage; needless to say, good thing I had clothes on!  Several issues occurred along these lines because it was showing that our assigned room wasn't occupied... The pool is beautiful but very cold.  That explains why you didn't see many people inside the pool.  NO washcloths, therefore bring your own.  The food in the A la Carte restaurant lacked flavor, just bland!... bring your own seasonings/hot sauces. The servers went above and beyond to make the experience tolerable-- Super Mario, Davidson Germain, Warner "Brother" and Alfredo Rodriquez were absolutely wonderful.   When dining in the restaurants, you can't go wrong by asking your server what do they recommend because they are on point with their recommendations.  Due to the fact that the A la Carte at Paradisus in Playa del Carmen was absolutely delicious, my expectations were set really high.

All in all, we made the best out of it and was determined not to let the issues spoil our time away, and the staff definitely played a big part in making that happen.   Also, brush up on your Spanish and always consider tipping because they work really hard to accommodate your every need.

reviews.author: Mahyar T
reviews.title: Better than excellente
reviews.text:
I am at the end of a two week trip to the Reserve and it has been fabulous. You may ask why so here is the reason. I do performance reviews at work and always have trouble with "exceed expectations" evaluation.   We saw it first hand here. Few days ago we mistakenly landed on Naos buffet which we thought we had a reservation for. It was their Mexican night which is not my favorite cuisine even though my friend loves it. Hostess Kendy Beato greeted us warmly and when she saw my reluctance she said she would talk to manager and see what can be done. I felt it is just a talk but in a second manager Licelot Rodriguez showed up and asked what I like to have.  I said I liked the Dominican soup i had in Fuegos and he said if I don't mind waiting he will call and ask them to bring it in from the other restaurant on the other side of this big resort. What do you say about that. In 5 minutes I had the soup in front of me. Server Garber Pineda was great too always smile on her face and leaving us with a good house wine, etc etc. We felt like part of a family. Thank you all.
A Hotel is not brick and mortar but it is people and service and Paradisus has it all. I see some of the negative reviews talking about why people expect tips. HELLO, have you ever been to a restaurant taking a taxi or receive any kind of service in anywhere without leaving 10-20% tips. Being in an all inclusive does not mean gratuity is included.  Grow up and thank people who are putting their heart and effort serving you. We are eating easily a $50 meal and complaining why we should leave a dollar which is way less than 10% norm. 
Other people to thank: They all exceeded and sorry if I do not remember all their names:
Juan and Joanna at the gabi bar, Luis server at Gabi club, Ambri tennis instructor, Marionell and Alejandro at Sushi class, Brunet for the excursion, Rosalina at the Spa and all the bar servers, bicycle renters, towel boys, maids, concierges Yennifer and Yani, activities team, gym, dancing, yoga, pilates,  and performers at great night shows. 
The room is very good and large. I selected the Reserve based on rankings here and when I found out it is away from beach I was disappointed first since I usually reserve rooms with an ocean view. But now i love it, we are close to everything and a short bike or bus ride to the beach. Even though the Reserve is family and kid oriented with their fabulous family concierges the areas are divided in a way that couples would enjoy peace and harmony as well. Great cabanas and chairs are plenty and no reason for silly towel games. And the food. Just great but in order of our preference Gabi club, Aqua, Fuegos,  Vento, Bana and the list goes on. I can write a book but I stop right here.

reviews.author: Nestor C
reviews.title: Supervisor de Restaurante ANGEL PACHE C.
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado quince dias de maravillas (29/11/ al 13/12/ 20149, pero lo excelente de destacar es la relación del personal con los pasajeros, en especial la del Sr. Angel Pache, quien ha demostrado en todo momento, cualidades personales dignas de destacar, educado, responsable, y lealtad en el cumplimiento de sus obligaciones. Se ha hecho merecedor de la mas absoluta confianza.
Los firmantes somos Dante G,Bonavera - Nestor Carbonetti y nuestras respectivas esposas Elina Bonavera y Lidia Carbonetti
Lamentablemente no puedo agregar fotos, cuando aprenda como hacerlo lo haré por separado para que le sea entregada a Angel - Muchas Gracias 
Atte N. Carbonetti

reviews.author: MelanieL273
reviews.title: BEST vacation EVER!
reviews.text:
I have been home a week since being in Punta Cana and cannot wait to go back.  It was a girls trip and it was the best one yet.  I really had no expectations of the location and property, I just wanted to get away and relax and be treated like royalty.  We did pay for the Royal Service and it is worth every penny.  Our butler, Thomas Newton was the best. He treated us like royalty and always left us a sweet suprise in our room.  The room was nice and spacious and great for 3 girls.  My friends didn't like that you could see in the bathroom but really that was about the biggest complaint I can remember.  
The food, oh the food! I never knew what I wanted to eat.  I ate so much fresh seafood and veggies and fruit and desserts.  Our waitstaff at Palazzo was amazing and everytime we walked in they greeted us like family, not like we were just more guest at the resort.  Alexander, Miguel, FranklinCedeno, Stefania, Pasquel and the others were just great and run that restaurant like its a 5 star in NYC!   Of course we hit up the Naos buffet more than once, mainly for breakfast and a couple of times for lunch.  Our first morning we were greeted by Davidson Germain and he made us feel right at home and the rest of our stay he always made time to come greet us and ask us how our stay was even if we were sitting somewhere else.  Our last morning we were seated with Wandy Castillo and he was so nice and was very sympathetic to our pouting faces because we were so sad we were leaving.  Our experience at Bana was just as fun as everywhere else, I really don't have anything bad to say about the entire place, Felix our chef made the meal fun and was very accomodating to all my request and changes to my meal.  Oh and if you come here, you must splurge and do the tasting menu at Passion, however come ready to eat!  
Entertainment at the resort was so good and so much fun.  The entertainment staff is so full of life and really about making this resort fun for everyone.  There were so many activities I couldn't keep up with when, where, times, etc and I really was worthless while on this trip because it was my VACATION, I wanted to read and sit in the sun.  I love to dance so, when Angel from the activities staff asked me to dance I couldn't jump off my bart stool fast enough.  Big Mac and the rest of the crew just about convinced me to get up from my lazy chair and play volleyball but I was saved and got to just watch! The dancers are AMAZING and the shows were great.  I do wish the 80's party would have been in the theater so all the drunk people wouldn't have taken the stage because I really enjoyed watching the staff.  
I cannot leave out Piterson and George in the Royal Service lounge.  Everytime I walked in there, I felt like I owned the place.  Piterson would see us and would know to go grab us our mimosas (they were so good)! I loved how everyone was so happy at the resort.  No matter what job they were doing, they were smiling, singing, dancing and ready to serve.  The snacks in the Royal Service lounge were amazing.  As you can tell, I love food.
If I have one complaint, it is that our room getting cleaned became an issue but not because they didn't want to or were skipping our room but because we would ask them to come back and then it would get late, so we did go a couple of days without our room being cleaned and having to call for fresh towels but that would be my only BIG complaint.  I know it is hard, this life, I'm just so blessed that I'm the one that has to do this! 
Thanks to everyone at this resort for making me feel like royalty and serving me as such.  This was the best vacation ever, I was recharged and ready to get back to work, so I can replenish my funds and return very soon.  Piterson have my mimosa ready!!!

reviews.author: MarkPatriciaS
reviews.title: Sunset Bar
reviews.text: Leo is the best. Keeps things lively. Sings to us. Makes my Mom feel special and remembers our favorite drinks. If you come to this hotel do the royal service to meet Leo. Come and relax at the Sunset bar.

reviews.author: bigmoetravel
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: Loved it so much, went back again.  Just returned 12/5 - 12/9/14....Beautiful resort, excellent service.  Went royal service this time.  Our butler, Juan De Leon, was fabulous!!  I was celebrating my 50th birthday and he decorated our poolside hut with balloons, birthday cake, and champagne!  Such a lovely surprise.  He had given me a phone to contact him.  Most of the time, I forgot to take it (or charge it), so he always seemed to track me down to see if there was anything I needed.  He also arranged for ballloons at my dinner table the night of my birthday where the entire restaurant staff sang happy birthday.  Grounds and beach are incredible!  You can not go wrong at this resort!  Luiz at the pool bar is the best bartender!  I had remembered him from my previous trip!  Cesar (groundskeeper, I believe) so helpful and friendly.  I had also remembered him from my previous trip!  Big Mac - just all around fun!

reviews.author: Dori E
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.text:
Fernando Geronimo was the friendliest and happiest room server we meet.
Thank you Fernando!!!! And the hotel was amazing and the. Pool very beautiful l liked the bar the naos restaurant was excellent.
The staff is so willing and ready to serve your every need. I would spend my next vacation here in a heart beat. I want all my friends to come here.

reviews.author: AamirandAliyah K
reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text:
PROS:The resort grounds are immaculate and extremely well kept. The cleaning staff are constantly cleaning so the place is very Clean!  The staff on the resort are very pleasant and wonderful. 

CONS:On the down side the dinners at the a la carte restaurants were very Blah and poorly done. I have told the resort managers in the past visit that chefs are needed.. because the Haitian line crew do not have the training.
The food at Naos was pretty good though, so we opted for that.
The beach and ocean is Beautiful....no complaints there. 
The food service staff above all make the experience great, they make you feel welcome and cared for... thank you also to Mayobanex Martinez our room cleaning staff.

reviews.author: Julia E
reviews.title: Cada vez mejor!
reviews.text: Disfrute de un fin de semana  con mi familia celebrando el cumpleaños de mi hermana,  maravilloso  el servicio,  la habitación,  cada detalle hace la experiencia  inolvidable..  Desde el check in hasta el check out un paraiso.. Gracias a todos por las atenciones,  en especial a Christelle la directora, nuestros concierge Elaidy y Alexis espectaculares,  el equipo del restaurante  Gabi,  el Chef Rodeiro, las chicas en el Kids Zone,  la limpieza  en la habitación, los maleteros,  todos se aseguran  de exceder  tus expectativas..  Sin duda volverémos!

reviews.author: 373denise373
reviews.title: Warning!
reviews.text: I recently visited this resort with friends who are members of Sol Melia, the resort company.  On our third day there we discovered we were burglarized.   Our room safe was emptied of all our American dollars.  Nothing that was traceable was taken.  My belongings had been rummaged through prior to the theft, but it did not compute until I realized we had been the victims of theft. The investigation conducted by the security showed the maid and a security person was in our room during the time the money went missing but we were told there was no evidence they took the money. Not only were we not compensated or apologized to, but we were made to feel we were the criminals and were insulted.  We left with a heavy heart but contacted the Sol Melia company in hopes that they would compensate our loss in some way.   I have traveled many places for many years.  Never have I had my property stolen and then treated with such disrespect.  The company, Sol Melia was so unresponsive and uncaring.  It was not the first time I vacationed at a Sol Melia resort.  But this trip to Paradisus Palma Real is certainly my last vacation with them.  It was admitted to us that the protocol is for the maid to first check the room safe.  Why would a hotel chain encourage such temptation??

reviews.author: Beverly J
reviews.title: Beautiful Grounds
reviews.text:
I just returned from a 6 day experience at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The property is beautiful.  I want to give a great big shout out to Ana Almonte, Front Dest Agent for being so professional and for showing me outstanding customer service.  Also Vladimir Rodrigues, Guest Service Assistant Manager in the VIP room was outstanding.  Franklin Caraballa greeting us from day one with a warm and beautiful smile, showed us around the property and was there at all times to assist us and make sure our visit was going well.  
I enjoyd eating at the Gabi Beach Restaurant and had amazing service from Dario and Franklin  and our hostess, Kinberli.

reviews.author: Fernando Lauria
reviews.title: Trip Sensacional!!!
reviews.text:
A nossa estadia foi perfeita sem absolutamente nenhum inconveniente ou problema que não pôde ser resolvido pelo pessoal do hotel.
O hotel é maravilhoso, com estrutura e serviço de excelente qualidade.
Os restaurantes são ótimos, principalmente o Bana que serve comidas feitas na hora e na sua frente pelo chef. 
Os funcionários são muito atenciosos. Fomos muito bem atendidos pelo nosso Mordomo Omar e pelos amigos Francisco Cabrera e Jorge, que trabalham na praia.
Agradeço também ao Daniel Lauria do Melia Tatuapé (SP/BR) pela maravilhosa indicação e conselhos!

reviews.author: ALINA P
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: JuanAlfonso Suárez Juan  Gonzalez  franklin de salas  son excelentes personas hacen su trabajo con mucho amor y profecionalmente la Sra que nos dio el servicio en el room melania Abreu  excelente su servicio Berenice de los santos guest service excelente, muy cordial .esta es la tercera ves que los visitos y de corazón me voy feliz gracias por tener personas trabajando aquí tan encantadora.MALVIN MERCEDEZ TRABAJA EN EL BAR DEL LOBBY EXCELENTE  EN SU SERVICIO QUE DIOS ME LOS BENDIGA A TODOS

reviews.author: Jennifer P
reviews.title: Beach service
reviews.text:
Francisco Cabrera does an excellent job providing drinks,towels and ice for the day at the beach.
The butler, Omar ,does a very good job taking care of you. He will do whatever he can to make your trip enjoyable,let him make your dinner reservations to insure you get to experience all the great food. Jorge at the royal service fruit bar will make you wonderful fresh fruit cocktails. Wandy at the buffet is very helpful for all your food choices. The beach bar and palazzo make a great Caparena(lime/rum) drink. If you love sushi you can eat it everyday. You won't go home hungry. The only thing I would really suggest is don't wait for a shuttle. It can take up time and a taxi is only 30 dollars and you don't have to stop along the way. It's windy in December.

reviews.author: traveler t
reviews.title: on a beautiful beach
reviews.text: So glad I chose this resort, on this particular beach as my first time in DR. This  boutiquesh  resort is not overwhelming and huge which is exactly what I wanted. It is located on the pinkish- white-sand beach called Bavaro Beach. I walked the beach every morning and joined the cute little  activities offered at this gorgeous resort by amazingly friendly and courteous staff. Activities like yoga, pool aerobics, light tae bo, wallyball, cigar making, salsa and even painting. I had an amazing time and would especially thank the staff Queen of Paula (that is her name), Francisco Reyna, Angel Alcantara.

reviews.author: Camille Y
reviews.title: Outstanding!!!
reviews.text: 10 Days in pure paradise. We stayed at the Reserve (a group of us) and all had different buildings but were in such close proximity that it wasn't a big deal. The staff was amazing. My luggage got left in the rain at the airport so my clothes all got soaked. My concierge offered to put them in the dryer for me, and even brought a fan to my room. The pool service was my favorite. Jose luis de los santos made sure we were taken care at all times. His level of service is impeccable and is the empitomy of being showered with care and luxury spoiling. :) Also the activities staff played an intregal role in our happiness during the visit. Marionelli, Anthony, Luis and David. Thanks guys for making our trip so memorable. We will be back, I promise.

reviews.author: CARRICK007
reviews.title: carrick007
reviews.text: Was back in the Reserve for three weeks in October and it is even better than before with facilities improved with lovely bars and restaurants at the beach. Speaking to the staff will make your holiday so much better. Ask their name and take it from there.Cuisine in the Al la Cartes is superb, cooked to perfection and well presented. Everywhere is spotless including the beach where Santos ,Luiz  and Ramonwill look after you well. Luiz went above and beyond when he assisted us when a member of our party took ill.Even ringing next day to enquire after her well being. Dhoralix  Polanco and her excellent staff were excellent in their service at Reception .       The front of house chaps are tops namely   Elvis, Hazael,Daniel , Eddie,Ambrouie and Pasqual with the beautiful Aleidy keeping everything spotless.  Hostess Janna Ortiz  in Gabi club is top class as is the hostess of Fuego /Bana Raismery Martuk ably assisted by Iilian. Amber at Gabi Beach and La Palapa  what a smile and so gracious an asset to any Company. .Guest service s Aisia Mateo was fantastic along with Jennifer,Claribel Anuvi Aquino and Anibel.  Melvin at Gabi Grill with  the excellent Jose Reinoso. B ar staff at Gabi club  Porfinnio , A lvin Hodge Amelka Paulino and of course SandraSantana.   GabiClub and Vento ran by the wonderful Caesar assisted by Theirry wth staff Willis ,Christain Fernando  ,Anthony   Cid,Rennelly Celso,Luiz Vasquez ,Johairo Mejia Adalberto Herrera , Jualin Fiquera  , Frank Martinezand Georibel Guzman ,hostess Mercedes not forgetting top man Robert lovely guy. reviews.author: Vito M
reviews.title: A lot of fun
reviews.text: We have gone there 4 times a lot of fun but to book a restaurant is pretty much impossible they tell you to do it when you get there but they are always booked and the restaurants are half filled when you walk by there. Just on a safety note do not leave anything of value laying around in your room cell phones, jewelry, money, etc.. it will go missing and no one will help you get it back.i had a phone and small bills stolen (cheap phone and jewelry )from me left on the room and no one knew anything after that we put the DO NOT DISTURB sign out and that ended the problem. Other than that we had a great time. Never had those issues staying at the Radisson hotel in aruba. The food there was ok nothing to write home about.but for the price it was good

reviews.author: HarryEP
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: The property was beautiful. The service impeccable. The staff would bend over backwards to accomodate. I sen 20 of my employees to this resort and all returned extremely happy. The only suuggestion I would have is to make sure that you understand all the benefits that are available to you while staying at the Reserve portion of this resort. I sent two different groups, including myself, to this resort and many of us did not know the extent of the additional amenities that were available. Beware of the orientation meeting (which I actually enjoyed), the purpose is to sell you a Melia Club membership. All in all agreat place.

reviews.author: TXAmanda
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
We visited The Reserve during Thanksgiving week.   There were plenty of people there but the resort is nicely laid out that you never felt crowded.   
The room we had was amazing!  The decor and furniture were perfect for our family of 3.  The housekeepers kept it clean and would make the beds and fresen up the towels daily.   Our housekeepers were Ramona Rosario and Sandra Garcia.
We also had a family concierge,  Francis Beros.  She was amazing!   She made our vacation go smoothly!   Francis met with us our first night there and helped us get settled in. She also checked in on us daily and set up our dinner reservations.   Francis also delivered treats to our room for our 3 year old son.   He loved the surprises!  On our last day Francis made sure that our transportation was lined up and called when they were late.   Francis took great care of us. ♡
Our son did go to the kids club while we were there.   While he was not old enough to enjoy all the activities,  he did enjoy playing in the play room.   Francisca took the time to get to know him and she would always ask about him when we saw her around the resort. 
The resort manager was always visible and would talk to you to make sure things are OK. 
I loved how the employees were always in uniform and always had a nametag on.   Everyone is so friendly.  The resort is kept clean and the grounds are immaculate.   The bartenders also make great drinks!
We also enjoyed a beach cabana, however we didn't stay there long because of the seaweed, rough water,  and wind blowing the sand.   We did visit the pool near the beach.   It was very nice and is only available to family concierge guests.   

Here are some things to consider:   
It was hard to find a spot near the kids pool but,  Juan a server at Hydro Grill helped us locate a spot. 
The food is average.  We ate at Mizu and the rice was crunchy and I'm not sure that the salmon was completely cooked.  The food is not typical American food.
We had the worst time getting the television to work in our room.   We had to call the tech people to visit our room 2 times! 
Overall,  I would recommend the reserve to others.  It was a nice family vacation at a gorgeous resort.

reviews.author: rosalind g
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus resort
reviews.text: I can't say enough about the beauty of this resort and the excellent staff. It was a girls (all over 50 of age) trip for Five days four nights most definitely not enough time.  We booked the  two bedroom master suite garden view very clean, spacious  and comfortable. The only downside are the Mosquitos so bring Deet or eucalyptus and use sparingly.  I fell in love with the serene music that plays in the morning  you can get lost in while on the balcony it really sets the tone for a relaxing day.  Yanley was our housekeeper and she was so kind and diligent in caring for our rooms daily.  Room service in the morning for continental was always less than half hour arrival and set up for us, We adopted our Reynaldo who kept us entertained at the beach or dancing in the evening, Wandy  Castillo, Franklin Cueva, !Deybi Garcia,George Alriche, Alfredo Rodriguez,have to mention these amazing staff who kept us entertained, drinks filled,, and served our meals with the words I have taken home with me "it is my pleasure". They really made our trip special and if you go write these names down and ask for them!!! There is excellent entertainment nightly ,daytime sports  even Zumba with energetic And talented Queenie. We shopped on the resort using american dollars without a problem.  Tipping is not required but with the service we received we could not help but show appreciation.  The weather was great rained in the late evenings so we had beach day every day. There are so many other names Deserving of recognition in the Noas Resturant where we ate breakfast daily Im sorry I can't remener them all. The Market Grill was the best evening meal lobster and prime rib!  Althought food was good at the Italian Resturant it was not Italian that was disappointing.  All in all it is on my list to return again for the beautiful resort , beach, perfect weather and amazing staff.

reviews.author: Mayra S
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: This is the third time I come to Paradisus Palma Real. The accommodation are great, the food is of great quality.  But most of all I enjoyed the service.  I want to specially mention Jorge Acevedo and Francisco Cabrera and our butler Jose Salvador who always made sure we had fruits, cheese, and champagne in our room.  At the beech the service provided by jorge Acevedo and francisco Cabrera was incomparable.  They are friendly, courteous and very helpfully with everything we needed. They made our trip very enjoyable-  I will definitely come back

reviews.author: Tianna R
reviews.title: Great Mini Vacation and Awesome Service
reviews.text:
I just returned from a pre-thanksgiving 5 day trip to this resort with my husband our another couple.  We did not upgrade to VIP or Royal service.  Nonetheless, we had excellent service.   Our concierge, Garnier was awesome and took care of issues for us including getting resort credits and also resolved an issue with the company(unrelated to the resort) that we hired to transport us to the airport.  Our rooms were beautiful suites with a living area, full kitchen (that we didn't need because of the 24hr room service and meals outside of the room), and a great bed.  The rooms were cleaned each morning and then in the evening with turn down service.  In fact, our housekeepers Yoanni Raina Javier and Yoanni did a great job cleaning every area of the room and making it picture perfect each day and evening.  
The resort is directly on a beautiful beach. There is a lot of seaweed, but that's nature and the waters were still beautiful.  The pools were great as well and I loved the swim up bar. There are several bars throughout the resort and great bartenders at each bar.  The bartenders at the swim up bar are awesome and my new favorite frozen drink is the passion fruit mojito.  I generally do not like buffets and make sure that I get restaurant reservations whenever I travel to all inclusives.  The buffet at Naos, however, is great.  The food was different every day. there are several stations each day including Asian (thai, Chinese, sushi), local, Mexican, Italian, meet and cheese, and soup and sandwiches, and carving stations.  Breakfast included your usual fare as well as other tasty items like juevos rancheros, and made to order omelets with REAL EGGS.  The desserts each night were sometimes hit or miss, but for the most part, with all of the variety you are sure to find something that you like.  I also liked that the Market Grill, which is the restaurant that remains open throughout the day kept fresh fruit, desserts and other fare for inbetween service times at Naos.  If you want to make the restaurant route, I suggest you make the reservations for your entire stay as soon as you check in.  My only complaint is that they don't tell you immediately if you actually get the reservation.  It was frustrating for us to have to wait until the evening to find out if we got reservations at the restaurants.  One night we did not, but thankfully the food at Naos is consistent and varied.  We ate at the tepanyaki restaurant, Market Grill (at night it is fine dining with no dress code), and at ventos. Our favorite was the lobster tails at Market Grill. The tepanyaki was the same as at any hibachi grill. Good, but not great. However, the chef was nice.  The folks who made my dining experience wonderful wee Juan m, Denis Concepcion, Juan Marte, Magalin Santos, Edwin Guerrero, Nicolas Nunez, G. Feliz, Leo Ozuna, Juan (serves the desserts/postres and is the NICEST and tiene mucha pacienca), Javier, Rafael Vasquez, Nicolas Espiritud.  All of them take pride in the wonderful food that they are preparing and make the meals an enjoyable experience!  Thanks so much to each of you.  

I love wine, but had to realize that I would have to venture into the mixed and frozen drinks.  The house wines were fine.  The house sauvignon blanc was the best.  The house reds were not good in my opinion. Although you can order premium wines and use resort credits, you will end up paying $15 for a bottle of Cavit and $40 or $50 for moderately good wines.  Of course, they have nicer wines on the premium (pay extra) wine list, they are at exorbitant prices.  So, if you are a wine connoisseur, get ready to shell out money for the better stuff.  

Throughout the time, we participated in some of the resort activities (aqua spinning, zumba, etc.) and also went to the night shows.  The Life enrichment staff are very welcoming and talented.  Yubrikis Arnaud works with them and was very involved and so sweet to make sure everyone had a good time at night.  Osvaldo Macdonna aka "Big Mac" is wonderful and has a great spirit. He was a highlight of the trip!  He told us about the Dominican culture, checked in with us when he saw us.  Reynaldo, Carlos were also great with the Life Enrichment team and the activities and general camaraderie they fostered added to the experience. We went to the wine tasting and in addition to learning a little from Domingo, we met some great folks who were staying at the resort.   My main goal for my trip was to relax, so I was not looking for  Las Vegas entertainment.  The nightly shows/activities were a good after dinner activity and fairly enjoyable.  The male and female dancers are very skilled in all types of dance and it was interesting to see the Bounce show (similar to Stomp) and to see the Dominican dances.  

In the end, the high quality food and service are second to none. Although I have a 2 year old, I did not take her on this trip.  The kids were there at the resort, but it wasn't overwhelming or annoying.  However, if you are honeymooning, I would recommend upgrading to Royal service so that you can have the pool without the kids. We toured the Reserve and next time would bring her and have her participate in the Kidzone activities which seem to be awesome and very organized and I would feel great about letting her participate.

reviews.author: Betty P
reviews.title: A wonderful resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
This resort was much better than I expected.  The staff was especially superb.  From our butler, Augustine Nunez to the staff at the pool, Francisco Cabrera, Pedro Cedano and Jorge Acevedo the service was exceptional.  They made our stay one that we will never forget.  

we are already planning our trip for next year!

reviews.author: Sal58
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Just came back from a girl's vacation and it was beautiful-read some of the other reviews and was surprised at some of the negatives. We had an adjoining suite and it was alway clean; the grounds were beautiful and the beach was excellent. Yes, there was some seaweed but the wind on the beach was not unbearable, in fact the weather was prefect everyday. Our server George Alriche was spot on-so friendly and accomodating; remembered what we drank and so pleasant-moving to the pool area, also great-clean, swim up bar-great place to hang out. The sushi restaurant was so-so, appetizers were good but the main courses were just OK-although Ricardo was great. The next restaurant we tried was Vento-that was ok too. Naos where we had breakfast every day was really good, lots to pick from and Wandy Castillo was wonderful. Gave us excellent service, so warm and friendly every morning-he's such a great asset to Naos. The last day Franklin Cuebo helped us and he too was so helpful. The best meal was at the Market Grill, lobster, rib-eye-food was very good. The entertainment was very lively every night, Reynoldo stood out with us; so sweet and Reyna aka Queen is quite a dancer. She also did the Zumba class for us. I accessed the gym and they have gift shops on the resort. Yes, Club Melia is always present-I did the tour with Nelson Hildalgo, he was very personable and knows his stuff so if you're thinking of investing ask for Nelson. Have to say the service is really what makes this place and all the staff should be recognized for that.

reviews.author: Darnell S
reviews.title: Best service staff hands down!!
reviews.text:
I was at the resort for a destination wedding. All of us attending work in the hospitality field. We look for great service! The staff was top notch!! From start to finish. 
Would like to recognize Saidy (nice lady at the lower bar) and Cesar (security at the upper level club) for stellar service. If you are thinking of visiting Punta Cana, consider this location.

reviews.author: mat282014
reviews.title: Service is outstanding

They have fun with what they are doing and it shows in how they take care of customers.  They brought us anything we needed to drinks & provided towels - great service. Our butler, Ariel Benzo was wonderful.  He went above and beyond to take care of every reservation, checking on us for anything we needed.  This is the place to visit if you want to be pampered and taken care of for a perfect, quiet vacation getaway where the service is great.

reviews.author: Candida30
reviews.title: Beautiful trip

A special thank you to our pool concierge José de Los Santos for making our stay a truly amazing experience. His attentiveness and friendly demeanor ensured that we were definitely in paradise. reviews.author: Aurora R

Quiero agradecer al departamento de grupos, en especial a Angelica Albuerme,.. tambien Ambioris, Silverio, Melvin, Elaidi, Alexis, Christian, Cerso, Eulises, Janna, Miguel Gener, Christelle y el chef Miguel quien nos guio en toda nuestra visita y se encargo de que cada comida fuese esquisita.

reviews.author: Juliano
reviews.title: Ainda volto lá.
reviews.text: Disparado o melhor lugar que pisei nesse planeta. Foi a semana mais sensacional da minha vida. Atendimento excelente (apesar da coação por gorjetas, o que é normal fora do Brasil), área das piscinas muito agradável e, principalmente no The Reserve, alimentação e sossego de Rei! Recomendo. Vale a pena gastar um pouco a mais.

reviews.author: Apollo5861
reviews.title: What can I say? Top notch resort with free wifi and EXCELLENT customer service!!
reviews.text:
This is going to be a LONG one, but its definitely deserved!! Recently back from a 6 day trip at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. The Reserve is within the larger Paradisus Punta Cana resort and you can use everything at both resorts (except areas reserved for Royal service clientele). I cannot say enough how much I enjoyed myself at this resort. The immaculate landscape, the beautiful, clean, spacious, well-appointed suite (One bedroom master suite- we were really blown away by the room. Whirlpool tub!! Just be careful not to lock yourself out on the balcony. It only opens from the inside), the large and fun pool with plenty of lounge spaces, good food, and impeccable hospitality! The hospitality at the Reserve is really what set this experience apart for me. Top notch. From the very beginning we were treated as VIPs and offered the highest level of customer service. Tony Sainteloi was our concierge and he is the MAN! He took care of everything for us including setting up a room change and connecting us with excursions. Tony if you’re reading this….You’re awesome and THANKS! Leidy and Asia were our building concierge’s at Building 36!! It’s a great location and these ladies are awesome! We were always greeted with a smile and they always wanted to make sure we were doing ok. Johanna at the front desk is the model of good customer service (in fact, all the front desk staff were on point). Eveling at the Yhi Spa has the hands of HEAVEN. Also, special shout outs to Antony in activities, Arturo who was our waiter at the Grill and Naos, and Alexander in Mole. Just all around good guys who made our experiences enjoyable. The people were just so friendly. As with anything there were a few not so great folks, but overall the staff are the most friendly and helpful I’ve ever encountered. 

I read a lot of concerns about the beach. It is a little distance away from the Reserve section but there are always trams to catch which were quite fun to ride and it really is only about a 7-10 minute walk to the beach. We didn’t get to rent a bike, but that looked like it would be fun to do. Now, we personally enjoyed the pool much better than the beach. It was a little choppy and the waves were a little rough, but it was beautiful and peaceful out. The Reserve beach section is definitely a plus. If you get a chance visit Macao beach!! One of the best experiences during our stay. 

Just a few things to highlight: 
Food- This is an international resort and the food models that. If you’re looking for a lot of pizza, wings, fries, or other typical American buffet food prepared in an American fashion, this isn’t the place for that. It’s a lot more upscale and varied. I’m a picky eater and would be more comfortable with the above described food experience, but I definitely found food to eat and it was good too! The a la carte restaurants were good as well. I felt they tried a little too hard to be contemporary or modern, but I enjoyed my dinners. Only went to Mole, Fuego, the Grill and those were really good. Also went to Vento, which was good, but the portions were toooo small and the food could use a little more flavor. My sister didn't enjoy it at all. 

Check-in- This isn’t your typical check-in experience. When you arrive they’ll ask you to sit down at a table in the lobby and bring you champagne. The place also has some timeshare holders and at first, it may feel like they’re getting ready to try to sell you something. They are NOT. They ask you to sit down so they can check you in, give you an overview of the hotel facilities and activities, and for you to meet your concierge. It’s a very smooth process, but could throw you off in the beginning if you’re not used to it. 

Resort credits- These are coupons not free cash. You can’t combine them; you have to use one per service. This means you’ll end up coming out of pocket for anything you use them for i.e spa treatments, wine, room upgrades. I only used the two for the spa. 

Towels- This seems like an odd thing to highlight, but the towels here are GREAT! I’m a bigger guy and usually hate typical hotel towels because they are too small. The towels here are BIG and plush. For me, it was little details like this that really added to my already great view of this property. 

Night Life- This was really the only area I could see some improvement. This is definitely not a party resort, which was great for us. I could see it being a little slow for some folks in my age range (late 20s, early 30s) but there were plenty people my age around. Because of my background in religion and human rights, I was VERY taken back by the “Dominican show”. I was expecting a play or something that would talk about the history or just the culture of the DR. However, it was a song and dance show that made it look like colonialism and imperialism were a great thing for the happy go lucky native peoples. I was really disappointed that such a sordid history would be told with such celebratory dance and song. Just my personal pet peeve. 

Last but not least, FREE WIFI!!

All in all, the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana is an experience everyone should have!! Loved it here and can’t wait to come back!!!

reviews.author: Mercedes D

Estuvimos un fin de semana, como en otras ocasiones, en este hotel y cada día quedamos más agradados.  En el Gaby tenemos un excelente represente que es el señor  De Haza, cuyas atenciones y comida de este restaurant han sido excelentes.

reviews.author: MDV2
reviews.title: Started out Nightmare, Ended up Paradise!
reviews.text:
At the risk of being a lengthy review, much needs to be said about the Paradisus Resorts in general.  Our girls week was booked in Jan 2014 for arrival at the Paradisus Palma Real in November of 2014. Ten months later, (48 hours before we were to arrive), Paradisus Palma Real decides to inform us that they were overbooked and we were being moved. Upon arriving, we were shoveled around to the Reserve Paradisus Palma Real, back to the Paradisus Palma Real, and then finally to the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana.  Dealing with management at the Paradisus Palma Real was a joke.  Management was a kid, and he changed his story every 5 minutes as to why our reservations had been sold out from under us.  After hours of arguing as to why we didn't have a room with a 10 month prior reservation, we were still told they had no room for our party of 6.  Our only alternative was to load up and go to the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana, where they had made arrangements for us.  We were madder than hornets but we had no other choice.
This is where we met the savior of the day Silvio Lantigua.  While we were on the beach at the Paradisus Punta Cana, Silvio happened to walk up to us and overheard what we were telling the waiters on the beach about our nightmare at the Paradisus Palma Real.  Silvo (who happens to be the Guest Service Manager of the Paradisus and the Reserve) asked us to explain the situation to him.  Once we did, he gave us his word that everything would change from that point on.  He apologized for everything that we had been through, and promised us that paradise was about to begin at that moment.  He instructed the two Beach boys Luis Santana and Ramo'n Ramirez that we were to have a covered Cabana and Lounge chairs reserved for us everyday right on the water.  He arranged for all of us to have champagne delivered to our rooms and also comped a dinner at the Lapalapa for us. (The Lapalapa is one of the restaurants that is not included in the all inclusive packages)  Luis and Ramo'n were over and beyond attentive and put up with the drink demands of 6 vacationing woman. Santos Frios also was an exceptional waiter at the beach.  The three of them always pulled through for us, and had us smiling and  laughing every moment they were around.
Big picture, I would never make plans to go to the Paradisus Palma Real.  The customer service was poor and the building was completely under construction.  HOWEVER, we will be going back to the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana.  Silvio was right, paradise did begin from the moment we met him, and he followed up to make sure nothing was short of perfect for us. He has an outstanding crew from the beaches all the way to the restaurants. The rooms were absolutely beautiful, clean and stocked.  The entertainment was superb, and the beaches were immaculate.  Even the maintenance crew were helpful.  They kindly cut down a coconut from the tree with their hatchet and cut the top off so we could all try the coconut milk.  You will not be disappointed in the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana, we certainly had a 180 turnaround.

reviews.author: VA12
reviews.title: Overall Good Experience
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed for five nights at the Paradisus Palma Real as part of a group trip through his company. We had a great time. This is a fun place to be with a group; we enjoyed spending time with others on the beach, seeing them around at meals, and hanging out at the bars in the evening. With that said, I don't personally see this as a couples/honeymoon spot - unless you're looking for that type of vibe. 

Location
The hotel is located about 30 minutes from Punta Cana airport. It's located on a strip of beach with a ton of other all-inclusive hotels. Walking north on the beach, you mostly pass other hotels. Walking south, you run into the "JC Penney" shopping outlet, and that area is a bit sketchy.  There are always people walking up and down the beach trying to talk to you and sell you something or to get you to come with him. There are usually security guards out on the beach at Paradisus, but not all resorts have them, so just be aware of your surroundings. 

The Resort
The resort is HUGE. There are at least seven restaurants, a huge pool, a family pool, the royal service pool, bars, even a club lounge. The grounds are beautiful and well maintained. The resort sits on a wide section of beach as opposed to a small section of beach and then the resort grounds sitting so far back from the ocean. This is nice as it gives you a *little* more room to spread out on the beach (at least in comparison to the other resorts). 

As others have mentioned, there is construction going on. It is loud and obnoxious when spending time at the large main pool or having lunch at the buffet or Market Grill. With that said, we rarely went over to that side and it didn't really bother us. Our section of beach was far enough away that we never heard it. 

Rooms
We were in a Royal Service room on the far end of the resort. The room was clean and serviced each day. The bathroom was very strange - it was open to the rest of the room and the toilet and shower stalls both had clear glass 'doors.' You need to be very comfortable with whoever you're sharing a room with! There is a huge jacuzzi tub, and one night our butler drew a bath for us, which was very nice. The mini bar was refilled each day and housekeeping did a good job. 

Food
The food overall was very mediocre. I would say it was better than the average all-inclusive resort, but nothing special. Breakfast at Palazzo was the best - I'm not sure if that's open only to Royal Service. You could order off the menu here or go to the pancake/crepe station and have the chef make you something fresh - with a bar of toppings to the side. For lunch, the buffet is very mediocre - except when the seafood section is serving peel and eat shrimp and lobster tails. Gabi Beach was, by far, the best for lunch. We had a delicious meal there.  We did the hibachi style restaurant at Bana - this was below average for hibachi you would see in the US, but decent. Vento was good for dinner. We also tried Passion, which is the Michelin star restaurant on site. The charge is an extra $60pp (+ drinks). Being from a US city where there are many amazing restaurants, we felt the food was good here but nothing amazing. The service was what made the experience so enjoyable, and we do recommend it for something different. 

Service
We were part of the Royal Service. The big sell here is that you get your own butler and you're issued a phone with which you can call him at any time. There are certain things included - one piece of ironing per day, a pillow menu, a bath menu, etc. We used our butler for ironing and for one dinner reservation - and that one reservation took him two days to confirm after we called back several times. We did see other butlers out on the beach bringing drinks, etc, but ours was not present. When we did call our butler for a few requests, we were told to dial a department (and that department told us to call another department, and so on...) I finally had to tell someone that we had already talked to our butler and three different departments and that they needed to figure it out and call me back. (Thankfully, they did!) Overall, we were very unimpressed with the service.  As for the Royal Service, I don't think it's worth it for the butler. However, I do think it's worth it to get extra access to restaurants, be a separate, more quiet area of the resort, separate beach area, and a separate, more quiet pool.  The kids all stayed in either the Family royal service area or the main pool, and the resort did a good job of separating the two. 

However, there were a couple of standouts to us - Starky the bartender did a great job. There was also an awesome bartender at Agency, the bar in the center of the resort, who made fabulous rum concoctions - I wish I had learned his name so I could call him out.  Carlos at Passion was phenomenal. The food was decent (not exceptional), but Carlos was fantastic and truly made our experience there.  Finally, Pedro, who worked in the royal service beach are and only helped us personally one time (to get a bali bed reserved on the beach), but every time we saw him, he was hustling, providing excellent service, and with a big smile on his face. Every time I saw him I had to smile, because he seemed so genuinely happy. 

Spa
We had a couples massage while there at the spa in the Reserve are of the resort (Lhi Spa). When we first arrived, at 8:30am, there was club music playing loudly - not the best for a spa environment. Thankfully, they turned this off by the time we came out. Our massages were mediocre in comparison to what you would receive in the US, but very relaxing and enjoyable. The best part of this spa was the facilities you could utilize after your treatment - hydrotherapy pools, foot baths, hot tubs, etc. Bring your bathing suit with you and take the time to enjoy this co-ed area after your treatment.  I also had an exfoliation at the other spa on site. I didn't have the same experience with this treatment. These spa facilities are not as nice and I didn't feel the service was up to par. 

Local Activities
There are plenty of day trips or half day trips you can sign up for - snorkeling, speed boats, island tours, etc. We ended up not taking advantage of this in order to have more time to relax. My husband did play golf at the course on site and enjoyed it. The cost is included in the all inclusive but you do have to pay cart fees and rentals. 

Overall, we had a positive experience. If you like a larger resort tons of activities,restaurant options on site, lots of people, all-inclusive style, this is for you. If you are looking for a quiet, relaxing place to stay with great service and not too many people around - this is not for you. 
We had a wonderful, amazing experience at Arenas del Mar. It is one of the most beautiful places we've ever stayed; we greatly enjoyed our stay there and were sad to leave. We very much hope to return for another stay at Arenas del Mar.

reviews.author: Shawn M
reviews.title: GFE '14
reviews.text: The resort is GORGEOUS!! Everything about it seemed like paradise! However, there seemed to be quite a bit of a mix up because, (I guess?) we booked our trip so far in advance. When we arrived, our rooms had been switched to a less desireable location. We were in the lobby arguing for HOURS... However, they did very well accomodating us in the end. On our first venture to the beach we met Silvio Lantigua who told the cabana boys to "take good care of us." & that, they did! Luiz Santana, Ramon Ramirez, Santos Frias were AWESOME!!! Oneida Zorrilla was very helpful sorting out issues at the front desk, as were Leidy & Asia @ concierge. There was SO MUCH wonderful food, but because of intestinal issues, (experienced by all of us...) It was difficult to enjoy it. :-( There was also a few days where there were internet challenges, which made it difficult to communicate w/ people at home.Other than the few hiccups, The Paradisus is a remarkable place & I would defn. reccommend it.

reviews.author: 50breezy
reviews.title: Girls Week
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. We loved our rooms, the grounds, the pool and the beach. Our trip started out on a bad note (booked in January and they switched our location within the resort when we arrived). They seemed to try very hard to make up for moving us, but it took hours of demanding on our part. 
Our "cabana boys" were great, Luis Santana, Ramon Ramirez, Santo Fria. They took very good care of us. Our concierge, Leidy and Asia were very professional. 
Our internet was down over half the time we were there. The food was good, but ALL of us had intestinal issues. Honestly, it was bad enough for me (and fresh enough in my mind at the moment), that it may deter me from returning.

reviews.author: Sharon W
reviews.title: Great pool service at the Reserve
reviews.text: Service at the Reserve pool was very good. In particular, Santo Polanco, our waiter at the pool, was great. He was very friendly and attentive and always remembered what our preferred drinks were for the six of us.

reviews.author: Connie S
reviews.title: November 2014 trip
reviews.text: Excellent resort. Very clean, friendly and BEAUTIFUL! Anthony Contreras made the trip for us. Very personable, friendly and fun. He made spinning class and pool fitness very fun. We would come back just to see him again and be in his class. Great young man

reviews.author: Excursion384415
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: This resort was gorgeous & pristine. Everything was very clean. The staff was always friendly & helpful. We had a wonderful trip. A few thoughts that concerned me before we went: 1- we always drank bottled water & used it to brush our teeth. But none in the group got sick from food or water. 2- I did not need an adaptor or converter for use of the outlets. 3- we felt very safe. The resort even provided security on the beach (mainly to keep guests from being bothered by salesmen) 4- the Punta Cana airport is in the process of a major remodel. It will be fabulous & modern when it is completed.

reviews.author: taubin5@yahoo.com
reviews.title: Warmth of people and the sun!
reviews.text:
I would recommend anyone to visit this resort. I spent a lot of time at the pool. Francisco, Reynaldo and Angel were always around encouraging participation in activities.  They had beach volleyball, aerobics, dance lessons along with cigar rolling, mixing drinks, painting and candle-making!  At night, there was always a show put on by the dancers.  Rachel, Sandy, Luis, Leo, Yubi and the other dancers were excellent !!  They were always rehearsing during the day to put on the best performance in the evening.... And they did!!! Juan at the Avenue Bar was always attentive to the guests with a great smile, too!  I loved being there!
