My only complaint was trying to pay the "very costly" all inclusive prior to the 15 day deadline for the reduced rate...I was transferred numerous times but they did honor the rate even though it was past the time because I explained my difficulties.  Although the food was delicious, I felt that the prices were quite expensive for the all inclusive and that it was difficult to make dinner reservations at the desk or phone for the week.  Aside from that, it's a great resort; it's my second time there and if a special pricing were offered for the all inclusive, I'd bring my whole family....there is something for everyone there!!!  Thank you, again, for a well needed vacation with a warm and friendly staff!!

reviews.author: MissMarilee
reviews.title: Awesome vaca at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: I must say that this is the best vacation I have had and I have been on many. Guys like Marciano made my in room dining a spectacular experience and compliments to whomever the Chef is - the Ceviche was some of the best I have tasted anywhere. Jeury our own personal concierge and his team which included Francisco Cabrera catered to our every need!  Shout out to Faustino who added a positive spin on a wonderful stay.  I love it sooooo much, am planning to return next year,

reviews.author: Camille Y
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!!!!!
reviews.text:
This was by far the best vacation I have ever been on. I credit Jose Luis de Los santos for making my experience one to always remember. His service at the pool (where I spent most of my time) was top notch. Always willing to serve and is an absolute pleasure. I would book the reserve again, especially if Jose was my pool server. Also, Santo Polanco also did a great job with service. Both guys were always willing to help and get us whatever we needed. 

Thanks for this great experience. Can't wait to come back again next year.

reviews.author: stalin
reviews.title: Excelente.
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, soy taxista en punta cana en verdad lo recomiendo, excelente piscina es grande y divertida la atención ofrecida por los empleados un servicio magnífico el bar es extraordinario ricos tragos 
Stalin taxi driver

reviews.author: Elisabeth D
reviews.title: Great time and wonderful staff at Paradisus, Punta Cana DR
reviews.text:
I just had a great week at the Reserve and Paradisus Resort in Punta Cana.  Staff was fantastic and just want to give a shout out to a few individuals (but everyone was great):
* Anthony & Arne (Activities)
* Jose de la Cruz & Pedro Aquisno (Activities)
* Maria & Emilio (Restaurant/Bar)
* Jessica, Victoria & Rosalina (Spa)

reviews.author: stephaniem0404
reviews.title: Beautiful Grounds, Best Pool, Awesome Service
reviews.text:
I booked this vacation for a girls trip and was impressed by the value for the service and amenities we received. Royal service was a component of our package and I have come to realize this is a MUST as it provides you a private adults-only pool, and an amazingly helpful bulter. Our butler, Jeriui, was perfection. He anticipated every one of our needs, including providing us a specialty drink when one of us became ill. He was kind, gracious, accommodating and exceeded every one of our expectations. Our cabana server, Francisco Cabrerra, was excellent. Although we weren't assigned to Francisco, he made sure we had everything we needed all week. He was kind, funny, and provided great service. Manny helped us book interesting excursions and never led us astray. 

The food was better than I expected for an all inclusive resort, and the drinks were great. The pools were exceptionally clean, as were the entire grounds. The beach is absolutely beautiful. Wifi connection was perfect for those of us who couldn't unplug. The location is close and convenient to many of the excursions offered including para-sailing--in most cases they depart directly from the beach on the grounds.

reviews.author: 797benjaminw
reviews.title: Excellent Island Get Away
reviews.text: We attended a destinatilon wedding and were so very pleased to have experienced location.  The interior decor was impressive; external architecture was simply beautiful.  The ocean view was breathtaking. We would return without a doubt.

reviews.author: JillsGreatEscapes
reviews.title: Excellent service beautiful beach starting property!
reviews.text: This all inclusive resort will appeal to many travelers. Families will enjoy the family concierge area with activities and programs for children 3 to 12 and teens. For families that would like a more upscale experience they can stay at the reserve on property.  This is a club level with additional services and amenities designed for families. Guests that would like an adults only experience should select the Royal service accommodations. This section of the hotel caters to adults, has private pool, lounge, dining and private beach. The butler service was welcome additional amenity. From packing and unpacking to drawing a bath pillow menu, and any additional services you require you have access to your butler with a cell phone that is provided. The white sand beaches, daybeds on the beach, cabanas, swim up bar and the many dining options or just some of the features that made this a luxurious retreat. We had the pleasure of staying on property for two nights while we toward 11 resorts over the course of four days. This was by far a favorite. Eight dining options and lively entertainment, beautifully landscaped grounds, and great service Will all be found at this luxurious all inclusive resort. I would recommend this to my guests that are seeking a relaxing retreat whether they be families or couples.

reviews.author: janelley
reviews.title: Great Vacation!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Punta Cana was absolutely beautiful.  The grounds were so well kept.  The people were so friendly and were very helpful.  The only things I didn't like about it was people trying to get you a time share there.  They didn't take no for an answer.  We were only there for 5 days and we actually wasted one of those days listening to their spiel.  Other than that everything was very nice.  A lot of variety of where you could go to eat.

reviews.author: Spadiva2011
reviews.title: Smoke and mirrors
reviews.text: The resort itself is great and offers great amenities how we the staff wasn't as accommodating to us as they were to others. For example it was tough getting coffee or juice in the morning, the butler would wait on others while filling our request (went get change, went to find him after waiting awhile and he was checking in another guest), staff was very friendly to others and rarely greeted us. There seemed to be a lack of attention to our needs. We had to do extra to get our resort credits (I had to call reservations and prove I had them, wait until the following day to redeem them, wait for rep in royal lounge while I would have rather been on the beach).  Just didn't seem to want to help us. Airport shuttle was 20 minutes late and it was tough getting someone to call the company.

reviews.author: Luis A
reviews.title: Excelent experience
reviews.text: If you ever decide to visit this paradise, you will experience one of the most enriechment moments of your life. Their Royal Service club and the buttler service will allow you to eliminate all concerns about what do do and the necessary planning and arrangements that attaches to your enjoyment. They will take care of all of your wishes and accomodations as well as any short time needs and desires inmediately. I recommend that you try their private pool and beaches as well as their excelent restaurants. We were fortunates to count with Mr. Juan De Leon as our buttler and it was extrordinarily efficient and diligent. Thanks Juan  !!!!!!!!

reviews.author: JenP1982
reviews.title: Royal service pool and beach
reviews.text: Service at the royal service pool and beach was amazing! Thank you to Francisco Cabrera for making our vacation even better!! Everyone should come to this resort and get the royal service experience with these guys! :-)

reviews.author: Ouida J
reviews.title: Great resort! Great Service! Great People!
reviews.text: I loved the Paradisus Palma Real. I received exceptional service from Julio Lopez, one of the shuttle drivers. I even enjoyed the "campy" activities offered through the hotel staff, including the parasailing, "boogey (dune buggy)" ride and cave expedition and the speed boat driving/snorkeling/"snuba" outing, since they were all things that I had never done. I wasn't too jazzed about the "not mandatory" but highly encouraged 90+ minute time share/vacation ownership sales pitch, but it comes with the territory and I didn't get to finish it anyway since I had an appointment. I agree about the food being bad--I subsisted off of french fries and fruit, so I didn't gain any weight and I didn't get sick, like most of the other people I was traveling with. Another issue for me was although the wifi is free, it is intermittent, at best--so in this case you really do get what you pay for. I loved the extensive grounds and beautiful beach enabling me to stay on the property and still walk several miles each day and see interesting sites. Overall I had a very positive experience, including my travel from and to Chicago.

reviews.author: Pamela C
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
My friend from college and I hadn't spent time together for nearly thirty years. We decided a vacation together at an island resort would be the perfect reunion destination.  For several months we planned our trip to Punta Cana. We decided on the Paradisus Punta Real because it was an all inclusive resort that catered more to adults. During our eight day stay, we were spoiled by hotel staff, waiters, bartenders, beach staff, and our butler, Yohel. Four employees in particular contributed significantly to the enjoyment of our vacation.
[1] Yohel ensured that every detail of our trip was perfect.  He made dinner reservations for us each night at one of the many onsite restaurants that we had selected. He answered all questions we had not only about restaurant options, but also about shopping, beach protocol, spa services, etc. A hotel provided cell phone connected us to Yohel who made himself available to us 24/7. His professionalism coupled with his warmth made our experience unforgettable.  On our last day, Yohel assisted us with the checkout process and arranged our transportation to the airport. During our farewell,  we exchanged hugs as Yohel commented that we reminded him of his family and that he would miss us. "Hasta luego" replaced "Adios" since Yohel explained that "goodbye" was more permanent and he wanted to see us return to the Dominican Republic.  
[2] On our first day of vacation, Yohel introduced us to Francisco Gil who managed the beach area. Francisco welcomed us warmly and continued to exude warmth every day all day. Francisco reserved a "front row" set of palapas and Bali chairs for us in the same spot every day. When we arrived at the beach after breakfast,  Francisco had already covered our beds and chairs with soft towels and placed a table between the chairs [for our drinks]. He greeted us with a beautiful, friendly smile and immediately brought us a bucket filled with ice and several bottles of water. He then brought us coffee or Pina Coladas, or choice. Although he was not working on the day of our departure,  he made arrangements for a colleague to set up our area for us. Thoughtful, kind, and always pleasant, Francisco contributed tremendously to our vacation enjoyment.
[3] Jorge Acevedo, bartender at the beach fruit bar, was very accommodating. He prepared tasty tropical fruit drinks for us and proudly shared with us information about his country. The day before our departure,  I wasn't feeling very well. Jorge recognized this immediately,  and prepared for me a bitter concoction to settle my stomach. It worked! It was evident that Jorge enjoyed his job and worked hard to provide superior service to all visitors.
[4] Although all of the waiters and waitresses were wonderfully attentive, one young man stood out.  Jose Ramos was the perfect waiter.  Jose was our waiter at the Palazzo restaurant many mornings. He anticipated our every need, greeting us with our customary "cafe con leche" and providing prompt refills with our our needing to ask. When we had dinner at another resort restaurant [Vento] later in the week, Jose was our waiter. He remembered us from our mornings at the Palazzo, and welcomed us by name! Jose is a hard working, kind, caring, friendly, and seasoned professional who made our dining experiences most personal and enjoyable.

reviews.author: saltacity
reviews.title: Simply outstanding
reviews.text: What an outstanding resort in such a lovely place. At first I was a little bit sceptical to see if this hotel could really live up to my expectations, but it did - it definitely did. The suites are very nice, in a perfect state, clean and very comfortable. Personnel is very friendly and genuinely so. Apparently the Melia groups puts a lot of effort into selecting local talent as well as training & retaining them. Service was always perfect. At one time I asked for fresh mango juice and the waiter told me that though they did not have any mango juice he would have the kitchen prepare me some fresh mango juice: 10 minutes later I got a freshly made mango juice!!! Food in the different restaurants is buffet style and good. The two big swimming pools (and one special family pool, great family concierge service by the way) are nice and kept clean, each with a swim-up bar. The beach part is very nice as well. A memorable stay and a highly recommendable resort.

reviews.author: AlisaHead
reviews.title: Would not stay again.....
reviews.text:
Dominican Republic has some secret gems. This place was not one of them. The rooms were not as pictured. They are older, have Air conditioning problems, mosquitos were all in the rooms and to find someone who understood english was difficult. Also the shower heads in the bathrooms kept falling off. I went with a group of 15 and many had to change rooms several times due to one problem or another. Many did not get their rooms cleaned until 4 or 5 o'clock in the evening or not at all. Food choices and wine choices were awful. Transportation was all screwed up and I had to pay a cab to get to the airport when I'd already prepaid a transportation company. 

I went to Punta Cana in May and stayed at Club Med which was AWESOME!!! GREAT FOOD, GREAT STAFF, GREAT ENTERTAINMENT, GREAT VACATION!! This second trip was just OK. I had a ball with my friends. Restaurant Vento I got food poisoning from, just by eating a salad. Some may have liked the accommodations but I knew there were better Resorts than Paradisus Palma Real. I love PUNTA CANA. I will go back but will not  use this hotel nor transportation company.

reviews.author: Cpisaacs
reviews.title: Hacer falta Naos
reviews.text: Por tercera vez volví a este hotel en el que siempre me va muy bien. La gran decepción: el buffet  principal estaba en remodelación y debimos ir hasta The Reserve para cenar todas las noches con una comida más bien modesta y poco variada. Es una lástima pues uno de los mayores atractivos de este hotel era justamente Naos. Ojalá  abra pronto. Por lo demás muy bien, como siempre, aunque el servicio de meseros en la playa fue totalmente inexistente.

reviews.author: berges9
reviews.title: Incredible Stay
reviews.text:
We went to the resort on a company trip and everything was incredible.  If you do go and stay near or at the Royal Services in the Hotel, ask for Angelo Mercedes to be you assistant!!  He was fantastic and did everything for us so we could maximize our time there.  The Royal services had a separate/ private pool and beach to get drinks and give you some privacy that is not part of the big pool area. 

What a beautiful, fun, and safe resort!

reviews.author: COLONEL5
reviews.title: Fantastic resort with excellent staff
reviews.text:
My wife and I are half way through a 3 week holiday staying in the ‘Reserve’ at the ‘Paradisus' hotel Punta Cana in the Dominican Republic and the combination of excellent food and accommodation is only surpassed by the outstanding service provided by the hotel staff. From Santo,the pool concierge, who caters for our comfort while lounging poolside, to Porfirio, Amilka,and Sandra whose excellent attention at the GABI lounge has ensured that  we enjoy a wonderful bar service to Christian,Lenny,Willis and Celsio whose efforts to provide an outstanding and friendly table service make mealtimes In the Gabi lounge such a relaxing and enjoyable experience.  Our favourite restaurant within the resort would have to be Vento where Caesar and his team, Janna, Mercedes,Renelley and, again, Celsio, have given us such memorable dining. 
However, i must also  make mention of our concierge, Diasmery Francisco who, not only, is, and has been such a welcoming presence in our lobby, but who has made such efforts to make our stay here truly unforgettable. She is a star and a perfect representative for this hotel.
Both my wife and I could not recommend this resort highly enough and would seriously consider making it our annual winter getaway.

reviews.author: kleighfass
reviews.title: Terrible Food, Extremely Rude Staff, Dirty Rooms
reviews.text: The title pretty much says it all. We had Royal service - not worth it. The food is horrible. We stayed at Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen, Mexico, last year and it was wonderful! Not so lucky here. There are a few friendly and helpful staff members, but they are truly few and far between. Many were actually downright rude and assume that Americans can't understand what they are saying in Spanish - well, I speak Spanish, and I understood them. Some people on the beach had drink orders taken, we were simply ignored and several times made to feel as if we were bothering them just for asking for what we had paid for. Our room was not clean - hairs all over the bathroom, including the tub, and stains on the sheets. The only plus was Passion restaurant, which was excellent, and had been excellent at the Mexico resort, as well.  We are not loud, rude, or pushy people, and did nothing to warrant the way we were treated. My suggestion to you - go to the Playa del Carmen, Mexico Paradisus I instead.

reviews.author: Bingobabe2013
reviews.title: The Best vacation ever!!!
reviews.text:
This is my second trip to this resort. Obviously I had a wonderful time and would recommend this resort to anyone who enjoys good weather, good food & drink and best of all good People. I want to give special thanks and appreciation to the staff that made this trip so enjoyable. First the the activities crew- Rafael Diaz, Marionell Ramirez, David Contreras, Noel Vasquez , Lismeiry Challenger and the best  water aerobic instructor Jose Fernandez ! Next the pool waiters, Emilio Valdez, Santo Polanco, Santos Frias and guest service manager Silvio Lantigua. They came. Around frequently and were there for anything u needed. Now I want to recognize the staff at the North Bar who always and a smile and your next drink ready- Jorelyis Vilorio, Carmen Pena, Julio Feliz and Eduardo Caminero. Thank you for such great service! 
The resort had many activities and a show each night. The beach party was a blast!!! The Michael Jackson show was excellent just to name a few. I recommend this resort to anyone who enjoys special treatment and meeting special people. To the staff members who I now consider friends, Thank You for making this trip memorable!!!

reviews.author: Cinthia R
reviews.title: Su nombre lo dice todo es un Paraiso
reviews.text: Si me tocaria otras vacaciones eligiaria este hotel, atenciones de primera, servicio a la habitacion, bebidas de categoria, las habitaciones preciosas, majestuosas, la fuente, la estructura del hotel en resumen es Espectacular

reviews.author: dj B
reviews.title: take the good with the bad
reviews.text: Reall nice grounds and friendly staff but the food was terrible. Half the time i thought i was eating cardboard and the choices we're limited. Beach was filled with seaweed so you really couldnt swim without getting tangled up so i was confined to the pool which is a pretty huge pool and actually nice. Drinks were a bit watered down but i was expecting that because its all inclusive. My biggest gripe was with the roach problem they have in the hotel room. I couldnt sleep because i was too busy on roach patrol. Seeing the roach on the wall right next to my bed kept me up, slipper in hand ready for action until i was able to fall asleep in the late am hours. smh!!! Hotel grounds gave me the luxury resort feeling which i enjoyed. They really need to bring they're food up to par with the looks of the hotel and figure the roach problem. The concierge did not let my cab leave and made me wait 15 minutes to verify if i was checked out and didn't take my word for it and this almost made me miss my flight home. Sad thing is the hotel is actually nice and pretty much all the workers are accomodating. i would go back if you guys fix the issues

reviews.author: Gourmet marbella
reviews.title: Excelentes de maravilla
reviews.text: Primero quiero decir el hotel es maravilloso es de los mejores que yo aiga  visitado, el servicio en general del personal del hotel es excepcional, las playas,el servicio las decoraciones de la habitación el complejo entero es una maravilla... También quiero mencionar primero a Carlos en guest service que es muy servicial... George alriche camarero en la playa muy atentó un gran profesional muchos saludos a el... Un saludo al chef anthony que es muy amable...y por último a Fernando geronimo de Room service que es muy simpático,amable, y muy puntual con nuestra cena gracias a el y todos por el buen servicio...¡,

reviews.author: Carlos R
reviews.title: O melhor!
reviews.text: Tudo muito lindo. Instalações impecáveis, gastronomia da melhor qualidade. Equipe muito atenciosa e disposta a ajudar. Um agradecimento especial ao sr. Francisco Cabrera pelo ótimo atendimento e presteza. Gracias Francisco.

reviews.author: marie s
reviews.title: Ramon Fuego, Francisco Cabrero & Vladimir are the best!
reviews.text: Vladimir helped the check in process go smoothly for us - he is outstanding.  Ramon and Luis need to stay at the swim up pool.  They add a dimension that helps people forget about their stresses and truly have a paradise experience!  Ramone is the BEST!!  Francisco Cabrero was also outstanding!  We love this place and come back all the time.  We highly recommend this awesome experience.  Seek out Ramon Fuego, Francisco Cabrero, Vladimir and Luis - they will make this trip worthwhile.

reviews.author: Wilma M
reviews.title: Great Time at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: This was the best vacation ever.  The food, desserts, weather, beaches, accommodations and most of all the people were great.  Everyone was extremely nice,.  Great customer service.  Thanks to Juan Jose Rosa for making sure we had extra snacks in our room on a daily basis.  Thanks to Kenny De Jesus for making outstanding drinks.  The best was the "Cocoloco and the "Dirty Monkey."  Now let me tell you about Alfonso Shephard he was the best driver.  He was there to pick us up in the morning, afternoon, and evening.  Very pleasant and answered all of our thousand questions.  Such a gentleman.  Angel Melendez was the best host.  His service was outstanding.  Always greeting us with a smile and making sure we were satisfied with our food  and drinks.  This is one of the best place to stay.  So, when you are thinking about a vacation this is the spot.  Great all the way around.

reviews.author: Carolyn l B
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: We went for pleasure and ended up with a luxurious time great food , great people very attentive to all your wants. The reserve is a part of paridise. The beaches are very clean and the land scrapping is well manicured, Santo   Polanco Mario Nell Santo Fria , Silvio Lantigua, were gracious and very helpful with everything.

reviews.author: nickmac207
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel, beautiful people, beautiful and gracious service. We were impressed by outstanding service of all personnel  at the hotel as well as the fact that no matter their position or employ all were willing to provide service without regard to their assigned position, i.e. landscapers, painters, maitainance, waiters , housekeeping..Food was outstanding and the beautiful people always had a smile and a courteous welcoming greeting.

reviews.author: Marcos L
reviews.title: Gran semana de vacaciones con amigos
reviews.text: El mejor hotel con diferencia y la mejor atención de Ramon Fuego como todos los años el nunca falla y también en el bar de la piscina Manuel Torres buen profesional y atención personalizada. El hotel tiene las mejores instalaciones de Punta Cana con los mejores restaurantes

reviews.author: Stephen D
reviews.title: October 9 - October 16th
reviews.text: Everything was Amazing!  Top notch for sure.  We had Royal Service, ALVARO was great!  Head to the Avenue bar and see JUAN....mention the name JOHN CLOONEY!  You will get taken care of !  Cant wait to go back!!

reviews.author: JL T
reviews.title: Absolutely no complaints
reviews.text: I went to this resort for a girlfriend's getaway. We expected fun in the sun but we didn't expect to be experience the awesome time that we did at this resort. Very beautiful grounds, very beautiful people (a plus for single folks *wink*), good food and exceptional service. The people there went out of their way to ensure we had everything we needed and did so with the utmost courtesy and respect. To note a few people who added to this wonderful trip: Ricardo saler, Claribel (who, in addition taught us spanish), omar, marco, and jose lugo and countless others. My friend and i will definitely return to this beautiful resort!

reviews.author: Laura H
reviews.title: Overall Wonderful
reviews.text:
This resort is an overall wonderful place to vacation. I am a travel agent and get to see several properties but I must say the service and experience here is a the top of my list. There is excellent, professional yet fun staff and they always have something to do. The food was delicious and always left me rolling out the door from eating too much. Juan the bartender at the bar in the lobby was always wonderful. He always had my lemon drop martinis freshly made when i was walking up to the bar and always made my friend and I laugh. 

Our room was spacious and has a pleasant aroma from the incense (we were in the Adults Only section). I would highly recommend upgrading to the adults only for the additional pool, beach section with smoothie bar, and restaurant access. 

Nightlife- There is the red lounge which was always filled with people but it more of a bar scene than a dance floor. There was a club apparently built/supported by Akon but it needs quite a few people to fill it up. It was free for guests but not for locals. We went during slow season so if you are here when there are more guests I'm sure the nightlife will be more happening. 

They do have good English but it is always nice to give an effort to speak Spanish. Don't drink the water and make sure to bring stomach relievers if you have a weak stomach. Overall there is nothing bad that I can say about this resort. It is a great place to vista in Punta Cana and I would highly recommend it to anyone.

reviews.author: Juanita A
reviews.title: Wedding & Vacation Bliss
reviews.text:
The primary reason for our trip to The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was to attend a good friend's wedding so we can't take any credit for picking this locale, but we are so happy that the bride and groom did!!  We combined the wedding with vacation time and so we were down with another couple we frequently travel with as well and I can share that we all had a wonderful time,

The resort itself is gorgeous with wonderfullly landscaped grounds that are immaculately maintained.  The suite we stayed in was spacious with a great balcony overlooking the pool that meanders through the resort complete with individual whirlpools on your balcony.

The main delight were the people who were very friendly and always interested in making your experience at The Reserve a great one,  special thanks to Santos and Santana and Chef from the Hydro Grille for taking such good care of us and for the wonderful food you whipped up for us-we loved it!  Also, a shout-out to Chocolate and Carlos Pena for our daily workouts and trying to offset the pounds we put on eating all of that good food not to mention the drinks and to Orlando for facilitating our departure!

A wonderful time was had by all and a tear was shed as we headed home!  We are fairly seasoned travelers and can say that our stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was one of the best vacations we have enjoyed and we look forward to returning in the near future to further enjoy that bit of paradise in DR!!

reviews.author: Vacation279371
reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text: We had an amazing time in Punta Cana, we enjoyed the beach area, the entertainment as well as dancing the night away at Club Red, it was something to do for our entire group.  The Paradisus Palma Real was a beautiful resort.  Although we did grow tried of the food, nothing was wrong with it, other than the same food everyday.

reviews.author: Lemorah B
reviews.title: Bang...Bang..Bang..Food not bad, But! I got burned by a hot plate in Vento!
reviews.text: I agree with the comments shared by the other guests regarding the noise level, banging and construction all day.  If your coming for a peaceful vacation, seek refuge at another resort.  The food is not bad but I got burned by a hot plate when a waiter dropped the plate on me....No one at the resort seemed to care.  We traveled with a group of 15, booked with vacation express, many of the rooms were not as pictured (older) but, well equipped, mosquitoes are a problem, as is maid service.  I've been to better 4 star rated resorts...Bottom line, shop around.

reviews.author: Helen D
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text: Royal service is a must.  Our butler Angelo was the best.  He made sure we had our dinner reservations when and where we wanted them.  He also was very attentive to all our needs.  The true definition of a gentleman.  Francisco Cabrerra remembered to have our chairs set up at the pool and on the beach every morning.  Francisco brought our cocktails to us wherever we where.  He was the best and we can't wait to return to see him again.  Paradisus Palma real royal service is a true paradise!

reviews.author: pdengine205
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: I would like to thank Francisco Cabrera who was our pool attendant and bar tender at the royal service area of the hotel for his outstanding service during our stay. He took care of all our needs everyday at the pool this week Oct 5th thru Oct 10th 2014.  Also our butler Angelo was fantastic. He gave us everything we needed sometimes before we asked for them. He got us reservations at every restaurant every night for the times we asked for. These two gentlemen made our stay fantastic from start to finish. When we come back to this resort I hope we can have these two to help us again. Great trip and great resort

reviews.author: Jamar P
reviews.title: Did not want to leave!
reviews.text: Immaculate property well manicured and everyone treats you like royalty. They accommodated me with whatever I needed. Large property and there are plenty of things to do. Went with a group of friends but there is a very romantic vibe at this property. Will be back next year!

reviews.author: James A
reviews.title: Juan de leon
reviews.text: I recently vacationed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort with a group of friends, and Juan de leon was our butler.  Juan was awesome, and made sure to handle all of our needs throughout the trip (food, drinks, reservations, travel to/from airport, etc).  He did a great job and made our vacation very pleasurable.

reviews.author: Janet V
reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: I want to start by saying this is not my first time here.  I had such a fantastic time with the help of many of the employees at this hotel I just had to come back.  Ramon Fuego from the pool bar had a huge part on our decision to come back - well to my surprise he was no longer at the pool bar.  I don't understand why would this hotel put such an important person to the guest experience at a restaurant bar.  Wasted talent!  I wish I had a hotel, I would snatch him up.  We noticed while at the pool we never got someone coming to us to ask if we wanted a drink - considering we were there for 5 days that is pretty disappointing.  The hotel restaurants were booked 2 days of the 5 days so we had to order in room dining.   When I was here 2 yrs ago with my family - I had such a great time I came back with my daughter and 3 friends - I'm not going to lie I was somewhat embarrassed.  Thank god for Jose Bravo & Drayi Escarraman that did a fantastic job at the Lobby Bar to make it up to us.  Ramon Fuego was missed big time.  I hope the hotel re-considers and bring back Ramon Fuego to the pool bar.

reviews.author: Chicago7732014
reviews.title: A friends wedding
reviews.text: This place was simply amazing. The all inclusive was well worth. You really don't have to want or need for anything. The entrainment can be better but that's about it. Ruddy was by far our favorite server always singing and dancing and always had a smile on his face, you can tell he enjoyed his job.

reviews.author: Kati
reviews.title: Great, relaxing getaway!
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful and very clean!  They keep it looking perfect every day.  The rooms were nice and housekeeping came twice a day!  Plenty of variety in foods and options to choose from.  The only down side is that we were told if we want to have dinner at one of the restaurants on the resort you have to make a reservation.  They told us you could make it the same day and be fine.  That wasn't the case and we weren't able to eat at some of the restaurants because they booked up.  Word of advice, book your dinner reservations for your entire stay on your first night!
Other than that this place was amazing!

reviews.author: Munkart0327
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: I recently stayed at this resort with my BFF.  The food and drinks were Great!  We liked Vento the Best, but also had Good Meals at Bana and Aqua.  We were most impressed with the night time entertainment.  The Michael Jackson show was awesome, as well as The Cirque style show.  The Beach here is awesome although we went during hurricane season so there was a lot of seaweed washing up on the beach.  They came around in the morning and cleaned it up.  Staff was very friendly, especially Roberto at The Avenue Bar and Angel, the activities director.  A few times I had to ask for directions and approached someone who worked there.  They did not speak English at all!  So be Aware!  To speak Spanish here is very helpful.  All in All it was a great weekend getaway.  George took good care of us getting us drinks when we were on the beach or by the pool.  I did notice Americans tipping a good bit, not a lot but $1 or $2 for service.  Although we did start tipping when we saw other Americans tipping the staff waited on us the same whether we tipped or not.

reviews.author: Renee R
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text:
I recently visited this resort and had a wonderful experience.  I was traveling with girlfriends and found this was a great place to unwind and relax but also have enough activities to keep from getting bored.  Daniel is one of the activity directors always kept us informed of what was going on and made sure people were joining the activities.  He was upbeat, spoke several languages and overal made our trip a success.  I should also mention his team helped in making great memories for my friends and I.  Marionell, Lismayre`, David and Ruben Dario Castillos were all friendly, friendly and welcoming.  Each night the hotel hosts a show which really gets the guests involved and the Saturday night beach party was a night not to forget!

Overall the food was good.  It was disappointing that the restaurants were not open each night, and since we had a group of 7 it was difficult to make reservations at the open ones.  The hotel concierge should have eluded to the fact we needed to make reservations on night one, instead of us calling the day of to finalize plans.  Given this, we were forced to eat at the buffet each night, which actually had really great food.  I thought the one night at the restaurant had less good food than the buffets.

The staff is very friendly except our disappointment with the gentlemen during check-in.  WIFI is spotty in the rooms.  Other than that, our trip was a great experience and a lot of fun.

reviews.author: Pete M
reviews.title: Ramon Ramirez... makes this the place to stay.
reviews.text:
The grounds are beautiful, the gardeners were always out keeping the property magnificent. From the Reserve, there is a ~10 minute walk to the beach or you can take the trolley which was less than frequent since they were not at full capacity last weekend. 

Ramon is the best of all the service men and women who we encountered and you will find him at the beach to the right until about 6. The service at the restaurants was good aside from our inability to secure reservations for a group of 10 at Vento the first night (which we ultimately filled, no problem) and another night for a group of four. We saw friends of ours that second night at Aqua who did not make a reservation, like we had, yet they were seated first. That was unacceptable since we had called many hours earlier and been granted the reservation for four. The food was not great at Aqua but it was excellent at Vento.

Unfortunately, we were not told (until later looking on TripAdvisor) that the buffet food was so much better by our pool (Gabi Club) near the Reserve rather than by the beach (Gabi Beach) but that doesn't mean we would have left until long after lunch, anyway. I would definitely recommend coming again but probably would schedule time to go back to Gabi Club for breakfast/lunch. The food was better there... 

When you get back by the beach, try the Cocoloco drink and ask Ramon about the RocketFuels as well. And, make no mistake, Ramon's service was excellent. The others were good to very good...

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: This place is true Paradise, set the bar high...
reviews.text: I was there in June 2012, yes 2012 for a wedding.  Our group was just over 80 people.  I never had the opportunity to write a review or felt the need until now.  We are now planning our next All Inclusive group vacation and I realized how high the bar was set for us after staying at this resort.  From the moment we stepped onto the property we were greeted with smiles and warm hellos.  We get to the desk and here come the Pina Coladas that were superior.  Check in went seamless.  We were a few hours earlier than the check in time of 3 PM but our rooms were ready and they gave us our keys.  Off to the buffet we went because it was lunch time.  The food was amazing, the staff was amazing!  We went to the beach next.  No fighting for seats or towels, there were plenty.  Finally we arrive at our rooms and they were cooled off, clean room, great space, stocked frig and great view.  We enjoyed drinks that were all premium.  The bride and groom were on the Reserve side and we went over there as well.  Both sides were amazing.  The pool was always clean, staff were always nice.  Angel and Jose did an excellent job with activities and just greeting you as the ran into you.  I have just as many pics with staff as I do my friends.  I cannot say enough about the great service amnd atmosphere.  I would return again and again and I plan too.

reviews.author: 1oraine
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: We attended a wedding at this resort. We were so happy with the service throughout the stay.  Entertainment was spectacular.  We loved the dance lessons with Daniel. He was a pleasure to see around the resort. We really relaxed and had such a pleasurable time with the help of Leidy Guerrero. We will return when we visit the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Veronica C
reviews.title: buena atenciòn personal de bar de piscina
reviews.text: quiero destacar la excelente atenciòn de Antonio Ramirez , Luis y Manuel Torres la cordialidad calidez y sobre todo el profesionalismo con el que trabajan, yo soy agente de viajes de Turismo Cocha de chile y uno piensa en como se siente el pasajero , sobre todo cuando va a descansar y encuentra eficiencia y sobre todo alegria que caracteriza al Dominicano...gracias por hacer que mis vacaciones fueran las mejores....los felicito.

reviews.author: Rjsexton
reviews.title: Beautiful property and excellent service!
reviews.text:
We were treated like royalty upon arrival. Almost all the staff were friendly, professional and very helpful.  I have to especially call out the excellent service we received from our butler Yohelvi Aracena.  He made everything so easy and I would definitely recommend the Royal Service upgrade which includes the butler service.  The smaller, intimate settings at the exclusive pool, beach and restaurants really put the Royal Service over the top.  The cabana beds by the pool--awesome!

At the pool bar, Leonardo Mota and Jorge could not have taken better care of us.  We started each morning with fresh coconut waters.  From there we had delicious dirty bananas, coco locos, pina coladas and more.  I loved the Presidente beer as well.

The room was nice and clean.  We had a large balcony overlooking the garden.  The other side of the property was under construction, though it did not impact our stay.

The spa facility is very pretty and the entire experience is very tranquil.  Go early and take advantage of the hydrotherapy baths.  I loved the body scrub (with outdoor shower) and facial.  

The property is a nice size and all the restaurants, bars and shops are easily accessible.  Take sunscreen and bug spray--outrageously priced at the gift shop.  I would suggest taking small U.S. bills.  They are easily accepted everywhere for tips or purchases.

reviews.author: K G
reviews.title: Royal Service Great Exp
reviews.text:
When we first arrived Piterson Francois took care of us in the VIP lounge area he was very pleasant and helpful.  Then we were excorted to our room by our butler  was Feimin Motta he took very good care of us for 5 days.  He went over and beyond for our group. I will be requesting Feimin every time I stay at this resort he gave us the best service ever no matter how many times we called he always arrived with a smile.

rm# 2086

reviews.author: Jean K
reviews.title: Outstanding Service!
reviews.text: I stayed at The Reserve at the Paradisus for my first trip to Punta Cana and had a wonderful experience.  The hotel was beautiful, clean and very quiet (Sept 13 - 20th).  There were plenty of restaurants to choose from and a variety of excellent food.  The best part of the trip was the staff, so friendly and helpful.  They were truly what made the experience a great one.  Luis Santana and Santos Polanco took care of us poolside every day.  Once they learned our schedule they anticipated our every need. They were both so pleasant and we had many great discussions about the DR. Next there was our tireless fitness / activity director, Ruben Castillo....what a blast we had with him.  His energy is infectious.  And last, but not least....Yadilky Mercedes....the sweetest, most pleasant person, who greeted us each day with a hug and a smile and made sure we had everything we needed. There were many other great staff...too many to name...who made our entire week one of the most relaxing and enjoyable vacations ever!

reviews.author: Pirata1934
reviews.title: One of our favorite vacations ever
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at Paradisus Punta Cana the reserve. We checked in with Elaidy Montero who helped us with all our questions and when we weren't fully satisfied with our initial room (  no one had stayed in it for a while and it was dusty) she accommodated us right away and moved us to another beautiful room. Adalgisa who is one on the friendliest concierge ever escorted us to our room and was always there if we needed help or advice on what to do or where to go. We ended up getting a family concierge, Hairol was super friendly and helpful setting up activities and reservations at all the restaurants as well as checking in with us constantly to see if there was anything we needed he would get our daughter a nice treat each evening which scored major brownie points with her. The concierge in our building Iris Soriano was always very friendly greeting us with a big smile and helping us with any questions we had. The hostess at Gabi Rosalba Columna and Daniella Castillo were always very friendly and always got us a table close to the pool were we would get a nice breeze while we ate. The waiters at Gabi Ramon Simbert, Jose Reinoso, Adalberto Herrera & our buddy Anthony Cid who took care of anything and everything we needed were great Anthony went out of his way to make us feel welcome. If you need anything while you're by the pool the guy at the grill Melvin  is always ready to whip something up quick and with a smile. While you're sitting by the pool make sure to see Emilo Valdes who is awesome! He treated us like gold and never let my "Emilio Special" run dry. His smile and great attitude made my day everyday. We had a great meal at Mole thanks to Leidy Rodrigues who was very pleasant. The hostess at Vento Katherine Sanchez was also very helpful and accommodating even when we were a "couple " of minutes late for dinner. We also had a great massage at the Yhi spa. Roselina  Del Rosario was great in helping us select what we wanted and scheduling my wife and I for the best reflexology and full body message ever given by Olga Perez. Berlis at kid zone was great with making our daughter feel right at home and relaxed. Isidra de Oca from club Melia was great and was very helpful with all our questions and any needs we had. We also had the pleasure of meeting Juan the club Melia driver who was just a phone call away whenever we needed  to get around the resort.  Overall we had a very pleasant experience and will be back. The beach is amazing with with white powder sand and you can't go wrong getting a drink and laying out in the sun. Thanks for everything everyone. The Mencia family

reviews.author: Angie C
reviews.title: Trip to Paradise
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with another couple. We both had a wonderful experience. We stayed in the Royal service with an ocean view room. Johnfi Rivera was our butler. Johnfi is very professional and did an outstanding job making our stay extra special and feel like we were the only ones he was serving. Johnfi prepared a bubble bath with flowers and candles one evening. The property was beautiful, clean and well maintained. We enjoyed all the meals we had. 
The negative was that our room a/c was not working properly but the staff worked until it was resolved. Very graciously. Also, thank you to Astrid at check in. 
The photos on their website are very accurate and  is even more beautiful in person.

reviews.author: Kristie B
reviews.title: Husband's 40th Birthday
reviews.text: I researched for months prior to selecting a hotel for my husband's 40th birthday in the Dominican Republic.  All I can say is you will not be disappointed one bit with this property! Royal Service is the way to go!! Sandy was our Butler and I cannot say enough things about his tremendous service. He took on our entire group of 13 and went above and beyond to make sure that our stay was impeccable.  He arranged the most romantic and perfect evening with dinner on the beach privately. Every detail was handled with the utmost care!! The table was adorned with lanterns, shells, and the menu was delicious! The entire staff, including the chef, joined our celebration with personal service and bright smiles that evening.  Sandy even had our area on the beach decorated with hand painted signs saying Happy Birthday and a cooler full of iced down beer, champagne, and other liquors that we had been enjoying thus far. The entire group was extremely impressed! He made our stay not only memorable, but has now set a new bar for the rest of our vacations! I also have to give major Kudos to Caesar the Room Service Manager for turning a stormy evening into one of the most memorable moments of my trip!  13 people having dinner in our suite, which was handled flawlessly! He personally walked to each of my friends and families rooms with me to take their orders. He personally delivered it all to my room and I cannot believe it was so well organized and delivered!   I would highly recommend this property. Everyone is more than happy to do anything to make your stay as perfect as possible!  My best reguards to the Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: anoblett
reviews.title: Birthday Trip w Friends and Family
reviews.text:
Great trip......great service, food, cocktails, spa/ resort and great memories! !!!!
If you do the royal service,which I highly recommend, ask for Sandy. Sandy, our group butler, went the extra mile for our rather large group. He never said no. Managed do all behind the scenes w a smile on his face all the time. When things weren't working out (like our transfer to the airport going home) he drove us himself...pretty sure that wasn't on his job title.  He had such the right temperament with a sweet sense of humor.  You could tell he enjoyed his job.
Leonardo Moto, the adult pool bar bartender in Royal Service, was attentive and remembered everyone's name.  Be careful though...he is a heck of a connect four player.  Had a crowd gathered just to see if one of the guest could beat him...happy to report my hubby was the only one THAT day.
Omar, took great care of us each day poolside to make sure our day was all set prior to stepping outside. Checking w us frequently to make sure our needs were met.  He was very friendly and had a warm smile...nice to see each day.   Highly recommend staying here if you want a trip to remember while staying in the Dominican Replublic.

reviews.author: Gladys G
reviews.title: entretenido
reviews.text:
Nos quedamos en Royal Service, donde nuestro mayordomo estuvo siempre preocupado por nosotros, me refiero a Evian, quien también nos sorprendió con un Jacuzzi, se preocupó ademas de las reservas a los restaurantes.  También nuestros agradecimientos a Leonardo Mota y a Antonio de los bares, quienes siempre atendían con una sonrisa y muy buena disposición. Mencionar también a los amables camareros del Palazzo y los otros restaurantes, quienes siempre lo hacían con mucho agrado, y a la recepcionista Stephania.
Las habitaciones muy buenas, sólo reclamar por el wifi, que costaba mucho que se conectara.
Además a pesar que pagamos más por Royal Service, el vino era en todos los restaurantes el mismo, a no ser que uno cancelara por otro mejor aparte. Mencionar también a Angel quien era el encargado de la entretención, quien siempre hacía lo que estaba a su alcance para entretener a los huéspedes,  Muy buenos los show.
En general nuestra estadía fue muy buena, lo pasamos muy bien .

reviews.author: LaMonica D
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: I went to the Dominican on Aug 27th - Sept 2nd.  Upon my arrival I read some reviews of this resort. One guy mentioned that he got sick from drinking the water.  Well when I arrived in DR, the guy on the shuttle specifically said to not drink the tap water and he mentioned that the resorts always give bottled water to their guests.  So he was wrong in writing his review.  One other person said that her diamond necklace was stolen off the dresser.  Well mostly all these resorts have safes in the rooms, why not utilize it!  This resort looks exactly like the pictures on the travel websites (expedia, bookit.com, etc).  It was beautiftul!  The people there were nice, very accomodating and attentive.  I want to recognize Angel Araujo, he worked in the area where you get the beach towels, and he was very friendly.  He also teached me a little spanish.  Emmanuel and Miquel that works in the front that help with the suitcases were awesome!  So friendly and attentive.  I will definitely visit this resort again, I had so much fun that I was sad to leave :).  My sister and I already planning to go back next year.

reviews.author: Zuly7360
reviews.title: Excellent service...far and beyond.
reviews.text: Dionisis Martinez, Juan Cabrera, Luis, Anthony, Severino, Ruth and Isabel to name a few of the folks who made this vacation worth while.  There was always a smile, there was always a willingness to serve and please.  Thank you for making this trip unforgettable.  The facility was also very nice and comfortable.

reviews.author: Angelica A
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation
reviews.text: The stay at The Reserve was really an amazing experience! The hotel is beautiful, the staff excellent, the amenities amazing! We really plan to come back with more friends and family. The only problem we had was with the internet wifi in our room which almost never worked. Other than that this is a luxury hotel experience and was worth every penny:)

reviews.author: Leticia P
reviews.title: Excelente!! Repetiria
reviews.text:
Estuvimos del 5 al 7 de septiembre en Palma Real. Excelente servicio. El personal muy dispuesto a consentir a los huespedes. Especialmente Rene García chef en Market Grill junto con Jose Mateo, Willi y Jhonny Acevedo. En el Restaurant Gabi Beach Milquiades. 
La comida y la bebida excelente y las habitaciones las mejores camas!!!!!

reviews.author: LiAussa
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise!
reviews.text: LOVED IT! My friend had her wedding here this summer and it was absolutely amazing. Nuria was the sweetest and most helpful person there! She arranged the dinner reservations at the different restaurants each night, and made sure the wedding (and the rest of the trip) went according to plan. I would love to go back and stay again. We walked along the beautiful beaches (which was connected to resort) and saw several other resorts, but Paradisus looked like it was by far the best around. No need to exchange any money when you go. The food was delicious and all inclusive, so really the only money you would need would be for tipping the staff or if you want to go off on any excursions. The entire resort is kept clean and in order and was very relaxing with calm music and the smell of incense. I was also impressed with the rooms. The bed in my room was MASSIVE! It was the size of two king beds to make one. The maids would usually come to turn your sheets and clean about twice a day, but I am convinced they must be ninjas because I never saw anyone around. If you are thinking about upgrading to royal suites and butler service, that would be your call. Some of my friends went all out, but I kept it simple. The rooms were the same either way. But if you get the butler service they give you a cell phone to use. This would come in handy if you wanted something hand delivered to you while you were on the beach, but otherwise it isn't hard to get what you want. There was always someone nearby ready to help. And don't worry if your Spanish skills are lacking, almost everyone there spoke English. Everyone I passed would greet you with an "Hola!" and seemed genuinely friendly. The pools were never crowded, and the shows at night were fun to watch! I would definitely recommend this resort to anyone traveling to the DR.

reviews.author: MikeVeloso
reviews.title: An Incredible Experience: Relaxing, Fun, Entertaining, and Friendly
reviews.text: This place was amazing!  The service, restaurants, rooms, and the all-inclusive services were incredible.  The art/drawing class and activities by the pool area were great.  The instructor Jose Luis was excellent.  He actually taught my friends and I how to draw. He was very patient and helpful as I kept asking for assistance since I am not a good painter. I never imagined myself sitting along the pool in an art class. My friends and I will definitely go back. As a matter of fact, we are already planning something for March 2015.

reviews.author: Tennis8640
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Amazing resort Juan de Leon was our butler and he did an excellent job. Went above and beyond our expectations. The beach was great and the restaurants superb. I would recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: tharealist
reviews.title: First time at an all-inclusive....SOLD!
reviews.text:
A beautiful resort. I am glad that I have started my all-inclusive exploration with an excellent hotel like the Paradisus Palma Real.

I paid for the basic all inclusive package (i.e no royal service, reserve, etc) and I don't think I would if I returned. I was extremely happy with all the basic services offered and took advantage of many of them. 

Pros (no particular order):

1. Many facilities (including restaurants) are shared between the Reserve and Palma Real. For example, I frequently went to the wellness centre during my stay.  You can use facilities at the reserve (I took spinning classes in the morning, tennis in the afternoon). 

We booked reservations for dinner at Aqua (located at the reserve) even though we stayed at the palma real and there were no issues.

2. rooms are spacious, clean, comfortable, kinda chilly though with high AC. nice jacuzzi.

3. food selection was wonderful and I am a pescatarian. My favourite place to eat was the Market Grill.  They are open 24hrs. Vento was great.

4. Extremely warm, friendly staff. Lovely people all around.

5. STUNNING views and beachfront. White sand was magnificent and I would spent entire days laid up in a cabana just marveling at the site of it all.

6. Very classy.  I highly recommend this place for newlyweds, families, young professionals.  Not too much of a "young college kid" crowd which was great. Low key, elegant.

7.  Very courteous staff.  I felt pampered.  Be sure to tip  generously as they clearly work extremely hard to make your stay enjoyable.

Cons

1. Had to call a few times to finally get the wifi to work in my room.  Hotel needs to get on top of this.  Its annoying.

2. I got sick on my last evening at the hotel. I hope the hotel is making ice for their drinks with filtered water. I have a feeling that not doing so may have been the culprit possibly along with what i ate.  Plenty of wedding guests got sick too. My stomach turns when I think of the last meal I had at the resort (pad thai at the bistro).

3. Making dinner reservations is a bit frustrating.  We never got the time slot that we wanted. However, food was good.

4. Unfortunately, I found that the quality and serving size of plated dinners for private events were simply not as good as the a la carte restaurants or buffet for that matter.  I attended two private events at the Palma Real and was not impressed.  Our group literally went to the market grill afterward and ate.  Just a note to those people thinking about holding private events certain dishes are not made in the traditional way (e.g. vegetable lasagna was not made with "normal" lasagna noodles.

Tips:

1.  I got a nice post-workout massage from fitness instructors at the resort.  Tip handsomely. No need for me to use the spa...it was that good. Just ask.

2. Take advantage of the included activities (e.g. kickboxing, tennis, basketball, etc).  The instructors will work with you to meet fitness goals and go above and beyond to educate you and provide you with extra/extended services that may not be included in 1 hour lessons.  Just talk to them, everyone there is relaxed and friendly.

3. I hated the sweet "dominican" style ketchup served at buffets.  I just got some mini heinz bottles from room service and would bring that with me to lunch for burgers, hotdogs, fries, etc.

4. Don't waste your money at the gift shop. When approaching the beachfront from the main pool area, make a left and walk all the way down the beach (pass the melia, gabi beach, etc) until you hit an indoor market (10 minute walk).  Haggle all you want for sourvenirs, jewellery, alcohol, etc. Its fun, you directly assist local business and you will save a tonne of cash.  Bring money and some patience.

5. Check out the evening shows, they are worth it.

6. Ask one of the groundskeepers outside wearing green to get you a fresh coconut to drink from off the trees. Tip well!!  Not sure if they are actually allowed to do this but money talks people!

Classy environment and wonderful experience overall.   WILL DEFINITELY RETURN !

reviews.author: Catherine P
reviews.title: All I can say is LUIS SANTANA is the best!
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, Luis Santana the waiter on the beach was excellent! He was super attentive, sweet and always welcoming! He helped with everything from getting drinks, towels and providing great conversation and service. He is truly one of a kind! If you come to this resort, make sure to ask for Luis...you won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Kurt S
reviews.title: Would not return
reviews.text: 1) The food was not worth the additional money spent for all-inclusive. 2). There are several restaurants on the property that require a reservation.  First, it is difficult to obtain a reservation, you have to go to the concierge in the morning, stand in line, and the wait until they get the reservation department on the phone (~20 minute wait).  However, there are 3 restaurants that never had availability, which was frustrating.  We ate at the Japanese steakhouse, Thai restaurant, and sushi restaurant.  The food at the Thai restaurant was decent.  The other two restaurants did not provide good food.  And the service at the sushi restaurant was terrible.  It was an approximately 2.5 hour meal. 3) the property is undergoing a major renovation and we experienced the sounds of jack hammering throughout the day. 4) the wifi service is awful, so if you need to check email or other work related items, this is problematic.

reviews.author: Nicole B
reviews.title: Relaxing trip could have been better
reviews.text: Not quite a 4-5 star yet. I  stayed there in July and at first we started off great at the reserve which was outstanding. The reserve Palma reel is a 5 star. We made the mistake and upgraded. The casino didn't open until our last day but no one told us that.  The activites were great and the food was ok. I do not recommend you up grade to Royal service being a traveler it was not up to the standards I get at other resorts. I must say our Butler Juan Castillo turned my bad experience into a great experience.  If Juan was not my butler this review would have changed. The reserve hotel is newer and nicer, the main hotel needs some up grading rooms were older. If there WiFi worked it would have been an awesome experience.  The manager Carmen went out of her way to make the trip a great one.  So I really can't say negative things because they tried to fix and did all the issues we had. Punta Cana was fun for 7 days but we will go some where else were customer service is top priority from all not just the Butler.

reviews.author: DonatoTrips
reviews.title: Cena Fantastica al Ristorante Palazzo
reviews.text:
Devo fare i miei Ringraziamenti al Direttore Generale del hotel Belen De Martinez per l'invito a visitare l'hotel !!! Grazie Belen.
Il Paradisus Palma Real e' fantastico e la sua struttura e' veramente impressionante con uno stile giovane e affascinante, abbiamo visitato sia la Hall centrale che tutti i Ristoranti compreso la parte Family conciergie e Royal Service e anche il bellissimo teatro e devo dire che siamo rimasti io e mia moglie molto impressionati positivamente, infatti secondo noi le foto in internet non gli danno giustizia. Devo anche dire che io è mia moglie abbiamo già' visto gli altri tre Hotel Paradisus esistenti (Paradisus Cancun,Paradisus Playa del Carmen e Paradisus Punta Cana) e questo e' uno dei migliori ha una qualità di servizio e la struttura paragonabile all'ultimo Paradisus Costruito(Playa Del Carmen). Abbiamo cenato al ristorante Palazzo nella zona Royal Service e devo dire che è come aver mangiato in uno dei ristoranti migliori nel centro della mia città ( Milano), un Grosso Grazie a Charly per la creazione del nostro menù speciale e la scelta di un ottimo vino della Nuova Zelanda Pinot nero era fantastico sei il migliore !!! Grazie anche per il servizio a tavola e' stato impeccabile.Vi consiglio vivamente questo splendido hotel come tutti Paradisus. Belen ancora grazie della tua ospitalità e per l'affetto Vero che ci dimostri ogni volta che ci vediamo e' stata una serata di vita Indimenticabile per Me' è Sonia anche per Vincenzo ed Anita, ci rivedremo molto presto.I Tuoi Amici Donato Conte - Sonia Dalle Crode.

reviews.author: Zoila O
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Very good service,  chef ceasar was great, and everyone was very friendly. The owner of the restaurant,  Geraldo was also fantastic. Sandy, Francisco, Pedro Sedano, Franklin, and the pool staff were all great too. Thank you for the attention and service from the families of Raul Busquet and Jose Orts.

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: VP RF Orchids Inc.
reviews.text: Had a great time!!!  The ambiance was like visiting a palace, the guest service was awesome, great customer service. Especially at the beach bar with Ramon Fuego n Starky Valoy went out of there way to accomidate us in our needs a made us feel at home. The variety of food was amazing but not my to my taste buds. Other than that it was a amazing!

reviews.author: Nicole B
reviews.title: Very poor experience
reviews.text: Too many room issue that were not handled efficiently.   Food was terrible an left in the sun uncovered and unrefrigerated at the buffets. Service was extremely poor and people were rude.  The man grilling chicken at the lunch buffet rolled his eyes at people asking for chicken. Unbelievable.

reviews.author: Raf9dejulio
reviews.title: hace honor a su nombre!!
reviews.text: Excelente atención y tranquilidad en la estadía, muy completas las habitaciones, muy buen servicio. El personal super atento, en cada lugar del hotel están a tu servicio con la mejor buena voluntad y siempre una sonrisa. Bien logrados los espacios, los jardines siempre perfectos, limpieza y prolijidad. La comida muy variada y buena, siempre fresca, con muchas opciones. Las bebidas y tragos preparados impecablemente para no parar de tomar!!!! La playa siempre limpia, con sus toallas, como también en la piscina. Entretenimiento muy bueno, con shows variados y atractivos. Buena atención de José Manuel Fernández del equipo de entretenimiento y los mozos de Gabi Club que hasta por nombre te saludan siempre y recuerdan las preferencias de los clientes. Para resumir, excelente servicio, atención y descanso.....Muy Recomendable!!!

reviews.author: Lance R
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: Just returned from a weeks vacation with friends and I have nothing but positives to say about our stay.  The service was superb, the rooms immaculate and the food equally as impressive.  Can't see myself staying anywhere else when traveling to Punta Cana.  Special thanks to Francisco, Rachel, Leo, Caridol, Sandyand the dance crew for teaching me to dance Latin style.  Highly recommend this resort if you are looking for relaxation, elegance & excellent service. Will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Inna S
reviews.title: Только положительные эмоции
reviews.text:
Шикарный отель,отличное обслуживание.

Персонал адекватный, адаптирован под иностранных клиентов,в том числе есть русскоговорящие
питание на 5 с+
У отеля свой выход на пляж(чистый и ухоженный)
P.S. Лучше брать номер на 1 этаже.есть своя терраса

reviews.author: Marjorie E
reviews.title: Stay at The Reserve!
reviews.text: The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real is fabulous and we will certainly go back. Definitely stay at The Reserve portion even if you don't have kids. It's much more private and upscale. The staff and the spa are awesome. Only criticism would be internet in the room was pretty bad (although it was fine in the business center as a work around) and some restaurants have dress codes for men (long pants and closed toe shoes). We only packed nice shorts and were turned away. Wish we'd known so we could have packed differently. Overall it was an amazing experience! Definitely great for a family or adult vacation.

reviews.author: Miguel Angel D
reviews.title: El mejor hotel que he estado en mi vida
reviews.text:
Estuve alojado en Royal Service con un amigo, y sinceramente, la experiencia ha sido extraordinaria. El hotel es precioso, tranquilo y tiene todo lo que quieras y de una excelente calidad. Es cierto que nos pillo la reconstrucción del restaurante principal, pero la oferta es tan variada que no cabe la queja.
El servicio, la comida, las instalaciones... todo es una autentica maravilla. He estado en otros hoteles de todo incluido, pero este supera ámpliamente las expectativas que tenia.

reviews.author: laurabuenosaires19
reviews.title: Para regresar
reviews.text:
Muy buen servicio el Royal Service. Una excelente propuesta si estas buscando descansar, buen servicio,  calidad en la comida y mucha profesionalidad en todo el personal que lo asiste durante las vacaciones. Para remarcar los camareros del lounge del Royal Service,  especialmente Piterson Francois. 
La zona de playa es muy buena y sus camareros tambien. Francisco Gil gracias.

reviews.author: Анастасия Р
reviews.title: Маленький рай на земле
reviews.text: Самый чудесный отель во все мире! Пожалуй лучший, из тех, где я. Успела побывать. Рекомендую всем, хоть раз в жизни посетить эту чудесную страну, и почувствовать все прелести этой жизни. В этом отеле есть все для прекрасного отдыха!

reviews.author: pedro luis r
reviews.title: my room service
reviews.text: we were in the royal service for months and we find the gods of service remember as today the excellent service provided by the oarlocks of room service pedro reyes and nicolas . Two young with espiritud service, thanks Peter and nicolas hope see you soon ........ ¿¿

reviews.author: landa930
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned last night from the most amazing vacation we've ever experienced.   The service is outstanding and the atmosphere was like paradise.   The grounds were well kept and the food was awesome.  We celebrated our 16th wedding anniversary there, he couldn't have picked a better place.   I posted a few photos on Facebook now all of our friends want to go. LOL.   Needless to say I am in the processes of planning a group trip for 2015.

reviews.author: L M
reviews.title: Damp cold rooms, even in the Royal Suites!
reviews.text: We stayed in what we were told were the exclusive Royal Suites where we had a full time butler.  The suite was damp constantly.  At first we thought they gave us sheets that were not fully dried so we asked for new sheets.  They gave us the sheets and they were still feeling wet and cold.  The rooms need a de-humidifier.  The restaurants were all very bland.  The value of price for what you get is not very good.  Our suite was about $800 per  night.  The furnishings were not the best, the internet was not the best and a cold wet room doesn't feel like luxury to me.  The staff was pleasant however.

reviews.author: Debbie W
reviews.title: **THEFT OUT OF SAFES IS A PROBLEM**
reviews.text: Ditto to all the other reviews: it's beautiful, the rooms are nice, the food is "meh" as my kids would say, the staff if friendly...but don't turn your back on them.  Our friends took $1,500 and it was STOLEN FROM A LOCKED SAFE in their room.  (Police were called...nothing will ever come of it.) So the folks across the hall rigged their safe with a piece of tape, then folded up an enveloped which they placed in the safe in a certain way....and later they found the tape seal had been broken, and the envelope had been moved...from their locked safe.  DO NOT TAKE CASH, GOLD OR JEWELRY...THINGS THAT CAN BE EASILY PAWNED.  Take your own box that you can lock yourself, and put that inside your safe.  Fortunately for us, my husband kept his cash in his pockets and neither of us took any expensive jewelry.  I was told by one worker that my $600 phone would be worth $2,500-$3,000 there.  So, keep an eye on your phones, too.

reviews.author: Jaye0721
reviews.title: "Amazing Experience"
reviews.text: This resort was totally amazing.  I went for my 50th birthday with some girlfriends.  The buffet food was great but the restaurants were just ok.  I didn't like the Japanese restaurant at all.  The food wasn't good and the service was really slow.  We stayed at The Reserve and our room was amazing!  We had two double beds, balcony, living room, dining room and a small kitchen with a refrigerator.  The bathroom has two sinks (yay) and a great shower & large sunk in tub.  The pool area was very clean and all of the staff was friendly and polite.  We did water aerobatics,  a spin class in the pool.  They had a casino (I won $20) and a fun disco.  The Michael Jackson show was really fun too!  Now the beaches.....we had to walk or take a tram car to the beach - I wasn't happy about that a first, but he landscape is so beautiful I didn't mind walking and taking pictures.  The sand was clean, the water was very blue and the service at The Reserve beach was amazing.  We had a "drink runner" named Maiker Ramirez aka:  Mikey Mikey Drinky Drink...what a great guy.  He spoke very good English, very fun, polite and accommodating.  He set up our chairs, umbrellas and most of all served us great drinks.  If you go there & want great service ask for Mikey Mikey - you won't be disappointed.  I will definitely return to this resort.

reviews.author: Jamba T
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Mint facilities.
Great service in most areas.
Personal attention for accidents was great.
Restaurant reservations system was annoying, needs lots of improvement.
Lack of elevators and long distances could be a problem for older people.

reviews.author: Lisa A
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: Going to this resort in the off season was perfect. Not overly crowed. Very large property but not so large that you get lost. We upgraded to the Royal Service and our butler Faustino Ramos was the best. Miss him so much. I wish we could have brought him back with us. All the staff were so friendly and always remembered your name. Anything you wanted just ask and they made it happen. I got lobster in bed one night because I was too tired from our day trip to go to the restaurant. I even came to the room one night and had a flower layden jacuzzi bubble bath waiting. We checked out some of the other resorts in the area and none compared. If you go to this resort and upgrade to the Royal Service ask for Faustino....I can't say enough about him.

reviews.author: nancy m
reviews.title: Wonderful and memorable trip
reviews.text: We arrived June 6 2014 and departed June 2014. The beach, water sports and food were outstanding!!!  We live in the states and found the food to be like a 5 star hotel. Rooms nice and clean!!  The service was prompt, polite and the butler Juan De Leon was available 24-7!!!!!!!  Ready to return.

reviews.author: altair36
reviews.title: El "paradisus" sin duda.
reviews.text:
Bonito, acogedor y espectacular hotel, desde sus habitaciones y su piscina hasta la playa con una serie de privilegios The Reserve.Muy buena decoracion y funcionalidad de sus habitaciones, los restaurantes, el servicio de la piscina y de la playa.
El equipo de animación y la fiesta de la playa merecen una mención especial. Al igual que la mayoria del personal que trabaja en restauantes, lobby, bar.....te hacen sentir realmente bien.
Para mi que conozco mas hoteles de Punta Cana, este es sin duda uno de los mejores.

reviews.author: Vicki B
reviews.title: Awesome trip
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful time, service was great and maiker Rameriz at Gabi beach was the best waiter and really made our time there fun!! The staff at the resort was so helpful and the pools were amazing, food was good, some of the restaurants were not so great but love the buffet choices. 
Over all it was a hit for the birthday celebration for my friend! I think everyone there knew the five laughing loud women!!! Thank u

reviews.author: Tami M
reviews.title: Hidden Treasure
reviews.text:
As a short flight from Miami, this was truly a find! 

Royal Service is the ONLY way to go.

Guarantees for dinner reservations, pool and beach side lounges/with service, private QUIET pools and Restaurant, as well as the opportunity for contact via cell phone at any time. Augustin, the assigned Butler was top-notch.  Each restaurant we chose was clean, accomodating, different and memorable. The staff can not do enough to be sure you are enjoying and relaxing.

Alexander Guzman/Clara Nunez at Palazzo restaurant made each breakfast relaxed and fun, and remembering your requests, upon your arrival, makes one feel special!!  
The ultimate dining experience at Passion made this vacation even more memorable, what a delicious and festive evening, from the moment of entry to the departure, the staff could not have been more attentive, but NOT overbearing.

The ONLY comment on the negative side is the way the bathroom is designed. WIth OPEN shutters, it is really NOT private from living space, however, the only time in the room was to shower, so it will not have any effect on visiting again.

I would highly recommend a visit! 
Maybe I will see you there when I go back in a few months!!

reviews.author: Nikki T
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience!
reviews.text:
I had a a fabolous time at the Paridisus and felt like I was in Paradise.  I had the Royal Service and my butlers Juan and Jose were great.  The food and decor was fantastic! 
The pools were clean and beaches with private cabanas helped me relax in my well needed vacation.

You should visit all of the restaurants which offered exquisite cuisine choices!

reviews.author: Burberrybaglady13
reviews.title: I have been proven WRONG!!!
reviews.text: A couple of years ago I wrote a review about my HELLISH vacation to Punta Cana DR. My family and I (husband and ten year old daughter) stayed at Moon Palace.  HORRIFIC!  I vowed never to return to Punta Cana....until this May when one of my best friends daughter got married at Pardisus Real.  Talk about night and day!!!! I had the BEST vacation I've EVER had in my life!  Take into account that the wedding party was about 75 people...a lot who had never been out of the country let alone to and all inclusive....A BLAST!!!!! The hotel is gorgeous. The beach is gorgeous. The staff if fantastic!  I have forgotten the name of the staf member who does most of the activities....water aerobics, evening dancing etc, but he was unbelievable! I'll remember and update this post!  The rooms were awesome. Always cleaned and stocked. Our maid must have been a Ninja she was that good. We got in on a late flight for the wedding (same day-with a two hour window). The staff put us in a room and drive like Mario Andrede to get us to the meet place for the wedding.
