Only (very minor negative) making reservations for dining got to be a pain. Didn't get to try every restaurant cause they were often full. Still looking forward to going back to eat everywhere!!!! Pardisus.... We LOVE you!!!

reviews.author: Jackie C
reviews.title: PARAISO TERRENAL
reviews.text: La mezcla de sol, arena, playa, palmas, buena comida, bebida, entretenimiento, buenas instalaciones fisica, fueron la conjugacion para pasar de jueves a domingo hace dos semanas compartiendo con un grupo de profesionales un Congreso Internacional de Actualizacion Financiera.

reviews.author: Jamila C
reviews.title: Terrible Royal Service Reservation Staff
reviews.text:
I would love to give this hotel a 5 because it's extremely beautiful, however, because of the incompetence of the reservation staff, my trip started off on a sour note. 

When I got there, the reservation staff didn't make any reservation for me, even though I received a confirmation in April. I traveled from July 23-27. The representative I was stuck with, Astrid, was not helpful and at some points rude. She refused to accept that the staff screwed up and wanted to charge me more money for a larger room that I didn't ask for because the forgot to book the room I originally asked for. I asked for a manager and she refused to get one. No one else who was there could help. It was a mess. When the issue was finally resolved (not to my liking), I spent about 3 hours disputing with them. Of course I emailed the manager when I returned, but to no surprise, there was no response. Which basically reflects on why this staff is so incompetent. 

Moving on, the only perk I realized that the Royal Service package have is for the Palazzo restaurant, a pool that has no screaming kids, and top shelf liquor which is only given to you if you asked. We had a butler named Alvaro.  We rarely saw him, but he did do our reservations that we requested and brought fruits to the room. We actually received more help and attention from Franklin, who was not our butler, but way more attentive and sweet. If you get him, you are in good hands. 

The Palazzo had the best breakfast, lunch, and dinner. And it was the only place where wifi worked because it definitely did not work in the room. The waiters were all nice. Especially Hosse and Francis. It was the best perk about Royal Service. 

The bar by the adult pool had the best bartender in the hotel named Leonardo. Leonardo made my drinks with love and gave me a flower everyday. He was a real sweetheart and you would be good in his hands. My other favorite bartender, because he was so funny was Liony.  He was another sweetheart and made great drinks. 

The nightclub was something to do after hours. The DJ will play your requests, but do not expect any mixing. He'll play the song and walk away. Caesar was the bouncer for the club and excellent at his job. He's another great employee that was extremely helpful. 

I think the other best place besides the palazzo to eat was the lobster tails at the Gaby Beach Restaurant. Everyone who was working there was great and the Lobster tail was delicious. 

For the place to be so beautiful, the place lacks music. No music by the bar. No music by the pool.  Dominican Republic has a bunch of wonderful music and it was so bland during the day. Yes, adults would like to relax, but relaxing does not mean not having fun. 

I would love to recommend this place, however, I would not want anyone to go through the horrors of the reservation staff like I did.

reviews.author: Tommie797
reviews.title: Great Staff!!!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at The Gabi Beach Restaurants the staff lead by Martires Acosta and 
Mailenis Diaz are the best they are so warm and made you feel so comfortable soon has you walk in.  Paradisus Punta Cana Resort is the best?????

reviews.author: Laura D
reviews.title: Excellent experience.
reviews.text: A friend and I went to the Paradisus Palma Real for a girl's getaway from July 17-22  2014. We are busy working moms and booked the Royal Service. We were treated like royalty from the moment we arrived until our departure. We had an ocean front room close to the beach with a beautiful view. Our butler, Fermin, had wine and cheese and fruits upon our arrival. We were provided with a cell phone to call him at any time we needed anything. Martin, at the beach area was super attentive, getting our chairs close to the water and getting the coconut guy to provide us with fresh coconut water from freshly picked coconuts on the property. We had great weather and the breeze made it very comfortable. Omar, in the Royal Service lounge was very helpful as well. Wi-Fi service was spotty in the room at times, so we went to the Royal Service lounge to have better access. The lounge is equipped with computers and staff that are very helpful. Fermin suggested we try the various restaurants for dinner, and we had great meals at Bento and the Asian fusion restaurants. We also booked massages from the Yhi Spa and received wonderful treatments. The location on a great beach, service, and wonderful staff made our stay truly relaxing and memorable. I highly recommend this resort. I have been to many resorts in the DR, and this was by far, my best experience.

reviews.author: wayno_w
reviews.title: Got back a lost day thanks to Marcos Florentino, Vladimir, and Omar Hernandez, Thanks !
reviews.text:
Package deals are good until the plane breaks down and you lose a day. We missed the first night at Paradissus due to mechanical failure on plane. It took some discussion with the staff but it was worth it. The hotel added an extra day for us. Thanks to the friendly staff at Paradisus, Vladimir and Marcos (customer service managers),  and Omar , who keeps the communication going in the business center so I could call U.S. and use internet. 

One thing though, we had petty cash for tips not locked in the safe and it was stolen from the room. About 170 dollars. 
This was disheartening as you want a place you trust completely. Unfortunately this was not the case. We will lock even small cash up next time. WiFI is weak in rooms but good at business center.
The bartenders were also very nice and service was great. wish we had the money to tip them. Sorry guys and girls. We will be back .

reviews.author: C Q
reviews.title: impressive setting let down by inefficient management
reviews.text: A veautiful lication and stunning buildings on the surface, the Palma Paradisus resort suffers from piirly irganized and traibed staff. The staff are unflaggingly cheerful and eager to help,  but they have not geen provided the training or freedom  to improve a very inefficient and frustrating system.  Restaurant reservations are a complete fiasco, but required for the most desirable dining options. Every time we requested one, ut was recorded in a nitebook and we were informed it would be taken care if. Not once did we get a scheduled time within 90 minutes of our request. And usually we were not notified. Once we were notufued at 6:30 pm that our requested reservation was set at 6:00 pm. What? They have computers but thus process is apparently done by phone with no one overseeing the process at either end.

reviews.author: jmf528
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel and Wonderful Time....EXCEPT
reviews.text:
As a travel agent I have been to many hotels and this hotel is one of the most beautiful I have been to.  There were 8 traveling in our group - all travel agents.  We didn't expect, nor did we want special treatment as we were on vacation.

Overall:  The hotel itself is simply stunning.  As soon as you walk in the main lobby your jaw drops.  The pool is large, clean and clear.  The beach was clean and had plenty of chairs for everyone.  Our room was beautiful and clean. The food was great.  Staff is very friendly and everything/everyone we encountered was a joy.

In detail:

Hotel itself - staff was very nice, everyone said hello and we were pleasantly surprised.  We have been to hotels on other islands who really could care less about you but the staff here seemed very eager to please and went out of their way.  KUDOS to everyone who we encountered....by name:  Jimmy Garcia and N. Torres who were bar tenders that served the best drinks!  

Rooms:  Always cleaned, water was hot and plentiful for showers/baths, refrigerator restocked continually and the view was pretty.  We were on the ground floor and overlooked the wedding pavilion. And important to note:  NO BUGS.  I hate going to a hotel to have a bunch of mosquitoes, flies, gnats, etc.  There were no bugs anywhere.

Pool/Beach:  Other than the reeds/grass washing up in the surf the beach was beautiful.  No trash anywhere.  Lots of lounge chairs/huts for everyone.  The pool was simply huge with plenty of lounge chairs and huts for shade.  The swim up bar was always busy and the bartenders there were GREAT.  We spent most of our time in the pool.  Be aware the pool is right around 4.5 feet throughout.  There is NO shallow end but there are is a kiddie pool.   Bring your own rafts/inner tubes or they sell them in the gift shop.

Breakfast/Lunch:  We enjoyed breakfast and lunch daily and the food was great.  Everything cooked to perfection.  The omelette bar was a high point and delicious.  Breakfast and Lunch were served buffet style and either in the Market Grill or in Bana and there was always plenty of food.  The waiters were always at our table bringing drinks and very nice.

Dinner:  DISASTER....getting reservations for dinner was where we and many other travelers have problems.  You are told when you check in to make dinner reservations but the people (except for one) at the desk made you sit and wait.  Every restaurant is always "full" and you get stuck at eating at 9pm HOWEVER the restaurants are always empty.  One poor woman got stuck eating sushi 3 nights in a row and was in tears trying to book someplace different.

The first night luckily we had friends who were already there and had reservations for us...if they didn't we would have had to order room service or not eat which was the case for many travelers.  The buffet was closed for updating and won't open until October/November so you HAD to eat at one of the restaurants or order room service or go off property. This was the main complaint of everyone we encountered.  On average we spent 3-4 hours a DAY dealing with the headache of trying to get reservations, waiting to hear if we got confirmed and just being completely stressed out.  Mind you we didn't expect any special treatment being travel agents but we did expect to be able to eat dinner without any hassles or stress.

We managed to get reservations for days 2 and 3.  Day 4 we waited over an hour while they helped others who were tipping.   Finally we went to the assistant hotel manager who assured us he would take care of our reservations and did get us into a restaurant that night.  Day 5 - no reservations so we went and found the assistant again and managed to get dinner HOWEVER they let us know at 7 that our reservations were for 7pm so we had to scramble and rush.  Day 6 - same thing until we got fed up by 6pm and tracked down the hotel manager and told him the problem.  Day 7 we had reservations we were notified at 5:45 that our reservations were for 6:30 but Day 8 ... 7pm still no reservations.  We finally got fed up and were going to demand to be seated but the restaurant was "full" with empty seats so the manager sent us to another restaurant.   This was the ONLY problem we encountered in our 9 day stay.

Room Service - food was actually pretty good and came hot.  Took around 45 minutes but was good.

The restaurants:
Bana - has 3 restaurants in it:  Hibachi, Asian Fusion and Sushi....the food was GREAT and I highly recommend the fried ice cream :)  The Asian Fusion was on the spicy side but still delicious.

Market Grille - great dinners - steak and lobster type of meals.  Market Grille is an open air venue

Aqua (located in the Reserve) - Italian and very delicious one of the best meals we had during our stay.

Misu (located in the Reserve) - another Hibachi type BUT they serve a tasting menu and you don't get to pick - we preferred the Hibachi at the main resort.

Gabi Beach - good and served nice food.  This is where we ate on our last night.  The menu is priced and on the higher end as compared to the food we received.  Pasta, Steak, Seafood, and a variety served here.

Entertainment:  They had shows every night that were very nice.  Cirque type show, Michael Jackson Experience, some sort of light show, and one night had local vendors come and set up tables for shopping.

Not much for children to do there but swim.  They had daily activities set up:  painting, drawing, exercise, sushi making, etc but other than that, not much for kids to do.

Gym - clean and up to date equipment.  A coupe in our group used the gym and liked it.

Nightclub - opened at 11pm and was hopping every night

Excursion desks - always had people there and a lot of excursions offered.  We booked our dive through the Costco desk and it was very good.  They were professional and even helped me make a call the day before we left so I could verify our transfers for the next day.

They were very busy with weddings and did a great job setting them up at the pavilion and on the beach.

The spa was great, a couple of us in the group had massages on the beach and simply loved it.

We did do an excursion and completed our open water dives for PADI certification at VIP Dives.  Some of our group went to the mall located just outside the resort area and did some shopping.

All in all it was a great experience.  

NOW:  would I go back - YES because I know how the reservation disaster works...would I recommend my clients go - that's a hard one.  My clients would love it if they got the dinner reservation disaster straightened up but I would have a hard time trying to explain to them how it works and they would get very frustrated.  I would tell them if they went to get the Royal Service so their butler would make the reservations for them so they wouldn't have the nightmare we had to deal with.

Even when you got to the desk at 8am to make your reservations for that night you are NOT guaranteed to have reservations until they slip it under your door.  So if you make reservations for 6:30 they may or may not let you know by 6.  If they do you are scrambling to shower and change for dinner.  It is a very stressful system they have and very frustration because they will tell you the restaurants are booked for your time but when you walk by they are completely empty so it is frustrating.

reviews.author: EduardoSouza
reviews.title: Excelente local para férias de praia
reviews.text: As instalações do hotel são excelentes. Os quartos do The Reserve, segundo informação do hotel, são padronizados. O quarto estava dividido em sala com TV, frigobar, sofá-cama; varanda; quarto de dormir com uma cama ótima; banheira de hidromassagem; banheiro amplo e confortável. O hotel oferece um pequeno cassino, espetáculos diários, música ao vivo, quadras de tênis e paddle, grandes piscinas, atividades para crianças, serviço de praia, etc.... No sistema que adotam, com tudo incluído, os hóspedes acabam passando a maior parte do tempo nas dependências do hotel. A comida dos buffets pode ser classificada como boa, mas não segue um padrão, há alguns itens muito bons e outros que deixam a desejar, mas sempre há algo bom para comer, em razão da grande variedade. Os restaurantes que dependem de reserva nem sempre estão disponíveis, e apresentaram um padrão um pouco inferior do que eu esperava, e são melhores que os buffets. A atenção do pessoal, em regra, é muito boa, e as dependências do hotel muito bem cuidadas. Considerando que quem busca o turismo num local como Punta Cana está em busca de praia e belas paisagens, o hotel é privilegiado. Durante minha estada o hotel não estava lotado, o que favoreceu o acesso aos serviços de um modo geral, imagino que com o hotel lotado o conforto não seja o mesmo. Paguei um preço promocional, com desconto de 25%, e achei o valor justo. Se tivesse pago o preço cheio e o hotel estivesse lotado, acredito que não teria a mesma satisfação. Minha sugestão, portanto, é fugir da alta temporada.

reviews.author: Shelli C
reviews.title: 2nd Time at PPR
reviews.text:
Just returned from our stay at Paradisus Palma Real 7/9-7/16. This was our 4th time to Punta Cana and our 2nd stay at PPR, and I was reminded again why we chose it over the others.  We booked Royal Service again and I can see why those who don't have RS may not have the same experience.  Without RS, you have fewer restaurant options and are limited on dining times and how far in advance you can book, and of course you don't get butler assistance to help with reservations.  The RS rooms are centrally located to everything.  We were in Rms. 1084, 1085, 1086 and the location was ideal.  We never had to walk far for anything.  You have access to RS pool and beach area, private lounge, etc.  I would not want to go without RS.  In my opinion, it was worth the extra money.

With RS, you are assigned a butler, and we were lucky enough to get Joanna.  She was fantastic!  We were given a dedicated cell phone to contact her, and every time we called she answered promptly and took care of our every request.  She handled all of our dinner resv, including an off property restaurant and some last minute changes, arranging spa appts, golf tee times, transportation, reserving pool palapas, etc. and even some things we didn't request (i.e. bubble baths, evening snacks sent to our room, etc.)  I can't say enough about Joanna.  She was personable, funny yet professional.  She exceeded our expectations.  Thanks Joanna for helping to make our stay so great! 

We spent some time at RS pool and some at main pool.  Francisco at RS pool was great.  Luis, bartender at main pool, was like having a pool butler.  He took care of us, helped us with getting a palapa each day, entertained everyone and was always smiling.  He would make a great butler!

The facilities are great, especially for AI.  The grounds are beautiful and very well maintained, the rooms are spacious and comfortable, the pools clean, etc.  The beach is soft, white sand and water calm enough to swim.  Since our last stay, they have moved the nightly live music from the lobby bar to the courtyard near the avenue bar, which was so much better.  You can sit outside, enjoy the music and feel the ocean breeze.  Each night, Ana took care of our drinks and she did a great job.  She was always there when we needed her and was so pleasant.  Best wishes to Ana on her upcoming baby in Sept!

The only area that was not consistent was food.  Some restaurants are good and some need improvement.  We enjoyed Gabi Beach and Vento the most.  Breakfast at Palazzo was good, but we really weren't able to enjoy the dinner there because it took sooooo long.  We were there 2 hrs before we got our entrees, and by then we had lost interest.  Market Grill really needs improvement.  We really didn't enjoy anything there. 

The guys played golf at Cocotal, La Cana, Punta Espada, and Cana Bay.  The "free" golf at Cocotal is anything but free.  When they played last year, the "cart fee" was $40/person.  This year, it was $65, and because they played before 9:00, they were required to buy $15 worth. So free became $80/person, and not worth that price.  If you want to play golf, it's worth the price difference to go to La Cana or one of the other courses.

While they played golf, the ladies enjoyed the spa at The Reserve.  It was very nice and we were able to use each of our $50 spa credits.

In summary, we had 7 great days at PPR and I would recommend it to others.  Anyone with specific questions, feel free free to IM me.

reviews.author: Getaway300175
reviews.title: confusion
reviews.text: They gave my $500 a night room away.  Told me another one would be available the next day.  Gave me keys to the new room told me they moved my luggage I found someone else in the new room.  Luggage never moved.  Refused to give any money back.  Rooms and grounds are nice.  Too much confusion.  I should have been compensated.

reviews.author: Robert G
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real from July 10 - July 13, 2014 and we had a great time. The staff was very friendly especially Franklin Carabello who escorted us to our room and asked how we were each time we bumped into him and Kenia and Hugo who worked in the Teppanyaki restaurant. The pool and beach area is where we spent most of our time and it was fantastic. The resort was clean and very well maintained. There were several bar and restaurant options. The rooms were nice but at certain times the outside noise was loud. This didn't bother us but I could see how others might find this as a negative. The dinner reservation process could be improved. When I spoke to the person at the desk I asked for and received a reservation for 7:30; however when we arrived at the restaurant we were told that the reservation was at 6:45. We were quickly seated at another restaurant next door but I think this process could be improved.This is a place I would refer to friends and I would visit again. Thanks to all of the staff for making us feel so welcome.

reviews.author: Brigid B
reviews.title: Memorable and pampering and not to be forgotten vacation...
reviews.text:
Everyone....from the arrival to the departure made my stay a memorable one. The check in was smooth and painless after a long flight from New York.The Butler..John-fi  Rivera was a fantastic
host. He walked us through all of the special events and the different locations to try each day.
He even surprised me with Spa jacuzzi..at mu age! full of red rose petals and bubbles. Wow!
The divine Martin TINEO..our beach Butler was attentive never waited for the glass or bottle of water to be empty..fresh towels  and attention all day.He even arranged for fresh coconut juice.
The Restaurant chef Mr. Carlos Seuno cooked food the quality of the South of France..I will return as soon as possible..

   Mr. Johnfi Rivera                       Butler/ Mayordomo ..... Fantastic...

 

Martin Tineo                                  Beach Butler extraordinaire  !!

 

Mr. Carlos Seuno     out of this world food and service...               
  Chef of the Palazzo Restaurant..Superb food..of the quality of the Mediterranean ...The  South of France.

The stay for seven wonderful days was so memorable. Not only the weather...the beach..spotless... the service... the staff.... all very impeccable ..I will return again and again..

reviews.author: Michele K
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: My friends and I just came back from 8 nights here. We loved it!  The grounds are beautiful and well maintained.  Everything is kept very clean.  There are many restaurants so you can eat dinner in a different place every night.  The pool and beach are wonderful, with chairs, beds, and huts to keep out of the sun.  There is a towel hut both at the beach and by the pool.  The grounds are very large so they have trolleys to take you places if you don't want to walk.  If you are unable to walk the stairs, be sure to ask for a first floor room.  There are no elevators.  Kudos to Santo, Emilio and Jose who served us drinks by the pool.  They always had a smile on their faces and were great to talk to.  The servers in the buffet restaurant by our pool were  great.  They got to know us at breakfast and lunch and brought us our drinks right away.  They knew I wanted iced coffee at breakfast and iced tea at lunch.  All I did was sit down and they put it in front of me.  Great customer service! They also have free wifi which made checking email so much easier.  I did not have to run back to the room and connect throughout the day.  I would definitely go back to The Reserve!

reviews.author: 83Bea
reviews.title: Viaje inolvidable gran hotel
reviews.text:
Fui de viaje con una amiga y nos alojamos en este magnífico hotel con el servicio royal. El servicio es espectacular en todos los sentidos, desde el mayordomo Manuel silvestre, que de manera muy educada y discreta estuvo pendiente de nosotras, y con quien nos sentimos muy cómodas. 

El hotel cuenta con buenísimos servicios, en especial nos encantó el restaurante italiano (sólo para clientes royal). Los bares de copas como el avenue o el lobby cuentan con el mejor servicio de camareros, siempre agradables y sonrientes, como Julio Rodriguez, Drayi Escarraman, Juan Yoel y Luis Martínez. 

Además contamos con la ayuda excelente del servicio de seguridad de hotel (Fausto) y el responsable del huestes service domingo, quienes demostraron ser unos magníficos profesionales.

Como único inconveniente, señalamos que el servicio q obtuvimos en la recepción del royal service no fue el adecuado. Tuvimos un pequeño imprevisto que no fueron capaces de resolver de manera profesional ni atendiendonos conforme a este servicio, intentando quitar la razón al cliente y creando un enfrentamiento totalmente innecesario.

Ha sido un viaje inolvidable y sin duda el haber elegido este hotel ha marcado la diferencia, totalmente recomendable el servicio royal y para nosotras, el mejor hotel de punta cana.

reviews.author: Jennifer L
reviews.title: Amazing Exeperience
reviews.text: The Reserve is by far the best hotel for the money. The accommodations are luxurious and the staff is attentive. Victor Medina went above and beyond to make sure everyone in our group was well taken care of and we had everything we needed an more. The Yhi Spa was out of this world. What an amazing relaxing vacation. I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Lisa K
reviews.title: Just an average stay
reviews.text: The dinner reservation system is as absolutely absurd.  You have to go to the desk the day of and they basically tell you there are no reservations and the check back later.  You spend your day going back and forth to the desk and it is very annoying.  The pool and beach areas are very nice, although the drinks are jut so so.  The room is nice although instead of a king sized bed, we had two doubles pushed together which was not ideal.  Overall I would not return, although it was still a fun few days away.

reviews.author: Taylor H
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: I returned from Paradisus Palma Real a week ago from vacation. I stayed in the royal suites and I had Johnfi Rivera as my butler. He was always around helping with special needs my family needed and just checking up on us throughout the day. He was so nice and friendly. He made the vacation a lot more fun and relaxing. I recommend this place to everybody and to stay in the royal service. It was such a beautiful and clean hotel. Everybody there is amazing and so friendly. I would definitely go back here again.

reviews.author: bob s
reviews.title: good time
reviews.text: We did Royal Service at Melia Paridisus Real and it was good to have perks.  However, we didn't get tour upon arrival *our fault as we were ready to party*... we should have as they offer more than we took advantage of, which was regrettable.  No beer selection other than local... but other than that, it was a great time.  Food wasn't as impressive as other islands, but it wasn't bad either.  I'm assuming par for the course given massive size of hotel.  Given what we paid *compared to other trips* I think it was worth the money.

reviews.author: Raquel L L
reviews.title: El mejor hotel de mi vida
reviews.text:
Tras diez días de estancia en este maravilloso destino, puedo decir que he pasado las mejores vacaciones de mi vida. 
Lo primero que te llama la atención es la amabilidad y el afán por agradar en todo momento de todo su staff. Todo el mundo intenta hacer que tu estancia sea inolvidable. El cuidado por los pequeños detalles es constante, y esto es algo que yo valoro mucho. Un ejemplo, sólo hizo falta el primer desayuno, para que desde ese momento, no tuviésemos que volver a decir como nos gustaba el café. Fantástica memoria la de Richard Ortiz, un camarero excepcional.
Nos alojamos en el "Royal Service", dotado de unas suites maravillosas, amuebladas con mucho gusto, y lo mejor, a un minuto de una espectacular piscina privada, en cuyo bar Leonardo servía los mejores mojitos del complejo. A dos metros de la piscina.... la playa privada, cuyo "jefe" Francisco, se desvivía por ofrecernos la mejor hamaca, cama, y como no las bebidas, zumos o piscolabis que nos apeteciera en cada momento.
Tras un día frenético de playa, piscina y actividades (parasailing, navegación, gimnasio, buceo...) la cena en cualquiera de los restaurantes del hotel. Amplísima oferta de todo tipo, destacando la genial cocina del Passion de Martin Berasategui, sin olvidarme del Palazzo, Vento, Gabi...
Bailar en cualquiera de los bares y tomar una copita era la mejor forma de finalizar el día.
Estoy segura de que esto no hubiera sido igual sin la ayuda de Jonfi Rivera, servicial y atento las 24 horas del día. Gracias.
Sin duda intentaremos repetir.

reviews.author: Ramón F F
reviews.title: Supero las grandes expectativas
reviews.text:
Hace unos días he tenido la fortuna de disfrutar con mi mujer y unos amigos de una semana de estancia en este maravilloso hotel-resort. Las expectativas previas eran muy altas, pero después de haber pasado allí nuestras vacaciones, tengo que decir que estas se han visto superadas con creces.
Nos alojamos en el "Royal Service"  y desde el primer momento el trato y la acogida fueron fenomenales. La mezcla perfecta de cordialidad, cercanía y comportamiento superprofesional.
Empezando por el "check in", acto burocrático que convierten en un recibimiento caluroso, con la información precisa, y en el que ya te dotan de todo aquello que necesitas para empezar a disfrutar de los servicios desde el primer minuto, siguiendo por la habitación, una suite espectacular, de estilo clásico, dotada de todas las comodidades (jacuzzi incluído), y a un minuto de la piscina privada, y de la playa.
En esta te reservan tus tumbonas y camas debajo de una palapa, y sólo te queda disfrutar del sol y de una preciosa playa de temperatura... increíble. Si la sed, el hambre o lo que sea te "ataca", inmediatamente el bueno de Francisco acudirá a servirte un mojito, un cocoloco, zumo, aperitivos o aquello que te apetezca (mi recomendación particular los mojitos de Leonardo¡¡).
Tanto para la comida como la cena el hotel dispone de una oferta variadísima de buffet y restaurantes de gran calidad, desde Palazzo, Vento, o el excepcional Passion by Martin Berasategui. Para terminar, la oferta nocturna de espectáculos y actividades es perfecta.
Durante la semana el hotel ofrece una amplia gama de actividades recreativas: sailing, parasailing, excursiones, gimnasio... En resumen, genial.
No quisiera terminar este post sin acordarme de Jonfi Rivera, cuya atención y cariño hizo que nuestra estancia fuera más que placentera. Gracias a él y a todo el staff del hotel. Volveremos.

reviews.author: Rosem M
reviews.title: EXCELLENT AT ITS BEST
reviews.text: This was an amazing trip. ..I went there to attend to a wedding and at first I thought it was going to be a big flop but I was so wrong..Once the coordinator said GO! It all  came together beautifully.  Also staff members such as RENA (the QUEEN) & waiter Ariel Rodriguez were marvelous.  They were attentive and professional at every detail and so was my house/room keeper. She was amazing (room 1045)..Overall I was very happy and I'm looking forward to going back and sharing my experience with others.

reviews.author: James H
reviews.title: Great Getaway
reviews.text: The resort was truly a place to get away in a tropical paradise.   The weather was beautiful, the accommodations were beautiful and the service was excellent.  We stayed in the Royal Service portion of the resort (which made a big difference) and found it to be well worth the extra money.  Johnfi Rivera was our butler and he did a great job arranging dinners and anything else we could have wanted.  Jore Ramos, Pasqual, and Gorge Luis Rivera were terrific waiters at the Royal Service restaurant, and Santo Salazar was a great sommelier at the Passions restaurant (7-star). The beach was beautiful as well....white, clean sand that never got hot.  Recommendations would be Passions (for a little extra cash), and the Royal service restaurant (forgot the name) below the royal service lounge.  Never had a bad meal at these two places.  Would not recommend the Market Place restaurant if you want quality food (unless you get the lobster). There was entertainment every night, nice gym and activities every day to keep us busy. Just a great place overall.

reviews.author: Gerald B
reviews.title: Royal Service Awesome
reviews.text: Augustin  Nunez is invited to come to US and promote our business in " how to be customer focused"  His customer service is world class and should be the role model for  your corporation.  Develop him to greater responsibility in management or we will take him back to US.   Thank you  Augustin.........Gerald Best # 3077 Vice President Quality and Customer Service of Whirlpool Corporation North America Regions.

reviews.author: Stephanie M
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Experience
reviews.text:
The Hotel at first glance was pretty.  The pool and ocean was warm.  There were beer cans in the ocean.  We were only allowed to stay in one area on the beach because bracelet colors.  We were told we had to pay more to sit on the other sides.  The food was average at best.  Room service was terrible.
The cost was expensive for poor service and food.  Will not be going back.

reviews.author: Cat-Stones
reviews.title: Treated Horribly until we paid for  Royal Service
reviews.text:
I have always read reviews on tripadvisor and wondered how anyone could be so unhappy with a hotel, when they were surrounded by paradise. We have been to six different all inclusive resorts and always been happy!! With that being said here is my first complaint on tripadvisor...

There were four in our party and we arrived at the Paradisus on a Friday. After checking in and getting our green bands we were taken on a tiny tour of the resort. We were quickly told that we weren't allowed to eat at three of the restaurants and that the royal service was a much better option. We figured our group was pretty laid back and didn't need to upgrade. We are the kind of people where you give us a pool, drinks, and the ocean, we are happy. However, because I had read the reviews prior, I knew we needed to make reservations right away. We went to the guest service table and was glared at by the lady at the desk, she motioned for us to sit down in front a gentlemen who was on the phone. She was not going to help us. After waiting 10 minutes the man was still on the phone, another couple came over and was begrudgingly helped by the lady at the desk, even though we had been waiting. She finally finished with them and decided to help us make one reservation at the Thai place. we tried to make more for the next nights but she said we would have to do that the next day. Ok great, let it go, she is just cranky. In the meantime my husband and friend go to the lobby bar for a beer. They ask for a beer and are told you have to wait 20 minutes to have one.  A minute later a guy walked up and asked for a beer and was handed one immediately.  Again, shake it off, we are on vacation, we let it go. 
We get to our room, double beds. Not a huge deal, but it would be nice to have the king bed we booked. We go to the pool. Bar tenders are nice but not a great drink selection.  Kids are splashing us and hanging out all over the swim up bar. We are starting to get a little annoyed at this point. We go to dinner and want to order an appetizer first while we figure out what we want for a meal. We are rudely told we are not allowed to do this. There are prices next to the wine, even the Woodbridge is $30. So much for the all inclusive aspect. We are extremely frustrated at this point. The next morning We go to the front desk and ask what the difference is with the royal service and ask if we will be treated more kindly. We don't really feel like we should have to pay more money for people to be nice to us, but we are on vacation and don't want to dwell on it. We are told we have hotel vouchers and if we use those it will be $250 to upgrade for the rest of our trip. We also ask to talk with the manager. We set an appointment and speak with Domingo about an hour later, more vacation time wasted. We tell him we are disappointed with the service and how we have wasted a day of our vacation dealing with this. He does nothing to help, but he does listen somewhat.  We go to the counter to upgrade and he walks to the counter with us. He stands there, and then the front desk lady says it will be $350. We are dumbfounded! We were clearly told earlier in the morning it would be $250. We are beyond upset at this point. Domingo looks at us like we are crazy. I ask to speak to the lady we spoke to in the morning so she can tell him what she told us. They just keep calculating numbers. I don't care what you are punching in your calculator, we were told a different price, treated terribly on three separate occasions,
didn't have the room we booked, and now you are going to argue
with us on the price we were quoted by YOUR staff. The VERY LEAST you could do is give us the price we were quoted. So after 15 more minutes wasted arguing, we are finally told our room will be ready later that afternoon and we will be charged the $250. We ask for 3rd floor and are told the hotel is completely booked. Funny because later on in the trip our butler tells is that they aren't and it's a pretty slow time.  We have now wasted a full day and a half dealing with this mess. Now to the good parts...

Royal Service was a different world. Francisco had our chair ready every morning by the pool and Leonardo makes the most delicious drinks! Both these guys went out of their way to make sure we had an excellent trip!! I can't say enough great things about the quality of service they provided us!

Our room service experience was wonderful also.  Fernando, Frankie, Jonathan and Jose, were so attentive and went over and beyond. Management needs to take a page out of these guys books because they actually know how to make people feel welcome and appreciated. 

We didn't let all the negative parts ruin our trip. However, vacation time is valuable to us and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. The way we were treated  is unacceptable regardless of what color bands were on our wrist. I will go out of my way to not stay at a Meila hotel. The staff tells you that you are treated better with the gold bands, they are rude if you don't have one, and management does nothing to remedy the situation. This could have been handled correctly by Domingo, but it was not! We had a great time and I am sure if we had started with the royal service it would have been different. I however feel that regardless of what part of the hotel you stay in, you should be treated with respect.

reviews.author: D2andM
reviews.title: Good value fir all inclusive
reviews.text:
This is a nice resort.  Very large, but you just jump on the resort golf cart trolleys to get around, grab a complimentary bicycle, or walk to get around. The buffet on the beach is excellent, staff very friendly, and the food was great. Wear a top & shoes even though it's open to the beach.  Skip the beach buffet associated with the "royal club". That one had terrible food and the service even worse. 

The rooms are spacious, modern, and mostly clean.  Don't plan on sleeping in the pull out sofa.  There are stains that I assume are from wet bathing suits on the cushions. Jacuzzi tubs are in a separated room between the bedroom and spacious bath. We have the opportunity to tour the family suite while considering upgrading our rooms.  This was large and very nice, perfect fora family stay. Beware, garden view means facing the little road that the golf carts travel on all day & night to transport guests around the resort.  It's not terrible, but get a pool or ocean facing room instead if you can.

reviews.author: Beth R
reviews.title: Relax and enjoy
reviews.text: Lovely resort with friendly staff.  Have already told many people if they go to Punta Cana this is a great place to stay.  I would suggest getting to the airport atleast 3 hours before your flight incase of long lines.  Airport has many options for food (Wendys) and is comfortable.  If you can upgrade to Royal Service with a Butler - do it!  1 Couple in our group had Louis and he took great care of the entire group.

reviews.author: Heather G
reviews.title: Expensive but beautiful
reviews.text: I went for a concert and shared a room with 2 friends for the night. This kind of hotel is normally WAY out of my budget, but split 3 ways, made it more affordable. It is very beautiful, almost gives the feeling of walking around your own palace. The staff was very friendly when an outlet in the bathroom blew, they had a maintenance person in our room within minutes. I never had a chance to see the beach view or pool as I left only there for the concert and left 12 hrs later. The main court yard has fabulous fountains and shops. The room and very lovely furniture and was laid out in a usable manner with a walk through bathroom from the hallway and the master bedroom.

reviews.author: Terri W
reviews.title: Fun in the Sun
reviews.text: Beautiful resort-people are so polite.  Water is beautiful. Scuba needs to be offered at other side of island -not much to see at Barvaro beaches. People are all wanting tips even though it is not requested.  Had to "gift" some people to get service.  Most restaurants were always booked so you had to eat at buffets.  Biggest complaint is not being able to get into restaurants.

reviews.author: kish3
reviews.title: terrible experience
reviews.text: This review probably won't make the cut but i'm going to post this anyway. The staff was ok but the manager was rude. Housekeeping didn't come until we called for them to come clean up our hotel room. Room service didn't come until about 2 hours after we called for them. when we called the front desk at 6 am because we had just ran out of toilette tissue and we needed towels, we were told to call back at 8am when somebody would be available.

reviews.author: Sajohnson9
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: I can't say enough about how great the staff is! Our favorite bartender Mindri, our room server Evan Martinez and our member service rep Sandra Zorrilla. They were all wonderful. We had an amazing stay. The hotel grounds are gorgeous and everyone is so friendly!

reviews.author: Karrie M
reviews.title: Wonderful service
reviews.text: My sister and I traveled together, two adults, and upgraded to Royal Service.  Royal Service was worth every penny.  The best part of the vacation was the friendly service from everyone including all restaurant staff, pool staff and bartenders.  One waiter in particular was outstanding as he remembered our names and our drink orders from one visit to the next.  He had a great sense of humor and always made our day fun.  His name was Smerlyn Olea.  He works in the Palazzo restaurant.

reviews.author: Lucille Judy C
reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: No mini bar in our room.We had soda pop and water in our refrigerator but for the price we paid for our stay very sad. No one waiting on guests at the pool. When we check in no one explained or opinions.

reviews.author: CRollins
reviews.title: HEAVEN ON EARTH, not to happy to be leaving, but will be back!
reviews.text:
I wanted to say a personal thank you to all those that treated us so special during our vacation.  It is with great joy to post a an awesome review.  I want the world to know how great this place really is. 
Paradisus Palma Real has searched and found the most outstanding team to make this resort the best in Dominican Republic.  From our first step into the resort everyone we met always exuded professionalism and the highest level of customer service.
This is our 4th time visiting, this is the only place to stay. We tried other resorts in Punta Cana and realized there is no comparison.
The resort is flawless and impeccably maintained, filled with amazing restaurants, each with their own team so proud that they shower you with all the great delicacies they have to offer.  Plan on putting on a few extra pounds. Paradisus meets and exceeds all expectations of a 5 start resort.
It is service that puts Paradisus at the top. I do recommend spending the few extra dollars and opt for the Royal Service you will regret it if you do not, trust me.
Now Drum Roll Please....these special individuals truly are in a league of their own, all taking the definition of hospitality to an unachievable level, we will never forget you.
Gerardo Del Rosario (Market Grill)
Ricardo Soler (Market Grill)
Luis Bello (Market Grill)
Gloria Riveras (Market Grill)
Will Mercado (Market Grill)
Marleny (Market Grill Hostess)

Richard Ortiz (Piazzo)
Stephania Auguste (Piazzo)
Miguel Jimenez(Piazzo)
Carlos Ceuno(Piazzo)
Felipe Maye (Piazzo)
Gladys Mole(Piazzo)

Augstin Nunez - Royal Service Butler
Juan Castillo - Royal Service Butlet
Pedro (Royal Service Pool)
Franciso (Royal Service Pool)
Leonardo (Royal Service Pool)
Osvaldo Acosta (Palazzo)
Franciso Garrido (Palazzo)
Clara Nunez (Palazzo)
Miguel Guerrero (Palazzo)

Baron Justo (Gabi Beach)
Elizabeth (Gabi Beach)

Kescia - Guest Concierge
Francisco Reynoso (Activities)
and finally, the Royal Service Manager Lara, is without question one of the best managers I have ever seen in action, she is on point 100% of the time and the beautiful smile never leaves her face.

Melia you continue to do it right, Miami could learn a lot from the standard you have set.

Great Job to ALL!  Thank you and see you again soon.

reviews.author: Rod L
reviews.title: Melia Palma Real Punta Cana VERY MEDIOCRE
reviews.text:
Except for its proximity to the beach it has no other positives.
The architectural design is poor, there is no hierarchy for all building entrances, all buildings, they all look the same making it very confusing. Rooms might look clean as long as you don't look closer. Breakfast (Apollo 6 or Outside Grill) was average, you might ants on your food- not very appetizing! Locks for doors and windows do not work, free access everybody! Workers always suggesting to leave them a tip: NOT VERY PROFESSIONAL! You must earn your tips with your hard work! I will not return to this hotel - I am confident that you can find better accomodation and customer service in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: ROSANE A
reviews.title: Um cantinho do Paraiso
reviews.text:
Trata-se de um hotel boutique dentro do Melia Paradisus Punta Cana. 
Você utiliza todas as dependências do Complexo Hoteleiro com atenções que somente um hotel menor pode lhe dar, como por exemplo check-in privado e uma concierge que se preocupará com suas reservas nos restaurantes. 
Por falar em restaurantes são 11 (onze) no complexo todo, não deixe de ir no Japonês o serviço é fantástico e no Grill, a carne é de primeira.
Você pode tomar café ou fazer as refeições em qualquer dos restaurantes que oferece esse tipo de serviço, porém na reserva tem seu próprio restaurante que por ser utilizado apenas pelos hospedes do hotel boutique oferece um atendimento mais pessoal e carinhoso. 
Há também uma área na praia que é reservada. Piscina Privativa da reserva adulto e infantil.
Todas as noites você terá algum tipo de show e após música ao vivo.
A qualidade das bebidas é ótima, claro se você quiser aquele vinho especial terá de pagar separado, porém a seleção oferecida no all inclusive é de ótima qualidade.
Há bicicletas à disposição dos hospedes, só é necessário solicitar a reserva com 24 horas de antecedência em uma casinha perto do SPA. Eles lhe entregam uma chave e você pode ficar com a magrela por 3 (três) dias.
Nossa estada foi tão boa que não fizemos nenhum passeio externo, ficamos os 07 ( sete) dias de nossa estada curtindo as opções do próprio hotel e o maravilhoso mar do Caribe.
Com certeza quando voltar a Punta Cana será nesta hotel.
Uma dica final, o Free shop de saída de Punta Cana é muito bom e os preços são em torno de 10% mais baratos que os free do Brasil.

reviews.author: trackdoc
reviews.title: BEST VACATION SPOT
reviews.text:
Came to Punta Cana w friends to the Paradisus PALMA REAL. Stayed 7 days and six nights was extremely impressed with the service and accommodations. JUAN DE LEON WAS GREAT!!!, he always there and attentive to the needs of my party. We had 9 in our party and he never failed to come through for us. IT WAS THE BEST TIME WE HAVE HAD IN A LONG TIME!!!. As our guide and assistant he was of tremendous character and always navigated the events of the days without fault. We will be back next year or sooner.  JUAN BEST TO YOU AND YOUR FAMILY.

Michael and Celeste

reviews.author: Cynthia C
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: Royal Service was the way to go.  Our Butler Juan De Leon treated all of us like family...When you book your trip ask for him..All the restaurants were great..They keep place so clean and every one is very friendly. .

reviews.author: Mary O
reviews.title: paradise
reviews.text: Only one more day left and hate to leave . Very glad we choose the royal service.  Our butler Juan de leon took care of all reservations and even had a birthday cake delievered to our room.  He was always available and we will return

reviews.author: Igor K
reviews.title: wow!!!
reviews.text:
Our group had a great experience at the resort. Exellent beach, excellent food, Staff is amaizing(Thank you Carlos and Christina for treating us like ROYALTIES). Will definatelly return back to PARADISE!!!

Igor K

reviews.author: flasunluver419
reviews.title: Great trip!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I went with 12 others! 
We did the RS, but our friends didn't... I'm sorry we spent the extra money!
We ended up going to the pool bar more then anything!
The bartenders at that bar are outstanding!
Manuel Torres, Jesus Padnor, big shout out to Andy Florial.. He made sure when we were on the beach our cups never went dry!
The best bartenders by far at any bar there... Go see,
Gustavo Pequero and Pedro. 
A great time was had by all!
Make sure you do water workout or volley ball with 
" Big Mac"... His energy and personality are great and he made the trip so much better! We miss you Mac!
Food is good.... Aqua is out of this world GOOD!
We had no issues except my friends waiting to get into their rooms..... Other than that the trip was awesome!

reviews.author: Ayesha U
reviews.title: Don't walk...RUN to get here!
reviews.text: From the moment my friends and I arrived, we were treated to a five star experience. As an all-inclusive, we were worried that the food might be mediocre. However, it was delicious and the selection of onsite restaurants is excellent. The concierge, the wait staff, the bartenders (we saw A LOT of them), and the front desk were a pure joy. We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.title: Great Accomodations
reviews.text: Relaxing stay. Hotel was at 50% capacity, so numbers were not an issue at any of the eateries and beach was very low traffic. One negative however concerning the beach was the constant soliciting on the hotel beachfront for nearby shopping  which was a big turn off.  Hotel staff were very proffesional and very accomodating although a language barrier did exist. The wait staff was great! Special thanks to Francisco at RS pool and beach area, Smerlin at the Pallzo for breakfast and lunch, and Roman at the RS lounge and Geuri our butler. Great Job Guys!

reviews.author: Joseph S
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text: We stayed here with friends from June 4 - June 9.  We did the extra expense of having the Royal Service.  It was well worth it.  Our butler was Luis Martinez and he was awesome!  He handled our reservations for dinner, hooked us up with poolside Bali beds with outstanding service from Franscisco to assist us with beach Bali beds.  He also took the time to run baths for us upon request and even if we did not!  Don't be concerned about potential awkwardness...there is none.  The resort itself is beautiful, well manicured and extremely well kept.  The pools are beautiful with plenty of towels.  The restaurants were very good with ample selections for everyone.  Jorge from Bana took excellent care of us.  There is plenty to do with lots of activities.  Don't miss an opportunity to spend some time in paradise at the Paradisus!

reviews.author: Tara B
reviews.title: Best beach service I have ever experienced
reviews.text:
My best friend and I recently spent a week at the Palma Real and were treated like royalty daily on the beach by Francisco Cabrera.  He ensured our chairs were beach side each morning with a table for our drinks and beach bag.  He came to check on us twice and hour and seemed to bring us things before we had a chance to ask.  He was amazing.  Simple amazing.  He made our trip one of the best experiences ever.  
Our butler Jeuri was also top notch and made sure the great service continued after we got off the beach.  He took care of our every need whether making dinner reservations or finding sunscreen when we ran out.  He was our go to guy.  
The beach was breathtaking.  A wide endless beach of pure white sand.  Quiet, well organized, and worth every penny.  I would love to visit again!

reviews.author: pserenari
reviews.title: Best Vacation!
reviews.text: Gee were do I start?  We didn't check in til 11:00pm. and didn't get gentlemen name that carried our luggage up and showed us around and explained things in the room to us he was wonderful to start with.  We were in the Reserve Building 43 I have never been in a room so nice through RCI like this one.  We had room service that night and the guy that brought dinner up and set it all up on the table and opened the bottle of wine and poured me a glass sorry but didn't have contacts in so didn't get his name.  Fabio V Romero (Reserve Activities Supervisor) what a amazing guy and wonderful personality he  taught me how to dance one evening what a wonderful time we had and Alexander Lopez he was so friendly and so helpful in letting us know everything going on every day and evening. If we looked confused to were something was going on later he would walk us and show were it was going to be so we would know.  These two guys made our trip so wonderful. We looked forward every day to seeing them and getting to know them.  They made us feel so important and made sure we had a great time.  I hope when I return which I hope I get to soon they are still at the Reserve so I can see them again.  Emilio Valdez (Drinky, Drinky) guy at the Reserve pool was also so amazing remembered us by name and what we were drinking every day. I also have to mention Jose Reinoso, Frank Mactinez, Ramon Simbect, Melvin Bcizon were all so wonderful I hope I got those names all correct guys.  The Beach was wonderful and so clean and beautiful and never had to worry about getting a lounge chair or lounge bed always one available.  The guy that took our drink orders at beach sorry but I forgot your name but he was very nice and never went thirsty at the beach.  We went snorkeling that was included and it was amazing so many fish and the reef was beautiful.  I got to give a shout out again to Alexander Lopez who told us to fill a water bottle with small pieces of bread and take with us for the fish was a great idea.  The guy who took us on snorkeling boat took the bottle and filled it with water when we got there and told me when I wanted to see a lot of fish twist of top and squeeze some bread out we had the best time!  First night we ate at Aqua excellent meal.  Bana was our favorite and Vento.  We never had a bad meal.  Every night we went to a show in the Nova Theater then after show always live music in Main Lobby area with workers dancing with everyone. We made sure every day to be up at Reserve Pool for Activities with Fabio and Alexander and all the people involved.  We made a candle, clutch purse, painted on canvas and learned about the Dominican Culture and about rolling cigars.  I could go on and on about this place If you don't have a great time here it is your own fault.

reviews.author: saul c
reviews.title: Raquel Guillen
reviews.text: Es en realidad un paraíso, muy buenas, un personal muy eficiente, gracias José Salvador y a todo el equipo de Royal Service. Quisimos disfrutar más, pero no fue posible. Hermoso lugar lo recomendamos.las piscinas, un ambiente de paz, armonía, siempre atentos y una agradable sonrisa, y muchas cosas más.

reviews.author: Wendy S
reviews.title: The Paradisus Reserve was AWESOME!
reviews.text: I can't say enough about this place.  There was some kind of mix-up and all 3 of us ended up in the Reserve after making reservations for the regular Paradisus.  It was amazing.  The best part were the people - in particular Anabel yAsio, Emilio Valdez, Fabio and Noel (unfortunately did not catch their last names).  But ALL of the staff was amazing !  The only complaint I had was that they don't leave washcloths with the towels. The food was amazing, the place was amazing, I could not have asked for anything more and I have never been in a more beautiful place!

reviews.author: 860angies
reviews.title: Amazing resort and wonderful staff!!
reviews.text:
First I would like to thank everyone for making my vacation one I will always remember . I travel a lot and I have to say this resort is one of my favorites. I will definitely be back.  Our butler, Agustin Nunez, was amazing! Very friendly and intuitive to our needs. He took care of everything  efficiently, like setting up the jacuzzi and bringing aromatic pillows to our room every night. He even surprised us with chocolate covered strawberries one night, which made a perfect end to a perfect night. All in all, Agustin is very hardworking and informative. Thank you Agustin! 
Two other butlers we met there was Narciso Green and Johnfi Rivera. They weren't assigned to us but they were extremely helpful and caring. Narciso made our stay relaxing and memorable. He is such a hardworking employee you have working at your resort. Thank you Narciso! Johnfi Rivera is a very reliable and friendly individual. Whenever he saw us he made sure we had everything we needed and if we did need something we would have it within five minutes. Pedro Cedano and Francisco Cabrera are very efficient and hard workers. We had our Bali bed every morning ready to go. Thank you guys for making our vacation so memorable and relaxing. All the workers there are more like family and friends. To the managers at the resort, you have wonderful, caring and informative staff, especially Agustin Narciso and Johnfi. I will definitely be visiting again due to the wonderful attentiveness we were given. Gracias!!!

One little suggestion if I may, I am an optician and I noticed the staff do not wear any protective sun wear, preferably polarized sunglasses. The suns UV rays are extremely strong and without that protection, they're many ailments that can occur. The same way we put sunscreen on our skin to protect, we should be doing with our eyes. Many will say it is informal, but your health should be number one. Hope to see you soon!

Angelicca S.

reviews.author: Jeannine S
reviews.title: Very High Expectations but was disappointed
reviews.text: I planned this 25 person trip for my best friends 50th birthday Celebration.  She trusted my opinion and decided on the Paradisus rather than AM Resort or the HardRock. Two restaurants were closed.  We were not told in advance. The casino was closed. We were not told in advance and the weekly beach party which I had raved about was cancelled and the ajacent restaturant Gabi Beach was closed for a private function.  The food choices were horrible.  This was my second time here and it will be  my last. There are too many other places in the DR and the world to experience

reviews.author: Calvin J
reviews.title: The food needs work
reviews.text: Overall the stay at the Paradius was nice. The waitstaff were very friendly. The bartenders were awesome and very attentative!  The alcohol was top notch.  The room was just as you see o the website. The food however was not soo great. For an all inclusive the room service was nasty and there were not as. Any restaurants as listed.  Some of the "restaurants" were just rooms that they brought food I to to serve.

reviews.author: Keven B
reviews.title: Voyage paradisisus Punta cana
reviews.text: Moi et mon amie venons de passer une semaine a la réserve du Paradisisus Punta cana avec notre hôtesse que nous désirons remercier Anabel Gonzalez qui nous a offert un super service !! Un seul mot WOW !!!! Personnelle incroyablement charment et prévenant !!! Super belle semaine !!! La restauration est incroyable on lui trouve de tout et de plus l'hotel est magnifique .

reviews.author: PRIMUS23
reviews.title: Husband's 50th Birthday
reviews.text:
The hotel should invest in a new executive chef.  The breakfast buffet was edible, but the lunch and dinner buffets were sometimes outright unedible. The Market Grill was an mediocre option,but much better than the indoor buffet.  There were a couple of days where the tortilla chips were stale and we reported it to the cooks.  The cooks pretended to not understand what we were saying. The restaurants were good, but not stellar.  The Italian restaurant, VENTO, was disgusting.  The atmosphere was absolutely gorgeous, but the pasta was gross.  ALfredo sauce is one of the most simple sauces to make.  Instead, they used milk and flour as a very poor substitute.   Aqua at the RESERVE was one of the best meals we had.  Dinner at the Market Grill would have been enjoyable if the lobsters were not overcooked and kept in the warming drawer. The lobsters were huge and would have been delicious if not overcooked.  

The resort itself was immaculately kept. The pools and beaches were absolutely prestine.  The towel bar custodians were very friendly and it was an added treat that they had balls and games for the kids.  

Overall, it was a great family vacation.

reviews.author: CaterinoWedding
reviews.title: Wedding at the Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: My husband and I were married on May 17, 2014 at the Paradisus Punta Cana resort. Having a destination wedding was the absolute best choice and having it here was amazing. When our group of 75 showed up on Wed-Thursday we found out they upgraded the whole group(yes the whole group, 75 of us!!) to the Reserve. We were completely shocked. It was such an awesome surprise. Our room was awesome and had a great view of the pool!! The Reserve was perfect for all of us because we all could find each other easy! The bartenders at the pool bar ( shout to Rodolfo- you were the best!) were friendly and fun and make some great drinks. The Buffett was okay. We totally recommend Vento! We didn't get a chance to really eat at a lot of restaurants because of our welcome party, rehearsal dinner and wedding nights had us booked. Make sure you book your reservations when you get there the first day. They fill up fast and won't let you eat without a reservation. We didn't try Passion (the one that costs money) but our guests did and raved about it! The overall appearance of the resort is amazing. The main hotel lobby is awesome and the grounds were gorgeous. Our wedding coordinator was Beatrice and she was such a blessing! She was so responsive and genuine. She did whatever she could to make our day special. She was able to throw together a welcome Party with 7 hours notice and it was perfect. We had the rehearsal dinner at Gabi Beach. That bar has an awesome view! The lit up trees and beach right there was so nice, especially with the breeze. Again it was a Buffett and was decent. Our wedding day was perfect. Perfect weather (6pm ceremony on the beach) and gorgeous cocktail hour (again on the beach). The reception looked awesome (Caney ballroom). I explained to Beatrice how I wanted it and it looked exactly how I imagined! The food wasn't great (Caribbean Buffett menu) but the DJ was awesome and the crowd was always dancing. One thing that was negative was that they did not have the AC on until people showed up at the ballroom. It was so hot and hard to cool down with 75 of us in there. If you have your reception in there make sure the AC is on a hour (at least) before any guest steps foot inside. The day was unforgettable and I am truly amazed on how smooth it went. I can't thank Beatrice enough- thank you thank you thank you!!!!! Oh and check out the main pool behind Gabi Beach- it's pretty cool. And thank god for the shuttles- the resort is so huge you need to use them If you are at the Reserve! We will definitely be coming back to the Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Jason N
reviews.title: It really is paradise
reviews.text: I had an fantastic stay at this resort.  I was here for 4 days for my friends wedding, and never wanted to leave.  The staff are one in a million, they are helpful and very friendly.  The resort is a slice of heaven, the food is top notch, be it at the buffet or one of the restaurants. The beach was one of the cleanest I have come encountered.  Even if you just lounge by the pool, and lay in the breeze, you are in for a treat.  3 of the best bartenders are Porfirio, Rodolfo D' Penta and Emilio Vardez.  When you hear "drinky drinky, time to order a drink", you know it's all about you.

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: Great Resort.  The Staff was very attentive and the food had alot of variety.  We only stayed 3 nights and 4 days and felt like we did not have enough time to experience all that they had to offer.  I would go back in a heart beat.

reviews.author: Jennifer R
reviews.title: Dream Wedding
reviews.text: Where do I begin!!! Lets start with when we did a site visit last year to check out venues for our wedding that took place May 14, 2014, and we met the lovely Estrella Garcia and she gave us an amazing tour of the property and we were sold instantly when we walked into the lobby. Estrella showed us rooms over at the royal service and even let us have lunch while we did a site visit!! Needless to say a year later when we came back we seen Estrella and she was so happy to see us and was so happy to know we were getting married at the Palma Real that week!! The night before our wedding we came back to our room after being out at the beach all day to a table with a cheese platter and a bottle of red wine waiting for us!! Needless to say it was our lovely friend Estrella who did a little something special for us!! She was great and I hope to see her again when we return to the Palma Real. Now for some wedding details!! Let start with my lovely wedding planner Mariela Garcia, she did an outstanding job from the time we got there to the time we left she made sure all our needs were being met, not only for the wedding but for the entire time of the trip. We had 45 people there for our wedding and she made sure that everyone had a reservation for dinner every night!! She took care of all our wedding details and made sure that day was amazing for us!!! My wedding super exceeded my expectations and was amazing!!! It was great to hear from my guests that it was the best wedding they had been to and it was all thanks to Mariela!!! My hair and make up at the resort came out AMAZING!!!! I didn't get the name of my hairdresser who also did my make up, but she was a perfectionist and knew what she was doing!!! Being a bride you want to look amazing on your wedding day, and the reaction I got from people was what I exactly wanted with loving the way I looked and saying how good the hair and make up looked. We met with Mariela the next day just to say hi and say thank you to her and my husband told her how good our wedding cake was, Mariela had a small cake made for us that night that was at our room waiting for us when we got back! She melted my heart the whole time, whatever we wanted she made happen!!! She did an amazing job along with her team in the romance department. The staff that waited on us through out the night of the wedding was awesome too!! They made sure we always had full drinks and made sure we had everything we needed at the table. Our waiters and bartender we had during the week were awesome too. Lourenco who took care of us at Avenue Bar was awesome, made sure our drinks were made when it was time for a new one, and making sure to give the ladies something new and tasty, he knew what he was doing!! Claudio and Dionis Martinez at Market Grill would make sure we were happy with breakfast and lunch and made sure we had what we needed and got us whatever we wanted!!!! Claudio was great with making sure we were taken care of weather we were at Bana or at the hibachi tables for dinner. Great guys and great service!!! The trip overall was unforgettable and I would do it again in a heart beat with the same 45 people!!! Of coarse after being there for 10 days I wish we stayed longer and got to enjoy the resort more with relaxing by the pool and the beach!!! Looks like we have to make it back again soon!!! Once again so in love with this trip,resort, and employees for creating such and amazing time and memories for such a huge milestone in me and my husbands life!!!! THANK YOU!!!!

reviews.author: Kim M
reviews.title: Unhappy :(
reviews.text: This was our 3rd time to this resort in the past year and a half and it has always been outstanding to say the least.   This visit, however, wasn't at the level that we had been accustomed to.  I am a Club Member and could have chose to go to any of their resorts worldwide.  As a Club Melia member, I feel we should be kept up to date on any communications that may be happening at the resort where we booked our vacations.   When we arrived at the Palma Real Resort, we were told at check in that the Naos restaurant was closed due to reconstruction.   What we were not told was that it was closed due to a fire.   We heard from other guests that it burned down due to a fireworks display.  As a member, this would have been valuable information to have prior to arriving at the resort.   In addition, the location of the rooms that we requested ended up being right next to the construction at Naos and they started every morning at 8 am with the jackhammer and other banging, clanging equipment.   This was not told to us either at check in.   We were just told that we had very nice rooms with a great view.  Also, during our week stay, the casino was closed due to reconstruction.  Was not informed of that either, we had to hear that from the other guests.   I had received an email from Club Melia prior to my arrival informing me of the improvement to the culinary experience for the members and guests with the addition of Master Chef Martin Berasategui in the Passion restaurant.  With that being said, I would have thought as being a member, that we would have been informed of the Naos restaurant closing (fire) and also the closing of the casino.  We made an appt with the Sales Manager at Club Melia to hopefully go over some of our concerns.  We arrived at our scheduled time only to be surprised that he was busy with another customer and basically did not have time to meet with us.   Marie at Club Melia was able to arrange for us to meet with the Quality Team to discuss our frustrations and concerns.  To date, we have not heard back from them.    The service at the resort was not as it had been previously.   There were alot of little things that kept popping up that became an real annoyance.  Just to name a few, running out of juice glasses at breakfast, having to flag someone down to get coffee, running out of butter, etc.   Our mini bar was not stocked unless we called to advise them of it and we never received any snacks in our room like we had previously.   I could go on.   One of our biggest disappointments was not having Ramon Fuego at the pool bar.  Ramon made that area fun.  He is one of the best bartenders and should be where the majority of the people are.  We have always told our friends about our fun experiences at the pool bar but this time there is not much to say.   We did meet some awesome people though that i want to make sure not to forget. Servers/Bartenders--- Diego Gonzalez, Santo Imarrero, Jonathan Arias---you rock.   Rosa Abreu, bartender, you were amazing!!   Ramon Fuego (my friends/family) we love you!!   We do HOPE to see you back at the pool bar where you belong.  I also want to mention Francisco, Angel and Big Mac (Francisco).  They are all awesome!!! Great dance lessons, etc.   After all of our frustrations, I do want to say that this is a beautiful resort.  I hope with the frustrations and concerns that we shared with them,  will help to continue to make this resort better and better--more like it was in the past.

reviews.author: Stephan L
reviews.title: Really bad
reviews.text: Stay away: bad service, bad food, dirty and expensive. Will never go again, will not recommend to anyone. Just trust me - it's REALLY bad. You can't sleep how noise rooms are, you're always hungry unless you can eat spoiled food.

reviews.author: AshleyInChucktown
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text:
Staying in the Royal Service at the Palmadisus Real in Punta Cana was absolutely paradise. When you first arrive you are greeted with a warm welcome and smiles from all. I went there with my best friend for my cousin’s wedding and it was truly a magnificent experience. Everyone was so helpful and always willing to lend a hand. Since we were Royal Service we got our very own butler, Angelo Mercedes. He was a ray of sunshine and a pleasure to be around. He always had a smile! We received a cell phone so we could call him whenever we needed him and he ALWAYS picked up. Anytime we needed something he was only a phone call away. He even would come find us in our usual spot on the beach to chat and make sure we were having a pleasurable stay…and of course we were!!! He was a wonderful butler and we appreciated him making our reservations, laughing at our silly stories, and making our experience with the Royal Service unforgettable! Francisco Gil served us out at the beach EVERY DAY. He was AMAZINGGGGG!!!! He truly made us feel like royalty. Every day he had our beach beds ready for us in our usual spot and would bring us mimosas, pina coladas, dirty monkeys, and any other drink we desired! And each drink was served with the biggest smile. Both Angelo and Francisco made the trip a magnificent experience.  At one point, Jorge started walking around with Angelo because he was in training and he was extremely caring! He made both of us feel like queens! Jorge, if you read this, Jenn and I WILL be back and we look forward to the meals you will create for us!!! 
The food there was wonderful! Our favorite breakfast location was the Palazzo (Royal Service only).  They made omelets to order, french toast, pancakes, crepes and had other options that were delightful. By FAR my favorite lunch was at Gabi Beach. They have a mouth-watering cheeseburger that I’m still having dreams about! It was called the Hawaiian I believe…pineapple, coleslaw, bbq sauce, pickles….it sounds odd but it tasted outstanding!!!  Favorite dinner place was the Asian Fusion. It was basically Thai food. My friend got the seafood curry which was SO good and I got the salmon. Of the two, I must say the salmon was a home run! I loved it!!! Angel was our server and we really enjoyed him! He was a lot of fun and made sure we had a pleasurable experience.  The bartender in that restaurant was Jonathan and he was great as well! We even went back over to him for drinks when we weren’t eating there just so we could say “Hola!” and sit with him for a moment. Gabi Beach also had a wonderful dinner…I got the lobster and it was SOOOOOOOO good! I can honestly say I’ve never eaten so much in my life! Very wonderful experience!
Just a heads up to those of you travelling here, there is only a glass door for privacy in the bathroom. This is NOT a deal breaker for staying here because we would just step out onto the balcony to give each other privacy.  The warmth we felt from the staff far outweighed that small matter. 
All in all, this was a life changing experience. Jenn and I have already started planning our next trip to this beautiful location and look forward to seeing all of the friends we made while there. We will DEFINITELY be requesting Angelo for our Butler and Francisco out on the beach. You guys ROCK!!!

reviews.author: MarlaG918
reviews.title: In Paradise at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My two girlfriends and I just returned from a fantastic 4-night experience at Paradisus Palma Real.  The resort was gorgeous and well maintained.  The staff were friendly and accommodating.  The pool area was enormous and elaborate and the beach was very clean.  The highlight of our trip was "Big Mac" (Mr. Macdonna) in Activities who is the ultimate "party starter."  He has a very engaging, fun personality and tries to get everyone involved in the fun and makes people feel welcomed.  He led zumba, salsa, bachata, water aerobics and kick boxing classes at the pool, among other things, and is dedicated to making guests smile and have a terrific time.  We had a blast dancing with him.  Andy and Angel at the pool area also gave particularly excellent service and made our experience very comfortable.  The best dining experiences we had were at Passion and Aqua.  The Yhi Spa at the Reserve was a lovely experience.  I would definitely return!

reviews.author: José Luis d
reviews.title: Lo major
reviews.text: Quiero recomendar este hotel a todas las personas que le guste pasar buenos momento inolvidable todas sus instalaciones nueva una jardinería espectacular felicidades al equipo de jardinería. Y también a el equipo de pool concierge y resaltando a José Luis de los santos la destrezas y la voluntad de servir y siempre atento no habían cosas que no nos pudiera conseguir José Luis un excelente empleado y amigo.mi nombre es John Smith y estuve en la habitación 2423 grasias José luis

reviews.author: Ryan S
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful and the people here are amazing.  We came for a wedding with family and had an excellent time.  We sat out at the pool almost everyday and had the drink guys.  Bana was a great restaurant, we ate there twice.  Keep em coming!!!!

reviews.author: Feiba A
reviews.title: Excelente atención,  excelente y bello lugar
reviews.text:
Pasamos un bello momento en un hermoso lugar, definitivamente volveremos a visitarlos, se lo recomiendo a todo el que nunca ha ido al Reserve en Paradisus Punta Cana, que vayan...
Mi hija escogió este hermoso lugar para su boda y todo quedó perfecto.

reviews.author: Richard D
reviews.title: Relaxed Paradise!!!
reviews.text:
This was our first trip there and I promise not our last.  I have never been to a place where you were made to feel so important and pampered! By the second day we were Mr.Richard and Mrs. Jean. Juan was delightful at the buffet room, pleasant and courteous at all times! Luiz at the pool bar was friendly and personable, I could not believe how he could remember what you had the day before!!!
