Mr.Mac at the beach was a wonder! My granddaughter totally enjoyed dancing and working out on the beach!
Since our return I have told people where to go to relax and feel pampered by such a wonderful resort.  We are planning a trip for the whole family in 2016!!! Looking forward to seeing our new friends again!

reviews.author: John G
reviews.title: Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, Dominican Republic
reviews.text: Our stay was from April 24 through 29, 2014. Overall we had a fantastic time. Especially thanks to our two concierge personnel at building 38 of the Reserve (Yueri and Anabel). They were the greatest. Things we had asked others to take care of weren't done until they were mentioned to Yueri and Anabel. Then we got immediate results. These two made our stay most enjoyable. They were very knowledgeable, extremely helpful and always very pleasant. Problems we had tried for several days to get resolved, were resolved immediately when mentioned to Yueri and Anabel. The room was great. The pool, beach, restaurants and live entertainment were great. We went with Costco Travel and all arrangements were top notch. The Costco Travel representative was very helpful with booking the local tours and activities. Other staff who made a positive impression on us included; The bellman at the Reserve (Haezael), the waiter at Gabi Grill (Luis), Rosmery De Jesus, Enrique Ortiz, Sandra Cedeno, Dhoralis Ponlanco among others. We had a great time dancing to the live music as well as relaxing on the beach. The Reserve had a private pool and beach which was an upgrade from our original reservation. We received this upgrade free to give us a taste of what we would get with a resort vacation membership. We agreed to attend a presentation like a time share even though it was not mandatory. We are sure we will return to this resort based on the great time we had. Thanks to all the wonderful staff mentioned in this review.

reviews.author: Ellen J
reviews.title: Our wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: If you want to experience complete luxury and relaxation you must take yourself to Paradisus Palma Real Resort on the beautiful beach of Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  The rooms are elegant; the beach is clean, the water is warm and the people are so friendly.  We had the best Butler, Johnfi Rivera.  He was always there when we needed him.  He was thoughtful, kind and very resourceful.  He performed miracles when we needed to get into a certain restaurant and was always nearby if we just wanted to say hello and visit.  He made our visit so wonderful it was hard to say goodbye to him when it was time to leave.  Everyone who worked at this Hotel seemed to enjoy working there and helping the visitors.  Their smiles went a long way for me and my husband.

reviews.author: Hanifea C
reviews.title: Girls trip Vacation
reviews.text: I resort was absolutely beautiful, from the moment we arrived everyone was really nice and accomodating because we initially were supposed to stay at Paradius Punta Cana.  Paradius Punta Cana moved our reservation to Paradius Palma Real without telling us and we were upset.  I am very glad that we ended up staying at Paradius Palma Real because the service was excellent, the resort was clean and beautiful.  Our Butler Narcisco Green was awesome and made our stay at Paradius Palma Real even better by making reservations for dinner each night, spa, excursions, and lastly preparing a birthday celebration for my best friend.  Paradius Palma Real is a great place to stay and I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Julie B
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: Overall service was great. Staff was very helpful, especially Juan Bautista Rodriguez. Juan was attentive, friendly and knowledgable. He made the dining experience enjoyable,considering we did not make reservations ahead of time. Hope to get Juan Bautista Rodriguez as our waiter again!

reviews.author: Francine30012
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Love, love, love  This was a girl's trip, my cousin, friend (her son)  and myself.  We had a blast.  Rosemary Dejesus thank you for your wonderful hospitality.  The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was highly recommended by a friend and I was not disappointed. You have options of jumping on one of the carts, bike ride, or walk to the beach.  I thought it was a very enjoyable walk looking over the luscious beautiful grounds.  We did all three,  The beautiful suite we had.  I travelled with a couple of picky eaters and did not hear one complaint.   We also enjoyed the food at "The Grill, Mole and Banos.  The entertainment was pretty good when we were there from May 15, 20014 - May 19, 2014, Michael Jackson Show.  I look forward to coming back with my husband!!!

reviews.author: Jorge Eduardo M
reviews.title: UN PREMIO INIMAGINABLE
reviews.text: llegue ayer a mi pais,argentina,despues de pasar cuatro dias en un lugar de ensueños maravilloso donde lo que mas rescato aparte de la decoracion de habitaciones ,lobbys y bares, las playas paradisiacas y la extructura del resort , es la ambilidad, gentileza, simpatia y sobre todo respeto com la que fuimos tratados durante toda nuestra estadia de parte del todo el personal de paradisus punta cana resort, los cuales nos han hecho sentir como verdaderos reyes. quiero destacar especialmente la atencion de felix quien se ocupo del room service,lenin,juana y edward nuestros barmans del bar del lobby central,la atencion de joaquin mella nuestro capitan en el grill restoranty la simpatia,energia y gracia de benjy bourjolly con sus clases de aqua gim y bachata,pero sobre todo rescar¡to la calidez de persona como hector rivera ortega el cual nos atendio mas que bien ,por todo ello quiero felicitar a los gerentes del lugar por el equipo de empleados maravillosos con los que cuentan. espero volver pronto y solo puedo decir gracias gracias mil gracias. varios paises latinoamericanos deberian copiar la manera de atender a sus visitantes

reviews.author: Bon I
reviews.title: First Class Treatment Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
A large group of our family and friends traveled to the DR and stayed at the PPR, Royal Service for a destination wedding.  Narciso Green was our Butler and served the majority of our party.  We received excellent service.  Our entire group was catered to in every way imaginable.  Not only did Narciso ensure the quality of our stay, he met every additional request we made of him, including introductions to other staff members in restaurants and bars who also provided first class service.  

Perhaps we were a bit demanding, but Narciso never missed a beat.  In fact, it seemed as thought every where we went, he was somewhere closeby.  He even sprang from his sleep early one morning to assist with a traveler in our group who was in distress.  

The food was acceptable, but not gourmet.
The grounds were meticulously manicured.
The staff was friendly and attentive.
The suite was clean and comfortable.

Not knowing what to expect on our first trip to the DR, we were pleased with the entirety of our trip and found it to be a great value as well.  My recommendation, Royal Service is well worth the added expense to ensure that all your needs are met.

Thank you Narciso for your excellent service.  PPR is fortunate to have you at their property.

BonJoe

reviews.author: Warren W
reviews.title: The Gold Experience
reviews.text:
This place was beautiful. From the start it very relaxing and surreal.The room was very clean and everything worked.  Service for the room was twice a day and had anything I wanted.  I paid for butler service and  had Francis Castillo.  He was very accomodating.  Once we recieved our butler phone, which took 2 days, we saw him everyday to plan our events and dinners.
Food and drink was very good. The room service food was lacking in time to the room.  And at times language was a minor issue but thats on me since I am in their country.
One thing I recommend they change is the dinner reservation policies.  You could not just walk to any restaurant to eat.  You had to have a reservation.  And always the place was empty.
Overall a fabulous time.  I would go back!

reviews.author: Douglas C
reviews.title: great experience
reviews.text: We were at Paradisus for a wedding. The whole event went perfect. The best part asside from the food was the happiness and helpfulness of the staff. I thought the gift shops and the laundry was a little too expensive since the guests had nowhere else to go.A t-shirt or a pair of rubber shower sandals shouldn't cost 30 dollars. The rooms were beautiful but I thought it was unusual for the bathrooms to be open to the sleeping area. Other than that it was perfect.

reviews.author: Recipriano26
reviews.title: Enjoyable Trip
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana this past month, from 5/14/14 - 5/20/14, and had plenty of great experiences, and some less great. 

We stayed here for a friends destination wedding, and in total I believe there were roughly 75 of us, friends and family included. The property was immaculate, pools always beautiful and clean, grounds landscapped, and the beach was phenominal. Without a doubt one of the most relaxing and beautiful locations I've ever been. Crystal blue water, amazingly soft sand, hammocks, beds, canopys, and chairs everywhere, all in pristine condition. Wish we spent a little more time beach-side, for sure. 

The room was also beautiful. A large king size bed awaited us, with very comfortable linens, always cleaned, and always turned down at night. The towels were always replenished, and always smelled fresh. The house keepers did an amazing job, and even the turn-down service was great. The shower had a few body jets, as well as a full-size jacuzzi connecting the bedroom and bathroom. 

The service was ok, depending on where you went. Let me preface this by saying I've been working in restaurants in a long time, and I tipped EVERYONE very well. I noticed all the bartenders were all smiles, all the time. Very happy to serve a drink, make a recomendation, and overall BS with all the guests. We took great care of them, and they took great care of us. Special shout out to Eddie and Guillermo. Yeah baby!!

Where I felt the service felt a little short was at the restaurants. At the buffet's, it seemed as if the hostess and servers were upset at us, as if we had done something wrong. I asked one hostess upon our first lunch where we could sit, and she flat out replied "wherever, I don't care", with an attitude. The servers also left a bit to be desired at the buffet's as their attitudes seemed comprable.

Serivce aside, the food was hit or miss. If they only had buffet's, I don't think I could have lasted more than 3 days. I'm not picky whatsoever, and always open to try new things, but the food was just flat out not good. Thankfully, they have a few selections of restaurants which we made a point to go to. 

First night out we tried Bana, the Japanese/Hibachi restaurant. They lost our reservations which were made by concierege, so it wasn't a great start. After waiting 15 minutes, they told us the sit-down side was closing, but they could sit us at the Hibachi table, which didn't make much sense to any of us. We were able to get a regular table after going back and forth, sat after another 5 minutes, and had some pretty good sushi and entrees. 

Next night was The Grill. Again, servce was nothing special, but they were also slammed, but still a poor attitude from our server. The steaks were good, and the salad bar was nice, too. (Word of advice: make a point to eat some salad/greens every day, as the food can become a bit heavy day after day.)

Next night we ate at Aqua, and the food was GREAT. I had the lamb osobuco, which was a nice hunk of meat on the bone, perfectly cooked. The 3 others I ate with also loved their entrees and apps. A great place to eat with a very nice wine list. 

Our last night we ate at Vento, which was AMAZING. Lobster, steak, stuffed chicken, it was all phenominal. Even the service was top notch. We would deffinitley have eaten here every night, and we were all a bit upset with ourselves we had it for the first time on our last night. 

A bit of advice is to study the paths/walkways. They have shuttles which are supposed to come every 10-15 minutes as the resort is HUGE and we were on the far side from the beach. With that being said, the weather was beautful, so walking 15 minutes wasn't a big deal, just know the shortcuts and stay in the shade!

Overall, it was a great trip. The venue was amazing, the beach amazing, and the wedding amazing. Pro's and con's with every trip, but this was a place I'd have no trouble booking again. Also want to say a special thanks to Ada Morlo and Eloi de Montero at the front desk (so sorry if I spelt your names wrong, ladies!)

reviews.author: Ted J
reviews.title: Great beach, great service, very nicely appointed
reviews.text: Very attentive, helpful and plentiful staff throughout the hotel.  Great location right on a spectacular sandy beach.  Very clean and spacious facilities.  Good food.  Nicely appointed rooms.  Very convenient 15 minute drive from the airport - which is chaotic, at best - you'll be glad to arrive

reviews.author: LaShawnta R
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Narcisus green was our Butler and the services were 5 star.  Very professional attentive and extraordinary. .  This resort was amazing ..royal service is the way to go....I highly recommend this resort. I also highly recommend to eat at gabi..beach and the hibachi. .

reviews.author: Walker V
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!!!!
reviews.text: Where do I start...ok, first of all THANK YOU to the staff!!!  Rosemery DeJesus from guest services assisted my friends and I for the brief 4 day period.  The reservations for the restaurants went without a hitch.  Now, to the food....EXCELLENT!!!!  I read an abundance of reviews prior to going down and got a little 'shaky', however, there was food for every taste bud.  The Grill and Mole was our best.  PLEASE would someone from management send me the recipe for the Oaxca chicken at Mole!  My son and I died and went to heaven over our meal and he is picky.  The rooms was wonderful no complaints. We arrived on Thursday, May 19th just before check-in time and we did not experience delays obtaining our room.  I think the best time to travel to this resort is during the non-holiday time for Europeans and Americans.  We had absolutely no problem with getting a cabana..no hogging chairs either.  The upcoming Memorial Day holiday may be an issue with chairs.  Also, no one had their hands out for tips, but we did tip well regardless.  They made our vacation a 'dream come true'.  The beach was a tad rough, but it could have been due to a host of 'mother nature' factors.  But, the waters were warm and still a lot of fun to dip in. By the way, NO RAIN the entire time while there. The grounds at the hotel were immaculate and gorgeous, kudos to the ground keepers.  We rented bikes and had fun.  Yes, the bikes are old and rusted, but that added to the fun.  The internet was spotty, however, my son didn't even complain because, we were on vacation and really didn't need it.  The entertainment was fun, we saw a band with dancers, the beach party was fun, and the Michael Jackson show was actually pretty good.  Our last night there, we ate at Bana (the Japanese restaurant).  That was a great experience because we were able to socialize with other vacationers during dinner.  I’ve done a lot of travel to the Caribbean and this has been the best experience so far.  If anyone have any questions about this resort, I’ll be more than happy to answer.  Management…Please send me the Oaxca chicken recipe (smile!).

reviews.author: Chuck B
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: It was great.  Very happy with Royal Service.  Room was nice, did not spend much time in room, at the beach or pool most of time.  Loved the patio off the room.  Had a foot massage on the beach thanks to Francisco Garcia and the two masseuse July and Lorenza. Excellent!!!  Only probably was with large group hard to make reservation want to go out at 8;00pm couldn't help us. Break up into small group easier.   Juan our butler was wonderful (THANKS).  We Enjoyed everything.

reviews.author: Rafael M
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text: As praias são perfeitas, o hotel maravilhoso, os restaurantes magníficos... Este é melhor hotel que já estive, todos fazem de tudo para te agradar.... Fazem o impossível em 1 segundo e o milagre em 2 segundos... Júlio Garcia, Rodolfo,  Francisco, Dulce, David, Mindri e Porfírio!!!

reviews.author: GboroMomGoes
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, nice rooms, hassels with dinner reservations
reviews.text:
This is one of the most beautiful stretches of beach I have ever seen! Don't venture too far far down the beach or you will be pestered by the sales pitches for those peddling their wares. The resort security does a good job of keeping them off the resort beach, but they do allow those selling excursions. If you are firm in telling them no, they will leave you alone.  There was adequate seating ln the beach but there were not servers to bring drinks. Apparently, you must be concierge level to receive beach service.
The main pool area was nice and we especially enjoyed the in pool loungers. There was not adequate seating around the pool deck. The swim up bar is nice but lacks enough bar tenders to handle how busy they get--expect to wait a considerable amount of time to be served. The first afternoon we were there, there were no beach towels but that didn't seem to be a problem the rest of the week. 
The rooms are spacious and clean, with nice bedding. Our room was cleaned each day and our fridge restocked with what we requested. It was nice to have room service but it did take quite a while to get our food. You may want to bring hour own wash cloths because we only got them the first day. Once they were dirty and taken away, they were not replaced--despite our repeated requests daily. Air conditioning worked very well.
The casino was nice but small. The evening entertainment was good, especially the MJ tribute show.The bar upstairs in the lobby is fabulous and has wonderful premium drinks. 
My major complaint with the resort is that they require reservations for dinner at the a la carte restaurants. The reservations must be made daily and are difficult to obtain. We were told that reservations were all taken many times, only to see the restaurants mostly empty in the evening. This seems to be their way of pushing guests to eat the buffet. We were not told prior to or at check in that the largest restaurant was closed for construction due to a fire. The buffets usually there were moved to a ballroom. The buffets were good but you have a walk a long distance to get to them. The outdoor buffet and grill is good for hamburgers and tacos but gets old. Gabi beach was the best restaurant we ate at for dinner and their lunch buffet was great. The Asian fusion restaurant was very good also. We couldn't get reservations at the other restaurants, which was very disappointing. No one wants to be on a tight schedule or hassel with reservations on vacation!
Second major complaint was the construction on the restaurants. The jack hammers are not relaxing when you are by the pool.

reviews.author: Jody H
reviews.title: Good Times
reviews.text:
First off - the good things about the hotel.  I was with a group and in the Royal Service section some of my group had a fantastic butler Joanna - she is the best! The pools are amazing and the bell boys do a great job. 

Overall good stay for my group.  Some things that could stand to have improvement:
WiFi - never really worked properly for guests in their rooms and was slow in the lobby.
Restaurant reservations: They need a couple more options so that people aren't left with only 9:30pm dinner times.

reviews.author: Audrey V
reviews.title: Mother's Day 2014!!
reviews.text:
My friends and I just returned yesterday from the Palma Real on a Mother's Day trip. Our trip started out eventful after staying at the Melia Tropical for one night then we moved to the Palma Real. The service here is outstanding..the staff is wonderful..shout out to our butler Juan Castillo that took care of every detail for us like running a bath for us on Mother's Day and making all of our reservations for the restaurants. The Royal Service is the way to go..another shout out to Franklin De La Cruz for giving us outstanding customer service.

 The drinks at the Lobby Bar rocks!!  This is a beautiful resort, but they did fall short on some minor areas..reason for the four stars. WiFi sucks big time..don't expect to get a consistent connection. They had several power outages while we were there and the food left little to be desired. We tried most of the restaurants, but the Pallazo Royal Service restaurant  was the most consistent. The nightclub was okay, but they do have bars that stay open till 7am in the morning. I'm not sure if I would come back..but I had a great time overall.

reviews.author: Nataliaviaja
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Nos pareció un hotel de excelencia con respecto a todo, tengo que destacar que extravié mi cámara de fotos en un sector del Hotel y aparentemente alguien del personal la encontró y la llevó a la recepción del Hotel pudiendo así recuperarla sin ningún inconveniente.
Lo que mas hizo sentirnos cómodos fue la calidez, amabilidad y alegría contagiosa con la que te atienden en todos los sectores, no puedo dejar de incluir en esto a Ramón Fuego y Fueguito que nos atendieron en forma excelente en la barra del Skar Bar al lado del Market Grill.
 Ramon, espero nos recuerde, Natalia y Alejandra pidiendo "piña colada" Saludos!

Volvería a elegir este Hotel para vacacionar sin dudas!

reviews.author: Priscila F
reviews.title: Agradecimento
reviews.text: Acabando de voltar e já com gostinho de quero mais. Ótimo atendimento, pessoas super prestativas e educadas, permitindo que nossa estadia fosse perfeita. Um obrigado a todos e em especial p Nuria q faz parte da recreação. Valeu cada minuto!!!

reviews.author: Rudy S
reviews.title: Beautiful with excellent customer service
reviews.text:
Outstanding resort with excellent service reps. One employee that stands head and shoulders above the rest is Marcos F. Teocadio.  This employee went above and beyond what was expected.  Also, the Lobby bartender, Yesenia Farias is a master of her trade and should be the manager of The Lobby Bar -- Without a question!  

Rudy
Jacksonville FL/Sacramento CA

reviews.author: Miguel Ángel L
reviews.title: Miguel Ángel León
reviews.text:
Estuve desde el 23 de abril al 1 de mayo por quinta vez disfrutando de este gran lugar. Segunda vez en Reserve y tres en Paradisus. Hacia tres años que no iba y me agrado todos los cambios que se han realzado especialmente en los comedores de la playa.
Feliz de encontrarme con personal conocido y agradecidos como siempre de sus atenciones.
Benita,Noraya Peña, Noemi Taylor, Rosa Yan, Marina Torrilla,Melvin Reyes, Juanilin Figueroa, Belkis Fulgencius y a muchos más que desgraciadamente no tengo su nombre.
Como lo digo siempre, si viajo a Punta Cana, midestino seguirá siendo el mismo.
Nuevamente felicitaciones y gracias.

reviews.author: Sebastian
reviews.title: ROBAN
reviews.text:
Fuí con un grupo... Comentando entre los 10 chilenos que estábamos, 4 personas sufrieron robos. (Dos denunciaron) Y estamos hablando de un hotel 4 estrellas... Realicé el reclamo correspondiente; Hablé con Isabel (administración) me derivaron con vladimir (RR.PP.) y la respuesta fue: "Este es un hotel que produce millones, pero sin pruebas, no podemos hacer nada" Lamentable! Jamas volví a dejar entrar a alguien a limpiar la habitación si yo no estaba. La postventa es pésima.
El servicio a la habitación es horrible 4 veces tuvieron que ir para dejarme el pedido de desayuno completo!! Se cortó la luz dos veces en 5 dias.... y sin luz la ducha NO FUNCIONA...
Estuve dos días sin wifi!!!
Se demoraron 6 horas en llevarme un par de cervezas!!!
Cuando uno recibe lo que pidió... ya no lo necesita!!! :/
 
La playa maravillosa, las personas de la barra y los restaurantes un 7. Freddy Lopez del Sky bar... Un 10 Excelente!!!

reviews.author: Annaki2014
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: I loved my  experience at Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana.  Overall experience was excellent.  Rosmery was extremely friendly and helpful throughout my  visit. House keeping service was outstanding Ylisy German and her supervisor Angela put emphasis to detail.  Daniel de Leon & Wilson made me feel welcomed. Best dinner experience was at Passion, it's a must go to place.  It was outstanding, Chef Ruben Jimenez Tavalera was superb.  Carolina Valdez, Anyelo Amaro and Ronad Marte provided the best  service during dinner. You  really  have to try the Tasting Menu.The hotel was great and one of the best beaches I've been to.  I highly recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: Jaime M
reviews.title: What a wonderful time we had!!
reviews.text: While vacationing at the Paradisus Palma real resort in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic  my wife and I had the pleasure of  having Johnfi Rivera as our butler who went above and beyond his call of duty to make sure that all of our needs where met and to our satisfaction. Do to this wonderful experience we will be visiting this destination again in the near future. Johnfi Rivera is an asset to your wonderful resort and to the people of the Dominican Republic as a person and as an employee of your resort

reviews.author: Derrick S
reviews.title: Spring Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed here 7 years ago and couldn't wait to come back.  Overall still a very very good experience and just as beautiful as we remembered. The views were still spectacular and the rooms very nice.  The food was very good.  The pool staff was spectacular keeping us refreshed with island drinks to cool us down from the bright sunshine.   Golf was not the bargain it was seven years ago (cart fee only for $24) but it was still reasonable.  The only concern I had was trying to keep the bar/refrigerator in the room stocked.  I had to ask the front desk two times during the week to have the refrigerator re-filled.  If that is the only concern I had, it was a great vacation.

reviews.author: Amy P
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
We recently visited Paradisus Palma Real Resort for our wedding on April 23, 2014. We were there for 11 days. We stayed in the Royal Service section of the resort. When we walked into the resort it has the most amazing view of the ocean. We were instantly greeted with mimosas while we were being checked into the resort. Everyone at the resort made our stay wonderful especially our butler Jose Salvador and our wedding coordinator Mariela Garcia. I couldn't have planned a more perfect place to be married. Everything went smoothly throughout the planning process and on the day of our wedding. I didn't have to worry about anything. We had both the wedding and the reception on the beach, which was breath taking. The food was amazing for an all inclusive resort. This was the first time that I stayed at an all inclusive and I was happy that I did my research prior to choosing a resort because we personally feel that we couldn't have chose a more perfect place.

 We had a total of 18 people stay at the resort for the wedding. Half stayed on the royal service side and the other half stayed on the regular side. Both groups had an amazing time. The only downfall for the people who didn't stay in the royal service side was that they had to make their own dinner reservations; which most didn't mind. I really enjoyed having a butler because he made the trip more relaxing. I didn't have to plan any dinners, he even reserved cabanas near the pool and made us bubble baths multiple times. 

The wedding was perfect. Mariela and the entire group of wedding coordinators went out of there way to make sure our wedding was perfect. It was exactly how I imagined being married on the beach. The decorations were amazing, along with the Caribbean trio, DJ, photographer Rodrigo, and the minister at the resort. I can't stop looking at all of my wedding pictures along the video. I just feel so lucky to have chose such an amazing resort. My husband is already talking of going back for our one year anniversary. I can't wait. This was definitely a trip of a lifetime. Very relaxing.

reviews.author: Cindy A
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Our stay here was a bit like being in paradise, experiencing a little slice of heaven. Our concierge, Franklin De La Cruz was the best part of the hotel! If we needed anything at all, he would drop everything to ensure we were taken care of. He made us feel right at home in the Dominican Republic. The entire hotel staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. They remind you you are on vacation and want you to have a good time.

reviews.author: Marilyn T
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: It was amazing!!!!  Definitely recommend, customer service/facilities/food and beverage were amazing.  I love my Paradisus family:  Luisaida, Marcos, Franklin, Victor, Jimmy Sazon, Reyna, Magdona.  To be honest I almost feel like I underpaid for the amazing experience, the dedication and commitment to customer service at Paradisus is amazing.  I can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Marceloconrado
reviews.title: Hotel com pacote Royal Service VIP contratado.
reviews.text:
Tipo de habitação: Suíte Garden View com pacote VIP Royal Service.

Pontos positivos:
Piscina Privativa (sem muvuca)
Quarto amplo com hidro e sacada.
Bebidas e comidas de primeira linha.
Restaurantes diferenciados.
Praia particular.
Ótimo serviço dos Franciscos da piscina e da praia.
Atendimento fantástico do sushi man Jorge, do restaurante Bana.
Café da manhã muito bom no Palazzo.
Drinks perfeitos no casino, pelo barman Victor
Atendimento excepcional do atencioso Gerente Ruben Ligero, merece um prêmio!
Bom atendimento das camareiras.

Pontos negativos:
Pegadinha da venda para sócio do Reserve Meliá. A Sra. Natalia nos aborda com a oferta de um delicioso café da manhã em lugar lindo, vip e diferenciado, na verdade perdemos nossa manhã entre idas e vindas de carro de um hotel para o outro, palestras inacabáveis, café da manhã sofrível e a presença do vendedor espanhol Jorge, extremamente arrogante, que queria nos obrigar a assistir a apresentação de vendas por 90 minutos, absurdo, fuja desta pegadinha, ela acabou com nossa manhã e com nosso humor.
Mordomo, o serviço poderia ter sido mais atencioso e presente, ele era mais um "contato" do que "mordomo", pois o cargo mordomo vai além das atribuições percebidas nele, muito simpático e agradável, mas pouco prestativo e presente.
Obrigatoriedade de utilização de calça e sapato fechado para frenquentar alguns restaurantes a noite, poxa, estamos na praia!
Internet realmente precária, praticamente nula no quarto, praia e piscina, só funcionava 100% na sala Royal Service.
Tivemos uma manhã sem água e uma noite sem luz.
Empresa receptiva Otium, serviço de razoável a ruim, nem o local de embarque no aeroporto eles acertaram, tratavam nossa bagagem como sacos de batata.
E por último, a necessidade frequente de distribuição de propinas, sem propinas nada acontece, você parece um fantasma, com propinas, principalmente gordas, serviço excelente, atendentes prestativos, tudo de bom.

reviews.author: tylerotte14
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: After reading all the RIDICULES negative reviews, I would have to say that my stay there was of NONE of what they said. The ONLY bad things I have to say is that the WiFi is not good...but after all you are on VACATION! We were part of the Royal Service with extended benefits above the common guests. Our personal butler, Alvaro Fernandez, was EXCEPTIONAL! He exceeded all expectations and was great to work with. He would make any reservations we needed or get us into our room if we were locked out. We traveled as a group and had 3 rooms and the resort did a great job keeping us all together in the same building and next to each other. The Royal Service lounge, private pool, restaurant, and private Royal Service beach were great amenities keeping kids and annoying nuisance guests away. The shows at night were great and service was pleasurable. Recommended for all!

reviews.author: bk_lowery
reviews.title: LOVE, LOVE, LOVED IT!!
reviews.text: Our trip was full of memories that will last a lifetime!!  We traveled to this beautiful resort the week of April 21, 2014 and the weather was perfect!  Our experience was outstanding!!  Our room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable and huge.  The Royal Service is the way to go!!  Our check in process was a breeze.  They escorted us from the resort entrance to a private room with a beautiful view of one of the pools and the beach and brought us chilled towels and tropical drinks while they took our passports and processed everything.  Royal Service allowed us access to the private beach and private pools which were pristine.  The spa was nice too.  I cannot compliment the entire staff enough, including our private butler, Jose Salvador, who assisted with our every need.  I could have not scripted a better time than in this paradise with great friends and more laughs than one could ever imagine!!  We will return 💗

reviews.author: Jason H
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: You must use Royal Service options.  Our butler, Jeziel Alvarez, was very responsive and set us up at every restaurant on the resort.  You must find Francisco Cabrera at the Royal Service pool & beach.  He made every day perfect!

reviews.author: vdimichele
reviews.title: Too expensive for an average/ok stay!
reviews.text:
Over all this resort is good.

We arrived at Paradisus Palma Real at 12 pm on Thursday April 24th, and they were all very friendly and attentive. We were able to check into our room 3 hours early which was a plus. We received our bracelets and carried out with our day. The pool very huge and the plus side of it was that there was a big swim up bar. House keeping was absolutely amazing as well as room service. The only complaint I will make here is the food. The food was edible but then again our friends and I are used to New York food. 

We stayed at the Paradisus because my best friend was getting married here. They did a fantastic job with the BBQ the night before the wedding, the ceremony on the beach and the reception! Being part of the regular side of the Paradisus instead of the Royal Service was not terrible. Unfortunately, since their restaurant Naos burned down, my boyfriend and I found ourselves eating breakfast and lunch every day at The Market Grill which got boring and too routine. Upon arrival at the Paradisus we were not notified by anyone that we were "allowed" to eat at the Apollo for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Frozen drinks were delicious!

One great thing was that when we checked out at 11:00 on Monday, we were able to leave our luggage with the hotel as we enjoyed a few more hours in the sun until we had to leave for the airport at 3:30pm. They allowed us to use a little room to shower and get changed out of our bathing suits. I really appreciated that! Thanks Antonio M at the front desk!

A few tips: 

Make a reservation for dinner early in the afternoon if you want to eat at a reasonable time like 6-7:30. Otherwise, if you wait until the late afternoon to make a dinner reservation, your only option for a dinner time wont be until 9 o'clock. 

Wi-Fi barely worked if you were in the lobby. It didn't work from our room.

Brush up on your Spanish because it is hard to communicate with the waiters and house keeping if you do not know Spanish.

Make sure you pack everything you need!!! Sunblock, aloe, lotion, motrin, and women's sanitary products are WAY OVER PRICED at the gift shop located in the hotels lobby.  

Bring a flashlight with you! During our stay, one night we experienced two blackouts. One of them lasted several minutes and we were in the casino at the time. The machine shut down and the place was pitch black for about 10-15 minutes. The second blackout occurred shortly after the first and it lasted 40-45 minutes. It was extremely annoying because at the time I was playing one of the slot machines and I had to sit there in front of my machine until the power came back on so I could collect my money! it was a disaster! 

So overall our 5 day 4 night stay at Paradisus Palma Real was ok. If we had been notified that we could eat at the Apollo and if the food was better, our stay would have been somewhat better.

reviews.author: Vanesa T
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Muy bueno. Hazael presto un servicio muy amable al llevarnos las maletas. Los restaurantes son buenos y the Grill es excelente. Rosmery fue muy atenta en el check out. El hotel es muy tranquilo. Se recomienda en general para parejas, amigos y familia

reviews.author: LisaD642014
reviews.title: Elvis is Alive!
reviews.text: We attended a destination wedding at the resort this past April.  The grounds were beautiful and the hotel staff was friendly and polite. One staffer in particular was our Butler Elvis.  His smile lit up the entire resort!  He was very attentive, kind and gentle.  Although there were some inconveniences throughout our stay, some of which were stressful and cost us time on the beach, the hotel management did everything possible and we were treated royally!  If you are vacationing at the resort as a Royal Member I would definetely request Elvis.  He made our stay memorable!

reviews.author: Krista P
reviews.title: Great staff made up for rude management and bad service from reception
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this hotel for 5 nights with a few friends.  As we were travelling from different cities  we found it best to book the room for two people and add me in after the fact.  We were told one price on the phone and charged an entirely different, and much higher price, when we arrived.  Over the next two days we were given several different prices every time we asked about the cost to add a person to the room. One of the customer service managers basically called me a liar when I mentioned the price we were given over the phone, then when I told him I was having a hard time coming up with the money as it was now triple the anticipated cost  and so I was afraid I would be out on the street with no where to stay he simply said "Find it." 

In addition, I had arranged a series of scuba diving lessons with an agency that was not associated with the resort.  This agency left several (6) messages for me with reception which were never delivered, even after I called and specifically asked if there had been messages left. This caused me to miss out on dives I had paid for and wasted much time for the company I was dealing with.  The same manager I had dealt with previously about costs was apologetic one day about it, asking me to come see him the next day to see if he could make up for it somehow. When I went to see him the next day he acted like I was dirt and brushed me off.  

The resort itself is beautiful, the food was divine. The regular staff, waiters, bartenders and activities people were all wonderful.  Florentina (pool bar waitress), Francisco (activities) and Manuel (waiter) made my time there much much better. If it were not for the aforementioned troubles I would have no hesitation going there again and again because of my experiences with these wonderful people. Unfortunately, the stress I had from the beginning really soured me to this resort, and indeed all Melia resorts, so I will not book with them again.   If you don't plan to do anything with groups off resort and do not need to make any changes then it is likely to be hassle free for most people.

reviews.author: Leatrice J
reviews.title: Resort Experience
reviews.text: From the moment that you step on the grounds, you are treated like royalty. All of the staff very courteous, warm, and welcoming. From check in to check out, you feel so pampered. The resort is gorgeous and I was very captivated from the scenery and all of the staff. Israel at the Market grill during the day time was excellent. He made sure I had everything and did not run out of anything. Royal service is the best way to describe this resort. The dance classes were excellent and fun especially the dance instructors Francisco Reynoso, Bick Mack, and Willfred. They made you feel at ease even when you never danced salsa or merengue. They were very entertaining and patient when teaching the dance moves and allowing me to practice with them after the Excellent nightly shows. The massage on the beach was heavenly. I was very impressed with every detail of the resort. I was sad to leave to leave this punta cana paradise!

reviews.author: Irma C
reviews.title: Perfection....almost
reviews.text: The Reserve is definitely the place to stay in Punta Cana.  The service is exceptional, the staff is very very friendly, helpful and efficient.  The buffet for breakfast and lunch is fantastic (ceviche, caviar, fresh variety of fruits) and much more elegant and low key than the buffet at the Paradisus.  Room service was absolutely on time (I requested coffee and fruit at 7 am and it arrived precisely).  I advise booking your restaurants the first day you arrive as the good time slots fill up quickly.  The rooms at the Reserve are spacious.  The property is large, so I would recommend getting a bicycle to get around at times.  There is a tram that takes you from your room to either the beach or restaurants, but I didn't find it very timely, sometimes a long wait, especially from the beach going back to the room.  I would suggest that the property provide daily newsletters in the rooms to inform guests of the daily activities and shows.  The only negative things I found were the shows (the theatre seats were uncomfortable and the shows were very amateur) and the casino (many slot machines didn't work).  But overall, had a wonderful, relaxing vacation in March 2014.

reviews.author: Sebastian C
reviews.title: agradecida
reviews.text: buenas tardes,en nombre de dolly cardona: estoy muy agradecida por el buena atención recibida en especial del señor jose torres del restaurante gabi , personas como el es que necesitamos para que el servicio se a excelente.

reviews.author: Claudia A
reviews.title: 5th time at hotel and disappointed!
reviews.text: I'd like to start out by saying that it's a shame that Naos burned down - it was such a wonderful place to have breakfast and lunch.  The Market Grill was horrible - we ate there twice and had RAW meat - very disgusting!  We were also disappointed to find that one of our favorite pool bartenders (Ramon "FUEGO") was no longer at the pool bar, but at the Sky bar - which is a little bar on the side of the Market Grill.  The pool bar wasn't the same.  We upgraded to VIP, but didn't get treated that way.  We made dinner reservations at the beginning of our stay for all 4 nights - so we thought.  We were told that we had dinner reservations our first night at the Gabi Beach club, but then when we went back to check the time, they didn't have the reservation, so we made a reservation for Bana for 8:15 that same evening.  Guess what, Bana did not have our reservation, but they called someone and found out that we had reservations a - you got it - Gabi Beach club.  When we got to the Gabi Beach club, they said that they were going to TRY to accommodate us.  Are you kidding me!  This happened day after day.  Very disappointed!  Don't think I'm going to go back next year - will try another all-inclusive Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Martha C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real, Never Again
reviews.text:
This resort has its cons and pros. Last year we stood at Melia, which was amazing! We ended up buying a timeshare so this year we decided to stay at the Paradisus since it's supposed to be an upgrade.

The resort itself is beautiful and well maintained. The food and drinks are good as well. We are Melia Club Members and didn't feel that we received any special treatment at Paradisus Palma Real as we did last year at Melia. We had a couple problems throughout our stay. 

First thing is that as club members we are guaranteed a bed by the pool. We were told we would have it the next day. When we arrived to the pool, of course we didn't have one. It took them a while to figure it out. The following day, we had the same problem. Second thing is that our concierge made our dinner reservations for the remainder of our stay. On the second to last night we were there, we went to the restaurant and they didn’t have us on their list. Luckily, there were a few tables empty so they were able to fit us. On our last night we didn’t end up having dinner until 10 pm because again, they didn’t have us on their list. We went to guest services and they couldn’t figure it out. When they tried looking me up by my room number, my name wasn’t even on their system. They had another family with a party of 6 in their system for our room. Another problem was room service. Every time we ordered room service, they screwed up the order. They never gave us our entire order. One of the times we were finished with room service, I called them so they could pick up the plates. After two hours of waiting, I decided to put the plates outside the room since it was late and we wanted to sleep. The next morning the plates were still there with a horrible smell since there was ceviche. We were also told that the servers were supposed to constantly come up to us by the pool to see if we wanted any drinks, we had to complain multiple times to get this type of service. It seemed that they only came around when we started tipping larger amounts and when they would come around they didn’t have our complete orders. We also thought that the hotel’s nightly entertainment was pretty boring. On our last day we bumped into our concierge and told him about all the problems, he looked like he could care less about anything. During checkout I also informed the receptionist and she didn’t seem to care either.

As I stated before, the resort is beautiful and the food and drinks are great. But I feel that for it being the Paradisus Palma Real, the service is horrible. Being a Melia Club Member, I expected better treatment was greatly disappointed. We will not be returning to the Paradisus Palma Real. Hands down, Melia gives you the treatment and service you deserve.

reviews.author: Jose C
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Muy buen hotel, muy buen servicio y atención, Me encanto la habitación y en general todas las instalaciones. Hermosa la playa y piscinas. Cordialidad de todo el personal de servicios. Excelente servicios de alimentación.

reviews.author: Rebecca M
reviews.title: Great vacaction!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in March with another couple.  We had the royal service, which I highly recommend. The royal service lounge was really good, with drinks and fresh snacks all day long. I found the free wifi in there didn't always work for me (but that certainly could of been user error!) Our personal concierge was Juan Castille and he was very good, made sure we had everything we needed, but occasionaly we had to seek him out if there was something we wanted.  He made our dinner reservations for the week the first day we were there, went over them with us, and we only made a few changes, but I appreciated that he made them for us in the first place.  The only "mistake" was that we tried to book a snorkeling trip two days in advance, but I believe he waited until the next day to book it and it was full. We probably could've walked on to the snorkeling boat (because people who reserve don't always show up) but we wound up being too late. Not a huge deal, we took an outdoor painting class instead.  Franscisco at the pool was great and reserved beach chairs for us everyday.  The food was better than average for an all inclusive.  I found some of the service was slow, but you're in the caribbean, so it's not that unusual.  There were some inconsistencies, for example, they pretty much only served Presidente beer, but one night at the casino I ordered a Corona and got one, but the next day (and the rest of the trip) they were out of it.  Rooms were beautiful but I wouldn't recommend rooming with someone if you're not completely comfortable with them, as the bathrooms are sort of open.  Overall this was a great and much needed vacation.

reviews.author: gstarke
reviews.title: Amazing vacation for friends getaway!
reviews.text:
The Palma Real was selected by my friends and I as this year's vacation destination.  When traveling, I love to enjoy the local cuisine and take in all the sights.  All-inclusive resorts were not my first option, so I was tentative about this location.  My mind has changed.

The property and accommodations are amazing, and beautiful.  There are plenty of areas to enjoy coffee in the morning, and afternoon book, and drinks in the evening.  The rooms are comfortable, and well taken care of by the staff.  My room was cleaned daily, and prepared for my weary body when I decided to go to bed.  I could go on about the property, but the photos really do it justice.

If you are selective about what you eat, you might have a difficult time with the food.  I live in Chicago, a foodie mecca, so I found the dining options challenging.  The food is fine, and abundant.  I was tired of the menu towards the end, but satisfied with the options.

If you regularly drink craft beers, wines from Wine Enthusiast, and buy tickets to your next dinner, then you're going to have a difficult time with the libation options.  I'm lucky to have a native Spanish speaker, and I make every attempt at speaking Spanish, so ordering from the bar is significantly easier (this is true for food too).  The lobby bar offers a few extra beers, and some well crafted drinks by the an award winning bartender (Mario???).  The other bars offer drinks based on the venue, so don't expect to order a Tiki Tiki at the cocktail bar.  They have all the basic options, so do your homework and make sure you know what to order.  I think using good judgement when ordering like you were at a wedding is good advice.

I have some special shout outs for some of the staff -

Ramón - he's the poolside bartender, and definitely one of the best bartenders on staff.  He's got game both behind the bar and around the pool with fantastic drink balancing routines.  The hotel should take notice of his skills, and make it part of the training program.

"Big Mac" - he's one of the entertainment staff, and comparing him to the energizer bunny would not do him justice.  This guy goes a mile-a-minute, and delivers customer service without blinking an eye.  You can't miss him, and shouldn't before you leave the hotel.

The hotel will push their vacation club during your visit, and it's up to you if and when you attend their informational meeting.  We turned it down right away, which may have affected our reservations for some of the restaurants during our visit.  We recommend the hotel staff gauging the customer and giving them the choice of if and when to learn more about the vacation club.  Hard selling is never going to fly when someone has just arrived from the airport.

Overall, my friends and I had a great time at this hotel, and given the option would return here for our next visit to Punta Cana.  I appreciate all the people that work here, and wish them all the best.

Thanks!

reviews.author: Patti L
reviews.title: Lovely vacation
reviews.text: Silvio was the best and I wish he was still taking care of us now that we are back in Chicago.....  He did everything he could to be sure that our vacation was wonderful and accomdated our requests.  If things went wrong, (minor inconveniences like with a dinner reservation or spa appointment) they did everything they could to remedy the situation and mitigate the inconvenience.  It is a beautiful hotel and we found the people working their to be quite nice...."Lady" and Annabelle were terrific and Lady even rode along with our group one night to be sure that our reservation was correct and that we were satisfied with the table we received.  The beach is lovely and the service is attentive and the employees truly try to  make you feel at home.  Highly recommend this lovely property.

reviews.author: Sarah R
reviews.title: Best vacation of my life!!!
reviews.text:
My best friend and I stayed here for the first time for her birthday. We opted to pay for the Royal Service which included our own private butler. Upon arrival, we were escorted to the Royal Service lounge and served mimosas to start our stay. The lounge had a full bar of premium alcohol and served snacks all day long. It also had daily periodicals and 8 computers with full internet access. We met our Butler, Yohelvi Aracena AKA "Yoel", we were given our Royal Service bracelets and cell phone to contact Yoel and then given a tour of the property. Royal Service included a private beach, pool, pool bar, restaurant, the lounge, our butler and of course "Royal Service" wherever we were on the property. It was worth every penny!
 
Every morning, Martin Tineo  would have our chair ready on the beach in our favorite spot in the sun, prepared with towels complete with a table for our drinks. After settling in, he would check on us frequently and bring us water, drinks, buckets of ice, anything we needed. Midday, he would turn the chair for us towards the sun. After lunch we generally visited the pool bar where Billy Levons and Leonardo would mix us up some drinks and back to the beautiful beach we went. All the alcohol was top shelf. There wasn't a "mystery" alcohol" that we didn't recognize. Billy would also bring us drinks on the beach and when Martin wasn't available, Francisco Cabrera took care of us. We were always attended to and wanted for nothing. We were completely pampered. 

Our room-the bed- was top notch. Scotch, Vodka, Rum, wine and beer was in the room when we arrived. Every night Yoel would deliver scented pillows to our room-lavender, chamomile, green apple. He drew me a bath complete with burning incense and rose petals. He left us chocolates and sweets at night. Even on the days his shift started later in the day, he made sure we were taken care of and had our dinner reservations made days in advance. Upon check in, we were given a cell phone to contact him and he answered every call no matter what time of the day. He even chatted with us and hung out at the bar with us while Leonardo made us delicious fruity drinks. 

The water was beautiful, clean, not even a sea shell. The breeze from the beach made the hot Dominican sun enjoyable. The white sand was lovely between our toes, even at night when the dinner buffet was served on the beach. And no matter where we ate-buffet, restaurants, outside, inside-the food was exquisite. Lobster was frequently served, even at the buffet.

The hotel, the accommodations, the people, the service-it was the best vacation of my life. I have been to Costa Rica, other parts of the Dominican Republic, Barbados and this by far was the best. I don't know if I will ever be able to take a vacation without the Royal Service. The pampering was exactly what a vacation should be. I will be back as much as possible.

reviews.author: Isabelle C
reviews.title: Fuego! Fuego! Fuego!
reviews.text: The staff at the pool bar is amazing! Gracias Ramon Fuego, Luiz and Gustabo! Excellent mojito, pina colada and dirty monkey. They are fast and always smiling. I highly recomand this place. It's clean and very nice.

reviews.author: Francisco P
reviews.title: Muchas oportunidades
reviews.text:
Nos hemos quedado en varios Melia ya que somos socios y sin duda alguna este es uno de los que tiene más oportunidades especialmente a nivel de servicio. 

Se supone que cuando estas en el club no tienes problemas con reservar sitio en la playa...pues todo lo contrario, hemos ido y no han tenido lugar para nosotros.. y hemos visto como solo le reservan a familias que les dan una "buena propina" por adelantado. 

En otros melia nos han asignado a una persona que se ocupe de hacer todas estas cosas... en este nos asignaron a un tal Frankelin que lo que ha hecho es tratar vendernos paquetes de excursiones que no queremos.... 

Muy lamentable esta situación ya que estamos pagando las anualidades de "los privilegios" del club Melia. 

Todavia seguimos aqui, esperemos que mejore.

reviews.author: Jan R
reviews.title: Paradise is the only name for this resort!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from 4 days in the Royal Service suites at Paradisus. His company awarded select employees with this lovely trip. It took all of the first day to get it through my head that what I was looking at was real! The property is arranged so that wherever you are you have a breathtaking view of something. The resort is large, but after wandering around you get the lay of the land and all the shops, pools, and beach entries were very easy to get to. 
Our butler (!) gave us a tour as soon as we arrived and made sure we knew to contact him for ANYthing we needed. Juan de Leon was lovely and served us well right up til the last minute we got on the bus to the airport. 
Our room was spotless, and everything was in perfect working order, stocked daily with water and snacks. Anything you forget - beach bag, beach towel, slippers, robes, etc. is in the room. We felt secure leaving our passports and valuables in the electronic safe daily. We never encountered any bugs, as you might expect in the tropics, but of course off the property is likely a different story.
We had food at a catered event the first night and lunch in the buffet; both were less than impressive and left us wanting for something. Room service was also less than tasty, though presented well and delivered timely and courteously. The restaurants, however are outstanding and well worth calling your butler to make a reservation. 
The beach and ocean were so enchanting that we avoided the pools altogether. If you want peace and quiet and experience in nature, stay on the beach/in the ocean. Though there were always a few couples near us, we felt we still had significant privacy on the Royal Services beach. The pool area seemed to be more of a social hangout - drinking at the swim up bar, a bit more crowded and noisy. Depends on your preferences. 
The smoothie bar on the beach was awesome! The butler brought us towels, smoothies, etc. and made dinner reservations for us so we never had to leave our beach beds! We also left our beach bags/items on our beach beds while in the ocean and no one ever disturbed them.
Go out at sunrise, stay all day if you can. There are plenty of shaded lounging options. Between 5pm and 7pm, people start leaving the beach, which makes it a good time to get some pics and walk on the shore.
We never saw beach or pool "hours" posted, but it seemed there was never anyone in the pools or at the beach after dark. Not sure what the rules were. 
There was one glitch the day we left - electricity and water suddenly went out at 6am, but were restored within the hour. Perhaps a reminder that we were staying in the DR. There was also a minor fire in one of the rooms due to an electrical short in the circuit box, but that also was dealt with quickly. 
All the staff were extremely friendly and cheerful. We felt fully welcomed and at home. We hope to return again and enjoy the pristine aqua waters and white sand on Bavaro Beach!

reviews.author: Drako23
reviews.title: wonderful vacation
reviews.text: This is an extraordinarily friendly and comfortable resort~rated 4th best for the entire island.  The restaurants offer variety and excellent cuisine, the staff are uniformly pleasant and helpful.  The pool at The Reserve is large, clean, and delightfully not heavily chlorinated.  The beach is gorgeous.  And the room/suite we had was impeccable and very comfortable.

reviews.author: Brian C
reviews.title: The Roof is on FIRE!
reviews.text: Ok so the resort is hands down one of the most beautiful ones I've been too. I was here for just the weekend for a friends wedding. The service was really good for the most part. We did have a few bad experiences with rude employees in the restaurants though. Also the "Market Grill" and a two other building caught on fire while we were there after the wedding... The entire wedding party watched it burn from the beach down to the ground... very scary! Other than the fire and the few (VERY FEW) rude staff members it a great place they keep the drinks coming and the food is good for the money! I would go back! Also the room are real nice too!

reviews.author: Sygraham
reviews.title: Friends 50th Birthday
reviews.text:
This was a great vacation and birthday celebration.  The resort amazing, the rooms were extra large. The service was great, our concierge was Mr. A.C. he was great.  Also, Omar Hernandez assisted me int he business center very help. 

I would highly recommend this resort and yes, I will be going back.

reviews.author: CAD
reviews.title: Great Time!
reviews.text: A group of 29 were there last week for a wedding and the holiday was wonderful.  The resort was much larger that most that i've been to, but there was a shuttle running back and forth to the lobby, room and beach.  The service was quite good, especially Orlando Diaz (room services) at the Reserve.  He was very professional, well spoken and friendly.

reviews.author: Yoanna P
reviews.title: excelente
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia un lugar maravilloso con un un equipo de personas muy preparadas y preocupadas en nuestra estadia el lugar es perfecto cuenta con todo lo necesario para tener unos diaa de relax y esparcimiento

reviews.author: gigi22r
reviews.title: Didn't want to come home
reviews.text: I just got back from my friends wedding there!  I had an amazing time.  We were a group of 60 . The hotel was beautiful!  Beach was to die for !  (i am feeling depressed to be back home)  The food was delicious  We were in RS and our butler Johnfi Rivera was so nice!!! He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed for an amazing vacation.  To tell you the truth the whole staff was very accommodating!  But a must see is Ramon Fuego, Luis Fuegito and Gloria they are by the main pool at the bar, OMG they def mad our trip that much more fun!!  Amazing , great drinks and fun company are cups were never empty!

reviews.author: Kurt K
reviews.title: Palma Real excellent; Royal Service not-so-much
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous stay at Paradisus Palma Real this March.  We took a friend and we all had a great beach, spa, and dining experience.  We are members of Club Melia and it just gets better and better.

We did stay one night in Royal Service which was terrible.  No hot water, broken lights, coffee maker didn't work, no space at the "private" pool.  Butler and lounge staff were sympathetic but not helpful.  I would never spend the money on this again.

reviews.author: jaime m
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: loved everything. stayed in the reserve one bedroom master suite with 2 friends. the room was perfect for us with plenty of space.4 days was not enough time to try all the restaurants but the buffet was great for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Dont eat the pizza though lol. Bartender Bertilio Tellerias was a great guy and gave us the run down on best things to do. Not far from other resorts you can check out. my biggest complaint was how ridiculously tiny the casino was.would like to come back with my wife to fully enjoy the relaxing and romantic side of the resort. Take the atv tour and bring cash(small bills)

reviews.author: Mari S
reviews.title: Spring break vacation
reviews.text: Had a great time with my friend carlos.  I recommend this place to any one or family. This is the second time I've come love  this place .a special thanks to miky and friends. Thank you too the staff at paradisus Punta cana.

reviews.author: Winelover2011
reviews.title: Paradise lost?  Not exactly.  Wedding review
reviews.text:
Because the Excellence does not allow children, we decided to get married at the Paradisus Palma Real.  It is the most elegant resort in Punta Cana that I have seen.

I found the wedding planning frustrating.  I felt that we were talking past each other.

The first part of the planning is with Paradisus' office in Miami.  We read and re-read all of the materials and yet were left feeling like idiots when we spoke with the Miami folks.  On this note, if you can, please take advantage of the Love at First Sight visit - you will get to see what they mean in their materials.

We felt that they kept getting an item or two of what we had chosen wrong, even when we submitted in writing.

For example, all the materials said that the wedding would be in Spanish and the hotel would provide a translator.  When we asked about that we were told it would be in English.  A week later we had a call with the decor folks and were told it would be in Spanish with a translator.  We asked again and were told it would be in English.   In fact, it was in English.

Another example is the lighting.  We were reminded by decor that we needed lighting and we wanted Chinese lanterns that we had been shown when we were there for our Love of First Sight.  I went to the decor website, as instructed, and such lighting was not in the catalog.  So I found a sample on line and sent a picture.  The response was in essence "silly boy, you missed them in the catalog."  The only problem was that the catalog they sent me was not on the website and in fact was the 2012 catalog.  I guess clairvoyance is required.

We were also very disappointed when after we had paid the initial deposit and the second installment, and after we had come back from the Love at First Sight visit, they told us that the pricing had changed and we would now have to pay extra for the cocktail party.  After my bride threatened to cancel the wedding and move it elsewhere, they relented.

As for the plated dinners, we were surprised to learn that every guest had to have the same meal, rather than choose a plate from the menu.  Keep in mind that this is an all inclusive with several restaurants.  If a guest did not like the meal, he or she could simply walk over to a restaurant and get a plate.  We decided to create our own menu.

Lastly, we scheduled several meetings during our Love at First Sight meeting, or I should say that we were told of the meetings.  The problem was that apparently the resort did not confirm the meetings with the decor folks or the photographer.  The former was over a half hour late, and the latter was not available until the next day.

As to the hotel generally, we were taken a bit aback by the staff attitude (not Nuria and Claribel mentioned below).  We felt as if the staff expected tips.  While we tip generously, we do not like to feel pressured.  Also, the hotel had made dinner arrangements for our guests on the first night.  The one group was no seated until 30 minutes after the reservation and the second was seated in a restaurant that did not serve what we expected.  The property did make it up to us - wine off the wine list was on them for the one group and they made a second set of reservations for the following night and everyone had a wonderful time the second night.

In a similar vain, while we were there another family (unrelated) made reservations for golf on Thursday.  When the went to the lobby to go golf, they were told there was no reservation.  They made a new reservation for Sunday.  The appointed time came and again they were told there was no reservation.  They were livid and rightfully so.  The course was just beautiful (we saw it on the Segway tour).

The wedding itself was wonderful.Our photographer, Hernan of Tropic One was superb.  Nuria and Claribel (the Romance Coordinators - the hotel folks in charge of getting things done) were really helpful and responsive.  The Romantic Dominican Trio was perfect for the cocktail reception.

There were two things wrong with the dinner.  The cake was rectangular instead of round.  Nuria offered to have a new one baked, but we did not care - it was fine.  The chairs were not covered in ivory but rather were tan.  This one does bother me, because we spoke 4 times and gave them written instruction.  In fact, the day before we said "when in doubt, its ivory."  So either they got it wrong even though we had gone over it and over it.  Or they made a managerial decision which should have been ours.

The food was perfect.  Cannot recommend the beach bbq more - it is exactly what a Caribbean destination wedding should be.

The next morning, we left and had a perfect honeymoon at the Excellence.  

In short the place is beautiful and the wedding and reception was just wonderful.  Management, however, is lacking.

reviews.author: BenW01
reviews.title: Excellent trip, relaxing property, great staff
reviews.text:
Back from a 5 day trip to Paradisus Palma Real.  We stayed in a Royal Service Imperial Ocean Front Suite.  The room was great.  The butlers are helpful- reserve your cabana 11am the day prior to hopefully guarantee you have one by the pool!  There are plenty of chairs, space on the beach and areas to setup for the day.  The bartender at the Royal Service pool bar, Leonardo Mota (Leo), helped make every day fun.  He's a great personality, has a good time doing his job and is one of those people that makes your stay memorable.  Definitely go see him.

The food was good- some of the best food we've had at all inclusives.  The entertainment was not great- their venue is more like a conference setup vs a tropical theater.  We've been to Excellence PC, Excellence Playa Mujeres and two Couples resorts- all of which had better evening entertainment options.  Having said that, if you don't care about the shows, you are not missing anything at this resort.  It has everything else you could work- including a more laid back atmosphere vs party atmosphere.  Good mix of different age couples.

reviews.author: Monica T
reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay
reviews.text: My company chose this hotel for the top sales rep of the year. They made an excellent choice. Their was about 200 people including a guest. From the time we reached the airport upon arriving at the hotel was an extremely flawless transition. The hotel got everyone checked in, assigned a butler and in your room within 30 minutes of arriving at the hotel. The room was beatuiful. The only issue was not too much privacy due to the shutters. Room service was quick. If you are able go with the Royal Service, the private pool and beach was awesome. Besides the bathroom which was not a deal breaker, our butler was missing in action. The phones they give you to keep in contact with your butler did not work the entire trip. The internet was horrible.

reviews.author: Lish K
reviews.title: Luxury but some unique things to consider
reviews.text:
First, I would definately go back but I am not sure of the experience for the average guest.
My husband's company took a large group and we stayed in the higher end-Royale , adult only area.
Our bracelets indicated to the staff and merchants on the beach ,we were in the higher area on
our resort. We were treated so well. Our butler, Fermin Mota, would come to the beach cabana
and find me every day to see if we needed anything. I did not  contact him much.
One of my favorite workers was,Martin on the beach. He was so kind and remembered us everytime. He saved our cabana every day and literally ran in that sand to get extra towels or drinks if we needed them. I did not tip him every day, so he was not being kind only for $$. I saw new people arrive daily and not know what was available. He seemed to always know and help everyone.
 I also have a food allergy to onion. Which makes it so difficult to eat out. We went to Mole one night (4 or 5 couples)Leo Handy was our waiter. He took such care and concern to make sure my food was ok. He checked on us alot and was very concerned for me. That means alot. All waiters were super helpful, especially during our organized farewell dinner.The only negative was in the private restaurant, Pallazo, the Chef on the grill had premade skewers of shrimp, onion and peppers. We were there right as they opened and there were no other guests. So he was not too busy. He refused to accommodate me with shrimp only. Very UGLY! I do not know his name but our waiter was obviously embarrassed and spoke to the head chef, who looked unhappy(I do not speak Spanish?)They had fresh shrimp grilled and brought to me. VERY AMAZING!!
The area is tight around the pool. We have stayed at several all-inclusive in Jamaica and Mexico. There were no tables and activities in the pool area. Which gave it a more relaxing feel and luxury. The other countries have a party vibe.  
If I had to say a con..The desserts were NOT impressive. Some people(myself) like a rich chocolate dessert .Bite size is good if it is YUMMY!No dessert was to me.There were children on
 property and the only open restaurant,Market Grill, often had old , cold food but ok for kids I GUESS. Most of the children were well behaved but I prefer adult only.

reviews.author: Mary H
reviews.title: Pedro Cedano
reviews.text:
Just had a recent trip to the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana from March 19-23rd.  What a BEAUTIFUL resort overall and the staff was extremely helpful and knowledgeable.  

The absolute shining star of this show though is Pedro Cedano....he was one of the attendants at the royal service beach....he should train the rest of the staff.  He hustled and was charming.  He is truly an asset to this resort and and to their guests.

reviews.author: Ali R
reviews.title: Dying to go back
reviews.text: My best friend and I found some great deals on expedia for Punta Cana, and after reading what felt like hundreds of reviews, finally settled on the Palma Real. It was an absolute paradise. From finger painting to the Michael Jackson show to basking on the pristine beach, this was the vacation of a lifetime. I'm already planning on going back next year. I still can't understand the negative reviews that I'm reading. Sure, they might not come to serve you a drink every few minutes, but there are bars everywhere and the wait is never that long. The property is gorgeous, the food is outstanding, and the people who work there are charming and enthusiastic. I guess that actually might be the one downside- that they try a little too hard to get you to do activities and are a little up in your face all day. But I loved joking with them, and after a few days they understand which activities you like and which you would rather skip. I have to say the highlights are the beach, the rooms, and the FOOD. I never got sick of it, the breakfast and lunch buffets are heavenly, and there are just so many dinner options. We had a room very near the lobby on the first floor, so it was a little loud with the dance club nearby, but it wasn't a problem. The gym had everything we needed and the free tennis and paddle tennis courts are just a short walk away. The shows were hit or miss, but still fun to see all of them. Our drinks were always really strong- we gave a couple dollars tip for every round. I can see why so many weddings take place, this resort is really a 5 star experience.

reviews.author: Dianne B
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort from March 18-25 and had a wonderful time.  We had excellent service from so many.  Juan Bautista Rodriguez at the Naos and Michglet Loase at the Sunrise Bar were awesome.  At the beach Junior Ramirez and Gabriel Dalusma gave us excellent service as well. I can't wait to go back there again next year.  The grounds were beautiful and the suites were clean and we had no problems.  
DJ & DAB  
Maine

reviews.author: SSSS611
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text:
The rooms, food and entertainment at this resort are all of very high quality.  You can get almost anything you want to do watch or eat within minutes during any time of day or night. The event staff including Big Mac and Anjeli are both welcoming and very entertaining. Luis the bartender is fabulous. I felt at home and extremely comfortable every day at this resort. 

However, the front desk staff needs help in understanding that their service may turn away customers. Most answers from front desk staff are no upon first requesting a room change or an extension of stay and a few other things like restaurant reservations while on the resort.  I would consider making reservations for restaurants in advance as they are Hard to get while on site.

reviews.author: mjp_travel8994
reviews.title: Great spot for friends
reviews.text:
Overall, the Palma Real was wonderful. The property is massive, and there seems to be something to do for everyone. While I would most likely recommend this hotel to others, there are a few details I want to mention:

PROS:
1. Great pool with a swim up bar
2. Beach access 
3. Cabanas available near the pool- should get up early to go down and reserve them
4. Spacious rooms
5. Bartenders at Avenue and Sky bar are great!! Bartenders in general were great, but those 2 seemed to make the best drinks
6. Reasonable breakfast selection at Naos buffet, service staff there was good. 
7. Property was kept clean

CONS:
1. Mole restaurant served food that was mediocre at best, and horrible service. It took over 1.5 hours to receive our food, and it was cold. 
2. Service overall at each of the restaurants is poor. Aptly staffed, but poor training 
3. Power went out twice while we were at the property (very early in the morning, between 4am-7am), which also stopped the running water. Not sure if this was a recurring problem or not
4. Walkup buildings for rooms
5. Food is mediocre at best. However, my friends who ate steaks at Market Grill said they were very good. 

TIPS:
1. Rooms are located in walkup buildings- we were not aware of this. If climbing stairs is an issue I would recommend contacting the hotel to request a ground floor room
2. Make your restaurant reservations ahead of time. We were in constant touch with the concierge about our restaurant reservations, and still experienced a few difficulties with them. Reconfirm your reservations as soon as you arrive at the hotel!
3. Market grill had the best service amongst the restaurants we visited
4. Ask the chef at market grill for fresh guacamole during the day! 
5. Go downstairs at 8am to grab a cabana for the day
6. I observed either families with infants/toddlers or groups of friends at this property, not sure how much a family might enjoy it (I think the reserve is targeted more towards families)

Punta Cana Traveling Tips:
1. Voltage is the same as the US
2. There is no airport shuttle, but the party traveling with us had a good experience with domincantransfers.com. We used a shared taxi to the hotel ($30 total for 2 people), and a private taxi on the way back ($30 total for 2 people). At the airport one of the men that was standing near the baggage claim took our bags and said it was for the taxi service (many people were doing this), and then lead us to a shared van. We did not want to do this, but it wasn't too bad as we were traveling in the same direction of our hotel.
