3. When traveling back, get to the airport early! We had an afternoon flight and experienced long lines at checkin, security, and immigration. CHECK IN FOR YOUR FLIGHT ONLINE AND PAY FOR YOUR CHECKED BAGS ONLINE (keep a receipt so they are able to verify). Bag drop lines are still long, but less than lines where bags still needed to be paid for.

reviews.author: Виктория М
reviews.title: Олег и Виктория 1.03 - 12.03.14
reviews.text: В сети Парадисус останавливаемся не первый раз и не в одной стране, все как всегда на высоком уровне! Удачное расположение, хороший номерной фонд, отличная еда, вкусные коктейли, все это плюсом к океану и отличной погоде! Что еще нужно? Хорошее обслуживание в роял сервис... и это есть в лице Джонфи Ривера! Такого толкового батлера у нас не было ни разу :) Отличное знание русского языка и готовность помочь в любом вопросе, очень тактичный и с очаровательной улыбкой! Спасибо тебе еще раз!!! моя семья :) Рекомендуем всем русскоязычным туристам! Вас не оставят без внимания и заботы!

reviews.author: Ken M
reviews.title: Palma Real
reviews.text:
We just returned from our 10th vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. Our stay was fantastic. To start on arrival we were able to upgrade to "Royal Service" which is well worth the expense. 
We noticed a big notch up in the quality of the food in the restaurants this year. Speaking to one of the waiters we learned the resort has a new chef and it shows. I have been in the Wine and Food business all my life and the Palma Real has the best food we have encountered anywhere in the Caribbean. 
There is a new restaurant only available to Royal Service guests called Palazzo which we enjoyed so much we went three times for dinner. Our food and wine service was very professionally handles by a personable young man named Alexander Guzman. Living on Cape Cod we are very picky about the freshness and quality of fish. My wife had the Seared Fresh Tuna three times it was so good. 
The only meal we had that was below par was at the Mexican Restaurant "Mole". That one can be skipped in my opinion. We had excellent meals at Gabi Beach and Vento as well as the above mentioned Palazzo. There is a new policy for Passion Restaurant which levies a $60.00 surcharge for dinner so we skipped that one all together.
We ate breakfast and lunch every day at the buffet at Naos which was very enjoyable. The fresh squeezed juice and smoothy bar at breakfast is terrific and the were very accommodating in making me a special passion fruit smoothy evry morning. Jaun Subrez was very attentive waiting on us at lunch in Naos.

The beach is the main attraction here and it is gorgeous. We were spoiled at the Royal Service beach by Pedro and Super Billy who looked out for our every need.
One very important feature of the stretch of beach the Palma Real is located on is a reef 500 yards or so off shore which protects the area from being too rough. On previous trips we stayed at one of the Majestic resorts and last year at the Excellence Punta Cana where the undertow was so severe they were keeping guests out of the water. We're not "pool people" so this was kind of a deal breaker for us. We have never had that problem at the Palma Real.

Sometimes even in Paradise bad things happen and the hotel was up to the challenge. I had a very painful dental emergency half way through the trip. I went to the front desk to inquire about dental services and they made a call which resulted in a dentist driving to pick me up in the lobby 10 minutes after the call. He drove me to his clinic did the required work, drove me to a pharmacy and picked up some pain medication and antibiotics and delivered me back to the resort. The result was that I was able to enjoy the rest of the trip. 

We will be revisiting the Palma Real again for many years.

reviews.author: Elise V
reviews.title: Incroyable hotel
reviews.text: Très bon service. Hôtel très propre avec des chambres incroyables. Superbe plage. Un merci tout particulier aux serveurs du Gaby Club pour leur service et professionnalisme. Merci tout particulier à Hehwan Ramirez Mercedes pour son bon travail !

reviews.author: panseco69
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
This was one of the best properties I've ever been to, the hotel, grounds, layout were first class and first rate.  We stayed there for 4 nights and could not have had a better time.

The service was exceptional, everyone was genuinely friendly and helpful and catered to our every need.

The grounds were immaculate and cared for daily, not a spec of trash or dead leaves on the ground, The flora and fauna were beautiful also with well maintained gardens.

The food was excellent with numerous restaurants and buffets, the liquor was ever flowing, we ate and drank ourselves into a coma daily.  The beach and pools were beautiful also.

The only thing I could think to make issue of would be the spotty wi fi service.

All in all a fantastic get away, I'll be going back in July.

reviews.author: Ellen T
reviews.title: Friendly staff and outstanding service
reviews.text: The staff at this beautiful resort really made our experience exceptional! Super Billy (Leonardo) from the day we arrived until the day we left made sure he prepared our chairs on the beach and had them ready for us when we came down in the morning. He remembered who we sat with and where we liked to sit. He never stopped smiling! Pedro Cedano gave us water and drinks and made sure we had everything we needed while we enjoyed the sun, sand, and beautiful ocean. We never saw him walk-he always runs! He knew which drink I liked and remembered what time I usually asked for it. By the second or third day he just asked me if I was ready for it. Amazing "Big Mac" MacDonna! Best water aerobic instructor/Zumba/dance/volleyball all- round talented great personality, fun, energetic guy! Gave a friend and me a private water aerobics lesson early in the morning the day we were leaving because we wanted to squeeze in one more session! There are a lot of beautiful resorts in the Caribbean, but none with a staff as exceptional friendly who give this high quality service.               Ellen

reviews.author: Alex G
reviews.title: Stay at the main Hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel is great!
The beach, the service, the food... are all great. There are only 2 things that I didn't like. Finding good vodka it's almost impossible. Keep in mind I'm not taking about cirroc, grey goose or the alike. I'm talking about something basic, but good, like absolut. They have the bottle everywhere but they won't serve it. I specifically asked for it and was told they were out. I had to point at the bottle everytime to force them to serve it. The other dissapointment was the Gabi restaurant. The service was horrible compare to the main hotel. The staff attitude was completely different than the staff at the main hotel.

reviews.author: Katherine O
reviews.title: Fabulous Spring Break Punta Cana!
reviews.text: For all inclusive, we had a wonderful time at the Paradisus PC.  Paradisus is located on the prettiest part of the beach!  We stayed at the Reserve section of the property which is set back from the main beach front, offering a little more personal attention, seclusion and quite.  OUr room was very spacious and well appointed. You definitely get your exercise with a lot of walking to and from the beach (it's really not far), but the resort offers a tram to shuttle you around the property and is very reliable. You can also reserve bikes at arrival for use during your stay too. The spa was wonderful, excellent massage! The gym is nicely equipped, with a daily spin class at 10am and yoga at 3. Our concierge Diosmery was genuinely sincere and helpful. The Aqua, Vento and La Palapa were our favorite restaurants.  If you have a big group, book your dinner reservations in advance. The grounds are immaculate and well maintained. As with any all inclusives hotels, there is give and take at times, but overall it was great and we were very pleased.  The staff were always warm and friendly! We had a lovely stay and hope to return again soon!

reviews.author: gary c
reviews.title: November 2013
reviews.text: What a great time.  The Royal Service is a must!  Private beach, pool and restaurant all for the Royal Service vacationers!  Numerous of places to eat.  Never a problem  From 5 Star to Buffet.  Private butler made all of our reservations both on the resort and off.  We were given a cell phone upon our arrival.  We would return in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Molly W
reviews.title: Plush resort that delivers relaxation- but skip royal service
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time here, however the Royal Service (RS) is something I was intrigued to try but having experienced it, I would not pay for again. Royal Service came with a Butler,Nicholas,who was absent majority of the time, the cell phone given to reach the butler, never worked; the exclusive RS restaurant had the worst service of all, ironically. The exclusive pool & bar were a nice concept, it was kinda nice to go to the "commoner" area where it was more alive. Having the butler draw baths and personally scented pillows was not worth it.  Yes, butler helped make dinner revs. But I think with iron persistence, u could do that yourself. Our RS level room was very nice and large, however we were rarely in the room. The RS lounge is overrated and seldom used by anyone, not to mention the ladies who work there are not too eager to help. The food at the resort no matter what unique specialty cuisine it's prides itself on, was ALL par.  Nothing extrordinary. (keep in mind they already have your money so they don't need to impress you, they just have to feed you a decent meal). The beaches and the pools were amazing and the best part of the RS was access to the private Bali beds on the beach with a palapa and attendant to get you bevies, reserve your Bali bed each day, ready with towels,etc..but if Bali beds on the beach was the only true value I found in the lofty up-charge for RS, I do not deem, that alone, worth it. As a non-RS guest you can still get Bali beds by the pool, just not the beach. Francisco Cabrera in the RS beach area was amazing! We tipped him up front and he made everyday worry free on the beach with our same selected palapa, Bali bed, and 2 lounge chairs set up for us every day. He also got drinks for us and checked-in with us routinely. He was way more attentive, helpful, and customer-serviced oriented than our assigned butler. Thank you Francisco Cabrera! We spent much of our time relaxing on the warm beach, and sitting in the shoreline of the ocean. We would definitely stay here again, we felt safe, it was very clean, and beautiful. We just would skip the RS, and miss our Bali beach beds and Francisco. In addition, you are not missing out on the "water ritual" at the spa- pathetic. Entertainment shows at night were fun. We also spent time at night watching iPad movies and FaceTime with folks back home. (Yes, they have WiFi)  Also, the "hot tubs" within the pools, are not hot, they are not even warm.. It just would appear they are. But u won't need them anyway.

reviews.author: CPJ518
reviews.title: Ladies Trip
reviews.text: We had a perfect ladies getaway at Palma Real.  The resort was beautiful and the weather perfect.  We enjoyed the special care and extra attention of the  Royal Service.  Our butler Sandy was terrific taking care of all of our dinner reservation and anything we needed.   Ramone our beach attendant made everyday a perfect day on the beach and Leonardo  the bartender was awesome and always surprised us with our special color drinks of the day!   The only complaint would be that the Royal service was supposed to provide a smooth  check in which it did not.....it took way too long,  our room was not ready or adjusted to our prior request and it took 3 days to finally get the TV working properly. We would still say  all in all a great vacation and can't wait to go back again next year!

reviews.author: Kellygurl74
reviews.title: Best Vacation!!
reviews.text: I have to say Punta Cana is such a beautiful city from the beaches to the people to just about everything.My hotel was gorgeous,right when i pulled up the wonderful service started,i was greeted by the most kindest and sweet bell boy named Ambiorix Mesa he was such a nice and helpful man to making sure from that start that i was completely taken care off and always happy.The Reserve part is where i stayed and it is breath taking.The pool is very clean and large to move around a lot or to just lounge by it drinking cocktails which of coarse are unlimited and very tasty.The staff every where are so gracious and kind and go completely out of their way to make sure your stay is fabulous.My room was also breath taking also with a big jacuzzi tub to a big comfy king size bed also a shower and terrace very roomie.The food also was great,huge selection of fish,all meats,salads,pizza,you name it they pretty much had it.My favourite el a cart restaurant was Ventio,very delicious it is a must try.The beach is gorgeous there nice white sand with endless clear blue water just amazing.I highly recommend The Paradisus Reserve i had such a great accommodating stay i will absolutely be back..very happy in paradise..An outstanding vacation.

reviews.author: Thiago Q
reviews.title: All our cash was stolen in the room
reviews.text:
My fiance and I spent 4 nights at the resort. At check-in, we upgraded to Royal Service for US$468 to improve our experience. Things went ok until the very last night. When we came to the room in the evening, we realized all of our cash (kept in our wallets inside our luggage) was taken. Situation was immediatelly reported to Mr. Domingo Beltre, hotel guest manager, who promptly initiated an internal investigation procedure. While they found out that only housekeeping and mini bar replacement were in the room that day, they asked for a 72 hours window to conclude on the investigation. A week after we took off, I received a call from Mr. Beltre (after leaving at least 4 messages and exchanging a few emails) saying they found no evidences and there was nothing to be done. I asked him to kindly consider refunding our Royal service upgrade money, because we obvisouly didn't get it. Mr. Beltre refused my request. 
While it was our mistake and our decision not to use the safebox, this is not what you expect from a 5 star resort. Lesson learned. AVOID THIS RESORT

reviews.author: 274Monica
reviews.title: muy mala atención
reviews.text: llegamos y nos dijeron que la reserva estaba cancelada, nos dejaron 4 hs sin respuesta teniendo la reserva activa, llamamos a la agencia que nos había vendido y estaba todo re confirmado y pagado. jamas nos pidieron disculpa. Nuestra habitacion tenia problemas de luz y de agua. un bajon

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus with a friend who was there on a business incentive trip. We stayed in a Royal Service sea view room. Wow. The view must have been the best in the hotel. The room came with butler service. Our butler was called Narciso Green and our stay was made even better with his excellent service and attention. If I return I will be asking for him again. The food is of a high standard and is plentiful. You have many restaurants and cuisines to choose from. Our favourites were the mexican (Mole) and the Japanese Tepanyaki (Misu, at The Reserve). Our chef at misu was called Felix and he did an amazing show. One tip I will add is to make your reservations for the selected restaurants early as they can get booked up quickly. The beaches are just fantastic. White sand, turquoise sea, palm trees and big double sun lounges with thick matresses. Just be sure to get out early to make sure you get one. If not there is pleanty of space around the massive main pool. There is also a swim up bar where they will serve cocktails, shorts or the local 'Presidente' beer which is very refreshing. The hotel has a small outlet shopping centre just outside the resort. We did not visit but there was a complimentary bus/shuttle service and there looked to be a variety of top branded shops. All in all I would like to revisit with my wife as it is ideally suited for a romantic getaway.

reviews.author: Gail R
reviews.title: Great Resort, Beautiful Beach, Exceptional Service
reviews.text:
This was my third visit to Paradisus Palma Real, and once again had a thoroughly enjoyable experience.    The facilities were well maintained and any small insufficiency was quickly resolved once brought to the attention of staff.   While every aspect of the resort -- beach, pools, restaurants and food, etc., were all great, in my opinion it was/is the friendly, well trained and capable staff that made the difference.     I would, in particular, like to acknowledge the following individuals who, because of their welcoming demeanor, attention to detail,and willingness to go the extra mile, made my stay a total success.  It is because of them that I have chosen to return next year rather than travel to a different destination.  

Juan De Rios; Fernando Pena; Felipe Morlac; Francesco Estrella; Wily Mercado; Wisly Fortune; Fanklon delaRosa; Jonathon Aria; Renee Garcia Peguero; Diony Martinez  -- thank you!    I look forward to seeing you same time next year!

reviews.author: R B
reviews.title: Not great (see also wedding review)
reviews.text:
This place has gorgeous grounds and friendly staff that will try to please you.  However, things are broken in the rooms (among all the people in my group 8 rooms altogether we had a broken closet/shower/safe/iron/toilet the first they we arrived.  Within one day they fixed everything (except I had to wait 2 days for a working iron).  Some of the rooms were dark (on the first floor) and smelled musty (the covers on the bed had moldy spots and smelled musty).  Our room was separated from the neighbors by a door and you could hear everything. The food was just OK.  I had a few complaints regarding my wedding and the night before we left me and my hubby sat down with one of the managers to talk with him about all the bad experiences we had (see below) but he just smiled took some notes and did nothing about it.  He said we will hear from him after he looks into the matter but we never did.  DO NOT eat at any of the restaurants you have to pay at.  As a treat my husband took me to Passions the day after our wedding for a 5 dinner course paired with wine.  For $150 we had food that was a joke (the dishes looked and tasted like plastic jelly - it was supposed to be French but tasted nothing like it) and was paired with cheap Spanish wine (our "champagne" was Spanish Cava).  Don't waste your money, just eat at the inclusive restaurants they were all ok except Bana (which I did not try but nobody in my wedding party liked).  Also they will not let men with open shoes in the restaurants.  My uncle has gout and they would not let him into Vento with his sandals even as I pleaded with the staff.  He had to put on closed toe shoe that made him uncomfortable the whole nite.   The positive about this place is that the grounds are very pretty and the staff is nice. That's about it.

I decided to have my wedding here last October and it took me a while to get over my disappointment and write a fair review hence this review is 5 months after.  The reason I decided on PPR was the glowing reviews other brides wrote and at the time it was considered #1 on destination weddings list in Punta Cana.  It was a small wedding (14 people) and since the amount I paid was just as much as if I had 24 people attending I especially expected good service.  The staff in charge of the wedding instead of taking care of my dress and the groom's outfit (as stated in the package I paid for) gave me a steamer that ended up leaking hot water all over.  Here I was the morning of the wedding trying to steam my dress with my mother and getting our hands burned all over.  So instead of steaming we decided to use the iron (thankfully I had a short dress without any complicated ruffles).  BTW the iron was replaced 2 days after we arrived (the one in the room was broken).  We got a working iron the night before the wedding so my fiancé can iron his shirt.  On the top of everything I come back to my room the morning of the wedding (after I had my hair done) to an unclean room (it was around 11am) and had to call the reception to send someone asap as my photographer was coming an hour later to start taking pictures (here I was trying to put makeup on and get organized and rushing the poor cleaning lady).  In addition, it was raining cats and dogs, so they had to change my wedding ceremony and reception location and they wanted me to let everyone know about this change.  At this point I decided to put my foot down so they decided to call everyone but I still had to provide everyone's room number.  Not to mention that my wedding party was placed all over the resort (not in one building as they should have been) and the place was pretty empty.  I am wondering why did I have to provide them with everyone's name and flight information a month before we arrived.  What a waste of time! The night of the wedding they were supposed to do a turn down service in the room (fill the tub, put roses in water and around bed and leave a bottle of champagne for us) which we never received.  When I complained we came back the next nite to rose petals on bed which at this point was a waste.  Overall I would not recommend this place for a wedding!  It was a very stressful experience that left me beyond disappointed.   As a couple that paid a lot of money for a wedding we did not receive the best service.  On the other hand a couple that were attending our wedding got the service of their life just because they attended a time share seminar upon their arrival (2 days before we arrived) and had dinners comped at Gabi, a person who checked with them every day to see what their needs were etc.  They received all the at  A few details about the services they offer: the person that did my hair was excellent, however my maid of honor's hair fell apart as soon as she started dancing.  So I guess it's upto who you get but I think they try to give the bride their best.  However, their nail polishes are really old, my French manicure did not last and did not look that great.  I recommend the DJ, they were excellent.  However, I made a cd just in case they did not have some of the songs I wanted and those particular songs they used from my cd did not sound great.  The day of my wedding it was a downpour (which started the night before) and they did a really good job moving me from beach terrace to the Apollo foyer, however there was no air circulation in there even though it's an open space.  After a night of dancing everyone was passing out from heat exhaustion.  The table setup was really nice but instead of candles I ordered in hurricanes they put cheap tea candles so bring your own if you can.

reviews.author: JETS
reviews.title: Great vacation at Palma Real
reviews.text: Just returned from a wonderful 5 days at Palma Real.  Beautiful property and fantastic beach.  Perfect for R&R.  We spent all 5 days just hanging out on the beach, and our Royal Service  experience was made even better by Francisco Cabrera and "Super" Billy.  These guys took such good care of us on the beach.  If you are traveling to this property, please seek them out.

reviews.author: Michaela H
reviews.title: Beach was Heavenly
reviews.text:
2 single gals - we went for a winter getaway. We paid the up-charge for Royal Service. Our upgraded room was ok - lovely balcony/deck, fantastic mini bar that they customize to your preference, but know that the bathrooms are not fully enclosed - a large part of the wall separating the bathroom from the first bed was shutters (like a country bar). Single sink in the bathroom too. The shower was built in such a way that abundant amounts of water escaped the enclosure so, plan to use all towels on hand to deal with that. The toilet ran 1/2 the time you flushed it, so build that into your routine too. The wifi worked 20% of the time at best and when it did, it was very slow. Wifi was the same THROUGHOUT the resort. 

Royal Service was great in that you can stop by the lounge for snacks, drinks or information throughout the day. Beautiful views from the lounge of course too! The butler service was more of a hassle than a help. Our butler told us wrong times/dates/locations for dinner (you have to have a reservation for dining anywhere but the main buffet). He didn't do anything that we could't have done without the headache of trying to reach him to make the reservation or to hear the result. We heard other butlers were fantastic. Ours was not and on the last day, he showed up to 'help us with luggage' - no doubt to get a tip. He couldn't be bothered to get my name right after the week so I couldn't be bothered to give him a tip. 

The other services - private beach, fresh juice bar on the beach, beach volleyball (main part of resort) were FANTASTIC. heavenly. private beach staff, esp Pedro were very helpful and nice. If you're looking for a beautiful beach, you'll find it here! Food was good throughout. Cevice on the buffets and/or menus was outstanding! Sushi restaurant was one of the best. Asian fusion - not bad, but not that great either.

reviews.author: Lizeth O
reviews.title: Beautiful family Resort
reviews.text:
I traveled with a group of 10 people. When we got to our rooms it turned out all but one of the rooms was upgraded without the staff telling us.  While the upgrade was great, it was unfair for them to exclude one couple. We would not have known the difference if they had just not upgraded us in the first place.  That being said, I was in one of the upgraded rooms and it was incredibly spacious and beautiful.  We were greeted at our door with a plate of chocolates.  Unfortunately no one else in our party was.  I'm not sure how they decide which rooms get the fun extras but since our party had several rooms at the resort it was interesting to compare which rooms got treats certain days and which rooms did not.  

The resort was clean and well maintained.  The food was good and they kept the drinks coming.  Even though the resort is large, there are shuttles that take you around. The beach is beautiful but you have to show up early to get a good spot near the water. We got the concierge service the last night. Worth it for the day service and just to feel a little extra special.  
The staff was nice.  We had a majority of extremely helpful people and a few seemed indifferent.  

Cons-  The shuttle they offer that takes you shopping  is not worth it if you want to get souvenirs.  The shuttle only takes you to the overpriced mall nearby.  If you want Souvenirs walk to the market right around the corner of the resort.  Its a 5 minute walk.  Go to the market to the right of the resort for better prices.  Always haggle!! I hate haggling but if one shop won't take your offer another one will.  
- room service takes forever

reviews.author: 513Bubbles
reviews.title: Another wonderful time at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Everything about this resort including the weather, couldn't have been nicer.  The routine service that goes along with Royal Service was terrific.  We especially would like to thank our Royal Service butler Fermin and Rosy in the Royal Service reception center.  We had to change our plans and leave sooner because of the weather and a family wedding and without their help, it might not have happened.  They couldn't have been more kind and caring.  Fermin made our new transfer pickup and waited with us in the lobby till our bags and we were on our way.  This is our second time at this resort with another couple and everything about it is consistently good and hope we can make this trip next year for the third time.

reviews.author: Torxpi T
reviews.title: Una vaina loca!!!
reviews.text:
Acabamos de llegar a Madrid de estar en este Hotel la semana pasada. Quiero señalar que estaba todo muy limpio y ordenado, y el personal maravilloso. Especialmente agradecer su atención a Francisco Macdonald ( Big Mac, para los amigos) que se esforzó al 100% para que estuviéramos a gusto, informarnos de las actividades de animación, explicarnos con claridad y un poco de humor la cultura de esa zona y sobre todo echarnos unas risas inolvidables con el. 
No nos podemos olvidar tampoco de Luis y Gustavo, del bar de la piscina que sufrieron y trabajaron muchísimo con nuestros pedidos , ya que éramos un grupo grande.
También agradecer a Roberto y Lorenzo del bar nocturno junto al teatro, que son unos auténticos profesionales del gremio e hicieron lo imposible para que estuviéramos a gusto. ( increíble los cócteles que hacen...)
En general, todo muy bien, si vuelvo a Punta Cana, iré allí de nuevo.
Saludos a tod@s.

reviews.author: PatWhit
reviews.title: A week at the Palma Real
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful. The service, for the most part, is fabulous. The room was great. Loved the "all-inclusive" aspect. Wonderful pool - I liked the swim-up bar. Beautiful beach. The parasailing and catamaran outing (neither was included in the price) were great fun. I did think the spa prices were excessively high. The food was the only disappointment. They should take lessons from the cruising industry. There were 5 restaurants to choose from besides the buffet. Only the two Asian restaurants and the Mexican bistro met expectations. Great place to relax and get away from the ice and snow up north.

reviews.author: Ann B
reviews.title: Almost Paradise!
reviews.text:
We loved our trip to the Paradisus overall. However, I would have expected the experience to be perfect for the price you pay. 

Pros: Food was almost always spot on with few exceptions, Massage at the YHI spa was incredible, the facility and grounds in general were wonderful: amazing pool, huge beach, beautiful lobby great bars and clubs, etc..., Staff was always friendly and for the most part spoke English. Even though it was all inclusive, no one opposed to asking for more alcohol in drinks or more food in general. Free room service at night was also key!

Cons: We had to switch rooms midway through our trip because first, there was water dripping from condensation on the ceiling - called to get it fixed and someone came out, drilled holes in the ceiling to drain water and essentially broke the air conditioner that was causing it. Had to sleep in a hot and sticky room the next night. When we switched rooms in the morning, it was beautiful! Perfect in every way. Bigger, cleaner, more light better view. Wish we could have avoided the first room all together. 

We were there as a group and really had a fantastic time. The bartenders and activity leaders were so energetic and friendly. I would certainly recommend staying here, but beware of the bad lemon rooms!

reviews.author: Salvador S
reviews.title: excelente
reviews.text:
falta profesionalidad en recepción y un responsable GERENTE que atienda al cliente que lo requiera.
A mi llegada no nos dierón la categoría VIP que teniamos contratada y nos pusieron a las 6 personas que viajamos ( 3 room) la pulsera verde en vez de la negra y solamente el último día que en el mostrador un recepcionista se dio cuenta y nos cambio las pulseras, cuando ya no lo necesitamos por regresar a la mañana siguiente.Varias veces pregunte por el Gerente o Director y nunca consegui verle en las 8 noches que hemos permanecido en ese hotel. Yo soy un cliente antiguo de los hoteles Melia y la reserva la realicé directamente con Meliá .com y no utilizo agencias.

reviews.author: Jean Michel D
reviews.title: Un endroit de rêve
reviews.text:
Nous sommes allés à punta Cana et sous le conseil d'un ami, nous avons choisi le paradisius à Punta Cana et plus spécialement La réserve.
Merci à nos amis car c'est vraiment un endroit magnifique.
Situé au milieu d'une végétation extraordinaire, l'hôtel entoure la piscine non moins extraordinaire avec les chaises longues intégrées dans l'eau
Que vous vouliez boire un verre dans la piscine ou au bar du Gaby beach, vous serez accueilli par une équipe toujours souriante et disponible. 
Si vous souhaitez déjeuner ou diner au Gaby, vous aurez le même accueil avec des repas dignes d'un très bon restaurant.
Détail non négligeable, la directrice, française d'origine, est très présente et à l'écoute des clients
Allez y les yeux fermés et suivez mon conseil comme nous avons suivi celui de nos amis

reviews.author: Ernesto T
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana IMPECABLE
reviews.text: Excelente trato y atención. Impecable atención del Manger Silvio Lantigua , los excelentes chefs Miguel en el restaurante Gabi  y Massimo en Aqua, con delicias y además el restaurante japonés todos con muy amable atención y excelente calidad y calidez

reviews.author: KRK4JC
reviews.title: A Wonderful Presidents Club Experience
reviews.text:
Just returned our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in the Royal Service section. It's a beautiful hotel with very nice rooms and a beautiful beach. A big shout out to Leonardo Mota who bartends at the Royal Service pool. He was outstanding and has an amazing attitude. Also, Luis the Butler who does his job extremely well with a smile.

There are a number of restaurant options and our personal favorite for dinner was Vento with excellent Mediterranean style food. Our experience at Bana was mixed and mainly due to the food, though our service was outstanding! Palazzo on the 1st night was a thumbs down and mainly due to the poor service and just how long it took for dinner to be served. Most liked their food and my steak was outstanding. Also had a serious issue here with the availability of Wines from the menu and finally settled on what was their suggested choice after I gave them 3. We came back for lunch a day later and it was much better! For most of the restaurants, you will want to order multiple Appetizers, since the portions are small.

If you want some energy in your nightlife, this is a great venue and we enjoyed the outdoors music and the vibe. We have been to a number of all-inclusives and this was a real distinctive. The layout of the restaurants and open atmosphere was a lot of fun that enhanced the experience. We aren't late nighters anymore, but the gathering of all the people was fun to watch.

My biggest negatives for the Royal Service experience ($650/nt) were that I had to pay extra if I wanted top-shelf Tequilla in the Lobby lounge or better wines in the restaurants, which is a hot button for me when paying this much. I literally had to go up to the Royal Service lounge, where you check in, to get a couple of shots of Herradura Tequila for the pool Bartender to use in my Frozen Margarita. Really! The other stuff was just rot gut, but Leonardo squeezed fresh limes for a greatly enhanced experience, which was truly appreciated. That was going the extra mile. Most of the inclusive wines were S. American and they weren't bad. We just had to pay if we wanted anything better from CA. Other places in Mexico like the Grand Velas resort have a much better selection from their all-inclusive list.

If you like to work out regularly, as I do, they have a pretty good Fitness Center with Free weights and Aerobic equipment. The Personal Trainers were always willing to help too.

My wife and I left very well rested and would go back if my company was paying for it as they did for 4 of the 5 nights. I personally would not pay $650/nt for the Royal Service experience.

reviews.author: Cindy E
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic. We chose the Paradesus Palma Real because of the reviews. The property is breathtaking and so are the beaches.  We were so pleased with our room.  It was quiet and beautiful.  We had a garden view which was gorgeous.  We were only steps away from the lobby which was so convenient.  We did not have royal service, but we did have the my time service. All of the staff was wonderful.  They were so nice and friendly.  When you have My time, you are able to use the club Melia services.  We were not able to use our credit card, but the staff had a credit card representative on the phone in minutes and the problem was resolved.  Our only complaint was the food. No one told us to make dinner reservations for the week when we arrived.  We ate at the market grill two nights and walked in with no reservations.  We were supposed to have one meal at Gabi Beach, but never got in.  We did eat lunch there one day, and it is by far the best restaurant.  We ate at the buffet most meals.  Breakfast is fine, but dinner and lunch are pretty much cafeteria grade food.  We would highly recommend the property and were not disappointed.  We went to enjoy the pool and beach.  We loved the water aerobics and zumba classes. My husband played golf.  It was only 40.00 after 2pm.  Overall , it was a great trip. I would highly recommend this property.

reviews.author: travelingk9
reviews.title: Not a Bad Trip
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, although OSHA does not exist in DR and some design features can be hazardous to one's health and safety.  For the most part, the service is good.  Tipping ensures excellent service at the bars, restaurants and poolside.  Our housekeeper was inconsistent although we tipped generously.  Despite the "Do Not Disturb" door hanger, she walked into our room several times.  She was "sparing" with soaps and lotion and did not take care of burnt out light bulbs.  We were uncomfortable leaving the property due to safety concerns, and we were there for 10 days. The beach had a lot of seaweed in the shallow water and along the shoreline.  The entertainment at night was a lot of fun, especially the fire dancers.  We also enjoyed the afternoon dance lessons. Finally, beware of tap water, raw fruits and vegetables, and under-cooked meats and eggs. My husband came home sick, and it has taken four weeks and several Rx for him to start feeling better.  The Paradisus is all-inclusive, and we had VIP access and accommodations, and can't imagine having less.

reviews.author: Jim S
reviews.title: Great Time - Service Excellent
reviews.text: Just returned from a customer incentive trip to the Paradisius Palma Real.  Had a wonderful time.  Special kudos to the help - bartenders at the Pool Bar: Pedro, Martin and especially Super Billy and Leonardo provided excellent service, great drinks and a friendly atmosphere around the bar.  Group functions were well planned and tended to with great service.  Thanks also to our butler, Sandy, for his attention to helping us with any questions or issues.  Hope to visit again.

reviews.author: Ceci H
reviews.title: Can't Wait to Return!
reviews.text: This all inclusive resort is top notch with beautiful grounds, incredible staff and great food selections.  This was a "girl's trip" to a new place and we all loved the experience and can't wait to go back.  We would like to say a special thank you to our friends from the Activities Team; Francisco and Wilfredo.  They truly helped make our trip special and memorable.  Gracias a todos!!!!!

reviews.author: Lirianspring
reviews.title: Hotel paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: O hotel e um eco resort com um paisagismo lindíssimo.  Bons restaurantes, instalação maravilhosa. O atendimento no lobby do hotel deixa um pouco a desejar.  Mas o hotel e incrível. Tudo mto bem organizado. Shows diários para entretenimento.

reviews.author: SPMF
reviews.title: Fantastic Activities Team
reviews.text: The "Life enriching activities" team are so energetic and encourage participation by all into the many different activities offered. Angel, Macdona, Francisco,Rachel, Wilfredo, Luis, and Famel kept me busy all week with water aerobics, water cycling, Zumba, Dance lessons, and beach games.  There was still lots of time to enjoy reading on the silky soft white sand beach and swimming in the glorious turquoise sea or in the pristine pools around the resort.  The grounds are vast and well kept with lots of walking paths.  The Wine tasting, cigar making, Dominican history and sushi workshops were so informative and enjoyable. The seven different restaurants were all great and offer a variety of cuisine styles.  Evenings shows were so enjoyable. The Michael Jackson show and the Cirque show being my favourites. I especially enjoyed the social dancing at the end of the day with the Activities crew and new found friends. Thanks to all for a real life 8 day fantacy!

reviews.author: Jim H
reviews.title: Awesome vacation
reviews.text: We made our First trip to Punta Cana on Jan. 25 and stayed for one week in building 39. The accomodations, food and staff were perfect. Our concierge Sandra made our stay very relaxing and took care of us like family. She made all our dinner reservations and checked on us several times during the week. We never had a bad meal and we ate at all the restaurants, our favorite was Bana. We stayed in the Reserve which provided everything it promised. We spent our days in the Reserve section of the beach and Ramon took excellent care of us.  All and all we never encountered anyone who was not smiling and happy to assist us. We are ready to make a return trip next year.

reviews.author: linda a
reviews.title: Perfect getaway!
reviews.text: What a beautiful property!  This hotel has excellent food, a wonderful staff and beautiful grounds.  Massage on the beach was amazing and coffee from Caesar to start the day was a real treat!  The drinks from the bar were all made from fresh ingredients, no mixes.  I've been to many properties in Punta Cana this is by far my favorite.

reviews.author: wqh
reviews.title: Unreal!
reviews.text:
Having been to many all inclusives, this is by far the best I've ever been to. The staff were simply unbelievable. The views and the beach are top notch - so relaxing! The food was excellent - WOW!
I'd go back in an instant!

reviews.author: malcato
reviews.title: Vale la pena ir al Royal Service
reviews.text:
Si podéis hacer el esfuerzo, vale la pena, por las habitaciones, por la localización, por los restaurantes reservados al RS, porque en la playa tienes una zona en la que tienes camas balinesas con una persona que viene cada poco tiempo a traerte lo que necesites, bebida, fruta, lo que quieras. Te preparan el jacuzzi de la habitación para la hora que quieras, que si con chocolate, con champán, que si bandeja de quesos.... 

He leído la última opinión nefasta de Silchina, y debe haber sido algo puntual. La diferencia entre la zona normal y la del RS, es pasar de un 5* a un 5*GL. Yo sólo por la parte de la playa, y el restaurante reservado al RS en el que se come genial, vale la pena pagar la diferencia. Hay otros restaurantes en el hotel, bastantes la verdad, a los que se fuimos varias veces, por probar y variar, pero con mucha distancia está la calidad de los productos que se ofrecen en el restaurante del Servicio Real. Igualmente para el personal.

El personal es muy amable, y desde luego no he visto diferente trato con americanos al que se refiere.

La zona de Spa, puedes ir al otro hotel y es genial, pero desde luego, la de este, aunque pequeña, está muy muy bien y en la semana que estuvimos, no recuerdo haber encontrado a nadie.
El tema del mayordomo, luego ya depende de la suerte que uno tenga con la persona, pero te gestiona las reservas de cenas, actividades, etc.

reviews.author: joyce m
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL / GREAT STAFF
reviews.text:
So impressed by the beauty and cleanliness of the resort.
However, what separates this place from others is the staff who go out of the way to make you and your trip feel special.
Four people we would like to single out for outstanding, pleasant, and helpful service.
They are Jorge Mora, Manager- Adriana, Management staff - Juana Rodriguez, front desk, and Juan Medrano, beach staff and sometimes bartender near Gabby's Restaurant.  We would definitely come back and we would also highly recommend this resort

reviews.author: BoardingPass7991
reviews.title: The Gabi club bar
reviews.text: Fun night at the bar with Alvin Martinez and Yael Familia. Great service and good drinks. Will definitely return. Special drinks without asking and kept us entertained. Friendly. Attentive. Great team. Nice atmosphere and people. Will recommend highly!

reviews.author: StarrBeaches
reviews.title: Exceptional Elegant and Under-Stated World-Class Resort
reviews.text: The Reserve has a very Zen vibe that I loved, but with every possible luxe touch the most decadent Western capitalist could ask for.  The decor was Eastern, minimal and understated. Lighting was muted and lovely. My friend and I (two 60-year-old women) somehow didn't know it was the family oriented part of the resort, so we were a little unprepared for the number of howling infants.  Our mistake. But the suites were gorgeous, roomy and comfortable, and we loved our garden and Thai hut outside. The staff was superb except for a slight tendency to blame the guest when a problem was mentioned in their loyal defense of their employer. (Like when I suggested security should have knocked before opening our door, where my friend was standing naked.) Yes, I had left my iPad exposed and the mini-bar guy had "dimed me out" and security wanted to be sure nothing was stolen.But still. Also, the pool isn't heated. It rained every night so it was always freezing (early January) as was the sea because Punta Cana is on the Atlantic, not the Caribbean.The food was superb everywhere--even the self-serve cafeteria--but they deserved better wines. And the list of wines to buy was totally inadequate. But in all, I would return in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Adam C
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!
reviews.text: Just got back from an amazing trip at the Paradisus!  The staff was attentive and did a great job.  Bayron Rodriguez was my room's butler - he was very attentive and professional.  Super Billy (he was super) took care of us on the beach, doing a great job serving drinks in a fun and welcoming manner.  Carlos at Skybar made late night drinking a blast. The food prevents this from gettig 5 stars. the food i had was average, but I must admit that I did not eat at any of the higher end restaurants at the resort.   Overall, great experience.

reviews.author: Theresa S
reviews.title: Wish I could have actually stayed there!!!
reviews.text:
We booked this holiday to spend time with my sister and her her husband.  They were able to go for two weeks, but with our work we were able to go only for one.  I had heard of people booking with other people and end up not even at the same resort, so to avoid this we booked through a travel agent at the Paradisus Punta Cana.  We even upgraded at $400 per person for Royal Service.  

My sister and her husband arrived on January 17th and were picked up at the airport and taken to what they thought was the Paradisus Punta Cana.  They were actually taken to the Paradisus Palma Real.  These two resorts are run by the same organization, and at no time were they told that they were in a different resort from what was booked.  They had a great time at the Palma Real, and thoroughly enjoyed their Royal Service Butler Javier.  They asked him to keep and eye out for our arrival on the 24th of January in hopes that we could get a room close to them and have Javier as our RS butler as well.  Much to their dismay they found out that we were going to be sent to an entirely different resort.  Luckily they sent us a text message that we got when our flight landed and we went to the Palma Real instead of the Punta Cana to have it all sorted out.

Unfortunately they informed us that both resorts were 110% booked and we would not be able to move to the Palma Real nor could they be moved to the Punta Cana.  We asked if we could have wrist bands for both resorts so we could travel back and forth between resorts and were told that they were not able to do this even though they are essentially the same organization.  We could not understand this.  Their ultimate solution was to move us all to an entirely different resort "Breathless" which was supposed to be 10 min away (more like 45 min).  So after landing at 4:30 pm we arrived at Breathless at approximately 11:00 pm.

I wish I could say what the service was like at either the Paradisus Punta Cana/Palma Real was like but unfortunately we paid $5200 cnd ($800) extra for Royal Service that we were not able to experience.  I believe that the simpler solution would have been to allow us to travel between resorts but keeping their customers happy was an option for them.  They kept saying that they were paying to have us moved but didn't seen to remember that we had already paid them as well.  I was especially disappointed when I found out that they paid to have us transferred to a resort that had the same "Royal Service" called "Xhale Club" at Breathless, but did not pay the extra for us to have what we paid for but were quite happy to keep the extra we paid to them.  Breathless is a very new resort about 45 min away and I have done a separate review for them.  Very disapointing!

reviews.author: Howeso
reviews.title: Great girls' getaway
reviews.text: Had a great time at Paradisus for a very short girls' getaway.  The grounds are lovely and the rooms clean and spacious.  The staff was incredibly friendly and this seemed to be a very genuine attitude throughout the resort.  The beach is gorgeous.  The rooms aren't the most modern in terms of amenities (eg: small bar fridge, old faucets and resurfaced tub, noisy AC) but more than satisfactory for the amount of time spent in them!  Special shoutouts to Marina for arranging a special dinner for us - what a treat, and to Noel for  wonderful yoga classes in the morning, and the other guys at the towel hut who helped out!  So much fun! Couple of suggestions for the resort: dinner arrangements are a big pain - it seems like the conventions take over the prime tables and times, making it hard to get a table anywhere. If you are going to an all inclusive you shouldn't have to book a private butler just to get dinner reservations.   Having to go each day back to the lobby to arrange this when you only have four days to enjoy is a bit of a hassle. Also when we just arrived after a long flight, quite hungry, we arrived at the unfortunate hour when NOTHING was open for food except the swim up pool bar with kinda gross fried food. It'd be nice to have one of the buffets open all day for those few hours when travellers or returning excursions could arrive hungry and tired.  A coupe other notes -  and these are genuinely reported more to let the hotel know how they could improve on a very nice location and experience, rather than a whining session: room keys that continually deprogrammed were a pain, and the room safes with a key rather than a passcode, carrying a $50 replacement fee - well that's not very convenient either!   Focus needs to be kept on convenience as much as service, and a little updating of these things could go a LONG way to greater enjoyment for guests. All this said, we had a great time and were very pleased and would return.

reviews.author: ALF
reviews.title: One of the best vacation experiences ever!
reviews.text: Wow! what an excellent vacation experience! My husband, friends and I are still raving about the fabulous time we had at the Paradisus Palma Real .First of all, we have to thank several outstanding individuals who made everyday that we were on the grounds very pleasant and enjoyable. The staff was top notch. Particularly those that made sure we were entertained and accommodated 24/7. Yubi, Maedonna, Francisco, Wilfred, Angel, Anyeli, and Famel (Life Enriching-Market Metrix) are to be commended for their dedication and professionalism that made us feel that we were being provided with VIP treatment. They were extremely multi-talented which helped us learn, laugh, stay active, and dance the nights away. They really made it difficult for us to leave this place of paradise. The resort grounds were immaculate, the pools and the beaches were beautiful, and resort suites were spacious and comfortable....although we spent very little time in our rooms. I should also mention the excellent service provided by the restaurant and bar staff. Juan, Wunder, and the rest of the Naos staff  were immediately available to ensure our taste buds were satisfied. And Mitchell at the members pool bar makes the best drinks on the island. My husband and I have traveled to Asia, Europe, and to many places around the world, but this Paradisus will always be a special memory for us. Without a doubt we will definitely be returning to Paradisus Palma Real and the Reserve for all of our future visits to Puna Canta. Absolutely amazing!!!

reviews.author: Ben B
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Great Resort, great beach, and great Pool.  Royal Service is the only way to go. Our Butler Sandy Gil was the best, and made our visit all worth the while.  Would deffintly go back, and would request Sandy as my Butler

reviews.author: Leslie W
reviews.title: The ultimate vacation!!!
reviews.text: This was my first time in Punta Cana and it was truly amazing.  Everyone at the resort catered to us from the minute we got there!!!  I went with friends who have stayed at this resort for the last 7 years and they knew most of the staff which was really cool.  We had an ultimate royal service experience.  Luis our butler was awesome and made sure we had everything we needed.  From champagne to rose petals and chocolate covered strawberries...not to mention the fruits, cheeses and wine left for you in the room every afternoon!  Everything about the resort was wonderful.  The rooms were very spacious and the grounds were very lush and well maintained.  And of course the beach was beautiful and I loved the beach beds...nice touch and very comfortable.   A big thank you to Juan, Pedro, the Francisco's, Martin, Leonardo, Maria Gil and Carlos(KING of the butler's) for making my stay extra special.  And an even bigger thank you to Luis, my butler for making this the ultimate vacation!!!   I will definitely be back soon!!!  Muah!

reviews.author: @ tripreviewer1957
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text:
I just spent MLK weekend with girlfriends at Paradisus. Beautiful beach and pool. Great accommodations.The only things that would have made it perfect: service is slow - waited 15 mins in the bar lobby for a glass of wine; wine selection could be improved upon; and out of 5 computers in the business center located below the main lobby, only 1 worked the whole time I was there. Nobody seemed hard pressed to get them fixed.

Overall though a wonderful experience - next time I take the H there for a romantic getaway.

reviews.author: Lynn S
reviews.title: wonderful stay
reviews.text:
This was our first stay at this resort, though we have visited Punta Cana in the past.
The resort is beautiful, well kept, and the service is excellent. My husband and I upgraded to Royal Service and it was totally worth it.  Our butler, Angelo Mercedes was friendly, attentive, professional and made our stay a wonderful experience.  He made sure we had everything we needed in our room, made reservations and checked in on us several times a day to see how we were doing.  He was always a step ahead of our needs, always anticipating what we would like, be it a bottle of wine at dinner, or a fresh fruit plate on the beach.  Jonathan in room service was also excellent.  He always included a little something extra with our morning coffee and left delicious appetizers in our room for when we returned from the beach.  He was friendly and enthusiastic and we enjoyed chatting with him each morning. Martin at the private beach took great care of us, having our beach beds ready each morning when we arrived at the beach and also reserving two in the shade. He works very hard to make sure his guests are enjoying themselves and he is very good at his job.  
The rooms are beautiful and very clean.  Restaurants are great--food is about what you expect for an all inclusive, but there is a good variety of places to eat.  The nightly entertainment is great.  The casino needs work--it's small and the dealers aren't all that friendly and they make mistakes pretty frequently.  
It is a wonderful resort and I would definitely stay there again and I would definitely book the royal service.

reviews.author: AnnMarie0719
reviews.title: Best Place Ever.  A true vacation
reviews.text:
This Resort I cannot say enough good about it.  From the minute we arrive and Patricia takes care of us as far as checking in, planning our reservations and just welcoming us.  Once to our rooms you can only hope you have Franklin Sosa as your room service person.  So helpful and always prompt.

Head to the Beach and Pool area absolutely immaculate.  Gabriel Dalusma was so attentive to what our needs and likes were from beach in the am and pool in the pm, getting us sand lounges everyday and remembering our favorite beverages.  He also knew enough to give space for privacy and alone time.

I love the fact that there are so many restaurants here and I am  a fussy eater and always so much for me to choose from.  My husband is just constantly eating. 

The only disappointment this year was Passions Restaurant.  Last year we ate there and it was fantastic so we decided to try it  again.  The food was not good.  Their attenton to service was good but not the food.  This was not good since you do pay extra for that Restaurant

I will definitely be back for trip number 6

reviews.author: Marie P
reviews.title: Visited 3 times -- better every year
reviews.text: The hotel is one of a kind -- beautiful spot and lovely rooms. Royal Service is definitely the way to go!  In the hands of our attentive, thorough and friendly butler, Angelo Mercede, every vacation need was met! He checked with us every day and delivered everything we could want ... and more! Angelo took care of every detail of our stay beautifully. The service of Johnny Jiminez was awesome. He delivered room service every day ... on time ... and in a friendly and efficient manner. He made us a priority every day. Billy made us so welcome at the beach with chairs, towels and drinks. These wonderful gentlemen helped to give us an unforgettable vacation experience.  We will be returning and asking for them by name.

reviews.author: Joan d
reviews.title: dream come true
reviews.text:
A week to remember.The rooms are spacious and very well maintained. A staff of many are accommodating to your need. Food  is excellent . Book restaurants early  the trolly could be a wait. All the  staff whoever was around you made you feel  like a friend and family. We left with great apprecieation to Santos Polanco  and Emelio  working to serve you with sincere manners.
Amando works hard in many capacities. Vento and Bana  were our favourite restaurants  The nightly entertainment was excellent Marionell had the audiences partaking in the true Dominican culture and was charming to all he seen.Patricio groomed the gardens daily and always had a kind word.

reviews.author: 4marianne
reviews.title: Best Room Service
reviews.text: We had the best room service offered by Johnny Morla -- he was fantastic - he made sure he did everything possible to keep us happy.  He was a true pleasure to have for room service.  Thanks Johnny for a job well done!!

reviews.author: Steve S
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort.
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at the Paradisus Palma Real. The resort is beautiful. The Entertainment at this resort is the best I've come across at any down south resort. The beach was fantastic well maintained. The pool is huge and the pool bar had amazing service. The buffet was just ok but there are lots of specialty restaurants to choose from you really never have to do dinner at the buffet. In general everything Waseem excellent.

reviews.author: Jamie M
reviews.title: Unbeatable Service
reviews.text:
While on vacation we met an exceptional chef! His name was Joan Forne! He was incrediable. We had some lobster, shrimp, and baked chicken that was prepared by him... I will never be able to match those meals anywhere. He was very professional when he came and presented. He is a beautiful person inside and out. 
When visiting please find Joan for the best food on the resort. 
The overall experience was wonderful too. All employees were very nice and fun.

reviews.author: Darlene M
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text:
We have just returned from a week long vacation in this beautiful resort. I must say that it is the most expensive resort that we have ever stayed in and not likely to return as it was a once in a lifetime vacation. The minute you walk into the lobby area you are blown away by the beauty. 
 Amazing beach -no merchants pressuring you to purchase goods unless you walk down the beach and then I caution you they are very aggressive and not so polite if you don't purchase. The activity staff was amazing in particular Famel Saldana,Wilfredo Flores, Francisco Reynoso and while we just met her for a short time Yubi. Every morning we ate in the buffet area and found a wonderful waiter "Edward Campusano". The Avenue Bar favorite server was Lucia she always made sure that we were very well taken care of! Franklin Delacruz while we didn't take part in the time share presentation you were most gracious and helped us with our reservation bookings and any other requests that we had. I must say that our favorite of all was Luis at the pool bar this gentleman is one of the resorts greatest assets...he greats you with a smile, entertains you with his voice and serves you a beer by bringing it to you on his head.  There are only a couple of cons to this resort and one being it was hard to be understood by some of the staff both in the front desk area and some of the dining and lounge areas. Also the service in the lounge in the lobby area left a lot to be desired. Our friends and us ended up calling it the no service bar. Other than that everything was wonderful!

reviews.author: 183mary
reviews.title: una semana de primera categoria
reviews.text: estuvimos en la primera quincena de enero 2014 en Paradisus Palma Real.El hotel de primera..muy estetico y sobre todo la atencion de todo el equipo excelente.Quiero referirme especialmente a la atencion que recibimos de Manuel Silvestre nuestro Mayordomo que se ocupo de todos los detalles de nuestra estadia permitiendonos unas perfectas vacaciones. Como asi tambien la atencion  en la playa de Francisco Gil con su sonrisa permanente y su predispocision a cumplir nuestros mas pequenos caprichos.Fue increible. me senti reina por una semana.Gracias.hasta la proxima!

reviews.author: noemore
reviews.title: True Paradise
reviews.text:
Just the second you step into the amazing lobby of Paradisus Palma Real for the very first time is breathtaking.. an amazing marble avenue with the bluest ocean at the end.
Beautiful white sand beach with warm peaceful water.
Great restaurants, a bit of trouble reserving sometimes.. but definitely any option is fine!
Nice rooms, very warm people and good service.
Coming back for sure!

reviews.author: M_Dot_Brink
reviews.title: Excellent Resort, Excellent Staff
reviews.text: My first all inclusive vacation.  Went to Punta Cana for my best friends wedding.  I was a little thrown off by the initial breakdown of the cost but once I got to the check in desk and was greeted by the excellent staff I quickly saw what a great value I had received.  Our entire party was well taken care of the entire stay.  We spent most of the day enjoying the beach, the pool and the great amenities around the resort.  all of the staff went out of their way to provide a wonderful experience.  Luis da Aza was the best of the best as he constantly provided us a fun experience whether it was at breakfast or dinner.  Luis made us feel like family.  I have told anyone and everyone I could about my trip and recommended they go enjoy the beauty of Paradisus!

reviews.author: Joa U
reviews.title: Restaurante passion
reviews.text:
Increibleeee el servicio y la atención. Excelente atencion de parte del mesero Joysel.
No les recomiendo que pidan el menu de degustación a mi parecer era muy raro, habíam platos ricos pero algunos ai totalmente ciencia, pero sí que llena.

reviews.author: VadimGan
reviews.title: Little Overpriced and No Information
reviews.text:
Resort is beautiful - very nice and very well made. However,lack of information of all services - main issue.Map of the resort is poorly made.
Also, We had black bracelets and other members of our weeding party had green bracelets - noone from the staff facility can explain what is the difference, they only said that black bracelets are VIP -  therefore we unable to fully enjoy the VIP services and spa facilities (they were free for VIP). The SPA experience was outstanding!!!!

reviews.author: NC-Natalie
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Last month (December 2013) I had the pleasure of visiting Punta Cana (PC), Dominican Republic – and staying at Club Melia's Paradisus Punta Cana (The Reserve) property.  What a great time my friends and I had!  Upon arrival, we were welcomed to PC by the team at Blue, who ensured our proper and safe arrival at The Reserve.  Upon arrival to The Reserve, we were greeted by several welcoming bell hops and other team members/staff.  We were introduced to Anubia (assisted by Sandra), who explained all options for our stay, and patiently answered our questions.  In their (announced) absence, we were placed in the capable hands of Dhoralix P. and Elaidy M. 

Upon being led to our (2nd floor) suite, one person in our party realized that the steps would be too much.  Magnificent Miguel promptly transferred us to a 1st floor suite – with a great view (as requested)!  Upon receiving a tour of our suite, we were left to explore on our own … with assurance that staff was just a phone call away.  Shortly after settling into our suite, we had the pleasure of meeting Iris (a most caring, compassionate, and concerned Concierge).  Both Miguel and Iris were readily available to assist however and whenever during our stay – and always with personable professionalism.

We were directed to the Blue counter to book our excursions.  Upon arrival, we were promptly greeted by a smiling Alfredo.  Alfredo patiently answered all of our questions, helped us narrow down our tour selections, and assisted with booking our return trip to PUJ.  During our Country Adventure Tour, we had one of the best drivers (Victor) and tour directors (Alex) ever!  What a great and adventurous day! I just wish that I had known that offering gifts of school supplies to the students of the school that we visited was welcome....

Unfortunately, I don't remember all of their names; but, that didn't diminish the daily greetings by many of the ever-pleasant and charming Bell Hops (aka The Papi's of The Reserve).  I had the pleasure  of being given a great mani-pedi by my very capable cosmetologist, Juana Silvestre – and meeting her coworker, Marisol, who gave a mani-pedi to a friend.  We were greeted by Super Mario daily; and, took Salsa and Tango lessons with some of the Nova Theater's best entertainers. 

Among the Restaurant and Wait Staff worthy of mentioning (because of their upbeat and pleasant personalities) were:  Hehwan R. M. and Luis David H. (Gabi Club); Geronimo (La Palapa); the Chefs/Staff at Gabi Beach.

Guest Service Manager Silvio Lantigua was available to address a concern that we had; and, followed up with us to ensure complete resolution and satisfaction.

Thanks to all who made my trip more enjoyable than I would have ever imagined!  If I interacted with you in a positive way; but, failed to mention your name, please charge it to my head and not my heart....  Equally as important, I appreciate all who allowed/encouraged me to practice my Spanish – and assisted me with improving it.  I'm looking forward to continuing to improve it … by corresponding with my PCV.  

What a great first trip to Paradisus Punta Cana, The Reserve, and to  Punta Cana!  I can't wait to return!

Mucho gracias!  Mucho gusto!
~Natalia

reviews.author: Tos C
reviews.title: My Experience!
reviews.text: This resort certainly exceeded our expectations. Their services, food, rooms, pools, environment and bars were excellent. From our arrival at the airport to departure, they took care of us. We'll be back!

reviews.author: Joan H
reviews.title: Super Staff
reviews.text: I received great service from the Hotel Manager, the bell boys, & guest service staff when my luggage went missing. The Manager ensured that all his staff were "on the same page" and to get it back to me asap, which they did. The hotel was excellent,  food, drinks,no problems getting in restaurants  (although they did have a dress code for men). It was wonderful.

reviews.author: richardfdez
reviews.title: Una experiencia fantástica
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado una semana en el Paradisus para despedir el 2013 y empezar el nuevo año de la mejor manera y la experiencia en general fue excelente e inolvidable. 

He tenido la suerte de estar en varios resorts todo-incluido y no tengo ninguna duda de que éste ha sido el mejor que he visto. Las infraestructuras son INCREIBLES, el trato de parte de todo el equipo, maravilloso y la variedad de las actividades, muy interesante (una propuesta de actividad: club de running para salir a correr por el resort cada dia a las 18:00?).

La oferta gastronómica es muy variada y todos los restaurantes tienen un toque diferente que hace que no se haga para nada repetitiva la semana. El restaurante Vento es más que recomendable en relación a otros años, por lo que me han comentado. Los buffets tanto en la playa como en la Reserva, más que buenos.

¡La fiesta de Nochevieja en la playa fue muy divertida! ¡Y la preparada en el lobby para los españoles, un gran detalle! Durante toda la semana, los shows de las 22:00 eran entretenidos (el del circo, espectacular), así como la música en directo posterior.

Especial mención a todos los empleados de las pistas de Tennis y Pádel. SÚPER AMABLES y divertidos.

¿A mejorar? Varios puntos, que no enturbian para nada nuestra grata experiencia:

+ La cena de Nochevieja debería de no ser Buffet. La verdad es que acabamos demasiado rápido y el impass entre la cena y la fiesta se nos hizo demasiado larga.

+ El servicio de cochecitos para miembros del Club debería ser mejor y más rápido. Sobretodo de noche/madrugada.

+ El buffet de madrugada podría ser algo más variado.

+ No se debería perseguir "tanto" a los huéspedes para la contratación de servicios adicionales (como masajes y excursiones). Además, el precio de todos estos servicios nos pareció excesivo.

+ Tanto la fruta como los postres son mejorables.

+ Todas las bebidas las notamos "flojas" de alcohol.

reviews.author: Jen C
reviews.title: Best all inclusive
reviews.text:
I vacationed at Paradissus Palma Real from  Dec 7 to Dec 13 2103.This was the best all inclusive vacation ever. I have very high standards for food coming from New York City. Didn't expect much for all inclusive but food like rib steak, lamb chops, pork, chicken, fish was grilled to order at NAOS this is the buffet (breakfast, lunch dinner) stay away from the Asian fusion Bana Bistro worse Chinese ever.Market Grill (steak place) was good. Had to pay additional for Passion it was worth it.
Booze was top stuff

Staff was very friendly, always greeted with HOLA .  Refrigerator was well stocked
They had activities all scheduled I didn't have to plan anything.
Francisco,Wilfredo and Magdonal and the activities coordinator were super. Magdonal was the water aerobics/exercise instructor I don't know where he gets the energy from but he was fantastic.

Francisco and Wilfredo were the best. They were giving dance classes with dancers from the shows. They were patient and took time to teach when you couldn't get it.they kept you entertained all week

Jen C. New York City

reviews.author: IosuLazcozIso
reviews.title: Gracias Ramón "Fuego"
reviews.text: Cuando tu profesión la ejerces con pasión de servicio, la fidelizacion esta hecha. Cuando conoces a Ramón "Fuego", ya no vuelves a encontrar nada ni siquiera parecido en ningún Hotel al que vayas. He viajado mucho, y nunca me he encontrado a nadie que amara tanto lo que hace. Este año hasta con lumbalgia era más solicito y servicial que muchos. Deberian clonar a a Ramón y exportarlo a otros Hoteles Melia, ganariais mucho. 3 año s repitiendo son la mejor mueatra. Gracias Ramon!

reviews.author: DubaiHiggins
reviews.title: Is Punta Cana a luxury destination??? Really ???
reviews.text:
I have to say I have a very uncertain opinion of our stay at the Reserve. But I don't know if it's the average quality of the overall stay or a mistake we made choosing Punta Cana, as a short holiday destination...Compare with immediate neighboring The Reserve at Paradisus was not so bad... But regarding what I read on the Melia website and what we experienced... may I say there is gap.. a huge gap in ability to deliver 5star service.. of course not bad not good... nothing.... Concierge service could be very good or absolutely rude, the guest manager is the only one really naturally kind and professional.... At Pool or beach there is almost no service/nobody to ake care of you ... Restaurants are not bad experiences but are not memorable ones... so I'm confused on my stay... good or bad... absolutely not in my memory!! and that s the problem we finally faced... service inconsistency... no warmth of welcoming...some staff are so nice so kind... and others really don't care about guest...
The worst experience anytime, any staff, any contact :the reception... the worst attitude of the hotel really administrative people without any empathy!!
My recommendation think twice before heading to Punta Cana....

reviews.author: Maria D
reviews.title: Excellent Staff!
reviews.text: My experience at Paradisus Palma Real was amazing. The staff was great especially Yuberkis Arnaud, Francisco Reyrioso, Angel Alcantara, and Macdonna. I recommend this resort as a place to stay while in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: bmccutch
reviews.title: The Reserve is worth it!
reviews.text:
My mom and aunt took my 2 cousins and I to Punta Cana for a girls trip for a week in October.  It was unbelievable!  We upgraded to the Reserve which was a great choice.  It is a separate resort with in Paradisus.  The Paradisus is beyond beautiful, but the Reserve gives you a VIP feel.  It is a very short 5 min walk from the main resort and the beach, which we needed because of all of the awesome food we were eating.  The Reserve has its own restaurant, snack bar area, 2 bars, and even a specific place on the beach that are only for the people staying in the Reserve.  There is also a specific pool in the main resort for Reserve guests.  It is a little quieter and very peaceful.  We had adjoining rooms, one of which was the master suite.  It had a full living and dining room inside of it.  The room had a giant jacuzzi tub right in the middle of the bathroom with an additional one on the balcony, which was a lot of fun!  

While the food was a great, my favorite dinner was the in the Japanese restaurant.  It is hibachi style, which was really fun and interactive.  This restaurant was in the Reserve section, but it was open to everyone.  There were so many restaurant options and we didn't find one we didn't love.  

The shows we fun as well!  The Punta Cana version the Cirque du Soleil was amazing!  I'm still in aw of what they can do! 

The Bavaro beach location is amazing!  The staff was amazing!  Especially Fransisco and Leonardo!  They made great drinks and kept them flowing!  They would even come down to the beach to take our drink orders and bring us waters without us even asking!

We had an amazing vacation and I would recommend the Paradisus to anyone!!

reviews.author: pearheads
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful and relaxing. The staff was absolutely stellar! Friendliness was a top priority. The pool and beach were super clean and in good repair. The only downside was the food. Stick to the buffet and you'll be completely happy.

reviews.author: Richard P
reviews.title: Imagine spending the holiday in paradise!
reviews.text: Had to use up my vacation time and this was the perfect place to enjoy the holiday. The property had so many excellent features from 24 hour buffet to daily activities such as workouts and body messages on the beach to live entertainment nightly either at the theatre or the bar, plus a casino.  The highly motivated staff such as Anyeli, Angel, etc. were around day and night to talk and dance, etc. Have been around the world and must say this property is so impressive. Even attempt to assist you in English.  Really like when you are surrounded by such friendly surroundings and beautiful accommodations as well as the plush beachfront and pool area. Can't say enough about our stay there.

reviews.author: sildebe1955
reviews.title: Paraíso!!!!!!
reviews.text:
El lugar es increíble! una belleza! las habitaciones, la comida, los shows impresionantes.
el personal que se dedica a las actividades y entretenimientos excelentes!!!!! super simpáticos, amables, lo mejor de toda la estadía!! Yubi, Yira, Leo, Angel, Fabio; Francisco 
Quiero hacer una mención especial para Yubi!!! sos genial!!!

Si tengo que decir que hay algo que me decepcionó y mucho! y me molestó mucho pagar por un servicio que no se brindo: No funcionaba Internet en las habitaciones! increíble ! solo  en el  hall de recepción y con suerte en algunas otras areas !y además que pagamos por ese servicio!!! si no fuese por este motivo mi calificación sería óptima

Volvería sin lugar a dudas!

reviews.author: Steve L
reviews.title: Great Staff Member
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.  Previously reviewed the property.  I want to send out a thank you to the great service that Estrella Garcia, Guest Service Concierge provided us.  She was excellent in following up on our requests, which was really appreciated.  She was friendly, caring and all in all a great employee who really made our vacation wonderful.  This is the 13th time we have been at Melia properties in Punta Cana and both this property (versus Melia Caribe and Paradisus Punta Cana) and Estrella were the very best.

reviews.author: Pat H
reviews.title: Luxury in paradise
reviews.text:
Trip was booked at the last minute and we had no problems at all. Checked in and our room was ready. There was some problem with the internet but that was resolved within a day or so, which wasn't a big deal. Our patio door was broken and they sent someone up to fix it right away. We did have to ask for our complementary fruit and booze when we arrived, it took a while to get it but then it arrived in a timely fashion every day after that.
The room was spacious and very clean. Bed was comfortable and hotel was quiet for sleeping. Had a lovely patio area where we spent a lot of time. The outdoor jet tub did not work, but we didn't try it until near the end of our holiday and at that point we didn't care, but reported it anyway. The staff were always helpful and checked in to see if we had what we needed. The food was consistently good I all of the restaurants. The pool areas were gorgeous and well maintained.
