The beach was not as clean as we had experienced the previous year at the other 
Paradisus resort up the beach, but the water was still lovely and very enjoyable. Lots of lounge chairs so no problem ever in getting a seat. Beautiful grounds, we felt very pampered and special at this resort. Would return in a heartbeat, and probably will!

reviews.author: Raj_Maitra
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation - people and property
reviews.text: I was at the Palma Real for five days with Royal Service and the stay was excellent.  The resort is gorgeous moreover the staff is what made our stay better.  The staff at the Royal Service office are courteous and caring. Ms. Rosy Batista was a wonderful help, ensuring everything was perfect and assisted when I had problems.  Her proffessionalism was refreshing! Our butler Jose Salvador checked in with us everyday and made sure our reservations were done for our dinner plans and ensured we did not have any issues.  Anabellis the bartender at the main lobby was attentive and caring and greeted us by name everythime she met us.  At the beach where I spent a lot of my time, Martin Tineo and Francisco Cabrera were two outstanding gentlemen! From maiing sure of the hut bedding to bringing the drinks to the courtesy they had, they were perfect models for service for employees.  Thank you Palma Real!

reviews.author: Kortney M
reviews.title: Great Place, Great Food, and Great People!
reviews.text:
A group of eight of us went to the Dominican and we had the most wonderful time. Everywhere you went in the resort the food was amazing, the housekeeping did an awesome job for a weeks stay, and the people were awesome! Especially Louis the bartender and Fransico Macdonald, who worked in activities. By the first day they new our names and greeted us every time they saw us! 
What an amazing vacation and a vacation we will never forget!

reviews.author: Ines K
reviews.title: Ein Gesamtpaket, das voll und ganz überzeugt hat!
reviews.text:
Nun seit einer Woche wieder zurück daheim, hat der Urlaub immer noch einen bleibenden Eindruck mit vielen positiven Erlebnissen hinterlassen. Ich habe zum ersten mal einen Urlaub in einem Resort gemacht und trotz aller Zweifel, die ich zu Beginn gegenüber Resortanlagen hatte, hat mich der erste Eindruck sofort überzeugt. Die wundervoll gestaltete Anlage hatte den Charme eines Naturparks. Wir waren im Reserve untergebracht und können hiervon nur schwärmen. Der Service, angefangen von der Rezeption über die Gastronomie bis hin zum Animationsteam war über den ganzen Urlaub hinweg wirklich sehr gut. Mittags haben wir meistens im Gabi Beach Restaurant gegessen. Die Qualität des Essens ließ keine Wünsche offen. Unser Stammkellner war José Mateo, der uns durch seine charmante und freundlich aufgeschlossene Art nicht das Gefühl eines Kunden, sondern das eines Freundes gegeben hat. Mein Feedback dazu, um es in seinen Worten zu sagen, "alles super!".
Auch am Abend nach dem Dinner wurde einem viel Abwechslung im Abendprogramm geboten. Von Livemusik bis hin zu spektakulären Shows, war alles mit dabei. Jeden Abend wurde man in die Welt des Tanzes und der Musik entführt. Das gesamte Show- und Animationsteam rund um Francisco, Macdonna, Angel, Yubi, Wilfredo und Co haben wirklich tolle Arbeit geleistet, wobei man ihnen nicht einmal angemerkt hat, dass es überhaupt um Arbeit ging. Sie haben es geschafft, alle Gäste egal von welchem Teil der Welt zu einer Art großen "global family" miteinander zu verbinden und das auf eine sehr charmante und nicht nervige oder aufdringliche Art. Am Ende kam eine wunderbare Atmosphäre voller Leichtigkeit heraus, wo man sagt, "ja, so fühlt sich Urlaub an".
FAZIT: Ich kann dieses Hotel jedem ans Herz legen, der einmal etwas außergewöhnliches erleben will. Egal ob Paare, Freunde oder Familien, jeder wird dort voll und ganz auf seine Kosten kommen :-)

reviews.author: sabzc
reviews.title: Best resort in Punta Cana!
reviews.text:
This resort was the best! I did my research on all the punta cana resorts before I picked this one and I do not regret it one bit! It was a girls trip that consisted of 5 girls (age 21-24). The resort was beautiful! From the moment I walked in to the hotel, I was amazed by it's beauty! Everything was clean and organized. The staff was AMAZING! I have to give shout outs to them: Genivel Mauricio was our waiter at Gabi beach a couple times and he is awesome! He is such a hard worker and great personality. We loved him! Miguel was also very nice! He was the one that showed us to our room when we first got there and he definitely left a wonderful impression on us. Eduard Campusano and Gregorin were also great waiters at the Naos buffet. They were always constantly making sure we got whatever we needed. Macdonna Fransisco was awesome! He did a great job in teaching me how to do the bachata! Alex at the Plaazo also had a amazing personality and he always had this big smile on his face. Roberto the bartender was our favorite bartender. He was amazing at making us shots and drinks and he is also veryyyy hard working. You have to see him shake when he mixes drinks! Best part! It was great meeting them all! Everyone took care of us like family. We miss them all so much after coming back home. I would definitely recommend this resort to everyone I know. 
FOOD- greatttttt!!

Only bad things were that saturday night Jewel (night club) was trying to charge us $20 per person for cover when it clearly said on the posters that it would be free cover. We didn't end up going in and ended up having a better night hanging out with other people. I was also told that it might not be safe to go outside of the resort area. But overall, this resort was amazing! We had so much fun!

reviews.author: JVMorales05
reviews.title: I'm sorry but TA got this one wrong...
reviews.text:
If you're like me, I check out Tripadvisor, yelp, foursquare everywhere I go.  Sometimes I won't even pick up a menu, rather I'll thumb through pictures on yelp.  Same goes for my taste in hotels, usually I link up with the masses on tripadvisor.  I'll find the highest hotel on the list that fits my budget.  Well in this case my Tripadvisor peers need to re-evaluate this place...

While there were many things wrong with this stay it all roots from the Policies in which this place is managed.  In a heart beat I wouldn't hold my unsatisfactory experience against any of the service staff and most importantly our butler.  The terrible experience is all managements hands, they own this one.

Lets start with SERVICE...  9 out of 10 times I would be disappointed for asking a question.  When most places you'll hear "es un placer" (it's a pleasure) this place most common response was "no, sorry".  Majority in part that I paid for a royal service experience, you justifiably would expect the frustration free, no worries, good time feeling.  Almost every night I was told, no reservations, we don't have this drink, that fruit, not open at this time, you can't use this...  Literally every day was one aggravation after another, most commonly were restaurant reservations which ALWAYS had plenty of tables.  The resort credits are a JOKE.  I basically let it go, but inside was furious, because it's just so DECEPTIVE.  For each credit you have to spend a certain amount, where the benefit is about 10-20% off in most cases, not outright credits.  So when you think you're getting a 1500$ credit, which may have factored into your length of stay, it's really just coupons for 20% off your getting.  Similar establishments in mexico let you use them outright, were services may end up being free to a point.  It's all good and accepted giving it was a promotion to earn your business, not to deceive guests into staying with you. 

FOOD and DRINKS are laughable...  the market grill is a step below high school cafeteria food and the prank on everyone is... that's what they call their steakhouse in the evening.  Just gets rebranded after 5pm.  So think of the pizza and fried food grill on your last cruise, now dim the lights and call it a steakhouse.  Thats just the beginning, we ventured to every restaurant including the reserve and all were hands down subpar cruise food.  You might say, well it's a large hotel what can you expect, food has to be scale-able at some point, can't be perfect?  I would agree but I also wouldn't give the place # 7 on hotels in punta cana!!!!  Seriously hotel should be in the 30s with this food quality.  And Drinks... the bottomless sugar coma non alcoholic beverages.  So I'm a big fan of fruity drinks when on vacations but these were just watered down, sugared down, messes.  First thing I wanted when I got there was a nice fresh fruit drink, shortly after disappointed because nothing is fresh.  Anything you want will be pre bottled, most likely watered down.  Only time I ever got a buzz from drinking on a 8 day trip was when I left the hotel for an excursion.  I'd have to ask them to serve 3 quarters alcohol just to taste it, even then would have several later without a buzz.  Yeah i know I must be an alcoholic (not the case :) just looking to have a good time while in paradise) And OMG open lunch at 12PM, you're killing me with the logic behind the time you open for lunch.  IT's like they purposely only want you to eat at the Marketplace grill.  The Royal service restuarant opens at 1:30 for lunch, gabi beach opens at 1pm and the buffet opens at 12:30.  12:30, 1pm doesn't sound bad, i know, but its incredibly inopportune when you have excursions scooping you up at 12 every time.  Or if you start the day earlier and therefore start getting hungry around 11:30.  The marketplace grill is just that bad that you will be doing everything to avoid it...  Also no menu service by pool or beach.  I wanted to take something out of the restaurantand bring to beach or room, would not allow it.  Don't even try ordering room service from a restaurant, they'll look at you with 10 heads.  It's an all inclusive, why are you being so STINGY????  Just remembered! They constantly ran out of alcohol at night! Instead of them running to another bar or asking for my supplies, they would tell you sorry all out and then point to the dozens of empty bottles behind them as if proud.  While I stand there stupified...  Seriously where is the supervision?  They don't even properly stock for the next day... went down to the cafe for cappuccino and baileys at 10am, "sorry sir all out of baileys"?????? Killing me....

I'm now tired of typing and while I could go on it's not worth my time.  Anybody excited about punta cana, sorry for being a buzz kill.  Had an exponentially better experience at Le Blanc in cancun.  Where Le Blanc was actually ROYAL SERVICE.  No matter what you ask for, they do their best to reasonably accommodate.  While paradisus royal service is by far better then not having it, it's still a low standard to go to for the expense. GO SOMEWHERE ELSE until this place starts shaping up.

reviews.author: Jaimie K K
reviews.title: GeniveL Mauricio
reviews.text:
GeniveL Mauricio was our first server when we got to Punta cana and went to Gabi Beach for dinner. My name is Jaimie and I went with 4 of my other girL cousins (my age: 22, cousins: 21 23 24 and 24). He was thee nicest server I have ever had in my Life! He was so caring and recommended aLL the right foods to eat. He was such a hard worker and was always on his feet. He made sure we had aLL that we needed and I couldnt have asked for anymore. Thank you so much GeniveL! You made my trip sooo much better! We even went back to visit him a few times just bc he was soo nice. We miss youu soo much guapo! You had true passion for the job and we really appreciated aLL that you did for us! The Lobster was amazinggg. 

The hoteL was amazing! The beach was right there. Woke up to the view of the ocean and WHITE sand every morning! ALL the workers were SO caring always watching out for us as if they were our older brothers. Everything in this place was soo clean, and there were NO problems at aLL the whole 5 days we stayed here. Right when you walk into this place it was amazing to see and we never wanted to Leave. I cant believe im back in Chicago. Writing this review is making me want to cry. I Love Paridisus Palma ReaL and ALL their workers and I hope to go back soon! Definitely recommending this place to anyone!! The pooL was toooo pretty. 24 hour Room serive was great.

reviews.author: Miguel Angel S
reviews.title: Miguel S.
reviews.text:
Debo dejar constancia que el servicio recibido es muy difícil de encontrar.
Todas las personas que nos han atendido, han hecho un ejercicio de amabilidad y servicio impecables.
SIn embargo creo que existe pequeñas cosas que deberían mejorar.
Quiero significar al personal del Gabi Beach, Kimberly ,Genivel, Liliana,Mateo,Daniel,Waner,Franklin porque han sido unos magnificos profesionales todas las veces que hemos usado el restaurante.

reviews.author: Cris S
reviews.title: 4 days in paradise
reviews.text:
We spent 3 nights, 4 days at the Paradisus Palma Real, and had the the Royal Service which mean we had a butler.  We aren't the type of people that would use a butler EVER, so that wasn't what we were there for.  She made our reservations and could help with special needs. She came with the package, but it was uncomfortable for us to have a butler, so we didn't call on her much.  We aren't high maintenance people, and didn't need the coddling.  But others have enjoyed it, so to each their own.   

The Royal Service gives guests access to a private area of the beach, two private bars on the beach, 2 private pools, a restaurant that has breakfast, lunch and dinner just for Royal Service guests, and access to Gabi bar and restaurant, which is for Royal Service and VIP of the Sol Meliá club.  For these reasons, and not a butler, I would recommend the Royal Service.

The Room:  Gorgeous, modern, clean and comfortable.  If you go on vacation to spend your time in your room, then you might want to read other reviews more carefully.  We slept, changed and showered there. It was beautiful.  The Royal Services gives you a stocked mini bar with Absolut, Dewars and local rum. HINT:   If you are a beer drinkers, ask for corona.  They will bring it to you.  For this, you need your butler.  : )

The Beach:  Paradise.  Period.  

The Bars:  The beach bar is wonderful for two reasons.  Leonardo Mota and Francisco Cardena.  Leo is the bartender with a smile that lights up the sky.  Attentive, friendly, fun, etc.  Francisco sets up your chairs and brings you drinks while on the beach and at the pool. He, too, is attentive and kind.  

At Gabi Beach, go meet Nelson Cardena and Santo.  We enjoyed sitting and chatting with them as much as being on the beach.  Lovely individuals.  

The Restaurants:  Let me start by saying this:  If you read the complaints of others that say the food is terrible and boring, then read that they are the type of people who complain everywhere. 

This hotel had more choices than are possible for consumption in one month.  The buffet has EVERYTHING for breakfast, except for grits, but really, who wants grits in the Dominican?  

Lunch:  Again, a well stocked buffet.  There is a restaurant dedicated to salads, one to paninis, Gabi Beach has an excellent menu (get the ceviche every day), and Palazzo is exquisite. 

Dinner:  We ate at Vento, Palazzo, and did  Passions the last night.  Exquisite.  Passions was an experience we won't soon forget.  Spend the $50 per person, and enjoy.  

The bars:  Drinks are weak, it is true.  Drink more.  Or slip them a dollar bill and ask for extra. 

The Spa:  We didn't book extra services, but they have a Hydrotherapy Circuit that we did twice which was very nice and fun.  

We have stayed in the Dominican 3 other times.  Ocean Blue twice and Iberostar the other.  This is the most beautiful of the three resorts, and the food is by far the best.  Go to relax, and enjoy.  I would definitely go back and hope to soon.

reviews.author: Stephanie K
reviews.title: The Most Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: From the moment you book a vacation to this resort you are dealing with family. A good family. From Donisius Rodriguez who is so helpful in arranging for transportation to and from the airport and making dinner reservations, to the concierge staff who cannot do enough for you, this is a world class resort.  To eat at the Passion restaurant is just a bit of magic.  Laura Castillo, the hostess is beyond charming.  She has such a beautiful smile and is so gracious; you just know how special this restaurant is.  She is an exceptional asset to the Sol Melia company, and should be noted as such. Poolside, Francesco is amazing.  Always ready to help with a ready smile.  He is a joy to see. This is a vacation spot not to be missed.   Bravo!!!

reviews.author: Lilia R
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: Very good hotel with huge territory  and a lot of restaurants!I notice that hotel service is high quality, and butler Huan is the best one!!!In my opinion one of the best hotels on the island with good location.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: All are equal, but some are more equal than others - (George Orwell )
reviews.text:
This hotel has 3 different levels of services provided:
1 regular - yellow wrist band
2 VIP - black wrist band
3 Royal Services - gold wrist band
 Places like some beaches, SPA bars and certain restaurants, are for Royal services gests only!
Don't be confused by advertising,  if you purchase regular or VIP trips many of things advertised are not included.
My travel agent did not tell me about this matter so I purchased regular service and many times was told this is not for you (go away).
Now about hotel :  Beautiful landscape, the best what I've seen at "Bavaro" or La Romana beaches.
Very good rooms. Beach and lounge chairs, towel services were just the best .
Food is descent. Drinks depend from you level of service you purchase. If you are not "Royal service" guest your Pina colada will be served from reg. factory frozen mixes and local cheap rum. Royal service guests will drink fresh mixes from  fresh pineapples, fresh coconut cream and premium rum. Same goes for the other drinks cheap booze and wines versus premium.
I stayed at this hotel because i was invited for a wedding, so guests were divided to different groups depending on the level of service they bought.
My choice at "Bavaro"  beach is Rio Palace  Macao - small,  old, recently renovated adults only hotel.
Also, "Bavaro"  beach located at the Southern tip of the island where the Atlantic meets Caribbean sea has more waves then La Romana or Jamaica. Keep it in mind if you are vacationing with kids.

reviews.author: Jacqueline W
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Starting with Wander, he was available to answer any questions we had. Very informative and friendly. Our concierges,Fernando mongo and Luis Nunez were excellent and made our week stay enjoyable....they were both pleasant, helpful and always smiling!!! My friend and I had the opportunity to get a massage...see Victoria and kocasta(at the reserve pool side) for a great massage....they were also very friendly. We also had a great time at the pool bar......we met Jesica Perez, Jose David, Yael and Jose Alexis.....there might be one or two names we missed....they were all awesome...very entertaining and fun time! Even the waiter who came around the pool yelling....drinky....drinky....was always upbeat and smiling (sorry but didn't catch his name). Food was great. Staff was excellent! Beach at the reserve was kept clean...no seaweed..check-out was a breeze with Elaidy Montero. Highly recommend this resort.....one very negative was getting out of airport....very crowded....too much confusion. Also, the casino did not offer the table games we expected.

reviews.author: Susan K
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL RESORT!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I and our friends, the Webb's, spent a fantastic eight days at the  Paradisus in Punta Cana.  Our room was upgraded on our arrival to a section called the Reserve and it consisted of an 800 square foot suite complete with a jacuzzi  and our own swimming pool!  We also were able to receive the best massage ever by Victoria and Kocasta who made us feel fantastic after a long day lounging in the sun!!!  The grounds were spotless and the scenery was unbelievable!!  Our concierges, Fernando Mengo and Louis Nunez, made all of our dinner reservations for all of the restaurants which served appetizing menus from seafood to steak!!!  After dinner at one of the nine superb restaurants we would go to the Gabi Club where our newfound friends Jesica Perez, Jose Alexis, Jose David, Lenin, and Yael would make us some of the best frozen margaritas and piña colada ever!!!  They were such fun to be with with their singing and dancing and most of all their friendliness!!!  We had such a good time we hated to leave this paradise, but when we did Elaidy Montero M. made it so easy to check out for our trip back home.  We will surely come back again soon!!!

Susan & Stan Kayesuski

reviews.author: Laurence O
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience, Laurence O.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 6 day stay at the Paradisus Palma Real! The grounds were immaculate and breathtaking! The staff were most accommodating and friendly, especially Jauno, at the front desk who went way out of her way to make our stay enjoyable. The selection of food and the number of restaurants available is excellent.

reviews.author: Gloria I
reviews.title: Winter Get-away
reviews.text: We had a great experience.  The hotel is extremely clean, and the grounds are very well maintained.  The Activities group of people are so motivating.  Every day they would come to the pool/beach to remind people of the water aerobics, or the painting class, or the candle making class, or volley ball, the activities are endless.  But the best part was the servers in the restaurants. These wonderful people who cater to everyone, as if you were in their own homes were amazing, smiling and friendly.  I witnessed them helping with babies and small children so the parents could enjoy their meals. The restaurant staff would work well together to meet the needs of the tourists, regardless of what section they were assigned to. The following should be commended on their skills as going above and beyond - Canaenia Garcia, Julio Oliva, Felipe Morla.   Thank you!

reviews.author: frederick w
reviews.title: The vacations ever!
reviews.text: Paradisus is absolutely a remarkable destination and exceeded our expectations. The Staff at the Reserve were exceptional, very friendly, most helpful and we shall never forget their kindnesses;especially  LUISA, Leidy, Sandra, Hairol!

reviews.author: Antonio R
reviews.title: Gran acierto
reviews.text: Fue sin duda un gran acierto reservar en The Reserve at Palma Real; lo mejor sin duda el ambiente y el cuidado diseño en general del hotel , así como la espectacular habitación. El personal y la atención dispensada inmejorable y la restauración extraordinaria, no sólo en The Passion de Martín Berasategui, (7 estrellas Michelín dentro del propio establecimiento) sino en cada uno de los restaurantes en los que comimos. No puedo poner peros a mi estancia en este auténtico Paraíso en Punta Cana, sin lugar a dudas el mejor y más cuidado resort de todo el Caribe. Mi más sincera felicitación a todo el equipo de Dirección.

reviews.author: marylou1017
reviews.title: Beautiful paradise
reviews.text:
We traveled to Paradisus Palma Real to attend the destination wedding of our niece. Plentiful help greeted us upon our arrival and registration was flawless.  Our room was beautiful: large king size bed,spa tub, absolutely amazing bathroom and a sitting room plus patio.  
The resort is enormous.  Beautiful pool and gardens.  I think it is not possible to see it all in 1 week.  There are at least seven restaurants.  We used the buffet style restaurant the most ...you did not need reservations and you could sit and talk as long as you wished.  If you want to eat at any of the specialty restaurants, make reservations upon arrival.  They book up fast.
The wedding was perfect...I felt like we were watching a TV special. Flowers, food, staff excellent!
The resort all inclusive is pricy but you certainly get your moneys worth.
Our family is still talking about the wonderful time we had at this resort.

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real was beyond excellent. I was very pleased with my stay. The property was beautiful and very well groomed. I would definitely recommend getting Royal Service as it was an experience unparalleled by any other resort. Royal Service was exactly what it sounds like, being treated like Royalty. Above all, the staff is what made my vacation incredible. This is what customer service should be like. Every member of the staff made me feel like I was family. Leonardo Mota, Willy Sanchez, and Nicolas Maracallo all made sure I was incredibly well taken care. Thank you for the best vacation ever! I will return next year!

reviews.author: Dottie W
reviews.title: True paradise in THE reserve
reviews.text: This has been a wonderful week ... Great restaurants beautiful accommodations  and the reserve. Master suite is the way to go .the staff is amazing  here ... We have been so entertained and welcomed here by the animation staff and dancers ... Mario and Oscar. Smiled at us , danced with us and always   Encouraged us  to have a  good time with all the activities offered .... Their energy   And talent made our stay that much more .. I would also like to recognize romeo and miki for their dance lesson as well ... I had so much fun !!!! The grounds here are beautiful and tropical  .... The restaurants  especially THE GRILL our favorite  were excellent . In GABI club  at the reserve. Our waiter  Melvin Reyes took care off us  with grace and perfection every day !!!! And we also enjoyed. PASSION which is worth the xtra charge if thou are looking for something special . We  had a palapa every day by the reserve pool where the service. The music and the breeze. Was unforgettable . I will be back here very soon .Paradisus punta Cana. Is a true paradise .

reviews.author: Kim W
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Palma Real Resort and Spa
reviews.text: From the moment we got to this breathtaking resort, we were in paradise.  I had no idea what staying in the Royal Service area of the resort was going to be like.  Johnfi was our butler and he made sure everything was perfect.  He even called us "His Family"!  Leonardo, the bartender near the beach was entertaining and took good care of us!  Francisco made sure we had the best spots on the beach!  Entertainment in the evenings was awesome.  This is the best place I have ever stayed in the Caribbean for sure and cannot wait to go back.  Johnfi, thank you so much for everything you did to make us feel special while we were here.

reviews.author: trippyNYC
reviews.title: big vegas type resort
reviews.text: from the minute i got there, i couldn't wait to leave. but had to attend friend's wedding so stayed til my plane departed. i really don't like big hotels/resorts. the women staff outfits are cute. the rooms are comfortable enough, pretty roomy. wireless in room wasn't very stable. food is absolutely horrendous, worse than dormitory food. how can breakfast buffet have like a hundred inedible offerings?  only good thing was the fresh juices. went to the teppanyaki restaurant and the guy left our meat cooking on the burner for an extra 20min after it was clearly cooked. so basically we got a bunch of dry scrappy chunks of meat. surprisingly the pool wasn't that well-used.  it's enormous and would be good for long laps if i could swim in a straight line.

reviews.author: Josie S
reviews.title: A vacation to remember
reviews.text:
My name is Josie, and for the 1st time I was able to experience an international vacation. I stayed at the Paradisus Resort week of 11/17-11/24, I have to say that all my expectations of what customer service, hospitality and more should be over exceeded my expectations.  Everyone that I came in contact with super nice & helpful, it made my stay very welcoming.  There were two young people that I want to really say thank you to and that would be Massiel Yoest for Animation, and Maikel Castillo for Animation; both young people really made my stay one I will always remember.  I am already making plans for March 2014 and I am bringing with me 10 single ladies because I know the party is always going to be at Paradisus Resort in Punta Cana.

~ Josie ~

reviews.author: hgashbyjr
reviews.title: Highly recommended!!!!
reviews.text:
This is one of the best places we've stayed. Luiz & Ramon (Fuego) @ the pool bar are a show you have to witness!!! If you get tired of the pool - 100 yards away is the ocean - & visa versa...
All the workers there were friendly & kind and the food was out of this world. 
Go there, relax & have a great time.

reviews.author: Lori N
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
My friend and I had the best vacation at the Palma Real.  The hotel was absolutely beautiful, clean, and luxurious.  We had plenty of staff who provided us with the best service possible.  Starting with customer service, we had Mindy Sanchez, who helped us with dinner reservations, snorkeling, and any other questions we had.  Next we had Ramon Fuego from the pool bar who provide us with excellent service.  He would deliver us drinks before we even finished the previous one.  The activities staff was friendly, fun, and attentive.  They engaged in conversation to get to know you, and not just to join their activity.  Their performance in the evening events were also exceptional.  Their names are as follows (Yiri, yubi, Favio, and our two favorites Francisco Macdonna and Angel).
Lastly was by far the best staff member we encountered the whole trip, Sonia from the Avenue Bar.  From our first night at the bar to our last night she provide the best experience with the best personality.  She is so sweet and caring and went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of.  Sonia made our trip beyond exceptional and we look forward to seeing her next time.

reviews.author: Eric P
reviews.title: pretty place, disappointing food and horrible service
reviews.text: Nice pool and beach.  Room was nice too.  Otherwise, this place was absolutely horrible.  If you ask a member of the staff to do something for you, or bring you something, you can bet it won't be done right.  The service at the restaurants was so bad -- and not just bad for an all-inclusive resort, but bad compared to any Denny's or diner.  Similarly, the front desk and room service were worse than I have ever experienced in any hotel.  For example, my wife and I lugged our own luggage from our room to the taxi stand (because the people who were supposed to come get the luggage never showed up, despite my calling the front desk -- no surprise there.   We, burdened by luggage, passed several employees who said "you are leaving?  ok, bye bye... safe trip...".  No offer to help.  No surprise to us by that point.  After 4 days here, we expected as much.  Once during my stay they brought me a warm can of beer and when I pointed out that it was warm and asked for another, I was told "do you want some ice?" I asked "could I have a cold one please?".  The response was a doubtful expression and "sorry.  I will check."   I knew I'd never see that server again and I was right.   This place is unbelievably bad.  Finally, they seem to spray A LOT of insect repellant around the place -- not many bugs (good), and constant stench of chemicals (can't be healthy).  Finally finally, the spa was really nice with excellent massages.  After the food and service at this place, I was reluctant to pay them another nickel, but the money I spent on my spa services were well worth it.

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Another fabulous week @ Palma Real
reviews.text: Seven days at the Palma Real and it never gets old.  We returned back after 6 months and I still didn't want to leave at the end of the trip. This has got to be one of the most beautiful places I've ever visited.  The staff is exceptional.  A few people who went above and beyond for our visit:  Georges Alriche who was our server on the beach--OUTSTANDING!  Anyeli y Yira--her first week of working at the resort!  You would never know-what a bright spot in our trip!  Francisco of the Activity department!  Superb!  And of course, the best bartender ever---RAMONE!!   BEST EVER! Lennie @ Club Melia was a big help, as usual.  We had issues with luggage not arriving and she was on top of that right away.   We absolutely love this resort and hope to come back again soon.

reviews.author: wcynthy
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text:
Check in and check out was the quickest I have ever had. I do wish they gave us a drink upon arrival though :-)!  The room we had was overlooking the pool. After requesting two separate beds they did accommodate us and change us from the king bed. The rooms at the Reserve are 15 minutes from the beach. I love to walk so we did not mind however it is not an easy walk because the trolly and the gardens in the trucks drive by. The trolly was not always easy to get. You wait 15 minutes a lot of times and the exhaust has a strong smell.  Everything in the resort is far apart. We would have loved if there were signs to help you get around. Some of the staff are friendly and helpful and others are not at all. The beach when we went was very wavy and had strong undertow. I do believe that this is the time of year we went. The resort does have great beach lounges and straw huts for everyone. Please note though if you are Family Reserve you can reserve the front beach huts.They put your names on them. We unfortunately got up at 7am and they were all taken but because we were just the Reserve we were unable to reserve seating.  You also at the Reserve are not allowed to go on the left side of the beach as that is for Royal members only. The first day we didn't realize this and got kicked off that side of beach by staff when we asked for a drink. There is  definitely plenty of room on our side of the beach though. We just didn't know. I prefer resort where there are no restrictions by class of room. I also think that the lay out of the resort is confusing. 

The speciality restaurants the food was decent. We especially love the Latin fusion. That was the best food and service we received.  It took a few phone calls to get reservations. I recommend to make reservations for all the restaurants on the day you arrive.

reviews.author: theJbird19
reviews.title: Beautiful setting tough service and food
reviews.text: We went for a destination wedding in late November... The property and the natural surroundings are amazing... The food and general hotel service are rough and leave one wanting a decent meal by the end of a four day trip. The efforts are there but the all inclusive concept here is not up to par with other Caribbean experiences we have had elsewhere. That said it's inexpensive comparatively to those other experiences.

reviews.author: NovaScotiaExplorer
reviews.title: Great Hosts
reviews.text: The natural setting and grounds are spectacular; allowing for serenity in some natural places and engaging social life in recreational areas. The amenities and services are as promised and meeting all of our needs. Most outstanding however were our "hosts". Inez, our concierge, found a way to say "yes" to all of our requests; she arranged and re-arranged our outings for golf and shopping off site; and ensured our dining adventures on site were excellent. She is limitless in her caring approach to guest services. Her colleagues at the restaurant "Passion", and we recommend the "tasting menu", were wonderful culinary guides and extremely flexible in modifying are dining in response to special requests. The experience at Passion was a "cut above" and worth it.

reviews.author: Guilherme Silva
reviews.title: "Feira"
reviews.text: O hotel é bonito. Possui uma boa estrutura mas em matéria de serviços e atenção ao hóspede, é pessimo: wi-fi não funciona (oscila demais), empregados ousados com os hóspedes, não avisavam para entrar nos quartos. Muito bagunçado: se não gosta de tumulto, não vá!

reviews.author: Jann B
reviews.title: Paradise!!
reviews.text: Wonderful facility, beautiful rooms and excellent service!  The "royal service" upgrade is worth the money.  The staff couldn't do enough for us, especially the beach staff - Martin Tineo in particular.  We will definitely go there again!!

reviews.author: AliciaInes52
reviews.title: Excelentes instalaciones y personal amable, pero no anda el wifi en las habitaciones
reviews.text: Pasé una hermosa semana de sol y playa, el hotel es muy bonito, el personal amable, los servicios no tanto, en especial no hay wifi en las habitaciones, hoy en día fundamental para cualquiera por mas que este de vacaciones. Dejo especial agradecimiento a algunas personas que hicieron mas agradable mi estadía, Lenny y Malvis de atención a socios, Kimberly y Lenny las chicas del Naos y del Gaby y Banna. Jesica del Gaby Beach y Francisco del servicio de playa. Del grupo de entretenimiento Yira y Yubi muy simpáticas y divertidas.

reviews.author: frank M
reviews.title: Great Stay- Francisco Estrella was great
reviews.text: Just returned from 5 days . The resort is beautiful and excellent service. Stayed at the Palma Real in a very nice suite. Francisco Estrella was great and set us up in very nice cabana next to the pool and on the beach. He was always around to help us out and bring drinks. Food was excellent at all the restaurants.

reviews.author: Donna D
reviews.title: Fabulous resort!
reviews.text:
Just returned from 5 days at the Reserve at PPR. The resort is beautiful visually and excellent service. Stayed at the Reserve in a lovely suite. Some mixup with our room which was quickly put to rights by the reception staff. I found the rooms a bit dark but overall lovely.
Food was excellent at all the restaurants and buffets. Cocktails and wines are average. They could do some work there with staff training and selections of house wines.
All in all a perfect vacation in Paradise. I will definitely return. Great value at the Reserve area for peace and quiet and privacy.
I would like to mention Juilio at the buffet and Francisco on the beach for great service.
Donna Deluco

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: Good food-Ramon at swim up bar goes above and beyond
reviews.text: The room and garden view were great. My wife and I were one of the couples in a group of 21. Our first time and definitely would like to return.On our last day as we walked the beach and were crossing the bridge Ramon ran over and handed me a drink. He bid us farewell and invited us to return. Everyone was friendly and courteous. Luis Fuegruto another bartender was good.

reviews.author: Monique M
reviews.title: Services hors pairs au Paradisus
reviews.text:
Je prends quelques minutes pour commenter l'excellent service que nous avons reçu au Paradisus Palma Real à Punta Cana.  Tout d'abord, nous avons bénéficié de l'encadrement d'un butler nommé Juan Castillo. Juan s'est occupé de notre groupe tout au long de la semaine.  Il voyait notamment à réserver nos places pour les soupers, il organisait les réservations pour les diverses activités telles que le catamaran, le tennis, etc. Toujours avec gentillesse, il voyait à ce nous manquions de rien et prime, il nous a fait bénéficié de petites attentions telles que des fruits frais dans notre chambre à chaque jour ou un bain mousseux préparé d'avance pour nous. Nous avons grandement apprécié toutes ses gentillesses. Le service royal avec Juan Castillo, c'est vraiment un traitement de roi!
De plus, nous aimerions souligner le dynamisme de l'équipe d'animateurs composés notamment de Angeli, Yubi, Dariana, Leo, Angel, Francisco et Fabio.  Grâce à eux, nos journées ont été ponctuées d'activités culturelles et sportives vraiment agréables. Toujours un plaisir de danser, de jouer et de s'entraîner avec vous!
Finalement, nous avons pu profiter des installations du YHI SPA. Wow! quel décor enchanteur, quelle ambiance relaxante, c'est un must, il faut l'essayer. Les massages de Vitaly vous feront un bien immense.

reviews.author: Monica W
reviews.title: brilliant resort
reviews.text:
My friend and I only stayed here for 4 days but we had the most relaxing time, the weather was fantastic, sometimes too hot for me.  The beaches are white sand and blue waters. The beach service was exceptional and we had wonderful service from our waiter (unfortunately I have forgotten his name) but really they were all great and very helpful and friendly. Would recommend the cocktails and fruit juices.

The restaurants were great serving delicious food and the variety to choose from was brilliant. Our waiter Luis de Aza was charming and looked after exceptionally well and fortunately he was at most of the restaurant we visited so our service was just perfect.. hats off to him.

We will certainly go again as the people, atmosphere and beauty of the place are recommendable & forgetful.

reviews.author: joanne b
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: The resort was relaxing and comfortable. We purchased the Royal Service package and were assigned a butler, Augustin Nunez who was so attentive and professional; he took care of all of our needs (dinner reservations, tennis reservations, travels back to the airport, and anything else we needed).  The food at the Palazzo was excellent as was the wait staff, especially Yudelka who was so friendly and attentive.  The yoga classes were excellent lead by Angel; the gyms were well equipped.  Entertainment in the evening was fantastic, especially the dance lessons with Angel.  The only room for improvement was transportation to the Reserve (spa treatments).  They could use more golf carts to get you back and forth.  Otherwise, would recommend Paradisus for a vacation to relax and indulge.  Internet service spotty but on vacation I really didn't need to be "in touch" but for those who need this service, there is service in the main lobby.

reviews.author: Daniel R
reviews.title: TUDO MUITO BOM!
reviews.text: Qualidade da comida e bebidas de primeira linha.Os funcionarios são muito atenciosos com  destaque especial para Darlin Iniri do restarurante Naos, e do bar man da piscina Luis e Ramon são demais. O quarto é muito bome confortavel, eu me hospedei no std vista Jardim piso superior.

reviews.author: Barry L
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Excellent property and facilities.  The staff is very accommodating.  Ramon, Luis and Paulino were excellent at the swim up bar.  The Romance Coordinator, Claribel De Los Santos, for the wedding we were attending was very helpful and pleasant.

reviews.author: Jane I
reviews.title: Paradisus palma real
reviews.text: The hotel itself was beautiful and very clean.  Staff was extremely friendly & most helpful.  We had the Royal service (RS), which I would highly recommend if it is within your budget.  With this you had the best restaurants including the Palazzo inclusive to RS only. Food was absolutely the best.  Not so impressed with the buffets and very grateful to have RS.  Francesco and especially Gloria at the RS bar were so lovely and so attentive.  Our butler was Sandy, who was the kindest, exemplary, person you could ever ask for.  Unfortunately there was one complaint that I hesitate to dwell on.  I was under the impression that premium liquor was available throughout the resort which is incorrect.  Very limited premium found only in the RS lounge & Palazzo.  Wine was not good.  Was this the fault of the Resort or my travel agent.  Find out what is included 1st.

reviews.author: beatrizantzoulatos
reviews.title: PARADISUS UNA FUENTE INAGOTABLE DE BELLEZA
reviews.text:
Los dominicanos en Punta Cana son una fuente inagotable de cariño, de sonrisas y buenas atenciones para sus tuirstas. He tendio la bendición de ser huésped del Paradisus Palma Real de la cadena Melià y como su nombre lo dice es un paraíso con fuentes inagotables de belleza y excelente atención por todos sus empleados.
Ellos piensan que cada turista es como una planta para regar, asì me dice Gerardo de Rosario encargado del Rest. Bistro.
En el Restaurante Paraiso nos atendió Pablo de la Piedra y nuestra compañera de viaje Carmen de la Cruz quedó fascinada con el, en realidad todas…
El dìa antes de partir cenamos con la atención de Linny, reconocimos lo agradecidas que nos sentimos por este abrazo dominicano . Nos llevamos lindos recuerdos, cuadros y velas en los talleres con Manta y con los otros señores super amables. Y nuestro principal guía en toda la semana Francisco, un chico de una sutileza y amabilidad única, ojalà tuviéramos un milòn de Franciscos en Venezuela.
Muchìsimas gracias por las atenciones en el Spa, en los restaurantes en el Front Desk, a los señores de los carritos de transporte, de la disco, de la playa, de la recepción en la entrada, a los mesoneros, a las chicas del café, de las camareras………..que màs puedo decir, que los llevo para siempre en mi corazón, gracias, gracias, gracias. Espero volver muchas veces màs. Beatriz Antzoulatos

reviews.author: Lazari Y
reviews.title: THANKS FOR MAKING MY 4OTH B-DAY CELEBRATION GRAND
reviews.text: I went to this resort on October 18th to celebrate my 40th birthday. The resort and the rooms were beautiful and the staff was amazing. I would like to give special recognition to Hehwan Ramirez Mercedes for being an outstanding waiter and taking care of me and friends every day at the Gabi. He was so nice and thoughtful and very attentive. I would definitely be visiting this resort again.

reviews.author: 123Monica123
reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text: Our trip to the Paradisus Palma Real was fantastic!  The grounds were beautiful and the service remarkable.  Johnfi Rivera and Ramon Fuego were two of the employees that stand out.  They went over and above to make sure our stay was enjoyable.  Johnfi was our personal butler.  Upon returning to our room one night, we found the jaccuzi tub filled with bubbles, rose petals surrounding it and chocolate covered strawberries to enjoy.  I recommend this place to anyone and please personally ask for Johnfi Rivera to be your family butler.

reviews.author: Christy C
reviews.title: Fabulous Resort!
reviews.text:
I came to this resort about 2 weeks ago for my friend's wedding.  This resort was the perfect place for them to get married!
From the moment we got there we were treated like we were royalty (even though we didn't have the royal package).  The staff was so welcoming and friendly.  They made sure we had everything we needed.
Rooms- The rooms were the perfect size.  They each had a mini bar and a balcony overlooking the garden area.  There was turn down service each night and always a special fruit tray or cheese plate waiting for us!
Beach-  The beach was not crowded at all and the views were beautiful.  The first day on the beach "Super Billy" waited on us and made sure we had a drink in our hands at all times.  He was very accommodating and made sure we were taken care of every day after.  Each morning he set up chairs for almost everyone that was visiting for the wedding (about 15 chairs).  After the third day he let us know he had to leave, but of course introduced us to Ramon who took great care of us after!  Big shout out to Billy and Ramon!
Activities-  The activities at the resort were a blast.  There was always something going on.  We participated in yoga, volleyball, beach party at Gabi Beach, salsa dancing lessons and a few other activities.  The activity staff was THE BEST!!!! Yubi, Leo, Yira, Angel, and Fabio went above and beyond what they needed to to make sure we were having fun.  We met them all on the first day and they remembered our name the whole trip.    At night we went dancing at the Red Lounge.  We had a blast dancing and appreciated the DJ for playing most of the songs we asked him to!
Wedding-  The ceremony was beautiful and the wedding planner made sure the bride had everything she needed.  The reception was outside in an area off of the first floor.  It was wonderfully set up and a great party.
Food-  I loved all the choices we had for food.  We went to the buffet in the mornings and Cana took good care of us.  She made sure we always had a drink and moved numerous tables around for our big group.  At night we tried a few restaurants and all of the food was tasty. 

We had a wonderful time on our trip and want to thank everyone who made it unforgettable.
Thank you Yubi, Leo, Yira, Angel, Fabio, Super Billy, Ramon and Cana!

reviews.author: Kavita K
reviews.title: 30th celebrating - All girls trip
reviews.text: The hotel was great, the only thing it lacked was the music while dining and by the pools. We stayed in the Royal service and Juan Castillo our butler was amazing! Everyone was very friendly and I would definitely return! Luis Martinez made great Mojitos! Angel and Francisco were two members of the staff and they made our stay pretty entertaining! All of the food we had there was delicious!

reviews.author: aem05
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text:
The reason for my trip to the Paradisus Palma Real was to celebrate my friends getting married. This was my first time in the Dominican and they chose the perfect resort to celebrate with family and friends. Our trip was  from October 24th- October 28th, arriving on Thursday and departing on Monday. 

Upon arrival at the airport, it was a short ride (20 min) to the hotel. The grounds when you enter the hotel are beautiful. We were greeted immediately off the shuttle and a bellman took our luggage for us. Check in was very quick and then we were taken to our room. We stayed on the second floor (the same floor as the lobby). The hotel is very large so it did take a second to get to our room. I would recommend requesting a room toward the front of the resort (the beach) or near the lobby if you don't like to walk.  Our room was beautiful and very clean. The man who carried our luggage for us showed us around the room. He explained about the beverages in the mini fridge, room service, and showed us how to use the safe. 

As you make your way to the beach, you pass the pool area. The hotel does not sit immediately on the beach front. The pools separate the hotel and the beach. There are also palm trees in front of the hotel as well. The pool is very large and there are many huts and lounge chairs in the water. The beach is beautiful and the water very clear. The beach in front of the Paradisus Palma Real was not crowded at all which was great. We walked down the beach to the left and right and many other resorts were very crowded. The wedding party received great service on the beach thanks to "Super Billy." I believe the Coco Loco was one of our drinks of choice on the beach...definitely try it out. 

The wedding day was beautiful. Her wedding planner did a great job with everything. She was married on the beach and it was perfect! After the wedding, we had a cocktail hour in the courtyard area outside one of the outdoor bars. The reception was in another location toward the back of the hotel. The reception was outdoors. The hotel did a great job of decorating all of the tables and setting up a great space for plenty of dancing. We were able to play our own music and dance the night away. 

On other nights, we often visited the sky bar and the red lounge. One night at the red lounge the DJ was generous enough to play several of our song requests which made the atmosphere a lot more fun. The food was amazing. We ate at several of the restaurants and all were delicious. We also ordered room service at night. It did not take long, typically 20-25 minutes. 

Another great part of our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real was the activities that they offer. The actividades staff were AWESOME. They were all very friendly and welcoming within a few minutes of being in the hotel. They were very fun and energetic and even learned all of our names after the first day. On Thursday there was a dance party on Gabi Beach where all of the staff made sure everyone was having fun. We participated in volleyball several times and salsa dancing with Angel. We also did yoga at the Chi Spa. This was a short golf cart ride where we were able to use the spa hot tubs and pools. I would recommend visiting the spa facilities. Special shout outs to the actividades staff: Yubi, Fabio, Angel, Yira, and Leo!! You guys were amazing!

Overall, this was an amazing trip. The wedding was beautiful and there were a lot of fun times made. Our group spanned all ages and I believe that everyone had a great time.

reviews.author: cronar66
reviews.title: Unbeleivable wedding and vacation at this resort
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. All the staff was very pleasant and helpful. The food was great. The rooms were perfect. The highlight of our vacation was the 2 bartenders at the pool bar. Ramon and Luis. They took care of our wedding group of 26 people like no one else could think of. No matter where we were at the pool or on the beach they would find us and make sure we all had drinks or anything we needed. I never had to think about what I wanted Ramon was always 1 step ahead of me and had something special waiting for me at the bar. Entertaining and professional these guys were the best. On our last day Ramon came over and thanked me and my wife even got a little teary eyed. He was the best. If you are ever at this resort go see them.

reviews.author: Mui Ying K
reviews.title: Awesome and great resort
reviews.text: One of the best resorts that I have ever stayed. I went for a friend's wedding and ended up having such a relaxing time. The service is impeccable and the food was really good. I am definetly going to come back!

reviews.author: Joe G
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
Spent a week at this resort and was treated like VIP then entire stay.  From check-in to onsite restaurant and bar service, as well as beach service for food/drinks to and from your beach bed, the entire experience was amazing.  The resort amenities are second to none; there was no shortage of conveniences right at your fingertips.  Our vacation package was the "Royal Service" stay; all inclusive fine dining, personal Butler, and access to all of the property locations.  We took the quick golf cart trip over to The Reserve and enjoyed a day at the spa; if the beach is not enough relaxation for you (property offers beach massages via hotel spa, highly recommend) then the 3 minute ride to the adjacent property is totally worth it.  The water ritual accompanied by many different types of treatments made our day.

One of the services, that absolutely made our trip even better, is the Hotel offers a personal butler.  They take complete care of you; give you a hotel cell phone so you can contact them for immediate attention without having to use your personal phone.  If you are able to request a personal butler during your stay and have the Royal Service package, I HIGHLY recommend requesting Nicolas Maracallo.  This gentleman is very professional with terrific customer service skills.  The friends we traveled with for this vacation are in the hospitality industry and have stayed at resorts all over the world and have come to recognize great customer service, and agreed he was excellent.  He understands how to make his guests feel completely at home and absolutely pampered.  Terrific communication skills, and was available at all times for us, all the while taking care of a group of 300 people at the same time who were there for an incentive trip from a US based company.  This did not stop him from making sure our stay at the Palma Real Paradisus was the best experience we could have possibly hoped for and more.  If only we were able to have this type of amazing experience in personal service on every vacation!  Very personable, professional, and punctual.  We tried to make the most of our stay and planned a lot of activities, and some of the items we wanted to do simply could not have been accomplished without his help.  

I will be returning this this resort.  It is paradise!!!

reviews.author: Lizette M
reviews.title: vacation in punta cana
reviews.text: i had a great time in this hotel food and service was great. room service was very good andres gomez perez was always on point as far as room service. the surounding grounds of the hotel is very tropical and magical.the beach is great and will not disappoint you. the people who work at the hotel are friendly and go out of there way to make you feel welcome.

reviews.author: Diane H
reviews.title: Best resort vacation!
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible! I really have nothing bad at all to say about this place. The service was unbelievable-our butler, Jonfi Rivera was the best! And "Super" Billy always had a cabana ready for us on the beach!! We stayed at the Royal Service area of the resort, which came with a private beach and pool. We ate at many of the resturants-Palazo, Vento, Gabi, Naos and all were very good. We even had a couples deep tissue massage and did the hydortherapy at the spa. (best massage ever) The resort is very large and spread out and  it took a few days to figure out where everything was. But I had no problem with getting lost in paradise!

reviews.author: Roger C
reviews.title: Beautiful property-friendly staff
reviews.text:
large beautiful property. Wonderful food, but you have to make dinner reservations for evening restaurants. The staff tries hard to speak English and have fun with you. 
Best server award goes to: Luis de aza 
Ramon, Fulgo & Gloria know how to keep things hoping at the swim-up bar. 
Fabio & Valerie - daytime entertainment team are STARS.

reviews.author: Capt Mitch
reviews.title: Shuttle waits No Bueno.
reviews.text:
Shuttle waits No Bueno.

This mature property is beautiful.
Stayed at The Reserve.
Room was perfect with a pool view, just one issue.
Hot Water! Not a lack of it, too much hot water.
Let concierge know and it was fixed that day. Other rooms in adjacent building were having same issue, and it returned for balance of our stay. In evenings, one of our rooms in adjacent building was super noisy due to excited younger guests. Our room in our building was mostly quiet.

Restaurants were ok.
Buffets were ok. Nothing spectacular. 
Typical omelette bar, and small grill for lunch.
Would have liked to see a greater selection of ingredients to put in omelette, such as bacon and shrimp.

Pools are awesome. We used the swim up bar at the reserve a lot.
Would also like to see guacamole and chips offered at small grill next to pool.

October is low season, so getting pool chairs and or  cabanas was easy.
Extra towels are self service, at unattended hut.

The beach is awesome. Again, low season so not problem getting chairs or cabana.
Drinks are self serve at the beach, not a far walk but still self serve.

Most all waiters, bartenders and staff are super friendly and outgoing.

Specialty restaurants were ok. Nothing like the food at The Vine Cancun or Zoetry.
Desserts  were varied and for the most part delicious.

Most aren't air conditioned, and some have so many Mosquitos that it would be prudent to apply great amount of bug spray or cream with deet prior to arrival. Two in our party got their legs bitten dozens of times in the ten minutes prior to staff offering Off spray.

I'd say the best meal we had was at the Grill. Not what you are thinking. Not the steak, ribs or sausage, those were not of good quality. The chicken and chicken soup were delicious.
We saw a fellow diner near that had Salmon. Fish was thick and looked great. Waiter offered us fish after he saw most left on my plate. It was thick, not at all fishy tasting (Fresh) and Delish.

The disco that opens at 11:30 pm in the main lobby was fun.
The shows by staff in the main showroom skip.

Drinks were ok, but most of the liquor is not premium and tasted it.

Some tips from our second trip to Punta Cana:

Buy your airport transfers online prior as cost vary.
We found $69 Round Trip for three online by Optim. Instructions online were clear, service was dependable, all brand new air conditioned vans and we were the only ones on board to and from the hotel. Five star rating from me on Optim.

Costco has a salesman in the lobby. Snorkel trip with transportation was $55 each, where lowest I could find in hotel for same trip was $69. You don't even have to be a costco member.
That trip was excellent as well.

Enjoy your next trip to Punta Cana.
I'll be returning, just probably not to this resort.

reviews.author: MsNiambi
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: This hotel resort is absolutely amazing! Adalgisa greeted us upon our arrival and was very nice and professional! and the concierge staff, Leidy Guerrero and Ariel Brito were nothing less than Phenomenal! They showed lots of enthusiasm from the moment we arrived, and went above and beyond to meet our every need! They made this vacation a top notch experience! My room was decorated beautifully to celebrate my birthday....ask for them when you come!

reviews.author: Bingobabe2013
reviews.title: Absolutely fabulous !
reviews.text: Every time is a good time with activity team supervisor Marionell- the wine tasting with Kelvin was very informative as well as enjoyable. The water aerobics with Michael was a lot of fun. There are activities and shows daily. The Fire and Desire show at the beach was very entertaining! The service is excellent . Anything you need the staff is more than happy to accommodate you. Our concierge Fernando Mengo was a pleasure to meet and was more than happy to accommodate us. The spa treatment with Maria Esther Eliot was fabulous. There was a variety of foods and no matter what time day or night you were hungry and waiters came around regularly with drinks to serve you, always with a smile. I would recommend this resort and will return!!! The rooms were also clean and comfy and the landscaping and decor of the resort was beautiful!

reviews.author: wsdryan
reviews.title: Beautiful surroundings and great staff
reviews.text:
I was at the Paradisus as part of a wedding party.  During our stay we had the opportunity to try several of the restaurants and bars; the food was always good, occasionally great.  Depending on which bar you were at the drinks were made from fresh fruit, not mixes, and the staff were knowledgeable. The grounds were immaculate and the gardens lush and well kept.  The real treasures are the staff, from the beach, to the poolside and Lobby Bar, everyone was fun, respectful and helpful.

The rooms were spacious and clean.   Although they a lovely set up for couple, the lack of privacy in the washroom make it less than perfect for roomies.

Overall a terrific experience and I can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Tiffany S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Paradises was like paradise. From the moment my family and I arrived until we left we were treated with nothing less than royalty. Ambiorix Mesa the bel boy, Andres Gomez delivered our room service and Rigoberto, Ramon were excellent as waitors. They went above and beyond to make sure we were happy as I celebrated my birthday. Great food, great service, and awesome hospitality and lasting memories. Punta Cana, I will be back soon!!

reviews.author: Margaret M
reviews.title: The name says it all.. PARADISE!
reviews.text:
Beautiful people, beach and resort!!
Excellent service and amazing drinks.  
Rodolfo is the absolute best... Número UNO!

Everyone strives to give you the best vacation...  Highly recommended...   We will be back.

reviews.author: Deloise F
reviews.title: Destination Wedding Trip
reviews.text: We had a great experience from check-in to check-out. Friendly staff, spotless and comfortable room, easy to navigate around the resort, great pool, and clean facility. The beach is awesome!!! It was very hot and humid, so be prepared to spend lots of time at the beach and pool. The one and only thing I did not enjoy was the mandatory dinner reservations. My preference was to decide on the fly and wait for a table while having a drink. I understand reservations for popular restaurants but not for every restaurant at the resort. Aside from the mandatory dinner reservations the food and service were superb!

reviews.author: Mario M
reviews.title: Awesome Stay!!
reviews.text: We stayed the week of 9/23. The staff is extremely accomodating. The service was excellent. We had the same concierge we had 4 years ago, Hugo Mena. He knew exactly how to arrange our schedule so that we were able to rest, while enjoying activities sprinkled in. The week was a perfect balance. The buffet is robust and the retaurants good to great. The portions are not quite we are used too in the states, but you can always have seconds or ask for double when you order.We just got back and am probably booking next year again.

reviews.author: Judi1018
reviews.title: Need to relax? Highly recommended!
reviews.text:
I just returned from The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real (9/28/13). I have a very stressful job and needed to chill out. This resort exceeded my expectations. I wish I had another week.

I travelled with a friend. We had a fabulous time! The YHI Spa was amazing. The rooms were great. The service was exemplary. It was just beautiful. We came during off-season, so the resort was sparsely populated. Several evenings I had the whole pool to myself. Loved it!

THE RESERVE: The property is well maintained and very clean. Our concierge, HEIDY, was very friendly. She answered all questions, made reservations for dinner, and made inquires for us. The grounds are beautiful. As a Reserve patron, we had access to exclusive facilities, pools, and restaurants. Yes, The Reserve is minutes away from the beach, but it’s tranquil environment made it well worth the 3-5 minute wait.

The Reserve itself has several pools surrounded by palm trees and a number of lounge chairs and unique seating arrangements. They have very restful music playing in the background. There is aroma/incense floating through the air. I liked the fact that the Reserve was just quiet and restful. Located just a tram ride away, Paradisus main resort has shops, money exchange, a disco, and live entertainment.

THE FOOD: You have to make reservations for the week when you first arrive, which is a bit confusing since you don’t know which is which. We tried several, including Aqua and Miso, but our favorite was Gabi Club. Gabi Club is a buffet with a wide offering of fruits and vegetables, main dishes, and a grill. The service in all the restaurants was very good. WILLIAM JAVIER and JULIO FLORES were our favorite servers. Both made us feel welcome, helped us with our broken Spanish, and made us laugh. They had a good command of English, so they made recommendations for drinks or menu choices. 

THE ROOM:  We had a one-bedroom suite. It came with a king-sized bed and a pull out couch. Unfortunately, there was no option for two queen beds, and I don't like sleeper couches. We did get a smaller single bed, which was quite comfortable. Our room had a shower with two rainfall heads, a commode room, two Jacuzzi tubs (one on the balcony), a dressing room, two couches, a large dining table and a kitchenette area. There was plenty of storage space.

Note: Unlike the main resort, The Reserve does not have elevators. Our room was on the third floor and we had no problem walking. I don’t know if there is an additional cost for ground floor rooms. (Ground floor rooms have private access to the lagoon like pools as well as extra lounge chairs and its own cabana.)

THE SPA:  Oh my, what a wonderful experience. YHI Spa is a serene, Asian-inspired spa. It offers the full complement of fee-based spa services—massage, manicure, facial, wraps—and, as a Reserve patron, we had unlimited access to the sauna, steam room and hydrotherapy baths. We went there every day once we found it. I did indulge in a detox wrap which left my skin silky smooth. ROSARIO was great! She was very gentle. I recommend her highly. What I loved most were the outside showers. All the showers were configured in private gardens so you could look up and see the sky as you bathed. 

ETC: 
1) Remember to bring mosquito repellant. This is the tropics and some people are more prone to mosquito bites. My travel companion got bitten while sitting outside at night while listening to live music the Paradisus main resort. I had treated my clothes with permethrin before I left and used a good, non-DEET insect repellant on my bare feet and arms with success. One couple that we had dinner with was not so fortunate. Be prepared.

2) Airport timeshare rush. When we first arrived, w found ourselves funneled to a guy offering free trips for timeshare presentation. We thought he was with our hotel. NOT! We did do the timeshare presentation at the Hard Rock Resort in exchange for a day-trip to Saona (the excursion was nice). I appreciated comparing our resort to the Hard Rock. The Hard Rock rooms were significantly smaller and the finishes and details were not as nice. It just felt like a huge hotel.  The Paradisus was FAR better in my estimation. I saw nothing that compared to the Reserve in tranquility and decor.

3) IVAN. Ivan is the guy to see for excursions. He is most helpful. We were looking for a local tour and he was able to arrange a private car with an English-speaking tour guide. He can help you decide which excursion best meets your desires. He was a pleasure to work with.
 
4) Exchange. Okay. Generally, 100 Dominican pesos equal 2 U.S. dollars. People will often accept either and seem to prefer U.S. currency. I woefully undertipped the guy who carried my luggage, but I didn’t realize it until much later. Service was great with or without tips. The staff does change frequently, so if you like the service don't wait until the end of the week.

I highly recommend the Paradisus and The Reserve, in particular. I look forward to staying their again.

reviews.author: Christine P
reviews.title: Relaxation at it's finest :)
reviews.text: This is my second experience with a Paradisus resort and they are amazing resorts, the service is next to none, the grounds are always amazing and the entertainment top notch as far as resort entertainment goes they exceed expectations. The a la carte restaurants are great and the buffets offer variety, however you need to be "careful" of undercooked meat when the buffet is busy. We were served chicken that was only brown on the outside off of the grill, pay attention to what you eat or sickness ensues quickly. Lock up valuables, when you are in an amazing resort where the staff is always willing to assist in everyway you get comfortable and leave things around the room, we had cell chargers go missing from the wall and quite frankly once there gone you can kiss them goodbye so use the safe for anything you don't want to lose. If you are looking for a great beach and fantastic service, this resort nails it.

reviews.author: Wendy O
reviews.title: Coming for visit
reviews.text: Excited about trip. Few concerns based on reviews. Want to know what we CANNOT do by not staying at the reserve; 2 restaurants and a pool but what else? Through my time share the Reserve was not available for time frame we could go. I want to make sure that my kids wont feel like they are missing out if I book at Palma Real.

reviews.author: Kay B
reviews.title: Best All inclusive experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Reserve at Punta Cana Dominican republic with a group of friends for a wedding. It was a very memorable experience. The grounds are idyllic, green, tropical, with little ponds and pools surrounded with flowers and fauna. Beautiful peacocks roam the grounds. The decor is very creative, tasteful and resort ready.

The competition for the various restaurants is keen so one must book well in advance.
The only draw back was the musky smell in the room but we changed our room the odor was gone.
The spa facilities are thoughtful with choices for a sauna depending on your level of tolerance to heat!
The bathrooms throughout the resort are clean and decorated with class and taste. There are many spots to lounge or sit and relax.
I was absolutely impressed with this hotel and will certainly recommend it .5 stars!!
 I traveled a few years ago so I selected the earliest date allowed!

reviews.author: evem77
reviews.title: Fantastic Time
reviews.text: I had an amazing time at the Reserve Paradisus. The service was excellent.  The entire staff was exceptional. Espescially Ines one of the hostesses, she is a gem. She helped make the trip one I will never forget.

reviews.author: LC B
reviews.title: Ok Resort
reviews.text: This was a ok resort.  The grounds, pool and beach were great.  The rooms left a lot to be desired-they are in need if refurbishing.  There were three of us in the room and it was a little tight so upgrading to a suite may be the way to go.  We were also told that wifi would be available in the room but that was not the case so we had to walk to common areas to get wifi.  This was my first foray into the all inclusive world and I was disappointed in the food choices.  It was lo a pain to make reservations at the various restaurants, so if you can o so before you get there that would be helpful-it always seem to b a half hour job.  I loved the various activities they had throughout the day and night-dance classes, 80s dance party-absolutely fun!  The staff were wonderful! Especially those who ran the various classes and the night time entertainment--outstanding!  Just wish the rooms were better appointed...

reviews.author: nunez1010
reviews.title: Un verdadero paraiso
reviews.text:
Gracias a Francisco Estrella y a Melvin Lagua
quqienes nos hicieron sentir como reyes del Paraiso
Francisco en la piscina dándonos un verdadero servicio, y melvin en recepción con una sonrisa siempre presente y dándonos un trato afable, y sin excusas a la hora de respondernos cualquier pregunta.
Lo mejor de este hotel, no es la ubicación, ni su estructura, son los empleados, que cada día ponen su granito de arena para que todo salga bien
 Lastima que solo fueron 3 días, pero trataremos de volver algún día
Todo estuvo bien..En room service disfrutamos de un buen desayuno que cada día Soesi nos traia, lo unico que en la noche no hay mucha variación, pero la comida es buena, y el servicio es eficaz, a tiempo y los camareros son muy profesionales y atento
Soesi , melvin y francisco estrella, gracias por todo.-

reviews.author: Thierry_O
reviews.title: Good service, food and activities
reviews.text:
We stayed in a 1 bedroom apartment. The room was clean but in need of some refurbishments.
The choice of restaurants was great and the food and staff were excellent. AI fee wasn't cheap, but worth it. The grounds and beaches are well maintained. We really enjoyed our stay. Participated at some activities and attended some of the shows. We would say special thanks in particular to Rachel, Francisco and Jonathan from the activities team, Nelson  the bar tender who hosted the the cocktail class for the commitment. We had dinner at most of the restaurants and would like to thank Androqui (Vento / Naos / Market Grill), Pedro (Bana / Market Grill), Wily Mercado (Market / Grill) and Wrander (Illy station / Naos) for their excellent service provided during our stay.
We enjoyed cocktails at the Swim Up bar, special thanks to Ramon for his cheerfulness and acrobatic skills.

reviews.author: Marcie M
reviews.title: Fantastic!!!
reviews.text:
When we checked in we thought we were going to just have a standard room but we were upgraded to a 1 bedroom master suite in the Reserve. Thank you Adrianna! OMG. Loved it. The beach at this resort is so nice, beautiful white sand and if you're staying at the Reserve you get special seating at the beach with a bartender just for us.
The Reserve has it's own pool and you can use the main pool as well. This resort was first class all the way. Everyone on the resort was so nice, always saying hola and asking if we needed anything.
You can use the spa facilities for no charge, only charges for massages etc.
The family concierge  was amazing. Thank you Fernando! 
The beds were so comfortable, we slept like babies every night.

reviews.author: Sandy L
reviews.title: Fantastic Place!!!
reviews.text:
We traveled with friends here and it was the best all inclusive place we have stayed at!  We were treated like royalty!  The place is spotless, and they are cleaning constantly.  Our bed was super comfortable and the room nice and cool.  Food was good with many choices available.  Lots of lounge chairs on the beach, we never had a hard time finding one.  The wait staff is excellent and super friendly!  Especially Androqui Colon, Luiz De Aza, and Jose Ramos.  They were our favorites, taking such good care of us!  Thank you so much!!!   This vacation was so great we cant wait to come back to this hotel.
Sandy & Frank  :)

reviews.author: Dharma D
reviews.title: Il meglio dell' All inclusive
reviews.text: La nota dolente, a mio parere della Repubblica Domenicana, e' la grande diffusione di All inclusive che ha sicuramente fatto aumentare il turismo in questo meraviglioso paese caraibico, ma un turismo di massa, di classe medio bassa che ha reso le spiagge e i palmizi di Punta Cana, Bavaro e Baya Hibe come  Rimini (con tutto il rispetto per Rimini) e non piu delle incredibili spiagge incontaminate come in altre isole vicine che non hanno fatto questa scelta, ma hanno privilegiato la natura il territorio quei beni preziosi che rendono queste isole un paradiso. Il Palma Real e' il meglio di quello che puo offrire un All inclusive con una struttura elegante, curata, un servizio eccellente, ristoranti diversificati con una cucina di un alto livello, cosa rara in All inclusive. I costi sono alti, ma adeguati a quello che viene offerto.

reviews.author: 1938Roberto
reviews.title: Dissapointment
reviews.text:
We Went to Paradisus Reserve Punta Cana  we are a member of Melia Caribe Tropical they dont have anything available for that week so I call the Network and we do the reserve 1 week we are very dissapoint because we pay more money for the all inclusive. 2 nights they don fix and change the towels we always stay in the Royal Service at Caribe Tropical. The bathroom they have a very hot water that we have to call to fix that I went to claim what we thought I have the right since we belong to the Member Club. In  other word we don't go back to that hotel, the only thing we really enjoy was the staff, Jose at the Gabi beach excellent person very "complaciente" and always in a very good mood and Juan Cruz at the bar pool
very nice too Rafael Evangelista at the pool bar that men is a such nice person very complaciente too. If for some reason I have to go back I go for the staff in general.
 
I HAVE TO GO BACK IS FOR THE STAFF.

reviews.author: Yolanda H
reviews.title: Amazing luxury resort
reviews.text: We went for a wedding as well as our anniversary and it's my first time outside if the United States. Everyone was helpful, kind, and hard- working. The hotel was beautiful, but very slippery when wet. I had the royal service, which would ave been more beneficial in the peak seasons.
