Since t was a low season, we received exceptional service from everyone everywhere, including informative Ali's about the country, which wouldn't have otherwise been able to happen. When we can save enough to come back, we definitely will stay at this same resort! We felt very safe, as well, and having a police officer as a spouse, safety is very important.

reviews.author: Lisa T.
reviews.title: Beautiful Property - Upper Mgmt Needs to Learn Hospitality
reviews.text:
As a well-seasoned traveler, in the hospitality industry and an avid Trip Adviser reader, my friend and I selected the Paradisus after much deliberation for a girl's getaway. Also, 2 friends of ours had also gone there and raved about the resort. We booked it through RCI and were excited for our first trip to the Dominican Republic. Normally, I take the negative reviews with a grain of salt but after our week there (August 24 - 31, 2013) I am compelled to write my first TA review ever. Also, after talking with other guests during that week, we weren't the only ones with these experiences. I'll break it down to the good and the not-so-good. 

Good: The grounds are stunning and well maintained. There are some fantastic workers at this resort. People who work really hard to do their job well, efficiently and make sure that their level of hospitality are on par. Edgar and Yetsy from the guest services/conceirge, Pascal and Osenia from Palazzo restaurant, Francisco and Nelson from the Royal Services pool, Pedro at Bana restaurant, Cesar who brought us tea & coffee every morning, and Kimberly from Gabi Beach restaurant made sure we had a good stay. The YHI Spa was absolutely amazing and probably the most redeeming thing about this resort. It was simply amazing and Maria and Altagracia were the best masseuses. Do yourself a favor and get the water ritual before your massage, you won't be disappointed. A note, however, the prices on the spa menu do NOT include tax, and their tax is a whopping 18%, so take that into account when trying to book. They have specials throughout the week that offer discounts on their spa services, so look for those. A special note and I would be sorely remiss to not point it out - we met one of the waiters there, Jensey at Market Grill on Wednesday during our week. We chatted and had fun and found out he'd be working at his normal restaurant, Vento, the next night. Well we were lucky because we had reservations for Vento on Thursday too. Jensey went out of his way to make me and my friend feel like royalty that night! Him and his partner that night, Victor, reserved us a special table, put beautiful flowers all over it, gave us fantastic wine, special wine glasses and even a special dessert. They truly went above and beyond and made our trip memorable! We will never forget that night at Vento thanks to Jensey and Victor. Ohh and the food at the resort is fantastic! We are foodies and pretty much enjoyed mostly everything we ate. Palazzo was fantastic!! 

Not-So-Good: Prior to arriving, I emailed Martina Gabriel, the reservations manager several times regarding pre-paying for the all inclusive as it was less costly to do so in advance. Also, in those emails I said "to confirm we have reserved a 1 bedroom ocean view suite with 2 double beds". She never returned the first emails with all my credit card info and I forwarded it to her again (with the bed requests) and she said she received it. When we got there, we upgraded to the Royal Service. We didn't get the full RS because we would have to downgrade our room type and then pay MORE money. A smaller room, not as nice and pay more money? So we opted to stay in our room (w/out butler service), which we were then told only the Royal Service rooms offered an ocean view. Okay, no big deal. We get to our room and there is a king sized bed when we requested 2 dbl beds. We call the front desk and speak to Antonio (who checked us in and upgraded us to RS) and he keeps going and speaking to his manager, who never once called us to handle the situation. I forwarded them all my emails from Martina Gabriel and I said, if 2 dbl beds were a problem - she should have told me prior. It was in ALL my emails. Good customer service requires honesty. Tell me it's not available, no problem. But when your hotel is at 46% occupancy and the hotel tells me in order to get double beds, I would have to downgrade my room OR pay more money! They made it seem like this was my fault when the hotel never told me it was a problem prior to arriving. Nope - they wanted me to pay more money or downgrade my room (when I paid $ for the better room and they weren't going to refund me that $ or tell RCI either of a lower valued (points) room switch). So we kept our room but not even an apology for the mistake on their end.Then the shower in our room flooded the bathroom every time we took a shower. I told 4 different people about this problem at the beginning of our stay, and it was never fixed. We used all of our towels to clean it up...and then the maid re-hung our dirty floor towels back up when she came to clean instead of changing them. We went to Gabi Beach, which was included in our RS upgrade. We wanted to eat a snack on the beach but were told that wasn't included. You had to pay $ to eat on the beach, but if you went and walked into the restaurant (200 feet away) it was included. This made no sense. The next day, instead of being upset the whole week I decided to address what had happened with the Manager. Just to clear the air. In my line of work, I'd want someone to tell me. The manager wasn't available but we spoke to the Manager's assistant, Camillo. I was very calm and explained all that happened. He was visibly shocked and said that A) Martina should have told us B) Gabi Beach food was included BOTH on the beach AND at the restaurant and C) He would have our shower fixed. Feeling much better we went to go relax at Gabi beach. Well guess what? Camillo was wrong. We spoke to Kimberly, the manager of the restaurant and after many back and forth calls to the hotel and the restaurant they said that the beach is not included and they couldn't get Camillo on the phone. Why doesn't management know this? Why don't they tell you this when you pay to upgrade for it , that it's not included? I've stayed at hotels all across Mexico and the Caribbean and have NEVER encountered a place where food on the beach (for the same restaurant) is not included. Also what was disappointing is at the Royal Services pool, there were only 8 covered cabanas which you had to reserve. Us, having no butler, could not do this even though we were told we could reserve them there when we upgraded to Royal Service. When we went to the pool to inquire about reserving one, we were told they were reserved all week. The other beds were in direct sunlight without even umbrellas. My friend and I were typically at the pool from 11 AM - 6 PM every day. Usually about 90% of the day those beds were reserved and completely unoccupied. They need a better reservation system for this. I understand them reserving them, however, when they go unused the entire day - no one is at the pool except the 2 of us and we don't have the option of cooling off in one of them, it leaves a sour taste in your mouth. Perhaps they should do 1/2 day reservations or if it's unoccupied for more than 2 hrs then it can go to someone else. Lastly, upon arriving we made reservations for Passions ($50/person) for our last night there, Friday night. After having such an amazing experience at Vento and looking over the Passions menu, we felt we would have not been happy and left disappointed. So we went to cancel our reservation that afternoon at 3 PM (reservations were at 7:30 PM). Yetsey at the conceirge told us that we could not cancel and had to have done so by 12 PM that day, which no one told us when we made the original reservation. She had to go to considerable length, calling/emailing, etc in order to TRY and cancel our reservation, which she could not guarantee and even if we didn't go were told we would have to pay for regardless. To her credit, she was able to cancel our reservation at no charge. However, something as simple as cancelling a reservation several hours in advance should not have been as big as an ordeal as it was. It should have been a simple, no problem! Of course, whatever you'd like to do! Also their restaurant reservation system does need improving, as they have a very limited number of "reservations per night", yet the restaurants are empty. Perhaps they go based on a certain amount of food/person and that's how they do their reservations, but it should be simpler. A tip - make all your reservations as soon as you arrive.

Overall, I think the upper management needs to learn hospitality and how to treat guests like their employees in the rest of their hotel. They need to be able to communicate with their guests what services they offer and what you're paying for them. Overall we did have a nice stay but too many small blips. Things that should have not been a problem, turned into big productions trying to get it rectified and usually never were fixed (I didn't even bother listing everything). It's even more upsetting as having tried to rectify the situation and inform upper management, and they still provided incorrect information and did not help to solve any of the problems. My friend and I may try another Melia property, but never a Paradisus again, which is sad because the resort is beautiful. But a beautiful resort cannot make up for mismanagement.

reviews.author: Ron D
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Review
reviews.text:
Wow- what a great place.  Service could not have been any better or any friendlier.  Vladimir Rodriguez was our contact, and set everything up perfectly for our return. 

Food was plentiful, awesome, and available. Great restaurants, casino is fun, pool spectacular.

Great trip for boys golf, couples, or family.

reviews.author: Jenny L
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, attentive staff
reviews.text:
We went to Punta Cana over labor day and had a wonderful experience.  Property was beautiful and very well maintained.  Staff was very attentive.  I will caution, however, it was off season and resort was not crowded- so it was very easy to be attentive.

We got our room upgraded (for free) on arrival to a huge suite.  Pools and beach were amazing.  Drinks were very strong.  Suggest making dinner reservations prior to arrival.  Also, take a taxi to and from resort, do not use their transportation.  It is $35 each way via taxi.

reviews.author: I-LoveToTravelNY
reviews.title: The perfect getaway sanctuary
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful! The resturants were very good. Every night they made our dinner reservations for us. We visted the gym the whole week (I guess because we felt gulity eating so much LOL). If you like spin class you won't like their old spin bikes.... BUT the cardio classes were great. The Reserve section has it's on pool and beach section. Even though, the Reserve is a little farther from the beach the trolly ride was short and sweet.Our biggest decisions during the stay was beach vs pool and what time to eat. If you want to relax an bask in the sun this is the place. The service was great and the concierge was so helpful. Along, the way Ines helped answer our questions. Super Mario was full of energy and had us dancing by the pool. I wish I was still there!!!!

reviews.author: RoamingAmbassador
reviews.title: Amazing week in paradise!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real - this place truly lives up to its name. It looked and felt like we were in paradise!! Our room was spacious and comfortable. We loved the 24hr room service, which came in handy after several late nights out! The pools and beach area were well-maintained, with plenty of comfortable seating. The swim-up bar was definitely a nice touch, had the best daiquiris there!  A big shout out to the activities staff, Angel & Yurbi. They were a lot of fun!

All restaurants were good, including the buffet restaurant Naos, which offered a wide variety of fresh fruit, desserts, and salads.  Vento was by far the best for both food and service.   I very much enjoyed my meal there! Teppenyaki at Bana restaurant was a lot of fun, especially with our chef Manuel.

Tip: If you have a garden view room, make sure you shut the inner curtains because you can see straight through to the bathroom from outside.

reviews.author: M_Alenia2013
reviews.title: Fantastic All Round Experience
reviews.text:
I have never come home from a vacation with nothing to complain about - but this time, its totally true.  I had a SUPER visit.  The location was magical, the accommodations luxurious, the food delectable and the staff so friendly and helpful that I couldn't even imagine how to express my appreciation fully.
I do want to make special mention of Angela Guzman who was my Valet at the Spa and who was particularly warm, helpful and attentive.

reviews.author: SugaP
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise!
reviews.text: This all-inclusive resort was absolute paradise!  However, stay away from KB Store in Palma Real Shopping Mall.  The cashier has a very bad attitude, unwilling to help and unfriendly.  Don't waste your time and money in KB Store!!! Otherwise, its a very luxurious resort with modern furnishings and good food.  Ariel welcomed us by delivering a fruit platter and champagne to our room. I enjoyed the best meal at Vento Restaurant and the service was exceptional by Hector and Victor.  The food at Vento was AWESOME from beginning to end!  I also recommend the food at Market Grill Restaurant and our waiter Yoheli was truly attentive.  The dance lessons offered by Miguel, Angel and Franciso was so much fun.  They made it easy to learn bachata and salsa.  Thanks guys for all the laughs and fun in the sun.  The highlight of my trip was the YHI Spa.  This spa was totally relaxing with beautiful fountains, sauna and Jacuzzis.  My masseuse Quintana was excellent and pampered my aching muscles.  Alexandra Moto attended to all of our needs while at the spa.  Special thanks to Maria for her help while instructing me in Pilates, Yoga and Body Balance.  The beach and pool were always clean and staff was consistent with greetings to check if I needed anything. I highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real!!!

reviews.author: laurentpT2502US
reviews.title: Très bon séjour
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné à l’hôtel au Paradisius Palma Réal du 28/07 au 4/08/2013.

Ce fut un très agréable séjour dans un hôtel où l’accueil, la gentillesse de tout le personnel, la qualité du service étaient au rendez-vous.

L’hôtel dispose d’une section « La réserve » qui est un peu éloignée du resort principal et plutôt destinée  aux familles.

La restauration est de très bonne qualité avec beaucoup de choix. Les restaurants sur réservation sont excellents avec mention particulière pour le restaurant « Passion » où nous avons été accueilli par Anthony Masas , Exécutive Sous Chef, qui parle français et nous a fait partager sa passion de la cuisine.

Les chambres sont très confortables et très grandes avec baignoire à remous. Le ménage est fait chaque jour avec remise de bouteilles d’eau.

Un grand merci à Georgelina à la réception qui nous a permis de changer de chambre à la 3ème nuit pour avoir une chambre avec vue mer sans supplément et également Laurent, jeune français travaillant à la réception depuis peu.

Yvan Gimenez au lobby bar nous a toujours préparé d’excellents cocktails dont le ti-punch antillais avec du rhum ambré dominicain.

Nous avons joué au golf sur le parcours attenant à l’hôtel «  le cocotal » qui est un parcours sans grande difficulté mais dont le prix du green fee est très raisonnable ( 40$ par personne) par rapport à ce qui se pratique ailleurs en République Dominicaine.

Une belle piscine et des catamarans sont à votre disposition sur la plage magnifique.

Pour résumer, un endroit idyllique pour passer quelques jours de détente.

reviews.author: Girlaine D
reviews.title: Fabulous!!!!!
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel from 8/22/13-8/26/13. I can't say enough about how great this hotel is including the staff. The room was clean and within a few minutes complimentary fruit and wine was brought to our room by Ariel. The ambiance of this hotel is absolutely gorgeous. We made dinner reservations right away for the restaurants Market Grill, Gabbi, Vento, and Bana. I would say Bana was my favorite followed by Market Grill. I must reiterate the service was impeccable at all of the restaurants. We also ate at Naos for breakfast and lunch. This is a buffet style restaurant. The BEACH is SUPERB. There was a nice breeze everyday, available chairs, and servers for drinks. Since I can't swim, the waves worked for me because they weren't strong. The activities at the hotel I participated in were dance lessons, aqua aerobics, yoga, and live entertainment in the evening. Shout out to Miguel, and the other dance instructor. I forgot his name and the yoga instructor. I also ENJOYED a massage and the fatalities at YHI Spa. I can't say enough about this hotel. I will definitely be back SOON.

reviews.author: Kaci W
reviews.title: Amazing Resort- Wedding of My Dreams!
reviews.text: My husband and I chose the Paradisus Palama Real Golf and Spa Resort for our wedding and honeymoon June 2013.  It was the best decision we could have made!  From beginning to end we were more than happy with the wedding, the resort, and the staff.  We are very busy people but enjoy traveling so a destination wedding for us and our closest family and friends was perfect.  The resort had an amazing wedding planning staff very professional, and there to answer any and every question big or small regarding wedding planning.  It made the whole process stress free!  When we arrived we were greeted with a warm welcome by the amazing staff.  They were there to make every moment perfect and enjoyable for my husband and I.  They even went out of there way to add extra touches and details that I hadn't even asked for.  The wedding photography (Arrecife Studio) was awesome. They were wonderful to work with and we were more than please with all our pictures.  The wedding planning staff really made the whole wedding weekend stress free and special. Mariela really made our special wedding weekend perfect.  She was there for every special moment and I'll always remember her professionalism, and kindness. They are very lucky to have her on staff at the Paradisus Palama Real! Our guests loved the resort and the whole wedding weekend.  We were able to plan a snorkel excursion for our guests on a private catamaran as a pre-rehersal dinner activity.  We also took more excursions.  I was able to call ahead and plan our excursion.  The staff was wonderful they answered all my questions and sent pictures so I would know what to expect for my guests.  Carlos Lluberes who is a part of the Club Melia staff was also a great person we met at the resort.  He spotted me in the lobby and shared that he heard I was the "bride".  He made it a point to go out of his way to make us feel welcome.   Each day we saw him and he was always quick to make sure we were taken care of and then some.  We also dinned at Gabi Beach and met the wonderful Juan Carlos Feliz who was so kind! I could go on and on... the Resort was beautiful, food was great, staff was amazing, spa was AWESOME!  We WILL be back.  My dream wedding was more than I could have even dreamed for.  Thank you paradisus palama real!

reviews.author: Travelagentviews
reviews.title: Honest Travel Agent review.  "Royal Service"  questionable??
reviews.text: Let me start out by saying that I am a US Travel Agent and have been to several All inclusive resorts.  Wanting a little more pampering My friends and I opted for the Royal Service.  Notifying the resort prior to our arrival that I was in fact a Travel Agent, was most confident that  I would be treated well.  When we arrived it seems as though we were not on the hotel manifest to arrive, but after showing my confirmation to the front desk they quickly transferred us to our personal check in that I have to say was very nice.  They greeted us with fresh cold towels and champagne.  There we met our Butler, Carmen.  She seemed very professional.  We were only staying 3 nights at this hotel and then moving over to another hotel to get a different perspective of the islands resorts.  After much research prior to our arrival,  we all knew exactly what restaurants and times we wanted as well as a Golf day and Scuba diving.  They give you a cell phone to keep in contact with your butler, We had given here all the information, and it seemed as though we would have to always try to get ahold of her, she never once called us on our phone.  We would have to ask the Royal service Bartender to see if she had been able to confirm anything.  She did finally come out to the beach  where we were most of the time for the 3 days.  She then gave us our restaurant reservations at 4PM for 7:30pm reservations, she even went as far to take our for breakfast room service on the morning that we had scheduled Golf/ and Scuba, but no breakfast ever showed up. We waited as long as we could and had to rush to catch our shuttles.  Unfortunately we arrived in the lobby minutes after the scheduled shuttle to the Cocotol Golf course departed.  We were unaware of the scheduled times (hourly) , as we were not told.  The bellman worked fast and got us to the Course just a little late.   I had read several reviews prior to our arrival was confident that the Butler service was the way to go.  Don't know if I would suggest it to my clients.  The Advance reservations was nice, but that was about it!.  The Palazzo restaurant was great, as well as the Mediterranean, and Japanese and Gabi beach.   Rooms were great and stayed very cold.  Service was impeccable as far as Bartenders and wait staff.  We received great beach service from Francisco!  The Spa experience was wonderful and would highly recommend the Spa at the Reserve.

reviews.author: Tracy M
reviews.title: Paradisus Reserve
reviews.text:
A couple friends and I traveled to Paradisus Punta Cana for a wedding. The location, property, service, cleanliness, and rooms were impeccable! Al a carte restaurants were good but Mole was my favorite. Pool was very clean and was maintenance daily. Excursion of banana boat and dune buggies were very fair in price. The employees go out of their way to make sure the guests have a great time! Two people who made my experience so much better were Danny (bartender by the pool) and Sandra (concierge at the reserve) they were amazing and deserve a raise! They really went out of their way for us. 

Two things I wasn't a fanatic about was the buffet food and bugs. I know it is a developing country but buffet food gave me some stomach aches. The Mosquitos really come out at night  and fully attack. I had to have gotten bit about 100xs just on my legs. Make sure you bring bug repellent. 

Overall , great experience! I would definitely return!

reviews.author: MsRet
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
I just returned from a 1 week vacation Aug 10-17, 2013 at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. I exchanged through RCI. Let me start by saying it was truly a beautiful vacation at a first class resort. We were in Royal Service and it was well worth it!. Starting with the great service provided by our butler, Luis Martinez. Luis went the extra mile to make certain all of our dinner reservations were made each evening at the various restaurants. We experienced different cultural cuisines each night. He made us aware of the activities going on each day and evening. He even had a bubble bath prepared in the room one evening while we were at dinner. A pleasant surprise to find upon our return to the room. Talk about going the extra mile... Wow! Whenever we needed an answer to a question, he was available via a cell phone provided by Royal Service that he programmed on speed dial for us! When I return again, I'll be sure to request Luis as my butler.

The resort is immaculate! The maintenance crew does an excellent job of maintaing the grounds on the entire property. They work tirelessly to make sure it is picture perfect. A special thank you to Cecil, one of the ground maintenance employees who was kind enough to cut down two fresh coconuts for us to drink coconut milk from one and eat the fresh coconut from the other.

Wilkins, the Royal Service pool bartender was always on top of his game. He became familiar with what our drink requests were and never failed to make them at the strength we desired.

Ramon and Francisco at the Royal Service pool also deserve props for making certain we had prime beach chair locations, drinks, and reserving us a Bali Bed poolside. 

Food and drinks are available 24 hours a day at Naos, the buffet and the Sky Lounge.There is no reason for anyone to ever go hungry or thirsty. Overall, the service at the A la carte restaurants was good. At times somewhat slower than I would like, as it appears that they could use more waiter staff to handle the volume. We experienced one problem with slow service and small portions at Bana, the asian fusion restaurant. The absolute best meal was at the Hibachi Grill on our last night. The preparation and presentation was wonderful. Make sure you dine at this one. Second to the Hibachi, would be the meals at Vento, the italian restaurant and Gabbi Beach where the seafood was great. Other than the Royal Service pool bar, the liquor at the Royal Service lounge was top shelf. Other bars at the resort did not offer the same top shelf liquor as Royal Service and were somewhat watered down. But if you requested more liquor, the staff would try very hard to accomodate you. Even once a supervisor personally brought the drink to our table at dinner at Gabbi Beach to make sure we were pleased.

We stayed in a 1 bedroom (2094) which was adequate for 2 people. We had a beautful view from our balcony of the garden, Royal Service pool and Carribbean. Couldn't have asked for a better scenic view. The room itself was clean but had a slight mildew odor in it. It seemed as though the odor was coming from the ventilation system. When we asked for a different room, we were shown a room that had a view of the backside of a building. Obviously we did not opt for it. We decided to keep the room we had after being told there were no other rooms available. The odor dissipated after a couple of days. And, there were incense provided in the room that we could burn as well. The room was cleaned daily with turn down service nitely. The fridge was stocked each day with beer, soda, juice and water. Our bar was also stocked with top shelf rum and vodka. A nice perk!

The Michael Jackson show was the best after dinner nitely entertainment. La Cirque would be rated second. Other entertainment was more or less take it or leave it. Something to do other than sit in your room. 

Lastly, YHI Spa at the Reserve is magnificent. It is like a sanctuary! We visited it twice and highly recommend it for just enjoying the tranquil atmosphere, massage pools, steam room and sauna. Even more if you have an opportunity to enjoy a massage.

Paradisus Palma Real is like paradise. It is a vacation of a lifetime! The scenery, immaculate grounds, food, drinks, ambiance, and service are top notch. It's like "living in the lap of luxury". I will definitely return!!!

reviews.author: Tony M
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!!
reviews.text:
We have been to many Resorts throughout Mexico and the Carribean. The Paradisius was by far the BEST one. Our butler Dionel Mendez was GREAT!!! We had fresh fruit daily & he was very attentive to our needs throughout the day. The bubble bath was quite the unexpected SURPRISE! (Thanks Dionel) We had an unbelievable experience at the Spa, a deep tissue massage, topped off with the water therapy. We would definitley recommend the Passion experience. The Wine pairings with the different courses were EXCELLENT!! At the Pallazo the food and service is very good also. (You can even get a language lesson!)  We had a GREAT
time and already trying to figure out when we can come back. The Paradisius has definitley taken the resort experience to another level.
Thank You Tony & Lori McAdam  MICHIGAN

reviews.author: my785
reviews.title: royal service
reviews.text: just got back after a week at Royal Service and it was great. It was my third time at Paradisus but 1st time at RS. totally worth it. the beds on the beach are great! we stayed out on the beach for hours. Pedro and billy on the beach were great with having our beds ready for us every morning. Our butler Tony was the best! So friendly and helpful. Went out of his way to make sure we were happy. Cesar L. from room service was so nice too! I was just surprised about the reception at RS. the girl that checked us  was a bit rude and acted like we were bothering them when we would visit to ask for something... besides that it was a great trip! they had opened a new bar while we were there in the terrace which is good addition and perfect for a few drinks after dinner. Try Aqua at the Reserve! sooo good :)

reviews.author: karen j
reviews.title: best ever
reviews.text: This was one of the best places I have every stayed. The food and service was great. The resort was wonderful. One of the staff members really stood out. His name is Paulino Hidalgo. He was friendly and went out of his way to make us happy. I would love to go back next year, hope Paulino is still working there!

reviews.author: A_Riz1166
reviews.title: FUEGGGOOO
reviews.text: From the moment we stepped foot onto the resort the service was great. Everyone was extremely friendly. The staff made sure they were taking great care of you. The pool bar was great, especially the bartenders named Luis and Ramon who made every day fun with their FUEGO chug. Fabio who worked at the activities hut was also a great staff member who helped us out often. I would recommend this trip to anyone.

reviews.author: eearhardt
reviews.title: Great Girls Trip
reviews.text: A bunch a girls went down to celebrate the big 40. We had a wonderful time and the resort was beautiful.  We were so blessed to have two wonderful butlers Jeuri Ferreira and Super Billy. Thanks again for such a wonderful trip and getaway. A trip we will never forget.

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from a week and loved this resort!  As with any new resort we are always a little worried about the cleanliness and service we will receive.  We have traveled to many different resorts and to other islands and so have our friends that traveled with us. This being our first trip to Punta Cana, we didn't know quite what to expect.   We were with 3 other couples and had a wonderful relaxing week!  We booked the Royal Service package and made the right choice!  The Royal Service provides you with an adult only area (this was great!), a reserved section of the beach for Royal Service Guests, a pool, lounge and restaurant for Royal Service Guests only.  If you can upgrade to this service, be sure and do so!  Royal Service is only for guests 18 and older.
Let me start by saying our butler, Nicholas, was excellent!  He worked so hard to make sure we had everything we needed at all times.  It was my birthday while we were there and he and three other butlers  brought a birthday cake to the beach along with bottles of champagne for us to celebrate, while singing Happy Birthday!  What a perfect birthday!!!!!!  Our son and his fiance flew in later in the week and Nicolas made sure that he was there to greet them when they arrived and to bring them to us on the beach.  One night we came to our room late in the evening to find he had prepared a romantic jacuzzi rose petal bath with a bottle of wine for us. He also did this for the 3 other couples.  He made our dinner reservations for us and we were given a cell phone that allowed us to call him directly. He would also call us to see if we neded anything.  Nicolas worked very hard to make sure he had a great time!  Antonio, another butler we met, would also ask if we needed anything and was there to help us if we needed anything at all, even though he wasn't assigned to us.  That was very impressive!  We couldn't have had better butler service!!!!  Thank you Nicholas!
The beach is beautiful!!!!  No coral or rocks at all!  White sand and beautiful water!  On the beach Martin and Francisco worked sooo hard each day to make sure we also had water, drinks etc.  When we arrived at the beach they would have our chairs and huts ready for us!  They worked so hard in the hot sun they 7 days we were there!  
At the adult pool, Wilkin, the bartender, was so nice.  He was always happy to make us any drink we requested!  All of these people work so hard to make sure you have everything you need at all times!
I had originally booked the Reserve section of this resort, but Martina Gabriel was so kind to help me with an upgrade to the Royal Service.  Martina corresponded with me several times through email.  Thank you Martina!  The Reserve section, I found out, is more for families especially those with small children.  If you have small children, be sure and request the reserve section of this resort.
The resort lobby is beautiful!  They have nightly entertainment with bands.  There is a small casino on the premises and the Red Lounge.  
All in all I would definately recommend this resort in Punta Cana.  The food was good, the beach is beautiful!  Nicholas, our butler, made it very easy to relax!
We will return to this amazing resort!

reviews.author: selma b
reviews.title: Conforto!
reviews.text: O hotel é maravilhoso! Tem vários restaurantes muito bons. Adoramos nossa Concierge chamada Sue, muito atenciosa, que fez várias reservas para os melhores restaurantes. Gostamos muito da comodidade de ter transfer grátis do hotel para o shopping. A única coisa que poderia ter sido melhor, foi o bar da piscina, que tinha somente 1 funcionário para atender as pessoas de dentro e de fora da piscina.

reviews.author: Acire1018
reviews.title: "Jose Salavador truly provided Royal Service!"
reviews.text: A wedding brought my friend and I to the Paradisus Palma Real but the service provided by various staff members will bring me back! This was my second trip to Punta Cana - I stayed a similar resort with upgraded services in the past (Majestic Elegance) but the Paradisus Palma Real by far surpassed the comparable resort. As a ROYAL Service member - JOSE Salavador was assigned to assist us. JOSE S.  was attentive, timely and often anticipated our needs. On his late day  his co-worker ELVIS provided assistance with extending our stay. ( YES we enjoyed ourselves that much!) All the staff we met were nice but most importantly professional. I have to mention - bartenders - Clari ( I wish I had a Coco Loco right now) , Maritiza and David Perez at the LOBBY BAR and of course my favorite beach bartender Wilkin M.  The girls at the  YHI spa Maria C. and Alexandra -love them! The waiters at Palazzo - Hector and Alexander -along with Victor at Vento, the service was on point and the food was great. We did dine at Passions winner of 7 Michelin stars - had the tasting menu with the wine paring. I must admit I enjoyed the presentation more than the food. I preferred the Palazzo for dinner.  The only negative thing I can say is that for some reason the house keepers did not provide us with face towels... however one call the JOSE and that small problem was resolved. (fyi -the rooms were cleaned properly.)   The vouchers/credits come with too many stipulations. I have stayed at other resorts with less limitations on how to use the credits. I will return to  this resort again and upgrade to the royal service, thanks to the exceptional service that the staff provided at this amazingly beautiful resort.  (Oh! I almost forgot Carlos C -of the event staff at the wedding on 07/20/2013 - also  kept the party going.) Again, I had an overall great time.  Erica R.

reviews.author: cokosmomma
reviews.title: Wow, and the not-so-Wow
reviews.text:
Just back from a Girlfriends' Getaway (4 ladies) and we had a wonderful time in Punta Cana.  Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort, and although there were a few issues, it was not enough to spoil 5 days in paradise. Prieto Tours provided our transfers from the airport and upon arrival we were told to check-in at the "My Time" desk which is separate from the lobby desk. Check-in took a little longer than one would expect, especially when there aren't any issues or special requests. But at least you're offered a welcome rum drink while everything is sorted. 

We reserved a suite with an adjoining guest room (garden view) and it was cozy yet spacious at the same time.  Our suites were located in the main building so no need to take a golf cart to get around.  There was a full kitchen with a washer/dryer, and the refrigerator is stocked with bottled water, soft drinks and Presidenté beer.  Since we arrived so late our first dinner was at the buffet in Naos which featured grilled lobster tails cooked-to-order. We also dined at Bana (the bistro & the teppanyaki), Market Grill and Gabi Beach. Overall the food at each restaurant was fantastic (especially Bana), and the waiters and service was great.  We also ordered pizza thru room service...tasty. 

Our “My Time” representative made reservations for our massages at the Yhi Spa (the one located away from the main building) and we took full advantage of their hydrotherapy facilities following our treatment. I won’t spoil the surprise but be sure to build in some extra time to go thru the ritual.

Now let me share the “not-so-wow”. The pools and hot tubs close at 7pm! That seems extremely early to me, especially during the summer months when you have longer daylight hours.  And if you arrive at the beach or pool in the afternoon, good luck obtaining clean beach towels. All the staff could say is “sorry we’re out”. I still don’t understand how a 4-5 star resort can run out of towels, even if each guest is hoarding 6 towels at a time. The resort wasn't at full capacity, and ideally the laundry department should be turning towels over all day like typical hotels, resorts and cruise ships.

We arranged our trip thru a travel agency and we were told by the Paradisus staff that our agency relayed a few promises that the hotel was unaware of and unwilling to honor.  However, now that I'm home and looking at the hotel's website it SAYS THE EXACT SAME THING as what was given to us by the agency. If the fine print was provided we could have managed our expectations. 

So please note for the “GIFT of up to $1500 per stay”, the $100-$150 to use in the casino is match play, the $200-$300 for food & beverage is actually only redeemable to dine on the beach at the Gabi Beach restaurant (not for Passions, not for premium liquor/champagne in the bars). Luckily we managed to take advantage of the Spa voucher; otherwise the vouchers/coupons were worthless for us.

Back to the positives, we arranged an all-day safari excursion and it was wonderful, despite the rain and extremely bumpy roads driving thru the mountains. The trip featured horseback riding, a visit to a cigar “factory”, and other sightseeing. Several tour operators are onsite so no problem to shop around and book activities once you arrive in PC. 

My score is closer to 3½ stars, but because the backdrop is so beautiful and the majority of staff is so accommodating, a 4 is fitting.

reviews.author: Que W
reviews.title: 40th Birthday all girls trip!!!
reviews.text:
From the airport to the resort, everything was wonderful. Staff was most accommodating. Upon arrival we received a complimentary upgrade to The Reserve..Awesome is all I can say..Resort is gorgeous, food was excellent, staff was very accommodating ,bartenders took pride in their jobs!! Not one single solitary complaint!! Best resort by far!!! Will return next year with family in tow!! Check in was a breeze, enough towels..treatment was far superb.. Thanks for a great 40th birthday celebration!!!! See you next year!!! Sincerely,

"Las chicas from Jamaica"!!!!

reviews.author: Emily R
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: This was my first time going to Punta Cana so I did not have much expectations, however this resort was absolutely beautiful! I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Palma Real, but like any vacation there are pros and cons. I'd have to say my biggest pet peeve was trying to find someone who understood English and could get your order correct. Other than that everything was fantastic! Luis Martinez at the Lobby Bar was by far my favorite person, he was always happy and enjoyed his job and his drinks were fabulous. I couldn't have asked for a better bartender.

reviews.author: Monica A
reviews.title: Reyna Rivera /Jorje Luis V/ Juana/Yeisy Geruam Mejia
reviews.text: Had the best experience with the service provided by a great team of people. It was the first time going to Punta Cana and honestly I could say that it won't be my last. The food, the service , the employees are great!!! They make sure they accomadate all your needs and are very respectful!!! Our house keeper Yeisy also provided a great service to my family. I wish I could remember everyones name because I really am so happy with my experience!!!! reviews.author: lucia s
reviews.title: vacaciones maravillosas!!!
reviews.text:
Desde el comienzo fuimos recibidos con muchas amabilidad por parte de todo el personal. 
La habitación era preciosa y contaba con una gran vista al mar. En cuanto a los servicios de alimentación, todo es de la mejor calidad y los restaurantes a parte de deliciosos son de una decoración increíble, cada uno con una temática diferente y diversas comidas dentro de su especialidad.
Nosotras nos encontrábamos en servicio real en donde la playa es exclusiva y la piscina también por lo tanto la tranquilidad era exquisita. sin embargo si queríamos diversión podíamos ir sin problemas a las demás dependencias del hotel, las cuales eran entretenidas.
en especial darle las gracias a quienes estuvieron a cargo de nosotros : Carlitos, Agustín, Daniel y Pedro.
Por último decir que volvería una y mil veces más.

reviews.author: dgonzalez623
reviews.title: Not What We Expected... Read if you're considering for a wedding!
reviews.text:
I will begin by giving some background information about our trip and then I will go into the positives and negatives that we experienced during our stay at PPR. My husband and I arrived at the hotel on Thursday, June 20, 2013 anxiously awaiting 60 family and friends that would be arriving within the next few days to attend our wedding. 

Positives

Check-in: This process was a breeze and the employees at the desk were very nice and welcoming. While they do speak English I did find it helpful for us to speak Spanish with them. Out of all of my guests there was only an issue with one reservation; they were given two beds when they requested a king. The hotel to care of this and upgrade them to a Royal Service room at no extra charge because it seemed to be the only room/area with king beds available. They also upgraded my husband and I to a one-bedroom suite at no extra charge since there was availability. 

Yhi Spa: The spa is wonderful and the ladies that did our hair and make-up were great. While they do work at a slower pace than we're accustomed to everyone looked beautiful! 

Negatives
Communication: The communication with the romance team is pretty much non-existent. As a bride, you have to be on top of them 24/7. They'll say that they'll call you right back and they don't. One coordinator in particular, Mariela, was extremely rude to me, my husband, and some of our guests. They seem to have so many weddings a day that they forget just how important this day is to each bride. It is evident that customer service is not high on their priority list. 

Service: While almost all of the employees are very kind and sweet the service is very slow and it didn't seem that the resort was at full capacity.

Food and Drinks: The food was mediocre... your average "all inclusive food". I would definitely recommend the Market Grill, Bana, and Aqua for dinner. However I must note that about 9 of my guests became ill at some point in the trip with fevers, stomach pains, vomiting, and diarrhea. One of them ended up at the hospital in Punta Cana and another went to the urgent care as soon as she arrived back in Miami. Drinks seemed to be a little watered down but you can drink all you want so it really doesn't matter. Ramon at the pool bar was wonderfully entertaining! The food at the wedding (buffet style) was delicious!!!!!

All in all, my guests spent a lot of money to be a part of our special day and I spent a good chunk of change on the wedding itself and I don't feel like you get what you pay for. For us, the positives did not outweigh the negatives. The hotel itself is gorgeous but I don't think that the price you pay matches the services your get.

reviews.author: Brittany B
reviews.title: Jose L. De Los Santos – Best asset to The Reserve
reviews.text:
I was at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana from July 3rd-July 7th for a destination wedding and I was excited because I had heard from the bride & groom that this was a 5 star resort; sorry to say it was not.  The St. Regis is a 5 star, The Waldorf Astoria is a 5 star, so if you are used to staying at a 5 star and this is what you are expecting you are setting yourself up for disappointment.   
The Rooms: Our room was in building 36 room 3361 (1 king size bed overlooking the pool) there were several stains on the sofa, the room looked very dated and used; it definitely could use an upgrade.  I heard The Reserve was new, however there is no way given the condition of the buildings.  The first night Wednesday, July 3rd I was walking back up to my room when I got to the 3rd floor landing I could not see that the roof was leaking from the rain and fell down on the tile floor I landed on my right hip (which I thought I broke; it hurt so bad) when I called downstairs they did nothing!!  It is amazing how quickly English language skills go out the window when there is an issue at this place.  My Mom had to put towels down on the ground; no one even came to clean up the water!  When I spoke to our concierge Fernando (who was amazing) he did apologize and said he would notify someone of the leak.  
The Food: On Thursday evening we ate at the Italian restaurant (Aqua) which was good, but we wanted pasta which there was none of, we had the steak which had a high sodium content that I swelled up immediately after eating.   We ate at the Mexican restaurant (Mole) on Saturday evening, the food here was amazing!  Great margaritas, amazing chicken enchiladas!!  The wedding was Friday so we only got to eat at 2 of the restaurants.  Breakfast at the Gabi Club was always awesome!!  I am already missing the homemade omelet with salsa verde!!! 
The Beach: Also, if you are a beach goer like me The Reserve makes it VERY difficult to get to the beach!!  They do have a tram car but it is very infrequent!  It is about a 15-20 minute walk to the beach from the reserve.  I am the type of person who likes to have a 30 second walk to the beach.  It would be nice to have a separate walking path direct to The Reserve private beach with a tram that just goes back and forth from the beach to The Reserve.  However, The Reserve beach is amazing!!!!  The best thing about The Reserve is Jose L De Los Santos & Ramon Ramirez.  “It’s drinky, drinky time!!!  Who wants alcohol?!”  Music to my ears and made each day the greatest day!!  He made me some of the best tropical drinks I have ever had!!!  This resort does have some great drinks!  Made with fresh fruit (not like others I have been to where they only use mixes) this place set the bar very high for drinks as far as I’m concerned!!  Jose & Ramon are the GREATEST workers at The Reserve and the GREATEST asset!!!  Also, make sure you tip your bartenders and waiters well!!  They work very hard!!!  Remember you have so much more and be generous!!  A few dollars go a long way!!!!
I more than likely would not come back, I have been to the Dominican Republic 3 times now and I want to try new destinations!  If I would go back I would stay at the regular part of the Paradisus and get the Royal Service!

reviews.author: nhaughee
reviews.title: Rest, Relaxation, and Royal Service!
reviews.text: We were fortunate to spend a week at the Paradisus Palma Real in late June.  It was a wonderful experience, with great surroundings and very attentive service.  ~   It's truly a place where time slows down.  I can still recall the serenity of lounging in our little beach hut.  Very special thanks to Pedro Cedano for his superior service and friendliness!  He is a treasure!   ~   The Royal Service allowed a great experience at Palazzo, where we started every day feasting and practicing the local language with Smerlyn Olea, Richard Ortiz, and Alexander Guzman who took such great care of us!  Muchas Gracias, Chicos!   ~  For us, Royal Service was the way to go... our butler, Juan de Leon was always looking out for us and making sure we had a truly royal experience!

reviews.author: MrSnook82
reviews.title: Awesome stay at an amzing resort!
reviews.text: Visited the Paradisus Palma Real in mid May with a few friends and had maybe my best vacation experience ever. On arrival we were greeted with a cold drink and an amazing view of the beach from the lobby. After checking in we were introduced to our concierge who immediately assisted us with locating our room and making dinner reservations. We stayed in a garden room which was nice and spacious.As expected the beach was beautiful, but what was surprising was that the pools were just as impressive.The food was was excellent for an all inclusive, plenty of choices and always more than enough to go around. Keeping busy was never a problem as there were so many activities to choose from. Salsa dancing, scuba lessons, and even a Micheal Jackson stage show. This place had it all! I can honestly say I feel it was money well spent on an memorable vacation. I will definitely stay here in the future.

reviews.author: glegler777
reviews.title: KEEPS GETTING BETTER
reviews.text:
Our recent stay at Palma Real, one of many, was better than ever.  There are so many new additions to the resort. We really enjoyed the new Lobby Bar and Lounge and the coffee and sandwich cafe. The beach party/fire show was lots of fun. The added shows i.e. magician and the entertainment at the Lobby Bar was enjoyable. There is so many daily activities for all ages including water sports and nightly shows. The food is excellent and the service impeccable. The staff goes out of their way to please you.  I like the new entranceway to the Market Grill and the Buffet restaurant Naos, it adds a nice touch. The variety of cuisine and quality of the food is amazing. We really enjoyed the Palazzo Restaurant. We had great service from Alexander Guzman Fria and Felipe Mayi.  The bartender at the Casino Bar, Antonio Castillo, made us great drinks.  He is attentive, friendly and serves you with a welcoming smile. 
Freddie the bartender at the vacation club pool is so gracious when making you his many speciality drinks.  Francisco Estrella is always there to make sure you have your palapa on the beach or pool. He is always watching out for you.  This resort has everything from a beautiful golf course to a Mall with many shops, disco, movie theater, etc.. The YHI spa is a relaxing oasis which offers many speciality treatments. We would like to thank the entire staff  and management for making our vacation memorable.

reviews.author: Sonja Z
reviews.title: When Can I Come Back?
reviews.text:
So, I haven't taken a vacation in three years and let's just say THANK GOD I found this place. I've always wanted to go to the Dominican Republic, and I'm so happy I made this choice. I booked the vacation on cheapcaribbean.com which was quick and easy. I was also able to book a shuttle from the airport with Olympus tours. 

Royal Service:

The minute I set foot in this place I was blown away. The beaches were expansive and beautiful, and the hotel was clean and inviting. My friend and I upgraded to the Royal Service package which was well worth it! For anyone who wants extra pampering, luxury, and a great experience I would get the royal service because you get your very own butler who is able to accomodate your every need. 

Our butler, Juan de Leon, was fantastic! He was always around if we needed him and also checked in with us every day to make sure we were having a good time. He was nice, charamistic and the best butler around. My friend and I felt so comfortable with him and were extremely impressed with his professionalism and dedication in ensuring that we had the time of our lives. For example, we signed up for an excursion and I realized that I had forgotten batteries for my camera. Juan found me batteries right away! It made me feel really good to know that someone was always there to help and get us what we needed. To make matters even better, he was always available on his cell phone, even when it was off hours. 

Activities:
Another great aspect about this hotel is that the service and activities are incredible! The activities (ie dance classes, painting, and candle making) were really fun and broke the monotony of beaching it up all day. The activities team is outstanding. Yeri Beltre, Rodolfo Castillo and Angel Alcantara made us feel like family. 

Rodolfo was in charge of the club house and always helped my friend and I feel welcome. He made sure that we always knew when and where the workshops were held and engaged us in great conversations. 

Angel Alcanatara was definitely a stand out at the resort. We loved his sense of humor and fun loving spirit. He remembers the guests names and wants to make sure that we are creating positive experiences and memories every day. If you see him walking around the hotel, make sure he shows you his dance moves! The man can definitely cut a rug! He'll be more than happy to teach you all kinds of popular Dominican dances. 

Restaurants:

The food options were great at the resort and luckily we had Juan de Leon to make all of our reservations. You can find whatever you like--sushi, italian or mediterreanean--but the best part is interacting with the servers. 

Oscar Polanco proved to be the best restaurant supervisor around. My friend had a broken foot whIle on the trip and had to ride a scooter the majority of the time. Oscar always made sure that we were seated at a convenient table close to the buffet and that he was there to help carry her plate for her. He was so sweet and accommodating and I very my appreciated his work ethic. 

Keep an eye out for Baron Justo, Jose Ramos, and Mauricio (at the Palazzo) they were great servers and super friendly. 

I honestly feel like I've not only gained some much needed rest and relaxation but that I've built great relarionships that made it really hard to say adios on our last day. 

The people and experience at Paradisus Palma Real made me realize that the Dominican Republic is a wonderful place to enjoy life and beauty. The staff alone would make me come back to visit the hotel again and again. 

I hope to book my next trip there very soon.

reviews.author: Bklynvalb
reviews.title: Girl Friends Get Away
reviews.text: Every year we plan a trip just the girls... This year was the Dominican Republic. The Paradisus came highly recommended. It has been a long cold spring and I needed Sun. The resort is beautiful, clean, the staff are the best. I would like to thank entire staff and special thank you to Francisco Estrella. See ya next year.

reviews.author: Karla W
reviews.title: Best Vacation ever!
reviews.text:
Our vacation at Paradisus Palma Real was something I will always remember.   We had the royal service and our very own butler, Tony.  Tony made this vacation even more amazing.  Catered to any of our needs, recommendations for excursions, scheduling our spa packages and visiting us frequently to see if there was anything needed.  He went above and beyond to take special care of our group.  Definately ask for Tony!
This resort was amazing, beautiful, clean and lots of fun.  Everyone was very gracious, helpful, pleasant and professional.  The food was extraordinary and Jesus, our waiter took care of our needs in NAOS.  He greeted us with a huge smile on his face every morning.  
I would definately recommend Paradisus Palma Real to all my family and friends and look forward to returning one day.  Thanks for making our office vacation so wonderful!

reviews.author: Tracie T
reviews.title: GREAT RESORT AND BEST BUTLER
reviews.text: This was my first time to this resort and It was AMAZING! Everything was so nice, clean, just perfect!! We had our own personal butler Tony who was "off the chain".  His personality was genuine! Poor thing will never be the same after our group of girls lol.  If you every visit this resort please ask specifically for Tony.  HE IS THE BEST!!!

reviews.author: Nina L
reviews.title: PPR and Francisco Know Customer Service
reviews.text:
5 girlfriends and I just returned from a getaway to Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana.  It was wonderful!  We didn't wanna come home!  From check-in to checkout things went smoothly I would say 98%. I would say the only hiccups were the inconsistent wi-fi connectivity (but who cares about that on vacation) and the confusion at the concierge desk when we tried to redeem some of the hotel credits that were part of our pkg ie. Premium wine discounts and visits to the spa. 

We cannot wait to return to the lush scenery,  beautiful breaches,  huge swimming pools and great freshly prepared seafood, fruits and juices at Naos. HOWEVER the biggest reason we can't wait to come back is because of 1 person: Francisco Estrella. He epitomizes great customer service.  We met Francisco on arrival at the beach and everyday after he greeted us at breakfast with a big smile letting us know that our lounge chairs, towels, drinks,  fruits and snacks were ready and waiting on the beach.  He met our every request and checked on us constantly everyday, throughout the day. As we checked out,  we even had the airport driver wait while we went down to the beach to say a special goodbye to Francisco.  The PPR property is gorgeous and I recommend to all Punta Cana visitors. But I especially suggest you seek out Francisco...... he will make your stay 10 times better!!!

Angelita

reviews.author: Robin5775
reviews.title: Amazing Senior Class Trip...Thank you Palma Real!
reviews.text: The beach..amazing, the pool...amazing, the breeze..amazing, the spa...amazing, the service staff...amazing, especially Jonathan our room service staff who welcomed us each morning with a big smile, hot coffee, fresh fruit and delicious pastries, also our pool experience would not have been the same without Gloria and Ramon and the spa facility and staff...all amazing.  Paradisus Palma Real Resort and Spa is truly a beach paradise!

reviews.author: Carlos B
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: i stayed at the resort from may28th to june 3rd 2013 for a friends wedding:loved the resort and everyone was super friendly and helpful especially (alexander lopez) oh yeaaa I was known as"drake" the famous rapper anytime he saw me lol. My only complaints would be wish there was more variety in food and feel the food was played to safe wishing it was more cultural and not so americanized but everything else was great. would come again for sure

reviews.author: Carolina L
reviews.title: Paradise...would definitely going back!!
reviews.text:
First time in Punta Cana and have to say it was more than expected.
First day was a little disappointed as we have to wait few hours to get our luggages therefore wasted the entire afternoon. I think it is just a pace to get use to when coming from NYC.
After few calls, we got our luggages and they arranged to offer us a complimentary diner at their top 4* restaurant "Passion" and it was a great experience.
Remaining our our stay was exceptional, we took an upgrade for an ocean front room with Royal service and it was extremely worthy.
Our butler Jose was there when we needed him and this is was you call service.
Pedro was great finding us right spot on the beach and welcoming us every day with extending smile. Got fresh fruits juices as wish on the beach.
My man was Wilkin, bartender at pool Royal service, after one day he knew our drinks by heart never wait more than 3 minutes and always with a smile. I end up to spend more time at the bar with him than with my fiancee.
They have many restaurants and have tested all of them with no disappointment.
Buffet is great with extensive choices...staff was great especially Richard who was extremely polite and attentive.
We have never heard a NO!!! 
Any staff we have met all over the property acknowledge us with a "buenos dias".
Been traveling all over the world and stayed in best hotels worldwide, our stay at Paradisius Palm Real was overall outstanding. Property is gorgeous, clean, beaches paradise and would definitely going back...no need to try different place...this one worth any pennies.

reviews.author: Bri Z
reviews.title: Amazing Hospitality
reviews.text: Palma Real was recommended by a few people and rightfully so.  It is an amazing resort for the cost, the service, food, premises, beach, etc.  My friend and I felt very at home and taken care of, anything we needed was within reach quickly by the help of guest services.  There is also an amazing gym at this resort and Juanluis Dickson, the trainer is wonderful.  He is so helpful and eager to push you to reach your fitness goals.  He is certified and educated and all forms of fitness, thanks to him I had some awesome work outs.  If you are into fitness, you should definitely pay him a visit, you won't be disappointed.  Overall, a wonderful experience at this hotel and I will definitely come back!

reviews.author: GoodTimeAtlanta
reviews.title: Luxury?
reviews.text: Spent Memorial Day weekend at this property with a group of friends. The resort seems ideally suited for couples. I don't think it is very conducive for children. The resort has a separate section called "Royal Service." This section offers butler service and two separate pools. The real benefit to the Royal Service is the VIP service lounge that offers excellent wi-fi, flat screen TV, I-Mac computers, all day snacks and beverages. Also this lounge is where you can manage all of the details of your stay with the helpful staff on duty. All this is very nice, but is it really worth the extra expense? I'm not so sure. Most of the resort is shared by all, including the restaurants and main pool. The property is quite nice with beautiful views and facilities. My hesitation with giving it a higher rating is the food. I have experienced better food at other resorts. Breakfast buffet is good, but lunch and dinner really under deliver. The specialty restaurants are an attempt at a real meal, but seem like a drawn out process for lackluster results. The process by which reservations are arranged for these meals can be cumbersome as well: line up at the service desk at specific times and then they call the restaurants. Royal Service guests can assign their butlers to do this for them. A cute gimmick is each Royal Service guest is assigned a cell phone to call the butler or other Royal Service guests. So all this sounds really great so far, but this place my be dressed up a 5 start fancy pants resort but in reality it is just another all inclusive. I found the bar service to be very slow and the quality of the drinks to be poor. For example everyone love pina coladas and such when near the beach, but the actual drink mixes used were poor quality and not enjoyable. I would also add that the Punta Cana airport is open air that seems like a fun novelty when you arrive, but when you return for departure the un-air conditioned waiting for your airplane can be quite unpleasant. I found it very gross to be all sweaty for my 3 hour flight home. Also the tap water in the rooms is un-potable and they even recommend brushing your teeth with bottled water.

reviews.author: Pat G
reviews.title: Luv Paradisus
reviews.text: We have been to Punta Cana 6 times and have stayed at 3 other resorts.  Since our first visit 4 years ago we have not considered staying anywhere else.  The beach service is far better here than anywhere else we have stayed.  Maiker Ramirez, the beach attendant, is the reason we keep coming back to the Paradisus.  His attentive service and personality makes every person on the beach feel special and catered too.  We already have our reservations to return this year Friday after Thanksgiving .  As I write this review we have 184 days and counting till our next stay.  All the staff are helpful, the resort is beautiful and the food is good.  We love the Paradisus.

reviews.author: JMartin25
reviews.title: Office Staff Vacation
reviews.text: Many months of planning went into this destination vacation for my husband's office staff and we could not have been more pleased!!! The beauty of the resort, wonderful rooms(I wanted to take my bed home with me) and excellent service was just the beginning of a fantastic vacation.  Royal Service was awesome and especially our butler,Tony.  One of the highlites of our trip was a private dinner we had planned at the resort and it was a perfect evening.(except due to windy conditions could not have it on the beach) The lobster was delicious, table decor lovely and attentiveness to every detail incredible. The only reccomendation I would make would be about the explanation about voucher system. We were not able to use our vouchers to the fullest due to some confusions when explained.  I will recommend this resort to my friends at home and Thank You for a vacation filled with lifetime memories.......

reviews.author: TonyaLetrice
reviews.title: Punta Cana at it's best!
reviews.text:
I was recently at the Paradisus Palma Real for a large wedding. The property was absolutely beautiful and our accomdations were luxurious! What I will say is that when we booked our trip, we elected for Royal Service, which seemed to make all of the difference. The royal service employees exceeded expectations. Our friends who didn't elect Royal Service definitely didn't have the same experience. The customer service and attentiveness was significantly different in Royal Service. The upgrade was money well spent.

I would like to individually take time to thank members of the Paradisus staff  and recommend the staff, because who without their high level of customer service our experience may have been quite different:

Carmen Paulino- our Royal Service butler. 
Carmen took care of us the minute that we arrived. She went above and beyond anything that I could have asked for. She made sure I was comfortalbe and had everything I needed.  She made sure I didn't forget to order my scented pillow, and know where I was to be for dinner. My friends were making dinner reservation and including me and she would know before me most of the time and kept me aware.  The biggest help for me was keeping me on task and prepared.  She made sure I knew what I was wearing for all the events I was to attend and that they were steamed and ready to go. This made sure I never felt rushed or late, which is a true vacation. She also worked with other butlers (Specifically Agustine) to make sure when he saw us to make sure we were happy and taken care of.  They all worked as a team.  She became part of the trip and felt like a friend. She was FANTASTIC!!!!!
The other butler worth mention is Augustine. Augustine was assigned to my friends but not me but he felt like he was my second butler.  If I didn't see Carmen I saw Augustine.  We receive phones to contact them but there was no need for me to use it.  They both made you feel like I was special, even though they had many other guest to care for. They never dropped the ball....Fabulous. We loved them.  
Wilkin- bartender at Royal Service pool he took care of us with a smile and the drinks were delicious!!!
Amazing vacation...hope to return some time soon!

reviews.author: TravlinLady34
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Just got back from a 5 night trip to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. Beautiful resort to relax on the beach, float in the pool and be pampered by the staff. The restaurants were fantastic, my favorite being Mole because of our charming and attentive server Jose-Mateo. Ask for Jose, he is the best and he lights up a room with his smile! Also make time to enjoy the Yhi spa, best Abhyanga massage I have ever had and the water therapy treatment is really fun and leaves you feeling refreshed. If you can upgrade to Royal Service...totally worth it. Our butler, Juan de Leon was really attentive and helped us make all our dinner, spa and excursion reservations and even brought us towels & drinks when he saw we needed them. Really easy to communicate when you have a cell phone that is a direct connection to him. I will be back, I thoroughly enjoyed this vacation. Make sure to get the Caipirinha, they are delicious an refreshing!

reviews.author: ziggypiggypie
reviews.title: beautiful place, management concerns.
reviews.text: The hotel and grounds were wonderful, clean, beautiful plants and nice rooms. The food at the restaurants was uninspired and bland. The best food we found was in the buffet. It was fresh and seasoned well. Not what you would expect with the trouble booking dinners in the restaurants. They  were always booked full. So you had to decide were you wanted to eat days in advance.  But when you ate there they were half empty. Had a few problems with things talked to management they said they would take care of it. Then nothing but excuses. What was said and what was done was not even close. There were some great employs. One of our waiters Wilson Ofanez was one of the best I have had at any restaurant.

reviews.author: Marisa251
reviews.title: EXXCELENTE PRINCIPALMENTE LA ATENCION DE LOS MOZOS Y PERSONAS ENCARGADAS
reviews.text:
Excelente!!! La gente muy servicial y calidos en su trato.El Restaurant Paluzzo una maravilla. Kimberlay la atenta persona nos recibia, amable y gentil, nos solucionaba cualquier problema inmediatamente.Los mozos Richard Ortiz., Alexander Guzman, Juan Taveras, Genivel Mauricio, Americo Paulino,Pasquel Rodrigues  etc, todos son serviciales y atentos y ,muy profesionales. Tomabamos desayuno y almorzabamos alli, por el buen servicio y excelentes comidas que alli habia, pero principalmente por la gente que nos atendia.
En la playa pasaba lo mismo, Francisco super atento y preocupado que nos sintieramos a gusto. Los felicitamos por toda la capacitación que le dan a su personal que tiene siempre en su mente que el Servicio al cliente marca la diferencia con otros hoteles.
Damos las gracias a Belen y Laura que con su atenta bienvenida hicieron que nosotros y nuestros amigos  tuvieramos una estadia dificil de olvidar.
Gracias a aquellos que tambien nos atendieron cuyos nombres no alcanzamos a retener...Atte.
Maria Luisa Garcia y Eduardo Bustamante.

reviews.author: Indimadi
reviews.title: Séjour mitigé
reviews.text:
J'ai séjourné dans cet hôtel à l'occasion du mariage de mon amie là-bas. La "Wedding Coordinator", Massiel , a été absolument excellente! Elle s'est donnée corps et âme afin que mon amie puisse avoir le mariage de ses rêves! Et elle  a réussi car le résultat fut extraordinaire, cérémonie, barbecue la veille du mariage, le cocktail hour, et la réception du mariage!

Par contre le département de la réception fut une réelle catastrophe! Et ceci à tout point de vue! Faisant partie d'un groupe pour le mariage, certaines chambres n'étaient pas prête à 17h alors que le check in est à 15h. Aucune solution n'a été proposée à part de poiroter tranquillement dans le lobby jusqu'à ce qu'une chambre soit prête...
C'est vraiment dommage car le personnel avait l'air volontaire et serviable mais malheureusement ils semblaient tous manqués de réelle formation.

Un autre véritable problème, est que l'internet n'a pas marché durant le séjour. Encore une fois le problème a été rapporté à la réception et ils étaient tous au courant mais en 8 jours, apparemment le technicien n'a pas trouver la solution car nous n'avons pas eut internet à part dans les parties communes. Réel problème dans un hôtel 5 étoiles au XXI eme siècle.

Le Yhi spa est un endroit magique situé dans une autre partie du resort accessible par voiture de golf. Le personnel est adorable et tres professionnel! Un réel moment de détente et de plaisir!

reviews.author: Yvonne B
reviews.title: Missing Paradise...Paradisus Palma Real already!!
reviews.text: Firstly, I was so pleased with my experience and the staff at the resort.  Fransico Gil, Juan Castillo, Jesus Cordones, Junior, Wilson, Fabio and many other people that work at the resort made my trip memorable.  Thanks Fransico you were always one step ahead of us.  Things were always ready when we arrived. Juan thanks for always seeing us off to our daily adventures and the surprises of snacks we received when returning to our room.  Also I always loved the daily pep and smiles Jesus brought to our dining experience.  Naos and Bano were my favorite places to eat, the beach daily at 10 and the daily smiles from everyone we crossed paths with.  Great trip!!

reviews.author: LOSBAHIENSES
reviews.title: Paraíso!!!
reviews.text:
Fue nuestra tercera vez en dominicana. Bávaro divina. El hotel, muy distinguido. Su gente, staff entreteniemientos ( Sócrates, Yira, Alex, Rodolfo), los del bar de la piscina ( Fuego, Gloria, Paulino), los mozos ( Travieso, Oscar, Domingo del Naos, y Juan Carlos del Gaby beach, por nombrar a algunos), inmejorables. Vaya un saludo y agradecimiento a cada uno de ellos. Si Dios quiere VOLVEREMOS!!!!! ;)
Raúl, Cora, Nestor y Cecilia de ARGENTINA.

reviews.author: PaulaB333333
reviews.title: Beautiful resort- wonderful staff
reviews.text:
My friend and I had a wonderful time in Punta Cana at the Paradisus Palma Real. The entertainment was great and the staff was very attentive.  Our butler, Elvis Hidalgo,  was very helpful, he checked on us daily and made sure we had everything we needed. We would definately travel there again.  
The Gabi restaruant and the paluzzo were our favorite two restaruants.  The sushi was our least favorite.

reviews.author: Francisco H
reviews.title: Satisfacción pura, integral y excelente trato.
reviews.text:
Hola, soy Francisco Hernández, de Murcia, que pasó sus vacaciones del 2 al 8 de mayo en este complejo de lujo. Me alojé el Royal Service con unas instalaciones fenomenales, disfrutando de los servicios TI a lo largo de la semana.
Recibí una atención personalizada y excelente por parte de todo el personal. Hacer mención de su profesionalidad a mi mayordomo Jean-Pierre, con su aptitud atenta y servicial. 
Quiero también felicitar por su atención y agrado a Esther Cobos (SPA) y a uno de los camareros que nos atendió, Juan Martínez ( a servicio de Juan Aza) que nos sirvió un una atención superagradable, muy correcta y muy servicial. Describiría la atención de éste como excelente.
Muy agradecido por todo y deseando poder volver a visitaros, os mando un saludo cordial.
Francisco Hernández Gil.

reviews.author: MzVannaB
reviews.title: Awesome 7 Day Vacation
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Reale is an upscale resort for those with a more sophisticated taste.  I have been to other resorts in Punta Cana and this resort is one of the best from my experience. The staff here are excellent, genuine, extremely nice and helpful. I have stayed at both the Reserve (Nov 2012) and at the Main hotel (May 2013) and the staff are excellent at both locations.  My  best friend and I just came back from a 7 day vacation and did not upgrade my room and we had a great room with a great view.

I would recommend you look for the following people to make your vacation memorable you will not go wrong:

Concierge Desk:  Estrella Garcia and Edgar Gonzalez  - Informative and exceptionally helpful. If you have a question about anything please see them. Either one will help you with your needs and will ensure that you walk away satisfied.

Activities Director: Socrates Mercedes aka Cinco Peso - Full of energy, people person, and lots of fun.  Even if you just want to lounge around by the pool you will have a great time with Socrates because of his great sense of humor as his passes by.  The best night we had was at the Fire Dance, Socrates had everyone dancing and just having a great time.  It was really nice seeing everyone from different ages and backgrounds having fun.

YHI Spa: Julio (Water Room), Wendy and Juana (Massage Therapists) - Awesome!!

Bana Restaurant: Jhonathan Acosta - Provides that personal touch and brings your food when it is hot.

Nao Buffet Restaurant: Francisco, Francisco, Francisco - Ask to sit in his station only.  You will not be disappointed.  He goes the extra 9 yards for his guests.

Babi Bar: Juan Tiren and Luis Martinez - Makes the best drinks and Sangria from scratch

Personal Concierge at the Reserve: Dalliance Laguevre - Extremely Attentive and made us feel like true VIPs

This resort is great for couples, friends vacation, and families.  The Paradisus Palma Reale is an exceptional beautiful resort and you must ask to see the Pink and White Flamingos in the pond.  Located near the YHI exercise room.

reviews.author: Toya R
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise!
reviews.text:
I was recently at the Paradisus Palma Real for a large wedding.  The property was absolutely beautiful and our accomdations were luxurious!  What I will say is that when we booked our trip, we elected for Royal Service, which seemed to make all of the difference.  The royal service employees seem to have the end on how to get what you need...quickly.  Our friends who didn't elect Royal Service definitely didn't have the same experience.  However, let me be clear...this property was gorgeous, the employees where very helpful and generally speaking, we would gladly return.  

Augustin, our Butler, was the best!  Not only did he provide exemplary service for us, but our friends who couldn't always find their butlers. Similarly, we had great experiences in the Spas...the therapist of my choice was Quintina C.  She gives great massages and was able to accomodate some friends with last minute requests.   

Amazing vacation...hope to return some time soon!

reviews.author: Lori_D_Esq
reviews.title: Luxury in Paradise!
reviews.text: This resort is only 20 minutes from the airport. It is absolutely beautiful with marble floors and walls and gorgeous palm trees and tropical flowers throughout. I could not get over how clean this place was despite the fact that much of it is open air. We stayed in the basic rooms and did not opt for royal service and we still had a great time and felt like royalty. All of the employees are very friendly and take time to remember your name.  I read some negative reviews and found that none of them were true. The food was delicious and flavorful and we were served coffee and or alcoholic drinks as soon as we sat and the buffet.
