The pool is huge and plenty of space to swim and lounge in a built-in pool chair. The beach is gorgeous with plenty of chairs and huts if you prefer shade. The bartenders would walk on the beach and take orders when they had time. We went to 2 of the shows and I really liked that one night they had a fire-show and outdoor DJ dance party at Gabi beach. If you have the money, royal service is great but really it just means butler service to your room and access to an exclusive restaurant and a quiet area of the pool. It also includes food at Gabi Beach and I heard that food is really good, whereas regular guests only get drinks at Gabi beach and have to pay if they want to eat there. I checked out the reserve area and think that is best suited for families--if you are a couple or going with friends it is not necessary. As I expected, the resort was mostly couples but if you are single and looking to mingle you probably want to stay at a cheaper resort.  My only recommendation to the resort is to invest in plastic cups for the pool area that are better quality--like outdoor plastic glasses that can be washed and reused rather than the throw-aways.  Also, could do a little bit of a better job of raking away seaweed from the beach.  We definitely had a fantastic vacation and I would highly recommend this resort and will definitely go back someday.

reviews.author: Andrea R
reviews.title: Great location, great service!
reviews.text: What a great relaxing getaway to Palma Real! The best part was the service, especially room service. Pedro and Nicolas were exceptional and make a great team. They were extremely helpful and friendly! Such a picturesque property with awesome staff equals ahhhhhhmazing vacation!

reviews.author: divatrotter
reviews.title: Wedding Weekend extraordinaire
reviews.text:
I would be remiss if I did not write a review about the incredible wedding weekend that I and my 85 guests had at Paradisus Palma Real. Our wedding was on May 4th and it was more than I could have dreamed! All of my guests loved their stay and the high quality of service that the resort offered. Overall the resort is gorgeous and the restaurants were a delight. When trying to decide where to have the wedding I also considered Sanctuary at Cap Cana. This is also a beautiful resort but in the end I went with Paradisus because of the many entertainment offerings that are very high end- not chintzy. IN addition, the Royal Service option is top grade and was ESSENTIAL for a bride. My guests were able to take advantage of the great restaurants, clubs and proximity to town which is a quick jaunt in a taxi. IT should not go without mention that the beach at Paradisus is splendid. Soft sand and turquoise waters. For our honeymoon we stayed in Uvero Alto and the sand is not as plush and waters much more tempermental. Now I would like to individually take time to thank members of the Paradisus staff who without their high level of customer service our experience may gave been quite different:
Carmen Paulino- our Royal Service butler. 
Carmen took care of us the minute that we arrived. We went above and beyond anything that I could have asked for. She helped me and my 3 bridesmaids get dressed for the wedding, unpacked our bags- twice! Prepared romantic and luxurious baths. Helped us in an emergency when I left the bouquets in the room minutes before the ceremony. And made sure the butlers of our other guests were aware that we were in the wedding party and thus gave us extra special treatment. She became like a daughter to us. She was FANTASTIC!!!!!
The other butlers worth mention are Elvis, Augustin and Tony. Fabulous. We love them. Also, Tony took special care of my 87 year old mother and I thank him for that. Gave her a book on DR history- she loves him. 
Wilkin- bartender at Royal Service pool he took care of us with a smile and the drinks were delicious!!!
Byron Rodriguez- front door greeter- bellman at Palma Real he knew all of my guests by name. Made sure that all of our bags were delivered timely to our room. And became the go to for my husband - Eric Moore for all happenings in Bavaro. Byron's customer service is what sets Paradisus apart from other resorts. He was exemplary!!!!
The Romance Dept- sometimes it is hard to translate the wishes of an American Bride to DR standards but the team of Massiel, Rosa and Mariela was outstanding. After working with our numerous demands they must surely have the best wedding services in Punta Cana. 

Overall it is a wonderful resort and corporate should be very proud of the well trained and mannered staff. Thank you for making our wedding weekend an event to remember!!!!
Courtney

reviews.author: Amanda C
reviews.title: Unforgettable! Would definitely return!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I stayed at The Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana from April 15-23 and it was by far one of the best all-inclusive experiences yet. There were many things that made this an unforgettable trip. The staff were exceptional, the grounds were lush, beautiful and very well maintained. Our concierge at The Reserve, Fernando Mengó & Asia Mateo took great care helping us with dinner reservations, room needs etc. There are so many people to thank that truly made our trip memorable (Louis Santana, Ramon ?...sorry can't recall the rest). We had some minor issues with our room when we first arrived however, Guest Services Manager, Juan Nathanael Perez was there to help us right away. The food was great…would of liked more selection at the buffet but overall I was pleased. Our favorite restaurant was the Palazzo (we visited twice) and Mole (Mexican). The ambience at The Reserve was beautiful, relaxing and quiet. The beach was gorgeous and we enjoyed going for walks to the El Cortiso (shops along the beach). We never had issues finding beds or chairs at the pool or the beach and even though the resort was huge we enjoyed buzzing around on the carts. The only downfall with this resort was the spa. Both my friend and I booked massages and were disappointed. I originally booked a Shiatsu and the attendant put me on a floor mat and proceeded to do Thai Yoga Massage. Very strange. I ended up getting a regular massage instead which was robotic and overpriced. The spa itself was beautiful and the attendants were courteous but the service was sub par. Overall it was a luxurious, relaxing and enjoyable time and we both would definitely go back! If you decide to do an excursion I highly recommend horse back riding. It was certainly a highlight for us and well worth the price.

reviews.author: sergio V
reviews.title: naturaleza, confort, placer
reviews.text:
Para disfrutar sin aburrirse. 
Hotel donde la belleza de la naturaleza se combina con una arquitectura edilicia y paisajistica, el confort de las habitaciones y la calidez del personal al servicio del visitante se juntan para que tengas la mejor estadìa.
Todo el personal es especial pero no olvidaras a Sandra Cediño, quien brinda la alegrìa y cordialidad con su eterna sonrisa.

reviews.author: Pamela Z
reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text:
Just got back from the Paradisus Palma Royal and can't stop talking about it. My daughter booked her wedding there next year. The service was very good by all the staff.
You have to go to the pool bar and meet RAMON FUEGO. He was the best bartender there. his personality is tremendous and he makes the best tropical drinks.............get his WAAAAAA drink.

reviews.author: Bob M
reviews.title: Beautiful place, but the food was mediocre
reviews.text: The Paradisus locations are definitely some of the nicest properties in the Caribbean. The Palma Real in Punta Cana was no exception.  The hotel and its staff were excellent. Very well kept property, beautiful pools, and free shuttle for shopping.  My only issue was the food.  This is an All Inclusive resort with several restaurants.  Breakfast and lunches were quite good, with a large selection of foods.  Dinner, however, was a bit disappointing for such a well run resort.  Decent selection, but the overall quality was not what I expected.

reviews.author: Stephanie M
reviews.title: The Best Resort Ever!
reviews.text: I recently visited for a bachelorette weekend trip and we had a blast! I stayed in the DR last year at La Romana and it paled in comparison to the Paradisus! Resort is clean, customer service is impeccable, and the food was great! Our butler Johnfi Rivera was also excellent and catered to our every request! Can't wait to come back and I will definitely be staying at Palma Real!

reviews.author: Nikki J
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: I just returned less than 24 hours ago and I'm ready to go back.  This was my 4th trip to Punta Cana and my first stay at this hotel.  Accommodations were excellent and customer service was superb.  When we arrived, we were greated by Bayron.  He gave our initial tour and escorted us to the Royal Service Area.  Johnfi Rivera, our butler, took care of us and the rest is history. Johnfi is the best and catered to our needs whether it was room service, beachside or poolside.  We were given cell phones for 24 hour complete access to him.  The rooms were spacious and very clean and comfortable.  Nightly entertainment included live music and dancing.  There was an amazing fire show and the Michael Jackson Experience was a definite highlight.  During the day, we met Sebastian for bachata lessions.  He is a great teacher and he kept us entertained on the dancefloor.  Great variety of food, beautiful pools and a peaceful beach.  Royal Service is definitely the way to go.

reviews.author: trvlseeker
reviews.title: Amazing!!!  "MyTime" at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real 4/28 - 5/3/13.  Make sure you have your travel agent  book your stay through GOGO Vacations, as such you will get exclusive VIP "MyTime" features which entitle you to special amenities like free use of Water Ritual facilities at the YHI Spa, spa credits, discounts at the gift shop, exclusive check in and check out area, and guaranteed reservations in their remarkable a la carte restaurants.  The amenities do vary depending on your length of stay, but we were truly treated like royalty.  We had no problem getting reservations at Gabi Beach, I had yummy lobster for entree, lobster cappuccino fennel soup and more, the second night we ate at Vento a Mediterranean Fusion delight for lamb musaka and then Misu Japanese restaurant for a sampling of several  wonderful Japanese dishes.  Be sure to visit the water sports shack next to Gabi Beach for included water sports.  Call ahead to reserve a catamaran with our favorite  Juan Carlos, scuba including resort scuba course, and a one hour snorkel trip out to the reef for remarkable snorkeling!! The Le Cirque show on Wednesday nights is INCREDIBLE! and the Retro 80's night on Monday and Dominican Show on Tuesday.  The dancers are phenomenal and after the show they invite you up to dance to  the likes of Donna Summers and the Bee Gees or try your hand at meringue and salsa to their Latin Beats.  We left our hubby's home so the talented male dancers lead us through the dances and boy did we enjoy ourselves.  Have a bartender make you a dirty monkey and sit under your beach Bali Bed.  Our vacation would not have been complete without the delightful and compassionate staff who were the highlights of our stay.  Ruis Alfredo Rivera a waiter at the Naos Restaurant delighted us with his smile and attentive service, Our cute Ms. Leidy at the YHI spa cajoled us into plunging into the 59 degree water bath followed by the warm hot tubs to revitalize our circulation.  How could we resist her sunny smile and mild manor as she rewarded us with a cup of healthy, warm, green tea. Fres Martes enhanced our room service with his prompt and courteous manor.  There are too many others to mention by name, but I found each and every staff member eager to help.  I tried out my Spanish on many and their faces lighted up as they assisted me in speaking their language correctly.  Oh and we arranged a Prieto Tour (Julian at Prieto tour desk in lobby or prebook through GOGO) for the Canopy / Zip line tour.  The scenery and bumpy roads up the mountain made it a fun adventure and the zip line was the best I've experienced.  Our tour guide Eddie was so funny and informative.  He said that good gifts to bring for the children are tee shirts, baseball caps, school supplies and give them to Prieto Tours who will deliver them to the most needy. FYI there is a considerable amount of hiking to do between platforms.  Make sure you wear sturdy shoes and if you are out of shape like myself, walk slowly and enjoy the adventure. We spoke to others who enjoyed their trips to Soaoan Island and also the jeep safari. I have found a new favorite destination, I miss it all ready.

reviews.author: Geraldine G
reviews.title: Superior treatment received during my stay
reviews.text: The room was beautifiul and spacious, the food was excellent, the performers near the lobby bar and pool area were extremely talented and accessable, the varied physical activities suited my active life style, the ocean was nearby and the pool welcoming but the special treatment provided by several of the staff members made this vacation spot stand out among the giants. I can't say enough about my #1 favorite:Edison the yoga, Pilates, water aerobics and all-around body enhancing instructor. His understanding of a client's needs and attention to these is uncanny. He is worth his weigh in gold. I wish i could coaxmhim to come to New York and work at my gym, in midtown Manhattan. Next, is Nixon, the young, water aerobics instructor. Finally, the TLC I received from Leidy, in the spa must be mentioned. The staff is excellent  but these individuals are superior!

reviews.author: Julie F
reviews.title: un voyage à refaire
reviews.text: Pendant la semaine du 21 au 28 avril, j'ai eu l'occasion de faire un voyage, organisé par une compagnie, qui a dépassé mes attentes.   Il y a longtemps que nous n'étions pas allés à Punta Cana et je n'ai aucun regret.  Notre chambre était très propre et elle avait toutes les commodités que nous avions besoin.  Même si nous devions marcher un peu, nous étions proches du lobby et des restos ( après souper c'était un mal nécessaire!)  Les retos à la carte sont variés et la nourriture est excellente.  Même mon conjoint, qui est plutôt difficile au sujet de la nourriture, a réussi à repartir avec quelques livres en plus.   J'ai eu un petit coup de coeur pour le resto Aqua qui est dans une autre partie de l'hôtel, mais nous y avons accès sans frais.  Le personnel est très sympathique et j'ai été surprise de constater à quel point plusieurs parlaient français (même si ce n'était pas une nécessité pour nous).  La plage est grande et il possible de marcher très très longtemps de chaque côté.  Les algues sont présentes dans l'eau et sur le bord.  Malgré cet élément de la nature, je suis allée me baigner à plusieurs reprises.    Quel plaisir de terminer l'après-midi, au bar de la piscine, avec Ramon et Luiz qui donnent un très bon service.  Grâce à Ramon, j'ai essayé d'autres drinks que le daiquiri aux bananes ( qui excellent à tous moments de la journée).  Je n'aurais aucune difficulté à retourner à cet endroit où la bouffe est excellente et les gens courtois.

reviews.author: mhwmom
reviews.title: Fabulous Girls Trip--Bucket List Spa Experience
reviews.text:
Just returned from a five day/four night trip with three best friends that was incredible.  I have very high expectations about accommodations/service/experience and for the most part the resort exceeded all of them. The resort is not Caribbean (no calypso music and loud “island” decorations) very classic and European with everyone speaking Spanish, which was a pleasant surprise.   Be aware that the resort has a variety of “levels of service” Royal, VIP, Reserve, etc. so know what you are getting and paying for because some parts of the resort are off limits based on your experience.  

Resort was easy to get to from airport; took a cab, $32, to resort, clean, easy to get and 25 minute drive.  Check-in was most disappointing part of experience.  We arrived and waited 20 minutes at counter then told we needed to go VIP room down hall.  That process took another 30 minutes, then told us room wasn’t ready, come back in 30 minutes (which is fine we ate), but then another 30 minutes after 3 p.m. (when rooms are ready) to finally get room and they gave us key and moved on.  Rooms were suppose to be adjoining with friends (but in person they said it was extra, not on phone).No one walked us to room or took us on tour of resort, when we saw others getting that service.  

I was starting to question if this was a five star resort, but luckily we quickly moved from the lackluster start.  Room was clean, beautiful and spacious.  We stayed in a garden view on Gabbi Beach side and loved the location to beach. Cleaning staff was noisy in mornings EARLY—6 a.m., but otherwise no room complaints.

The food was great!  Hard to find quality at all-inclusive so the food exceeded my expectations. The buffet was good, but the restaurants have great options and the staff is more than willing to accommodate your requests . Get reservations for your stay the first night you arrive.  I thought Vinto was best meal and loved Thai (Bana) and Steakhouse (MarketGrill) (want to have fun server, find Anthoni!!.  Would skip Gabbi for dinner, but they had great lunch.  Didn’t get to Mole, but I am sure it was great.  We didn’t pay additional $50 for Michelin star restaurant.  I would save money for spa.  Special call out to Jendy who took the extra time and effort to make my 40th party dinner special.  He is FABULOUS and can train everyone on true customer service!!

We are use to gulf coast beaches, so we are spoiled with our soft white sand, but these beaches were great, clean, deep and the water –well is isn’t possible to do it justice in words. It was REALLY windy a few days during our visit, so not sure if it was seasonal (sand blowing in your face when you laying out, burying chairs windy) so you might want to do some research.  JUAN made our trip special.  He was a server at Gabbi who took care of us.  Find Juan!!!

The SPA—This is what sets this resort apart from many great all inclusive I have stayed at around the world.  Don’t waste your time at the smaller Royal Service, go to the main spa and get any treatment (I had three and they were all great!) , but go two hours early to get the complimentary water treatment, it will change your life!

Think this resort is best suited for couple or groups of friends.  Not too many families and babies (left my kiddos at home and sure didn’t want to hang out with other peoples) Also loved it wasn’t a lot of singles.

reviews.author: Claudia A
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: Gorgeous resort!  Ramon "Fuego" and Luis Felguito are the BEST pool bartenders ever!  They were very accommodating and always attentive to our needs.  The rooms were beautiful and always clean!  This is our 4th time at this resort and we can't say enough good things about it!  Everyone goes above and beyond to make sure we are completely happy with everything!  We can't wait to come back again next year!  LOVE IT HERE - truly paradise!

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Average experience mars beautiful property
reviews.text:
So for a quick version before the extended review I'll sum up how I view this property.  If you're looking for an average hotel with a great beach to visit, this is the place!

My initial impression of this hotel was very good!  Driving up you're greeted with a lush tropical landscape thats obviously very well groomed and maintained.  The hotel itself is quite large and open with modern appointments.

Upon arrival we went to the front desk to arrange for our check in.  There is a definite language barrier here as Spanish is the main spoken language but most employees speak some degree of English.  While we were checking in I inquired about several of the activities, most specifically the scuba diving. (The website is pretty much a joke when it comes to describing the activities).  At first the employee didnt seem to know what I was asking, and then told me scuba diving was not included.  I responsded that I had called prior and was assured that it was.  She then asked several other employees each one echoing a different sentiment.  Finally the Scuba Aquatics center was called and it was clarified.  In case anyone is interested Tuesdays and Thursdays are single tank dives and are included.  Mon-Wed-Fri are 2 tank dives and require an additional 50 dollars.

My biggest gripe with the check in process was that there was no orientation.  My friend and I had no idea what was and wasnt included.  You are handed an envelope that goes over most of the basic things, but questions can take a long time to answer.

Once check in was complete the employee suggested we go to guest services to book a reservation for dinner and then eat lunch.  When we went to the guest services area I told them we'd like to make a dinner reservation.  Without a word they picked up the phone, dialed a number and handed it to me.  I have no problem making my own reservation, but why tell me to go to guest services if I was supposed to do it myself?  Talking to the person on the other end of the phone was also frustrating.  They asked where I would like to eat and I asked for a recommendation.  They said "I Dont know what kind of food you like."  Ok, I thought, well what kind of restaurants do you have?  "Um, an asian place, sushi, greek.."  The lack of knowledge from a person that was supposed to help you make your reservation was dissapointing to say the least.

Now lets talk about the food.  Breakfast and lunch are average at best.  Breakfast basically consists of a buffet with typical breakfast foods.  If I were to grade it I'd give it a solid C.  Nothing spectacular nothing terrible.  The service is definitely inconsistent though.  Every morning I'd usually order an ice tea.  A couple days I was told they dont have ice tea and often times it would take quite a while to receive drink orders.  The lunch buffet I'd rate a little worse than the breakfast buffet although they do offer another option "Market Grille" that serves pretty decent burgers.

Dinner on the other hand is usually pretty good.  I'd rate most restaurants B-B+.  We ate at the Sushi Place (the only dissapointment I'd give it a C-), Teppanyaki (B+) Asian Fusion (B+), Vento (B+) Market Grille (A) Gabi Beach (not included you have to pay A).  24 hour room service is also available and actually comes in quite handy..

Alcohol is also included in your all inclusive package.  For the most part the drinks were quite good and usually decent alcohol was used.  However your mileage can vary wildly based on the bartender.

Now lets move on to activities.  Paradisus offers a WIDE variety of activities that are definitely a selling point.  I didnt get a chance to experience many, so I'll only comment on thsoe that I did.

I signed up for a tennis lesson the 2nd day there and was the only one that showed up so I basically got a free tennis lesson.  The instructor was very knowledgeable and friendly and took the time to help correct my mistakes.  I enjoyed my time doing this and would recommend it.

Snorkeling. The resort offers snorkeling once a day at 3 pm.  I'm not sure why they offer a popular activity like this only once a day.  The boat literally takes you on a 3 minute ride within sight of the hotel to a reef. If you would like to do this I suggest you book it early.  We tried to book 24 hours in advance and were told a group had filled it for the next day.  Seriously?  If you take a boat that close why not offer it several times a day?  Its obviously a very popular activity.  When we finally got to snorkel it was well worth it.  There is a pretty decent variety of marine life and if you're lucky you might see some bigger critters.  I got to swim with a small barracuda which was very cool.  If you can arrange it I would recommend giving this a shot.

I also had the opportunity to dive.  Diving is arranged through Scuba Aquatics which is located on the resorts 'Gabi Beach' section.  They ask you to show up around 850 to get sized and go over a few things.  Domingo the dive master was awesome and very knowledgeable.  We did the Astron (sp?) wreck which was quite fun as I'd never had the opportunity to dive around a wreck before.  The only bad thing about the experience was the boat.  You're on a small skiff style boat maybe 15-17ft in length.  There were 6 divers, the driver, and a passenger.  The boat is VERY crowded and it makes it a pain to get in and out of your equipment.  Still the overall experience was good and I would recommend it.

One of my biggest problems with the activities was the lack of 'local' type activities.  When I was in belize we could kayak through the forest, explore caves, go on nature hikes etc.  This resort offers only 'resort' type activies.  I was really hoping they would offer different activities.

There is also a shuttle to a shopping mall... This isnt a local shopping mall.  This is a mall that has Gucci, Diesel, etc.  If you want to go out and experience a local market or cuisine you'll have to have them call a taxi for you.

As far as overall service there is definitely an 'island casual' or very relaxed regard to service.  When going to guest services they are almost always on the hotel phone or looking down into the desk drawer on to their personal phones.  When you walk up they usually greet you uninterestedly and seem to not really want to help you.  I'm not sure if thats just part of the relaxed atmosphere or what.  

There's also a pass the buck attitude. We were walking looking for the spa and asked an employee to guide us in the right direction.  He literally grabbed another employee and told him to do it.  This second employee grabbed a third and told HIM to do it.  We were very fortunate this third employee led us where we needed to go.  We felt bad as he was off work and on his way home to study (he was carrying his school books)

I know the overall tone of this review is negative and thats not my intention.  I didnt have a bad time at this resort, nor did I have an amazing time.  I had a very average stay that could be improved upon with a few small tips.

Some suggestions I would offer:

I do not expect to be catered to in English.  However a couple of strategically placed employees that are fluent at the front desk and guest services would stream line the process immensely.  Also a brief 3-5 minute orientation of what is and is not included would help quite a bit.

Offer more times for the more popular activities.  Offer a larger variety of activities that might allow a deeper view into local culture.

Engage your employees to be more friendly and helpful!  

We stayed at the Palma Real portion of the resort.  There are other areas such as the reserve that include more amenities.  This review is based on the Palma real.

Again if you're looking for a resort with a nice beach and average service, this might just fit the ticket.  (Althought if you want to travel somwhere with a nice beach and decent service why pay the premium to fly here when you can save money and go somewhere closer?)

reviews.author: guillermoruiz
reviews.title: es un señor hotel........
reviews.text:
el hotel cubrio todas las espectativas a cabalidad frente a sus ..... instalaciones ,comodidad, descanso, confort, alimentacion e una insuperable atencion personalizada.
recomiendo el hotel para disfrutar de unas excelentes y verdaderas vacaciones.

reviews.author: nicole m
reviews.title: Best Time!
reviews.text: We were there for a wedding with about 20 other people and had such a great time! The resort was beautiful and we have to give a HUGE thank you to Maiker Ramirez! He took care of us and the group the whole time we were on the beach. Our trip wouldnt have been the same without him there!

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Destination Wedding Review
reviews.text:
This is our second trip to the Paradisus Palma Real and it was for our wedding (April, 12th).  I first want to give a HUGE shout out to Massiel and Rosa at the Romance Department.  They put together the most amazing wedding anyone could have wished for.  They were both so easy to work with and really made sure everything was perfect.  We had as large wedding (80 guests) and there was not a single complaint about the wedding from anyone.  They were all telling us that this was the best wedding they have been to.  If you are thinking about having a destination wedding, please use Rosa and Massiel.  They will make this even more memorable than you ever would have thought.  Splurge and have your wedding at Gabi Beach.  It was so nice having the ceremony, cocktail hour and reception in one place.  And the pictures turned out AMAZING at the Gabi.  If you are considering using any photographer other than Arrecife DON'T.  They are located on Site and know the resort better than any other company.  Marisol was so helpful in getting everything set up and making sure we were getting exactly what we envisioned.  Rodrigo was our photographer and did an amazing job.  He was easy to work with and had so many creative ideas.  Please request him if possible.. he was awesome! After the wedding i sat there and thought about what i would have changed and there is absolutely nothing I could think of.  Weddings are always stressful leading up tot he BIG day but they really make sure you are not dealing with anything the day of the wedding.  I want them to all know how much i appreciated everything and hope they get the recognition they deserve.  A few other high notes from our trip were the room service, bartenders and servers.  Fred Martes gave TOP ROOM SERVICE!  He was there every morning on time with our breakfast.  He would check in during the day to see what we would need and at what time.  When you check in i would call room service and ask for Fred.  Let him know what you like, what time you eat breakfast and any other room service requests.  He will have notes of everything and make your trip so enjoyable.  Fred was so friendly and just a genuine person. As for restaurants we LOVE Palazzo!  Try the spaghetti with garlic sauce...yum!  We try to go there as much as possible and would always have Miguel Lopez Gil as our server.  He would have a bottle of our favorite wine ready for us when we sat down.   He would remember everything we talked with him about and really made us feel like "regulars".  And I cant forget Gloria at the Pool Bar.  She was so much fun and had so much fun with our group.  She was so good that we requested her for the wedding and she was able to work it.  It is great when all of your guests are getting the best possible service at the wedding and you keep hearing how great everything was.  I really want to thank Massiel, Rosa, Rodrigo, Gloria, Fred and Miguel Lopez.  You made this wedding the most amazing event I could have ever imagined.  You know these people are great because you want to go back and see them again.

Thx
J & K

reviews.author: Krystal D D
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort and Excellent Service
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and we thoroughly enjoyed our experience at the Paradisus Palma Royal with Royal Service. We are two single female friends in our 40's and did not feel out of place, as we would in some resorts surrounded by all romantic couples or all families. There was a nice mix of people - couples, business groups and families. I highly recommend the Royal Service -- adults only, excellent service, exclusive restaurants, butler service, beautiful rooms, oh-so comfy beach beds, private beach and pool -- definitely worth the splurge!! The beach and ocean were simply gorgeous! Our very friendly and always smiling beach waiter, Francisco Cabrera, pampered us daily reserving our favorite palapa and keeping us happy with yummy drinks! Also, Alexander, our favorite waiter at Palazzo restaurant, was consistently very attentive and sweet. The food at every restaurant was excellent -- even the buffets. I cannot say the same about other all-inclusives I have visited. We highly recommend especially Palazzo, Vento and Gabi Beach restaurants, which were included in Royal Service. There were only a couple things in which we were disappointed. First, the check-in service for Royal Service took a ridiculous amount of time - approx. 2 hours in which we were sequestered in a room without open air while waiting for our check in process to be completed and have our butler arrive. We heard from other guests the same complaint. Secondly, we were recommended to Sunny C travel company (representatives at the excursion desk at our resort daily) for our Snorkeling and Dune Buggy excursions. The Marinarium Snorkeling excursion was to include stops at a coral reef, as well as swimming with sharks and stingrays. We were never taken to a coral reef to snorkel - very disappointing. And upon return, checking my Amex bill noticed we were charged $100 over what we were told for the 2 excursions!! Amex is disputing, so we'll see. Don't bother with this excursion - just take the short snorkel trip off the resort coast that's included in Royal Service at the resort dive center. It was short, but good. We also enjoyed our own excursion to the Indigenous Eyes Ecological Reserve. It was all nature -- not a tourist trap. Very beautiful lagoons and very peaceful. Royal Service included a free ride to the park. Word to the wise: bring small bills -- $1.00 and $5.00 for tipping -- change for big bills is really hard to come by!! You cannot get cash at the main desk -- only at the ATM, which only dispurses Dominican dollars, or the Exchange desk, which charges a large fee. All in all our trip to the Dominican was wonderful!

reviews.author: Jo E
reviews.title: Lovely Resort and Friendly Staff
reviews.text:
This was my first all inclusive resort visit.  A fantastic choice - we were greeted by cold towels and native drinks upon arrival.  The view from the lobby to the ocean was awesome.  We enjoyed the attentiveness of the staff, especially the room service provided by Espiritu.  Special efforts were made to make our trip memorable.  Thank you Espiritu !

Yes, I would definitely recommend this resort.  It is huge with varied meal choices on the property.  Our room was huge and clean.  Just be prepared to speak slowly, as English is not easily understood by all staff.  However, everyone's aim was to please the customer.  A traveler can not ask more than that from a resort.   Loved it!

reviews.author: Christine D
reviews.title: "Outstanding resort with fantastic service"
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real is a lovely resort! The rooms are lovely, the grounds and landscaping are breathtaking and of course the view of the surrounding ocean is spectacular. Above all is the excellence in service coupled with the sweet hospitality of the Dominican people. We would return to the Paradisus again and again so that we could enjoy the kind services of Tiburcio De Pena 
(our personal butler),  Pedro Reyes, who brought us our coffee every morning, Billy Levons and Francisco who assisted us continually by the beach and pool with drinks, towels, chairs etc. These young men are gifted in their gifts of hospitality and service and are assets to this outstanding resort. Bravo for selecting these men to contribute to the success of this establishment. We hope to return and we will specifically ask for them by name next time.

reviews.author: bessy a
reviews.title: not sure what you are looking for
reviews.text:
enjoyed every thing during my vacation, service laked. It was not so bad for me personally, with the exception of a minor item that they couldnt get right until the day before going home, I did get an apology from Pedro Reyes, followed by a cheese try, wine and chocolate covered strowberry, it was nice of him, however, there was no shortage of food and drinks provided in our trip. but I did appreciate his effort.
I have no complains about the maintenance of my room, with the exception of shortage in wash and hand towels. but that was corrected most of the time.
Other people in our group had very bad experience in maintenance of their rooms, there was time when the room was not clean, beds were not made for 3 days.

reviews.author: jacques l
reviews.title: pas vraiment dans mes attentes
reviews.text: On prévoyait des belles vacances en groupe mais à notre arrivée cela à été très pénible d'avoir notre chambre  17hrs  ensuite c'étais le défi de réserver un restaurant pour le soir des fois à trois reprises dans la même journée et le buffet très ordinaire, heureusement on a réussi à  avoir accès aux restaurants de la Réserve donc  enfin du service. Pour le personnel rien à dire  que ce soit Ramon Fulgo,Luiz Fulgnito ou Paulino au bar de la piscine,  Miriam et Guillermo Avila au buffet et surtout Marcelino Munoz et Malcom Nunez du Restaurant Mizu lors de mon anniversaire c'étais super !! Bref je ne  crois pas y retourné et surtout que les commentaires sur trip advisor mentionnait exactement les problème que nous avons vécu, donc j'espère qu'un jour on va apporter les correctifs

reviews.author: TATANANIE
reviews.title: Upgraded to Paradisus
reviews.text: A few days before our trip to Melia Caribe, Punta Cana, we were notified that we had been upgraded to Paradisus Palma Real. We had the advantage that we knew the Paradisus was next door to Melia, and that the most important thing was that golf was included. This resort is not huge, so all amenities are literally next to each other. The staff are excellent, if you request something in your room, for example, another facecloth, it magically appears within moments.This is a quiet resort , so if you are looking for total relaxtion, it fits the bill.Food is excellent, lots of variety. No problem getting a lounger on the beach.Once again a fantastic vacation. Thank you to all at Paradisus Palma Real. Just to add, the beds are super comfortable.

reviews.author: Maria_Falcao
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: Minha irmã e eu estivemos hospedadas no Paradisus Palma Real por uma semana em março de 2013 e nossa viagem foi maravilhosa. O hotel possui uma excelente estrutura, a praia é linda e o atendimento é impecável!! Todos sempre sorridentes e muito simpáticos. Não tive problema nenhum com o inglês, quase todos falavam a língua. Faço referência especial ao Andrés que nos recebeu e cuidou de tudo para nós, à Eliza e Liliana do Gabi Beach, ao José da recepção, ao Fabio e todos do concierge. Os restaurantes são excelentes, com ótima comida, especialmente no jantar. O único ponto negativo foi a grande demora no check in, pois tivemos que esperar muito tempo para que o nosso quarto ficasse pronto. Como forma de se desculpar o hotel nos ofereceu um upgrade na pulseira, o que foi bem legal. Com certeza um lugar para voltar! Recomendo para viagens de casais (Royal Service), família (The Reserve) e amigos!

reviews.author: JUSTINF890
reviews.title: nicolas de room service es lo meor que tiene este complejo
reviews.text: estub hospedado en este hotel y puedo decir que sialgo me sorprendio fue el trato obtenido por el departamento de room service,en especial por el joven nicolas,siempre un paso delante de nuestras espectativas...racias a su supervisor bertoldo y su ayudante feliz creo sin temor a equivocarme que volveria slo por ese exelente trato

reviews.author: NevioSavieto
reviews.title: RESORT 5 ESTRELAS SÓ NO NOME
reviews.text:
Serviço de limpeza de quarto péssimo, todo dia era preciso implorar para limpeza.
Restaurantes a la carte deixaram muito a desejar
Nos acessos externos ao quarto, as fossas liberavam cheiro de esgoto o dia todo, até na área do Royal Service
Falta de informações, no primeiro dia, o jantar foi alterado de lugar e ninguém nos comunicou.
Ar condicionado no quarto precário, internet precária

reviews.author: Mary S
reviews.title: enjoyed  the stay
reviews.text: The check  in was so easy with help of Santos, the bellman,and all who welcomed  our party of four.   we got to our rooms they showed us the pool, the Gabi restaurant and the beach bar. We made resivations  at six different  restaurants  all the meals were excellent. The upscale  restaurants and waitstaff were so pleasant  and could not do enough for us. The crew at Gabi beach bar was so helpful with our Spanish  lessons  and drinks thanks to Jose David, Dani Romdro andWilson Vallo. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. The beach is outstanding  great for walks or just relaxing.  We are planning to return soon but not soon enough.

reviews.author: BettyMF
reviews.title: What a Magical Experience !!!
reviews.text:
I don't typically write reviews but I felt very compelled to write one this time. I have been to all inclusive resorts in Cancun, Turks and Caicos, and other Punta Cana resorts and this is the first review I write. I just returned from the most fabulous and magical place and the weather was not even on our side. I went with a friend of mine and we upgraded to the Royal Services. It was truly a "Royal Service". I could not have asked for better service, better food and drink, better pool, better beach, etc. 

We arrived at this magical paradise to a staff that was superb and a resort that was gorgeous. Since we upgraded to Royal Service, we soon met our butler, Yohelvi Arecena. His smile alone said a million. What ever we could dream of he was there to provide us from the daily fruit platters, cheese platters, alcohol of choice, bubble bath, personalized cake for our last dinner, and a message for safe travels created in rose petals on the night before we left. You name it, Yohelvi provided. Our favorite place was the private beach and private pool for Royal Service members. One of the things that made these places special was our wonderful, fantastic, always at your service, friendly, etc pool and beach concierge, Billy Lerons. Billy took such good care of us that I wanted to pack him in my suitcase and bring him to America. Before we were even at the beach, Billy had set aside our beach chairs (2 in the shade, 2 in the sun). Each chair had plenty of towels to accommodate us. As soon as we got to the beach, he was ready with our favorite drink. We asked him for a drink in a coconut. There were not coconuts so he went to a tree and knocked down 2 coconuts for us. He also made drinks in pineapples for us. He also had our chairs ready by the pool for our afternoon lounging. Billy sure knew how to spoil us. While at the beach, we were guarded by a wonderful Security Guard, Hilario Santana Reyes. Of course, who can forget food? The food was excellent and service was magnificent. Some of the wonderful staff that catered to us in the restaurants were Richard Ortiz at the Palazzo, restaurant for Royal Service members only so we saw him every day. He knew our names by the second day. Rosa from Gabi Beach, Wilson from Mole' and Naos, and Yuderqui Javier from Vento. Every single one of these people (and so many others) when out of there way to be friendly, courteous, accommodating, and provide spectacular service. 

Paradisus Palma Real was by far the best (out of about 10 visited) All Inclusive resort I have visited. I plan to go back very soon and (of course) see in all these "friends". I highly recommend this resort. Everything about it was just great!

reviews.author: Lori O
reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text: We just returned from our trip to a destination wedding.  The resort was beautiful and the service was excellent.  Every day started out great thanks to Nicoles and Peter from Room Service.  They provided excellent service throughout our whole stay.  The weather was perfect all six days we were there and the beaches were not crowded and relaxing.

reviews.author: Ruben_Tabernero
reviews.title: MEJOR..... IMPOSIBLE
reviews.text:
Estuvimos alojados esta Semana Santa en este hotel y tengo que decir que nos ha sorprendido el servicio y la atención de todo el equipo del Palma Real.
Optamos por la opción de Royal Service con Mayordomo y la experiencia ha superado todas las expectativas. 
Hace un par de años me alojé en un hotel de la India, que posteriormente fue elegido como uno de los 10 mejores hoteles del mundo y pensé, después de vivir esa experiencia, que dificilmente volvería a vivir y a encontrar un hotel que me aportara las mismas vivencias y sensaciones y creo que el Paradisus Palma Real con el paquete de Royal Service lo ha superado con creces.
Las habitaciones eran súper espaciosas, las vistas al mar no podían ser mejores y los restaurantes, ofrecían una calidad y servicio inmejorable y su spa, realmente muy bueno.
Desde aquí quiero felicitar a su Director Rafael Torres, a Belén la room manager, a todo el equipo de F&B (Vicente y Miguel Angel) a nuestro mayordomo Manuel que siempre estaba en el momento que lo necesitábamos y como no, a Pedro, que en la playa nos regalaba siempre su mejor sonrisa.

reviews.author: MLVQ1267
reviews.title: An exceptional hotel but...
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real is the most elegant and exquisite hotel in Punta Cana. The personnel service, quality of the food and beverages in the bars and buffet areas are excellent. While other hotels in the area offer lower rates, the quality of the service, food and beverages are, likewise, of lower quality.  I suggest sticking with the buffet for meals.
On the down side, there are only two a la carte restaurants Bana (asian) and Vento (mediterranean). An extra fee would offer one more restaurant option (italian). Bana has VERY limited capacity if you wish to dine sushi since, as the hostess explained, they only had one sushi chef. Several tables are left unoccupied.  This asian restaurant is apparently undergoing some renovations and therefore, the physical appearance is not optimal. On the teppanyaki side of the restaurant, chefs in training left much to be desired regarding performance and food taste.  Vento, on the other hand was very good overall, but the personnel seemed stressed about capacity and food servings.  
Paradissus needs to be more competitive in the entertainment area.  Although the guests are more elegant than those of other hotels, they still expect some level of entertainment. Perhaps a more appropriate area or tropical theater would make the shows more attractive. The cold atmosphere and layout of the auditorium does not provide the best forum for performers.
The hotel offers a complimentary hydrotherapy spa experience at The Reserve, the Yhi Spa. This experience is a must and make sure you request MARIA PILIER for professional, knowledgeable and quality service.

reviews.author: TaylorM17
reviews.title: El Presidente
reviews.text:
Recently took a weeklong vacation to the Paradisus (not Royal Service or Reserve).

First the Pros:

1) The staff was very friendly and helpful on the whole.  Paulino from the poolside bar was the highlight of the trip.  We met Paulino on day 1, and his service was amazing for the rest of our stay.  He would always check in to see what we needed. Waters, drinks, chips, ice cream, and of course Presidente's (con Limon).  He was always smiling and we never found him to be intrusive or looking for tips.  We also thought the Roy from the lobby bar and Fabio (entertainment/dancing) were very nice.  We did not find our "butler" to be helpful at all.

2) Pool Area/Beach: Nice clean pool, not crowded with comfortable seating, although you have to get up early to reserve the best chairs. Same story for the beach.  Some seaweed, but not too bad.

Cons:

1) Poor drink selection: For a resort, one would think that they would have consistent cocktails, including mojitos, margaritas etc.  Some were ok, some were horrible.  At the Sky Bar a member of the group was served the worst tasting "margarita" of all time.  Tasted like dish water.  The wine was also terrible.  Beer selection lacking, although many Presidentes were enjoyed. For mixed drinks see Roy or Annabella at the Lobby Bar, or make the trek to the Gabi Club at the Reserve.

2) "Reservations": Reservations are "required".  However, most people make them for the week through their butler.  We had reservations and in most of the cases, the restaurants were less than 1/3 full. This is because most people don't cancel their reservations.  We also had to eat late in many cases after 830 or 9, which was not desirable.

As Expected:

1) The rooms are adequate, comfortable beds.

2) The Food:  Buffet was good for breakfast, but was lacking at lunch.  The Market was consistently terrible.  Restaurants:

Bana: Has three different Asian sections:  These include Chinese, Japanese (Tepinyaki), and Sushi.  All were pretty good, with the sushi probably being the best.

Vento: Passable,but not great.  Chicken was particularly awful

Mole: Decent Mexican food

Aqua: At the Reserve...the best meal that we had (twice).

Without the Royal Service, you cannot access Palazzo or Gabi Beach, unless you were willing to pay more money. We were not!  Also, Passion is a restaurant from a Michelin Star chef, but was also extra money.  No way we were paying for that.

Overall:  4 star rating due mostly to the pool/beach as well as the service.  The food is what we had expected.  The drinks and "reservation" system could all use an upgrade.  Also- better tour of the grounds would be helpful.  We did not realize that we could get drink at the Reserve until two days before we left. They have better liquor and Corona!  If you end up at the Palma Real...make sure you get seats close to the poolside bar and ask for Paulino

reviews.author: Ronnie S
reviews.title: Hotel staff
reviews.text:
the Resort was the perfect place to destress..JUST PERFECT..
besides being beautiful ,clean...the rooms where perfect large bathroom suite..with plenty of 
living area..
BUT THE BEST FEATURE of this resort is the STAFF..
Maiker Ramirez....HE TOOK SUCH GOOD CARE OF US AT THE RESERVE BEACH..
THIS IS A MAN WHO LOVES HiS JOB AND IS PERFECT FOR IT...he had a smile that could light up the universe..any thing we wanted or needed was gotten for us...he is a employee who should be commended everyday for his great excellant job..
Ramon Ramirez...Mikie's partner at the Reserve beach was another example of a perfect employee for that job personable ..These employees MADE our trip...
The Bartenders at the North Avenue Bar..should have there own show..fabulous group..
I think a big part of a vacation experience is the people who are there to make sure your trip is perfect...the staff (from the front desk A GAL CALLED Lady..To all the wait staff happy caring people.
they all should be cheered for there loving  ways.and the excellant job they do.
THE ONLY NEGITIVE WAS THE FOOD..MUCH TO MUCH SALT !!!!...THAT WAS THE ONLY DOWNSIDE OF OUR EXPERIENCE...NOT GREAT.we hated the food the only restaraunt that i would rave about was AQUA..THAT WAS A GOOD DINNER..
I WILL RETURN..because of the wonderful  staff that give you there ALL..

reviews.author: Coche S
reviews.title: Fabulous Vacation!
reviews.text: This resort was absolutely amazing! The service was exceptionally well, especially Domingo, Oscar, David de Gracias, Andy Florial, and Juan Cruz. I would recommend this resort to anyone! Very clean, safe, and very family oriented!

reviews.author: kelseyk151
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: This hotel was very very nice.  All of the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. The all inclusive option was well worth the money.  The room service was very quick and efficient. Juan Cruz and Nicolas De La Rosa were very helpful and were some of the best staff at the resort. In addition, Domingo, David DeGracias, and Andy Florial were also very good workers- very polite and did their job well!! I highly recommend this resort for all ages because the service was so friendly and helpful! Very clean, fun, and safe!!

reviews.author: Sandra K
reviews.title: Excellent hotel and people!
reviews.text:
I went for a one-week vacation with a friend, and our goal was to spend time at the hotel and enjoy all the benefits of an all-inclusive. The hotel was great, the property is gorgeous, the rooms are spacious and have a beautiful decor. They had daily activities such as dancing classes, building sand castles, producing your own cigar, etc. We had a great experience, we really felt welcomed, and specially want to recognize Yira and Angel, who are the coordinators of those activities and were so welcoming and professional. The food was also of excellent quality, the presentation was sophisticated and not what you would expect from an all-inclusive. 
Definitely a great choice of hotel, I plan to go back there with the family now!

reviews.author: Gkj9
reviews.title: The food was okay, the venue is beautiful, no running water was not acceptable.
reviews.text:
We had no running water in our room for 18 hours and no hot water for three days! This was a problem in most of the rooms in the Reserve due to a water pump failure. 

The staff was helpful although had little or no information for us, gave us other rooms in the resort to shower in fro the two nights with no hot water, and gave us our spa treatments for free if we asked. But really..... running water and hot water seemed like a basic service item that should be able to be fixed quickly, even in the DR. 

More activities on the beach would be a nice addition. Room service is free, except for a $5 fee, but is always very, very, very slow. 

The location is stunningly beautiful and because we were there for a senior high school spring break trip, the venue was perfect for our needs.... except for the hot water/running water thing.

reviews.author: Les_Lanthier
reviews.title: Great stay!!
reviews.text:
The view when you come in the hotel is lovely (view direct on the ocean).  Rooms are nice and the staff, very helpful.   Food was good and the beach, calm and blue.  On the up side:  the entertainment in the evening was the best that I have seen in an all inclusive facilities.  On the down side:  reservation to the restaurant (a la carte) was not easy and the choice of hours was not great.

The accommodations were well above standards

reviews.author: carlos m
reviews.title: Excelente hotel y excelente staff en general.
reviews.text: Estuvimos alojados del 6 al 9 de marzo pasando vacaciones con mi esposa y nos alojamos en el royal service, el servicio se supone es mejor al resto del hotel, aunque nuestro concierge lo vimos al momento del check in y ya luego jamás, nunca contesto nuestras llamadas, el internet nefasto, jamás arreglaron el problema que decían que tenían y la gente de royal service nunca resolvieron nuestras dudas. De ahí en adelante el hotel es fabuloso, la locación fantástica, y el staff de restaurantes y bares de lo mejor, vale la pena regresar pero no volvería a contratar el royal service de nuevo. Tienen un lindo hotel, una gente fantástica en general con la excepción de la de el área del servicio real, ahí si hay serias deficiencias, por lo demás es grandioso.

reviews.author: Mashean H
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation!
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus Palma Real in February 2013 for a week and it was fabulous. I was on vacation with two great friends to celebrate our birthdays.  We had a great time! The resort is an oasis and words really cannot describe how beautiful it is.  You must visit to see for yourself this gorgeous resort.  The cabana near the pool was great and the ocean was breathtaking with the white sand. I wish we could have stayed in that paradise longer. The staff was awesome, very attentive and helpful.  The entertainment staff Yira, Ridolfo, Angel and Jo Angel was fun and entertaining.  I loved the classes during the day teaching me Latin moves to bring to the dance floor in the evening.  

Our bartenders David and Orny were fun and very pleasant.  We enjoyed their company and great service.  The staff works very hard and they take pride in their work and making the guest feel welcomed.  I enjoyed the food and the staff at the restaurants was AWESOME!  They made our experience such a joy each evening (especially on our birthdays Feb 25-27) at the various restaurants were birthdays to remember. 

 Issidro was great!  He attended to our needs late nights after partying and was so helpful and very pleasant each time.  I also have to thank the friendly smile and attentiveness from Anareus who also made our trip memorable and very pleasant.  Great thanks to Alberto our concierge and staff at the beach and pool they all were great and very attentive.  I may have left off some names but everyone we encountered during our stay was excellent and I will be returning to visit Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Pamdonna
reviews.title: Fun, fun, fun and more!
reviews.text:
My friend and I just came back from a 7 day holiday at Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  Two women travelling on their own could be a little worrisome. We never felt we needed to at this resort. There are 3 resorts (I think it was 3) on one compound. It was huge and you never had to leave it as everything was there even a shopping mall!  We felt safe walking around it, in fact we went for a couple of runs around it. We walked outside in the evenings and never felt unsafe. 

Now the fun part - there are so many activities going on every day and the instructors are so much fun - Yira, Angel, Fabio and many others made our trip so much fun!!!  Make sure you ask for the activity schedule at the reception desk when you arrive. The day is full of different activities. We took dancing lessons with them in the morning for 30 mins outside and then in the evening at the bar they danced with everyone so we got to practice our dance moves - we are not young but we kept up with them. We took dance fit, yogapilates, and if we had more energy, could have done much more. The dancers/activity instructors were just the best. I have never laughed so much!!!  I am a recent widow and they just brought the fun out of me which I needed. They really made our trip so enjoyable - thanks Yira, Angel, Fabio and the others - sorry I can't remember all your names - for making our trip a memorable one!!!

There was a show of some sort every night and they were fabulous - Michael Jackson is alive and in Punta Cana!  The beach went on for miles, in fact we never did reach the end on our walks. There is snorkelling, diving right there with just a short boat ride. Most activities are free except parasailing but it was only $45 US - I thought very reasonable. 

The food was fabulous!  We watched what we ate so we wouldn't get sick but after the first few days forgot about that and ate everything and anything and neither of us got sick. It was an all inclusive and there was never a shortage of anything or places to get whatever you wanted. There are many restaurants on the property included in the all inclusive and all had great food. We ate in a different restaurant every night and didn't get them all covered. 

There were different pools, beach loungers with straw huts for escape from the sun for a little snooze. The sand was unbelievable, so fine and clean!!!

Rooms were beautiful with a small patio/balcony to sit out on.  We were in the Club Melia portion of the hotel and couldn't have stayed in a nicer place!   The grounds are kept beautifully!  The people are very friendly and if they couldn't answer your question, they would direct you in the right direction. 

This IS a five star resort and some!!!  I would highly recommend it!  Make sure you ask for Angel, Fabio and Yira to ensure you have as much fun as we did!!!

Pam

reviews.author: LaTonya B
reviews.title: My best vacation ever
reviews.text: I visited the Paradisus Palma Real in February 2013 for a week, it was absolutely amazing.  I was on vacation with two of my good friends.  We had the best time ever.  The resort is gorgeus and the beach and pool were great.  I wish I could have stayed longer.  The staff and management were amazing and extremely helpful.  The entertainment staff Yira, Ridolfo, Angel, and Joangel were lots of fun.  The staff David and Orny from the main bar were very pleasant and top notch. The staff works very hard and they have great pride in the work. They were pleasant, engaging, friendly and attentive to our needs. The food was fanatastic and they satff in the restaurants were also amazing.  Issidro was especially helpful and attentive, even though it would be late in the evining. This was a memorable trip and plan to visit again soon.

reviews.author: cubsgirl017
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana for a week in Feb 2013.  We were in the Reserve area which was well worth it.  I highly recommend upgrading to the Reserve.  The room was huge and very clean.  The pool area is amazing!  The grill has great food and the chairs/beds/cabanas are very comfy.  The buffets were decent.  I didn't mind the buffets but my friend is a little more picky and thought they were just ok.  She always found something to eat and we never left hungry.  The restaurants were fantastic.  We went to Mole and the italian restaurant and both dinners were great.  You must make reservations for the restaurants and they fill up quick so book them days in advance if possible. The beach is beautiful with nice chairs/beds/cabanas and plenty of them.  The service was superb.  All the servers, bartenders and front desk were tentative, friendly and helpful.  I would highly recommend the Paradisus Punta Cana and can't wait to go back someday.

reviews.author: Nadine M
reviews.title: best vacation resort ever.
reviews.text: I have never been to Punta Cana before and for my first visit I was able to stay at this beautiful resort.  Paradisus Palma Real treated me and my sisters with exceptional service.  The staff and management was wonderful.  Pedro Reyes in room service was great.  Every morning he called to make sure that we got what we wanted for breakfast and always asked if we needed anything else. and delivered it with a smile on his face.  The bartenders were excellent and very helpful as well as entertaining.  Also the VIP check in staff was extremely helpful.  I would love to go back to the Palma Real with my family next time!

reviews.author: Alison
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!!
reviews.text: I was recently a guest at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  This was the most amazing vacation I have ever been on.  We had THE GREATEST concierges Massiel Moline, Fernando and Ada!! We also had amazing service from Claudio and Deborah. They were all so friendly and helpful.  I wished I could have brought them home with me. I never once had an issue with anyone working at the resort.  The place was beautiful and so relaxing! My massage and body scrub at the spa was the best I have ever experienced.  The entire place always smelled so good...it was exactly what a vacation is supposed to be relaxing and fun!  I would go back in a heartbeat!!

reviews.author: Kristin S
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text:
We traveled to the Dominican Republic in February 2013 and spent four nights at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The gist, for those of you who do not wish to read further, is that we highly recommend the Paradisus Palma Real.  To learn more about the positivies and areas for improvement, read on.

Before I begin the review, let me tell you a little about us to help you better understand our perspective.  We are an upper-middle class couple in our mid-late thirties from Washington, DC.  We've traveled all over the world and typically stay in 4-5 star hotels.  We were joined on this vacation by a couple in their mid-thirties from Manhattan.  Our friends recommended the Dominican Republic because they enjoy all-inclusive resorts and wanted to experience this particular island.  We've never stayed at an all-inclusive resort because we believe their goal is quantity over quality (much like cruises) and we prefer quality, but we compromised on the location because spending time with our friends was our goal.

Positives
Distance from the airport:  The resort is a 25 minute ride from the Punta Cana airport.  The cost was $30 USD (note that the taxi driver accepted USD).  We added another $6 for tip.  Locating a taxi at the airport was simple and felt safe.

Pool(s):  The main pool was beautiful and quite large.  It never felt crowded and always appeared clean.  There is a pool bar and lots of in-pool lounges.  We enjoyed it.  The other small pools were also quite nice.  

Resort:  The resort grounds are in great condition and just beautiful.

Room:  We booked our trip within two weeks of arriving and so we didn't have an ocean front option so we just booked the garden view.  We found the room large, clean, well-stocked, and pretty.  The bed was comfortable too.  It looked like all rooms have either a patio or a balcony.

Gym:  We used the gym twice and found it a good size with updated equipment and plenty of workout options (cardio, free weights, and machine weights).  They also offer fitness classes, but we did not utilize that service.  The gym operator, Wendy, was very nice and helpful.

Palazzo Restaurant:  The service at this restaurant was quite good and the food was above average.  We ate breakfast at the Palazzo daily and could order a la carte items as well as grab food from the buffet (including made to order pancakes, crepes, and omelets).  We also ate at the Palazzo for dinner one night, a la carte options, and it was very good.

Beach:  We did not spend much time on the beach or in the ocean (we prefer to sit by the pool and look at the beach/ocean).  However, we did go for walks on the beach and found it pretty - a little crowded, but not overwhelming.  People do try to sell you things on the beach, but are quick to turn away once you say no thank you.  The ocean was warmer than the pool and was nice.  Because there were small waves the ocean is not as clear as other islands, but it is still clear enough and a pretty turquoise.  Some reviewers noted the seaweed on the beach - and it is there - but we didn't find it offensive.

Room for Improvement
Food:  With the exception of the Palazzo restaurant, we'd describe the food as tolerable. We ate at Gabi Beach, Vento, Naos, and the Palazzo.  I highly recommend NOT going to Vento.  The food was terrible (we actually left and went to the buffet - and we really dislike buffets) and the service took forever.  The service at Gabi Beach was bizarre.  The waiter knocked over our drinks twice and never apologized.  He also kept bringing out food we didn't order.

Service:  We found the service to be average.  Essentially, the staff did not go out of their way to make our experience special.  Some staff went above and beyond, but mostly they just did their jobs.  

Check-in:  We chose the Royal Service and the check-in process was too formal.  We were greeted by someone at the front of the resort who took us to the Royal Service lounge.  We then had to wait for someone to walk us through the Royal Service amenities.  We then had to wait for another person to take us to our room and show us around our room.  During this entire time, the staff waxed poetic about their butler service.  However, we never met our butler or heard from him our entire stay.  We should note that we did not feel we needed a butler and so we were not concerned by this fact, however, for those who would like a butler - be warned that you may have to hunt him down. 

Items to Note
- There is no hair conditioner in the room.  Bring your own from home if you need/want to use conditioner.
- The beer served is El Presidente (a DR beer, I believe).  The alcohol is rail-level.  If you opt for the Royal Service you can get premium alcohol from the Royal Service lounge.
- You cannot drink the water in your room.  We used bottled water to brush our teeth, but our friends did not (they used the tap).  No one got sick.  The resort does a good job keeping plenty of bottle water in your room and around the resort.  The water used by restaurants is filtered and okay.
- You can reserve palapas with 24 hours notice, which we'd recommend if you want to stay in the shade and lounge.  Otherwise, we did find that the beach/pool chairs get taken earlier (around 9:30am), but a lot of people seem to just leave their things and then disappear.
- The resort claims you need reservations for dinner at most restaurants.  We found this to never be the case.  We were told that we couldn't get reservations at the Palazzo until 9pm, but when we stopped by at 7:30pm the restaurant was only half full and they seated us right away.  We noticed this elsewhere too.
- The resort offers nice music to listen to throughout the day by the pools and has enjoyable evening entertainment.  There are lots of places to lounge in the evening.

Despite the suggested areas for improvement, I still would recommend this resort to any of my friends or family.  It was beautiful and we felt comfortable and relaxed.  We may even return one day.

reviews.author: Don M
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: My wife and I and our" best friends couple" who we have know for 50 years vacationed at Palma Real from 2/16 to 2/23. It was almost the best vacation ever except for the very,very frustrating experience trying to get a boarding pass at the airport to go home. It was a 3 hour ordeal but not the fault of the hotel. We chose not to pay extra for the Royal Service and were very happy with the service and food at all the resturants. The resturants are busy so i suggest you contact your conserige (Alberto Mercedes is the best) and make your reservations as soon as you arrive. If you like to eat dinner early 6-6:30 you should have no problem. Don't miss the lobster buffet on thursday nite we also loved Vento and Gabi. We found the staff to be extraordinarly friendly and helpful and 95% speak english. Our beach server David de Garcia was like a son. If your a golfer the Cocotal is accross the street. Try to play around 9-10am and you can still get a few hours back at the beach. Bring about $50 in one dollar bills for tips. Its amasing what a $2 tip will get you. The all-inclusive is a little pricey if your not a big eater and drinker but all in all a fabulous Resort.

reviews.author: Paneuropean-visitor
reviews.title: AWESOME from start to finish
reviews.text:
This is my second time in this hotel.  I was here last year and they have improved the place a lot.
Food at the restaurants is really good.  However service at the Palazzo restaurant was terrible.
there was one activity my friends and I enjoyed which was the making of rings out of wire with Erika.  
At the beach, Maiker and Ramon will make you feel at home.  By the second day, they already know which drinks you like, and how you like them.  
In the entertainment area, do ask for Julio, he made us laugh and dance last year and this year was no different.
I also want to point out that Reyes at the pool grill was very kind.  I had just arrived at the hotel and was starving.  Although he was already closed (and cleaning up) he made time to make me a hamburger.  Sorry I made you loose the "guagua" (bus)... I really appreciate your kindness...
Overall, I believe this place is fabulous whether its a family vacation, friends reunion or couple's get away.

reviews.author: Lynette C
reviews.title: Great Escape from the Cold!
reviews.text:
Just returning from a wonderful stay at The Reserve. It was the perfect escape from the winter cold.

As others have mentioned, the food in the restaurants was “OK” and making reservations was a bit of a challenge. But, we found that the buffet at Gabi Club was perfect for all meals. Lots of meat and vegetarian options. The service at Gabi Club was terrific. In particular, Wander Gomez Batista, waited on us during several meals. He was friendly, knowledgeable, very professional, and always greeted us with a smile. We looked forward to seeing him at each meal. We couldn’t have asked for better service. Hehwan Ramirez at Gabi Club was also great. Keep a look out for these two…they will do their best to make sure you have a great experience.

The private beach at The Reserve is also very good. The beach is clean, no seaweed, and the selection of sun/shade options is very good. And, The Reserve has one of the best stretches of beach along a very long strand. The best part of the beach experience is the wait staff. Specifically, Maiker Ramirez (aka Mikey Mikey), Ramon Ramirez, and Jose de Los Santos made the beach an incredibly fun experience. It was great to be greeted each day by these friendly and fun young men. They attended to our every need with a smile on their faces. Deibe Esquea made some very fine drinks as well.

As others have mentioned, the beach is a short (~10 min) walk from The Reserve units. However, we found it an excellent opportunity to view the lush tropical grounds. The grounds are beautiful and immaculately maintained. There is also a trolley that runs on a regular basis that is a quick and easy way to get to the beach for those who don’t want to walk.

The room was large and spacious but there was not an elevator in our building. So, those with mobility impairment may want to request a room on a lower level. Our room was only a short walk to the pool and it was beautiful as well…very large with a nice bar and towel service.

This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and we chose The Reserve based on a friend’s recommendation. The Reserve exceeded my expectations and I couldn’t have asked for a better location or friendlier staff. It really was a great vacation!

reviews.author: JimeSoto
reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL!!!
reviews.text: I stayed there for a week and everything went great! Food was amazing, specially Passion restaurant, the beach and pool are beatiful and the customer service is just superb! The bedroom was fantastic even though it had a garden view.

reviews.author: Dodie4640
reviews.title: Excellent Service Beautiful Resort Delicious Food
reviews.text: A big thank you to Nicolos and Sergio they took very good care of my husband Greg and myself while we stayed at the Paradisus Feb. 9 -17. This is one trip we will not soon forget.  The resort was beautiful, the food delicious and the service excellent++++++.  The spa was the most beautiful spa I have ever been in.  Don't miss it if you go to this resort.

reviews.author: PooHoosMom
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve
reviews.text: I was quite skeptical of staying at this resort after reading all the negative reviews. We arrived on Feb 7th and we were met at reception with an icy cold cocktail and cold 'towels' for our face that smelled absolutely wonderful! We were completely delighted to receive a complimentary upgrade to the Reserve section of the hotel. This hotel is BEAUTIFUL with well kept grounds, water features and rooms. Although you could take a trolley around the grounds to the beach and restaurant areas, we found walking the short distance to be very pleasant (and I have REALLY bad feet!) so we chose that option instead. It would probably be a 2-3 minute walk from the Reserve (front of hotel) to the beach.  Our room was HUGE with two couches, a chair, a dining area, small kitchenette with mini bar, one bedroom, two bathrooms - one with a giant jacuzzi and double sinks and the other with a sink, shower with many heads and a separate toilet. There is a large keypad safe in the closet. There was also a nice balcony. The food at this resort was EXCELLENT, a great variety at every lunch and dinner buffet and the al a cart restaurants were beyond expectation. My favorites were Palazzo (Italian) and Vento (Mediterranean). Some of our meals were like being at a high end restaurant at home. The house wines were excellent and I am looking into  purchasing some of them at home. We enjoyed the golf (yes the carts are $65 per person) every day and found the course well kept and challenging. The pool was supreme and the staff attentive to asking us if we needed drinks about 2x per hour. I highly recommend the "Night and Day with rum"! They were generous with the alcohol and asked if we wanted 'special' alcohol (top shelf)without us having to ask but honestly their brands were excellent. ALL of the staff were cheerful and very good at their jobs. Our concierge "Jerardine" was wonderful and helped with all our reservations for restaurants and golf and even the flight home. We were never turned down for a reservation. The beach is awesome but a bit too much undertow for my weak swimming skills ;( but it was lovely for a walk and dip along the edge. There were a ton of activities going on so there is no way you should ever get bored. The Reserve pool is definitely quieter than the beach/main pool. There were  a ton of chairs, chaises, and little 'cubby hole' areas to lounge in. We never had any issue getting a wonderful spot on any day no matter what the time. We also NEVER encountered anyone asking us to listen to a sales pitch for purchasing a condo and did not see anyone else getting asked either. I would love to return to this hotel. Forgot to mention: the  airport is small and you deplane on the tarmack. It is delightful! We whisked through customs and there was a trio of gentlemen who played music when you arrived and left.

reviews.author: Sandgirl52
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
We have travelled to several resorts in the Carribean and read the reviews for this and and were very excited to go!  Upon arrival we were greeted very warmly and then shown to our room, that is when things changed, our room smelled like we were dropped off in a sewer.  We spent the night and when we awoke my husbands throat was sore from the odor.  I asked to be changed and by lunch time that did happen.  I might have thought this was just bad luck but we were travelling with 2 other couples and they had the same problem.  Unfortunately for them it took most of their day waiting in there room to be promised just one more hour and we will move you will that hour was all day.

The next morning we made reservations for dinners for the week and they were written down for us and after the first nights dinner they lost all of the rest so instead of standing in the lineup for another 1 1/2 hours were went to the buffet.  Having said that the food was good and lots of variety.  

The beach is great for taking long walks.  There is quite a bit of grass in the water but still quite nice.  

Sevice was good and staff were friendly.  

Would I go back to this resort?  Probably not very touristy in this area - helicopters, boats and more boats zooming back and forth.  For the money we spent we were very disappointed.

reviews.author: xyzzy_ma
reviews.title: Not impressed. Poor service. Overpriced.
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days at this resort, and unfortunately, this place failed to impress, by any stretch of the imagination.  There were so many negatives, it was hard to know where I should begin with this review.  Rather than detail all our issues, I'll simply highlight the ones likely to be most useful to fellow travelers.

Service was poor, poor, poor.  This was the overwhelming problem of our stay at this resort.  Other members in our group confirmed this.  The staff at this resort seemed amateurish and inexperienced.
