On more than one occasion, I asked members of my party if they felt like we had arrived on a week when the resort was training a large number of new staff.  That, or the resort was understaffed for the number of guests.

I was reduced to self-service on more than one occasion.  During lunch, after waiting 10 to 15 minutes for someone to get me a soft drink, I just went to the beverage bar, and got one myself.

Communication.  If you do not speak Spanish, you may find language to be a barrier to communication.  This was true for much of the staff we encountered.  When I asked our restaurant waiter about an appetizer on the menu, he indicated the dish was his favorite.  When I asked him to elaborate more on the dish and its ingredients, he couldn't tell me anything more about it.

We had similar communication issues, when ordering drinks at the resort's various bars.  There must be a shortage of bar-tending schools in the Dominican Republic, because the bartenders were awful.  Many of my drink requests were met with blank stares.  They had no idea how to mix well-known cocktails.  I ultimately had to explain to bartenders how to mix a number of  very common, well-known drinks.  Seriously, I was dumbfounded when I couldn't get a Kir Royal apértif drink before our meal.

The Room.  Ours had a strong musty smell to it.  When we complained and requested another room, we were told there were no other rooms available.  We had arrived as part of a group, so the front desk advised us that we should find another person in our group willing to swap rooms with us.  Seriously?  Can you imagine that?  Asking another member of our group, "Would you mind swapping your room for our musty-smelling room?"  Keep this in mind, when you read the hotel management's response to negative reviews, indicating they "have a commitment to provide quality service beyond our guests’ expectations."  That's the kind of quality service you can expect at this resort.

About the bathroom ... I hope you enjoy taking cold showers.  Our room provided enough warm (not hot) water for only 1 person.  The second person's shower was always cold.

Food was typical of all-inclusive resorts I have attended.  Acceptably good (but not great), and certainly not of a quality that you will write home about.  When you arrive to one of the evening restaurants on the resort, you will be asked about your reservation.  When we indicated that we did not have a reservation, because we had just arrived from the airport an hour earlier, we were made to feel that the restaurant staff were doing us a favor by seating us.  Really?  Only a third of the tables were occupied, and it was 9 pm, well after the dinner rush.  The hostess was acting as though we were trying to walk up to a hot new restaurant in Beverly Hills, expecting to be seated without being a famous celebrity.  This is an all-inclusive resort, is it not?

Heed mine and other negative reviews about this resort.  These comments are not the exception.  In our experience, they were the norm.  Bottom line: You will most likely regret coming here, as it will feel like a waste of your time and money.

The only nice thing I can say about this hotel resort is that the grounds were beautiful.  The beach is very nice and just a short walk off the property.  If that alone is worth your time and money, then go for it.  If not, then I must suggest that you pass.

reviews.author: KatyBoston
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text:
We just returned from a two week vacation at the Paradisus Punta Cana.  As is with all vacations, it is what you make of it.  We stayed at the Reserve, it was our first time in the reserve, but not our first time at the resort.  I am a landscape junkie.  If you love gorgeous landscaping, this is a place to see.  Beautiful grounds, flowers, beach and pools.  The landscape designer has an eye and they are constantly planting, pruning and making it more spectacular.  

We enjoyed all of the amenities.  We played golf and met many fun players.  The golf course, although still included, has raised their price for the cart to $65/pp and it's mandatory.  It's a decent course but at $65 it is starting to be less of a good deal.  It may be a deal breaker when golf is one of the draws for us.  

We played tennis and paddle ball.  Awesome guys work there.  Ambioris, a.k.a Ambi, Jose and Domingo were fabulous guys and loads of fun.  They played tennis and paddle ball with us and we all laughed as we tried to learn more Spanish.   They were constantly trying to learn and practice their English which we also appreciated. It's their country but they are trying to learn so many different languages.  They made our vacation much more enjoyable.

Marlena down at the breakfast spot by the beach is a constant favorite of ours, she goes out of her way to make us feel welcome and we were sorry that we were unable to say goodbye.  My husband had a nasty allergy attack and he wasn't feel well enough to trek to the beach. Someone please tell her that the perfume ladies friend is sorry that we did not make it.  

The reserve bar has some awesome help and we were treated like kings by Lenin at the bar and Luis and Emilio around the pool.  They went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of.  

They have a few things they really need to address.  There were several late night parties right under our window that were large scheduled events.  These events should have their own area and should not be held under guests rooms.  Calls to the desk were not helpful and no one called to explain why were were kept up so late with loud blasting music.

Another issue was that the hotel was very slow when we arrived.  We were originally given a room with the worst view in the place, it was hard to tell as we arrived after dark.  In the morning, we realized that our view was horrible.  A call to the desk fixed the situation, but I will not understand why, when the place was empty, that you put us in one of the worst rooms in the place.  

The food was good, better than our previous experiences, but some places are better than others.  If you are looking for American 5 star, you will be disappointed.  It's very good food and good quality, but that is for Caribbean standards.  We would never complain, as we were happy with the food, but we met people who's expectations were unrealistic for an all inclusive hotel.  

We had a great time and would still recommend it for a decent deal.

reviews.author: shirlee b
reviews.title: Absolutely loved our trip!
reviews.text:
This is to thank the entire staff for the most comfortable stay at your magnificent resort and the complimentary champagne that we enjoyed very much.

People that are “exceptional assets” to your team are; Lorenzo and Lenin Mora at the Reserve Bar – they make everyday a JOY and make you smile.   Also, we’d like to mention Amelio Valdez and at the front desk Marie, Lenin’s (Lenny’s wife) is so sweet and helpful.  They’re service is First Class and there knowledge is examplinary. 

We stayed in the Reserve area which is very impressive, from the double person Jacuzzi in our room to the cabanas around the pool and also the built-in lounges surrounding and in the center of the pool.

The ladies that cleaned our room everyday are impeccable with requests and making our room perfect daily!

Also, we did the Excursion "Splash" which included "Snuba and Speed Boating" which is amazing.  The staff is fabulous and you feel safe at all times....the snuba was something I can't wait to experience again....my husband isn't an great candidate for this but made the effort and our guide Patrick took a special interest in making sure that he also had a great experience.

We've been to Punta Cana twice before but this was by far the best experience we've had so far.

reviews.author: Ginette L
reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: Vacance du 19 au 16 janvier 2013,Tout tout est parfait, seule commentaire négatif la réception pas vite et nous avons eu probleme de over booking. donc petite difficulté avoir notre chambre mais un coup celà réglé tout est parfait.5 étoiles et plus.La propretié impeccable, le manger excellent.Les restos a la carte et les buffets bon et surtout très bien présenté.Jamais j ai eu un resort aussi propre le personnel est dévoué sur le Resort.Les salles de bains incrayablement belle et propre partout sur le site. Déco à la plage le soir de toute beauté, Rien ne m a déplu sauf l acceuil pas assez de personnel perdu notre après midi au lobby a attendre.Nous devions avoir cadeau d arriver a la chambre et souper nolitour et nous ne l avons pas eu.Mais je suis prete à retourner n importe quand et le recommande fortement.FELICITATION A SANTOS FRIAS POUR L EXCELLENT TRAVAIL SUPER.

reviews.author: PaulAK2011
reviews.title: Stunning grounds and setting
reviews.text:
Paradisus on the ocean in Punta Cana is one of the most beautiful settings and grounds of any resort I have seen world wide.   It has mangrove swamp areas, jungle areas, and beautiful landscaped grounds  with the housing buildings and restaurants interspersed from The Reserve area to the lovely beach.  It is spread out, so plan on lots of walking, however there are golf cart type shuttles along the main pathways about every 10 minutes.   The lodge checkin area is a vast open area with pools and gorgeous plantings, rest area swings, and just a natural beauty that has to be seen to be believed. The main pool for all was lovely as was the slightly smaller or 2nd pool in the Private Reserve housing area furtherest from the ocean.  The facilities were nice and modern.   It took a while for hot water for the big shower.  The air conditioning failed twice, but maintance had it back on quickly.  I wish I could say the same for the room keys which needed to be replaced 4 times during the week, a real nuisance.
The restaurants were all beautiful facilities, but  the food was mediocre at all but at the Palazzo, where I had a wonderful tenderloin dinner.    The service there was very slow, but good elsewhere.   The highlights were the friendly , warm, wonderful staff all over the resort, and the beauty of the area.   The swim up bar at the main pool had the most wonderful staff all week.  The other pool in the Private Reserve area had no swim up bar. The beach area had a nice variety of activities and 3 small catamaran sailboats that one could take out by the hour at no charge.  The Gabi bar and restaurant right on the beach was a fun area,  with one stand out spot.  They had an array of white sheep seats with black ears and face one could sit on.   If you want an eco resort with unmatched beauty and friendy staff,  Paradisus is for you.

reviews.author: Bev D
reviews.title: Great Week
reviews.text: Returned Feb. 1 after a week with two other couples.After making sure that the hotel staff understood that we were not interested in the time shares offered, we were not bothered for the rest of the week. All 6 of us had a great week. The rooms were quite large and very clean. All the common areas, including restaurants and bar areas were kept spotless. Both a la carte and buffet restaurants had excellant food, with a large selection of food for all tastes. We refused to pay a premium for the two specialty restaurants, as there was plenty of choices without paying for a meal.The restaurant and bar staff were excellent. Freddy and all his staff did a great job at the buffet area, making sure we had whatever we needed, with a smile and sometimes even a dance. Ramon at the pool bar was always looking out for us and serving any where across the pool deck with a drink balanced on his head. Sammy, at the all night bar always made sure that there was plenty of premium brand drinks available, and always had a smile for all hotel patrons. Only downfall was the fact that the Cocotal Golf course has raised its cart rental to $65/person which is rediculous. Overall, the week was great and would definately consider going back

reviews.author: Tulips91
reviews.title: Great Wedding!!!
reviews.text:
I attended to my best friend´s wedding in Paradisus Palma Real, and I have to say that the wedding was amazing.The beach set up was spectacular,I´ve attended to others destinations weddings and definitely this is one of the most beautiful beach areas I´ve ever seen.
As a bridesmaid I had the opportunity to share with my friend the preparation of her big day, the romance team is the best, they are super professional and helpful, Massiel the romance manager did a tremendous job putting together my friends  wedding.
I totally recommend this hotel as the perfect weeding venue and for sure that my own will be there!!!

reviews.author: Puntican
reviews.title: Super Hotel, wie im Paradies
reviews.text: Super-entspannte Stimmung, hier kann man einfach toll Urlaub machen. Das Personal war wirklich kompetent, sehr freundlich und diskret. Das Hotel an sich ist wirklich sauber, das Essen schmeckt echt gut, ist immer frisch gekocht, lecker und es gibt eine Riesenauswahl. Es gibt viele Unterhaltungsangebote von Tanzen bis Tauchkurse, wenn man einmal Lust auf Action hat. Wenn man aber keine Lust auf Abenteuer hat, kann man sich super-toll im "Spa" verwöhnen lassen und andere ruhige Angebote genießen, wie z.Bsp.: Cocktail-Bar und Abendessen bei ruhiger Musik. Alles in allem: Es war wirklich die Reise und das Geld wert. Würden immer wieder hierher zurück kommen!!!! Dankeschön für die 2 tollen Wochen!

reviews.author: David_hs36
reviews.title: Experiencia Inolvidable
reviews.text:
i've had a wonderful time there, everything was perfect, thanks Massiel for all the help there, i found the place very professional and the people really know who to make the stay quite nice.
i absolutely will go back after that beautiful experience

reviews.author: Michelle_Hn
reviews.title: Great Vacation - Super Staff  - Can't wait to go back!
reviews.text: I spent a week at the Paradisus Palma Real and was so impressed. The resort was the best all inclusive I have ever stayed at. Fresh fruit, vegetables, fish (grilled to order), so many other great entrees and delicious desserts every day at the buffet, and 10 other restaurants for dinner. My most fun was participating in the dance lessons and exercise classes every day. The staff was patient and fun as they taught dances like Merengue, Salsa, Bachata, etc. Rodolfo, Joangel, Jose, Angel, Elizzer, and Yira spoke perfect English (among several other languages) and made my stay a blast. They taught dances and Zumba during the daytime and at night, after entertainment, they would dance with everyone. Wendy was fun for water aerobics and yoga. I certainly got plenty of exercise to keep up with eating all that great food! The bartenders were very kind and Ramon especially! My room was beautiful and spacious. Just like in the pictures. The bed was very comfortable. The beach was safe for long walks alone. Everyone was friendly who worked there. I can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: anabella d
reviews.title: An Amazing Experience
reviews.text:
The best experience that one can possibly have.
The amenities were superb, the food excellent and varied. The staff, waiters/waitresses, cooks/chefs, towel boys.
Thank you to Eduardo Perero Castro/the general manager, Henry Joseph from HotelBeds, Emilio Valdez/pool towel service, Fanny/wait staff, Yosely/wait staff, Joselo/chef-cook, Felipe Villas/waitstaff, Ambioris Marte/staff, Johair/waitstaff, Nelson/personal trainer at the great modern gym on the premises and all the other wonderful waiters, waitresses and staff whose names I wish I would remember.
Will definitely retuen sooner than later.

Anabella D. from Fairfield/CT

reviews.author: whitpan2moore
reviews.title: Great people, great entertainment, food ok
reviews.text: We had an incredible time at this resort! my only other tropical vacation like this was in Jamiaca, and although the food was better in Jamaica, the Palma Real did an exceptional job in entertainment at all times.  Drinks from our favorite bartenders Luis (don't know last name), Ramon Fuego, and David Garcia were top notch and they we so entertaining!  My favorite however who deserves an exceptional round of applause was Rodolfo Castillo who organized tons of fun activities included many great games of beach volleyball.  He was funny and personable, just a really great time!  We will definately we back again.  my only suggestion is that you switch the food up in the buffet more ofter.  I felt like i ate the same thing everyday.

reviews.author: Chris H
reviews.title: Total Perfection, from arrival to wedding to departure
reviews.text:
We simply cannot express enough how spectacular our entire week at Paradisus was.  The resort itself is a stunning masterpiece, with 5-star atmosphere, ambiance, decor, and service at every bar and restaurant we visited.

The pools (both Reserve and main) and grounds were immaculate, the music and incense that floated through the air in every corner of the resort was a great little touch, and the shuttle buses were always available (true, the resort is enormous....but part of what makes it great is that there are so many places to go, so many things to see, so much beautiful landscaping, and great paths to walk).

The rooms - oh my, simply beautiful.  When we booked in early 2012 we read that some rooms were dated and hadn't been renovated.  We had 29 guests stay all over the resort in different buildings and different room classes, and everyone's room was lovely.  From what we saw, the renovations are complete across the resort.

We enjoyed each meal we had in the different restaurants, although some people in our group noted on particular evenings service was slow.  The restaurants were busy, and in some cases I think the meals were being "paced" slower that guests would have liked.  From our perspective, even the buffets were excellent (and nicely varied from restaurant to restaurant and day to day).  One tip - book your a la carte dinners as soon as possible upon check-in.  Everything fills up quickly (although some in our group discovered that just showing up and "playing dumb" about their "missing reservation" typically got you a table within minutes.
Seating for large groups (more than 8) was challenging at the a la cartes, so we ended up splitting into smaller groups and either eating at different restaurants, or trying to book a few tables and just sitting together.
The Tepanyaki Grill, the Mexican Restaurant, and the Italian restaurant were favourites.  We ate at the new "not included" restaurant, and their tapas was fantastic.  We found that splitting one order of tapas was enough to enjoy it, and the meal was quite reasonably priced.
The a la carte night at Gabi Beach was really enjoyed by a number of people in our group 

There were lots of late night food options (maybe not "gourmet", but at 2 in the morning all you need is a piece of chicken and some salad anyways).

Free room service (with only a $5 delivery charge) was always available - a really nice touch.  

Nightly entertainment wasn't excellent every night, but at least they put on a good show.  I can imagine it is hard to entertain people from 4 to 90+ years old!
The hot spot in the evening was Gabi Beach - great DJ's playing late into the night, and often staff were out encouraging dancing and revelry.  The Red Lounge was a true nightclub experience.

The beach was gorgeous, with tons of beds (many different types and seating arrangements), but like all resorts everyone plays the "towel game".  A bit annoying, but my father solved it by just moving towels after an hour and taking the bed he wanted (and no one ever came by to claim them).

We were upgraded to the Reserve section - oh my.  Stunning room and decor, and the biggest jacuzzi tub we've ever seen (two people sitting comfortably without even touching each other).

And the service - outstanding.  We really didn't use it as much as we could have, but little touches like having room service make up the room while we were at breakfast (how they did it I don't know, we were only gone 20 minutes) was nice.  The concierges in building 38 were lovely, pleasant, and always helpful.

And then there were the unexpected touches....in room setup with flowers and champagne, petit-fours that would rival a great restaurant in Toronto, little congratulation notes, and even a hot bath drawn for us when we returned from an excursion (I still don't know how they figured out when we would return).

The wedding itself was absolutely perfect.  There are no words that can be used other than perfection.  Miguelina Martinez was our wedding planner, and she executed every details we could think of perfectly.  She was superb from start to finish.

The welcome cocktail party, last minute changes in venue for the reception dinner, our own centrepieces and table settings, nothing was an inconvenience for the staff at Paradisus.  The planners even sat with our families and reviewed all of the details with us as a group.  I noted that the planners were always on standby at each venue, making sure everything ran smoothly (which it did).  Thank you to each and every person involved in making our wedding a complete success!

Joaquin the resort photographer was fantastic.  Not pushy, but always making sure each detail was right.  We ended up buying 197 photos because we couldn't resist every one he had edited for us.

Paradisus exceeded our expectations in every respect, and we had pretty high expectations going in to this trip of a lifetime.  It boggles my mind to read negative reviews....for example, I've never been to a resort where everyone had such a great command of the English language.  Sure, they aren't native English speakers - they are from a Spanish-speaking country!
And check-ins will never be fast when two busloads of people arrive at the same time.  That's why there is a bar 100 feet away and lounge chairs everywhere - just relax and enjoy the start of your vacation!

reviews.author: Cath B
reviews.title: Le paradis
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné au Paradisus palma real et avons adoré notre semaine de rêve. L’hôtel était impeccable, il y avait toujours quelqu’un en train d'améliorer quelque chose ( peinture nettoyage de la piscine, du sol ou autre ). Tout était très propre et très beau. Nous n'avons vu aucun insectes en une semaine. Pour se qui est des divisions de l’hôtel, j'ai cru comprendre qu'il y avait 3 sections: 1- Palma real, qui est de base. vous avez accès a la plage de l’hôtel, mais la plage de la sections ''The reserve'' n'est pas très surveiller, vous pouvez y accéder sans problème. Les chambre de cette section sont très belle, souvent des suites avec jaccusie et petit salon. 2- Palma real Royale service, qui contient sa plage privée à laquelle les autre sections ne peuvent accèder. 3- The reserve, qui est située plus loin de la plage, vous devez donc marcher un bon bout avant d'y accéder, ou vous y rendre en voiture de golf. The reserve comprend ses restaurants privés qui, selon nous, qui n'étais pas mieux que ceux pour les autres. Les jardins sont magnifiques, la plage était aussi très belle et bien entretenue. Le service était exceptionnel, et la nourriture délicieuse, même au buffet. 

Les quelques petits désavantage de ce voyage fut la température. Il ventait énormément, tellement qu'il en était désagréable d’être assis sur la plage car nous recevions du sable au visage. Il n'avais pas beaucoup de jeunes a l'hôtel, les gens y allaient surtout pour des conférences ou en familles, donc ce n'était pas idéale pour faire la fête!

Pour le reste tout était parfait, activitées et autre.

reviews.author: Arno E
reviews.title: Luxus pur mit Abstrichen
reviews.text: Riesiges Luxushotel direkt am Meer. Die ersten Zimmer parterre rochen muffig. Im 2. Stock waren sie dann ok. Sehr geräumig und mit allem drum und dran. Betten sehr gut. Der Service lässt zu wünschen übrig. Nicht immer bekamen wir frische Handtücher. Oft funktionierten die Keycards nicht. Auch das für den RoyalService zur Verfügung gestellte Handy war nicht zum Laufen zu bringen. Das Essen in den Restaurants ist mittelmässig bis schlecht. Dafür ist das Frühstücksbuffet sehr reichhaltig und ausgezeichnet. Am reservierten Strand für die Royalen Gäste bekommt man Getränke und Ost, natürlich alles inclusive. Wilan funktionierte sogar am Strand.

reviews.author: katoul99
reviews.title: très belle endroit
reviews.text:
Nous avons payés 400$ de plus par personne en arrivant à cet hotel pour pourvoir avoir à la réserve, la réserve une autre section de l'hotel que tu peux aller, au lieu d'avoir la boisson dans un verre,tu peux prendre un 6 packs avec un sceau et de la glace, pour le vin au lieu de prendre une coupe et bien tu prends la bouteille, les resto sont bon sur la réserve, y a un coin enfants avec jeux dans l'eau, il y a un accès internet gratuit avec un endroit pour prendre café et dessert 24h.vraiment propre partout, autant du côté de la réserve que celui de l'hotel.
tout les resto à la carte sont bon.
seule point négatif, les réservations pour les soupers à la carte.....pénible.

reviews.author: 882Tee
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
My new hubby and I had the pleasure of spending two weeks at this resort.  We arrived a few days before our wedding guests and stayed an extra week to enjoy our honeymoon.  We had such a great time that the hiccups that occurred seem minor as I look back.  With that said, I will focus on the amazing staff members we came in contact with.

The one team that was consistently providing top notch service was the dining crew.  They gave us superior service from day 1.  They learned who our family and friends were (35 ppl) and took excellent care of them as well.   The hostess Kimberly Mercedes was extremely personable and kind.  She set up a special area in the main dining room just for us so that our guest could find us easily during any meal.  The servers learned our likes and dislikes and seemed to have a steady flow of the "likes" before being asked.  Thank you Domingo Jimenez, Carlos Trinidad, Kimberly and Yuderdui Javier, for making our stay with you such a pleasant memory.  The head chef, Juan was awesome also.  We arrived at the hotel starving but in between meals; not a lot to choose from on the buffet at all.  Juan was kind enough to prepare something fresh and of substance despite being in the middle of preparing for the dinner crowd and a huge corporate event.  Juan also oversaw the preparation of the food for our wedding reception and everything was delicious and flavorful.  Not always an easy task with a buffet!  Again, thank you for making my wedding day everything I hoped it would be.  All of you rock!

The Romance team was accommodating and created an environment of confidence.  They work well together and although there were a few challenges, overall they did a great job.  Thank you Mariela for making my wedding extraordinary and Massiel for doing all you could to ensure we were happy.

reviews.author: Rachel J
reviews.title: Treated like Royalty
reviews.text:
I always enjoy the beaches and lovely people in the Dominican Republic.  In addition the Paradisus is beautiful, great rooms, beautiful pool (both the royal service private pool and the main pool).  The royal service is very much worth it - the team went above and beyond to meet and anticipate our every wish.  I have also stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana (slightly older property -but same spectacular royal service and the private pool is even  nicer)

Several other resorts have tried to do a VIP service but none as successfully as the Paradisus properties

reviews.author: Alejandra G
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Fuimos tres amigas, todo estuvo estupendo. La personas que trabajan en el hotel son muy amables, Ramon Fuego barman del bar de la piscina muy simpático, Carlos chef del Palazzo personalmente hablo de sus preparaciones, Luis garzon del Passion se preocupó de todos los detalles. Los espectaculos muy entretenidos. Volvería de todas maneras.

reviews.author: Betsy_w61
reviews.title: Bets
reviews.text:
We enjoyed this resort greatly!  Bolivar Guzman went out of his way to see that all our needs were met.  We enjoyed a fantastic meal at Vento where our server Jose Ramos was very attentive. The Orbitz representative Hansy Gron Ramirez was extyremely helpful in explaining and helping us choose outside excursions.  
The room was modern and clean.  Housekeeping could have been done earlier in the day. We would definately return to this resort.

reviews.author: Mary R
reviews.title: An Amazing Experience
reviews.text: My Sister and I just got back from the Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana Dominican Republic.  We had one of the best experiences at this resort. The service was impeccable, the restaurants were amazing and the staff was to die for.  Our favorites by far are the bartenders at the Main Pool Bar, Ramon Fuego, Paulivo Bomba, and Martin Ciclon who never leave your drink empty and always are at your service.  (5 star service) I would highly recommend requesting some of these waiters who were amazing to us every night we ate. Felix Dela Cruz & Martin Frias Sunami at Vento, Juan Martinez at the Sushi bar inside Bana, and Manuel Saldarta at the Asian Bistro in Bana.  We paid the $25 per person one night to eat at Palazzo and were mind blown by the taste of the food.  We asked our fabulous waiter Hosse Sylvain to meet the Chef Carlos Srunq who came out to great us with the humbly.  Bar far would recommend this place to everyone

reviews.author: Diana D
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - beautiful resort.
reviews.text:
This was a large, beautiful resort.  Our travel dates were the first week of December 2012 and our group size was 8.  Upon arrival, my guest and I were upgraded to a one bedroom master suite, which was very comfortable with a living room area, but we did not need the dining room table, full-sized refrigerator or wet sink, however the TV’s in the bedroom and living room were nice to have.  On the other side of the suite, we had a king sized bed, a room with a large Jacuzzi tub and two sinks, and another room had a shower, toilet and a sink.  There was a hot water problem in the shower and with one call to the front desk, within 10 minutes, a technician arrived and fixed it pronto.  Our room did not smell and was very clean.

One evening, a member of our party ordered room service, and the food arrived on time, warm and well-presented.  The food was good at all restaurants and the only complaint we had was with the ones where a reservation was required.  The wait staff at these seemed to be in training and missed the mark on expedience with drinks, and the food received was not always that which was ordered.  We dealt with it and everyone had something they enjoyed.  Just make sure not to change your order and you won't be surprised!  There also seemed to be a problem getting a group reservation at some of these restaurants and several times we had the concierge make arrangements for us. The entertainment was outstanding in the lobby bar and there was also an evening show in the theatre.  

The hotel staff was very accommodating but some of them spoke little or no English, so at times they were difficult to understand.  There is a shopping mall with a Hard Rock Café at the entrance to the resort and they have a shuttle bus that will take you there or if available, a golf cart.  There never seemed to be a shortage of drinks at the Aqua Bar (swim up) and Ramon and Martin were very entertaining.

The beach was beautiful and there is a lot of it to cover for a walk.   Unlike other resorts I’ve stayed at in the DR, the seaweed on the beach was not as voluminous and you could actually get in the water without getting tangled up in it.  

Our group had a late flight and some of them were able to get a late room check out, however, we were not able as the staff said our room was to be occupied.  

The only negative comment I have is that room service sometimes appeared so late in the day, that we opted out and only asked for clean towels.  One evening they knocked on the door around 10 PM!

This resort is about a 15-20 minute ride from the airport.

reviews.author: BMelic
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Just returned after a wonderful week of relaxation in a beautiful setting.  Wonderful food, attentive staff and a very comfortable one bedroom unit.  Alberto Mercedes Ruiz, our concierge, met us each morning with a big smile and warm greeting.  He was more than helpful, making sure we had our dinner reservations made and ready to help with anything we might need.  This was my second time at the Palma Real and the friend I traveled with was very impressed with her first visit.  I look forward to my next visit.

reviews.author: Greg B
reviews.title: Best place to stay in DR
reviews.text:
Great resort, excellent food, and gracious service. Have returned again and again. 
You can't go wrong. Great for families or romantic getaway. Passion restaurant is one of the best I have been too. Gabbi beach restaurant is also great.

reviews.author: Mark R
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!!
reviews.text: This is one of the nicest resorts that I have visited, I loved it! There are beautiful pools, views, gardens, architecture, scenery. The energy of the entire place almost feels like you are at a spa, very calming and serene. There are lots of well-planned activites, and the staff is great! Especially Apolinar Santana who helped out a lot! Aesthetically it was by far the nicest resort I've been too... the food was decent, but definitely not a highlight. Several restaurants were good, but overall the food was only okay. Overall, I definitely recommend it, whether for business, pleasure, honeymoon, wedding, or just a getaway. A great experience.

reviews.author: Patrick_G
reviews.title: The worst food I had in 15 years...
reviews.text:
...and the best dinner I had in the Dominican Republic at the same time...!!!
The positive point is the Passion restaurant (with $40 extra charge) : excellent, even if still not worth a Michelin Star like they try to sell it; I will write a specific review for it.
Nice gardens, nice pool and nice beach. Pretty OK rooms, but we stop here for the good things.
Our first room was a little bit smelly (like many in most of the all-inclusive hotels in Punta Cana), but still OK. We had a problem during the night, hearing big and strong water noises, and waking up in the morning we discovered a lot of water in the bedroom itself. In the evening it came back, but this time we realized that the black waters of other rooms were escaping from our bath tub, shower and toilets (see pictures) !!! We called the reception and they did not seem very surprised, just telling us that they would come asap to transfer us to another room on the second floor. One hour and 6 phone calls later, we were still waiting for the bellman for the transfer, missing our restaurant reservation.... The day of our depature we also waited more than 50 minutes to have our luggage picked up. It is a deep feeling that the whole hotel management is very bad and unprofessional, and the service is very poor.
But the worst remains the main buffet restaurant : the (very small) buffet room is really ugly, the choice is so limited that it looks like a real joke and I don't speak about the food. It is just totally UNACCEPTABLE to serve such food in a so-called "5*" hotel !!! My university restaurant was 100 times better !!!
Paradisus Palma real used to have a good reputation, but some years ago. It is now one of the worst managed hotel in the area, and the food is really not acceptable.
Just AVOID !
Two months ago, we tried the Riu Palace Bavaro, which for a lower price gave us 10 times more !

reviews.author: Rita A
reviews.title: OH MY GOD!
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, amazing service. We had Feliz De la Cruz as our attendant/waiter and he was fantastic! Great place for a vacation. If you want to be surrounded by nature, beach, excellent food and amazing service, then I would definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: pulgitaRepentigny
reviews.title: excellent choix
reviews.text:
Bonjour tout le monde, je sais que ce n'est pas récent car j'ai voyagé au Paradisus Palma Rel en septembre 2012 et je n'écris que maintenant mais.. vaut mieux tard que jamais!!
J'ai adoré l'hotel pour plusieurs raisons . Nous étions 2 femmes et c,est un hotel ou il y a beaucoup de famille et couples alors pas évident pour nous. Le service est impecable à tous les niveaux et la gentillesse des gens m'a beaucoup frappé. Ce que j'ai adoré c,es que personne ne nous a sollicité pour du temps partagé et cela n'est pas fréquent en République!! El la deuxième chose c'est que même hors saison le service et le choix de repas n'a pas diminué.Un clin d'oeil particulier aux gens de l'animation et corps de ballet entre autres jose manuel gonzalez, Elieser Robles Henrriuqe et Maria Cecilia Arias Reyes. On aurait pu s'attendre à du harcelement puisque nous étions 2 filles mais pas du tout! Ils nous on aidé sans aucune arrière pensée. Cela aussi fut très apprécié. Beau sejour et merci Paradisus!

reviews.author: mkbrown87
reviews.title: Very Good Value for the $$$'s
reviews.text: We spent the week here with some other couples celebrating a 50th birthday.  This was not our first all-inclusive, but we had an enjoyable week.  The weather was disappointing (windy all week--had to cancel our snorkeling and scuba diving trips), but was warm and mostly sunny.  The property wasn't that crowded at all, so we were able to enjoy just hanging out on the beach or by the pool.  I have to add that Ramon Fuego was the King of the Bartenders, while Gloria was the Queen of the Bartenders.  Actually, they are really what helped make the week as good as it was--the service was phenonmenal.  This was a smaller property than we are used to, and, as such, there weren't as many choices of restaurants or bars or activities as usual.  All in all, had a good week, but with 2 times having bad weather in the Dominican, we may not return, but it certainly isn't because of our experience at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: dina w
reviews.title: THE RESERVE-MAIS PAS ASSEZ.
reviews.text:
J ai passe une semaine du 17au24 NOV 2012. En réservant, j ai du paye un surplus pour être dans section Reserve avec mon cousin. l accueille a la réception par MR DIAZ LILIAM était excellent. J avais réserve une chambre avec jacuzzi, a mon arrive on m a informe que c chambre n existe pas avec deux lits, j ai demande de mes trouve deux lits, et il m ont demande de paye un souplement c que j ai refuse. sur ça je remercie beaucoup MR STERLING LEONARDO de main lobby Paradusus suit qui travaillait la nuit de m avoir aide a change de chambre le lendemain pour avoir les deux lits. Emilio a la piscine reserve est  vraiment gentil, souriant,travaillant,comique. (MIKE TYSON) Un petit qui siffle comme un oiseau est fou aussi.Les femmes de chambre font un travaille remarquable... j étais dans le bâtiment 37 vue piscine. 
+vous allez passe bcp de temps dans l autre section au main lobby.
+vous avez bcp d activités compris et gratuit a la plage mais personne de va vous en parle!!
POSITIF: la beauté ,les arbres,les employés.
NEGATIVE:pas de nourriture, pas des ICE CUBE dans le bâtiment(5$).

reviews.author: karatemamma
reviews.title: I would definitely go back.
reviews.text: One of my best trips ever! The resort was absolutely stunning.  I loved seeing the live pink flamingos in the tropical garden.  The grounds were very well maintained despite the torrential down pours we had a couple nights in a row. The beach was gorgeous although I found there to be too much seaweed in the water. We’re more pool people which by the way was enormous. It seemed endless.  The pool was clean and spacious. There were copious amount of beds to lie on, in the water, around the pool and on the beach.  Some of the chairs could use a new liner, many were torn.   Our suite was lovely, clean and well furnished. The airport was 15 minutes away. They offered amazing workshops at the resorts.  The first one I attended was the sushi making class.  It was instructional and interactive but unfortunately not hands-on. Maybe it was too big of a class.  We got to enjoy the food but it’s all inclusive and sushi was offered at lunch and dinner anyway so I decided to skip the other workshops (flower arrangements, candle-making, dance lessons, finger painting and paint brushing).  What a mistake I wish I had done the finger painting. The guests made gorgeous mini paintings.  They looked so professional. It would have made a great souvenir.  So the following day I went for the paint brushing workshop.  I got there 15 minutes early and the class was already full.  What a disappointment. There were only 5 easels set up as they didn’t have anymore.  There were many more people who were equally disappointed when they arrived after me. JoAngel was a great activities guy and he felt bad he spoke with the instructor but there was nothing that could have been done. I stayed and sat with the group anyway and they produced such amazing canvas paintings. I tipped the instructor and kept his painting, so I was happy but not really satisfied. I would much have preferred to make my own. The employees were genuinely super nice: restaurant servers (Wilken a Aqua was super), cleaning ladies and bar tenders (Ramon – was amazing). Fernando was a sweetheart too but then again everyone was amazing. I loved the food!  We ate each night at a different a-la-carte restaurant. Everything was utterly delicious.  A little salty a couple times but absolutely delicious. We never had a chance to try the buffet for dinner because of all the other restaurants, but for lunch and breakfast it was good.  I ate lots and there is enough variety. I don’t eat that well at home for lunch and breakfast so I can’t complain. Too much variety so you can certainly end up eating excessively.  There was a problem with leaking in the wash room during the heavy rains but I just laid some towels down an all was well. The closest door was broken but useable and half way through the week the light by the night stand got ripped out of the wall. I assume that happened when the cleaning lady was making the bed. I clearly left the wire coiled there to be fixed hoping that it was have been fixed at some point during my stay but that didn’t happen so I mentioned it upon checkout.  It’s a resort for relaxation not wild parties. Although there was volleyball there were not other real games or activities with guests. It was quiet and classy. I definitely would go back.

reviews.author: Raquelita_11
reviews.title: CHFI Trip-a-Day Winner - Nov 10th to 17th, 2012
reviews.text:
Hubby & I had won a trip with CHFI (Toronto) radio station along with 33 other couples/families. This hotel is classified as 5 stars & rightfully deserves the rating. We stayed during off season, so hotel was only at 50% capacity.

Property: There are 3 sections to the hotel; Royal Service (Adults only), Reserve (Families) & Palma Real (standard rooms). Our rooms were in the Palma Real section & did not see the need to upgrade. The overall property & amenities were spectacular & reception staff was always helpful and friendly.

Rooms: The bedrooms were quite large & luxurious with sitting area, small walk-in closet equipped with bathrobes, slippers & umbrella. We had exceptional maid service all week. Wi-Fi was spotty in the room & blackberry tablet only connected well in the lobby. Smartphone would connect with no problem whatsoever.

Beach: Great expanse of beach, but ocean was weedy due to nightly downpours we encountered almost daily.

Restaurants: Only one buffet; Naos restaurant was opened due to low season & breakfast was adequate but repetitive. The dinner buffet on Dominican night was disappointing & not up to 5 star standard. There was a lack of info regarding which Ala carte restaurants were available to the group, so we only dined at the following: Vento (Mediterranean), Bana & Mizu (both Teppanyaki). We missed out on Gabi Beach (Steak & Seafood) which we heard was excellent. The ones we ate at were very good & had great service at these restaurants.

Activities:  A big shout out & thank you goes out to the Animacion team of Angel, JoAngel & Jose who worked hard all day making our stay so much more memorable. The hotel offered different activities we had not encountered at other hotels we had been to (finger/oil painting, sushi making, cigar rolling, sand castle building etc.) I participated in as many events as my schedule would allow & enjoyed them all. 

Shows: The theatre shows were average, but Retro/Disco night & Beach/Fire night were loads of fun. Missed the Michael Jackson show as we checked in late on Saturday night. However, we thoroughly enjoyed the live bands & dancing in the lobby prior to & after the shows. Thanks again Animacion team for the daily dance lessons so we could practice every night in the lobby. 

In closing, I would like to comment that we have on several occasions vacationed at the Riu chain of 5 star hotels, but PPR is the real deal with no comparison. 
Besides meeting a whole bunch of new people & forming new friendships we were very appreciative for the opportunity to stay at PPR & hope to visit again sometime in the future.

reviews.author: smckeon
reviews.title: Great pool bar service
reviews.text: Just returned from this beautiful resort.  Spectacular beach and accommodations are wonderful even if you don't stay in the Royal Service rooms.  The attitude of the waiters and bar staff are incredible.  They are very, very personable and make the dining experience a fun time no matter what meal.  The best bartender is at the main pool bar, Ramon Fuego was fantastic.  His service was outstanding and his social skills were excellent.  He certainly added the "fun" to the pool bar atmosphere.

reviews.author: Monica S
reviews.title: Incredible vacation
reviews.text: I've been in this hotel 3 times and it's getting better ever. The service is perfect, employees are always very polite and helpful. They are very kind and always ready to serve you. The rooms are always clean. The hotel atmosphere is nice and cozy. The beach is simply fantastic.  Is a perfect place to vacation.

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: Gorgeous, Relaxing, Fun, Modern, Top Notch Resort
reviews.text: The view when you walk into the lobby is breathtaking of both the resort and the beach.  Huge white sand beaches with tons of palm trees.  Cabanas on the beachfront and around the pool were great.  Pool area, beach, rooms, hotel areas palatial and gorgeous.  Service very good with very few exceptions.  Many restaurants with great food and service except service at Thai  place (Bana?) was very slow and food ok, the Market Grill food was not as good as others.  Japanese was outstanding, as well as grilled lobster at the buffet (best quality buffet for all three dinners; no nice cruise line I have been on came close to this food)and grilled lobster at Gabi Beach were outstanding.  Bars used top-shelf/high quality liquors and daily drink specials were good; few bars ran out of bar basics and could not make your drink; ex: no lime juice or no bananas.  Room service good.  Stocked bar in rooms was good.  Staff was very responsive when jet in shower popped out of wall and when TV remote did not work.  Maid responded to all requests.  Activities crew was awesome; Joangel, Angel, and Elizer(sp?) were so nice, energetic, and Joangel remembered our names and came looking for us when activities were starting!  Couldn't asked for a nicer  person to lead all activities. The Michael Jackson review was unbelievably good.  Again, just as good or better than the good cruise ship entertainment.  It's hard to find much to complain about.  The concierge would always make dinner reservations for our group of 8 at 9 or 9:30.  WAY too late for me.  We made it earlier a few times.  They also really push you to attend their "Club Melia" talk, which we were not interested in, but we would definitely return to this resort in the future and would recommend it to anyone.  We are 50, but enjoy younger people, and met numerous couples in their 20's and 30's, as well as people our age (we were with a pretty "young" acting group; we still think we are in college sometimes I think!)

reviews.author: mjscuba
reviews.title: Perfect Stay!
reviews.text:
I will apologize in advance for how long this will be! We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real November 2 -11th! We had the VIP package by booking through the hotel website. I must say that their customer service was excellent prior to check in, we were traveling on a girls trip, and one of us was delayed a day due to hurricane Sandy. I was still allowed to check in, even though the reservations were under my cousins name. I felt perfectly safe being there my first night all by myself. With the VIP package we had access to Gabi beach, and restaurant, plus 15% off all spa services, and a slightly larger room than normal. I will break up the rest of the review based on different categories.
CHeck in: I was whisked away to the VIP check in area, was checked in very quickly, and up to my room in no time! I was brought a welcome cocktail and a fruit plate up to my room, My suitcase was delivered a few minutes later!
The Room:  3rd floor, one king bed was pretty comfortable, not too hard or soft, a view of the ocean through the trees, large tub, nice shower, and walk in closet! There are glass doors on the shower and water closet, so privacy can be a bit of an issue, but it wasn't as bad as we thought it would be. AC worked really well!
Room Service: We ordered room service almost everyday for breakfast, and almost every night for a late night snack! Breakfast was always good, Dinner was hit or miss, one day it was good, the next, just ok. We ordered champagne to our room each night, which was a really nice treat! 
Pool: The pool was really nice, plenty of loungers to lay on, great place to cool off.
The Beach: We spent the majority of our time at Gabi Beach on one of the Bali beds. We had the same waiter everyday, and I feel terrible, I do not recall his name :( He was amazing, always remembered what we were drinking the day before, and even had out bed all set up for us with towels and pillows when he knew we were going to be back the next day!  The first few days the water was very cloudy and weedy, I think this was mostly due to the hurricane that had just passed, the next few days the water was much clearer!
Bars: The lobby bar was our favorite, as well as the bar just outside Naos buffet! A huge Thank you to all of the ladies we sat and chatted with each night! The Pool bar was fun also, however we found a lot of rude people at the bar (not the employees, but the vacationers)
Restaurants: Dinner at the main buffet was ok, nothing special, but slightly better than normal all inclusive buffet food. Breakfast and lunch were much better. Bana Bistro was amazing, no complaints there, as well as Bana Hibachi, that was very good as well! Gabi beach was excellent for lunch and dinner, we thoroughly enjoyed eating there! Vento was ok, probably wouldnt eat there again. Aqua was good, but our favorites by far were Gabi, and Bana!
Spa: We did not do any massages or anything, but being VIP we had free access to the spa, we did their Water Ritual which was amazing! It was so relaxing, a very peaceful place!
Activities: We went parasailing, It was amazing! we booked through the hotel and had to get a ride about 5 miles down the beach, being 2 single females, we weren't very comfortable with that. I would suggest just talking to the dive shop right next to Gabi beach and setting it up there, its the same price! We did the candle making class, and the cigar rolling class, they were fun!
Entertainment: We only saw the Cirque show, and the Michael Jackson show, which were pretty good!
Nightlife: There was not alot of night life at the resort, but thats not what we were there for, we were in bed pretty early each night! The red lounge was busy one night, but it is pretty small.

Overall, we had an amazing trip, everyone remembered our names, and treated us like royalty! I would definitely go back, It is a beautiful resort! There is so much more, but I think I covered the basics. One of the best all inclusives I have been to! We did tip, it seemed much appreciated, but mostly just having good attitude and being nice to everyone went a long way!

reviews.author: Cathy430
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: This resort is one to return to again and again!  The service is wonderful, the people are amazing, the rooms are spacious with good sized balconies, the pool is fantastic, the beach is the best I have ever had the pleasure of lounging on!  The food at this all inclusive resort is really very good and the variety is endless.

reviews.author: Wayman H
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: We are just finishing a 7 day vacation here, very nice! The staff are so attentive, the food is great, the grounds are very well kept, lastly the rooms are very spacious and clean. We would return in a heartbeat to this resort, thanks to all the staff for making us feel so welcome....

reviews.author: scott b
reviews.title: First trip to the Punta Cana
reviews.text: This resort was more than  I ever expected. The architecture is beautiful and this place was clean as could be. The views from the main lobby out to the beach are amazing. So many places to sit and and have a drink it was so easy to relax. The only down side would be  getting reservation was a bit tough. After multiple conversations with the front desk we got our reservations and were suprprised to see many empty tables ?? so if you find yourself not getting into to restaraunts keep trying there are tables available. The highlight of the week was our friend Ramon Fuego he was OUTSTANDING !!! He treated us as if we were the only people there! Drinks were delivered , drink were ready for us when we got the bar ! this guy was amazing and was a huge reason we had such a good time he is a valuabel member of the hotel !!!!!!!  Fuego !! Fuego !!!

reviews.author: squeenwhite
reviews.title: welcome
reviews.text: this is ma first time to visit this hotel it was good , i went with ma friends, everyone had a great time so many thing to do, were just relaxing on the beach , playing valleyball on the swimming pool, we had a best breakfast,best lunch and dinner. love the intertainment every night. overall- great time had by all!!!!

reviews.author: Mary S
reviews.title: Great vacation - once again!!
reviews.text:
This is our third trip to this resort - twice with kids - once with friends-
Everyone had a great time - so many things to do, or just relaxing on the beach or the pool - we had the best drink service and great assistance from the pool waiter Francisco Estrella - he was always there helping us with cabanas, towels or drinks - we could really count on him to take care of us!!! The food at the resort was good - best meal was at Passion - however, I didn't appreciate having to pay an up charge of $40 per person to eat there since for 8 of we already spent $6500 for all inclusive - all their restaurants should be that delicious!!! Overall - the food was pretty good and the drinks were always good - love the entertainment every night. - always something for everyone - while I didn't come here to gamble, the casino isn't that great - the spa was terrific, as was golf - overall - great time had by all!!!

reviews.author: Luis G
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text:
This was my first time at Paradisus Palma Real!, i have been in others hotels, but, this vacations were amazing. RAMÓN FUEGO AT THE POOL BAR, CLARI AT THE LOBBY BAR, GLORIA AT THE BAR NEAR THE NAOS RESTAURANT, were the people than makes this few das here really amazing....

If you want to come to DR, try Paradisus Palma Real.

Enyoi it!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Angie B
reviews.title: Impressed Once Again!
reviews.text:
This is the 4th time I have been to this hotel and they seem to impress me every time.
From the minute you arrive at the Palma Real you can see and experience the the most friendly and proffesional staff anywhere! The property is spotless and absolutly breathtaking!
The resort has gone through many renovatons and it is one of the most beautiful resorts I have stayed at!
want to take an opportunity to recognize some of the staff from the hotel especially the Royal Service department!!! Jeuri Ferreira (Butler) , Leandro, Samuel, Domingo, Smerlyn (Palazzo Restaurant) Ornie and Juan (Lobby Bar).
The Animation staff was amazing but I do recommend they add more to the team because it seemed these guys were working all alone most times since there was so much to do and not enough bodies to go around :(  Dance lessons, Beach Volleyball etc need more than one member of the Animation.  Also there wasn't much communication on the events going on during the day.  Water aerobics only was offered twice during the week. Congrats on the nightly shows they were amazing.  My recommendaton is if the guests are enjoying the live band or DJ in the lobby and dancing it was sad to see it being closed down even though there were so many who still wanted to dance and not go to the Red Lounge (Jose, Angel,Elizer,Maria and Henry (Animation Staff).
Thank you Sarah (RS lounge) , Andrea and Reyes (Groups) for all your help and making my stay once again unforgettable.  Ready to book my winter holiday again.  Will see you soon to all my friends at Paradisus Palma Real.  Besos!!!!!!

reviews.author: mytalyho
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Royal Service with Yomalyn Balbuena as our service consultant and Juan as our Butler made our vacation exceed our highest expectations. The resort is absolutely amazing and I fell in love with the Paradisus everyday. Since I was there during my birthday, they prepared so many surprises for me during the day. Rooms are very spacious, staff eveywhere were very gracious, beach, pool, and grounds are breath taking.  Golf at Cocotal was an enjoyable experience.  I felt like I was in PARADISE.

SF

reviews.author: AileenMardez
reviews.title: PARADISE INDEED!
reviews.text: Hand's down one of the BEST resorts I've been to.  Paradisus Palma Real exceeded my expectations and kept me in awe the whole time I was there.  The property is beautiful and pristine, the rooms are spacious and clean, the food is superb but I think what makes this resort truly Paradise is the AMAZING service.  From the moment I walked in to the time I left I felt I was courted to the max.  I encountered personal issues (like misplacing my passport) and everyone was more than willing to assist.  Camilo Pache is one of my favs! by far one of the most professional, nicest and humblest humans I've ever met! Thank you Yessica Perez (VIP lounge) for assisting me as well. The Bartender Luis and "Fuego" were amazing entertainers, Victor M. Colen was a great waiter, at one point I felt the wedding planner Massiel was my friend!, Wilson Beard and Julio (receptionist) were extremely resourceful and our night cleaning lady Maria Mendez made me want to live in my room forever!! This is not the type of place you go to party in, its more of a relaxing vaca.  However leaving with a smile on your face and remembering every last detail is the meaning of paradise!

reviews.author: doris a
reviews.title: magnifique
reviews.text:
i was in Punta Cana for a week, at the Paradisus and everything at the hotel was perfect. as it is low season, the service was wonderful, as the barman at the pool, Mr Ramon Fuego!

I appreciate every moment at this hotel. quiet, absolutly clean, veru good meals, and the perfect Passion, a wonderful restaurant.  thank you all!

reviews.author: ohiofoodluv
reviews.title: great hotel few improvements to make perfect
reviews.text:
We went with a large group and extended our stay a few days.  Beautiful hotel and the Royal Service is a great add.  I didn't think we would use the lounge but it was a nice AC break before dinner.  There were so many nice adds in the room like beach bags, lotion, toothbrush, all very nice touches.   The butler was handy when we could find him.  We have been to a number of all-inclusives and this was in our top two even though my review may sound a bit negative,  I asked for a comment card at checkout and they recommended trip advisor which I already use.   A few minor updates would make this resort top notch and thought I would let management know as they monitor this site. 

Room -  was great.  We had issues with our bathroom flooding due to all the fancy buttons/options in the shower.    The big complaint was we were lucky to have a nice ocean view but the chairs on the balcony were cheap and uncomfortable.   This probably isn't important to most but I love sitting and relaxing on the balcony.  

Food - overall was very good for a resort.  The desserts were not great for people with a sweet tooth but the rest of the food made up for it.   A few friends didn't like the Market Grill and be aware when booking the Asian restaurant (Bana). See my tip note.   With the Royal Service the Palazzo restaurant is very relaxing and great food presentation but similar food and way more options at the buffet.    We did the extra upgrade to Passions restaurant and really enjoyed it.   Some of our friends weren't too impressed but think we may have talked it up.  

Staff - like other reviewers the staff was ok.   Mostly I felt we were bothering them and we are consistent tippers.  The worst was the sunset bar, for the upgrade bar I thought that staff should be a bit better.  I realize it wasn't busy season but the main bartender was texting quite often.  One day at Palazzo, the restaurant was empty but  a staff member was standing in the corner  a few feet from us talking loud on his phone for a good 20 minutes.   More pool and beach service would have been nice too.   

Drinks - the beer was cold but the mixed drinks were mostly watered down and you needed to find a bar with a slushy machine to get a good pina colada.   The margaritas at the sunset bar were very nice. 

Excursions - although not related to the hotel thought I would comment.  We did the Outback Safari, it was a nice trip and educational...we felt a bit trapped to donate and buy items at many of the stops.  The half day trip would have been perfect.  We did a snorkel trip with a big group, it was fun.  The beginning was about snorkel the rest was a bit of a booze cruise.  The floating bar was a great staff member with beer on a life preserver!  Made us laugh.

reviews.author: Sharon T
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Just returned from this beautiful hotel and all the previous positive reviews are true.  Juan Castillo was our butler and he was always available to make the vacation the best. In fact all of the staff, restaurant, beach, spa, golf-- all there with a smile and to make a vacation a memorable one  We even had a private tour arranged .  Thanks to all

reviews.text:

reviews.author: PenelopeMarseille
reviews.title: amazing staff + beautiful resort = Paradisus
reviews.text:
(sorry for my bad English)

This is my first review and I want to do it because they deserve it.

PARADISUS PALMA REAL IS A MUST! I mean, the resort is stunning, the rooms are nice and spacious, the beach is clean, the food is really good and the spa atmosphere really makes you forget about home/work/study…I could keep talking about the resort for 10 pages but I won’t because in fact there is nothing bad to say about this hotel. It’s just amazing. But there is one thing that really brings this resort to another level:  the employees. They are SO nice, polite, respectful…They really treat you like family. They are working really hard and you can see they like their job. Whether to solve any of your problems, to make the perfect dinner or to entertain you at the pool they’ll do whatever it takes to make it perfect.

Vladimir Rodriguez and Emannuel at the customer service
Kelvin Feliciano, Anthony Diffo and Ricardo Canela at the naos restaurant
Maria , Rachel and Leo (the dancers)
Eliezer Robles , Angel Alcantara , Jose Gonzalez, Henry Heredia and Stalin Brito  (the animation team)
Ramon Fugeo at the pool bar

These are just a few among many others. They push their limits to serve you better and to make you enjoy your vacation. This is the difference between a great hotel and a good hotel. So I find it important to name them because we are coming back next year mostly because of them.
The good reputation of this hotel is based on the hospitality and kindness of the staff.

Had a great trip!!!

reviews.author: Francesca T

Trinidad, Robert Ubri, Saudy Sanchez, Jose Vargas sin palabras la atención de ellos, personas súper humanas siempre a la orden, muy alegres. Se me escapa muchísima gente por nombrar pero que de igual  manera son trabajadores excepcionales. No tengo queja alguna , volvería mil veces al Paradisus realmente es un Paraiso, Gracias por todo!!!

reviews.author: AprilMo
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation with friends
reviews.text:
If you get nothing else from reading my review, remember to upgrade to Royal Service. It is by far worth the minimal extra cost. I traveled to Paradisus Palma Real from August 22nd through August 29th with my boyfriend and another couple. We were fully anticipating to have our vacation ruined by Hurricane Isaac but fortunately we were spared. I will try to keep this review as organized as possible as I've found that to be helpful in reading other reviews.

Service:
The quality of service provided under Royal Service was exceptional. Our butler, Tayrone Menor, was so friendly and helpful from the moment he greeted us and showed us around the resort. Anything that we needed was provided very quickly and always with a smile. He was always leaving snacks and surprises in our room which was a nice treat. He absolutely made our trip special. We also experienced wonderful service in most of the restaurants, certainly Palazzo, the Royal Service restaurant but I will get to that in a minute. Our breakfast server, Smerlyn, made a point to learn our names and preferences for the week which added a nice personal touch.

Room:
We had a junior suite on the first floor of the Royal Service area. I would normally be apprehensive about a room on the first floor as I had read that they can be musty but we had no problem. It was clear that it had been recently renovated as many of the nearby rooms were under construction. Sometimes housekeeping didn't come until mid afternoon but we were always at the pool or beach so it didn't bother us at all. We always had our mini fridge refilled and fresh towels available, never a problem there. We were also provided with three bottles of alcohol upon our arrival which was a nice touch.

Grounds:
The resort grounds are impeccable. There is always someone cleaning or painting to keep everything looking nice. Both pools are nice but we preferred the pool in the Royal Service area as there were many kids staying in the other side of the resort and we were looking for a more relaxing vacation. It seemed like mostly families in the main part of the resort and honeymooners on the Royal Service side. We still had a great time but I wouldn't necessarily recommend this place for a friends vacation. Be sure to reserve a palapa by the pool and you will not be sorry. We used this as our home base throughout the day to get out of the sun and read, play cards, or nap. With the constant light breeze off the water, it was always a perfectly comfortable place to rest. The beach was beautiful and also had palapas to relax under. The beach within the resort and the one directly next to it had 24 hour security who would prevent solicitors from approaching guests. However, when we walked past the the security, we were quickly harassed by local vendors trying to convince us to visit their shops. They were very aggressive and would not stop until we were back on the resort beach. As someone who likes to walk along the water, this was disappointing to me but I know that is outside of the control of the resort.

Food
The food overall was pretty good but got a bit repetitive as all inclusives sometimes can. The best restaurant was Palazzo with the second being Gabi Beach. We tried a few of the others but after having one particularly lackluster dinner, we decided to stick to our two favorites. Be sure to get the chocolate lava cake at Palazzo. We certainly had our fair share while we were there. A few of us experienced some minor digestive discomforts but we were never able to pinpoint the cause. It certainly wasn't a deal breaker but I thought it worth mentioning.

Spa
One especially cool amenity included with Royal Service is access to the Yhi Spa. Even without purchasing a spa treatment, we had access to use the facilities at the spa, which we did daily. These included multiple hot tubs, a cold tub, water massage, and a steam room. We thoroughly enjoyed relaxing here especially when a storm was rolling through as we could look out over the pool from the protection of the covered hot tub. We also purchased a couples massage which was wonderful. They took us out to a private hut back away from all of the noise of the resort and once inside, all we could hear was the wind. It was absolutely lovely and worth the extra cost.

Activities:
The resort offers a number of activities and evening shows for guests. We didn't participate in many of the activities because there were lots of kids usually involved and we were looking for a different kind of experience. We did do the free snorkel trip which was arranged through our butler. They didn't tell us this but you must wear a tshirt under your life vest so come prepared. The trip was decent for a free trip but the reef certainly seemed over snorkeled. I would do it again but I wouldn't pay for it. We also went to a few of the shows at night and enjoyed the Michael Jackson show quite a bit. One thing I would recommend is to ask your butler for an activities guide when you first arrive so you can plan to participate in the activities that interest you. One other thing of note is that we tried to do a cocktail making class at The Reserve and were told that we were not allowed to participate so don't waste your time making the trek up there. 

Overall we had a great week and enjoyed our stay at Paradisus. I would certainly recommend friends to visit but I don't think that I would return only because I like to see new places. Also, the solicitors on the beach were a bit of a turn off when we traveled so far to see the beach and the beautiful water. This resort is a great value when you consider all of the benefits you get from Royal Service.

reviews.author: J A
reviews.title: El mejor resort de Punta Cana!
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real es un resort de lujo con un servicio al cliente excepcional. Desde la llegada al hotel, el trato y esmero de sus empleados, las atenciones, la comida, la playa, piscina, los bares, restaurantes y shows nocturnos son espectaculares. He estado en varios resorts en Punta Cana y definitivamente este es el mejor. reviews.author: Rossana T

reviews.author: capavamo v
reviews.title: paradise and amazing service
reviews.text: My cousin had his wedding at the Paradisus Palma Real and it was the best experience ever.  My husband and I felt as if we were on a second honeymoon! The property was big enough for us to have some time alone away from the other guest.  The main pool was the meeting point for the wedding party during early afternoons until dinner.  Ramon, the bar tender, made it exceptionally fun and entertaining for us to be there...  he was very attentive  and made sure our cups were always full!!  Overall the service was on point, the place was well kept and the view just breath taking.  It was like Paradise!

reviews.author: LY2MP
reviews.title: Best Service, Amazing View
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in July. Upgraded to Royal Services, had wonderful service but my ultimate favorite was the service I received at The Palazzo. Everyone was friendly but the best service received was from Richard Ortiz. He always had a pleasant demeanor, a smile on his face and was attentive to our every need, even before we realized we needed something. Richard always remembered our favorite food & drinks. When I go back, I will be requesting him personally and hope to bring him home with me, I love Richard Ortiz!

reviews.author: cispat
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds/service, but the food was just ok
reviews.text:
We just returned from a wedding here.  The grounds are beautiful, the beach and pools were gorgeous, and our room was amazing!  We chose the Royal Service and quickly realized this is the only way to go if you're planning to stay here.  All of our friends did the standard all inclusive package and they were stuck eating the bland food at the included restaurants.  We quickly realized that the only good food was located at Gabi beach and Palazzo, neither of which was included in the standard all inclusive package.  Plus the wonderful butler service included with the Royal service was what made the Royal service really stand out.  Our service was excellent when going through Jose, our butler.  Even if the phone wasn't immediately answered, he or another butler called the provided royal service cell phone back within 1 minute of hanging up the phone.  Jose handled all our questions and brought surprises to us at least once per day (fruit plate, cheese platter, chocolate covered strawberries, prepared Jacuzzi with pretty flower petals...two different days!).  He arranged our private dinner on the beach (excellent food, but definitely an extra cost) and made sure to introduce us to the covering butler since Jose was off that day before our dinner started.  He told us from the beginning that he didn't want a tip unless we felt he deserved it at the end of our stay.  He totally deserved it and we were more than happy to tip him on our last day because he is the reason why our stay was so great!
The other areas of the resort were mostly friendly and helpful.  Our first night in Bana was a little rough as we were part of a rehearsal dinner part.  The staff didn't bring me and my husband our drinks and in general were not helpful.  We went to the sushi bar after the dinner and the chefs seemed annoyed, but once they saw us tipping, then they were very attentive.  The rest of our stay the staff was very attentive and helpful.  Everyone said hello and almost everyone was more than happy to let me attempt my Spanish to communicate.  We spent a lot of time at the pool bar, Royal service bar, and lobby bar.  The bartenders got to know us and were always very good at keeping our drinks full.  Ramone at the pool bar was by far the most memorable!  He remembered what we were drinking the day prior and made sure to get us our drinks ASAP the following day.  He even put my husband's drink on his head and ran it all the way over to him in the Royal service cabana.  Whenever he'd see us walking by the pool bar he'd call us by name and offer to prepare our favorite drinks.  
The exercise room was great, open nice and early so I could get my work out done.  The spa at the Reserve was great as well as the water ritual at the Palma real.  I did prefer the reserve spa as the space was so pretty and the cabanas there were heavenly.  
We did have 1 day of no power for over 6 hours.  No blended drinks, no AC...it was annoying, but per the staff, this never has happened before...a generator was down?  It was a bit annoying and the pool wasn't filtering, but it kept us cool.  The ocean was actually very warm that day, so the pool was more refreshing.  
The room was beautiful, but humid at times.  Our bathing suites never dried the entire time we were there.  This is to be expected, given it's almost 100% humidity there this time of year.
The wi fi is pretty spotty, but I expected this, so it didn't bother me much.  Also, I could go to the Royal service lounge whenever I wanted to use their MACs to go online. 
Overall we enjoyed our stay, but I have to say that the food was a big disappointment.  I will not likely return because of this.  I feel that for the price we paid and our comfort with tipping, we would get the same service at any similar resort for the same price...and maybe the food would be better.  If you're not a foodie/food snob, this resort will be perfect for you!

reviews.author: SILVIA F
