reviews.author: anthony_sexyboy
reviews.title: es brillante
reviews.text: es uno de los hoteles mas bellos k existe y el serviio es excelente muy ameno y con una buena variedad de comidas y bebidas la playa es exquisita la arena blanca el agua color azul turqueza las parmeras bien relajantes y sombreadas los cocteles muy buenos la sonrrisa de las pesonas te roban el corazon y es muy cerca de los lugares exoticos de la isla caribena

reviews.author: Sheila A
reviews.title: Best Trip Ever!
reviews.text: I have been to Punta Cana 2 other times previous, but my stay and experience at this resort was by far the best.  The resort is beautiful and the professional lighting strategically placed around the resort was spectacular; the candles placed around the lobby and bar gave a gorgeous ambiance. The service we received was first class all the way.  Starting with Peter Frias, our personal concierge, who gave us impeccable service and attention by giving us a tour of the resort, making all of our reservations and being available for any questions we may have had.  The food was delicious with a myriad of selections. Our waiter, Joel, was superb.  He served us breakfast at Naos and Bana and was the consummate professional who gave us excellent service and made my trip very special and one I will cherish always.  Last, but not least, Ramon Fuego was great.  He made the bar exciting and fun. You must try the spa!!! All around excellent…can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Andre L Sidou
reviews.title: A resort experience
reviews.text:
I had never been much fan of resort all inclusive kinda trip, but I have to confess that this resort and it's services and personal has changed my view of it , in a very positive way.
We had the lucky of having Janic Santo as our concierge for the 10 days that my friends and I was staying there. Janic 's professionalism and kindness really suprised us , even when we asked for a last minute change of reservation for dinner on the restaurants of Palma real. If you get the chance to have her as your concierge , you won't regret.
Of all the restaurants my favorites was Mizu, with good sakê and food, the performance of the cooker Adolfo was also very entertaining. 
Acqua restaurant has a delicious tomato soup with vieiras, we had the pleasure to have Wilkin as our "camarero" for the night, excellent service and deserved a good tip.
The host of the main restaurants, self service buffet,  called Karen is such a character and it's good to be "friends" with her, the fast way to get a table.
Baba restaurant has not a amazing food but the sushi and sashimi are good, to compensate the bar serves caipirinha's.
I am back home now and pretty glad that I chose this resort for my holidays.

reviews.author: JackieAZ87
reviews.title: Amazing Girls Trip!
reviews.text: I celebrated my "21st" birthday at the Paradisus Palma Real the first week of August with my sister and best friend and we had a blast.  We upgraded to the Royal Service package, which was totally worth it.  From check-in to check-out, the service was outstanding and no kids were allowed in that area of the hotel.  Our days at the Royal Service pool made our trip.  Nelson, the bartender at the Sunset Bar there, and Francisco, the pool concierge, as well as the rest of the Royal Service pool staff, went out of their way to show us a good time and take care of us.  We were also assigned our own personal concierge, Carlos de la Cruz, who was the best.  He made us dinner reservations every night and even escorted us to the restaurants most nights.  Being three girls travelling alone, he also looked out for us and made sure we were safe and taken care of, which we really appreciated.  On the actual day of my birthday, Carlos and Francisco surprised me by decorating my chair at the pool with balloons, flowers and a sign.  They had even created a design with the towels to make a heart!  It was really sweet and everyone really helped make that day special for me.  Later that day, we were surprised with a beautiful cake and chocolate covered strawberries that Carlos had brought to our room.  All in all, it was the perfect birthday celebration trip and I couldn’t have asked for anything more.  I would go back in a heartbeat just because of the Royal Service staff alone, but the fact that the resort is beautiful doesn’t hurt either.

reviews.author: 99steve73
reviews.title: Great Group Gathering
reviews.text:
First let me say that I had read literally over 100 reviews of the Paradisus Palma Real before we took our trip which made me a little nervous.  Some of the reviews scared me regarding being hounded for timeshare purchases and slow or poor service with mediocre food.  Forget all of that.  THIS PLACE IS GREAT!  What I would tell anyone reading this review is that if you are someone looking for a great vacation with really good food and outstanding service then this resort is perfect for you. And it's up to you as to how relaxing or exciting you want to make it.  I do have to qualify the review in that we upgraded to Royal Service upon arrival and I don't regret the decision one bit.  After using our resort credit, it worked out to less than $50 per person per day which I feel was well worth it.  

We celebrated a friend's birthday with a group of 14 people and didn't have any problems with a group that size.  I'm certain that having our butler, Ramon Avila Garcia, attending to our every need from dinner reservations to late night snacks made it much easier for a group that size, but more on Ramon later.  

Check-in at the Royal Service lounge was totally laid back with a fantastic view and even better drinks.  We were greeted by super-friendly staff and waiters at every turn.  I was eager to work on my Spanish and every single staff member we encountered was more than happy to assist. But, be sure that almost everyone there speaks fairly fluent English if it's of any concern for you.  

It was a relaxing experience from the word 'go' and just got better as the trip progressed.  
Our group arrived over the course of 3 consecutive days and we were able to get rooms relatively close to one another with just a simple request.  Our room was ready by the time we were done checking in and Ramon led us through the resort giving us the details to every aspect from restaurants and bars to pools and spa.  Ramon handled our mini bar requests, pillow menu, dinner reservations, deep sea fishing excursion, trip to the local gift shop down the beach in a private van…pretty much anything we could possibly think of was covered by this unbelievably helpful and service oriented individual.  It is safe to say that Ramon Avila Garcia was instrumental in our group’s overall love of the resort.    

There were a few other individuals that made the trip great as well.  Nelson at the Royal Service pool along with Martin and Francisco (Que lo que, mis amigos) took care of us all day as we hung out and enjoyed the infamous ‘dos amigos’ as well as ‘coco locos’ and many, many Presidentes.  Never a shortage of covered palapas or sunbeds for our entire group.  Beach sand was like powder and I really think there were more beds available than total guests that could be accommodated by the entire resort.  The wet area of the spa which included steam room, hot tub, cold plunge, massage shower etc. was included as part of Royal Service and it played a key role in clearing my head on a couple of self-induced hazy mornings.  Again, really great.  

We had a standard room, 3097,which was still great with a huge and ridiculously comfortable bed, giant jacuzzi tub, multi-jet shower, air conditioning that got the room so cold I actually had to turn it down at one point and I like my room really cold.  No problems getting our mini bar replenished, extra towels and pillows, incense for the room...anything you wanted.  

Our group ate dinners at Palazzo(our overall favorite, awesome, awesome food) twice, Passion (great French food), Vento (very nice) Gabi Beach (very long dinner but also very good food) and Bana’s Asian Fusion (good not great).  We had lunch and breakfast at just about every available option and were never disappointed in any of our food.  

We spent just about every night dancing in the Red Light disco and had a great time meeting people from all over the world.  I got some dance lessons from new friends from Puerto Rico and we had an absolute blast everywhere we went whether it was the lobby bar, aqua bar, or just hanging out in the main area outside the restaurants and casino.  We even got one of the waiters near Aqua bar to carry over 16 coco locos to the Royal Service pool as that bar had already closed.  It was that kind of service we encountered everywhere we went.  I never felt pressured to tip but did so because I truly feel the staff had earned it.  Never, even one time, was I approached or pressured to purchase a timeshare.  

The best remark I can give is that I would go back to this resort in a heartbeat.  I’ll request Ramon as a butler again without hesitation.  And I’ll have another great vacation in Punta Cana.  

Thanks to everyone at the Paradisus Palma Real for making our vacation such an enjoyable time.  
(Sorry about the long review, but if you're reading countless reviews like I did, I wanted to give you as much info as possible.  Hope it helps!)

reviews.author: Amy L
reviews.title: FUEGO, FUEGO, FUEGO
reviews.text:
We had an awesome week at the Paradisus Palma Real.  I read these reviews religiously before our trip and I wanted to give the fair and unbiased review that I hoped I was reading. For context my husband and I are in our 40's and traveled with friends.

Check In - Upon checking into our room it was discovered that our sofa bed was broke. As we had checked into the resort through RCI expecting to be able to sleep four adults this was not going to be acceptable.  After an hour and several unacceptable attempts to remedy the situation we ended up just paying for a second seperate room.  We were not offered a discount but were "upgraded" to VIP status. Which in essence gave us access to Gabi Beach.

Room - We had the one bedroom master suite, king size bed, pull out sofa bed (broken). Large kitchen area and large refrigerator, dining room and balcony.  The kitchen and large refrigerator made little sense to me as the only thing in it were soda, water and beer.  Seemed like wasted space to me.  Other than the sofa and kitchen we were very happy with the room.

Food - We had zero complaints in the food department. Keep in mind that you are in the Dominican and they have different preperation methods and all will be fine.

Activities - We were there to relax so did not partake in very many activities but we really enjoyed the Michael Jackson show and the Fire Dancing on the beach.  We also went parasaling.  However our mornings were spent at the beach and our afternoons at the pool bar (Aqua).

People - Out of all of the people we interacted with at the resort Ramon "Fuego" is beyond a doubt the single most valuable employee this resort employs.  He goes out of his way to make you welcome, he remembers your drink and has it ready for you the moment you walk/swim up. He even went out of his way to make dinner reservations for us one day.  If any one thing were to make us pick this resort specifically on our next trip to the DR it would be him.

Spa - We did the one hour relaxation massage and it was very similar to the states.  The steam room/ cold water therapy is a must!!

All in all it was an amazing trip.  We stayed in the main hotel area so really cannot speak to how kid friendly the resort is or is not but we would have no problem taking our 7 year old daughter with us to stay here.

reviews.author: Cyndi V
reviews.title: BEYOND DISAPPOINTED
reviews.text:
I was so excited about coming to Punta Cana for our friends wedding and to enjoy our time in through photos online what seemed to be a luxurious hotel. 
GROUNDS: Upon arriving the hotel looked very clean, hotel design and decor beautiful. However, there was no AC in the lobby or throughout the entire hotel with the exception of restaurants and our room. The humidity level is @ 100% which means your clothing is soaked by the time you arrive to the elevator or stairs.. 
ROOM: Our room is beautiful! Clean, decor is amazing very tropical and luxurious.. 
SERVICE: This was the most disappointing of all you're never asked if you need assistance, however you have to ask and BE PATIENT cause your going to have to wait a LONG time before you receive what you requested. 
ROOM SERVICE: 24 hr room service (what a joke) called @ 7 am for a 1/2 hr no one answered the phone. Called front desk they promised they'd communicate with room service on my behalf and get back to me. 9 am after no return call we were at the market grill eating from there poor selection. Following day tried room service again no answer spoke to the front desk which took my order and I was so excited as I'd finally get to have a nice breakfast on the balcony.. (Wrong again) 1 hr later no bkfast called complained 1 hr received COLD bkfast. (SMH) 
ALL INCLUSIVE: Beware you are easily identified and the staff will not attend to you as they assume you won't be tipping.  
POOL: There's no service, no help by the pool.  You'll die of thirst.. And by 1:30 there are no TOWELS.. 
I've never been to a hotel were I was made to feel as if I had to make the staff happy.  The staff will literally stare at you before greeting you or heaven forbid ask if they can help you. Needless to say I will NEVER return. Furthermore I have cut our trip short. We're out! I'd rather spend more money to leave than stay here!!! From this experience I will never return to the Dominican republic there are many other places to visit. 
This hotel should be named SERVE YOURSELF RESORT...
 I recommend the Fountain blue in Miami, Atlantis paradise island, Sheraton in Cancun, Marriott Orlando, Continental hotel Puerto Rico. 
Before I leave you LOCK your doors when you're doors as many barge right in 3xs to be exact! For those who have written great reviews all I can say is I don't know where they were staying on these grounds. 
Someone call Hotel impossible this place needs help... and that's an understatement!!!

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
Having previously travelled to DR, I knew exactly what I did not want to experience on my vacation. My previous experience involved a lot of haggling and negotiating for something as simple as dinner reservations. The grounds were too large--trying to get back to the rooms at night was like trying to get a helicopter out of Saigon in 1973 :)

I chose the Palma Real and the Royal Service because I wanted a more intimate and personalized vacation experience. I cannot fully express how pleased I was with the service the Palma Real offers to its guests both royal service and not!

The staff is beyond pleasant! Each morning began with a  sincere Buen Dia, from the grounds crew to the pool staff, everyone smiles and seems genuinely pleased to be working at Palma Real. 

As a Royal Service guest, you are given a personal butler to handle all the ins and outs of your vacation. My friends and I were blessed with Agustin Nunez. On our arrival Agustin greeted us at the Royal Service lounge, toured us around, carrying our small bags and explaining all the resort had to offer. He answered our questions both silly and serious. Each day of our 6 day trip, Agustin would find my friends and I at the pool, beach, or more commonly the Royal Service poolside bar and tell us about our reservations for dinner or a night event. He ensured that we were content and not in need of anything. Agustin also mde our spa appointments and ensured our transportation to another side of the resort. Agustin made our trip so pleasurable, chatting with us and introducing us to staff.  Also, Agustin got us reservations for a poolside cacbana twice (there are only 8, we were lucky). On our check-out date, Agustin met us at our room, which he called our home when we arrived, and hugged each of us so warmly. We genuinely bonded! Agustin, you were awesome!!! Gracias por todo.

Lastly, there are other members of the staff that deserve recognition for their amazing hospitality and warmth: Wilkin our first poolside bartender was so much fun but sadly left for his own vacation after our first day. Francisco, Martin, and Manuel chatted us up daily. Nelson, our poolside bartender had the best laugh EVER and never let my beer get warm. And last but not least, Pedro, one of the most amazing employees. There was nothing Pedro would not do for us on the beach or at the pool! He took such great care of all of us. 

I cannot wait for a return trip to visit all my new friends! The Palma Real gets relaxation.

Although this trip was one of the best of my life, there are a few things to keep in mind: portions in the restaurants are gourmet and service is "slow." Americans are horse-like in their appetites, I adjusted to island pace easily. Also, there is little to no AC in the hotel common areas. If there isn't a breeze, pin your hair-up and put on some extra deodorant--you're bound to sweat. Nightlife for singles is almost non-existent, but after drinking and eating all day, sleep by midnight was welcomed.

While I am glad to be home, my memories of the Palma Real will keep me happy for a long time to come.

reviews.author: alijade02
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go!
reviews.text:
What a great resort!  We stayed in the Roral Service section of the hotel and had Ramon as our butler.  He went above and beyond and made our stay exceptional.  He is awesome!!

The only negative feedback I have is when we checked out.  The woman who checked us out, Santa Sanchez, was extremely rude.  She needs to learn that the customer comes first and her attitude needs to stay in check!!  The resort otherwise would have received a 5 star rating from me!

reviews.author: duffychatham
reviews.title: Excellent Trip!
reviews.text:
We recently visited Punta Cana and stayed at the Paradisus, Palma Real for 5 days and 4 nights.  We had a great time! Here are comments by different categories:

Property  - The property is not large so everything is pretty close (unless you stay at The Reserve, which has the king size beds and connecting suites). It you stay there you'll need to take golf carts to the main hotel and the beach.  Otherwise, it's very easy to get to the restaurants, the beach, the lobby, etc from your room. The landscaping is beautiful and everything is kept very clean and well-maintained.

Food - I've been to 2 other all-inclusives (Dreams in Cancun and Melia Caribe in Punta Cana).  the Palma Real had the best food by far.  I consider myself a picky eater but i thought the options at the buffet restaurants were wonderful for every meal,  including but not limited to made to order omelets and eggs for breakfast, chicken/beef prepared hibachi style for lunch,  grilled fresh seafood, as well as the usual hamburgers and hot dogs.  There were many other choices as well.  I just bring these up because you could get freshly prepared food, even at the buffet restaurants.

When you check-in, go to the concierge's desk and make your restaurant reservations for every night you are there.  This is very important, so you get to eat at the other restaurants, other than the buffet restaurant.  For dinner, we ate at the Market Grill and Vento.  Both were very good! 

Beverages - the beverages for the kids are the usual.  The lemonade was not that good, tasted more like the margarita mix.  but if your kids are happy with water or soda, you'll be fine.  The frozen drinks (pina colada, daiquiris, margaritas, etc) were not that great.  I think it had to do with the mixes they used.  The wine was pretty good and we didn't upgrade to the royal service. the beer was good.

Service - the service was great.  Of course, if you leave a tip and the bartenders/waiters get to know you, the service is even better.  Get your beach towels early.  By 3 pm, they had run out of towels for the day.

Accommodations - the rooms were very clean and updated.

Beach - the beach was very clean and it was not crowded. You should get to the beach early to reserve your palapas, as they are claimed early.  the water is very calm, no surf.  There was a lot of seaweed though.

Other - If you are interested in snorkeling, there is a boat that goes out at 11 am and 3 pm and it's no extra charge for hotel guests.  However, i would make the reservation when you check in, so that you can get a spot.  We were not able to go because it was booked every day.  I think there are only 25 people on the boat at a time.

Entertainment - there were shows every night that were fun to watch. Latin Fusion Night, Michael Jackson night, 80's night.  We attended the Michael Jackson show and liked it.  There's also a bunch of bars throughout the property that were very fun!

We took a zip line excursion with Canopy Tours.  It was very safe and i highly recommend it.  it's an 1-1/2 hour trip each way and then you are there about 1 hour doing the zip lines.  Lots of travel time but i thought it was worth it.

Check in time is 3 pm, so if you take an early flight, I would pack a bathing suit bag separately so you can enjoy the beach/pool while you wait for your room to be ready.

I would definitely return to this property!

reviews.author: Alejandrina I
reviews.title: EXCELENTE ATENCION
reviews.text: El lugar se soñado!, la ambientación señorial... la música en los jardines.......etc.super recomendable..........gracias!!

reviews.author: mmiron_2000
reviews.title: Paradise at Palma Real!
reviews.text:
I stayed at Palma Real (Reserve) for 6 nights. The purpose of the trip was my best friend’s wedding! And it was honestly the BEST EXPERIENCE EVER! Wedding Planner (Rosa) was sooo professional and made sure everyone had everything they needed.

RESORT: Absolutely amazing, with well kept beautiful  grounds. So much work goes into maintaining everything at the highest standard. The beach was unbelievable/warm water and various water activities to take advantage of (snorkeling, wind surfing, catamaran, kayaking, etc) Since we stayed at the Reserve we were able to use a private beach (with actual beds on the beach) with Gabi Beach Restaurant (open for breakfast, lunch dinner). Totally worth it!

ROOM: Unbelievable unit – apartment style with a terrace and Jacuzzi outside, with very modern amenities and design. The room was cleaned twice daily! Fridge was restocked every day. 

SERVICE: 5 stars!!! Everyone goes above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need.

PEOPLE: Huge thank you to everyone who made this trip so unforgettable. The staff are  sooo professional and caring. Special thank you to GREGORI at the Reserve. Your customer service skills are impeccable. 
 
FOOD: Definitely recommend Gabi Beach Restaurant – amazing view/right on the beach and great food – lobster tails, superb! Naos Buffest is also a great option for breakfast/lunch/dinner. There is always so much variety and changing menu every day! 

ENTERTAINMENT: Every night, there is always either a show or live performance. On one of the nights there was a show (latin dancing) and live band afterwards, so plenty of opportunities to practice salsa/bachata/merengue.  There was also a fire show/dancing right on the beach a very unique experience! If you are into clubs there is a lounge/club close to reception at the main Palma Real resort which just opened up a week ago. Big thank you to the DJ for spinning the best songs and making every night better than the last!

OVERALL: Highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real! (5 stars all across). Will definitely be back to this paradise! Please message me if you have any questions about the resort.

reviews.author: MabelNYC
reviews.title: Outstanding Service!
reviews.text:
The Palma Real is a beautiful resort but what made my vacation incredible was the service and attention given to me and my travel mates.
Francisco Estrella (poolside attendant) was already with a smile, towels, and drinks to keep us cool. Sonia Joseph (housekeeping) went above and beyond what should be expected.  She made our a room a pleasure to return to each evening.  Carlos Trinidad, Carlos German, Isaias, Anthony, and Richard (waiters) made every meal enjoyable. They always had smiles to greet us and were always accommodating.  If we asked for something that was not on the menu or in the buffet, they made attempts to find what we asked for.  Overall, the staff was friendly, attentive, and professional.
I would go back to this resort and recommend it to anyone who wants to stay at a beautiful resort and be showered with attention.

reviews.author: Monica W
reviews.title: Leaky roof, stolen earrings, 10 days of diarrhea
reviews.text: First of all, I want to clarify my rating- I gave this hotel a "terrible" rating because when a hotel is labeled as a "5 Star Hotel", I have certain expectations. I'll start with the positives- the property is beautiful, the architecture is amazing, the beaches are perfect, the hotel is very clean and the staff is very friendly. However, this hotel fell short in all other areas- ESPECIALLY SERVICE. Upon arrival we checked our bags to be delivered once we checked in. Once I turned in my ticket to the gentlemen who checked the bags, they stated it should be between 10 and 15 minutes before they were delivered. It took over an hour for the bags to be delivered and I had to wait because my swimsuits, coverups and everything I needed for the beach was in the bag. I understand that is a huge property, so I tried to not let that spoil my first impression. As I looked around the hotel room, the room was immaculate. Honestly, I don't think I have ever stayed at a hotel that clean, and I have stayed at many top rated hotels. After I spent the day at the beach, I came back to a hotel room that had huge puddles and a leaky roof. A pipe had broken in the room and I called the front desk to address the problem. It took 30 minutes for someone to show up. The gentleman's name was Antonio and he conveyed the severity of the problem to the front desk over the phone. (He spoke in Spanish not realizing I am a fluent speaker and he made it clear I was not overreacting) Once he got off the phone,  Antonio said that someone would call me when the issue was resolved. I asked how they intended to call me, seeing as how my cell phone was not turned on. He told me he couldn't answer that, but not to worry- the room would be fixed. When I asked who would be fixing the pipes, he responded that he didn't know. I asked if he could find out a timeline as to when I could expect the problem to be fixed and who I should follow up with should the problem not be fixed. Antonio said he couldn't answer those question, but if I was Royal Service, THEN he could help me. Two hours later and nearly an inch of water on the floor later, I called the front desk. The man at the front desk said they were working on getting someone to fix it. I then walked across the property and demanded my room to be changed. I had to speak to TWO different people before someone FINALLY decided that I deserved to have a clean, dry room. I did not ask for an upgrade. I did not ask anything other than what I paid for (clean, dry accommodations)and it took 3 hours and 4 different staff members to actually get that. Day Two was a lovely day, except that the food wasn't very good. It wasn't awful, but it was not of good quality. It doesn't seem to be kept at proper temperatures while on the buffet station. You can see the "sweat" on the cold deserts and cheeses. The flavor of the food was similar to cruise buffet food. The exception was the Italian restaurant- where the food was delicious. The Asian bistro had food similar to Panda Express. I had different expectations. The food also seems re-used. I stayed at the resort because a friend of mine got married there. The day following the wedding, the buffet style restaurant was offering the SAME EXACT food that was served at her cocktail hour. This may have been a coincidence, but considering the fact that the wedding had over 100 guests and we all thought the same thing, it was a bit disturbing. The rest of the stay was fine. The beaches were amazing, the staff was friendly, the pools were lovely and the casino was fun. HOWEVER- KEEP A CLOSE WATCH ON YOUR CHIPS. My friends and I all had the dealers make "MISTAKES" and "ACCIDENTALLY" take our chips when we won hands. The day before check out I had my first issue with diarrhea. (Sorry to share, but it really has been an issue.) I never drank the water, I never used the water to brush my teeth, yet 10 days later I am taking antibiotics  because I am STILL suffering symptoms. I am not sure if is caused by the poor storing of re-used food, if it was caused produced being washed in the tap water, or what other things could have caused this- BUT I am still dealing with it. LASTLY, on the day of check out I noticed my faux diamond earrings (with real gold backings) were missing. I thought perhaps my husband had packed them or maybe I had packed them in a different bag. Because they were fake, I did not put them in the safe- even if I  was leaving the room. I know I did not leave them behind because I am a woman of habits and I always placed them the same location( on the dresser) when I took them off.  Also, my husband did a thorough check of the room to make sure we didn't leave anything behind. However, I am VERY hesitant to ever accuse anyone of theft, so I emailed the hotel to see if someone turned them in as a "lost" item or "left behind" item. It has been 6 days and I have not had a response. SO- basically I would never return to this hotel, even if it was free. I had a good time because it was a family and friend filled trip. I was there with over 100 people whom I have known my entire life, so we had a ball. HOWEVER, in addition to the ridiculous price we paid for a "FIVE STAR HOTEL" I am also out the $100 earrings, a $50 co-payment to my doctor's office, $15 for my prescription for my antibiotics and of course the time spent frustrated that getting what you paid for was nearly impossible at this hotel.

reviews.author: loulabelle123408
reviews.title: Perfect Trip June 10-June 15 2012!
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Punta Cana and I was a bit leary about where we would stay.  Thankfully, we found the perfect resort.  From the beginning at check in, we could tell that this resort wanted people to feel comfortable, accomodated and have fun - which we certainly did!  Room, pool, buffet, restaurants are beautiful and spotless.  Nightly theme entertainment was enough and fun to watch and join in with dancing.  Would like to mention the following employees that made our vacation a great experience and also made us want to visit the Paradisus Palma Real again and again.  We met so many nice, fun employees that we can't remember what each one did, but here are there names:  Garnier Pierre Paul (gave us a tour, made restaurant reservations, helped us with excursions and kept track of our "schedule"), Ricardo Canela (our waiter each day at the bufffet who took very special care of us), Louis Savarino (another waiter who also made us feel special), Ramon Fuego (bartender and able to carry drinks on his head and took time to make sure we always had a drink at the pool), Gloria Rodriguez (also from the pool bar and always smiling and happy and ready to get us something), Maria Ortiz (she was at the coffee cart every day and always happy to see us and serve us something special), Yubekis and Angel ( the best dancers and entertainers that entertained us and made us want to get up and join in the dancing and fun.  They have boundless energy!),  Victor Felix (another great bartender with a smile).  There was also Aneury Rojes Pasantes, Luis M D'Oleo, Isaura Garcia, Gissel Matena, Apolinar, Marcos Florentino.  And, Reunaldo Cabrera (the bartender by the buffet) who made us his "special drink" on our last day there, which if I had known about on the first day, I would have drank it everyday of our trip!  Thanks to all of you for making our stay a fabulous experience and we hope to see you all again one day soon. We highly recommend this resort if you want to go on vacation, make new friends, go with the flow and have fun!  This is not for stuffy, stuck up people who look to find fault.  This is for people who want to enjoy their vacation.

reviews.author: Novis S
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
I had the wonderful privileged of being the maid of honor is my friends wedding at Paradisus Palma Real last week. There were about 12 of us on our flight. We took a red eye Monday evening from Arizona and arrived in Punta Cana around 11:30 am on Tuesday. When we got on the property, we were instantly blown away at the beauty of the property. It felt like we were in the Garden of Eden. It was very green and lush, the sand was white, and the water was warm. There were flamingos on the property, that was cool and very unexpected. The staff was exceptional. We always had wonderful service. I have to give props to Jose and Anjel, two of the best activity coordinators! We took dance lessons from them on the beach and had an instant connection. We saw them at all of the events...latin dance night, the fire passion dance party on the beach, etc. The food was pretty good. We ate at the Market Grill our first evening there. Most people ate steaks and raved about them. I'm not much of a steak person but I had shrimp and it was delicious. We also ate at Vento, which was resort upscale, and delicious. The atmosphere was great and the food was very satisfying. All of our other meals were at Naos which was a buffet. The food was good but after a while, I was ready for something new. When preparing for the wedding, the staff was great. We got ready in a bridal suite. Then they lead the wedding party (which was just the bride, parents, maid of honor/best man, her son, and the flower girl) to the beach for the wedding. The ceremony was gorgeous and very short. The cocktail hour was fantastic and the reception was one of the best receptions I've ever been too. Overall, I'd say this was the best wedding I've ever attended in my life and that says a lot since the movie 27 dresses was based on my life! I highly recommend this property!!!!! 

My only suggestion is to wear plenty of sunblock and stay out of the sun. Coming from Arizona, I figured I would be fine with the sun. I wore sunblock and I was in the sun but in moderation. I ended up getting sun poisoning. I had a horrible heat rash spread across my entire body (except the parts that weren't exposed to the sun where my bathing suit covered). I was violently ill the night before the wedding. Again, my suggestion is to protect yourself! Remember that even though it doesn't feel hot, the sun is in full effect because its closer to the equator and the sand is white which, from my understanding, reflects the sun. Just be careful. You want to enjoy your vacation, not be sick during it. Over all, two thumbs up! :)

reviews.author: Karen R
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
This Resort is a great place to spend a relaxing vacation.  I am not typically a fan of all-inclusive resorts as I find them to get boring after a few days.  However, this resort had AMAZING entertainment/shows every night with beautiful and energetic dancers, and not only was it never boring, but I looked forward to the entertainment every night.  Everyone we ran into in this hotel was friendly and helpful.  As for bartenders, Danny Romero was hands down the best bartender at the place -- he made great drinks, you never had to wait, and he has a great personality with a sense of humor that would keep you laughing all day.  We stayed at the Reserve Section, which I recommend spending the extra money to be in because the service and facilities are much nicer.  The pool, restaurants, and rooms were all very well kept and we had no problems.  If you have children, they have an amazing Kids Zone with a great staff.  Every child that went into the Kids Zone for a day was begging their parents to return.  Overall, a great experience.  I look forward to going back again.
Karen R.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.text: Our trip would not have been the same without the amazing staff at this resort.  Ramon fuego and Luis at the Aqua bar were entertaining and made excellent drinks.  Jose gonzales on the activities team made sure that we always had a smile on our face and that we knew what we could next.

reviews.author: Estef_SR
reviews.title: Ramón Fuego y Luis Fueguino :)
reviews.text:
Acudimos de vacaciones unos días para desconectar del trabajo y claramente lo logramos.
Todo el personal era encantador, en especial el camarero del bar de la piscina, que siempre te recibía con una sonrisa, y un rápido y eficaz trabajo: Ramón Fuego.

reviews.author: Okey1
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Awesome resort with Excellent Service. Front office staff was very helpful during check-in and check-out. Food was outstanding. The service from Ramon Fuego at the Pool was one of a kind. He was attentive to all our needs and made us feel at home. 

I'll be back!

reviews.author: Marc M
reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text:
This place will not disappoint. The only bad thing that I can say is that the casino had lopsided blackjack rules.  Great beach, great grounds, huge clean pool, everything you want at your finger tips. The staff is ALWAYS smiling and friendly.   

I went down with a group of guys for a bachelor party trip and it was great. We did have to leave the place to find nightlife, but was not a problem. 

The rooms were amazing. Extremely pleasantly surprised.  I thought they had messed up my reservation since our rooms were so nice.

reviews.author: Lstidis
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise!
reviews.text: We just recently visited the Paradisus Palma Real & it was absolutely gorgeous!  The resort grounds are beautiful & always in perfect care.  It is extremely clean.  Everyone who works at the resort is very polite & courteous and willing to help.  We upgraded to the Royal Service for an extra $99 per night/couple - it was well worth it.  With this package you receive your own person butler - ours was Juan Castillo and he was fabulous.  He consistently went above & beyond to make sure our stay was perfect.  Juan was in charge of making our dinner reservations, helped line up an outside excursion, he even met us at our meeting time for the excursion to make sure we were taken care of and that all the details were covered, Juan booked all our spa appointments, had chocolate covered strawberries & fruit delivered to our room, drew up a bubble bath in our jacuzzi ... and the list goes on.  Juan really made us & our friends feel special!  With the Royal Service we also received a cell phone that we could receive unlimited incoming calls on - it was perfect for us to communicate with our kids back home in the US & to call other friends at the resort with whom we were traveling.  We also felt the food was wonderful - definitely not your typical all-inclusive buffet.  We would absolutely stay here again!

reviews.author: 1Worldtraveler1984
reviews.title: Great Bartenders!
reviews.text: One thing that was a constant was two of the bartenders at the resort. Nelson from the lobby bar and Ramon Fuego from the aqua bar are both great men who always greeted me with a smile and remembered what and how I like my beverages. I was not impressed with the food and the dress code was ridiculous for the quality. Most of the staff were nice but there are some exceptions, If they did not see your wristband then they would ask questions. This is a resort that caters to the middle aged people and there is little to do and not alot of younger adults around after 11pm. On the other hand the beach was wonderful and the amenities were nice. It is interesting that there were several different levels of "all-inclusive" stay, it seems that if you upgrade to at least the reserve level then you have a couple more options for dining and also a private beach section. If i was to visit this establishment again I would either hope that they would lower there price to get more people into the resort or upgrade the quality of the food.

reviews.author: candido a
reviews.title: Fun in the DR
reviews.text:
Trip from 4/27 to 5/4.
 The resort was beautiful and the service was very good.  The food in the buffet I felt was better than the food in the restaurants. Portion sizes in the restaurants were small. My friends enjoyed the restaurants more than I so it depends on your preference. We had the royal service package of which I recommend highly. They attend to all your needs and then some. As in all of life, it was'nt all perfect, but I would return there.

If you are planning to play golf, Cocotal Golf and CC is located across street and is fun to play. It has three nines, Habiscut, Benjamina, and Bouganvillea. The course is wide open.  The course offers a challange for all levels of play. Bouganvillea is the toughest of the three with a costant wind in the face and long fairways.

reviews.author: oliverMichigan
reviews.title: Ramon Fuego Saved The Trip !!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that It is not a 5 star hotel in my opinion. The food was average, Not even the Special restaurants weren't anything more that average, and the service was not anything special. I was having a 3 star hotel experience until we met Ramon Fuego at the Pool Bar, Ramon, Luis, Victor and Bianca made this hotel a better place, wtih Ramon Jumping around with Drinks on his head and making people Drink Fuegooo!! He's the only reason to come to this hotel!!! 

Bottom line this hotel is overpriced, But if you have the Money Ramon is well worth it !!!!!!!

reviews.author: Shepsys
reviews.title: Unforgettable trip. I love this country and people
reviews.text: Hello, i am from Ukraine, my name Anastasiya)  We came for couple weeks for usual AL relaxing vacation and it was our first visit to DR. Have choose hotel because of advices of our friends. It was just enough for me to be on Atlantic oceans beaches and i did not expected anythings else except  amazing nature. BUT the hotel was gifted us most amazing impressions of our trip!!!!!  its was just sooooo much fun there!!! A lot of different handmade lessons, crazy and passionate lessons of their local dances, gym, yoga, pilates etc...If i would visit them all every day i won't have free minutre to just lay and relax and i was crazily close to it)) My best wishes and just positive impressions of our Animation Exelenteee)) guys! They rocks! and made me fall in love with their guys))) Want to advice next guys for girls who love to dance salsa, bachata, samba and other dances : Eliezer Sealin, then tall guy Gabriel (sorry, don't know his surname but you will recognize him coz he looks like Adriano Chelentano, but just a little darker:)))  Also great guys who entertained me and my friend - Jose Pikacho, Luis Bailario, Angel Alcantare  and Jose Gonzales!!! These guys knows their job and how to take care of newbies in dance. Thank you very much, buddies! I never forget you! By the way,  all staff people very friendly and always smily. I never received NO as an answer. My best wishes to Pablo Perez (works in Naos restaurant) and to barman David on Lobby Bar. I hope to get back to this hotel again when i will plan my next trip to DR. Just 10 of 10. Thank you for small life you gifted me! Now i surely will go to bachata lessons in my city! Love you all!!

reviews.author: Marina B
reviews.title: Animacion Excelente!
reviews.text:
Первый раз не хотелось возвращаться домой после двухнедельного отдыха. Огромное спасибо ребятам, которые не давали нам скучать ни минуты. Анимация просто превосходная, Спасибо Jose, Angel, Leo, Gabriel, Lois, Maria, Eliezen, Pikacho! Вы сделали наш отдых незабываемым!
Обязательно посетите бар у бассейна, передайте привет Луису и Рамону "Фуего" и он угостит вас своим фирменным коктейлем Fuego
Еда с утра до ночи разнообразная и вкусная, вино, каждый день особенный коктейль, вечером развлекательная программа, танцы. 
Всем рекомендую.
Обязательно вернусь сюда еще!

reviews.author: rmendell7244
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Beautiful Beach, Sweet Staff
reviews.text: I really wanted to give this place 4 stars but I just couldn't.  First lets start off with the pros.  The beach, pools, hotel, restaurants are ALL beautiful!  Looks like a 4-5 star resort when you drive up.  The thing that makes it drop down to 3 stars is the food.  I consider myself a foodie and when I go on vacation that's the one thing I look forward and I can't say that any of it was good.  NOW if you want to pay the $40 extra and go to Passion every night you'll be fine.  We went to Passion on our last night and the food was delicious and the service was excellent.  If we ever go back I will eat at Passion every night.  The rooms are clean and I would give them 3.5 stars.  I know they are doing a lot of renovations.  The liquor drinks are NOT watered down and they have great house champagne.  If your not into food and want to enjoy cocktails by the beach or pool then this is the place for you.  Spend the extra $40 a day and eat at Passion.  Hope this helps.  I've done a full post on my blog about this place... www.ryanspearl.blogspot.com

reviews.author: Khloe M
reviews.title: great deal
reviews.text: Gorgeous hotel & rooms. good beds, Clean. Its two resorts in one so its Kind of a maze to get around until you really get a chance to map it out, in day light.Very picturesque  The Beach & pool are fantastic. Food was great but not much variety at buffet. Only there a few nights during the week and not much for evening entertainment, NO nightlife at all.......there is a 24hr bar and supposedly a disco but they were completey dead our entire visit. Another guest who'd been there 10 days said its more a family atmosphere, best bet was to crash a wedding for a good time. lol. Apparently the party place was two resorts down??? Merengue night was excellent, David at the lobby bar is great. Friendly and all smiles! Not much for shops. But it is literally next door to the Mall,where you can catch the hockey game in Tony Roma's or party at the Hard Rock. The Spa is top notch and worth the $$. Only complaint was check out, guys at the desk didnt speak english well and didnt resolve the issue. Overall though, great stay

reviews.author: Cecilia Y
reviews.title: wonderful people !!!!!!!.
reviews.text: my husband and I just got back from paradisus palma real it was a wonderful holliday . the food was excellent, the service was amazing as well , we travel a lot and appreciate  good  service and we want to thank a few employees that made us feel right at home  : Starting with Fernando Vargas, our favourite bartender at the resort. He pays attention  when  people order drinks  to the point that after a few times at the bar , he sees you and has your drink ready for you. That is absolutely excellent service to pay attention to small details to make people feel welcome!!!!!! In the buffet  for lunch we came across a very friendly waiter his name is Juan Martinez Gonzalez. He made sure that everything was fine with us and everybody else. He will go an extra mile to make sure that  you are taken care ofwith your food and drinks. Excellent service!!!!!! and the place is absolutely impecable and clean , The beach was beautiful as well. The only down side was making reservation for dinners. It was a very bad  experience because it took  a long  time for something that  should  have taken a couple of minutes but instead took  hours. That is the only  part that we didn't  like at all . Other than that the hotel  and people are amazing . We highly recommend it !!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Cindy M
reviews.title: Beautiful resort...very poor customer service
reviews.text: Beautiful and enormous resort with a breathtaking beachfront.  The problem with such a big resort is that it needs more people to maintain it.  Check-in was at 3pm and at 4pm, our rooms were still not ready.  This happened to several people at the counter checking in around the same time.  For half my stay, my room was not cleaned until 6pm.  Also the dining options were very limited.  Unless you signed up for the Royal Service, it was impossible to get a dinner reservation since the reservation line was busy from 9am-5pm.  Dinner at one of the restaurants was almost impossible without a reservation.  After complaining several times, we finally got a dinner reservation at Aqua at The Reserve, only for them to not have our reservation on their list when we arrived.  To be honest, after all the hassle at the restaurants, the food at the buffet was better.  If customer service and dining out are your thing, I would be cautious to stay here.  If you don't care about having buffet for all your meals and want to enjoy the pool and beach at a beautiful resort, then this is the place for you.

reviews.author: Revlon C
reviews.title: Fabulous Vacation
reviews.text:
I just returned from staying at Paradisus Palma Real and I have nothing but great things to say. I was there on a girls trip & we did the Royal Service. I've read some of the other reviews & I'd have to agree that Royal Service is definitely the way to go.  Our butler, Carlos & concierge-Alvaro (AC) made sure we were taken care of every step of the way.  Overall the food was good...of course, some restaurants were better than others.  Loved Gabi Restaurant the most...the food, ambiance as well as the music. Also, loved the bartender, Samuel, at the new restaurant, Palazzo.  No matter where we had our dinner reservation, we would always get the "Samuel Special" before heading to dinner.  They also had a good chocolate soufflee at Palazzo!

We mostly stayed in the private beach & pool area.  We had a reserved bali bed & palapa every day at the beach.  There was a slight issue w/our palapa reservation by the pool but it was resolved quickly.  All of our reservations were taken care of by our butler & concierge and whenever we needed anything at all, we had a cell phone (given to us by the resort) that allowed us to call our butler any time.  It was a nice touch!

The spa at the Reserve was wonderful...we literally did not want to leave that place.  My massage therapist, Milly, was great.  And the warm pool & jacuzzi didn't hurt either. 

Admittedly, reading some of the negative reviews was very shocking to me because our experience was so exceptional!  However, with any resort, there will always be someone that may have a negative experience because no place is perfect. So I can only speak about our experience as a Royal Service guest and they met & in many cases, exceeded our expectations. We would definitely recommend staying here & we plan to be back again next year.

reviews.author: Lucio P
reviews.title: Buenisimo, de lo mejor!!
reviews.text:
Es de los mejores hoteles de playa que he visitado, desde la recepción la cual fue muy cálida, después la habitación tan bonita y sobretodo limpia que encontré, nos topamos con un excelente servicio al cliente.
Regresaria ahi sin pensarlo.

reviews.author: cheerdoc
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text:
I just returned from Punta Cana on April 1, 2012.  We were there from March 28- April 1.  I went with a group of my girlfriends and we had a blast!!!  This is not the typical all-girls trip hotel but we made the best out of it!  We did the royal service and our Butlers (Jose and Carl) were very attentive and helpful.  Jose set up all of dinner reservation on our first night and he was even able to get us one for that first night despite the fact that we arrived later in the day.  Vento had the best food.  The hibachi restaurant was good too. So over all the food was A+.  Having paid for the royal service we had more options than the baseline rooms which I really appreciated.  Plus the day we left they opened the new royal lounge and restaurant, which was very nice.  Enough about food...

The room was very clean.  I enjoyed the iPod radio in the room.  We used it whenever we were in the room getting ready!!  I read about the power outages.  I happened to be in the room for one and it only lasted a few seconds.  But otherwise I didn't notice any issues with this.  Since we had royal service we had chocolate covered strawberries, fruit plate, cheese tray etc delivered to our room daily...it was a nice touch while we were preparing fro dinner and a night out!! 

THE STAFF!!!  Well were to begin??  Everyone was very pleasant and helpful.  I want to really mention the activities staff...Jose', Angel, Gabriel, Jimmy and Eliejer.. This group of guys made our trip unbelievable.  they were very friendly and attentive.  We participated in all the classes/activities: dance classes, wine tasting, painting classes and many others. Words cant express how much fun we had with them and what they added to our trip.  Thanks guys!!! 

Well just to let you know we had a such a great time we WILL be returning very soon!!! And doing everything the same way...royal service included.

reviews.author: clau1975
reviews.title: Excelente atención de Ramon Fuego!
reviews.text:
Acabo de llegar de Punta Cana, soy de Argentina, me aloje en la habitación 1019.-
Excelente la atención en el bar de la psicina de Ramon Fuego el creador del trago "Adelita", el mejor trago!! 
Excelente el hotel, las habitaciones, verdaderamente un paraiso!

reviews.author: CathyP315
reviews.title: Have no complaints at all.  Was just an amazing holiday.
reviews.text:
I just returned from a week stay at Paradisus Palma Real.  I was lucky enough to have Royal Service and was especially pleased by the attentive and quick responses of our butler Jari.  The one evening we returned to our room it was to find a bubblebath ready to go and chocolate covered strawberries...oh la la!  We loved all the staff the bartenders and wait staff on the beach and pool area in particular especially Nelson & Wilkins.  Upstairs Lobby favorite bartenders who made our stay that much more special were Orny and Fernando.  Thanks guys!!  The food was amazing, absolutely no complaints, whether it was the Buffet or the a la cartes it was all good.  If you love seafood you will be very happy..if you do not love seafood you will still be very happy.  Lots of choice everyday.
The rooms and maid service were clean and well kept.  We never had any issues with towels although a couple of days there were no facecloths...(really hardly worth mentioning).
The grounds, the beach, the pools all excellent.  Also enjoyed several walks done the beaches and unless you ventured close to the market areas no one bothered you.  If you did go near the market areas a polite no gracias and no problem, there were no hassles at all.  
I did do several activities and enjoyed them all...Thanks to Javier at the boat place for a wonderful snorkelling trip and boat ride.  Thanks to the very helpful (can't remember his name-sorry!) man at the aqua center for all his help with the bookings for sailing and snorkelling.  
I had a wonderful first time scuba experience with the scuba team as well, thanks Amigos!!
We often missed the main entertainment as some of our reservations were late however we did catch a couple of shows including an amazing Micheal Jackson show-not to be missed.
The beach party was rained out however the fire show continued in the lobby and was equally amazing.  
I especially enjoyed the after dinner and entertainment dancing in the courtyard or the lobby each night.  The animation staff were friendly and fun and always included everyone in the dancing.  Thanks to all the wonderful dancers for fun evenings of bachata and merengue and salsa and lil bit of hiphop as well :)   It was a truly amazing experience that I enjoyed completely.
Just as a note...I did come home with a few itchy bites and perhaps next time I would use some bug spray but all in all we live in a world where there are bugs so I actually was pleased that I didn't get more bites.  I would recommend some spray in the evenings for dinner but there definately was no slapping at mosquitos like I have experienced at other places and times.
Bravo Paradisus Palma Real for making my holiday so sweet!   Oh and do not miss the amazing Cuban bartender at gabi Beach, be sure to have a Mojito...best I ever had~!

reviews.author: Julie F
reviews.title: Probably the best all-inclusive anywhere...
reviews.text: Just returned from our ninth vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real. Where else would they rake the their beach every morning. The grounds are beautiful and immaculately kept. Try and find a piece of litter. The food in the buffets and restaurants is great and the main reason we go there. The management and staff are accomodating and happy. Some people this visit whom we thought were outstanding were Dionisio Rodriguez, Kerlin Avila, Pedro Paulino, Felix Sanchez, and Alexander Valerio. And where else can you play on a top notch 27 hole golf course just for the cart fee. And the key to any great vacation (anywhere) is saying something if you are not happy with it. Here they will make every effort to fix it. We will return again in November.

reviews.author: Juju_Bello
reviews.title: Excelente hotel!!
reviews.text:
Olá, 

Sou Juliana Belló, fui para Punta Cana de 10/03 a 17/03.... fiquei hospedada no resort Paradisus Palma Real, e foi um sonho!!!! Quero agradecer o carinho de todos!! Principalmente dos rapazes Jimmy, Angel, Gabriel Marte, Picachu (Luis Emilio), Luis (dançarino), eles são rapazes incrivelmente carinhosos e atenciosos!!! Ensinaram a mim e minha amiga a dançarmos  merengue, salsa, rumba.... Quero também dizer que adorei El Fueeeeeegooooo!!!! Ramon Fuego é muito atencioso e carinhoso também....sempre a postos com seu EL Fueeeeegoooo!!!  Também a coreógrafa Maria Ceilia, uma moça de extrema competencia, carinho e simpatia!!!!! Amei cada segundo que passei neste resort!!! Ficará em minha memória para sempre!!! Os quartos são lindos, limpos, cheirosos, aliás, todo o hotel é cheiroso e muito limpo!!! A comida é muito boa!!! Grande abraço a todas essas pessoas que comentei acima! Nunca mais esquecerei! Obrigada por fazerem minhas férias inesquecível!!!!

reviews.author: Diana G
reviews.title: Excelente!!
reviews.text: Paradisus es uno de esos sitios a los cuales uno no puede dejar de ir (y volver!!!!). Instalaciones, jardines, playas... no hay palabras que permitan hacer una justa descripcion....armonia, buen gusto, impecables!!. Tampoco hay una frase que exprese todo el valor del grupo humano que integra el staff del Hotel, su profesionalismo y la pasion con la que llevan a cabo su trabajo, por esa capacidad de lograr que uno se sienta mejor que en casa, que al final de la estadía uno se retire del Paradisus pensando en regresar. Quiero destacar en este aspecto al Grupo de Animación:  Angel, Jose, Oxnard, Stalin, Gabriel, María Cecilia, Pikachu, Isaias, Eliezer, Ariel, Patri...gracias por enseñarme pintura, armado de velas, baile, como doblar una toalla, preparar tragos, pero por sobre todo por mostrarme Dominicana!

reviews.author: voyager157
reviews.title: You can find a better place
reviews.text: In short, beautiful property! Immaculate grounds, gorgeous beach, nice rooms. BUT, the service is very lacking and the food unbelievable. Here are a few examples of poor service: my phone in the room didn't work and they never were able to fix it, our screen door didn't lock, it was never fixed, our iron didn't work and it took 2 days to get a new one not to mention 4 reminder calls, you have to make reservations to eat at the on-site restaurants which always seemed to be a time consuming ordeal). And finally, the food......almost inedible. Plenty of choices, none of them good. Many people in our group got very sick and I suspect it was the food to blame. Honestly, the worst food I have ever had in my life. I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: lane0413
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation!
reviews.text:
This  was our first trip to the Dominican and I hope to go back there.  We were there for a wedding and got a discount on the room  The accomodations were very nice. The hotel staff were super  friendly and helpful. My only complaint was the food didn't meet our high expectations. It reminded me of cruise food. Everything looked delicious but tasted bland.  We slso had our 3 year old very picky eater  she didnt eat  much while we were there! You also had to have reservations for all the restaurants except the Buffett. Some nights we were not able to eat until 9:30pm. 
The drinks were delicious!

reviews.author: Anita A
reviews.title: Animacion, Animacion, Excelente!!!! Ana M. de Argentina
reviews.text: Viaje con parte de mi familia y una amiga y puedo decir que Paradisus Palma Real sin dudas es "EL" hotel para ir a vacacionar, nunca me senti tan bien y tan comoda como en este all inclusive, no tengo palabras para describir los jardines, la playa, la habitacion todas las facilidades del hotel,  simplemente fabuloso "the pure freedom to just be" . Para destacar el grupo de Animacion, grupo divino, gente hermosa de animacion, creativos con una onda increible, chicos por ustedes vuelvo al Paradisus. No paramos de divertirnos desde el jueves 16 de febrero hasta el ultimo dia que estuvimos alli. Gracias al talento de ustedes pinte (gracias Oxnar!!!), hice velas, tragos, aprendi todo sobre "cocos" y lo mejor ... aprendi a bailar bachata, salsa y me falto tiempo para los otros ritmos, gracias al divino y paciente de Jose, que lindos momentos pasamos!!!. Sexy Gabriel extraño las clases de aerobics  en la playa y prometo equivocarme menos en el baile!!!, Angel siempre en su puesto, tranquilo y con su gran sonrisa y va mi reconocimiento para el resto del grupo Stalin, Luis, Maria Cecilia, Ivelise a Patri Hidalgo de Relaciones Publicas y Casino. Me encanto haber compartido una partecita de mi vida con todos ustedes y en ese soñado Paradisus Palma Real. Me traje el mejor de los recuerdos y vuelvo al mismo lugar en mis proximas vacaciones sin duda. Cariños y besos para todos desde Argentina!!!

reviews.author: JmChoi
reviews.title: Horrible Resort Experience
reviews.text:
I don't even know where to start. First of all, I travel a lot and this is my third and my husband's fourth time to the Dominican Republic. This is our first time to Punta Cana though and I will never go back. We stayed at this hotel for our friends' wedding on February 12th and spent more money on 4 nights here than 12 nights in Thailand for my sister's destination wedding last year.

When we first arrived (after a horrible wait at the airport) we had a couple more daylight hours and were excited to just relax before dinner. Instead, we were taxied over to Melia, next door as they had overbooked Paradisus and assured us that with our upgraded royal service there, it would be practically the same. After checking in, we were about to get escorted to our rooms when some of our friends came back to the VIP check in and told us to turn around because the rooms they were just in were disgusting. We asked the Melia ladies to call someone over to talk to us about the room situation and were assured that he/she was immediately on their way. After about a half hour, the lady said, "I just spoke to the booking manager at Palma Real and you MUST stay here for your entire trip" Excuse me? We don't have to do anything and we paid to stay at Paradisus! We immediately picked up our bags and went back to the front desk at Paradisus where it took another hour or so to miraculously find the rooms that they didn't have a while ago but had now. I had to pull up my confirmation email proving that I had paid for a master suite as they were trying to put us into a junior suite. How is it that the hotel doesn't have this information in their system?! Irritation beyond belief.

When we got to the room (3937), the door was WIDE open. The room was fine. It would have been great if we spent at least half of what we did but because it was so expensive, you'd expect it to be amazing. The bathtub doesn't have working jets and the stopper didn't work so we shoved a face towel around it to take a bath. As many other reviewers have said, I have to give it to the housekeeping staff as it was really clean however, on the second day, we came back to the room and the door was open again! This time it was simply ajar but still! Nothing had been taken and I called the concierge right away and they sent a memo to housekeeping and security. It didn't happen again.

The food was terrible. We ate at Gabi beach twice and it was terrible there too. Everyone's taste is different but for us, the food was borderline inedible and they did not offer any Dominican food. I don't know about you but I want to eat and drink local when I travel. Terrible... that is all.

Service. Settle in because this is where it gets really good. Now, we're tippers but by the middle of the second day, we mostly stopped because it got us nowhere. The only place to get a good drink is at the lobby bar and preferably from Esteban. Drinks from the pool bar were weak and often disgusting. I had a bloody mary that tasted a bit like actual blood. Yup, true story. Service at meals was attentive. At one dinner our waiter was there to pull out our chairs and brought new drinks when the last ones were almost done. Service with the concierge was either non-existent or amazingly slow. Our friends that were trying to set up a babysitter during the wedding reception was at the desk for almost an hour although they had already set it up prior to arriving at the hotel. I'll let them review their own experience.

The managers are no better. After the room debacle the groom negotiated an upgrade in bracelet color from white to black for those of us that were affected. To this day, we have no idea what we got with the upgrade as not a single person could tell us. We asked many people and no one could give us a clear answer. One thing we do know is that it allowed us to eat at Gabi Beach without any additional cost. We were supposed to meet before the rehearsal dinner at the front desk to upgrade the bracelets where the groom was told by Frederick that they did not have them and could not do it right then but come back before 10pm and they could chat. This meant we had to pay for the rehearsal dinner at Gabi Beach. Directly after dinner, the groom and my husband went to talk to Frederick for an hour and a half. 

They missed the Michael Jackson tribute concert, which was, on a side note, the highlight of the resort. Kudos to those performers and they should do it every night.

Now, I don't know the details of their conversation with Frederick but I didn't want to be in my husband's path when I saw him at the front desk afterward. I do know that at one point, Frederick said to my husband after asking him who he was, "Oh, you're the one who keeps leaving your door open." Excuse me?! Anyway, back to the bracelets. It got to the point that the bride was crying on the night before her wedding day. My friend and I were livid and tried to set up a meeting with Frederick the next day. We were told he would be back by 7am and left him a note with the concierge that we would be there at 10am. He was offsite all day, we had the front desk call him, we went to the wedding coordinators and spoke with Manesa and she couldn't find him. She assured us that she would call us and set up a time with both the head of the wedding department, Maciele and Frederick to discuss the problems. We never got that call. I think their tactic is to ignore their guests repeatedly until they give up because it worked on us. We were so tired of all the BS, we didn't pursue it after the wedding.

The day after the wedding, the weather was cloudy and rainy and that was when it was obvious that there is absolutely nothing to do at this resort if the weather isn't beautiful. As I'm writing this, there is so much more to say that I'm completely overwhelmed and I'd be surprised if you're still reading. I can't believe this place has any good reviews. If it weren't for our friends and a very happy wedding, this would have been the most expensive disappointment of a trip imaginable.

reviews.author: Kelly C
reviews.title: Blast at the pool bar~
reviews.text: We had a blast at the pool bar with Ramon and Luis! They kept the drinks coming all day long and were very entertaining. FUEGO all day long, and fruity cocktails which they kept changing it up for us. We were at the resort for a wedding party and they made the days so much fun! I personally didnt think the food was that great and some of the other bartenders should have the fun and friendly attitudes that Ramon and Luis have. Resort was very clean and beautiful though. We had a lot of great memories of Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Emilie F
reviews.title: FUEGO FUEGO, VIVA RAMON!!!
reviews.text:
Thanks to RAMON we had a lot of fun at the Beach Bar of the pool's resort. There was almost no "drinking activities" except for Ramon and his incredible fuego!

If you want a beautiful hotel with great food, but no parties after 7pm, this is the hotel for you!

We will go back at 50 for sure! :) Ramon will you still be there??!?!

We payed 1400$ for 7 days.

reviews.author: robert c
reviews.title: Good spot
reviews.text:
Excellent place. The place is in a beautiful location in Bavaro, Punta Cana.  The hotel is clean and well kept.  The service is exceptional.  There is a young woman at the front desk that is wonderful.  Very concerned about the visitors happiness.  At the entrance a wonderful young man named Pedro was always asking me by name how my trip was going.  Juan was a also a real gentleman.  The beach is gorgeous and the pool is beautiful.  The food was fair as i assume any all inclusive would be.

Overall I felt that people were there to make sure I was having a good time.  I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Brian T
reviews.title: 79 people for wedding...read this and youll know what to expect
reviews.text:
...our trip started off being booked for 79 people for a wedding...half from canada half from chile...the original hotel was over booked and they tried to split us up at 2 resorts..haha well this was where the spanish came in handy cause the chileans spoke up (not sure it wouldve happened with english speakers only?!?) and after a couple hours were all checked in at the palma real... upgraded to royal rooms with no royal service..which in my opionion is not worth the extra $ anyway but being closer to the beach was definatley a bonus...so good start right? haha most people were tired and frusterated at the miscues and were wary of how this trip might turn out?!?!

....after that it was smooth sailing...just remember that these people strive on tips..i dont wanna say youll get better service if you do but...plan on tipping a couple dollars to each and everyone that goes above and beyond..youll appriciate the service and so will they..that being said haha with a group so big i think we tipped a months wages per day to our waitress on the beach daily haha..they will remember your name,  drink of choice..whether you want triples or not...etc....dont bring your 1 litre cooler ..you look like a fool and really its unnecessary...

Wedding was perfect...from what i understood there was a surcharge for just about everything involved but works the same way at most if not all resorts and with such a large group to be expected..i was just along for the ride but all service and ammenities seemed to be in order and well taken care of...dinner was amazing surf n turf in private ballroom with DJ and dancing.

2 people stood out for me..one was "charlie" he works at the towel bar..this guy will make arrangements for anything and "everything"...very personable..good english...and isnt pushy as he works 100% on commision...the guys that walk around on the beach trying to sell you trips i understand are only doing their jobs but sometimes I just wanna be left alone...but "charlie" Juan is is real name just explains what there is and if you dont see it ...ask him hell get it or arrange it ..cheaper than through your tour guides as well with no BS....as a group we booked all our excursions through him..dune buggys (do this as you get three trips in 1 ..little bit of shopping swimming at one of nicest beaches in dominican and of course ripping through mudpuddles. in a 4 wheel...good times..., trip for shopping, & imagine bar( GO HERE!! AND GET VIP SERVICE  its worth the extra $ to have a place to sit and home base) very cool bar in caves...just dont miss your 3 am bus back to the resort haha...
the other was Bianca...she was personable didnt speak perfect english made mistakes with our orders but worked her but off...like i said few dollars here and there she will always make sure you have a drink.. remember your name and in general made our trip great...she even found some flowers for the girls in wedding to wear in their hair....10 + flowers and no charge very cool..
understand that there are many people on the beach all wanting 5* service...most not wanting but expecting..be a little patient and understanding...your on Dominican time...
rooms were well kept..and cleaned and didnt have any complaints..other people around the resort were always smiling and keeping busy....restaurants were average and booking was never a problem...but prefered the buffet bar...as seat always available at any time and food was good to above average...saying that... it wasnt the best ive had...with good selection but nothing that seemed above and beyond..but good....impossible for such a large group to be together but everyone had their own shedules anyway and they were accomidating as best they could....I rarley go back to same resorts twice...only becuase i want a different experience each time..but if i could take this staff to another resort..i know it would be great...from what i understand Pardisus treats their staff well and it shows in their service where as other hotels just treat them as "staff" and they just show up to work..nothing more..

side note there was some issues about towels and reserving chairs...i woke up early..and hung over for the most part and never had a problem getting a shady spot on the beach...some of the more coveted pool bungalows seemed to be reserved nightly?!?! as we went back to our rooms in the early a.m. someone would leave a book or something to reserve?!?! liitle bit shady in my opionion but its the way it works here..so if you sleep in you might not get the premium spot but seemed there was enough room non the less..or do as i did..just remove the towel and when the person shows up at noon!??!?! just say there wasnt a towel here sorry....haha should be first come first serve and i think the hotel should look at this...maybe have staff remove all towels and belongings before 6-7 am?!....and if you get up to reserve at this time you deseve your spot...if not then tough...
hope this was helpful....

reviews.author: 307myl_ne_s
reviews.title: de belles vacances
reviews.text:
tres bel hotel, des jardins immenses très bien entretenus. Les points positifs: l'espace, le service: le personnel très sympathique, une équipe d'animateurs très dynamiques (ils vous font participer, vous invite à danser), le petit déjeuner et le buffet (grand choix), la salle de fitness, la piscine-bar et les chambres très bien équipées et très spacieuses.
Les points négatifs: obligation de reserver à l'avance les repas au restaurant: nous sommes restés 9 nuits et n'avons pas pu décrocher une reservation au restaurant Passion: nous ne saurons jamais pourquoi l'accès nous y a été systèmatiquement refusé. Quant aux autres, seul le japonais était correct: le vento n'était vraiment pas à la hauteur. Nous nous sommes donc rabattus sur le buffet le soir aussi. Trop d'humidité dans les chambres, certainement dûe à l'exposition (nos draps étaient humides). Mais l'ambiance générale étant sympathique, nous avons passé de bonnes vacances.

reviews.author: LB078
reviews.title: GLORIA!!!! THE BEST SERVER EVER
reviews.text:
We got married in this hotel in november of 2011 and we had a blast. The food was really good, the pools, the weather, the ocean, the rooms, etc., but the best thing out of the hotel was the bar-beach worker named GLORIA, she served us for a whole week and she was the best... the most lovely, kind, joyful and hard working woman that I have ever met. Also I want to say thank you to the whole wedding team at paradisus palma real, they made sure that we had the best wedding ever. 
The only problem: the hotel doesn't have a night club :( The DJs at the gabi beach club only put music till early and it is not loud enough to get people motivated enough to dance...

reviews.author: Sheila A
reviews.title: Spoiled at the Paraduis Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:
This was a fabulous resort from check in with Antonio. It was excellent service.

Then our next pleasure was meeting Pedro Zorilla our conceirge who treated us so well.
He made all our restaurant reservations. Friendly, in fact I have not been to an all-inclusive in the Carribean that has had such a great concierge. We always knew he had a dinner plans for us every night. We never had to wait in line up. He would even find us on the beach to let us know our dinner plans. Went to the next level to make us have a excellent holiday.
He also booked us taxi sevice back to the airport.

Next the waiter's  2 stick out in my mind Pedro in the breakfast and lunch buffet. He looked after us every day for 14 and always made sure we had a table. he always had a smile on his face working such long hard hours.  He was always there ready to meet your needs. Look him up  and tell him Sheila sent you. He always remembered our  names.

All the staff was very friendly  always smiling .

The person that sticks is Hamlet  Rosario at Aqua. He was very nice and gave great service. This was by far the best restaurant for evening dining. Service was like a top notch restarant in any large city in North America. Hamlet made it even more special.

Next the bar  lots of great service here also. They always had a smile and remembered our names. Made us laugh. Special thanks to Ramon, Victor,Luis, Gloria, Delina at the pool bar.

Then of course we cannot forget Freddy and Nelson at the bar by the breakfast buffet. They were awesome.

Then of course we have Omy at the lounge bar. Again waht can I say amazing service.

We also have the great activities crew. Who all made us laugh and managed to find us no matter where we hiding to learn dancing, all about coconuts, fitness . What an amazing smiling bunch whom also remembered our names. Thanks to Santa,Angel,Elliott, Jose and Jimmy.
I am sorry if I missed a couple of names. You guys rock.

Then of course our room which was so clean you could eat of the floors. The whole resort  was like this and for those that I missed your name in this write up you do a great job.

The rooms where spacious and well appointed. You would not be disappointed in this resort.

Paraduis Palma Real you made us the best 14 days. We will be back. As a travel agent it is lovely to see where you are treated so well.

reviews.author: karenfbl
reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text:
