We met friends there for a wonderful week of a vacation in the sun.  My husband and I were desperately in need of serious relaxation and this was the perfect place for us. We sprung for the Royal Service which was great.  Pedro, the King of Personality, was very attentive and always on hand to get us another towel, drink and make sure we were happy! He has a contagious smile and as he says, he is not the problem, he is the solution! 
Our Royal Service garden view room was spacious, clean and very comfortable. The hotel itself is beautiful and the smiles that the staff continually share are genuine. The restaurants, while not 5 star, had pretty good food, decent service and were certainly clean.  My friend was obsessed with the flamingos that hung out at one of the small ponds.  They were fascinating. 
This was one of the best vacations we ever had!

reviews.author: weiny66
reviews.title: Fantastic!!!
reviews.text:
Ramon Fuego is the best bartender in Punta Cana!!!!!! Fuego!! Fuego!!! He's at the aqua bar at the pool.  He'll make your vacation. Also Volleyball everyday at the beach.  Service is great.  Beach is beautiful.  Tennis every morning.  Make sure you arrange your own private beach dinner the hotel does a great job.

Will go back in a heartbeat!!

reviews.author: christine w
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: First off i would like to say the entertainment crew were unreal! (Jimmy, Joze, Santa, Eliezer & Gabriel) Also each night they put on an  amazing show for the guests. As well as the entertainment crew, the bartenders were very good also, the drinks were all good. (shout out to Luis he was in training but was very quick with the drinks.) The hotel was beauitful overall, the rooms were spacious and the maids were quick to clean them. I will be back again!

reviews.author: plep
reviews.title: Top Notch Vacations
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel and great service.  You do not need to be worry about anything.  All rooms are spacious and beautiful.  Everything is also super clean (which is critical to me). 
I did my wedding there and brought 57 guests to the hotel.     We had guests from Miami, Colorado, Spain, Mexico and Venezuela, and everyone told us that selecting Paradisus Palma Real was a wonderful choice for my wedding destination.
It was so great that my guests asked me to renew my vows each October and do in the same hotel.  All with the objective to get together and have an excuse to return to Paradisus Palma Real each year. 
Sarah from Romance did a great work with my wedding and the people from Caribbean Celebration made an outstanding decoration.  The band was top notch.  They truly sounded like a 26 people band and it was just 6 guys. We dance and dance and dance.  The MC and the DJ were also great.  It was a super party and everybody was extremely happy.  
Juan Fuego was the best serving our drinks.  He took care of all of my guests when at the pool.  He was also part of the entertainment at the pool when serving our drinks.  One day he actually got inside of the beach to bring us our drinks.  Could you believe it?
Do not doubt it.  GO there for a memorable vacation or for a wonderful wedding destination.

reviews.author: Jamie C
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: I visited Paradisus Palma Real from December 8th to the 13th.  It was such a fabulous trip.  The staff was friendly and attentive (special honors go to Ramon at the pool bar, he was a riot) and the facilities were clean and beautiful.  My only complaint is that I couldn't stay longer - but I will be back!

reviews.author: Jeannie S
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real is a real deal!
reviews.text: The Royal Service is a must!! Carlos P. was our personal butler and he was excellent!! On the private beach and pool , Franciso Cabrera, Pedro, Winkin Mejia, and Francisco Gil were wonderful!!  They had our chairs fixed for us everyday, and they waited on us hand and foot!   We never had  to move!

reviews.author: Jennine J
reviews.title: Hotel Makes You Ill and then Denies
reviews.text: This hotel gave me an acute parasitic intestinal infection and fell violently ill. I needed hospital care (at the direction of their resort doctor) in the Domincan Republic. I do understand that you take some risks travellign to other countries but in a "5 star" resort this should not be a concern. The hotel has denied having anything to do with me falling ill and suggested that i had travel anxiety. Beyond falling ill our toilet was broken the entire time and the maid only cleaned our room once over 5 days - despite our requests.

reviews.author: claramike
reviews.title: December 2011
reviews.text: We sayed for 10 days.  Room was very nice. The staff at the hotel were excellent - Edgar Gonzalez; Gabriel, Santa (Isabella) and the entire activities staff. Erickson was a great server. Staff made us feel very special. The pool had no handrails at steps and was almost 5 five deep all around.   The food and mixed drinks (had an after taste) were our only disappointment - at best, it was edible.  Best:  Vento Italian.  Nightly entertainment was superb and plenty of actvities:  fingerpainting, oil painting, wine tasting, etc.  The staff helps you produce beautiful artwork. They closed the spa and gym at the hotel and guests had to go ride a golf cart to the Reserve area to use those facilities, which was inconvenient.  Gym is expected to re-open, but the only Spa will be at the Reserve.

reviews.author: Christopher C
reviews.title: Ramon is the Man
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Paradisus Palma Real and the resort is stunning.  Beautiful grounds, everything was very clean and the staff was very nice.  Food was ok, except Gabby Beach (Don't go there).  Room was very nice and clean.  But as I read with all of the other reviews, Ramon made the trip.  I always got a big "Good Morning" with a morning drink on his head.  He bends over backwards to make everyone's experience as good as it can be (and maybe better after a couple of cocktails).  The only negative that I have is the constant sales pitch when trying to make reservations with restaurants.  After the 2nd day of them trying to sell me a timeshare I was done, so needless to say after day 6 I was really done.

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience in December 2011
reviews.text: I spent a wonderful week here in early December 2011.  The staff was exceptional.  Our concierge (Edgar Gonzalez) exceeded expectations.  He was able to arrange non-routine offsite visits to some very interesting locations not typically explored by tourists.  Food and drink was very good to excellent.  We stayed in the Non-Reserve Area (like most tourists).  The rooms were nice but could use an update.  Would I go back - YES.  I would stay in the Reserve Area next time.  If you go, try to get offsite to see the real Dominica.  The people are wonderful.

reviews.author: Brittany R
reviews.title: Best holiday vacation ever!
reviews.text: Best vacation we have ever had! The service was beyond amazing!! Food was great, resort was beautiful, and the staff was absolutely wonderful! We plan on going back! I would recommend this place to everyone! We had a great time at the pool bar with Ramon "fuego", the bartender. He did tricks and kept our drinks coming at all times! He made our days by the pool so enjoyable and entertaining. He is crazy, hilarious, and gives great service all at the same time. We did a lot of fun activities by the pool. They had a drink making class and dancing lessons almost every day. Jimmy, one of the boys that leads the classes, is so funny and outgoing. He made sure everyone had a great time at all the classes he was a part of. Also, Carlos, the bartender at Gabi Beach was great too! He did all sorts of entertaining bar tricks and made the best drinks we had on the island! We always went to see him at night at the Gabi Beach Club. Rafael, the waiter in Passion, was also amazing. He made our dinner very special and the service was impeccable. Also, every morning, he served us breakfast and had our table and mimosas ready when we arrived. We could not have asked for better service. These people truly make your trip the best experience ever! We are beyond pleased with this vacation and cannot wait to go back! On a little side note, I know this place is all-inclusive, but bring some extra cash for tips! We made sure and took care of the people waiting on us and they definitely took great care of us in return. I found it very rude when people were provided outstanding service, yet couldn't even leave a couple of bucks for the staff. So, I would suggest bringing some extra cash for these people just as a courteous gesture because they truly do an outstanding job and deserve it.

reviews.author: sylvie2trottier
reviews.title: Accueillant,chic,propre.bonne bouffe
reviews.text: Nous sommes 2 couples dans la cinquantaine  sommes allés au paradisus palma real à Punta Cana.le site, est magnifique, les chambres super propre le lit très très confortable.la Bouffe excellente dans tout les restos...la plage, la mer, très belle, les chaises lonques et palapas sont en qualités supérieur pas besoin d'aller porté notre serviette à 6 heures du matin ils y a toujours de la place...Nos conjoints ont joué au Golf Cocotal un 27 trous en arrière du site très beau golf....illimité.tout est Positif....Sauf, un seul point négatif Aussitôt arrivés aussitôt pogné par un Employé pour nous vendre des points pour bénéficier de la Chaine Mélia dans le monde..Ont n'a perdu 3 heures de notre temps pour ce service qui nous intéressent pas....2ieme point les portes de chambres et planchers de chambre un peu bruyant surtout avec des souliers à talons hauts........

reviews.author: hector b
reviews.title: Paradisiac Experience
reviews.text: I went there with my girlfriend and friends and we absolutely loved the service and treatment that we received from the staff.. We stayed at the royal service area... We felt at paradise since the moment we got there.. We got a private check in and its been the fastest one we have ever been through... This hotel truly meets up to its name paradisus... The rooms were so nice and the private beach and pool area wowed us away... The restaurants had great dishes and the service was impecable... We simply didn't want to go back to reality..

reviews.author: Stacy W
reviews.title: Amazing Resort - Activities Staff Rocks!!
reviews.text: I recently spent a week at the Palma Real for my wedding.  We had about 40 guests staying with us at the resort - and everyone had a great time!  They loved the resort, the food, the service - but most of all the activities staff!!  We immediately became friends with them and they helped make our entire week nonstop fun!  We took dance lessons, played volleyball and danced every night with them!  They were always smiling and laughing and really contributed to us having such a great time!!  I can't thank them enough - Gabrielle, Santa, Max, Victor and Angel!!

reviews.author: svengali82
reviews.title: Not so good
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited this resort in late October as part of "reward perk" for her achieving sales goals in her line of work. So her half of the trip was free and I paid just my airfare. That fact lessened the pain of what I am about to write.

We arrived mid-week and stayed four days. The weather was great and typical for the Caribbean this time of year. This is a large resort with different accommodations and levels of service. Our group was treated to the Royal Service plan in The Reserve which is supposedly at the upper end of their price range. Royal Service has more privacy, it's own checkin desk, concierge and features a butler 24/7 for your needs.......supposedly :^(. Each guest was provided a cell phone to contact our butler and hotel services as  needed. This is a great idea, but the phones we received did not work. Our butler escorted a group of us to six rooms offering help as we dispersed. We were escorted to our room last whereupon  I tipped the fellow $20......... and never saw or heard from him again for the entire stay. 

Our room was very nice with tile floors, somewhat comfortable bed and all the expected amenities. The wifi service did not work so well.

The resort states that its many dining opportunities are "world class"...........Hardly!!!........Reservations were virtually impossible without the help of our vanishing butler. The food is of lesser quality than what one would receive at a typical chain restaurant in the US and certainly not "world class". There were opportunities to try Dominican cuisine which is almost identical to Puerto Rican fare and very bland in my opinion.

The beaches with cabanas and pools with outdoor bars were the best part of the vacation. There were other activities available including spa services that were unexpectedly ............. sublime. The groundskeeper does a great job keeping this resort looking great, too.

All inclusive resorts should be just that and this one did not measure up. I do not recommend Paradisus Palma Real Resort as an all inclusive based my experience.

reviews.author: Cappy D
reviews.title: "Pack Your Bags & GO!"
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is certainly among the best All-Inclusive Resorts you will ever experience. From the moment you arrive into this magnificent lobby, you are welcomed and made to feel like you are the most important people. The service level is of the highest. The staff of this resort genuinelly want to take care of your every wish. The restaurants are excellent, and the drinks are top shelf. If you take the Royal Service program you will love Gabi Beach and the staff there in the sit-down restaurant for lunch is fabulous. If you are staying at the Paradisus Reserve area, you can also come over for the exclusive Gabi Beach. Don't miss the evening shows. They are fun and wonderful and you can see how multi-talented the staff is as performers. The Resort is beautifully kept. The gardens are so lovely and the fountains are everywhere, creating a joyous feeling within you. By the time you stayed a day or two, you get to feel you are part of the Paradisus Palma Real family.

reviews.author: RobynN416
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the resort with a group of 10 all together.  We stayed in the Royal Reserve Suite and had a wonderful time.  The resort was very very nice and clean, the people there were very nice and pleasant.  Our rooms were imaculate and our butler Carlos De La Cruz gave us a 110% of his time he was the very best we have ever had and I would recommend him to anyone as well as the resort.  We also had a pool guy (Francisco Cabrera) who was there everytime we needed a cabana outside by the pool.  We took advantage of some excursions and they were well worth it (parasailing, horseback riding and zip-lining). The spa was amazing it is worth going to see, I would definitely recommend this resort to friends and family as well as planning on going back for future vacations!!!!  Thank you Paradisus for the wonderful stay that we had there!!
Robyn & Keith

reviews.author: valerie l
reviews.title: The best trip ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: The Paradisus is beautiful!!  The food was excellent (even the buffets) and the service was wonderful and very friendly.  I must give a shout out to Jose, Max, Angel, Santa, and Gabriel doing activities.  You guys are the best and we hope that each of you will be there when we come back next year.

reviews.author: Sammy029
reviews.title: Girls Getaway
reviews.text: This was my 3rd time here and the first time for my 2 friends.  Because I was here before with my husband and family (March 2011), I felt comfortable to be here with friends who haven't travelled to the Dominican before.   The staff was professional, courteous and attended to whatever you needed.  Santo, the waiter at the Reserve beach, is fabulous!  Santo is right on the ball;  he makes sure your beach chairs are ready and the drinks are on there way to your hut!  He's professional and kind.  Francesco was also great and Freddy the bartender, too!  Martin y Jose Luiz at Vento restaurant made sure our reservations were what we wanted and that are table was always ready.  Because it was a 5 day trip, I didn't do the Reserve or Royal service.  If you stay for 7 days or longer, I rec the Reserve because of the additional restaurants offered and a little more pampering...  Would offer more info if anyone needs it on this beautiful resort!

reviews.author: israel68
reviews.title: un hotel excelente
reviews.text: excelente el hotel y la atencion muy buena , el personal del bar de la piscina tiene una atecion 10 estrellas , tanto ramon como luis son muy serviciales y estan atentos a cualquier deseos de los clientes , el resto del hotel muy bueno , solo deseo que lleguen mis proximas vacaciones para volver a este hotel israel y adalberto

reviews.author: IsabelA484
reviews.title: Destination Wedding DISASTER
reviews.text:
Went to my nieces wedding with 26 others in our party. Let me tell you that first impressions always count. When you have terrible management what can you expect from this hotel. Upon check in there were 3 buses full of college students all checking out at the same time. Now i would think there would have had a representatives checking the students out not all the students checking themselves out im talking about 300 people all at once. Once i saw that first thing that came to my mind was I came at the wrong time boy was i right. 2nd thought was going to another hotel however, we had a contract for 3 nights which meant if I didn't stay I would lose my money. So, it was downhill from that point on.

PROS - Beautiful beach and nice architecture and beautiful pool.

CONS - Mangement, i asked for manager never came out
              Staff - attended to you when it was convient to them. You would have to go get  someone to bring you a drink unless you just got up and got your own drink at the bar.
Food not bad but not hot. Now the reason to all of this is due to the management at the hotel they OVERWORK their staff so, of course they are too tired to help the guest. The hotel staff works 22 days on 8 days off. I wouldn't want to work either. 
You would think that a 4 DIAMOND property would have superb service they DON'T. I have been to 4 Diamond properties and 5 star resorts and I would give them 3 stars and that is alot for the service that was given.  The only time staff will acknowledge you is to sell you their time share.
The hall ways are poorly lit and they use 25 watt bulbs so, it's hard to see where your going at night. If your on the 3rd floor the water pressure is very low so, you might find that your toilet doesn't work properly nor does your shower or sink. BEWARE on picking up the phone to make a call i made the mistake and made a call within the same country and i spoke for 6 minutes and was hit with a $25.00 US phone bill thank goodness I didn't call to the U.S.
This hotel is OVERPRICED for the terrible service one recieves. Maybe at one time this hotel had great service but they do not now. I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone. Now, those of you that don't believe me go ahead give it a try and prove me wrong. 
I had to make the most of this for my niece and her special day but I will not be returning again. I have been to better resorts in Punta Cana,Puerto Plata,Sosua,Samana and Santo Domingo that have 0 diamonds. HOTELS STAFF SHOULDN'T  IGNORE GUEST.

reviews.author: Natottawa
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Beautiful beautiful, all so beautiful...  Felt like a princess. Great suite, Gorgeous pool, not too crowed, great beach and loved the spa !  The only thing that wasn't top draw was the food in specialty restaurants.  French and italian were ok, Thai was awful.  Great selection at buffet.

reviews.author: paco f
reviews.title: Pensaba que habia estado en Hoteles buenos en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Llevo 11 años yendo de vacaciones a la Republica Dominicana, y hemos estado en varias zonas y también en varios Hoteles, siempre de alto standing, entre ellos algunos de la cadena Iberostar, Barcelo, NH, Bahía Príncipe (Cayo Levantado y Ambar del que el año pasado, nos fuimos indignados por sus malas maneras del club de vacaciones) siempre en zona exclusiva para adultos y este año en el Paradisus Palma Real  “Servicio Real”.

Antes de ir  a este hotel, estuve mirando los comentarios en esta misma página web, tanto los buenos como los malos y ciertamente los malos daban la impresión de ser un despecho por algo. Finalmente nos decidimos a ir a este hotel al “Royal Service” y tengo que reconocer que es el mejor de los que he ido en Rep. Dominicana hasta el momento, La recepción del Royal Service es exclusiva con un mini bufet (solo debo criticar que el aire acondicionado esta extremadamente frio), El bufet normal en general bastante bien, los restaurantes de reserva en general bien excepto el Gabi Beach que tardaron una eternidad.
Las instalaciones del hotel muy bien (curiosamente no olía a humedad como en la mayoría de los hoteles) la playa en los dos primeros días tenia muchas algas, aunque no paraban de limpiarla, luego mejoro bastante después de una tormenta tropical que se llevo las algas de la orilla. La piscina del Royal Service pequeña pero suficiente para nuestra necesidad de descanso. Las hamacas y tumbonas en la playa y la piscina excelentes.
El Personal del hotel en general muy atento, si además eres generoso con ellos, como en todas partes del mundo, yo diría que entonces la atención y el agradecimiento de su parte son recíprocos y mejora sustancialmente.
La limpieza en general muy bien y nosotros tuvimos la suerte de conocer al director del Hotel Sr. Rabel Torres, a quien debo agradecer la atención que tuvo con nosotros y también hacerlo extensivo a todo su equipo.
Francamente no dudaría ni un instante en volver a este hotel ni tampoco en recomendarlo.

Paco Flores, Paloma Arroyo, Jose Maria Sanchez y Mari Carmen Gomez

reviews.author: vpchahin
reviews.title: Un lugar para regresar
reviews.text: Un lugar muy bonito, un sueño. Ideal para estar en pareja o entre amigos. Entretenimiento todo el tiempo, la playa espectacular y hasta un pequeño centro comercial habia dentro. Pensado para todas las edades.. muy buena experiencia.

reviews.author: BORRAS
reviews.title: Absolutamente recomendable
reviews.text: Han sido unas vacaciones extraordinarias. Por el Hotel, las instalaciones y sobre todo por el servicio recibido, especialmente por nuestro querido Carlos, que nos asistió en todo momento de forma muy especial; también par nuestra querida Veralucia, absolutamente cariñosa y resolutiva y el no va más con Winkin Mejia, Pedro Cedano y Francisco Gil, que nos atendieron de maravilla y que por sí solos, los tres, son un verdadero espectáculo de servicio,atención y cordialidad. FAMILIA BORRAS

reviews.author: SeaMona
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus!  29th Anniversary Celebration...
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of our stay (18 - 26 June 2011) at the Paradisus Palma Real with Royal Service (can't imagine not doing Royal Service here).  Ramon Avila was our personal butler and he was excellent, taking great care to ensure we had a wonderful time and all our requests were handled efficiently.  Ramon even went 'above and beyond' several times during our stay, which we appreciated very much  since we were celebrating our 29th anniversary.

ROYAL SERVICE:  ocean front or ocean view rooms; private pool area and bar as well as private beach area.  Both beach and pool areas had more than enough padded lounge seating to accommodate (also, thatch covered bali beds).  If one wanted a thatched covered bali bed poolside then a request to our butler the day prior assured we had one reserved (our name was on side of bali bed -- low down so look!)  RS also assures dining reservations each night of our stay:  we asked Ramon to choose the restaurants for us, which he did with great care (he really seemed to care that we enjoy our experience).  Any changes we requested of Ramon were handled with a smile... thanks, Ramon!  RS lounge has a nice little breakfast, lunch and snack buffet daily so food is always available if you just need a quick bite...

TOURS:  plenty of options - I suggest you do internet research prior to leaving home so you have a good idea of what's available.  We  chose golf (Cocatal - free but cart fee of $37/pp); horseback riding ($45/pp - Pat Ranch, which is not really a ranch at all but the horses were healthy and well-cared for... Paso Finos are small so don't think they're not in good shape); catamaran trip to Saona Island with stop at Altos de Chavon ($20/pp extra for Altos, which may not be worth it during low season since all the stores and restaurants were closed -- beautiful surroundings though if you haven't been).

RESTAURANTS:  Vento (Italian, but not really -- good food); Passions (French, but definitely not really -- good food); Gabi Beach (not on beach but somewhat of a beach view -- good food); Bana Asian Fusion (Yep! -- good food); Bana Tepanyaki (Yumm!  Wierd to see Dominicans behind grill, but Yumm!); Bana Sushi (didn't try)...  Naos the buffet!  We loved this place and opted to come here for most of our breakfasts and all our lunches (yes, we ate way too much "good food!").  I've read some 'not so great' reviews about this buffet, but we truly loved the selections, and everything was so fresh! (Note:  Market Grill was not open while we were there.)

We absolutely loved this resort and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to our close friends and family.  What a perfect place for a destination wedding, if you're thinking along those lines!

reviews.author: GoodGuy71
reviews.title: Over the Top and Beyond -
reviews.text:
I have just returned back to work from your oasis and the first I wanted to do was write a review and tell everyone what a great time we had.  Thank you so very much for your gratious hospitality, again.  You have so much to be proud of with that amazing resort. When staying  there, it truly is a fantasy come true.  Royal Service is a must and put personalized service on a new level, they really make you feel important. The suites are palatial and fully stocked with drinks and nibbles. Room Service is just minutes away.  The restaurants are all in category of their own and deserve their own awards.  The staff and  team is so sensational, and as I promised each of them, I would mention their names.  These individuals really take pride in their work and it shows, they particularly have admiration for the resort, so job well done.  So with not being in any order:

Juan Castillo
Carlos Peppin
Augustine
Pedro (Royal Service Bar)
Winkin (Royal Service Bar)
Francisco (Royal Service Bar)
Leo (Restaurant)
Yerical (Restaurant)
Rafael (Restaurant)
Luis (Restaurant)
Renso (pool)
Daysi Rodas (Royal Service Desk)

That is everyone that we came in contact with, each of them, did whatever they could do to accomodate and make us happy and comfortable.  What a fabulous team.

Thank you for the generous rate and upgrades. The room was awesome.
I only wish Trip Advisor had a high rating than excellent ,  Paradisus is way above that.

reviews.author: RP1971BsAs
reviews.title: Excelente instalaciones, muy buen servicio!!
reviews.text:
Desde que hicimos el check in fuimos muy bien atendidas. Nos asignaron un conserje de nombre Genaro que se ocupo de hacer nuestras reservas en los restaurantes y estuvo a nuestra disposición durante toda la semana. Muy atento y cordial.
Las instalaciones son preciosas, habitaciones, restaurantes, piscina, bar, jardines y el Spa en The Reserve es alucinante! No dejen de ir a hacerse un tratamiento, vale la pena. 
Tuvimos la suerte de hacer Scuba gracias a nuestro instructor Jorge quien nos trato maravillosamente bien, súper profesional tomando los recaudos necesarios para que nuestro bautismo sea sin riesgos. Nos gusto tanto que todos los días salíamos con el barco al mar.
Los restaurantes son buenos , el mejor sin duda es el Tepanyaki y el chef Pedro el mejor cocinero. Sin embargo no nos fue tan bien cuando cenamos en el italiano Vento; la comida italiana no es tan italiana. El rissoto lo sirvieron en un molde seco....esperaba encontrarme con un rissoto cremoso :-(. 
Algo que me llamo poderosamente la atención es que durante el desayuno servían jugos naturales de frutas hechos en el momento...sin embargo en los bares de la piscina y playa el jugo era artificial; cuando pedí un jugo natural, me respondieron que solo se sirve durante el desayuno.
Mis criticas no son negativas, sin embargo creo que hay algunos detalles como estos que detallo que deberían tenerlos en cuenta ya que ayudan a mejorar aun mas la calidad del Servicio.
El hotel es un excelente hotel, con muy buenas instalaciones y con un excelente trato de todos los que dan el servicio, la hospitalidad dominicana esta presente en todo momento y eso es un plus.

reviews.author: Liz_B_84
reviews.title: Based on reviews my expectations were high...but not met
reviews.text: I had the honor of serving as a close friend's Maid of Honor last weekend. I did research on the resort and chose to upgrade to the "Royal Service" package with a Butler. I only saw my Butler one time during the trip and he didn't follow up on multiple requests (we never got our walkie-talkies, special t-shirts, etc.). We ordered chocolate covered strawberries for the Bride on her wedding day and they were delievered...but to the wrong room. Another bridesmaid had her very nice robe "lost" within her room and still hasn't gotten it back. Upon check-in, I was told I could make outbound calls and would only be charged for inbound calls. When I checked out, apparently I had "misunderstood" the "free" calls and had to pay a fee upon checkout. The service at the restaurants was ok and the food was alright. The bartenders at the pool were the saving grace as they could make one hell of a pina colada. On the bright side, I did enjoy the free scuba diving that was included in my package. The bride was disappointed in some of the aspects of her ceremony- the woman from the Romance Department completely skipped the reading of the vows and played songs for certain dances (First Dance, Father/Daughter dance) out of order. During my stay, the resort was not very full, hence my disappointment with the lack of service, especially on the Butler end. Additionally, the bathrooms in the guest rooms are very open, so there isn't much privacy (may not be an issue for some). The grounds are lovely and the architecture is fantastic, also the pools are great. The beach could have been better maintained as there was tons of guest garbage (empty drink cups, bags, etc.) that only seemed to be cleared at the end of the day, rather than throughout. Don't get me wrong, the hotel was nice, just didn't meet expectations and service (especially attention to detail) is a dealbreaker for me. There are many other resorts in the area, so may be your best bet to check out other options.

reviews.author: ElPresidenteLight
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
We spent a week at the hotel with a large group for a wedding.  It was  spectacular.  We stayed in Royal Service and were very pleased with it, some of our group did not and they were very happy as well.  The service, food and rooms were all amazing.  The treatment by all of the staff from check in to check out was above and beyond. The staff at the royal service pool bar were wonderful.  The Bartender, Nelson Cedana and Poolside waiter, Francesco were outstanding.  They were both friendly, helpful and made us feel at home right away.  The security was also excellent and the beaches were kept clean.  There was wireless internet in our rooms in royal service as well as by the pool and we had no qualms about leaving our laptop and other belongings on our bali bed while venturing to other parts of the resort for short periods.  I had a bed reserved by the pool everyday, even on the days that I forgot to ask the butler to reserve one for me, Francesco had one ready and waiting.  I think it helped that we went in May and it wasn't super busy there.  Our Butler Marcelovichly Paul  looked after our every need.  We also had Jose as a butler while Marcelo was on days off.  He was also excellent.  Our room was always clean and the bar well stocked including hard liquor and snacks.  My wife is very particular about food but she was happy with the food at all of the restaurants including the buffet.  The food is different for sure but that is all part of the experience.

The perks of Royal Service were: Check-in and out ( no standing in line and waiting in the heat.  We had an air conditioned private check-in with lounge and snack bar).  We were escorted to our room by the butler, who showed us where everything was on the way there.  Our room had wireless internet as well as the pool area.  It seemed that our room was cleaned 3 times a day.  A complete cleaning in the morning, then a once over in the afternoon and again at turndown.  Our towels were replaced 2 or 3 times a day and garbages emptied as well. Our Butlers made reservations for us daily as well as helping us with any excursions that we did.  We were provided with a cell phone to call them anytime we needed anything.  We also purchased long distance minutes for the phone so we could call home a few times while we were there.  The cost was very reasonable.  We were only approached once each by someone trying to sell timeshares (vacation club).  Once too many but not nearly as often as our friends were approached that were not staying in royal service.  We were treated daily to little extras in our room, such as romantic baths prepared for us, fruit trays, meat and cheese plates etc.

The wedding that we attended was top notch.  We thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of the wedding from the service itself to horsdoeuvres to the meal and dance.  Everything was done on the beach and was perfect!  We loved it there and would definitley go back.

reviews.author: ErininDC
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real  - worth every penny.
reviews.text: Okay. Do you need to see the sun and want to just getaway from the grind, your blackberry and crazy coworkers?  If so, this is the place. Excellent service, great beach, and the weather is unbelivably perfect. The food is just par, but since all inclusive you don’t care so much.  If you need a respite and want to just chill while the bartenders bring you cocktails next to the pool or ocean – this is it. Staff will go out their way to make sure you get what you need. The spa was glorious. Cocktails were never ending. Stellar golf courses close-by and just a fantastic trip all-together. I highly recommend. THE Best money I have ever spent.  Check it out!

reviews.author: patasciu
reviews.title: ottima vacanza!!!
reviews.text:
Soggiornato in questo meraviglioso hotel dal 28 Marzo al 5 Aprile.
Era la seconda volta che andavamo nella Repubblica Dominicana,
ma la prima volta a Punta Cana, devo dire che ci è piaciuto tantissimo, 
L'hotel sorge sulla lunghissima spiaggia di Bavaro, molto bella la struttura in stile coloniale, ottima la pulizia sia delle parti comuni che delle camere,
bellissima la piscina.
Ottima la ristorazione con la possibilità di scegliere fra vari ristoranti.
Personale gentile e molto attento.
Simpatiche le cameriere della spiaggia, 
E come ultimo è tutto incluso.
Se proprio devo trovare un difetto metterei qualche ombrellone in più in spiaggia.
Ultima cosa riguarda il trasferimento, ci vogliono circa 2 ore di auto, dall'aereoporto della Romana a Punta Cana poichè i voli internazionali atterrano tutti lì.
Dimenticavo, l'hotel è frequentato da americani e canadesi, noi eravamo le uniche, quindi se in vacanza cercate gli italiani non è il posto x voi!
Io cmq ripartirei subito!!!

reviews.author: mjfunk
reviews.title: Service ranges from spotty to rude
reviews.text: I just returned from this resort and was quite dissappointed at the overall experience.  First of all the food was bad.  Not ok, bad.  The breakfast buffet was ok, but it took 10 min to flag somebody down for coffee.  The dinner choices were ok, but the results were not.  And the service, especially the hostess at Venta, was very poor.  At the casino, drunk gamblers were abusive to the staff and other guests w/o any consequence.  The resort itself is tired.  Rooms are ok, but just beneath the surface you see signs of age.  Very few on staff seem incented to help anybody.  Perhaps its the all-inclusive nature of the resort that dis-incents its employees to try harder, who knows.

reviews.author: Michoopoo
reviews.title: Not Long enough
reviews.text:
Nice Resort with lovely clean rooms, did not have wireless internet though.....

 The beach was great, nice white sand beach, but I did find the water dirty with seaweed?  The Beach chairs were all saved with towels, but no one one them quite frustrating...  There were lounging beds, but never the opportunity to use any....don't know what time of the day you would have to get up to get one! 

 Pool bar was great, very entertaining staff, and the service was wonderful.  We were warned upon arrival to book restaurants early, it was the 1st thing we did, and we had no problem, but heard complaints from people who did not book right away.  Food was wonderful. 

 All in All, A beautiful quiet resort, good food, good service, wonderful stay

reviews.author: JennyLuv
reviews.title: It was amazing
reviews.text: I just got back from my trip to Paradisus Palma Real Resort. This was absolutely amazing trip. The services was great, although sometimes a little slow but that didn't matter too much and did not ruin my vacation. The grounds are beautiful. The beach is very close to the hotel. The pool was huge and had enough room for both adults and kids. The room was very well kept and beautiful. The cleaning staff was great never had to ask for anything extra. We had a jacuzzi in the room which we ended up using twice. There were quiet a few option for dinner and the food was great too. In one of the restaurants (Vento, Passion) the bartender was awesome he was doing trick while serving the drinks. The entertainment was very good too shows were unreal, the ones that I really like were tribute to Michael Jackson, Fire show, and show with the bartender. The activities staff did their job 100% can't help but mention a few names Jose is an amazing dancer, fun, and made me feel very comfortable and special; also Angel who  is a good dancer as well and just very sweet person. I would definitely recommend this resort to anyone and would actually come back myself too.

reviews.author: csutfin
reviews.title: First "all-inclusive" resort vacation and super disappointing!!
reviews.text:
My finace and I went to DR on a group trip with about 24 of our friends. The day before we left we got a call saying we were being "upgraded" to the 5-star Paradisus from it's 4-star sister resort only to find out that 18 of our friends were still at the other resort. We were assured they would make it right with day passes, or something else...didn't happen. In fact, when we went to the other resort we were told it would be an extra $214/couple to use all their facilities besides the rooms. 
Our resort only had 5 restaurants that were included compared to the 10 or 12 that the 4-star had. Only one of our restaurants didn't need reservations and getting a reservation for 6 was hard to do without 2-3 days advance notice. One night we went to eat at said restaurant and it was closed, when we asked to front desk they didn't even know it was closed. It ended up being in the theatre for a dinner theatre, so we showed up only to find no seats available, so we got plates went outside and ate with our fingers...some 5-star resort. Things only declined from there...I won't bore you with all my complaints. Just know that if you are expecting to be treated like "royalty" it won't happen.
The rooms were clean, the service was fair, but overall, I was highly disappointed and wouldn't even consider going back.

reviews.author: kemeyercrna
reviews.title: A real review---and can't wait to return
reviews.text:
My husband and I escaped the cold for 6 nights with another couple and had an absolutely great time at the Paradisus.  We have been to several other Carribean islands and have doen all inclusive vacations again and would definately return to the Paradisus.  On checkout we were upgraded to The Reserve, and it would have been worth it to pay for it.  The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable.  We never once had to fight for or wait for a spot on the beach or by the pool and both were beautiful.  As far as teh restaurants go, there are many to choose from and we did not go to all of them.  We had breakfast every day at the Gabi, which is the Reserve's buffet, and it was great.  Lunch you can choose from several buffet spots or the grill by the pool and dinner has many options.  There are so many a la carte restarants...our favorite was Vento followed by Fuego and Sakura....bottomless glasses of wine in  them all.  The service varied depending on where you are but on the whole it is a bit slower than we are used to in the states...if you've been to the carribbean before it is nothing suprising.  You are never far from a bar and can always get what you need.  
There are folks trying to sell you something at checkin and onthe beach.  However, tourism is thier industry and when we told them no and we were not interested we were not bothered again.  We booked our trip through expedia and did not have a problem.  
We would all recommend this beautiful resort for a great time with friends or family!

reviews.author: ToSweet
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Recently returned from a wonderful 7 days at the Palma Real Paradisus.  We stayed in an ocean front Royal Service suite.  The entire holiday was a delight.  Our butler Juan DeCastillo was amazing.  He spoke very good english and made sure that all our needs where met during our stay.  The staff at the Royal service pool bar (Pedro and Winkin) where wonderful,  very accommodating, exceptionally friendly and appeared to be enjoying their work.  Housekeeping was also very attentive to all our needs and kept our room fresh and clean throughout our stay.  The food in the restaurants exclusive to Royal customers was all very good (the best I have encountered in all my trips to the Domincan).  I was not overly impressed with the buffet, although the offerings where plentiful and extensive the cleanliness was questionable.  We ordered a bottle of wine or champagne with every meal and I would have really like to have someone on staff that was more knowledgable about the wine list.  An in house sommelier would be a GREAT addition to the staff.   I also think the resort could potentially sell better wines to guests (rather than opting for the included wine) if they had someone on staff that knew more about some the unique Spanish wines on the list.  We tended to order mostly Italian, French or California only because of my lack of knowledge on Spanish wines.  When I asked the servers to assist no one had a clue what the wines where.  Although all of the service staff we encountered where very pleasant.   We did use room service on one occasion and was very pleased with the prompt service and hot food that was delivered. (again the best I have encountered in the Dominican)   
The tour staff arranged for a private driver and translater to take us on an excursion.  Santo our driver was terrific and our guide Cesar Tanazos was so knowledgable on the Dominican and very very proud of his country.  Cesar made our 2 trips off the resort very memorable. If you are planning a trip to Paradisus don't miss the restaurant JellyFish just down the beach.  Amazing food !! 
My travel companion and myself are definitely going to plan another trip to DR and will be re-booking at the Palma Real.  I have been to the Dominican on 5 different occasions and this was going to be my last visit if this hotel didn't add up.  Well,  Paradisus has renewed my love for the DR and thanks to the great staff, Juan, Pedro, Winkin,  the delightful ladies who run the Royal Club concierge and my new friend Cesar I can't wait to return.
Cheers from Canada

reviews.author: roberto30187857
reviews.title: nettamente peggiorato
reviews.text:
Ci sono ritornato dopo tre anni perchè a suo tempo ci ero stato benissimo . E' da allora nettamente peggiorato sopratutto nel mangiare . Ricevimento scortese e degrado visibile .
Lo avevo decantato ai miei amici e non ho fatto una buona figura . Sono andato nella spa per una pedicure e mi sono rimediato una ferita al piede con infezione !

reviews.author: EndaTravel
reviews.title: Paradise with a Personal Touch
reviews.text:
We checked into the Paradisus Palma Real and were greeted by very friendly check in staff at the front desk of the resort. We were quickly assigned a concierge to familiarize us with the property. Our concierge, Hugo Mena, was so incredibly helpful. He made our dinner reservations, informed us of new excursions leaving from the resort and even offered to go to a convenience store for us! He provided such excellent service, I would go back to this hotel for that alone!

The property is beautifully maintained and is filled with palm trees, tropical flowers and beautiful green lawns. Every morning, there are hundreds of landscaping staff weeding and watering around our suite. The property is gorgeous! The pool area is well kept and you can check out more than one beach towel at a time from the club house which is huge in my book! Some resorts only allow one towel. The pool bar was the best!!! The staff were AWESOME at the Aqua Bar. Ramon Bonilla AKA "FUEGO" and Bianca checked on us several times throughout the day and were the highlight of the pool area. The only complaint about the pool area -- I wish the pool was slightly heated due to the low 70-mid 80s temperatures of early December. However, "FUEGO" gave us a Dominican drink called "mamajuana" which was better than a personal heater after getting out of the pool!!! The beach was clean and free of debris! Excellent!

The food. I am a bit mixed about the food. The food at the buffet was not up to my standard by far. The fruit and salads were lifeless and flavorless. However, I do not eat a lot of meat. I would say the vegetarian options were quite slim. The buffet food was your only option for breakfast and lunch and I just was not pleased. At night, dining was a totally different experience. There were several different restaurant locations to enjoy -- the options were Asian, French and Italian or the restaurants at The Reserve or Gabi Beach. My favorite was the Italian restaurant. The service was impeccable and the food was delish. The shrimp au gratin was just heavenly! The wait staff, Luigi, Luis, Jose and Juan were absolutely wonderful!

The entertainment was a bit boring other than the Michael Jackson show which was splendid! Their nightclub was boring -- barely anyone in it.

A bit of a downer...we discovered that the housekeeping staff was rifling through our luggage. My friend had something stolen from her luggage. We were a bit unhappy about it and the GM Eduardo apologized profusely.

The beds in our room were a bit saggy in the middle and the sheets were moist ( a bit moist is typical in the Caribbean, but this was too moist) which made sleeping a bit of a challenge sometimes. However, our jacuzzi made up for the discomfort.

I definitely would go back if they increase the quality of the food for breakfast and lunch. I love the staff and love the atmosphere. It is not a party resort, but truly one for relaxation.

reviews.author: Nass0603
reviews.title: Thanks for giving me such good time !
reviews.text:
I will never forget that trip and the Hotel Paradisus Palma Real that correspond exactly to my wishes to have memorable holidays
People are so kind and professional, available too, the hotel is beautiful!
I would like to thank, Karyn Agurto especially, for her availibility, she was wonderful with us! Thanks again !
Hope to return !!
Nassera Hammadi

reviews.author: FredTx23
reviews.title: Stunning hotel, great location, excellent service
reviews.text: We had a great time in this property, at the beginning I was scared thinking if this hotel could reach our expectatives, we spend 7 days and I feel I need to be back as soon as I can. The rooms are so pretty, comfortable and cozy, I got surprised with the ocean beauty, at the enormous beach area you can stay the all day ordering refreshing cocktails and caribbean delights, they have a wide culinary options so you won´t get bored, don´t miss Agave restaurant delicious mexican food and Bana with the asian cuisine, one think I can´t forget is the amability and service of all the staff, everyone went above and beyond trying to pleased our needs. Wow

reviews.author: TiegemWouter
reviews.title: Laat je niet vangen !!! (the leading hotels of de world)
reviews.text:
Beste,
Onze reis zit er weeral op, we hadden er ons wel iets anders bij voorgesteld !
Wij boeken als jaren met v.i.p selection, maar ditmaal zijn we heel erg ontgoocheld.
Het hotel paradisus palma real is heel mooi van stijl en inrichting maar de service en het eten zijn echt beneden alle peil!
Wij zijn zeker niet de eerste om te gaan klagen hoor, maar wanneer je +- €7500 betaald voor 1 weekje velof per koppel mag het wel iets meer zijn.
Zwembad is totaal niet verwarmd , geen kat die zich in het water durft te wagen.
Bij aankomst werden onze valiezen open gebroken en werden alle parfums en juwelen gestolen, we hebben daarover een gesprek gehad met de verantwoordelijke van het hotel en die gingen ons binnen de 24 uur iets laten weten.
Helaas, er werd er niets ondernomen.
Enfin, het feit dat ik niet tevreden ben staat los van de diefstal.
Nog een geluk dat we onze vrienden meehadden!!!!!(anders waren we vroeger terug gekomen denk ik)
Nog een tip, vip labels best niet bloot op valiezen hangen, Ze gaan ervan uit dat je heel rijk bent dan.(zeker geen juwelen meedoen, ofwel nepjuwelen)

Gegroet wouter asja stijn anneleen

reviews.author: SuperDorbo
reviews.title: It's beauty was only skin deep
reviews.text: The Paradisus was a beautiful resort, the people were all very nice. Problems: one of staff who had access to our room stole $100 bill. The management team said they would let us know outcome of investigation but we never heard back from anyone. Our friend's first room leaked on the bed, their second room had a leak over the toilet, the third room... they turned it down and stayed where they were because it was so far removed from everyone else. instead they used an umbrella any time they had to use the facilities. Our other friend's room - the sink plumbing in the bathroom started leaking during the night, when they got up the next morning one of them slipped and fell almost cracking their head on the marble floor.

reviews.author: starfish007
reviews.title: Our Wedding Was Amazing!!  Pure Paradise!
reviews.text:
We stayed in The Reserve section of the Paradisus Palma Real from November 23 to December 3 for our wedding/honeymoon.  It was spectacular!  Don't be scared of the negative reviews.  
Check-in was very easy, we were offered a welcome drink and were upgraded to a one bedroom master suite on the third floor with a view of the pool (Room 5020).  I could not believe how gorgeous it was.  There were basically two bathrooms, one had a sink, huge shower for two and toilet and the second had double sinks, jacuzzi tub and two built in closets with drawers.  There was a dining room table, kitchen area with a sink, fully stocked mini fridge (other rooms had a microwave and stove but ours did not) and two sofas (one pulled out to a bed).  The terrace was gorgeous with a round table and four chairs, sofa, table, two chairs and outdoor jacuzzi.  The view from our room overlooked the entire pool area.  Our room looked exactly like what was pictured on the website.  Bed was kind of hard but they offer a pillow menu and turn down service every night.  Our conceirge was Johan and he arranged all of our dinner reservations for us.  He was wonderful!
The pool area is beautiful and there were plenty of lounge chairs and bali beds.  The pool is so big that you can go away from the main pool to a more quiet area that has lounge chairs and quieter pool area.  Servers come around and take drink orders.  Francisco took care of us many days.  We always threw him some money and he always took care of us.
The restaurants were good, some better than others but the food was inconsistent:
Gabi Club: Open air restaurant off the pool.  We had breakfast buffet there every day.  Some days they had lunch buffet or a la carte lunch.  The mofungo was delicious!  Gabi Bar is situated here as well and had a great time with the bartenders Rosalina, Evelyn, and Abraham.  They have top shelf liquor and make very strong drinks!
Hydro Grill:  A la carte restaurant by the pool.  I had ribeye there one day and it was great!  Tomato and cheese salad was delicious and I had it every time we ate there.  One day burger was good other day it was dried out.  Calamari was great.  On two occassions I asked for authentic Dominican food (which they don't really have) and I got rice and beans with fried plantains (awesome!) and my last day they made me two huge lobster tails with mofungo (smushed plaintains with bacon).  Soooo yummy!
Aqua:  Gorgeous interior, dinner was great!  Grouper, beef carpaccio and cream of potato soup were the best.
Mizu: We did hibachi dinner here and it was as good as in the States.
Bana: We did family style asian dishes for our welcome dinner.  Everything was great.
Passions: "French Restaurant"  It was definitley not French.  My least favorite restaurant.
Vento: Italian Restaurant, It was pretty good.
Gabi Beach: Same concept as Gabi Club but located in the main hotel on the beach instead of the pool.  Filet, scallop and lobster, it was delicious.
One note about the food: Everything seems to have peppers on or in it and I hate peppers so I had to always ask for no peppers.  Also, the first couple of times my steak came out overcooked when I ordered it medium rare so I ordered everything rare the rest of the trip and it came out perfectly.
Gabi Beach: The beach is gorgeous but there was some trash in the water.  There is a special section for the Reserve guest only with nicer padded lounge chairs and plenty of shade.  Servers will come and bring you drinks.  We always tipped and got great service.  Juan Bautista took good care of us.
Because we stayed in The Reserve we just took a golf cart to the main resort to access the beach, other restaurants and casino (two minute ride).  Casino was ok, drinks there were really good.
Spa:  Definitely worth the money!!  I did the timeshare deal and received a $100 credit for the spa.  I received a wonderful hydrotherapy session (approx. 45 minutes) as well as a 50 minute massage.  I also had my hair done for the wedding and she did a great job!
I would highly recommend this resort, if you need more info just PM me and any to-be-brides, feel free to ask any questions since I didn't go into the details of our wedding.  Only thing they should work on is more consistent food.  Room service was quick but not always tasty.  Coffee was awesome!  Service was top-notch and most everyone was extremely friendly!  The resort is spotless!  People complained that some restaurants were closed but that is because they clean them.  On the day we left, Gabi Club was closed and they were literally scrubbing it down.  Anyone who says the resort is dirty is crazy.

reviews.author: JayJay151976
reviews.title: Abosolutely beautiful, clean relaxing a wonderful experience.
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and accomodating. Rooms and whole entire place beautiful. Decor was so nice very open and airy.

reviews.author: lv2tvlatl
reviews.title: All inculsive with friendly service.
reviews.text: Service is timely and friendly.  Gorgeous pools, free nightly entertainment, pleasant service and good food.  The Domicians are very friendly, not like some of the other Caribbean islands.  The property has a beautiful, large white sand beach with plenty of beach chairs and beach beds.  The property is large.  We found are way around by the third day though.  We had an ocean front room in the Royal Service section.  The room came with a butler!  The room was very spacious with a daily stocked mini bar and a extra large jacuzzi tub along with a shower.  Liked the architecture in the room and around the property.

reviews.author: BradyVT
reviews.title: Great Resort, Great Service, Awesome Time!
reviews.text: We just got back from vacation at the Palma Real and had a wonderful time!  Even though Hurrican Tomas was threatening the D.R. the staff remained focused on making sure that we had a great time!  Our room was amazing and the resort is top notch!  If you have a chance to visit Punta Cana please check it out.  Luis Diaz and Bianca, that worked at the pool bar, were awesome!  They always kept our drinks full and were always having fun.  Also, Jimmy (Activities Coordinator) was a lot of fun and did a great job arranging volleyball games each day and setting up different activities for us to participate in.  Please make sure to find these folks when you visit!  They will be sure to take care of you!

reviews.author: Mel_wanderlust
reviews.title: FUEGO FUEGO FUEGO
reviews.text: Amazing hotel - Ramon Bonilla was amazing. Best bartender ever. He was so kind to our entire group - made drinks for the kids inside empty coconut shells and we never had a an empty drink. He made our stay so memorable

reviews.author: wingradrt
reviews.title: Just what we needed
reviews.text:
We stayed a week at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort and we would definitely go back. It was us two single girls looking for a little rest and relaxation – we certainly were not disappointed. The resort it self was beyond beautiful! The pool was huge and there were plenty of chairs in and outside of the pool to relax in. The depth of the pool was a little deep for me, as I am just 5’4, but it was still great. The ocean front beach was also very beautiful, well kept and again, plenty of places to relax in the sun or under shade if the sun got too intense. We liked the idea of being able to walk the beach for miles, in either direction and felt safe. There were local shops where we stopped to look at things along the way. 
	The service was exceptional. Being single, it is sometimes hard to find professional and polite members of the staff at other resorts we visited. Genaro and Emmanuel, our concierges were great. They took us on a short tour of the entire place when we first arrived. They took care of all our dinner reservations and anytime we needed help, they were there. The pool bar group – Luis, Ramon and Bianka were very fun and attentive. They would see us swimming up to the bar and have our drinks waiting for us. They demonstrated a love of their jobs and the people that they served. Fernando at the Ceil Sky Bar outside of the Market Place was very kind and made the best drinks – nice and cold after playing beach volleyball. We often stopped there after dinner too – it was nice to be outside and enjoy the great weather and ocean front.  If you did not like the drink, he would make you a new one. His motto: if his customers are happy, he is happy. Guastvo, the mini-bar service was very prompt and courteous when we called. He was very well-mannered and his smile could light up a room. Even though these ladies and gentlemen were younger than us, they all acted in a very mature, professional manner at all times while being amusing and entertaining. They also all shared with us their love of the Dominican and how important work is to them. 
	The food was exceptional. We ate at almost all the restaurants. The staff again was very professional and polite and the portions were just right – not too small not too much. The selections were vast and the presentations were brilliant. The buffet for breakfast and lunch was also very good. There was always a wide variety of selections at all times.
	We did not stay at the reserve, but our room was beautiful, with an ocean view. The housekeepers were fantastic. We used the fitness center, took part in water aerobics, beach volleyball and kayaked the ocean almost every day. There is a shopping mall in walking distance and a few nights, local exhibitors came to the resort with a wide assortment of things to buy. All in all, our week was fantastic and we did not want to leave.

reviews.author: TropicalTrailblazer
reviews.title: Pure Tropical Paradise
reviews.text:
I travel every year and have been to the Dominican 4 times.  For this trip I went well above my typical budget and went for the full VIP treatment, and now nothing else will ever compare!  It's a stunning resort of the highest quality - the kind of place they film movies at.  In fact, I'm pretty sure I recognized it in an episode of 'Rock of Love with Bret Michaels'!!

Food:  the best resort food I've ever had, right down to the snack bar.  Room service is included at no extra charge.  Drinks like pina coladas were really kicked up a notch - blended with fresh fruit!

Beach: beautiful white sand beach & clear aqua water; plenty of places to lounge in sun or shade. You can even get staff to bring you drinks if you're that lazy.

Resort & Rooms: the photos speak for themselves; everything was pristine and luxurious, and postcard-perfect

Staff: friendly & helpful

Weather:  hot (but not too hot!), sunny, blue skies

reviews.author: SunLuvnGirl
reviews.title: IF YOU DON'T MIND PEOPLE/THIEVES WALKING INTO YOUR ROOM WHILE YOUR SLEEPING STAY HERE!!!!!
reviews.text:
BEWARE!!!! 
Upon arriving to the hotel at 130PM, our rooms would not be ready till 3PM, so our group had drinks at the bar in the lobby and waited for our rooms.  Once we got our room keys, we were exhausted from the day of traveling and the heat and settled into our rooms for a nap, leaving the do not disturb sign on the door.  My friends staying two doors down said they were woken up from their nap a few hours later when the maid had let herself in & started "reorganizing" their belongings.  What she actually was doing was riffling through their belongings!!!  When I woke up, I not only found things had been moved but my ring was missing from the night stand next to my bed where I was sleeping!!!  Someone let themselves into our room & had stolen my ring while I slept!!!  I was more terrified than appalled that someone had the audacity to come into our room while we were there sleeping!  We could have been raped & killed!!  I reported this to security which pretty much told me that it was my fault for leaving the ring on the nightstand but that they would look into the matter and get back to me w/in 48hours.  This was July 29th today is August 4th and I never heard back from them.  Before checking out I contacted security again and was told the man who was handling the situation wasn't there but would call me, no one has!  This definitely put a damper on our vacation but we were grateful to be alive & tried to enjoy our friends wedding.   We will never go there again & I would never recommend staying at this hotel to anyone!!!

PROS: From a distance its a beautiful place filled w/lush gardens, over-sized pool, bars every where, 15min drive from airport & located directly on the beach.

CONS: Up close the hotel needs a face-lift.  Paint was peeling every where & every Sunday instead of scrapping off the paint & repainting, they just painted over everything in the lobby.  Pool & Beach closed @ 7PM!!!  Food was average at best & I'm being too kind, w/the exception of BANA - the staff & food were amazing. Most people were unfriendly & spoke no English (except for the bartender Nelson located in the hotel lobby, who went above & beyond my expectations of what customer service should be.) No entertainment other than a 30min show on the weekends, which got old quick.  Rooms were moldy, leaky showers & mosquitoes in the room because the maids would leave the doors open while the cleaned! 

LUXURY HOTEL??? FAR FROM IT! STAY AWAY SAVE YOUR MONEY & STAY SOME WHERE ELSE FOR HALF THE PRICE!!!

reviews.author: getme0ut0fjersey
reviews.title: Great stay! Glad we took the chance despite bad reviews
reviews.text:
Well almost a year later and I am writing the review! I felt I had to write something since I do rely upon these reviews for my vacation decisions.
We LOVED this place, although there were some bad reviews written we are seasoned travelers and found this place to be great! I am in the travel industry and can tell you we know lots of tricks to get around. So heres some tips for this place.
-Get to know who your concierge is as soon as possible.Ours was fantastic and we tipped him FIRST. We booked our dinner reservations first with him right away. If you are going to stay All inclusive that is a must!
-READ! There are signs telling you about what the resort offers.I read that people commented there was nothing to do! THis place had shows every night, entertainers during different times in the lobby. 
-Get sick to your stomach? Dominican Republic is notorious for issues with food. I always eat yogurt before and during my stay. Dont drink water unless bottled. 
-The outside vendors for ziplining was an issue, seems that way with the horseback riding too....it is definately an HOUR drive away. Zip lines were dangerous, exercise caution.
Beautiful beaches although there are issues with seaweed, this resort rakes for their guests.
-IMMACULATE, this entire resort is clean clean clean!
-Spa was very accomodating and good service.
-we did not stay in the Reserve area, seems that might NOT be the way to go if you want to be close to the beach. 
-and YES ...surprise, surprise ENGLISH was a little shaky with the staff....UM Hello people, the native laguage is SPANISH....learn some basic spanish before you go its helpful. It always amazes me how people complain about this...no matter where you go...its never gonna be perfect.
-Top shelf alcohol has to be asked for, not all bars had the same liquor at each one.
We read the comments about this place and took a chance going and we all were glad we went it was a great vacation and would definately go back!

reviews.author: GetAwayGirl04
reviews.title: Stay Here - you will not regret it!
reviews.text:
How wonderful!  If you are looking to relax -just do nothing - be in that frame of mind.  Our day consisted of getting up - throwing on the swim suits - getting a place at the pool - eating at an open air restaurant for breakfast (buffet - omlets are great!) - heading to the pool and staying most of the day.  We then got ready for dinner - make your reservations when you check in - and then the evening entertainment.  

You will be ask about hearing there "promotion" - BUT - you do not have to do it.  We chose to and did it the first morning we were there to get it our of the way.  We were given a wonderful gift!  Well worth our time - and after our 90 minutes - we said "no" and very kindly parted ways.  No biggie.  They do not "con" you into doing this.

Our rooms were very clean and well tended to, the restaurants were very good, and the beach was pristeen.  My favorite part - the staff at the pool!  We made very good friends of Ramon, Bianca and Luis!  We spent alot of time at the pool and they were AWESOME!!!!  Very kind to all and remembered our drinks - all week!

Very romantic!    Enjoy!  and remember - you are going on vacation to de-stress not re-stress.  Remember - Your attitude is 90% of how any trip goes!

reviews.author: Dmoon
reviews.title: Great Resort !!!!!- Dont upgrade to Royal Butler Service
reviews.text: Being from the DR, I’ve had the opportunity to stay in many resorts in Punta Cana.  Palma Real might just be my favorite. The resort is absolutely gorgeous, well maintained and the beach is second to none.  The resort is not too big, and not to small.  Food was above average and all the Top Shelf drinks you can handle.  I opted for the Royal Butler service (which was well  more than doubled the price for a regular room) and I must say ITS NOT WORTH IT.  We saw the butler once, the room was a suite, but I was barely in it (other then sleep and showers).  I HIGHLY recommend this resort for a fun in the sun vacation and one of the most beautiful resorts/ beaches in the world.

reviews.author: RDL77
reviews.title: Stunning resort with a few gaps in service
reviews.text:
The resort is absolutely gorgeous and I very much enjoyed my staff, but I would offer just a couple of caveats. First, we were told that we qualified for an upgrade to the Royal Service when booking, but when we arrived we were told this was not true, which led to a frustrating check-in experience. In the end, we got a "VIP" upgrade, which turned out to be better than the Royal Service, as far I could tell. The private Royal Service beach didn't seem to have much to offer, while access to Gabi Beach (which comes with VIP service) had these fantastic Bali beds with pillows. We also got an ocean view room, with balcony, and access to Gabi Beach Restaurant. However, even the Gabi Beach Restaurant is supposed to be the nicest (those without VIP access are charged) the food was much better at Bana and Passion. 

Because there is little information about the fitness amenities on the web site, I'll add just a few words about them. The gym is small but functional compared to most places in the region. What I really enjoyed was the outdoor yoga studio, where free classes were held every day at 11 and 5 (not all yoga, there was a mixture of pilates, meditation, etc as well.) That was a nice touch, for those who want to get some exercise but don't want to walk on a treadmill or lift weights.

The pools are absolutely gorgeous, although you'll barely need them considering how stunning the beaches are, with soft, powdery white sand and blue water. 

Other points I would highlight -- this place is geared toward couples, families and small groups looking for a relaxing time. If you're looking for a "singles" scene, this is not the right place. While there are a lot of activities to do, like snorkeling, diving, parasailing, etc, the resort isn't really close to a town where you can walk around and try the nightlife. This is definitely for those who want to just stick to the resort. Also, while some of the staff speaks English well, others know only a limited amount and some don't speak it at all. I know enough Spanish that it wasn't a problem, but if you don't speak any Spanish at all, I can see how it might be frustrating at times.

The bottom line is that this resort is one of the most beautiful I have ever seen. Some of the limitations mean that it's not for everyone. But if you're looking for a gorgeous resort, gorgeous beach and a relaxing, quiet time, this place is about as good as it gets in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: ECH1012
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: I visited the Paradisus Palma Real for a girl's trip and we had a fabulous time!  The area felt very safe which was important to us since it was "just girls".  The trip to and from the resort from the airport was brief and convenient.  The resort is beautiful and the service was excellent.  We did not stay in the reserve nor did we opt for the royal service and had no problems as a result of this.  We were there during "low season", after Easter break and before summer when family travel picks up.  If the resort were busy it would make since to upgrade for better service.  One thing we especially enjoyed was the spa.  We have visited a lot of spas and this one ranked very high for service, treatments, price, and the available relaxation areas.  If the weather is rainy go to the spa and take a book, you are set for they day!  We will definitely be returning again and appreciate the value and service at the Paradisus!

reviews.author: archiphile
reviews.title: I'm not going to sue but
reviews.text:
We had a below average break at this resort.  We found the food in the buffets average at best.  The restaurants require a reservation an they messed ours up so I'm not that happy with that aspect.

We also intended on Kayaking, and sailing however the red flag (wind) was up for the four days of our trip and we were not allowed out on the water.

The guy at the pool yelling fire water really put the icing on the cake for us, I mean do I really want a shot pool side at 10am?  if so do I really need a guy to scream at me to do it?  and then to imitate as though it is him urinating in my mouth with the bottle?  
The place is a little confused between new age relaxation and DR frat boys gone wild.

reviews.author: krayoung
reviews.title: 5 Star Hotel, 2 Stars for Service & Food
reviews.text:
First of all, let me start by saying that I would go back to this resort.  The hotel was beautiful, the pools and beach were amazing, I had a fantastic room, and the staff was very friendly.  However, I did have problems with the service which made it very frustrating at times.  We paid a lot of money to be at this resort, and the service did not reflect that. Getting coffee or juice during breakfast was a joke.  I would usually ask 3-5 times and either give up or finally get it as I was walking away done with my meal. We had the same problem at dinner.  It would take forever to even have them bring you a glass of water at times, and even longer to take your order.  I also had problem ordering drinks.  One bartender at the Reserve didn't know how to make any drinks - even the ones on the menu.  Other times I would order something, and get something entirely different then what I ordered.  

The food was ok, nothing mind blowing but I still enjoyed it.  The sushi was my favorite.  Probably because that was one thing they couldn't over cook.  If you don't want your meat and fish cooked extremely well done, make sure you stress that you want it rare. We only had one really bad meal.  We had a 6:45 reservation for the Japanese Restaurant where they cook on the table.  They sat us at the 6:00 pm table, everyone was already finished with their appetizers and salads so we didn't get any of that.  The food when we got it was all blackened, the cook ran out of vegetables so we didn't get that either, and after 25 min. of sitting down for dinner they asked us to move to a different table for our dessert so they could seat another group.  Not my idea of a great dinner. We left and found a buffet to have dinner at which was much better. 

There is suppose to be a shuttle that takes you from the Reserve Section to the Beach.  The shuttles rarely came by and when it did, they often did not stop to pick us up even though the shuttle was empty.  I stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana resort last time, and we never had a problem with the shuttles there-they ran all the time.  It was also a rare event to have a waiter or waitress bring you a drink on the beach.  I would usually see them once during the day, and sometimes they would never come back after placing my order.  Tipping did not help.  I never saw a waiter at the pool.  There were pool bars so that was nice, but it would have been nice to have had someone walking around taking drink orders.  

Despite these issues, I still really enjoyed my stay here.  The pool, beach, and room made up for some of these problems.  The maids cleaned our room twice a day, and always did a great job. We found people who gave us great, consistent service like Saul at the Martini Bar in Bana, Luis at the Pool Bar, Ekatarina in Concierge Svs, and Jorge for Scuba diving.  These were all people who went above and beyond and made our trip special, but they were rare. 

If great food and service is important to you, this probably isn't the best place for you.

reviews.author: onholidayNewJersey
reviews.title: Don't let the negative reviews stop you
reviews.text:
We spent five days at the Paradisus Palma Real at the end of February.  This is our third trip to the DR and our first time at the Pradisus.  Before we left, we read the reviews and were a little concerned.  A number of writers stated that the service was horrible and the resort itself was below par.  This was not my experience.  We staryed at the Reserve.  The room was spacious and well appointed.  The grounds are well maintained and and the pool area is huge.  The other writers were correct.  It is about a 10 minute walk to the beach, however the reserve uses golf carts that will transport you to the beach and the main lobby and the hotels restaurants. The reserve has it's own beach which is staffed to provide beverage service.  They also have a beach restaurant for lunch.

There are some downsides to the Paradisus.  As in most all-inclusives the food is not great.  If you stay at the reserve, have your breakfasts at the reserve.  The buffet is better organized.  We had dinner at the Gobi restaurant at the reserve which was not too bad.  Also had dinner at Passions and the Italian restaurant.  The food was at least edible.  We ate at the buffet at the main resort.  I wouldn't recommend that.  I think the resort really needs to work on the food as so most all inclusives.

One last issue.  If you are going for the night life...don't.  The bars are okay and they do have top shelf alcohol.  They also have shows which did not look appealing.

I would absolutely recommend this hotel.  They just need to work on the food.

reviews.author: Maryarose21
reviews.title: Fun all the way around
reviews.text: Nice to place to stay and relax. Loved the activities I participated in and the fact food and drink were readily available. The only downside is the beach is public, so there are always people trying to sell goods and services.

reviews.author: Анна Ш
reviews.title: Terrible service for big money
reviews.text:
If you want to stay in a hotel where the General Manager will tell you: are you going to sleep now? After your complaints that your bed has no bedclothes after cleaning!! Come on!! I should not explain what I am going to do in my room, for which I paid (by the way I had very high temperature and I called to the manager after few calls to room service, etc).
If you want to stay in a hotel where you book a table restaurant, you go there and they tell you that there is no your reservation. You spend a lot of time explaining, asking, demanding and finally they gave you a table and... The restaurant is empty, only few tables are busy. Does all this talks worth that????
So if you don't want to spoil your vacations and spend too much money for that - DON'T GO THERE!!

reviews.author: chrisozz
reviews.title: BEWARE: Bait and switch: Looks can be deceiving - terrible service
reviews.text:
Complete Bait and Switch!  I booked a 6 person birthday trip online in Nov getting a special rate for 3 rooms that included the "Royal Service" in a garden suite.   I had called to clarify the extra service and special rate prior to booking and was told at the time that there were 9 rooms left.  I booked three.  I was particularly interested in the Royal Service as it allowed us entry to the adult only beaches, which all of my travelers, especially those with families that they were leaving behind, would appreciate.

Upon check-in, the front desk person said our rate was actually lower than what I had booked, and there was no "Royal Service".
