Despite having the paperwork to show our confirmed rate, he said he would look into the reservation company as to why my rate was higher than the rooms they had for us and get back to us after we enjoyed some lunch.  

Lunch buffet was average, wide selection of local foods.  The property is nice, great vast views of the water and a nice pool.

An hour and a half later after lunch the front desk offered no solution and somehow blamed me for the mistake.  While my confirmation  did not mention "royal service", the confirmed, written rate for the rooms was the advertised rate online at that time that I booked, which was obviously different than the rate that they were now quoting us.   He blamed me and then the reservation company for the error.  Despite me having called and spoken to people at the time of the reservation prior and reconfirming the "royal service" booking by phone after I placed my order online, apparently I should have known that the email confirmation needed to say that it was a special rate with additional services.  The front desk people refused to acknowledge the fact that the rates on my confirmation matched that of the special and insisted on giving us the lesser quality/service rooms.

My request to speak to a manager fell on deaf ears.  When we had a local friend who is the real estate agent that referred us to this property talk to the front desk person on the phone, he revealed that they actually were overbooked and couldn't give us the room that we had reserved even if they wanted to.  The front desk supervisor eventually came out, 2 hours later and just kept repeating that they couldn't do anything, that the rooms we had were the cheaper ones they offered.  They were unapologetic, blaming me and the reservation company.  After three hours of heated conversation going no where, and we arranged for staying at Tortuga Bay, they offered us rooms at another lower end property.   

There was a wedding party checking in at the time we were dealing with all this hassle and all I could think about was how terrible it would be to be a bride dealing with the incompetence and lack of customer service demonstrated by the front desk at this hotel.  I strongly discourage anyone from booking with this property and definitely don't expect them to be able to coordinate all the fine details of any special event.

Despite getting a note from them in writing that they would no charge us a cancellation fee, I am now having my credit card fight the charges that appeared on my  credit card 2 weeks later.

So three hours of hell into the start of what was supposed to be a luxurious rare getaway to celebrate birthdays, we were finally whisked away by the amazing people from Tortuga Bay, where the service was outstanding,  accommodation were luxurious, right on the beach and food was amazing.  Everything was perfect at Tortuga Bay.  

Leave the bait and switch for the fish.  If you want a hassle-free, relaxed, fun time, go to Tortuga Bay.

reviews.author: Lauren B
reviews.title: Definitely a GREAT choice, I certainly will be a repeat customer!
reviews.text:
I went with a friend for a long weekend getaway, we live in Chicago and anything to get away from the cold and snow sounded good to us. I have been to Punta Cana before and quite honestly have not been impressed with many of the hotels I have stated at previously so when we arrived at PPR I was happily surprised. Our flight landed around 3, and we got to the hotel around 330, based upon other reviews I expected we would not get reservations for that evening and was ok with going to buffet, much to my surprise, not only were we upgraded at check in our personal concierge ( given to you at check in) was able to get us reservations at Vento for 815 that very same evening. 

Vento was a good restaurant, not my favorite at the resort, but it was good and the staff was very friendly. Possibly because of what we ordered we were not floored by the food or anything, but we also weren't expecting to, it is an all inclusive resort, you can't go in expecting 5 star gourmet meals. The food came out quickly with not much lag time between courses. It was a treat, and a great beginning to our trip!

The next morning we went out to the pool and were able to get great seats ( and if you get out early enough you can grab a cabana at the main pool, which is a real treat in the heat in the middle of the day) we were helped by one of the pool boys, his name was William, he was amazing, so much so that we ended up tipping him quite a lot at the end of our stay. The bartenders at the pool are also very friendly if you make friends with them they will say hi to you every day and might even speak up on your behalf if someone tries to take the seats that you have consistently used every day.

Our second night we had a power outage which many people might say was an inconvenienve or some other silly remark. quite honestly, a night in paradise where you could see nothing but the stars in the sky and the moon on the horizon, no sounds of music, no lights, just you, the wind and the waves, it was great! towards the end of the evening when my friend and I were ready to return to our rooms ( the key cards still worked) we grabbed a hold of a housekeeper and she hadned over a handful of candles so we could get ready for bed, of course about an hour after we went to our room the lights came on, but I truly found it to be a magical once in a lifetime experience.

The rest of our trip was equally as wonderful, good meals, not gourmet, but for an all you can eat, all inclusive place expecting gourmet is silly.

WARNING: the staff here is not very proficient in English, thankfully I speak Spanish fluently so it didn't impact our stay, but, we realized that aside from one or two staff members in each hotel area, many of them didn't know enough to handle a complain or carry on a conversation, or even give you the time. The hotel, as with many resorts only has a clock in the room so we relied upon the watches of the staff.

reviews.author: NYOutnabout
reviews.title: Loved it!!!!!!! I'LL BE BACK!!!
reviews.text: Overall our stay was great!!!. We were upgraded to a suite!!!!!!  The concierge desk coordinated all of our activities... Swimming with dophins, parasailing...etc... EXCELLENT. The Lobby bartender was so sweet, and made great drinks!!!  The resturants were great (Lobster!!!!)... the all inclusive price we paid was worth it!!!! I'll be back in 2010!!!!!

reviews.author: KL_SF
reviews.title: Perfect place for a relaxing getaway!
reviews.text: I just returned from a 5 day stay at the Paradisus Palma Real and already am looking forward to my next visit.  The resort was amazing and was decorated beautifully for the Holidays and the Spa was on par with best I've been to in the States.  The staff was very friendly and knew each of us personally by the third day.  The beaches were clean and beautiful and it was never difficult to get a lounge chair near the water.   The resort had 5+ restaurants to choose from at night, ranging from romantic white tablecloth to casual beachside dining with different types of cuisine, so you never get tired of eating the same thing, like at other all inclusive resorts.  Great amenities.  Great food.  Friendly staff.  All in all, a great experience!

reviews.author: Queenbella
reviews.title: Oour wedding day was a dream come true here
reviews.text:
My husband and I had our wedding/reception at the Paradisus Palma Real.  It was a fairytale wedding!!  It was better than we had imagined it.  We must give special thanks to our wedding planner, Mrs. Noelia Moreno.  She was absolutely the most professional and accomodating wedding planner and she made it all happen perfectly.  We had our wedding at the gazebo (surrounded by the pool) and it was awesome!!  It was beautifully decorated and perfect and all the guests at the hotel even surrounded us and we felt like royalty.  The reception was spectacular! The food was absolutely divine; our guests complimented it all and said it was worth every penny we paid to have our wedding there.  The servers were great and polite and they catered to our every need. If you every want to have your wedding there, please contact Noelia Moreno, she is wonderful!!  She had an assistant, Maria, who was a gem as well.  Frank Peeters, the resident manager is an asset to that hotel as well; he was very attentive and accomodating!! I would definitely visit this hotel again.  It was beautiful and we were very happy with the service they provided.  Our friends/family were thrilled as well.  We all had an absolutely wonderful time on our wedding day and I could not ask for better.  Our wedding/honeymoon/vacation was the best here!!  We would even consider going back to renew our vows there as we had a great time.  It was one of the best vacations I had.
It is a gorgeous resort and we would highly recommend this resort!!

reviews.author: pablo700
reviews.title: Overrated, but a nice vacation spot
reviews.text:
First, let me preface my review by saying that this was my (16) visit to the dominican
republic in (4) years and my fourth visit to punta cana in three years. My stay was for seven days in November.  First, the flight from bwi direct to punta cana is a three hour direct flight via USA 3000 airlines. This airlines is exceeds expectations and for a direct price is moderately priced. Back to the hotel, the grounds are manicured and the grounds crew should be commended, it looks like a tropical oasis but not overdone. The Gabi beach was great, secluded by ropes and very few people have access to this area. With royal palace type security. There is a waiter assigned to this area that takes your order if alcohol or drinks is what you desire.  All drinks are top shelf and not watered down.  Additionally, there are a sufficient number of beds and lounge chairs if sunbathing or napping is your desire.  Overall the staff were great, Juckson, Robert, and Griselle who are waiters were excellent, everyday I enjoyed conversing in espanol with them.  The casino as advertised is misleading as it is tiny as casinos go. The restaurants overall were good, but I did have one very negative experience. The restaurant "Passion" has a policy of long pants and shoes as the "hostess"  Ibelka emphatically  informed me and I use the word hostess with reservation as she was unprofessional to say the least.  Anyway after I was advised that I would not be permitted to enter with saddles I left to change shoes and upon my return was advised by my party that an older gentleman of a lighter complexion with saddles was permitted entrance. I immediately questioned the on-duty manager who was apologetic but did not rectify the situation.  The following day I met with Cesar Garcia 'Food and Beverage Manager" and Denise Ortiz Concierge Manager, they apologized and assured me that it was an error on their part, and as a token of good will offered me a fifty-minute massage compliments of the hotel. In closing I will say one negative experience should not determine the quality or lack of regarding a hotel. I would stay here again given that the food, staff and amenities overall were very appealing. Oh yeah, the gym was tiny but no treadmill can be beat a beautiful sandy beach for running 3 miles anyday. A great place to vacation for couples and those who enjoy being pampered. Chao

reviews.author: atlanta96
reviews.title: Décor 5 étoiles pour une service 2 étoiles - Pas prêt pour les européens
reviews.text:
Cet hotel est magnifique, spacieux et les vues sur la mer et la plage sont somptueuses.  Les chambres sont grandes et très bien entretenues. La grande piscine centrale est incroyable : on se croit très vite au paradis.
Le buffet est délicieux, fourni et les serveurs très sympathiques. C'est d'ailleurs le cas dans tous les restaurants du resort. 
Nous avions choisi le RoyalService qui met à votre disposition pour la durée de notre séjour un concierge sensé satisfaire à toutes nos petites demandes. Et là, ça se gate :  
Le service est pompeux mais inefficace. Les concierges sont élevés à l'américaine, c'est à  dire qu'ils s'attendent à recevoir un pourboire dès qu'ils executent une de vos demandes ( donc c'est royal service all inclusive excepté le concierge !!!). 
C'est lui qui décide de l'heure et du restaurant ou vous mangerez le soir, pas cool ! -
-  Vous demandez un changement et là tout va de travers la résa bien que confirmée n'est pas faite quand on se présente, et pour couronner le tout on se fait gentilement remettre à sa place. 
- Ne laisser pas trainer 5 euros dans votre chambre car la femme de ménage considère que c'est un pourboire. Bien que nous ayons spécifier que ce n'était pas le cas, rien n'a été fait : c'est comme ça et puis c'est tout. 
- Une carte désactivée et c'est à vous de vous déplacer pour faire le changement
- Nous avons eu un accident de bateau et là l'hotel n'est responsable de rien (alors qu'il s'agissait d'un de ces prestataires), c'est à peine s'ils appellent un médecin, prévoir 95 dollars pour avoir un morceau de glace sur la tête au bout d'une heure. Ils n'appellent pas l'ambulance ni rien car ils ne sont responsables de rien encore une fois. bref, nous aurions pu mourir 10 fois que rien ne se serait passé. Nous avons du tout gerer nous même.
- Le jour de notre départ le concierge avait disparu
Finalement le concierge ne sert à rien à part à  déambuler avec son carnet noir autour des piscines à vous servir des How are you doing today ???? C'est le seul hôtel de punta cana à bénéficier de l'appellation "Leading of the world", mais ne vous y trompez pas le service n'est absolument pas à la hauteur. En tout cas, les critères de service sont à l'américaine, en fonction du pourboire que vous laisser vous avez un niveau de service : mais dans un all inclusive il y a un décalage. Ils ne sont pas prêt pour recevoir des européens. C'est très décevant pour un hôtel classé 5 étoiles, si le lieu les mérite le service est très très en dessous. Pour moi c'est un hôtel qui n'est pas classifié correctement et mieux vaut quelque chose de moins prétentieux avec un vrai service de qualité.

reviews.author: MissinDaBeach
reviews.title: Did the people with bad reviews stay at the same place?
reviews.text: I read all the reviews before we went to Palma Real and I must say I was a little worried. Seriously, I don't think anyone could write a bad review. We stayed there for a week with another couple. The only problem we had was the hot water did not work in one of our rooms and we received an upgrade to another suite right away. The service there is fabulous! Jose Martinez "PePe" made our reservations for dinner everyday and held our hands on any and everything we wished to do......We Love You PePe. Then there is housekeeping, Ivelisse Pinaly was our housekeeper and she is the most adorable and friendly person I have ever had the pleasure of meeting.....she had flower and choclates in our room everynight. The resort itself is unbelieveable!! Beautiful is the only word to describe it.  The food for an all inclusive was way above average and I would suggest going to Gabi, it is not included in the standard service but the lobster is well worth the $32.00. However, if you are going on a Zip Line do not take the Canopy Tours, we found them to rush us and felt very unsafe. All and All it was a fabulous trip. If you have the chance to go you will be pleased.

reviews.author: Paul_D25
reviews.title: Beautiful, but service is terrible!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Reserve (newest and trendiest part of the hotel inagurated about 10 months ago). Expect a beautiful property with fantastic decor and ambiance. The quality of the food is also quite nice specially if you pay the higher scale all-inclusive packages that grant access to all restaurants and hotel areas, as well as the water sport activities (worthwhile for the relatively small difference). One drawback is the amount of seaweed from the ocean (plenty of it at least during October) that might bother some people, but didn't bother me. 

Service was quite variable and we had a couple of instances where service was awful (the type of things you don't want to experience in a good vacation). For a 5 star hotel service was overall bad. I would recommend instead the Paradisus in the Mayan Riviera (Mexico) if you are looking for the same but with a nicer beach and much better service.

reviews.author: SPAGIRL111
reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text:
A ripoff!
For what they charge we expected luxury-what we got was horrible service,terrible food,1/2 the restuarants areclosed, BED BUGS ALL OVER,the staff has no idea of what you want and could not care less.
I would suggest staying at Eden (NH) next door for less than 1/2 the price.!

reviews.author: travbud540
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, service doesn't match the facade
reviews.text:
I originally booked the trip through an RCI timeshare deal.  I am not a part of RCI nor do I pay fees to them, but I got a decent deal through them in the "Reserve" section of the hotel.  I traveled in September, which is the off session to avoid most of the crowds.  The hotel was extremely empty and from talking to the staff they were only at 15% occupancy.  Great for lounging at the pool and scheduling in dives (free daily dive per package - great perk!) and the remote relaxation that I needed.
That being said, you would think that issues would be handled in a quick manner since there were more staff then guests within the resort....Not so much.  I figured I would just list the things that I had issue with:
- power loss through out the trip (usually only for a short period of time)
- room seemed clean, but the mens underwear under my bed would suggest other wise (as I'm a girl and I brought no men back to my room....well you do the math)
- After a heavy evening shower the ceiling began to leak pooling up in the bathroom
- Addressed the leaky roof to our concierge and she stated she would get someone to look at it, no one ever came
- Checked back with the front desk concerning the leak 3 times, still no one came (thankfully there were no more rainy nights)
- Large amounts of sea weed in the beach area (I can live with this, it's nature)
- half of the restaurants were closed due to the low season
- they push the timeshare package
- At check out the desk was unable to void the $600 deposit I had placed, it toke over half an hour to figure things out.  They ended up charging 1 cent on my card to cancel the whole transaction.

I'm all about making the best of a trip, but I can see if someone had high expectations they might be disappointed.

reviews.author: IbizaNyc
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: perfect for couples, or people that just want to really relax and use spa services. Its quiet, all inclusive and has a fabulous beach with the best possible service from the staff.

reviews.author: BK11214
reviews.title: Cant wait till next year...
reviews.text: This is the 2nd time I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real. I stayed there 7/11/09-7/18/09 and had an amazing time.  We had absolutely no problem getting dinner reservations at any of the restaurants, but I guess if you are more than 10 people i guess it would be difficult to accomodate.  The resort is stunning, the people are friendly, the rooms are nice. I've had no issues with the resort at all and I can't wait to go back next year.  Victor at the pool bar is great, and a good singer too! We met so many people this year and everyone loved the resort as well.  Try to make your reservations in the morning for the next night and you should not have any issues.  If you have any questions please feel free to email me.

reviews.author: Tabatha C
reviews.title: "Paradise"
reviews.text: Me and my very good friend Carolyn had a wonderful time at the Paradise Palma Real. Great food, beautiful beach, and very nice people. Kick a$% club. I even learned a couple of new dance moves. The mall down the sidewalk is reasonable. Bought some bad shoes. Beds are comfortable. Jacuzzi tub and walk-in shower is dreamy!!!! This place is for all...best friends, girlfriends, couples, families.

reviews.author: tffCalgary
reviews.title: Exactly what we were looking for!!
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for 7 days in April 2009.  It was without a doubt the best trip we have ever taken.  I highly recommend the "Royal Service" as it made our stay that much more enjoyable.  We had no problem making reservations for dinner and we were able to eat breakfast and lunch in a couple restaurants instead of the buffet everyday.  Buffet food was good but the restaurants (7 in total) were fantastic.  The butler service (ours was Jose) that was part of our package was excellent, not to mention the bar and serving staff in the Royal Service area...Francisco, Galven and Pablo...amazing!  We spent our days by the pool or on the beach and our nights at the Monte Cristo (at the shopping mall on resort property but accessible to those off the resort as well).  The atmosphere was perfect.  Be prepared to bring a partner!  If you are lucky enough to find someone to dance with, as we did, great!  But the locals tend to come with a partner of some sort!  The music alone wasn't enough, you really have to dance!  We got exactly what we were looking for in the Paradisus, a girls week of relaxation and nightlife.  Beach was beautiful...white powder and very clean.  The shows the resort put on at night were excellent.  Completely different than the ones I've seen at resorts in Mexico, well worth seeing.  Fantastic experience.

reviews.author: dal01
reviews.title: Exceeded all expectations - would love to return
reviews.text:
After reading many of the views on Trip Advisor I did not want to build up my expectations too high for my holiday to the Paradisus Palma Real.  I expected poor service, problems at check in, with dinner reservations, average food, problems with the bathroom layout and no service at the pool or beach.  The good reviews on the hotel itself and the sumtuous surroundings convinced me to choose this hotel, but I kept my expectations capped, especially we did not book Royal Service.

Arrival / Check in

When arriving at the hotel we were greeted with a lovely cocktail and checked in without any issues at the main desk.  We had requested a Twin room as we were two friends travelling together, and they had allocated us a double room.  This was no problem to change and another room was made ready in 15 minutes.

In this time we were introduced to a member of the concierge who told us all about the hotel and made a reservation for us for dinner the following night.  It is true that you cannot book a restaurant for the first evening but this gave us chance to try the buffet which we only used this first night.

Room

The room was fantastic.  We booked the garden view room which was fine.  It overlooked the garden and had a view of the see but not a direct view.  It seems that the majority of the rooms overlook the garden and therefore I would go for a garden view room again in the future.  We had a top floor room (ie. starting with a 3) which was great as the ceiling height makes the room feel even larger.  The bathroom is open but with the shutters closed and a strategically placed towel we had no issues at all.  Remember we were 2 friends travelling together and not a couple and we found it fine.  The air conditioning does not go very cold but it was a very nice temperature when set to the lowest level.  The double jacuzzi bath and power shower were both excellent.  We also got a turn down service every night.  Some other reviews said this was hit and miss so perhaps we were just lucky.

Meals / restaurants

I found the food fantastic.  I ate Lobster 3 times during the stay at Passion restaurant twice and the market grill once.  We arranged the restaurants ourselves at the desk in reception and it took no more than 2-3 minutes each time.  You have to book a day in advance but it was very quick to do and you got a reservation slip.  Not once did we ever not get a booking and I would suggest if as other trallers have suggested the concierge made a fuss about getting these reservations for you or saying they are not available then just do it yourself it was really simple.  The restaurantes were better than the buffet for dinner in my opinion and would recomment them all.  The breakfast and lunch buffets were good and there was always something fresh to order if you took the time to wait for it to be cooked.  I always therefore had hot and fresh food so no complaints.  One lunch I had king tiger prawns freshly cooked to order steamed in white wine which were delicious.  In my view the food was way above the standard of normal all inclusive hotels.  

Drinks

These were one of the highlights of the holiday.  All premium drinks were serve in the bars.  My favourite is Aboslut Vodka and it was always available, along with cocktails, and very good wine on the all inclusive list.  Not a plastic cup to be seen the drinks were always served in very nice glasses.  We never felt the need to order a bottle of wine from the paid list.

Tipping

We read the reviews so expected to have to tip at every occassion but this was not the case.  Often the drinks had been serves and the staff would move onto the next person before getting a chance to tip.  Never once did I feel that the staff were lingering for tips quite the opposite.  We did tip but mainly in the evening for the drinks and for dinner but only a few dollars and it was much appreciated but never expected.

Beach

This was fantastic.  There was never a shortage of beds or towels.  You could just pick upt he towels by the Gabi Beach or from the club house which was great.  The beach has a lovely breeze which keeps you nice a cool and plenty of shade from from the sun if needed.

Royal Service

For the question of royal service many people have said that this is a must but in my opinion it is an option but not required to have a great holiday.  We preferred as mentioned to book our own restuarants, but we did have a concierge assigned who would have done this for us even though we were not a royal service.  The reserving of the beds we did not need as there were plenty to choose from that you did not have to reserve.  The Royal Service pool was fairly small and I preferred the larger pool and the beach.  The only things we could not use was the Royal Service lounge which had internet access free but we did not want to use it so was not an issue, and the GABI Beach restaurant.  You can use the bar and the beach but not the restuarant  There were many other restaurantes (too many for a 1 week stay) so this was also not a problem.  If I was to be lucky enough to return to the Palma Real I would have not hessitation in booking a standard garden view suite with no royal service.

Free activities

I can really recommend the horse back riding which was fantastic, and also the catamaran which was a real trhill to be able to try.  Both were free and no request for any money was made.

Other trips.

One of the trips I can highly recommend is the hiring of a speed boat.  You get to drive your own boat to along the coast and stop at a site in the middle of the ocean with a shallow reef and feed the fish and snorkel, and then drive back.  It cost us $80 for 2 people for 2 hours and was well worth the money.

Summary

The hotel was fantastic the architecture and design was jaw dropping, the service was always great the food was unbelievable and whole holiday was a joy from start to finish.

reviews.author: Shareen18
reviews.title: Hammer Hotel
reviews.text:
Ich war mit meinem Cousin und seinen Eltern über Weihnachten da.
Es ist der absolute Hammer! Wenn ich im Lotto gewinne gehe ich nochmals dahin :P
Der einzige Nachteil war, ich war noch nicht 18 ( wäre es 2 wochen später geworden), durfte kein alkohol und konnte nicht in den internen "club", musste aber den selben Preis zahlen wie mein Onkel und meine Tante. Trotzdem ein: WOW!
Ich empfehle es für ein Paar, es ist herrlich romantisch. Bestes Hotel welches ich je war!  sauber, top lage, zimmer sind ein Traum, Service geht nicht besser, Preis: Man gönnt sich ja sonst nichts ;)

reviews.author: sarah987
reviews.title: beautiful, but unhappy staff and subpar food
reviews.text: the resort is stunning - incredible landscaping, great beaches, and lots of thought given to the rooms etc. however most staff you meet seem to just hate their jobs. few smile, most clealry don' want to be there, and with a few sentences they'll all start openly complaning about the resort. the food is decent in the reservation-requred restaurants ( system designed to be a touch cumbersome to prevent people from flocking there) and if you haven't thought through what you want to eat and when and planned it for the day it's not at all easy to just grab a sandwich somewhere, grab a coke, etc.

reviews.author: sandy039
reviews.title: Awesome Resort 1st class everything!!
reviews.text: I just returned from a 3 night getaway to the Paraidsus Palma Real. My 2 girlfriends and I went to celebrate a big..birthday! Check-in was a little slow, ok slow.. but the gal was so friendly and accomodated us with a hopitality suite. Our room was not ready until 5pm, but it didn't bohter us because we hd use of the resort facilites and laid by the pool and drank and ate. I thought the food was great. I have been to other All inclusives and hated the food. I felt like this was sooo.. much better. The resort decor had my friends and I blown away. Whomever did  the design, was all over it!! The furniture and design in the restaurants and  lounges was mezmerizing. Many of the guests were Europeon, with money and fabulous chothes.. .great for people watching! We did not get the royal serivce, we didn't need it. The pool area where we spent most days because it was unusually windy during our stay was beautiful. We made sure to get up early and put our towels on these neat "tiki beds" that were designed for reading and napping, out of the sun. The nightlife was pretty good. They had a show with live entertainment each night in the atruim area. The night club (DJ) got going after we got a group to join us there. The bell man will give you a "chariot" (golf cart) ride to 2 local night clubs which are on the front side of the property. My one friend used the spa and loved it. I used the gym, it was small but, decent equipment. The service of the staff was fabulous. I have been to Cancun and Jamaica and felt like the staff were not nearly as accomodating as the Domincans. Even though All inclusive, we did tip certain service staff. We enjoyed taking care of them. I would rate this one of the best resorts over-all for the value. I usually stay at Hyatt/ Marriott resorts. I will go back with my husband and or friends.

reviews.author: NY914
reviews.title: People like to complain...this place is really great
reviews.text:
This hotel was great.  All the complainers are probably people that are never happy.  The only real complaint I have with this hotel is the bathroom situation.  There is a hole in the wall between the room and the bathroom and while there are wooden shutters there are open slats on each side of the the shutters that lets you see right in.  Also, the toilet and shower doors are see through as well.  Not good for privacy AT ALL.  Other than that the hotel is gorgeous.  The beach is beautiful and well maintained - the pool is the same.  We did royal service and our butler "Francis" was amazing.  He was constantly checking in and doing great things for us throughout our trip.  The food was good at all of the restaurants except the Gabi Beach.  I had the best cappucino of my life in Vento. The Spa was also great - and very well priced.  The only issue with the spa is that the changing area is very small.  Every person we encountered was wonderful and helpful at this resort.  Although beware - don't go on the "free shopping trip" unless you want to kill an hour at a cigar factory!   
The Royal Service lounge was great because we were able to get free internet access and a nice air conditioned lounge - though it was quiet far away from our rooms.  Also, the royal service pool was small and if you didn't get there first thing in the morning you did not get a seat.

reviews.author: Kathryn B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, but the food....
reviews.text:
Let me begin by saying this resort is absolutely gorgeous! The grounds, rooms, pools, beaches and restaurants are among the most beautiful I have ever seen. The staff are all very friendly and they do their best to make sure you have a good visit. That being said, if you are thinking about upgrading to the Royal Service, you might want to rethink it and save your money for the casino. Our "butler" was very nice, but clearly not cut out for this type of work. Our dinner reservations were almost always wrong, he rarely checked on us to see if we needed anything, often acted a bit put out by the simplest request and some request were never even acknowledged. The "Royal Service" pool area was nice, but if you don't get out there by 7:30 in the morning, you're not getting a chair. And good luck getting a palapa bed in that area. On the plus side, they did offer a nice lounge for royal service customers that provide free internet access, nice cocktails, gameboards and appetizers away from the crowds.  
The food, oh where to begin? I am no expert on gourmet food, but when the buffet food surpasses that of the upscale restaurants on site there's a problem. The steak was very odd tasting, the seafood almost always overcooked and many dishes were tepid at best when they arrived at the table. Passion- highly overrated. Vento- excellent breakfasts and the best of all the places for dinner. We did enjoy the Market Grill and as stated, the buffet for breakfast and lunch was quite good.

reviews.author: chickiewv
reviews.title: LOVED IT!!!! Hope to return!
reviews.text:
My best friend and I spent four days at the Paradisus Palma Real for our annual fall Chick Trip, and it was wonderful. I read some negative reviews before we left, and we heard a guy next to us a the lunch buffet complaining. But I can honestly say that if you're not happy here, you're not happy anywhere! 

I'll break my impressions down by category.

FOOD:

 This was our first all-inclusive experience, and we chose it carefully. If every meal is going to be consumed on the same site, you'd better be certain it's good food. And it is. 

For breakfast and lunch, there is a massive buffet that changes daily. I was frankly astonished by the volume and variety of food we found, and how fresh it was. For breakfast, we had delicious made-to-order omelettes, self-serve Eggs Benedict and anything else you can imagine. For lunch, we had a fantastic assortment of ceviches, awesome tuna and seafood salads and a dizzying array of well chosen dishes to choose from. If you could not find something you liked on these buffets, then you should just stay home because no one can satisfy you.

In addition to the buffets, there is an all day "snack bar" that was unbelievably good. You can get chicken and fish shish kabobs, churrasco steaks, tacos, guacamole and chips, or just plain old burgers and fries, hot dogs and pasta. Whatever you want, you can get there, at any time.

Then there are the dinnertime restaurants. Vento, the Mediterranean restaurant, was wonderful, with the most charming, accommodating staff, while we just fell in love with the sushi restaurant. Both were out of this world. We also dined at the slightly stuffier Passion (although we are not a couple, LOL) and found it to be our least favorite, though still perfectly great in terms of the quality of food. 

SPA:

  We had massages at the spa, which were lovely. My masseuse worked on an aching shoulder with delicacy that I did not believe would relieve my discomfort. To my sheer amazement, she turned out to be a miracle worker. The pain was gone, without the deep-tissue work that so many therapists use. 

  We also spent time in the water center, which is simply FABULOUS. There are several jacuzzis, a cold plunge pool and a variety of huge faucet- or shower-head type devices that pummel your neck and shoulders with water in an unbelievably awesome way. I could have stayed there for hours!!

GROUNDS:

  The property is absolutely gorgeous, literally breathtaking from the moment your van pulls up to the entrance. You can see down through the vast foyer to the courtyards and to the turquoise ocean beyond. Simply beautiful. Then you walk into a huge, well furnished lobby with oversized furniture for lounging and even a lobby bar. You're greeted at the front desk by incredibly friendly staff, and a concierge offers you a drink while you check in. It's just lovely from the moment you arrive. You are treated like royalty.

 Our jacuzzi suite room faced onto a sprawling, remarkably quiet courtyard where spa-like music flowed from speakers that looked like rocks. From the rooms and the balconies, there was no noise whatsoever. No screaming pool parties, no loud music, nothing. It was blissfully peaceful. Exactly what we needed.

Throughout the property are gorgeous pieces of oversized furniture, mirrors, sculpture and other artwork, and tons of outdoor seating that is used mainly in the evening.

SERVICE

 We did not opt for the Royal Service, and we honestly don't feel as if we missed a thing. From the front desk person down to the maintenance staff, every single person we encountered was unfailingly friendly and helpful, always equipped with a smile and a polite word. The restaurant staffs were prompt and caring and warm. The pool bar and beach staff were attentive and friendly and charming. 

The property was only 65 percent full when we visited, so I'm sure they are more taxed when there are more people, but we were universally impressed by the service.

 We were disappointed to see how few of our well-heeled fellow travelers tipped. We stocked up on $1 and $5 and $10 bills before we left and left the $1s just about everywhere we went, even for the waiters who refilled our glasses at the buffet. At the pool bar, we'd tip our bartender $5 in the morning and we were looked after all day. We'd leave smaller tips as the day went on, but even $1 was enough to elicit a smile and a gracias. For dinner, where we got more extensive service, we left $10s. Every single time, our staff seemed grateful and gracious.

ACTIVITIES 

The only thing that was a minor (very minor) disappoinment was the "party boat" tour we took, which is free on Mondays. It simply cruised very slowly along the shoreline for maybe a few miles, then stopped at a shallow swimming spot, then brought us back. Our "party" was a group of about 20 people and it was definitely no party. LOL. It was a definite snoozer, but nothing to complain about.. I just wouldn't waste my time or money on it, if I were you.

We were only there for a few days, so we did not do any other excursions. But if we go back, we definitely will.

SHOPPING

Do NOT bother going to the shopping plaza just down the beach from the hotel. You have to barter for everything, and the prices they want are FAR higher than what you pay even in the hotel gift shop. As we were leaving, we even saw things in the airport that were cheaper than what those guys wanted. It's a tourist trap for rich folks.

CONCLUSION:

We loved that this place catered to adults and was not crawling with kids. We loved that the pool was a peaceful place to be, not a huge party thumping with music and teeming with "posers." It was just what we wanted: lovely, relaxing, indulgent and peaceful. We didn't pay for the Royal Service, and we didn't need to: We were treated like royalty anyway.

We had a wonderful time and are thinking we'll return with a third friend for another Chick Trip.

reviews.author: Krissy7159
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!  Don't Listen To The Bad Reviews!
reviews.text: The Palma Real is the best resort you could stay at in Punta Cana.  My best friend and I just returned last night and we had an amazing time.  This resort is 5 star as well as the staff.  The food was good, the staff spoke great English, the weather was perfect, the resort wasn't crowded, and there was always something to do at the resort.  I can't believe that anyone would ever complain about this resort.  I have been all over and have stayed at dozens of all inclusive resorts and this one is by far at the top of my list.  I would go back in a heartbeat.  Don't listen to the bad reviews on this resort.  If you don't love it, there is something wrong with you!  I would recommend the Paradisus to anyone!

reviews.author: fernando50
reviews.title: Horrible, extremely overated
reviews.text: So, i just came back from the palma de crap. i have stayed in the other paradisus in punta cana and it by far exceeds the palma real. this was by far absolutely the worst the hotel that i have stayed in. so not worth the 400 a night, especially when the hotel was only 26% occuppied. They lacked simple things like black label. what kind of 5 star resport does not have black label, and charges for absolute vodka. this place was extemely overated.

reviews.author: Fro_Thrill_40_PRJay
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text: Six thirtysomethings (4 male, 2 female) from New York stayed here for a long golf weekend.  We had a wonderful time.  Royal Service plan is a must.  Royal Service has adults only pool, butler service, and beds on the beach.  Minor disappointment was having to hunt down butler or butler not answereing the provided cellular phone.  However, they get you whatever you want.  Food is the best on the island.  Gabi Beach and Passion had the best dinners for us.  Excursions leave right from property.  Try the party boat.  Golf and shopping mall at very front of property...a short bell boy chauffeured golf cart ride down the road.  Pools and bars are amazing.  Quiet reort with little or no nightlife...we made our own.  Staff is VERY friendly if you are not an obnoxious stuck up traveler...try out your Spanish, it's fun!  Both family friendly and romantic at same time.  Amazing place and we will return, maybe for a wedding!

reviews.author: nc89wolf
reviews.title: VERY NICE ALL INCLUSIVE
reviews.text: If you like all inclusive this place is awesome.  I have been to many all inclusives only to find that they do a great job of making it difficult to eat or drink, epecially liquor or beer, but not here.  We went with 6 other couples and had a wonederful time.  We were able to drink top shelf liquors and had a choice of beers like the local "presidente", Corona or Budweiser.  I personally was glad to see a Bud.  The rooms are big with a great bathroom and shower along with a hot tub.  Balconies have ocean view and the bed is very comfortable.  The food it adequate and what I would expect from an all inculsive.  The buffet has great choice for breakfast and lunch.  The pool is awesome with a great swim up bar.  Plenty of chairs and space to lounge.  The beach was well maintained and had plenty of shady spaces for when the sun was too much.  I would not recommend this resort for families with young children, although I did see them there, as there is not much for them to do.  No slides, activities etc,  The staff was generally friendly and willing however there can be a language barrier with most of them.

reviews.author: BUZA
reviews.title: No está a nivel de su categoría
reviews.text:
Estuvimos alojados 1 semana en el mes de julio, tenia mucho interés por conocer este hotel, ya que, en otras visitas a Pta. Cana había visto como lo construían.
Efectivamente las instalaciones son estupendas, pero el resto deja mucho que desear para la categoría de hotel que tiene, y como lo venden indicando es uno de los mejores hoteles del Caribe. Puedo asegurar, que conozco bien el Caribe, y para nada es un buen hotel. Empezando porque parece un mercado, cada 100 mts. tienes o una mesa con un comercial o te asaltan a lo largo del hotel, para venderte una especie de multipropiedad. Yo creo que este tipo de servicios deberían hacerlo de una manera discreta, y con elegancia. En cuanto a la comida se refiere, creo que esta enfocada al turismo América, mucho frito, hamburguesas, pizzas, costaba trabajo comer algo de calidad. Y ni que decir tiene el servicio, aquí si me quede alucinada, teniendo en cuenta el buen carácter Dominicano, creo que han contratado a los mas resabiados de la Isla, contestando con desgana y si comprobaban que no eras turista Americano con sus propinas, no te hacían mucho caso. Durante mi estancia de tan solo 1 semana, ha sido constante el comprobar el mal servicio, y a excepción de 2 camareros y el cheff del rte. Asiático, un desastre.
Por mi parte, no volveré a este hotel, habiendo como hay magníficos hoteles en el Caribe, y recomendaría al Dpto. de Auditoria de esta gran cadena hotelera hicieran una visita sorpresa y comprobaran lo escrito.

reviews.author: frankCastellon
reviews.title: YO SOY UN ASIDUO DEL HOTEL
reviews.text:
Que voy a decir de un hotel que en un año y medio lo he visitado 9 veces y el proximo dia 5 de agosto va a ser la decima.
Os lo podeis imaginar, excelente pero siempre en servicio real, con Pedro, amed, galven, francisco, victor, santos Karyn y unque no este para mi gran amiga Helena, t seguro que alguno me dejare y le pido perdon, animaros para estar alli con toda esta familia es impresionante, fabulosa y para descansar de verdad.
Eso si, como cliente me quejo a la dirección por los constantes cambios de personal que tiene el hotel, desde mi profundo pesar le digo " NO" eso no es bueno, ya que el cliente cuando tiene confianza con el personal se encuentra en sus repetición que ya no esta. Eso señores de la dirección crea desconfianza y no te hace estar como en casa.
Mantenga el personal mas tiempo a ser posible no cambie tan a menudo.
Saludos a todos 
FRANCISCO MOLINER Y FAMILIA

reviews.author: kikiheff
reviews.title: Beautiful but not secure
reviews.text:
The property is by far one of the most beautiful I have seen. The pool is amazing. However, the hotel "misplaced" one of our bags (between the bell stand and our room) The bag conrtained electronics and the hotel took no action, and as of yet has made no restution. We spent a portion of our stay at the police station. 

In addition, another member of our group spent a couple of nights at the local hospital with food posioning. You can never pinpoint where that happened, however it is all inclusive and we ate all meals there.

Lastly, it doesn't live up the the "all inclusive" title. It is only every resturant if you upgrade to family concierge.

So, I think you can find other properties with the scenery and better amenities, support and security.

reviews.author: BaltimoreValerie
reviews.title: Girls getaway
reviews.text: This was a girls getaway. We were overwhelmed by the beauty of the hotel - the architecture of the building was stunning, the gardens were spectacular, the pool was impeccably maintained, and the beaches were clean and full of lounge chairs under large huts. The other plus is that they had live entertainment every night. Our room was very lovely, but it did have a mild smell of mildew (I see other travellers here noted that odor as well).  The food was good, not great. We did not enjoy having to make reservations so far in advance to secure a reasonable dinner time. The staff were very nice, but there was definitely a language barrier. Not many of them spoke fluent English. I appreciated having Security walking around in view, but not in your face.  Getting there was an easy flight from the East Coast and the airport at Punta Cana was fabulous - very easy to get in and out of, plus it was really beautiful. I would recommend this place.

reviews.author: kittymommy
reviews.title: Paradise is a Short Flight Away
reviews.text:
Just came back from the annual Girl Friends Getaway.  We stayed for a long weekend (July 10-13).  I can't say enough about this place.    The beauty, the staff, the atmosphere.  It was wonderful.  From the time we arrived we were treated like royalty.  It helped that the resort was only about half full.  We tried 2 of the restaurants and were pleased, but not blown away.  But the regular breakfast, lunch and dinner buffet was fantastic.  If you couldn't find something here, you must be starving yourself.  The beach was lovely with the palapas dotted around.  We found one that we came back to again and again.  It felt like there was an air conditioner under it the sea breeze was soooo wonderful.  The pool is very very large and there was room for everyone.  There are so many activities that are free you can't possibly get bored.  From the wine tasting to the casino, every minute you could find something to do until you passed out from exhaustion.  I must also say that it was one of the best beds I've slept on outside of my own home in quite a while.  

I've read different reviews of how the staff is not that friendly, well we did encounter some that were sort of "indifferent" but never rude.  I never felt uncomfortable.  

The Girls and I are definately looking into coming back here next year and I'm trying to talk my husband into making this our winter getaway in February.  We were looking at Cabo but might just come back here.

reviews.author: lvnlite
reviews.title: I wasn't in-love
reviews.text:
Let me first begin by saying that I had a good time at the Paridisus Palma Real. The beach was radiant and the pools were fabulous. But I thought I should share with others my experiences with at the resort. We (My husband and I with our 13 month old along with another couple with their also 13 month old) choose this resort because it was beautiful, and the amenities where what we wanted. Since we were traveling with two babies, we opted for the “Family Concierge” service at an extra cost. This service was convenient as they give you a walkie-talkie upon you arrival. You can use this from anywhere on the property to get in touch with your concierge. He/she is available to reserve pool/beach cabanas and lounge chairs (not that was necessary to do so – it was very slow), make dinner reservations, spa reservations, and other reasonable accommodations that you might request. Having this service with two babies was helpful, we just laid out at the beach/pool, call her and she would appear. She also kept us informed about resort activities. 

However, I was not so impressed with the family concierge service or the resort itself during my fist 48 hour stay. First, they gave us a room that smelled disgustingly of mildew. At our first inquiry about the smell we were told that because it was raining outside, we would incur the moldy smell. With a 13 month old this was immediately a concern for me. When we asked if we could see another room, we were told that we were in the best building and that it is genuinely only stinky because of the rain. “It should go away.” After the 3rd day and still that wet, mildew smell, we asked again if we could “see” another room and the new room had no smell what so ever. I immediately felt lied to. We proceeded to change rooms after having to endure that smell for three days. 

Also upon our arrival, we were starving after traveling there. We ordered room service at 4:30 PM. We didn’t actually eat it until 9:30 PM. Yes. 5 hours later. We contacted room service several times to check on our food and were apologized to and said that it is delayed because of the rain. However, after more calls we found out that our order was lost and we had to re-place it. This was at 8:30 PM. At this point we were extremely upset. We were in a stinky, cold, and wet room with no food. For a second I thought I had gone to jail! I was paying a not so cheap price to be treated like a prisoner. Oh, and there were ants everywhere, even in bed. Tip: I also took a mosquito net for the baby’s crib (totsinmind.com) I was bitten 6 times he wasn’t. 

Generally speaking, the food was not that great to me. I was expecting more of a DR flair to the cuisine. Instead I got a mix of Mexican, American, Asian & Italian fare. The restaurants were all very nice but to me, the food was just okay. I kept calling the restaurants “the beautiful lead in to the big let down.” My favorite place to eat was Naos, the buffet. The selections were huge. 

I’m torn as to whether or not I would recommend this place to others because all-in-all it was a good vacation, the grounds were beautiful and relaxing. But I do think that it is over priced considering that I had to sleep with the ants.

reviews.author: SoaringEagle007
reviews.title: Perfecto girlfriend getaway in Paradise!
reviews.text:
My girlfriend getaway just ended and I miss the Dominican Republic already!

I highly, highly, highly recommend the Royal Service option when staying at this resort. You definitely feel pampered the entire time. The resort is breathtaking! The white sand beaches, aqua waters and palm cabanas are a perfect retreat.  The service was wonderful.  The Dominicans realize that they need to keep you happy!!

This is a perfect girlfriend getaway if you are looking to relax and have fun at the same time. It is definitely an adult resort ,although many people traveled with children. I will definitely consider this place for a honeymoon spot because the royal service gives you access to so much, including a private beach. There are many, many  honeymoon oriented events as well.

The only disappointing aspect was the food. The restaurants hardly served authentic Latino food! The food was average at best. But, then again, if  food is #1 on your 'things to do list', you will miss the point of traveling to such a wonderful and exotic place.

I'm planning my next trip already. It gets a 10 overall in my book.

reviews.author: arodri70
reviews.title: Any Doubts....Please Read
reviews.text:
My wife and another couple stayed at the Paradisus for 8 nights in mid May.  I have to admit that after reading several reviews leading up to the trip I was a bit nervous.  With complaints such as terrible check in, unfriendly staff, awful food and a tough language barrier we were both apprehensive.  Well, we loved every second of our trip.  Check in was a breeze and the couple that we were with their room was not ready so we simply had a few drinks at the lobby bar.  The staff was very friendly especially Johan our conciere.  As per the language barrier, to put it bluntly....you are in another country and they speak spanish just like we speak english in the US!  With a little patience we were never unable to get our point across, just be respectful and they will do they will do the same.

The white beach was beautiful and we never felt crowded for such a big resort.  The pool was wonderful and the swim up bar was a great touch.  The grounds were kept like a golf course and the beach was clean.  There was always some sort of activity going on like painting classes, volley ball or dance lessons.  We did not do any of them becasue we opted to relax for our stay but it was a nice thing to have aroung you.  

The casino was small but fun and it was never crowded.  As per the food it was not spectacular but it was good enough especially for an all inclusive.  Vento, Bana Tepanyaki (hibatchi) and the romantic dinner on the beach (well worth the $$) provided us with the best meals of the trip.  The buffet was good for breakfast but not so much for the other 2 meals of the day.  I recommend the Market Grill for lunch.  If you are looking for gourmet I would not stay at an all inclusive, but the food was good here.  The spa was very professional and the couples massage was great.

Overall, it was a great experience and I would reccommend this resort to young couples.  We had a great time and never wanted to leave.

reviews.author: daiz222
reviews.title: Nothing But Problems
reviews.text: My husband and I went with another couple in June 07. We had nothing but problems since the day we arrived. Our rooms were not ready when we got there. They tried to give us a room with double beds and offered to "push them together". Anyone who has ever slept like that knows how uncomfortable that is. With the amount of money we were paying for this trip it was totally unacceptable. They tried to tell us that they do not guarantee king beds. Ha! After endless fighting with management we got a room with a king bed. We opted for the royal service...what a SCAM! The "personal butler" that you are supposed to be assigned is NEVER around and your lucky if you get something that you request 2 days later! It was such a waste of money since all the things that he supposedly could provide are easier to get yourself! We travel to Mexico quite a bit and this was our first time in the DR. We found it highly lacking as far as service and hospitality goes. Most of the staff barely speaks English (or maybe they pretend not to when you have a request or complaint!) We are reasonable people, we just expect a certain calibur of service when paying so much for it. We tried to go parasailing and had to wait an hour on a boat for them to come and refuel. Then, after three days, they had us checking out even though we were booked for five days! I showed them the confirmation given to us by the travel agent but they still tried to get us to change rooms! The whole resort is very poorly run and very disorganized. The restaurants were above average... I have to give it that. We also loved Neftale, an amazing bartender. The casino was a good place to go at night since there is absolutely nothing else to do. It just seemed like everyone else that we met at the resort was from NY or NJ. I love my hometown but I went to the DR to get away from it for a week. The pool was overrun by loud drunk brooklynites during the day which is why we opted to stay in the private pool area most of the time that only Royal Service guests had access to. Next time we will just go back to Mexico where the service is outstanding and they aim to please.

reviews.author: jrjazzAtlanta
reviews.title: Fantastic ... wedding and relaxation
reviews.text:
All I can say is that everything was excellent.  Staff, food, grounds, entertainment.  It was all so wonderful we truly hated to leave.  I wish I could truly put into words how wonderful an experience it was but, I am at a loss because it was so nice.

We will willmost definitely return!!!!!

reviews.author: MOP19
reviews.title: A Very Nice Resort!!!
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful hotel with great service. I read many of the  negative reviews  here on trip advisor prior to my trip and was definitely nervous about what to expect, so I was happily surprised with just about everything. I did experience a disruptive hiccup with check in, which resulted in the need to switch rooms after getting very upset with the front desk... but once that was resolved (< 1 hr) everything from that point forward was great. 

The food is very good... especially for an all inclusive resort which I do not normally prefer due to poor food quality. The offerings are plentiful- something for everyone and everything was very good quality and very fresh. For peopl who drink, top shelf liquor and beer is offered and there are numerous bars positioned around the property. There is even a coffee bar. 

The beach is spectacular, and even though we were there during a busy time (presidents wk) there was someone always around bringing drinks to the people on the beach. There were plenty of lounge chairs , towels, etc

The room was lovely, spacious and every room has a large jacuzzi tub, a nice added touch. Housekeeping did a perfectly fine job.

The service was great from top to bottom... the locals are all very friendly.
All in all, I would recommend this hotel , it is however for families and couples primarily, it is not a party scene for singles.

reviews.author: jamesr1165
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: We just got back from a 5 day stay here and I wanted to let my thoughts be known. Although some other reviews had some legitimate complaints about the check-in, check-out process at the Paradisus, which was a little slow, I give this place two thumbs up. It was an absolutely beautiful property which they kept unbelievably clean. The food was outstanding as well. The service was great in just about every category and I would not hesitate to return.I recommend it to anyone!

reviews.author: friendNewYork
reviews.title: hated it
reviews.text:
I can in all honesty tell people do not expect 5 star service! In our case the resort was overbooked and we were expected to take a room a distance from all activity and the management made no effort to help. After much ado they found us a new room the next  day. We were only asking for what we paid for! The restaurants are difficult to get into...you spend each morning trying to make reservations.  The facilities and activities they advertise are great......but only for the few that manage to get reservations. You need to make each morning a race to get a shade hut on the beach. We gave up trying to use room service.....even for ice we needed to get a cleaning lady to help us.
If you are a royal service guest it may be different, but friends we we were with also had difficulties with service. If you go as a regal suite guest, do not expect much. It is quite a shame because the resort is quite beautiful, but not worth the hassle.

reviews.author: luv2eat29
reviews.title: Asi Asi
reviews.text: Hi All!  Paradisus Palma Real is amazingly stunning when you first arrive!  it was picture perfect!  Check in was a breeze for me, although it wasn't as easy for other members of my traveling crew!  Some of their rooms weren't ready, and some of the front desk receptionist were not on the ball.  My friend had been helped first, but by the time I was already on my way to my room, she was still standing there without any answers and a room, just  a finger ttelling her to hold on.  I later found out that the front desk person she dealt with was new.  I believe for a four diamond resort everyone should be trained before they get thrown onto the floor.  I was happy though, the girl that checked us in upgraded us to a room in "family concierge."  I felt really lucky and was psyched!  We had help getting to our room from Willyn, a bellhop, who by the way was such a pleasure.  He filled us in on all of the do's and don'ts, like do not brush yoru teeth with the water, etc.  If you ever have the pleasure of meeting him, it is in your best interest to take care of him ;)  He'll make everything so much easier.  Our room was o.k.  It was a little musty and damp, which, what can you expect down there.  It is hot and humid.  I don't think there is anyway of controlling that.  I did however find our room to be a bit narrow but,  it was something that wasn't worth bringing up.  I mean, we did get an "upgrade."  Willyn made me aware not to be afraid to order things to the room, like a bottle of vodka for my mini bar.  It comes stocked with a few cans of pepsi, pesi light, oj, water and presidente.  It took me 30 seconds to order a bottle of vodka and a case of corona.  Press 0 on your phone and order through the mini bar service, not room service.  I was told by a friend that if you order liquor through the room service you will be charged.  But don't be afraid to order food from them.  It isn't very good, but at 2 in the morning, tastes just fine!  The grounds were beautiful.  The resort was very well maintained, which I learned the hard way every morning at 7am!  The "upgraded" room ended up being right on a rd., and abutting a stair well, and surrounded by tons of grass that the groundskeepers were really good at maintaining daily at 7am.  They were oblivious to the fact that I had just strolled in at 4am from a wild night at the casino.  So sleep was definitley hard to come by.  I didn't want to complain, but then by the third day, my entry way to my room was filled with painters, their chatter, and the non stop buzzing of the weed wacker was echoing through my room.  I easily could have pulled my hair out.  I was there for a wedding, my best friends wedding, so I steered clear of switching rooms until after it was over.  The wedding was absolutely amazing, she was gorgeous, it was the most beautiful wedding I've ever been a part of.  The wedding planner Kelly, is amazing, and really know's her stuff.  My best friend got married in the garden instead of on the beach, which I happen to think was better.  Everyday we were there, there was a wedding on the beach, and it was sooooo windy!  The one thing I would double check on if you are getting married there is if you have guests staying at other hotels, to somehow have Kelly, the wedding coordinator stay ontop of the front desk regarding bracelets for the resort.  There was mass chaos regarding guests from other resorts coming in, and even though the wedding planner did her job and had a print out of who was coming, it still took 4 front desk attendants to figure things out, and your guest will be sitting there for at leat 30 minutes to get the bracelet.  It is really aggravating and is something that can be avoided.  I finally was able to switch rooms but, just my luck, they switched me to the exact same room but on the other side of the grass.  Ummm, did I not make myself clear?  I can't sleep!!!!  Finally, Willyn showed up and I told him the problem, and he got our room swtiched over, downgraded, but much better and not as chlosterphobic feeling.  Not to mention it was much closer to the lobby.  The other room 2221 was off in another world, don't stay there.  Let's see, what else, the food was mediocre.  The best restaurant was Bana, the tepanyaki side.  It was a lot of fun and the food was being cooked in front of you.  I went there for my birthday and again another night because we forgot to make reservations for the other places.  All of the restaurants had great ambiance.  We ate at Bana the second night we were there but, on the otherside which was more prepared asian cusine.  That was yummy, however we were there for the rehersal dinner so we might have had a different menu.  Vento was the next best restaurant, really nice, but again I'd have to say the food was mediocre.  I love to eat and I definitley was underwhelmed by the dishes.  We went to Passion another night which is the adult only restaurant.  The portions are shockingly small.  The food was o.k., no where near being great, except for the soup that came in a shot glass.  I ended up going to the buffet (NAOS) afterwards and filling up on yummies there.  I'd have to say we ate at the buffet more then any other place.  It offered a great variety.  At least I was able to pick and choose a few different things.  I'm pretty sure I gained 10lbs from that buffet.  I didn't even fit into my wedding dress!  Woops.  Note to self, stay away from the almond cookies!!!  I would recommend on Mondays not making a reservation for any restaurant because they have a fun Dominican festival in the courtyard with a huge buffet set up.  It has even more food then the NAOS buffet and even has goat, if you are adventurous enough to try it.  There also is this little buffet area called Market grill that is open for you when the other eating facilities are closed.  It is especially fun to go at 3 in the morning when the Casino closes.  O.K.  Casino time.  I'd have to say, I had a great time there.  They have black jack, texas hold'em, roulette, three card poker, and carribean poker.  Just keep your eyes on the dealer payouts because they tend to make mistakes.  Stay away from Alba, my boyfriend calls her the General.  You are guaranteed to lose your money when she deals.  The cooler!!!  Failsto, on the other hand was the best dealer and was super friendly.  The beach was nice, however, I was a little hesitant to go swimming because of the murkey water.  I watch a lot of discovery channel and they say never to swim in murkey water because sharks like it.  Speaking of Sharks, we went snorkling with the nurse sharks, but almost all of our crew of 17 failed to see the one shark in the man made jail house in the middle of the ocean.  It was very disturbing to take a boat out into the middle of the ocean only to find a rusty fence barricading this poor shark in.  Its pretty ironic, this shark is in the middle of the beautiful sea, but he can't go anywhere because he is trapped in this cage.  I was under the impression we were going to a reef of some sort.  The water was really murkey and I couldn't see the damn shark!  I snapped a picture when someoen yelled out here is the shark,  but I only got the tip of its head.  Not worth the $$$$.  Overall I had a good time.  You can't complain too much when you are at a beautiful resort looking out at torquoise water.  I will say I ended up getting a little bored because it seemed as if everyday was the same thing.  I would take advantage of the activities they offer.  It'll help pass the time.  I went for 8 days.  I think that was way too long for an all inclusive place.  Thank goodness for the casino.  Would I go back?  Probably not, I think there are too many other destinations I would rather go to first.  I would recommend getting married there though.  I also think they need to tighten up on their service.  Btw, stay clear of the people trying to sell you vacation clubs.  You'll find yourself trapped becasue someone is being really nice to you, it'll seem like they are interested in you, but then they'll pull a sneak attack on you and somehow you'll be sitting through a presentation for the Sol Melia Vacation Club.  Stay away.  Maybe you should wear garlic around your neck.  They might stay away.  Have fun on your trip!  Feel free to contact me with any questions!

reviews.author: Naplesqueen
reviews.title: Some problems at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We just returned last night from a 7 day stay at this resort.  I want to write this review while things are fresh in my mind.  The resort itself is beautiful!  We found the food to be fair in all restaurants.  Passion was our least favorite and Market Grill our most enjoyable. The service overall was quite good in the areas that we came in contact with.  The staff for the most part was very friendly and accomodating but the language barrier created problems almost everywhere.  USE THE SAFE!  One of the couples travelling with us, who were in a hurry to go to dinner on the first evening, came back to find $500 in cash gone.  The first clue should have been when their key card didn't work!  They got absolutely no satisfaction from management even after several meetings.  They could have at least tried to appease them by offerring a spa comp.  But, nothing.

Most guests were chair hogs at the pool by getting there very  early and putting their things on a chair to reserve it until they were ready to go back.....whenever that might be.  The service at the Pool Bar was excellent.  

The drinks are very good ( top shelf liquor ) and they don't skimp.  The bartenders at the lobby bar were great and very entertaining.

Room service is a joke!  They only offer one type of breakfast....continental.  Expect to wait forever to get it even if you order it the night before.  Your mini fridge is stocked one day and not stocked the next.

The Buffet was ok for breakfast and lunch.  We never tried it for dinner but friends did and said it was good.

I'm sure those who have reviewed this resort who had the Royal Service had a different experience with getting dinner reservations but for most of us who had the regular accomodations it was often difficult. 

When they tell you to get to the airport 3 hours early, they aren't kidding.  What a fiasco to leave the country.

The casino is not big at all and I wonder about some of the people working there.  They try to steer you to slot machines that are going to hit........they didn't!

Overall, we found the resort to be beautiful and the staff eager to please.  We had mini aggravations every day but got used to them.  We only left the resort to play golf and to walk down the beach to the local shops.  I wouldn't advise going to those shops.  They almost attack you to buy their goods.  It was most uncomfortable and scary. There are armed guards patrolling the perimeter of the property at night!  I guess that's a good thing but it doesn't make you feel really comfortable.

Would we go back?  Probably not.........................

reviews.author: LINative
reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text:
We just got back from a 4 night stay and although the place was beautiful and clean, I wouldn't recommend it to anyone!

The food was terrible and it was very difficult to get reservations. They tell you to book them at 6pm the night before, but at 6pm there are no reservations available until 9pm?  

We heard numerous complaints about the dealers at the casino were cheating.
 
There was NO customer service. The staff just did not care.

We had 4 rooms. Whether it was room service, maintenance or security that we called, it took them all at least 45 minutes to come.    

We all felt like we were being scammed every time we turned around. 

And yes, the bugs were biting like crazy!

reviews.author: Travelersx4
reviews.title: Book elsewhere
reviews.text:
The hotel is physically beautiful, but thats about it. 
The staff can use a lesson in customer  service. It is hard to communicate with the staff. They do not honer reservations, the room service is very slow. The FOOD is INEDIBLE. Activities for the hotel are very sparse, but you are constantly hounded by outside companies trying to sell you expensive extra activities..... sailing, para sailing, ATVs etc. We had a bad experience with an ATV breaking down and they didn't seem to care or refund our money back. 
Our next door neighbors got robbed in their room. They came back and found their key didn't work. When they finally got into their room, it was ransacked and $500 dollars was missing. All their belongings were thrown around.

While in a buffet line, part of the ceiling fell on my head and the staff could care less. No one even came over to see if I was alright. They cleaned up the mess and that was about it. 

My ID bracelet fell off and the front desk wanted to charge me $250 dollars to replace it. The manager wouldn't budge and was so rude. Security wouldn't let me into the pool even though there were 17 people in our group. It took another visit to the desk with my husband until they finally gave me another bracelet, which is a flimsy rope. 
We all got eaten alive by bugs.....go elsewhere not worth it !

reviews.author: simon_inf
reviews.title: ennuyeisement magnifique
reviews.text:
Un hotel magnifique avec des jardins epoustoufflant mais un divertissement abscent. Par contre, c'est tranquille il y avait de la place partout mais 7 jour qui peu devenir long.Pour ma part ca ma fait du bien de rien faire mais le resorte est relativement petit et la clientèle un peu vieille.
La nourriture est médiocre et a cause du service absent les réservation pour les restaurant à la carte sont difficile.
On y trouve un meilleur choix de vin qu'ailleur, enfin de meilleurs ``picket``
piscine et plage excellente mais très peu de vagues
Les chambres sont grandiosent le mini bar bien rempli.Pas de probleme de débarbouillette. Ecran plasma.Bain tourbillon pour 3-4- personnes..
Endroit par aileur très propre malgre une énorme bibitte morte dans la chambre la 2ième journée. Disons qu'il est possible d'avoir cette situation au québec.
Excurtion très couteuse et de type attrape touriste sauf celle de `james bonds`` ou pendant un pm on conduit des petit bateau a moteur pour aller faire de la plongé en apnée: snorking, sur une plateforme nourrir les poisson tropicaux entourer de corail mort.
Quand meme très beau.80$ us par pers.
Personnel très peu souriant et compétant. E ATTENTION au retour les doiniers de punta cana ne s'intéresse qu' à votre porte feuille même si vous avec un éléphant dans votre sac a dos ils ne veulent que vous voller.Nous et quelque autre voyager ce sont plaint a sunwing qui ne pouvait rien y faire mais qui nous a offert un voyage très bien avec un excellent service. Sauf pour le representant a destination qui était très difficile a rencontré s'excusant par papier nous disant que nous allons le voir qu'au 3ième jours.

reviews.author: neecyAtlantaga
reviews.title: We had a greaat time
reviews.text:
This was our first time to time to the Dominican Republic.  We traveled with another couple and had a great time.  We have traveled many islands and countries.  I would not say we are picky however we do like the finer things of life.  Two of us are golfers and the hotel advertised AI golf, we were able to play daily and take the hotel shuttle which always ran on time,  The golf  course Cocotal is lovely .  You have to pay 35.00 pp for the cart but we knew that up front.  We had a tee time at 7:00 am and took the 11:00am shuttle back to the resort.  We ordered room service for breakfast 3 days our order was correct and on time daily.

The property was clean our room was clean.  I did not like the seaweed at the beach but it is cleaned daily from the beach area.  I undersand the seaweed is there all the time.  

We used the watersports paddleboats, and took a catamaran sailing lesson.  You have to book the day prior if they are busy but had no problem getting to do what we wanted.  The spa is okay compared to world class spa areas it is not tops.  Again book ahead of time our appointment was on time and I had no complanits.  

We ate at all the reasturants Passion was our favorite and Market Grille was our least favorite.

The main trouble is the language barrier.  We speak  enough to be dangerous.  Most of the staff speak little or NO English.  You can ask for something and it becomes frustrating for both.  The property could use Customer training and Language assistance but we had the best time ever and would go back anytime

reviews.author: SEJ2
reviews.title: PPR Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text:
We just returned from a week vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real and were impressed with the property, the restaurants and almost all of the recreation options offered.  My husband and I traveled with another couple and by the end of the week we were already looking up where all of the other Paradisus properties in the world are to plan our next trip.

First, the property was absolutely beautiful.  We stayed in a Gardenview room and thought it was spacious and very comfortable.  A couple of times we left a note with special requests for minibar items and each time we received exactly what we wanted the next day.  One note, calling the front desk and making requests was not quite as successful for the couple we were traveling with.  

We tried almost all of the restaurants at the resort and LOVED Bana (Bistro) and Gabi Beach.  I agree with some other reviews saying Passion was overrated.  Overall, the food at the resort was good and there was a decent variety everywhere we went.

The amount of recreation options included with no additional cost was also a nice surprise.  My husband went SCUBA diving almost everyday and all equipment and dive trips were included.  There are also tennis lessons offered where you basically get one-on-one instruction from the on-site pro.  We all spent a lot of time at the pool.  The pool was enormous and never felt crowded.  One recommendation, there are no pool floats available (unless you purchase your own), it would definitely be worth it to pack a couple.
